verses.kjv_text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.nlt_text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness {was} upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.nlt_text: The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the deep waters. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

verses.kjv_text: And God saw the light, that {it was} good: and God divided the light from the darkness. {the light from...: Heb. between the light and between the darkness}
verses.nlt_text: And God saw that the light was good. Then he separated the light from the darkness.

verses.kjv_text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day. {And the evening...: Heb. And the evening was, and the morning was etc.}
verses.nlt_text: God called the light "day" and the darkness "night." And evening passed and morning came, marking the first day.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters. {firmament: Heb. expansion}
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let there be a space between the waters, to separate the waters of the heavens from the waters of the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which {were} under the firmament from the waters which {were} above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.nlt_text: And that is what happened. God made this space to separate the waters of the earth from the waters of the heavens.

verses.kjv_text: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day. {And the evening...: Heb. And the evening was, and the morning was etc.}
verses.nlt_text: God called the space "sky." And evening passed and morning came, marking the second day.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry {land} appear: and it was so.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let the waters beneath the sky flow together into one place, so dry ground may appear." And that is what happened.

verses.kjv_text: And God called the dry {land} Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that {it was} good.
verses.nlt_text: God called the dry ground "land" and the waters "seas." And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, {and} the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed {is} in itself, upon the earth: and it was so. {grass: Heb. tender grass}
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let the land sprout with vegetation-- every sort of seed-bearing plant, and trees that grow seed-bearing fruit. These seeds will then produce the kinds of plants and trees from which they came." And that is what happened.

verses.kjv_text: And the earth brought forth grass, {and} herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed {was} in itself, after his kind: and God saw that {it was} good.
verses.nlt_text: The land produced vegetation-- all sorts of seed-bearing plants, and trees with seed-bearing fruit. Their seeds produced plants and trees of the same kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv_text: And the evening and the morning were the third day. {And the evening...: Heb. And the evening was, and the morning was etc.}
verses.nlt_text: And evening passed and morning came, marking the third day.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years: {the day...: Heb. between the day and between the night}
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let great lights appear in the sky to separate the day from the night. Let them mark off the seasons, days, and years.

verses.kjv_text: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.nlt_text: Let these lights in the sky shine down on the earth." And that is what happened.

verses.kjv_text: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: {he made} the stars also. {to rule the day...: Heb. for the rule of the day, etc.}
verses.nlt_text: God made two great lights, the sun and the moon-- the larger one to govern the day, and the smaller one to govern the night. He also made the stars.

verses.kjv_text: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.nlt_text: God set these lights in the sky to light the earth,

verses.kjv_text: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that {it was} good.
verses.nlt_text: to govern the day and night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv_text: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day. {And the evening...: Heb. And the evening was, and the morning was etc.}
verses.nlt_text: And evening passed and morning came, marking the fourth day.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl {that} may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven. {moving: or, creeping} {life: Heb. soul} {fowl...: Heb. let fowl fly} {open...: Heb. face of the firmament of heaven}
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let the waters swarm with fish and other life. Let the skies be filled with birds of every kind."

verses.kjv_text: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that {it was} good.
verses.nlt_text: So God created great sea creatures and every living thing that scurries and swarms in the water, and every sort of bird-- each producing offspring of the same kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv_text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Then God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply. Let the fish fill the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day. {And the evening...: Heb. And the evening was, and the morning was etc.}
verses.nlt_text: And evening passed and morning came, marking the fifth day.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let the earth produce every sort of animal, each producing offspring of the same kind-- livestock, small animals that scurry along the ground, and wild animals." And that is what happened.

verses.kjv_text: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that {it was} good.
verses.nlt_text: God made all sorts of wild animals, livestock, and small animals, each able to produce offspring of the same kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Let us make human beings in our image, to be like ourselves. They will reign over the fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the livestock, all the wild animals on the earth, and the small animals that scurry along the ground."

verses.kjv_text: So God created man in his {own} image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.nlt_text: So God created human beings in his own image. In the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

verses.kjv_text: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth. {moveth: Heb. creepeth}
verses.nlt_text: Then God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth and govern it. Reign over the fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, and all the animals that scurry along the ground."

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which {is} upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which {is} the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat. {bearing...: Heb. seeding seed} {yielding...: Heb. seeding seed}
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "Look! I have given you every seed-bearing plant throughout the earth and all the fruit trees for your food.

verses.kjv_text: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein {there is} life, {I have given} every green herb for meat: and it was so. {life: Heb. a living soul}
verses.nlt_text: And I have given every green plant as food for all the wild animals, the birds in the sky, and the small animals that scurry along the ground-- everything that has life." And that is what happened.

verses.kjv_text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, {it was} very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day. {And the evening...: Heb. And the evening was, and the morning was etc.}
verses.nlt_text: Then God looked over all he had made, and he saw that it was very good! And evening passed and morning came, marking the sixth day.

verses.kjv_text: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.nlt_text: So the creation of the heavens and the earth and everything in them was completed.

verses.kjv_text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verses.nlt_text: On the seventh day God had finished his work of creation, so he rested from all his work.

verses.kjv_text: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made. {created...: Heb. created to make}
verses.nlt_text: And God blessed the seventh day and declared it holy, because it was the day when he rested from all his work of creation.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of the creation of the heavens and the earth. When the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

verses.kjv_text: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and {there was} not a man to till the ground.
verses.nlt_text: neither wild plants nor grains were growing on the earth. The LORD God had not yet sent rain to water the earth, and there were no people to cultivate the soil.

verses.kjv_text: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground. {there...: or, a mist which went up from, etc.}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, springs came up from the ground and watered all the land.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God formed man {of} the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul. {of the dust...: Heb. dust of the ground}
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God formed the man from the dust of the ground. He breathed the breath of life into the man's nostrils, and the man became a living person.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God planted a garden in Eden in the east, and there he placed the man he had made.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD God made all sorts of trees grow up from the ground-- trees that were beautiful and that produced delicious fruit. In the middle of the garden he placed the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

verses.kjv_text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
verses.nlt_text: A river watered the garden and then flowed out of Eden and divided into four branches.

verses.kjv_text: The name of the first {is} Pison: that {is} it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where {there is} gold;
verses.nlt_text: The first branch, called the Pishon, flowed around the entire land of Havilah, where gold is found.

verses.kjv_text: And the gold of that land {is} good: there {is} bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.nlt_text: The gold of that land is exceptionally pure; aromatic resin and onyx stone are also found there.

verses.kjv_text: And the name of the second river {is} Gihon: the same {is} it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia. {Ethiopia: Heb. Cush}
verses.nlt_text: The second branch, called the Gihon, flowed around the entire land of Cush.

verses.kjv_text: And the name of the third river {is} Hiddekel: that {is} it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river {is} Euphrates. {toward...: or, eastward to Assyria}
verses.nlt_text: The third branch, called the Tigris, flowed east of the land of Asshur. The fourth branch is called the Euphrates.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it. {the man: or, Adam}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD God placed the man in the Garden of Eden to tend and watch over it.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat: {thou...: Heb. eating thou shalt eat}
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD God warned him, "You may freely eat the fruit of every tree in the garden

verses.kjv_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die. {thou shalt surely...: Heb. dying thou shalt die}
verses.nlt_text: -- except the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. If you eat its fruit, you are sure to die."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God said, {It is} not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. {meet...: Heb. as before him}
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper who is just right for him."

verses.kjv_text: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought {them} unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that {was} the name thereof. {Adam: or, the man}
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD God formed from the ground all the wild animals and all the birds of the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would call them, and the man chose a name for each one.

verses.kjv_text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. {gave: Heb. called}
verses.nlt_text: He gave names to all the livestock, all the birds of the sky, and all the wild animals. But still there was no helper just right for him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. While the man slept, the LORD God took out one of the man's ribs and closed up the opening.

verses.kjv_text: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. {made: Heb. builded}
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God made a woman from the rib, and he brought her to the man.

verses.kjv_text: And Adam said, This {is} now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. {Woman: Heb. Isha} {Man: Heb. Ish}
verses.nlt_text: "At last!" the man exclaimed. "This one is bone from my bone, and flesh from my flesh! She will be called 'woman,' because she was taken from 'man.'"

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
verses.nlt_text: This explains why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife, and the two are united into one.

verses.kjv_text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.nlt_text: Now the man and his wife were both naked, but they felt no shame.

verses.kjv_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden? {Yea...: Heb. Yea, because, etc.}
verses.nlt_text: The serpent was the shrewdest of all the wild animals the LORD God had made. One day he asked the woman, "Did God really say you must not eat the fruit from any of the trees in the garden?"

verses.kjv_text: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.nlt_text: "Of course we may eat fruit from the trees in the garden," the woman replied.

verses.kjv_text: But of the fruit of the tree which {is} in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.nlt_text: "It's only the fruit from the tree in the middle of the garden that we are not allowed to eat. God said, 'You must not eat it or even touch it; if you do, you will die.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.nlt_text: "You won't die!" the serpent replied to the woman.

verses.kjv_text: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.nlt_text: "God knows that your eyes will be opened as soon as you eat it, and you will be like God, knowing both good and evil."

verses.kjv_text: And when the woman saw that the tree {was} good for food, and that it {was} pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make {one} wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat. {pleasant: Heb. a desire}
verses.nlt_text: The woman was convinced. She saw that the tree was beautiful and its fruit looked delicious, and she wanted the wisdom it would give her. So she took some of the fruit and ate it. Then she gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it, too.

verses.kjv_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they {were} naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons. {aprons: or, things to gird about}
verses.nlt_text: At that moment their eyes were opened, and they suddenly felt shame at their nakedness. So they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden. {cool: Heb. wind}
verses.nlt_text: When the cool evening breezes were blowing, the man and his wife heard the LORD God walking about in the garden. So they hid from the LORD God among the trees.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where {art} thou?
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God called to the man, "Where are you?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I {was} naked; and I hid myself.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "I heard you walking in the garden, so I hid. I was afraid because I was naked."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Who told thee that thou {wast} naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.nlt_text: "Who told you that you were naked?" the LORD God asked. "Have you eaten from the tree whose fruit I commanded you not to eat?"

verses.kjv_text: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest {to be} with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.nlt_text: The man replied, "It was the woman you gave me who gave me the fruit, and I ate it."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What {is} this {that} thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God asked the woman, "What have you done?" "The serpent deceived me," she replied. "That's why I ate it."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou {art} cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, you are cursed more than all animals, domestic and wild. You will crawl on your belly, groveling in the dust as long as you live.

verses.kjv_text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.nlt_text: And I will cause hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will strike your head, and you will strike his heel."

verses.kjv_text: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire {shall be} to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee. {to thy...: or, subject to thy husband}
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to the woman, "I will sharpen the pain of your pregnancy, and in pain you will give birth. And you will desire to control your husband, but he will rule over you. "

verses.kjv_text: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed {is} the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat {of} it all the days of thy life;
verses.nlt_text: And to the man he said, "Since you listened to your wife and ate from the tree whose fruit I commanded you not to eat, the ground is cursed because of you. All your life you will struggle to scratch a living from it.

verses.kjv_text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field; {bring...: Heb. cause to bud}
verses.nlt_text: It will grow thorns and thistles for you, though you will eat of its grains.

verses.kjv_text: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou {art}, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.nlt_text: By the sweat of your brow will you have food to eat until you return to the ground from which you were made. For you were made from dust, and to dust you will return."

verses.kjv_text: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living. {Eve: Heb. Chavah: that is Living}
verses.nlt_text: Then the man-- Adam-- named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all who live.

verses.kjv_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD God made clothing from animal skins for Adam and his wife.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD God said, "Look, the human beings have become like us, knowing both good and evil. What if they reach out, take fruit from the tree of life, and eat it? Then they will live forever!"

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD God banished them from the Garden of Eden, and he sent Adam out to cultivate the ground from which he had been made.

verses.kjv_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.nlt_text: After sending them out, the LORD God stationed mighty cherubim to the east of the Garden of Eden. And he placed a flaming sword that flashed back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.

verses.kjv_text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD. {Cain: that is, Gotten, or, Acquired}
verses.nlt_text: Now Adam had sexual relations with his wife, Eve, and she became pregnant. When she gave birth to Cain, she said, "With the LORD's help, I have produced a man!"

verses.kjv_text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground. {Abel: Heb. Hebel} {a keeper: Heb. a feeder}
verses.nlt_text: Later she gave birth to his brother and named him Abel.When they grew up, Abel became a shepherd, while Cain cultivated the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD. {in process...: Heb. at the end of days}
verses.nlt_text: When it was time for the harvest, Cain presented some of his crops as a gift to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering: {flock: Heb. sheep, or, goats}
verses.nlt_text: Abel also brought a gift-- the best of the firstborn lambs from his flock. The LORD accepted Abel and his gift,

verses.kjv_text: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.nlt_text: but he did not accept Cain and his gift. This made Cain very angry, and he looked dejected.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.nlt_text: "Why are you so angry?" the LORD asked Cain. "Why do you look so dejected?

verses.kjv_text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee {shall be} his desire, and thou shalt rule over him. {be accepted: or, have the excellency} {unto...: or, subject unto thee}
verses.nlt_text: You will be accepted if you do what is right. But if you refuse to do what is right, then watch out! Sin is crouching at the door, eager to control you. But you must subdue it and be its master."

verses.kjv_text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.nlt_text: One day Cain suggested to his brother, "Let's go out into the fields." And while they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother, Abel, and killed him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where {is} Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: {Am} I my brother's keeper?
verses.nlt_text: Afterward the LORD asked Cain, "Where is your brother? Where is Abel?" "I don't know," Cain responded. "Am I my brother's guardian?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground. {blood: Heb. bloods}
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother's blood cries out to me from the ground!

verses.kjv_text: And now {art} thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.nlt_text: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has swallowed your brother's blood.

verses.kjv_text: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.nlt_text: No longer will the ground yield good crops for you, no matter how hard you work! From now on you will be a homeless wanderer on the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment {is} greater than I can bear. {My...: or, Mine iniquity is greater than that it may be forgiven}
verses.nlt_text: Cain replied to the LORD, "My punishment is too great for me to bear!

verses.kjv_text: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, {that} every one that findeth me shall slay me.
verses.nlt_text: You have banished me from the land and from your presence; you have made me a homeless wanderer. Anyone who finds me will kill me!"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replied, "No, for I will give a sevenfold punishment to anyone who kills you." Then the LORD put a mark on Cain to warn anyone who might try to kill him.

verses.kjv_text: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.nlt_text: So Cain left the LORD's presence and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

verses.kjv_text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch. {Enoch: Heb. Chanoch}
verses.nlt_text: Cain had sexual relations with his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain founded a city, which he named Enoch, after his son.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech. {Lamech: Heb. Lemech}
verses.nlt_text: Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

verses.kjv_text: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one {was} Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.nlt_text: Lamech married two women. The first was named Adah, and the second was Zillah.

verses.kjv_text: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and {of such as have} cattle.
verses.nlt_text: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the first of those who raise livestock and live in tents.

verses.kjv_text: And his brother's name {was} Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
verses.nlt_text: His brother's name was Jubal, the first of all who play the harp and flute.

verses.kjv_text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain {was} Naamah. {instructer: Heb. whetter}
verses.nlt_text: Lamech's other wife, Zillah, gave birth to a son named Tubal-cain. He became an expert in forging tools of bronze and iron. Tubal-cain had a sister named Naamah.

verses.kjv_text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. {I have...: or, I would slay a man in my wound, etc.} {to my hurt: or, in my hurt}
verses.nlt_text: One day Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; listen to me, you wives of Lamech. I have killed a man who attacked me, a young man who wounded me.

verses.kjv_text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.nlt_text: If someone who kills Cain is punished seven times, then the one who kills me will be punished seventy-seven times!"

verses.kjv_text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, {said she}, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew. {Seth: Heb. Sheth: that is Appointed, or, Put}
verses.nlt_text: Adam had sexual relations with his wife again, and she gave birth to another son. She named him Seth, for she said, "God has granted me another son in place of Abel, whom Cain killed."

verses.kjv_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD. {Enos: Heb. Enosh} {to call...: or, to call themselves by the name of the Lord}
verses.nlt_text: When Seth grew up, he had a son and named him Enosh. At that time people first began to worship the LORD by name.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.nlt_text: This is the written account of the descendants of Adam. When God created human beings, he made them to be like himself.

verses.kjv_text: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.nlt_text: He created them male and female, and he blessed them and called them "human."

verses.kjv_text: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat {a son} in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.nlt_text: When Adam was 130 years old, he became the father of a son who was just like him-- in his very image. He named his son Seth.

verses.kjv_text: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Seth, Adam lived another 800 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Adam lived 930 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos: {Enos: Heb. Enosh}
verses.nlt_text: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.

verses.kjv_text: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Enosh, Seth lived another 807 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Seth lived 912 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan: {Cainan: Heb. Kenan}
verses.nlt_text: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.

verses.kjv_text: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Kenan, Enosh lived another 815 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Enosh lived 905 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel: {Mahalaleel: Gr. Maleleel}
verses.nlt_text: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.

verses.kjv_text: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Mahalalel, Kenan lived another 840 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Kenan lived 910 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared: {Jared: Heb. Jered}
verses.nlt_text: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.

verses.kjv_text: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Jared, Mahalalel lived another 830 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Mahalalel lived 895 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
verses.nlt_text: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.

verses.kjv_text: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Enoch, Jared lived another 800 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Jared lived 962 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah: {Methuselah: Gr. Mathusala}
verses.nlt_text: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.

verses.kjv_text: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Methuselah, Enoch lived in close fellowship with God for another 300 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
verses.nlt_text: Enoch lived 365 years,

verses.kjv_text: And Enoch walked with God: and he {was} not; for God took him.
verses.nlt_text: walking in close fellowship with God. Then one day he disappeared, because God took him.

verses.kjv_text: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
verses.nlt_text: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.

verses.kjv_text: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters: {Lamech: Heb. Lemech}
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Lamech, Methuselah lived another 782 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Methuselah lived 969 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
verses.nlt_text: When Lamech was 182 years old, he became the father of a son.

verses.kjv_text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This {same} shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed. {Noah: Gr. Noe: that is Rest, or, Comfort}
verses.nlt_text: Lamech named his son Noah, for he said, "May he bring us relief from our work and the painful labor of farming this ground that the LORD has cursed."

verses.kjv_text: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Noah, Lamech lived another 595 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: Lamech lived 777 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.nlt_text: By the time Noah was 500 years old, he was the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.nlt_text: Then the people began to multiply on the earth, and daughters were born to them.

verses.kjv_text: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they {were} fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of God saw the beautiful women and took any they wanted as their wives.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also {is} flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said, "My Spirit will not put up with humans for such a long time, for they are only mortal flesh. In the future, their normal lifespan will be no more than 120 years."

verses.kjv_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare {children} to them, the same {became} mighty men which {were} of old, men of renown.
verses.nlt_text: In those days, and for some time after, giant Nephilites lived on the earth, for whenever the sons of God had intercourse with women, they gave birth to children who became the heroes and famous warriors of ancient times.

verses.kjv_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man {was} great in the earth, and {that} every imagination of the thoughts of his heart {was} only evil continually. {every...: or, the whole imagination: the Hebrew word signifieth not only the imagination, but also the purposes and desires} {continually: Heb. every day}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD observed the extent of human wickedness on the earth, and he saw that everything they thought or imagined was consistently and totally evil.

verses.kjv_text: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD was sorry he had ever made them and put them on the earth. It broke his heart.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them. {both...: Heb. from man unto beast}
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD said, "I will wipe this human race I have created from the face of the earth. Yes, and I will destroy every living thing-- all the people, the large animals, the small animals that scurry along the ground, and even the birds of the sky. I am sorry I ever made them."

verses.kjv_text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But Noah found favor with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man {and} perfect in his generations, {and} Noah walked with God. {perfect: or, upright}
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, the only blameless person living on earth at the time, and he walked in close fellowship with God.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.nlt_text: Noah was the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv_text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.nlt_text: Now God saw that the earth had become corrupt and was filled with violence.

verses.kjv_text: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: God observed all this corruption in the world, for everyone on earth was corrupt.

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth. {with the earth: or, from the earth}
verses.nlt_text: So God said to Noah, "I have decided to destroy all living creatures, for they have filled the earth with violence. Yes, I will wipe them all out along with the earth!

verses.kjv_text: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch. {rooms: Heb. nests}
verses.nlt_text: "Build a large boat from cypress wood and waterproof it with tar, inside and out. Then construct decks and stalls throughout its interior.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is the fashion} which thou shalt make it {of}: The length of the ark {shall be} three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.nlt_text: Make the boat 450 feet long, 75 feet wide, and 45 feet high.

verses.kjv_text: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; {with} lower, second, and third {stories} shalt thou make it.
verses.nlt_text: Leave an 18-inch opening below the roof all the way around the boat. Put the door on the side, and build three decks inside the boat-- lower, middle, and upper.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein {is} the breath of life, from under heaven; {and} every thing that {is} in the earth shall die.
verses.nlt_text: "Look! I am about to cover the earth with a flood that will destroy every living thing that breathes. Everything on earth will die.

verses.kjv_text: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.nlt_text: But I will confirm my covenant with you. So enter the boat-- you and your wife and your sons and their wives.

verses.kjv_text: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every {sort} shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep {them} alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.nlt_text: Bring a pair of every kind of animal-- a male and a female-- into the boat with you to keep them alive during the flood.

verses.kjv_text: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every {sort} shall come unto thee, to keep {them} alive.
verses.nlt_text: Pairs of every kind of bird, and every kind of animal, and every kind of small animal that scurries along the ground, will come to you to be kept alive.

verses.kjv_text: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather {it} to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
verses.nlt_text: And be sure to take on board enough food for your family and for all the animals."

verses.kjv_text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
verses.nlt_text: So Noah did everything exactly as God had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
verses.nlt_text: When everything was ready, the LORD said to Noah, "Go into the boat with all your family, for among all the people of the earth, I can see that you alone are righteous.

verses.kjv_text: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that {are} not clean by two, the male and his female. {by sevens: Heb. seven seven}
verses.nlt_text: Take with you seven pairs-- male and female-- of each animal I have approved for eating and for sacrifice, and take one pair of each of the others.

verses.kjv_text: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth. {by sevens: Heb. seven seven}
verses.nlt_text: Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird. There must be a male and a female in each pair to ensure that all life will survive on the earth after the flood.

verses.kjv_text: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth. {destroy: Heb. blot out}
verses.nlt_text: Seven days from now I will make the rains pour down on the earth. And it will rain for forty days and forty nights, until I have wiped from the earth all the living things I have created."

verses.kjv_text: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
verses.nlt_text: So Noah did everything as the LORD commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah {was} six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Noah was 600 years old when the flood covered the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.nlt_text: He went on board the boat to escape the flood-- he and his wife and his sons and their wives.

verses.kjv_text: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that {are} not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
verses.nlt_text: With them were all the various kinds of animals-- those approved for eating and for sacrifice and those that were not-- along with all the birds and the small animals that scurry along the ground.

verses.kjv_text: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.nlt_text: They entered the boat in pairs, male and female, just as God had commanded Noah.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth. {after...: or, on the seventh day}
verses.nlt_text: After seven days, the waters of the flood came and covered the earth.

verses.kjv_text: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened. {windows: or, floodgates}
verses.nlt_text: When Noah was 600 years old, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the underground waters erupted from the earth, and the rain fell in mighty torrents from the sky.

verses.kjv_text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.nlt_text: The rain continued to fall for forty days and forty nights.

verses.kjv_text: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.nlt_text: That very day Noah had gone into the boat with his wife and his sons-- Shem, Ham, and Japheth-- and their wives.

verses.kjv_text: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort. {sort: Heb. wing}
verses.nlt_text: With them in the boat were pairs of every kind of animal-- domestic and wild, large and small-- along with birds of every kind.

verses.kjv_text: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein {is} the breath of life.
verses.nlt_text: Two by two they came into the boat, representing every living thing that breathes.

verses.kjv_text: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
verses.nlt_text: A male and female of each kind entered, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD closed the door behind them.

verses.kjv_text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.nlt_text: For forty days the floodwaters grew deeper, covering the ground and lifting the boat high above the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.nlt_text: As the waters rose higher and higher above the ground, the boat floated safely on the surface.

verses.kjv_text: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that {were} under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, the water covered even the highest mountains on the earth,

verses.kjv_text: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.nlt_text: rising more than twenty-two feet above the highest peaks.

verses.kjv_text: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
verses.nlt_text: All the living things on earth died-- birds, domestic animals, wild animals, small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the people.

verses.kjv_text: All in whose nostrils {was} the breath of life, of all that {was} in the dry {land}, died. {the breath...: Heb. the breath of the spirit of life}
verses.nlt_text: Everything that breathed and lived on dry land died.

verses.kjv_text: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained {alive}, and they that {were} with him in the ark.
verses.nlt_text: God wiped out every living thing on the earth-- people, livestock, small animals that scurry along the ground, and the birds of the sky. All were destroyed. The only people who survived were Noah and those with him in the boat.

verses.kjv_text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
verses.nlt_text: And the floodwaters covered the earth for 150 days.

verses.kjv_text: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that {was} with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
verses.nlt_text: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and livestock with him in the boat. He sent a wind to blow across the earth, and the floodwaters began to recede.

verses.kjv_text: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
verses.nlt_text: The underground waters stopped flowing, and the torrential rains from the sky were stopped.

verses.kjv_text: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated. {continually: Heb. in going and returning}
verses.nlt_text: So the floodwaters gradually receded from the earth. After 150 days,

verses.kjv_text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.nlt_text: exactly five months from the time the flood began, the boat came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

verses.kjv_text: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth {month}, on the first {day} of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen. {decreased...: Heb. were in going and decreasing}
verses.nlt_text: Two and a half months later, as the waters continued to go down, other mountain peaks became visible.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.nlt_text: After another forty days, Noah opened the window he had made in the boat

verses.kjv_text: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth. {to...: Heb. in going forth and returning}
verses.nlt_text: and released a raven. The bird flew back and forth until the floodwaters on the earth had dried up.

verses.kjv_text: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verses.nlt_text: He also released a dove to see if the water had receded and it could find dry ground.

verses.kjv_text: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters {were} on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark. {pulled...: Heb. caused her to come}
verses.nlt_text: But the dove could find no place to land because the water still covered the ground. So it returned to the boat, and Noah held out his hand and drew the dove back inside.

verses.kjv_text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.nlt_text: After waiting another seven days, Noah released the dove again.

verses.kjv_text: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth {was} an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.nlt_text: This time the dove returned to him in the evening with a fresh olive leaf in its beak. Then Noah knew that the floodwaters were almost gone.

verses.kjv_text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
verses.nlt_text: He waited another seven days and then released the dove again. This time it did not come back.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first {month}, the first {day} of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.nlt_text: Noah was now 601 years old. On the first day of the new year, ten and a half months after the flood began, the floodwaters had almost dried up from the earth. Noah lifted back the covering of the boat and saw that the surface of the ground was drying.

verses.kjv_text: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.nlt_text: Two more months went by, and at last the earth was dry!

verses.kjv_text: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then God said to Noah,

verses.kjv_text: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Leave the boat, all of you-- you and your wife, and your sons and their wives.

verses.kjv_text: Bring forth with thee every living thing that {is} with thee, of all flesh, {both} of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Release all the animals-- the birds, the livestock, and the small animals that scurry along the ground-- so they can be fruitful and multiply throughout the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
verses.nlt_text: So Noah, his wife, and his sons and their wives left the boat.

verses.kjv_text: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, {and} whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark. {kinds: Heb. families}
verses.nlt_text: And all of the large and small animals and birds came out of the boat, pair by pair.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD, and there he sacrificed as burnt offerings the animals and birds that had been approved for that purpose.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart {is} evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done. {a sweet...: Heb. a savour of rest or, satisfaction} {for the imagination: or, through the imagination}
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD was pleased with the aroma of the sacrifice and said to himself, "I will never again curse the ground because of the human race, even though everything they think or imagine is bent toward evil from childhood. I will never again destroy all living things.

verses.kjv_text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease. {While...: Heb. As yet all the days of the earth}
verses.nlt_text: As long as the earth remains, there will be planting and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night."

verses.kjv_text: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Then God blessed Noah and his sons and told them, "Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth {upon} the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.nlt_text: All the animals of the earth, all the birds of the sky, all the small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the fish in the sea will look on you with fear and terror. I have placed them in your power.

verses.kjv_text: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.nlt_text: I have given them to you for food, just as I have given you grain and vegetables.

verses.kjv_text: But flesh with the life thereof, {which is} the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.nlt_text: But you must never eat any meat that still has the lifeblood in it.

verses.kjv_text: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.nlt_text: "And I will require the blood of anyone who takes another person's life. If a wild animal kills a person, it must die. And anyone who murders a fellow human must die.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone takes a human life, that person's life will also be taken by human hands. For God made human beings in his own image.

verses.kjv_text: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.nlt_text: Now be fruitful and multiply, and repopulate the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then God told Noah and his sons,

verses.kjv_text: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.nlt_text: "I hereby confirm my covenant with you and your descendants,

verses.kjv_text: And with every living creature that {is} with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: and with all the animals that were on the boat with you-- the birds, the livestock, and all the wild animals-- every living creature on earth.

verses.kjv_text: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I am confirming my covenant with you. Never again will floodwaters kill all living creatures; never again will a flood destroy the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And God said, This {is} the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that {is} with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "I am giving you a sign of my covenant with you and with all living creatures, for all generations to come.

verses.kjv_text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.nlt_text: I have placed my rainbow in the clouds. It is the sign of my covenant with you and with all the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.nlt_text: When I send clouds over the earth, the rainbow will appear in the clouds,

verses.kjv_text: And I will remember my covenant, which {is} between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.nlt_text: and I will remember my covenant with you and with all living creatures. Never again will the floodwaters destroy all life.

verses.kjv_text: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that {is} upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: When I see the rainbow in the clouds, I will remember the eternal covenant between God and every living creature on earth."

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Noah, This {is} the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that {is} upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said to Noah, "Yes, this rainbow is the sign of the covenant I am confirming with all the creatures on earth."

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham {is} the father of Canaan. {Canaan: Heb. Chenaan}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Noah who came out of the boat with their father were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Ham is the father of Canaan.)

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.nlt_text: From these three sons of Noah came all the people who now populate the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah began {to be} an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.nlt_text: After the flood, Noah began to cultivate the ground, and he planted a vineyard.

verses.kjv_text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.nlt_text: One day he drank some wine he had made, and he became drunk and lay naked inside his tent.

verses.kjv_text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.nlt_text: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw that his father was naked and went outside and told his brothers.

verses.kjv_text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid {it} upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces {were} backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: Then Shem and Japheth took a robe, held it over their shoulders, and backed into the tent to cover their father. As they did this, they looked the other way so they would not see him naked.

verses.kjv_text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.nlt_text: When Noah woke up from his stupor, he learned what Ham, his youngest son, had done.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Cursed {be} Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Then he cursed Canaan, the son of Ham: "May Canaan be cursed! May he be the lowest of servants to his relatives."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant. {his servant: or, servant to them}
verses.nlt_text: Then Noah said, "May the LORD, the God of Shem, be blessed, and may Canaan be his servant!

verses.kjv_text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant. {enlarge: or, persuade}
verses.nlt_text: May God expand the territory of Japheth! May Japheth share the prosperity of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant."

verses.kjv_text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.nlt_text: Noah lived another 350 years after the great flood.

verses.kjv_text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.nlt_text: He lived 950 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of the families of Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the three sons of Noah. Many children were born to them after the great flood.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim. {Dodanim: or, as some read it, Rodanim}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

verses.kjv_text: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.nlt_text: Their descendants became the seafaring peoples that spread out to various lands, each identified by its own language, clan, and national identity.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv_text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Cush was also the ancestor of Nimrod, who was the first heroic warrior on earth.

verses.kjv_text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Since he was the greatest hunter in the world, his name became proverbial. People would say, "This man is like Nimrod, the greatest hunter in the world."

verses.kjv_text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. {Babel: Gr. Babylon}
verses.nlt_text: He built his kingdom in the land of Babylonia, with the cities of Babylon, Erech, Akkad, and Calneh.

verses.kjv_text: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah, {went...: or, he went out into Assyria} {the city...: or, the streets of the city}
verses.nlt_text: From there he expanded his territory to Assyria, building the cities of Nineveh, Rehoboth-ir, Calah,

verses.kjv_text: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same {is} a great city.
verses.nlt_text: and Resen (the great city located between Nineveh and Calah).

verses.kjv_text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.nlt_text: Mizraim was the ancestor of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

verses.kjv_text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.nlt_text: Pathrusites, Casluhites, and the Caphtorites, from whom the Philistines came.

verses.kjv_text: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth, {Sidon: Heb. Tzidon}
verses.nlt_text: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon, the ancestor of the Sidonians. Canaan was also the ancestor of the Hittites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.nlt_text: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.nlt_text: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.nlt_text: Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites. The Canaanite clans eventually spread out,

verses.kjv_text: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha. {Gaza: Heb. Azzah}
verses.nlt_text: and the territory of Canaan extended from Sidon in the north to Gerar and Gaza in the south, and east as far as Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, near Lasha.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, {and} in their nations.
verses.nlt_text: These were the descendants of Ham, identified by clan, language, territory, and national identity.

verses.kjv_text: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were {children} born.
verses.nlt_text: Sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth. Shem was the ancestor of all the descendants of Eber.

verses.kjv_text: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram. {Arphaxad: Heb. Arpachshad}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

verses.kjv_text: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber. {Salah: Heb. Shelah}
verses.nlt_text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one {was} Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name {was} Joktan. {Peleg: that is Division}
verses.nlt_text: Eber had two sons. The first was named Peleg (which means "division"), for during his lifetime the people of the world were divided into different language groups. His brother's name was Joktan.

verses.kjv_text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.nlt_text: Joktan was the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.kjv_text: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.nlt_text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.kjv_text: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.nlt_text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.kjv_text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these {were} the sons of Joktan.
verses.nlt_text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were descendants of Joktan.

verses.kjv_text: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.nlt_text: The territory they occupied extended from Mesha all the way to Sephar in the eastern mountains.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.nlt_text: These were the descendants of Shem, identified by clan, language, territory, and national identity.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.nlt_text: These are the clans that descended from Noah's sons, arranged by nation according to their lines of descent. All the nations of the earth descended from these clans after the great flood.

verses.kjv_text: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech. {language: Heb. lip.} {speech: Heb. words}
verses.nlt_text: At one time all the people of the world spoke the same language and used the same words.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there. {from...: or, eastward}
verses.nlt_text: As the people migrated to the east, they found a plain in the land of Babylonia and settled there.

verses.kjv_text: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter. {they said...: Heb. a man said to his neighbour} {burn...: Heb. burn them to a burning}
verses.nlt_text: They began saying to each other, "Let's make bricks and harden them with fire." (In this region bricks were used instead of stone, and tar was used for mortar.)

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top {may reach} unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.nlt_text: Then they said, "Come, let's build a great city for ourselves with a tower that reaches into the sky. This will make us famous and keep us from being scattered all over the world."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD came down to look at the city and the tower the people were building.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, Behold, the people {is} one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.nlt_text: "Look!" he said. "The people are united, and they all speak the same language. After this, nothing they set out to do will be impossible for them!

verses.kjv_text: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
verses.nlt_text: Come, let's go down and confuse the people with different languages. Then they won't be able to understand each other."

verses.kjv_text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.nlt_text: In that way, the LORD scattered them all over the world, and they stopped building the city.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth. {Babel: that is, Confusion}
verses.nlt_text: That is why the city was called Babel, because that is where the LORD confused the people with different languages. In this way he scattered them all over the world.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the generations of Shem: Shem {was} an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of Shem's family. Two years after the great flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.

verses.kjv_text: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Arphaxad, Shem lived another 500 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.nlt_text: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.

verses.kjv_text: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Shelah, Arphaxad lived another 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.nlt_text: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.

verses.kjv_text: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Eber, Shelah lived another 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg: {Peleg: Gr. Phalec}
verses.nlt_text: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.

verses.kjv_text: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Peleg, Eber lived another 430 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.nlt_text: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.

verses.kjv_text: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Reu, Peleg lived another 209 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug: {Serug: Gr. Saruch}
verses.nlt_text: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.

verses.kjv_text: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Serug, Reu lived another 207 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.nlt_text: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.

verses.kjv_text: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Nahor, Serug lived another 200 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah: {Terah: Gr. Thara}
verses.nlt_text: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.
