verses.kjv_text: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.nlt_text: After the birth of Terah, Nahor lived another 119 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.nlt_text: When Terah was 70 years old, he had become the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of Terah's family. Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.

verses.kjv_text: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.nlt_text: But Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, the land of his birth, while his father, Terah, was still living.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife {was} Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah. (Milcah and her sister Iscah were daughters of Nahor's brother Haran.)

verses.kjv_text: But Sarai was barren; she {had} no child.
verses.nlt_text: But Sarai was unable to become pregnant and had no children.

verses.kjv_text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.nlt_text: One day Terah took his son Abram, his daughter-in-law Sarai (his son Abram's wife), and his grandson Lot (his son Haran's child) and moved away from Ur of the Chaldeans. He was headed for the land of Canaan, but they stopped at Haran and settled there.

verses.kjv_text: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.nlt_text: Terah lived for 205 years and died while still in Haran.

verses.kjv_text: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD had said to Abram, "Leave your native country, your relatives, and your father's family, and go to the land that I will show you.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.nlt_text: I will make you into a great nation. I will bless you and make you famous, and you will be a blessing to others.

verses.kjv_text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
verses.nlt_text: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who treat you with contempt. All the families on earth will be blessed through you."

verses.kjv_text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram {was} seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.nlt_text: So Abram departed as the LORD had instructed, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.nlt_text: He took his wife, Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all his wealth-- his livestock and all the people he had taken into his household at Haran-- and headed for the land of Canaan. When they arrived in Canaan,

verses.kjv_text: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite {was} then in the land. {plain: Heb. plains}
verses.nlt_text: Abram traveled through the land as far as Shechem. There he set up camp beside the oak of Moreh. At that time, the area was inhabited by Canaanites.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, "I will give this land to your descendants. " And Abram built an altar there and dedicated it to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

verses.kjv_text: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, {having} Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: After that, Abram traveled south and set up camp in the hill country, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built another altar and dedicated it to the LORD, and he worshiped the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south. {going...: Heb. in going and journeying}
verses.nlt_text: Then Abram continued traveling south by stages toward the Negev.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine {was} grievous in the land.
verses.nlt_text: At that time a severe famine struck the land of Canaan, forcing Abram to go down to Egypt, where he lived as a foreigner.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou {art} a fair woman to look upon:
verses.nlt_text: As he was approaching the border of Egypt, Abram said to his wife, Sarai, "Look, you are a very beautiful woman.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This {is} his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.nlt_text: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, 'This is his wife. Let's kill him; then we can have her!'

verses.kjv_text: Say, I pray thee, thou {art} my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.nlt_text: So please tell them you are my sister. Then they will spare my life and treat me well because of their interest in you."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she {was} very fair.
verses.nlt_text: And sure enough, when Abram arrived in Egypt, everyone spoke of Sarai's beauty.

verses.kjv_text: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.nlt_text: When the palace officials saw her, they sang her praises to Pharaoh, their king, and Sarai was taken into his palace.

verses.kjv_text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.nlt_text: Then Pharaoh gave Abram many gifts because of her-- sheep, goats, cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD sent terrible plagues upon Pharaoh and his household because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What {is} this {that} thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she {was} thy wife?
verses.nlt_text: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and accused him sharply. "What have you done to me?" he demanded. "Why didn't you tell me she was your wife?

verses.kjv_text: Why saidst thou, She {is} my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take {her}, and go thy way.
verses.nlt_text: Why did you say, 'She is my sister,' and allow me to take her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and get out of here!"

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh commanded {his} men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.nlt_text: Pharaoh ordered some of his men to escort them, and he sent Abram out of the country, along with his wife and all his possessions.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.nlt_text: So Abram left Egypt and traveled north into the Negev, along with his wife and Lot and all that they owned.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram {was} very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.nlt_text: (Abram was very rich in livestock, silver, and gold.)

verses.kjv_text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
verses.nlt_text: From the Negev, they continued traveling by stages toward Bethel, and they pitched their tents between Bethel and Ai, where they had camped before.

verses.kjv_text: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: This was the same place where Abram had built the altar, and there he worshiped the LORD again.

verses.kjv_text: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.nlt_text: Lot, who was traveling with Abram, had also become very wealthy with flocks of sheep and goats, herds of cattle, and many tents.

verses.kjv_text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.nlt_text: But the land could not support both Abram and Lot with all their flocks and herds living so close together.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
verses.nlt_text: So disputes broke out between the herdsmen of Abram and Lot. (At that time Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land.)

verses.kjv_text: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we {be} brethren. {brethren: Heb. men brethren}
verses.nlt_text: Finally Abram said to Lot, "Let's not allow this conflict to come between us or our herdsmen. After all, we are close relatives!

verses.kjv_text: {Is} not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if {thou wilt take} the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if {thou depart} to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.nlt_text: The whole countryside is open to you. Take your choice of any section of the land you want, and we will separate. If you want the land to the left, then I'll take the land on the right. If you prefer the land on the right, then I'll go to the left."

verses.kjv_text: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it {was} well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, {even} as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
verses.nlt_text: Lot took a long look at the fertile plains of the Jordan Valley in the direction of Zoar. The whole area was well watered everywhere, like the garden of the LORD or the beautiful land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)

verses.kjv_text: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.nlt_text: Lot chose for himself the whole Jordan Valley to the east of them. He went there with his flocks and servants and parted company with his uncle Abram.

verses.kjv_text: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched {his} tent toward Sodom.
verses.nlt_text: So Abram settled in the land of Canaan, and Lot moved his tents to a place near Sodom and settled among the cities of the plain.

verses.kjv_text: But the men of Sodom {were} wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
verses.nlt_text: But the people of this area were extremely wicked and constantly sinned against the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
verses.nlt_text: After Lot had gone, the LORD said to Abram, "Look as far as you can see in every direction-- north and south, east and west.

verses.kjv_text: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.nlt_text: I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, {then} shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.nlt_text: And I will give you so many descendants that, like the dust of the earth, they cannot be counted!

verses.kjv_text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: Go and walk through the land in every direction, for I am giving it to you."

verses.kjv_text: Then Abram removed {his} tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which {is} in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD. {plain: Heb. plains}
verses.nlt_text: So Abram moved his camp to Hebron and settled near the oak grove belonging to Mamre. There he built another altar to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
verses.nlt_text: About this time war broke out in the region. King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Kedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim

verses.kjv_text: {That these} made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.nlt_text: fought against King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

verses.kjv_text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.nlt_text: This second group of kings joined forces in Siddim Valley (that is, the valley of the Dead Sea).

verses.kjv_text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.nlt_text: For twelve years they had been subject to King Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled against him.

verses.kjv_text: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that {were} with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim, {Shaveh...: or, The plain of Kiriathaim}
verses.nlt_text: One year later Kedorlaomer and his allies arrived and defeated the Rephaites at Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzites at Ham, the Emites at Shaveh-kiriathaim,

verses.kjv_text: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which {is} by the wilderness. {Elparan: or, The plain of Paran}
verses.nlt_text: and the Horites at Mount Seir, as far as El-paran at the edge of the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which {is} Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
verses.nlt_text: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat (now called Kadesh) and conquered all the territory of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites living in Hazazon-tamar.

verses.kjv_text: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same {is} Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.nlt_text: Then the rebel kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela (also called Zoar) prepared for battle in the valley of the Dead Sea.

verses.kjv_text: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
verses.nlt_text: They fought against King Kedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar-- four kings against five.

verses.kjv_text: And the vale of Siddim {was full of} slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.nlt_text: As it happened, the valley of the Dead Sea was filled with tar pits. And as the army of the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some fell into the tar pits, while the rest escaped into the mountains.

verses.kjv_text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.nlt_text: The victorious invaders then plundered Sodom and Gomorrah and headed for home, taking with them all the spoils of war and the food supplies.

verses.kjv_text: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.nlt_text: They also captured Lot-- Abram's nephew who lived in Sodom-- and carried off everything he owned.

verses.kjv_text: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these {were} confederate with Abram. {plain: Heb. plains}
verses.nlt_text: But one of Lot's men escaped and reported everything to Abram the Hebrew, who was living near the oak grove belonging to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his relatives, Eshcol and Aner, were Abram's allies.

verses.kjv_text: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained {servants}, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued {them} unto Dan. {armed: or, led forth} {trained: or, instructed}
verses.nlt_text: When Abram heard that his nephew Lot had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men who had been born into his household. Then he pursued Kedorlaomer's army until he caught up with them at Dan.

verses.kjv_text: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which {is} on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.nlt_text: There he divided his men and attacked during the night. Kedorlaomer's army fled, but Abram chased them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

verses.kjv_text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.nlt_text: Abram recovered all the goods that had been taken, and he brought back his nephew Lot with his possessions and all the women and other captives.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that {were} with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which {is} the king's dale.
verses.nlt_text: After Abram returned from his victory over Kedorlaomer and all his allies, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King's Valley).

verses.kjv_text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he {was} the priest of the most high God.
verses.nlt_text: And Melchizedek, the king of Salem and a priest of God Most High, brought Abram some bread and wine.

verses.kjv_text: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed {be} Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.nlt_text: Melchizedek blessed Abram with this blessing: "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

verses.kjv_text: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
verses.nlt_text: And blessed be God Most High, who has defeated your enemies for you." Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of all the goods he had recovered.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself. {persons: Heb. souls}
verses.nlt_text: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give back my people who were captured. But you may keep for yourself all the goods you have recovered."

verses.kjv_text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.nlt_text: Abram replied to the king of Sodom, "I solemnly swear to the LORD, God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

verses.kjv_text: That I will not {take} from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that {is} thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.nlt_text: that I will not take so much as a single thread or sandal thong from what belongs to you. Otherwise you might say, 'I am the one who made Abram rich.'

verses.kjv_text: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
verses.nlt_text: I will accept only what my young warriors have already eaten, and I request that you give a fair share of the goods to my allies-- Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre."

verses.kjv_text: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I {am} thy shield, {and} thy exceeding great reward.
verses.nlt_text: Some time later, the LORD spoke to Abram in a vision and said to him, "Do not be afraid, Abram, for I will protect you, and your reward will be great."

verses.kjv_text: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house {is} this Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.nlt_text: But Abram replied, "O Sovereign LORD, what good are all your blessings when I don't even have a son? Since you've given me no children, Eliezer of Damascus, a servant in my household, will inherit all my wealth.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
verses.nlt_text: You have given me no descendants of my own, so one of my servants will be my heir."

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, the word of the LORD {came} unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to him, "No, your servant will not be your heir, for you will have a son of your own who will be your heir."

verses.kjv_text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD took Abram outside and said to him, "Look up into the sky and count the stars if you can. That's how many descendants you will have!"

verses.kjv_text: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: And Abram believed the LORD, and the LORD counted him as righteous because of his faith.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, I {am} the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD told him, "I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land as your possession."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.nlt_text: But Abram replied, "O Sovereign LORD, how can I be sure that I will actually possess it?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD told him, "Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."

verses.kjv_text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
verses.nlt_text: So Abram presented all these to him and killed them. Then he cut each animal down the middle and laid the halves side by side; he did not, however, cut the birds in half.

verses.kjv_text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
verses.nlt_text: Some vultures swooped down to eat the carcasses, but Abram chased them away.

verses.kjv_text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.nlt_text: As the sun was going down, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a terrifying darkness came down over him.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land {that is} not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Abram, "You can be sure that your descendants will be strangers in a foreign land, where they will be oppressed as slaves for 400 years.

verses.kjv_text: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.nlt_text: But I will punish the nation that enslaves them, and in the end they will come away with great wealth.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.nlt_text: (As for you, you will die in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.)

verses.kjv_text: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites {is} not yet full.
verses.nlt_text: After four generations your descendants will return here to this land, for the sins of the Amorites do not yet warrant their destruction."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces. {a burning...: Heb. a lamp of fire}
verses.nlt_text: After the sun went down and darkness fell, Abram saw a smoking firepot and a flaming torch pass between the halves of the carcasses.

verses.kjv_text: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD made a covenant with Abram that day and said, "I have given this land to your descendants, all the way from the border of Egypt to the great Euphrates River--

verses.kjv_text: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
verses.nlt_text: the land now occupied by the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
verses.nlt_text: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
verses.nlt_text: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites."

verses.kjv_text: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name {was} Hagar.
verses.nlt_text: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had not been able to bear children for him. But she had an Egyptian servant named Hagar.

verses.kjv_text: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai. {obtain...: Heb. be built by her}
verses.nlt_text: So Sarai said to Abram, "The LORD has prevented me from having children. Go and sleep with my servant. Perhaps I can have children through her." And Abram agreed with Sarai's proposal.

verses.kjv_text: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
verses.nlt_text: So Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar the Egyptian servant and gave her to Abram as a wife. (This happened ten years after Abram had settled in the land of Canaan.)

verses.kjv_text: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.nlt_text: So Abram had sexual relations with Hagar, and she became pregnant. But when Hagar knew she was pregnant, she began to treat her mistress, Sarai, with contempt.

verses.kjv_text: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong {be} upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then Sarai said to Abram, "This is all your fault! I put my servant into your arms, but now that she's pregnant she treats me with contempt. The LORD will show who's wrong-- you or me!"

verses.kjv_text: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid {is} in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face. {as...: Heb. that which is good in thine eyes} {dealt...: Heb. afflicted her}
verses.nlt_text: Abram replied, "Look, she is your servant, so deal with her as you see fit." Then Sarai treated Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.nlt_text: The angel of the LORD found Hagar beside a spring of water in the wilderness, along the road to Shur.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.nlt_text: The angel said to her, "Hagar, Sarai's servant, where have you come from, and where are you going?" "I'm running away from my mistress, Sarai," she replied.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.nlt_text: The angel of the LORD said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit to her authority."

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.nlt_text: Then he added, "I will give you more descendants than you can count."

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou {art} with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction. {Ishmael: that is, God shall hear}
verses.nlt_text: And the angel also said, "You are now pregnant and will give birth to a son. You are to name him Ishmael (which means 'God hears'), for the LORD has heard your cry of distress.

verses.kjv_text: And he will be a wild man; his hand {will be} against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: This son of yours will be a wild man, as untamed as a wild donkey! He will raise his fist against everyone, and everyone will be against him. Yes, he will live in open hostility against all his relatives."

verses.kjv_text: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.nlt_text: Thereafter, Hagar used another name to refer to the LORD, who had spoken to her. She said, "You are the God who sees me." She also said, "Have I truly seen the One who sees me?"

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, {it is} between Kadesh and Bered. {Beerlahairoi: that is, The well of him that liveth and seeth me}
verses.nlt_text: So that well was named Beer-lahai-roi (which means "well of the Living One who sees me"). It can still be found between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.kjv_text: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.nlt_text: So Hagar gave Abram a son, and Abram named him Ishmael.

verses.kjv_text: And Abram {was} fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.nlt_text: Abram was eighty-six years old when Ishmael was born.

verses.kjv_text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I {am} the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect. {perfect: or, upright, or, sincere}
verses.nlt_text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, "I am El-Shaddai-- 'God Almighty.' Serve me faithfully and live a blameless life.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.nlt_text: I will make a covenant with you, by which I will guarantee to give you countless descendants."

verses.kjv_text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
verses.nlt_text: At this, Abram fell face down on the ground. Then God said to him,

verses.kjv_text: As for me, behold, my covenant {is} with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations. {many...: Heb. multitude of nations}
verses.nlt_text: "This is my covenant with you: I will make you the father of a multitude of nations!

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee. {Abraham: that is, Father of a great multitude}
verses.nlt_text: What's more, I am changing your name. It will no longer be Abram. Instead, you will be called Abraham, for you will be the father of many nations.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.nlt_text: I will make you extremely fruitful. Your descendants will become many nations, and kings will be among them!

verses.kjv_text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
verses.nlt_text: "I will confirm my covenant with you and your descendants after you, from generation to generation. This is the everlasting covenant: I will always be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

verses.kjv_text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God. {wherein...: Heb. of thy sojournings}
verses.nlt_text: And I will give the entire land of Canaan, where you now live as a foreigner, to you and your descendants. It will be their possession forever, and I will be their God."

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said to Abraham, "Your responsibility is to obey the terms of the covenant. You and all your descendants have this continual responsibility.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
verses.nlt_text: This is the covenant that you and your descendants must keep: Each male among you must be circumcised.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
verses.nlt_text: You must cut off the flesh of your foreskin as a sign of the covenant between me and you.

verses.kjv_text: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which {is} not of thy seed. {he that is eight...: Heb. a son of eight days}
verses.nlt_text: From generation to generation, every male child must be circumcised on the eighth day after his birth. This applies not only to members of your family but also to the servants born in your household and the foreign-born servants whom you have purchased.

verses.kjv_text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.nlt_text: All must be circumcised. Your bodies will bear the mark of my everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv_text: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
verses.nlt_text: Any male who fails to be circumcised will be cut off from the covenant family for breaking the covenant."

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah {shall} her name {be}. {Sarah: that is Princess}
verses.nlt_text: Then God said to Abraham, "Regarding Sarai, your wife-- her name will no longer be Sarai. From now on her name will be Sarah.

verses.kjv_text: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be {a mother} of nations; kings of people shall be of her. {she...: Heb. she shall become nations}
verses.nlt_text: And I will bless her and give you a son from her! Yes, I will bless her richly, and she will become the mother of many nations. Kings of nations will be among her descendants."

verses.kjv_text: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall {a child} be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham bowed down to the ground, but he laughed to himself in disbelief. "How could I become a father at the age of 100?" he thought. "And how can Sarah have a baby when she is ninety years old?"

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.nlt_text: So Abraham said to God, "May Ishmael live under your special blessing!"

verses.kjv_text: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, {and} with his seed after him.
verses.nlt_text: But God replied, "No-- Sarah, your wife, will give birth to a son for you. You will name him Isaac, and I will confirm my covenant with him and his descendants as an everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv_text: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.nlt_text: As for Ishmael, I will bless him also, just as you have asked. I will make him extremely fruitful and multiply his descendants. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

verses.kjv_text: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
verses.nlt_text: But my covenant will be confirmed with Isaac, who will be born to you and Sarah about this time next year."

verses.kjv_text: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: When God had finished speaking, he left Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
verses.nlt_text: On that very day Abraham took his son, Ishmael, and every male in his household, including those born there and those he had bought. Then he circumcised them, cutting off their foreskins, just as God had told him.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham {was} ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,

verses.kjv_text: And Ishmael his son {was} thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.nlt_text: and Ishmael, his son, was thirteen.

verses.kjv_text: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.nlt_text: Both Abraham and his son, Ishmael, were circumcised on that same day,

verses.kjv_text: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.nlt_text: along with all the other men and boys of the household, whether they were born there or bought as servants. All were circumcised with him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day; {plain: Heb. plains}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD appeared again to Abraham near the oak grove belonging to Mamre. One day Abraham was sitting at the entrance to his tent during the hottest part of the day.

verses.kjv_text: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw {them}, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
verses.nlt_text: He looked up and noticed three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he ran to meet them and welcomed them, bowing low to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.nlt_text: "My lord," he said, "if it pleases you, stop here for a while.

verses.kjv_text: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.nlt_text: Rest in the shade of this tree while water is brought to wash your feet.

verses.kjv_text: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said. {comfort: Heb. stay} {are...: Heb. you have passed}
verses.nlt_text: And since you've honored your servant with this visit, let me prepare some food to refresh you before you continue on your journey." "All right," they said. "Do as you have said."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead {it}, and make cakes upon the hearth. {Make ready...: Heb. Hasten}
verses.nlt_text: So Abraham ran back to the tent and said to Sarah, "Hurry! Get three large measures of your best flour, knead it into dough, and bake some bread."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave {it} unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham ran out to the herd and chose a tender calf and gave it to his servant, who quickly prepared it.

verses.kjv_text: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set {it} before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.nlt_text: When the food was ready, Abraham took some yogurt and milk and the roasted meat, and he served it to the men. As they ate, Abraham waited on them in the shade of the trees.

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto him, Where {is} Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.nlt_text: "Where is Sarah, your wife?" the visitors asked."She's inside the tent," Abraham replied.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard {it} in the tent door, which {was} behind him.
verses.nlt_text: Then one of them said, "I will return to you about this time next year, and your wife, Sarah, will have a son!" Sarah was listening to this conversation from the tent.

verses.kjv_text: Now Abraham and Sarah {were} old {and} well stricken in age; {and} it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham and Sarah were both very old by this time, and Sarah was long past the age of having children.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.nlt_text: So she laughed silently to herself and said, "How could a worn-out woman like me enjoy such pleasure, especially when my master-- my husband-- is also so old?"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh? Why did she say, 'Can an old woman like me have a baby?'

verses.kjv_text: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.nlt_text: Is anything too hard for the LORD? I will return about this time next year, and Sarah will have a son."

verses.kjv_text: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.nlt_text: Sarah was afraid, so she denied it, saying, "I didn't laugh." But the LORD said, "No, you did laugh."

verses.kjv_text: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.nlt_text: Then the men got up from their meal and looked out toward Sodom. As they left, Abraham went with them to send them on their way.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
verses.nlt_text: "Should I hide my plan from Abraham?" the LORD asked.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.nlt_text: "For Abraham will certainly become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed through him.

verses.kjv_text: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.nlt_text: I have singled him out so that he will direct his sons and their families to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just. Then I will do for Abraham all that I have promised."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD told Abraham, "I have heard a great outcry from Sodom and Gomorrah, because their sin is so flagrant.

verses.kjv_text: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.nlt_text: I am going down to see if their actions are as wicked as I have heard. If not, I want to know."

verses.kjv_text: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The other men turned and headed toward Sodom, but the LORD remained with Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.nlt_text: Abraham approached him and said, "Will you sweep away both the righteous and the wicked?

verses.kjv_text: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that {are} therein?
verses.nlt_text: Suppose you find fifty righteous people living there in the city-- will you still sweep it away and not spare it for their sakes?

verses.kjv_text: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.nlt_text: Surely you wouldn't do such a thing, destroying the righteous along with the wicked. Why, you would be treating the righteous and the wicked exactly the same! Surely you wouldn't do that! Should not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD replied, "If I find fifty righteous people in Sodom, I will spare the entire city for their sake."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which {am but} dust and ashes:
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham spoke again. "Since I have begun, let me speak further to my Lord, even though I am but dust and ashes.

verses.kjv_text: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for {lack of} five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Suppose there are only forty-five righteous people rather than fifty? Will you destroy the whole city for lack of five?" And the LORD said, "I will not destroy it if I find forty-five righteous people there."

verses.kjv_text: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do {it} for forty's sake.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham pressed his request further. "Suppose there are only forty?" And the LORD replied, "I will not destroy it for the sake of the forty."

verses.kjv_text: And he said {unto him}, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do {it}, if I find thirty there.
verses.nlt_text: "Please don't be angry, my Lord," Abraham pleaded. "Let me speak-- suppose only thirty righteous people are found?" And the LORD replied, "I will not destroy it if I find thirty."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy {it} for twenty's sake.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham said, "Since I have dared to speak to the Lord, let me continue-- suppose there are only twenty?" And the LORD replied, "Then I will not destroy it for the sake of the twenty."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy {it} for ten's sake.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, Abraham said, "Lord, please don't be angry with me if I speak one more time. Suppose only ten are found there?" And the LORD replied, "Then I will not destroy it for the sake of the ten."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.nlt_text: When the LORD had finished his conversation with Abraham, he went on his way, and Abraham returned to his tent.

verses.kjv_text: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing {them} rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
verses.nlt_text: That evening the two angels came to the entrance of the city of Sodom. Lot was sitting there, and when he saw them, he stood up to meet them. Then he welcomed them and bowed with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.nlt_text: "My lords," he said, "come to my home to wash your feet, and be my guests for the night. You may then get up early in the morning and be on your way again." "Oh no," they replied. "We'll just spend the night out here in the city square."

verses.kjv_text: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.nlt_text: But Lot insisted, so at last they went home with him. Lot prepared a feast for them, complete with fresh bread made without yeast, and they ate.

verses.kjv_text: But before they lay down, the men of the city, {even} the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
verses.nlt_text: But before they retired for the night, all the men of Sodom, young and old, came from all over the city and surrounded the house.

verses.kjv_text: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where {are} the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
verses.nlt_text: They shouted to Lot, "Where are the men who came to spend the night with you? Bring them out to us so we can have sex with them!"

verses.kjv_text: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
verses.nlt_text: So Lot stepped outside to talk to them, shutting the door behind him.

verses.kjv_text: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.nlt_text: "Please, my brothers," he begged, "don't do such a wicked thing.

verses.kjv_text: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as {is} good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
verses.nlt_text: Look, I have two virgin daughters. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do with them as you wish. But please, leave these men alone, for they are my guests and are under my protection."

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Stand back. And they said {again}, This one {fellow} came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, {even} Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.nlt_text: "Stand back!" they shouted. "This fellow came to town as an outsider, and now he's acting like our judge! We'll treat you far worse than those other men!" And they lunged toward Lot to break down the door.

verses.kjv_text: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
verses.nlt_text: But the two angels reached out, pulled Lot into the house, and bolted the door.

verses.kjv_text: And they smote the men that {were} at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.nlt_text: Then they blinded all the men, young and old, who were at the door of the house, so they gave up trying to get inside.

verses.kjv_text: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring {them} out of this place:
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the angels questioned Lot. "Do you have any other relatives here in the city?" they asked. "Get them out of this place-- your sons-in-law, sons, daughters, or anyone else.

verses.kjv_text: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.
verses.nlt_text: For we are about to destroy this city completely. The outcry against this place is so great it has reached the LORD, and he has sent us to destroy it."

verses.kjv_text: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
verses.nlt_text: So Lot rushed out to tell his daughters' fianc�s, "Quick, get out of the city! The LORD is about to destroy it." But the young men thought he was only joking.

verses.kjv_text: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city. {are here: Heb. are found} {iniquity: or, punishment}
verses.nlt_text: At dawn the next morning the angels became insistent. "Hurry," they said to Lot. "Take your wife and your two daughters who are here. Get out right now, or you will be swept away in the destruction of the city!"

verses.kjv_text: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.nlt_text: When Lot still hesitated, the angels seized his hand and the hands of his wife and two daughters and rushed them to safety outside the city, for the LORD was merciful.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.nlt_text: When they were safely out of the city, one of the angels ordered, "Run for your lives! And don't look back or stop anywhere in the valley! Escape to the mountains, or you will be swept away!"

verses.kjv_text: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
verses.nlt_text: "Oh no, my lord!" Lot begged.

verses.kjv_text: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
verses.nlt_text: "You have been so gracious to me and saved my life, and you have shown such great kindness. But I cannot go to the mountains. Disaster would catch up to me there, and I would soon die.

verses.kjv_text: Behold now, this city {is} near to flee unto, and it {is} a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, ({is} it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
verses.nlt_text: See, there is a small village nearby. Please let me go there instead; don't you see how small it is? Then my life will be saved."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken. {thee: Heb. thy face}
verses.nlt_text: "All right," the angel said, "I will grant your request. I will not destroy the little village.

verses.kjv_text: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar. {Zoar: that is, Little}
verses.nlt_text: But hurry! Escape to it, for I can do nothing until you arrive there." (This explains why that village was known as Zoar, which means "little place.")

verses.kjv_text: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar. {risen: Heb. gone forth}
verses.nlt_text: Lot reached the village just as the sun was rising over the horizon.

verses.kjv_text: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD rained down fire and burning sulfur from the sky on Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.kjv_text: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.nlt_text: He utterly destroyed them, along with the other cities and villages of the plain, wiping out all the people and every bit of vegetation.

verses.kjv_text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.nlt_text: But Lot's wife looked back as she was following behind him, and she turned into a pillar of salt.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: Abraham got up early that morning and hurried out to the place where he had stood in the LORD's presence.

verses.kjv_text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.nlt_text: He looked out across the plain toward Sodom and Gomorrah and watched as columns of smoke rose from the cities like smoke from a furnace.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
verses.nlt_text: But God had listened to Abraham's request and kept Lot safe, removing him from the disaster that engulfed the cities on the plain.

verses.kjv_text: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward Lot left Zoar because he was afraid of the people there, and he went to live in a cave in the mountains with his two daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father {is} old, and {there is} not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.nlt_text: One day the older daughter said to her sister, "There are no men left anywhere in this entire area, so we can't get married like everyone else. And our father will soon be too old to have children.

verses.kjv_text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.nlt_text: Come, let's get him drunk with wine, and then we will have sex with him. That way we will preserve our family line through our father."

verses.kjv_text: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.nlt_text: So that night they got him drunk with wine, and the older daughter went in and had intercourse with her father. He was unaware of her lying down or getting up again.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, {and} lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.nlt_text: The next morning the older daughter said to her younger sister, "I had sex with our father last night. Let's get him drunk with wine again tonight, and you go in and have sex with him. That way we will preserve our family line through our father."

verses.kjv_text: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.nlt_text: So that night they got him drunk with wine again, and the younger daughter went in and had intercourse with him. As before, he was unaware of her lying down or getting up again.

verses.kjv_text: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, both of Lot's daughters became pregnant by their own father.

verses.kjv_text: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same {is} the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: When the older daughter gave birth to a son, she named him Moab. He became the ancestor of the nation now known as the Moabites.

verses.kjv_text: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same {is} the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: When the younger daughter gave birth to a son, she named him Ben-ammi. He became the ancestor of the nation now known as the Ammonites.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham moved south to the Negev and lived for a while between Kadesh and Shur, and then he moved on to Gerar. While living there as a foreigner,

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She {is} my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham introduced his wife, Sarah, by saying, "She is my sister." So King Abimelech of Gerar sent for Sarah and had her brought to him at his palace.

verses.kjv_text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou {art but} a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she {is} a man's wife. {a man's...: Heb. married to an husband}
verses.nlt_text: But that night God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him, "You are a dead man, for that woman you have taken is already married!"

verses.kjv_text: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
verses.nlt_text: But Abimelech had not slept with her yet, so he said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?

verses.kjv_text: Said he not unto me, She {is} my sister? and she, even she herself said, He {is} my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this. {integrity: or, simplicity, or, sincerity}
verses.nlt_text: Didn't Abraham tell me, 'She is my sister'? And she herself said, 'Yes, he is my brother.' I acted in complete innocence! My hands are clean."

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.nlt_text: In the dream God responded, "Yes, I know you are innocent. That's why I kept you from sinning against me, and why I did not let you touch her.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore restore the man {his} wife; for he {is} a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore {her} not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that {are} thine.
verses.nlt_text: Now return the woman to her husband, and he will pray for you, for he is a prophet. Then you will live. But if you don't return her to him, you can be sure that you and all your people will die."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.nlt_text: Abimelech got up early the next morning and quickly called all his servants together. When he told them what had happened, his men were terrified.

verses.kjv_text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abimelech called for Abraham. "What have you done to us?" he demanded. "What crime have I committed that deserves treatment like this, making me and my kingdom guilty of this great sin? No one should ever do what you have done!

verses.kjv_text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.nlt_text: Whatever possessed you to do such a thing?"

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God {is} not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham replied, "I thought, 'This is a godless place. They will want my wife and will kill me to get her.'

verses.kjv_text: And yet indeed {she is} my sister; she {is} the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.nlt_text: And she really is my sister, for we both have the same father, but different mothers. And I married her.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This {is} thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He {is} my brother.
verses.nlt_text: When God called me to leave my father's home and to travel from place to place, I told her, 'Do me a favor. Wherever we go, tell the people that I am your brother.'"

verses.kjv_text: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave {them} unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abimelech took some of his sheep and goats, cattle, and male and female servants, and he presented them to Abraham. He also returned his wife, Sarah, to him.

verses.kjv_text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land {is} before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee. {where...: Heb. as is good in thine eyes}
verses.nlt_text: Then Abimelech said, "Look over my land and choose any place where you would like to live."

verses.kjv_text: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand {pieces} of silver: behold, he {is} to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that {are} with thee, and with all {other}: thus she was reproved.
verses.nlt_text: And he said to Sarah, "Look, I am giving your 'brother' 1,000 pieces of silver in the presence of all these witnesses. This is to compensate you for any wrong I may have done to you. This will settle any claim against me, and your reputation is cleared."

verses.kjv_text: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare {children}.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, so they could have children.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD had caused all the women to be infertile because of what happened with Abraham's wife, Sarah.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD kept his word and did for Sarah exactly what he had promised.

verses.kjv_text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.nlt_text: She became pregnant, and she gave birth to a son for Abraham in his old age. This happened at just the time God had said it would.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.nlt_text: And Abraham named their son Isaac.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.nlt_text: Eight days after Isaac was born, Abraham circumcised him as God had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham was 100 years old when Isaac was born.

verses.kjv_text: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, {so that} all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.nlt_text: And Sarah declared, "God has brought me laughter. All who hear about this will laugh with me.

verses.kjv_text: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born {him} a son in his old age.
verses.nlt_text: Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse a baby? Yet I have given Abraham a son in his old age!"

verses.kjv_text: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the {same} day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.nlt_text: When Isaac grew up and was about to be weaned, Abraham prepared a huge feast to celebrate the occasion.

verses.kjv_text: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.nlt_text: But Sarah saw Ishmael-- the son of Abraham and her Egyptian servant Hagar-- making fun of her son, Isaac.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, {even} with Isaac.
verses.nlt_text: So she turned to Abraham and demanded, "Get rid of that slave-woman and her son. He is not going to share the inheritance with my son, Isaac. I won't have it!"

verses.kjv_text: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
verses.nlt_text: This upset Abraham very much because Ishmael was his son.

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.nlt_text: But God told Abraham, "Do not be upset over the boy and your servant. Do whatever Sarah tells you, for Isaac is the son through whom your descendants will be counted.

verses.kjv_text: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he {is} thy seed.
verses.nlt_text: But I will also make a nation of the descendants of Hagar's son because he is your son, too."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave {it} unto Hagar, putting {it} on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.nlt_text: So Abraham got up early the next morning, prepared food and a container of water, and strapped them on Hagar's shoulders. Then he sent her away with their son, and she wandered aimlessly in the wilderness of Beersheba.

verses.kjv_text: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.nlt_text: When the water was gone, she put the boy in the shade of a bush.

verses.kjv_text: And she went, and sat her down over against {him} a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against {him}, and lift up her voice, and wept.
verses.nlt_text: Then she went and sat down by herself about a hundred yards away. "I don't want to watch the boy die," she said, as she burst into tears.

verses.kjv_text: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he {is}.
verses.nlt_text: But God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, "Hagar, what's wrong? Do not be afraid! God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.

verses.kjv_text: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.nlt_text: Go to him and comfort him, for I will make a great nation from his descendants."

verses.kjv_text: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.nlt_text: Then God opened Hagar's eyes, and she saw a well full of water. She quickly filled her water container and gave the boy a drink.

verses.kjv_text: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.nlt_text: And God was with the boy as he grew up in the wilderness. He became a skillful archer,

verses.kjv_text: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: and he settled in the wilderness of Paran. His mother arranged for him to marry a woman from the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God {is} with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.nlt_text: About this time, Abimelech came with Phicol, his army commander, to visit Abraham. "God is obviously with you, helping you in everything you do," Abimelech said.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: {but} according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned. {that thou...: Heb. if thou shalt lie unto me}
verses.nlt_text: "Swear to me in God's name that you will never deceive me, my children, or any of my descendants. I have been loyal to you, so now swear that you will be loyal to me and to this country where you are living as a foreigner."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham replied, "Yes, I swear to it!"

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well that Abimelech's servants had taken by force from Abraham's servants.

verses.kjv_text: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I {of it}, but to day.
verses.nlt_text: "This is the first I've heard of it," Abimelech answered. "I have no idea who is responsible. You have never complained about this before."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham then gave some of his sheep, goats, and cattle to Abimelech, and they made a treaty.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.nlt_text: But Abraham also took seven additional female lambs and set them off by themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What {mean} these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.nlt_text: Abimelech asked, "Why have you set these seven apart from the others?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, For {these} seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham replied, "Please accept these seven lambs to show your agreement that I dug this well."

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them. {Beersheba: that is, The well of the oath}
verses.nlt_text: Then he named the place Beersheba (which means "well of the oath"), because that was where they had sworn the oath.

verses.kjv_text: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.nlt_text: After making their covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech left with Phicol, the commander of his army, and they returned home to the land of the Philistines.

verses.kjv_text: And {Abraham} planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God. {grove: or, tree}
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham planted a tamarisk tree at Beersheba, and there he worshiped the LORD, the Eternal God.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
verses.nlt_text: And Abraham lived as a foreigner in Philistine country for a long time.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, {here} I {am}. {Behold...: Heb. Behold me}
verses.nlt_text: Some time later, God tested Abraham's faith. "Abraham!" God called."Yes," he replied. "Here I am."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only {son} Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.nlt_text: "Take your son, your only son-- yes, Isaac, whom you love so much-- and go to the land of Moriah. Go and sacrifice him as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.nlt_text: The next morning Abraham got up early. He saddled his donkey and took two of his servants with him, along with his son, Isaac. Then he chopped wood for a fire for a burnt offering and set out for the place God had told him about.

verses.kjv_text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.nlt_text: On the third day of their journey, Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
verses.nlt_text: "Stay here with the donkey," Abraham told the servants. "The boy and I will travel a little farther. We will worship there, and then we will come right back."

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid {it} upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.nlt_text: So Abraham placed the wood for the burnt offering on Isaac's shoulders, while he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them walked on together,
