verses.nlt_text: But when Jacob woke up in the morning-- it was Leah! "What have you done to me?" Jacob raged at Laban. "I worked seven years for Rachel! Why have you tricked me?"

verses.kjv_text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn. {country: Heb. place}
verses.nlt_text: "It's not our custom here to marry off a younger daughter ahead of the firstborn," Laban replied.

verses.kjv_text: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
verses.nlt_text: "But wait until the bridal week is over, then we'll give you Rachel, too-- provided you promise to work another seven years for me."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob agreed to work seven more years. A week after Jacob had married Leah, Laban gave him Rachel, too.

verses.kjv_text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
verses.nlt_text: (Laban gave Rachel a servant, Bilhah, to be her maid.)

verses.kjv_text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob slept with Rachel, too, and he loved her much more than Leah. He then stayed and worked for Laban the additional seven years.

verses.kjv_text: And when the LORD saw that Leah {was} hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel {was} barren.
verses.nlt_text: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, he enabled her to have children, but Rachel could not conceive.

verses.kjv_text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me. {Reuben: that is, See a son}
verses.nlt_text: So Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "The LORD has noticed my misery, and now my husband will love me."

verses.kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I {was} hated, he hath therefore given me this {son} also: and she called his name Simeon. {Simeon: that is, Hearing}
verses.nlt_text: She soon became pregnant again and gave birth to another son. She named him Simeon, for she said, "The LORD heard that I was unloved and has given me another son."

verses.kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi. {Levi: that is, Joined}
verses.nlt_text: Then she became pregnant a third time and gave birth to another son. She named him Levi, for she said, "Surely this time my husband will feel affection for me, since I have given him three sons!"

verses.kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing. {Judah: that is, Praise} {left...: Heb. stood from bearing}
verses.nlt_text: Once again Leah became pregnant and gave birth to another son. She named him Judah, for she said, "Now I will praise the LORD!" And then she stopped having children.

verses.kjv_text: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.nlt_text: When Rachel saw that she wasn't having any children for Jacob, she became jealous of her sister. She pleaded with Jacob, "Give me children, or I'll die!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, {Am} I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob became furious with Rachel. "Am I God?" he asked. "He's the one who has kept you from having children!"

verses.kjv_text: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her. {have...: Heb. be built by her}
verses.nlt_text: Then Rachel told him, "Take my maid, Bilhah, and sleep with her. She will bear children for me, and through her I can have a family, too."

verses.kjv_text: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.nlt_text: So Rachel gave her servant, Bilhah, to Jacob as a wife, and he slept with her.

verses.kjv_text: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.nlt_text: Bilhah became pregnant and presented him with a son.

verses.kjv_text: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan. {Dan: that is, Judging}
verses.nlt_text: Rachel named him Dan, for she said, "God has vindicated me! He has heard my request and given me a son."

verses.kjv_text: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.nlt_text: Then Bilhah became pregnant again and gave Jacob a second son.

verses.kjv_text: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali. {great...: Heb. wrestlings of God} {Naphtali: that is, My wrestling: Gr. Nephthalim}
verses.nlt_text: Rachel named him Naphtali, for she said, "I have struggled hard with my sister, and I'm winning!"

verses.kjv_text: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Leah realized that she wasn't getting pregnant anymore, so she took her servant, Zilpah, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

verses.kjv_text: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
verses.nlt_text: Soon Zilpah presented him with a son.

verses.kjv_text: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad. {Gad: that is, A troop, or, company}
verses.nlt_text: Leah named him Gad, for she said, "How fortunate I am!"

verses.kjv_text: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.nlt_text: Then Zilpah gave Jacob a second son.

verses.kjv_text: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher. {Happy...: Heb. In my happiness} {Asher: that is, Happy}
verses.nlt_text: And Leah named him Asher, for she said, "What joy is mine! Now the other women will celebrate with me."

verses.kjv_text: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
verses.nlt_text: One day during the wheat harvest, Reuben found some mandrakes growing in a field and brought them to his mother, Leah. Rachel begged Leah, "Please give me some of your son's mandrakes."

verses.kjv_text: And she said unto her, {Is it} a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
verses.nlt_text: But Leah angrily replied, "Wasn't it enough that you stole my husband? Now will you steal my son's mandrakes, too?" Rachel answered, "I will let Jacob sleep with you tonight if you give me some of the mandrakes."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.nlt_text: So that evening, as Jacob was coming home from the fields, Leah went out to meet him. "You must come and sleep with me tonight!" she said. "I have paid for you with some mandrakes that my son found." So that night he slept with Leah.

verses.kjv_text: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
verses.nlt_text: And God answered Leah's prayers. She became pregnant again and gave birth to a fifth son for Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar. {Issachar: that is, An hire}
verses.nlt_text: She named him Issachar, for she said, "God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband as a wife."

verses.kjv_text: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
verses.nlt_text: Then Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth son for Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: And Leah said, God hath endued me {with} a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun. {Zebulun: that is, Dwelling: Gr. Zabulon}
verses.nlt_text: She named him Zebulun, for she said, "God has given me a good reward. Now my husband will treat me with respect, for I have given him six sons."

verses.kjv_text: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah. {Dinah: that is Judgment}
verses.nlt_text: Later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

verses.kjv_text: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.nlt_text: Then God remembered Rachel's plight and answered her prayers by enabling her to have children.

verses.kjv_text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.nlt_text: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. "God has removed my disgrace," she said.

verses.kjv_text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son. {Joseph: that is, Adding}
verses.nlt_text: And she named him Joseph, for she said, "May the LORD add yet another son to my family."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.nlt_text: Soon after Rachel had given birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Please release me so I can go home to my own country.

verses.kjv_text: Give {me} my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.nlt_text: Let me take my wives and children, for I have earned them by serving you, and let me be on my way. You certainly know how hard I have worked for you."

verses.kjv_text: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, {tarry: for} I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.nlt_text: "Please listen to me," Laban replied. "I have become wealthy, for the LORD has blessed me because of you.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Tell me how much I owe you. Whatever it is, I'll pay it."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob replied, "You know how hard I've worked for you, and how your flocks and herds have grown under my care.

verses.kjv_text: For {it was} little which thou hadst before I {came}, and it is {now} increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also? {increased: Heb. broken forth} {since...: Heb. at my foot}
verses.nlt_text: You had little indeed before I came, but your wealth has increased enormously. The LORD has blessed you through everything I've done. But now, what about me? When can I start providing for my own family?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed {and} keep thy flock:
verses.nlt_text: "What wages do you want?" Laban asked again.Jacob replied, "Don't give me anything. Just do this one thing, and I'll continue to tend and watch over your flocks.

verses.kjv_text: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and {of such} shall be my hire.
verses.nlt_text: Let me inspect your flocks today and remove all the sheep and goats that are speckled or spotted, along with all the black sheep. Give these to me as my wages.

verses.kjv_text: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that {is} not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me. {in time...: Heb. to morrow}
verses.nlt_text: In the future, when you check on the animals you have given me as my wages, you'll see that I have been honest. If you find in my flock any goats without speckles or spots, or any sheep that are not black, you will know that I have stolen them from you."

verses.kjv_text: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.nlt_text: "All right," Laban replied. "It will be as you say."

verses.kjv_text: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, {and} every one that had {some} white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave {them} into the hand of his sons.
verses.nlt_text: But that very day Laban went out and removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, all the female goats that were speckled and spotted or had white patches, and all the black sheep. He placed them in the care of his own sons,

verses.kjv_text: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
verses.nlt_text: who took them a three-days' journey from where Jacob was. Meanwhile, Jacob stayed and cared for the rest of Laban's flock.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which {was} in the rods.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob took some fresh branches from poplar, almond, and plane trees and peeled off strips of bark, making white streaks on them.

verses.kjv_text: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.nlt_text: Then he placed these peeled branches in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink, for that was where they mated.

verses.kjv_text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.nlt_text: And when they mated in front of the white-streaked branches, they gave birth to young that were streaked, speckled, and spotted.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob separated those lambs from Laban's flock. And at mating time he turned the flock to face Laban's animals that were streaked or black. This is how he built his own flock instead of increasing Laban's.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.nlt_text: Whenever the stronger females were ready to mate, Jacob would place the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of them. Then they would mate in front of the branches.

verses.kjv_text: But when the cattle were feeble, he put {them} not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
verses.nlt_text: But he didn't do this with the weaker ones, so the weaker lambs belonged to Laban, and the stronger ones were Jacob's.

verses.kjv_text: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, Jacob became very wealthy, with large flocks of sheep and goats, male and female servants, and many camels and donkeys.

verses.kjv_text: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that {was} our father's; and of {that} which {was} our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.nlt_text: But Jacob soon learned that Laban's sons were grumbling about him. "Jacob has robbed our father of everything!" they said. "He has gained all his wealth at our father's expense."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it {was} not toward him as before. {as before: Heb. as yesterday and the day before}
verses.nlt_text: And Jacob began to notice a change in Laban's attitude toward him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your father and grandfather and to your relatives there, and I will be with you."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob called Rachel and Leah out to the field where he was watching his flock.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it {is} not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.nlt_text: He said to them, "I have noticed that your father's attitude toward me has changed. But the God of my father has been with me.

verses.kjv_text: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.nlt_text: You know how hard I have worked for your father,

verses.kjv_text: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.nlt_text: but he has cheated me, changing my wages ten times. But God has not allowed him to do me any harm.

verses.kjv_text: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.nlt_text: For if he said, 'The speckled animals will be your wages,' the whole flock began to produce speckled young. And when he changed his mind and said, 'The striped animals will be your wages,' then the whole flock produced striped young.

verses.kjv_text: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given {them} to me.
verses.nlt_text: In this way, God has taken your father's animals and given them to me.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle {were} ringstraked, speckled, and grisled. {rams: or, he goats}
verses.nlt_text: "One time during the mating season, I had a dream and saw that the male goats mating with the females were streaked, speckled, and spotted.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, {saying}, Jacob: And I said, Here {am} I.
verses.nlt_text: Then in my dream, the angel of God said to me, 'Jacob!' And I replied, 'Yes, here I am.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle {are} ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: "The angel said, 'Look up, and you will see that only the streaked, speckled, and spotted males are mating with the females of your flock. For I have seen how Laban has treated you.

verses.kjv_text: I {am} the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, {and} where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.nlt_text: I am the God who appeared to you at Bethel, the place where you anointed the pillar of stone and made your vow to me. Now get ready and leave this country and return to the land of your birth.' "

verses.kjv_text: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, {Is there} yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.nlt_text: Rachel and Leah responded, "That's fine with us! We won't inherit any of our father's wealth anyway.

verses.kjv_text: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.nlt_text: He has reduced our rights to those of foreign women. And after he sold us, he wasted the money you paid him for us.

verses.kjv_text: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that {is} ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.nlt_text: All the wealth God has given you from our father legally belongs to us and our children. So go ahead and do whatever God has told you."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob put his wives and children on camels,

verses.kjv_text: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: and he drove all his livestock in front of him. He packed all the belongings he had acquired in Paddan-aram and set out for the land of Canaan, where his father, Isaac, lived.

verses.kjv_text: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that {were} her father's. {images: Heb. teraphim}
verses.nlt_text: At the time they left, Laban was some distance away, shearing his sheep. Rachel stole her father's household idols and took them with her.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled. {unawares...: Heb. the heart of Laban}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob outwitted Laban the Aramean, for they set out secretly and never told Laban they were leaving.

verses.kjv_text: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face {toward} the mount Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob took all his possessions with him and crossed the Euphrates River, heading for the hill country of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.nlt_text: Three days later, Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

verses.kjv_text: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: So he gathered a group of his relatives and set out in hot pursuit. He caught up with Jacob seven days later in the hill country of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad. {either...: Heb. from good to bad}
verses.nlt_text: But the previous night God had appeared to Laban the Aramean in a dream and told him, "I'm warning you-- leave Jacob alone!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: Laban caught up with Jacob as he was camped in the hill country of Gilead, and he set up his camp not far from Jacob's.

verses.kjv_text: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives {taken} with the sword?
verses.nlt_text: "What do you mean by stealing away like this?" Laban demanded. "How dare you drag my daughters away like prisoners of war?

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp? {steal...: Heb. hast stolen me}
verses.nlt_text: Why did you slip away secretly? Why did you steal away? And why didn't you say you wanted to leave? I would have given you a farewell feast, with singing and music, accompanied by tambourines and harps.

verses.kjv_text: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in {so} doing.
verses.nlt_text: Why didn't you let me kiss my daughters and grandchildren and tell them good-bye? You have acted very foolishly!

verses.kjv_text: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.nlt_text: I could destroy you, but the God of your father appeared to me last night and warned me, 'Leave Jacob alone!'

verses.kjv_text: And now, {though} thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, {yet} wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.nlt_text: I can understand your feeling that you must go, and your intense longing for your father's home. But why have you stolen my gods?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.nlt_text: "I rushed away because I was afraid," Jacob answered. "I thought you would take your daughters from me by force.

verses.kjv_text: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what {is} thine with me, and take {it} to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.nlt_text: But as for your gods, see if you can find them, and let the person who has taken them die! And if you find anything else that belongs to you, identify it before all these relatives of ours, and I will give it back!" But Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the household idols.

verses.kjv_text: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found {them} not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.nlt_text: Laban went first into Jacob's tent to search there, then into Leah's, and then the tents of the two servant wives-- but he found nothing. Finally, he went into Rachel's tent.

verses.kjv_text: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found {them} not. {searched: Heb. felt}
verses.nlt_text: But Rachel had taken the household idols and hidden them in her camel saddle, and now she was sitting on them. When Laban had thoroughly searched her tent without finding them,

verses.kjv_text: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women {is} upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
verses.nlt_text: she said to her father, "Please, sir, forgive me if I don't get up for you. I'm having my monthly period." So Laban continued his search, but he could not find the household idols.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What {is} my trespass? what {is} my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob became very angry, and he challenged Laban. "What's my crime?" he demanded. "What have I done wrong to make you chase after me as though I were a criminal?

verses.kjv_text: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set {it} here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both. {searched: Heb. felt}
verses.nlt_text: You have rummaged through everything I own. Now show me what you found that belongs to you! Set it out here in front of us, before our relatives, for all to see. Let them judge between us!

verses.kjv_text: This twenty years {have} I {been} with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.nlt_text: "For twenty years I have been with you, caring for your flocks. In all that time your sheep and goats never miscarried. In all those years I never used a single ram of yours for food.

verses.kjv_text: That which was torn {of beasts} I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, {whether} stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.nlt_text: If any were attacked and killed by wild animals, I never showed you the carcass and asked you to reduce the count of your flock. No, I took the loss myself! You made me pay for every stolen animal, whether it was taken in broad daylight or in the dark of night.

verses.kjv_text: {Thus} I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.nlt_text: "I worked for you through the scorching heat of the day and through cold and sleepless nights.

verses.kjv_text: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, for twenty years I slaved in your house! I worked for fourteen years earning your two daughters, and then six more years for your flock. And you changed my wages ten times!

verses.kjv_text: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked {thee} yesternight.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, if the God of my father had not been on my side-- the God of Abraham and the fearsome God of Isaac-- you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen your abuse and my hard work. That is why he appeared to you last night and rebuked you!"

verses.kjv_text: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, {These} daughters {are} my daughters, and {these} children {are} my children, and {these} cattle {are} my cattle, and all that thou seest {is} mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.nlt_text: Then Laban replied to Jacob, "These women are my daughters, these children are my grandchildren, and these flocks are my flocks-- in fact, everything you see is mine. But what can I do now about my daughters and their children?

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.nlt_text: So come, let's make a covenant, you and I, and it will be a witness to our commitment."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up {for} a pillar.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a monument.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.nlt_text: Then he told his family members, "Gather some stones." So they gathered stones and piled them in a heap. Then Jacob and Laban sat down beside the pile of stones to eat a covenant meal.

verses.kjv_text: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed. {Jegarsahadutha: that is, The heap of witness, Chaldee} {Galeed: that is, The heap of witness, Heb.}
verses.nlt_text: To commemorate the event, Laban called the place Jegar-sahadutha (which means "witness pile" in Aramaic), and Jacob called it Galeed (which means "witness pile" in Hebrew).

verses.kjv_text: And Laban said, This heap {is} a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.nlt_text: Then Laban declared, "This pile of stones will stand as a witness to remind us of the covenant we have made today." This explains why it was called Galeed-- "Witness Pile."

verses.kjv_text: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another. {Mizpah: that is, A beacon, or, watchtower}
verses.nlt_text: But it was also called Mizpah (which means "watchtower"), for Laban said, "May the LORD keep watch between us to make sure that we keep this covenant when we are out of each other's sight.

verses.kjv_text: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take {other} wives beside my daughters, no man {is} with us; see, God {is} witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.nlt_text: If you mistreat my daughters or if you marry other wives, God will see it even if no one else does. He is a witness to this covenant between us.

verses.kjv_text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold {this} pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;
verses.nlt_text: "See this pile of stones," Laban continued, "and see this monument I have set between us.

verses.kjv_text: This heap {be} witness, and {this} pillar {be} witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.nlt_text: They stand between us as witnesses of our vows. I will never pass this pile of stones to harm you, and you must never pass these stones or this monument to harm me.

verses.kjv_text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.nlt_text: I call on the God of our ancestors-- the God of your grandfather Abraham and the God of my grandfather Nahor-- to serve as a judge between us." So Jacob took an oath before the fearsome God of his father, Isaac, to respect the boundary line.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount. {offered...: or, killed beasts}
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice to God there on the mountain and invited everyone to a covenant feast. After they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.

verses.kjv_text: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.nlt_text: Laban got up early the next morning, and he kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.nlt_text: As Jacob started on his way again, angels of God came to meet him.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This {is} God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim. {Mahanaim: that is, Two hosts, or, camps}
verses.nlt_text: When Jacob saw them, he exclaimed, "This is God's camp!" So he named the place Mahanaim.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom. {country: Heb. field}
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob sent messengers ahead to his brother, Esau, who was living in the region of Seir in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.nlt_text: He told them, "Give this message to my master Esau: 'Humble greetings from your servant Jacob. Until now I have been living with Uncle Laban,

verses.kjv_text: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
verses.nlt_text: and now I own cattle, donkeys, flocks of sheep and goats, and many servants, both men and women. I have sent these messengers to inform my lord of my coming, hoping that you will be friendly to me.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.nlt_text: After delivering the message, the messengers returned to Jacob and reported, "We met your brother, Esau, and he is already on his way to meet you-- with an army of 400 men!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that {was} with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.nlt_text: Jacob was terrified at the news. He divided his household, along with the flocks and herds and camels, into two groups.

verses.kjv_text: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.nlt_text: He thought, "If Esau meets one group and attacks it, perhaps the other group can escape."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my grandfather Abraham, and God of my father, Isaac-- O LORD, you told me, 'Return to your own land and to your relatives.' And you promised me, 'I will treat you kindly.'

verses.kjv_text: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands. {I am not...: Heb. I am less than all}
verses.nlt_text: I am not worthy of all the unfailing love and faithfulness you have shown to me, your servant. When I left home and crossed the Jordan River, I owned nothing except a walking stick. Now my household fills two large camps!

verses.kjv_text: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, {and} the mother with the children. {with: Heb. upon}
verses.nlt_text: O LORD, please rescue me from the hand of my brother, Esau. I am afraid that he is coming to attack me, along with my wives and children.

verses.kjv_text: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.nlt_text: But you promised me, 'I will surely treat you kindly, and I will multiply your descendants until they become as numerous as the sands along the seashore-- too many to count.'"

verses.kjv_text: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.nlt_text: Jacob stayed where he was for the night. Then he selected these gifts from his possessions to present to his brother, Esau:

verses.kjv_text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.nlt_text: 200 female goats, 20 male goats, 200 ewes, 20 rams,

verses.kjv_text: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.nlt_text: 30 female camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 male donkeys.

verses.kjv_text: And he delivered {them} into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.nlt_text: He divided these animals into herds and assigned each to different servants. Then he told his servants, "Go ahead of me with the animals, but keep some distance between the herds."

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose {art} thou? and whither goest thou? and whose {are} these before thee?
verses.nlt_text: He gave these instructions to the men leading the first group: "When my brother, Esau, meets you, he will ask, 'Whose servants are you? Where are you going? Who owns these animals?'

verses.kjv_text: Then thou shalt say, {They be} thy servant Jacob's; it {is} a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he {is} behind us.
verses.nlt_text: You must reply, 'They belong to your servant Jacob, but they are a gift for his master Esau. Look, he is coming right behind us.'"

verses.kjv_text: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob gave the same instructions to the second and third herdsmen and to all who followed behind the herds: "You must say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.

verses.kjv_text: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob {is} behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me. {of me: Heb. my face}
verses.nlt_text: And be sure to say, 'Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.' " Jacob thought, "I will try to appease him by sending gifts ahead of me. When I see him in person, perhaps he will be friendly to me."

verses.kjv_text: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.nlt_text: So the gifts were sent on ahead, while Jacob himself spent that night in the camp.

verses.kjv_text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.nlt_text: During the night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two servant wives, and his eleven sons and crossed the Jabbok River with them.

verses.kjv_text: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had. {sent them: Heb. caused to pass}
verses.nlt_text: After taking them to the other side, he sent over all his possessions.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day. {breaking...: Heb. ascending of the morning}
verses.nlt_text: This left Jacob all alone in the camp, and a man came and wrestled with him until the dawn began to break.

verses.kjv_text: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.nlt_text: When the man saw that he would not win the match, he touched Jacob's hip and wrenched it out of its socket.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.nlt_text: Then the man said, "Let me go, for the dawn is breaking!" But Jacob said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, What {is} thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: "What is your name?" the man asked.He replied, "Jacob."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed. {Israel: that is, A prince of God}
verses.nlt_text: "Your name will no longer be Jacob," the man told him. "From now on you will be called Israel, because you have fought with God and with men and have won."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob asked {him}, and said, Tell {me}, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore {is} it {that} thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.nlt_text: "Please tell me your name," Jacob said."Why do you want to know my name?" the man replied. Then he blessed Jacob there.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved. {Peniel: that is, The face of God}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob named the place Peniel (which means "face of God"), for he said, "I have seen God face to face, yet my life has been spared."

verses.kjv_text: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.nlt_text: The sun was rising as Jacob left Peniel, and he was limping because of the injury to his hip.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the children of Israel eat not {of} the sinew which shrank, which {is} upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.nlt_text: (Even today the people of Israel don't eat the tendon near the hip socket because of what happened that night when the man strained the tendon of Jacob's hip.)

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming with his 400 men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and his two servant wives.

verses.kjv_text: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.nlt_text: He put the servant wives and their children at the front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph last.

verses.kjv_text: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob went on ahead. As he approached his brother, he bowed to the ground seven times before him.

verses.kjv_text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.nlt_text: Then Esau ran to meet him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.

verses.kjv_text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who {are} those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant. {with...: Heb. to thee}
verses.nlt_text: Then Esau looked at the women and children and asked, "Who are these people with you?" "These are the children God has graciously given to me, your servant," Jacob replied.

verses.kjv_text: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.nlt_text: Then the servant wives came forward with their children and bowed before him.

verses.kjv_text: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.nlt_text: Next came Leah with her children, and they bowed before him. Finally, Joseph and Rachel came forward and bowed before him.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, What {meanest} thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, {These are} to find grace in the sight of my lord. {What...: Heb. What is all this band to thee?}
verses.nlt_text: "And what were all the flocks and herds I met as I came?" Esau asked.Jacob replied, "They are a gift, my lord, to ensure your friendship."

verses.kjv_text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself. {keep...: Heb. be that to thee that is thine}
verses.nlt_text: "My brother, I have plenty," Esau answered. "Keep what you have for yourself."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.nlt_text: But Jacob insisted, "No, if I have found favor with you, please accept this gift from me. And what a relief to see your friendly smile. It is like seeing the face of God!

verses.kjv_text: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took {it}. {enough: Heb. all things}
verses.nlt_text: Please take this gift I have brought you, for God has been very gracious to me. I have more than enough." And because Jacob insisted, Esau finally accepted the gift.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Well," Esau said, "let's be going. I will lead the way."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children {are} tender, and the flocks and herds with young {are} with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.nlt_text: But Jacob replied, "You can see, my lord, that some of the children are very young, and the flocks and herds have their young, too. If they are driven too hard, even for one day, all the animals could die.

verses.kjv_text: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir. {according...: Heb. according to the foot of the work, etc., and according to the foot of the children}
verses.nlt_text: Please, my lord, go ahead of your servant. We will follow slowly, at a pace that is comfortable for the livestock and the children. I will meet you at Seir."

verses.kjv_text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee {some} of the folk that {are} with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord. {leave: Heb. set, or, place} {What...: Heb. Wherefore is this?}
verses.nlt_text: "All right," Esau said, "but at least let me assign some of my men to guide and protect you." Jacob responded, "That's not necessary. It's enough that you've received me warmly, my lord!"

verses.kjv_text: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.nlt_text: So Esau turned around and started back to Seir that same day.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth. {Succoth: that is, Booths}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob, on the other hand, traveled on to Succoth. There he built himself a house and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place was named Succoth (which means "shelters").

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which {is} in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city. {Shechem: Gr. Sychem}
verses.nlt_text: Later, having traveled all the way from Paddan-aram, Jacob arrived safely at the town of Shechem, in the land of Canaan. There he set up camp outside the town.

verses.kjv_text: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money. {Hamor: Gr. Emmor} {pieces...: or, lambs}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob bought the plot of land where he camped from the family of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for 100 pieces of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And he erected there an altar, and called it Elelohe-Israel. {Elelohe-Israel: that is God the God of Israel}
verses.nlt_text: And there he built an altar and named it El-Elohe-Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.nlt_text: One day Dinah, the daughter of Jacob and Leah, went to visit some of the young women who lived in the area.

verses.kjv_text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her. {defiled...: Heb. humbled her}
verses.nlt_text: But when the local prince, Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, saw Dinah, he seized her and raped her.

verses.kjv_text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel. {kindly...: Heb. to the heart of the damsel}
verses.nlt_text: But then he fell in love with her, and he tried to win her affection with tender words.

verses.kjv_text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.nlt_text: He said to his father, Hamor, "Get me this young girl. I want to marry her."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.nlt_text: Soon Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter, Dinah. But since his sons were out in the fields herding his livestock, he said nothing until they returned.

verses.kjv_text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.nlt_text: Hamor, Shechem's father, came to discuss the matter with Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard {it}: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Jacob's sons had come in from the field as soon as they heard what had happened. They were shocked and furious that their sister had been raped. Shechem had done a disgraceful thing against Jacob's family, something that should never be done.

verses.kjv_text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.nlt_text: Hamor tried to speak with Jacob and his sons. "My son Shechem is truly in love with your daughter," he said. "Please let him marry her.

verses.kjv_text: And make ye marriages with us, {and} give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, let's arrange other marriages, too. You give us your daughters for our sons, and we will give you our daughters for your sons.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.nlt_text: And you may live among us; the land is open to you! Settle here and trade with us. And feel free to buy property in the area."

verses.kjv_text: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.nlt_text: Then Shechem himself spoke to Dinah's father and brothers. "Please be kind to me, and let me marry her," he begged. "I will give you whatever you ask.

verses.kjv_text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.nlt_text: No matter what dowry or gift you demand, I will gladly pay it-- just give me the girl as my wife."

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
verses.nlt_text: But since Shechem had defiled their sister, Dinah, Jacob's sons responded deceitfully to Shechem and his father, Hamor.

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that {were} a reproach unto us:
verses.nlt_text: They said to them, "We couldn't possibly allow this, because you're not circumcised. It would be a disgrace for our sister to marry a man like you!

verses.kjv_text: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we {be}, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.nlt_text: But here is a solution. If every man among you will be circumcised like we are,

verses.kjv_text: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.nlt_text: then we will give you our daughters, and we'll take your daughters for ourselves. We will live among you and become one people.

verses.kjv_text: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.nlt_text: But if you don't agree to be circumcised, we will take her and be on our way."

verses.kjv_text: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
verses.nlt_text: Hamor and his son Shechem agreed to their proposal.

verses.kjv_text: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he {was} more honourable than all the house of his father.
verses.nlt_text: Shechem wasted no time in acting on this request, for he wanted Jacob's daughter desperately. Shechem was a highly respected member of his family,

verses.kjv_text: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.nlt_text: and he went with his father, Hamor, to present this proposal to the leaders at the town gate.

verses.kjv_text: These men {are} peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, {it is} large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.nlt_text: "These men are our friends," they said. "Let's invite them to live here among us and trade freely. Look, the land is large enough to hold them. We can take their daughters as wives and let them marry ours.

verses.kjv_text: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they {are} circumcised.
verses.nlt_text: But they will consider staying here and becoming one people with us only if all of our men are circumcised, just as they are.

verses.kjv_text: {Shall} not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs {be} ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.nlt_text: But if we do this, all their livestock and possessions will eventually be ours. Come, let's agree to their terms and let them settle here among us."

verses.kjv_text: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.nlt_text: So all the men in the town council agreed with Hamor and Shechem, and every male in the town was circumcised.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
verses.nlt_text: But three days later, when their wounds were still sore, two of Jacob's sons, Simeon and Levi, who were Dinah's full brothers, took their swords and entered the town without opposition. Then they slaughtered every male there,

verses.kjv_text: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out. {edge: Heb. mouth}
verses.nlt_text: including Hamor and his son Shechem. They killed them with their swords, then took Dinah from Shechem's house and returned to their camp.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the rest of Jacob's sons arrived. Finding the men slaughtered, they plundered the town because their sister had been defiled there.

verses.kjv_text: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which {was} in the city, and that which {was} in the field,
verses.nlt_text: They seized all the flocks and herds and donkeys-- everything they could lay their hands on, both inside the town and outside in the fields.

verses.kjv_text: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that {was} in the house.
verses.nlt_text: They looted all their wealth and plundered their houses. They also took all their little children and wives and led them away as captives.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I {being} few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have ruined me! You've made me stink among all the people of this land-- among all the Canaanites and Perizzites. We are so few that they will join forces and crush us. I will be ruined, and my entire household will be wiped out!"

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
verses.nlt_text: "But why should we let him treat our sister like a prostitute?" they retorted angrily.

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.nlt_text: Then God said to Jacob, "Get ready and move to Bethel and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother, Esau."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that {were} with him, Put away the strange gods that {are} among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob told everyone in his household, "Get rid of all your pagan idols, purify yourselves, and put on clean clothing.

verses.kjv_text: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.nlt_text: We are now going to Bethel, where I will build an altar to the God who answered my prayers when I was in distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone."

verses.kjv_text: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which {were} in their hand, and {all their} earrings which {were} in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which {was} by Shechem.
verses.nlt_text: So they gave Jacob all their pagan idols and earrings, and he buried them under the great tree near Shechem.

verses.kjv_text: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that {were} round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: As they set out, a terror from God spread over the people in all the towns of that area, so no one attacked Jacob's family.

verses.kjv_text: So Jacob came to Luz, which {is} in the land of Canaan, that {is}, Bethel, he and all the people that {were} with him.
verses.nlt_text: Eventually, Jacob and his household arrived at Luz (also called Bethel) in Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother. {Elbethel: that is, The God of Bethel}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob built an altar there and named the place El-bethel (which means "God of Bethel"), because God had appeared to him there when he was fleeing from his brother, Esau.

verses.kjv_text: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth. {Allonbachuth: that is, The oak of weeping}
verses.nlt_text: Soon after this, Rebekah's old nurse, Deborah, died. She was buried beneath the oak tree in the valley below Bethel. Ever since, the tree has been called Allon-bacuth (which means "oak of weeping").

verses.kjv_text: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
verses.nlt_text: Now that Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again at Bethel. God blessed him,

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto him, Thy name {is} Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.nlt_text: saying, "Your name is Jacob, but you will not be called Jacob any longer. From now on your name will be Israel." So God renamed him Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto him, I {am} God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.nlt_text: Then God said, "I am El-Shaddai-- 'God Almighty.' Be fruitful and multiply. You will become a great nation, even many nations. Kings will be among your descendants!

verses.kjv_text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.nlt_text: And I will give you the land I once gave to Abraham and Isaac. Yes, I will give it to you and your descendants after you."

verses.kjv_text: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
verses.nlt_text: Then God went up from the place where he had spoken to Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, {even} a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob set up a stone pillar to mark the place where God had spoken to him. Then he poured wine over it as an offering to God and anointed the pillar with olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
verses.nlt_text: And Jacob named the place Bethel (which means "house of God"), because God had spoken to him there.

verses.kjv_text: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour. {a little...: Heb. a little piece of ground}
verses.nlt_text: Leaving Bethel, Jacob and his clan moved on toward Ephrath. But Rachel went into labor while they were still some distance away. Her labor pains were intense.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.nlt_text: After a very hard delivery, the midwife finally exclaimed, "Don't be afraid-- you have another son!"

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin. {Benoni: that is, The son of my sorrow} {Benjamin: that is, The son of the right hand}
verses.nlt_text: Rachel was about to die, but with her last breath she named the baby Ben-oni (which means "son of my sorrow"). The baby's father, however, called him Benjamin (which means "son of my right hand").

verses.kjv_text: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which {is} Bethlehem.
verses.nlt_text: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that {is} the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob set up a stone monument over Rachel's grave, and it can be seen there to this day.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob traveled on and camped beyond Migdal-eder.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard {it}. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.nlt_text: While he was living there, Reuben had intercourse with Bilhah, his father's concubine, and Jacob soon heard about it.These are the names of the twelve sons of Jacob:

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Leah were Reuben (Jacob's oldest son), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel's servant, were Dan and Naphtali.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these {are} the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant, were Gad and Asher. These are the names of the sons who were born to Jacob at Paddan-aram.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which {is} Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob returned to his father, Isaac, in Mamre, which is near Kiriath-arba (now called Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had both lived as foreigners.

verses.kjv_text: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
verses.nlt_text: Isaac lived for 180 years.

verses.kjv_text: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, {being} old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he breathed his last and died at a ripe old age, joining his ancestors in death. And his sons, Esau and Jacob, buried him.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the generations of Esau, who {is} Edom.
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of the descendants of Esau (also known as Edom).

verses.kjv_text: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.nlt_text: Esau married two young women from Canaan: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite; and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite.

verses.kjv_text: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth. {Bashemath: or, Mahalath}
verses.nlt_text: He also married his cousin Basemath, who was the daughter of Ishmael and the sister of Nebaioth.

verses.kjv_text: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.nlt_text: Adah gave birth to a son named Eliphaz for Esau. Basemath gave birth to a son named Reuel.

verses.kjv_text: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these {are} the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: Oholibamah gave birth to sons named Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. All these sons were born to Esau in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob. {persons: Heb. souls}
verses.nlt_text: Esau took his wives, his children, and his entire household, along with his livestock and cattle-- all the wealth he had acquired in the land of Canaan-- and moved away from his brother, Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.nlt_text: There was not enough land to support them both because of all the livestock and possessions they had acquired.

verses.kjv_text: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau {is} Edom.
verses.nlt_text: So Esau (also known as Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir: {the Edomites: Heb. Edom}
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of Esau's descendants, the Edomites, who lived in the hill country of Seir.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah; and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz. {Zepho: or, Zephi}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.kjv_text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these {were} the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
verses.nlt_text: Timna, the concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz, gave birth to a son named Amalek. These are the descendants of Esau's wife Adah.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the descendants of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.kjv_text: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.nlt_text: Esau also had sons through Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon. Their names were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn {son} of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.nlt_text: These are the descendants of Esau who became the leaders of various clans: The descendants of Esau's oldest son, Eliphaz, became the leaders of the clans of Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, {and} duke Amalek: these {are} the dukes {that came} of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these {were} the sons of Adah.
verses.nlt_text: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. These are the clan leaders in the land of Edom who descended from Eliphaz. All these were descendants of Esau's wife Adah.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these {are} the dukes {that came} of Reuel in the land of Edom; these {are} the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Esau's son Reuel became the leaders of the clans of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the clan leaders in the land of Edom who descended from Reuel. All these were descendants of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these {were} the dukes {that came} of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Esau and his wife Oholibamah became the leaders of the clans of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the clan leaders who descended from Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Esau, who {is} Edom, and these {are} their dukes.
verses.nlt_text: These are the clans descended from Esau (also known as Edom), identified by their clan leaders.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of the tribes that descended from Seir the Horite. They lived in the land of Edom: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.kjv_text: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these {are} the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.nlt_text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the Horite clan leaders, the descendants of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister {was} Timna. {Hemam: or, Homam}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan also had a sister named Timna.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Shobal {were} these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. {Alvan: or, Alian} {Shepho: or, Shephi}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Shobal were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this {was that} Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the wilderness while he was grazing his father's donkeys.)

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Anah {were} these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Anah were his son, Dishon, and his daughter, Oholibamah.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran. {Hemdan: or, Amram}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

verses.kjv_text: The children of Ezer {are} these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan. {Akan: or, Jakan}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.kjv_text: The children of Dishan {are} these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Dishan were Uz and Aran.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the dukes {that came} of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.nlt_text: So these were the leaders of the Horite clans: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these {are} the dukes {that came} of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.nlt_text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. The Horite clans are named after their clan leaders, who lived in the land of Seir.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites:

verses.kjv_text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city {was} Dinhabah.
verses.nlt_text: Bela son of Beor, who ruled in Edom from the city of Dinhabah.

verses.kjv_text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: After Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king in his place.

verses.kjv_text: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: After Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.

verses.kjv_text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Avith.
verses.nlt_text: After Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Avith. He was the one who defeated the Midianites in the land of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: After Hadad died, Samlah from the city of Masrekah became king in his place.

verses.kjv_text: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth {by} the river reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: After Samlah died, Shaul from the city of Rehoboth-on-the-River became king in his place.

verses.kjv_text: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: After Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Acbor became king in his place.

verses.kjv_text: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Pau; and his wife's name {was} Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab. {Hadar, Pau: or, Hadad, Pai: after his death was an Aristocracy}
verses.nlt_text: After Baal-hanan son of Acbor died, Hadad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Pau. Hadad's wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the names of the dukes {that came} of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth, {Alvah: or, Aliah}
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of the leaders of the clans descended from Esau, who lived in the places named for them: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.nlt_text: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.nlt_text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these {be} the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he {is} Esau the father of the Edomites. {the Edomites: Heb. Edom}
verses.nlt_text: Magdiel, and Iram. These are the leaders of the clans of Edom, listed according to their settlements in the land they occupied. They all descended from Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan. {wherein...: Heb. of his father's sojournings}
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob settled again in the land of Canaan, where his father had lived as a foreigner.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the generations of Jacob. Joseph, {being} seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad {was} with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of Jacob and his family. When Joseph was seventeen years old, he often tended his father's flocks. He worked for his half brothers, the sons of his father's wives Bilhah and Zilpah. But Joseph reported to his father some of the bad things his brothers were doing.

verses.kjv_text: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he {was} the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of {many} colours. {colours: or, pieces}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob loved Joseph more than any of his other children because Joseph had been born to him in his old age. So one day Jacob had a special gift made for Joseph-- a beautiful robe.

verses.kjv_text: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.nlt_text: But his brothers hated Joseph because their father loved him more than the rest of them. They couldn't say a kind word to him.
