verses.kjv_text: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou {art} even as Pharaoh.
verses.nlt_text: Then Judah stepped forward and said, "Please, my lord, let your servant say just one word to you. Please, do not be angry with me, even though you are as powerful as Pharaoh himself.

verses.kjv_text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.nlt_text: "My lord, previously you asked us, your servants, 'Do you have a father or a brother?'

verses.kjv_text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
verses.nlt_text: And we responded, 'Yes, my lord, we have a father who is an old man, and his youngest son is a child of his old age. His full brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother's children, and his father loves him very much.'

verses.kjv_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.nlt_text: "And you said to us, 'Bring him here so I can see him with my own eyes.'

verses.kjv_text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for {if} he should leave his father, {his father} would die.
verses.nlt_text: But we said to you, 'My lord, the boy cannot leave his father, for his father would die.'

verses.kjv_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.nlt_text: But you told us, 'Unless your youngest brother comes with you, you will never see my face again.'

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.nlt_text: "So we returned to your servant, our father, and told him what you had said.

verses.kjv_text: And our father said, Go again, {and} buy us a little food.
verses.nlt_text: Later, when he said, 'Go back again and buy us more food,'

verses.kjv_text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother {be} with us.
verses.nlt_text: we replied, 'We can't go unless you let our youngest brother go with us. We'll never get to see the man's face unless our youngest brother is with us.'

verses.kjv_text: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two {sons}:
verses.nlt_text: "Then my father said to us, 'As you know, my wife had two sons,

verses.kjv_text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.nlt_text: and one of them went away and never returned. Doubtless he was torn to pieces by some wild animal. I have never seen him since.

verses.kjv_text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.nlt_text: Now if you take his brother away from me, and any harm comes to him, you will send this grieving, white-haired man to his grave. '

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad {be} not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
verses.nlt_text: "And now, my lord, I cannot go back to my father without the boy. Our father's life is bound up in the boy's life.

verses.kjv_text: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad {is} not {with us}, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.nlt_text: If he sees that the boy is not with us, our father will die. We, your servants, will indeed be responsible for sending that grieving, white-haired man to his grave.

verses.kjv_text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.nlt_text: My lord, I guaranteed to my father that I would take care of the boy. I told him, 'If I don't bring him back to you, I will bear the blame forever.'

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: "So please, my lord, let me stay here as a slave instead of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.

verses.kjv_text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad {be} not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father. {come...: Heb. find my father}
verses.nlt_text: For how can I return to my father if the boy is not with me? I couldn't bear to see the anguish this would cause my father!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph could stand it no longer. There were many people in the room, and he said to his attendants, "Out, all of you!" So he was alone with his brothers when he told them who he was.

verses.kjv_text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard. {wept...: Heb. gave forth his voice in weeping}
verses.nlt_text: Then he broke down and wept. He wept so loudly the Egyptians could hear him, and word of it quickly carried to Pharaoh's palace.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I {am} Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence. {troubled: or, terrified}
verses.nlt_text: "I am Joseph!" he said to his brothers. "Is my father still alive?" But his brothers were speechless! They were stunned to realize that Joseph was standing there in front of them.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I {am} Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: "Please, come closer," he said to them. So they came closer. And he said again, "I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into slavery in Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life. {nor...: Heb. neither let there be anger in your eyes}
verses.nlt_text: But don't be upset, and don't be angry with yourselves for selling me to this place. It was God who sent me here ahead of you to preserve your lives.

verses.kjv_text: For these two years {hath} the famine {been} in the land: and yet {there are} five years, in the which {there shall} neither {be} earing nor harvest.
verses.nlt_text: This famine that has ravaged the land for two years will last five more years, and there will be neither plowing nor harvesting.

verses.kjv_text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance. {to preserve...: Heb. to put for you a remnant}
verses.nlt_text: God has sent me ahead of you to keep you and your families alive and to preserve many survivors.

verses.kjv_text: So now {it was} not you {that} sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: So it was God who sent me here, not you! And he is the one who made me an adviser to Pharaoh-- the manager of his entire palace and the governor of all Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.nlt_text: "Now hurry back to my father and tell him, 'This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me master over all the land of Egypt. So come down to me immediately!

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.nlt_text: You can live in the region of Goshen, where you can be near me with all your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.

verses.kjv_text: And there will I nourish thee; for yet {there are} five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
verses.nlt_text: I will take care of you there, for there are still five years of famine ahead of us. Otherwise you, your household, and all your animals will starve.'"

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that {it is} my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph added, "Look! You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that I really am Joseph!

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.nlt_text: Go tell my father of my honored position here in Egypt. Describe for him everything you have seen, and then bring my father here quickly."

verses.kjv_text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.nlt_text: Weeping with joy, he embraced Benjamin, and Benjamin did the same.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph kissed each of his brothers and wept over them, and after that they began talking freely with him.

verses.kjv_text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants. {pleased...: Heb. was good in the eyes of Pharaoh}
verses.nlt_text: The news soon reached Pharaoh's palace: "Joseph's brothers have arrived!" Pharaoh and his officials were all delighted to hear this.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.nlt_text: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, 'This is what you must do: Load your pack animals, and hurry back to the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.nlt_text: Then get your father and all of your families, and return here to me. I will give you the very best land in Egypt, and you will eat from the best that the land produces.'"

verses.kjv_text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.nlt_text: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, 'Take wagons from the land of Egypt to carry your little children and your wives, and bring your father here.

verses.kjv_text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt {is} yours. {regard...: Heb. let not your eye spare, etc.}
verses.nlt_text: Don't worry about your personal belongings, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way. {commandment: Heb. mouth}
verses.nlt_text: So the sons of Jacob did as they were told. Joseph provided them with wagons, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he gave them supplies for the journey.

verses.kjv_text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred {pieces} of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.nlt_text: And he gave each of them new clothes-- but to Benjamin he gave five changes of clothes and 300 pieces of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And to his father he sent after this {manner}; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way. {laden...: Heb. carrying}
verses.nlt_text: He also sent his father ten male donkeys loaded with the finest products of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other supplies he would need on his journey.

verses.kjv_text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.nlt_text: So Joseph sent his brothers off, and as they left, he called after them, "Don't quarrel about all this along the way!"

verses.kjv_text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.nlt_text: And they left Egypt and returned to their father, Jacob, in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And told him, saying, Joseph {is} yet alive, and he {is} governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not. {Jacob's: Heb. his}
verses.nlt_text: "Joseph is still alive!" they told him. "And he is governor of all the land of Egypt!" Jacob was stunned at the news-- he couldn't believe it.

verses.kjv_text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.nlt_text: But when they repeated to Jacob everything Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons Joseph had sent to carry him, their father's spirits revived.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel said, {It is} enough; Joseph my son {is} yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob exclaimed, "It must be true! My son Joseph is alive! I must go and see him before I die."

verses.kjv_text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob set out for Egypt with all his possessions. And when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

verses.kjv_text: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here {am} I.
verses.nlt_text: During the night God spoke to him in a vision. "Jacob! Jacob!" he called."Here I am," Jacob replied.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I {am} God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.nlt_text: "I am God, the God of your father," the voice said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for there I will make your family into a great nation.

verses.kjv_text: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up {again}: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.nlt_text: I will go with you down to Egypt, and I will bring you back again. But you will die in Egypt with Joseph attending to you."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob left Beersheba, and his sons took him to Egypt. They carried him and their little ones and their wives in the wagons Pharaoh had provided for them.

verses.kjv_text: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.nlt_text: They also took all their livestock and all the personal belongings they had acquired in the land of Canaan. So Jacob and his entire family went to Egypt--

verses.kjv_text: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: sons and grandsons, daughters and granddaughters-- all his descendants.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of the descendants of Israel-- the sons of Jacob-- who went to Egypt: Reuben was Jacob's oldest son.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Reuben were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman. {Jemuel: or, Nemuel} {Jachin: or, Jarib} {Zohar: or, Zerah}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul. (Shaul's mother was a Canaanite woman.)

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. {Gershon: or, Gershom}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (though Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron. {Phuvah, and Job: or, Puah, and Jashub}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Zebulun were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.kjv_text: These {be} the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters {were} thirty and three.
verses.nlt_text: These were the sons of Leah and Jacob who were born in Paddan-aram, in addition to their daughter, Dinah. The number of Jacob's descendants (male and female) through Leah was thirty-three.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli. {Ziphion: or, Zephon} {Ezbon: or, Ozni} {Arodi: or, Arod}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Gad were Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. Beriah's sons were Heber and Malkiel.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, {even} sixteen souls.
verses.nlt_text: These were the sons of Zilpah, the servant given to Leah by her father, Laban. The number of Jacob's descendants through Zilpah was sixteen.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jacob's wife Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him. {priest: or, prince}
verses.nlt_text: Joseph's sons, born in the land of Egypt, were Manasseh and Ephraim. Their mother was Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, the priest of On.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Benjamin {were} Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard. {Ehi: or, Ahiram} {Muppim: or, Shupham or, Shuppim} {Huppim: or, Hupham}
verses.nlt_text: Benjamin's sons were Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls {were} fourteen.
verses.nlt_text: These were the sons of Rachel and Jacob. The number of Jacob's descendants through Rachel was fourteen.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Dan; Hushim. {Hushim: or, Shuham}
verses.nlt_text: The son of Dan was Hushim.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls {were} seven.
verses.nlt_text: These were the sons of Bilhah, the servant given to Rachel by her father, Laban. The number of Jacob's descendants through Bilhah was seven.

verses.kjv_text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls {were} threescore and six; {loins: Heb. thigh}
verses.nlt_text: The total number of Jacob's direct descendants who went with him to Egypt, not counting his sons' wives, was sixty-six.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, {were} two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, {were} threescore and ten.
verses.nlt_text: In addition, Joseph had two sons who were born in Egypt. So altogether, there were seventy members of Jacob's family in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.nlt_text: As they neared their destination, Jacob sent Judah ahead to meet Joseph and get directions to the region of Goshen. And when they finally arrived there,

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph prepared his chariot and traveled to Goshen to meet his father, Jacob. When Joseph arrived, he embraced his father and wept, holding him for a long time.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou {art} yet alive.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, Jacob said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen your face again and know you are still alive."

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which {were} in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.nlt_text: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's entire family, "I will go to Pharaoh and tell him, 'My brothers and my father's entire family have come to me from the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And the men {are} shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have. {their trade...: Heb. they are men of cattle}
verses.nlt_text: These men are shepherds, and they raise livestock. They have brought with them their flocks and herds and everything they own.'"

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What {is} your occupation?
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "When Pharaoh calls for you and asks you about your occupation,

verses.kjv_text: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, {and} also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd {is} an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.nlt_text: you must tell him, 'We, your servants, have raised livestock all our lives, as our ancestors have always done.' When you tell him this, he will let you live here in the region of Goshen, for the Egyptians despise shepherds."

verses.kjv_text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they {are} in the land of Goshen.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph went to see Pharaoh and told him, "My father and my brothers have arrived from the land of Canaan. They have come with all their flocks and herds and possessions, and they are now in the region of Goshen."

verses.kjv_text: And he took some of his brethren, {even} five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph took five of his brothers with him and presented them to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What {is} your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants {are} shepherds, both we, {and} also our fathers.
verses.nlt_text: And Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" They replied, "We, your servants, are shepherds, just like our ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine {is} sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.nlt_text: We have come to live here in Egypt for a while, for there is no pasture for our flocks in Canaan. The famine is very severe there. So please, we request permission to live in the region of Goshen."

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
verses.nlt_text: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Now that your father and brothers have joined you here,

verses.kjv_text: The land of Egypt {is} before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest {any} men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.nlt_text: choose any place in the entire land of Egypt for them to live. Give them the best land of Egypt. Let them live in the region of Goshen. And if any of them have special skills, put them in charge of my livestock, too."

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph brought in his father, Jacob, and presented him to Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old {art} thou? {How...: Heb. How many are the days of the years of thy life?}
verses.nlt_text: "How old are you?" Pharaoh asked him.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage {are} an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob replied, "I have traveled this earth for 130 hard years. But my life has been short compared to the lives of my ancestors."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh again before leaving his court.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.nlt_text: So Joseph assigned the best land of Egypt-- the region of Rameses-- to his father and his brothers, and he settled them there, just as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to {their} families. {according...: or, as a little child is nourished: Heb. according to the little ones}
verses.nlt_text: And Joseph provided food for his father and his brothers in amounts appropriate to the number of their dependents, including the smallest children.

verses.kjv_text: And {there was} no bread in all the land; for the famine {was} very sore, so that the land of Egypt and {all} the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the famine became so severe that all the food was used up, and people were starving throughout the lands of Egypt and Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
verses.nlt_text: By selling grain to the people, Joseph eventually collected all the money in Egypt and Canaan, and he put the money in Pharaoh's treasury.

verses.kjv_text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
verses.nlt_text: When the people of Egypt and Canaan ran out of money, all the Egyptians came to Joseph. "Our money is gone!" they cried. "But please give us food, or we will die before your very eyes!"

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph replied, "Since your money is gone, bring me your livestock. I will give you food in exchange for your livestock."

verses.kjv_text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread {in exchange} for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year. {fed...: Heb. led them}
verses.nlt_text: So they brought their livestock to Joseph in exchange for food. In exchange for their horses, flocks of sheep and goats, herds of cattle, and donkeys, Joseph provided them with food for another year.

verses.kjv_text: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide {it} from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.nlt_text: But that year ended, and the next year they came again and said, "We cannot hide the truth from you, my lord. Our money is gone, and all our livestock and cattle are yours. We have nothing left to give but our bodies and our land.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give {us} seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
verses.nlt_text: Why should we die before your very eyes? Buy us and our land in exchange for food; we offer our land and ourselves as slaves for Pharaoh. Just give us grain so we may live and not die, and so the land does not become empty and desolate."

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
verses.nlt_text: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh. All the Egyptians sold him their fields because the famine was so severe, and soon all the land belonged to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv_text: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from {one} end of the borders of Egypt even to the {other} end thereof.
verses.nlt_text: As for the people, he made them all slaves, from one end of Egypt to the other.

verses.kjv_text: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion {assigned them} of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands. {priests: or, princes}
verses.nlt_text: The only land he did not buy was the land belonging to the priests. They received an allotment of food directly from Pharaoh, so they didn't need to sell their land.

verses.kjv_text: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, {here is} seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph said to the people, "Look, today I have bought you and your land for Pharaoh. I will provide you with seed so you can plant the fields.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth {part} unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.nlt_text: Then when you harvest it, one-fifth of your crop will belong to Pharaoh. You may keep the remaining four-fifths as seed for your fields and as food for you, your households, and your little ones."

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
verses.nlt_text: "You have saved our lives!" they exclaimed. "May it please you, my lord, to let us be Pharaoh's servants."

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, {that} Pharaoh should have the fifth {part}; except the land of the priests only, {which} became not Pharaoh's. {priests: or, princes}
verses.nlt_text: Joseph then issued a decree still in effect in the land of Egypt, that Pharaoh should receive one-fifth of all the crops grown on his land. Only the land belonging to the priests was not given to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the people of Israel settled in the region of Goshen in Egypt. There they acquired property, and they were fruitful, and their population grew rapidly.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years. {the whole...: Heb. the days of the years of his life}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob lived for seventeen years after his arrival in Egypt, so he lived 147 years in all.

verses.kjv_text: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
verses.nlt_text: As the time of his death drew near, Jacob called for his son Joseph and said to him, "Please do me this favor. Put your hand under my thigh and swear that you will treat me with unfailing love by honoring this last request: Do not bury me in Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
verses.nlt_text: When I die, please take my body out of Egypt and bury me with my ancestors." So Joseph promised, "I will do as you ask."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
verses.nlt_text: "Swear that you will do it," Jacob insisted. So Joseph gave his oath, and Jacob bowed humbly at the head of his bed.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after these things, that {one} told Joseph, Behold, thy father {is} sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.nlt_text: One day not long after this, word came to Joseph, "Your father is failing rapidly." So Joseph went to visit his father, and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: And {one} told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.nlt_text: When Joseph arrived, Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to see you." So Jacob gathered his strength and sat up in his bed.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.nlt_text: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee {for} an everlasting possession.
verses.nlt_text: He said to me, 'I will make you fruitful, and I will multiply your descendants. I will make you a multitude of nations. And I will give this land of Canaan to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.'

verses.kjv_text: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, {are} mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
verses.nlt_text: "Now I am claiming as my own sons these two boys of yours, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born here in the land of Egypt before I arrived. They will be my sons, just as Reuben and Simeon are.

verses.kjv_text: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, {and} shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: But any children born to you in the future will be your own, and they will inherit land within the territories of their brothers Ephraim and Manasseh.

verses.kjv_text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet {there was} but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same {is} Bethlehem.
verses.nlt_text: "Long ago, as I was returning from Paddan-aram, Rachel died in the land of Canaan. We were still on the way, some distance from Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem). So with great sorrow I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath."

verses.kjv_text: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who {are} these?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob looked over at the two boys. "Are these your sons?" he asked.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his father, They {are} my sons, whom God hath given me in this {place}. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," Joseph told him, "these are the sons God has given me here in Egypt." And Jacob said, "Bring them closer to me, so I can bless them."

verses.kjv_text: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, {so that} he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them. {dim: Heb. heavy}
verses.nlt_text: Jacob was half blind because of his age and could hardly see. So Joseph brought the boys close to him, and Jacob kissed and embraced them.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob said to Joseph, "I never thought I would see your face again, but now God has let me see your children, too!"

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph moved the boys, who were at their grandfather's knees, and he bowed with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought {them} near unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he positioned the boys in front of Jacob. With his right hand he directed Ephraim toward Jacob's left hand, and with his left hand he put Manasseh at Jacob's right hand.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid {it} upon Ephraim's head, who {was} the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh {was} the firstborn.
verses.nlt_text: But Jacob crossed his arms as he reached out to lay his hands on the boys' heads. He put his right hand on the head of Ephraim, though he was the younger boy, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, though he was the firstborn.

verses.kjv_text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.nlt_text: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my grandfather Abraham and my father, Isaac, walked-- the God who has been my shepherd all my life, to this very day,

verses.kjv_text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth. {grow: Heb. as fishes do increase}
verses.nlt_text: the Angel who has redeemed me from all harm-- may he bless these boys. May they preserve my name and the names of Abraham and Isaac. And may their descendants multiply greatly throughout the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head. {displeased...: was evil in his eyes}
verses.nlt_text: But Joseph was upset when he saw that his father placed his right hand on Ephraim's head. So Joseph lifted it to move it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this {is} the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
verses.nlt_text: "No, my father," he said. "This one is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head."

verses.kjv_text: And his father refused, and said, I know {it}, my son, I know {it}: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations. {multitude: Heb. fulness}
verses.nlt_text: But his father refused. "I know, my son; I know," he replied. "Manasseh will also become a great people, but his younger brother will become even greater. And his descendants will become a multitude of nations."

verses.kjv_text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob blessed the boys that day with this blessing: "The people of Israel will use your names when they give a blessing. They will say, 'May God make you as prosperous as Ephraim and Manasseh.' " In this way, Jacob put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob said to Joseph, "Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and will take you back to Canaan, the land of your ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.nlt_text: And beyond what I have given your brothers, I am giving you an extra portion of the land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow."

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you {that} which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob called together all his sons and said, "Gather around me, and I will tell you what will happen to each of you in the days to come.

verses.kjv_text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.nlt_text: "Come and listen, you sons of Jacob; listen to Israel, your father.

verses.kjv_text: Reuben, thou {art} my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.nlt_text: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my strength, the child of my vigorous youth. You are first in rank and first in power.

verses.kjv_text: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou {it}: he went up to my couch. {thou shalt...: Heb. do not thou excel} {he went...: or, my couch is gone}
verses.nlt_text: But you are as unruly as a flood, and you will be first no longer. For you went to bed with my wife; you defiled my marriage couch.

verses.kjv_text: Simeon and Levi {are} brethren; instruments of cruelty {are in} their habitations. {instruments...: or, their swords are weapons of violence}
verses.nlt_text: "Simeon and Levi are two of a kind; their weapons are instruments of violence.

verses.kjv_text: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall. {digged...: or, houghed oxen}
verses.nlt_text: May I never join in their meetings; may I never be a party to their plans. For in their anger they murdered men, and they crippled oxen just for sport.

verses.kjv_text: Cursed {be} their anger, for {it was} fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: A curse on their anger, for it is fierce; a curse on their wrath, for it is cruel. I will scatter them among the descendants of Jacob; I will disperse them throughout Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Judah, thou {art he} whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand {shall be} in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Judah, your brothers will praise you. You will grasp your enemies by the neck. All your relatives will bow before you.

verses.kjv_text: Judah {is} a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.nlt_text: Judah, my son, is a young lion that has finished eating its prey. Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness-- who dares to rouse him?

verses.kjv_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him {shall} the gathering of the people {be}.
verses.nlt_text: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from his descendants, until the coming of the one to whom it belongs, the one whom all nations will honor.

verses.kjv_text: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.nlt_text: He ties his foal to a grapevine, the colt of his donkey to a choice vine. He washes his clothes in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

verses.kjv_text: His eyes {shall be} red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.nlt_text: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.

verses.kjv_text: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he {shall be} for an haven of ships; and his border {shall be} unto Zidon.
verses.nlt_text: "Zebulun will settle by the seashore and will be a harbor for ships; his borders will extend to Sidon.

verses.kjv_text: Issachar {is} a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.nlt_text: "Issachar is a sturdy donkey, resting between two saddlepacks.

verses.kjv_text: And he saw that rest {was} good, and the land that {it was} pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.nlt_text: When he sees how good the countryside is and how pleasant the land, he will bend his shoulder to the load and submit himself to hard labor.

verses.kjv_text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "Dan will govern his people, like any other tribe in Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward. {an adder: Heb. an arrow-snake}
verses.nlt_text: Dan will be a snake beside the road, a poisonous viper along the path that bites the horse's hooves so its rider is thrown off.

verses.kjv_text: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I trust in you for salvation, O LORD!

verses.kjv_text: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.nlt_text: "Gad will be attacked by marauding bands, but he will attack them when they retreat.

verses.kjv_text: Out of Asher his bread {shall be} fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.nlt_text: "Asher will dine on rich foods and produce food fit for kings.

verses.kjv_text: Naphtali {is} a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
verses.nlt_text: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

verses.kjv_text: Joseph {is} a fruitful bough, {even} a fruitful bough by a well; {whose} branches run over the wall: {branches: Heb. daughters}
verses.nlt_text: "Joseph is the foal of a wild donkey, the foal of a wild donkey at a spring-- one of the wild donkeys on the ridge.

verses.kjv_text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot {at him}, and hated him:
verses.nlt_text: Archers attacked him savagely; they shot at him and harassed him.

verses.kjv_text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty {God} of Jacob; (from thence {is} the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
verses.nlt_text: But his bow remained taut, and his arms were strengthened by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, by the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: {Even} by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.nlt_text: May the God of your father help you; May the Almighty bless you with the blessings of the heavens above, and blessings of the watery depths below, and blessings of the breasts and womb.

verses.kjv_text: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: May the blessings of your father surpass the blessings of the ancient mountains, reaching to the heights of the eternal hills. May these blessings rest on the head of Joseph, who is a prince among his brothers.

verses.kjv_text: Benjamin shall ravin {as} a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.nlt_text: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, devouring his enemies in the morning and dividing his plunder in the evening."

verses.kjv_text: All these {are} the twelve tribes of Israel: and this {is it} that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.nlt_text: These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said as he told his sons good-bye. He blessed each one with an appropriate message.

verses.kjv_text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that {is} in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.nlt_text: Then Jacob instructed them, "Soon I will die and join my ancestors. Bury me with my father and grandfather in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

verses.kjv_text: In the cave that {is} in the field of Machpelah, which {is} before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.nlt_text: This is the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, that Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite as a permanent burial site.

verses.kjv_text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.nlt_text: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried. There Isaac and his wife, Rebekah, are buried. And there I buried Leah.

verses.kjv_text: The purchase of the field and of the cave that {is} therein {was} from the children of Heth.
verses.nlt_text: It is the plot of land and the cave that my grandfather Abraham bought from the Hittites."

verses.kjv_text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.nlt_text: When Jacob had finished this charge to his sons, he drew his feet into the bed, breathed his last, and joined his ancestors in death.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph told the physicians who served him to embalm his father's body; so Jacob was embalmed.

verses.kjv_text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days. {mourned: Heb. wept}
verses.nlt_text: The embalming process took the usual forty days. And the Egyptians mourned his death for seventy days.

verses.kjv_text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.nlt_text: When the period of mourning was over, Joseph approached Pharaoh's advisers and said, "Please do me this favor and speak to Pharaoh on my behalf.

verses.kjv_text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.nlt_text: Tell him that my father made me swear an oath. He said to me, 'Listen, I am about to die. Take my body back to the land of Canaan, and bury me in the tomb I prepared for myself.' So please allow me to go and bury my father. After his burial, I will return without delay."

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.nlt_text: Pharaoh agreed to Joseph's request. "Go and bury your father, as he made you promise," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.nlt_text: So Joseph went up to bury his father. He was accompanied by all of Pharaoh's officials, all the senior members of Pharaoh's household, and all the senior officers of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph also took his entire household and his brothers and their households. But they left their little children and flocks and herds in the land of Goshen.

verses.kjv_text: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.nlt_text: A great number of chariots and charioteers accompanied Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which {is} beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.nlt_text: When they arrived at the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan River, they held a very great and solemn memorial service, with a seven-day period of mourning for Joseph's father.

verses.kjv_text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This {is} a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which {is} beyond Jordan. {Abelmizraim: that is, The mourning of the Egyptians}
verses.nlt_text: The local residents, the Canaanites, watched them mourning at the threshing floor of Atad. Then they renamed that place (which is near the Jordan) Abel-mizraim, for they said, "This is a place of deep mourning for these Egyptians."

verses.kjv_text: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob's sons did as he had commanded them.

verses.kjv_text: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.nlt_text: They carried his body to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre. This is the cave that Abraham had bought as a permanent burial site from Ephron the Hittite.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.nlt_text: After burying Jacob, Joseph returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had accompanied him to his father's burial.

verses.kjv_text: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.nlt_text: But now that their father was dead, Joseph's brothers became fearful. "Now Joseph will show his anger and pay us back for all the wrong we did to him," they said.

verses.kjv_text: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying, {sent: Heb. charged}
verses.nlt_text: So they sent this message to Joseph: "Before your father died, he instructed us

verses.kjv_text: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.nlt_text: to say to you: 'Please forgive your brothers for the great wrong they did to you-- for their sin in treating you so cruelly.' So we, the servants of the God of your father, beg you to forgive our sin." When Joseph received the message, he broke down and wept.

verses.kjv_text: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we {be} thy servants.
verses.nlt_text: Then his brothers came and threw themselves down before Joseph. "Look, we are your slaves!" they said.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for {am} I in the place of God?
verses.nlt_text: But Joseph replied, "Don't be afraid of me. Am I God, that I can punish you?

verses.kjv_text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; {but} God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as {it is} this day, to save much people alive.
verses.nlt_text: You intended to harm me, but God intended it all for good. He brought me to this position so I could save the lives of many people.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them. {kindly...: Heb. to their hearts}
verses.nlt_text: No, don't be afraid. I will continue to take care of you and your children." So he reassured them by speaking kindly to them.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
verses.nlt_text: So Joseph and his brothers and their families continued to live in Egypt. Joseph lived to the age of 110.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third {generation}: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees. {brought...: Heb. born}
verses.nlt_text: He lived to see three generations of descendants of his son Ephraim, and he lived to see the birth of the children of Manasseh's son Makir, whom he claimed as his own.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: "Soon I will die," Joseph told his brothers, "but God will surely come to help you and lead you out of this land of Egypt. He will bring you back to the land he solemnly promised to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph made the sons of Israel swear an oath, and he said, "When God comes to help you and lead you back, you must take my bones with you."

verses.kjv_text: So Joseph died, {being} an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: So Joseph died at the age of 110. The Egyptians embalmed him, and his body was placed in a coffin in Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of the sons of Israel (that is, Jacob) who moved to Egypt with their father, each with his family:

verses.kjv_text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.nlt_text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah,

verses.kjv_text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.nlt_text: Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin,

verses.kjv_text: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.nlt_text: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.kjv_text: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt {already}. {loins: Heb. thigh}
verses.nlt_text: In all, Jacob had seventy descendants in Egypt, including Joseph, who was already there.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.nlt_text: In time, Joseph and all of his brothers died, ending that entire generation.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.nlt_text: But their descendants, the Israelites, had many children and grandchildren. In fact, they multiplied so greatly that they became extremely powerful and filled the land.

verses.kjv_text: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
verses.nlt_text: Eventually, a new king came to power in Egypt who knew nothing about Joseph or what he had done.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel {are} more and mightier than we:
verses.nlt_text: He said to his people, "Look, the people of Israel now outnumber us and are stronger than we are.

verses.kjv_text: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and {so} get them up out of the land.
verses.nlt_text: We must make a plan to keep them from growing even more. If we don't, and if war breaks out, they will join our enemies and fight against us. Then they will escape from the country. "

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.nlt_text: So the Egyptians made the Israelites their slaves. They appointed brutal slave drivers over them, hoping to wear them down with crushing labor. They forced them to build the cities of Pithom and Rameses as supply centers for the king.

verses.kjv_text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel. {But...: Heb. And as they afflicted them, so they multiplied, etc}
verses.nlt_text: But the more the Egyptians oppressed them, the more the Israelites multiplied and spread, and the more alarmed the Egyptians became.

verses.kjv_text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
verses.nlt_text: So the Egyptians worked the people of Israel without mercy.

verses.kjv_text: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, {was} with rigour.
verses.nlt_text: They made their lives bitter, forcing them to mix mortar and make bricks and do all the work in the fields. They were ruthless in all their demands.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one {was} Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.nlt_text: Then Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, gave this order to the Hebrew midwives, Shiphrah and Puah:

verses.kjv_text: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see {them} upon the stools; if it {be} a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it {be} a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.nlt_text: "When you help the Hebrew women as they give birth, watch as they deliver. If the baby is a boy, kill him; if it is a girl, let her live."

verses.kjv_text: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
verses.nlt_text: But because the midwives feared God, they refused to obey the king's orders. They allowed the boys to live, too.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
verses.nlt_text: So the king of Egypt called for the midwives. "Why have you done this?" he demanded. "Why have you allowed the boys to live?"

verses.kjv_text: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women {are} not as the Egyptian women; for they {are} lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
verses.nlt_text: "The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women," the midwives replied. "They are more vigorous and have their babies so quickly that we cannot get there in time."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.nlt_text: So God was good to the midwives, and the Israelites continued to multiply, growing more and more powerful.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
verses.nlt_text: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.nlt_text: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Throw every newborn Hebrew boy into the Nile River. But you may let the girls live."

verses.kjv_text: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took {to wife} a daughter of Levi.
verses.nlt_text: About this time, a man and woman from the tribe of Levi got married.

verses.kjv_text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he {was a} goodly {child}, she hid him three months.
verses.nlt_text: The woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She saw that he was a special baby and kept him hidden for three months.

verses.kjv_text: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid {it} in the flags by the river's brink.
verses.nlt_text: But when she could no longer hide him, she got a basket made of papyrus reeds and waterproofed it with tar and pitch. She put the baby in the basket and laid it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile River.

verses.kjv_text: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
verses.nlt_text: The baby's sister then stood at a distance, watching to see what would happen to him.

verses.kjv_text: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash {herself} at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verses.nlt_text: Soon Pharaoh's daughter came down to bathe in the river, and her attendants walked along the riverbank. When the princess saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maid to get it for her.

verses.kjv_text: And when she had opened {it}, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This {is one} of the Hebrews' children.
verses.nlt_text: When the princess opened it, she saw the baby. The little boy was crying, and she felt sorry for him. "This must be one of the Hebrew children," she said.

verses.kjv_text: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
verses.nlt_text: Then the baby's sister approached the princess. "Should I go and find one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?" she asked.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, do!" the princess replied. So the girl went and called the baby's mother.

verses.kjv_text: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give {thee} thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
verses.nlt_text: "Take this baby and nurse him for me," the princess told the baby's mother. "I will pay you for your help." So the woman took her baby home and nursed him.

verses.kjv_text: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water. {Moses: that is, Drawn out}
verses.nlt_text: Later, when the boy was older, his mother brought him back to Pharaoh's daughter, who adopted him as her own son. The princess named him Moses, for she explained, "I lifted him out of the water."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Many years later, when Moses had grown up, he went out to visit his own people, the Hebrews, and he saw how hard they were forced to work. During his visit, he saw an Egyptian beating one of his fellow Hebrews.

verses.kjv_text: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that {there was} no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.nlt_text: After looking in all directions to make sure no one was watching, Moses killed the Egyptian and hid the body in the sand.

verses.kjv_text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
verses.nlt_text: The next day, when Moses went out to visit his people again, he saw two Hebrew men fighting. "Why are you beating up your friend?" Moses said to the one who had started the fight.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known. {a prince: Heb. a man, a prince}
verses.nlt_text: The man replied, "Who appointed you to be our prince and judge? Are you going to kill me as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?" Then Moses was afraid, thinking, "Everyone knows what I did."

verses.kjv_text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
verses.nlt_text: And sure enough, Pharaoh heard what had happened, and he tried to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in the land of Midian.When Moses arrived in Midian, he sat down beside a well.

verses.kjv_text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew {water}, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock. {priest: or, prince}
verses.nlt_text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters who came as usual to draw water and fill the water troughs for their father's flocks.

verses.kjv_text: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.nlt_text: But some other shepherds came and chased them away. So Moses jumped up and rescued the girls from the shepherds. Then he drew water for their flocks.

verses.kjv_text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How {is it that} ye are come so soon to day? {Reuel: called also Jethro, or, Jether}
verses.nlt_text: When the girls returned to Reuel, their father, he asked, "Why are you back so soon today?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew {water} enough for us, and watered the flock.
verses.nlt_text: "An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds," they answered. "And then he drew water for us and watered our flocks."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto his daughters, And where {is} he? why {is} it {that} ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
verses.nlt_text: "Then where is he?" their father asked. "Why did you leave him there? Invite him to come and eat with us."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
verses.nlt_text: Moses accepted the invitation, and he settled there with him. In time, Reuel gave Moses his daughter Zipporah to be his wife.

verses.kjv_text: And she bare {him} a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land. {Gershom: that is, A stranger here}
verses.nlt_text: Later she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, for he explained, "I have been a foreigner in a foreign land."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
verses.nlt_text: Years passed, and the king of Egypt died. But the Israelites continued to groan under their burden of slavery. They cried out for help, and their cry rose up to God.

verses.kjv_text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: God heard their groaning, and he remembered his covenant promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto {them}. {had...: Heb. knew}
verses.nlt_text: He looked down on the people of Israel and knew it was time to act.

verses.kjv_text: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, {even} to Horeb.
verses.nlt_text: One day Moses was tending the flock of his father-in-law, Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock far into the wilderness and came to Sinai, the mountain of God.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush {was} not consumed.
verses.nlt_text: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from the middle of a bush. Moses stared in amazement. Though the bush was engulfed in flames, it didn't burn up.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verses.nlt_text: "This is amazing," Moses said to himself. "Why isn't that bush burning up? I must go see it."

verses.kjv_text: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here {am} I.
verses.nlt_text: When the LORD saw Moses coming to take a closer look, God called to him from the middle of the bush, "Moses! Moses!" "Here I am!" Moses replied.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest {is} holy ground.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not come any closer," the LORD warned. "Take off your sandals, for you are standing on holy ground.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he said, I {am} the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.nlt_text: I am the God of your father-- the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." When Moses heard this, he covered his face because he was afraid to look at God.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which {are} in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD told him, "I have certainly seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their cries of distress because of their harsh slave drivers. Yes, I am aware of their suffering.

verses.kjv_text: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.nlt_text: So I have come down to rescue them from the power of the Egyptians and lead them out of Egypt into their own fertile and spacious land. It is a land flowing with milk and honey-- the land where the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites now live.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.nlt_text: Look! The cry of the people of Israel has reached me, and I have seen how harshly the Egyptians abuse them.

verses.kjv_text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: Now go, for I am sending you to Pharaoh. You must lead my people Israel out of Egypt."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto God, Who {am} I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
verses.nlt_text: But Moses protested to God, "Who am I to appear before Pharaoh? Who am I to lead the people of Israel out of Egypt?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this {shall be} a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
verses.nlt_text: God answered, "I will be with you. And this is your sign that I am the one who has sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God at this very mountain."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto God, Behold, {when} I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What {is} his name? what shall I say unto them?
verses.nlt_text: But Moses protested, "If I go to the people of Israel and tell them, 'The God of your ancestors has sent me to you,' they will ask me, 'What is his name?' Then what should I tell them?"

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
verses.nlt_text: God replied to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM. Say this to the people of Israel: I AM has sent me to you."

verses.kjv_text: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this {is} my name for ever, and this {is} my memorial unto all generations.
verses.nlt_text: God also said to Moses, "Say this to the people of Israel: Yahweh, the God of your ancestors-- the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob-- has sent me to you. This is my eternal name, my name to remember for all generations.

verses.kjv_text: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and {seen} that which is done to you in Egypt:
verses.nlt_text: "Now go and call together all the elders of Israel. Tell them, 'The LORD, the God of your ancestors-- the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob-- has appeared to me. He told me, "I have been watching closely, and I see how the Egyptians are treating you.

verses.kjv_text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
