verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.nlt_text: "These are the regulations you must present to Israel.

verses.kjv_text: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.nlt_text: "If you buy a Hebrew slave, he may serve for no more than six years. Set him free in the seventh year, and he will owe you nothing for his freedom.

verses.kjv_text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him. {by himself: Heb. with his body}
verses.nlt_text: If he was single when he became your slave, he shall leave single. But if he was married before he became a slave, then his wife must be freed with him.

verses.kjv_text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.nlt_text: "If his master gave him a wife while he was a slave and they had sons or daughters, then only the man will be free in the seventh year, but his wife and children will still belong to his master.

verses.kjv_text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free: {shall...: Heb. saying shall say}
verses.nlt_text: But the slave may declare, 'I love my master, my wife, and my children. I don't want to go free.'

verses.kjv_text: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.nlt_text: If he does this, his master must present him before God. Then his master must take him to the door or doorpost and publicly pierce his ear with an awl. After that, the slave will serve his master for life.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.nlt_text: "When a man sells his daughter as a slave, she will not be freed at the end of six years as the men are.

verses.kjv_text: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her. {please...: Heb. be evil in the eyes of, etc}
verses.nlt_text: If she does not satisfy her owner, he must allow her to be bought back again. But he is not allowed to sell her to foreigners, since he is the one who broke the contract with her.

verses.kjv_text: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.nlt_text: But if the slave's owner arranges for her to marry his son, he may no longer treat her as a slave but as a daughter.

verses.kjv_text: If he take him another {wife}; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.nlt_text: "If a man who has married a slave wife takes another wife for himself, he must not neglect the rights of the first wife to food, clothing, and sexual intimacy.

verses.kjv_text: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.nlt_text: If he fails in any of these three obligations, she may leave as a free woman without making any payment.

verses.kjv_text: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who assaults and kills another person must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver {him} into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.nlt_text: But if it was simply an accident permitted by God, I will appoint a place of refuge where the slayer can run for safety.

verses.kjv_text: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.nlt_text: However, if someone deliberately kills another person, then the slayer must be dragged even from my altar and be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who strikes father or mother must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "Kidnappers must be put to death, whether they are caught in possession of their victims or have already sold them as slaves.

verses.kjv_text: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death. {curseth: or, revileth}
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who dishonors father or mother must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with {his} fist, and he die not, but keepeth {his} bed: {another: or, his neighbour}
verses.nlt_text: "Now suppose two men quarrel, and one hits the other with a stone or fist, and the injured person does not die but is confined to bed.

verses.kjv_text: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote {him} be quit: only he shall pay {for} the loss of his time, and shall cause {him} to be thoroughly healed. {the loss...: Heb. his ceasing}
verses.nlt_text: If he is later able to walk outside again, even with a crutch, the assailant will not be punished but must compensate his victim for lost wages and provide for his full recovery.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished. {punished: Heb. avenged}
verses.nlt_text: "If a man beats his male or female slave with a club and the slave dies as a result, the owner must be punished.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he {is} his money.
verses.nlt_text: But if the slave recovers within a day or two, then the owner shall not be punished, since the slave is his property.

verses.kjv_text: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart {from her}, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges {determine}.
verses.nlt_text: "Now suppose two men are fighting, and in the process they accidentally strike a pregnant woman so she gives birth prematurely. If no further injury results, the man who struck the woman must pay the amount of compensation the woman's husband demands and the judges approve.

verses.kjv_text: And if {any} mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.nlt_text: But if there is further injury, the punishment must match the injury: a life for a life,

verses.kjv_text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.nlt_text: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot,

verses.kjv_text: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.nlt_text: a burn for a burn, a wound for a wound, a bruise for a bruise.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
verses.nlt_text: "If a man hits his male or female slave in the eye and the eye is blinded, he must let the slave go free to compensate for the eye.

verses.kjv_text: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
verses.nlt_text: And if a man knocks out the tooth of his male or female slave, he must let the slave go free to compensate for the tooth.

verses.kjv_text: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox {shall be} quit.
verses.nlt_text: "If an ox gores a man or woman to death, the ox must be stoned, and its flesh may not be eaten. In such a case, however, the owner will not be held liable.

verses.kjv_text: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: But suppose the ox had a reputation for goring, and the owner had been informed but failed to keep it under control. If the ox then kills someone, it must be stoned, and the owner must also be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.nlt_text: However, the dead person's relatives may accept payment to compensate for the loss of life. The owner of the ox may redeem his life by paying whatever is demanded.

verses.kjv_text: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.nlt_text: "The same regulation applies if the ox gores a boy or a girl.

verses.kjv_text: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.nlt_text: But if the ox gores a slave, either male or female, the animal's owner must pay the slave's owner thirty silver coins, and the ox must be stoned.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.nlt_text: "Suppose someone digs or uncovers a pit and fails to cover it, and then an ox or a donkey falls into it.

verses.kjv_text: The owner of the pit shall make {it} good, {and} give money unto the owner of them; and the dead {beast} shall be his.
verses.nlt_text: The owner of the pit must pay full compensation to the owner of the animal, but then he gets to keep the dead animal.

verses.kjv_text: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead {ox} also they shall divide.
verses.nlt_text: "If someone's ox injures a neighbor's ox and the injured ox dies, then the two owners must sell the live ox and divide the price equally between them. They must also divide the dead animal.

verses.kjv_text: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.nlt_text: But if the ox had a reputation for goring, yet its owner failed to keep it under control, he must pay full compensation-- a live ox for the dead one-- but he may keep the dead ox.

verses.kjv_text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep. {or a sheep: or, or a goat}
verses.nlt_text: "If someone steals an ox or sheep and then kills or sells it, the thief must pay back five oxen for each ox stolen, and four sheep for each sheep stolen.

verses.kjv_text: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, {there shall} no blood {be shed} for him.
verses.nlt_text: "If a thief is caught in the act of breaking into a house and is struck and killed in the process, the person who killed the thief is not guilty of murder.

verses.kjv_text: If the sun be risen upon him, {there shall be} blood {shed} for him; {for} he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.nlt_text: But if it happens in daylight, the one who killed the thief is guilty of murder."A thief who is caught must pay in full for everything he stole. If he cannot pay, he must be sold as a slave to pay for his theft.

verses.kjv_text: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.nlt_text: If someone steals an ox or a donkey or a sheep and it is found in the thief's possession, then the thief must pay double the value of the stolen animal.

verses.kjv_text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.nlt_text: "If an animal is grazing in a field or vineyard and the owner lets it stray into someone else's field to graze, then the animal's owner must pay compensation from the best of his own grain or grapes.

verses.kjv_text: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed {therewith}; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.nlt_text: "If you are burning thornbushes and the fire gets out of control and spreads into another person's field, destroying the sheaves or the uncut grain or the whole crop, the one who started the fire must pay for the lost crop.

verses.kjv_text: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.nlt_text: "Suppose someone leaves money or goods with a neighbor for safekeeping, and they are stolen from the neighbor's house. If the thief is caught, the compensation is double the value of what was stolen.

verses.kjv_text: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, {to see} whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
verses.nlt_text: But if the thief is not caught, the neighbor must appear before God, who will determine if he stole the property.

verses.kjv_text: For all manner of trespass, {whether it be} for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, {or} for any manner of lost thing, which {another} challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; {and} whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.nlt_text: "Suppose there is a dispute between two people who both claim to own a particular ox, donkey, sheep, article of clothing, or any lost property. Both parties must come before God, and the person whom God declares guilty must pay double compensation to the other.

verses.kjv_text: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing {it}:
verses.nlt_text: "Now suppose someone leaves a donkey, ox, sheep, or any other animal with a neighbor for safekeeping, but it dies or is injured or gets away, and no one sees what happened.

verses.kjv_text: {Then} shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept {thereof}, and he shall not make {it} good.
verses.nlt_text: The neighbor must then take an oath in the presence of the LORD. If the LORD confirms that the neighbor did not steal the property, the owner must accept the verdict, and no payment will be required.

verses.kjv_text: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.nlt_text: But if the animal was indeed stolen, the guilty person must pay compensation to the owner.

verses.kjv_text: If it be torn in pieces, {then} let him bring it {for} witness, {and} he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.nlt_text: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, the remains of the carcass must be shown as evidence, and no compensation will be required.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man borrow {ought} of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof {being} not with it, he shall surely make {it} good.
verses.nlt_text: "If someone borrows an animal from a neighbor and it is injured or dies when the owner is absent, the person who borrowed it must pay full compensation.

verses.kjv_text: {But} if the owner thereof {be} with it, he shall not make {it} good: if it {be} an hired {thing}, it came for his hire.
verses.nlt_text: But if the owner was present, no compensation is required. And no compensation is required if the animal was rented, for this loss is covered by the rental fee.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.nlt_text: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not engaged to anyone and has sex with her, he must pay the customary bride price and marry her.

verses.kjv_text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins. {pay: Heb. weigh}
verses.nlt_text: But if her father refuses to let him marry her, the man must still pay him an amount equal to the bride price of a virgin.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.nlt_text: "You must not allow a sorceress to live.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: He that sacrificeth unto {any} god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who sacrifices to any god other than the LORD must be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: "You must not mistreat or oppress foreigners in any way. Remember, you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.nlt_text: "You must not exploit a widow or an orphan.

verses.kjv_text: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.nlt_text: If you exploit them in any way and they cry out to me, then I will certainly hear their cry.

verses.kjv_text: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.nlt_text: My anger will blaze against you, and I will kill you with the sword. Then your wives will be widows and your children fatherless.

verses.kjv_text: If thou lend money to {any of} my people {that is} poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.nlt_text: "If you lend money to any of my people who are in need, do not charge interest as a money lender would.

verses.kjv_text: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.nlt_text: If you take your neighbor's cloak as security for a loan, you must return it before sunset.

verses.kjv_text: For that {is} his covering only, it {is} his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I {am} gracious.
verses.nlt_text: This coat may be the only blanket your neighbor has. How can a person sleep without it? If you do not return it and your neighbor cries out to me for help, then I will hear, for I am merciful.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people. {gods: or, judges}
verses.nlt_text: "You must not dishonor God or curse any of your rulers.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not delay {to offer} the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me. {the first...: Heb. thy fulness} {liquors: Heb. tear}
verses.nlt_text: "You must not hold anything back when you give me offerings from your crops and your wine."You must give me your firstborn sons.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, {and} with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.nlt_text: "You must also give me the firstborn of your cattle, sheep, and goats. But leave the newborn animal with its mother for seven days; then give it to me on the eighth day.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat {any} flesh {that is} torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.nlt_text: "You must be my holy people. Therefore, do not eat any animal that has been torn up and killed by wild animals. Throw it to the dogs.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness. {raise: or, receive}
verses.nlt_text: "You must not pass along false rumors. You must not cooperate with evil people by lying on the witness stand.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to {do} evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest {judgment}: {speak: Heb. answer}
verses.nlt_text: "You must not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you are called to testify in a dispute, do not be swayed by the crowd to twist justice.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.nlt_text: And do not slant your testimony in favor of a person just because that person is poor.

verses.kjv_text: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.nlt_text: "If you come upon your enemy's ox or donkey that has strayed away, take it back to its owner.

verses.kjv_text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him. {and...: or, wilt thou cease to help him? or, and wouldest cease to leave thy business for him: thou shalt surely leave it to join with him}
verses.nlt_text: If you see that the donkey of someone who hates you has collapsed under its load, do not walk by. Instead, stop and help.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.nlt_text: "In a lawsuit, you must not deny justice to the poor.

verses.kjv_text: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.nlt_text: "Be sure never to charge anyone falsely with evil. Never sentence an innocent or blameless person to death, for I never declare a guilty person to be innocent.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous. {the wise: Heb. the seeing}
verses.nlt_text: "Take no bribes, for a bribe makes you ignore something that you clearly see. A bribe makes even a righteous person twist the truth.

verses.kjv_text: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt. {heart: Heb. soul}
verses.nlt_text: "You must not oppress foreigners. You know what it's like to be a foreigner, for you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.nlt_text: "Plant and harvest your crops for six years,

verses.kjv_text: But the seventh {year} thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, {and} with thy oliveyard. {oliveyard: or, olive trees}
verses.nlt_text: but let the land be renewed and lie uncultivated during the seventh year. Then let the poor among you harvest whatever grows on its own. Leave the rest for wild animals to eat. The same applies to your vineyards and olive groves.

verses.kjv_text: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.nlt_text: "You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but on the seventh day you must stop working. This gives your ox and your donkey a chance to rest. It also allows your slaves and the foreigners living among you to be refreshed.

verses.kjv_text: And in all {things} that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.nlt_text: "Pay close attention to all my instructions. You must not call on the name of any other gods. Do not even speak their names.

verses.kjv_text: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.nlt_text: "Each year you must celebrate three festivals in my honor.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.nlt_text: First, celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, just as I commanded you. Celebrate this festival annually at the appointed time in early spring, in the month of Abib, for that is the anniversary of your departure from Egypt. No one may appear before me without an offering.

verses.kjv_text: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, {which is} in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.nlt_text: "Second, celebrate the Festival of Harvest, when you bring me the first crops of your harvest."Finally, celebrate the Festival of the Final Harvest at the end of the harvest season, when you have harvested all the crops from your fields.

verses.kjv_text: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: At these three times each year, every man in Israel must appear before the Sovereign, the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning. {sacrifice: or, feast}
verses.nlt_text: "You must not offer the blood of my sacrificial offerings together with any baked goods containing yeast. And do not leave the fat from the festival offerings until the next morning.

verses.kjv_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.nlt_text: "As you harvest your crops, bring the very best of the first harvest to the house of the LORD your God."You must not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.nlt_text: "See, I am sending an angel before you to protect you on your journey and lead you safely to the place I have prepared for you.

verses.kjv_text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name {is} in him.
verses.nlt_text: Pay close attention to him, and obey his instructions. Do not rebel against him, for he is my representative, and he will not forgive your rebellion.

verses.kjv_text: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries. {an adversary...: or, I will afflict them that afflict thee}
verses.nlt_text: But if you are careful to obey him, following all my instructions, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and I will oppose those who oppose you.

verses.kjv_text: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.nlt_text: For my angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, so you may live there. And I will destroy them completely.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.nlt_text: You must not worship the gods of these nations or serve them in any way or imitate their evil practices. Instead, you must utterly destroy them and smash their sacred pillars.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.nlt_text: "You must serve only the LORD your God. If you do, I will bless you with food and water, and I will protect you from illness.

verses.kjv_text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.nlt_text: There will be no miscarriages or infertility in your land, and I will give you long, full lives.

verses.kjv_text: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee. {backs: Heb. neck}
verses.nlt_text: "I will send my terror ahead of you and create panic among all the people whose lands you invade. I will make all your enemies turn and run.

verses.kjv_text: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.nlt_text: I will send terror ahead of you to drive out the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites.

verses.kjv_text: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.nlt_text: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals would multiply and threaten you.

verses.kjv_text: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.nlt_text: I will drive them out a little at a time until your population has increased enough to take possession of the land.

verses.kjv_text: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.nlt_text: And I will fix your boundaries from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the eastern wilderness to the Euphrates River. I will hand over to you the people now living in the land, and you will drive them out ahead of you.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.nlt_text: "Make no treaties with them or their gods.

verses.kjv_text: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: They must not live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me. If you serve their gods, you will be caught in the trap of idolatry."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD instructed Moses: "Come up here to me, and bring along Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel's elders. All of you must worship from a distance.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.nlt_text: Only Moses is allowed to come near to the LORD. The others must not come near, and none of the other people are allowed to climb up the mountain with him."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses went down to the people and repeated all the instructions and regulations the LORD had given him. All the people answered with one voice, "We will do everything the LORD has commanded."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses carefully wrote down all the LORD's instructions. Early the next morning Moses got up and built an altar at the foot of the mountain. He also set up twelve pillars, one for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Then he sent some of the young Israelite men to present burnt offerings and to sacrifice bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses took half of the blood, and put {it} in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Moses drained half the blood from these animals into basins. The other half he splattered against the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.nlt_text: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it aloud to the people. Again they all responded, "We will do everything the LORD has commanded. We will obey."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled {it} on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses took the blood from the basins and splattered it over the people, declaring, "Look, this blood confirms the covenant the LORD has made with you in giving you these instructions."

verses.kjv_text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel climbed up the mountain again.

verses.kjv_text: And they saw the God of Israel: and {there was} under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in {his} clearness.
verses.nlt_text: There they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet there seemed to be a surface of brilliant blue lapis lazuli, as clear as the sky itself.

verses.kjv_text: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
verses.nlt_text: And though these nobles of Israel gazed upon God, he did not destroy them. In fact, they ate a covenant meal, eating and drinking in his presence!

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain. Stay there, and I will give you the tablets of stone on which I have inscribed the instructions and commands so you can teach the people."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses and his assistant Joshua set out, and Moses climbed up the mountain of God.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur {are} with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Moses told the elders, "Stay here and wait for us until we come back. Aaron and Hur are here with you. If anyone has a dispute while I am gone, consult with them."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses climbed up the mountain, and the cloud covered it.

verses.kjv_text: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.nlt_text: And the glory of the LORD settled down on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from inside the cloud.

verses.kjv_text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD {was} like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: To the Israelites at the foot of the mountain, the glory of the LORD appeared at the summit like a consuming fire.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses disappeared into the cloud as he climbed higher up the mountain. He remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering. {bring me: Heb. take for me} {offering: or, heave offering}
verses.nlt_text: "Tell the people of Israel to bring me their sacred offerings. Accept the contributions from all whose hearts are moved to offer them.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass, {offering: or, heave offering}
verses.nlt_text: Here is a list of sacred offerings you may accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;

verses.kjv_text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' {hair}, {fine...: or, silk}
verses.nlt_text: blue, purple, and scarlet thread; fine linen and goat hair for cloth;

verses.kjv_text: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.nlt_text: tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather; acacia wood;

verses.kjv_text: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.nlt_text: olive oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;

verses.kjv_text: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.nlt_text: onyx stones, and other gem stones to be set in the ephod and the priest's chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.nlt_text: "Have the people of Israel build me a holy sanctuary so I can live among them.

verses.kjv_text: According to all that I shew thee, {after} the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make {it}.
verses.nlt_text: You must build this Tabernacle and its furnishings exactly according to the pattern I will show you.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall make an ark {of} shittim wood: two cubits and a half {shall be} the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "Have the people make an Ark of acacia wood-- a sacred chest 45 inches long, 27 inches wide, and 27 inches high.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.nlt_text: Overlay it inside and outside with pure gold, and run a molding of gold all around it.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put {them} in the four corners thereof; and two rings {shall be} in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.nlt_text: Cast four gold rings and attach them to its four feet, two rings on each side.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make staves {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.nlt_text: Make poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.nlt_text: Insert the poles into the rings at the sides of the Ark to carry it.

verses.kjv_text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.nlt_text: These carrying poles must stay inside the rings; never remove them.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.nlt_text: When the Ark is finished, place inside it the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, which I will give to you.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make a mercy seat {of} pure gold: two cubits and a half {shall be} the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "Then make the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- from pure gold. It must be 45 inches long and 27 inches wide.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make two cherubims {of} gold, {of} beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.nlt_text: Then make two cherubim from hammered gold, and place them on the two ends of the atonement cover.

verses.kjv_text: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: {even} of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof. {of...: or, of the matter of the mercy seat}
verses.nlt_text: Mold the cherubim on each end of the atonement cover, making it all of one piece of gold.

verses.kjv_text: And the cherubims shall stretch forth {their} wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces {shall look} one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.nlt_text: The cherubim will face each other and look down on the atonement cover. With their wings spread above it, they will protect it.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.nlt_text: Place inside the Ark the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, which I will give to you. Then put the atonement cover on top of the Ark.

verses.kjv_text: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which {are} upon the ark of the testimony, of all {things} which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: I will meet with you there and talk to you from above the atonement cover between the gold cherubim that hover over the Ark of the Covenant. From there I will give you my commands for the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt also make a table {of} shittim wood: two cubits {shall be} the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "Then make a table of acacia wood, 36 inches long, 18 inches wide, and 27 inches high.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.nlt_text: Overlay it with pure gold and run a gold molding around the edge.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.nlt_text: Decorate it with a 3-inch border all around, and run a gold molding along the border.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that {are} on the four feet thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Make four gold rings for the table and attach them at the four corners next to the four legs.

verses.kjv_text: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.nlt_text: Attach the rings near the border to hold the poles that are used to carry the table.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the staves {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.nlt_text: Make these poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: {of} pure gold shalt thou make them. {to...: or, to pour out withal}
verses.nlt_text: Make special containers of pure gold for the table-- bowls, pans, pitchers, and jars-- to be used in pouring out liquid offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.nlt_text: Place the Bread of the Presence on the table to remain before me at all times.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make a candlestick {of} pure gold: {of} beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.nlt_text: "Make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. Make the entire lampstand and its decorations of one piece-- the base, center stem, lamp cups, buds, and petals.

verses.kjv_text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.nlt_text: Make it with six branches going out from the center stem, three on each side.

verses.kjv_text: Three bowls made like unto almonds, {with} a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, {with} a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.nlt_text: Each of the six branches will have three lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.

verses.kjv_text: And in the candlestick {shall be} four bowls made like unto almonds, {with} their knops and their flowers.
verses.nlt_text: Craft the center stem of the lampstand with four lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.

verses.kjv_text: And {there shall be} a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.nlt_text: There will also be an almond bud beneath each pair of branches where the six branches extend from the center stem.

verses.kjv_text: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it {shall be} one beaten work {of} pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: The almond buds and branches must all be of one piece with the center stem, and they must be hammered from pure gold.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it. {shall light: or, shall cause to ascend} {it: Heb. the face of it}
verses.nlt_text: Then make the seven lamps for the lampstand, and set them so they reflect their light forward.

verses.kjv_text: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, {shall be of} pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: The lamp snuffers and trays must also be made of pure gold.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.nlt_text: You will need seventy-five pounds of pure gold for the lampstand and its accessories.

verses.kjv_text: And look that thou make {them} after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount. {which...: Heb. which thou wast caused to see}
verses.nlt_text: "Be sure that you make everything according to the pattern I have shown you here on the mountain.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle {with} ten curtains {of} fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: {with} cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them. {of cunning...: Heb. the work of a cunning workman, or, embroiderer}
verses.nlt_text: "Make the Tabernacle from ten curtains of finely woven linen. Decorate the curtains with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: The length of one curtain {shall be} eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.nlt_text: These ten curtains must all be exactly the same size-- 42 feet long and 6 feet wide.

verses.kjv_text: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and {other} five curtains {shall be} coupled one to another.
verses.nlt_text: Join five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, then join the other five into a second long curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of {another} curtain, in the coupling of the second. {selvedge: an edge of cloth so woven that it cannot unravel}
verses.nlt_text: Put loops of blue yarn along the edge of the last curtain in each set.

verses.kjv_text: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that {is} in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.nlt_text: The fifty loops along the edge of one curtain are to match the fifty loops along the edge of the other curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Then make fifty gold clasps and fasten the long curtains together with the clasps. In this way, the Tabernacle will be made of one continuous piece.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make curtains {of} goats' {hair} to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.nlt_text: "Make eleven curtains of goat-hair cloth to serve as a tent covering for the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: The length of one curtain {shall be} thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains {shall be all} of one measure.
verses.nlt_text: These eleven curtains must all be exactly the same size-- 45 feet long and 6 feet wide.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Join five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, and join the other six into a second long curtain. Allow 3 feet of material from the second set of curtains to hang over the front of the sacred tent.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain {that is} outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.nlt_text: Make fifty loops for one edge of each large curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one. {tent: or, covering}
verses.nlt_text: Then make fifty bronze clasps, and fasten the loops of the long curtains with the clasps. In this way, the tent covering will be made of one continuous piece.

verses.kjv_text: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: The remaining 3 feet of this tent covering will be left to hang over the back of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it. {of that...: Heb. in the remainder, or, surplus}
verses.nlt_text: Allow 18 inches of remaining material to hang down over each side, so the Tabernacle is completely covered.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent {of} rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above {of} badgers' skins.
verses.nlt_text: Complete the tent covering with a protective layer of tanned ram skins and a layer of fine goatskin leather.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle {of} shittim wood standing up.
verses.nlt_text: "For the framework of the Tabernacle, construct frames of acacia wood.

verses.kjv_text: Ten cubits {shall be} the length of a board, and a cubit and a half {shall be} the breadth of one board.
verses.nlt_text: Each frame must be 15 feet high and 27 inches wide,

verses.kjv_text: Two tenons {shall there be} in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle. {tenons: Heb. hands}
verses.nlt_text: with two pegs under each frame. Make all the frames identical.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.nlt_text: Make twenty of these frames to support the curtains on the south side of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons. {tenons: Heb. hands}
verses.nlt_text: Also make forty silver bases-- two bases under each frame, with the pegs fitting securely into the bases.

verses.kjv_text: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side {there shall be} twenty boards:
verses.nlt_text: For the north side of the Tabernacle, make another twenty frames,

verses.kjv_text: And their forty sockets {of} silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.nlt_text: with their forty silver bases, two bases under each frame.

verses.kjv_text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.nlt_text: Make six frames for the rear-- the west side of the Tabernacle--

verses.kjv_text: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.nlt_text: along with two additional frames to reinforce the rear corners of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners. {coupled: Heb. twinned}
verses.nlt_text: These corner frames will be matched at the bottom and firmly attached at the top with a single ring, forming a single corner unit. Make both of these corner units the same way.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets {of} silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.nlt_text: So there will be eight frames at the rear of the Tabernacle, set in sixteen silver bases-- two bases under each frame.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make bars {of} shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.nlt_text: "Make crossbars of acacia wood to link the frames, five crossbars for the north side of the Tabernacle

verses.kjv_text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.nlt_text: and five for the south side. Also make five crossbars for the rear of the Tabernacle, which will face west.

verses.kjv_text: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.nlt_text: The middle crossbar, attached halfway up the frames, will run all the way from one end of the Tabernacle to the other.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings {of} gold {for} places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.nlt_text: Overlay the frames with gold, and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Overlay the crossbars with gold as well.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.nlt_text: "Set up this Tabernacle according to the pattern you were shown on the mountain.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make a vail {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.nlt_text: "For the inside of the Tabernacle, make a special curtain of finely woven linen. Decorate it with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim {wood} overlaid with gold: their hooks {shall be of} gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.nlt_text: Hang this curtain on gold hooks attached to four posts of acacia wood. Overlay the posts with gold, and set them in four silver bases.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy {place} and the most holy.
verses.nlt_text: Hang the inner curtain from clasps, and put the Ark of the Covenant in the room behind it. This curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy {place}.
verses.nlt_text: "Then put the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- on top of the Ark of the Covenant inside the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.nlt_text: Place the table outside the inner curtain on the north side of the Tabernacle, and place the lampstand across the room on the south side.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.nlt_text: "Make another curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent. Make it of finely woven linen and embroider it with exquisite designs, using blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars {of} shittim {wood}, and overlay them with gold, {and} their hooks {shall be of} gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.nlt_text: Craft five posts from acacia wood. Overlay them with gold, and hang the curtain from them with gold hooks. Cast five bronze bases for the posts.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make an altar {of} shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof {shall be} three cubits.
verses.nlt_text: "Using acacia wood, construct a square altar 7-1/2 feet wide, 7-1/2 feet long, and 4-1/2 feet high.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.nlt_text: Make horns for each of its four corners so that the horns and altar are all one piece. Overlay the altar with bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make {of} brass.
verses.nlt_text: Make ash buckets, shovels, basins, meat forks, and firepans, all of bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network {of} brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Make a bronze grating for it, and attach four bronze rings at its four corners.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Install the grating halfway down the side of the altar, under the ledge.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.nlt_text: For carrying the altar, make poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.nlt_text: Insert the poles through the rings on the two sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make {it}. {it was...: Heb. he shewed}
verses.nlt_text: The altar must be hollow, made from planks. Build it just as you were shown on the mountain.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward {there shall be} hangings for the court {of} fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.nlt_text: "Then make the courtyard for the Tabernacle, enclosed with curtains made of finely woven linen. On the south side, make the curtains 150 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets {shall be of} brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets {shall be of} silver.
verses.nlt_text: They will be held up by twenty posts set securely in twenty bronze bases. Hang the curtains with silver hooks and rings.

verses.kjv_text: And likewise for the north side in length {there shall be} hangings of an hundred {cubits} long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets {of} brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets {of} silver.
verses.nlt_text: Make the curtains the same on the north side-- 150 feet of curtains held up by twenty posts set securely in bronze bases. Hang the curtains with silver hooks and rings.

verses.kjv_text: And {for} the breadth of the court on the west side {shall be} hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.nlt_text: The curtains on the west end of the courtyard will be 75 feet long, supported by ten posts set into ten bases.

verses.kjv_text: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward {shall be} fifty cubits.
verses.nlt_text: The east end of the courtyard, the front, will also be 75 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: The hangings of one side {of the gate shall be} fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.nlt_text: The courtyard entrance will be on the east end, flanked by two curtains. The curtain on the right side will be 22-1/2 feet long, supported by three posts set into three bases.

verses.kjv_text: And on the other side {shall be} hangings fifteen {cubits}: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.nlt_text: The curtain on the left side will also be 22-1/2 feet long, supported by three posts set into three bases.

verses.kjv_text: And for the gate of the court {shall be} an hanging of twenty cubits, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: {and} their pillars {shall be} four, and their sockets four.
verses.nlt_text: "For the entrance to the courtyard, make a curtain that is 30 feet long. Make it from finely woven linen, and decorate it with beautiful embroidery in blue, purple, and scarlet thread. Support it with four posts, each securely set in its own base.

verses.kjv_text: All the pillars round about the court {shall be} filleted with silver; their hooks {shall be of} silver, and their sockets {of} brass.
verses.nlt_text: All the posts around the courtyard must have silver rings and hooks and bronze bases.

verses.kjv_text: The length of the court {shall be} an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits {of} fine twined linen, and their sockets {of} brass. {fifty...: Heb. fifty by fifty}
verses.nlt_text: So the entire courtyard will be 150 feet long and 75 feet wide, with curtain walls 7-1/2 feet high, made from finely woven linen. The bases for the posts will be made of bronze.

verses.kjv_text: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, {shall be of} brass.
verses.nlt_text: "All the articles used in the rituals of the Tabernacle, including all the tent pegs used to support the Tabernacle and the courtyard curtains, must be made of bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always. {to burn: Heb. to ascend up}
verses.nlt_text: "Command the people of Israel to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.

verses.kjv_text: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which {is} before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: {it shall be} a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: The lampstand will stand in the Tabernacle, in front of the inner curtain that shields the Ark of the Covenant. Aaron and his sons must keep the lamps burning in the LORD's presence all night. This is a permanent law for the people of Israel, and it must be observed from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, {even} Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
verses.nlt_text: "Call for your brother, Aaron, and his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Set them apart from the rest of the people of Israel so they may minister to me and be my priests.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.nlt_text: Make sacred garments for Aaron that are glorious and beautiful.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto all {that are} wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: Instruct all the skilled craftsmen whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom. Have them make garments for Aaron that will distinguish him as a priest set apart for my service.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: These are the garments they are to make: a chestpiece, an ephod, a robe, a patterned tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother, Aaron, and his sons to wear when they serve me as priests.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.nlt_text: So give them fine linen cloth, gold thread, and blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall make the ephod {of} gold, {of} blue, and {of} purple, {of} scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
verses.nlt_text: "The craftsmen must make the ephod of finely woven linen and skillfully embroider it with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and {so} it shall be joined together.
verses.nlt_text: It will consist of two pieces, front and back, joined at the shoulders with two shoulder-pieces.

verses.kjv_text: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which {is} upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; {even of} gold, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen. {curious: or, embroidered}
verses.nlt_text: The decorative sash will be made of the same materials: finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: "Take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Six of their names on one stone, and {the other} six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.nlt_text: Six names will be on each stone, arranged in the order of the births of the original sons of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: With the work of an engraver in stone, {like} the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
verses.nlt_text: Engrave these names on the two stones in the same way a jeweler engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in settings of gold filigree.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod {for} stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.nlt_text: Fasten the two stones on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod as a reminder that Aaron represents the people of Israel. Aaron will carry these names on his shoulders as a constant reminder whenever he goes before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make ouches {of} gold;
verses.nlt_text: Make the settings of gold filigree,

verses.kjv_text: And two chains {of} pure gold at the ends; {of} wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
verses.nlt_text: then braid two cords of pure gold and attach them to the filigree settings on the shoulders of the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; {of} gold, {of} blue, and {of} purple, and {of} scarlet, and {of} fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.nlt_text: "Then, with great skill and care, make a chestpiece to be worn for seeking a decision from God. Make it to match the ephod, using finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: Foursquare it shall be {being} doubled; a span {shall be} the length thereof, and a span {shall be} the breadth thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Make the chestpiece of a single piece of cloth folded to form a pouch nine inches square.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, {even} four rows of stones: {the first} row {shall be} a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: {this shall be} the first row. {set...: Heb. fill in it fillings of stone} {sardius: or, ruby}
verses.nlt_text: Mount four rows of gemstones on it. The first row will contain a red carnelian, a pale green peridot, and an emerald.

verses.kjv_text: And the second row {shall be} an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.nlt_text: The second row will contain a turquoise, a blue lapis lazuli, and a white moonstone.

verses.kjv_text: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.nlt_text: The third row will contain an orange jacinth, an agate, and a purple amethyst.

verses.kjv_text: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings. {inclosings: Heb. fillings}
verses.nlt_text: The fourth row will contain a blue-green beryl, an onyx, and a green jasper. All these stones will be set in gold filigree.

verses.kjv_text: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, {like} the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.nlt_text: Each stone will represent one of the twelve sons of Israel, and the name of that tribe will be engraved on it like a seal.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends {of} wreathen work {of} pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: "To attach the chestpiece to the ephod, make braided cords of pure gold thread.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.nlt_text: Then make two gold rings and attach them to the top corners of the chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put the two wreathen {chains} of gold in the two rings {which are} on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.nlt_text: Tie the two gold cords to the two rings on the chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And {the other} two ends of the two wreathen {chains} thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put {them} on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
verses.nlt_text: Tie the other ends of the cords to the gold settings on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which {is} in the side of the ephod inward.
verses.nlt_text: Then make two more gold rings and attach them to the inside edges of the chestpiece next to the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And two {other} rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the {other} coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.nlt_text: And make two more gold rings and attach them to the front of the ephod, below the shoulder-pieces, just above the knot where the decorative sash is fastened to the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that {it} may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.nlt_text: Then attach the bottom rings of the chestpiece to the rings on the ephod with blue cords. This will hold the chestpiece securely to the ephod above the decorative sash.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy {place}, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
verses.nlt_text: "In this way, Aaron will carry the names of the tribes of Israel on the sacred chestpiece over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place. This will be a continual reminder that he represents the people when he comes before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
verses.nlt_text: Insert the Urim and Thummim into the sacred chestpiece so they will be carried over Aaron's heart when he goes into the LORD's presence. In this way, Aaron will always carry over his heart the objects used to determine the LORD's will for his people whenever he goes in before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all {of} blue.
verses.nlt_text: "Make the robe that is worn with the ephod from a single piece of blue cloth,

verses.kjv_text: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
verses.nlt_text: with an opening for Aaron's head in the middle of it. Reinforce the opening with a woven collar so it will not tear.

verses.kjv_text: And {beneath} upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates {of} blue, and {of} purple, and {of} scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about: {hem: or, skirts}
verses.nlt_text: Make pomegranates out of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and attach them to the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.

verses.kjv_text: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
verses.nlt_text: The gold bells and pomegranates are to alternate all around the hem.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy {place} before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.nlt_text: Aaron will wear this robe whenever he ministers before the LORD, and the bells will tinkle as he goes in and out of the LORD's presence in the Holy Place. If he wears it, he will not die.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make a plate {of} pure gold, and grave upon it, {like} the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Next make a medallion of pure gold, and engrave it like a seal with these words: HOLY TO THE LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.nlt_text: Attach the medallion with a blue cord to the front of Aaron's turban, where it must remain.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Aaron must wear it on his forehead so he may take on himself any guilt of the people of Israel when they consecrate their sacred offerings. He must always wear it on his forehead so the LORD will accept the people.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre {of} fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle {of} needlework.
verses.nlt_text: "Weave Aaron's patterned tunic from fine linen cloth. Fashion the turban from this linen as well. Also make a sash, and decorate it with colorful embroidery.

verses.kjv_text: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.nlt_text: "For Aaron's sons, make tunics, sashes, and special head coverings that are glorious and beautiful.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office. {consecrate...: Heb. fill their hand}
verses.nlt_text: Clothe your brother, Aaron, and his sons with these garments, and then anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they can serve as my priests.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach: {their...: Heb. flesh of their nakedness} {reach: Heb. be}
verses.nlt_text: Also make linen undergarments for them, to be worn next to their bodies, reaching from their hips to their thighs.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy {place}; that they bear not iniquity, and die: {it shall be} a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
verses.nlt_text: These must be worn whenever Aaron and his sons enter the Tabernacle or approach the altar in the Holy Place to perform their priestly duties. Then they will not incur guilt and die. This is a permanent law for Aaron and all his descendants after him.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.nlt_text: "This is the ceremony you must follow when you consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: {of} wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.nlt_text: Then, using choice wheat flour and no yeast, make loaves of bread, thin cakes mixed with olive oil, and wafers spread with oil.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.nlt_text: Place them all in a single basket, and present them at the entrance of the Tabernacle, along with the young bull and the two rams.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.nlt_text: "Present Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and wash them with water.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
verses.nlt_text: Dress Aaron in his priestly garments-- the tunic, the robe worn with the ephod, the ephod itself, and the chestpiece. Then wrap the decorative sash of the ephod around him.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.nlt_text: Place the turban on his head, and fasten the sacred medallion to the turban.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour {it} upon his head, and anoint him.
