verses.nlt_text: Then anoint him by pouring the anointing oil over his head.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.nlt_text: Next present his sons, and dress them in their tunics.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons. {put: Heb. bind} {consecrate: Heb. fill the hand of}
verses.nlt_text: Wrap the sashes around the waists of Aaron and his sons, and put their special head coverings on them. Then the right to the priesthood will be theirs by law forever. In this way, you will ordain Aaron and his sons.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.nlt_text: "Bring the young bull to the entrance of the Tabernacle, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, {by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Then slaughter the bull in the LORD's presence at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Put some of its blood on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul {that is} above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, and burn {them} upon the altar. {the caul: it seemeth by anatomy, and the Hebrew doctors, to be the midriff}
verses.nlt_text: Take all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat around them, and burn it all on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it {is} a sin offering.
verses.nlt_text: Then take the rest of the bull, including its hide, meat, and dung, and burn it outside the camp as a sin offering.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.nlt_text: "Next Aaron and his sons must lay their hands on the head of one of the rams.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle {it} round about upon the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Then slaughter the ram, and splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put {them} unto his pieces, and unto his head. {unto: or, upon}
verses.nlt_text: Cut the ram into pieces, and wash off the internal organs and the legs. Set them alongside the head and the other pieces of the body,

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it {is} a burnt offering unto the LORD: it {is} a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: then burn the entire animal on the altar. This is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasing aroma, a special gift presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.nlt_text: "Now take the other ram, and have Aaron and his sons lay their hands on its head.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put {it} upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.nlt_text: Then slaughter it, and apply some of its blood to the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons. Also put it on the thumbs of their right hands and the big toes of their right feet. Splatter the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take of the blood that {is} upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle {it} upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.nlt_text: Then take some of the blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his sons and on their garments. In this way, they and their garments will be set apart as holy.

verses.kjv_text: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul {above} the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, and the right shoulder; for it {is} a ram of consecration:
verses.nlt_text: "Since this is the ram for the ordination of Aaron and his sons, take the fat of the ram, including the fat of the broad tail, the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat around them, along with the right thigh.

verses.kjv_text: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that {is} before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: Then take one round loaf of bread, one thin cake mixed with olive oil, and one wafer from the basket of bread without yeast that was placed in the LORD's presence.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD. {shalt wave: or, shalt shake to and fro}
verses.nlt_text: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons to be lifted up as a special offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn {them} upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it {is} an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward take the various breads from their hands, and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering. It is a pleasing aroma to the LORD, a special gift for him.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it {for} a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
verses.nlt_text: Then take the breast of Aaron's ordination ram, and lift it up in the LORD's presence as a special offering to him. Then keep it as your own portion.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, {even} of {that} which {is} for Aaron, and of {that} which is for his sons:
verses.nlt_text: "Set aside the portions of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons. This includes the breast and the thigh that were lifted up before the LORD as a special offering.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it {is} an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, {even} their heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: In the future, whenever the people of Israel lift up a peace offering, a portion of it must be set aside for Aaron and his descendants. This is their permanent right, and it is a sacred offering from the Israelites to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.nlt_text: "Aaron's sacred garments must be preserved for his descendants who succeed him, and they will wear them when they are anointed and ordained.

verses.kjv_text: {And} that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy {place}. {that son: Heb. he of his sons}
verses.nlt_text: The descendant who succeeds him as high priest will wear these clothes for seven days as he ministers in the Tabernacle and the Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.nlt_text: "Take the ram used in the ordination ceremony, and boil its meat in a sacred place.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that {is} in the basket, {by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Then Aaron and his sons will eat this meat, along with the bread in the basket, at the Tabernacle entrance.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate {and} to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat {thereof}, because they {are} holy.
verses.nlt_text: They alone may eat the meat and bread used for their purification in the ordination ceremony. No one else may eat them, for these things are set apart and holy.

verses.kjv_text: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it {is} holy.
verses.nlt_text: If any of the ordination meat or bread remains until the morning, it must be burned. It may not be eaten, for it is holy.

verses.kjv_text: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all {things} which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.nlt_text: "This is how you will ordain Aaron and his sons to their offices, just as I have commanded you. The ordination ceremony will go on for seven days.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock {for} a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.nlt_text: Each day you must sacrifice a young bull as a sin offering to purify them, making them right with the LORD. Afterward, cleanse the altar by purifying it; make it holy by anointing it with oil.

verses.kjv_text: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.nlt_text: Purify the altar, and consecrate it every day for seven days. After that, the altar will be absolutely holy, and whatever touches it will become holy.

verses.kjv_text: Now this {is that} which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.nlt_text: "These are the sacrifices you are to offer regularly on the altar. Each day, offer two lambs that are a year old,

verses.kjv_text: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
verses.nlt_text: one in the morning and the other in the evening.

verses.kjv_text: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine {for} a drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: With one of them, offer two quarts of choice flour mixed with one quart of pure oil of pressed olives; also, offer one quart of wine as a liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Offer the other lamb in the evening, along with the same offerings of flour and wine as in the morning. It will be a pleasing aroma, a special gift presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: {This shall be} a continual burnt offering throughout your generations {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: "These burnt offerings are to be made each day from generation to generation. Offer them in the LORD's presence at the Tabernacle entrance; there I will meet with you and speak with you.

verses.kjv_text: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and {the tabernacle} shall be sanctified by my glory. {the tabernacle: or, Israel}
verses.nlt_text: I will meet the people of Israel there, in the place made holy by my glorious presence.

verses.kjv_text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I will consecrate the Tabernacle and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.

verses.kjv_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.nlt_text: Then I will live among the people of Israel and be their God,

verses.kjv_text: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I {am} the LORD their God.
verses.nlt_text: and they will know that I am the LORD their God. I am the one who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I could live among them. I am the LORD their God.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: {of} shittim wood shalt thou make it.
verses.nlt_text: "Then make another altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

verses.kjv_text: A cubit {shall be} the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits {shall be} the height thereof: the horns thereof {shall be} of the same.
verses.nlt_text: Make it 18 inches square and 36 inches high, with horns at the corners carved from the same piece of wood as the altar itself.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about. {top: Heb. roof} {sides: Heb. walls}
verses.nlt_text: Overlay the top, sides, and horns of the altar with pure gold, and run a gold molding around the entire altar.

verses.kjv_text: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make {it}; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal. {corners: Heb. ribs}
verses.nlt_text: Make two gold rings, and attach them on opposite sides of the altar below the gold molding to hold the carrying poles.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make the staves {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.nlt_text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put it before the vail that {is} by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that {is} over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Place the incense altar just outside the inner curtain that shields the Ark of the Covenant, in front of the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- that covers the tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant. I will meet with you there.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it. {sweet incense: Heb. incense of spices}
verses.nlt_text: "Every morning when Aaron maintains the lamps, he must burn fragrant incense on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations. {lighteth: or setteth up: Heb. causeth to ascend} {at even: Heb. between the two evenings}
verses.nlt_text: And each evening when he lights the lamps, he must again burn incense in the LORD's presence. This must be done from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
verses.nlt_text: Do not offer any unholy incense on this altar, or any burnt offerings, grain offerings, or liquid offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it {is} most holy unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing its horns with blood from the offering made to purify the people from their sin. This will be a regular, annual event from generation to generation, for this is the LORD's most holy altar."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when {thou} numberest them. {their number: Heb. them that are to be numbered}
verses.nlt_text: "Whenever you take a census of the people of Israel, each man who is counted must pay a ransom for himself to the LORD. Then no plague will strike the people as you count them.

verses.kjv_text: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel {is} twenty gerahs:) an half shekel {shall be} the offering of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Each person who is counted must give a small piece of silver as a sacred offering to the LORD. (This payment is half a shekel, based on the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs.)

verses.kjv_text: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: All who have reached their twentieth birthday must give this sacred offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when {they} give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls. {give more: Heb. multiply} {give less: Heb. diminish}
verses.nlt_text: When this offering is given to the LORD to purify your lives, making you right with him, the rich must not give more than the specified amount, and the poor must not give less.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.nlt_text: Receive this ransom money from the Israelites, and use it for the care of the Tabernacle. It will bring the Israelites to the LORD's attention, and it will purify your lives."

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt also make a laver {of} brass, and his foot {also of} brass, to wash {withal}: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
verses.nlt_text: "Make a bronze washbasin with a bronze stand. Place it between the Tabernacle and the altar, and fill it with water.

verses.kjv_text: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.nlt_text: Aaron and his sons will wash their hands and feet there.

verses.kjv_text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: They must wash with water whenever they go into the Tabernacle to appear before the LORD and when they approach the altar to burn up their special gifts to the LORD-- or they will die!

verses.kjv_text: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, {even} to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.nlt_text: They must always wash their hands and feet, or they will die. This is a permanent law for Aaron and his descendants, to be observed from generation to generation."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred {shekels}, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, {even} two hundred and fifty {shekels}, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty {shekels},
verses.nlt_text: "Collect choice spices-- 12-1/2 pounds of pure myrrh, 6-1/4 pounds of fragrant cinnamon, 6-1/4 pounds of fragrant calamus,

verses.kjv_text: And of cassia five hundred {shekels}, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
verses.nlt_text: and 12-1/2 pounds of cassia-- as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel. Also get one gallon of olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil. {apothecary: or, perfumer}
verses.nlt_text: Like a skilled incense maker, blend these ingredients to make a holy anointing oil.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.nlt_text: Use this sacred oil to anoint the Tabernacle, the Ark of the Covenant,

verses.kjv_text: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.nlt_text: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and all its accessories, the incense altar,

verses.kjv_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
verses.nlt_text: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the washbasin with its stand.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.nlt_text: Consecrate them to make them absolutely holy. After this, whatever touches them will also become holy.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that {they} may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: "Anoint Aaron and his sons also, consecrating them to serve me as priests.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
verses.nlt_text: And say to the people of Israel, 'This holy anointing oil is reserved for me from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make {any other} like it, after the composition of it: it {is} holy, {and} it shall be holy unto you.
verses.nlt_text: It must never be used to anoint anyone else, and you must never make any blend like it for yourselves. It is holy, and you must treat it as holy.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever compoundeth {any} like it, or whosoever putteth {any} of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who makes a blend like it or anoints someone other than a priest will be cut off from the community.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; {these} sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like {weight}:
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Gather fragrant spices-- resin droplets, mollusk shell, and galbanum-- and mix these fragrant spices with pure frankincense, weighed out in equal amounts.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure {and} holy: {tempered...: Heb. salted}
verses.nlt_text: Using the usual techniques of the incense maker, blend the spices together and sprinkle them with salt to produce a pure and holy incense.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt beat {some} of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
verses.nlt_text: Grind some of the mixture into a very fine powder and put it in front of the Ark of the Covenant, where I will meet with you in the Tabernacle. You must treat this incense as most holy.

verses.kjv_text: And {as for} the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Never use this formula to make this incense for yourselves. It is reserved for the LORD, and you must treat it as holy.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who makes incense like this for personal use will be cut off from the community."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.nlt_text: "Look, I have specifically chosen Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.nlt_text: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, giving him great wisdom, ability, and expertise in all kinds of crafts.

verses.kjv_text: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.nlt_text: He is a master craftsman, expert in working with gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And in cutting of stones, to set {them}, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.nlt_text: He is skilled in engraving and mounting gemstones and in carving wood. He is a master at every craft!

verses.kjv_text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
verses.nlt_text: "And I have personally appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, to be his assistant. Moreover, I have given special skill to all the gifted craftsmen so they can make all the things I have commanded you to make:

verses.kjv_text: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that {is} thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle, {furniture: Heb. vessels}
verses.nlt_text: the Tabernacle; the Ark of the Covenant; the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement; all the furnishings of the Tabernacle;

verses.kjv_text: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense, {furniture: Heb. vessels}
verses.nlt_text: the table and its utensils; the pure gold lampstand with all its accessories; the incense altar;

verses.kjv_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot, {furniture: Heb. vessels}
verses.nlt_text: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils; the washbasin with its stand;

verses.kjv_text: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
verses.nlt_text: the beautifully stitched garments-- the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to wear as they minister as priests;

verses.kjv_text: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy {place}: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
verses.nlt_text: the anointing oil; the fragrant incense for the Holy Place. The craftsmen must make everything as I have commanded you."

verses.kjv_text: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it {is} a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that {ye} may know that I {am} the LORD that doth sanctify you.
verses.nlt_text: "Tell the people of Israel: 'Be careful to keep my Sabbath day, for the Sabbath is a sign of the covenant between me and you from generation to generation. It is given so you may know that I am the LORD, who makes you holy.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it {is} holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth {any} work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.nlt_text: You must keep the Sabbath day, for it is a holy day for you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; anyone who works on that day will be cut off from the community.

verses.kjv_text: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh {is} the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth {any} work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death. {holy: Heb. holiness}
verses.nlt_text: You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day must be a Sabbath day of complete rest, a holy day dedicated to the LORD. Anyone who works on the Sabbath must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, {for} a perpetual covenant.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel must keep the Sabbath day by observing it from generation to generation. This is a covenant obligation for all time.

verses.kjv_text: It {is} a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for {in} six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.nlt_text: It is a permanent sign of my covenant with the people of Israel. For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, but on the seventh day he stopped working and was refreshed.'"

verses.kjv_text: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.nlt_text: When the LORD finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, written by the finger of God.

verses.kjv_text: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for {as for} this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.nlt_text: When the people saw how long it was taking Moses to come back down the mountain, they gathered around Aaron. "Come on," they said, "make us some gods who can lead us. We don't know what happened to this fellow Moses, who brought us here from the land of Egypt."

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which {are} in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring {them} unto me.
verses.nlt_text: So Aaron said, "Take the gold rings from the ears of your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me."

verses.kjv_text: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which {were} in their ears, and brought {them} unto Aaron.
verses.nlt_text: All the people took the gold rings from their ears and brought them to Aaron.

verses.kjv_text: And he received {them} at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These {be} thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: Then Aaron took the gold, melted it down, and molded it into the shape of a calf. When the people saw it, they exclaimed, "O Israel, these are the gods who brought you out of the land of Egypt!"

verses.kjv_text: And when Aaron saw {it}, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow {is} a feast to the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Aaron saw how excited the people were, so he built an altar in front of the calf. Then he announced, "Tomorrow will be a festival to the LORD!"

verses.kjv_text: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.nlt_text: The people got up early the next morning to sacrifice burnt offerings and peace offerings. After this, they celebrated with feasting and drinking, and they indulged in pagan revelry.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted {themselves}:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD told Moses, "Quick! Go down the mountain! Your people whom you brought from the land of Egypt have corrupted themselves.

verses.kjv_text: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These {be} thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: How quickly they have turned away from the way I commanded them to live! They have melted down gold and made a calf, and they have bowed down and sacrificed to it. They are saying, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it {is} a stiffnecked people:
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said, "I have seen how stubborn and rebellious these people are.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.nlt_text: Now leave me alone so my fierce anger can blaze against them, and I will destroy them. Then I will make you, Moses, into a great nation."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand? {the LORD: Heb. the face of the LORD}
verses.nlt_text: But Moses tried to pacify the LORD his God. "O LORD!" he said. "Why are you so angry with your own people whom you brought from the land of Egypt with such great power and such a strong hand?

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.nlt_text: Why let the Egyptians say, 'Their God rescued them with the evil intention of slaughtering them in the mountains and wiping them from the face of the earth'? Turn away from your fierce anger. Change your mind about this terrible disaster you have threatened against your people!

verses.kjv_text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit {it} for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You bound yourself with an oath to them, saying, 'I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars of heaven. And I will give them all of this land that I have promised to your descendants, and they will possess it forever.' "

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD changed his mind about the terrible disaster he had threatened to bring on his people.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony {were} in his hand: the tables {were} written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other {were} they written.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain. He held in his hands the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

verses.kjv_text: And the tables {were} the work of God, and the writing {was} the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.nlt_text: These tablets were God's work; the words on them were written by God himself.

verses.kjv_text: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, {There is} a noise of war in the camp.
verses.nlt_text: When Joshua heard the boisterous noise of the people shouting below them, he exclaimed to Moses, "It sounds like war in the camp!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, {It is} not the voice of {them that} shout for mastery, neither {is it} the voice of {them that} cry for being overcome: {but} the noise of {them that} sing do I hear. {being...: Heb. weakness}
verses.nlt_text: But Moses replied, "No, it's not a shout of victory nor the wailing of defeat. I hear the sound of a celebration."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.nlt_text: When they came near the camp, Moses saw the calf and the dancing, and he burned with anger. He threw the stone tablets to the ground, smashing them at the foot of the mountain.

verses.kjv_text: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt {it} in the fire, and ground {it} to powder, and strawed {it} upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink {of it}.
verses.nlt_text: He took the calf they had made and burned it. Then he ground it into powder, threw it into the water, and forced the people to drink it.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.nlt_text: Finally, he turned to Aaron and demanded, "What did these people do to you to make you bring such terrible sin upon them?"

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they {are set} on mischief.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't get so upset, my lord," Aaron replied. "You yourself know how evil these people are.

verses.kjv_text: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for {as for} this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.nlt_text: They said to me, 'Make us gods who will lead us. We don't know what happened to this fellow Moses, who brought us here from the land of Egypt.'

verses.kjv_text: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break {it} off. So they gave {it} me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.nlt_text: So I told them, 'Whoever has gold jewelry, take it off.' When they brought it to me, I simply threw it into the fire-- and out came this calf!"

verses.kjv_text: And when Moses saw that the people {were} naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto {their} shame among their enemies:) {their enemies: Heb. those that rose up against them}
verses.nlt_text: Moses saw that Aaron had let the people get completely out of control, much to the amusement of their enemies.

verses.kjv_text: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who {is} on the LORD'S side? {let him come} unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.nlt_text: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and shouted, "All of you who are on the LORD's side, come here and join me." And all the Levites gathered around him.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, {and} go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.nlt_text: Moses told them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Each of you, take your swords and go back and forth from one end of the camp to the other. Kill everyone-- even your brothers, friends, and neighbors."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.nlt_text: The Levites obeyed Moses' command, and about 3,000 people died that day.

verses.kjv_text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day. {For Moses...: or, And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, because every man hath been against his brother, etc} {Consecrate...: Heb. Fill your hands}
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses told the Levites, "Today you have ordained yourselves for the service of the LORD, for you obeyed him even though it meant killing your own sons and brothers. Today you have earned a blessing."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.nlt_text: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have committed a terrible sin, but I will go back up to the LORD on the mountain. Perhaps I will be able to obtain forgiveness for your sin."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses returned to the LORD and said, "Oh, what a terrible sin these people have committed. They have made gods of gold for themselves.

verses.kjv_text: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin-; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.nlt_text: But now, if you will only forgive their sin-- but if not, erase my name from the record you have written!"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD replied to Moses, "No, I will erase the name of everyone who has sinned against me.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore now go, lead the people unto {the place} of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.nlt_text: Now go, lead the people to the place I told you about. Look! My angel will lead the way before you. And when I come to call the people to account, I will certainly hold them responsible for their sins."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD sent a great plague upon the people because they had worshiped the calf Aaron had made.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, {and} go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses, "Get going, you and the people you brought up from the land of Egypt. Go up to the land I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I told them, 'I will give this land to your descendants.'

verses.kjv_text: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.nlt_text: And I will send an angel before you to drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

verses.kjv_text: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou {art} a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.nlt_text: Go up to this land that flows with milk and honey. But I will not travel among you, for you are a stubborn and rebellious people. If I did, I would surely destroy you along the way."

verses.kjv_text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.nlt_text: When the people heard these stern words, they went into mourning and stopped wearing their jewelry and fine clothes.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye {are} a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD had told Moses to tell them, "You are a stubborn and rebellious people. If I were to travel with you for even a moment, I would destroy you. Remove your jewelry and fine clothes while I decide what to do with you."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.nlt_text: So from the time they left Mount Sinai, the Israelites wore no more jewelry or fine clothes.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, {that} every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which {was} without the camp.
verses.nlt_text: It was Moses' practice to take the Tent of Meeting and set it up some distance from the camp. Everyone who wanted to make a request of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, {that} all the people rose up, and stood every man {at} his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Whenever Moses went out to the Tent of Meeting, all the people would get up and stand in the entrances of their own tents. They would all watch Moses until he disappeared inside.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood {at} the door of the tabernacle, and {the LORD} talked with Moses.
verses.nlt_text: As he went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and hover at its entrance while the LORD spoke with Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand {at} the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man {in} his tent door.
verses.nlt_text: When the people saw the cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, they would stand and bow down in front of their own tents.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Inside the Tent of Meeting, the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend. Afterward Moses would return to the camp, but the young man who assisted him, Joshua son of Nun, would remain behind in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
verses.nlt_text: One day Moses said to the LORD, "You have been telling me, 'Take these people up to the Promised Land.' But you haven't told me whom you will send with me. You have told me, 'I know you by name, and I look favorably on you.'

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation {is} thy people.
verses.nlt_text: If it is true that you look favorably on me, let me know your ways so I may understand you more fully and continue to enjoy your favor. And remember that this nation is your very own people."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, My presence shall go {with thee}, and I will give thee rest.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replied, "I will personally go with you, Moses, and I will give you rest-- everything will be fine for you."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not {with me}, carry us not up hence.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses said, "If you don't personally go with us, don't make us leave this place.

verses.kjv_text: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? {is it} not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that {are} upon the face of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: How will anyone know that you look favorably on me-- on me and on your people-- if you don't go with us? For your presence among us sets your people and me apart from all other people on the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replied to Moses, "I will indeed do what you have asked, for I look favorably on you, and I know you by name."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.nlt_text: Moses responded, "Then show me your glorious presence."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replied, "I will make all my goodness pass before you, and I will call out my name, Yahweh, before you. For I will show mercy to anyone I choose, and I will show compassion to anyone I choose.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.nlt_text: But you may not look directly at my face, for no one may see me and live."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, Behold, {there is} a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD continued, "Look, stand near me on this rock.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.nlt_text: As my glorious presence passes by, I will hide you in the crevice of the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

verses.kjv_text: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.nlt_text: Then I will remove my hand and let you see me from behind. But my face will not be seen."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon {these} tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD told Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones. I will write on them the same words that were on the tablets you smashed.

verses.kjv_text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
verses.nlt_text: Be ready in the morning to climb up Mount Sinai and present yourself to me on the top of the mountain.

verses.kjv_text: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.nlt_text: No one else may come with you. In fact, no one is to appear anywhere on the mountain. Do not even let the flocks or herds graze near the mountain."

verses.kjv_text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses chiseled out two tablets of stone like the first ones. Early in the morning he climbed Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him, and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD came down in a cloud and stood there with him; and he called out his own name, Yahweh.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD passed in front of Moses, calling out, "Yahweh! The LORD! The God of compassion and mercy! I am slow to anger and filled with unfailing love and faithfulness.

verses.kjv_text: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear {the guilty}; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth {generation}.
verses.nlt_text: I lavish unfailing love to a thousand generations. I forgive iniquity, rebellion, and sin. But I do not excuse the guilty. I lay the sins of the parents upon their children and grandchildren; the entire family is affected-- even children in the third and fourth generations."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.nlt_text: Moses immediately threw himself to the ground and worshiped.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it {is} a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: And he said, "O Lord, if it is true that I have found favor with you, then please travel with us. Yes, this is a stubborn and rebellious people, but please forgive our iniquity and our sins. Claim us as your own special possession."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou {art} shall see the work of the LORD: for it {is} a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replied, "Listen, I am making a covenant with you in the presence of all your people. I will perform miracles that have never been performed anywhere in all the earth or in any nation. And all the people around you will see the power of the LORD-- the awesome power I will display for you.

verses.kjv_text: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.nlt_text: But listen carefully to everything I command you today. Then I will go ahead of you and drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

verses.kjv_text: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.nlt_text: "Be very careful never to make a treaty with the people who live in the land where you are going. If you do, you will follow their evil ways and be trapped.

verses.kjv_text: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves: {images: Heb. statues}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, you must break down their pagan altars, smash their sacred pillars, and cut down their Asherah poles.

verses.kjv_text: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name {is} Jealous, {is} a jealous God:
verses.nlt_text: You must worship no other gods, for the LORD, whose very name is Jealous, is a God who is jealous about his relationship with you.

verses.kjv_text: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and {one} call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
verses.nlt_text: "You must not make a treaty of any kind with the people living in the land. They lust after their gods, offering sacrifices to them. They will invite you to join them in their sacrificial meals, and you will go with them.

verses.kjv_text: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will accept their daughters, who sacrifice to other gods, as wives for your sons. And they will seduce your sons to commit adultery against me by worshiping other gods.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.nlt_text: You must not make any gods of molten metal for yourselves.

verses.kjv_text: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: "You must celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, just as I commanded you. Celebrate this festival annually at the appointed time in early spring, in the month of Abib, for that is the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: All that openeth the matrix {is} mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, {whether} ox or sheep, {that is male}. {sheep: or, kid}
verses.nlt_text: "The firstborn of every animal belongs to me, including the firstborn males from your herds of cattle and your flocks of sheep and goats.

verses.kjv_text: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem {him} not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty. {lamb: or, kid}
verses.nlt_text: A firstborn donkey may be bought back from the LORD by presenting a lamb or young goat in its place. But if you do not buy it back, you must break its neck. However, you must buy back every firstborn son."No one may appear before me without an offering.

verses.kjv_text: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.nlt_text: "You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but on the seventh day you must stop working, even during the seasons of plowing and harvest.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end. {year's end: Heb. revolution of the year}
verses.nlt_text: "You must celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the first crop of the wheat harvest, and celebrate the Festival of the Final Harvest at the end of the harvest season.

verses.kjv_text: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Three times each year every man in Israel must appear before the Sovereign, the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
verses.nlt_text: I will drive out the other nations ahead of you and expand your territory, so no one will covet and conquer your land while you appear before the LORD your God three times each year.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.nlt_text: "You must not offer the blood of my sacrificial offerings together with any baked goods containing yeast. And none of the meat of the Passover sacrifice may be kept over until the next morning.

verses.kjv_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.nlt_text: "As you harvest your crops, bring the very best of the first harvest to the house of the LORD your God."You must not cook a young goat in its mother's milk."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Write down all these instructions, for they represent the terms of the covenant I am making with you and with Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments. {commandments: Heb. words}
verses.nlt_text: Moses remained there on the mountain with the LORD forty days and forty nights. In all that time he ate no bread and drank no water. And the LORD wrote the terms of the covenant-- the Ten Commandments-- on the stone tablets.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.nlt_text: When Moses came down Mount Sinai carrying the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, he wasn't aware that his face had become radiant because he had spoken to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.nlt_text: So when Aaron and the people of Israel saw the radiance of Moses' face, they were afraid to come near him.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.nlt_text: But Moses called out to them and asked Aaron and all the leaders of the community to come over, and he talked with them.

verses.kjv_text: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.nlt_text: Then all the people of Israel approached him, and Moses gave them all the instructions the LORD had given him on Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv_text: And {till} Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
verses.nlt_text: When Moses finished speaking with them, he covered his face with a veil.

verses.kjv_text: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel {that} which he was commanded.
verses.nlt_text: But whenever he went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he would remove the veil until he came out again. Then he would give the people whatever instructions the LORD had given him,

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.nlt_text: and the people of Israel would see the radiant glow of his face. So he would put the veil over his face until he returned to speak with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These {are} the words which the LORD hath commanded, that {ye} should do them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses called together the whole community of Israel and told them, "These are the instructions the LORD has commanded you to follow.

verses.kjv_text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death. {an...: Heb. holiness}
verses.nlt_text: You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day must be a Sabbath day of complete rest, a holy day dedicated to the LORD. Anyone who works on that day must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.nlt_text: You must not even light a fire in any of your homes on the Sabbath."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This {is} the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses said to the whole community of Israel, "This is what the LORD has commanded:

verses.kjv_text: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever {is} of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.nlt_text: Take a sacred offering for the LORD. Let those with generous hearts present the following gifts to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;

verses.kjv_text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' {hair},
verses.nlt_text: blue, purple, and scarlet thread; fine linen and goat hair for cloth;

verses.kjv_text: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.nlt_text: tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather; acacia wood;

verses.kjv_text: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.nlt_text: olive oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;

verses.kjv_text: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.nlt_text: onyx stones, and other gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest's chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
verses.nlt_text: "Come, all of you who are gifted craftsmen. Construct everything that the LORD has commanded:

verses.kjv_text: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.nlt_text: the Tabernacle and its sacred tent, its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts, and bases;

verses.kjv_text: The ark, and the staves thereof, {with} the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.nlt_text: the Ark and its carrying poles; the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement; the inner curtain to shield the Ark;

verses.kjv_text: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.nlt_text: the table, its carrying poles, and all its utensils; the Bread of the Presence;

verses.kjv_text: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.nlt_text: for light, the lampstand, its accessories, the lamp cups, and the olive oil for lighting;

verses.kjv_text: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.nlt_text: the incense altar and its carrying poles; the anointing oil and fragrant incense; the curtain for the entrance of the Tabernacle;

verses.kjv_text: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.nlt_text: the altar of burnt offering; the bronze grating of the altar and its carrying poles and utensils; the washbasin with its stand;

verses.kjv_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.nlt_text: the curtains for the walls of the courtyard; the posts and their bases; the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;

verses.kjv_text: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.nlt_text: the tent pegs of the Tabernacle and courtyard and their ropes;

verses.kjv_text: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy {place}, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: the beautifully stitched garments for the priests to wear while ministering in the Holy Place-- the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to wear as they minister as priests."

verses.kjv_text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.nlt_text: So the whole community of Israel left Moses and returned to their tents.

verses.kjv_text: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, {and} they brought the LORD'S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.nlt_text: All whose hearts were stirred and whose spirits were moved came and brought their sacred offerings to the LORD. They brought all the materials needed for the Tabernacle, for the performance of its rituals, and for the sacred garments.

verses.kjv_text: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, {and} brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered {offered} an offering of gold unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Both men and women came, all whose hearts were willing. They brought to the LORD their offerings of gold-- brooches, earrings, rings from their fingers, and necklaces. They presented gold objects of every kind as a special offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' {hair}, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought {them}.
verses.nlt_text: All those who owned the following items willingly brought them: blue, purple, and scarlet thread; fine linen and goat hair for cloth; and tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather.

verses.kjv_text: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD'S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought {it}.
verses.nlt_text: And all who had silver and bronze objects gave them as a sacred offering to the LORD. And those who had acacia wood brought it for use in the project.

verses.kjv_text: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, {both} of blue, and of purple, {and} of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.nlt_text: All the women who were skilled in sewing and spinning prepared blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine linen cloth.

verses.kjv_text: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' {hair}.
verses.nlt_text: All the women who were willing used their skills to spin the goat hair into yarn.

verses.kjv_text: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.nlt_text: The leaders brought onyx stones and the special gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest's chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.nlt_text: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light, the anointing oil, and the fragrant incense.

verses.kjv_text: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.nlt_text: So the people of Israel-- every man and woman who was eager to help in the work the LORD had given them through Moses-- brought their gifts and gave them freely to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses told the people of Israel, "The LORD has specifically chosen Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God, giving him great wisdom, ability, and expertise in all kinds of crafts.

verses.kjv_text: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.nlt_text: He is a master craftsman, expert in working with gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And in the cutting of stones, to set {them}, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.nlt_text: He is skilled in engraving and mounting gemstones and in carving wood. He is a master at every craft.

verses.kjv_text: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, {both} he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach their skills to others.

verses.kjv_text: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, {even} of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has given them special skills as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet thread on fine linen cloth, and weavers. They excel as craftsmen and as designers.

verses.kjv_text: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD has gifted Bezalel, Oholiab, and the other skilled craftsmen with wisdom and ability to perform any task involved in building the sanctuary. Let them construct and furnish the Tabernacle, just as the LORD has commanded."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, {even} every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
verses.nlt_text: So Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and all the others who were specially gifted by the LORD and were eager to get to work.

verses.kjv_text: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it {withal}. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
verses.nlt_text: Moses gave them the materials donated by the people of Israel as sacred offerings for the completion of the sanctuary. But the people continued to bring additional gifts each morning.

verses.kjv_text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
verses.nlt_text: Finally the craftsmen who were working on the sanctuary left their work.

verses.kjv_text: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
verses.nlt_text: They went to Moses and reported, "The people have given more than enough materials to complete the job the LORD has commanded us to do!"

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses gave the command, and this message was sent throughout the camp: "Men and women, don't prepare any more gifts for the sanctuary. We have enough!" So the people stopped bringing their sacred offerings.

verses.kjv_text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.nlt_text: Their contributions were more than enough to complete the whole project.

verses.kjv_text: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains {of} fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: {with} cherubims of cunning work made he them.
verses.nlt_text: The skilled craftsmen made ten curtains of finely woven linen for the Tabernacle. Then Bezalel decorated the curtains with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: The length of one curtain {was} twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains {were} all of one size.
verses.nlt_text: All ten curtains were exactly the same size-- 42 feet long and 6 feet wide.

verses.kjv_text: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and {the other} five curtains he coupled one unto another.
verses.nlt_text: Five of these curtains were joined together to make one long curtain, and the other five were joined to make a second long curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of {another} curtain, in the coupling of the second. {selvedge: an edge of cloth so woven that it cannot unravel}
verses.nlt_text: He made fifty loops of blue yarn and put them along the edge of the last curtain in each set.

verses.kjv_text: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which {was} in the coupling of the second: the loops held one {curtain} to another.
verses.nlt_text: The fifty loops along the edge of one curtain matched the fifty loops along the edge of the other curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Then he made fifty gold clasps and fastened the long curtains together with the clasps. In this way, the Tabernacle was made of one continuous piece.

verses.kjv_text: And he made curtains {of} goats' {hair} for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.nlt_text: He made eleven curtains of goat-hair cloth to serve as a tent covering for the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: The length of one curtain {was} thirty cubits, and four cubits {was} the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains {were} of one size.
verses.nlt_text: These eleven curtains were all exactly the same size-- 45 feet long and 6 feet wide.

verses.kjv_text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.nlt_text: Bezalel joined five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, and the other six were joined to make a second long curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.nlt_text: He made fifty loops for the edge of each large curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he made fifty taches {of} brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.nlt_text: He also made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the long curtains together. In this way, the tent covering was made of one continuous piece.

verses.kjv_text: And he made a covering for the tent {of} rams' skins dyed red, and a covering {of} badgers' skins above {that}.
verses.nlt_text: He completed the tent covering with a layer of tanned ram skins and a layer of fine goatskin leather.

verses.kjv_text: And he made boards for the tabernacle {of} shittim wood, standing up.
verses.nlt_text: For the framework of the Tabernacle, Bezalel constructed frames of acacia wood.

verses.kjv_text: The length of a board {was} ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
verses.nlt_text: Each frame was 15 feet high and 27 inches wide,

verses.kjv_text: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: with two pegs under each frame. All the frames were identical.

verses.kjv_text: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.nlt_text: He made twenty of these frames to support the curtains on the south side of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.nlt_text: He also made forty silver bases-- two bases under each frame, with the pegs fitting securely into the bases.

verses.kjv_text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, {which is} toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
verses.nlt_text: For the north side of the Tabernacle, he made another twenty frames,

verses.kjv_text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.nlt_text: with their forty silver bases, two bases under each frame.

verses.kjv_text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
