verses.nlt_text: He made six frames for the rear-- the west side of the Tabernacle--

verses.kjv_text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.nlt_text: along with two additional frames to reinforce the rear corners of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners. {coupled: Heb. twinned}
verses.nlt_text: These corner frames were matched at the bottom and firmly attached at the top with a single ring, forming a single corner unit. Both of these corner units were made the same way.

verses.kjv_text: And there were eight boards; and their sockets {were} sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets. {under...: Heb. two sockets, two sockets under one board}
verses.nlt_text: So there were eight frames at the rear of the Tabernacle, set in sixteen silver bases-- two bases under each frame.

verses.kjv_text: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.nlt_text: Then he made crossbars of acacia wood to link the frames, five crossbars for the north side of the Tabernacle

verses.kjv_text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
verses.nlt_text: and five for the south side. He also made five crossbars for the rear of the Tabernacle, which faced west.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.nlt_text: He made the middle crossbar to attach halfway up the frames; it ran all the way from one end of the Tabernacle to the other.

verses.kjv_text: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings {of} gold {to be} places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.nlt_text: He overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. Then he overlaid the crossbars with gold as well.

verses.kjv_text: And he made a vail {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: {with} cherubims made he it of cunning work.
verses.nlt_text: For the inside of the Tabernacle, Bezalel made a special curtain of finely woven linen. He decorated it with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: And he made thereunto four pillars {of} shittim {wood}, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks {were of} gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.nlt_text: For the curtain, he made four posts of acacia wood and four gold hooks. He overlaid the posts with gold and set them in four silver bases.

verses.kjv_text: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework; {of needlework: Heb. the work of a needleworker or, embroiderer}
verses.nlt_text: Then he made another curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent. He made it of finely woven linen and embroidered it with exquisite designs using blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets {were of} brass.
verses.nlt_text: This curtain was hung on gold hooks attached to five posts. The posts with their decorated tops and hooks were overlaid with gold, and the five bases were cast from bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And Bezaleel made the ark {of} shittim wood: two cubits and a half {was} the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
verses.nlt_text: Next Bezalel made the Ark of acacia wood-- a sacred chest 45 inches long, 27 inches wide, and 27 inches high.

verses.kjv_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.nlt_text: He overlaid it inside and outside with pure gold, and he ran a molding of gold all around it.

verses.kjv_text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, {to be set} by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
verses.nlt_text: He cast four gold rings and attached them to its four feet, two rings on each side.

verses.kjv_text: And he made staves {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.nlt_text: Then he made poles from acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.nlt_text: He inserted the poles into the rings at the sides of the Ark to carry it.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the mercy seat {of} pure gold: two cubits and a half {was} the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Then he made the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- from pure gold. It was 45 inches long and 27 inches wide.

verses.kjv_text: And he made two cherubims {of} gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat; {on...: or, out of, etc}
verses.nlt_text: He made two cherubim from hammered gold and placed them on the two ends of the atonement cover.

verses.kjv_text: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the {other} end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof. {on the end: or, out of, etc} {on the other end: or, out of, etc}
verses.nlt_text: He molded the cherubim on each end of the atonement cover, making it all of one piece of gold.

verses.kjv_text: And the cherubims spread out {their} wings on high, {and} covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; {even} to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
verses.nlt_text: The cherubim faced each other and looked down on the atonement cover. With their wings spread above it, they protected it.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the table {of} shittim wood: two cubits {was} the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
verses.nlt_text: Then Bezalel made the table of acacia wood, 36 inches long, 18 inches wide, and 27 inches high.

verses.kjv_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
verses.nlt_text: He overlaid it with pure gold and ran a gold molding around the edge.

verses.kjv_text: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
verses.nlt_text: He decorated it with a 3-inch border all around, and he ran a gold molding along the border.

verses.kjv_text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that {were} in the four feet thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Then he cast four gold rings for the table and attached them at the four corners next to the four legs.

verses.kjv_text: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.nlt_text: The rings were attached near the border to hold the poles that were used to carry the table.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the staves {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.nlt_text: He made these poles from acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the vessels which {were} upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, {of} pure gold. {to cover...: or, to pour out withal}
verses.nlt_text: Then he made special containers of pure gold for the table-- bowls, pans, jars, and pitchers-- to be used in pouring out liquid offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the candlestick {of} pure gold: {of} beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
verses.nlt_text: Then Bezalel made the lampstand of pure, hammered gold. He made the entire lampstand and its decorations of one piece-- the base, center stem, lamp cups, buds, and petals.

verses.kjv_text: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.nlt_text: The lampstand had six branches going out from the center stem, three on each side.

verses.kjv_text: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.nlt_text: Each of the six branches had three lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.

verses.kjv_text: And in the candlestick {were} four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
verses.nlt_text: The center stem of the lampstand was crafted with four lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.

verses.kjv_text: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
verses.nlt_text: There was an almond bud beneath each pair of branches where the six branches extended from the center stem, all made of one piece.

verses.kjv_text: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it {was} one beaten work {of} pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: The almond buds and branches were all of one piece with the center stem, and they were hammered from pure gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, {of} pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: He also made seven lamps for the lampstand, lamp snuffers, and trays, all of pure gold.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.nlt_text: The entire lampstand, along with its accessories, was made from seventy-five pounds of pure gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the incense altar {of} shittim wood: the length of it {was} a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; {it was} foursquare; and two cubits {was} the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
verses.nlt_text: Then Bezalel made the incense altar of acacia wood. It was 18 inches square and 36 inches high, with horns at the corners carved from the same piece of wood as the altar itself.

verses.kjv_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, {both} the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.nlt_text: He overlaid the top, sides, and horns of the altar with pure gold, and he ran a gold molding around the entire altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.nlt_text: He made two gold rings and attached them on opposite sides of the altar below the gold molding to hold the carrying poles.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the staves {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.nlt_text: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
verses.nlt_text: Then he made the sacred anointing oil and the fragrant incense, using the techniques of a skilled incense maker.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the altar of burnt offering {of} shittim wood: five cubits {was} the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; {it was} foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Next Bezalel used acacia wood to construct the square altar of burnt offering. It was 7-1/2 feet wide, 7-1/2 feet long, and 4-1/2 feet high.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.nlt_text: He made horns for each of its four corners so that the horns and altar were all one piece. He overlaid the altar with bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, {and} the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he {of} brass.
verses.nlt_text: Then he made all the altar utensils of bronze-- the ash buckets, shovels, basins, meat forks, and firepans.

verses.kjv_text: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
verses.nlt_text: Next he made a bronze grating and installed it halfway down the side of the altar, under the ledge.

verses.kjv_text: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, {to be} places for the staves.
verses.nlt_text: He cast four rings and attached them to the corners of the bronze grating to hold the carrying poles.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the staves {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.nlt_text: He made the poles from acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
verses.nlt_text: He inserted the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar. The altar was hollow and was made from planks.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the laver {of} brass, and the foot of it {of} brass, of the lookingglasses of {the women} assembling, which assembled {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. {lookingglasses: or, brasen glasses} {assembling: Heb. assembling by troops}
verses.nlt_text: Bezalel made the bronze washbasin and its bronze stand from bronze mirrors donated by the women who served at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court {were of} fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
verses.nlt_text: Then Bezalel made the courtyard, which was enclosed with curtains made of finely woven linen. On the south side the curtains were 150 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: Their pillars {were} twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets {were of} silver.
verses.nlt_text: They were held up by twenty posts set securely in twenty bronze bases. He hung the curtains with silver hooks and rings.

verses.kjv_text: And for the north side {the hangings were} an hundred cubits, their pillars {were} twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets {of} silver.
verses.nlt_text: He made a similar set of curtains for the north side-- 150 feet of curtains held up by twenty posts set securely in bronze bases. He hung the curtains with silver hooks and rings.

verses.kjv_text: And for the west side {were} hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets {of} silver.
verses.nlt_text: The curtains on the west end of the courtyard were 75 feet long, hung with silver hooks and rings and supported by ten posts set into ten bases.

verses.kjv_text: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.nlt_text: The east end, the front, was also 75 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: The hangings of the one side {of the gate were} fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.nlt_text: The courtyard entrance was on the east end, flanked by two curtains. The curtain on the right side was 22-1/2 feet long and was supported by three posts set into three bases.

verses.kjv_text: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, {were} hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.nlt_text: The curtain on the left side was also 22-1/2 feet long and was supported by three posts set into three bases.

verses.kjv_text: All the hangings of the court round about {were} of fine twined linen.
verses.nlt_text: All the curtains used in the courtyard were made of finely woven linen.

verses.kjv_text: And the sockets for the pillars {were of} brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets {of} silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters {of} silver; and all the pillars of the court {were} filleted with silver.
verses.nlt_text: Each post had a bronze base, and all the hooks and rings were silver. The tops of the posts of the courtyard were overlaid with silver, and the rings to hold up the curtains were made of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And the hanging for the gate of the court {was} needlework, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits {was} the length, and the height in the breadth {was} five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.nlt_text: He made the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard of finely woven linen, and he decorated it with beautiful embroidery in blue, purple, and scarlet thread. It was 30 feet long, and its height was 7-1/2 feet, just like the curtains of the courtyard walls.

verses.kjv_text: And their pillars {were} four, and their sockets {of} brass four; their hooks {of} silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets {of} silver.
verses.nlt_text: It was supported by four posts, each set securely in its own bronze base. The tops of the posts were overlaid with silver, and the hooks and rings were also made of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, {were of} brass.
verses.nlt_text: All the tent pegs used in the Tabernacle and courtyard were made of bronze.

verses.kjv_text: This is the sum of the tabernacle, {even} of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, {for} the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.nlt_text: This is an inventory of the materials used in building the Tabernacle of the Covenant. The Levites compiled the figures, as Moses directed, and Ithamar son of Aaron the priest served as recorder.

verses.kjv_text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And with him {was} Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.nlt_text: He was assisted by Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, a craftsman expert at engraving, designing, and embroidering with blue, purple, and scarlet thread on fine linen cloth.

verses.kjv_text: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy {place}, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.nlt_text: The people brought special offerings of gold totaling 2,193 pounds, as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel. This gold was used throughout the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation {was} an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.nlt_text: The whole community of Israel gave 7,545 pounds of silver, as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv_text: A bekah for every man, {that is}, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty {men}. {every man: Heb. a poll}
verses.nlt_text: This silver came from the tax collected from each man registered in the census. (The tax is one beka, which is half a shekel, based on the sanctuary shekel.) The tax was collected from 603,550 men who had reached their twentieth birthday.

verses.kjv_text: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.nlt_text: The hundred bases for the frames of the sanctuary walls and for the posts supporting the inner curtain required 7,500 pounds of silver, about 75 pounds for each base.

verses.kjv_text: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.nlt_text: The remaining 45 pounds of silver was used to make the hooks and rings and to overlay the tops of the posts.

verses.kjv_text: And the brass of the offering {was} seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.nlt_text: The people also brought as special offerings 5,310 pounds of bronze,

verses.kjv_text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.nlt_text: which was used for casting the bases for the posts at the entrance to the Tabernacle, and for the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all the altar utensils.

verses.kjv_text: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.nlt_text: Bronze was also used to make the bases for the posts that supported the curtains around the courtyard, the bases for the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard, and all the tent pegs for the Tabernacle and the courtyard.

verses.kjv_text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy {place}, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: The craftsmen made beautiful sacred garments of blue, purple, and scarlet cloth-- clothing for Aaron to wear while ministering in the Holy Place, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the ephod {of} gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.nlt_text: Bezalel made the ephod of finely woven linen and embroidered it with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut {it into} wires, to work {it} in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, {with} cunning work.
verses.nlt_text: He made gold thread by hammering out thin sheets of gold and cutting it into fine strands. With great skill and care, he worked it into the fine linen with the blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple {it} together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.nlt_text: The ephod consisted of two pieces, front and back, joined at the shoulders with two shoulder-pieces.

verses.kjv_text: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that {was} upon it, {was} of the same, according to the work thereof; {of} gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: The decorative sash was made of the same materials: finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: They mounted the two onyx stones in settings of gold filigree. The stones were engraved with the names of the tribes of Israel, just as a seal is engraved.

verses.kjv_text: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, {that they should be} stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: He fastened these stones on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod as a reminder that the priest represents the people of Israel. All this was done just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the breastplate {of} cunning work, like the work of the ephod; {of} gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.nlt_text: Bezalel made the chestpiece with great skill and care. He made it to match the ephod, using finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.

verses.kjv_text: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span {was} the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, {being} doubled.
verses.nlt_text: He made the chestpiece of a single piece of cloth folded to form a pouch nine inches square.

verses.kjv_text: And they set in it four rows of stones: {the first} row {was} a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this {was} the first row. {sardius: or, ruby}
verses.nlt_text: They mounted four rows of gemstones on it. The first row contained a red carnelian, a pale green peridot, and an emerald.

verses.kjv_text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.nlt_text: The second row contained a turquoise, a blue lapis lazuli, and a white moonstone.

verses.kjv_text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.nlt_text: The third row contained an orange jacinth, an agate, and a purple amethyst.

verses.kjv_text: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: {they were} inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.nlt_text: The fourth row contained a blue-green beryl, an onyx, and a green jasper. All these stones were set in gold filigree.

verses.kjv_text: And the stones {were} according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, {like} the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.nlt_text: Each stone represented one of the twelve sons of Israel, and the name of that tribe was engraved on it like a seal.

verses.kjv_text: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, {of} wreathen work {of} pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: To attach the chestpiece to the ephod, they made braided cords of pure gold thread.

verses.kjv_text: And they made two ouches {of} gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.nlt_text: They also made two settings of gold filigree and two gold rings and attached them to the top corners of the chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.nlt_text: They tied the two gold cords to the rings on the chestpiece.

verses.kjv_text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.nlt_text: They tied the other ends of the cords to the gold settings on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And they made two rings of gold, and put {them} on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which {was} on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.nlt_text: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the inside edges of the chestpiece next to the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And they made two {other} golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the {other} coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.nlt_text: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the front of the ephod, below the shoulder-pieces, just above the knot where the decorative sash was fastened to the ephod.

verses.kjv_text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: They attached the bottom rings of the chestpiece to the rings on the ephod with blue cords. In this way, the chestpiece was held securely to the ephod above the decorative sash. All this was done just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the robe of the ephod {of} woven work, all {of} blue.
verses.nlt_text: Bezalel made the robe that is worn with the ephod from a single piece of blue woven cloth,

verses.kjv_text: And {there was} an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, {with} a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.nlt_text: with an opening for Aaron's head in the middle of it. The opening was reinforced with a woven collar so it would not tear.

verses.kjv_text: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, {and} twined {linen}.
verses.nlt_text: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and attached them to the hem of the robe.

verses.kjv_text: And they made bells {of} pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.nlt_text: They also made bells of pure gold and placed them between the pomegranates along the hem of the robe,

verses.kjv_text: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister {in}; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: with bells and pomegranates alternating all around the hem. This robe was to be worn whenever the priest ministered before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And they made coats {of} fine linen {of} woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.nlt_text: They made tunics for Aaron and his sons from fine linen cloth.

verses.kjv_text: And a mitre {of} fine linen, and goodly bonnets {of} fine linen, and linen breeches {of} fine twined linen,
verses.nlt_text: The turban and the special head coverings were made of fine linen, and the undergarments were also made of finely woven linen.

verses.kjv_text: And a girdle {of} fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, {of} needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: The sashes were made of finely woven linen and embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet thread, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And they made the plate of the holy crown {of} pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, {like to} the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, they made the sacred medallion-- the badge of holiness-- of pure gold. They engraved it like a seal with these words: HOLY TO THE LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten {it} on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: They attached the medallion with a blue cord to Aaron's turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.nlt_text: And so at last the Tabernacle was finished. The Israelites had done everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.nlt_text: And they brought the entire Tabernacle to Moses: the sacred tent with all its furnishings, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts, and bases;

verses.kjv_text: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.nlt_text: the tent coverings of tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather; the inner curtain to shield the Ark;

verses.kjv_text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.nlt_text: the Ark of the Covenant and its carrying poles; the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement;

verses.kjv_text: The table, {and} all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.nlt_text: the table and all its utensils; the Bread of the Presence;

verses.kjv_text: The pure candlestick, {with} the lamps thereof, {even with} the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.nlt_text: the pure gold lampstand with its symmetrical lamp cups, all its accessories, and the olive oil for lighting;

verses.kjv_text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door, {the sweet...: Heb. the incense of sweet spices}
verses.nlt_text: the gold altar; the anointing oil and fragrant incense; the curtain for the entrance of the sacred tent;

verses.kjv_text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.nlt_text: the bronze altar; the bronze grating and its carrying poles and utensils; the washbasin with its stand;

verses.kjv_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.nlt_text: the curtains for the walls of the courtyard; the posts and their bases; the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs; all the furnishings to be used in worship at the Tabernacle;

verses.kjv_text: The cloths of service to do service in the holy {place}, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: the beautifully stitched garments for the priests to wear while ministering in the Holy Place-- the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to wear as they minister as priests.

verses.kjv_text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.nlt_text: So the people of Israel followed all of the LORD's instructions to Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses inspected all their work. When he found it had been done just as the LORD had commanded him, he blessed them.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: "Set up the Tabernacle on the first day of the new year.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.nlt_text: Place the Ark of the Covenant inside, and install the inner curtain to enclose the Ark within the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof. {the things...: Heb. the order thereof}
verses.nlt_text: Then bring in the table, and arrange the utensils on it. And bring in the lampstand, and set up the lamps.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: "Place the gold incense altar in front of the Ark of the Covenant. Then hang the curtain at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the Tabernacle entrance.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.nlt_text: Set the washbasin between the Tabernacle and the altar, and fill it with water.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.nlt_text: Then set up the courtyard around the outside of the tent, and hang the curtain for the courtyard entrance.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that {is} therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.nlt_text: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the Tabernacle and all its furnishings to consecrate them and make them holy.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy. {most holy: Heb. holiness of holinesses}
verses.nlt_text: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and its utensils to consecrate them. Then the altar will become absolutely holy.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.nlt_text: Next anoint the washbasin and its stand to consecrate them.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.nlt_text: "Present Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and wash them with water.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: Dress Aaron with the sacred garments and anoint him, consecrating him to serve me as a priest.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.nlt_text: Then present his sons and dress them in their tunics.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.nlt_text: Anoint them as you did their father, so they may also serve me as priests. With their anointing, Aaron's descendants are set apart for the priesthood forever, from generation to generation."

verses.kjv_text: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.nlt_text: Moses proceeded to do everything just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first {day} of the month, {that} the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.nlt_text: So the Tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.nlt_text: Moses erected the Tabernacle by setting down its bases, inserting the frames, attaching the crossbars, and setting up the posts.

verses.kjv_text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Then he spread the coverings over the Tabernacle framework and put on the protective layers, just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.nlt_text: He took the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant and placed them inside the Ark. Then he attached the carrying poles to the Ark, and he set the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- on top of it.

verses.kjv_text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Then he brought the Ark of the Covenant into the Tabernacle and hung the inner curtain to shield it from view, just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.nlt_text: Next Moses placed the table in the Tabernacle, along the north side of the Holy Place, just outside the inner curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: And he arranged the Bread of the Presence on the table before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.nlt_text: He set the lampstand in the Tabernacle across from the table on the south side of the Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Then he lit the lamps in the LORD's presence, just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.nlt_text: He also placed the gold incense altar in the Tabernacle, in the Holy Place in front of the inner curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: On it he burned the fragrant incense, just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And he set up the hanging {at} the door of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: He hung the curtain at the entrance of the Tabernacle,

verses.kjv_text: And he put the altar of burnt offering {by} the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: and he placed the altar of burnt offering near the Tabernacle entrance. On it he offered a burnt offering and a grain offering, just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash {withal}.
verses.nlt_text: Next Moses placed the washbasin between the Tabernacle and the altar. He filled it with water so the priests could wash themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.nlt_text: Moses and Aaron and Aaron's sons used water from it to wash their hands and feet.

verses.kjv_text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Whenever they approached the altar and entered the Tabernacle, they washed themselves, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.nlt_text: Then he hung the curtains forming the courtyard around the Tabernacle and the altar. And he set up the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard. So at last Moses finished the work.

verses.kjv_text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Then the cloud covered the Tabernacle, and the glory of the LORD filled the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Moses could no longer enter the Tabernacle because the cloud had settled down over it, and the glory of the LORD filled the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys: {went onward: Heb. journeyed}
verses.nlt_text: Now whenever the cloud lifted from the Tabernacle, the people of Israel would set out on their journey, following it.

verses.kjv_text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.nlt_text: But if the cloud did not rise, they remained where they were until it lifted.

verses.kjv_text: For the cloud of the LORD {was} upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.nlt_text: The cloud of the LORD hovered over the Tabernacle during the day, and at night fire glowed inside the cloud so the whole family of Israel could see it. This continued throughout all their journeys.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD called to Moses from the Tabernacle and said to him,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, {even} of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. When you present an animal as an offering to the LORD, you may take it from your herd of cattle or your flock of sheep and goats.

verses.kjv_text: If his offering {be} a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "If the animal you present as a burnt offering is from the herd, it must be a male with no defects. Bring it to the entrance of the Tabernacle so you may be accepted by the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.nlt_text: Lay your hand on the animal's head, and the LORD will accept its death in your place to purify you, making you right with him.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that {is by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Then slaughter the young bull in the LORD's presence, and Aaron's sons, the priests, will present the animal's blood by splattering it against all sides of the altar that stands at the entrance to the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.nlt_text: Then skin the animal and cut it into pieces.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Aaron the priest will build a wood fire on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that {is} on the fire which {is} upon the altar:
verses.nlt_text: They will arrange the pieces of the offering, including the head and fat, on the wood burning on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, {to be} a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But the internal organs and the legs must first be washed with water. Then the priest will burn the entire sacrifice on the altar as a burnt offering. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if his offering {be} of the flocks, {namely}, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.nlt_text: "If the animal you present as a burnt offering is from the flock, it may be either a sheep or a goat, but it must be a male with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Slaughter the animal on the north side of the altar in the LORD's presence, and Aaron's sons, the priests, will splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that {is} on the fire which {is} upon the altar:
verses.nlt_text: Then cut the animal in pieces, and the priests will arrange the pieces of the offering, including the head and fat, on the wood burning on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring {it} all, and burn {it} upon the altar: it {is} a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But the internal organs and the legs must first be washed with water. Then the priest will burn the entire sacrifice on the altar as a burnt offering. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD {be} of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.nlt_text: "If you present a bird as a burnt offering to the LORD, choose either a turtledove or a young pigeon.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn {it} on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar: {wring...: or, pinch off the head with the nail}
verses.nlt_text: The priest will take the bird to the altar, wring off its head, and burn it on the altar. But first he must drain its blood against the side of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes: {his feathers: or, the filth thereof}
verses.nlt_text: The priest must also remove the crop and the feathers and throw them in the ashes on the east side of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, {but} shall not divide {it} asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that {is} upon the fire: it {is} a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Then, grasping the bird by its wings, the priest will tear the bird open, but without tearing it apart. Then he will burn it as a burnt offering on the wood burning on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be {of} fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.nlt_text: "When you present grain as an offering to the LORD, the offering must consist of choice flour. You are to pour olive oil on it, sprinkle it with frankincense,

verses.kjv_text: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, {to be} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: and bring it to Aaron's sons, the priests. The priest will scoop out a handful of the flour moistened with oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this representative portion on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the remnant of the meat offering {shall be} Aaron's and his sons': {it is} a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.nlt_text: The rest of the grain offering will then be given to Aaron and his sons. This offering will be considered a most holy part of the special gifts presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, {it shall be} unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.nlt_text: "If your offering is a grain offering baked in an oven, it must be made of choice flour, but without any yeast. It may be presented in the form of thin cakes mixed with olive oil or wafers spread with olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And if thy oblation {be} a meat offering {baken} in a pan, it shall be {of} fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil. {in a pan: or, on a flat plate, or, slice}
verses.nlt_text: If your grain offering is cooked on a griddle, it must be made of choice flour mixed with olive oil but without any yeast.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it {is} a meat offering.
verses.nlt_text: Break it in pieces and pour olive oil on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.kjv_text: And if thy oblation {be} a meat offering {baken} in the fryingpan, it shall be made {of} fine flour with oil.
verses.nlt_text: If your grain offering is prepared in a pan, it must be made of choice flour and olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.nlt_text: "No matter how a grain offering for the LORD has been prepared, bring it to the priest, who will present it at the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn {it} upon the altar: {it is} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will take a representative portion of the grain offering and burn it on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And that which is left of the meat offering {shall be} Aaron's and his sons': {it is} a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.nlt_text: The rest of the grain offering will then be given to Aaron and his sons as their food. This offering will be considered a most holy part of the special gifts presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not use yeast in preparing any of the grain offerings you present to the LORD, because no yeast or honey may be burned as a special gift presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour. {be burnt: Heb. ascend}
verses.nlt_text: You may add yeast and honey to an offering of the first crops of your harvest, but these must never be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.nlt_text: Season all your grain offerings with salt to remind you of God's eternal covenant. Never forget to add salt to your grain offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, {even} corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.nlt_text: "If you present a grain offering to the LORD from the first portion of your harvest, bring fresh grain that is coarsely ground and roasted on a fire.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it {is} a meat offering.
verses.nlt_text: Put olive oil on this grain offering, and sprinkle it with frankincense.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, {part} of the beaten corn thereof, and {part} of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: {it is} an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will take a representative portion of the grain moistened with oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn it as a special gift presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if his oblation {be} a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer {it} of the herd; whether {it be} a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "If you present an animal from the herd as a peace offering to the LORD, it may be a male or a female, but it must have no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.nlt_text: Lay your hand on the animal's head, and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tabernacle. Then Aaron's sons, the priests, will splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards, {fat: or, suet}
verses.nlt_text: The priest must present part of this peace offering as a special gift to the LORD. This includes all the fat around the internal organs,

verses.kjv_text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} on them, which {is} by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away. {caul...: or, midriff over the liver, and over the kidneys}
verses.nlt_text: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. These must be removed with the kidneys,

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which {is} upon the wood that {is} on the fire: {it is} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: and Aaron's sons will burn them on top of the burnt offering on the wood burning on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD {be} of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.nlt_text: "If you present an animal from the flock as a peace offering to the LORD, it may be a male or a female, but it must have no defects.

verses.kjv_text: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: If you present a sheep as your offering, bring it to the LORD,

verses.kjv_text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.nlt_text: lay your hand on its head, and slaughter it in front of the Tabernacle. Aaron's sons will then splatter the sheep's blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, {and} the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,
verses.nlt_text: The priest must present the fat of this peace offering as a special gift to the LORD. This includes the fat of the broad tail cut off near the backbone, all the fat around the internal organs,

verses.kjv_text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, which {is} by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.nlt_text: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. These must be removed with the kidneys,

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: {it is} the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: and the priest will burn them on the altar. It is a special gift of food presented to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if his offering {be} a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "If you present a goat as your offering, bring it to the LORD,

verses.kjv_text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.nlt_text: lay your hand on its head, and slaughter it in front of the Tabernacle. Aaron's sons will then splatter the goat's blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer thereof his offering, {even} an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,
verses.nlt_text: The priest must present part of this offering as a special gift to the LORD. This includes all the fat around the internal organs,

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: {it is} the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat {is} the LORD'S.
verses.nlt_text: and the priest will burn them on the altar. It is a special gift of food, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. All the fat belongs to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: {It shall be} a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.nlt_text: "You must never eat any fat or blood. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation, wherever you live."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD {concerning things} which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. This is how you are to deal with those who sin unintentionally by doing anything that violates one of the LORD's commands.

verses.kjv_text: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
verses.nlt_text: "If the high priest sins, bringing guilt upon the entire community, he must give a sin offering for the sin he has committed. He must present to the LORD a young bull with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: He must bring the bull to the LORD at the entrance of the Tabernacle, lay his hand on the bull's head, and slaughter it before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: The high priest will then take some of the bull's blood into the Tabernacle,

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.nlt_text: dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the inner curtain of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall put {some} of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which {is} in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which {is at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar for fragrant incense that stands in the LORD's presence inside the Tabernacle. He will pour out the rest of the bull's blood at the base of the altar for burnt offerings at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest must remove all the fat of the bull to be offered as a sin offering. This includes all the fat around the internal organs,

verses.kjv_text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, which {is} by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.nlt_text: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. He must remove these along with the kidneys,

verses.kjv_text: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: just as he does with cattle offered as a peace offering, and burn them on the altar of burnt offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.nlt_text: But he must take whatever is left of the bull-- its hide, meat, head, legs, internal organs, and dung--

verses.kjv_text: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt. {without...: Heb. to without the camp} {where...: Heb. at the pouring out of the ashes}
verses.nlt_text: and carry it away to a place outside the camp that is ceremonially clean, the place where the ashes are dumped. There, on the ash heap, he will burn it on a wood fire.

verses.kjv_text: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done {somewhat against} any of the commandments of the LORD {concerning things} which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.nlt_text: "If the entire Israelite community sins by violating one of the LORD's commands, but the people don't realize it, they are still guilty.

verses.kjv_text: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: When they become aware of their sin, the people must bring a young bull as an offering for their sin and present it before the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The elders of the community must then lay their hands on the bull's head and slaughter it before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: The high priest will then take some of the bull's blood into the Tabernacle,

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall dip his finger {in some} of the blood, and sprinkle {it} seven times before the LORD, {even} before the vail.
verses.nlt_text: dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the inner curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall put {some} of the blood upon the horns of the altar which {is} before the LORD, that {is} in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which {is at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: He will then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar for fragrant incense that stands in the LORD's presence inside the Tabernacle. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar for burnt offerings at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn {it} upon the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest must remove all the animal's fat and burn it on the altar,

verses.kjv_text: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.nlt_text: just as he does with the bull offered as a sin offering for the high priest. Through this process, the priest will purify the people, making them right with the LORD, and they will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it {is} a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest must take what is left of the bull and carry it outside the camp and burn it there, just as is done with the sin offering for the high priest. This offering is for the sin of the entire congregation of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: When a ruler hath sinned, and done {somewhat} through ignorance {against} any of the commandments of the LORD his God {concerning things} which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.nlt_text: "If one of Israel's leaders sins by violating one of the commands of the LORD his God but doesn't realize it, he is still guilty.

verses.kjv_text: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: When he becomes aware of his sin, he must bring as his offering a male goat with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it {is} a sin offering.
verses.nlt_text: He must lay his hand on the goat's head and slaughter it at the place where burnt offerings are slaughtered before the LORD. This is an offering for his sin.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will dip his finger in the blood of the sin offering and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must burn all the goat's fat on the altar, just as he does with the peace offering. Through this process, the priest will purify the leader from his sin, making him right with the LORD, and he will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth {somewhat against} any of the commandments of the LORD {concerning things} which ought not to be done, and be guilty; {any one: Heb. any soul} {common...: Heb. people of the land}
verses.nlt_text: "If any of the common people sin by violating one of the LORD's commands, but they don't realize it, they are still guilty.

verses.kjv_text: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.nlt_text: When they become aware of their sin, they must bring as an offering for their sin a female goat with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: They must lay a hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place where burnt offerings are slaughtered.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will dip his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn {it} upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must remove all the goat's fat, just as he does with the fat of the peace offering. He will burn the fat on the altar, and it will be a pleasing aroma to the LORD. Through this process, the priest will purify the people, making them right with the LORD, and they will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.nlt_text: "If the people bring a sheep as their sin offering, it must be a female with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: They must lay a hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place where burnt offerings are slaughtered.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will dip his finger in the blood of the sin offering and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must remove all the sheep's fat, just as he does with the fat of a sheep presented as a peace offering. He will burn the fat on the altar on top of the special gifts presented to the LORD. Through this process, the priest will purify the people from their sin, making them right with the LORD, and they will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and {is} a witness, whether he hath seen or known {of it}; if he do not utter {it}, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: "If you are called to testify about something you have seen or that you know about, it is sinful to refuse to testify, and you will be punished for your sin.

verses.kjv_text: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether {it be} a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and {if} it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose you unknowingly touch something that is ceremonially unclean, such as the carcass of an unclean animal. When you realize what you have done, you must admit your defilement and your guilt. This is true whether it is a wild animal, a domestic animal, or an animal that scurries along the ground.

verses.kjv_text: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness {it be} that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth {of it}, then he shall be guilty.
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose you unknowingly touch something that makes a person unclean. When you realize what you have done, you must admit your guilt.

verses.kjv_text: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with {his} lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever {it be} that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth {of it}, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose you make a foolish vow of any kind, whether its purpose is for good or for bad. When you realize its foolishness, you must admit your guilt.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these {things}, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that {thing}:
verses.nlt_text: "When you become aware of your guilt in any of these ways, you must confess your sin.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.nlt_text: Then you must bring to the LORD as the penalty for your sin a female from the flock, either a sheep or a goat. This is a sin offering with which the priest will purify you from your sin, making you right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. {he be...: Heb. his hand cannot reach to the sufficiency of a lamb}
verses.nlt_text: "But if you cannot afford to bring a sheep, you may bring to the LORD two turtledoves or two young pigeons as the penalty for your sin. One of the birds will be for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer {that} which {is} for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide {it} asunder:
verses.nlt_text: You must bring them to the priest, who will present the first bird as the sin offering. He will wring its neck but without severing its head from the body.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it {is} a sin offering.
verses.nlt_text: Then he will sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering against the sides of the altar, and the rest of the blood will be drained out at the base of the altar. This is an offering for sin.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer the second {for} a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him. {manner: or, ordinance}
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then prepare the second bird as a burnt offering, following all the procedures that have been prescribed. Through this process the priest will purify you from your sin, making you right with the LORD, and you will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put {any} frankincense thereon: for it {is} a sin offering.
verses.nlt_text: "If you cannot afford to bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, you may bring two quarts of choice flour for your sin offering. Since it is an offering for sin, you must not moisten it with olive oil or put any frankincense on it.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, {even} a memorial thereof, and burn {it} on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it {is} a sin offering.
verses.nlt_text: Take the flour to the priest, who will scoop out a handful as a representative portion. He will burn it on the altar on top of the special gifts presented to the LORD. It is an offering for sin.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and {the remnant} shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
verses.nlt_text: Through this process, the priest will purify those who are guilty of any of these sins, making them right with the LORD, and they will be forgiven. The rest of the flour will belong to the priest, just as with the grain offering."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
verses.nlt_text: "If one of you commits a sin by unintentionally defiling the LORD's sacred property, you must bring a guilt offering to the LORD. The offering must be your own ram with no defects, or you may buy one of equal value with silver, as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
