verses.kjv_text: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.nlt_text: But if the scabby sore begins to spread after the person is pronounced clean,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he {is} unclean.
verses.nlt_text: the priest must do another examination. If he finds that the sore has spread, the priest does not need to look for yellow hair. The infected person is ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and {that} there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he {is} clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.nlt_text: But if the color of the scabby sore does not change and black hair has grown on it, it has healed. The priest will then pronounce the person ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, {even} white bright spots;
verses.nlt_text: "If anyone, either a man or woman, has shiny white patches on the skin,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, {if} the bright spots in the skin of their flesh {be} darkish white; it {is} a freckled spot {that} groweth in the skin; he {is} clean.
verses.nlt_text: the priest must examine the affected area. If he finds that the shiny patches are only pale white, this is a harmless skin rash, and the person is ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he {is} bald; {yet is} he clean. {hair...: Heb. head is pilled}
verses.nlt_text: "If a man loses his hair and his head becomes bald, he is still ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he {is} forehead bald: {yet is} he clean.
verses.nlt_text: And if he loses hair on his forehead, he simply has a bald forehead; he is still clean.

verses.kjv_text: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it {is} a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.nlt_text: However, if a reddish white sore appears on the bald area at the top or back of his head, this is a skin disease.

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, {if} the rising of the sore {be} white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.nlt_text: The priest must examine him, and if he finds swelling around the reddish white sore anywhere on the man's head and it looks like a skin disease,

verses.kjv_text: He is a leprous man, he {is} unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague {is} in his head.
verses.nlt_text: the man is indeed infected with a skin disease and is unclean. The priest must pronounce him ceremonially unclean because of the sore on his head.

verses.kjv_text: And the leper in whom the plague {is}, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.nlt_text: "Those who suffer from a serious skin disease must tear their clothing and leave their hair uncombed. They must cover their mouth and call out, 'Unclean! Unclean!'

verses.kjv_text: All the days wherein the plague {shall be} in him he shall be defiled; he {is} unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp {shall} his habitation {be}.
verses.nlt_text: As long as the serious disease lasts, they will be ceremonially unclean. They must live in isolation in their place outside the camp.

verses.kjv_text: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, {whether it be} a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.nlt_text: "Now suppose mildew contaminates some woolen or linen clothing,

verses.kjv_text: Whether {it be} in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin; {thing...: Heb. work of}
verses.nlt_text: woolen or linen fabric, the hide of an animal, or anything made of leather.

verses.kjv_text: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it {is} a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest: {thing: Heb. vessel, or, instrument}
verses.nlt_text: If the contaminated area in the clothing, the animal hide, the fabric, or the leather article has turned greenish or reddish, it is contaminated with mildew and must be shown to the priest.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up {it that hath} the plague seven days:
verses.nlt_text: After examining the affected spot, the priest will put the article in quarantine for seven days.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, {or} in any work that is made of skin; the plague {is} a fretting leprosy; it {is} unclean.
verses.nlt_text: On the seventh day the priest must inspect it again. If the contaminated area has spread, the clothing or fabric or leather is clearly contaminated by a serious mildew and is ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it {is} a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.nlt_text: The priest must burn the item-- the clothing, the woolen or linen fabric, or piece of leather-- for it has been contaminated by a serious mildew. It must be completely destroyed by fire.

verses.kjv_text: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.nlt_text: "But if the priest examines it and finds that the contaminated area has not spread in the clothing, the fabric, or the leather,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall command that they wash {the thing} wherein the plague {is}, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.nlt_text: the priest will order the object to be washed and then quarantined for seven more days.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, {if} the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it {is} unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it {is} fret inward, {whether} it {be} bare within or without. {whether...: Heb. whether it be bald in the head thereof, or in the forehead thereof}
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest must examine the object again. If he finds that the contaminated area has not changed color after being washed, even if it did not spread, the object is defiled. It must be completely burned up, whether the contaminated spot is on the inside or outside.

verses.kjv_text: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague {be} somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.nlt_text: But if the priest examines it and finds that the contaminated area has faded after being washed, he must cut the spot from the clothing, the fabric, or the leather.

verses.kjv_text: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it {is} a spreading {plague}: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague {is} with fire.
verses.nlt_text: If the spot later reappears on the clothing, the fabric, or the leather article, the mildew is clearly spreading, and the contaminated object must be burned up.

verses.kjv_text: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin {it be}, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.nlt_text: But if the spot disappears from the clothing, the fabric, or the leather article after it has been washed, it must be washed again; then it will be ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.nlt_text: "These are the instructions for dealing with mildew that contaminates woolen or linen clothing or fabric or anything made of leather. This is how the priest will determine whether these items are ceremonially clean or unclean."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.nlt_text: "The following instructions are for those seeking ceremonial purification from a skin disease. Those who have been healed must be brought to the priest,

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, {if} the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.nlt_text: who will examine them at a place outside the camp. If the priest finds that someone has been healed of a serious skin disease,

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive {and} clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop: {birds: or, sparrows}
verses.nlt_text: he will perform a purification ceremony, using two live birds that are ceremonially clean, a stick of cedar, some scarlet yarn, and a hyssop branch.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will order that one bird be slaughtered over a clay pot filled with fresh water.

verses.kjv_text: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird {that was} killed over the running water:
verses.nlt_text: He will take the live bird, the cedar stick, the scarlet yarn, and the hyssop branch, and dip them into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field. {into...: Heb. upon the face of the field}
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then sprinkle the blood of the dead bird seven times on the person being purified of the skin disease. When the priest has purified the person, he will release the live bird in the open field to fly away.

verses.kjv_text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.nlt_text: "The persons being purified must then wash their clothes, shave off all their hair, and bathe themselves in water. Then they will be ceremonially clean and may return to the camp. However, they must remain outside their tents for seven days.

verses.kjv_text: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.nlt_text: On the seventh day they must again shave all the hair from their heads, including the hair of the beard and eyebrows. They must also wash their clothes and bathe themselves in water. Then they will be ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour {for} a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil. {of the...: Heb. the daughter of her year}
verses.nlt_text: "On the eighth day each person being purified must bring two male lambs and a one-year-old female lamb, all with no defects, along with a grain offering of six quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil, and a cup of olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest that maketh {him} clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: Then the officiating priest will present that person for purification, along with the offerings, before the LORD at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will take one of the male lambs and the olive oil and present them as a guilt offering, lifting them up as a special offering before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering {is} the priest's, {so is} the trespass offering: it {is} most holy:
verses.nlt_text: He will then slaughter the male lamb in the sacred area where sin offerings and burnt offerings are slaughtered. As with the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest. It is a most holy offering.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take {some} of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put {it} upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then take some of the blood of the guilt offering and apply it to the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot of the person being purified.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take {some} of the log of oil, and pour {it} into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.nlt_text: "Then the priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his own left hand.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that {is} in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: He will dip his right finger into the oil in his palm and sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And of the rest of the oil that {is} in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then apply some of the oil in his palm over the blood from the guilt offering that is on the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot of the person being purified.

verses.kjv_text: And the remnant of the oil that {is} in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will apply the oil remaining in his hand to the head of the person being purified. Through this process, the priest will purify the person before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
verses.nlt_text: "Then the priest must present the sin offering to purify the person who was cured of the skin disease. After that, the priest will slaughter the burnt offering

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.nlt_text: and offer it on the altar along with the grain offering. Through this process, the priest will purify the person who was healed, and the person will be ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: And if he {be} poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb {for} a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil; {cannot...: Heb. his hand reach not} {to be...: Heb. for a waving}
verses.nlt_text: "But anyone who is too poor and cannot afford these offerings may bring one male lamb for a guilt offering, to be lifted up as a special offering for purification. The person must also bring two quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil for the grain offering and a cup of olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: The offering must also include two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whichever the person can afford. One of the pair must be used for the sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: On the eighth day of the purification ceremony, the person being purified must bring the offerings to the priest in the LORD's presence at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will take the lamb for the guilt offering, along with the olive oil, and lift them up as a special offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take {some} of the blood of the trespass offering, and put {it} upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will slaughter the lamb for the guilt offering. He will take some of its blood and apply it to the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot of the person being purified.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.nlt_text: "The priest will also pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his own left hand.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger {some} of the oil that {is} in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: He will dip his right finger into the oil in his palm and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall put of the oil that {is} in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then apply some of the oil in his palm over the blood from the guilt offering that is on the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot of the person being purified.

verses.kjv_text: And the rest of the oil that {is} in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will apply the oil remaining in his hand to the head of the person being purified. Through this process, the priest will purify the person before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.nlt_text: "Then the priest will offer the two turtledoves or the two young pigeons, whichever the person can afford.

verses.kjv_text: {Even} such as he is able to get, the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: One of them is for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, to be presented along with the grain offering. Through this process, the priest will purify the person before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the law {of him} in whom {is} the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get {that which pertaineth} to his cleansing.
verses.nlt_text: These are the instructions for purification for those who have recovered from a serious skin disease but who cannot afford to bring the offerings normally required for the ceremony of purification."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.kjv_text: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.nlt_text: "When you arrive in Canaan, the land I am giving you as your own possession, I may contaminate some of the houses in your land with mildew.

verses.kjv_text: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me {there is} as it were a plague in the house:
verses.nlt_text: The owner of such a house must then go to the priest and say, 'It appears that my house has some kind of mildew.'

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go {into it} to see the plague, that all that {is} in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house: {empty: or, prepare}
verses.nlt_text: Before the priest goes in to inspect the house, he must have the house emptied so nothing inside will be pronounced ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, {if} the plague {be} in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight {are} lower than the wall;
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will go in and examine the mildew on the walls. If he finds greenish or reddish streaks and the contamination appears to go deeper than the wall's surface,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
verses.nlt_text: the priest will step outside the door and put the house in quarantine for seven days.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, {if} the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.nlt_text: On the seventh day the priest must return for another inspection. If he finds that the mildew on the walls of the house has spread,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague {is}, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
verses.nlt_text: the priest must order that the stones from those areas be removed. The contaminated material will then be taken outside the town to an area designated as ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
verses.nlt_text: Next the inside walls of the entire house must be scraped thoroughly and the scrapings dumped in the unclean place outside the town.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall take other stones, and put {them} in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
verses.nlt_text: Other stones will be brought in to replace the ones that were removed, and the walls will be replastered.

verses.kjv_text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
verses.nlt_text: "But if the mildew reappears after all the stones have been replaced and the house has been scraped and replastered,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, {if} the plague be spread in the house, it {is} a fretting leprosy in the house: it {is} unclean.
verses.nlt_text: the priest must return and inspect the house again. If he finds that the mildew has spread, the walls are clearly contaminated with a serious mildew, and the house is defiled.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry {them} forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.nlt_text: It must be torn down, and all its stones, timbers, and plaster must be carried out of town to the place designated as ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: Those who enter the house during the period of quarantine will be ceremonially unclean until evening,

verses.kjv_text: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.nlt_text: and all who sleep or eat in the house must wash their clothing.

verses.kjv_text: And if the priest shall come in, and look {upon it}, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed. {shall come...: Heb. in coming in shall come in, etc}
verses.nlt_text: "But if the priest returns for his inspection and finds that the mildew has not reappeared in the house after the fresh plastering, he will pronounce it clean because the mildew is clearly gone.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.nlt_text: To purify the house the priest must take two birds, a stick of cedar, some scarlet yarn, and a hyssop branch.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.nlt_text: He will slaughter one of the birds over a clay pot filled with fresh water.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
verses.nlt_text: He will take the cedar stick, the hyssop branch, the scarlet yarn, and the live bird, and dip them into the blood of the slaughtered bird and into the fresh water. Then he will sprinkle the house seven times.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
verses.nlt_text: When the priest has purified the house in exactly this way,

verses.kjv_text: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
verses.nlt_text: he will release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. Through this process, the priest will purify the house, and it will be ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
verses.nlt_text: "These are the instructions for dealing with serious skin diseases, including scabby sores;

verses.kjv_text: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
verses.nlt_text: and mildew, whether on clothing or in a house;

verses.kjv_text: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
verses.nlt_text: and a swelling on the skin, a rash, or discolored skin.

verses.kjv_text: To teach when {it is} unclean, and when {it is} clean: this {is} the law of leprosy. {when it is unclean...: Heb. in the day of the unclean, and in the day of the clean}
verses.nlt_text: This procedure will determine whether a person or object is ceremonially clean or unclean."These are the instructions regarding skin diseases and mildew."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, {because of} his issue he {is} unclean. {running...: or, running of the reins}
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel."Any man who has a bodily discharge is ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it {is} his uncleanness.
verses.nlt_text: This defilement is caused by his discharge, whether the discharge continues or stops. In either case the man is unclean.

verses.kjv_text: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean. {thing: Heb. vessel}
verses.nlt_text: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies and anything on which he sits will be ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: So if you touch the man's bed, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And he that sitteth on {any} thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If you sit where the man with the discharge has sat, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If you touch the man with the discharge, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If the man spits on you, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.nlt_text: Any saddle blanket on which the man rides will be ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth {any of} those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If you touch anything that was under the man, you will be unclean until evening. You must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If the man touches you without first rinsing his hands, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.nlt_text: Any clay pot the man touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil he touches must be rinsed with water.

verses.kjv_text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.nlt_text: "When the man with the discharge is healed, he must count off seven days for the period of purification. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe himself in fresh water, and he will be ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.nlt_text: On the eighth day he must get two turtledoves or two young pigeons and come before the LORD at the entrance of the Tabernacle and give his offerings to the priest.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall offer them, the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will offer one bird for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. Through this process, the priest will purify the man before the LORD for his discharge.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: "Whenever a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his entire body in water, and he will remain ceremonially unclean until the next evening.

verses.kjv_text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: Any clothing or leather with semen on it must be washed in water, and it will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: The woman also with whom man shall lie {with} seed of copulation, they shall {both} bathe {themselves} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: After a man and a woman have sexual intercourse, they must each bathe in water, and they will remain unclean until the next evening.

verses.kjv_text: And if a woman have an issue, {and} her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even. {put...: Heb. in her separation}
verses.nlt_text: "Whenever a woman has her menstrual period, she will be ceremonially unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her during that time will be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.nlt_text: Anything on which the woman lies or sits during the time of her period will be unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If any of you touch her bed, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If you touch any object she has sat on, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: And if it {be} on {her} bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: This includes her bed or any other object she has sat on; you will be unclean until evening if you touch it.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.nlt_text: If a man has sexual intercourse with her and her blood touches him, her menstrual impurity will be transmitted to him. He will remain unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies will be unclean.

verses.kjv_text: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she {shall be} unclean.
verses.nlt_text: "If a woman has a flow of blood for many days that is unrelated to her menstrual period, or if the blood continues beyond the normal period, she is ceremonially unclean. As during her menstrual period, the woman will be unclean as long as the discharge continues.

verses.kjv_text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.nlt_text: Any bed she lies on and any object she sits on during that time will be unclean, just as during her normal menstrual period.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.nlt_text: If any of you touch these things, you will be ceremonially unclean. You must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv_text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.nlt_text: "When the woman's bleeding stops, she must count off seven days. Then she will be ceremonially clean.

verses.kjv_text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: On the eighth day she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons and present them to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall offer the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. Through this process, the priest will purify her before the LORD for the ceremonial impurity caused by her bleeding.

verses.kjv_text: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that {is} among them.
verses.nlt_text: "This is how you will guard the people of Israel from ceremonial uncleanness. Otherwise they would die, for their impurity would defile my Tabernacle that stands among them.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the law of him that hath an issue, and {of him} whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.nlt_text: These are the instructions for dealing with anyone who has a bodily discharge-- a man who is unclean because of an emission of semen

verses.kjv_text: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.nlt_text: or a woman during her menstrual period. It applies to any man or woman who has a bodily discharge, and to a man who has sexual intercourse with a woman who is ceremonially unclean."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
verses.nlt_text: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron's two sons, who died after they entered the LORD's presence and burned the wrong kind of fire before him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy {place} within the vail before the mercy seat, which {is} upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses, "Warn your brother, Aaron, not to enter the Most Holy Place behind the inner curtain whenever he chooses; if he does, he will die. For the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- is there, and I myself am present in the cloud above the atonement cover.

verses.kjv_text: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy {place}: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: "When Aaron enters the sanctuary area, he must follow these instructions fully. He must bring a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv_text: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these {are} holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and {so} put them on.
verses.nlt_text: He must put on his linen tunic and the linen undergarments worn next to his body. He must tie the linen sash around his waist and put the linen turban on his head. These are sacred garments, so he must bathe himself in water before he puts them on.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: Aaron must take from the community of Israel two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which {is} for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.nlt_text: "Aaron will present his own bull as a sin offering to purify himself and his family, making them right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must take the two male goats and present them to the LORD at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat. {scapegoat: Heb. Azazel}
verses.nlt_text: He is to cast sacred lots to determine which goat will be reserved as an offering to the LORD and which will carry the sins of the people to the wilderness of Azazel.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD'S lot fell, and offer him {for} a sin offering. {fell: Heb. went up}
verses.nlt_text: Aaron will then present as a sin offering the goat chosen by lot for the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, {and} to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: The other goat, the scapegoat chosen by lot to be sent away, will be kept alive, standing before the LORD. When it is sent away to Azazel in the wilderness, the people will be purified and made right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which {is} for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which {is} for himself:
verses.nlt_text: "Aaron will present his own bull as a sin offering to purify himself and his family, making them right with the LORD. After he has slaughtered the bull as a sin offering,

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring {it} within the vail:
verses.nlt_text: he will fill an incense burner with burning coals from the altar that stands before the LORD. Then he will take two handfuls of fragrant powdered incense and will carry the burner and the incense behind the inner curtain.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that {is} upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.nlt_text: There in the LORD's presence he will put the incense on the burning coals so that a cloud of incense will rise over the Ark's cover-- the place of atonement-- that rests on the Ark of the Covenant. If he follows these instructions, he will not die.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle {it} with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must take some of the blood of the bull, dip his finger in it, and sprinkle it on the east side of the atonement cover. He must sprinkle blood seven times with his finger in front of the atonement cover.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that {is} for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.nlt_text: "Then Aaron must slaughter the first goat as a sin offering for the people and carry its blood behind the inner curtain. There he will sprinkle the goat's blood over the atonement cover and in front of it, just as he did with the bull's blood.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy {place}, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness. {remaineth: Heb. dwelleth}
verses.nlt_text: Through this process, he will purify the Most Holy Place, and he will do the same for the entire Tabernacle, because of the defiling sin and rebellion of the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy {place}, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: No one else is allowed inside the Tabernacle when Aaron enters it for the purification ceremony in the Most Holy Place. No one may enter until he comes out again after purifying himself, his family, and all the congregation of Israel, making them right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall go out unto the altar that {is} before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.nlt_text: "Then Aaron will come out to purify the altar that stands before the LORD. He will do this by taking some of the blood from the bull and the goat and putting it on each of the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must sprinkle the blood with his finger seven times over the altar. In this way, he will cleanse it from Israel's defilement and make it holy.

verses.kjv_text: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy {place}, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.nlt_text: "When Aaron has finished purifying the Most Holy Place and the Tabernacle and the altar, he must present the live goat.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send {him} away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness: {a fit...: Heb. a man of opportunity}
verses.nlt_text: He will lay both of his hands on the goat's head and confess over it all the wickedness, rebellion, and sins of the the people of Israel. In this way, he will transfer the people's sins to the head of the goat. Then a man specially chosen for the task will drive the goat into the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness. {not...: Heb. of separation}
verses.nlt_text: As the goat goes into the wilderness, it will carry all the people's sins upon itself into a desolate land.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy {place}, and shall leave them there:
verses.nlt_text: "When Aaron goes back into the Tabernacle, he must take off the linen garments he was wearing when he entered the Most Holy Place, and he must leave the garments there.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.nlt_text: Then he must bathe himself with water in a sacred place, put on his regular garments, and go out to sacrifice a burnt offering for himself and a burnt offering for the people. Through this process, he will purify himself and the people, making them right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.nlt_text: He must then burn all the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.nlt_text: "The man chosen to drive the scapegoat into the wilderness of Azazel must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water. Then he may return to the camp.

verses.kjv_text: And the bullock {for} the sin offering, and the goat {for} the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy {place}, shall {one} carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.nlt_text: "The bull and the goat presented as sin offerings, whose blood Aaron takes into the Most Holy Place for the purification ceremony, will be carried outside the camp. The animals' hides, internal organs, and dung are all to be burned.

verses.kjv_text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.nlt_text: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water before returning to the camp.

verses.kjv_text: And {this} shall be a statute for ever unto you: {that} in the seventh month, on the tenth {day} of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, {whether it be} one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.nlt_text: "On the tenth day of the appointed month in early autumn, you must deny yourselves. Neither native-born Israelites nor foreigners living among you may do any kind of work. This is a permanent law for you.

verses.kjv_text: For on that day shall {the priest} make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, {that} ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: On that day offerings of purification will be made for you, and you will be purified in the LORD's presence from all your sins.

verses.kjv_text: It {shall be} a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.nlt_text: It will be a Sabbath day of complete rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. This is a permanent law for you.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, {even} the holy garments: {consecrate: Heb. fill his hand}
verses.nlt_text: In future generations, the purification ceremony will be performed by the priest who has been anointed and ordained to serve as high priest in place of his ancestor Aaron. He will put on the holy linen garments

verses.kjv_text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: and purify the Most Holy Place, the Tabernacle, the altar, the priests, and the entire congregation.

verses.kjv_text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: This is a permanent law for you, to purify the people of Israel from their sins, making them right with the LORD once each year." Moses followed all these instructions exactly as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This {is} the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to Aaron and his sons and all the people of Israel. This is what the LORD has commanded.

verses.kjv_text: What man soever {there be} of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth {it} out of the camp,
verses.nlt_text: "If any native Israelite sacrifices a bull or a lamb or a goat anywhere inside or outside the camp

verses.kjv_text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.nlt_text: instead of bringing it to the entrance of the Tabernacle to present it as an offering to the LORD, that person will be as guilty as a murderer. Such a person has shed blood and will be cut off from the community.

verses.kjv_text: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them {for} peace offerings unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The purpose of this rule is to stop the Israelites from sacrificing animals in the open fields. It will ensure that they bring their sacrifices to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle, so he can present them to the LORD as peace offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will be able to splatter the blood against the LORD's altar at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and he will burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.nlt_text: The people must no longer be unfaithful to the LORD by offering sacrifices to the goat idols. This is a permanent law for them, to be observed from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man {there be} of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.nlt_text: "Give them this command as well. If any native Israelite or foreigner living among you offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice

verses.kjv_text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.nlt_text: but does not bring it to the entrance of the Tabernacle to offer it to the LORD, that person will be cut off from the community.

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever man {there be} of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.nlt_text: "And if any native Israelite or foreigner living among you eats or drinks blood in any form, I will turn against that person and cut him off from the community of your people,

verses.kjv_text: For the life of the flesh {is} in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it {is} the blood {that} maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.nlt_text: for the life of the body is in its blood. I have given you the blood on the altar to purify you, making you right with the LORD. It is the blood, given in exchange for a life, that makes purification possible.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.nlt_text: That is why I have said to the people of Israel, 'You must never eat or drink blood-- neither you nor the foreigners living among you.'

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever man {there be} of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust. {which...: Heb. that hunteth any hunting}
verses.nlt_text: "And if any native Israelite or foreigner living among you goes hunting and kills an animal or bird that is approved for eating, he must drain its blood and cover it with earth.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} the life of all flesh; the blood of it {is} for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh {is} the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.nlt_text: The life of every creature is in its blood. That is why I have said to the people of Israel, 'You must never eat or drink blood, for the life of any creature is in its blood.' So whoever consumes blood will be cut off from the community.

verses.kjv_text: And every soul that eateth that which died {of itself}, or that which was torn {with beasts, whether it be} one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean. {that which died...: Heb. a carcase}
verses.nlt_text: "And if any native-born Israelites or foreigners eat the meat of an animal that died naturally or was torn up by wild animals, they must wash their clothes and bathe themselves in water. They will remain ceremonially unclean until evening, but then they will be clean.

verses.kjv_text: But if he wash {them} not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: But if they do not wash their clothes and bathe themselves, they will be punished for their sin."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.nlt_text: So do not act like the people in Egypt, where you used to live, or like the people of Canaan, where I am taking you. You must not imitate their way of life.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: You must obey all my regulations and be careful to obey my decrees, for I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: If you obey my decrees and my regulations, you will find life through them. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover {their} nakedness: I {am} the LORD. {near...: Heb. remainder of his flesh}
verses.nlt_text: "You must never have sexual relations with a close relative, for I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she {is} thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not violate your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.

verses.kjv_text: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it {is} thy father's nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with any of your father's wives, for this would violate your father.

verses.kjv_text: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, {whether she be} born at home, or born abroad, {even} their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your sister or half sister, whether she is your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, whether she was born into your household or someone else's.

verses.kjv_text: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, {even} their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs {is} thine own nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your granddaughter, whether she is your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, for this would violate yourself.

verses.kjv_text: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she {is} thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your stepsister, the daughter of any of your father's wives, for she is your sister.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she {is} thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your father's sister, for she is your father's close relative.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she {is} thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your mother's sister, for she is your mother's close relative.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she {is} thine aunt.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not violate your uncle, your father's brother, by having sexual relations with his wife, for she is your aunt.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she {is} thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law; she is your son's wife, so you must not have sexual relations with her.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it {is} thy brother's nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with your brother's wife, for this would violate your brother.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; {for} they {are} her near kinswomen: it {is} wickedness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. And do not take her granddaughter, whether her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives, and this would be a wicked act.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex {her}, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life {time}. {a wife...: or, one wife to another}
verses.nlt_text: "While your wife is living, do not marry her sister and have sexual relations with her, for they would be rivals.

verses.kjv_text: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not have sexual relations with a woman during her period of menstrual impurity.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not defile yourself by having sexual intercourse with your neighbor's wife.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through {the fire} to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I {am} the LORD. {Molech: Gr. Moloch}
verses.nlt_text: "Do not permit any of your children to be offered as a sacrifice to Molech, for you must not bring shame on the name of your God. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it {is} abomination.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not practice homosexuality, having sex with another man as with a woman. It is a detestable sin.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it {is} confusion.
verses.nlt_text: "A man must not defile himself by having sex with an animal. And a woman must not offer herself to a male animal to have intercourse with it. This is a perverse act.

verses.kjv_text: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.nlt_text: "Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, for the people I am driving out before you have defiled themselves in all these ways.

verses.kjv_text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.nlt_text: Because the entire land has become defiled, I am punishing the people who live there. I will cause the land to vomit them out.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit {any} of these abominations; {neither} any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.nlt_text: You must obey all my decrees and regulations. You must not commit any of these detestable sins. This applies both to native-born Israelites and to the foreigners living among you.

verses.kjv_text: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which {were} before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.nlt_text: "All these detestable activities are practiced by the people of the land where I am taking you, and this is how the land has become defiled.

verses.kjv_text: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that {were} before you.
verses.nlt_text: So do not defile the land and give it a reason to vomit you out, as it will vomit out the people who live there now.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit {them} shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.nlt_text: Whoever commits any of these detestable sins will be cut off from the community of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that {ye} commit not {any one} of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: So obey my instructions, and do not defile yourselves by committing any of these detestable practices that were committed by the people who lived in the land before you. I am the LORD your God."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD also said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God {am} holy.
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the entire community of Israel. You must be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: "Each of you must show great respect for your mother and father, and you must always observe my Sabbath days of rest. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not put your trust in idols or make metal images of gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.nlt_text: "When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, offer it properly so you will be accepted by God.

verses.kjv_text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.nlt_text: The sacrifice must be eaten on the same day you offer it or on the next day. Whatever is left over until the third day must be completely burned up.

verses.kjv_text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it {is} abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.nlt_text: If any of the sacrifice is eaten on the third day, it will be contaminated, and I will not accept it.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore {every one} that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who eats it on the third day will be punished for defiling what is holy to the LORD and will be cut off from the community.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.nlt_text: "When you harvest the crops of your land, do not harvest the grain along the edges of your fields, and do not pick up what the harvesters drop.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather {every} grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: It is the same with your grape crop-- do not strip every last bunch of grapes from the vines, and do not pick up the grapes that fall to the ground. Leave them for the poor and the foreigners living among you. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not steal."Do not deceive or cheat one another.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not bring shame on the name of your God by using it to swear falsely. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob {him}: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not defraud or rob your neighbor."Do not make your hired workers wait until the next day to receive their pay.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not insult the deaf or cause the blind to stumble. You must fear your God; I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: {but} in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not twist justice in legal matters by favoring the poor or being partial to the rich and powerful. Always judge people fairly.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not go up and down {as} a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not spread slanderous gossip among your people. "Do not stand idly by when your neighbor's life is threatened. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him. {and...: or, that thou bear not sin for him}
verses.nlt_text: "Do not nurse hatred in your heart for any of your relatives. Confront people directly so you will not be held guilty for their sin.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against a fellow Israelite, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.nlt_text: "You must obey all my decrees."Do not mate two different kinds of animals. Do not plant your field with two different kinds of seed. Do not wear clothing woven from two different kinds of thread.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that {is} a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free. {betrothed...: or, abused by any: Heb. reproached by (or, for) man} {she shall...: or, they, etc: Heb. there shall be a scourging}
verses.nlt_text: "If a man has sex with a slave girl whose freedom has never been purchased but who is committed to become another man's wife, he must pay full compensation to her master. But since she is not a free woman, neither the man nor the woman will be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, {even} a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.nlt_text: The man, however, must bring a ram as a guilt offering and present it to the LORD at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then purify him before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering, and the man's sin will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.nlt_text: "When you enter the land and plant fruit trees, leave the fruit unharvested for the first three years and consider it forbidden. Do not eat it.

verses.kjv_text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD {withal}. {holy...: Heb. holiness of praises to the LORD}
verses.nlt_text: In the fourth year the entire crop must be consecrated to the LORD as a celebration of praise.

verses.kjv_text: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, in the fifth year you may eat the fruit. If you follow this pattern, your harvest will increase. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall not eat {any thing} with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not eat meat that has not been drained of its blood."Do not practice fortune-telling or witchcraft.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not trim off the hair on your temples or trim your beards.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not cut your bodies for the dead, and do not mark your skin with tattoos. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness. {prostitute: Heb. profane}
verses.nlt_text: "Do not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be filled with prostitution and wickedness.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Keep my Sabbath days of rest, and show reverence toward my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not defile yourselves by turning to mediums or to those who consult the spirits of the dead. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Stand up in the presence of the elderly, and show respect for the aged. Fear your God. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him. {vex: or, oppress}
verses.nlt_text: "Do not take advantage of foreigners who live among you in your land.

verses.kjv_text: {But} the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: Treat them like native-born Israelites, and love them as you love yourself. Remember that you were once foreigners living in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight, or volume.

verses.kjv_text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I {am} the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt. {weights: Heb. stones}
verses.nlt_text: Your scales and weights must be accurate. Your containers for measuring dry materials or liquids must be accurate. I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "You must be careful to keep all of my decrees and regulations by putting them into practice. I am the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever {he be} of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth {any} of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.nlt_text: "Give the people of Israel these instructions, which apply both to native Israelites and to the foreigners living in Israel."If any of them offer their children as a sacrifice to Molech, they must be put to death. The people of the community must stone them to death.

verses.kjv_text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.nlt_text: I myself will turn against them and cut them off from the community, because they have defiled my sanctuary and brought shame on my holy name by offering their children to Molech.

verses.kjv_text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.nlt_text: And if the people of the community ignore those who offer their children to Molech and refuse to execute them,

verses.kjv_text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.nlt_text: I myself will turn against them and their families and will cut them off from the community. This will happen to all who commit spiritual prostitution by worshiping Molech.

verses.kjv_text: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.nlt_text: "I will also turn against those who commit spiritual prostitution by putting their trust in mediums or in those who consult the spirits of the dead. I will cut them off from the community.

verses.kjv_text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: So set yourselves apart to be holy, for I am the LORD your God.
