verses.kjv_text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.nlt_text: here is the scale of values to be used. A man between the ages of twenty and sixty is valued at fifty shekels of silver, as measured by the sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv_text: And if it {be} a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.nlt_text: A woman of that age is valued at thirty shekels of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.nlt_text: A boy between the ages of five and twenty is valued at twenty shekels of silver; a girl of that age is valued at ten shekels of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation {shall be} three shekels of silver.
verses.nlt_text: A boy between the ages of one month and five years is valued at five shekels of silver; a girl of that age is valued at three shekels of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} from sixty years old and above; if {it be} a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.nlt_text: A man older than sixty is valued at fifteen shekels of silver; a woman of that age is valued at ten shekels of silver.

verses.kjv_text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.nlt_text: If you desire to make such a vow but cannot afford to pay the required amount, take the person to the priest. He will determine the amount for you to pay based on what you can afford.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that {any man} giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.nlt_text: "If your vow involves giving an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the LORD, any gift to the LORD will be considered holy.

verses.kjv_text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.nlt_text: You may not exchange or substitute it for another animal-- neither a good animal for a bad one nor a bad animal for a good one. But if you do exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and its substitute will be considered holy.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.nlt_text: If your vow involves an unclean animal-- one that is not acceptable as an offering to the LORD-- then you must bring the animal to the priest.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, {who art} the priest, so shall it be. {as...: Heb. according to thy estimation, O priest, etc}
verses.nlt_text: He will assess its value, and his assessment will be final, whether high or low.

verses.kjv_text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth {part} thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.nlt_text: If you want to buy back the animal, you must pay the value set by the priest, plus 20 percent.

verses.kjv_text: And when a man shall sanctify his house {to be} holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.nlt_text: "If someone dedicates a house to the LORD, the priest will come to assess its value. The priest's assessment will be final, whether high or low.

verses.kjv_text: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth {part} of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.nlt_text: If the person who dedicated the house wants to buy it back, he must pay the value set by the priest, plus 20 percent. Then the house will again be his.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD {some part} of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed {shall be valued} at fifty shekels of silver. {an...: or, the land of an homer, etc}
verses.nlt_text: "If someone dedicates to the LORD a piece of his family property, its value will be assessed according to the amount of seed required to plant it-- fifty shekels of silver for a field planted with five bushels of barley seed.

verses.kjv_text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.nlt_text: If the field is dedicated to the LORD in the Year of Jubilee, then the entire assessment will apply.

verses.kjv_text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.nlt_text: But if the field is dedicated after the Year of Jubilee, the priest will assess the land's value in proportion to the number of years left until the next Year of Jubilee. Its assessed value is reduced each year.

verses.kjv_text: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth {part} of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.nlt_text: If the person who dedicated the field wants to buy it back, he must pay the value set by the priest, plus 20 percent. Then the field will again be legally his.

verses.kjv_text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.nlt_text: But if he does not want to buy it back, and it is sold to someone else, the field can no longer be bought back.

verses.kjv_text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
verses.nlt_text: When the field is released in the Year of Jubilee, it will be holy, a field specially set apart for the LORD. It will become the property of the priests.

verses.kjv_text: And if {a man} sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which {is} not of the fields of his possession;
verses.nlt_text: "If someone dedicates to the LORD a field he has purchased but which is not part of his family property,

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, {even} unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, {as} a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: the priest will assess its value based on the number of years left until the next Year of Jubilee. On that day he must give the assessed value of the land as a sacred donation to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, {even} to him to whom the possession of the land {did belong}.
verses.nlt_text: In the Year of Jubilee the field must be returned to the person from whom he purchased it, the one who inherited it as family property.

verses.kjv_text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.nlt_text: (All the payments must be measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs.)

verses.kjv_text: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD'S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether {it be} ox, or sheep: it {is} the LORD'S. {firstling of: Heb. firstborn, etc}
verses.nlt_text: "You may not dedicate a firstborn animal to the LORD, for the firstborn of your cattle, sheep, and goats already belong to him.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem {it} according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth {part} of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.nlt_text: However, you may buy back the firstborn of a ceremonially unclean animal by paying the priest's assessment of its worth, plus 20 percent. If you do not buy it back, the priest will sell it at its assessed value.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, {both} of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing {is} most holy unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "However, anything specially set apart for the LORD-- whether a person, an animal, or family property-- must never be sold or bought back. Anything devoted in this way has been set apart as holy, and it belongs to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; {but} shall surely be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: No person specially set apart for destruction may be bought back. Such a person must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And all the tithe of the land, {whether} of the seed of the land, {or} of the fruit of the tree, {is} the LORD'S: {it is} holy unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "One tenth of the produce of the land, whether grain from the fields or fruit from the trees, belongs to the LORD and must be set apart to him as holy.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man will at all redeem {ought} of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth {part} thereof.
verses.nlt_text: If you want to buy back the LORD's tenth of the grain or fruit, you must pay its value, plus 20 percent.

verses.kjv_text: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, {even} of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Count off every tenth animal from your herds and flocks and set them apart for the LORD as holy.

verses.kjv_text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.nlt_text: You may not pick and choose between good and bad animals, and you may not substitute one for another. But if you do exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and its substitute will be considered holy and cannot be bought back."

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.nlt_text: These are the commands that the LORD gave through Moses on Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first {day} of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.nlt_text: A year after Israel's departure from Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tabernacle in the wilderness of Sinai. On the first day of the second month of that year he said,

verses.kjv_text: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of {their} names, every male by their polls;
verses.nlt_text: "From the whole community of Israel, record the names of all the warriors by their clans and families. List all the men

verses.kjv_text: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.nlt_text: twenty years old or older who are able to go to war. You and Aaron must register the troops,

verses.kjv_text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.nlt_text: and you will be assisted by one family leader from each tribe.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the names of the men that shall stand with you: of {the tribe of} Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.nlt_text: "These are the tribes and the names of the leaders who will assist you: Tribe Leader Reuben Elizur son of Shedeur

verses.kjv_text: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.nlt_text: Simeon Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai

verses.kjv_text: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.nlt_text: Judah Nahshon son of Amminadab

verses.kjv_text: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.nlt_text: Issachar Nethanel son of Zuar

verses.kjv_text: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.nlt_text: Zebulun Eliab son of Helon

verses.kjv_text: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.nlt_text: Ephraim son of Joseph Elishama son of Ammihud Manasseh son of Joseph Gamaliel son of Pedahzur

verses.kjv_text: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.nlt_text: Benjamin Abidan son of Gideoni

verses.kjv_text: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.nlt_text: Dan Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai

verses.kjv_text: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.nlt_text: Asher Pagiel son of Ocran

verses.kjv_text: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel. {Deuel: also called, Reuel}
verses.nlt_text: Gad Eliasaph son of Deuel

verses.kjv_text: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.nlt_text: Naphtali Ahira son of Enan

verses.kjv_text: These {were} the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: These are the chosen leaders of the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes, the heads of the clans of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by {their} names:
verses.nlt_text: So Moses and Aaron called together these chosen leaders,

verses.kjv_text: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first {day} of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.nlt_text: and they assembled the whole community of Israel on that very day. All the people were registered according to their ancestry by their clans and families. The men of Israel who were twenty years old or older were listed one by one,

verses.kjv_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.nlt_text: just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So Moses recorded their names in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: This is the number of men twenty years old or older who were able to go to war, as their names were listed in the records of their clans and families: Tribe Number Reuben (Jacob's oldest son) 46,500

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Reuben, {were} forty and six thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Simeon 59,300

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Simeon, {were} fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Gad, {were} forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Issachar, {were} fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Zebulun 57,400

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Zebulun, {were} fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Joseph, {namely}, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Ephraim son of Joseph 40,500

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Ephraim, {were} forty thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Manasseh son of Joseph 32,200

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Manasseh, {were} thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Benjamin 35,400

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Benjamin, {were} thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Dan, {were} threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Asher 41,500

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Asher, {were} forty and one thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.nlt_text: Naphtali 53,400

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Naphtali, {were} fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
These {are} those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, {being} twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.nlt_text: These were the men registered by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, all listed according to their ancestral descent.

verses.kjv_text: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.nlt_text: They were registered by families-- all the men of Israel who were twenty years old or older and able to go to war.

verses.kjv_text: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.nlt_text: The total number was 603,550.

verses.kjv_text: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.nlt_text: But this total did not include the Levites.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD had said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: "Do not include the tribe of Levi in the registration; do not count them with the rest of the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that {belong} to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Put the Levites in charge of the Tabernacle of the Covenant, along with all its furnishings and equipment. They must carry the Tabernacle and all its furnishings as you travel, and they must take care of it and camp around it.

verses.kjv_text: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: Whenever it is time for the Tabernacle to move, the Levites will take it down. And when it is time to stop, they will set it up again. But any unauthorized person who goes too near the Tabernacle must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.nlt_text: Each tribe of Israel will camp in a designated area with its own family banner.

verses.kjv_text: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.nlt_text: But the Levites will camp around the Tabernacle of the Covenant to protect the community of Israel from the LORD's anger. The Levites are responsible to stand guard around the Tabernacle."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.nlt_text: So the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD gave these instructions to Moses and Aaron:

verses.kjv_text: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch. {far...: Heb. over against}
verses.nlt_text: "When the Israelites set up camp, each tribe will be assigned its own area. The tribal divisions will camp beneath their family banners on all four sides of the Tabernacle, but at some distance from it.

verses.kjv_text: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab {shall be} captain of the children of Judah.
verses.nlt_text: "The divisions of Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun are to camp toward the sunrise on the east side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe Leader Number Judah Nahshon son of Amminadab 74,600

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
And those that do pitch next unto him {shall be} the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar {shall be} captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.nlt_text: Issachar Nethanel son of Zuar 54,400

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, {were} fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
{Then} the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon {shall be} captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.nlt_text: Zebulun Eliab son of Helon 57,400

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, {were} fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
All that were numbered in the camp of Judah {were} an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.nlt_text: So the total of all the troops on Judah's side of the camp is 186,400. These three tribes are to lead the way whenever the Israelites travel to a new campsite.

verses.kjv_text: On the south side {shall be} the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben {shall be} Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.nlt_text: "The divisions of Reuben, Simeon, and Gad are to camp on the south side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe Leader Number Reuben Elizur son of Shedeur 46,500

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, {were} forty and six thousand and five hundred.
And those which pitch by him {shall be} the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon {shall be} Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.nlt_text: Simeon Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai 59,300

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad {shall be} Eliasaph the son of Reuel. {Reuel: also called, Deuel}
verses.nlt_text: Gad Eliasaph son of Deuel 45,650

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben {were} an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.nlt_text: So the total of all the troops on Reuben's side of the camp is 151,450. These three tribes will be second in line whenever the Israelites travel.

verses.kjv_text: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.nlt_text: "Then the Tabernacle, carried by the Levites, will set out from the middle of the camp. All the tribes are to travel in the same order that they camp, each in position under the appropriate family banner.

verses.kjv_text: On the west side {shall be} the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim {shall be} Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.nlt_text: "The divisions of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin are to camp on the west side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe Leader Number Ephraim Elishama son of Ammihud 40,500

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty thousand and five hundred.
And by him {shall be} the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh {shall be} Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.nlt_text: Manasseh Gamaliel son of Pedahzur 32,200

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin {shall be} Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.nlt_text: Benjamin Abidan son of Gideoni 35,400

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim {were} an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.nlt_text: So the total of all the troops on Ephraim's side of the camp is 108,100. These three tribes will be third in line whenever the Israelites travel.

verses.kjv_text: The standard of the camp of Dan {shall be} on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan {shall be} Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.nlt_text: "The divisions of Dan, Asher, and Naphtali are to camp on the north side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe Leader Number Dan Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai 62,700

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
And those that encamp by him {shall be} the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher {shall be} Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.nlt_text: Asher Pagiel son of Ocran 41,500

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali {shall be} Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.nlt_text: Naphtali Ahira son of Enan 53,400

verses.kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan {were} an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.nlt_text: So the total of all the troops on Dan's side of the camp is 157,600. These three tribes will be last, marching under their banners whenever the Israelites travel."

verses.kjv_text: These {are} those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts {were} six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.nlt_text: In summary, the troops of Israel listed by their families totaled 603,550.

verses.kjv_text: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: But as the LORD had commanded, the Levites were not included in this registration.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: So the people of Israel did everything as the LORD had commanded Moses. Each clan and family set up camp and marched under their banners exactly as the LORD had instructed them.

verses.kjv_text: These also {are} the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day {that} the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.nlt_text: This is the family line of Aaron and Moses as it was recorded when the LORD spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai:

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.nlt_text: The names of Aaron's sons were Nadab (the oldest), Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office. {whom...: Heb. whose hand he filled}
verses.nlt_text: These sons of Aaron were anointed and ordained to minister as priests.

verses.kjv_text: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.nlt_text: But Nadab and Abihu died in the LORD's presence in the wilderness of Sinai when they burned before the LORD the wrong kind of fire, different than he had commanded. Since they had no sons, this left only Eleazar and Ithamar to serve as priests with their father, Aaron.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.nlt_text: "Call forward the tribe of Levi, and present them to Aaron the priest to serve as his assistants.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: They will serve Aaron and the whole community, performing their sacred duties in and around the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: They will also maintain all the furnishings of the sacred tent, serving in the Tabernacle on behalf of all the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they {are} wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They have been given from among all the people of Israel to serve as their assistants.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: Appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood. But any unauthorized person who goes too near the sanctuary must be put to death."

verses.kjv_text: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.nlt_text: "Look, I have chosen the Levites from among the Israelites to serve as substitutes for all the firstborn sons of the people of Israel. The Levites belong to me,

verses.kjv_text: Because all the firstborn {are} mine; {for} on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: for all the firstborn males are mine. On the day I struck down all the firstborn sons of the Egyptians, I set apart for myself all the firstborn in Israel, both of people and of animals. They are mine; I am the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD spoke again to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai. He said,

verses.kjv_text: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.nlt_text: "Record the names of the members of the tribe of Levi by their families and clans. List every male who is one month old or older."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded. {word: Heb. mouth}
verses.nlt_text: So Moses listed them, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.nlt_text: Levi had three sons, whose names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.nlt_text: The clans descended from Gershon were named after two of his descendants, Libni and Shimei.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.nlt_text: The clans descended from Kohath were named after four of his descendants, Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These {are} the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: The clans descended from Merari were named after two of his descendants, Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, listed according to their family groups.

verses.kjv_text: Of Gershon {was} the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these {are} the families of the Gershonites.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gershon were composed of the clans descended from Libni and Shimei.

verses.kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, {even} those that were numbered of them {were} seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.nlt_text: There were 7,500 males one month old or older among these Gershonite clans.

verses.kjv_text: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.nlt_text: They were assigned the area to the west of the Tabernacle for their camp.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites {shall be} Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.nlt_text: The leader of the Gershonite clans was Eliasaph son of Lael.

verses.kjv_text: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation {shall be} the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.nlt_text: These two clans were responsible to care for the Tabernacle, including the sacred tent with its layers of coverings, the curtain at its entrance,

verses.kjv_text: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which {is} by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.nlt_text: the curtains of the courtyard that surrounded the Tabernacle and altar, the curtain at the courtyard entrance, the ropes, and all the equipment related to their use.

verses.kjv_text: And of Kohath {was} the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these {are} the families of the Kohathites.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Kohath were composed of the clans descended from Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv_text: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, {were} eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.nlt_text: There were 8,600 males one month old or older among these Kohathite clans. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary,

verses.kjv_text: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.nlt_text: and they were assigned the area south of the Tabernacle for their camp.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites {shall be} Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.nlt_text: The leader of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

verses.kjv_text: And their charge {shall be} the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.nlt_text: These four clans were responsible for the care of the Ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the various articles used in the sanctuary, the inner curtain, and all the equipment related to their use.

verses.kjv_text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest {shall be} chief over the chief of the Levites, {and have} the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.nlt_text: Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, was the chief administrator over all the Levites, with special responsibility for the oversight of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv_text: Of Merari {was} the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these {are} the families of Merari.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Merari were composed of the clans descended from Mahli and Mushi.

verses.kjv_text: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, {were} six thousand and two hundred.
verses.nlt_text: There were 6,200 males one month old or older among these Merarite clans.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari {was} Zuriel the son of Abihail: {these} shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.nlt_text: They were assigned the area north of the Tabernacle for their camp. The leader of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail.

verses.kjv_text: And {under} the custody and charge of the sons of Merari {shall be} the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto, {under...: Heb. the office of the charge}
verses.nlt_text: These two clans were responsible for the care of the frames supporting the Tabernacle, the crossbars, the pillars, the bases, and all the equipment related to their use.

verses.kjv_text: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.nlt_text: They were also responsible for the posts of the courtyard and all their bases, pegs, and ropes.

verses.kjv_text: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, {even} before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, {shall be} Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: The area in front of the Tabernacle, in the east toward the sunrise, was reserved for the tents of Moses and of Aaron and his sons, who had the final responsibility for the sanctuary on behalf of the people of Israel. Anyone other than a priest or Levite who went too near the sanctuary was to be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, {were} twenty and two thousand.
verses.nlt_text: When Moses and Aaron counted the Levite clans at the LORD's command, the total number was 22,000 males one month old or older.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Now count all the firstborn sons in Israel who are one month old or older, and make a list of their names.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I {am} the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: The Levites must be reserved for me as substitutes for the firstborn sons of Israel; I am the LORD. And the Levites' livestock must be reserved for me as substitutes for the firstborn livestock of the whole nation of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses counted the firstborn sons of the people of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.nlt_text: The number of firstborn sons who were one month old or older was 22,273.

verses.kjv_text: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Take the Levites as substitutes for the firstborn sons of the people of Israel. And take the livestock of the Levites as substitutes for the firstborn livestock of the people of Israel. The Levites belong to me; I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.nlt_text: There are 273 more firstborn sons of Israel than there are Levites. To redeem these extra firstborn sons,

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take {them}: (the shekel {is} twenty gerahs:)
verses.nlt_text: collect five pieces of silver for each of them (each piece weighing the same as the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs).

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.nlt_text: Give the silver to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the extra firstborn sons."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.nlt_text: So Moses collected the silver for redeeming the firstborn sons of Israel who exceeded the number of Levites.

verses.kjv_text: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five {shekels}, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.nlt_text: He collected 1,365 pieces of silver on behalf of these firstborn sons of Israel (each piece weighing the same as the sanctuary shekel).

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: And Moses gave the silver for the redemption to Aaron and his sons, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.kjv_text: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.nlt_text: "Record the names of the members of the clans and families of the Kohathite division of the tribe of Levi.

verses.kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: List all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who are eligible to serve in the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: This {shall be} the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, {about} the most holy things:
verses.nlt_text: "The duties of the Kohathites at the Tabernacle will relate to the most sacred objects.

verses.kjv_text: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.nlt_text: When the camp moves, Aaron and his sons must enter the Tabernacle first to take down the inner curtain and cover the Ark of the Covenant with it.

verses.kjv_text: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over {it} a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Then they must cover the inner curtain with fine goatskin leather and spread over that a single piece of blue cloth. Finally, they must put the carrying poles of the Ark in place.

verses.kjv_text: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon: {cover...: or, pour out withal}
verses.nlt_text: "Next they must spread a blue cloth over the table where the Bread of the Presence is displayed, and on the cloth they will place the bowls, pans, jars, pitchers, and the special bread.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.nlt_text: They must spread a scarlet cloth over all of this, and finally a covering of fine goatskin leather on top of the scarlet cloth. Then they must insert the carrying poles into the table.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.nlt_text: "Next they must cover the lampstand with a blue cloth, along with its lamps, lamp snuffers, trays, and special jars of olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put {it} upon a bar.
verses.nlt_text: Then they must cover the lampstand and its accessories with fine goatskin leather and place the bundle on a carrying frame.

verses.kjv_text: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.nlt_text: "Next they must spread a blue cloth over the gold incense altar and cover this cloth with fine goatskin leather. Then they must attach the carrying poles to the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put {them} in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put {them} on a bar:
verses.nlt_text: They must take all the remaining furnishings of the sanctuary and wrap them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine goatskin leather, and place them on the carrying frame.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.nlt_text: "They must remove the ashes from the altar for sacrifices and cover the altar with a purple cloth.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, {even} the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it. {basons: or, bowls}
verses.nlt_text: All the altar utensils-- the firepans, meat forks, shovels, basins, and all the containers-- must be placed on the cloth, and a covering of fine goatskin leather must be spread over them. Finally, they must put the carrying poles in place.

verses.kjv_text: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear {it}: but they shall not touch {any} holy thing, lest they die. These {things are} the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: The camp will be ready to move when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the sacred articles. The Kohathites will come and carry these things to the next destination. But they must not touch the sacred objects, or they will die. So these are the things from the Tabernacle that the Kohathites must carry.

verses.kjv_text: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest {pertaineth} the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, {and} the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein {is}, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be responsible for the oil of the lampstand, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. In fact, Eleazar will be responsible for the entire Tabernacle and everything in it, including the sanctuary and its furnishings."

verses.kjv_text: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.nlt_text: "Do not let the Kohathite clans be destroyed from among the Levites!

verses.kjv_text: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.nlt_text: This is what you must do so they will live and not die when they approach the most sacred objects. Aaron and his sons must always go in with them and assign a specific duty or load to each person.

verses.kjv_text: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.nlt_text: The Kohathites must never enter the sanctuary to look at the sacred objects for even a moment, or they will die."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.nlt_text: "Record the names of the members of the clans and families of the Gershonite division of the tribe of Levi.

verses.kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation. {to perform...: Heb. to war the warfare}
verses.nlt_text: List all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who are eligible to serve in the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens: {burdens: or, carriage}
verses.nlt_text: "These Gershonite clans will be responsible for general service and carrying loads.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that {is} above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.nlt_text: They must carry the curtains of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle itself with its coverings, the outer covering of fine goatskin leather, and the curtain for the Tabernacle entrance.

verses.kjv_text: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which {is} by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.nlt_text: They are also to carry the curtains for the courtyard walls that surround the Tabernacle and altar, the curtain across the courtyard entrance, the ropes, and all the equipment related to their use. The Gershonites are responsible for all these items.

verses.kjv_text: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens. {appointment: Heb. mouth}
verses.nlt_text: Aaron and his sons will direct the Gershonites regarding all their duties, whether it involves moving the equipment or doing other work. They must assign the Gershonites responsibility for the loads they are to carry.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge {shall be} under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.nlt_text: So these are the duties assigned to the Gershonite clans at the Tabernacle. They will be directly responsible to Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv_text: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.nlt_text: "Now record the names of the members of the clans and families of the Merarite division of the tribe of Levi.

verses.kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation. {service: Heb. warfare}
verses.nlt_text: List all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who are eligible to serve in the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.nlt_text: "Their only duty at the Tabernacle will be to carry loads. They will carry the frames of the Tabernacle, the crossbars, the posts, and the bases;

verses.kjv_text: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.nlt_text: also the posts for the courtyard walls with their bases, pegs, and ropes; and all the accessories and everything else related to their use. Assign the various loads to each man by name.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.nlt_text: So these are the duties of the Merarite clans at the Tabernacle. They are directly responsible to Ithamar son of Aaron the priest."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.nlt_text: So Moses, Aaron, and the other leaders of the community listed the members of the Kohathite division by their clans and families.

verses.kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: The list included all the men between thirty and fifty years of age who were eligible for service in the Tabernacle,

verses.kjv_text: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.nlt_text: and the total number came to 2,750.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.nlt_text: So this was the total of all those from the Kohathite clans who were eligible to serve at the Tabernacle. Moses and Aaron listed them, just as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.nlt_text: The Gershonite division was also listed by its clans and families.

verses.kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.nlt_text: The list included all the men between thirty and fifty years of age who were eligible for service in the Tabernacle,

verses.kjv_text: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.nlt_text: and the total number came to 2,630.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So this was the total of all those from the Gershonite clans who were eligible to serve at the Tabernacle. Moses and Aaron listed them, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.nlt_text: The Merarite division was also listed by its clans and families.

verses.kjv_text: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.nlt_text: and the total number came to 3,200.

verses.kjv_text: These {be} those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.nlt_text: So this was the total of all those from the Merarite clans who were eligible for service. Moses and Aaron listed them, just as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv_text: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.nlt_text: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel listed all the Levites by their clans and families.

verses.kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.nlt_text: All the men between thirty and fifty years of age who were eligible for service in the Tabernacle and for its transportation

verses.kjv_text: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.nlt_text: numbered 8,580.

verses.kjv_text: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: When their names were recorded, as the LORD had commanded through Moses, each man was assigned his task and told what to carry.And so the registration was completed, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD gave these instructions to Moses:

verses.kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.nlt_text: "Command the people of Israel to remove from the camp anyone who has a skin disease or a discharge, or who has become ceremonially unclean by touching a dead person.

verses.kjv_text: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.nlt_text: This command applies to men and women alike. Remove them so they will not defile the camp in which I live among them."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses and removed such people from the camp.

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel: If any of the people-- men or women-- betray the LORD by doing wrong to another person, they are guilty.

verses.kjv_text: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth {part} thereof, and give {it} unto {him} against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.nlt_text: They must confess their sin and make full restitution for what they have done, adding an additional 20 percent and returning it to the person who was wronged.

verses.kjv_text: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, {even} to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.nlt_text: But if the person who was wronged is dead, and there are no near relatives to whom restitution can be made, the payment belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest. Those who are guilty must also bring a ram as a sacrifice, and they will be purified and made right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his. {offering: or, heave offering}
verses.nlt_text: All the sacred offerings that the Israelites bring to a priest will belong to him.

verses.kjv_text: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.nlt_text: Each priest may keep all the sacred donations that he receives."

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel."Suppose a man's wife goes astray, and she is unfaithful to her husband

verses.kjv_text: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and {there be} no witness against her, neither she be taken {with the manner};
verses.nlt_text: and has sex with another man, but neither her husband nor anyone else knows about it. She has defiled herself, even though there was no witness and she was not caught in the act.

verses.kjv_text: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.nlt_text: If her husband becomes jealous and is suspicious of his wife and needs to know whether or not she has defiled herself,

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth {part} of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it {is} an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.nlt_text: the husband must bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring an offering of two quarts of barley flour to be presented on her behalf. Do not mix it with olive oil or frankincense, for it is a jealousy offering-- an offering to prove whether or not she is guilty.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: "The priest will then present her to stand trial before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put {it} into the water:
verses.nlt_text: He must take some holy water in a clay jar and pour into it dust he has taken from the Tabernacle floor.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which {is} the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.nlt_text: When the priest has presented the woman before the LORD, he must unbind her hair and place in her hands the offering of proof-- the jealousy offering to determine whether her husband's suspicions are justified. The priest will stand before her, holding the jar of bitter water that brings a curse to those who are guilty.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness {with another} instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse: {with another...: or, being in the power of thy husband: Heb. under thy husband}
verses.nlt_text: The priest will then put the woman under oath and say to her, 'If no other man has had sex with you, and you have not gone astray and defiled yourself while under your husband's authority, may you be immune from the effects of this bitter water that brings on the curse.

verses.kjv_text: But if thou hast gone aside {to another} instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.nlt_text: But if you have gone astray by being unfaithful to your husband, and have defiled yourself by having sex with another man--'

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell; {rot: Heb. fall}
verses.nlt_text: "At this point the priest must put the woman under oath by saying, 'May the people know that the LORD's curse is upon you when he makes you infertile, causing your womb to shrivel and your abdomen to swell.

verses.kjv_text: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make {thy} belly to swell, and {thy} thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.nlt_text: Now may this water that brings the curse enter your body and cause your abdomen to swell and your womb to shrivel. ' And the woman will be required to say, 'Yes, let it be so.'

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot {them} out with the bitter water:
verses.nlt_text: And the priest will write these curses on a piece of leather and wash them off into the bitter water.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, {and become} bitter.
verses.nlt_text: He will make the woman drink the bitter water that brings on the curse. When the water enters her body, it will cause bitter suffering if she is guilty.

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.nlt_text: "The priest will take the jealousy offering from the woman's hand, lift it up before the LORD, and carry it to the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, {even} the memorial thereof, and burn {it} upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.nlt_text: He will take a handful of the flour as a token portion and burn it on the altar, and he will require the woman to drink the water.

verses.kjv_text: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, {that}, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, {and become} bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.nlt_text: If she has defiled herself by being unfaithful to her husband, the water that brings on the curse will cause bitter suffering. Her abdomen will swell and her womb will shrink, and her name will become a curse among her people.

verses.kjv_text: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.nlt_text: But if she has not defiled herself and is pure, then she will be unharmed and will still be able to have children.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside {to another} instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.nlt_text: "This is the ritual law for dealing with suspicion. If a woman goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband's authority,

verses.kjv_text: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.nlt_text: or if a man becomes jealous and is suspicious that his wife has been unfaithful, the husband must present his wife before the LORD, and the priest will apply this entire ritual law to her.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: The husband will be innocent of any guilt in this matter, but his wife will be held accountable for her sin."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate {themselves} to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate {themselves} unto the LORD: {to separate...: or, to make themselves Nazarites}
verses.nlt_text: "If any of the people, either men or women, take the special vow of a Nazirite, setting themselves apart to the LORD in a special way,

verses.kjv_text: He shall separate {himself} from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.nlt_text: they must give up wine and other alcoholic drinks. They must not use vinegar made from wine or from other alcoholic drinks, they must not drink fresh grape juice, and they must not eat grapes or raisins.

verses.kjv_text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk. {separation: or, Nazariteship} {vine...: Heb. vine of the wine}
verses.nlt_text: As long as they are bound by their Nazirite vow, they are not allowed to eat or drink anything that comes from a grapevine-- not even the grape seeds or skins.

verses.kjv_text: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth {himself} unto the LORD, he shall be holy, {and} shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.nlt_text: "They must never cut their hair throughout the time of their vow, for they are holy and set apart to the LORD. Until the time of their vow has been fulfilled, they must let their hair grow long.

verses.kjv_text: All the days that he separateth {himself} unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
verses.nlt_text: And they must not go near a dead body during the entire period of their vow to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God {is} upon his head. {consecration: Heb. separation}
verses.nlt_text: Even if the dead person is their own father, mother, brother, or sister, they must not defile themselves, for the hair on their head is the symbol of their separation to God.

verses.kjv_text: All the days of his separation he {is} holy unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: This requirement applies as long as they are set apart to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.nlt_text: "If someone falls dead beside them, the hair they have dedicated will be defiled. They must wait for seven days and then shave their heads. Then they will be cleansed from their defilement.

verses.kjv_text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: On the eighth day they must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.nlt_text: The priest will offer one of the birds for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way, he will purify them from the guilt they incurred through contact with the dead body. Then they must reaffirm their commitment and let their hair begin to grow again.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled. {be lost: Heb. fall}
verses.nlt_text: The days of their vow that were completed before their defilement no longer count. They must rededicate themselves to the LORD as a Nazirite for the full term of their vow, and each must bring a one-year-old male lamb for a guilt offering.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: "This is the ritual law for Nazirites. At the conclusion of their time of separation as Nazirites, they must each go to the entrance of the Tabernacle

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
verses.nlt_text: and offer their sacrifices to the LORD: a one-year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a one-year-old female lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a peace offering,

verses.kjv_text: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.nlt_text: a basket of bread made without yeast-- cakes of choice flour mixed with olive oil and wafers spread with olive oil-- along with their prescribed grain offerings and liquid offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall bring {them} before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
verses.nlt_text: The priest will present these offerings before the LORD: first the sin offering and the burnt offering;

verses.kjv_text: And he shall offer the ram {for} a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: then the ram for a peace offering, along with the basket of bread made without yeast. The priest must also present the prescribed grain offering and liquid offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put {it} in the fire which {is} under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.nlt_text: "Then the Nazirites will shave their heads at the entrance of the Tabernacle. They will take the hair that had been dedicated and place it on the fire beneath the peace-offering sacrifice.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put {them} upon the hands of the Nazarite, after {the hair of} his separation is shaven:
verses.nlt_text: After the Nazirite's head has been shaved, the priest will take for each of them the boiled shoulder of the ram, and he will take from the basket a cake and a wafer made without yeast. He will put them all into the Nazirite's hands.

verses.kjv_text: And the priest shall wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD: this {is} holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priest will lift them up as a special offering before the LORD. These are holy portions for the priest, along with the breast of the special offering and the thigh of the sacred offering that are lifted up before the LORD. After this ceremony the Nazirites may again drink wine.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, {and of} his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside {that} that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
verses.nlt_text: "This is the ritual law of the Nazirites, who vow to bring these offerings to the LORD. They may also bring additional offerings if they can afford it. And they must be careful to do whatever they vowed when they set themselves apart as Nazirites."

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
verses.nlt_text: "Tell Aaron and his sons to bless the people of Israel with this special blessing:

verses.kjv_text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.nlt_text: 'May the LORD bless you and protect you.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.nlt_text: May the LORD smile on you and be gracious to you.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.nlt_text: May the LORD show you his favor and give you his peace.'

verses.kjv_text: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
