verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.nlt_text: "Stay here overnight," Balaam said. "In the morning I will tell you whatever the LORD directs me to say." So the officials from Moab stayed there with Balaam.

verses.kjv_text: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men {are} these with thee?
verses.nlt_text: That night God came to Balaam and asked him, "Who are these men visiting you?"

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, {saying},
verses.nlt_text: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent me this message:

verses.kjv_text: Behold, {there is} a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out. {I shall...: Heb. I shall prevail in fighting against him}
verses.nlt_text: 'Look, a vast horde of people has arrived from Egypt, and they cover the face of the earth. Come and curse these people for me. Then perhaps I will be able to stand up to them and drive them from the land.'"

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they {are} blessed.
verses.nlt_text: But God told Balaam, "Do not go with them. You are not to curse these people, for they have been blessed!"

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.nlt_text: The next morning Balaam got up and told Balak's officials, "Go on home! The LORD will not let me go with you."

verses.kjv_text: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.nlt_text: So the Moabite officials returned to King Balak and reported, "Balaam refused to come with us."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.nlt_text: Then Balak tried again. This time he sent a larger number of even more distinguished officials than those he had sent the first time.

verses.kjv_text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me: {Let...: Heb. Be not thou hindered from, etc}
verses.nlt_text: They went to Balaam and delivered this message to him: "This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Please don't let anything stop you from coming to help me.

verses.kjv_text: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.nlt_text: I will pay you very well and do whatever you tell me. Just come and curse these people for me!"

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
verses.nlt_text: But Balaam responded to Balak's messengers, "Even if Balak were to give me his palace filled with silver and gold, I would be powerless to do anything against the will of the LORD my God.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
verses.nlt_text: But stay here one more night, and I will see if the LORD has anything else to say to me."

verses.kjv_text: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, {and} go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.nlt_text: That night God came to Balaam and told him, "Since these men have come for you, get up and go with them. But do only what I tell you to do."

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.nlt_text: So the next morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and started off with the Moabite officials.

verses.kjv_text: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants {were} with him.
verses.nlt_text: But God was angry that Balaam was going, so he sent the angel of the LORD to stand in the road to block his way. As Balaam and two servants were riding along,

verses.kjv_text: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.nlt_text: Balaam's donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. The donkey bolted off the road into a field, but Balaam beat it and turned it back onto the road.

verses.kjv_text: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall {being} on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angel of the LORD stood at a place where the road narrowed between two vineyard walls.

verses.kjv_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.nlt_text: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, it tried to squeeze by and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall. So Balaam beat the donkey again.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where {was} no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angel of the LORD moved farther down the road and stood in a place too narrow for the donkey to get by at all.

verses.kjv_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.nlt_text: This time when the donkey saw the angel, it lay down under Balaam. In a fit of rage Balaam beat the animal again with his staff.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD gave the donkey the ability to speak. "What have I done to you that deserves your beating me three times?" it asked Balaam.

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.nlt_text: "You have made me look like a fool!" Balaam shouted. "If I had a sword with me, I would kill you!"

verses.kjv_text: And the ass said unto Balaam, {Am} not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since {I was} thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay. {upon...: Heb. who hast ridden upon me} {ever since...: or, ever since thou wast, etc}
verses.nlt_text: "But I am the same donkey you have ridden all your life," the donkey answered. "Have I ever done anything like this before?" "No," Balaam admitted.

verses.kjv_text: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face. {fell...: or, bowed himself}
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD opened Balaam's eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the roadway with a drawn sword in his hand. Balaam bowed his head and fell face down on the ground before him.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because {thy} way is perverse before me: {to...: Heb. to be an adversary unto thee}
verses.nlt_text: "Why did you beat your donkey those three times?" the angel of the LORD demanded. "Look, I have come to block your way because you are stubbornly resisting me.

verses.kjv_text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.nlt_text: Three times the donkey saw me and shied away; otherwise, I would certainly have killed you by now and spared the donkey."

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again. {displease...: Heb. be evil in thine eyes}
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam confessed to the angel of the LORD, "I have sinned. I didn't realize you were standing in the road to block my way. I will return home if you are against my going."

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.nlt_text: But the angel of the LORD told Balaam, "Go with these men, but say only what I tell you to say." So Balaam went on with Balak's officials.

verses.kjv_text: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which {is} in the border of Arnon, which {is} in the utmost coast.
verses.nlt_text: When King Balak heard that Balaam was on the way, he went out to meet him at a Moabite town on the Arnon River at the farthest border of his land.

verses.kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.nlt_text: "Didn't I send you an urgent invitation? Why didn't you come right away?" Balak asked Balaam. "Didn't you believe me when I said I would reward you richly?"

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.nlt_text: Balaam replied, "Look, now I have come, but I have no power to say whatever I want. I will speak only the message that God puts in my mouth."

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth. {Kirjathhuzoth: or, a city of streets}
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam accompanied Balak to Kiriath-huzoth,

verses.kjv_text: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that {were} with him.
verses.nlt_text: where the king sacrificed cattle and sheep. He sent portions of the meat to Balaam and the officials who were with him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost {part} of the people.
verses.nlt_text: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth-baal. From there he could see some of the people of Israel spread out below him.

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam said to King Balak, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven young bulls and seven rams for me to sacrifice."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on {every} altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.nlt_text: Balak followed his instructions, and the two of them sacrificed a young bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place. {to an...: or, solitary}
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stand here by your burnt offerings, and I will go to see if the LORD will respond to me. Then I will tell you whatever he reveals to me." So Balaam went alone to the top of a bare hill,

verses.kjv_text: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon {every} altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.nlt_text: and God met him there. Balaam said to him, "I have prepared seven altars and have sacrificed a young bull and a ram on each altar."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD gave Balaam a message for King Balak. Then he said, "Go back to Balak and give him my message."

verses.kjv_text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.nlt_text: So Balaam returned and found the king standing beside his burnt offerings with all the officials of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, {saying}, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.nlt_text: This was the message Balaam delivered: "Balak summoned me to come from Aram; the king of Moab brought me from the eastern hills. 'Come,' he said, 'curse Jacob for me! Come and announce Israel's doom.'

verses.kjv_text: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, {whom} the LORD hath not defied?
verses.nlt_text: But how can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I condemn those whom the LORD has not condemned?

verses.kjv_text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.nlt_text: I see them from the cliff tops; I watch them from the hills. I see a people who live by themselves, set apart from other nations.

verses.kjv_text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth {part} of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his! {me: Heb. my soul, or, my life}
verses.nlt_text: Who can count Jacob's descendants, as numerous as dust? Who can count even a fourth of Israel's people? Let me die like the righteous; let my life end like theirs."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed {them} altogether.
verses.nlt_text: Then King Balak demanded of Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies. Instead, you have blessed them!"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
verses.nlt_text: But Balaam replied, "I will speak only the message that the LORD puts in my mouth."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.nlt_text: Then King Balak told him, "Come with me to another place. There you will see another part of the nation of Israel, but not all of them. Curse at least that many!"

verses.kjv_text: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on {every} altar. {Pisgah: or, the hill}
verses.nlt_text: So Balak took Balaam to the plateau of Zophim on Pisgah Peak. He built seven altars there and offered a young bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet {the LORD} yonder.
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam said to the king, "Stand here by your burnt offerings while I go over there to meet the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD met Balaam and gave him a message. Then he said, "Go back to Balak and give him my message."

verses.kjv_text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.nlt_text: So Balaam returned and found the king standing beside his burnt offerings with all the officials of Moab. "What did the LORD say?" Balak asked eagerly.

verses.kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.nlt_text: This was the message Balaam delivered: "Rise up, Balak, and listen! Hear me, son of Zippor.

verses.kjv_text: God {is} not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do {it}? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.nlt_text: God is not a man, so he does not lie. He is not human, so he does not change his mind. Has he ever spoken and failed to act? Has he ever promised and not carried it through?

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I have received {commandment} to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.nlt_text: Listen, I received a command to bless; God has blessed, and I cannot reverse it!

verses.kjv_text: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God {is} with him, and the shout of a king {is} among them.
verses.nlt_text: No misfortune is in his plan for Jacob; no trouble is in store for Israel. For the LORD their God is with them; he has been proclaimed their king.

verses.kjv_text: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.nlt_text: God brought them out of Egypt; for them he is as strong as a wild ox.

verses.kjv_text: Surely {there is} no enchantment against Jacob, neither {is there} any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought! {against: or, in}
verses.nlt_text: No curse can touch Jacob; no magic has any power against Israel. For now it will be said of Jacob, 'What wonders God has done for Israel!'

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat {of} the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.nlt_text: These people rise up like a lioness, like a majestic lion rousing itself. They refuse to rest until they have feasted on prey, drinking the blood of the slaughtered!"

verses.kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.nlt_text: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Fine, but if you won't curse them, at least don't bless them!"

verses.kjv_text: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
verses.nlt_text: But Balaam replied to Balak, "Didn't I tell you that I can do only what the LORD tells me?"

verses.kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.nlt_text: Then King Balak said to Balaam, "Come, I will take you to one more place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them from there."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.nlt_text: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Mount Peor, overlooking the wasteland.

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.nlt_text: Balaam again told Balak, "Build me seven altars, and prepare seven young bulls and seven rams for me to sacrifice."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on {every} altar.
verses.nlt_text: So Balak did as Balaam ordered and offered a young bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.kjv_text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness. {to seek...: Heb. to the meeting of}
verses.nlt_text: By now Balaam realized that the LORD was determined to bless Israel, so he did not resort to divination as before. Instead, he turned and looked out toward the wilderness,

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding {in his tents} according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.nlt_text: where he saw the people of Israel camped, tribe by tribe. Then the Spirit of God came upon him,

verses.kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said: {whose...: Heb. who had his eyes shut, but now opened}
verses.nlt_text: and this is the message he delivered: "This is the message of Balaam son of Beor, the message of the man whose eyes see clearly,

verses.kjv_text: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling {into a trance}, but having his eyes open:
verses.nlt_text: the message of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:

verses.kjv_text: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, {and} thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.nlt_text: How beautiful are your tents, O Jacob; how lovely are your homes, O Israel!

verses.kjv_text: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, {and} as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.nlt_text: They spread before me like palm groves, like gardens by the riverside. They are like tall trees planted by the LORD, like cedars beside the waters.

verses.kjv_text: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed {shall be} in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.nlt_text: Water will flow from their buckets; their offspring have all they need. Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.

verses.kjv_text: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce {them} through with his arrows.
verses.nlt_text: God brought them out of Egypt; for them he is as strong as a wild ox. He devours all the nations that oppose him, breaking their bones in pieces, shooting them with arrows.

verses.kjv_text: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed {is} he that blesseth thee, and cursed {is} he that curseth thee.
verses.nlt_text: Like a lion, Israel crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to arouse her? Blessed is everyone who blesses you, O Israel, and cursed is everyone who curses you."

verses.kjv_text: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed {them} these three times.
verses.nlt_text: King Balak flew into a rage against Balaam. He angrily clapped his hands and shouted, "I called you to curse my enemies! Instead, you have blessed them three times.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.nlt_text: Now get out of here! Go back home! I promised to reward you richly, but the LORD has kept you from your reward."

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Balaam told Balak, "Don't you remember what I told your messengers? I said,

verses.kjv_text: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do {either} good or bad of mine own mind; {but} what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
verses.nlt_text: 'Even if Balak were to give me his palace filled with silver and gold, I would be powerless to do anything against the will of the LORD.' I told you that I could say only what the LORD says!

verses.kjv_text: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come {therefore, and} I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.nlt_text: Now I am returning to my own people. But first let me tell you what the Israelites will do to your people in the future."

verses.kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.nlt_text: This is the message Balaam delivered: "This is the message of Balaam son of Beor, the message of the man whose eyes see clearly,

verses.kjv_text: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, {which} saw the vision of the Almighty, falling {into a trance}, but having his eyes open:
verses.nlt_text: the message of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:

verses.kjv_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth. {smite...: or, smite through the princes of}
verses.nlt_text: I see him, but not here and now. I perceive him, but far in the distant future. A star will rise from Jacob; a scepter will emerge from Israel. It will crush the foreheads of Moab's people, cracking the skulls of the people of Sheth.

verses.kjv_text: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.nlt_text: Edom will be taken over, and Seir, its enemy, will be conquered, while Israel marches on in triumph.

verses.kjv_text: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.nlt_text: A ruler will rise in Jacob who will destroy the survivors of Ir."

verses.kjv_text: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek {was} the first of the nations; but his latter end {shall be} that he perish for ever. {the nations: the nations that warred against Israel} {that...: or, even to destruction}
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam looked over toward the people of Amalek and delivered this message: "Amalek was the greatest of nations, but its destiny is destruction!"

verses.kjv_text: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.nlt_text: Then he looked over toward the Kenites and delivered this message: "Your home is secure; your nest is set in the rocks.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive. {the Kenite: Heb. Kain} {until...: or, how long shall it be ere Asshur carry thee away captive}
verses.nlt_text: But the Kenites will be destroyed when Assyria takes you captive."

verses.kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.nlt_text: Balaam concluded his messages by saying: "Alas, who can survive unless God has willed it?

verses.kjv_text: And ships {shall come} from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus; they will oppress Assyria and afflict Eber, but they, too, will be utterly destroyed."

verses.kjv_text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.nlt_text: Then Balaam and Balak returned to their homes.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.nlt_text: While the Israelites were camped at Acacia Grove, some of the men defiled themselves by having sexual relations with local Moabite women.

verses.kjv_text: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.nlt_text: These women invited them to attend sacrifices to their gods, so the Israelites feasted with them and worshiped the gods of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
verses.nlt_text: In this way, Israel joined in the worship of Baal of Peor, causing the LORD's anger to blaze against his people.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD issued the following command to Moses: "Seize all the ringleaders and execute them before the LORD in broad daylight, so his fierce anger will turn away from the people of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses ordered Israel's judges, "Each of you must put to death the men under your authority who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor."

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who {were} weeping {before} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Just then one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman into his tent, right before the eyes of Moses and all the people, as everyone was weeping at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw {it}, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.nlt_text: When Phinehas son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest saw this, he jumped up and left the assembly. He took a spear

verses.kjv_text: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: and rushed after the man into his tent. Phinehas thrust the spear all the way through the man's body and into the woman's stomach. So the plague against the Israelites was stopped,

verses.kjv_text: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.nlt_text: but not before 24,000 people had died.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy. {for...: Heb. with my zeal}
verses.nlt_text: "Phinehas son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest has turned my anger away from the Israelites by being as zealous among them as I was. So I stopped destroying all Israel as I had intended to do in my zealous anger.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.nlt_text: Now tell him that I am making my special covenant of peace with him.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, {even} the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: In this covenant, I give him and his descendants a permanent right to the priesthood, for in his zeal for me, his God, he purified the people of Israel, making them right with me. "

verses.kjv_text: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, {even} that was slain with the Midianitish woman, {was} Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites. {chief...: Heb. house of a father}
verses.nlt_text: The Israelite man killed with the Midianite woman was named Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a family from the tribe of Simeon.

verses.kjv_text: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain {was} Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he {was} head over a people, {and} of a chief house in Midian.
verses.nlt_text: The woman's name was Cozbi; she was the daughter of Zur, the leader of a Midianite clan.

verses.kjv_text: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.nlt_text: "Attack the Midianites and destroy them,

verses.kjv_text: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
verses.nlt_text: because they assaulted you with deceit and tricked you into worshiping Baal of Peor, and because of Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, who was killed at the time of the plague because of what happened at Peor."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.nlt_text: After the plague had ended, the LORD said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,

verses.kjv_text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "From the whole community of Israel, record the names of all the warriors by their families. List all the men twenty years old or older who are able to go to war."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho, saying,
verses.nlt_text: So there on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued these instructions to the leaders of Israel:

verses.kjv_text: {Take the sum of the people}, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: "List all the men of Israel twenty years old and older, just as the LORD commanded Moses." This is the record of all the descendants of Israel who came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, {of whom cometh} the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Reuben, Jacob's oldest son: The Hanochite clan, named after their ancestor Hanoch. The Palluite clan, named after their ancestor Pallu.

verses.kjv_text: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.nlt_text: The Hezronite clan, named after their ancestor Hezron. The Carmite clan, named after their ancestor Carmi.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Reuben. Their registered troops numbered 43,730.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.nlt_text: Pallu was the ancestor of Eliab,

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This {is that} Dathan and Abiram, {which were} famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: and Eliab was the father of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. This Dathan and Abiram are the same community leaders who conspired with Korah against Moses and Aaron, rebelling against the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.nlt_text: But the earth opened up its mouth and swallowed them with Korah, and fire devoured 250 of their followers. This served as a warning to the entire nation of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
verses.nlt_text: However, the sons of Korah did not die that day.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites: {Nemuel: also called, Jemuel} {Jachin: also called, Jarib}
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Simeon: The Jemuelite clan, named after their ancestor Jemuel. The Jaminite clan, named after their ancestor Jamin. The Jakinite clan, named after their ancestor Jakin.

verses.kjv_text: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites. {Zerah: also called, Zohar}
verses.nlt_text: The Zoharite clan, named after their ancestor Zohar. The Shaulite clan, named after their ancestor Shaul.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Simeon. Their registered troops numbered 22,200.

verses.kjv_text: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites: {Zephon: also called, Ziphion}
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Gad: The Zephonite clan, named after their ancestor Zephon. The Haggite clan, named after their ancestor Haggi. The Shunite clan, named after their ancestor Shuni.

verses.kjv_text: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites: {Ozni: also called, Ezbon}
verses.nlt_text: The Oznite clan, named after their ancestor Ozni. The Erite clan, named after their ancestor Eri.

verses.kjv_text: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites. {Arod: also called, Arodi}
verses.nlt_text: The Arodite clan, named after their ancestor Arodi. The Arelite clan, named after their ancestor Areli.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Gad. Their registered troops numbered 40,500.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Judah {were} Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: Judah had two sons, Er and Onan, who had died in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from Judah's surviving sons: The Shelanite clan, named after their ancestor Shelah. The Perezite clan, named after their ancestor Perez. The Zerahite clan, named after their ancestor Zerah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.nlt_text: These were the subclans descended from the Perezites: The Hezronites, named after their ancestor Hezron. The Hamulites, named after their ancestor Hamul.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Judah. Their registered troops numbered 76,500.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} the sons of Issachar after their families: {of} Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites: {Pua: or, Phuvah}
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Issachar: The Tolaite clan, named after their ancestor Tola. The Puite clan, named after their ancestor Puah.

verses.kjv_text: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites. {Jashub: or, Job}
verses.nlt_text: The Jashubite clan, named after their ancestor Jashub. The Shimronite clan, named after their ancestor Shimron.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Issachar. Their registered troops numbered 64,300.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Zebulun: The Seredite clan, named after their ancestor Sered. The Elonite clan, named after their ancestor Elon. The Jahleelite clan, named after their ancestor Jahleel.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Zebulun. Their registered troops numbered 60,500.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Joseph after their families {were} Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.nlt_text: Two clans were descended from Joseph through Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead {come} the family of the Gileadites.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from Manasseh: The Makirite clan, named after their ancestor Makir. The Gileadite clan, named after their ancestor Gilead, Makir's son.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Gilead: {of} Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites: {Jeezer: also called Abiezer}
verses.nlt_text: These were the subclans descended from the Gileadites: The Iezerites, named after their ancestor Iezer. The Helekites, named after their ancestor Helek.

verses.kjv_text: And {of} Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and {of} Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
verses.nlt_text: The Asrielites, named after their ancestor Asriel. The Shechemites, named after their ancestor Shechem.

verses.kjv_text: And {of} Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and {of} Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.nlt_text: The Shemidaites, named after their ancestor Shemida. The Hepherites, named after their ancestor Hepher.

verses.kjv_text: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad {were} Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.nlt_text: (One of Hepher's descendants, Zelophehad, had no sons, but his daughters' names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.)

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Manasseh. Their registered troops numbered 52,700.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites. {Becher: also called, Bered}
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Ephraim: The Shuthelahite clan, named after their ancestor Shuthelah. The Bekerite clan, named after their ancestor Beker. The Tahanite clan, named after their ancestor Tahan.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.nlt_text: This was the subclan descended from the Shuthelahites: The Eranites, named after their ancestor Eran.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These {are} the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Ephraim. Their registered troops numbered 32,500. These clans of Manasseh and Ephraim were all descendants of Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites: {Ahiram: also called, Ehi, or, Aharah}
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Benjamin: The Belaite clan, named after their ancestor Bela. The Ashbelite clan, named after their ancestor Ashbel. The Ahiramite clan, named after their ancestor Ahiram.

verses.kjv_text: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites. {Shupham...Hupham: also called, Muppim and Huppim}
verses.nlt_text: The Shuphamite clan, named after their ancestor Shupham. The Huphamite clan, named after their ancestor Hupham.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: {of Ard}, the family of the Ardites: {and} of Naaman, the family of the Naamites. {Ard: also called, Addar}
verses.nlt_text: These were the subclans descended from the Belaites: The Ardites, named after their ancestor Ard. The Naamites, named after their ancestor Naaman.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them {were} forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Benjamin. Their registered troops numbered 45,600.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These {are} the families of Dan after their families. {Shuham: or, Hushim}
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Dan: The Shuhamite clan, named after their ancestor Shuham.

verses.kjv_text: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, {were} threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the Shuhamite clans of Dan. Their registered troops numbered 64,400.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Asher: The Imnite clan, named after their ancestor Imnah. The Ishvite clan, named after their ancestor Ishvi. The Beriite clan, named after their ancestor Beriah.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.nlt_text: These were the subclans descended from the Beriites: The Heberites, named after their ancestor Heber. The Malkielites, named after their ancestor Malkiel.

verses.kjv_text: And the name of the daughter of Asher {was} Sarah.
verses.nlt_text: Asher also had a daughter named Serah.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; {who were} fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Asher. Their registered troops numbered 53,400.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans descended from the sons of Naphtali: The Jahzeelite clan, named after their ancestor Jahzeel. The Gunite clan, named after their ancestor Guni.

verses.kjv_text: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites. {Shillem: also called, Shallum}
verses.nlt_text: The Jezerite clan, named after their ancestor Jezer. The Shillemite clan, named after their ancestor Shillem.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them {were} forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.nlt_text: These were the clans of Naphtali. Their registered troops numbered 45,400.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.nlt_text: In summary, the registered troops of all Israel numbered 601,730.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.nlt_text: "Divide the land among the tribes, and distribute the grants of land in proportion to the tribes' populations, as indicated by the number of names on the list.

verses.kjv_text: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him. {give the more...: Heb. multiply his inheritance} {give the less...: Heb. diminish his inheritance}
verses.nlt_text: Give the larger tribes more land and the smaller tribes less land, each group receiving a grant in proportion to the size of its population.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.nlt_text: But you must assign the land by lot, and give land to each ancestral tribe according to the number of names on the list.

verses.kjv_text: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.nlt_text: Each grant of land must be assigned by lot among the larger and smaller tribal groups."

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.nlt_text: This is the record of the Levites who were counted according to their clans: The Gershonite clan, named after their ancestor Gershon. The Kohathite clan, named after their ancestor Kohath. The Merarite clan, named after their ancestor Merari.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.nlt_text: The Libnites, the Hebronites, the Mahlites, the Mushites, and the Korahites were all subclans of the Levites.Now Kohath was the ancestor of Amram,

verses.kjv_text: And the name of Amram's wife {was} Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom {her mother} bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.nlt_text: and Amram's wife was named Jochebed. She also was a descendant of Levi, born among the Levites in the land of Egypt. Amram and Jochebed became the parents of Aaron, Moses, and their sister, Miriam.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.nlt_text: To Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv_text: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But Nadab and Abihu died when they burned before the LORD the wrong kind of fire, different than he had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: The men from the Levite clans who were one month old or older numbered 23,000. But the Levites were not included in the registration of the rest of the people of Israel because they were not given an allotment of land when it was divided among the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho.
verses.nlt_text: So these are the results of the registration of the people of Israel as conducted by Moses and Eleazar the priest on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.

verses.kjv_text: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.nlt_text: Not one person on this list had been among those listed in the previous registration taken by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD had said of them, "They will all die in the wilderness." Not one of them survived except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these {are} the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.nlt_text: One day a petition was presented by the daughters of Zelophehad-- Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. Their father, Zelophehad, was a descendant of Hepher son of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, son of Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, {by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.nlt_text: These women stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the tribal leaders, and the entire community at the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.nlt_text: "Our father died in the wilderness," they said. "He was not among Korah's followers, who rebelled against the LORD; he died because of his own sin. But he had no sons.

verses.kjv_text: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us {therefore} a possession among the brethren of our father. {done...: Heb. diminished}
verses.nlt_text: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan just because he had no sons? Give us property along with the rest of our relatives."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses brought their case before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD replied to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.nlt_text: "The claim of the daughters of Zelophehad is legitimate. You must give them a grant of land along with their father's relatives. Assign them the property that would have been given to their father.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.nlt_text: "And give the following instructions to the people of Israel: If a man dies and has no son, then give his inheritance to his daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: And if he has no daughter either, transfer his inheritance to his brothers.

verses.kjv_text: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
verses.nlt_text: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

verses.kjv_text: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: But if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan. This is a legal requirement for the people of Israel, just as the LORD commanded Moses."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: One day the LORD said to Moses, "Climb one of the mountains east of the river, and look out over the land I have given the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.nlt_text: After you have seen it, you will die like your brother, Aaron,

verses.kjv_text: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that {is} the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.nlt_text: for you both rebelled against my instructions in the wilderness of Zin. When the people of Israel rebelled, you failed to demonstrate my holiness to them at the waters." (These are the waters of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

verses.kjv_text: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses said to the LORD,

verses.kjv_text: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.nlt_text: "O LORD, you are the God who gives breath to all creatures. Please appoint a new man as leader for the community.

verses.kjv_text: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.nlt_text: Give them someone who will guide them wherever they go and will lead them into battle, so the community of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom {is} the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replied, "Take Joshua son of Nun, who has the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.

verses.kjv_text: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.nlt_text: Present him to Eleazar the priest before the whole community, and publicly commission him to lead the people.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt put {some} of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.nlt_text: Transfer some of your authority to him so the whole community of Israel will obey him.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask {counsel} for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, {both} he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: When direction from the LORD is needed, Joshua will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will use the Urim-- one of the sacred lots cast before the LORD-- to determine his will. This is how Joshua and the rest of the community of Israel will determine everything they should do."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: So Moses did as the LORD commanded. He presented Joshua to Eleazar the priest and the whole community.

verses.kjv_text: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Moses laid his hands on him and commissioned him to lead the people, just as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, {and} my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, {for} a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season. {a sweet...: Heb. a savour of my rest}
verses.nlt_text: "Give these instructions to the people of Israel: The offerings you present as special gifts are a pleasing aroma to me; they are my food. See to it that they are brought at the appointed times and offered according to my instructions.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt say unto them, This {is} the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, {for} a continual burnt offering. {day by day: Heb. in a day}
verses.nlt_text: "Say to the people: This is the special gift you must present to the LORD as your daily burnt offering. You must offer two one-year-old male lambs with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even; {at even: Heb. between the two evenings}
verses.nlt_text: Sacrifice one lamb in the morning and the other in the evening.

verses.kjv_text: And a tenth {part} of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth {part} of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.nlt_text: With each lamb you must offer a grain offering of two quarts of choice flour mixed with one quart of pure oil of pressed olives.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the drink offering thereof {shall be} the fourth {part} of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy {place} shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD {for} a drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: Along with it you must present the proper liquid offering of one quart of alcoholic drink with each lamb, poured out in the Holy Place as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer {it}, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Offer the second lamb in the evening with the same grain offering and liquid offering. It, too, is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour {for} a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.nlt_text: "On the Sabbath day, sacrifice two one-year-old male lambs with no defects. They must be accompanied by a grain offering of four quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil, and a liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: {This is} the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: This is the burnt offering to be presented each Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.nlt_text: "On the first day of each month, present an extra burnt offering to the LORD of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And three tenth deals of flour {for} a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour {for} a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.nlt_text: These must be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil-- six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,

verses.kjv_text: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil {for} a meat offering unto one lamb; {for} a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: and two quarts with each lamb. This burnt offering will be a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third {part} of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth {part} of an hin unto a lamb: this {is} the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.nlt_text: You must also present a liquid offering with each sacrifice: two quarts of wine for each bull, a third of a gallon for the ram, and one quart for each lamb. Present this monthly burnt offering on the first day of each month throughout the year.

verses.kjv_text: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: "On the first day of each month, you must also offer one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD. This is in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And in the fourteenth day of the first month {is} the passover of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "On the fourteenth day of the first month, you must celebrate the LORD's Passover.

verses.kjv_text: And in the fifteenth day of this month {is} the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.nlt_text: On the following day-- the fifteenth day of the month-- a joyous, seven-day festival will begin, but no bread made with yeast may be eaten.

verses.kjv_text: In the first day {shall be} an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work {therein}:
verses.nlt_text: The first day of the festival will be an official day for holy assembly, and no ordinary work may be done on that day.

verses.kjv_text: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire {for} a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: As a special gift you must present a burnt offering to the LORD-- two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.nlt_text: These will be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil-- six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,

verses.kjv_text: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.nlt_text: and two quarts with each of the seven lambs.

verses.kjv_text: And one goat {for} a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.nlt_text: You must also offer a male goat as a sin offering to purify yourselves and make yourselves right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which {is} for a continual burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: Present these offerings in addition to your regular morning burnt offering.

verses.kjv_text: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: On each of the seven days of the festival, this is how you must prepare the food offering that is presented as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. These will be offered in addition to the regular burnt offerings and liquid offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.nlt_text: The seventh day of the festival will be another official day for holy assembly, and no ordinary work may be done on that day.

verses.kjv_text: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks {be out}, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
verses.nlt_text: "At the Festival of Harvest, when you present the first of your new grain to the LORD, you must call an official day for holy assembly, and you may do no ordinary work on that day.

verses.kjv_text: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
verses.nlt_text: Present a special burnt offering on that day as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It will consist of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs.

verses.kjv_text: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
verses.nlt_text: These will be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil-- six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,

verses.kjv_text: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
verses.nlt_text: and two quarts with each of the seven lambs.

verses.kjv_text: {And} one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
verses.nlt_text: Also, offer one male goat to purify yourselves and make yourselves right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall offer {them} beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.nlt_text: Prepare these special burnt offerings, along with their liquid offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying grain offering. Be sure that all the animals you sacrifice have no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And in the seventh month, on the first {day} of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
verses.nlt_text: "Celebrate the Festival of Trumpets each year on the first day of the appointed month in early autumn. You must call an official day for holy assembly, and you may do no ordinary work.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, {and} seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: On that day you must present a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It will consist of one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, {and} two tenth deals for a ram,
verses.nlt_text: These must be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil-- six quarts with the bull, four quarts with the ram,

verses.kjv_text: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.nlt_text: and two quarts with each of the seven lambs.

verses.kjv_text: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
verses.nlt_text: In addition, you must sacrifice a male goat as a sin offering to purify yourselves and make yourselves right with the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: These special sacrifices are in addition to your regular monthly and daily burnt offerings, and they must be given with their prescribed grain offerings and liquid offerings. These offerings are given as a special gift to the LORD, a pleasing aroma to him.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall have on the tenth {day} of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work {therein}:
verses.nlt_text: "Ten days later, on the tenth day of the same month, you must call another holy assembly. On that day, the Day of Atonement, the people must go without food and must do no ordinary work.

verses.kjv_text: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD {for} a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, {and} seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: You must present a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It will consist of one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, {and} two tenth deals to one ram,
verses.nlt_text: These offerings must be accompanied by the prescribed grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil-- six quarts of choice flour with the bull, four quarts of choice flour with the ram,

verses.kjv_text: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.nlt_text: and two quarts of choice flour with each of the seven lambs.

verses.kjv_text: One kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.nlt_text: You must also sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering. This is in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular daily burnt offering with its grain offering, and their accompanying liquid offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
verses.nlt_text: "Five days later, on the fifteenth day of the same month, you must call another holy assembly of all the people, and you may do no ordinary work on that day. It is the beginning of the Festival of Shelters, a seven-day festival to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: On the first day of the festival, you must present a burnt offering as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It will consist of thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
verses.nlt_text: Each of these offerings must be accompanied by a grain offering of choice flour moistened with olive oil-- six quarts for each of the thirteen bulls, four quarts for each of the two rams,

verses.kjv_text: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
verses.nlt_text: and two quarts for each of the fourteen lambs.

verses.kjv_text: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: You must also sacrifice a male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its accompanying grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And on the second day {ye shall offer} twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.nlt_text: "On the second day of this seven-day festival, sacrifice twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:
verses.nlt_text: Each of these offerings of bulls, rams, and lambs must be accompanied by its prescribed grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
verses.nlt_text: You must also sacrifice a male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its accompanying grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.nlt_text: "On the third day of the festival, sacrifice eleven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And one goat {for} a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: You must also sacrifice a male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its accompanying grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: "On the fourth day of the festival, sacrifice ten young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:
verses.nlt_text: Each of these offerings of bulls, rams, and lambs must be accompanied by its prescribed grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.nlt_text: "On the fifth day of the festival, sacrifice nine young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: "On the sixth day of the festival, sacrifice eight young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: And one goat {for} a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.nlt_text: You must also sacrifice a male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its accompanying grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: "On the seventh day of the festival, sacrifice seven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work {therein}:
verses.nlt_text: "On the eighth day of the festival, proclaim another holy day. You must do no ordinary work on that day.

verses.kjv_text: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.nlt_text: You must present a burnt offering as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It will consist of one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.

verses.kjv_text: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:
verses.nlt_text: Each of these offerings must be accompanied by its prescribed grain offering and liquid offering.

verses.kjv_text: These {things} ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings. {do: or, offer}
verses.nlt_text: "You must present these offerings to the LORD at your annual festivals. These are in addition to the sacrifices and offerings you present in connection with vows, or as voluntary offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, liquid offerings, or peace offerings."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses gave all of these instructions to the people of Israel as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This {is} the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses summoned the leaders of the tribes of Israel and told them, "This is what the LORD has commanded:

verses.kjv_text: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth. {break: Heb. profane}
verses.nlt_text: A man who makes a vow to the LORD or makes a pledge under oath must never break it. He must do exactly what he said he would do.

verses.kjv_text: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, {being} in her father's house in her youth;
verses.nlt_text: "If a young woman makes a vow to the LORD or a pledge under oath while she is still living at her father's home,
