verses.kjv_text: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.nlt_text: and her father hears of the vow or pledge and does not object to it, then all her vows and pledges will stand.

verses.kjv_text: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.nlt_text: But if her father refuses to let her fulfill the vow or pledge on the day he hears of it, then all her vows and pledges will become invalid. The LORD will forgive her because her father would not let her fulfill them.

verses.kjv_text: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul; {she vowed: Heb. her vows were upon her}
verses.nlt_text: "Now suppose a young woman makes a vow or binds herself with an impulsive pledge and later marries.

verses.kjv_text: And her husband heard {it,} and held his peace at her in the day that he heard {it}: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.nlt_text: If her husband learns of her vow or pledge and does not object on the day he hears of it, her vows and pledges will stand.

verses.kjv_text: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard {it}; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.
verses.nlt_text: But if her husband refuses to accept her vow or impulsive pledge on the day he hears of it, he nullifies her commitments, and the LORD will forgive her.

verses.kjv_text: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.nlt_text: If, however, a woman is a widow or is divorced, she must fulfill all her vows and pledges.

verses.kjv_text: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.nlt_text: "But suppose a woman is married and living in her husband's home when she makes a vow or binds herself with a pledge.

verses.kjv_text: And her husband heard {it}, and held his peace at her, {and} disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.nlt_text: If her husband hears of it and does not object to it, her vow or pledge will stand.

verses.kjv_text: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard {them; then} whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
verses.nlt_text: But if her husband refuses to accept it on the day he hears of it, her vow or pledge will be nullified, and the LORD will forgive her.

verses.kjv_text: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.nlt_text: So her husband may either confirm or nullify any vows or pledges she makes to deny herself.

verses.kjv_text: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which {are} upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard {them}.
verses.nlt_text: But if he does not object on the day he hears of it, then he is agreeing to all her vows and pledges.

verses.kjv_text: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard {them}; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: If he waits more than a day and then tries to nullify a vow or pledge, he will be punished for her guilt."

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, {being yet} in her youth in her father's house.
verses.nlt_text: These are the regulations the LORD gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and a young daughter who still lives at home.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.nlt_text: "On behalf of the people of Israel, take revenge on the Midianites for leading them into idolatry. After that, you will die and join your ancestors."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses said to the people, "Choose some men, and arm them to fight the LORD's war of revenge against Midian.

verses.kjv_text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war. {Of...: Heb. A thousand of a tribe, a thousand of a tribe}
verses.nlt_text: From each tribe of Israel, send 1,000 men into battle."

verses.kjv_text: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of {every} tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.nlt_text: So they chose 1,000 men from each tribe of Israel, a total of 12,000 men armed for battle.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of {every} tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses sent them out, 1,000 men from each tribe, and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest led them into battle. They carried along the holy objects of the sanctuary and the trumpets for sounding the charge.

verses.kjv_text: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.nlt_text: They attacked Midian as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed all the men.

verses.kjv_text: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; {namely}, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.nlt_text: All five of the Midianite kings-- Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba-- died in the battle. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel took {all} the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Israelite army captured the Midianite women and children and seized their cattle and flocks and all their wealth as plunder.

verses.kjv_text: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.nlt_text: They burned all the towns and villages where the Midianites had lived.

verses.kjv_text: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, {both} of men and of beasts.
verses.nlt_text: After they had gathered the plunder and captives, both people and animals,

verses.kjv_text: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which {are} by Jordan {near} Jericho.
verses.nlt_text: they brought them all to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and to the whole community of Israel, which was camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.nlt_text: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, {with} the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle. {battle: Heb. host of war}
verses.nlt_text: But Moses was furious with all the generals and captains who had returned from the battle.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.nlt_text: "Why have you let all the women live?" he demanded.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "These are the very ones who followed Balaam's advice and caused the people of Israel to rebel against the LORD at Mount Peor. They are the ones who caused the plague to strike the LORD's people.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him. {him: Heb. a male}
verses.nlt_text: So kill all the boys and all the women who have had intercourse with a man.

verses.kjv_text: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.nlt_text: Only the young girls who are virgins may live; you may keep them for yourselves.

verses.kjv_text: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify {both} yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.nlt_text: And all of you who have killed anyone or touched a dead body must stay outside the camp for seven days. You must purify yourselves and your captives on the third and seventh days.

verses.kjv_text: And purify all {your} raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' {hair}, and all things made of wood. {that...: Heb. instrument, or, vessel of skins}
verses.nlt_text: Purify all your clothing, too, and everything made of leather, goat hair, or wood."

verses.kjv_text: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This {is} the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
verses.nlt_text: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men who were in the battle, "The LORD has given Moses this legal requirement:

verses.kjv_text: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.nlt_text: Anything made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead--

verses.kjv_text: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make {it} go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.nlt_text: that is, all metals that do not burn-- must be passed through fire in order to be made ceremonially pure. These metal objects must then be further purified with the water of purification. But everything that burns must be purified by the water alone.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.nlt_text: On the seventh day you must wash your clothes and be purified. Then you may return to the camp."

verses.kjv_text: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, {both} of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation: {that...: Heb. of the captivity}
verses.nlt_text: "You and Eleazar the priest and the family leaders of each tribe are to make a list of all the plunder taken in the battle, including the people and animals.

verses.kjv_text: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.nlt_text: Then divide the plunder into two parts, and give half to the men who fought the battle and half to the rest of the people.

verses.kjv_text: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, {both} of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.nlt_text: From the army's portion, first give the LORD his share of the plunder-- one of every 500 of the prisoners and of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.

verses.kjv_text: Take {it} of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, {for} an heave offering of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Give this share of the army's half to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD. {flocks: or, goats}
verses.nlt_text: From the half that belongs to the people of Israel, take one of every fifty of the prisoners and of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats, and other animals. Give this share to the Levites, who are in charge of maintaining the LORD's Tabernacle."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And the booty, {being} the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.nlt_text: The plunder remaining from everything the fighting men had taken totaled 675,000 sheep and goats,

verses.kjv_text: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.nlt_text: 72,000 cattle,

verses.kjv_text: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.nlt_text: 61,000 donkeys,

verses.kjv_text: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.nlt_text: and 32,000 virgin girls.

verses.kjv_text: And the half, {which was} the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.nlt_text: Half of the plunder was given to the fighting men. It totaled 337,500 sheep and goats,

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.nlt_text: of which 675 were the LORD's share;

verses.kjv_text: And the beeves {were} thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute {was} threescore and twelve.
verses.nlt_text: 36,000 cattle, of which 72 were the LORD's share;

verses.kjv_text: And the asses {were} thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute {was} threescore and one.
verses.nlt_text: 30,500 donkeys, of which 61 were the LORD's share;

verses.kjv_text: And the persons {were} sixteen thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute {was} thirty and two persons.
verses.nlt_text: and 16,000 virgin girls, of whom 32 were the LORD's share.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave the tribute, {which was} the LORD'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Moses gave all the LORD's share to Eleazar the priest, just as the LORD had directed him.

verses.kjv_text: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.nlt_text: Half of the plunder belonged to the people of Israel, and Moses separated it from the half belonging to the fighting men.

verses.kjv_text: (Now the half {that pertained unto} the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand {and} seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.nlt_text: It totaled 337,500 sheep and goats,

verses.kjv_text: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.nlt_text: 36,000 cattle,

verses.kjv_text: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.nlt_text: 30,500 donkeys,

verses.kjv_text: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.nlt_text: and 16,000 virgin girls.

verses.kjv_text: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, {both} of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: From the half-share given to the people, Moses took one of every fifty prisoners and animals and gave them to the Levites, who maintained the LORD's Tabernacle. All this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And the officers which {were} over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.nlt_text: Then all the generals and captains came to Moses

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which {are} under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us. {charge: Heb. hand}
verses.nlt_text: and said, "We, your servants, have accounted for all the men who went out to battle under our command; not one of us is missing!

verses.kjv_text: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD. {gotten: Heb. found}
verses.nlt_text: So we are presenting the items of gold we captured as an offering to the LORD from our share of the plunder-- armbands, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces. This will purify our lives before the LORD and make us right with him. "

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, {even} all wrought jewels.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from all the military commanders-- all kinds of jewelry and crafted objects.

verses.kjv_text: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels. {offering: Heb. heave offering}
verses.nlt_text: In all, the gold that the generals and captains presented as a gift to the LORD weighed about 420 pounds.

verses.kjv_text: ({For} the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.nlt_text: All the fighting men had taken some of the plunder for themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, {for} a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gifts from the generals and captains and brought the gold to the Tabernacle as a reminder to the LORD that the people of Israel belong to him.

verses.kjv_text: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place {was} a place for cattle;
verses.nlt_text: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned vast numbers of livestock. So when they saw that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were ideally suited for their flocks and herds,

verses.kjv_text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.nlt_text: they came to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the other leaders of the community. They said,

verses.kjv_text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon, {Nimrah: also called, Bethnimrah} {Shebam: also called, Shibmah} {Beon: also called, Baalmeon}
verses.nlt_text: "Notice the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sibmah, Nebo, and Beon.

verses.kjv_text: {Even} the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, {is} a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has conquered this whole area for the community of Israel, and it is ideally suited for all our livestock.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, {and} bring us not over Jordan.
verses.nlt_text: If we have found favor with you, please let us have this land as our property instead of giving us land across the Jordan River."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.nlt_text: "Do you intend to stay here while your brothers go across and do all the fighting?" Moses asked the men of Gad and Reuben.

verses.kjv_text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them? {discourage: Heb. break}
verses.nlt_text: "Why do you want to discourage the rest of the people of Israel from going across to the land the LORD has given them?

verses.kjv_text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
verses.nlt_text: Your ancestors did the same thing when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to explore the land.

verses.kjv_text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.nlt_text: After they went up to the valley of Eshcol and explored the land, they discouraged the people of Israel from entering the land the LORD was giving them.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD was very angry with them, and he vowed,

verses.kjv_text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me: {wholly...: Heb. fulfilled after me}
verses.nlt_text: 'Of all those I rescued from Egypt, no one who is twenty years old or older will ever see the land I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, for they have not obeyed me wholeheartedly.

verses.kjv_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The only exceptions are Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they have wholeheartedly followed the LORD.'

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD was angry with Israel and made them wander in the wilderness for forty years until the entire generation that sinned in the LORD's sight had died.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
verses.nlt_text: But here you are, a brood of sinners, doing exactly the same thing! You are making the LORD even angrier with Israel.

verses.kjv_text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.nlt_text: If you turn away from him like this and he abandons them again in the wilderness, you will be responsible for destroying this entire nation!"

verses.kjv_text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.nlt_text: But they approached Moses and said, "We simply want to build pens for our livestock and fortified towns for our wives and children.

verses.kjv_text: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.nlt_text: Then we will arm ourselves and lead our fellow Israelites into battle until we have brought them safely to their land. Meanwhile, our families will stay in the fortified towns we build here, so they will be safe from any attacks by the local people.

verses.kjv_text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: We will not return to our homes until all the people of Israel have received their portions of land.

verses.kjv_text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.nlt_text: But we do not claim any of the land on the other side of the Jordan. We would rather live here on the east side and accept this as our grant of land."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses said, "If you keep your word and arm yourselves for the LORD's battles,

verses.kjv_text: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.nlt_text: and if your troops cross the Jordan and keep fighting until the LORD has driven out his enemies,

verses.kjv_text: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: then you may return when the LORD has conquered the land. You will have fulfilled your duty to the LORD and to the rest of the people of Israel. And the land on the east side of the Jordan will be your property from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.nlt_text: But if you fail to keep your word, then you will have sinned against the LORD, and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.

verses.kjv_text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.nlt_text: Go ahead and build towns for your families and pens for your flocks, but do everything you have promised."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.nlt_text: Then the men of Gad and Reuben replied, "We, your servants, will follow your instructions exactly.

verses.kjv_text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.nlt_text: Our children, wives, flocks, and cattle will stay here in the towns of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.nlt_text: But all who are able to bear arms will cross over to fight for the LORD, just as you have said."

verses.kjv_text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: So Moses gave orders to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the clans of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.nlt_text: He said, "The men of Gad and Reuben who are armed for battle must cross the Jordan with you to fight for the LORD. If they do, give them the land of Gilead as their property when the land is conquered.

verses.kjv_text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: But if they refuse to arm themselves and cross over with you, then they must accept land with the rest of you in the land of Canaan."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.nlt_text: The tribes of Gad and Reuben said again, "We are your servants, and we will do as the LORD has commanded!

verses.kjv_text: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan {may be} ours.
verses.nlt_text: We will cross the Jordan into Canaan fully armed to fight for the LORD, but our property will be here on this side of the Jordan."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave unto them, {even} to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, {even} the cities of the country round about.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses assigned land to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph. He gave them the territory of King Sihon of the Amorites and the land of King Og of Bashan-- the whole land with its cities and surrounding lands.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gad built the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

verses.kjv_text: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah, {Jaazer: also called, Jazer}
verses.nlt_text: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

verses.kjv_text: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep. {Bethnimrah: also called, Nimrah}
verses.nlt_text: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran. These were all fortified towns with pens for their flocks.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Reuben built the towns of Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

verses.kjv_text: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded. {gave...: Heb. they called by names the names of the cities}
verses.nlt_text: Nebo, Baal-meon, and Sibmah. They changed the names of some of the towns they conquered and rebuilt.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which {was} in it.
verses.nlt_text: Then the descendants of Makir of the tribe of Manasseh went to Gilead and conquered it, and they drove out the Amorites living there.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.

verses.kjv_text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Jair, another clan of the tribe of Manasseh, captured many of the towns in Gilead and changed the name of that region to the Towns of Jair.

verses.kjv_text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, a man named Nobah captured the town of Kenath and its surrounding villages, and he renamed that area Nobah after himself.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.nlt_text: This is the route the Israelites followed as they marched out of Egypt under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these {are} their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.nlt_text: At the LORD's direction, Moses kept a written record of their progress. These are the stages of their march, identified by the different places where they stopped along the way.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.nlt_text: They set out from the city of Rameses in early spring-- on the fifteenth day of the first month-- on the morning after the first Passover celebration. The people of Israel left defiantly, in full view of all the Egyptians.

verses.kjv_text: For the Egyptians buried all {their} firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn sons, whom the LORD had killed the night before. The LORD had defeated the gods of Egypt that night with great acts of judgment!

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.nlt_text: After leaving Rameses, the Israelites set up camp at Succoth.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which {is} in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: Then they left Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which {is} before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.nlt_text: They left Etham and turned back toward Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and camped near Migdol.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Pi-hahiroth and crossed the Red Sea into the wilderness beyond. Then they traveled for three days into the Etham wilderness and camped at Marah.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim {were} twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.nlt_text: They left Marah and camped at Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.nlt_text: They left Elim and camped beside the Red Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.nlt_text: They left the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.kjv_text: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.nlt_text: They left the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.nlt_text: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.nlt_text: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.nlt_text: They left Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah. {Kibrothhattaavah: that is, the graves of lust}
verses.nlt_text: They left the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.nlt_text: They left Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
verses.nlt_text: They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.

verses.kjv_text: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

verses.kjv_text: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.nlt_text: They left Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.nlt_text: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.nlt_text: They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Tahath and camped at Terah.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Terah and camped at Mithcah.

verses.kjv_text: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Mithcah and camped at Hashmonah.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.nlt_text: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
verses.nlt_text: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
verses.nlt_text: They left Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.

verses.kjv_text: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.nlt_text: They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
verses.nlt_text: They left Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which {is} Kadesh.
verses.nlt_text: They left Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.nlt_text: They left Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the border of Edom.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first {day} of the fifth month.
verses.nlt_text: While they were at the foot of Mount Hor, Aaron the priest was directed by the LORD to go up the mountain, and there he died. This happened in midsummer, on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after Israel's departure from Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And Aaron {was} an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.nlt_text: Aaron was 123 years old when he died there on Mount Hor.

verses.kjv_text: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: At that time the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the people of Israel were approaching his land.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the Israelites left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.nlt_text: Then they left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.nlt_text: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab. {Ijeabarim: or, heaps of Abarim}
verses.nlt_text: They left Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
verses.nlt_text: They left Iye-abarim and camped at Dibon-gad.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
verses.nlt_text: They left Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.

verses.kjv_text: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.nlt_text: They left Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains east of the river, near Mount Nebo.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho.
verses.nlt_text: They left the mountains east of the river and camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.

verses.kjv_text: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth {even} unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab. {Abelshittim: or, the plains of Shittim}
verses.nlt_text: Along the Jordan River they camped from Beth-jeshimoth as far as the meadows of Acacia on the plains of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho, saying,
verses.nlt_text: While they were camped near the Jordan River on the plains of Moab opposite Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel: When you cross the Jordan River into the land of Canaan,

verses.kjv_text: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.nlt_text: you must drive out all the people living there. You must destroy all their carved and molten images and demolish all their pagan shrines.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall dispossess {the inhabitants} of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: Take possession of the land and settle in it, because I have given it to you to occupy.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: {and} to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's {inheritance} shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit. {give the more...: Heb. multiply his inheritance} {give the less...: Heb. diminish his inheritance}
verses.nlt_text: You must distribute the land among the clans by sacred lot and in proportion to their size. A larger portion of land will be allotted to each of the larger clans, and a smaller portion will be allotted to each of the smaller clans. The decision of the sacred lot is final. In this way, the portions of land will be divided among your ancestral tribes.

verses.kjv_text: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them {shall be} pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.nlt_text: But if you fail to drive out the people who live in the land, those who remain will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land where you live.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover it shall come to pass, {that} I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.nlt_text: And I will do to you what I had planned to do to them."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this {is} the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, {even} the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.nlt_text: "Give these instructions to the Israelites: When you come into the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your special possession, these will be the boundaries.

verses.kjv_text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.nlt_text: The southern portion of your country will extend from the wilderness of Zin, along the edge of Edom. The southern boundary will begin on the east at the Dead Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.nlt_text: It will then run south past Scorpion Pass in the direction of Zin. Its southernmost point will be Kadesh-barnea, from which it will go to Hazar-addar, and on to Azmon.

verses.kjv_text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.nlt_text: From Azmon the boundary will turn toward the Brook of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And {as for} the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.nlt_text: "Your western boundary will be the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.nlt_text: "Your northern boundary will begin at the Mediterranean Sea and run east to Mount Hor,

verses.kjv_text: From mount Hor ye shall point out {your border} unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.nlt_text: then to Lebo-hamath, and on through Zedad

verses.kjv_text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
verses.nlt_text: and Ziphron to Hazar-enan. This will be your northern boundary.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
verses.nlt_text: "The eastern boundary will start at Hazar-enan and run south to Shepham,

verses.kjv_text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward: {side of the sea: Heb. shoulder of the sea}
verses.nlt_text: then down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there the boundary will run down along the eastern edge of the Sea of Galilee,

verses.kjv_text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.nlt_text: and then along the Jordan River to the Dead Sea. These are the boundaries of your land."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This {is} the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses told the Israelites, "This territory is the homeland you are to divide among yourselves by sacred lot. The LORD has commanded that the land be divided among the nine and a half remaining tribes.

verses.kjv_text: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received {their inheritance}; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.nlt_text: The families of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received their grants of land

verses.kjv_text: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan {near} Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.nlt_text: on the east side of the Jordan River, across from Jericho toward the sunrise."

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.nlt_text: "Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun are the men designated to divide the grants of land among the people.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: Enlist one leader from each tribe to help them with the task.

verses.kjv_text: And the names of the men {are} these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.nlt_text: These are the tribes and the names of the leaders: Tribe Leader Judah Caleb son of Jephunneh

verses.kjv_text: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.nlt_text: Simeon Shemuel son of Ammihud

verses.kjv_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.nlt_text: Benjamin Elidad son of Kislon

verses.kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.nlt_text: Dan Bukki son of Jogli

verses.kjv_text: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.nlt_text: Manasseh son of Joseph Hanniel son of Ephod

verses.kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.nlt_text: Ephraim son of Joseph Kemuel son of Shiphtan

verses.kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.nlt_text: Zebulun Elizaphan son of Parnach

verses.kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.nlt_text: Issachar Paltiel son of Azzan

verses.kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.nlt_text: Asher Ahihud son of Shelomi

verses.kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.nlt_text: Naphtali Pedahel son of Ammihud

verses.kjv_text: These {are they} whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: These are the men the LORD has appointed to divide the grants of land in Canaan among the Israelites."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho, saying,
verses.nlt_text: While Israel was camped beside the Jordan on the plains of Moab across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give {also} unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.nlt_text: "Command the people of Israel to give to the Levites from their property certain towns to live in, along with the surrounding pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.nlt_text: These towns will be for the Levites to live in, and the surrounding lands will provide pasture for their cattle, flocks, and other livestock.

verses.kjv_text: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, {shall reach} from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.nlt_text: The pastureland assigned to the Levites around these towns will extend 1,500 feet from the town walls in every direction.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city {shall be} in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.nlt_text: Measure off 3,000 feet outside the town walls in every direction-- east, south, west, north-- with the town at the center. This area will serve as the larger pastureland for the towns.

verses.kjv_text: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites {there shall be} six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities. {to them...: Heb. above them ye shall give}
verses.nlt_text: "Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can flee for safety. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.

verses.kjv_text: {So} all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites {shall be} forty and eight cities: them {shall ye give} with their suburbs.
verses.nlt_text: In all, forty-eight towns with the surrounding pastureland will be given to the Levites.

verses.kjv_text: And the cities which ye shall give {shall be} of the possession of the children of Israel: from {them that have} many ye shall give many; but from {them that have} few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth. {he...: Heb. they inherit}
verses.nlt_text: These towns will come from the property of the people of Israel. The larger tribes will give more towns to the Levites, while the smaller tribes will give fewer. Each tribe will give property in proportion to the size of its land."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.nlt_text: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel."When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.kjv_text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares. {at...: Heb. by error}
verses.nlt_text: designate cities of refuge to which people can flee if they have killed someone accidentally.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.nlt_text: These cities will be places of protection from a dead person's relatives who want to avenge the death. The slayer must not be put to death before being tried by the community.

verses.kjv_text: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.nlt_text: Designate six cities of refuge for yourselves,

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, {which} shall be cities of refuge.
verses.nlt_text: three on the east side of the Jordan River and three on the west in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: These six cities shall be a refuge, {both} for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.nlt_text: These cities are for the protection of Israelites, foreigners living among you, and traveling merchants. Anyone who accidentally kills someone may flee there for safety.

verses.kjv_text: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he {is} a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "But if someone strikes and kills another person with a piece of iron, it is murder, and the murderer must be executed.

verses.kjv_text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he {is} a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death. {with...: Heb. with a stone of the hand}
verses.nlt_text: Or if someone with a stone in his hand strikes and kills another person, it is murder, and the murderer must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: Or {if} he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he {is} a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: Or if someone strikes and kills another person with a wooden object, it is murder, and the murderer must be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.nlt_text: The victim's nearest relative is responsible for putting the murderer to death. When they meet, the avenger must put the murderer to death.

verses.kjv_text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.nlt_text: So if someone hates another person and pushes him or throws a dangerous object at him and he dies, it is murder.

verses.kjv_text: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote {him} shall surely be put to death; {for} he {is} a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.nlt_text: Or if someone hates another person and hits him with a fist and he dies, it is murder. In such cases, the avenger must put the murderer to death when they meet.

verses.kjv_text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.nlt_text: "But suppose someone pushes another person without having shown previous hostility, or throws something that unintentionally hits another person,

verses.kjv_text: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing {him} not, and cast {it} upon him, that he die, and {was} not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.nlt_text: or accidentally drops a huge stone on someone, though they were not enemies, and the person dies.

verses.kjv_text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.nlt_text: If this should happen, the community must follow these regulations in making a judgment between the slayer and the avenger, the victim's nearest relative:

verses.kjv_text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.nlt_text: The community must protect the slayer from the avenger and must escort the slayer back to live in the city of refuge to which he fled. There he must remain until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the sacred oil.

verses.kjv_text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.nlt_text: "But if the slayer ever leaves the limits of the city of refuge,

verses.kjv_text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood: {he...: Heb. no blood shall be to him}
verses.nlt_text: and the avenger finds him outside the city and kills him, it will not be considered murder.

verses.kjv_text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.nlt_text: The slayer should have stayed inside the city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the slayer may return to his own property.

verses.kjv_text: So these {things} shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.nlt_text: These are legal requirements for you to observe from generation to generation, wherever you may live.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person {to cause him} to die.
verses.nlt_text: "All murderers must be put to death, but only if evidence is presented by more than one witness. No one may be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which {is} guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death. {guilty...: Heb. faulty to die}
verses.nlt_text: Also, you must never accept a ransom payment for the life of someone judged guilty of murder and subject to execution; murderers must always be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.nlt_text: And never accept a ransom payment from someone who has fled to a city of refuge, allowing a slayer to return to his property before the death of the high priest.

verses.kjv_text: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye {are}: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it. {the land cannot...: Heb. there can be no expiation for the land}
verses.nlt_text: This will ensure that the land where you live will not be polluted, for murder pollutes the land. And no sacrifice except the execution of the murderer can purify the land from murder.

verses.kjv_text: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: You must not defile the land where you live, for I live there myself. I am the LORD, who lives among the people of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: Then the heads of the clans of Gilead-- descendants of Makir, son of Manasseh, son of Joseph-- came to Moses and the family leaders of Israel with a petition.

verses.kjv_text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.nlt_text: They said, "Sir, the LORD instructed you to divide the land by sacred lot among the people of Israel. You were told by the LORD to give the grant of land owned by our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And if they be married to any of the sons of the {other} tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance. {whereunto...: Heb. unto whom they shall be}
verses.nlt_text: But if they marry men from another tribe, their grants of land will go with them to the tribe into which they marry. In this way, the total area of our tribal land will be reduced.

verses.kjv_text: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers. {whereunto...: Heb. unto whom they shall be}
verses.nlt_text: Then when the Year of Jubilee comes, their portion of land will be added to that of the new tribe, causing it to be lost forever to our ancestral tribe."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses gave the Israelites this command from the LORD: "The claim of the men of the tribe of Joseph is legitimate.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry. {marry: Heb. be wives}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: Let them marry anyone they like, as long as it is within their own ancestral tribe.

verses.kjv_text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers. {keep...: Heb. cleave to the, etc}
verses.nlt_text: None of the territorial land may pass from tribe to tribe, for all the land given to each tribe must remain within the tribe to which it was first allotted.

verses.kjv_text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.nlt_text: The daughters throughout the tribes of Israel who are in line to inherit property must marry within their tribe, so that all the Israelites will keep their ancestral property.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall the inheritance remove from {one} tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: No grant of land may pass from one tribe to another; each tribe of Israel must keep its allotted portion of land."

verses.kjv_text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.nlt_text: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
verses.nlt_text: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah all married cousins on their father's side.

verses.kjv_text: {And} they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father. {into...: Heb. to some that were of the families}
verses.nlt_text: They married into the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. Thus, their inheritance of land remained within their ancestral tribe.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho.
verses.nlt_text: These are the commands and regulations that the LORD gave to the people of Israel through Moses while they were camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River across from Jericho.

verses.kjv_text: These {be} the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red {sea}, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab. {the Red...: or, Zuph}
verses.nlt_text: These are the words that Moses spoke to all the people of Israel while they were in the wilderness east of the Jordan River. They were camped in the Jordan Valley near Suph, between Paran on one side and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab on the other.

verses.kjv_text: ({There are} eleven days' {journey} from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
verses.nlt_text: Normally it takes only eleven days to travel from Mount Sinai to Kadesh-barnea, going by way of Mount Seir.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first {day} of the month, {that} Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.nlt_text: But forty years after the Israelites left Egypt, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses addressed the people of Israel, telling them everything the LORD had commanded him to say.

verses.kjv_text: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.nlt_text: This took place after he had defeated King Sihon of the Amorites, who had ruled in Heshbon, and King Og of Bashan, who had ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

verses.kjv_text: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.nlt_text: While the Israelites were in the land of Moab east of the Jordan River, Moses carefully explained the LORD's instructions as follows.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.nlt_text: "When we were at Mount Sinai, the LORD our God said to us, 'You have stayed at this mountain long enough.

verses.kjv_text: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all {the places} nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates. {all...: Heb. all his neighbours}
verses.nlt_text: It is time to break camp and move on. Go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the neighboring regions-- the Jordan Valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Negev, and the coastal plain. Go to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, and all the way to the great Euphrates River.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them. {set: Heb. given}
verses.nlt_text: Look, I am giving all this land to you! Go in and occupy it, for it is the land the LORD swore to give to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to all their descendants.'"

verses.kjv_text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.nlt_text: Moses continued, "At that time I told you, 'You are too great a burden for me to carry all by myself.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye {are} this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD your God has increased your population, making you as numerous as the stars!

verses.kjv_text: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye {are}, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.nlt_text: And may the LORD, the God of your ancestors, multiply you a thousand times more and bless you as he promised!

verses.kjv_text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.nlt_text: But you are such a heavy load to carry! How can I deal with all your problems and bickering?

verses.kjv_text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you. {Take: Heb. Give}
verses.nlt_text: Choose some well-respected men from each tribe who are known for their wisdom and understanding, and I will appoint them as your leaders.'

verses.kjv_text: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken {is} good {for us} to do.
verses.nlt_text: "Then you responded, 'Your plan is a good one.'

verses.kjv_text: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes. {made: Heb. gave}
verses.nlt_text: So I took the wise and respected men you had selected from your tribes and appointed them to serve as judges and officials over you. Some were responsible for a thousand people, some for a hundred, some for fifty, and some for ten.

verses.kjv_text: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear {the causes} between your brethren, and judge righteously between {every} man and his brother, and the stranger {that is} with him.
verses.nlt_text: "At that time I instructed the judges, 'You must hear the cases of your fellow Israelites and the foreigners living among you. Be perfectly fair in your decisions

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; {but} ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment {is} God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring {it} unto me, and I will hear it. {respect...: Heb. acknowledge faces}
verses.nlt_text: and impartial in your judgments. Hear the cases of those who are poor as well as those who are rich. Don't be afraid of anyone's anger, for the decision you make is God's decision. Bring me any cases that are too difficult for you, and I will handle them.'

verses.kjv_text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.nlt_text: "At that time I gave you instructions about everything you were to do.

verses.kjv_text: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
verses.nlt_text: "Then, just as the LORD our God commanded us, we left Mount Sinai and traveled through the great and terrifying wilderness, as you yourselves remember, and headed toward the hill country of the Amorites. When we arrived at Kadesh-barnea,

verses.kjv_text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
verses.nlt_text: I said to you, 'You have now reached the hill country of the Amorites that the LORD our God is giving us.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up {and} possess {it}, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.nlt_text: Look! He has placed the land in front of you. Go and occupy it as the LORD, the God of your ancestors, has promised you. Don't be afraid! Don't be discouraged!'

verses.kjv_text: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.nlt_text: "But you all came to me and said, 'First, let's send out scouts to explore the land for us. They will advise us on the best route to take and which towns we should enter.'

verses.kjv_text: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.nlt_text: "This seemed like a good idea to me, so I chose twelve scouts, one from each of your tribes.

verses.kjv_text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.nlt_text: They headed for the hill country and came to the valley of Eshcol and explored it.

verses.kjv_text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought {it} down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, {It is} a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
verses.nlt_text: They picked some of its fruit and brought it back to us. And they reported, 'The land the LORD our God has given us is indeed a good land.'

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
verses.nlt_text: "But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God and refused to go in.

verses.kjv_text: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.nlt_text: You complained in your tents and said, 'The LORD must hate us. That's why he has brought us here from Egypt-- to hand us over to the Amorites to be slaughtered.

verses.kjv_text: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people {is} greater and taller than we; the cities {are} great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there. {discouraged: Heb. melted}
verses.nlt_text: Where can we go? Our brothers have demoralized us with their report. They tell us, "The people of the land are taller and more powerful than we are, and their towns are large, with walls rising high into the sky! We even saw giants there-- the descendants of Anak!"'

verses.kjv_text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.nlt_text: "But I said to you, 'Don't be shocked or afraid of them!

verses.kjv_text: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.nlt_text: The LORD your God is going ahead of you. He will fight for you, just as you saw him do in Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.nlt_text: And you saw how the LORD your God cared for you all along the way as you traveled through the wilderness, just as a father cares for his child. Now he has brought you to this place.'

verses.kjv_text: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
verses.nlt_text: "But even after all he did, you refused to trust the LORD your God,

verses.kjv_text: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents {in}, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.nlt_text: who goes before you looking for the best places to camp, guiding you with a pillar of fire by night and a pillar of cloud by day.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.nlt_text: "When the LORD heard your complaining, he became very angry. So he solemnly swore,

verses.kjv_text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.nlt_text: 'Not one of you from this wicked generation will live to see the good land I swore to give your ancestors,

verses.kjv_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD. {wholly...: Heb. fulfilled to go after}
verses.nlt_text: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see this land because he has followed the LORD completely. I will give to him and his descendants some of the very land he explored during his scouting mission.'

verses.kjv_text: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.nlt_text: "And the LORD was also angry with me because of you. He said to me, 'Moses, not even you will enter the Promised Land!

verses.kjv_text: {But} Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will lead the people into the land. Encourage him, for he will lead Israel as they take possession of it.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.nlt_text: I will give the land to your little ones-- your innocent children. You were afraid they would be captured, but they will be the ones who occupy it.

verses.kjv_text: But {as for} you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.nlt_text: As for you, turn around now and go on back through the wilderness toward the Red Sea. '

verses.kjv_text: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.nlt_text: "Then you confessed, 'We have sinned against the LORD! We will go into the land and fight for it, as the LORD our God has commanded us.' So your men strapped on their weapons, thinking it would be easy to attack the hill country.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I {am} not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.nlt_text: "But the LORD told me to tell you, 'Do not attack, for I am not with you. If you go ahead on your own, you will be crushed by your enemies.'

verses.kjv_text: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill. {went...: Heb. ye were presumptuous, and went up}
verses.nlt_text: "This is what I told you, but you would not listen. Instead, you again rebelled against the LORD's command and arrogantly went into the hill country to fight.

verses.kjv_text: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, {even} unto Hormah.
