verses.kjv_text: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.nlt_text: You will go mad because of all the tragedy you see around you.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will cover your knees and legs with incurable boils. In fact, you will be covered from head to foot.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD will exile you and your king to a nation unknown to you and your ancestors. There in exile you will worship gods of wood and stone!

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.nlt_text: You will become an object of horror, ridicule, and mockery among all the nations to which the LORD sends you.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather {but} little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.nlt_text: "You will plant much but harvest little, for locusts will eat your crops.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress {them}, but shalt neither drink {of} the wine, nor gather {the grapes}; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.nlt_text: You will plant vineyards and care for them, but you will not drink the wine or eat the grapes, for worms will destroy the vines.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint {thyself} with the oil; for thine olive shall cast {his fruit}.
verses.nlt_text: You will grow olive trees throughout your land, but you will never use the olive oil, for the fruit will drop before it ripens.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity. {thou shalt not...: Heb. they shall not be thine}
verses.nlt_text: You will have sons and daughters, but you will lose them, for they will be led away into captivity.

verses.kjv_text: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume. {consume: or, possess}
verses.nlt_text: Swarms of insects will destroy your trees and crops.

verses.kjv_text: The stranger that {is} within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.nlt_text: "The foreigners living among you will become stronger and stronger, while you become weaker and weaker.

verses.kjv_text: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.nlt_text: They will lend money to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, and you will be the tail!

verses.kjv_text: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.nlt_text: "If you refuse to listen to the LORD your God and to obey the commands and decrees he has given you, all these curses will pursue and overtake you until you are destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.nlt_text: These horrors will serve as a sign and warning among you and your descendants forever.

verses.kjv_text: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all {things};
verses.nlt_text: If you do not serve the LORD your God with joy and enthusiasm for the abundant benefits you have received,

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all {things}: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.nlt_text: you will serve your enemies whom the LORD will send against you. You will be left hungry, thirsty, naked, and lacking in everything. The LORD will put an iron yoke on your neck, oppressing you harshly until he has destroyed you.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, {as swift} as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand; {understand: Heb. hear}
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD will bring a distant nation against you from the end of the earth, and it will swoop down on you like a vulture. It is a nation whose language you do not understand,

verses.kjv_text: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young: {of fierce...: Heb. strong of face}
verses.nlt_text: a fierce and heartless nation that shows no respect for the old and no pity for the young.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which {also} shall not leave thee {either} corn, wine, or oil, {or} the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.nlt_text: Its armies will devour your livestock and crops, and you will be destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine, olive oil, calves, or lambs, and you will starve to death.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.nlt_text: They will attack your cities until all the fortified walls in your land-- the walls you trusted to protect you-- are knocked down. They will attack all the towns in the land the LORD your God has given you.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee: {body: Heb. belly}
verses.nlt_text: "The siege and terrible distress of the enemy's attack will be so severe that you will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you.

verses.kjv_text: {So that} the man {that is} tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.nlt_text: The most tenderhearted man among you will have no compassion for his own brother, his beloved wife, and his surviving children.

verses.kjv_text: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.nlt_text: He will refuse to share with them the flesh he is devouring-- the flesh of one of his own children-- because he has nothing else to eat during the siege and terrible distress that your enemy will inflict on all your towns.

verses.kjv_text: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.nlt_text: The most tender and delicate woman among you-- so delicate she would not so much as touch the ground with her foot-- will be selfish toward the husband she loves and toward her own son or daughter.

verses.kjv_text: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all {things} secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates. {young one: Heb. afterbirth}
verses.nlt_text: She will hide from them the afterbirth and the new baby she has borne, so that she herself can secretly eat them. She will have nothing else to eat during the siege and terrible distress that your enemy will inflict on all your towns.

verses.kjv_text: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.nlt_text: "If you refuse to obey all the words of instruction that are written in this book, and if you do not fear the glorious and awesome name of the LORD your God,

verses.kjv_text: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, {even} great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.nlt_text: then the LORD will overwhelm you and your children with indescribable plagues. These plagues will be intense and without relief, making you miserable and unbearably sick.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: He will afflict you with all the diseases of Egypt that you feared so much, and you will have no relief.

verses.kjv_text: Also every sickness, and every plague, which {is} not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed. {bring: Heb. cause to ascend}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will afflict you with every sickness and plague there is, even those not mentioned in this Book of Instruction, until you are destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.nlt_text: Though you become as numerous as the stars in the sky, few of you will be left because you would not listen to the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: "Just as the LORD has found great pleasure in causing you to prosper and multiply, the LORD will find pleasure in destroying you. You will be torn from the land you are about to enter and occupy.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, {even} wood and stone.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD will scatter you among all the nations from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship foreign gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known, gods made of wood and stone!

verses.kjv_text: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.nlt_text: There among those nations you will find no peace or place to rest. And the LORD will cause your heart to tremble, your eyesight to fail, and your soul to despair.

verses.kjv_text: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.nlt_text: Your life will constantly hang in the balance. You will live night and day in fear, unsure if you will survive.

verses.kjv_text: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.nlt_text: In the morning you will say, 'If only it were night!' And in the evening you will say, 'If only it were morning!' For you will be terrified by the awful horrors you see around you.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy {you}.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD will send you back to Egypt in ships, to a destination I promised you would never see again. There you will offer to sell yourselves to your enemies as slaves, but no one will buy you."

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.nlt_text: These are the terms of the covenant the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites while they were in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.nlt_text: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them, "You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to his whole country--

verses.kjv_text: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.nlt_text: all the great tests of strength, the miraculous signs, and the amazing wonders.

verses.kjv_text: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: But to this day the LORD has not given you minds that understand, nor eyes that see, nor ears that hear!

verses.kjv_text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.nlt_text: For forty years I led you through the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I {am} the LORD your God.
verses.nlt_text: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other alcoholic drink, but he gave you food so you would know that he is the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.nlt_text: "When we came here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.

verses.kjv_text: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.nlt_text: We took their land and gave it to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh as their grant of land.

verses.kjv_text: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, obey the terms of this covenant so that you will prosper in everything you do.

verses.kjv_text: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, {with} all the men of Israel,
verses.nlt_text: All of you-- tribal leaders, elders, officers, all the men of Israel-- are standing today in the presence of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that {is} in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.nlt_text: Your little ones and your wives are with you, as well as the foreigners living among you who chop your wood and carry your water.

verses.kjv_text: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day: {enter: Heb. pass}
verses.nlt_text: You are standing here today to enter into the covenant of the LORD your God. The LORD is making this covenant, including the curses.

verses.kjv_text: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and {that} he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: By entering into the covenant today, he will establish you as his people and confirm that he is your God, just as he promised you and as he swore to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.nlt_text: "But you are not the only ones with whom I am making this covenant with its curses.

verses.kjv_text: But with {him} that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with {him} that {is} not here with us this day:
verses.nlt_text: I am making this covenant both with you who stand here today in the presence of the LORD our God, and also with the future generations who are not standing here today.

verses.kjv_text: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.nlt_text: "You remember how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we traveled through the lands of enemy nations as we left.

verses.kjv_text: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which {were} among them:) {idols: Heb. dungy gods}
verses.nlt_text: You have seen their detestable practices and their idols made of wood, stone, silver, and gold.

verses.kjv_text: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go {and} serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood; {gall: or, a poisonous herb: Heb. rosh}
verses.nlt_text: I am making this covenant with you so that no one among you-- no man, woman, clan, or tribe-- will turn away from the LORD our God to worship these gods of other nations, and so that no root among you bears bitter and poisonous fruit.

verses.kjv_text: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst: {imagination: or, stubbornness} {drunkenness...: Heb. the drunken to the thirsty}
verses.nlt_text: "Those who hear the warnings of this curse should not congratulate themselves, thinking, 'I am safe, even though I am following the desires of my own stubborn heart.' This would lead to utter ruin!

verses.kjv_text: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will never pardon such people. Instead his anger and jealousy will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will come down on them, and the LORD will erase their names from under heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law: {are: Heb. is}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will separate them from all the tribes of Israel, to pour out on them all the curses of the covenant recorded in this Book of Instruction.

verses.kjv_text: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it; {which...: Heb. wherewith the LORD hath made it sick}
verses.nlt_text: "Then the generations to come, both your own descendants and the foreigners who come from distant lands, will see the devastation of the land and the diseases the LORD inflicts on it.

verses.kjv_text: {And that} the whole land thereof {is} brimstone, and salt, {and} burning, {that} it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.nlt_text: They will exclaim, 'The whole land is devastated by sulfur and salt. It is a wasteland with nothing planted and nothing growing, not even a blade of grass. It is like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD destroyed in his intense anger.'

verses.kjv_text: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what {meaneth} the heat of this great anger?
verses.nlt_text: "And all the surrounding nations will ask, 'Why has the LORD done this to this land? Why was he so angry?'

verses.kjv_text: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.nlt_text: "And the answer will be, 'This happened because the people of the land abandoned the covenant that the LORD, the God of their ancestors, made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and {whom} he had not given unto them: {whom he...: or, who had not given to them any portion} {given: Heb. divided}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, they turned away to serve and worship gods they had not known before, gods that were not from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.nlt_text: That is why the LORD's anger has burned against this land, bringing down on it every curse recorded in this book.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as {it is} this day.
verses.nlt_text: In great anger and fury the LORD uprooted his people from their land and banished them to another land, where they still live today!'

verses.kjv_text: The secret {things belong} unto the LORD our God: but those {things which are} revealed {belong} unto us and to our children for ever, that {we} may do all the words of this law.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD our God has secrets known to no one. We are not accountable for them, but we and our children are accountable forever for all that he has revealed to us, so that we may obey all the terms of these instructions.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call {them} to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.nlt_text: "In the future, when you experience all these blessings and curses I have listed for you, and when you are living among the nations to which the LORD your God has exiled you, take to heart all these instructions.

verses.kjv_text: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.nlt_text: If at that time you and your children return to the LORD your God, and if you obey with all your heart and all your soul all the commands I have given you today,

verses.kjv_text: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.nlt_text: then the LORD your God will restore your fortunes. He will have mercy on you and gather you back from all the nations where he has scattered you.

verses.kjv_text: If {any} of thine be driven out unto the outmost {parts} of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.nlt_text: Even though you are banished to the ends of the earth, the LORD your God will gather you from there and bring you back again.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD your God will return you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will possess that land again. Then he will make you even more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors!

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD your God will change your heart and the hearts of all your descendants, so that you will love him with all your heart and soul and so you may live!

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD your God will inflict all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate and persecute you.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will again obey the LORD and keep all his commands that I am giving you today.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD your God will then make you successful in everything you do. He will give you many children and numerous livestock, and he will cause your fields to produce abundant harvests, for the LORD will again delight in being good to you as he was to your ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, {and} if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD your God will delight in you if you obey his voice and keep the commands and decrees written in this Book of Instruction, and if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and soul.

verses.kjv_text: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it {is} not hidden from thee, neither {is} it far off.
verses.nlt_text: "This command I am giving you today is not too difficult for you to understand, and it is not beyond your reach.

verses.kjv_text: It {is} not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.nlt_text: It is not kept in heaven, so distant that you must ask, 'Who will go up to heaven and bring it down so we can hear it and obey?'

verses.kjv_text: Neither {is} it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.nlt_text: It is not kept beyond the sea, so far away that you must ask, 'Who will cross the sea to bring it to us so we can hear it and obey?'

verses.kjv_text: But the word {is} very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.nlt_text: No, the message is very close at hand; it is on your lips and in your heart so that you can obey it.

verses.kjv_text: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.nlt_text: "Now listen! Today I am giving you a choice between life and death, between prosperity and disaster.

verses.kjv_text: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: For I command you this day to love the LORD your God and to keep his commands, decrees, and regulations by walking in his ways. If you do this, you will live and multiply, and the LORD your God will bless you and the land you are about to enter and occupy.

verses.kjv_text: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.nlt_text: "But if your heart turns away and you refuse to listen, and if you are drawn away to serve and worship other gods,

verses.kjv_text: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, {and that} ye shall not prolong {your} days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: then I warn you now that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live a long, good life in the land you are crossing the Jordan to occupy.

verses.kjv_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, {that} I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.nlt_text: "Today I have given you the choice between life and death, between blessings and curses. Now I call on heaven and earth to witness the choice you make. Oh, that you would choose life, so that you and your descendants might live!

verses.kjv_text: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, {and} that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he {is} thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.nlt_text: You can make this choice by loving the LORD your God, obeying him, and committing yourself firmly to him. This is the key to your life. And if you love and obey the LORD, you will live long in the land the LORD swore to give your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.nlt_text: When Moses had finished giving these instructions to all the people of Israel,

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, I {am} an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.nlt_text: he said, "I am now 120 years old, and I am no longer able to lead you. The LORD has told me, 'You will not cross the Jordan River.'

verses.kjv_text: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, {and} he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: {and} Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy the nations living there, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua will lead you across the river, just as the LORD promised.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD will destroy the nations living in the land, just as he destroyed Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will hand over to you the people who live there, and you must deal with them as I have commanded you.

verses.kjv_text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he {it is} that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.nlt_text: So be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid and do not panic before them. For the LORD your God will personally go ahead of you. He will neither fail you nor abandon you."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses called for Joshua, and as all Israel watched, he said to him, "Be strong and courageous! For you will lead these people into the land that the LORD swore to their ancestors he would give them. You are the one who will divide it among them as their grants of land.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD, he {it is} that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.nlt_text: Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD will personally go ahead of you. He will be with you; he will neither fail you nor abandon you."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses wrote this entire body of instruction in a book and gave it to the priests, who carried the Ark of the LORD's Covenant, and to the elders of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of {every} seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses gave them this command: "At the end of every seventh year, the Year of Release, during the Festival of Shelters,

verses.kjv_text: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.nlt_text: you must read this Book of Instruction to all the people of Israel when they assemble before the LORD your God at the place he chooses.

verses.kjv_text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that {is} within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.nlt_text: Call them all together-- men, women, children, and the foreigners living in your towns-- so they may hear this Book of Instruction and learn to fear the LORD your God and carefully obey all the terms of these instructions.

verses.kjv_text: And {that} their children, which have not known {any thing}, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: Do this so that your children who have not known these instructions will hear them and will learn to fear the LORD your God. Do this as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to occupy."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The time has come for you to die. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tabernacle, so that I may commission him there." So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD appeared to them in a pillar of cloud that stood at the entrance to the sacred tent.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go {to be} among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them. {sleep: Heb. lie down}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to Moses, "You are about to die and join your ancestors. After you are gone, these people will begin to worship foreign gods, the gods of the land where they are going. They will abandon me and break my covenant that I have made with them.

verses.kjv_text: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God {is} not among us? {befall: Heb. find}
verses.nlt_text: Then my anger will blaze forth against them. I will abandon them, hiding my face from them, and they will be devoured. Terrible trouble will come down on them, and on that day they will say, 'These disasters have come down on us because God is no longer among us!'

verses.kjv_text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.nlt_text: At that time I will hide my face from them on account of all the evil they commit by worshiping other gods.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "So write down the words of this song, and teach it to the people of Israel. Help them learn it, so it may serve as a witness for me against them.

verses.kjv_text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.nlt_text: For I will bring them into the land I swore to give their ancestors-- a land flowing with milk and honey. There they will become prosperous, eat all the food they want, and become fat. But they will begin to worship other gods; they will despise me and break my covenant.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware. {against: Heb. before} {go...: Heb. do}
verses.nlt_text: And when great disasters come down on them, this song will stand as evidence against them, for it will never be forgotten by their descendants. I know the intentions of these people, even now before they have entered the land I swore to give them."

verses.kjv_text: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So that very day Moses wrote down the words of the song and taught it to the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun with these words: "Be strong and courageous, for you must bring the people of Israel into the land I swore to give them. I will be with you."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.nlt_text: When Moses had finished writing this entire body of instruction in a book,

verses.kjv_text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
verses.nlt_text: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the Ark of the LORD's Covenant:

verses.kjv_text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Take this Book of Instruction and place it beside the Ark of the Covenant of the LORD your God, so it may remain there as a witness against the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
verses.nlt_text: For I know how rebellious and stubborn you are. Even now, while I am still alive and am here with you, you have rebelled against the LORD. How much more rebellious will you be after my death!

verses.kjv_text: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.nlt_text: "Now summon all the elders and officials of your tribes, so that I can speak to them directly and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

verses.kjv_text: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt {yourselves}, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.nlt_text: I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and will turn from the way I have commanded you to follow. In the days to come, disaster will come down on you, for you will do what is evil in the LORD's sight, making him very angry with your actions."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses recited this entire song publicly to the assembly of Israel:

verses.kjv_text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: "Listen, O heavens, and I will speak! Hear, O earth, the words that I say!

verses.kjv_text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.nlt_text: Let my teaching fall on you like rain; let my speech settle like dew. Let my words fall like rain on tender grass, like gentle showers on young plants.

verses.kjv_text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.nlt_text: I will proclaim the name of the LORD; how glorious is our God!

verses.kjv_text: {He is} the Rock, his work {is} perfect: for all his ways {are} judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right {is} he.
verses.nlt_text: He is the Rock; his deeds are perfect. Everything he does is just and fair. He is a faithful God who does no wrong; how just and upright he is!

verses.kjv_text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot {is} not {the spot} of his children: {they are} a perverse and crooked generation. {They have...: Heb. He hath corrupted to himself} {their...: or, that they are not his children, that is their blot}
verses.nlt_text: "But they have acted corruptly toward him; when they act so perversely, are they really his children? They are a deceitful and twisted generation.

verses.kjv_text: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? {is} not he thy father {that} hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.nlt_text: Is this the way you repay the LORD, you foolish and senseless people? Isn't he your Father who created you? Has he not made you and established you?

verses.kjv_text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee. {many...: Heb. generation and generation}
verses.nlt_text: Remember the days of long ago; think about the generations past. Ask your father, and he will inform you. Inquire of your elders, and they will tell you.

verses.kjv_text: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: When the Most High assigned lands to the nations, when he divided up the human race, he established the boundaries of the peoples according to the number in his heavenly court.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD'S portion {is} his people; Jacob {is} the lot of his inheritance. {lot: Heb. cord}
verses.nlt_text: "For the people of Israel belong to the LORD; Jacob is his special possession.

verses.kjv_text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye. {led: or, compassed}
verses.nlt_text: He found them in a desert land, in an empty, howling wasteland. He surrounded them and watched over them; he guarded them as he would guard his own eyes.

verses.kjv_text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.nlt_text: Like an eagle that rouses her chicks and hovers over her young, so he spread his wings to take them up and carried them safely on his pinions.

verses.kjv_text: {So} the LORD alone did lead him, and {there was} no strange god with him.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD alone guided them; they followed no foreign gods.

verses.kjv_text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.nlt_text: He let them ride over the highlands and feast on the crops of the fields. He nourished them with honey from the rock and olive oil from the stony ground.

verses.kjv_text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.nlt_text: He fed them yogurt from the herd and milk from the flock, together with the fat of lambs. He gave them choice rams from Bashan, and goats, together with the choicest wheat. You drank the finest wine, made from the juice of grapes.

verses.kjv_text: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered {with fatness}; then he forsook God {which} made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.nlt_text: "But Israel soon became fat and unruly; the people grew heavy, plump, and stuffed! Then they abandoned the God who had made them; they made light of the Rock of their salvation.

verses.kjv_text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange {gods}, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.nlt_text: They stirred up his jealousy by worshiping foreign gods; they provoked his fury with detestable deeds.

verses.kjv_text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new {gods that} came newly up, whom your fathers feared not. {not to...: or, which were not God}
verses.nlt_text: They offered sacrifices to demons, which are not God, to gods they had not known before, to new gods only recently arrived, to gods their ancestors had never feared.

verses.kjv_text: Of the Rock {that} begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.nlt_text: You neglected the Rock who had fathered you; you forgot the God who had given you birth.

verses.kjv_text: And when the LORD saw {it}, he abhorred {them}, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters. {abhorred: or, despised}
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD saw this and drew back, provoked to anger by his own sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end {shall be}: for they {are} a very froward generation, children in whom {is} no faith.
verses.nlt_text: He said, 'I will abandon them; then see what becomes of them. For they are a twisted generation, children without integrity.

verses.kjv_text: They have moved me to jealousy with {that which is} not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with {those which are} not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.nlt_text: They have roused my jealousy by worshiping things that are not God; they have provoked my anger with their useless idols. Now I will rouse their jealousy through people who are not even a people; I will provoke their anger through the foolish Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains. {shall burn: or, hath burned} {shall consume: or, hath consumed}
verses.nlt_text: For my anger blazes forth like fire and burns to the depths of the grave. It devours the earth and all its crops and ignites the foundations of the mountains.

verses.kjv_text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.nlt_text: I will heap disasters upon them and shoot them down with my arrows.

verses.kjv_text: {They shall be} burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust. {heat: Heb. coals}
verses.nlt_text: I will weaken them with famine, burning fever, and deadly disease. I will send the fangs of wild beasts and poisonous snakes that glide in the dust.

verses.kjv_text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling {also} with the man of gray hairs. {within: Heb. from the chambers} {destroy: Heb. bereave}
verses.nlt_text: Outside, the sword will bring death, and inside, terror will strike both young men and young women, both infants and the aged.

verses.kjv_text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.nlt_text: I would have annihilated them, wiping out even the memory of them.

verses.kjv_text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, {and} lest they should say, Our hand {is} high, and the LORD hath not done all this. {Our...: or, Our high hand, and not the LORD hath done}
verses.nlt_text: But I feared the taunt of Israel's enemy, who might misunderstand and say, "Our own power has triumphed! The LORD had nothing to do with this!"'

verses.kjv_text: For they {are} a nation void of counsel, neither {is there any} understanding in them.
verses.nlt_text: "But Israel is a senseless nation; the people are foolish, without understanding.

verses.kjv_text: O that they were wise, {that} they understood this, {that} they would consider their latter end!
verses.nlt_text: Oh, that they were wise and could understand this! Oh, that they might know their fate!

verses.kjv_text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.nlt_text: How could one person chase a thousand of them, and two people put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?

verses.kjv_text: For their rock {is} not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves {being} judges.
verses.nlt_text: But the rock of our enemies is not like our Rock, as even they recognize.

verses.kjv_text: For their vine {is} of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes {are} grapes of gall, their clusters {are} bitter: {of the vine: or, worse than the vine}
verses.nlt_text: Their vine grows from the vine of Sodom, from the vineyards of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison, and their clusters are bitter.

verses.kjv_text: Their wine {is} the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.nlt_text: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.

verses.kjv_text: {Is} not this laid up in store with me, {and} sealed up among my treasures?
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD says, 'Am I not storing up these things, sealing them away in my treasury?

verses.kjv_text: To me {belongeth} vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in {due} time: for the day of their calamity {is} at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.nlt_text: I will take revenge; I will pay them back. In due time their feet will slip. Their day of disaster will arrive, and their destiny will overtake them.'

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that {their} power is gone, and {there is} none shut up, or left. {power: Heb. hand}
verses.nlt_text: "Indeed, the LORD will give justice to his people, and he will change his mind about his servants, when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall say, Where {are} their gods, {their} rock in whom they trusted,
verses.nlt_text: Then he will ask, 'Where are their gods, the rocks they fled to for refuge?

verses.kjv_text: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, {and} drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, {and} be your protection. {your...: Heb. an hiding for you}
verses.nlt_text: Where now are those gods, who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their offerings? Let those gods arise and help you! Let them provide you with shelter!

verses.kjv_text: See now that I, {even} I, {am} he, and {there is} no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither {is there any} that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.nlt_text: Look now; I myself am he! There is no other god but me! I am the one who kills and gives life; I am the one who wounds and heals; no one can be rescued from my powerful hand!

verses.kjv_text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Now I raise my hand to heaven and declare, "As surely as I live,

verses.kjv_text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.nlt_text: when I sharpen my flashing sword and begin to carry out justice, I will take revenge on my enemies and repay those who reject me.

verses.kjv_text: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; {and that} with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.nlt_text: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword will devour flesh-- the blood of the slaughtered and the captives, and the heads of the enemy leaders."'

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice, O ye nations, {with} his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, {and} to his people. {Rejoice...: or, Praise his people, ye nations: or, Sing ye}
verses.nlt_text: "Rejoice with him, you heavens, and let all of God's angels worship him. Rejoice with his people, you nations, and let all the angels be strengthened in him. For he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take revenge against his enemies. He will repay those who hate him and cleanse the land for his people."

verses.kjv_text: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun. {Hoshea: or, Joshua}
verses.nlt_text: So Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song to the people.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.nlt_text: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to the people of Israel,

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.nlt_text: he added: "Take to heart all the words of warning I have given you today. Pass them on as a command to your children so they will obey every word of these instructions.

verses.kjv_text: For it {is} not a vain thing for you; because it {is} your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong {your} days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: These instructions are not empty words-- they are your life! By obeying them you will enjoy a long life in the land you will occupy when you cross the Jordan River."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.nlt_text: That same day the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv_text: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, {unto} mount Nebo, which {is} in the land of Moab, that {is} over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.nlt_text: "Go to Moab, to the mountains east of the river, and climb Mount Nebo, which is across from Jericho. Look out across the land of Canaan, the land I am giving to the people of Israel as their own special possession.

verses.kjv_text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.nlt_text: Then you will die there on the mountain. You will join your ancestors, just as Aaron, your brother, died on Mount Hor and joined his ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel. {Meribah-Kadesh: or, strife at Kadesh}
verses.nlt_text: For both of you betrayed me with the Israelites at the waters of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin. You failed to demonstrate my holiness to the people of Israel there.

verses.kjv_text: Yet thou shalt see the land before {thee}; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So you will see the land from a distance, but you may not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.nlt_text: This is the blessing that Moses, the man of God, gave to the people of Israel before his death:

verses.kjv_text: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand {went} a fiery law for them. {a fiery...: Heb. a fire of law}
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD came from Mount Sinai and dawned upon us from Mount Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran and came from Meribah-kadesh with flaming fire at his right hand.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints {are} in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; {every one} shall receive of thy words.
verses.nlt_text: Indeed, he loves his people; all his holy ones are in his hands. They follow in his steps and accept his teaching.

verses.kjv_text: Moses commanded us a law, {even} the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: Moses gave us the LORD's instruction, the special possession of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people {and} the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD became king in Israel-- when the leaders of the people assembled, when the tribes of Israel gathered as one."

verses.kjv_text: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let {not} his men be few.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Reuben: "Let the tribe of Reuben live and not die out, though they are few in number."

verses.kjv_text: And this {is the blessing} of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help {to him} from his enemies.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Judah: "O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring them together as a people. Give them strength to defend their cause; help them against their enemies!"

verses.kjv_text: And of Levi he said, {Let} thy Thummim and thy Urim {be} with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, {and with} whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Levi: "O LORD, you have given your Thummim and Urim-- the sacred lots-- to your faithful servants the Levites. You put them to the test at Massah and struggled with them at the waters of Meribah.

verses.kjv_text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.nlt_text: The Levites obeyed your word and guarded your covenant. They were more loyal to you than to their own parents. They ignored their relatives and did not acknowledge their own children.

verses.kjv_text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar. {They shall teach: or, Let them teach} {they shall put: or, let them put} {before...: Heb. at thy nose}
verses.nlt_text: They teach your regulations to Jacob; they give your instructions to Israel. They present incense before you and offer whole burnt offerings on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.nlt_text: Bless the ministry of the Levites, O LORD, and accept all the work of their hands. Hit their enemies where it hurts the most; strike down their foes so they never rise again."

verses.kjv_text: {And} of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; {and the LORD} shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Benjamin: "The people of Benjamin are loved by the LORD and live in safety beside him. He surrounds them continuously and preserves them from every harm."

verses.kjv_text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD {be} his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribes of Joseph: "May their land be blessed by the LORD with the precious gift of dew from the heavens and water from beneath the earth;

verses.kjv_text: And for the precious fruits {brought forth} by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon, {put: Heb. thrust} {moon: Heb. moons}
verses.nlt_text: with the rich fruit that grows in the sun, and the rich harvest produced each month;

verses.kjv_text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.nlt_text: with the finest crops of the ancient mountains, and the abundance from the everlasting hills;

verses.kjv_text: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and {for} the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let {the blessing} come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him {that was} separated from his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: with the best gifts of the earth and its bounty, and the favor of the one who appeared in the burning bush. May these blessings rest on Joseph's head, crowning the brow of the prince among his brothers.

verses.kjv_text: His glory {is like} the firstling of his bullock, and his horns {are like} the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they {are} the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they {are} the thousands of Manasseh. {unicorns: Heb. an unicorn}
verses.nlt_text: Joseph has the majesty of a young bull; he has the horns of a wild ox. He will gore distant nations, driving them to the ends of the earth. This is my blessing for the multitudes of Ephraim and the thousands of Manasseh."

verses.kjv_text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribes of Zebulun and Issachar: "May the people of Zebulun prosper in their travels. May the people of Issachar prosper at home in their tents.

verses.kjv_text: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck {of} the abundance of the seas, and {of} treasures hid in the sand.
verses.nlt_text: They summon the people to the mountain to offer proper sacrifices there. They benefit from the riches of the sea and the hidden treasures in the sand."

verses.kjv_text: And of Gad he said, Blessed {be} he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Gad: "Blessed is the one who enlarges Gad's territory! Gad is poised there like a lion to tear off an arm or a head.

verses.kjv_text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, {in} a portion of the lawgiver, {was he} seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel. {seated: Heb. cieled}
verses.nlt_text: The people of Gad took the best land for themselves; a leader's share was assigned to them. When the leaders of the people were assembled, they carried out the LORD's justice and obeyed his regulations for Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And of Dan he said, Dan {is} a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Dan: "Dan is a lion's cub, leaping out from Bashan."

verses.kjv_text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Naphtali: "O Naphtali, you are rich in favor and full of the LORD's blessings; may you possess the west and the south."

verses.kjv_text: And of Asher he said, {Let} Asher {be} blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said this about the tribe of Asher: "May Asher be blessed above other sons; may he be esteemed by his brothers; may he bathe his feet in olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: Thy shoes {shall be} iron and brass; and as thy days, {so shall} thy strength {be}. {Thy shoes: or, Under thy shoes}
verses.nlt_text: May the bolts of your gates be of iron and bronze; may you be secure all your days."

verses.kjv_text: {There is} none like unto the God of Jeshurun, {who} rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.nlt_text: "There is no one like the God of Israel. He rides across the heavens to help you, across the skies in majestic splendor.

verses.kjv_text: The eternal God {is thy} refuge, and underneath {are} the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy {them}.
verses.nlt_text: The eternal God is your refuge, and his everlasting arms are under you. He drives out the enemy before you; he cries out, 'Destroy them!'

verses.kjv_text: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob {shall be} upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.nlt_text: So Israel will live in safety, prosperous Jacob in security, in a land of grain and new wine, while the heavens drop down dew.

verses.kjv_text: Happy {art} thou, O Israel: who {is} like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who {is} the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places. {found...: or, subdued}
verses.nlt_text: How blessed you are, O Israel! Who else is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is your protecting shield and your triumphant sword! Your enemies will cringe before you, and you will stomp on their backs!"

verses.kjv_text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that {is} over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan, {Pisgah: or, the hill}
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses went up to Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab and climbed Pisgah Peak, which is across from Jericho. And the LORD showed him the whole land, from Gilead as far as Dan;

verses.kjv_text: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
verses.nlt_text: all the land of Naphtali; the land of Ephraim and Manasseh; all the land of Judah, extending to the Mediterranean Sea;

verses.kjv_text: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.nlt_text: the Negev; the Jordan Valley with Jericho-- the city of palms-- as far as Zoar.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, This {is} the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see {it} with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, 'I will give it to your descendants.' I have now allowed you to see it with your own eyes, but you will not enter the land."

verses.kjv_text: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So Moses, the servant of the LORD, died there in the land of Moab, just as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv_text: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD buried him in a valley near Beth-peor in Moab, but to this day no one knows the exact place.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses {was} an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated. {natural...: Heb. moisture} {abated: Heb. fled}
verses.nlt_text: Moses was 120 years old when he died, yet his eyesight was clear, and he was as strong as ever.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping {and} mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel mourned for Moses on the plains of Moab for thirty days, until the customary period of mourning was over.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Now Joshua son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. So the people of Israel obeyed him, doing just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.nlt_text: There has never been another prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face.

verses.kjv_text: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD sent him to perform all the miraculous signs and wonders in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, and all his servants, and his entire land.

verses.kjv_text: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.nlt_text: With mighty power, Moses performed terrifying acts in the sight of all Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,
verses.nlt_text: After the death of Moses the LORD's servant, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses' assistant. He said,

verses.kjv_text: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, {even} to the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "Moses my servant is dead. Therefore, the time has come for you to lead these people, the Israelites, across the Jordan River into the land I am giving them.

verses.kjv_text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
verses.nlt_text: I promise you what I promised Moses: 'Wherever you set foot, you will be on land I have given you--

verses.kjv_text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
verses.nlt_text: from the Negev wilderness in the south to the Lebanon mountains in the north, from the Euphrates River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west, including all the land of the Hittites.'

verses.kjv_text: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, {so} I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.nlt_text: No one will be able to stand against you as long as you live. For I will be with you as I was with Moses. I will not fail you or abandon you.

verses.kjv_text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them. {unto this...: or, thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land, etc}
verses.nlt_text: "Be strong and courageous, for you are the one who will lead these people to possess all the land I swore to their ancestors I would give them.

verses.kjv_text: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it {to} the right hand or {to} the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest. {prosper: or, do wisely}
verses.nlt_text: Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the instructions Moses gave you. Do not deviate from them, turning either to the right or to the left. Then you will be successful in everything you do.

verses.kjv_text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success. {have...: or, do wisely}
verses.nlt_text: Study this Book of Instruction continually. Meditate on it day and night so you will be sure to obey everything written in it. Only then will you prosper and succeed in all you do.

verses.kjv_text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God {is} with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.nlt_text: This is my command-- be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged. For the LORD your God is with you wherever you go."

verses.kjv_text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Joshua then commanded the officers of Israel,

verses.kjv_text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
verses.nlt_text: "Go through the camp and tell the people to get their provisions ready. In three days you will cross the Jordan River and take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you."

verses.kjv_text: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua called together the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. He told them,

verses.kjv_text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
verses.nlt_text: "Remember what Moses, the servant of the LORD, commanded you: 'The LORD your God is giving you a place of rest. He has given you this land.'

verses.kjv_text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them; {armed: Heb. marshalled by five}
verses.nlt_text: Your wives, children, and livestock may remain here in the land Moses assigned to you on the east side of the Jordan River. But your strong warriors, fully armed, must lead the other tribes across the Jordan to help them conquer their territory. Stay with them

verses.kjv_text: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as {he hath given} you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD'S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.nlt_text: until the LORD gives them rest, as he has given you rest, and until they, too, possess the land the LORD your God is giving them. Only then may you return and settle here on the east side of the Jordan River in the land that Moses, the servant of the LORD, assigned to you."

verses.kjv_text: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
verses.nlt_text: They answered Joshua, "We will do whatever you command us, and we will go wherever you send us.

verses.kjv_text: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
verses.nlt_text: We will obey you just as we obeyed Moses. And may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever {he be} that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who rebels against your orders and does not obey your words and everything you command will be put to death. So be strong and courageous!"

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there. {sent: or, had sent} {lodged: Heb. lay}
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua secretly sent out two spies from the Israelite camp at Acacia Grove. He instructed them, "Scout out the land on the other side of the Jordan River, especially around Jericho." So the two men set out and came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there that night.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
verses.nlt_text: But someone told the king of Jericho, "Some Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
verses.nlt_text: So the king of Jericho sent orders to Rahab: "Bring out the men who have come into your house, for they have come here to spy out the whole land."

verses.kjv_text: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they {were}:
verses.nlt_text: Rahab had hidden the two men, but she replied, "Yes, the men were here earlier, but I didn't know where they were from.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass {about the time} of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
verses.nlt_text: They left the town at dusk, as the gates were about to close. I don't know where they went. If you hurry, you can probably catch up with them."

verses.kjv_text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
verses.nlt_text: (Actually, she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them beneath bundles of flax she had laid out.)

verses.kjv_text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
