verses.kjv_text: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that {were} therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.nlt_text: There, too, the LORD gave them the town and its king. He killed everyone in it, leaving no survivors. Then Joshua killed the king of Libnah as he had killed the king of Jericho.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.nlt_text: From Libnah, Joshua and the Israelites went to Lachish and attacked it.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that {were} therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.nlt_text: Here again, the LORD gave them Lachish. Joshua took it on the second day and killed everyone in it, just as he had done at Libnah.

verses.kjv_text: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.nlt_text: During the attack on Lachish, King Horam of Gezer arrived with his army to help defend the town. But Joshua's men killed him and his army, leaving no survivors.

verses.kjv_text: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua and the Israelite army went on to Eglon and attacked it.

verses.kjv_text: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that {were} therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.nlt_text: They captured it that day and killed everyone in it. He completely destroyed everyone, just as he had done at Lachish.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.nlt_text: From Eglon, Joshua and the Israelite army went up to Hebron and attacked it.

verses.kjv_text: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that {were} therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that {were} therein.
verses.nlt_text: They captured the town and killed everyone in it, including its king, leaving no survivors. They did the same thing to all of its surrounding villages. And just as he had done at Eglon, he completely destroyed the entire population.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua and the Israelites turned back and attacked Debir.

verses.kjv_text: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that {were} therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.nlt_text: He captured the town, its king, and all of its surrounding villages. He completely destroyed everyone in it, leaving no survivors. He did to Debir and its king just what he had done to Hebron and to Libnah and its king.

verses.kjv_text: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.
verses.nlt_text: So Joshua conquered the whole region-- the kings and people of the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills, and the mountain slopes. He completely destroyed everyone in the land, leaving no survivors, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.nlt_text: Joshua slaughtered them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza and from the region around the town of Goshen up to Gibeon.

verses.kjv_text: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Joshua conquered all these kings and their land in a single campaign, for the LORD, the God of Israel, was fighting for his people.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard {those things}, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.nlt_text: When King Jabin of Hazor heard what had happened, he sent messages to the following kings: King Jobab of Madon; the king of Shimron; the king of Acshaph;

verses.kjv_text: And to the kings that {were} on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
verses.nlt_text: all the kings of the northern hill country; the kings in the Jordan Valley south of Galilee; the kings in the Galilean foothills; the kings of Naphoth-dor on the west;

verses.kjv_text: {And to} the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and {to} the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and {to} the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.nlt_text: the kings of Canaan, both east and west; the kings of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites in the hill country, and the Hivites in the towns on the slopes of Mount Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

verses.kjv_text: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that {is} upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.nlt_text: All these kings came out to fight. Their combined armies formed a vast horde. And with all their horses and chariots, they covered the landscape like the sand on the seashore.

verses.kjv_text: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel. {met...: Heb. assembled by appointment}
verses.nlt_text: The kings joined forces and established their camp around the water near Merom to fight against Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them. By this time tomorrow I will hand all of them over to Israel as dead men. Then you must cripple their horses and burn their chariots."

verses.kjv_text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
verses.nlt_text: So Joshua and all his fighting men traveled to the water near Merom and attacked suddenly.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining. {great Zidon: or, Zidonrabbah} {Misrephothmaim: or, Salt pits: Heb. Burnings of waters}
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD gave them victory over their enemies. The Israelites chased them as far as Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward into the valley of Mizpah, until not one enemy warrior was left alive.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua crippled the horses and burned all the chariots, as the LORD had instructed.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.nlt_text: Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor and killed its king. (Hazor had at one time been the capital of all these kingdoms.)

verses.kjv_text: And they smote all the souls that {were} therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying {them}: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire. {any...: Heb. any breath}
verses.nlt_text: The Israelites completely destroyed every living thing in the city, leaving no survivors. Not a single person was spared. And then Joshua burned the city.

verses.kjv_text: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, {and} he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
verses.nlt_text: Joshua slaughtered all the other kings and their people, completely destroying them, just as Moses, the servant of the LORD, had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: But {as for} the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; {that} did Joshua burn. {in their...: Heb. on their heap}
verses.nlt_text: But the Israelites did not burn any of the towns built on mounds except Hazor, which Joshua burned.

verses.kjv_text: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
verses.nlt_text: And the Israelites took all the plunder and livestock of the ravaged towns for themselves. But they killed all the people, leaving no survivors.

verses.kjv_text: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses. {left...: Heb. removed nothing}
verses.nlt_text: As the LORD had commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. And Joshua did as he was told, carefully obeying all the commands that the LORD had given to Moses.

verses.kjv_text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
verses.nlt_text: So Joshua conquered the entire region-- the hill country, the entire Negev, the whole area around the town of Goshen, the western foothills, the Jordan Valley, the mountains of Israel, and the Galilean foothills.

verses.kjv_text: {Even} from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them. {the mount...: or, the smooth mountain}
verses.nlt_text: The Israelite territory now extended all the way from Mount Halak, which leads up to Seir in the south, as far north as Baal-gad at the foot of Mount Hermon in the valley of Lebanon. Joshua killed all the kings of those territories,

verses.kjv_text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.nlt_text: waging war for a long time to accomplish this.

verses.kjv_text: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all {other} they took in battle.
verses.nlt_text: No one in this region made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites of Gibeon. All the others were defeated.

verses.kjv_text: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, {and} that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD hardened their hearts and caused them to fight the Israelites. So they were completely destroyed without mercy, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
verses.nlt_text: During this period Joshua destroyed all the descendants of Anak, who lived in the hill country of Hebron, Debir, Anab, and the entire hill country of Judah and Israel. He killed them all and completely destroyed their towns.

verses.kjv_text: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
verses.nlt_text: None of the descendants of Anak were left in all the land of Israel, though some still remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

verses.kjv_text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.nlt_text: So Joshua took control of the entire land, just as the LORD had instructed Moses. He gave it to the people of Israel as their special possession, dividing the land among the tribes. So the land finally had rest from war.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
verses.nlt_text: These are the kings east of the Jordan River who had been killed by the Israelites and whose land was taken. Their territory extended from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon and included all the land east of the Jordan Valley.

verses.kjv_text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, {and} ruled from Aroer, which {is} upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, {which is} the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.nlt_text: King Sihon of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, was defeated. His kingdom included Aroer, on the edge of the Arnon Gorge, and extended from the middle of the Arnon Gorge to the Jabbok River, which serves as a border for the Ammonites. This territory included the southern half of the territory of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, {even} the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah: {the south: or, Teman} {Ashdothpisgah: or, the springs of Pisgah, or, the hill}
verses.nlt_text: Sihon also controlled the Jordan Valley and regions to the east-- from as far north as the Sea of Galilee to as far south as the Dead Sea, including the road to Beth-jeshimoth and southward to the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.kjv_text: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, {which was} of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.nlt_text: King Og of Bashan, the last of the Rephaites, lived at Ashtaroth and Edrei.

verses.kjv_text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.nlt_text: He ruled a territory stretching from Mount Hermon to Salecah in the north and to all of Bashan in the east, and westward to the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. This territory included the northern half of Gilead, as far as the boundary of King Sihon of Heshbon.

verses.kjv_text: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it {for} a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.nlt_text: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had destroyed the people of King Sihon and King Og. And Moses gave their land as a possession to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel {for} a possession according to their divisions;
verses.nlt_text: The following is a list of the kings that Joshua and the Israelite armies defeated on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which leads up to Seir. (Joshua gave this land to the tribes of Israel as their possession,

verses.kjv_text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.nlt_text: including the hill country, the western foothills, the Jordan Valley, the mountain slopes, the Judean wilderness, and the Negev. The people who lived in this region were the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.) These are the kings Israel defeated:

verses.kjv_text: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which {is} beside Bethel, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Jericho The king of Ai, near Bethel

verses.kjv_text: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Jerusalem The king of Hebron

verses.kjv_text: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Jarmuth The king of Lachish

verses.kjv_text: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Eglon The king of Gezer

verses.kjv_text: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Debir The king of Geder

verses.kjv_text: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Hormah The king of Arad

verses.kjv_text: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Libnah The king of Adullam

verses.kjv_text: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Makkedah The king of Bethel

verses.kjv_text: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Tappuah The king of Hepher

verses.kjv_text: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one; {Lasharon: or, Sharon}
verses.nlt_text: The king of Aphek The king of Lasharon

verses.kjv_text: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Madon The king of Hazor

verses.kjv_text: The king of Shimronmeron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Shimron-meron The king of Acshaph

verses.kjv_text: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Taanach The king of Megiddo

verses.kjv_text: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Kedesh The king of Jokneam in Carmel

verses.kjv_text: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
verses.nlt_text: The king of Dor in the town of Naphoth-dor The king of Goyim in Gilgal

verses.kjv_text: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
verses.nlt_text: The king of Tirzah. In all, thirty-one kings were defeated.

verses.kjv_text: Now Joshua was old {and} stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old {and} stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed. {to...: Heb. to possess it}
verses.nlt_text: When Joshua was an old man, the LORD said to him, "You are growing old, and much land remains to be conquered.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
verses.nlt_text: This is the territory that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and the Geshurites,

verses.kjv_text: From Sihor, which {is} before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, {which} is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
verses.nlt_text: and the larger territory of the Canaanites, extending from the stream of Shihor on the border of Egypt, northward to the boundary of Ekron. It includes the territory of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron. The land of the Avvites

verses.kjv_text: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that {is} beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites: {Mearah: or, the cave}
verses.nlt_text: in the south also remains to be conquered. In the north, the following area has not yet been conquered: all the land of the Canaanites, including Mearah (which belongs to the Sidonians), stretching northward to Aphek on the border of the Amorites;

verses.kjv_text: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.nlt_text: the land of the Gebalites and all of the Lebanon mountain area to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath;

verses.kjv_text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, {and} all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.nlt_text: and all the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, including all the land of the Sidonians."I myself will drive these people out of the land ahead of the Israelites. So be sure to give this land to Israel as a special possession, just as I have commanded you.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.nlt_text: Include all this territory as Israel's possession when you divide this land among the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh."

verses.kjv_text: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, {even} as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
verses.nlt_text: Half the tribe of Manasseh and the tribes of Reuben and Gad had already received their grants of land on the east side of the Jordan, for Moses, the servant of the LORD, had previously assigned this land to them.

verses.kjv_text: From Aroer, that {is} upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that {is} in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.nlt_text: Their territory extended from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Gorge (including the town in the middle of the gorge) to the plain beyond Medeba, as far as Dibon.

verses.kjv_text: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.nlt_text: It also included all the towns of King Sihon of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon, and extended as far as the borders of Ammon.

verses.kjv_text: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.nlt_text: It included Gilead, the territory of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah, all of Mount Hermon, all of Bashan as far as Salecah,

verses.kjv_text: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.nlt_text: and all the territory of King Og of Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. King Og was the last of the Rephaites, for Moses had attacked them and driven them out.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.nlt_text: But the Israelites failed to drive out the people of Geshur and Maacah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.

verses.kjv_text: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire {are} their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Moses did not assign any allotment of land to the tribe of Levi. Instead, as the LORD had promised them, their allotment came from the offerings burned on the altar to the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben {inheritance} according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: Moses had assigned the following area to the clans of the tribe of Reuben.

verses.kjv_text: And their coast was from Aroer, that {is} on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that {is} in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.nlt_text: Their territory extended from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Gorge (including the town in the middle of the gorge) to the plain beyond Medeba.

verses.kjv_text: Heshbon, and all her cities that {are} in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon, {Bamothbaal...: or, the high places of Baal, and house of Baalmeon}
verses.nlt_text: It included Heshbon and the other towns on the plain-- Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,

verses.kjv_text: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.nlt_text: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

verses.kjv_text: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.nlt_text: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill above the valley,

verses.kjv_text: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth, {Ashdothpisgah: or, springs of Pisgah, or, the hill}
verses.nlt_text: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth.

verses.kjv_text: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, {which were} dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.nlt_text: The land of Reuben also included all the towns of the plain and the entire kingdom of Sihon. Sihon was the Amorite king who had reigned in Heshbon and was killed by Moses along with the leaders of Midian-- Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba-- princes living in the region who were allied with Sihon.

verses.kjv_text: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them. {soothsayer: or, diviner}
verses.nlt_text: The Israelites had also killed Balaam son of Beor, who used magic to tell the future.

verses.kjv_text: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border {thereof}. This {was} the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.nlt_text: The Jordan River marked the western boundary for the tribe of Reuben. The towns and their surrounding villages in this area were given as a homeland to the clans of the tribe of Reuben.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave {inheritance} unto the tribe of Gad, {even} unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: Moses had assigned the following area to the clans of the tribe of Gad.

verses.kjv_text: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that {is} before Rabbah;
verses.nlt_text: Their territory included Jazer, all the towns of Gilead, and half of the land of Ammon, as far as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah.

verses.kjv_text: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.nlt_text: It extended from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to Lo-debar.

verses.kjv_text: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and {his} border, {even} unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.nlt_text: In the valley were Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, Zaphon, and the rest of the kingdom of King Sihon of Heshbon. The western boundary ran along the Jordan River, extended as far north as the tip of the Sea of Galilee, and then turned eastward.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The towns and their surrounding villages in this area were given as a homeland to the clans of the tribe of Gad.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses gave {inheritance} unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and {this} was {the possession} of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.nlt_text: Moses had assigned the following area to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv_text: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which {are} in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.nlt_text: Their territory extended from Mahanaim, including all of Bashan, all the former kingdom of King Og, and the sixty towns of Jair in Bashan.

verses.kjv_text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, {were pertaining} unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, {even} to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.nlt_text: It also included half of Gilead and King Og's royal cities of Ashtaroth and Edrei. All this was given to the clans of the descendants of Makir, who was Manasseh's son.

verses.kjv_text: These {are the countries} which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.nlt_text: These are the allotments Moses had made while he was on the plains of Moab, across the Jordan River, east of Jericho.

verses.kjv_text: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not {any} inheritance: the LORD God of Israel {was} their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.nlt_text: But Moses gave no allotment of land to the tribe of Levi, for the LORD, the God of Israel, had promised that he himself would be their allotment.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are the countries} which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
verses.nlt_text: The remaining tribes of Israel received land in Canaan as allotted by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the tribal leaders.

verses.kjv_text: By lot {was} their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and {for} the half tribe.
verses.nlt_text: These nine and a half tribes received their grants of land by means of sacred lots, in accordance with the LORD's command through Moses.

verses.kjv_text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
verses.nlt_text: Moses had already given a grant of land to the two and a half tribes on the east side of the Jordan River, but he had given the Levites no such allotment.

verses.kjv_text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell {in}, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Joseph had become two separate tribes-- Manasseh and Ephraim. And the Levites were given no land at all, only towns to live in with surrounding pasturelands for their livestock and all their possessions.

verses.kjv_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.nlt_text: So the land was distributed in strict accordance with the LORD's commands to Moses.

verses.kjv_text: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
verses.nlt_text: A delegation from the tribe of Judah, led by Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, came to Joshua at Gilgal. Caleb said to Joshua, "Remember what the LORD said to Moses, the man of God, about you and me when we were at Kadesh-barnea.

verses.kjv_text: Forty years old {was} I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as {it was} in mine heart.
verses.nlt_text: I was forty years old when Moses, the servant of the LORD, sent me from Kadesh-barnea to explore the land of Canaan. I returned and gave an honest report,

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.nlt_text: but my brothers who went with me frightened the people from entering the Promised Land. For my part, I wholeheartedly followed the LORD my God.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.nlt_text: So that day Moses solemnly promised me, 'The land of Canaan on which you were just walking will be your grant of land and that of your descendants forever, because you wholeheartedly followed the LORD my God.'

verses.kjv_text: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while {the children of} Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I {am} this day fourscore and five years old. {wandered: Heb. walked}
verses.nlt_text: "Now, as you can see, the LORD has kept me alive and well as he promised for all these forty-five years since Moses made this promise-- even while Israel wandered in the wilderness. Today I am eighty-five years old.

verses.kjv_text: As yet I {am as} strong this day as {I was} in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength {was} then, even so {is} my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.nlt_text: I am as strong now as I was when Moses sent me on that journey, and I can still travel and fight as well as I could then.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims {were} there, and {that} the cities {were} great {and} fenced: if so be the LORD {will be} with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
verses.nlt_text: So give me the hill country that the LORD promised me. You will remember that as scouts we found the descendants of Anak living there in great, walled towns. But if the LORD is with me, I will drive them out of the land, just as the LORD said."

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: So Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave Hebron to him as his portion of land.

verses.kjv_text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Hebron still belongs to the descendants of Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite because he wholeheartedly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the name of Hebron before {was} Kirjatharba; {which Arba was} a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.nlt_text: (Previously Hebron had been called Kiriath-arba. It had been named after Arba, a great hero of the descendants of Anak.)And the land had rest from war.

verses.kjv_text: {This} then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; {even} to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward {was} the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.nlt_text: The allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah reached southward to the border of Edom, as far south as the wilderness of Zin.

verses.kjv_text: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward: {bay: Heb. tongue}
verses.nlt_text: The southern boundary began at the south bay of the Dead Sea,

verses.kjv_text: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa: {Maalehacrebbim: or, the going up to Acrabbim}
verses.nlt_text: ran south of Scorpion Pass into the wilderness of Zin, and then went south of Kadesh-barnea to Hezron. Then it went up to Addar, where it turned toward Karka.

verses.kjv_text: {From thence} it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.nlt_text: From there it passed to Azmon until it finally reached the Brook of Egypt, which it followed to the Mediterranean Sea. This was their southern boundary.

verses.kjv_text: And the east border {was} the salt sea, {even} unto the end of Jordan. And {their} border in the north quarter {was} from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.nlt_text: The eastern boundary extended along the Dead Sea to the mouth of the Jordan River. The northern boundary began at the bay where the Jordan River empties into the Dead Sea,

verses.kjv_text: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.nlt_text: went up from there to Beth-hoglah, then proceeded north of Beth-arabah to the Stone of Bohan. (Bohan was Reuben's son.)

verses.kjv_text: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that {is} before the going up to Adummim, which {is} on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
verses.nlt_text: From that point it went through the valley of Achor to Debir, turning north toward Gilgal, which is across from the slopes of Adummim on the south side of the valley. From there the boundary extended to the springs at En-shemesh and on to En-rogel.

verses.kjv_text: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same {is} Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that {lieth} before the valley of Hinnom westward, which {is} at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.nlt_text: The boundary then passed through the valley of Ben-Hinnom, along the southern slopes of the Jebusites, where the city of Jerusalem is located. Then it went west to the top of the mountain above the valley of Hinnom, and on up to the northern end of the valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv_text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which {is} Kirjathjearim:
verses.nlt_text: From there the boundary extended from the top of the mountain to the spring at the waters of Nephtoah, and from there to the towns on Mount Ephron. Then it turned toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).

verses.kjv_text: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which {is} Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.nlt_text: The boundary circled west of Baalah to Mount Seir, passed along to the town of Kesalon on the northern slope of Mount Jearim, and went down to Beth-shemesh and on to Timnah.

verses.kjv_text: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.nlt_text: The boundary then proceeded to the slope of the hill north of Ekron, where it turned toward Shikkeron and Mount Baalah. It passed Jabneel and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And the west border {was} to the great sea, and the coast {thereof}. This {is} the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: The western boundary was the shoreline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries for the clans of the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, {even} the city of Arba the father of Anak, which {city is} Hebron. {the city...: or, Kirjatharba}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD commanded Joshua to assign some of Judah's territory to Caleb son of Jephunneh. So Caleb was given the town of Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), which had been named after Anak's ancestor.

verses.kjv_text: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.nlt_text: Caleb drove out the three groups of Anakites-- the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the sons of Anak.

verses.kjv_text: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before {was} Kirjathsepher.
verses.nlt_text: From there he went to fight against the people living in the town of Debir (formerly called Kiriath-sepher).

verses.kjv_text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.nlt_text: Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to the one who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher."

verses.kjv_text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.nlt_text: Othniel, the son of Caleb's brother Kenaz, was the one who conquered it, so Acsah became Othniel's wife.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as she came {unto him}, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off {her} ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.nlt_text: When Acsah married Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she got down off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What's the matter?"

verses.kjv_text: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.nlt_text: She said, "Give me another gift. You have already given me land in the Negev; now please give me springs of water, too." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: This was the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.nlt_text: The towns of Judah situated along the borders of Edom in the extreme south were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

verses.kjv_text: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.nlt_text: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

verses.kjv_text: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.nlt_text: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

verses.kjv_text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.nlt_text: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

verses.kjv_text: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, {and} Hezron, which {is} Hazor,
verses.nlt_text: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),

verses.kjv_text: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.nlt_text: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

verses.kjv_text: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
verses.nlt_text: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,

verses.kjv_text: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.nlt_text: Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

verses.kjv_text: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.nlt_text: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

verses.kjv_text: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.nlt_text: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,

verses.kjv_text: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.nlt_text: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

verses.kjv_text: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities {are} twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon-- twenty-nine towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: {And} in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.nlt_text: The following towns situated in the western foothills were also given to Judah: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

verses.kjv_text: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.nlt_text: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

verses.kjv_text: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.nlt_text: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

verses.kjv_text: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages: {and Gederothaim: or, or Gederothaim}
verses.nlt_text: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim-- fourteen towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
verses.nlt_text: Also included were Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,

verses.kjv_text: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.nlt_text: Dilean, Mizpeh, Joktheel,

verses.kjv_text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.nlt_text: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

verses.kjv_text: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.nlt_text: Cabbon, Lahmam, Kitlish,

verses.kjv_text: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah-- sixteen towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.nlt_text: Besides these, there were Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

verses.kjv_text: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.nlt_text: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

verses.kjv_text: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Keilah, Aczib, and Mareshah-- nine towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.nlt_text: The territory of the tribe of Judah also included Ekron and its surrounding settlements and villages.

verses.kjv_text: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that {lay} near Ashdod, with their villages: {near: Heb. by the place of}
verses.nlt_text: From Ekron the boundary extended west and included the towns near Ashdod with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border {thereof}:
verses.nlt_text: It also included Ashdod with its surrounding settlements and villages and Gaza with its settlements and villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt and along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.nlt_text: Judah also received the following towns in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

verses.kjv_text: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which {is} Debir,
verses.nlt_text: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),

verses.kjv_text: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.nlt_text: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

verses.kjv_text: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh-- eleven towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.nlt_text: Also included were the towns of Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

verses.kjv_text: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah, {Janum: or, Janus}
verses.nlt_text: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,

verses.kjv_text: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which {is} Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior-- nine towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
verses.nlt_text: Besides these, there were Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

verses.kjv_text: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.nlt_text: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

verses.kjv_text: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah-- ten towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
verses.nlt_text: In addition, there were Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,

verses.kjv_text: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon-- six towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Kirjathbaal, which {is} Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: There were also Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim) and Rabbah-- two towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.nlt_text: In the wilderness there were the towns of Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,

verses.kjv_text: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi-- six towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: But the tribe of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites, who lived in the city of Jerusalem, so the Jebusites live there among the people of Judah to this day.

verses.kjv_text: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel, {fell: Heb. went forth}
verses.nlt_text: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan River near Jericho, east of the springs of Jericho, through the wilderness and into the hill country of Bethel.

verses.kjv_text: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
verses.nlt_text: From Bethel (that is, Luz) it ran over to Ataroth in the territory of the Arkites.

verses.kjv_text: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
verses.nlt_text: Then it descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer and over to the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.kjv_text: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: This was the homeland allocated to the families of Joseph's sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was {thus}: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
verses.nlt_text: The following territory was given to the clans of the tribe of Ephraim. The boundary of their homeland began at Ataroth-addar in the east. From there it ran to Upper Beth-horon,

verses.kjv_text: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.nlt_text: then on to the Mediterranean Sea. From Micmethath on the north, the boundary curved eastward past Taanath-shiloh to the east of Janoah.

verses.kjv_text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
verses.nlt_text: From Janoah it turned southward to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho, and ended at the Jordan River.

verses.kjv_text: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.nlt_text: From Tappuah the boundary extended westward, following the Kanah Ravine to the Mediterranean Sea. This is the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim {were} among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: In addition, some towns with their surrounding villages in the territory allocated to the half-tribe of Manasseh were set aside for the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
verses.nlt_text: They did not drive the Canaanites out of Gezer, however, so the people of Gezer live as slaves among the people of Ephraim to this day.

verses.kjv_text: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he {was} the firstborn of Joseph; {to wit}, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.nlt_text: The next allotment of land was given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, the descendants of Joseph's older son. Makir, the firstborn son of Manasseh, was the father of Gilead. Because his descendants were experienced soldiers, the regions of Gilead and Bashan on the east side of the Jordan had already been given to them.

verses.kjv_text: There was also {a lot} for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these {were} the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families. {Abiezer: also called, Jeezer}
verses.nlt_text: So the allotment on the west side of the Jordan was for the remaining families within the clans of the tribe of Manasseh: Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These clans represent the male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these {are} the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.nlt_text: However, Zelophehad, a descendant of Hepher son of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, had no sons. He had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.kjv_text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.nlt_text: These women came to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the Israelite leaders and said, "The LORD commanded Moses to give us a grant of land along with the men of our tribe." So Joshua gave them a grant of land along with their uncles, as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which {were} on the other side Jordan;
verses.nlt_text: As a result, Manasseh's total allocation came to ten parcels of land, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan across the Jordan River,

verses.kjv_text: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: because the female descendants of Manasseh received a grant of land along with the male descendants. (The land of Gilead was given to the rest of the male descendants of Manasseh.)

verses.kjv_text: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that {lieth} before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
verses.nlt_text: The boundary of the tribe of Manasseh extended from the border of Asher to Micmethath, near Shechem. Then the boundary went south from Micmethath to the settlement near the spring of Tappuah.

verses.kjv_text: {Now} Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh {belonged} to the children of Ephraim;
verses.nlt_text: The land surrounding Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town of Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh's territory, belonged to the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim {are} among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also {was} on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea: {river Kanah: or, brook of reeds}
verses.nlt_text: From the spring of Tappuah, the boundary of Manasseh followed the Kanah Ravine to the Mediterranean Sea. Several towns south of the ravine were inside Manasseh's territory, but they actually belonged to the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: Southward {it was} Ephraim's, and northward {it was} Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.nlt_text: In general, however, the land south of the ravine belonged to Ephraim, and the land north of the ravine belonged to Manasseh. Manasseh's boundary ran along the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. North of Manasseh was the territory of Asher, and to the east was the territory of Issachar.

verses.kjv_text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, {even} three countries.
verses.nlt_text: The following towns within the territory of Issachar and Asher, however, were given to Manasseh: Beth-shan, Ibleam, Dor (that is, Naphoth-dor), Endor, Taanach, and Megiddo, each with their surrounding settlements.

verses.kjv_text: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out {the inhabitants of} those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.nlt_text: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these towns. They could not drive out the Canaanites who continued to live there.

verses.kjv_text: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.nlt_text: Later, however, when the Israelites became strong enough, they forced the Canaanites to work as slaves. But they did not drive them out of the land.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me {but} one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I {am} a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Joseph came to Joshua and asked, "Why have you given us only one portion of land as our homeland when the LORD has blessed us with so many people?"

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua answered them, If thou {be} a great people, {then} get thee up to the wood {country}, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee. {giants: or, Rephaims}
verses.nlt_text: Joshua replied, "If there are so many of you, and if the hill country of Ephraim is not large enough for you, clear out land for yourselves in the forest where the Perizzites and Rephaites live."

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, {both they} who {are} of Bethshean and her towns, and {they} who {are} of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Joseph responded, "It's true that the hill country is not large enough for us. But all the Canaanites in the lowlands have iron chariots, both those in Beth-shan and its surrounding settlements and those in the valley of Jezreel. They are too strong for us."

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, {even} to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou {art} a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot {only}:
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua said to the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh, the descendants of Joseph, "Since you are so large and strong, you will be given more than one portion.

verses.kjv_text: But the mountain shall be thine; for it {is} a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, {and} though they {be} strong.
verses.nlt_text: The forests of the hill country will be yours as well. Clear as much of the land as you wish, and take possession of its farthest corners. And you will drive out the Canaanites from the valleys, too, even though they are strong and have iron chariots."

verses.kjv_text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.nlt_text: Now that the land was under Israelite control, the entire community of Israel gathered at Shiloh and set up the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: But there remained seven tribes who had not yet been allotted their grants of land.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long {are} ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.nlt_text: Then Joshua asked them, "How long are you going to wait before taking possession of the remaining land the LORD, the God of your ancestors, has given to you?

verses.kjv_text: Give out from among you three men for {each} tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come {again} to me.
verses.nlt_text: Select three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to explore the land and map it out. They will then return to me with a written report of their proposed divisions of their new homeland.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.nlt_text: Let them divide the land into seven sections, excluding Judah's territory in the south and Joseph's territory in the north.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall therefore describe the land {into} seven parts, and bring {the description} hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
verses.nlt_text: And when you record the seven divisions of the land and bring them to me, I will cast sacred lots in the presence of the LORD our God to assign land to each tribe.

verses.kjv_text: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD {is} their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
verses.nlt_text: "The Levites, however, will not receive any allotment of land. Their role as priests of the LORD is their allotment. And the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh won't receive any more land, for they have already received their grant of land, which Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave them on the east side of the Jordan River."

verses.kjv_text: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
verses.nlt_text: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua commanded them, "Go and explore the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will assign the land to the tribes by casting sacred lots here in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh."

verses.kjv_text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came {again} to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.nlt_text: The men did as they were told and mapped the entire territory into seven sections, listing the towns in each section. They made a written record and then returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

verses.kjv_text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.nlt_text: And there at Shiloh, Joshua cast sacred lots in the presence of the LORD to determine which tribe should have each section.

verses.kjv_text: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.nlt_text: The first allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. It lay between the territory assigned to the tribes of Judah and Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
verses.nlt_text: The northern boundary of Benjamin's land began at the Jordan River, went north of the slope of Jericho, then west through the hill country and the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.kjv_text: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which {is} Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that {lieth} on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
verses.nlt_text: From there the boundary went south to Luz (that is, Bethel) and proceeded down to Ataroth-addar on the hill that lies south of Lower Beth-horon.

verses.kjv_text: And the border was drawn {thence}, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that {lieth} before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which {is} Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this {was} the west quarter.
verses.nlt_text: The boundary then made a turn and swung south along the western edge of the hill facing Beth-horon, ending at the village of Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a town belonging to the tribe of Judah. This was the western boundary.

verses.kjv_text: And the south quarter {was} from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.nlt_text: The southern boundary began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim. From that western point it ran to the spring at the waters of Nephtoah,

verses.kjv_text: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that {lieth} before the valley of the son of Hinnom, {and} which {is} in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
verses.nlt_text: and down to the base of the mountain beside the valley of Ben-Hinnom, at the northern end of the valley of Rephaim. From there it went down the valley of Hinnom, crossing south of the slope where the Jebusites lived, and continued down to En-rogel.

verses.kjv_text: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which {is} over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.nlt_text: From En-rogel the boundary proceeded in a northerly direction and came to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth (which is across from the slopes of Adummim). Then it went down to the Stone of Bohan. (Bohan was Reuben's son.)

verses.kjv_text: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah: {Arabah: or, the plain}
verses.nlt_text: From there it passed along the north side of the slope overlooking the Jordan Valley. The border then went down into the valley,

verses.kjv_text: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this {was} the south coast. {bay: Heb. tongue}
verses.nlt_text: ran past the north slope of Beth-hoglah, and ended at the north bay of the Dead Sea, which is the southern end of the Jordan River. This was the southern boundary.

verses.kjv_text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This {was} the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: The eastern boundary was the Jordan River. These were the boundaries of the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.nlt_text: These were the towns given to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,

verses.kjv_text: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
verses.nlt_text: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

verses.kjv_text: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.nlt_text: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

verses.kjv_text: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Kephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba-- twelve towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.nlt_text: Also Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

verses.kjv_text: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.nlt_text: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,

verses.kjv_text: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.nlt_text: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

verses.kjv_text: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which {is} Jerusalem, Gibeath, {and} Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This {is} the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim-- fourteen towns with their surrounding villages. This was the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, {even} for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.nlt_text: The second allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Simeon. Their homeland was surrounded by Judah's territory.

verses.kjv_text: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.nlt_text: Simeon's homeland included Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,

verses.kjv_text: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.nlt_text: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,

verses.kjv_text: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.nlt_text: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

verses.kjv_text: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
verses.nlt_text: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,

verses.kjv_text: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.nlt_text: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen-- thirteen towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.nlt_text: It also included Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan-- four towns with their villages,

verses.kjv_text: And all the villages that {were} round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: including all the surrounding villages as far south as Baalath-beer (also known as Ramah of the Negev). This was the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Simeon.

verses.kjv_text: Out of the portion of the children of Judah {was} the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
verses.nlt_text: Their allocation of land came from part of what had been given to Judah because Judah's territory was too large for them. So the tribe of Simeon received an allocation within the territory of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
verses.nlt_text: The third allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Zebulun. The boundary of Zebulun's homeland started at Sarid.

verses.kjv_text: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that {is} before Jokneam;
verses.nlt_text: From there it went west, going past Maralah, touching Dabbesheth, and proceeding to the brook east of Jokneam.

verses.kjv_text: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
verses.nlt_text: In the other direction, the boundary went east from Sarid to the border of Kisloth-tabor, and from there to Daberath and up to Japhia.

verses.kjv_text: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah; {methoar: or, which is drawn}
verses.nlt_text: Then it continued east to Gath-hepher, Eth-kazin, and Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

verses.kjv_text: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
verses.nlt_text: The northern boundary of Zebulun passed Hannathon and ended at the valley of Iphtah-el.

verses.kjv_text: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The towns in these areas included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem-- twelve towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Zebulun included these towns and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: {And} the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: The fourth allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Issachar.

verses.kjv_text: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.nlt_text: Its boundaries included the following towns: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,

verses.kjv_text: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
verses.nlt_text: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

verses.kjv_text: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.nlt_text: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

verses.kjv_text: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
verses.nlt_text: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

verses.kjv_text: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The boundary also touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, ending at the Jordan River-- sixteen towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Issachar included these towns and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: The fifth allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Asher.

verses.kjv_text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.nlt_text: Its boundaries included these towns: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,

verses.kjv_text: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
verses.nlt_text: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. The boundary on the west touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath,

verses.kjv_text: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.nlt_text: then it turned east toward Beth-dagon, and ran as far as Zebulun in the valley of Iphtah-el, going north to Beth-emek and Neiel. It then continued north to Cabul,

verses.kjv_text: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, {even} unto great Zidon;
verses.nlt_text: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far as Greater Sidon.

verses.kjv_text: And {then} the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib: {Tyre: Heb. Tzor}
verses.nlt_text: Then the boundary turned toward Ramah and the fortified city of Tyre, where it turned toward Hosah and came to the Mediterranean Sea. The territory also included Mehebel, Aczib,

verses.kjv_text: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob-- twenty-two towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Asher included these towns and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, {even} for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: The sixth allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Naphtali.

verses.kjv_text: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
verses.nlt_text: Its boundary ran from Heleph, from the oak at Zaanannim, and extended across to Adami-nekeb, Jabneel, and as far as Lakkum, ending at the Jordan River.

verses.kjv_text: And {then} the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.nlt_text: The western boundary ran past Aznoth-tabor, then to Hukkok, and touched the border of Zebulun in the south, the border of Asher on the west, and the Jordan River on the east.

verses.kjv_text: And the fenced cities {are} Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.nlt_text: The fortified towns included in this territory were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,

verses.kjv_text: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.nlt_text: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

verses.kjv_text: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
verses.nlt_text: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,

verses.kjv_text: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.nlt_text: Yiron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh-- nineteen towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.nlt_text: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Naphtali included these towns and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv_text: {And} the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.nlt_text: The seventh allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Dan.

verses.kjv_text: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
verses.nlt_text: The land allocated as their homeland included the following towns: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,

verses.kjv_text: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.nlt_text: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

verses.kjv_text: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.nlt_text: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

verses.kjv_text: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.nlt_text: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

verses.kjv_text: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
verses.nlt_text: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
