verses.kjv_text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.nlt_text: For this, O LORD, I will praise you among the nations; I will sing praises to your name.

verses.kjv_text: {He is} the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.nlt_text: You give great victories to your king; you show unfailing love to your anointed, to David and all his descendants forever."

verses.kjv_text: Now these {be} the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man {who was} raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
verses.nlt_text: These are the last words of David: "David, the son of Jesse, speaks-- David, the man who was raised up so high, David, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, David, the sweet psalmist of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word {was} in my tongue.
verses.nlt_text: "The Spirit of the LORD speaks through me; his words are upon my tongue.

verses.kjv_text: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men {must be} just, ruling in the fear of God. {He...: or, Be thou ruler, etc}
verses.nlt_text: The God of Israel spoke. The Rock of Israel said to me: 'The one who rules righteously, who rules in the fear of God,

verses.kjv_text: And {he shall be} as the light of the morning, {when} the sun riseth, {even} a morning without clouds; {as} the tender grass {springing} out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.nlt_text: is like the light of morning at sunrise, like a morning without clouds, like the gleaming of the sun on new grass after rain.'

verses.kjv_text: Although my house {be} not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all {things}, and sure: for {this is} all my salvation, and all {my} desire, although he make {it} not to grow.
verses.nlt_text: "Is it not my family God has chosen? Yes, he has made an everlasting covenant with me. His agreement is arranged and guaranteed in every detail. He will ensure my safety and success.

verses.kjv_text: But {the sons} of Belial {shall be} all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.nlt_text: But the godless are like thorns to be thrown away, for they tear the hand that touches them.

verses.kjv_text: But the man {that} shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the {same} place. {fenced: Heb. filled}
verses.nlt_text: One must use iron tools to chop them down; they will be totally consumed by fire."

verses.kjv_text: These {be} the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same {was} Adino the Eznite: {he lift up his spear} against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time. {The Tachmonite...: or, Joshebbassebet the Tachmonite, head of the three} {whom he...: Heb. slain} {he lift...: from (1ch:) whom he...: Heb. slain}
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of David's mightiest warriors. The first was Jashobeam the Hacmonite, who was leader of the Three-- the three mightiest warriors among David's men. He once used his spear to kill 800 enemy warriors in a single battle.

verses.kjv_text: And after him {was} Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, {one} of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines {that} were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
verses.nlt_text: Next in rank among the Three was Eleazar son of Dodai, a descendant of Ahoah. Once Eleazar and David stood together against the Philistines when the entire Israelite army had fled.

verses.kjv_text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.nlt_text: He killed Philistines until his hand was too tired to lift his sword, and the LORD gave him a great victory that day. The rest of the army did not return until it was time to collect the plunder!

verses.kjv_text: And after him {was} Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines. {into...: or, for foraging}
verses.nlt_text: Next in rank was Shammah son of Agee from Harar. One time the Philistines gathered at Lehi and attacked the Israelites in a field full of lentils. The Israelite army fled,

verses.kjv_text: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
verses.nlt_text: but Shammah held his ground in the middle of the field and beat back the Philistines. So the LORD brought about a great victory.

verses.kjv_text: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim. {three...: or, the three captains over the thirty}
verses.nlt_text: Once during the harvest, when David was at the cave of Adullam, the Philistine army was camped in the valley of Rephaim. The Three (who were among the Thirty-- an elite group among David's fighting men) went down to meet him there.

verses.kjv_text: And David {was} then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines {was} then {in} Bethlehem.
verses.nlt_text: David was staying in the stronghold at the time, and a Philistine detachment had occupied the town of Bethlehem.

verses.kjv_text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which {is} by the gate!
verses.nlt_text: David remarked longingly to his men, "Oh, how I would love some of that good water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem."

verses.kjv_text: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that {was} by the gate, and took {it}, and brought {it} to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew some water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: {is not this} the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD forbid that I should drink this!" he exclaimed. "This water is as precious as the blood of these men who risked their lives to bring it to me." So David did not drink it. These are examples of the exploits of the Three.

verses.kjv_text: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, {and} slew {them}, and had the name among three. {and slew them: Heb. slain}
verses.nlt_text: Abishai son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab, was the leader of the Thirty. He once used his spear to kill 300 enemy warriors in a single battle. It was by such feats that he became as famous as the Three.

verses.kjv_text: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the {first} three.
verses.nlt_text: Abishai was the most famous of the Thirty and was their commander, though he was not one of the Three.

verses.kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow: {who...: Heb. great of acts} {lionlike...: Heb. lion of God}
verses.nlt_text: There was also Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant warrior from Kabzeel. He did many heroic deeds, which included killing two champions of Moab. Another time, on a snowy day, he chased a lion down into a pit and killed it.

verses.kjv_text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear. {a goodly...: Heb. a man of countenance, or, sight: also called, a man of great stature}
verses.nlt_text: Once, armed only with a club, he killed a great Egyptian warrior who was armed with a spear. Benaiah wrenched the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed him with it.

verses.kjv_text: These {things} did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.nlt_text: Deeds like these made Benaiah as famous as the Three mightiest warriors.

verses.kjv_text: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the {first} three. And David set him over his guard. {more...: or, honourable among the thirty} {guard: or, council: Heb. at his command}
verses.nlt_text: He was more honored than the other members of the Thirty, though he was not one of the Three. And David made him captain of his bodyguard.

verses.kjv_text: Asahel the brother of Joab {was} one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.nlt_text: Other members of the Thirty included: Asahel, Joab's brother; Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem;

verses.kjv_text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.nlt_text: Shammah from Harod; Elika from Harod;

verses.kjv_text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.nlt_text: Helez from Pelon; Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa;

verses.kjv_text: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.nlt_text: Abiezer from Anathoth; Sibbecai from Hushah;

verses.kjv_text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.nlt_text: Zalmon from Ahoah; Maharai from Netophah;

verses.kjv_text: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.nlt_text: Heled son of Baanah from Netophah; Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah (in the land of Benjamin);

verses.kjv_text: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash, {brooks: or, valleys}
verses.nlt_text: Benaiah from Pirathon; Hurai from Nahale-gaash;

verses.kjv_text: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.nlt_text: Abi-albon from Arabah; Azmaveth from Bahurim;

verses.kjv_text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.nlt_text: Eliahba from Shaalbon; the sons of Jashen;

verses.kjv_text: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.nlt_text: Jonathan son of Shagee from Harar; Ahiam son of Sharar from Harar;

verses.kjv_text: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.nlt_text: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai from Maacah; Eliam son of Ahithophel from Giloh;

verses.kjv_text: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.nlt_text: Hezro from Carmel; Paarai from Arba;

verses.kjv_text: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.nlt_text: Igal son of Nathan from Zobah; Bani from Gad;

verses.kjv_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.nlt_text: Zelek from Ammon; Naharai from Beeroth, Joab's armor bearer;

verses.kjv_text: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.nlt_text: Ira from Jattir; Gareb from Jattir;

verses.kjv_text: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.nlt_text: Uriah the Hittite. There were thirty-seven in all.

verses.kjv_text: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
verses.nlt_text: Once again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and he caused David to harm them by taking a census. "Go and count the people of Israel and Judah," the LORD told him.

verses.kjv_text: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which {was} with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people. {Go: or, Compass}
verses.nlt_text: So the king said to Joab and the commanders of the army, "Take a census of all the tribes of Israel-- from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south-- so I may know how many people there are."

verses.kjv_text: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see {it}: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.nlt_text: But Joab replied to the king, "May the LORD your God let you live to see a hundred times as many people as there are now! But why, my lord the king, do you want to do this?"

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: But the king insisted that they take the census, so Joab and the commanders of the army went out to count the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that {lieth} in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer: {river: or, valley}
verses.nlt_text: First they crossed the Jordan and camped at Aroer, south of the town in the valley, in the direction of Gad. Then they went on to Jazzier,

verses.kjv_text: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon, {land of Tahtimhodshi: or, nether land newly inhabited}
verses.nlt_text: then to Gilead in the land of Tahtim-hodshi and to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon.

verses.kjv_text: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, {even} to Beersheba.
verses.nlt_text: Then they came to the stronghold of Tyre, and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went south to Judah as far as Beersheba.

verses.kjv_text: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.nlt_text: Having gone through the entire land for nine months and twenty days, they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah {were} five hundred thousand men.
verses.nlt_text: Joab reported the number of people to the king. There were 800,000 capable warriors in Israel who could handle a sword, and 500,000 in Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.nlt_text: But after he had taken the census, David's conscience began to bother him. And he said to the LORD, "I have sinned greatly by taking this census. Please forgive my guilt, LORD, for doing this foolish thing."

verses.kjv_text: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The next morning the word of the LORD came to the prophet Gad, who was David's seer. This was the message:

verses.kjv_text: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three {things}; choose thee one of them, that I may {do it} unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Go and say to David, 'This is what the LORD says: I will give you three choices. Choose one of these punishments, and I will inflict it on you.'"

verses.kjv_text: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: So Gad came to David and asked him, "Will you choose three years of famine throughout your land, three months of fleeing from your enemies, or three days of severe plague throughout your land? Think this over and decide what answer I should give the LORD who sent me."

verses.kjv_text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies {are} great: and let me not fall into the hand of man. {are great: or, are many}
verses.nlt_text: "I'm in a desperate situation!" David replied to Gad. "But let us fall into the hands of the LORD, for his mercy is great. Do not let me fall into human hands."

verses.kjv_text: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel that morning, and it lasted for three days. A total of 70,000 people died throughout the nation, from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south.

verses.kjv_text: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite. {Araunah: also called, Ornan}
verses.nlt_text: But as the angel was preparing to destroy Jerusalem, the LORD relented and said to the death angel, "Stop! That is enough!" At that moment the angel of the LORD was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.kjv_text: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
verses.nlt_text: When David saw the angel, he said to the LORD, "I am the one who has sinned and done wrong! But these people are as innocent as sheep-- what have they done? Let your anger fall against me and my family."

verses.kjv_text: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite. {Araunah: Heb. Araniah}
verses.nlt_text: That day Gad came to David and said to him, "Go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."

verses.kjv_text: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.
verses.nlt_text: So David went up to do what the LORD had commanded him.

verses.kjv_text: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
verses.nlt_text: When Araunah saw the king and his men coming toward him, he came and bowed before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.nlt_text: "Why have you come, my lord the king?" Araunah asked.David replied, "I have come to buy your threshing floor and to build an altar to the LORD there, so that he will stop the plague."

verses.kjv_text: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what {seemeth} good unto him: behold, {here be} oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and {other} instruments of the oxen for wood.
verses.nlt_text: "Take it, my lord the king, and use it as you wish," Araunah said to David. "Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and you can use the threshing boards and ox yokes for wood to build a fire on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: All these {things} did Araunah, {as} a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.
verses.nlt_text: I will give it all to you, Your Majesty, and may the LORD your God accept your sacrifice."

verses.kjv_text: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy {it} of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.nlt_text: But the king replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on buying it, for I will not present burnt offerings to the LORD my God that have cost me nothing." So David paid him fifty pieces of silver for the threshing floor and the oxen.

verses.kjv_text: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
verses.nlt_text: David built an altar there to the LORD and sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings. And the LORD answered his prayer for the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.

verses.kjv_text: Now king David was old {and} stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat. {stricken...: Heb. entered into days}
verses.nlt_text: King David was now very old, and no matter how many blankets covered him, he could not keep warm.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat. {Let there...: Heb. Let them seek} {a young...: Heb. a damsel, a virgin} {cherish...: Heb. be a cherisher unto him}
verses.nlt_text: So his advisers told him, "Let us find a young virgin to wait on you and look after you, my lord. She will lie in your arms and keep you warm."

verses.kjv_text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.nlt_text: So they searched throughout the land of Israel for a beautiful girl, and they found Abishag from Shunem and brought her to the king.

verses.kjv_text: And the damsel {was} very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.nlt_text: The girl was very beautiful, and she looked after the king and took care of him. But the king had no sexual relations with her.

verses.kjv_text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him. {be king: Heb. reign}
verses.nlt_text: About that time David's son Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, began boasting, "I will make myself king." So he provided himself with chariots and charioteers and recruited fifty men to run in front of him.

verses.kjv_text: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also {was a} very goodly {man}; and {his mother} bare him after Absalom. {at any...: Heb. from his days}
verses.nlt_text: Now his father, King David, had never disciplined him at any time, even by asking, "Why are you doing that?" Adonijah had been born next after Absalom, and he was very handsome.

verses.kjv_text: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped {him}. {he...: Heb. his words were with} {following...: Heb. helped after Adonijah}
verses.nlt_text: Adonijah took Joab son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest into his confidence, and they agreed to help him become king.

verses.kjv_text: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which {belonged} to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.nlt_text: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's personal bodyguard refused to support Adonijah.

verses.kjv_text: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which {is} by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants: {Enrogel: or, the well Rogel}
verses.nlt_text: Adonijah went to the Stone of Zoheleth near the spring of En-rogel, where he sacrificed sheep, cattle, and fattened calves. He invited all his brothers-- the other sons of King David-- and all the royal officials of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.nlt_text: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the king's bodyguard or his brother Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth {it} not?
verses.nlt_text: Then Nathan went to Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and asked her, "Haven't you heard that Haggith's son, Adonijah, has made himself king, and our lord David doesn't even know about it?

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: If you want to save your own life and the life of your son Solomon, follow my advice.

verses.kjv_text: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.nlt_text: Go at once to King David and say to him, 'My lord the king, didn't you make a vow and say to me, "Your son Solomon will surely be the next king and will sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?'

verses.kjv_text: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words. {confirm: Heb. fill up}
verses.nlt_text: And while you are still talking with him, I will come and confirm everything you have said."

verses.kjv_text: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.nlt_text: So Bathsheba went into the king's bedroom. (He was very old now, and Abishag was taking care of him.)

verses.kjv_text: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou? {What...: Heb. What to thee?}
verses.nlt_text: Bathsheba bowed down before the king."What can I do for you?" he asked her.

verses.kjv_text: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, {saying}, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.nlt_text: She replied, "My lord, you made a vow before the LORD your God when you said to me, 'Your son Solomon will surely be the next king and will sit on my throne.'

verses.kjv_text: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest {it} not:
verses.nlt_text: But instead, Adonijah has made himself king, and my lord the king does not even know about it.

verses.kjv_text: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.nlt_text: He has sacrificed many cattle, fattened calves, and sheep, and he has invited all the king's sons to attend the celebration. He also invited Abiathar the priest and Joab, the commander of the army. But he did not invite your servant Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel {are} upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.nlt_text: And now, my lord the king, all Israel is waiting for you to announce who will become king after you.

verses.kjv_text: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders. {offenders: Heb. sinners}
verses.nlt_text: If you do not act, my son Solomon and I will be treated as criminals as soon as my lord the king has died."

verses.kjv_text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.nlt_text: While she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet arrived.

verses.kjv_text: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.nlt_text: The king's officials told him, "Nathan the prophet is here to see you." Nathan went in and bowed before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.nlt_text: Nathan asked, "My lord the king, have you decided that Adonijah will be the next king and that he will sit on your throne?

verses.kjv_text: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah. {God...: Heb. Let king Adonijah live}
verses.nlt_text: Today he has sacrificed many cattle, fattened calves, and sheep, and he has invited all the king's sons to attend the celebration. He also invited the commanders of the army and Abiathar the priest. They are feasting and drinking with him and shouting, 'Long live King Adonijah!'

verses.kjv_text: But me, {even} me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.nlt_text: But he did not invite me or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or your servant Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed {it} unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.nlt_text: Has my lord the king really done this without letting any of his officials know who should be the next king?"

verses.kjv_text: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king. {into...: Heb. before the king}
verses.nlt_text: King David responded, "Call Bathsheba!" So she came back in and stood before the king.

verses.kjv_text: And the king sware, and said, {As} the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.nlt_text: And the king repeated his vow: "As surely as the LORD lives, who has rescued me from every danger,

verses.kjv_text: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.nlt_text: your son Solomon will be the next king and will sit on my throne this very day, just as I vowed to you before the LORD, the God of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: Then Bathsheba bowed with {her} face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Then Bathsheba bowed down with her face to the ground before the king and exclaimed, "May my lord King David live forever!"

verses.kjv_text: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.nlt_text: Then King David ordered, "Call Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada." When they came into the king's presence,

verses.kjv_text: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon: {mine...: Heb. which belongeth to me}
verses.nlt_text: the king said to them, "Take Solomon and my officials down to Gihon Spring. Solomon is to ride on my own mule.

verses.kjv_text: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet are to anoint him king over Israel. Blow the ram's horn and shout, 'Long live King Solomon!'

verses.kjv_text: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.nlt_text: Then escort him back here, and he will sit on my throne. He will succeed me as king, for I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and Judah."

verses.kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so {too}.
verses.nlt_text: "Amen!" Benaiah son of Jehoiada replied. "May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, decree that it happen.

verses.kjv_text: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.nlt_text: And may the LORD be with Solomon as he has been with you, my lord the king, and may he make Solomon's reign even greater than yours!"

verses.kjv_text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.nlt_text: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the king's bodyguard took Solomon down to Gihon Spring, with Solomon riding on King David's own mule.

verses.kjv_text: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: There Zadok the priest took the flask of olive oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon with the oil. Then they sounded the ram's horn and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"

verses.kjv_text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them. {pipes: or, flutes}
verses.nlt_text: And all the people followed Solomon into Jerusalem, playing flutes and shouting for joy. The celebration was so joyous and noisy that the earth shook with the sound.

verses.kjv_text: And Adonijah and all the guests that {were} with him heard {it} as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore {is this} noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.nlt_text: Adonijah and his guests heard the celebrating and shouting just as they were finishing their banquet. When Joab heard the sound of the ram's horn, he asked, "What's going on? Why is the city in such an uproar?"

verses.kjv_text: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou {art} a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.nlt_text: And while he was still speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. "Come in," Adonijah said to him, "for you are a good man. You must have good news."

verses.kjv_text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.nlt_text: "Not at all!" Jonathan replied. "Our lord King David has just declared Solomon king!

verses.kjv_text: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
verses.nlt_text: The king sent him down to Gihon Spring with Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, protected by the king's bodyguard. They had him ride on the king's own mule,

verses.kjv_text: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This {is} the noise that ye have heard.
verses.nlt_text: and Zadok and Nathan have anointed him at Gihon Spring as the new king. They have just returned, and the whole city is celebrating and rejoicing. That's what all the noise is about.

verses.kjv_text: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: What's more, Solomon is now sitting on the royal throne as king.

verses.kjv_text: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.nlt_text: And all the royal officials have gone to King David and congratulated him, saying, 'May your God make Solomon's fame even greater than your own, and may Solomon's reign be even greater than yours!' Then the king bowed his head in worship as he lay in his bed,

verses.kjv_text: And also thus said the king, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, which hath given {one} to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing {it}.
verses.nlt_text: and he said, 'Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, who today has chosen a successor to sit on my throne while I am still alive to see it.'"

verses.kjv_text: And all the guests that {were} with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.nlt_text: Then all of Adonijah's guests jumped up in panic from the banquet table and quickly scattered.

verses.kjv_text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Adonijah was afraid of Solomon, so he rushed to the sacred tent and grabbed onto the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.nlt_text: Word soon reached Solomon that Adonijah had seized the horns of the altar in fear, and that he was pleading, "Let King Solomon swear today that he will not kill me!"

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon replied, "If he proves himself to be loyal, not a hair on his head will be touched. But if he makes trouble, he will die."

verses.kjv_text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.nlt_text: So King Solomon summoned Adonijah, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed respectfully before King Solomon, who dismissed him, saying, "Go on home."

verses.kjv_text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.nlt_text: As the time of King David's death approached, he gave this charge to his son Solomon:

verses.kjv_text: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.nlt_text: "I am going where everyone on earth must someday go. Take courage and be a man.

verses.kjv_text: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself: {prosper: or, do wisely}
verses.nlt_text: Observe the requirements of the LORD your God, and follow all his ways. Keep the decrees, commands, regulations, and laws written in the Law of Moses so that you will be successful in all you do and wherever you go.

verses.kjv_text: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel. {fail...: Heb. be cut off from thee from the throne}
verses.nlt_text: If you do this, then the LORD will keep the promise he made to me. He told me, 'If your descendants live as they should and follow me faithfully with all their heart and soul, one of them will always sit on the throne of Israel.'

verses.kjv_text: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, {and} what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that {was} about his loins, and in his shoes that {were} on his feet. {shed: Heb. put}
verses.nlt_text: "And there is something else. You know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me when he murdered my two army commanders, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He pretended that it was an act of war, but it was done in a time of peace, staining his belt and sandals with innocent blood.

verses.kjv_text: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.nlt_text: Do with him what you think best, but don't let him grow old and go to his grave in peace.

verses.kjv_text: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.nlt_text: "Be kind to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead. Make them permanent guests at your table, for they took care of me when I fled from your brother Absalom.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, {thou hast} with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword. {grievous: Heb. strong}
verses.nlt_text: "And remember Shimei son of Gera, the man from Bahurim in Benjamin. He cursed me with a terrible curse as I was fleeing to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan River, I swore by the LORD that I would not kill him.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou {art} a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.nlt_text: But that oath does not make him innocent. You are a wise man, and you will know how to arrange a bloody death for him. "

verses.kjv_text: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.nlt_text: Then David died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David.

verses.kjv_text: And the days that David reigned over Israel {were} forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: David had reigned over Israel for forty years, seven of them in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon became king and sat on the throne of David his father, and his kingdom was firmly established.

verses.kjv_text: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.nlt_text: One day Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, came to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother. "Have you come with peaceful intentions?" she asked him."Yes," he said, "I come in peace.

verses.kjv_text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, I have a favor to ask of you." "What is it?" she asked.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and {that} all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "As you know, the kingdom was rightfully mine; all Israel wanted me to be the next king. But the tables were turned, and the kingdom went to my brother instead; for that is the way the LORD wanted it.

verses.kjv_text: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on. {deny...: Heb. turn not away my face}
verses.nlt_text: So now I have just one favor to ask of you. Please don't turn me down." "What is it?" she asked.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "Speak to King Solomon on my behalf, for I know he will do anything you request. Ask him to let me marry Abishag, the girl from Shunem."

verses.kjv_text: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.nlt_text: "All right," Bathsheba replied. "I will speak to the king for you."

verses.kjv_text: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.nlt_text: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak on Adonijah's behalf. The king rose from his throne to meet her, and he bowed down before her. When he sat down on his throne again, the king ordered that a throne be brought for his mother, and she sat at his right hand.

verses.kjv_text: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; {I pray thee}, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.nlt_text: "I have one small request to make of you," she said. "I hope you won't turn me down." "What is it, my mother?" he asked. "You know I won't refuse you."

verses.kjv_text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.nlt_text: "Then let your brother Adonijah marry Abishag, the girl from Shunem," she replied.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he {is} mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.nlt_text: "How can you possibly ask me to give Abishag to Adonijah?" King Solomon demanded. "You might as well ask me to give him the kingdom! You know that he is my older brother, and that he has Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah on his side."

verses.kjv_text: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.nlt_text: Then King Solomon made a vow before the LORD: "May God strike me and even kill me if Adonijah has not sealed his fate with this request.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore, {as} the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has confirmed me and placed me on the throne of my father, David; he has established my dynasty as he promised. So as surely as the LORD lives, Adonijah will die this very day!"

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.nlt_text: So King Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada to execute him, and Adonijah was put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou {art} worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted. {worthy...: Heb. a man of death}
verses.nlt_text: Then the king said to Abiathar the priest, "Go back to your home in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not kill you now, because you carried the Ark of the Sovereign LORD for David my father and you shared all his hardships."

verses.kjv_text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.nlt_text: So Solomon deposed Abiathar from his position as priest of the LORD, thereby fulfilling the prophecy the LORD had given at Shiloh concerning the descendants of Eli.

verses.kjv_text: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.nlt_text: Joab had not joined Absalom's earlier rebellion, but he had joined Adonijah's rebellion. So when Joab heard about Adonijah's death, he ran to the sacred tent of the LORD and grabbed onto the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, {he is} by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.nlt_text: When this was reported to King Solomon, he sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada to execute him.

verses.kjv_text: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.nlt_text: Benaiah went to the sacred tent of the LORD and said to Joab, "The king orders you to come out!" But Joab answered, "No, I will die here." So Benaiah returned to the king and told him what Joab had said.

verses.kjv_text: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.nlt_text: "Do as he said," the king replied. "Kill him there beside the altar and bury him. This will remove the guilt of Joab's senseless murders from me and from my father's family.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing {thereof, to wit}, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will repay him for the murders of two men who were more righteous and better than he. For my father knew nothing about the deaths of Abner son of Ner, commander of the army of Israel, and of Amasa son of Jether, commander of the army of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: May their blood be on Joab and his descendants forever, and may the LORD grant peace forever to David, his descendants, his dynasty, and his throne."

verses.kjv_text: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada returned to the sacred tent and killed Joab, and he was buried at his home in the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king appointed Benaiah to command the army in place of Joab, and he installed Zadok the priest to take the place of Abiathar.

verses.kjv_text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.nlt_text: The king then sent for Shimei and told him, "Build a house here in Jerusalem and live there. But don't step outside the city to go anywhere else.

verses.kjv_text: For it shall be, {that} on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.nlt_text: On the day you so much as cross the Kidron Valley, you will surely die; and your blood will be on your own head."

verses.kjv_text: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying {is} good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.nlt_text: Shimei replied, "Your sentence is fair; I will do whatever my lord the king commands." So Shimei lived in Jerusalem for a long time.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants {be} in Gath.
verses.nlt_text: But three years later two of Shimei's slaves ran away to King Achish son of Maacah of Gath. When Shimei learned where they were,

verses.kjv_text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.nlt_text: he saddled his donkey and went to Gath to search for them. When he found them, he brought them back to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon heard that Shimei had left Jerusalem and had gone to Gath and returned.

verses.kjv_text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word {that} I have heard {is} good.
verses.nlt_text: So the king sent for Shimei and demanded, "Didn't I make you swear by the LORD and warn you not to go anywhere else or you would surely die? And you replied, 'The sentence is fair; I will do as you say.'

verses.kjv_text: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.nlt_text: Then why haven't you kept your oath to the LORD and obeyed my command?"

verses.kjv_text: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.nlt_text: The king also said to Shimei, "You certainly remember all the wicked things you did to my father, David. May the LORD now bring that evil on your own head.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon {shall be} blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
verses.nlt_text: But may I, King Solomon, receive the LORD's blessings, and may one of David's descendants always sit on this throne in the presence of the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: Then, at the king's command, Benaiah son of Jehoiada took Shimei outside and killed him.So the kingdom was now firmly in Solomon's grip.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and married one of his daughters. He brought her to live in the City of David until he could finish building his palace and the Temple of the LORD and the wall around the city.

verses.kjv_text: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
verses.nlt_text: At that time the people of Israel sacrificed their offerings at local places of worship, for a temple honoring the name of the LORD had not yet been built.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon loved the LORD and followed all the decrees of his father, David, except that Solomon, too, offered sacrifices and burned incense at the local places of worship.

verses.kjv_text: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that {was} the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.nlt_text: The most important of these places of worship was at Gibeon, so the king went there and sacrificed 1,000 burnt offerings.

verses.kjv_text: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.nlt_text: That night the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream, and God said, "What do you want? Ask, and I will give it to you!"

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as {it is} this day. {mercy: or, bounty}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon replied, "You showed faithful love to your servant my father, David, because he was honest and true and faithful to you. And you have continued your faithful love to him today by giving him a son to sit on his throne.

verses.kjv_text: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I {am but} a little child: I know not {how} to go out or come in.
verses.nlt_text: "Now, O LORD my God, you have made me king instead of my father, David, but I am like a little child who doesn't know his way around.

verses.kjv_text: And thy servant {is} in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.nlt_text: And here I am in the midst of your own chosen people, a nation so great and numerous they cannot be counted!

verses.kjv_text: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people? {understanding: Heb. hearing}
verses.nlt_text: Give me an understanding heart so that I can govern your people well and know the difference between right and wrong. For who by himself is able to govern this great people of yours?"

verses.kjv_text: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.nlt_text: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for wisdom.

verses.kjv_text: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment; {long life: Heb. many days} {discern: Heb. hear}
verses.nlt_text: So God replied, "Because you have asked for wisdom in governing my people with justice and have not asked for a long life or wealth or the death of your enemies--

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: I will give you what you asked for! I will give you a wise and understanding heart such as no one else has had or ever will have!

verses.kjv_text: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days. {shall...: or, hath not been}
verses.nlt_text: And I will also give you what you did not ask for-- riches and fame! No other king in all the world will be compared to you for the rest of your life!

verses.kjv_text: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.nlt_text: And if you follow me and obey my decrees and my commands as your father, David, did, I will give you a long life."

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, {it was} a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon woke up and realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem and stood before the Ark of the LORD's Covenant, where he sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then he invited all his officials to a great banquet.

verses.kjv_text: Then came there two women, {that were} harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.nlt_text: Some time later two prostitutes came to the king to have an argument settled.

verses.kjv_text: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.nlt_text: "Please, my lord," one of them began, "this woman and I live in the same house. I gave birth to a baby while she was with me in the house.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we {were} together; {there was} no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.nlt_text: Three days later this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there were only two of us in the house.

verses.kjv_text: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.nlt_text: "But her baby died during the night when she rolled over on it.

verses.kjv_text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.nlt_text: Then she got up in the night and took my son from beside me while I was asleep. She laid her dead child in my arms and took mine to sleep beside her.

verses.kjv_text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.nlt_text: And in the morning when I tried to nurse my son, he was dead! But when I looked more closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn't my son at all."

verses.kjv_text: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living {is} my son, and the dead {is} thy son. And this said, No; but the dead {is} thy son, and the living {is} my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.nlt_text: Then the other woman interrupted, "It certainly was your son, and the living child is mine." "No," the first woman said, "the living child is mine, and the dead one is yours." And so they argued back and forth before the king.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the king, The one saith, This {is} my son that liveth, and thy son {is} the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son {is} the dead, and my son {is} the living.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king said, "Let's get the facts straight. Both of you claim the living child is yours, and each says that the dead one belongs to the other.

verses.kjv_text: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.nlt_text: All right, bring me a sword." So a sword was brought to the king.

verses.kjv_text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Cut the living child in two, and give half to one woman and half to the other!"

verses.kjv_text: Then spake the woman whose the living child {was} unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, {but} divide {it}. {yearned: Heb. were hot}
verses.nlt_text: Then the woman who was the real mother of the living child, and who loved him very much, cried out, "Oh no, my lord! Give her the child-- please do not kill him!" But the other woman said, "All right, he will be neither yours nor mine; divide him between us!"

verses.kjv_text: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she {is} the mother thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king said, "Do not kill the child, but give him to the woman who wants him to live, for she is his mother!"

verses.kjv_text: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God {was} in him, to do judgment. {in him: Heb. in the midst of him}
verses.nlt_text: When all Israel heard the king's decision, the people were in awe of the king, for they saw the wisdom God had given him for rendering justice.

verses.kjv_text: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.nlt_text: King Solomon now ruled over all Israel,

verses.kjv_text: And these {were} the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest, {priest: or, chief officer}
verses.nlt_text: and these were his high officials: Azariah son of Zadok was the priest.

verses.kjv_text: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder. {scribes: or, secretaries} {recorder: or, remembrancer}
verses.nlt_text: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, were court secretaries. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the royal historian.

verses.kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was} over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar {were} the priests:
verses.nlt_text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of the army. Zadok and Abiathar were priests.

verses.kjv_text: And Azariah the son of Nathan {was} over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan {was} principal officer, {and} the king's friend:
verses.nlt_text: Azariah son of Nathan was in charge of the district governors. Zabud son of Nathan, a priest, was a trusted adviser to the king.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahishar {was} over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda {was} over the tribute. {tribute: or, levy}
verses.nlt_text: Ahishar was manager of the palace property. Adoniram son of Abda was in charge of the labor force.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also had twelve district governors who were over all Israel. They were responsible for providing food for the king's household. Each of them arranged provisions for one month of the year.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim: {The son...: or, Benhur}
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of the twelve governors: Ben-hur, in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.kjv_text: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan: {The son...: or, Bendekar}
verses.nlt_text: Ben-deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elon-bethhanan.

verses.kjv_text: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him {pertained} Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher: {The son...: or, Benhesed}
verses.nlt_text: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth, including Socoh and all the land of Hepher.

verses.kjv_text: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife: {The son...: or, Benabinadab}
verses.nlt_text: Ben-abinadab, in all of Naphoth-dor. (He was married to Taphath, one of Solomon's daughters.)

verses.kjv_text: Baana the son of Ahilud; {to him pertained} Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which {is} by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, {even} unto {the place that is} beyond Jokneam:
verses.nlt_text: Baana son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, all of Beth-shan near Zarethan below Jezreel, and all the territory from Beth-shan to Abel-meholah and over to Jokmeam.

verses.kjv_text: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him {pertained} the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which {are} in Gilead; to him {also pertained} the region of Argob, which {is} in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars: {The son...: or, Bengeber}
verses.nlt_text: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead, including the Towns of Jair (named for Jair of the tribe of Manasseh) in Gilead, and in the Argob region of Bashan, including sixty large fortified towns with bronze bars on their gates.

verses.kjv_text: Ahinadab the son of Iddo {had} Mahanaim: {Mahanaim: or, to Mahanaim}
verses.nlt_text: Ahinadab son of Iddo, in Mahanaim.

verses.kjv_text: Ahimaaz {was} in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.nlt_text: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali. (He was married to Basemath, another of Solomon's daughters.)

verses.kjv_text: Baanah the son of Hushai {was} in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.nlt_text: Baana son of Hushai, in Asher and in Aloth.

verses.kjv_text: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.nlt_text: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah, in Issachar.

verses.kjv_text: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.nlt_text: Shimei son of Ela, in Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: Geber the son of Uri {was} in the country of Gilead, {in} the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and {he was} the only officer which {was} in the land.
verses.nlt_text: Geber son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, including the territories of King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. There was also one governor over the land of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: Judah and Israel {were} many, as the sand which {is} by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They were very contented, with plenty to eat and drink.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of the Philistines and the border of Egypt in the south. The conquered peoples of those lands sent tribute money to Solomon and continued to serve him throughout his lifetime.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal, {provision: Heb. bread} {measures: Heb. cors}
verses.nlt_text: The daily food requirements for Solomon's palace were 150 bushels of choice flour and 300 bushels of meal;

verses.kjv_text: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.nlt_text: also 10 oxen from the fattening pens, 20 pasture-fed cattle, 100 sheep or goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roe deer, and choice poultry.

verses.kjv_text: For he had dominion over all {the region} on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon's dominion extended over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza. And there was peace on all his borders.

verses.kjv_text: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon. {safely: Heb. confidently}
verses.nlt_text: During the lifetime of Solomon, all of Judah and Israel lived in peace and safety. And from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, each family had its own home and garden.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for his chariot horses, and he had 12,000 horses.

verses.kjv_text: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.nlt_text: The district governors faithfully provided food for King Solomon and his court; each made sure nothing was lacking during the month assigned to him.

verses.kjv_text: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where {the officers} were, every man according to his charge. {dromedaries: or, mules, or, swift beasts}
verses.nlt_text: They also brought the necessary barley and straw for the royal horses in the stables.

verses.kjv_text: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that {is} on the sea shore.
verses.nlt_text: God gave Solomon very great wisdom and understanding, and knowledge as vast as the sands of the seashore.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, his wisdom exceeded that of all the wise men of the East and the wise men of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.nlt_text: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite and the sons of Mahol-- Heman, Calcol, and Darda. His fame spread throughout all the surrounding nations.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.nlt_text: He composed some 3,000 proverbs and wrote 1,005 songs.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that {is} in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.nlt_text: He could speak with authority about all kinds of plants, from the great cedar of Lebanon to the tiny hyssop that grows from cracks in a wall. He could also speak about animals, birds, small creatures, and fish.

verses.kjv_text: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: And kings from every nation sent their ambassadors to listen to the wisdom of Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David. {Hiram: also called, Huram}
verses.nlt_text: King Hiram of Tyre had always been a loyal friend of David. When Hiram learned that David's son Solomon was the new king of Israel, he sent ambassadors to congratulate him.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon sent this message back to Hiram:

verses.kjv_text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.nlt_text: "You know that my father, David, was not able to build a Temple to honor the name of the LORD his God because of the many wars waged against him by surrounding nations. He could not build until the LORD gave him victory over all his enemies.

verses.kjv_text: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, {so that there is} neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.nlt_text: But now the LORD my God has given me peace on every side; I have no enemies, and all is well.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name. {purpose: Heb. say}
verses.nlt_text: So I am planning to build a Temple to honor the name of the LORD my God, just as he had instructed my father, David. For the LORD told him, 'Your son, whom I will place on your throne, will build the Temple to honor my name.'

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that {there is} not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians. {appoint: Heb. say}
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, please command that cedars from Lebanon be cut for me. Let my men work alongside yours, and I will pay your men whatever wages you ask. As you know, there is no one among us who can cut timber like you Sidonians!"

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed {be} the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.nlt_text: When Hiram received Solomon's message, he was very pleased and said, "Praise the LORD today for giving David a wise son to be king of the great nation of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: {and} I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir. {considered: Heb. heard}
verses.nlt_text: Then he sent this reply to Solomon: "I have received your message, and I will supply all the cedar and cypress timber you need.

verses.kjv_text: My servants shall bring {them} down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive {them}: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household. {appoint: Heb. send}
verses.nlt_text: My servants will bring the logs from the Lebanon mountains to the Mediterranean Sea and make them into rafts and float them along the coast to whatever place you choose. Then we will break the rafts apart so you can carry the logs away. You can pay me by supplying me with food for my household."

verses.kjv_text: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees {according to} all his desire.
verses.nlt_text: So Hiram supplied as much cedar and cypress timber as Solomon desired.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat {for} food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year. {measures: Heb. cors}
verses.nlt_text: In return, Solomon sent him an annual payment of 100,000 bushels of wheat for his household and 110,000 gallons of pure olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD gave wisdom to Solomon, just as he had promised. And Hiram and Solomon made a formal alliance of peace.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men. {levy: Heb. tribute of men}
verses.nlt_text: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, {and} two months at home: and Adoniram {was} over the levy.
verses.nlt_text: He sent them to Lebanon in shifts, 10,000 every month, so that each man would be one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of this labor force.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also had 70,000 common laborers, 80,000 quarry workers in the hill country,

verses.kjv_text: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which {were} over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.nlt_text: and 3,600 foremen to supervise the work.

verses.kjv_text: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, {and} hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
