verses.nlt_text: At the king's command, they quarried large blocks of high-quality stone and shaped them to make the foundation of the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew {them}, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house. {stonesquares: or, Giblites}
verses.nlt_text: Men from the city of Gebal helped Solomon's and Hiram's builders prepare the timber and stone for the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which {is} the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD. {began...: Heb. built}
verses.nlt_text: It was in midspring, in the month of Ziv, during the fourth year of Solomon's reign, that he began to construct the Temple of the LORD. This was 480 years after the people of Israel were rescued from their slavery in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof {was} threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty {cubits}, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.nlt_text: The Temple that King Solomon built for the LORD was 90 feet long, 30 feet wide, and 45 feet high.

verses.kjv_text: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits {was} the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; {and} ten cubits {was} the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.nlt_text: The entry room at the front of the Temple was 30 feet wide, running across the entire width of the Temple. It projected outward 15 feet from the front of the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights. {of...: or, broad within, and narrow without: or, skewed and closed}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also made narrow recessed windows throughout the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, {against} the walls of the house round about, {both} of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about: {against the wall: or, upon, or, joining to the wall} {built chambers: Heb. built floors} {made chambers: Heb. made ribs}
verses.nlt_text: He built a complex of rooms against the outer walls of the Temple, all the way around the sides and rear of the building.

verses.kjv_text: The nethermost chamber {was} five cubits broad, and the middle {was} six cubits broad, and the third {was} seven cubits broad: for without {in the wall} of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that {the beams} should not be fastened in the walls of the house. {narrowed...: Heb. narrowings, or, rebatements}
verses.nlt_text: The complex was three stories high, the bottom floor being 7-1/2 feet wide, the second floor 9 feet wide, and the top floor 10-1/2 feet wide. The rooms were connected to the walls of the Temple by beams resting on ledges built out from the wall. So the beams were not inserted into the walls themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe {nor} any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.nlt_text: The stones used in the construction of the Temple were finished at the quarry, so there was no sound of hammer, ax, or any other iron tool at the building site.

verses.kjv_text: The door for the middle chamber {was} in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle {chamber}, and out of the middle into the third. {side: Heb. shoulder}
verses.nlt_text: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the Temple. There were winding stairs going up to the second floor, and another flight of stairs between the second and third floors.

verses.kjv_text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar. {with...: or, the vaultbeams and the panellings with cedar}
verses.nlt_text: After completing the Temple structure, Solomon put in a ceiling made of cedar beams and planks.

verses.kjv_text: And {then} he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house {with} timber of cedar.
verses.nlt_text: As already stated, he built a complex of rooms on three sides of the building, attached to the Temple walls by cedar timbers. Each story of the complex was 7-1/2 feet high.

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD gave this message to Solomon:

verses.kjv_text: {Concerning} this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.nlt_text: "Concerning this Temple you are building, if you keep all my decrees and regulations and obey all my commands, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father, David.

verses.kjv_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.nlt_text: I will live among the Israelites and will never abandon my people Israel."

verses.kjv_text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.nlt_text: So Solomon finished building the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: {and} he covered {them} on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir. {both...: or, from the floor of the house unto the walls, etc}
verses.nlt_text: The entire inside, from floor to ceiling, was paneled with wood. He paneled the walls and ceilings with cedar, and he used planks of cypress for the floors.

verses.kjv_text: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built {them} for it within, {even} for the oracle, {even} for the most holy {place}.
verses.nlt_text: He partitioned off an inner sanctuary-- the Most Holy Place-- at the far end of the Temple. It was 30 feet deep and was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.

verses.kjv_text: And the house, that {is}, the temple before it, was forty cubits {long}.
verses.nlt_text: The main room of the Temple, outside the Most Holy Place, was 60 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: And the cedar of the house within {was} carved with knops and open flowers: all {was} cedar; there was no stone seen. {knops: or, gourds} {open: Heb. openings of}
verses.nlt_text: Cedar paneling completely covered the stone walls throughout the Temple, and the paneling was decorated with carvings of gourds and open flowers.

verses.kjv_text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: He prepared the inner sanctuary at the far end of the Temple, where the Ark of the LORD's Covenant would be placed.

verses.kjv_text: And the oracle in the forepart {was} twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and {so} covered the altar {which was of} cedar. {pure: Heb. shut up}
verses.nlt_text: This inner sanctuary was 30 feet long, 30 feet wide, and 30 feet high. He overlaid the inside with solid gold. He also overlaid the altar made of cedar.

verses.kjv_text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon overlaid the rest of the Temple's interior with solid gold, and he made gold chains to protect the entrance to the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that {was} by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.nlt_text: So he finished overlaying the entire Temple with gold, including the altar that belonged to the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And within the oracle he made two cherubims {of} olive tree, {each} ten cubits high. {olive: or, oily: Heb. trees of oil}
verses.nlt_text: He made two cherubim of wild olive wood, each 15 feet tall, and placed them in the inner sanctuary.

verses.kjv_text: And five cubits {was} the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other {were} ten cubits.
verses.nlt_text: The wingspan of each of the cherubim was 15 feet, each wing being 7-1/2 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: And the other cherub {was} ten cubits: both the cherubims {were} of one measure and one size.
verses.nlt_text: The two cherubim were identical in shape and size;

verses.kjv_text: The height of the one cherub {was} ten cubits, and so {was it} of the other cherub.
verses.nlt_text: each was 15 feet tall.

verses.kjv_text: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the {one} wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house. {they...: or, the cherubims stretched forth their wings}
verses.nlt_text: He placed them side by side in the inner sanctuary of the Temple. Their outspread wings reached from wall to wall, while their inner wings touched at the center of the room.

verses.kjv_text: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.nlt_text: He overlaid the two cherubim with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without. {open flowers: Heb. openings of flowers}
verses.nlt_text: He decorated all the walls of the inner sanctuary and the main room with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.

verses.kjv_text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.nlt_text: He overlaid the floor in both rooms with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors {of} olive tree: the lintel {and} side posts {were} a fifth part {of the wall}. {a fifth...: or, fivesquare}
verses.nlt_text: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary, he made double doors of wild olive wood with five-sided doorposts.

verses.kjv_text: The two doors also {were of} olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid {them} with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees. {two...: or, leaves of the doors} {open flowers: Heb. openings of flowers}
verses.nlt_text: These double doors were decorated with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers. The doors, including the decorations of cherubim and palm trees, were overlaid with gold.

verses.kjv_text: So also made he for the door of the temple posts {of} olive tree, a fourth part {of the wall}. {a fourth...: or, foursquare}
verses.nlt_text: Then he made four-sided doorposts of wild olive wood for the entrance to the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And the two doors {were of} fir tree: the two leaves of the one door {were} folding, and the two leaves of the other door {were} folding.
verses.nlt_text: There were two folding doors of cypress wood, and each door was hinged to fold back upon itself.

verses.kjv_text: And he carved {thereon} cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered {them} with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.nlt_text: These doors were decorated with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers-- all overlaid evenly with gold.

verses.kjv_text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.nlt_text: The walls of the inner courtyard were built so that there was one layer of cedar beams between every three layers of finished stone.

verses.kjv_text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
verses.nlt_text: The foundation of the LORD's Temple was laid in midspring, in the month of Ziv, during the fourth year of Solomon's reign.

verses.kjv_text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which {is} the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it. {through out...: or, with all the parts thereof, and with all the ordinances thereof}
verses.nlt_text: The entire building was completed in every detail by midautumn, in the month of Bul, during the eleventh year of his reign. So it took seven years to build the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also built a palace for himself, and it took him thirteen years to complete the construction.

verses.kjv_text: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof {was} an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.nlt_text: One of Solomon's buildings was called the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon. It was 150 feet long, 75 feet wide, and 45 feet high. There were four rows of cedar pillars, and great cedar beams rested on the pillars.

verses.kjv_text: And {it was} covered with cedar above upon the beams, that {lay} on forty five pillars, fifteen {in} a row. {beams: Heb. ribs}
verses.nlt_text: The hall had a cedar roof. Above the beams on the pillars were forty-five side rooms, arranged in three tiers of fifteen each.

verses.kjv_text: And {there were} windows {in} three rows, and light {was} against light {in} three ranks. {light was...: Heb. sight against sight}
verses.nlt_text: On each end of the long hall were three rows of windows facing each other.

verses.kjv_text: And all the doors and posts {were} square, with the windows: and light {was} against light {in} three ranks. {doors...: or, spaces and pillars were square in prospect}
verses.nlt_text: All the doorways and doorposts had rectangular frames and were arranged in sets of three, facing each other.

verses.kjv_text: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof {was} fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch {was} before them: and the {other} pillars and the thick beam {were} before them. {before them: or, according to them}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also built the Hall of Pillars, which was 75 feet long and 45 feet wide. There was a porch in front, along with a canopy supported by pillars.

verses.kjv_text: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, {even} the porch of judgment: and {it was} covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other. {from...: Heb. from floor to floor}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also built the throne room, known as the Hall of Justice, where he sat to hear legal matters. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.

verses.kjv_text: And his house where he dwelt {had} another court within the porch, {which} was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken {to wife}, like unto this porch.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon's living quarters surrounded a courtyard behind this hall, and they were constructed the same way. He also built similar living quarters for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had married.

verses.kjv_text: All these {were of} costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and {so} on the outside toward the great court.
verses.nlt_text: From foundation to eaves, all these buildings were built from huge blocks of high-quality stone, cut with saws and trimmed to exact measure on all sides.

verses.kjv_text: And the foundation {was of} costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.nlt_text: Some of the huge foundation stones were 15 feet long, and some were 12 feet long.

verses.kjv_text: And above {were} costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.nlt_text: The blocks of high-quality stone used in the walls were also cut to measure, and cedar beams were also used.

verses.kjv_text: And the great court round about {was} with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
verses.nlt_text: The walls of the great courtyard were built so that there was one layer of cedar beams between every three layers of finished stone, just like the walls of the inner courtyard of the LORD's Temple with its entry room.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre. {Hiram: also called, Huram}
verses.nlt_text: King Solomon then asked for a man named Huram to come from Tyre.

verses.kjv_text: He {was} a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father {was} a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work. {a widow's...: Heb. the son of a widow woman}
verses.nlt_text: He was half Israelite, since his mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father had been a craftsman in bronze from Tyre. Huram was extremely skillful and talented in any work in bronze, and he came to do all the metal work for King Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about. {cast: Heb. fashioned}
verses.nlt_text: Huram cast two bronze pillars, each 27 feet tall and 18 feet in circumference.

verses.kjv_text: And he made two chapiters {of} molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter {was} five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter {was} five cubits:
verses.nlt_text: For the tops of the pillars he cast bronze capitals, each 7-1/2 feet tall.

verses.kjv_text: {And} nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which {were} upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.nlt_text: Each capital was decorated with seven sets of latticework and interwoven chains.

verses.kjv_text: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that {were} upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.nlt_text: He also encircled the latticework with two rows of pomegranates to decorate the capitals over the pillars.

verses.kjv_text: And the chapiters that {were} upon the top of the pillars {were} of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.nlt_text: The capitals on the columns inside the entry room were shaped like water lilies, and they were six feet tall.

verses.kjv_text: And the chapiters upon the two pillars {had pomegranates} also above, over against the belly which {was} by the network: and the pomegranates {were} two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.nlt_text: The capitals on the two pillars had 200 pomegranates in two rows around them, beside the rounded surface next to the latticework.

verses.kjv_text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz. {Jachin: that is, He shall establish} {Boaz: that is, In it is strength}
verses.nlt_text: Huram set the pillars at the entrance of the Temple, one toward the south and one toward the north. He named the one on the south Jakin, and the one on the north Boaz.

verses.kjv_text: And upon the top of the pillars {was} lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.nlt_text: The capitals on the pillars were shaped like water lilies. And so the work on the pillars was finished.

verses.kjv_text: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: {it was} round all about, and his height {was} five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about. {from...: Heb. from his brim to his brim}
verses.nlt_text: Then Huram cast a great round basin, 15 feet across from rim to rim, called the Sea. It was 7-1/2 feet deep and about 45 feet in circumference.

verses.kjv_text: And under the brim of it round about {there were} knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops {were} cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.nlt_text: It was encircled just below its rim by two rows of decorative gourds. There were about six gourds per foot all the way around, and they were cast as part of the basin.

verses.kjv_text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea {was set} above upon them, and all their hinder parts {were} inward.
verses.nlt_text: The Sea was placed on a base of twelve bronze oxen, all facing outward. Three faced north, three faced west, three faced south, and three faced east, and the Sea rested on them.

verses.kjv_text: And it {was} an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.nlt_text: The walls of the Sea were about three inches thick, and its rim flared out like a cup and resembled a water lily blossom. It could hold about 11,000 gallons of water.

verses.kjv_text: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits {was} the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.nlt_text: Huram also made ten bronze water carts, each 6 feet long, 6 feet wide, and 4-1/2 feet tall.

verses.kjv_text: And the work of the bases {was} on this {manner}: they had borders, and the borders {were} between the ledges:
verses.nlt_text: They were constructed with side panels braced with crossbars.

verses.kjv_text: And on the borders that {were} between the ledges {were} lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges {there was} a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen {were} certain additions made of thin work.
verses.nlt_text: Both the panels and the crossbars were decorated with carved lions, oxen, and cherubim. Above and below the lions and oxen were wreath decorations.

verses.kjv_text: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver {were} undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.nlt_text: Each of these carts had four bronze wheels and bronze axles. There were supporting posts for the bronze basins at the corners of the carts; these supports were decorated on each side with carvings of wreaths.

verses.kjv_text: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above {was} a cubit: but the mouth thereof {was} round {after} the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it {were} gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.nlt_text: The top of each cart had a rounded frame for the basin. It projected 1-1/2 feet above the cart's top like a round pedestal, and its opening was 2-1/4 feet across; it was decorated on the outside with carvings of wreaths. The panels of the carts were square, not round.

verses.kjv_text: And under the borders {were} four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels {were joined} to the base: and the height of a wheel {was} a cubit and half a cubit. {joined...: Heb. in the base}
verses.nlt_text: Under the panels were four wheels that were connected to axles that had been cast as one unit with the cart. The wheels were 2-1/4 feet in diameter

verses.kjv_text: And the work of the wheels {was} like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, {were} all molten.
verses.nlt_text: and were similar to chariot wheels. The axles, spokes, rims, and hubs were all cast from molten bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And {there were} four undersetters to the four corners of one base: {and} the undersetters {were} of the very base itself.
verses.nlt_text: There were handles at each of the four corners of the carts, and these, too, were cast as one unit with the cart.

verses.kjv_text: And in the top of the base {was there} a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof {were} of the same.
verses.nlt_text: Around the top of each cart was a rim nine inches wide. The corner supports and side panels were cast as one unit with the cart.

verses.kjv_text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about. {proportion: Heb. nakedness}
verses.nlt_text: Carvings of cherubim, lions, and palm trees decorated the panels and corner supports wherever there was room, and there were wreaths all around.

verses.kjv_text: After this {manner} he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, {and} one size.
verses.nlt_text: All ten water carts were the same size and were made alike, for each was cast from the same mold.

verses.kjv_text: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: {and} every laver was four cubits: {and} upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.nlt_text: Huram also made ten smaller bronze basins, one for each cart. Each basin was six feet across and could hold 220 gallons of water.

verses.kjv_text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south. {side: Heb. shoulder}
verses.nlt_text: He set five water carts on the south side of the Temple and five on the north side. The great bronze basin called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD: {And Hiram: Heb. And Hirom}
verses.nlt_text: He also made the necessary washbasins, shovels, and bowls.So at last Huram completed everything King Solomon had assigned him to make for the Temple of the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: The two pillars, and the {two} bowls of the chapiters that {were} on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which {were} upon the top of the pillars;
verses.nlt_text: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two networks of interwoven chains that decorated the capitals;

verses.kjv_text: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, {even} two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that {were} upon the pillars; {upon...: Heb. upon the face of the pillars}
verses.nlt_text: the 400 pomegranates that hung from the chains on the capitals (two rows of pomegranates for each of the chain networks that decorated the capitals on top of the pillars);

verses.kjv_text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
verses.nlt_text: the ten water carts holding the ten basins;

verses.kjv_text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.nlt_text: the Sea and the twelve oxen under it;

verses.kjv_text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, {were of} bright brass. {bright: Heb. made bright or, scoured}
verses.nlt_text: the ash buckets, the shovels, and the bowls. Huram made all these things of burnished bronze for the Temple of the LORD, just as King Solomon had directed.

verses.kjv_text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan. {in...: Heb. in the thickness of the ground}
verses.nlt_text: The king had them cast in clay molds in the Jordan Valley between Succoth and Zarethan.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon left all the vessels {unweighed}, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out. {because...: Heb. for the exceeding multitude} {found: Heb. searched}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon did not weigh all these things because there were so many; the weight of the bronze could not be measured.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon made all the vessels that {pertained} unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread {was},
verses.nlt_text: Solomon also made all the furnishings of the Temple of the LORD: the gold altar; the gold table for the Bread of the Presence;

verses.kjv_text: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right {side}, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs {of} gold,
verses.nlt_text: the lampstands of solid gold, five on the south and five on the north, in front of the Most Holy Place; the flower decorations, lamps, and tongs-- all of gold;

verses.kjv_text: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers {of} pure gold; and the hinges {of} gold, {both} for the doors of the inner house, the most holy {place, and} for the doors of the house, {to wit}, of the temple. {censers: Heb. ash pans}
verses.nlt_text: the small bowls, lamp snuffers, bowls, dishes, and incense burners-- all of solid gold; the doors for the entrances to the Most Holy Place and the main room of the Temple, with their fronts overlaid with gold.

verses.kjv_text: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; {even} the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD. {things...: Heb. holy things of David}
verses.nlt_text: So King Solomon finished all his work on the Temple of the LORD. Then he brought all the gifts his father, David, had dedicated-- the silver, the gold, and the various articles-- and he stored them in the treasuries of the LORD's Temple.

verses.kjv_text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which {is} Zion. {chief: Heb. princes}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon then summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes-- the leaders of the ancestral families of the Israelites. They were to bring the Ark of the LORD's Covenant to the Temple from its location in the City of David, also known as Zion.

verses.kjv_text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which {is} the seventh month.
verses.nlt_text: So all the men of Israel assembled before King Solomon at the annual Festival of Shelters, which is held in early autumn in the month of Ethanim.

verses.kjv_text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.nlt_text: When all the elders of Israel arrived, the priests picked up the Ark.

verses.kjv_text: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that {were} in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.nlt_text: The priests and Levites brought up the Ark of the LORD along with the special tent and all the sacred items that had been in it.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, {were} with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.nlt_text: There, before the Ark, King Solomon and the entire community of Israel sacrificed so many sheep, goats, and cattle that no one could keep count!

verses.kjv_text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy {place, even} under the wings of the cherubims.
verses.nlt_text: Then the priests carried the Ark of the LORD's Covenant into the inner sanctuary of the Temple-- the Most Holy Place-- and placed it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: For the cherubims spread forth {their} two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.nlt_text: The cherubim spread their wings over the Ark, forming a canopy over the Ark and its carrying poles.

verses.kjv_text: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy {place} before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day. {ends: Heb. heads} {holy...: or, ark}
verses.nlt_text: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Temple's main room-- the Holy Place-- but not from the outside. They are still there to this day.

verses.kjv_text: {There was} nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made {a covenant} with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt. {when the: or, where the}
verses.nlt_text: Nothing was in the Ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Mount Sinai, where the LORD made a covenant with the people of Israel when they left the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy {place}, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
verses.nlt_text: When the priests came out of the Holy Place, a thick cloud filled the Temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The priests could not continue their service because of the cloud, for the glorious presence of the LORD filled the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon prayed, "O LORD, you have said that you would live in a thick cloud of darkness.

verses.kjv_text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Now I have built a glorious Temple for you, a place where you can live forever! "

verses.kjv_text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
verses.nlt_text: Then the king turned around to the entire community of Israel standing before him and gave this blessing:

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled {it}, saying,
verses.nlt_text: "Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, who has kept the promise he made to my father, David. For he told my father,

verses.kjv_text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
verses.nlt_text: 'From the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have never chosen a city among any of the tribes of Israel as the place where a Temple should be built to honor my name. But I have chosen David to be king over my people Israel.'"

verses.kjv_text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon said, "My father, David, wanted to build this Temple to honor the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD told him, 'You wanted to build the Temple to honor my name. Your intention is good,

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
verses.nlt_text: but you are not the one to do it. One of your own sons will build the Temple to honor me.'

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "And now the LORD has fulfilled the promise he made, for I have become king in my father's place, and I now sit on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD promised. I have built this Temple to honor the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein {is} the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: And I have prepared a place there for the Ark, which contains the covenant that the LORD made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt."

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the entire community of Israel. He lifted his hands toward heaven,

verses.kjv_text: And he said, LORD God of Israel, {there is} no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
verses.nlt_text: and he prayed, "O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like you in all of heaven above or on the earth below. You keep your covenant and show unfailing love to all who walk before you in wholehearted devotion.

verses.kjv_text: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled {it} with thine hand, as {it is} this day.
verses.nlt_text: You have kept your promise to your servant David, my father. You made that promise with your own mouth, and with your own hands you have fulfilled it today.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me. {fail...: Heb. be cut off unto thee a man from my sight} {so that: Heb. only if}
verses.nlt_text: "And now, O LORD, God of Israel, carry out the additional promise you made to your servant David, my father. For you said to him, 'If your descendants guard their behavior and faithfully follow me as you have done, one of them will always sit on the throne of Israel.'

verses.kjv_text: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
verses.nlt_text: Now, O God of Israel, fulfill this promise to your servant David, my father.

verses.kjv_text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
verses.nlt_text: "But will God really live on earth? Why, even the highest heavens cannot contain you. How much less this Temple I have built!

verses.kjv_text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
verses.nlt_text: Nevertheless, listen to my prayer and my plea, O LORD my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is making to you today.

verses.kjv_text: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, {even} toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place. {toward this place: or, in this place}
verses.nlt_text: May you watch over this Temple night and day, this place where you have said, 'My name will be there.' May you always hear the prayers I make toward this place.

verses.kjv_text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive. {toward this place: or, in this place}
verses.nlt_text: May you hear the humble and earnest requests from me and your people Israel when we pray toward this place. Yes, hear us from heaven where you live, and when you hear, forgive.

verses.kjv_text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house: {and an oath...: Heb. and he require an oath of him}
verses.nlt_text: "If someone wrongs another person and is required to take an oath of innocence in front of your altar in this Temple,

verses.kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: then hear from heaven and judge between your servants-- the accuser and the accused. Punish the guilty as they deserve. Acquit the innocent because of their innocence.

verses.kjv_text: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house: {in: or, toward}
verses.nlt_text: "If your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you, and if they turn to you and acknowledge your name and pray to you here in this Temple,

verses.kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and return them to this land you gave their ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
verses.nlt_text: "If the skies are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and if they pray toward this Temple and acknowledge your name and turn from their sins because you have punished them,

verses.kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: then hear from heaven and forgive the sins of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them to follow the right path, and send rain on your land that you have given to your people as their special possession.

verses.kjv_text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, {or} if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness {there be}; {cities: or, jurisdiction}
verses.nlt_text: "If there is a famine in the land or a plague or crop disease or attacks of locusts or caterpillars, or if your people's enemies are in the land besieging their towns-- whatever disaster or disease there is--

verses.kjv_text: What prayer and supplication soever be {made} by any man, {or} by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
verses.nlt_text: and if your people Israel pray about their troubles, raising their hands toward this Temple,

verses.kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, {even} thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
verses.nlt_text: then hear from heaven where you live, and forgive. Give your people what their actions deserve, for you alone know each human heart.

verses.kjv_text: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Then they will fear you as long as they live in the land you gave to our ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover concerning a stranger, that {is} not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
verses.nlt_text: "In the future, foreigners who do not belong to your people Israel will hear of you. They will come from distant lands because of your name,

verses.kjv_text: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.nlt_text: for they will hear of your great name and your strong hand and your powerful arm. And when they pray toward this Temple,

verses.kjv_text: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as {do} thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name. {this...: Heb. thy name is called upon this house}
verses.nlt_text: then hear from heaven where you live, and grant what they ask of you. In this way, all the people of the earth will come to know and fear you, just as your own people Israel do. They, too, will know that this Temple I have built honors your name.

verses.kjv_text: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and {toward} the house that I have built for thy name: {toward the city: Heb. the way of the city}
verses.nlt_text: "If your people go out where you send them to fight their enemies, and if they pray to the LORD by turning toward this city you have chosen and toward this Temple I have built to honor your name,

verses.kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause. {cause: or, right}
verses.nlt_text: then hear their prayers from heaven and uphold their cause.

verses.kjv_text: If they sin against thee, (for {there is} no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.nlt_text: "If they sin against you-- and who has never sinned?-- you might become angry with them and let their enemies conquer them and take them captive to their land far away or near.

verses.kjv_text: {Yet} if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness; {bethink...: Heb. bring back to their heart}
verses.nlt_text: But in that land of exile, they might turn to you in repentance and pray, 'We have sinned, done evil, and acted wickedly.'

verses.kjv_text: And {so} return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.nlt_text: If they turn to you with their whole heart and soul in the land of their enemies and pray toward the land you gave to their ancestors-- toward this city you have chosen, and toward this Temple I have built to honor your name--

verses.kjv_text: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause, {cause: or, right}
verses.nlt_text: then hear their prayers and their petition from heaven where you live, and uphold their cause.

verses.kjv_text: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
verses.nlt_text: Forgive your people who have sinned against you. Forgive all the offenses they have committed against you. Make their captors merciful to them,

verses.kjv_text: For they {be} thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
verses.nlt_text: for they are your people-- your special possession-- whom you brought out of the iron-smelting furnace of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: "May your eyes be open to my requests and to the requests of your people Israel. May you hear and answer them whenever they cry out to you.

verses.kjv_text: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, {to be} thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: For when you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, O Sovereign LORD, you told your servant Moses that you had set Israel apart from all the nations of the earth to be your own special possession."

verses.kjv_text: And it was {so}, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.nlt_text: When Solomon finished making these prayers and petitions to the LORD, he stood up in front of the altar of the LORD, where he had been kneeling with his hands raised toward heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.nlt_text: He stood and in a loud voice blessed the entire congregation of Israel:

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant. {failed: Heb. fallen}
verses.nlt_text: "Praise the LORD who has given rest to his people Israel, just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the wonderful promises he gave through his servant Moses.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
verses.nlt_text: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us or abandon us.

verses.kjv_text: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.nlt_text: May he give us the desire to do his will in everything and to obey all the commands, decrees, and regulations that he gave our ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require: {at all...: Heb. the thing of a day in his day}
verses.nlt_text: And may these words that I have prayed in the presence of the LORD be before him constantly, day and night, so that the LORD our God may give justice to me and to his people Israel, according to each day's needs.

verses.kjv_text: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD {is} God, {and that there is} none else.
verses.nlt_text: Then people all over the earth will know that the LORD alone is God and there is no other.

verses.kjv_text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
verses.nlt_text: And may you be completely faithful to the LORD our God. May you always obey his decrees and commands, just as you are doing today."

verses.kjv_text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon offered to the LORD a peace offering of 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep and goats. And so the king and all the people of Israel dedicated the Temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that {was} before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that {was} before the LORD {was} too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.nlt_text: That same day the king consecrated the central area of the courtyard in front of the LORD's Temple. He offered burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat of peace offerings there, because the bronze altar in the LORD's presence was too small to hold all the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, {even} fourteen days.
verses.nlt_text: Then Solomon and all Israel celebrated the Festival of Shelters in the presence of the LORD our God. A large congregation had gathered from as far away as Lebo-hamath in the north and the Brook of Egypt in the south. The celebration went on for fourteen days in all-- seven days for the dedication of the altar and seven days for the Festival of Shelters.

verses.kjv_text: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people. {blessed: or, thanked}
verses.nlt_text: After the festival was over, Solomon sent the people home. They blessed the king and went to their homes joyful and glad because the LORD had been good to his servant David and to his people Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,
verses.nlt_text: So Solomon finished building the Temple of the LORD, as well as the royal palace. He completed everything he had planned to do.

verses.kjv_text: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon a second time, as he had done before at Gibeon.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to him, "I have heard your prayer and your petition. I have set this Temple apart to be holy-- this place you have built where my name will be honored forever. I will always watch over it, for it is dear to my heart.

verses.kjv_text: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, {and} wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
verses.nlt_text: "As for you, if you will follow me with integrity and godliness, as David your father did, obeying all my commands, decrees, and regulations,

verses.kjv_text: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: then I will establish the throne of your dynasty over Israel forever. For I made this promise to your father, David: 'One of your descendants will always sit on the throne of Israel.'

verses.kjv_text: {But} if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments {and} my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
verses.nlt_text: "But if you or your descendants abandon me and disobey the commands and decrees I have given you, and if you serve and worship other gods,

verses.kjv_text: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
verses.nlt_text: then I will uproot Israel from this land that I have given them. I will reject this Temple that I have made holy to honor my name. I will make Israel an object of mockery and ridicule among the nations.

verses.kjv_text: And at this house, {which} is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
verses.nlt_text: And though this Temple is impressive now, all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads in amazement. They will ask, 'Why did the LORD do such terrible things to this land and to this Temple?'

verses.kjv_text: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
verses.nlt_text: "And the answer will be, 'Because his people abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and they worshiped other gods instead and bowed down to them. That is why the LORD has brought all these disasters on them.'"

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king's house,
verses.nlt_text: It took Solomon twenty years to build the LORD's Temple and his own royal palace. At the end of that time,

verses.kjv_text: ({Now} Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: he gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to King Hiram of Tyre. (Hiram had previously provided all the cedar and cypress timber and gold that Solomon had requested.)

verses.kjv_text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not. {pleased...: Heb. were not right in his eyes}
verses.nlt_text: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the towns Solomon had given him, he was not at all pleased with them.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, What cities {are} these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day. {Cabul: that is, displeasing, or, dirty}
verses.nlt_text: "What kind of towns are these, my brother?" he asked. So Hiram called that area Cabul (which means "worthless"), as it is still known today.

verses.kjv_text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.nlt_text: Nevertheless, Hiram paid Solomon 9,000 pounds of gold.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.nlt_text: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon conscripted to build the LORD's Temple, the royal palace, the supporting terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and the cities of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

verses.kjv_text: {For} Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it {for} a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.
verses.nlt_text: (Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, had attacked and captured Gezer, killing the Canaanite population and burning it down. He gave the city to his daughter as a wedding gift when she married Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
verses.nlt_text: So Solomon rebuilt the city of Gezer.) He also built up the towns of Lower Beth-horon,

verses.kjv_text: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.nlt_text: Baalath, and Tamar in the wilderness within his land.

verses.kjv_text: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion. {that which...: Heb. the desire of Solomon which he desired}
verses.nlt_text: He built towns as supply centers and constructed towns where his chariots and horses could be stationed. He built everything he desired in Jerusalem and Lebanon and throughout his entire realm.

verses.kjv_text: {And} all the people {that were} left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which {were} not of the children of Israel,
verses.nlt_text: There were still some people living in the land who were not Israelites, including Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

verses.kjv_text: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: These were descendants of the nations whom the people of Israel had not completely destroyed. So Solomon conscripted them for his labor force, and they serve in the labor force to this day.

verses.kjv_text: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they {were} men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.nlt_text: But Solomon did not conscript any of the Israelites for forced labor. Instead, he assigned them to serve as fighting men, government officials, officers and captains in his army, commanders of his chariots, and charioteers.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} the chief of the officers that {were} over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon appointed 550 of them to supervise the people working on his various projects.

verses.kjv_text: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which {Solomon} had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon moved his wife, Pharaoh's daughter, from the City of David to the new palace he had built for her. Then he constructed the supporting terraces.

verses.kjv_text: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that {was} before the LORD. So he finished the house. {upon the altar that: Heb. upon it, etc}
verses.nlt_text: Three times each year Solomon presented burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD. He also burned incense to the LORD. And so he finished the work of building the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which {is} beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom. {shore: Heb. lip}
verses.nlt_text: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, a port near Elath in the land of Edom, along the shore of the Red Sea.

verses.kjv_text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: Hiram sent experienced crews of sailors to sail the ships with Solomon's men.

verses.kjv_text: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought {it} to king Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: They sailed to Ophir and brought back to Solomon some sixteen tons of gold.

verses.kjv_text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.nlt_text: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame, which brought honor to the name of the LORD, she came to test him with hard questions.

verses.kjv_text: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.nlt_text: She arrived in Jerusalem with a large group of attendants and a great caravan of camels loaded with spices, large quantities of gold, and precious jewels. When she met with Solomon, she talked with him about everything she had on her mind.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not {any} thing hid from the king, which he told her not. {questions: Heb. words}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon had answers for all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.

verses.kjv_text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.nlt_text: When the queen of Sheba realized how very wise Solomon was, and when she saw the palace he had built,

verses.kjv_text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her. {attendance: Heb. standing} {cupbearers: or, butlers}
verses.nlt_text: she was overwhelmed. She was also amazed at the food on his tables, the organization of his officials and their splendid clothing, the cup-bearers, and the burnt offerings Solomon made at the Temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom. {report: Heb. word} {acts: or, sayings}
verses.nlt_text: She exclaimed to the king, "Everything I heard in my country about your achievements and wisdom is true!

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen {it}: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard. {thy...: Heb. thou hast added wisdom and goodness to}
verses.nlt_text: I didn't believe what was said until I arrived here and saw it with my own eyes. In fact, I had not heard the half of it! Your wisdom and prosperity are far beyond what I was told.

verses.kjv_text: Happy {are} thy men, happy {are} these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, {and} that hear thy wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: How happy your people must be! What a privilege for your officials to stand here day after day, listening to your wisdom!

verses.kjv_text: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.nlt_text: Praise the LORD your God, who delights in you and has placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the LORD's eternal love for Israel, he has made you king so you can rule with justice and righteousness."

verses.kjv_text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.nlt_text: Then she gave the king a gift of 9,000 pounds of gold, great quantities of spices, and precious jewels. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones. {almug...: also called, algum trees}
verses.nlt_text: (In addition, Hiram's ships brought gold from Ophir, and they also brought rich cargoes of red sandalwood and precious jewels.

verses.kjv_text: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day. {pillars: or, rails: Heb. a prop}
verses.nlt_text: The king used the sandalwood to make railings for the Temple of the LORD and the royal palace, and to construct lyres and harps for the musicians. Never before or since has there been such a supply of sandalwood.)

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside {that} which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants. {of his...: Heb. according to the hand of king Solomon}
verses.nlt_text: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba whatever she asked for, besides all the customary gifts he had so generously given. Then she and all her attendants returned to their own land.

verses.kjv_text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.nlt_text: Each year Solomon received about 25 tons of gold.

verses.kjv_text: Beside {that he had} of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country. {governors: or, captains}
verses.nlt_text: This did not include the additional revenue he received from merchants and traders, all the kings of Arabia, and the governors of the land.

verses.kjv_text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets {of} beaten gold: six hundred {shekels} of gold went to one target.
verses.nlt_text: King Solomon made 200 large shields of hammered gold, each weighing more than fifteen pounds.

verses.kjv_text: And {he made} three hundred shields {of} beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.nlt_text: He also made 300 smaller shields of hammered gold, each weighing nearly four pounds. The king placed these shields in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king made a huge throne, decorated with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.

verses.kjv_text: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne {was} round behind: and {there were} stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays. {behind: Heb. on the hinder part thereof} {stays: Heb. hands}
verses.nlt_text: The throne had six steps and a rounded back. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, and the figure of a lion stood on each side of the throne.

verses.kjv_text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom. {the like: Heb. so}
verses.nlt_text: There were also twelve other lions, one standing on each end of the six steps. No other throne in all the world could be compared with it!

verses.kjv_text: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels {were of} gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon {were of} pure gold; none {were of} silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon. {none...: or, there was no silver in them}
verses.nlt_text: All of King Solomon's drinking cups were solid gold, as were all the utensils in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon. They were not made of silver, for silver was considered worthless in Solomon's day!

verses.kjv_text: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks. {ivory: or, elephants' teeth}
verses.nlt_text: The king had a fleet of trading ships that sailed with Hiram's fleet. Once every three years the ships returned, loaded with gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

verses.kjv_text: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: So King Solomon became richer and wiser than any other king on earth.

verses.kjv_text: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart. {sought to: Heb. sought the face of}
verses.nlt_text: People from every nation came to consult him and to hear the wisdom God had given him.

verses.kjv_text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.nlt_text: Year after year everyone who visited brought him gifts of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon built up a huge force of chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses. He stationed some of them in the chariot cities and some near him in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And the king made silver {to be} in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he {to be} as the sycomore trees that {are} in the vale, for abundance. {made: Heb. gave}
verses.nlt_text: The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stone. And valuable cedar timber was as common as the sycamore-fig trees that grow in the foothills of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price. {And Solomon...: Heb. And the going forth of the horses which was Solomon's}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from Cilicia; the king's traders acquired them from Cilicia at the standard price.

verses.kjv_text: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred {shekels} of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring {them} out by their means. {by their...: Heb. by their hand}
verses.nlt_text: At that time chariots from Egypt could be purchased for 600 pieces of silver, and horses for 150 pieces of silver. They were then exported to the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.

verses.kjv_text: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, {and} Hittites; {together...: or, beside}
verses.nlt_text: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women. Besides Pharaoh's daughter, he married women from Moab, Ammon, Edom, Sidon, and from among the Hittites.

verses.kjv_text: Of the nations {concerning} which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: {for} surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD had clearly instructed the people of Israel, 'You must not marry them, because they will turn your hearts to their gods.' Yet Solomon insisted on loving them anyway.

verses.kjv_text: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.nlt_text: He had 700 wives of royal birth and 300 concubines. And in fact, they did turn his heart away from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, {that} his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as {was} the heart of David his father.
verses.nlt_text: In Solomon's old age, they turned his heart to worship other gods instead of being completely faithful to the LORD his God, as his father, David, had been.

verses.kjv_text: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites. {Milcom: also called, Molech}
verses.nlt_text: Solomon worshiped Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molech, the detestable god of the Ammonites.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as {did} David his father. {went...: Heb. fulfilled not after}
verses.nlt_text: In this way, Solomon did what was evil in the LORD's sight; he refused to follow the LORD completely, as his father, David, had done.

verses.kjv_text: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that {is} before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.nlt_text: On the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, he even built a pagan shrine for Chemosh, the detestable god of Moab, and another for Molech, the detestable god of the Ammonites.

verses.kjv_text: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.nlt_text: Solomon built such shrines for all his foreign wives to use for burning incense and sacrificing to their gods.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD was very angry with Solomon, for his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.

verses.kjv_text: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
verses.nlt_text: He had warned Solomon specifically about worshiping other gods, but Solomon did not listen to the LORD's command.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant. {is done...: Heb. is with thee}
verses.nlt_text: So now the LORD said to him, "Since you have not kept my covenant and have disobeyed my decrees, I will surely tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your servants.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: {but} I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.nlt_text: But for the sake of your father, David, I will not do this while you are still alive. I will take the kingdom away from your son.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; {but} will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
verses.nlt_text: And even so, I will not take away the entire kingdom; I will let him be king of one tribe, for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, my chosen city."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he {was} of the king's seed in Edom.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD raised up Hadad the Edomite, a member of Edom's royal family, to be Solomon's adversary.

verses.kjv_text: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.nlt_text: Years before, David had defeated Edom. Joab, his army commander, had stayed to bury some of the Israelite soldiers who had died in battle. While there, they killed every male in Edom.

verses.kjv_text: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
