verses.nlt_text: During Jehoiachin's reign, the officers of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came up against Jerusalem and besieged it.

verses.kjv_text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
verses.nlt_text: Nebuchadnezzar himself arrived at the city during the siege.

verses.kjv_text: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign. {officers: or, eunuchs} {his reign: Nebuchadnezzar's eighth year}
verses.nlt_text: Then King Jehoiachin, along with the queen mother, his advisers, his commanders, and his officials, surrendered to the Babylonians.In the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's reign, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.

verses.kjv_text: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.
verses.nlt_text: As the LORD had said beforehand, Nebuchadnezzar carried away all the treasures from the LORD's Temple and the royal palace. He stripped away all the gold objects that King Solomon of Israel had placed in the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, {even} ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
verses.nlt_text: King Nebuchadnezzar took all of Jerusalem captive, including all the commanders and the best of the soldiers, craftsmen, and artisans-- 10,000 in all. Only the poorest people were left in the land.

verses.kjv_text: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, {those} carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon. {officers: or, eunuchs}
verses.nlt_text: Nebuchadnezzar led King Jehoiachin away as a captive to Babylon, along with the queen mother, his wives and officials, and all Jerusalem's elite.

verses.kjv_text: And all the men of might, {even} seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all {that were} strong {and} apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
verses.nlt_text: He also exiled 7,000 of the best troops and 1,000 craftsmen and artisans, all of whom were strong and fit for war.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king of Babylon installed Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's uncle, as the next king, and he changed Mattaniah's name to Zedekiah.

verses.kjv_text: Zedekiah {was} twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.nlt_text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

verses.kjv_text: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.nlt_text: But Zedekiah did what was evil in the LORD's sight, just as Jehoiakim had done.

verses.kjv_text: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.nlt_text: These things happened because of the LORD's anger against the people of Jerusalem and Judah, until he finally banished them from his presence and sent them into exile. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth {day} of the month, {that} Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
verses.nlt_text: So on January 15, during the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon led his entire army against Jerusalem. They surrounded the city and built siege ramps against its walls.

verses.kjv_text: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.nlt_text: Jerusalem was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah's reign.

verses.kjv_text: And on the ninth {day} of the {fourth} month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.nlt_text: By July 18 in the eleventh year of Zedekiah's reign, the famine in the city had become very severe, and the last of the food was entirely gone.

verses.kjv_text: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war {fled} by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which {is} by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees {were} against the city round about:) and {the king} went the way toward the plain.
verses.nlt_text: Then a section of the city wall was broken down, and all the soldiers fled. Since the city was surrounded by the Babylonians, they waited for nightfall. Then they slipped through the gate between the two walls behind the king's garden and headed toward the Jordan Valley.

verses.kjv_text: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
verses.nlt_text: But the Babylonian troops chased the king and caught him on the plains of Jericho, for his men had all deserted him and scattered.

verses.kjv_text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him. {gave...: Heb. spake judgment with him}
verses.nlt_text: They took him to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where they pronounced judgment upon Zedekiah.

verses.kjv_text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon. {put...: Heb. made blind}
verses.nlt_text: They made Zedekiah watch as they slaughtered his sons. Then they gouged out Zedekiah's eyes, bound him in bronze chains, and led him away to Babylon.

verses.kjv_text: And in the fifth month, on the seventh {day} of the month, which {is} the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem: {captain...: or, chief marshal}
verses.nlt_text: On August 14 of that year, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar's reign, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard and an official of the Babylonian king, arrived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great {man's} house burnt he with fire.
verses.nlt_text: He burned down the Temple of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He destroyed all the important buildings in the city.

verses.kjv_text: And all the army of the Chaldees, that {were with} the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.nlt_text: Then he supervised the entire Babylonian army as they tore down the walls of Jerusalem on every side.

verses.kjv_text: Now the rest of the people {that were} left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away. {fugitives: Heb. fallen away}
verses.nlt_text: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, then took as exiles the rest of the people who remained in the city, the defectors who had declared their allegiance to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the population.

verses.kjv_text: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land {to be} vinedressers and husbandmen.
verses.nlt_text: But the captain of the guard allowed some of the poorest people to stay behind in Judah to care for the vineyards and fields.

verses.kjv_text: And the pillars of brass that {were} in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that {was} in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.nlt_text: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars in front of the LORD's Temple, the bronze water carts, and the great bronze basin called the Sea, and they carried all the bronze away to Babylon.

verses.kjv_text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.nlt_text: They also took all the ash buckets, shovels, lamp snuffers, dishes, and all the other bronze articles used for making sacrifices at the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And the firepans, and the bowls, {and} such things as {were} of gold, {in} gold, and of silver, {in} silver, the captain of the guard took away.
verses.nlt_text: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, also took the incense burners and basins, and all the other articles made of pure gold or silver.

verses.kjv_text: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight. {one...: Heb. the one sea}
verses.nlt_text: The weight of the bronze from the two pillars, the Sea, and the water carts was too great to be measured. These things had been made for the LORD's Temple in the days of King Solomon.

verses.kjv_text: The height of the one pillar {was} eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it {was} brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
verses.nlt_text: Each of the pillars was 27 feet tall. The bronze capital on top of each pillar was 7-1/2 feet high and was decorated with a network of bronze pomegranates all the way around.

verses.kjv_text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door: {door: Heb. threshold}
verses.nlt_text: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took with him as prisoners Seraiah the high priest, Zephaniah the priest of the second rank, and the three chief gatekeepers.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land {that were} found in the city: {officer: or, eunuch} {were in...: Heb. saw the king's face} {principal...: or, scribe of the captain of the host}
verses.nlt_text: And from among the people still hiding in the city, he took an officer who had been in charge of the Judean army; five of the king's personal advisers; the army commander's chief secretary, who was in charge of recruitment; and sixty other citizens.

verses.kjv_text: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
verses.nlt_text: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took them all to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
verses.nlt_text: And there at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king of Babylon had them all put to death. So the people of Judah were sent into exile from their land.

verses.kjv_text: And {as for} the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
verses.nlt_text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam and grandson of Shaphan as governor over the people he had left in Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.nlt_text: When all the army commanders and their men learned that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they went to see him at Mizpah. These included Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite, and all their men.

verses.kjv_text: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
verses.nlt_text: Gedaliah vowed to them that the Babylonian officials meant them no harm. "Don't be afraid of them. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and all will go well for you," he promised.

verses.kjv_text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah. {royal: Heb. of the kingdom}
verses.nlt_text: But in midautumn of that year, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and grandson of Elishama, who was of the royal family, went to Mizpah with ten men and killed Gedaliah. He also killed all the Judeans and Babylonians who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah.

verses.kjv_text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
verses.nlt_text: Then all the people of Judah, from the least to the greatest, as well as the army commanders, fled in panic to Egypt, for they were afraid of what the Babylonians would do to them.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth {day} of the month, {that} Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
verses.nlt_text: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin of Judah, Evil-merodach ascended to the Babylonian throne. He was kind to Jehoiachin and released him from prison on April 2 of that year.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that {were} with him in Babylon; {kindly...: Heb. good things with him}
verses.nlt_text: He spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and gave him a higher place than all the other exiled kings in Babylon.

verses.kjv_text: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
verses.nlt_text: He supplied Jehoiachin with new clothes to replace his prison garb and allowed him to dine in the king's presence for the rest of his life.

verses.kjv_text: And his allowance {was} a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
verses.nlt_text: So the Babylonian king gave him a regular food allowance as long as he lived.

verses.kjv_text: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Adam were Seth, Enosh,

verses.kjv_text: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
verses.nlt_text: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

verses.kjv_text: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.nlt_text: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

verses.kjv_text: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.nlt_text: and Noah. The sons of Noah were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah. {Riphath: or, Diphath as it is in some copies}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim. {Dodanim: or, Rodanim, according to some copies}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv_text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Cush was also the ancestor of Nimrod, who was the first heroic warrior on earth.

verses.kjv_text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.nlt_text: Mizraim was the ancestor of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

verses.kjv_text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
verses.nlt_text: Pathrusites, Casluhites, and the Caphtorites, from whom the Philistines came.

verses.kjv_text: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.nlt_text: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon, the ancestor of the Sidonians. Canaan was also the ancestor of the Hittites,

verses.kjv_text: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.nlt_text: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.nlt_text: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

verses.kjv_text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.nlt_text: Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech. {Meshech: or, Mash}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The descendants of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

verses.kjv_text: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.nlt_text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah. Shelah was the father of Eber.

verses.kjv_text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one {was} Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name {was} Joktan. {Peleg: that is, division}
verses.nlt_text: Eber had two sons. The first was named Peleg (which means "division"), for during his lifetime the people of the world were divided into different language groups. His brother's name was Joktan.

verses.kjv_text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.nlt_text: Joktan was the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.kjv_text: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.nlt_text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.kjv_text: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.nlt_text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.kjv_text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these {were} the sons of Joktan.
verses.nlt_text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were descendants of Joktan.

verses.kjv_text: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.nlt_text: So this is the family line descended from Shem: Arphaxad, Shelah,

verses.kjv_text: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.nlt_text: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.kjv_text: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.nlt_text: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

verses.kjv_text: Abram; the same {is} Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: and Abram, later known as Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.nlt_text: These are their genealogical records: The sons of Ishmael were Nebaioth (the oldest), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

verses.kjv_text: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema, {Hadad: also called, Hadar}
verses.nlt_text: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

verses.kjv_text: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.nlt_text: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

verses.kjv_text: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine, were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these {are} the sons of Keturah.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

verses.kjv_text: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek. {Zephi: or, Zepho}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, and Amalek, who was born to Timna.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna {was} Lotan's sister. {Homam: or, Hemam}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan's sister was named Timna.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah. {Alian: also called, Alvan} {Shephi: also called, Shepho}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Shobal were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran. {Amram: or, Hemdan}
verses.nlt_text: The son of Anah was Dishon. The sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, {and} Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran. {Jakan: or, Akan}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before {any} king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city {was} Dinhabah.
verses.nlt_text: These are the kings who ruled in Edom before there were kings in Israel: Bela son of Beor, who ruled from his city of Dinhabah.

verses.kjv_text: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king.

verses.kjv_text: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Avith.
verses.nlt_text: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from the city of Avith. He was the one who destroyed the Midianite army in the land of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: When Hadad died, Samlah from the city of Masrekah became king.

verses.kjv_text: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: When Samlah died, Shaul from the city of Rehoboth on the river became king.

verses.kjv_text: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Acbor became king.

verses.kjv_text: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Pai; and his wife's name {was} Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab. {Hadad: or, Hadar} {Pai: or, Pau}
verses.nlt_text: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad became king and ruled from the city of Pau. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab.

verses.kjv_text: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.nlt_text: Then Hadad died. The clan leaders of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.nlt_text: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.nlt_text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

verses.kjv_text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These {are} the dukes of Edom.
verses.nlt_text: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the clan leaders of Edom.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun, {Israel: or, Jacob}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Israel were Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

verses.kjv_text: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.nlt_text: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: {which} three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
verses.nlt_text: Judah had three sons from Bathshua, a Canaanite woman. Their names were Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the LORD saw that the oldest son, Er, was a wicked man, so he killed him.

verses.kjv_text: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah {were} five.
verses.nlt_text: Later Judah had twin sons from Tamar, his widowed daughter-in-law. Their names were Perez and Zerah. So Judah had five sons in all.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all. {Zimri: or, Zabdi} {Dara: or, Darda}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda-- five in all.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed. {Achar: or, Achan}
verses.nlt_text: The son of Carmi (a descendant of Zimri) was Achan, who brought disaster on Israel by taking plunder that had been set apart for the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.nlt_text: The son of Ethan was Azariah.

verses.kjv_text: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai. {Ram: Gr. Aram} {Chelubai: or, Caleb}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Hezron were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

verses.kjv_text: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.nlt_text: Ram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz, {Salma: also called, Salmon}
verses.nlt_text: Nahshon was the father of Salmon. Salmon was the father of Boaz.

verses.kjv_text: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.nlt_text: Boaz was the father of Obed. Obed was the father of Jesse.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third, {Shimma: or, Shammah}
verses.nlt_text: Jesse's first son was Eliab, his second was Abinadab, his third was Shimea,

verses.kjv_text: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.nlt_text: his fourth was Nethanel, his fifth was Raddai,

verses.kjv_text: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.nlt_text: his sixth was Ozem, and his seventh was David.

verses.kjv_text: Whose sisters {were} Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.nlt_text: Their sisters were named Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah had three sons named Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

verses.kjv_text: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa {was} Jether the Ishmeelite. {Jether...: also called, Ithra an Israelite}
verses.nlt_text: Abigail married a man named Jether, an Ishmaelite, and they had a son named Amasa.

verses.kjv_text: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat {children} of Azubah {his} wife, and of Jerioth: her sons {are} these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.nlt_text: Hezron's son Caleb had sons from his wife Azubah and from Jerioth. Her sons were named Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

verses.kjv_text: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.nlt_text: After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrathah, and they had a son named Hur.

verses.kjv_text: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.nlt_text: Hur was the father of Uri. Uri was the father of Bezalel.

verses.kjv_text: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he {was} threescore years old; and she bare him Segub. {married: Heb. took}
verses.nlt_text: When Hezron was sixty years old, he married Gilead's sister, the daughter of Makir. They had a son named Segub.

verses.kjv_text: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: Segub was the father of Jair, who ruled twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, {even} threescore cities. All these {belonged to} the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: (But Geshur and Aram captured the Towns of Jair and also took Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages.) All these were descendants of Makir, the father of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.nlt_text: Soon after Hezron died in the town of Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah gave birth to a son named Ashhur (the father of Tekoa).

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, {and} Ahijah.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, were Ram (the firstborn), Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

verses.kjv_text: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name {was} Atarah; she {was} the mother of Onam.
verses.nlt_text: Jerahmeel had a second wife named Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.

verses.kjv_text: And the name of the wife of Abishur {was} Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Abishur and his wife Abihail were Ahban and Molid.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children,

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.nlt_text: but Appaim had a son named Ishi. The son of Ishi was Sheshan. Sheshan had a descendant named Ahlai.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jada, Shammai's brother, were Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children,

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.nlt_text: but Jonathan had two sons named Peleth and Zaza. These were all descendants of Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv_text: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name {was} Jarha.
verses.nlt_text: Sheshan had no sons, though he did have daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

verses.kjv_text: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.nlt_text: Sheshan gave one of his daughters to be the wife of Jarha, and they had a son named Attai.

verses.kjv_text: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.nlt_text: Attai was the father of Nathan. Nathan was the father of Zabad.

verses.kjv_text: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.nlt_text: Zabad was the father of Ephlal. Ephlal was the father of Obed.

verses.kjv_text: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.nlt_text: Obed was the father of Jehu. Jehu was the father of Azariah.

verses.kjv_text: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.nlt_text: Azariah was the father of Helez. Helez was the father of Eleasah.

verses.kjv_text: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.nlt_text: Eleasah was the father of Sismai. Sismai was the father of Shallum.

verses.kjv_text: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.nlt_text: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah. Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

verses.kjv_text: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel {were}, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, included Mesha (the firstborn), who became the father of Ziph. Caleb's descendants also included the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

verses.kjv_text: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.nlt_text: Shema was the father of Raham. Raham was the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.

verses.kjv_text: And the son of Shammai {was} Maon: and Maon {was} the father of Bethzur.
verses.nlt_text: The son of Shammai was Maon. Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

verses.kjv_text: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.nlt_text: Caleb's concubine Ephah gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

verses.kjv_text: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.nlt_text: Another of Caleb's concubines, Maacah, gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.

verses.kjv_text: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb {was} Achsah.
verses.nlt_text: She also gave birth to Shaaph (the father of Madmannah) and Sheva (the father of Macbenah and Gibea). Caleb also had a daughter named Acsah.

verses.kjv_text: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim, {Ephratah: also called, Ephreth}
verses.nlt_text: These were all descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the oldest son of Caleb's wife Ephrathah, were Shobal (the founder of Kiriath-jearim),

verses.kjv_text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
verses.nlt_text: Salma (the founder of Bethlehem), and Hareph (the founder of Beth-gader).

verses.kjv_text: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, {and} half of the Manahethites. {Haroeh: or, Reaiah} {half...: or, half of the Menuchites, or, Hatsihammenuchoth}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Shobal (the founder of Kiriath-jearim) were Haroeh, half the Manahathites,

verses.kjv_text: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.nlt_text: and the families of Kiriath-jearim-- the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites, from whom came the people of Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites. {Ataroth...: or, Atarites, or, crowns of the house of Joab}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Salma were the people of Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, the other half of the Manahathites, the Zorites,

verses.kjv_text: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, {and} Suchathites. These {are} the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.nlt_text: and the families of scribes living at Jabez-- the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. All these were Kenites who descended from Hammath, the father of the family of Recab.

verses.kjv_text: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess: {Daniel: or, Chileab}
verses.nlt_text: These are the sons of David who were born in Hebron: The oldest was Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel. The second was Daniel, whose mother was Abigail from Carmel.

verses.kjv_text: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.nlt_text: The third was Absalom, whose mother was Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur. The fourth was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith.

verses.kjv_text: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.nlt_text: The fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital. The sixth was Ithream, whose mother was Eglah, David's wife.

verses.kjv_text: {These} six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.nlt_text: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven and a half years. Then David reigned another thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel: {Shimea: or, Shammua} {Bathshua: or, Bathsheba} {Ammiel: or, Eliam}
verses.nlt_text: The sons born to David in Jerusalem included Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. Their mother was Bathsheba, the daughter of Ammiel.

verses.kjv_text: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet, {Elishama: also called, Elishua}
verses.nlt_text: David also had nine other sons: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

verses.kjv_text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.nlt_text: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.kjv_text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine. {Eliada: or, Beeliada}
verses.nlt_text: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

verses.kjv_text: {These were} all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.nlt_text: These were the sons of David, not including his sons born to his concubines. Their sister was named Tamar.

verses.kjv_text: And Solomon's son {was} Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, {Abia: or, Abijam}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Solomon were Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,

verses.kjv_text: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son, {Ahaziah: or, Azariah}
verses.nlt_text: Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash,

verses.kjv_text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son, {Azariah: or, Uzziah}
verses.nlt_text: Amaziah, Uzziah, Jotham,

verses.kjv_text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.nlt_text: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh,

verses.kjv_text: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.nlt_text: Amon, and Josiah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Josiah {were}, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum. {Johanan: or, Jehoahaz} {Jehoiakim: or, Eliakim} {Zedekiah: or, Mattaniah}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Josiah were Johanan (the oldest), Jehoiakim (the second), Zedekiah (the third), and Jehoahaz (the fourth).

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son. {Jeconiah: also called, Jehoiachin or Coniah}
verses.nlt_text: The successors of Jehoiakim were his son Jehoiachin and his brother Zedekiah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son, {Salathiel: Heb. Shealtiel}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jehoiachin, who was taken prisoner by the Babylonians, were Shealtiel,

verses.kjv_text: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.nlt_text: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Pedaiah {were}, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam and Hananiah. (Their sister was Shelomith.)

verses.kjv_text: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
verses.nlt_text: His five other sons were Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah. Jeshaiah's son was Rephaiah. Rephaiah's son was Arnan. Arnan's son was Obadiah. Obadiah's son was Shecaniah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons, Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat-- six in all.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three. {Hezekiah: Heb. Hiskijah}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam-- three in all.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Elioenai {were}, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani-- seven in all.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal. {Carmi: also called, Chelubai or Caleb}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

verses.kjv_text: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These {are} the families of the Zorathites. {Reaiah: or, Haroeh}
verses.nlt_text: Shobal's son Reaiah was the father of Jahath. Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.

verses.kjv_text: And these {were of} the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister {was} Hazelelponi:
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Etam were Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash, their sister Hazzelelponi,

verses.kjv_text: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These {are} the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.nlt_text: Penuel (the father of Gedor), and Ezer (the father of Hushah). These were the descendants of Hur (the firstborn of Ephrathah), the ancestor of Bethlehem.

verses.kjv_text: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.nlt_text: Ashhur (the father of Tekoa) had two wives, named Helah and Naarah.

verses.kjv_text: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These {were} the sons of Naarah.
verses.nlt_text: Naarah gave birth to Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Helah {were}, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.nlt_text: Helah gave birth to Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,

verses.kjv_text: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.nlt_text: and Koz, who became the ancestor of Anub, Zobebah, and all the families of Aharhel son of Harum.

verses.kjv_text: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow. {Jabez: that is, Sorrowful}
verses.nlt_text: There was a man named Jabez who was more honorable than any of his brothers. His mother named him Jabez because his birth had been so painful.

verses.kjv_text: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep {me} from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested. {Oh...: Heb. If thou wilt, etc} {keep...: Heb. do me}
verses.nlt_text: He was the one who prayed to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and expand my territory! Please be with me in all that I do, and keep me from all trouble and pain!" And God granted him his request.

verses.kjv_text: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which {was} the father of Eshton.
verses.nlt_text: Kelub (the brother of Shuhah) was the father of Mehir. Mehir was the father of Eshton.

verses.kjv_text: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These {are} the men of Rechah. {Irnahash: or, the city of Nahash}
verses.nlt_text: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash. These were the descendants of Recah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath. {Hathath...: or, Hathath, and Meonothai, who begat, etc}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel's sons were Hathath and Meonothai.

verses.kjv_text: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen. {valley: or, inhabitants of the valley} {Charashim: that is, craftsmen} {Hathath...: or, Hathath, and Meonothai, who begat, etc}
verses.nlt_text: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the founder of the Valley of Craftsmen, so called because they were craftsmen.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz. {even Kenaz: or, Uknaz}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah was Kenaz.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ezra {were}, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. One of Mered's wives became the mother of Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah (the father of Eshtemoa).

verses.kjv_text: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these {are} the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took. {Jehudijah: or, the Jewess}
verses.nlt_text: He married a woman from Judah, who became the mother of Jered (the father of Gedor), Heber (the father of Soco), and Jekuthiel (the father of Zanoah). Mered also married Bithia, a daughter of Pharaoh, and she bore him children.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of {his} wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite. {Hodiah: or, Jehudijah, mentioned before}
verses.nlt_text: Hodiah's wife was the sister of Naham. One of her sons was the father of Keilah the Garmite, and another was the father of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Shimon {were}, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi {were}, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah {were}, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.nlt_text: Shelah was one of Judah's sons. The descendants of Shelah were Er (the father of Lecah); Laadah (the father of Mareshah); the families of linen workers at Beth-ashbea;

verses.kjv_text: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And {these are} ancient things.
verses.nlt_text: Jokim; the men of Cozeba; and Joash and Saraph, who ruled over Moab and Jashubi-lehem. These names all come from ancient records.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.nlt_text: They were the pottery makers who lived in Netaim and Gederah. They lived there and worked for the king.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Simeon {were}, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, {and} Shaul: {Nemuel: or, Jemuel} {Jarib, Zerah: or, Jachin Zohar}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zohar, and Shaul.

verses.kjv_text: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Shaul were Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Mishma were Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.

verses.kjv_text: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah. {like...: Heb. unto}
verses.nlt_text: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but none of his brothers had large families. So Simeon's tribe never grew as large as the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
verses.nlt_text: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,

verses.kjv_text: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad, {Bilhah: or, Balah} {Tolad: or, Eltolad}
verses.nlt_text: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,

verses.kjv_text: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.nlt_text: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,

verses.kjv_text: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These {were} their cities unto the reign of David. {Hazarsusim: or, Hazarsusah}
verses.nlt_text: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These towns were under their control until the time of King David.

verses.kjv_text: And their villages {were}, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities: {Etam: or, Ether}
verses.nlt_text: Their descendants also lived in Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, and Ashan-- five towns

verses.kjv_text: And all their villages that {were} round about the same cities, unto Baal. These {were} their habitations, and their genealogy. {Baal: or, Baalathbeer} {their genealogy: or, as they divided themselves by nations among them}
verses.nlt_text: and their surrounding villages as far away as Baalath. This was their territory, and these names are listed in their genealogical records.

verses.kjv_text: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.nlt_text: Other descendants of Simeon included Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,

verses.kjv_text: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.nlt_text: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, son of Seraiah, son of Asiel,

verses.kjv_text: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.nlt_text: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

verses.kjv_text: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.nlt_text: and Ziza son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah.

verses.kjv_text: These mentioned by {their} names {were} princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly. {mentioned: Heb. coming}
verses.nlt_text: These were the names of some of the leaders of Simeon's wealthy clans. Their families grew,

verses.kjv_text: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, {even} unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.nlt_text: and they traveled to the region of Gerar, in the east part of the valley, seeking pastureland for their flocks.

verses.kjv_text: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land {was} wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for {they} of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.nlt_text: They found lush pastures there, and the land was quiet and peaceful.Some of Ham's descendants had been living in that region.

verses.kjv_text: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because {there was} pasture there for their flocks.
verses.nlt_text: But during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah, these leaders of Simeon invaded the region and completely destroyed the homes of the descendants of Ham and of the Meunites. No trace of them remains today. They killed everyone who lived there and took the land for themselves, because they wanted its good pastureland for their flocks.

verses.kjv_text: And {some} of them, {even} of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.nlt_text: Five hundred of these invaders from the tribe of Simeon went to Mount Seir, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel-- all sons of Ishi.

verses.kjv_text: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: They destroyed the few Amalekites who had survived, and they have lived there ever since.

verses.kjv_text: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he {was} the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.nlt_text: The oldest son of Israel was Reuben. But since he dishonored his father by sleeping with one of his father's concubines, his birthright was given to the sons of his brother Joseph. For this reason, Reuben is not listed in the genealogical records as the firstborn son.

verses.kjv_text: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him {came} the chief ruler; but the birthright {was} Joseph's:) {chief...: or, prince}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Judah became the most powerful tribe and provided a ruler for the nation, but the birthright belonged to Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: The sons, {I say}, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel {were}, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Joel were Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei,

verses.kjv_text: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.nlt_text: Micah, Reaiah, Baal,

verses.kjv_text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away {captive}: he {was} prince of the Reubenites. {Tilgathpilneser: also called, Tiglathpileser}
verses.nlt_text: and Beerah. Beerah was the leader of the Reubenites when they were taken into captivity by King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria.

verses.kjv_text: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, {were} the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.nlt_text: Beerah's relatives are listed in their genealogical records by their clans: Jeiel (the leader), Zechariah,

verses.kjv_text: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon: {Shema: or, Shemaiah}
verses.nlt_text: and Bela son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Joel. The Reubenites lived in the area that stretches from Aroer to Nebo and Baal-meon.

verses.kjv_text: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.nlt_text: And since they had so many livestock in the land of Gilead, they spread east toward the edge of the desert that stretches to the Euphrates River.

verses.kjv_text: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east {land} of Gilead. {throughout...: Heb. upon all the face of the east}
verses.nlt_text: During the reign of Saul, the Reubenites defeated the Hagrites in battle. Then they moved into the Hagrite settlements all along the eastern edge of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
verses.nlt_text: Next to the Reubenites, the descendants of Gad lived in the land of Bashan as far east as Salecah.

verses.kjv_text: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.nlt_text: Joel was the leader in the land of Bashan, and Shapham was second-in-command, followed by Janai and Shaphat.

verses.kjv_text: And their brethren of the house of their fathers {were}, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.nlt_text: Their relatives, the leaders of seven other clans, were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.

verses.kjv_text: These {are} the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.nlt_text: These were all descendants of Abihail son of Huri, son of Jaroah, son of Gilead, son of Michael, son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz.

verses.kjv_text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Ahi son of Abdiel, son of Guni, was the leader of their clans.

verses.kjv_text: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders. {their...: Heb. their goings forth}
verses.nlt_text: The Gadites lived in the land of Gilead, in Bashan and its villages, and throughout all the pasturelands of Sharon.

verses.kjv_text: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: All of these were listed in the genealogical records during the days of King Jotham of Judah and King Jeroboam of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, {were} four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war. {valiant...: Heb. sons of valour}
verses.nlt_text: There were 44,760 capable warriors in the armies of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. They were all skilled in combat and armed with shields, swords, and bows.

verses.kjv_text: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.nlt_text: They waged war against the Hagrites, the Jeturites, the Naphishites, and the Nodabites.

verses.kjv_text: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that {were} with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.nlt_text: They cried out to God during the battle, and he answered their prayer because they trusted in him. So the Hagrites and all their allies were defeated.

verses.kjv_text: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand. {took...: Heb. led captive} {men: Heb. souls of men}
verses.nlt_text: The plunder taken from the Hagrites included 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep and goats, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 captives.

verses.kjv_text: For there fell down many slain, because the war {was} of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.nlt_text: Many of the Hagrites were killed in the battle because God was fighting against them. The people of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh lived in their land until they were taken into exile.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.nlt_text: The half-tribe of Manasseh was very large and spread through the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

verses.kjv_text: And these {were} the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, {and} heads of the house of their fathers. {famous...: Heb. men of names}
verses.nlt_text: These were the leaders of their clans: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. These men had a great reputation as mighty warriors and leaders of their clans.

verses.kjv_text: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.nlt_text: But these tribes were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors. They worshiped the gods of the nations that God had destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: So the God of Israel caused King Pul of Assyria (also known as Tiglath-pileser) to invade the land and take away the people of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh as captives. The Assyrians exiled them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the Gozan River, where they remain to this day.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. {Gershon: or, Gershom}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Kohath included Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.nlt_text: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv_text: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.nlt_text: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas. Phinehas was the father of Abishua.

verses.kjv_text: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.nlt_text: Abishua was the father of Bukki. Bukki was the father of Uzzi.

verses.kjv_text: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.nlt_text: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth.

verses.kjv_text: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.nlt_text: Meraioth was the father of Amariah. Amariah was the father of Ahitub.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.nlt_text: Ahitub was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.nlt_text: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah. Azariah was the father of Johanan.

verses.kjv_text: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he {it is} that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:) {in the temple: Heb. in the house}
verses.nlt_text: Johanan was the father of Azariah, the high priest at the Temple built by Solomon in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.nlt_text: Azariah was the father of Amariah. Amariah was the father of Ahitub.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum, {Shallum: or, Meshullam}
verses.nlt_text: Ahitub was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Shallum.

verses.kjv_text: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.nlt_text: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah was the father of Azariah.

verses.kjv_text: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.nlt_text: Azariah was the father of Seraiah. Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak,

verses.kjv_text: And Jehozadak went {into captivity}, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.nlt_text: who went into exile when the LORD sent the people of Judah and Jerusalem into captivity under Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari. {Gershom: or, Gershon}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv_text: And these {be} the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gershon included Libni and Shimei.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath {were}, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Kohath included Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these {are} the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Merari included Mahli and Mushi. The following were the Levite clans, listed according to their ancestral descent:

verses.kjv_text: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gershon included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah,

verses.kjv_text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son. {Joah: or, Ethan} {Iddo: or, Adaiah} {Jeaterai: also called, Ethni}
verses.nlt_text: Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son, {Amminadab: or, Izhar}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Kohath included Amminadab, Korah, Assir,

verses.kjv_text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.nlt_text: Elkanah, Abiasaph, Assir,

verses.kjv_text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.nlt_text: Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Elkanah included Amasai, Ahimoth,

verses.kjv_text: {As for} Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son, {Zophai: or, Zuph}
verses.nlt_text: Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath,

verses.kjv_text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.nlt_text: Eliab, Jeroham, Elkanah, and Samuel.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah. {Vashni: called also Joel}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Samuel were Joel (the older) and Abijah (the second).

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Merari included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah,

verses.kjv_text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.nlt_text: Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are they} whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
verses.nlt_text: David assigned the following men to lead the music at the house of the LORD after the Ark was placed there.

verses.kjv_text: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and {then} they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.nlt_text: They ministered with music at the Tabernacle until Solomon built the Temple of the LORD in Jerusalem. They carried out their work, following all the regulations handed down to them.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel, {waited: Heb. stood}
verses.nlt_text: These are the men who served, along with their sons: Heman the musician was from the clan of Kohath. His genealogy was traced back through Joel, Samuel,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.nlt_text: Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.nlt_text: Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.nlt_text: Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.nlt_text: Tahath, Assir, Abiasaph, Korah,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Izhar, Kohath, Levi, and Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, {even} Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.nlt_text: Heman's first assistant was Asaph from the clan of Gershon. Asaph's genealogy was traced back through Berekiah, Shimea,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.nlt_text: Michael, Baaseiah, Malkijah,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.nlt_text: Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.nlt_text: Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.nlt_text: Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.

verses.kjv_text: And their brethren the sons of Merari {stood} on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch, {Kishi: or, Kushaiah}
verses.nlt_text: Heman's second assistant was Ethan from the clan of Merari. Ethan's genealogy was traced back through Kishi, Abdi, Malluch,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.nlt_text: Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.nlt_text: Amzi, Bani, Shemer,

verses.kjv_text: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.nlt_text: Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.

verses.kjv_text: Their brethren also the Levites {were} appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.nlt_text: Their fellow Levites were appointed to various other tasks in the Tabernacle, the house of God.

verses.kjv_text: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, {and were appointed} for all the work of the {place} most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.nlt_text: Only Aaron and his descendants served as priests. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and the altar of incense, and they performed all the other duties related to the Most Holy Place. They made atonement for Israel by doing everything that Moses, the servant of God, had commanded them.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Aaron were Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua,

verses.kjv_text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.nlt_text: Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah,

verses.kjv_text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.nlt_text: Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub,

verses.kjv_text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.nlt_text: Zadok, and Ahimaaz.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.nlt_text: This is a record of the towns and territory assigned by means of sacred lots to the descendants of Aaron, who were from the clan of Kohath.

verses.kjv_text: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.nlt_text: This territory included Hebron and its surrounding pasturelands in Judah,

verses.kjv_text: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.nlt_text: but the fields and outlying areas belonging to the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv_text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, {namely}, Hebron, {the city} of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: So the descendants of Aaron were given the following towns, each with its pasturelands: Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,

verses.kjv_text: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs, {Hilen: or, Holon}
verses.nlt_text: Holon, Debir,

verses.kjv_text: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs: {Ashan: or, Ain}
verses.nlt_text: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families {were} thirteen cities. {Alemeth: or, Almon}
verses.nlt_text: And from the territory of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, each with its pasturelands. So thirteen towns were given to the descendants of Aaron.

verses.kjv_text: And unto the sons of Kohath, {which were} left of the family of that tribe, {were cities given} out of the half tribe, {namely, out of} the half {tribe} of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.nlt_text: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten towns from the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh by means of sacred lots.

verses.kjv_text: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gershon received by sacred lots thirteen towns from the territories of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and from the Bashan area of Manasseh, east of the Jordan.

verses.kjv_text: Unto the sons of Merari {were given} by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Merari received by sacred lots twelve towns from the territories of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites {these} cities with their suburbs.
verses.nlt_text: So the people of Israel assigned all these towns and pasturelands to the Levites.

verses.kjv_text: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by {their} names.
verses.nlt_text: The towns in the territories of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin, mentioned above, were assigned to them by means of sacred lots.

verses.kjv_text: And {the residue} of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Kohath were given the following towns from the territory of Ephraim, each with its pasturelands:

verses.kjv_text: And they gave unto them, {of} the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; {they gave} also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: Shechem (a city of refuge in the hill country of Ephraim), Gezer,

verses.kjv_text: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: Jokmeam, Beth-horon,

verses.kjv_text: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
verses.nlt_text: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.nlt_text: The remaining descendants of Kohath were assigned the towns of Aner and Bileam from the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: Unto the sons of Gershom {were given} out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gershon received the towns of Golan (in Bashan) and Ashtaroth from the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: From the territory of Issachar, they were given Kedesh, Daberath,

verses.kjv_text: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.nlt_text: Ramoth, and Anem, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: From the territory of Asher, they received Mashal, Abdon,

verses.kjv_text: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.nlt_text: Hukok, and Rehob, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.nlt_text: From the territory of Naphtali, they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: Unto the rest of the children of Merari {were given} out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.nlt_text: The remaining descendants of Merari received the towns of Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmon, and Tabor from the territory of Zebulun, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, {were given them} out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: From the territory of Reuben, east of the Jordan River opposite Jericho, they received Bezer (a desert town), Jahaz,

verses.kjv_text: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.nlt_text: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.nlt_text: And from the territory of Gad, they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,

verses.kjv_text: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.nlt_text: Heshbon, and Jazer, each with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv_text: Now the sons of Issachar {were}, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.nlt_text: The four sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, {to wit}, of Tola: {they were} valiant men of might in their generations; whose number {was} in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
