verses.nlt_text: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel. Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. At the time of King David, the total number of mighty warriors listed in the records of these clans was 22,600.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.nlt_text: The son of Uzzi was Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. These five became the leaders of clans.

verses.kjv_text: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, {were} bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand {men}: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.nlt_text: All of them had many wives and many sons, so the total number of men available for military service among their descendants was 36,000.

verses.kjv_text: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar {were} valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.nlt_text: The total number of mighty warriors from all the clans of the tribe of Issachar was 87,000. All of them were listed in their genealogical records.

verses.kjv_text: {The sons} of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.nlt_text: Three of Benjamin's sons were Bela, Beker, and Jediael.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of {their} fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.nlt_text: The five sons of Bela were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. The total number of mighty warriors from these clans was 22,034, as listed in their genealogical records.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these {are} the sons of Becher.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Beker were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.

verses.kjv_text: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, {was} twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.nlt_text: Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. The total number of mighty warriors and leaders from these clans was 20,200, as listed in their genealogical records.

verses.kjv_text: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.nlt_text: The son of Jediael was Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

verses.kjv_text: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, {were} seventeen thousand and two hundred {soldiers}, fit to go out for war {and} battle.
verses.nlt_text: Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. From these clans the total number of mighty warriors ready for war was 17,200.

verses.kjv_text: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, {and} Hushim, the sons of Aher. {Ir: or, Iri} {Aher: or, Ahiram}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Ir were Shuppim and Huppim. Hushim was the son of Aher.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem. They were all descendants of Jacob's concubine Bilhah.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: ({but} his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Manasseh through his Aramean concubine included Asriel. She also bore Makir, the father of Gilead.

verses.kjv_text: And Machir took to wife {the sister} of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name {was} Maachah;) and the name of the second {was} Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.nlt_text: Makir found wives for Huppim and Shuppim. Makir had a sister named Maacah. One of his descendants was Zelophehad, who had only daughters.

verses.kjv_text: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother {was} Sheresh; and his sons {were} Ulam and Rakem.
verses.nlt_text: Makir's wife, Maacah, gave birth to a son whom she named Peresh. His brother's name was Sheresh. The sons of Peresh were Ulam and Rakem.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These {were} the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.nlt_text: The son of Ulam was Bedan. All these were considered Gileadites, descendants of Makir son of Manasseh.

verses.kjv_text: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.nlt_text: Makir's sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Ephraim were Shuthelah, Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,

verses.kjv_text: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath {that were} born in {that} land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.nlt_text: Zabad, Shuthelah, Ezer, and Elead. These two were killed trying to steal livestock from the local farmers near Gath.

verses.kjv_text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.nlt_text: Their father, Ephraim, mourned for them a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.

verses.kjv_text: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward Ephraim slept with his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. Ephraim named him Beriah because of the tragedy his family had suffered.

verses.kjv_text: (And his daughter {was} Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
verses.nlt_text: He had a daughter named Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower and Upper Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah.

verses.kjv_text: And Rephah {was} his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Ephraim included Rephah, Resheph, Telah, Tahan,

verses.kjv_text: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.nlt_text: Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama,

verses.kjv_text: Non his son, Jehoshua his son. {Non: or, Nun} {Jehoshua: or, Joshua}
verses.nlt_text: Nun, and Joshua.

verses.kjv_text: And their possessions and habitations {were}, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof: {towns: Heb. daughters} {unto Gaza: or, Adassa}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Ephraim lived in the territory that included Bethel and its surrounding towns to the south, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its surrounding villages to the north as far as Ayyah and its towns.

verses.kjv_text: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel. {towns: Heb. daughters}
verses.nlt_text: Along the border of Manasseh were the towns of Beth-shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and their surrounding villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. They had a sister named Serah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who {is} the father of Birzavith.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malkiel (the father of Birzaith).

verses.kjv_text: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Heber were Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham. They had a sister named Shua.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These {are} the children of Japhlet.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Shomer were Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of his brother Helem were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Zophah were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

verses.kjv_text: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.nlt_text: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Jether were Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

verses.kjv_text: All these {were} the children of Asher, heads of {their} father's house, choice {and} mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war {and} to battle {was} twenty and six thousand men.
verses.nlt_text: Each of these descendants of Asher was the head of an ancestral clan. They were all select men-- mighty warriors and outstanding leaders. The total number of men available for military service was 26,000, as listed in their genealogical records.

verses.kjv_text: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.nlt_text: Benjamin's first son was Bela, the second was Ashbel, the third was Aharah,

verses.kjv_text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.nlt_text: the fourth was Nohah, and the fifth was Rapha.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud, {Addar: or, Ard}
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Bela were Addar, Gera, Abihud,

verses.kjv_text: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.nlt_text: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

verses.kjv_text: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram. {Shephuphan: or, Shupham}
verses.nlt_text: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Ehud, leaders of the clans living at Geba, were exiled to Manahath.

verses.kjv_text: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.nlt_text: Ehud's sons were Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. Gera, who led them into exile, was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.kjv_text: And Shaharaim begat {children} in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara {were} his wives.
verses.nlt_text: After Shaharaim divorced his wives Hushim and Baara, he had children in the land of Moab.

verses.kjv_text: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.nlt_text: Hodesh, his new wife, gave birth to Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

verses.kjv_text: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These {were} his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Jeuz, Sakia, and Mirmah. These sons all became the leaders of clans.

verses.kjv_text: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.nlt_text: Shaharaim's wife Hushim had already given birth to Abitub and Elpaal.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Elpaal were Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built the towns of Ono and Lod and their nearby villages),

verses.kjv_text: Beriah also, and Shema, who {were} heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.nlt_text: Beriah, and Shema. They were the leaders of the clans living in Aijalon, and they drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.nlt_text: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

verses.kjv_text: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.nlt_text: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

verses.kjv_text: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.nlt_text: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

verses.kjv_text: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.nlt_text: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

verses.kjv_text: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.nlt_text: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

verses.kjv_text: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.nlt_text: Jakim, Zicri, Zabdi,

verses.kjv_text: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.nlt_text: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

verses.kjv_text: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi; {Shimhi: or, Shema}
verses.nlt_text: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.

verses.kjv_text: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.nlt_text: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

verses.kjv_text: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.nlt_text: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan,

verses.kjv_text: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.nlt_text: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

verses.kjv_text: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.nlt_text: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

verses.kjv_text: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.nlt_text: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

verses.kjv_text: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.nlt_text: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zicri were the sons of Jeroham.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief {men}. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: These were the leaders of the ancestral clans; they were listed in their genealogical records, and they all lived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name {was} Maachah: {father...: also called Jehiel}
verses.nlt_text: Jeiel (the father of Gibeon) lived in the town of Gibeon. His wife's name was Maacah,

verses.kjv_text: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.nlt_text: and his oldest son was named Abdon. Jeiel's other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

verses.kjv_text: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher. {Zacher: or, Zechariah}
verses.nlt_text: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah,

verses.kjv_text: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them. {Shimeah: or, Shimeam}
verses.nlt_text: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeam. All these families lived near each other in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal. {Abinadab: also called, Ishui} {Eshbaal: or, Ishbosheth}
verses.nlt_text: Ner was the father of Kish. Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.kjv_text: And the son of Jonathan {was} Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah. {Meribbaal: or, Mephibosheth}
verses.nlt_text: Jonathan was the father of Merib-baal. Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Micah {were}, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz. {Tarea: or, Tahrea}
verses.nlt_text: Micah was the father of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza, {Jehoadah: also called, Jarah}
verses.nlt_text: Ahaz was the father of Jadah. Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.

verses.kjv_text: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha {was} his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son: {Rapha: also called, Rephaiah}
verses.nlt_text: Moza was the father of Binea. Binea was the father of Rephaiah. Rephaiah was the father of Eleasah. Eleasah was the father of Azel.

verses.kjv_text: And Azel had six sons, whose names {are} these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these {were} the sons of Azel.
verses.nlt_text: Azel had six sons: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Eshek his brother {were}, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.nlt_text: Azel's brother Eshek had three sons: the first was Ulam, the second was Jeush, and the third was Eliphelet.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these {are} of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.nlt_text: Ulam's sons were all mighty warriors and expert archers. They had many sons and grandsons-- 150 in all. All these were descendants of Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they {were} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, {who} were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.nlt_text: So all Israel was listed in the genealogical records in [The Book of the Kings of Israel.] The people of Judah were exiled to Babylon because they were unfaithful to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Now the first inhabitants that {dwelt} in their possessions in their cities {were}, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.nlt_text: The first of the exiles to return to their property in their former towns were priests, Levites, Temple servants, and other Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.nlt_text: Some of the people from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh came and settled in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.nlt_text: One family that returned was that of Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.nlt_text: Others returned from the Shilonite clan, including Asaiah (the oldest) and his sons.

verses.kjv_text: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.nlt_text: From the Zerahite clan, Jeuel returned with his relatives. In all, 690 families from the tribe of Judah returned.

verses.kjv_text: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Benjamin came Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah;

verses.kjv_text: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.nlt_text: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, son of Micri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah.

verses.kjv_text: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men {were} chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: These men were all leaders of clans, and they were listed in their genealogical records. In all, 956 families from the tribe of Benjamin returned.

verses.kjv_text: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.nlt_text: Among the priests who returned were Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jakin,

verses.kjv_text: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God; {Azariah: also called, Seraiah}
verses.nlt_text: Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub. Azariah was the chief officer of the house of God.

verses.kjv_text: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.nlt_text: Other returning priests were Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah, and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer.

verses.kjv_text: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God. {very...: Heb. mighty men of valour}
verses.nlt_text: In all, 1,760 priests returned. They were heads of clans and very able men. They were responsible for ministering at the house of God.

verses.kjv_text: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.nlt_text: The Levites who returned were Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;

verses.kjv_text: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.nlt_text: Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zicri, son of Asaph;

verses.kjv_text: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.nlt_text: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the area of Netophah.

verses.kjv_text: And the porters {were}, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum {was} the chief;
verses.nlt_text: The gatekeepers who returned were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was the chief gatekeeper.

verses.kjv_text: Who hitherto {waited} in the king's gate eastward: they {were} porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.nlt_text: Prior to this time, they were responsible for the King's Gate on the east side. These men served as gatekeepers for the camps of the Levites.

verses.kjv_text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, {were} over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, {being} over the host of the LORD, {were} keepers of the entry. {gates: Heb. thresholds}
verses.nlt_text: Shallum was the son of Kore, a descendant of Abiasaph, from the clan of Korah. He and his relatives, the Korahites, were responsible for guarding the entrance to the sanctuary, just as their ancestors had guarded the Tabernacle in the camp of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, {and} the LORD {was} with him.
verses.nlt_text: Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers in earlier times, and the LORD had been with him.

verses.kjv_text: {And} Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah {was} porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: And later Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was responsible for guarding the entrance to the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: All these {which were} chosen to be porters in the gates {were} two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office. {did...: Heb. founded} {set...: or, trust}
verses.nlt_text: In all, there were 212 gatekeepers in those days, and they were listed according to the genealogies in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed their ancestors because they were reliable men.

verses.kjv_text: So they and their children {had} the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, {namely}, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.nlt_text: These gatekeepers and their descendants, by their divisions, were responsible for guarding the entrance to the house of the LORD when that house was a tent.

verses.kjv_text: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.nlt_text: The gatekeepers were stationed on all four sides-- east, west, north, and south.

verses.kjv_text: And their brethren, {which were} in their villages, {were} to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.nlt_text: Their relatives in the villages came regularly to share their duties for seven-day periods.

verses.kjv_text: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in {their} set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God. {set...: or, trust} {chambers: or, storehouses}
verses.nlt_text: The four chief gatekeepers, all Levites, were trusted officials, for they were responsible for the rooms and treasuries at the house of God.

verses.kjv_text: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge {was} upon them, and the opening thereof every morning {pertained} to them.
verses.nlt_text: They would spend the night around the house of God, since it was their duty to guard it and to open the gates every morning.

verses.kjv_text: And {certain} of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale. {bring...: Heb. bring them in by tale, and carry them out by tale}
verses.nlt_text: Some of the gatekeepers were assigned to care for the various articles used in worship. They checked them in and out to avoid any loss.

verses.kjv_text: {Some} of them also {were} appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices. {instruments: or, vessels}
verses.nlt_text: Others were responsible for the furnishings, the items in the sanctuary, and the supplies, such as choice flour, wine, olive oil, frankincense, and spices.

verses.kjv_text: And {some} of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.nlt_text: But it was the priests who blended the spices.

verses.kjv_text: And Mattithiah, {one} of the Levites, who {was} the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans. {set...: or, trust} {in...: or, on flat plates, or, slices}
verses.nlt_text: Mattithiah, a Levite and the oldest son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread used in the offerings.

verses.kjv_text: And {other} of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, {were} over the shewbread, to prepare {it} every sabbath. {shewbread: Heb. bread of ordering}
verses.nlt_text: And some members of the clan of Kohath were in charge of preparing the bread to be set on the table each Sabbath day.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, {who remaining} in the chambers {were} free: for they were employed in {that} work day and night. {they...: Heb. upon them}
verses.nlt_text: The musicians, all prominent Levites, lived at the Temple. They were exempt from other responsibilities since they were on duty at all hours.

verses.kjv_text: These chief fathers of the Levites {were} chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: All these men lived in Jerusalem. They were the heads of Levite families and were listed as prominent leaders in their genealogical records.

verses.kjv_text: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name {was} Maachah:
verses.nlt_text: Jeiel (the father of Gibeon) lived in the town of Gibeon. His wife's name was Maacah,

verses.kjv_text: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.nlt_text: and his oldest son was named Abdon. Jeiel's other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

verses.kjv_text: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.nlt_text: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.kjv_text: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. All these families lived near each other in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.nlt_text: Ner was the father of Kish. Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.kjv_text: And the son of Jonathan {was} Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.nlt_text: Jonathan was the father of Merib-baal. Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Micah {were}, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, {and Ahaz}.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

verses.kjv_text: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.nlt_text: Ahaz was the father of Jadah. Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.

verses.kjv_text: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.nlt_text: Moza was the father of Binea. Binea's son was Rephaiah. Rephaiah's son was Eleasah. Eleasah's son was Azel.

verses.kjv_text: And Azel had six sons, whose names {are} these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these {were} the sons of Azel.
verses.nlt_text: Azel had six sons, whose names were Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa. {slain: or, wounded}
verses.nlt_text: Now the Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them. Many were slaughtered on the slopes of Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv_text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul. {Abinadab: also called, Ishui}
verses.nlt_text: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons, and they killed three of his sons-- Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malkishua.

verses.kjv_text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers. {and the archers: Heb. and the shooters with bows} {hit: Heb. found}
verses.nlt_text: The fighting grew very fierce around Saul, and the Philistine archers caught up with him and wounded him.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it. {abuse me: or, mock me}
verses.nlt_text: Saul groaned to his armor bearer, "Take your sword and kill me before these pagan Philistines come to taunt and torture me." But his armor bearer was afraid and would not do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

verses.kjv_text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.nlt_text: When his armor bearer realized that Saul was dead, he fell on his own sword and died.

verses.kjv_text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.nlt_text: So Saul and his three sons died there together, bringing his dynasty to an end.

verses.kjv_text: And when all the men of Israel that {were} in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.nlt_text: When all the Israelites in the Jezreel Valley saw that their army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. So the Philistines moved in and occupied their towns.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.nlt_text: The next day, when the Philistines went out to strip the dead, they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.nlt_text: So they stripped off Saul's armor and cut off his head. Then they proclaimed the good news of Saul's death before their idols and to the people throughout the land of Philistia.

verses.kjv_text: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.nlt_text: They placed his armor in the temple of their gods, and they fastened his head to the temple of Dagon.

verses.kjv_text: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.nlt_text: But when everyone in Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.kjv_text: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.nlt_text: all their mighty warriors brought the bodies of Saul and his sons back to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones beneath the great tree at Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.

verses.kjv_text: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, {even} against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking {counsel} of {one that had} a familiar spirit, to enquire {of it}; {committed: Heb. transgressed}
verses.nlt_text: So Saul died because he was unfaithful to the LORD. He failed to obey the LORD's command, and he even consulted a medium

verses.kjv_text: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse. {Jesse: Heb. Isai}
verses.nlt_text: instead of asking the LORD for guidance. So the LORD killed him and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

verses.kjv_text: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we {are} thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.nlt_text: Then all Israel gathered before David at Hebron and told him, "We are your own flesh and blood.

verses.kjv_text: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou {wast} he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel. {in time...: Heb. both yesterday and the third day} {feed: or, rule}
verses.nlt_text: In the past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who really led the forces of Israel. And the LORD your God told you, 'You will be the shepherd of my people Israel. You will be the leader of my people Israel.' "

verses.kjv_text: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel. {by: Heb. by the hand of}
verses.nlt_text: So there at Hebron, David made a covenant before the LORD with all the elders of Israel. And they anointed him king of Israel, just as the LORD had promised through Samuel.

verses.kjv_text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which {is} Jebus; where the Jebusites {were}, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.nlt_text: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (or Jebus, as it used to be called), where the Jebusites, the original inhabitants of the land, were living.

verses.kjv_text: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which {is} the city of David.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Jebus taunted David, saying, "You'll never get in here!" But David captured the fortress of Zion, which is now called the City of David.

verses.kjv_text: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief. {chief: Heb. head}
verses.nlt_text: David had said to his troops, "Whoever is first to attack the Jebusites will become the commander of my armies!" And Joab, the son of David's sister Zeruiah, was first to attack, so he became the commander of David's armies.

verses.kjv_text: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David. {it: that is, Zion}
verses.nlt_text: David made the fortress his home, and that is why it is called the City of David.

verses.kjv_text: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city. {repaired: Heb. revived}
verses.nlt_text: He extended the city from the supporting terraces to the surrounding area, while Joab rebuilt the rest of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts {was} with him. {waxed...: Heb. went in going and increasing}
verses.nlt_text: And David became more and more powerful, because the LORD of Heaven's Armies was with him.

verses.kjv_text: These also {are} the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, {and} with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel. {strengthened...: or, held strongly with him}
verses.nlt_text: These are the leaders of David's mighty warriors. Together with all Israel, they decided to make David their king, just as the LORD had promised concerning Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And this {is} the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain {by him} at one time. {an Hachmonite: or, son of Hachmoni}
verses.nlt_text: Here is the record of David's mightiest warriors: The first was Jashobeam the Hacmonite, who was leader of the Three-- the mightiest warriors among David's men. He once used his spear to kill 300 enemy warriors in a single battle.

verses.kjv_text: And after him {was} Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who {was one} of the three mighties.
verses.nlt_text: Next in rank among the Three was Eleazar son of Dodai, a descendant of Ahoah.

verses.kjv_text: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines. {Pasdammim: also called, Ephesdammim}
verses.nlt_text: He was with David in the battle against the Philistines at Pas-dammim. The battle took place in a field full of barley, and the Israelite army fled.

verses.kjv_text: And they set themselves in the midst of {that} parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved {them} by a great deliverance. {set...: or, stood} {deliverance: or, salvation}
verses.nlt_text: But Eleazar and David held their ground in the middle of the field and beat back the Philistines. So the LORD saved them by giving them a great victory.

verses.kjv_text: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim. {three...: or, three captains over the thirty}
verses.nlt_text: Once when David was at the rock near the cave of Adullam, the Philistine army was camped in the valley of Rephaim. The Three (who were among the Thirty-- an elite group among David's fighting men) went down to meet him there.

verses.kjv_text: And David {was} then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison {was} then at Bethlehem.
verses.nlt_text: David was staying in the stronghold at the time, and a Philistine detachment had occupied the town of Bethlehem.

verses.kjv_text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that {is} at the gate!
verses.nlt_text: David remarked longingly to his men, "Oh, how I would love some of that good water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem."

verses.kjv_text: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that {was} by the gate, and took {it}, and brought {it} to David: but David would not drink {of} it, but poured it out to the LORD,
verses.nlt_text: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew some water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But David refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with {the jeopardy of} their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest. {that have...: Heb. with their lives?}
verses.nlt_text: "God forbid that I should drink this!" he exclaimed. "This water is as precious as the blood of these men who risked their lives to bring it to me." So David did not drink it. These are examples of the exploits of the Three.

verses.kjv_text: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew {them}, and had a name among the three.
verses.nlt_text: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was the leader of the Thirty. He once used his spear to kill 300 enemy warriors in a single battle. It was by such feats that he became as famous as the Three.

verses.kjv_text: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the {first} three.
verses.nlt_text: Abishai was the most famous of the Thirty and was their commander, though he was not one of the Three.

verses.kjv_text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day. {who had...: Heb. great of deeds}
verses.nlt_text: There was also Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant warrior from Kabzeel. He did many heroic deeds, which included killing two champions of Moab. Another time, on a snowy day, he chased a lion down into a pit and killed it.

verses.kjv_text: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of {great} stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand {was} a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear. {great...: Heb. measure}
verses.nlt_text: Once, armed only with a club, he killed an Egyptian warrior who was 7-1/2 feet tall and whose spear was as thick as a weaver's beam. Benaiah wrenched the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed him with it.

verses.kjv_text: These {things} did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.nlt_text: Deeds like these made Benaiah as famous as the three mightiest warriors.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the {first} three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.nlt_text: He was more honored than the other members of the Thirty, though he was not one of the Three. And David made him captain of his bodyguard.

verses.kjv_text: Also the valiant men of the armies {were}, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.nlt_text: David's mighty warriors also included: Asahel, Joab's brother; Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem;

verses.kjv_text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite, {Shammoth: or, Shammah} {Harorite: or, Harodite} {Pelonite: or, Paltite}
verses.nlt_text: Shammah from Harod; Helez from Pelon;

verses.kjv_text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.nlt_text: Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth;

verses.kjv_text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite, {Sibbecai: or, Mebunnai} {Ilai: or, Zalmon}
verses.nlt_text: Sibbecai from Hushah; Zalmon from Ahoah;

verses.kjv_text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite, {Heled: or, Heleb}
verses.nlt_text: Maharai from Netophah; Heled son of Baanah from Netophah;

verses.kjv_text: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, {that pertained} to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.nlt_text: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah (in the land of Benjamin); Benaiah from Pirathon;

verses.kjv_text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite, {Hurai: or, Hiddai} {Abiel: or, Abialbon}
verses.nlt_text: Hurai from near Nahale-gaash; Abi-albon from Arabah;

verses.kjv_text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.nlt_text: Azmaveth from Bahurim; Eliahba from Shaalbon;

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite, {Hashem: or, Jashen}
verses.nlt_text: the sons of Jashen from Gizon; Jonathan son of Shagee from Harar;

verses.kjv_text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur, {Sacar: or, Sharar} {Eliphal: or, Eliphelet} {Ur: or, Ahasbai}
verses.nlt_text: Ahiam son of Sharar from Harar; Eliphal son of Ur;

verses.kjv_text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.nlt_text: Hepher from Mekerah; Ahijah from Pelon;

verses.kjv_text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai, {Hezro: or Hezrai} {Naarai: or Paarai the Arbite}
verses.nlt_text: Hezro from Carmel; Paarai son of Ezbai;

verses.kjv_text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri, {the son...: or, the Haggerite}
verses.nlt_text: Joel, the brother of Nathan; Mibhar son of Hagri;

verses.kjv_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.nlt_text: Zelek from Ammon; Naharai from Beeroth, Joab's armor bearer;

verses.kjv_text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.nlt_text: Ira from Jattir; Gareb from Jattir;

verses.kjv_text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.nlt_text: Uriah the Hittite; Zabad son of Ahlai;

verses.kjv_text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.nlt_text: Adina son of Shiza, the Reubenite leader who had thirty men with him;

verses.kjv_text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.nlt_text: Hanan son of Maacah; Joshaphat from Mithna;

verses.kjv_text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.nlt_text: Uzzia from Ashtaroth; Shama and Jeiel, the sons of Hotham, from Aroer;

verses.kjv_text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite, {son...: or, Shimrite}
verses.nlt_text: Jediael son of Shimri; Joha, his brother, from Tiz;

verses.kjv_text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.nlt_text: Eliel from Mahavah; Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam; Ithmah from Moab;

verses.kjv_text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.nlt_text: Eliel and Obed; Jaasiel from Zobah.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they {were} among the mighty men, helpers of the war. {while...: Heb. being yet shut up}
verses.nlt_text: The following men joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul son of Kish. They were among the warriors who fought beside David in battle.

verses.kjv_text: {They were} armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in {hurling} stones and {shooting} arrows out of a bow, {even} of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
verses.nlt_text: All of them were expert archers, and they could shoot arrows or sling stones with their left hand as well as their right. They were all relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: The chief {was} Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite, {Shemaah: or, Hasmaah}
verses.nlt_text: Their leader was Ahiezer son of Shemaah from Gibeah; his brother Joash was second-in-command. These were the other warriors: Jeziel and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu from Anathoth;

verses.kjv_text: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
verses.nlt_text: Ishmaiah from Gibeon, a famous warrior and leader among the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad from Gederah;

verses.kjv_text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.nlt_text: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah from Haruph;

verses.kjv_text: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.nlt_text: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;

verses.kjv_text: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.nlt_text: Joelah and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

verses.kjv_text: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, {and} men of war {fit} for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces {were like} the faces of lions, and {were} as swift as the roes upon the mountains; {of war: Heb. of the host} {as swift...: Heb. as the roes upon the mountains to make haste}
verses.nlt_text: Some brave and experienced warriors from the tribe of Gad also defected to David while he was at the stronghold in the wilderness. They were expert with both shield and spear, as fierce as lions and as swift as deer on the mountains.

verses.kjv_text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.nlt_text: Ezer was their leader. Obadiah was second. Eliab was third.

verses.kjv_text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.nlt_text: Mishmannah was fourth. Jeremiah was fifth.

verses.kjv_text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.nlt_text: Attai was sixth. Eliel was seventh.

verses.kjv_text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.nlt_text: Johanan was eighth. Elzabad was ninth.

verses.kjv_text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.nlt_text: Jeremiah was tenth. Macbannai was eleventh.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least {was} over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand. {one...: or, one that was least could resist an hundred, and the greatest a thousand}
verses.nlt_text: These warriors from Gad were army commanders. The weakest among them could take on a hundred regular troops, and the strongest could take on a thousand!

verses.kjv_text: These {are} they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all {them} of the valleys, {both} toward the east, and toward the west. {overflown: Heb. filled over}
verses.nlt_text: These were the men who crossed the Jordan River during its seasonal flooding at the beginning of the year and drove out all the people living in the lowlands on both the east and west banks.

verses.kjv_text: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
verses.nlt_text: Others from Benjamin and Judah came to David at the stronghold.

verses.kjv_text: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if {ye be come} to betray me to mine enemies, seeing {there is} no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look {thereon}, and rebuke {it}. {to meet...: Heb. before them} {be knit: Heb. be one} {wrong: or, violence}
verses.nlt_text: David went out to meet them and said, "If you have come in peace to help me, we are friends. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when I am innocent, then may the God of our ancestors see it and punish you."

verses.kjv_text: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, {who was} chief of the captains, {and he said}, Thine {are we}, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace {be} unto thee, and peace {be} to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band. {came...: Heb. clothed}
verses.nlt_text: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the leader of the Thirty, and he said, "We are yours, David! We are on your side, son of Jesse. Peace and prosperity be with you, and success to all who help you, for your God is the one who helps you." So David let them join him, and he made them officers over his troops.

verses.kjv_text: And there fell {some} of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to {the jeopardy of} our heads. {to the...: Heb. on our heads}
verses.nlt_text: Some men from Manasseh defected from the Israelite army and joined David when he set out with the Philistines to fight against Saul. But as it turned out, the Philistine rulers refused to let David and his men go with them. After much discussion, they sent them back, for they said, "It will cost us our heads if David switches loyalties to Saul and turns against us."

verses.kjv_text: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that {were} of Manasseh.
verses.nlt_text: Here is a list of the men from Manasseh who defected to David as he was returning to Ziklag: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. Each commanded 1,000 troops from the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv_text: And they helped David against the band {of the rovers}: for they {were} all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host. {against...: or, with a band}
verses.nlt_text: They helped David chase down bands of raiders, for they were all brave and able warriors who became commanders in his army.

verses.kjv_text: For at {that} time day by day there came to David to help him, until {it was} a great host, like the host of God.
verses.nlt_text: Day after day more men joined David until he had a great army, like the army of God.

verses.kjv_text: And these {are} the numbers of the bands {that were} ready armed to the war, {and} came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD. {bands: or, captains, or, men: Heb. heads}
verses.nlt_text: These are the numbers of armed warriors who joined David at Hebron. They were all eager to see David become king instead of Saul, just as the LORD had promised.

verses.kjv_text: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear {were} six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war. {armed: or, prepared}
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Judah, there were 6,800 warriors armed with shields and spears.

verses.kjv_text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Simeon, there were 7,100 brave warriors.

verses.kjv_text: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Levi, there were 4,600 warriors.

verses.kjv_text: And Jehoiada {was} the leader of the Aaronites, and with him {were} three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.nlt_text: This included Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, who had 3,700 under his command.

verses.kjv_text: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
verses.nlt_text: This also included Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 members of his family who were all officers.

verses.kjv_text: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul. {kindred: Heb. brethren} {the greatest...: Heb. a multitude of them}
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Benjamin, Saul's relatives, there were 3,000 warriors. Most of the men from Benjamin had remained loyal to Saul until this time.

verses.kjv_text: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers. {famous: Heb. men of names}
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Ephraim, there were 20,800 brave warriors, each highly respected in his own clan.

verses.kjv_text: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.nlt_text: From the half-tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan, 18,000 men were designated by name to help David become king.

verses.kjv_text: And of the children of Issachar, {which were men} that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them {were} two hundred; and all their brethren {were} at their commandment.
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Issachar, there were 200 leaders of the tribe with their relatives. All these men understood the signs of the times and knew the best course for Israel to take.

verses.kjv_text: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: {they were} not of double heart. {expert...: or, rangers of battle, or, ranged in battle} {keep...: or, set the battle in array} {not...: Heb. without a heart and a heart}
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Zebulun, there were 50,000 skilled warriors. They were fully armed and prepared for battle and completely loyal to David.

verses.kjv_text: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Naphtali, there were 1,000 officers and 37,000 warriors armed with shields and spears.

verses.kjv_text: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Dan, there were 28,600 warriors, all prepared for battle.

verses.kjv_text: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand. {expert: or, keeping their rank}
verses.nlt_text: From the tribe of Asher, there were 40,000 trained warriors, all prepared for battle.

verses.kjv_text: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.nlt_text: From the east side of the Jordan River-- where the tribes of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh lived-- there were 120,000 troops armed with every kind of weapon.

verses.kjv_text: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel {were} of one heart to make David king.
verses.nlt_text: All these men came in battle array to Hebron with the single purpose of making David the king over all Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel agreed that David should be their king.

verses.kjv_text: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.nlt_text: They feasted and drank with David for three days, for preparations had been made by their relatives for their arrival.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover they that were nigh them, {even} unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, {and} meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for {there was} joy in Israel. {meat...: or, victual of meal}
verses.nlt_text: And people from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen. Vast supplies of flour, fig cakes, clusters of raisins, wine, olive oil, cattle, sheep, and goats were brought to the celebration. There was great joy throughout the land of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, {and} with every leader.
verses.nlt_text: David consulted with all his officials, including the generals and captains of his army.

verses.kjv_text: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If {it seem} good unto you, and {that it be} of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, {that are} left in all the land of Israel, and with them {also} to the priests and Levites {which are} in their cities {and} suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us: {send...: Heb. break forth and send} {in their...: Heb. in the cities of their suburbs}
verses.nlt_text: Then he addressed the entire assembly of Israel as follows: "If you approve and if it is the will of the LORD our God, let us send messages to all the Israelites throughout the land, including the priests and Levites in their towns and pasturelands. Let us invite them to come and join us.

verses.kjv_text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul. {bring...: Heb. bring about}
verses.nlt_text: It is time to bring back the Ark of our God, for we neglected it during the reign of Saul."

verses.kjv_text: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.nlt_text: The whole assembly agreed to this, for the people could see it was the right thing to do.

verses.kjv_text: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
verses.nlt_text: So David summoned all Israel, from the Shihor Brook of Egypt in the south all the way to the town of Lebo-hamath in the north, to join in bringing the Ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

verses.kjv_text: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, {that is}, to Kirjathjearim, which {belonged} to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth {between} the cherubims, whose name is called {on it}.
verses.nlt_text: Then David and all Israel went to Baalah of Judah (also called Kiriath-jearim) to bring back the Ark of God, which bears the name of the LORD who is enthroned between the cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart. {carried...: Heb. made the ark to ride}
verses.nlt_text: They placed the Ark of God on a new cart and brought it from Abinadab's house. Uzzah and Ahio were guiding the cart.

verses.kjv_text: And David and all Israel played before God with all {their} might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets. {singing: Heb. songs}
verses.nlt_text: David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, singing songs and playing all kinds of musical instruments-- lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

verses.kjv_text: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled. {Chidon: also called Nachon} {stumbled: or, shook it}
verses.nlt_text: But when they arrived at the threshing floor of Nacon, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the Ark.

verses.kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD's anger was aroused against Uzzah, and he struck him dead because he had laid his hand on the Ark. So Uzzah died there in the presence of God.

verses.kjv_text: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day. {Perezuzza: that is, The breach of Uzza}
verses.nlt_text: David was angry because the LORD's anger had burst out against Uzzah. He named that place Perez-uzzah (which means "to burst out against Uzzah"), as it is still called today.

verses.kjv_text: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God {home} to me?
verses.nlt_text: David was now afraid of God, and he asked, "How can I ever bring the Ark of God back into my care?"

verses.kjv_text: So David brought not the ark {home} to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite. {brought: Heb. removed}
verses.nlt_text: So David did not move the Ark into the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-edom of Gath.

verses.kjv_text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
verses.nlt_text: The Ark of God remained there in Obed-edom's house for three months, and the LORD blessed the household of Obed-edom and everything he owned.

verses.kjv_text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.nlt_text: Then King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar timber, and stonemasons and carpenters to build him a palace.

verses.kjv_text: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.nlt_text: And David realized that the LORD had confirmed him as king over Israel and had greatly blessed his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters. {more: Heb. yet}
verses.nlt_text: Then David married more wives in Jerusalem, and they had more sons and daughters.

verses.kjv_text: Now these {are} the names of {his} children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.nlt_text: These are the names of David's sons who were born in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

verses.kjv_text: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.nlt_text: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

verses.kjv_text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.nlt_text: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.kjv_text: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet. {Beeliada: also called, Eliada}
verses.nlt_text: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

verses.kjv_text: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard {of it}, and went out against them.
verses.nlt_text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they mobilized all their forces to capture him. But David was told they were coming, so he marched out to meet them.

verses.kjv_text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.nlt_text: The Philistines arrived and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv_text: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.nlt_text: So David asked God, "Should I go out to fight the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The LORD replied, "Yes, go ahead. I will hand them over to you."

verses.kjv_text: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim. {Baalperazim: that is, A place of breaches}
verses.nlt_text: So David and his troops went up to Baal-perazim and defeated the Philistines there. "God did it!" David exclaimed. "He used me to burst through my enemies like a raging flood!" So they named that place Baal-perazim (which means "the Lord who bursts through").

verses.kjv_text: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.nlt_text: The Philistines had abandoned their gods there, so David gave orders to burn them.

verses.kjv_text: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.nlt_text: But after a while the Philistines returned and raided the valley again.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.nlt_text: And once again David asked God what to do. "Do not attack them straight on," God replied. "Instead, circle around behind and attack them near the poplar trees.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, {that} then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.nlt_text: When you hear a sound like marching feet in the tops of the poplar trees, go out and attack! That will be the signal that God is moving ahead of you to strike down the Philistine army."

verses.kjv_text: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer. {Gibeon: also called, Geba}
verses.nlt_text: So David did what God commanded, and they struck down the Philistine army all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

verses.kjv_text: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.nlt_text: So David's fame spread everywhere, and the LORD caused all the nations to fear David.

verses.kjv_text: And {David} made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.nlt_text: David now built several buildings for himself in the City of David. He also prepared a place for the Ark of God and set up a special tent for it.

verses.kjv_text: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever. {None...: Heb. It is not to carry the ark of God, but for the Levites}
verses.nlt_text: Then he commanded, "No one except the Levites may carry the Ark of God. The LORD has chosen them to carry the Ark of the LORD and to serve him forever."

verses.kjv_text: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.nlt_text: Then David summoned all Israel to Jerusalem to bring the Ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.

verses.kjv_text: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.nlt_text: This is the number of the descendants of Aaron (the priests) and the Levites who were called together:

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty: {brethren: or, kinsmen}
verses.nlt_text: From the clan of Kohath, 120, with Uriel as their leader.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.nlt_text: From the clan of Merari, 220, with Asaiah as their leader.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.nlt_text: From the clan of Gershon, 130, with Joel as their leader.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Elizaphan, 200, with Shemaiah as their leader.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Hebron, 80, with Eliel as their leader.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Uzziel, 112, with Amminadab as their leader.

verses.kjv_text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.nlt_text: Then David summoned the priests, Zadok and Abiathar, and these Levite leaders: Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, Ye {are} the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, {both} ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto {the place that} I have prepared for it.
verses.nlt_text: He said to them, "You are the leaders of the Levite families. You must purify yourselves and all your fellow Levites, so you can bring the Ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.

verses.kjv_text: For because ye {did it} not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.nlt_text: Because you Levites did not carry the Ark the first time, the anger of the LORD our God burst out against us. We failed to ask God how to move it properly."

verses.kjv_text: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So the priests and the Levites purified themselves in order to bring the Ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Levites carried the Ark of God on their shoulders with its carrying poles, just as the LORD had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren {to be} the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.nlt_text: David also ordered the Levite leaders to appoint a choir of Levites who were singers and musicians to sing joyful songs to the accompaniment of harps, lyres, and cymbals.

verses.kjv_text: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.nlt_text: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel along with his fellow Levites: Asaph son of Berekiah, and Ethan son of Kushaiah from the clan of Merari.

verses.kjv_text: And with them their brethren of the second {degree}, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.nlt_text: The following men were chosen as their assistants: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers-- Obed-edom and Jeiel.

verses.kjv_text: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, {were appointed} to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.nlt_text: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were chosen to sound the bronze cymbals.

verses.kjv_text: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.nlt_text: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were chosen to play the harps.

verses.kjv_text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel. {on the...: or, on the eighth to oversee}
verses.nlt_text: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were chosen to play the lyres.

verses.kjv_text: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, {was} for song: he instructed about the song, because he {was} skilful. {was for...: or, was for the carriage: he instructed about the carriage} {song: Heb. lifting up}
verses.nlt_text: Kenaniah, the head Levite, was chosen as the choir leader because of his skill.

verses.kjv_text: And Berechiah and Elkanah {were} doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.nlt_text: Berekiah and Elkanah were chosen to guard the Ark.

verses.kjv_text: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah {were} doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.nlt_text: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer-- all of whom were priests-- were chosen to blow the trumpets as they marched in front of the Ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were chosen to guard the Ark.

verses.kjv_text: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
verses.nlt_text: Then David and the elders of Israel and the generals of the army went to the house of Obed-edom to bring the Ark of the LORD's Covenant up to Jerusalem with a great celebration.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.nlt_text: And because God was clearly helping the Levites as they carried the Ark of the LORD's Covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

verses.kjv_text: And David {was} clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also {had} upon him an ephod of linen. {song: or, carriage}
verses.nlt_text: David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who carried the Ark, and also the singers, and Kenaniah the choir leader. David was also wearing a priestly garment.

verses.kjv_text: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.nlt_text: So all Israel brought up the Ark of the LORD's Covenant with shouts of joy, the blowing of rams' horns and trumpets, the crashing of cymbals, and loud playing on harps and lyres.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, {as} the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.nlt_text: But as the Ark of the LORD's Covenant entered the City of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looked down from her window. When she saw King David skipping about and laughing with joy, she was filled with contempt for him.

verses.kjv_text: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.nlt_text: They brought the Ark of God and placed it inside the special tent David had prepared for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings to God.

verses.kjv_text: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: When he had finished his sacrifices, David blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon {of wine}.
verses.nlt_text: Then he gave to every man and woman in all Israel a loaf of bread, a cake of dates, and a cake of raisins.

verses.kjv_text: And he appointed {certain} of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: David appointed the following Levites to lead the people in worship before the Ark of the LORD-- to invoke his blessings, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
