verses.kjv_text: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals; {with psalteries...: Heb. with instruments of psalteries and harps}
verses.nlt_text: Asaph, the leader of this group, sounded the cymbals. Second to him was Zechariah, followed by Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They played the harps and lyres.

verses.kjv_text: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.nlt_text: The priests, Benaiah and Jahaziel, played the trumpets regularly before the Ark of God's Covenant.

verses.kjv_text: Then on that day David delivered first {this psalm} to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: On that day David gave to Asaph and his fellow Levites this song of thanksgiving to the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.nlt_text: Give thanks to the LORD and proclaim his greatness. Let the whole world know what he has done.

verses.kjv_text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.nlt_text: Sing to him; yes, sing his praises. Tell everyone about his wonderful deeds.

verses.kjv_text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Exult in his holy name; rejoice, you who worship the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.nlt_text: Search for the LORD and for his strength; continually seek him.

verses.kjv_text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.nlt_text: Remember the wonders he has performed, his miracles, and the rulings he has given,

verses.kjv_text: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.nlt_text: you children of his servant Israel, you descendants of Jacob, his chosen ones.

verses.kjv_text: He {is} the LORD our God; his judgments {are} in all the earth.
verses.nlt_text: He is the LORD our God. His justice is seen throughout the land.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word {which} he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.nlt_text: Remember his covenant forever-- the commitment he made to a thousand generations.

verses.kjv_text: {Even of the covenant} which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.nlt_text: This is the covenant he made with Abraham and the oath he swore to Isaac.

verses.kjv_text: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, {and} to Israel {for} an everlasting covenant,
verses.nlt_text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, and to the people of Israel as a never-ending covenant:

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance; {the lot: Heb. the cord}
verses.nlt_text: "I will give you the land of Canaan as your special possession."

verses.kjv_text: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it. {few, even: Heb. men of number, etc}
verses.nlt_text: He said this when you were few in number, a tiny group of strangers in Canaan.

verses.kjv_text: And {when} they went from nation to nation, and from {one} kingdom to another people;
verses.nlt_text: They wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

verses.kjv_text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.nlt_text: Yet he did not let anyone oppress them. He warned kings on their behalf:

verses.kjv_text: {Saying}, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.nlt_text: "Do not touch my chosen people, and do not hurt my prophets."

verses.kjv_text: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.nlt_text: Let the whole earth sing to the LORD! Each day proclaim the good news that he saves.

verses.kjv_text: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.nlt_text: Publish his glorious deeds among the nations. Tell everyone about the amazing things he does.

verses.kjv_text: For great {is} the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also {is} to be feared above all gods.
verses.nlt_text: Great is the LORD! He is most worthy of praise! He is to be feared above all gods.

verses.kjv_text: For all the gods of the people {are} idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.nlt_text: The gods of other nations are mere idols, but the LORD made the heavens!

verses.kjv_text: Glory and honour {are} in his presence; strength and gladness {are} in his place.
verses.nlt_text: Honor and majesty surround him; strength and joy fill his dwelling.

verses.kjv_text: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.nlt_text: O nations of the world, recognize the LORD, recognize that the LORD is glorious and strong.

verses.kjv_text: Give unto the LORD the glory {due} unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.nlt_text: Give to the LORD the glory he deserves! Bring your offering and come into his presence. Worship the LORD in all his holy splendor.

verses.kjv_text: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.nlt_text: Let all the earth tremble before him. The world stands firm and cannot be shaken.

verses.kjv_text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let {men} say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
verses.nlt_text: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice! Tell all the nations, "The LORD reigns!"

verses.kjv_text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that {is} therein.
verses.nlt_text: Let the sea and everything in it shout his praise! Let the fields and their crops burst out with joy!

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Let the trees of the forest rustle with praise, for the LORD is coming to judge the earth.

verses.kjv_text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for {he is} good; for his mercy {endureth} for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.

verses.kjv_text: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, {and} glory in thy praise.
verses.nlt_text: Cry out, "Save us, O God of our salvation! Gather and rescue us from among the nations, so we can thank your holy name and rejoice and praise you."

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, who lives from everlasting to everlasting! And all the people shouted "Amen!" and praised the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.nlt_text: David arranged for Asaph and his fellow Levites to serve regularly before the Ark of the LORD's Covenant, doing whatever needed to be done each day.

verses.kjv_text: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah {to be} porters:
verses.nlt_text: This group included Obed-edom (son of Jeduthun), Hosah, and sixty-eight other Levites as gatekeepers.

verses.kjv_text: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that {was} at Gibeon,
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, David stationed Zadok the priest and his fellow priests at the Tabernacle of the LORD at the place of worship in Gibeon, where they continued to minister before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and {to do} according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel; {morning...: Heb. in the morning, and in the evening}
verses.nlt_text: They sacrificed the regular burnt offerings to the LORD each morning and evening on the altar set aside for that purpose, obeying everything written in the Law of the LORD, as he had commanded Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy {endureth} for ever;
verses.nlt_text: David also appointed Heman, Jeduthun, and the others chosen by name to give thanks to the LORD, for "his faithful love endures forever."

verses.kjv_text: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun {were} porters. {porters: Heb. for the gate}
verses.nlt_text: They used their trumpets, cymbals, and other instruments to accompany their songs of praise to God. And the sons of Jeduthun were appointed as gatekeepers.

verses.kjv_text: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.nlt_text: Then all the people returned to their homes, and David turned and went home to bless his own family.

verses.kjv_text: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD {remaineth} under curtains.
verses.nlt_text: When David was settled in his palace, he summoned Nathan the prophet. "Look," David said, "I am living in a beautiful cedar palace, but the Ark of the LORD's Covenant is out there under a tent!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that {is} in thine heart; for God {is} with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Nathan replied to David, "Do whatever you have in mind, for God is with you."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.nlt_text: But that same night God said to Nathan,

verses.kjv_text: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.nlt_text: "Go and tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD has declared: You are not the one to build a house for me to live in.

verses.kjv_text: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from {one} tabernacle {to another}. {have gone: Heb. have been}
verses.nlt_text: I have never lived in a house, from the day I brought the Israelites out of Egypt until this very day. My home has always been a tent, moving from one place to another in a Tabernacle.

verses.kjv_text: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.nlt_text: Yet no matter where I have gone with the Israelites, I have never once complained to Israel's leaders, the shepherds of my people. I have never asked them, "Why haven't you built me a beautiful cedar house?" '

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, {even} from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel: {from following: Heb. from after}
verses.nlt_text: "Now go and say to my servant David, 'This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies has declared: I took you from tending sheep in the pasture and selected you to be the leader of my people Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that {are} in the earth.
verses.nlt_text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have destroyed all your enemies before your eyes. Now I will make your name as famous as anyone who has ever lived on the earth!

verses.kjv_text: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.nlt_text: And I will provide a homeland for my people Israel, planting them in a secure place where they will never be disturbed. Evil nations won't oppress them as they've done in the past,

verses.kjv_text: And since the time that I commanded judges {to be} over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
verses.nlt_text: starting from the time I appointed judges to rule my people Israel. And I will defeat all your enemies. " 'Furthermore, I declare that the LORD will build a house for you-- a dynasty of kings!

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go {to be} with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: For when you die and join your ancestors, I will raise up one of your descendants, one of your sons, and I will make his kingdom strong.

verses.kjv_text: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.nlt_text: He is the one who will build a house-- a temple-- for me. And I will secure his throne forever.

verses.kjv_text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took {it} from {him} that was before thee:
verses.nlt_text: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my favor from him as I took it from the one who ruled before you.

verses.kjv_text: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.nlt_text: I will confirm him as king over my house and my kingdom for all time, and his throne will be secure forever.'"

verses.kjv_text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.nlt_text: So Nathan went back to David and told him everything the LORD had said in this vision.

verses.kjv_text: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who {am} I, O LORD God, and what {is} mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.nlt_text: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD and prayed, "Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

verses.kjv_text: And {yet} this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast {also} spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
verses.nlt_text: And now, O God, in addition to everything else, you speak of giving your servant a lasting dynasty! You speak as though I were someone very great, O LORD God!

verses.kjv_text: What can David {speak} more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.nlt_text: "What more can I say to you about the way you have honored me? You know what your servant is really like.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all {these} great things. {great...: Heb. greatnesses}
verses.nlt_text: For the sake of your servant, O LORD, and according to your will, you have done all these great things and have made them known.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, {there is} none like thee, neither {is there any} God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.nlt_text: "O LORD, there is no one like you. We have never even heard of another God like you!

verses.kjv_text: And what one nation in the earth {is} like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem {to be} his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.nlt_text: What other nation on earth is like your people Israel? What other nation, O God, have you redeemed from slavery to be your own people? You made a great name for yourself when you redeemed your people from Egypt. You performed awesome miracles and drove out the nations that stood in their way.

verses.kjv_text: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
verses.nlt_text: You chose Israel to be your very own people forever, and you, O LORD, became their God.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.nlt_text: "And now, O LORD, I am your servant; do as you have promised concerning me and my family. May it be a promise that will last forever.

verses.kjv_text: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts {is} the God of Israel, {even} a God to Israel: and {let} the house of David thy servant {be} established before thee.
verses.nlt_text: And may your name be established and honored forever so that everyone will say, 'The LORD of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, is Israel's God!' And may the house of your servant David continue before you forever.

verses.kjv_text: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found {in his heart} to pray before thee. {hast...: Heb. hast revealed the ear of thy servant}
verses.nlt_text: "O my God, I have been bold enough to pray to you because you have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him-- a dynasty of kings!

verses.kjv_text: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.nlt_text: For you are God, O LORD. And you have promised these good things to your servant.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and {it shall be} blessed for ever. {let...: or, it hath pleased thee}
verses.nlt_text: And now, it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, so that it will continue forever before you. For when you grant a blessing, O LORD, it is an eternal blessing!"

verses.kjv_text: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.nlt_text: After this, David defeated and subdued the Philistines by conquering Gath and its surrounding towns.

verses.kjv_text: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, {and} brought gifts.
verses.nlt_text: David also conquered the land of Moab, and the Moabites who were spared became David's subjects and paid him tribute money.

verses.kjv_text: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates. {Hadarezer: or, Hadadezer}
verses.nlt_text: David also destroyed the forces of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, as far as Hamath, when Hadadezer marched out to strengthen his control along the Euphrates River.

verses.kjv_text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot {horses}, but reserved of them an hundred chariots. {seven...: or, seven hundred}
verses.nlt_text: David captured 1,000 chariots, 7,000 charioteers, and 20,000 foot soldiers. He crippled all the chariot horses except enough for 100 chariots.

verses.kjv_text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men. {Damascus: Heb. Darmesek}
verses.nlt_text: When Arameans from Damascus arrived to help King Hadadezer, David killed 22,000 of them.

verses.kjv_text: Then David put {garrisons} in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, {and} brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.nlt_text: Then he placed several army garrisons in Damascus, the Aramean capital, and the Arameans became David's subjects and paid him tribute money. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.

verses.kjv_text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: David brought the gold shields of Hadadezer's officers to Jerusalem,

verses.kjv_text: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass. {Tibhath...: called in the book of Samuel Betah, and Berothai}
verses.nlt_text: along with a large amount of bronze from Hadadezer's towns of Tebah and Cun. Later Solomon melted the bronze and molded it into the great bronze basin called the Sea, the pillars, and the various bronze articles used at the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah; {Tou: also called, Toi}
verses.nlt_text: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had destroyed the entire army of King Hadadezer of Zobah,

verses.kjv_text: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and {with him} all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass. {Hadoram: also called, Joram} {to enquire...: or, to salute} {to congratulate: Heb. to bless} {had war: Heb. was the man of wars}
verses.nlt_text: he sent his son Joram to congratulate King David for his successful campaign. Hadadezer and Toi had been enemies and were often at war. Joram presented David with many gifts of gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv_text: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all {these} nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.nlt_text: King David dedicated all these gifts to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had taken from the other nations-- from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand. {Abishai: Heb. Abshai}
verses.nlt_text: Abishai son of Zeruiah destroyed 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

verses.kjv_text: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.nlt_text: He placed army garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became David's subjects. In fact, the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.

verses.kjv_text: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.nlt_text: So David reigned over all Israel and did what was just and right for all his people.

verses.kjv_text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah {was} over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder. {recorder: or, remembrancer}
verses.nlt_text: Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the royal historian.

verses.kjv_text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, {were} the priests; and Shavsha was scribe; {Abimelech: also called, Ahimelech} {Shavsha: also called Seraiah or Shisha}
verses.nlt_text: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were the priests. Seraiah was the court secretary.

verses.kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was} over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David {were} chief about the king. {about...: Heb. at the hand of the king}
verses.nlt_text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was captain of the king's bodyguard. And David's sons served as the king's chief assistants.

verses.kjv_text: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: Some time after this, King Nahash of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun became king.

verses.kjv_text: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.nlt_text: David said, "I am going to show loyalty to Hanun because his father, Nahash, was always loyal to me." So David sent messengers to express sympathy to Hanun about his father's death.But when David's ambassadors arrived in the land of Ammon,

verses.kjv_text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land? {Thinkest...: Heb. In thine eyes doth David, etc}
verses.nlt_text: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, "Do you really think these men are coming here to honor your father? No! David has sent them to spy out the land so they can come in and conquer it!"

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.nlt_text: So Hanun seized David's ambassadors and shaved them, cut off their robes at the buttocks, and sent them back to David in shame.

verses.kjv_text: Then there went {certain}, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and {then} return.
verses.nlt_text: When David heard what had happened to the men, he sent messengers to tell them, "Stay at Jericho until your beards grow out, and then come back." For they felt deep shame because of their appearance.

verses.kjv_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah. {odious: Heb. to stink}
verses.nlt_text: When the people of Ammon realized how seriously they had angered David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent 75,000 pounds of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.

verses.kjv_text: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.nlt_text: They also hired 32,000 chariots and secured the support of the king of Maacah and his army. These forces camped at Medeba, where they were joined by the Ammonite troops that Hanun had recruited from his own towns.

verses.kjv_text: And when David heard {of it}, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.nlt_text: When David heard about this, he sent Joab and all his warriors to fight them.

verses.kjv_text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come {were} by themselves in the field.
verses.nlt_text: The Ammonite troops came out and drew up their battle lines at the entrance of the city, while the other kings positioned themselves to fight in the open fields.

verses.kjv_text: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put {them} in array against the Syrians. {the battle...: Heb. the face of the battle was} {choice: or, young men}
verses.nlt_text: When Joab saw that he would have to fight on both the front and the rear, he chose some of Israel's elite troops and placed them under his personal command to fight the Arameans in the fields.

verses.kjv_text: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set {themselves} in array against the children of Ammon. {Abishai: Heb. Abshai}
verses.nlt_text: He left the rest of the army under the command of his brother Abishai, who was to attack the Ammonites.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.nlt_text: "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then come over and help me," Joab told his brother. "And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will help you.

verses.kjv_text: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do {that which is} good in his sight.
verses.nlt_text: Be courageous! Let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. May the LORD's will be done."

verses.kjv_text: So Joab and the people that {were} with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.nlt_text: When Joab and his troops attacked, the Arameans began to run away.

verses.kjv_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: And when the Ammonites saw the Arameans running, they also ran from Abishai and retreated into the city. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that {were} beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer {went} before them. {river: that is, Euphrates} {Shophach: also called, Shobach}
verses.nlt_text: The Arameans now realized that they were no match for Israel, so they sent messengers and summoned additional Aramean troops from the other side of the Euphrates River. These troops were under the command of Shobach, the commander of Hadadezer's forces.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set {the battle} in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.nlt_text: When David heard what was happening, he mobilized all Israel, crossed the Jordan River, and positioned his troops in battle formation. Then David engaged the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.

verses.kjv_text: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand {men which fought in} chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.nlt_text: But again the Arameans fled from the Israelites. This time David's forces killed 7,000 charioteers and 40,000 foot soldiers, including Shobach, the commander of their army.

verses.kjv_text: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.nlt_text: When Hadadezer's allies saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they surrendered to David and became his subjects. After that, the Arameans were no longer willing to help the Ammonites.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out {to battle}, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it. {after...: Heb. at the return of the year}
verses.nlt_text: In the spring of the year, when kings normally go out to war, Joab led the Israelite army in successful attacks against the land of the Ammonites. In the process he laid siege to the city of Rabbah. However, David stayed behind in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and {there were} precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city. {to weigh: Heb. the weight of}
verses.nlt_text: When David arrived at Rabbah, he removed the crown from the king's head, and it was placed on his own head. The crown was made of gold and set with gems, and he found that it weighed seventy-five pounds. David took a vast amount of plunder from the city.

verses.kjv_text: And he brought out the people that {were} in it, and cut {them} with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: He also made slaves of the people of Rabbah and forced them to labor with saws, iron picks, and iron axes. That is how David dealt with the people of all the Ammonite towns. Then David and all the army returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, {that was} of the children of the giant: and they were subdued. {arose: or, continued: Heb. stood} {Gezer: also called, Gob} {Sippai: also called, Saph} {the giant: or, Rapha}
verses.nlt_text: After this, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. As they fought, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Saph, a descendant of the giants, and so the Philistines were subdued.

verses.kjv_text: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff {was} like a weaver's beam. {Jair: also called, Jaareoregim}
verses.nlt_text: During another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath of Gath. The handle of Lahmi's spear was as thick as a weaver's beam!

verses.kjv_text: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of {great} stature, whose fingers and toes {were} four and twenty, six {on each hand}, and six {on each foot}: and he also was the son of the giant. {great...: Heb. measure} {the son...: Heb. born to the giant, or, Rapha}
verses.nlt_text: In another battle with the Philistines at Gath, they encountered a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in all, who was also a descendant of the giants.

verses.kjv_text: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him. {defied: or, reproached} {Shimea: also called Shammah}
verses.nlt_text: But when he defied and taunted Israel, he was killed by Jonathan, the son of David's brother Shimea.

verses.kjv_text: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.nlt_text: These Philistines were descendants of the giants of Gath, but David and his warriors killed them.

verses.kjv_text: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Satan rose up against Israel and caused David to take a census of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know {it}.
verses.nlt_text: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the army, "Take a census of all the people of Israel-- from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north-- and bring me a report so I may know how many there are."

verses.kjv_text: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they {be}: but, my lord the king, {are} they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.nlt_text: But Joab replied, "May the LORD increase the number of his people a hundred times over! But why, my lord the king, do you want to do this? Are they not all your servants? Why must you cause Israel to sin?"

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: But the king insisted that they take the census, so Joab traveled throughout all Israel to count the people. Then he returned to Jerusalem

verses.kjv_text: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all {they of} Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah {was} four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.nlt_text: and reported the number of people to David. There were 1,100,000 warriors in all Israel who could handle a sword, and 470,000 in Judah.

verses.kjv_text: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
verses.nlt_text: But Joab did not include the tribes of Levi and Benjamin in the census because he was so distressed at what the king had made him do.

verses.kjv_text: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel. {And...: Heb. And it was evil in the eyes of the LORD concerning this thing}
verses.nlt_text: God was very displeased with the census, and he punished Israel for it.

verses.kjv_text: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.nlt_text: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by taking this census. Please forgive my guilt for doing this foolish thing."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD spoke to Gad, David's seer. This was the message:

verses.kjv_text: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three {things}: choose thee one of them, that I may do {it} unto thee. {offer: Heb. stretch out}
verses.nlt_text: "Go and say to David, 'This is what the LORD says: I will give you three choices. Choose one of these punishments, and I will inflict it on you.'"

verses.kjv_text: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee {Choose...: Heb. Take to thee}
verses.nlt_text: So Gad came to David and said, "These are the choices the LORD has given you.

verses.kjv_text: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh {thee}; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: You may choose three years of famine, three months of destruction by the sword of your enemies, or three days of severe plague as the angel of the LORD brings devastation throughout the land of Israel. Decide what answer I should give the LORD who sent me."

verses.kjv_text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great {are} his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man. {very great: or, very many}
verses.nlt_text: "I'm in a desperate situation!" David replied to Gad. "But let me fall into the hands of the LORD, for his mercy is very great. Do not let me fall into human hands."

verses.kjv_text: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel, and 70,000 people died as a result.

verses.kjv_text: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite. {Ornan: also called, Araunah}
verses.nlt_text: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But just as the angel was preparing to destroy it, the LORD relented and said to the death angel, "Stop! That is enough!" At that moment the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.kjv_text: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders {of Israel, who were} clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.nlt_text: David looked up and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth with his sword drawn, reaching out over Jerusalem. So David and the leaders of Israel put on burlap to show their deep distress and fell face down on the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And David said unto God, {Is it} not I {that} commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but {as for} these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.nlt_text: And David said to God, "I am the one who called for the census! I am the one who has sinned and done wrong! But these people are as innocent as sheep-- what have they done? O LORD my God, let your anger fall against me and my family, but do not destroy your people."

verses.kjv_text: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angel of the LORD told Gad to instruct David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.kjv_text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So David went up to do what the LORD had commanded him through Gad.

verses.kjv_text: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat. {And Ornan...: or, When Ornan turned back and saw the angel, then he and his four sons with him hid themselves}
verses.nlt_text: Araunah, who was busy threshing wheat at the time, turned and saw the angel there. His four sons, who were with him, ran away and hid.

verses.kjv_text: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with {his} face to the ground.
verses.nlt_text: When Araunah saw David approaching, he left his threshing floor and bowed before David with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of {this} threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people. {Grant: Heb. Give}
verses.nlt_text: David said to Araunah, "Let me buy this threshing floor from you at its full price. Then I will build an altar to the LORD there, so that he will stop the plague."

verses.kjv_text: And Ornan said unto David, Take {it} to thee, and let my lord the king do {that which is} good in his eyes: lo, I give {thee} the oxen {also} for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.nlt_text: "Take it, my lord the king, and use it as you wish," Araunah said to David. "I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, and the threshing boards for wood to build a fire on the altar, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give it all to you."

verses.kjv_text: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take {that} which {is} thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.nlt_text: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on buying it for the full price. I will not take what is yours and give it to the LORD. I will not present burnt offerings that have cost me nothing!"

verses.kjv_text: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.nlt_text: So David gave Araunah 600 pieces of gold in payment for the threshing floor.

verses.kjv_text: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.nlt_text: David built an altar there to the LORD and sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings. And when David prayed, the LORD answered him by sending fire from heaven to burn up the offering on the altar.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD spoke to the angel, who put the sword back into its sheath.

verses.kjv_text: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.nlt_text: When David saw that the LORD had answered his prayer, he offered sacrifices there at Araunah's threshing floor.

verses.kjv_text: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, {were} at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.nlt_text: At that time the Tabernacle of the LORD and the altar of burnt offering that Moses had made in the wilderness were located at the place of worship in Gibeon.

verses.kjv_text: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But David was not able to go there to inquire of God, because he was terrified by the drawn sword of the angel of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Then David said, This {is} the house of the LORD God, and this {is} the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then David said, "This will be the location for the Temple of the LORD God and the place of the altar for Israel's burnt offerings!"

verses.kjv_text: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that {were} in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.nlt_text: So David gave orders to call together the foreigners living in Israel, and he assigned them the task of preparing finished stone for building the Temple of God.

verses.kjv_text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.nlt_text: David provided large amounts of iron for the nails that would be needed for the doors in the gates and for the clamps, and he gave more bronze than could be weighed.

verses.kjv_text: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.nlt_text: He also provided innumerable cedar logs, for the men of Tyre and Sidon had brought vast amounts of cedar to David.

verses.kjv_text: And David said, Solomon my son {is} young and tender, and the house {that is} to be builded for the LORD {must be} exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will {therefore} now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.nlt_text: David said, "My son Solomon is still young and inexperienced. And since the Temple to be built for the LORD must be a magnificent structure, famous and glorious throughout the world, I will begin making preparations for it now." So David collected vast amounts of building materials before his death.

verses.kjv_text: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then David sent for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a Temple for the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
verses.nlt_text: "My son, I wanted to build a Temple to honor the name of the LORD my God," David told him.

verses.kjv_text: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.nlt_text: "But the LORD said to me, 'You have killed many men in the battles you have fought. And since you have shed so much blood in my sight, you will not be the one to build a Temple to honor my name.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days. {Solomon: that is, Peaceable}
verses.nlt_text: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace. I will give him peace with his enemies in all the surrounding lands. His name will be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel during his reign.

verses.kjv_text: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I {will be} his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.nlt_text: He is the one who will build a Temple to honor my name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will secure the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.'

verses.kjv_text: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and give you success as you follow his directions in building the Temple of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv_text: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
verses.nlt_text: And may the LORD give you wisdom and understanding, that you may obey the Law of the LORD your God as you rule over Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
verses.nlt_text: For you will be successful if you carefully obey the decrees and regulations that the LORD gave to Israel through Moses. Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or lose heart!

verses.kjv_text: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto. {trouble: or, poverty}
verses.nlt_text: "I have worked hard to provide materials for building the Temple of the LORD-- nearly 4,000 tons of gold, 40,000 tons of silver, and so much iron and bronze that it cannot be weighed. I have also gathered timber and stone for the walls, though you may need to add more.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover {there are} workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work. {workers...: that is, masons and carpenters}
verses.nlt_text: You have a large number of skilled stonemasons and carpenters and craftsmen of every kind.

verses.kjv_text: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, {there is} no number. Arise {therefore}, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
verses.nlt_text: You have expert goldsmiths and silversmiths and workers of bronze and iron. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you!"

verses.kjv_text: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, {saying},
verses.nlt_text: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to assist Solomon in this project.

verses.kjv_text: {Is} not the LORD your God with you? and hath he {not} given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD your God is with you," he declared. "He has given you peace with the surrounding nations. He has handed them over to me, and they are now subject to the LORD and his people.

verses.kjv_text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Now seek the LORD your God with all your heart and soul. Build the sanctuary of the LORD God so that you can bring the Ark of the LORD's Covenant and the holy vessels of God into the Temple built to honor the LORD's name."

verses.kjv_text: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.nlt_text: When David was an old man, he appointed his son Solomon to be king over Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.nlt_text: David summoned all the leaders of Israel, together with the priests and Levites.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.nlt_text: All the Levites who were thirty years old or older were counted, and the total came to 38,000.

verses.kjv_text: Of which, twenty and four thousand {were} to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand {were} officers and judges: {set...: or, oversee}
verses.nlt_text: Then David said, "From all the Levites, 24,000 will supervise the work at the Temple of the LORD. Another 6,000 will serve as officials and judges.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover four thousand {were} porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, {said David}, to praise {therewith}.
verses.nlt_text: Another 4,000 will work as gatekeepers, and 4,000 will praise the LORD with the musical instruments I have made."

verses.kjv_text: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, {namely}, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. {courses: Heb. divisions}
verses.nlt_text: Then David divided the Levites into divisions named after the clans descended from the three sons of Levi-- Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv_text: Of the Gershonites {were}, Laadan, and Shimei. {Laadan: or, Libni}
verses.nlt_text: The Gershonite family units were defined by their lines of descent from Libni and Shimei, the sons of Gershon.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Laadan; the chief {was} Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.nlt_text: Three of the descendants of Libni were Jehiel (the family leader), Zetham, and Joel.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These {were} the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.nlt_text: These were the leaders of the family of Libni. Three of the descendants of Shimei were Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Shimei {were}, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four {were} the sons of Shimei. {Zina: or, Zizah}
verses.nlt_text: Four other descendants of Shimei were Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah.

verses.kjv_text: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to {their} father's house. {had...: Heb. did not multiply sons}
verses.nlt_text: Jahath was the family leader, and Ziza was next. Jeush and Beriah were counted as a single family because neither had many sons.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.nlt_text: Four of the descendants of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Amram were Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart to dedicate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices in the LORD's presence, to serve the LORD, and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.

verses.kjv_text: Now {concerning} Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.nlt_text: As for Moses, the man of God, his sons were included with the tribe of Levi.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Moses {were}, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Moses were Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel {was} the chief. {Shebuel: also called, Shubael}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Gershom included Shebuel, the family leader.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Eliezer {were}, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many. {the chief: or, the first} {very many: Heb. highly multiplied}
verses.nlt_text: Eliezer had only one son, Rehabiah, the family leader. Rehabiah had numerous descendants.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief. {Shelomith: also called, Shelomoth}
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Izhar included Shelomith, the family leader.

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Hebron included Jeriah (the family leader), Amariah (the second), Jahaziel (the third), and Jekameam (the fourth).

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Uzziel included Micah (the family leader) and Isshiah (the second).

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.nlt_text: The descendants of Merari included Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.

verses.kjv_text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them. {brethren: or, kinsmen}
verses.nlt_text: Eleazar died with no sons, only daughters. His daughters married their cousins, the sons of Kish.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.nlt_text: Three of the descendants of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; {even} the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.nlt_text: These were the descendants of Levi by clans, the leaders of their family groups, registered carefully by name. Each had to be twenty years old or older to qualify for service in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever: {that...: or, and he dwelleth in Jerusalem, etc}
verses.nlt_text: For David said, "The LORD, the God of Israel, has given us peace, and he will always live in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And also unto the Levites; they shall no {more} carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Now the Levites will no longer need to carry the Tabernacle and its furnishings from place to place."

verses.kjv_text: For by the last words of David the Levites {were} numbered from twenty years old and above: {numbered: Heb. number}
verses.nlt_text: In accordance with David's final instructions, all the Levites twenty years old or older were registered for service.

verses.kjv_text: Because their office {was} to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God; {their...: Heb. their station was at the hand of the sons of Aaron}
verses.nlt_text: The work of the Levites was to assist the priests, the descendants of Aaron, as they served at the house of the LORD. They also took care of the courtyards and side rooms, helped perform the ceremonies of purification, and served in many other ways in the house of God.

verses.kjv_text: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for {that which is baked in} the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size; {pan: or, flat plate}
verses.nlt_text: They were in charge of the sacred bread that was set out on the table, the choice flour for the grain offerings, the wafers made without yeast, the cakes cooked in olive oil, and the other mixed breads. They were also responsible to check all the weights and measures.

verses.kjv_text: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
verses.nlt_text: And each morning and evening they stood before the LORD to sing songs of thanks and praise to him.

verses.kjv_text: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: They assisted with the burnt offerings that were presented to the LORD on Sabbath days, at new moon celebrations, and at all the appointed festivals. The required number of Levites served in the LORD's presence at all times, following all the procedures they had been given.

verses.kjv_text: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy {place}, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: And so, under the supervision of the priests, the Levites watched over the Tabernacle and the Temple and faithfully carried out their duties of service at the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Now {these are} the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.nlt_text: This is how Aaron's descendants, the priests, were divided into groups for service. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv_text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.nlt_text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and they had no sons. So only Eleazar and Ithamar were left to carry on as priests.

verses.kjv_text: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.nlt_text: With the help of Zadok, who was a descendant of Eleazar, and of Ahimelech, who was a descendant of Ithamar, David divided Aaron's descendants into groups according to their various duties.

verses.kjv_text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and {thus} were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar {there were} sixteen chief men of the house of {their} fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Eleazar's descendants were divided into sixteen groups and Ithamar's into eight, for there were more family leaders among the descendants of Eleazar.

verses.kjv_text: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors {of the house} of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.nlt_text: All tasks were assigned to the various groups by means of sacred lots so that no preference would be shown, for there were many qualified officials serving God in the sanctuary from among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.kjv_text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, {one} of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and {before} the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and {one} taken for Ithamar. {principal...: Heb. house of the father}
verses.nlt_text: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, acted as secretary and wrote down the names and assignments in the presence of the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites. The descendants of Eleazar and Ithamar took turns casting lots.

verses.kjv_text: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.nlt_text: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib. The second lot fell to Jedaiah.

verses.kjv_text: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.nlt_text: The third lot fell to Harim. The fourth lot fell to Seorim.

verses.kjv_text: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.nlt_text: The fifth lot fell to Malkijah. The sixth lot fell to Mijamin.

verses.kjv_text: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.nlt_text: The seventh lot fell to Hakkoz. The eighth lot fell to Abijah.

verses.kjv_text: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.nlt_text: The ninth lot fell to Jeshua. The tenth lot fell to Shecaniah.

verses.kjv_text: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.nlt_text: The eleventh lot fell to Eliashib. The twelfth lot fell to Jakim.

verses.kjv_text: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.nlt_text: The thirteenth lot fell to Huppah. The fourteenth lot fell to Jeshebeab.

verses.kjv_text: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.nlt_text: The fifteenth lot fell to Bilgah. The sixteenth lot fell to Immer.

verses.kjv_text: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.nlt_text: The seventeenth lot fell to Hezir. The eighteenth lot fell to Happizzez.

verses.kjv_text: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.nlt_text: The nineteenth lot fell to Pethahiah. The twentieth lot fell to Jehezkel.

verses.kjv_text: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.nlt_text: The twenty-first lot fell to Jakin. The twenty-second lot fell to Gamul.

verses.kjv_text: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.nlt_text: The twenty-third lot fell to Delaiah. The twenty-fourth lot fell to Maaziah.

verses.kjv_text: These {were} the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.nlt_text: Each group carried out its appointed duties in the house of the LORD according to the procedures established by their ancestor Aaron in obedience to the commands of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the rest of the sons of Levi {were these}: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah. {Shubael: also called, Shebuel}
verses.nlt_text: These were the other family leaders descended from Levi: From the descendants of Amram, the leader was Shebuel. From the descendants of Shebuel, the leader was Jehdeiah.

verses.kjv_text: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first {was} Isshiah.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Rehabiah, the leader was Isshiah.

verses.kjv_text: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath. {Shelomoth: also called, Shelomith}
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Izhar, the leader was Shelomith. From the descendants of Shelomith, the leader was Jahath.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons {of Hebron}; Jeriah {the first}, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Hebron, Jeriah was the leader, Amariah was second, Jahaziel was third, and Jekameam was fourth.

verses.kjv_text: {Of} the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Uzziel, the leader was Micah. From the descendants of Micah, the leader was Shamir,

verses.kjv_text: The brother of Michah {was} Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.nlt_text: along with Isshiah, the brother of Micah. From the descendants of Isshiah, the leader was Zechariah.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Merari {were} Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Merari, the leaders were Mahli and Mushi. From the descendants of Jaaziah, the leader was Beno.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Merari through Jaaziah, the leaders were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

verses.kjv_text: Of Mahli {came} Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Mahli, the leader was Eleazar, though he had no sons.

verses.kjv_text: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish {was} Jerahmeel.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Kish, the leader was Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv_text: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These {were} the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: From the descendants of Mushi, the leaders were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi in their various families.

verses.kjv_text: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Like the descendants of Aaron, they were assigned to their duties by means of sacred lots, without regard to age or rank. Lots were drawn in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and the Levites.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.nlt_text: David and the army commanders then appointed men from the families of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to proclaim God's messages to the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. Here is a list of their names and their work:

verses.kjv_text: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king. {Asarelah: otherwise called Jesharelah} {according...: Heb. by the hands of the king}
verses.nlt_text: From the sons of Asaph, there were Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. They worked under the direction of their father, Asaph, who proclaimed God's messages by the king's orders.

verses.kjv_text: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD. {Zeri: or, Izri}
verses.nlt_text: From the sons of Jeduthun, there were Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six in all. They worked under the direction of their father, Jeduthun, who proclaimed God's messages to the accompaniment of the lyre, offering thanks and praise to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, {and} Mahazioth: {Uzziel: also called, Azareel} {Shebuel: also called, Shubael}
verses.nlt_text: From the sons of Heman, there were Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

verses.kjv_text: All these {were} the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters. {words: or, matters}
verses.nlt_text: All these were the sons of Heman, the king's seer, for God had honored him with fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.kjv_text: All these {were} under the hands of their father for song {in} the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman. {according...: Heb. by the hands of the king}
verses.nlt_text: All these men were under the direction of their fathers as they made music at the house of the LORD. Their responsibilities included the playing of cymbals, harps, and lyres at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman reported directly to the king.

verses.kjv_text: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, {even} all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.nlt_text: They and their families were all trained in making music before the LORD, and each of them-- 288 in all-- was an accomplished musician.

verses.kjv_text: And they cast lots, ward against {ward}, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.nlt_text: The musicians were appointed to their term of service by means of sacred lots, without regard to whether they were young or old, teacher or student.

verses.kjv_text: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The first lot fell to Joseph of the Asaph clan and twelve of his sons and relatives. The second lot fell to Gedaliah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The third to Zaccur, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The third lot fell to Zaccur and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The fourth to Izri, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The fourth lot fell to Zeri and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The fifth to Nethaniah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The fifth lot fell to Nethaniah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The sixth to Bukkiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The sixth lot fell to Bukkiah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The seventh to Jesharelah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The seventh lot fell to Asarelah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The eighth to Jeshaiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The eighth lot fell to Jeshaiah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The ninth to Mattaniah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The ninth lot fell to Mattaniah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The tenth to Shimei, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The tenth lot fell to Shimei and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The eleventh to Azareel, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The eleventh lot fell to Uzziel and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The twelfth to Hashabiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The twelfth lot fell to Hashabiah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The thirteenth to Shubael, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The thirteenth lot fell to Shubael and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The fourteenth lot fell to Mattithiah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The fifteenth lot fell to Jerimoth and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The sixteenth to Hananiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The sixteenth lot fell to Hananiah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The seventeenth lot fell to Joshbekashah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The eighteenth to Hanani, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The eighteenth lot fell to Hanani and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The nineteenth to Mallothi, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The nineteenth lot fell to Mallothi and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The twentieth to Eliathah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The twentieth lot fell to Eliathah and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The one and twentieth to Hothir, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The twenty-first lot fell to Hothir and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The twenty-second lot fell to Giddalti and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:
verses.nlt_text: The twenty-third lot fell to Mahazioth and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve.
verses.nlt_text: The twenty-fourth lot fell to Romamti-ezer and twelve of his sons and relatives.

verses.kjv_text: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites {was} Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph. {Meshelemiah: also called, Shelemiah} {Asaph: also called, Ebiasaph}
verses.nlt_text: These are the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites, there was Meshelemiah son of Kore, of the family of Abiasaph.

verses.kjv_text: And the sons of Meshelemiah {were}, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Meshelemiah were Zechariah (the oldest), Jediael (the second), Zebadiah (the third), Jathniel (the fourth),

verses.kjv_text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.nlt_text: Elam (the fifth), Jehohanan (the sixth), and Eliehoenai (the seventh).

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the sons of Obededom {were}, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
verses.nlt_text: The sons of Obed-edom, also gatekeepers, were Shemaiah (the oldest), Jehozabad (the second), Joah (the third), Sacar (the fourth), Nethanel (the fifth),

verses.kjv_text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him. {him: that is, Obededom}
verses.nlt_text: Ammiel (the sixth), Issachar (the seventh), and Peullethai (the eighth). God had richly blessed Obed-edom.

verses.kjv_text: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they {were} mighty men of valour.
verses.nlt_text: Obed-edom's son Shemaiah had sons with great ability who earned positions of great authority in the clan.

verses.kjv_text: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren {were} strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.nlt_text: Their names were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad. Their relatives, Elihu and Semakiah, were also very capable men.

verses.kjv_text: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, {were} threescore and two of Obededom.
verses.nlt_text: All of these descendants of Obed-edom, including their sons and grandsons-- sixty-two of them in all-- were very capable men, well qualified for their work.

verses.kjv_text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
verses.nlt_text: Meshelemiah's eighteen sons and relatives were also very capable men.
