verses.nlt_text: Instead, I suffer if I defend myself, and I suffer no less if I refuse to speak.

verses.kjv_text: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.nlt_text: "O God, you have ground me down and devastated my family.

verses.kjv_text: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, {which} is a witness {against me}: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.nlt_text: As if to prove I have sinned, you've reduced me to skin and bones. My gaunt flesh testifies against me.

verses.kjv_text: He teareth {me} in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.nlt_text: God hates me and angrily tears me apart. He snaps his teeth at me and pierces me with his eyes.

verses.kjv_text: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.nlt_text: People jeer and laugh at me. They slap my cheek in contempt. A mob gathers against me.

verses.kjv_text: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked. {hath...: Heb. hath shut me up}
verses.nlt_text: God has handed me over to sinners. He has tossed me into the hands of the wicked.

verses.kjv_text: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken {me} by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.nlt_text: "I was living quietly until he shattered me. He took me by the neck and broke me in pieces. Then he set me up as his target,

verses.kjv_text: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.nlt_text: and now his archers surround me. His arrows pierce me without mercy. The ground is wet with my blood.

verses.kjv_text: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.nlt_text: Again and again he smashes against me, charging at me like a warrior.

verses.kjv_text: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.nlt_text: I wear burlap to show my grief. My pride lies in the dust.

verses.kjv_text: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids {is} the shadow of death;
verses.nlt_text: My eyes are red with weeping; dark shadows circle my eyes.

verses.kjv_text: Not for {any} injustice in mine hands: also my prayer {is} pure.
verses.nlt_text: Yet I have done no wrong, and my prayer is pure.

verses.kjv_text: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.nlt_text: "O earth, do not conceal my blood. Let it cry out on my behalf.

verses.kjv_text: Also now, behold, my witness {is} in heaven, and my record {is} on high. {on high: Heb. in the high places}
verses.nlt_text: Even now my witness is in heaven. My advocate is there on high.

verses.kjv_text: My friends scorn me: {but} mine eye poureth out {tears} unto God. {scorn me: Heb. are my scorners}
verses.nlt_text: My friends scorn me, but I pour out my tears to God.

verses.kjv_text: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man {pleadeth} for his neighbour! {neighbour: or, friend}
verses.nlt_text: I need someone to mediate between God and me, as a person mediates between friends.

verses.kjv_text: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way {whence} I shall not return. {a few...: Heb. years of number}
verses.nlt_text: For soon I must go down that road from which I will never return.

verses.kjv_text: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves {are ready} for me. {breath...: or, spirit is spent}
verses.nlt_text: "My spirit is crushed, and my life is nearly snuffed out. The grave is ready to receive me.

verses.kjv_text: {Are there} not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation? {continue: Heb. lodge}
verses.nlt_text: I am surrounded by mockers. I watch how bitterly they taunt me.

verses.kjv_text: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who {is} he {that} will strike hands with me?
verses.nlt_text: "You must defend my innocence, O God, since no one else will stand up for me.

verses.kjv_text: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt {them}.
verses.nlt_text: You have closed their minds to understanding, but do not let them triumph.

verses.kjv_text: He that speaketh flattery to {his} friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.nlt_text: They betray their friends for their own advantage, so let their children faint with hunger.

verses.kjv_text: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret. {aforetime: or, before them}
verses.nlt_text: "God has made a mockery of me among the people; they spit in my face.

verses.kjv_text: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members {are} as a shadow. {my members: or, my thoughts}
verses.nlt_text: My eyes are swollen with weeping, and I am but a shadow of my former self.

verses.kjv_text: Upright {men} shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.nlt_text: The virtuous are horrified when they see me. The innocent rise up against the ungodly.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger. {be...: Heb. add strength}
verses.nlt_text: The righteous keep moving forward, and those with clean hands become stronger and stronger.

verses.kjv_text: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find {one} wise {man} among you.
verses.nlt_text: "As for all of you, come back with a better argument, though I still won't find a wise man among you.

verses.kjv_text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, {even} the thoughts of my heart. {the thoughts: Heb. the possessions}
verses.nlt_text: My days are over. My hopes have disappeared. My heart's desires are broken.

verses.kjv_text: They change the night into day: the light {is} short because of darkness. {short: Heb. near}
verses.nlt_text: These men say that night is day; they claim that the darkness is light.

verses.kjv_text: If I wait, the grave {is} mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.nlt_text: What if I go to the grave and make my bed in darkness?

verses.kjv_text: I have said to corruption, Thou {art} my father: to the worm, {Thou art} my mother, and my sister. {said: Heb. cried, or, called}
verses.nlt_text: What if I call the grave my father, and the maggot my mother or my sister?

verses.kjv_text: And where {is} now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.nlt_text: Where then is my hope? Can anyone find it?

verses.kjv_text: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when {our} rest together {is} in the dust.
verses.nlt_text: No, my hope will go down with me to the grave. We will rest together in the dust!"

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

verses.kjv_text: How long {will it be ere} ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.nlt_text: "How long before you stop talking? Speak sense if you want us to answer!

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, {and} reputed vile in your sight?
verses.nlt_text: Do you think we are mere animals? Do you think we are stupid?

verses.kjv_text: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place? {himself: Heb. his soul}
verses.nlt_text: You may tear out your hair in anger, but will that destroy the earth? Will it make the rocks tremble?

verses.kjv_text: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.nlt_text: "Surely the light of the wicked will be snuffed out. The sparks of their fire will not glow.

verses.kjv_text: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him. {candle: or, lamp}
verses.nlt_text: The light in their tent will grow dark. The lamp hanging above them will be quenched.

verses.kjv_text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.nlt_text: The confident stride of the wicked will be shortened. Their own schemes will be their downfall.

verses.kjv_text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked walk into a net. They fall into a pit.

verses.kjv_text: The gin shall take {him} by the heel, {and} the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.nlt_text: A trap grabs them by the heel. A snare holds them tight.

verses.kjv_text: The snare {is} laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way. {laid: Heb. hidden}
verses.nlt_text: A noose lies hidden on the ground. A rope is stretched across their path.

verses.kjv_text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet. {drive: Heb. scatter}
verses.nlt_text: "Terrors surround the wicked and trouble them at every step.

verses.kjv_text: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction {shall be} ready at his side.
verses.nlt_text: Hunger depletes their strength, and calamity waits for them to stumble.

verses.kjv_text: It shall devour the strength of his skin: {even} the firstborn of death shall devour his strength. {strength: Heb. bars}
verses.nlt_text: Disease eats their skin; death devours their limbs.

verses.kjv_text: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.nlt_text: They are torn from the security of their homes and are brought down to the king of terrors.

verses.kjv_text: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because {it is} none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.nlt_text: The homes of the wicked will burn down; burning sulfur rains on their houses.

verses.kjv_text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.nlt_text: Their roots will dry up, and their branches will wither.

verses.kjv_text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.nlt_text: All memory of their existence will fade from the earth, No one will remember their names.

verses.kjv_text: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world. {He...: Heb. They shall drive him}
verses.nlt_text: They will be thrust from light into darkness, driven from the world.

verses.kjv_text: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.nlt_text: They will have neither children nor grandchildren, nor any survivor in the place where they lived.

verses.kjv_text: They that come after {him} shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted. {went...: or, lived with him} {were...: Heb. laid hold on horror}
verses.nlt_text: People in the west are appalled at their fate; people in the east are horrified.

verses.kjv_text: Surely such {are} the dwellings of the wicked, and this {is} the place {of him that} knoweth not God.
verses.nlt_text: They will say, 'This was the home of a wicked person, the place of one who rejected God.'"

verses.kjv_text: Then Job answered and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Job spoke again:

verses.kjv_text: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.nlt_text: "How long will you torture me? How long will you try to crush me with your words?

verses.kjv_text: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed {that} ye make yourselves strange to me. {make...: or, harden yourselves against me}
verses.nlt_text: You have already insulted me ten times. You should be ashamed of treating me so badly.

verses.kjv_text: And be it indeed {that} I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.nlt_text: Even if I have sinned, that is my concern, not yours.

verses.kjv_text: If indeed ye will magnify {yourselves} against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.nlt_text: You think you're better than I am, using my humiliation as evidence of my sin.

verses.kjv_text: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.nlt_text: But it is God who has wronged me, capturing me in his net.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but {there is} no judgment. {wrong: or, violence}
verses.nlt_text: "I cry out, 'Help!' but no one answers me. I protest, but there is no justice.

verses.kjv_text: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.nlt_text: God has blocked my way so I cannot move. He has plunged my path into darkness.

verses.kjv_text: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown {from} my head.
verses.nlt_text: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.

verses.kjv_text: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.nlt_text: He has demolished me on every side, and I am finished. He has uprooted my hope like a fallen tree.

verses.kjv_text: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as {one of} his enemies.
verses.nlt_text: His fury burns against me; he counts me as an enemy.

verses.kjv_text: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: His troops advance. They build up roads to attack me. They camp all around my tent.

verses.kjv_text: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.nlt_text: "My relatives stay far away, and my friends have turned against me.

verses.kjv_text: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.nlt_text: My family is gone, and my close friends have forgotten me.

verses.kjv_text: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.nlt_text: My servants and maids consider me a stranger. I am like a foreigner to them.

verses.kjv_text: I called my servant, and he gave {me} no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: When I call my servant, he doesn't come; I have to plead with him!

verses.kjv_text: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's {sake} of mine own body. {mine...: Heb. my belly}
verses.nlt_text: My breath is repulsive to my wife. I am rejected by my own family.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me. {young...: or, the wicked}
verses.nlt_text: Even young children despise me. When I stand to speak, they turn their backs on me.

verses.kjv_text: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me. {my...: Heb. the men of my secret}
verses.nlt_text: My close friends detest me. Those I loved have turned against me.

verses.kjv_text: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth. {and to: or, as to}
verses.nlt_text: I have been reduced to skin and bones and have escaped death by the skin of my teeth.

verses.kjv_text: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.nlt_text: "Have mercy on me, my friends, have mercy, for the hand of God has struck me.

verses.kjv_text: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.nlt_text: Must you also persecute me, like God does? Haven't you chewed me up enough?

verses.kjv_text: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book! {Oh...: Heb. Who will give, etc}
verses.nlt_text: "Oh, that my words could be recorded. Oh, that they could be inscribed on a monument,

verses.kjv_text: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.nlt_text: carved with an iron chisel and filled with lead, engraved forever in the rock.

verses.kjv_text: For I know {that} my redeemer liveth, and {that} he shall stand at the latter {day} upon the earth:
verses.nlt_text: "But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives, and he will stand upon the earth at last.

verses.kjv_text: And {though} after my skin {worms} destroy this {body}, yet in my flesh shall I see God: {And...: or, After I shall awake, though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh}
verses.nlt_text: And after my body has decayed, yet in my body I will see God!

verses.kjv_text: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; {though} my reins be consumed within me. {another: Heb. a stranger} {though...: or, my reins within me are consumed with earnest desire (for that day} {within...: Heb. in my bosom}
verses.nlt_text: I will see him for myself. Yes, I will see him with my own eyes. I am overwhelmed at the thought!

verses.kjv_text: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me? {seeing...: or, and what root of matter is found in me?}
verses.nlt_text: "How dare you go on persecuting me, saying, 'It's his own fault'?

verses.kjv_text: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath {bringeth} the punishments of the sword, that ye may know {there is} a judgment.
verses.nlt_text: You should fear punishment yourselves, for your attitude deserves punishment. Then you will know that there is indeed a judgment."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

verses.kjv_text: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for {this} I make haste. {I make...: Heb. my haste is in me}
verses.nlt_text: "I must reply because I am greatly disturbed.

verses.kjv_text: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.nlt_text: I've had to endure your insults, but now my spirit prompts me to reply.

verses.kjv_text: Knowest thou {not} this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.nlt_text: "Don't you realize that from the beginning of time, ever since people were first placed on the earth,

verses.kjv_text: That the triumphing of the wicked {is} short, and the joy of the hypocrite {but} for a moment? {short: Heb. from near}
verses.nlt_text: the triumph of the wicked has been short-lived and the joy of the godless has been only temporary?

verses.kjv_text: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds; {clouds: Heb. cloud}
verses.nlt_text: Though the pride of the godless reaches to the heavens and their heads touch the clouds,

verses.kjv_text: {Yet} he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where {is} he?
verses.nlt_text: yet they will vanish forever, thrown away like their own dung. Those who knew them will ask, 'Where are they?'

verses.kjv_text: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.nlt_text: They will fade like a dream and not be found. They will vanish like a vision in the night.

verses.kjv_text: The eye also {which} saw him shall {see him} no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.nlt_text: Those who once saw them will see them no more. Their families will never see them again.

verses.kjv_text: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods. {His children...: or, The poor shall oppress his children}
verses.nlt_text: Their children will beg from the poor, for they must give back their stolen riches.

verses.kjv_text: His bones are full {of the sin} of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.nlt_text: Though they are young, their bones will lie in the dust.

verses.kjv_text: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, {though} he hide it under his tongue;
verses.nlt_text: "They enjoyed the sweet taste of wickedness, letting it melt under their tongue.

verses.kjv_text: {Though} he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth: {within...: Heb. in the midst of his palate}
verses.nlt_text: They savored it, holding it long in their mouths.

verses.kjv_text: {Yet} his meat in his bowels is turned, {it is} the gall of asps within him.
verses.nlt_text: But suddenly the food in their bellies turns sour, a poisonous venom in their stomach.

verses.kjv_text: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.nlt_text: They will vomit the wealth they swallowed. God won't let them keep it down.

verses.kjv_text: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
verses.nlt_text: They will suck the poison of cobras. The viper will kill them.

verses.kjv_text: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter. {the floods...: or, streaming brooks}
verses.nlt_text: They will never again enjoy streams of olive oil or rivers of milk and honey.

verses.kjv_text: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow {it} down: according to {his} substance {shall} the restitution {be}, and he shall not rejoice {therein}. {his...: Heb. the substance of his exchange}
verses.nlt_text: They will give back everything they worked for. Their wealth will bring them no joy.

verses.kjv_text: Because he hath oppressed {and} hath forsaken the poor; {because} he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not; {oppressed: Heb. crushed}
verses.nlt_text: For they oppressed the poor and left them destitute. They foreclosed on their homes.

verses.kjv_text: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired. {feel: Heb. know}
verses.nlt_text: They were always greedy and never satisfied. Nothing remains of all the things they dreamed about.

verses.kjv_text: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods. {none...: or, be none left for his meat}
verses.nlt_text: Nothing is left after they finish gorging themselves. Therefore, their prosperity will not endure.

verses.kjv_text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him. {wicked: or, troublesome}
verses.nlt_text: "In the midst of plenty, they will run into trouble and be overcome by misery.

verses.kjv_text: {When} he is about to fill his belly, {God} shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain {it} upon him while he is eating.
verses.nlt_text: May God give them a bellyful of trouble. May God rain down his anger upon them.

verses.kjv_text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, {and} the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.nlt_text: When they try to escape an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce them.

verses.kjv_text: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors {are} upon him.
verses.nlt_text: The arrow is pulled from their back, and the arrowhead glistens with blood. The terrors of death are upon them.

verses.kjv_text: All darkness {shall be} hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: Their treasures will be thrown into deepest darkness. A wildfire will devour their goods, consuming all they have left.

verses.kjv_text: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.nlt_text: The heavens will reveal their guilt, and the earth will testify against them.

verses.kjv_text: The increase of his house shall depart, {and his goods} shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.nlt_text: A flood will sweep away their house. God's anger will descend on them in torrents.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God. {appointed...: Heb. of his decree from God}
verses.nlt_text: This is the reward that God gives the wicked. It is the inheritance decreed by God."

verses.kjv_text: But Job answered and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Job spoke again:

verses.kjv_text: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.nlt_text: "Listen closely to what I am saying. That's one consolation you can give me.

verses.kjv_text: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.nlt_text: Bear with me, and let me speak. After I have spoken, you may resume mocking me.

verses.kjv_text: As for me, {is} my complaint to man? and if {it were so}, why should not my spirit be troubled? {troubled: Heb. shortened?}
verses.nlt_text: "My complaint is with God, not with people. I have good reason to be so impatient.

verses.kjv_text: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay {your} hand upon {your} mouth. {Mark...: Heb. Look unto me}
verses.nlt_text: Look at me and be stunned. Put your hand over your mouth in shock.

verses.kjv_text: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.nlt_text: When I think about what I am saying, I shudder. My body trembles.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.nlt_text: "Why do the wicked prosper, growing old and powerful?

verses.kjv_text: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.nlt_text: They live to see their children grow up and settle down, and they enjoy their grandchildren.

verses.kjv_text: Their houses {are} safe from fear, neither {is} the rod of God upon them. {safe...: Heb. peace from}
verses.nlt_text: Their homes are safe from every fear, and God does not punish them.

verses.kjv_text: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.nlt_text: Their bulls never fail to breed. Their cows bear calves and never miscarry.

verses.kjv_text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.nlt_text: They let their children frisk about like lambs. Their little ones skip and dance.

verses.kjv_text: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.nlt_text: They sing with tambourine and harp. They celebrate to the sound of the flute.

verses.kjv_text: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave. {in wealth: or, in mirth}
verses.nlt_text: They spend their days in prosperity, then go down to the grave in peace.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.nlt_text: And yet they say to God, 'Go away. We want no part of you and your ways.

verses.kjv_text: What {is} the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.nlt_text: Who is the Almighty, and why should we obey him? What good will it do us to pray?'

verses.kjv_text: Lo, their good {is} not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.nlt_text: (They think their prosperity is of their own doing, but I will have nothing to do with that kind of thinking.)

verses.kjv_text: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and {how oft} cometh their destruction upon them! {God} distributeth sorrows in his anger. {candle: or, lamp}
verses.nlt_text: "Yet the light of the wicked never seems to be extinguished. Do they ever have trouble? Does God distribute sorrows to them in anger?

verses.kjv_text: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away. {carrieth: Heb. stealeth}
verses.nlt_text: Are they driven before the wind like straw? Are they carried away by the storm like chaff? Not at all!

verses.kjv_text: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know {it}. {his iniquity: that is, the punishment of his iniquity}
verses.nlt_text: " 'Well,' you say, 'at least God will punish their children!' But I say he should punish the ones who sin, so that they understand his judgment.

verses.kjv_text: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.nlt_text: Let them see their destruction with their own eyes. Let them drink deeply of the anger of the Almighty.

verses.kjv_text: For what pleasure {hath} he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.nlt_text: For they will not care what happens to their family after they are dead.

verses.kjv_text: Shall {any} teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.nlt_text: "But who can teach a lesson to God, since he judges even the most powerful?

verses.kjv_text: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet. {his...: Heb. his very, or, the strength of, his perfection}
verses.nlt_text: One person dies in prosperity, completely comfortable and secure,

verses.kjv_text: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow. {breasts: or, milk pails}
verses.nlt_text: the picture of good health, vigorous and fit.

verses.kjv_text: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.nlt_text: Another person dies in bitter poverty, never having tasted the good life.

verses.kjv_text: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.nlt_text: But both are buried in the same dust, both eaten by the same maggots.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices {which} ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.nlt_text: "Look, I know what you're thinking. I know the schemes you plot against me.

verses.kjv_text: For ye say, Where {is} the house of the prince? and where {are} the dwelling places of the wicked? {the dwelling...: Heb. the tent of the tabernacles}
verses.nlt_text: You will tell me of rich and wicked people whose houses have vanished because of their sins.

verses.kjv_text: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.nlt_text: But ask those who have been around, and they will tell you the truth.

verses.kjv_text: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath. {wrath: Heb. wraths}
verses.nlt_text: Evil people are spared in times of calamity and are allowed to escape disaster.

verses.kjv_text: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him {what} he hath done?
verses.nlt_text: No one criticizes them openly or pays them back for what they have done.

verses.kjv_text: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb. {grave: Heb. graves} {remain...: Heb. watch in the heap}
verses.nlt_text: When they are carried to the grave, an honor guard keeps watch at their tomb.

verses.kjv_text: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as {there are} innumerable before him.
verses.nlt_text: A great funeral procession goes to the cemetery. Many pay their respects as the body is laid to rest, and the earth gives sweet repose.

verses.kjv_text: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood? {falsehood: Heb. transgression?}
verses.nlt_text: "How can your empty clich�s comfort me? All your explanations are lies!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

verses.kjv_text: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself? {as he...: or, if he may be profitable, doth his good success depend thereon?}
verses.nlt_text: "Can a person do anything to help God? Can even a wise person be helpful to him?

verses.kjv_text: {Is it} any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or {is it} gain {to him}, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.nlt_text: Is it any advantage to the Almighty if you are righteous? Would it be any gain to him if you were perfect?

verses.kjv_text: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.nlt_text: Is it because you're so pious that he accuses you and brings judgment against you?

verses.kjv_text: {Is} not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.nlt_text: No, it's because of your wickedness! There's no limit to your sins.

verses.kjv_text: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing. {the naked...: Heb. the clothes of the naked}
verses.nlt_text: "For example, you must have lent money to your friend and demanded clothing as security. Yes, you stripped him to the bone.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.nlt_text: You must have refused water for the thirsty and food for the hungry.

verses.kjv_text: But {as for} the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it. {mighty...: Heb. man of arm} {honourable...: Heb. eminent, or, accepted for countenance}
verses.nlt_text: You probably think the land belongs to the powerful and only the privileged have a right to it!

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.nlt_text: You must have sent widows away empty-handed and crushed the hopes of orphans.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore snares {are} round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.nlt_text: That is why you are surrounded by traps and tremble from sudden fears.

verses.kjv_text: Or darkness, {that} thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.nlt_text: That is why you cannot see in the darkness, and waves of water cover you.

verses.kjv_text: {Is} not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are! {height of the stars: Heb. head of the stars}
verses.nlt_text: "God is so great-- higher than the heavens, higher than the farthest stars.

verses.kjv_text: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud? {How: or, What}
verses.nlt_text: But you reply, 'That's why God can't see what I am doing! How can he judge through the thick darkness?

verses.kjv_text: Thick clouds {are} a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: For thick clouds swirl about him, and he cannot see us. He is way up there, walking on the vault of heaven.'

verses.kjv_text: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.nlt_text: "Will you continue on the old paths where evil people have walked?

verses.kjv_text: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood: {whose...: Heb. a flood was poured upon their foundation}
verses.nlt_text: They were snatched away in the prime of life, the foundations of their lives washed away.

verses.kjv_text: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them? {for: or, to}
verses.nlt_text: For they said to God, 'Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?'

verses.kjv_text: Yet he filled their houses with good {things}: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.nlt_text: Yet he was the one who filled their homes with good things, so I will have nothing to do with that kind of thinking.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous see {it}, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.nlt_text: "The righteous will be happy to see the wicked destroyed, and the innocent will laugh in contempt.

verses.kjv_text: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth. {substance: or, estate} {the remnant...: or, their excellency}
verses.nlt_text: They will say, 'See how our enemies have been destroyed. The last of them have been consumed in the fire.'

verses.kjv_text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee. {him: that is, God}
verses.nlt_text: "Submit to God, and you will have peace; then things will go well for you.

verses.kjv_text: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to his instructions, and store them in your heart.

verses.kjv_text: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.nlt_text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored-- so clean up your life.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the {gold} of Ophir as the stones of the brooks. {as dust: or, on the dust}
verses.nlt_text: If you give up your lust for money and throw your precious gold into the river,

verses.kjv_text: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver. {defence: or, gold} {plenty...: Heb. silver of strength}
verses.nlt_text: the Almighty himself will be your treasure. He will be your precious silver!

verses.kjv_text: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.nlt_text: "Then you will take delight in the Almighty and look up to God.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.nlt_text: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows to him.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.nlt_text: You will succeed in whatever you choose to do, and light will shine on the road ahead of you.

verses.kjv_text: When {men} are cast down, then thou shalt say, {There is} lifting up; and he shall save the humble person. {the humble...: Heb. him that hath low eyes}
verses.nlt_text: If people are in trouble and you say, 'Help them,' God will save them.

verses.kjv_text: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands. {He shall...: or, The innocent shall deliver the island}
verses.nlt_text: Even sinners will be rescued; they will be rescued because your hands are pure."

verses.kjv_text: Then Job answered and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Job spoke again:

verses.kjv_text: Even to day {is} my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning. {stroke: Heb. hand}
verses.nlt_text: "My complaint today is still a bitter one, and I try hard not to groan aloud.

verses.kjv_text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! {that} I might come {even} to his seat!
verses.nlt_text: If only I knew where to find God, I would go to his court.

verses.kjv_text: I would order {my} cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.nlt_text: I would lay out my case and present my arguments.

verses.kjv_text: I would know the words {which} he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.nlt_text: Then I would listen to his reply and understand what he says to me.

verses.kjv_text: Will he plead against me with {his} great power? No; but he would put {strength} in me.
verses.nlt_text: Would he use his great power to argue with me? No, he would give me a fair hearing.

verses.kjv_text: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.nlt_text: Honest people can reason with him, so I would be forever acquitted by my judge.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I go forward, but he {is} not {there}; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.nlt_text: I go east, but he is not there. I go west, but I cannot find him.

verses.kjv_text: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold {him}: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see {him}:
verses.nlt_text: I do not see him in the north, for he is hidden. I look to the south, but he is concealed.

verses.kjv_text: But he knoweth the way that I take: {when} he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold. {that...: Heb. that is with me}
verses.nlt_text: "But he knows where I am going. And when he tests me, I will come out as pure as gold.

verses.kjv_text: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.nlt_text: For I have stayed on God's paths; I have followed his ways and not turned aside.

verses.kjv_text: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary {food}. {esteemed: Heb. hid, or, laid up} {my...: or, my appointed portion}
verses.nlt_text: I have not departed from his commands, but have treasured his words more than daily food.

verses.kjv_text: But he {is} in one {mind}, and who can turn him? and {what} his soul desireth, even {that} he doeth.
verses.nlt_text: But once he has made his decision, who can change his mind? Whatever he wants to do, he does.

verses.kjv_text: For he performeth {the thing that is} appointed for me: and many such {things are} with him.
verses.nlt_text: So he will do to me whatever he has planned. He controls my destiny.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.nlt_text: No wonder I am so terrified in his presence. When I think of it, terror grips me.

verses.kjv_text: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.nlt_text: God has made me sick at heart; the Almighty has terrified me.

verses.kjv_text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, {neither} hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.nlt_text: Darkness is all around me; thick, impenetrable darkness is everywhere.

verses.kjv_text: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.nlt_text: "Why doesn't the Almighty bring the wicked to judgment? Why must the godly wait for him in vain?

verses.kjv_text: {Some} remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed {thereof}. {feed...: or, feed them}
verses.nlt_text: Evil people steal land by moving the boundary markers. They steal livestock and put them in their own pastures.

verses.kjv_text: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
verses.nlt_text: They take the orphan's donkey and demand the widow's ox as security for a loan.

verses.kjv_text: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.nlt_text: The poor are pushed off the path; the needy must hide together for safety.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, {as} wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness {yieldeth} food for them {and} for {their} children.
verses.nlt_text: Like wild donkeys in the wilderness, the poor must spend all their time looking for food, searching even in the desert for food for their children.

verses.kjv_text: They reap {every one} his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked. {corn: Heb. mingled corn, or, dredge} {they gather...: Heb. the wicked gather the vintage}
verses.nlt_text: They harvest a field they do not own, and they glean in the vineyards of the wicked.

verses.kjv_text: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that {they have} no covering in the cold.
verses.nlt_text: All night they lie naked in the cold, without clothing or covering.

verses.kjv_text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.nlt_text: They are soaked by mountain showers, and they huddle against the rocks for want of a home.

verses.kjv_text: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.nlt_text: "The wicked snatch a widow's child from her breast, taking the baby as security for a loan.

verses.kjv_text: They cause {him} to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf {from} the hungry;
verses.nlt_text: The poor must go about naked, without any clothing. They harvest food for others while they themselves are starving.

verses.kjv_text: {Which} make oil within their walls, {and} tread {their} winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.nlt_text: They press out olive oil without being allowed to taste it, and they tread in the winepress as they suffer from thirst.

verses.kjv_text: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly {to them}.
verses.nlt_text: The groans of the dying rise from the city, and the wounded cry for help, yet God ignores their moaning.

verses.kjv_text: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "Wicked people rebel against the light. They refuse to acknowledge its ways or stay in its paths.

verses.kjv_text: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.nlt_text: The murderer rises in the early dawn to kill the poor and needy; at night he is a thief.

verses.kjv_text: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth {his} face. {disguiseth...: Heb. setteth his face in secret}
verses.nlt_text: The adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, 'No one will see me then.' He hides his face so no one will know him.

verses.kjv_text: In the dark they dig through houses, {which} they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.nlt_text: Thieves break into houses at night and sleep in the daytime. They are not acquainted with the light.

verses.kjv_text: For the morning {is} to them even as the shadow of death: if {one} know {them, they are in} the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.nlt_text: The black night is their morning. They ally themselves with the terrors of the darkness.

verses.kjv_text: He {is} swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.nlt_text: "But they disappear like foam down a river. Everything they own is cursed, and they are afraid to enter their own vineyards.

verses.kjv_text: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: {so doth} the grave {those which} have sinned. {consume: Heb. violently take}
verses.nlt_text: The grave consumes sinners just as drought and heat consume snow.

verses.kjv_text: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.nlt_text: Their own mothers will forget them. Maggots will find them sweet to eat. No one will remember them. Wicked people are broken like a tree in the storm.

verses.kjv_text: He evil entreateth the barren {that} beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.nlt_text: They cheat the woman who has no son to help her. They refuse to help the needy widow.

verses.kjv_text: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no {man} is sure of life. {no...: or, he trusteth not his own life}
verses.nlt_text: "God, in his power, drags away the rich. They may rise high, but they have no assurance of life.

verses.kjv_text: {Though} it be given him {to be} in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes {are} upon their ways.
verses.nlt_text: They may be allowed to live in security, but God is always watching them.

verses.kjv_text: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all {other}, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn. {are gone: Heb. are not} {taken...: Heb. closed up}
verses.nlt_text: And though they are great now, in a moment they will be gone like all others, cut off like heads of grain.

verses.kjv_text: And if {it be} not {so} now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.nlt_text: Can anyone claim otherwise? Who can prove me wrong?"

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

verses.kjv_text: Dominion and fear {are} with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.nlt_text: "God is powerful and dreadful. He enforces peace in the heavens.

verses.kjv_text: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.nlt_text: Who is able to count his heavenly army? Doesn't his light shine on all the earth?

verses.kjv_text: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean {that is} born of a woman?
verses.nlt_text: How can a mortal be innocent before God? Can anyone born of a woman be pure?

verses.kjv_text: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.nlt_text: God is more glorious than the moon; he shines brighter than the stars.

verses.kjv_text: How much less man, {that is} a worm? and the son of man, {which is} a worm?
verses.nlt_text: In comparison, people are maggots; we mortals are mere worms."

verses.kjv_text: But Job answered and said,
verses.nlt_text: Then Job spoke again:

verses.kjv_text: How hast thou helped {him that is} without power? {how} savest thou the arm {that hath} no strength?
verses.nlt_text: "How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the weak!

verses.kjv_text: How hast thou counselled {him that hath} no wisdom? and {how} hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.nlt_text: How you have enlightened my stupidity! What wise advice you have offered!

verses.kjv_text: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.nlt_text: Where have you gotten all these wise sayings? Whose spirit speaks through you?

verses.kjv_text: Dead {things} are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof. {and the...: or, with the inhabitants}
verses.nlt_text: "The dead tremble-- those who live beneath the waters.

verses.kjv_text: Hell {is} naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.nlt_text: The underworld is naked in God's presence. The place of destruction is uncovered.

verses.kjv_text: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, {and} hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.nlt_text: God stretches the northern sky over empty space and hangs the earth on nothing.

verses.kjv_text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.nlt_text: He wraps the rain in his thick clouds, and the clouds don't burst with the weight.

verses.kjv_text: He holdeth back the face of his throne, {and} spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.nlt_text: He covers the face of the moon, shrouding it with his clouds.

verses.kjv_text: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end. {until...: Heb. until the end of light with darkness}
verses.nlt_text: He created the horizon when he separated the waters; he set the boundary between day and night.

verses.kjv_text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.nlt_text: The foundations of heaven tremble; they shudder at his rebuke.

verses.kjv_text: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud. {the proud: Heb. pride}
verses.nlt_text: By his power the sea grew calm. By his skill he crushed the great sea monster.

verses.kjv_text: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.nlt_text: His Spirit made the heavens beautiful, and his power pierced the gliding serpent.

verses.kjv_text: Lo, these {are} parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.nlt_text: These are just the beginning of all that he does, merely a whisper of his power. Who, then, can comprehend the thunder of his power?"

verses.kjv_text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said, {continued: Heb. added to take up}
verses.nlt_text: Job continued speaking:

verses.kjv_text: {As} God liveth, {who} hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, {who} hath vexed my soul; {vexed...: Heb. made my soul bitter}
verses.nlt_text: "I vow by the living God, who has taken away my rights, by the Almighty who has embittered my soul--

verses.kjv_text: All the while my breath {is} in me, and the spirit of God {is} in my nostrils; {the spirit...: that is, the breath which God gave him}
verses.nlt_text: As long as I live, while I have breath from God,

verses.kjv_text: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.nlt_text: my lips will speak no evil, and my tongue will speak no lies.

verses.kjv_text: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.nlt_text: I will never concede that you are right; I will defend my integrity until I die.

verses.kjv_text: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach {me} so long as I live. {so long...: Heb. from my days}
verses.nlt_text: I will maintain my innocence without wavering. My conscience is clear for as long as I live.

verses.kjv_text: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.nlt_text: "May my enemy be punished like the wicked, my adversary like those who do evil.

verses.kjv_text: For what {is} the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
verses.nlt_text: For what hope do the godless have when God cuts them off and takes away their life?

verses.kjv_text: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.nlt_text: Will God listen to their cry when trouble comes upon them?

verses.kjv_text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
verses.nlt_text: Can they take delight in the Almighty? Can they call to God at any time?

verses.kjv_text: I will teach you by the hand of God: {that} which {is} with the Almighty will I not conceal. {by...: or, being in the hand, etc}
verses.nlt_text: I will teach you about God's power. I will not conceal anything concerning the Almighty.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen {it}; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
verses.nlt_text: But you have seen all this, yet you say all these useless things to me.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, {which} they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the wicked will receive from God; this is their inheritance from the Almighty.

verses.kjv_text: If his children be multiplied, {it is} for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.nlt_text: They may have many children, but the children will die in war or starve to death.

verses.kjv_text: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.nlt_text: Those who survive will die of a plague, and not even their widows will mourn them.

verses.kjv_text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.nlt_text: "Evil people may have piles of money and may store away mounds of clothing.

verses.kjv_text: He may prepare {it}, but the just shall put {it} on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.nlt_text: But the righteous will wear that clothing, and the innocent will divide that money.

verses.kjv_text: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth {that} the keeper maketh.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked build houses as fragile as a spider's web, as flimsy as a shelter made of branches.

verses.kjv_text: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he {is} not.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked go to bed rich but wake to find that all their wealth is gone.

verses.kjv_text: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.nlt_text: Terror overwhelms them like a flood, and they are blown away in the storms of the night.

verses.kjv_text: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.nlt_text: The east wind carries them away, and they are gone. It sweeps them away.

verses.kjv_text: For {God} shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand. {he...: Heb. in fleeing he would flee}
verses.nlt_text: It whirls down on them without mercy. They struggle to flee from its power.

verses.kjv_text: {Men} shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.nlt_text: But everyone jeers at them and mocks them.

verses.kjv_text: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold {where} they fine {it}. {vein: or, mine}
verses.nlt_text: "People know where to mine silver and how to refine gold.

verses.kjv_text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass {is} molten {out of} the stone. {earth: or, dust}
verses.nlt_text: They know where to dig iron from the earth and how to smelt copper from rock.

verses.kjv_text: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.nlt_text: They know how to shine light in the darkness and explore the farthest regions of the earth as they search in the dark for ore.

verses.kjv_text: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; {even the waters} forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.nlt_text: They sink a mine shaft into the earth far from where anyone lives. They descend on ropes, swinging back and forth.

verses.kjv_text: {As for} the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.nlt_text: Food is grown on the earth above, but down below, the earth is melted as by fire.

verses.kjv_text: The stones of it {are} the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold. {dust...: or, gold ore}
verses.nlt_text: Here the rocks contain precious lapis lazuli, and the dust contains gold.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
verses.nlt_text: These are treasures no bird of prey can see, no falcon's eye observe.

verses.kjv_text: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.nlt_text: No wild animal has walked upon these treasures; no lion has ever set his paw there.

verses.kjv_text: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots. {rock: or, flint}
verses.nlt_text: People know how to tear apart flinty rocks and overturn the roots of mountains.

verses.kjv_text: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.nlt_text: They cut tunnels in the rocks and uncover precious stones.

verses.kjv_text: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and {the thing that is} hid bringeth he forth to light. {overflowing: Heb. weeping}
verses.nlt_text: They dam up the trickling streams and bring to light the hidden treasures.

verses.kjv_text: But where shall wisdom be found? and where {is} the place of understanding?
verses.nlt_text: "But do people know where to find wisdom? Where can they find understanding?

verses.kjv_text: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.nlt_text: No one knows where to find it, for it is not found among the living.

verses.kjv_text: The depth saith, It {is} not in me: and the sea saith, {It is} not with me.
verses.nlt_text: 'It is not here,' says the ocean. 'Nor is it here,' says the sea.

verses.kjv_text: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed {for} the price thereof. {It...: Heb. Fine gold shall not be given for it}
verses.nlt_text: It cannot be bought with gold. It cannot be purchased with silver.

verses.kjv_text: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.nlt_text: It's worth more than all the gold of Ophir, greater than precious onyx or lapis lazuli.

verses.kjv_text: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it {shall not be for} jewels of fine gold. {jewels...: or, vessels of}
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom is more valuable than gold and crystal. It cannot be purchased with jewels mounted in fine gold.

verses.kjv_text: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom {is} above rubies. {coral: or, Ramoth}
verses.nlt_text: Coral and jasper are worthless in trying to get it. The price of wisdom is far above rubies.

verses.kjv_text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.nlt_text: Precious peridot from Ethiopia cannot be exchanged for it. It's worth more than the purest gold.

verses.kjv_text: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where {is} the place of understanding?
verses.nlt_text: "But do people know where to find wisdom? Where can they find understanding?

verses.kjv_text: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air. {air: or, heaven}
verses.nlt_text: It is hidden from the eyes of all humanity. Even the sharp-eyed birds in the sky cannot discover it.

verses.kjv_text: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.nlt_text: Destruction and Death say, 'We've heard only rumors of where wisdom can be found.'

verses.kjv_text: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "God alone understands the way to wisdom; he knows where it can be found,

verses.kjv_text: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, {and} seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.nlt_text: for he looks throughout the whole earth and sees everything under the heavens.

verses.kjv_text: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.nlt_text: He decided how hard the winds should blow and how much rain should fall.

verses.kjv_text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.nlt_text: He made the laws for the rain and laid out a path for the lightning.

verses.kjv_text: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out. {declare...: or, number it}
verses.nlt_text: Then he saw wisdom and evaluated it. He set it in place and examined it thoroughly.

verses.kjv_text: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that {is} wisdom; and to depart from evil {is} understanding.
verses.nlt_text: And this is what he says to all humanity: 'The fear of the Lord is true wisdom; to forsake evil is real understanding.'"

verses.kjv_text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said, {continued: Heb. added to take up}
verses.nlt_text: Job continued speaking:

verses.kjv_text: Oh that I were as {in} months past, as {in} the days {when} God preserved me;
verses.nlt_text: "I long for the years gone by when God took care of me,

verses.kjv_text: When his candle shined upon my head, {and when} by his light I walked {through} darkness; {candle: or, lamp}
verses.nlt_text: when he lit up the way before me and I walked safely through the darkness.

verses.kjv_text: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God {was} upon my tabernacle;
verses.nlt_text: When I was in my prime, God's friendship was felt in my home.

verses.kjv_text: When the Almighty {was} yet with me, {when} my children {were} about me;
verses.nlt_text: The Almighty was still with me, and my children were around me.

verses.kjv_text: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil; {me: Heb. with me}
verses.nlt_text: My cows produced milk in abundance, and my groves poured out streams of olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: When I went out to the gate through the city, {when} I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.nlt_text: "Those were the days when I went to the city gate and took my place among the honored leaders.

verses.kjv_text: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, {and} stood up.
verses.nlt_text: The young stepped aside when they saw me, and even the aged rose in respect at my coming.

verses.kjv_text: The princes refrained talking, and laid {their} hand on their mouth.
verses.nlt_text: The princes stood in silence and put their hands over their mouths.

verses.kjv_text: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth. {The nobles...: Heb. The voice of the nobles was hid}
verses.nlt_text: The highest officials of the city stood quietly, holding their tongues in respect.

verses.kjv_text: When the ear heard {me}, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw {me}, it gave witness to me:
verses.nlt_text: "All who heard me praised me. All who saw me spoke well of me.

verses.kjv_text: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and {him that had} none to help him.
verses.nlt_text: For I assisted the poor in their need and the orphans who required help.

verses.kjv_text: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
verses.nlt_text: I helped those without hope, and they blessed me. And I caused the widows' hearts to sing for joy.

verses.kjv_text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment {was} as a robe and a diadem.
verses.nlt_text: Everything I did was honest. Righteousness covered me like a robe, and I wore justice like a turban.

verses.kjv_text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet {was} I to the lame.
verses.nlt_text: I served as eyes for the blind and feet for the lame.

verses.kjv_text: I {was} a father to the poor: and the cause {which} I knew not I searched out.
verses.nlt_text: I was a father to the poor and assisted strangers who needed help.

verses.kjv_text: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth. {the jaws: Heb. the jawteeth, or, the grinders} {plucked: Heb. cast}
verses.nlt_text: I broke the jaws of godless oppressors and plucked their victims from their teeth.

verses.kjv_text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply {my} days as the sand.
verses.nlt_text: "I thought, 'Surely I will die surrounded by my family after a long, good life.

verses.kjv_text: My root {was} spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch. {spread...: Heb. opened}
verses.nlt_text: For I am like a tree whose roots reach the water, whose branches are refreshed with the dew.

verses.kjv_text: My glory {was} fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand. {fresh: Heb. new} {renewed: Heb. changed}
verses.nlt_text: New honors are constantly bestowed on me, and my strength is continually renewed.'

verses.kjv_text: Unto me {men} gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.nlt_text: "Everyone listened to my advice. They were silent as they waited for me to speak.

verses.kjv_text: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.nlt_text: And after I spoke, they had nothing to add, for my counsel satisfied them.

verses.kjv_text: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide {as} for the latter rain.
verses.nlt_text: They longed for me to speak as people long for rain. They drank my words like a refreshing spring rain.

verses.kjv_text: {If} I laughed on them, they believed {it} not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.nlt_text: When they were discouraged, I smiled at them. My look of approval was precious to them.

verses.kjv_text: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one {that} comforteth the mourners.
verses.nlt_text: Like a chief, I told them what to do. I lived like a king among his troops and comforted those who mourned.

verses.kjv_text: But now {they that are} younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock. {younger...: Heb. of fewer days than I}
verses.nlt_text: "But now I am mocked by people younger than I, by young men whose fathers are not worthy to run with my sheepdogs.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, whereto {might} the strength of their hands {profit} me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.nlt_text: A lot of good they are to me-- those worn-out wretches!

verses.kjv_text: For want and famine {they were} solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste. {solitary: or, dark as the night} {in...: Heb. yesternight}
verses.nlt_text: They are gaunt with hunger and flee to the deserts, to desolate and gloomy wastelands.

verses.kjv_text: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots {for} their meat.
verses.nlt_text: They pluck wild greens from among the bushes and eat from the roots of broom trees.

verses.kjv_text: They were driven forth from among {men}, (they cried after them as {after} a thief;)
verses.nlt_text: They are driven from human society, and people shout at them as if they were thieves.

verses.kjv_text: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, {in} caves of the earth, and {in} the rocks. {caves: Heb. holes}
verses.nlt_text: So now they live in frightening ravines, in caves and among the rocks.

verses.kjv_text: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.nlt_text: They sound like animals howling among the bushes, huddled together beneath the nettles.

verses.kjv_text: {They were} children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth. {base...: Heb. men of no name}
verses.nlt_text: They are nameless fools, outcasts from society.

verses.kjv_text: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.nlt_text: "And now they mock me with vulgar songs! They taunt me!

verses.kjv_text: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face. {and...: Heb. and withhold not spittle from}
verses.nlt_text: They despise me and won't come near me, except to spit in my face.

verses.kjv_text: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.nlt_text: For God has cut my bowstring. He has humbled me, so they have thrown off all restraint.

verses.kjv_text: Upon {my} right {hand} rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.nlt_text: These outcasts oppose me to my face. They send me sprawling and lay traps in my path.

verses.kjv_text: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.nlt_text: They block my road and do everything they can to destroy me. They know I have no one to help me.

verses.kjv_text: They came {upon me} as a wide breaking in {of waters}: in the desolation they rolled themselves {upon me}.
verses.nlt_text: They come at me from all directions. They jump on me when I am down.

verses.kjv_text: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud. {my soul: Heb. my principal one}
verses.nlt_text: I live in terror now. My honor has blown away in the wind, and my prosperity has vanished like a cloud.

verses.kjv_text: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.nlt_text: "And now my life seeps away. Depression haunts my days.

verses.kjv_text: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.nlt_text: At night my bones are filled with pain, which gnaws at me relentlessly.

verses.kjv_text: By the great force {of my disease} is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.nlt_text: With a strong hand, God grabs my shirt. He grips me by the collar of my coat.

verses.kjv_text: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.nlt_text: He has thrown me into the mud. I'm nothing more than dust and ashes.

verses.kjv_text: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me {not}.
verses.nlt_text: "I cry to you, O God, but you don't answer. I stand before you, but you don't even look.

verses.kjv_text: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me. {become...: Heb. turned to be cruel} {thy...: Heb. the strength of thy hand}
verses.nlt_text: You have become cruel toward me. You use your power to persecute me.

verses.kjv_text: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride {upon it}, and dissolvest my substance. {substance: or, wisdom}
verses.nlt_text: You throw me into the whirlwind and destroy me in the storm.

verses.kjv_text: For I know {that} thou wilt bring me {to} death, and {to} the house appointed for all living.
verses.nlt_text: And I know you are sending me to my death-- the destination of all who live.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit he will not stretch out {his} hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction. {grave: Heb. heap}
verses.nlt_text: "Surely no one would turn against the needy when they cry for help in their trouble.

verses.kjv_text: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was {not} my soul grieved for the poor? {in trouble: Heb. hard of day?}
verses.nlt_text: Did I not weep for those in trouble? Was I not deeply grieved for the needy?

verses.kjv_text: When I looked for good, then evil came {unto me}: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.nlt_text: So I looked for good, but evil came instead. I waited for the light, but darkness fell.

verses.kjv_text: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.nlt_text: My heart is troubled and restless. Days of suffering torment me.

verses.kjv_text: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, {and} I cried in the congregation.
verses.nlt_text: I walk in gloom, without sunlight. I stand in the public square and cry for help.

verses.kjv_text: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls. {owls: or, ostriches}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, I am considered a brother to jackals and a companion to owls.

verses.kjv_text: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.nlt_text: My skin has turned dark, and my bones burn with fever.

verses.kjv_text: My harp also is {turned} to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.nlt_text: My harp plays sad music, and my flute accompanies those who weep.

verses.kjv_text: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.nlt_text: "I made a covenant with my eyes not to look with lust at a young woman.

verses.kjv_text: For what portion of God {is there} from above? and {what} inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.nlt_text: For what has God above chosen for us? What is our inheritance from the Almighty on high?

verses.kjv_text: {Is} not destruction to the wicked? and a strange {punishment} to the workers of iniquity?
verses.nlt_text: Isn't it calamity for the wicked and misfortune for those who do evil?

verses.kjv_text: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.nlt_text: Doesn't he see everything I do and every step I take?

verses.kjv_text: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
verses.nlt_text: "Have I lied to anyone or deceived anyone?

verses.kjv_text: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity. {Let...: Heb. Let him weigh me in balances of justice}
verses.nlt_text: Let God weigh me on the scales of justice, for he knows my integrity.

verses.kjv_text: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.nlt_text: If I have strayed from his pathway, or if my heart has lusted for what my eyes have seen, or if I am guilty of any other sin,

verses.kjv_text: {Then} let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.nlt_text: then let someone else eat the crops I have planted. Let all that I have planted be uprooted.

verses.kjv_text: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or {if} I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
verses.nlt_text: "If my heart has been seduced by a woman, or if I have lusted for my neighbor's wife,

verses.kjv_text: {Then} let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.nlt_text: then let my wife belong to another man; let other men sleep with her.

verses.kjv_text: For this {is} an heinous crime; yea, it {is} an iniquity {to be punished by} the judges.
verses.nlt_text: For lust is a shameful sin, a crime that should be punished.

verses.kjv_text: For it {is} a fire {that} consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.nlt_text: It is a fire that burns all the way to hell. It would wipe out everything I own.

verses.kjv_text: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.nlt_text: "If I have been unfair to my male or female servants when they brought their complaints to me,

verses.kjv_text: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.nlt_text: how could I face God? What could I say when he questioned me?

verses.kjv_text: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb? {did not one...: or, did he not fashion us in one womb?}
verses.nlt_text: For God created both me and my servants. He created us both in the womb.

verses.kjv_text: If I have withheld the poor from {their} desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.nlt_text: "Have I refused to help the poor, or crushed the hopes of widows?

verses.kjv_text: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.nlt_text: Have I been stingy with my food and refused to share it with orphans?

verses.kjv_text: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as {with} a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;) {her: that is, the widow}
verses.nlt_text: No, from childhood I have cared for orphans like a father, and all my life I have cared for widows.

verses.kjv_text: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.nlt_text: Whenever I saw the homeless without clothes and the needy with nothing to wear,

verses.kjv_text: If his loins have not blessed me, and {if} he were {not} warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.nlt_text: did they not praise me for providing wool clothing to keep them warm?

verses.kjv_text: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.nlt_text: "If I raised my hand against an orphan, knowing the judges would take my side,

verses.kjv_text: {Then} let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone. {bone: or, chanelbone}
verses.nlt_text: then let my shoulder be wrenched out of place! Let my arm be torn from its socket!

verses.kjv_text: For destruction {from} God {was} a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.nlt_text: That would be better than facing God's judgment. For if the majesty of God opposes me, what hope is there?

verses.kjv_text: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, {Thou art} my confidence;
verses.nlt_text: "Have I put my trust in money or felt secure because of my gold?

verses.kjv_text: If I rejoiced because my wealth {was} great, and because mine hand had gotten much; {gotten...: Heb. found much}
verses.nlt_text: Have I gloated about my wealth and all that I own?

verses.kjv_text: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking {in} brightness; {sun: Heb. light} {in...: Heb. bright}
verses.nlt_text: "Have I looked at the sun shining in the skies, or the moon walking down its silver pathway,

verses.kjv_text: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand: {my mouth...: Heb. my hand hath kissed my mouth}
verses.nlt_text: and been secretly enticed in my heart to throw kisses at them in worship?

verses.kjv_text: This also {were} an iniquity {to be punished by} the judge: for I should have denied the God {that is} above.
verses.nlt_text: If so, I should be punished by the judges, for it would mean I had denied the God of heaven.

verses.kjv_text: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.nlt_text: "Have I ever rejoiced when disaster struck my enemies, or become excited when harm came their way?

verses.kjv_text: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul. {mouth: Heb. palate}
verses.nlt_text: No, I have never sinned by cursing anyone or by asking for revenge.

verses.kjv_text: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
