Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble {which I suffer} of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
The heathen are sunk down in the pit {that} they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
The LORD is known {by} the judgment {which} he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah. {Higgaion: that is, Meditation}
The wicked shall be turned into hell, {and} all the nations that forget God.
For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall {not} perish for ever.
Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
Put them in fear, O LORD: {that} the nations may know themselves {to be but} men. Selah.
Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? {why} hidest thou {thyself} in times of trouble?
The wicked in {his} pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined. {The wicked...: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute}
For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, {whom} the LORD abhorreth. {heart's: Heb. soul's} {blesseth...: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the LORD}
The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek {after God}: God {is} not in all his thoughts. {God is...: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God}
His ways are always grievous; thy judgments {are} far above out of his sight: {as for} all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for {I shall} never {be} in adversity. {never: Heb. unto generation and generation}
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue {is} mischief and vanity. {deceit: Heb. deceits} {vanity: or, iniquity}
He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor. {are...: Heb. hide themselves}
He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net. {secretly: Heb. in the secret places}
He croucheth, {and} humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones. {He...: Heb. He breaketh himself} {by...: or, into his strong parts}
He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see {it}.
Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble. {humble: or, afflicted}
Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require {it}.
Thou hast seen {it}; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite {it} with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless. {committeth: Heb. leaveth}
Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil {man}: seek out his wickedness {till} thou find none.
The LORD {is} King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear: {prepare: or, establish}
To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress. {oppress: or, terrify}
[To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David.] In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee {as} a bird to your mountain?
For, lo, the wicked bend {their} bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart. {privily: Heb. in darkness}
If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
The LORD {is} in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne {is} in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: {this shall be} the portion of their cup. {an horrible...: or, a burning tempest}
For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
[To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.] Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men. {upon...: or, upon the eighth} {Help: or, Save}
They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: {with} flattering lips {and} with a double heart do they speak. {a double...: Heb. an heart and an heart}
The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, {and} the tongue that speaketh proud things: {proud: Heb. great}
Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips {are} our own: who {is} lord over us? {are...: Heb. are with us}
For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set {him} in safety {from him that} puffeth at him. {puffeth...: or, would ensnare him}
The words of the LORD {are} pure words: {as} silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever. {them from: Heb. him, etc: that is, every one of them, etc}
The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted. {men: Heb. of the sons of the men}
[To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me? {chief...: or, overseer}
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, {having} sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
Consider {and} hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the {sleep of} death;
Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; {and} those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
[To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David.] The fool hath said in his heart, {There is} no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, {there is} none that doeth good.
The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, {and} seek God.
They are all gone aside, they are {all} together become filthy: {there is} none that doeth good, no, not one. {filthy: Heb. stinking}
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people {as} they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
There were they in great fear: for God {is} in the generation of the righteous. {were...: Heb. they feared a fear}
Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD {is} his refuge.
Oh that the salvation of Israel {were come} out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, {and} Israel shall be glad. {Oh...: Heb. Who will give}
[A Psalm of David.] LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill? {abide: Heb. sojourn}
He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
{He that} backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour. {taketh...: or, receiveth, or, endureth}
In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. {He that} sweareth to {his own} hurt, and changeth not.
{He that} putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these {things} shall never be moved.
[Michtam of David.] Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust. {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}
{O my soul}, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou {art} my Lord: my goodness {extendeth} not to thee;
{But} to the saints that {are} in the earth, and {to} the excellent, in whom {is} all my delight.
Their sorrows shall be multiplied {that} hasten {after} another {god}: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips. {hasten...: or, give gifts to another}
The LORD {is} the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot. {of mine...: Heb. of my part}
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant {places}; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
I have set the LORD always before me: because {he is} at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope. {rest...: Heb. dwell confidently}
For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence {is} fulness of joy; at thy right hand {there are} pleasures for evermore.
[A Prayer of David.] Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, {that goeth} not out of feigned lips. {the right: Heb. justice} {not...: Heb. without lips of deceit}
Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited {me} in the night; thou hast tried me, {and} shalt find nothing; I am purposed {that} my mouth shall not transgress.
Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept {me from} the paths of the destroyer.
Hold up my goings in thy paths, {that} my footsteps slip not. {slip...: Heb. be not moved}
I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, {and hear} my speech.

Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust {in thee} from those that rise up {against them}. {by thy...: or, them which trust in thee from those that rise up against thy right hand}
Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
From the wicked that oppress me, {from} my deadly enemies, {who} compass me about. {oppress: Heb. waste} {my...: Heb. my enemies against the soul}
They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

Like as a lion {that} is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places. {Like...: Heb. The likeness of him (that is, of every one of them) is as a lion that desireth to ravin} {lurking: Heb. sitting}
Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, {which is} thy sword: {disappoint...: Heb. prevent his face} {which is: or, by}

From men {which are} thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, {which have} their portion in {this} life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid {treasure}: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their {substance} to their babes. {which are: or, by} {they...: or, their children are full}
As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

[To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David, the servant of the LORD, who spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day {that} the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said,] I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
The LORD {is} my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, {and} my high tower. {my strength: Heb. my rock}
I will call upon the LORD, {who is worthy} to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. {ungodly men: Heb. Belial}
The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. {sorrows: or, cords}
In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, {even} into his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc}
He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness {was} under his feet.
And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him {were} dark waters {and} thick clouds of the skies.
At the brightness {that was} before him his thick clouds passed, hail {stones} and coals of fire.
The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail {stones} and coals of fire.
Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters. {many: or, great}
He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
For all his judgments {were} before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity. {before: Heb. with}
Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight. {in...: Heb. before his eyes}
With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward. {shew thyself froward: or, wrestle}
For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness. {candle: or, lamp}
For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall. {run...: or, broken}
{As for} God, his way {is} perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he {is} a buckler to all those that trust in him. {tried: or, refined}
For who {is} God save the LORD? or who {is} a rock save our God?
{It is} God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
He maketh my feet like hinds' {feet}, and setteth me upon my high places.
He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great. {thy gentleness...: or, with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me}
Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip. {my feet: Heb. mine ankles}
I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

He sendeth forth his commandment {upon} earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, {and} the waters flow.
He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel. {his word: Heb. his words}
He hath not dealt so with any nation: and {as for his} judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights. {Praise ye the LORD. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc}
Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that {be} above the heavens.
Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl: {flying...: Heb. birds of wing}
Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory {is} above the earth and heaven. {excellent: Heb. exalted}
He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; {even} of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, {and} his praise in the congregation of saints. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}
Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King. {in him...: Heb. in his Makers}
Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp. {in...: or, with the pipe}
For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
{Let} the high {praises} of God {be} in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand; {mouth: Heb. throat}
To execute vengeance upon the heathen, {and} punishments upon the people;
To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}
Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp. {trumpet: or, cornet}
Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs. {dance: or, pipe}
Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.nlt_text: These are the proverbs of Solomon, David's son, king of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.nlt_text: Their purpose is to teach people wisdom and discipline, to help them understand the insights of the wise.

verses.kjv_text: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity; {equity: Heb. equities}
verses.nlt_text: Their purpose is to teach people to live disciplined and successful lives, to help them do what is right, just, and fair.

verses.kjv_text: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion. {discretion: or, advisement}
verses.nlt_text: These proverbs will give insight to the simple, knowledge and discernment to the young.

verses.kjv_text: A wise {man} will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.nlt_text: Let the wise listen to these proverbs and become even wiser. Let those with understanding receive guidance

verses.kjv_text: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings. {the interpretation: or, an eloquent speech}
verses.nlt_text: by exploring the meaning in these proverbs and parables, the words of the wise and their riddles.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD {is} the beginning of knowledge: {but} fools despise wisdom and instruction. {the beginning: or, the principal part}
verses.nlt_text: Fear of the LORD is the foundation of true knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

verses.kjv_text: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.nlt_text: My child, listen when your father corrects you. Don't neglect your mother's instruction.

verses.kjv_text: For they {shall be} an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck. {an...: Heb. an adding}
verses.nlt_text: What you learn from them will crown you with grace and be a chain of honor around your neck.

verses.kjv_text: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.nlt_text: My child, if sinners entice you, turn your back on them!

verses.kjv_text: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.nlt_text: They may say, "Come and join us. Let's hide and kill someone! Just for fun, let's ambush the innocent!

verses.kjv_text: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.nlt_text: Let's swallow them alive, like the grave; let's swallow them whole, like those who go down to the pit of death.

verses.kjv_text: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.nlt_text: Think of the great things we'll get! We'll fill our houses with all the stuff we take.

verses.kjv_text: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.nlt_text: Come, throw in your lot with us; we'll all share the loot."

verses.kjv_text: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.nlt_text: My child, don't go along with them! Stay far away from their paths.

verses.kjv_text: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.nlt_text: They rush to commit evil deeds. They hurry to commit murder.

verses.kjv_text: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird. {in the...: Heb. in the eyes of every thing that hath a wing}
verses.nlt_text: If a bird sees a trap being set, it knows to stay away.

verses.kjv_text: And they lay wait for their {own} blood; they lurk privily for their {own} lives.
verses.nlt_text: But these people set an ambush for themselves; they are trying to get themselves killed.

verses.kjv_text: So {are} the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; {which} taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Such is the fate of all who are greedy for money; it robs them of life.

verses.kjv_text: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets: {Wisdom: Heb. Wisdoms, that is, Excellent wisdom}
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom shouts in the streets. She cries out in the public square.

verses.kjv_text: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, {saying},
verses.nlt_text: She calls to the crowds along the main street, to those gathered in front of the city gate:

verses.kjv_text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.nlt_text: "How long, you simpletons, will you insist on being simpleminded? How long will you mockers relish your mocking? How long will you fools hate knowledge?

verses.kjv_text: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Come and listen to my counsel. I'll share my heart with you and make you wise.

verses.kjv_text: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.nlt_text: "I called you so often, but you wouldn't come. I reached out to you, but you paid no attention.

verses.kjv_text: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.nlt_text: You ignored my advice and rejected the correction I offered.

verses.kjv_text: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.nlt_text: So I will laugh when you are in trouble! I will mock you when disaster overtakes you--

verses.kjv_text: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.nlt_text: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster engulfs you like a cyclone, and anguish and distress overwhelm you.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.nlt_text: "When they cry for help, I will not answer. Though they anxiously search for me, they will not find me.

verses.kjv_text: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.nlt_text: They rejected my advice and paid no attention when I corrected them.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, they must eat the bitter fruit of living their own way, choking on their own schemes.

verses.kjv_text: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them. {turning...: or, ease of the simple}
verses.nlt_text: For simpletons turn away from me-- to death. Fools are destroyed by their own complacency.

verses.kjv_text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.nlt_text: But all who listen to me will live in peace, untroubled by fear of harm."

verses.kjv_text: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.nlt_text: My child, listen to what I say, and treasure my commands.

verses.kjv_text: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, {and} apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.nlt_text: Tune your ears to wisdom, and concentrate on understanding.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, {and} liftest up thy voice for understanding; {liftest...: Heb. givest thy voice}
verses.nlt_text: Cry out for insight, and ask for understanding.

verses.kjv_text: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as {for} hid treasures;
verses.nlt_text: Search for them as you would for silver; seek them like hidden treasures.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will understand what it means to fear the LORD, and you will gain knowledge of God.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth {cometh} knowledge and understanding.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD grants wisdom! From his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.kjv_text: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: {he is} a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.nlt_text: He grants a treasure of common sense to the honest. He is a shield to those who walk with integrity.

verses.kjv_text: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.nlt_text: He guards the paths of the just and protects those who are faithful to him.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; {yea}, every good path.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will understand what is right, just, and fair, and you will find the right way to go.

verses.kjv_text: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.nlt_text: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will fill you with joy.

verses.kjv_text: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.nlt_text: Wise choices will watch over you. Understanding will keep you safe.

verses.kjv_text: To deliver thee from the way of the evil {man}, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom will save you from evil people, from those whose words are twisted.

verses.kjv_text: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.nlt_text: These men turn from the right way to walk down dark paths.

verses.kjv_text: Who rejoice to do evil, {and} delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.nlt_text: They take pleasure in doing wrong, and they enjoy the twisted ways of evil.

verses.kjv_text: Whose ways {are} crooked, and {they} froward in their paths:
verses.nlt_text: Their actions are crooked, and their ways are wrong.

verses.kjv_text: To deliver thee from the strange woman, {even} from the stranger {which} flattereth with her words;
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom will save you from the immoral woman, from the seductive words of the promiscuous woman.

verses.kjv_text: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.nlt_text: She has abandoned her husband and ignores the covenant she made before God.

verses.kjv_text: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.nlt_text: Entering her house leads to death; it is the road to the grave.

verses.kjv_text: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.nlt_text: The man who visits her is doomed. He will never reach the paths of life.

verses.kjv_text: That thou mayest walk in the way of good {men}, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.nlt_text: Follow the steps of good men instead, and stay on the paths of the righteous.

verses.kjv_text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.nlt_text: For only the godly will live in the land, and those with integrity will remain in it.

verses.kjv_text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it. {rooted: or, plucked up}
verses.nlt_text: But the wicked will be removed from the land, and the treacherous will be uprooted.

verses.kjv_text: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.nlt_text: My child, never forget the things I have taught you. Store my commands in your heart.

verses.kjv_text: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee. {long...: Heb. years of life}
verses.nlt_text: If you do this, you will live many years, and your life will be satisfying.

verses.kjv_text: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.nlt_text: Never let loyalty and kindness leave you! Tie them around your neck as a reminder. Write them deep within your heart.

verses.kjv_text: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man. {good...: or, good success}
verses.nlt_text: Then you will find favor with both God and people, and you will earn a good reputation.

verses.kjv_text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.nlt_text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart; do not depend on your own understanding.

verses.kjv_text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.nlt_text: Seek his will in all you do, and he will show you which path to take.

verses.kjv_text: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be impressed with your own wisdom. Instead, fear the LORD and turn away from evil.

verses.kjv_text: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones. {health: Heb. medicine} {marrow: Heb. watering, or, moistening}
verses.nlt_text: Then you will have healing for your body and strength for your bones.

verses.kjv_text: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.nlt_text: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the best part of everything you produce.

verses.kjv_text: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.nlt_text: Then he will fill your barns with grain, and your vats will overflow with good wine.

verses.kjv_text: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.nlt_text: My child, don't reject the LORD's discipline, and don't be upset when he corrects you.

verses.kjv_text: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son {in whom} he delighteth.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD corrects those he loves, just as a father corrects a child in whom he delights.

verses.kjv_text: Happy {is} the man {that} findeth wisdom, and the man {that} getteth understanding. {that getteth...: Heb. that draweth out understanding}
verses.nlt_text: Joyful is the person who finds wisdom, the one who gains understanding.

verses.kjv_text: For the merchandise of it {is} better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.nlt_text: For wisdom is more profitable than silver, and her wages are better than gold.

verses.kjv_text: She {is} more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

verses.kjv_text: Length of days {is} in her right hand; {and} in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.nlt_text: She offers you long life in her right hand, and riches and honor in her left.

verses.kjv_text: Her ways {are} ways of pleasantness, and all her paths {are} peace.
verses.nlt_text: She will guide you down delightful paths; all her ways are satisfying.

verses.kjv_text: She {is} a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy {is every one} that retaineth her.
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom is a tree of life to those who embrace her; happy are those who hold her tightly.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens. {established: or, prepared}
verses.nlt_text: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth; by understanding he created the heavens.

verses.kjv_text: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.nlt_text: By his knowledge the deep fountains of the earth burst forth, and the dew settles beneath the night sky.

verses.kjv_text: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.nlt_text: My child, don't lose sight of common sense and discernment. Hang on to them,

verses.kjv_text: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.nlt_text: for they will refresh your soul. They are like jewels on a necklace.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.nlt_text: They keep you safe on your way, and your feet will not stumble.

verses.kjv_text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.nlt_text: You can go to bed without fear; you will lie down and sleep soundly.

verses.kjv_text: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.nlt_text: You need not be afraid of sudden disaster or the destruction that comes upon the wicked,

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.nlt_text: for the LORD is your security. He will keep your foot from being caught in a trap.

verses.kjv_text: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do {it}. {them...: Heb. the owners thereof}
verses.nlt_text: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it when it's in your power to help them.

verses.kjv_text: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.nlt_text: If you can help your neighbor now, don't say, "Come back tomorrow, and then I'll help you."

verses.kjv_text: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee. {Devise...: or, Practise no evil}
verses.nlt_text: Don't plot harm against your neighbor, for those who live nearby trust you.

verses.kjv_text: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.nlt_text: Don't pick a fight without reason, when no one has done you harm.

verses.kjv_text: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways. {the oppressor: Heb. a man of violence}
verses.nlt_text: Don't envy violent people or copy their ways.

verses.kjv_text: For the froward {is} abomination to the LORD: but his secret {is} with the righteous.
verses.nlt_text: Such wicked people are detestable to the LORD, but he offers his friendship to the godly.

verses.kjv_text: The curse of the LORD {is} in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD curses the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the upright.

verses.kjv_text: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD mocks the mockers but is gracious to the humble.

verses.kjv_text: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools. {shall be...: Heb. exalteth the fools}
verses.nlt_text: The wise inherit honor, but fools are put to shame!

verses.kjv_text: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.nlt_text: My children, listen when your father corrects you. Pay attention and learn good judgment,

verses.kjv_text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.nlt_text: for I am giving you good guidance. Don't turn away from my instructions.

verses.kjv_text: For I was my father's son, tender and only {beloved} in the sight of my mother.
verses.nlt_text: For I, too, was once my father's son, tenderly loved as my mother's only child.

verses.kjv_text: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.nlt_text: My father taught me, "Take my words to heart. Follow my commands, and you will live.

verses.kjv_text: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget {it} not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: Get wisdom; develop good judgment. Don't forget my words or turn away from them.

verses.kjv_text: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.nlt_text: Don't turn your back on wisdom, for she will protect you. Love her, and she will guard you.

verses.kjv_text: Wisdom {is} the principal thing; {therefore} get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.nlt_text: Getting wisdom is the wisest thing you can do! And whatever else you do, develop good judgment.

verses.kjv_text: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.nlt_text: If you prize wisdom, she will make you great. Embrace her, and she will honor you.

verses.kjv_text: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee. {a crown...: or, she shall compass thee with a crown of glory}
verses.nlt_text: She will place a lovely wreath on your head; she will present you with a beautiful crown."

verses.kjv_text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.nlt_text: My child, listen to me and do as I say, and you will have a long, good life.

verses.kjv_text: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.nlt_text: I will teach you wisdom's ways and lead you in straight paths.

verses.kjv_text: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.nlt_text: When you walk, you won't be held back; when you run, you won't stumble.

verses.kjv_text: Take fast hold of instruction; let {her} not go: keep her; for she {is} thy life.
verses.nlt_text: Take hold of my instructions; don't let them go. Guard them, for they are the key to life.

verses.kjv_text: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil {men}.
verses.nlt_text: Don't do as the wicked do, and don't follow the path of evildoers.

verses.kjv_text: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.nlt_text: Don't even think about it; don't go that way. Turn away and keep moving.

verses.kjv_text: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause {some} to fall.
verses.nlt_text: For evil people can't sleep until they've done their evil deed for the day. They can't rest until they've caused someone to stumble.

verses.kjv_text: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.nlt_text: They eat the food of wickedness and drink the wine of violence!

verses.kjv_text: But the path of the just {is} as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.nlt_text: The way of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, which shines ever brighter until the full light of day.

verses.kjv_text: The way of the wicked {is} as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.nlt_text: But the way of the wicked is like total darkness. They have no idea what they are stumbling over.

verses.kjv_text: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.nlt_text: My child, pay attention to what I say. Listen carefully to my words.

verses.kjv_text: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.nlt_text: Don't lose sight of them. Let them penetrate deep into your heart,

verses.kjv_text: For they {are} life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh. {health: Heb. medicine}
verses.nlt_text: for they bring life to those who find them, and healing to their whole body.

verses.kjv_text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it {are} the issues of life. {with...: Heb. above all keeping}
verses.nlt_text: Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life.

verses.kjv_text: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee. {a froward...: Heb. frowardness of mouth and perverseness of lips}
verses.nlt_text: Avoid all perverse talk; stay away from corrupt speech.

verses.kjv_text: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.nlt_text: Look straight ahead, and fix your eyes on what lies before you.

verses.kjv_text: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established. {let...: or, all thy ways shall be ordered aright}
verses.nlt_text: Mark out a straight path for your feet; stay on the safe path.

verses.kjv_text: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.nlt_text: Don't get sidetracked; keep your feet from following evil.

verses.kjv_text: My son, attend unto my wisdom, {and} bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.nlt_text: My son, pay attention to my wisdom; listen carefully to my wise counsel.

verses.kjv_text: That thou mayest regard discretion, and {that} thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will show discernment, and your lips will express what you've learned.

verses.kjv_text: For the lips of a strange woman drop {as} an honeycomb, and her mouth {is} smoother than oil: {mouth: Heb. palate}
verses.nlt_text: For the lips of an immoral woman are as sweet as honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil.

verses.kjv_text: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
verses.nlt_text: But in the end she is as bitter as poison, as dangerous as a double-edged sword.

verses.kjv_text: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.nlt_text: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.

verses.kjv_text: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, {that} thou canst not know {them}.
verses.nlt_text: For she cares nothing about the path to life. She staggers down a crooked trail and doesn't realize it.

verses.kjv_text: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: So now, my sons, listen to me. Never stray from what I am about to say:

verses.kjv_text: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.nlt_text: Stay away from her! Don't go near the door of her house!

verses.kjv_text: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.nlt_text: If you do, you will lose your honor and will lose to merciless people all you have achieved.

verses.kjv_text: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours {be} in the house of a stranger; {thy wealth: Heb. thy strength}
verses.nlt_text: Strangers will consume your wealth, and someone else will enjoy the fruit of your labor.

verses.kjv_text: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.nlt_text: In the end you will groan in anguish when disease consumes your body.

verses.kjv_text: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.nlt_text: You will say, "How I hated discipline! If only I had not ignored all the warnings!

verses.kjv_text: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.nlt_text: Oh, why didn't I listen to my teachers? Why didn't I pay attention to my instructors?

verses.kjv_text: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.nlt_text: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, and now I must face public disgrace."

verses.kjv_text: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.nlt_text: Drink water from your own well-- share your love only with your wife.

verses.kjv_text: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, {and} rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.nlt_text: Why spill the water of your springs in the streets, having sex with just anyone?

verses.kjv_text: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
verses.nlt_text: You should reserve it for yourselves. Never share it with strangers.

verses.kjv_text: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.nlt_text: Let your wife be a fountain of blessing for you. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

verses.kjv_text: {Let her be as} the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love. {satisfy...: Heb. water thee} {be thou...: Heb. err thou always in her love}
verses.nlt_text: She is a loving deer, a graceful doe. Let her breasts satisfy you always. May you always be captivated by her love.

verses.kjv_text: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.nlt_text: Why be captivated, my son, by an immoral woman, or fondle the breasts of a promiscuous woman?

verses.kjv_text: For the ways of man {are} before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD sees clearly what a man does, examining every path he takes.

verses.kjv_text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins. {sins: Heb. sin}
verses.nlt_text: An evil man is held captive by his own sins; they are ropes that catch and hold him.

verses.kjv_text: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.nlt_text: He will die for lack of self-control; he will be lost because of his great foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, {if} thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.nlt_text: My child, if you have put up security for a friend's debt or agreed to guarantee the debt of a stranger--

verses.kjv_text: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.nlt_text: if you have trapped yourself by your agreement and are caught by what you said--

verses.kjv_text: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend. {and make...: or, so shalt thou prevail with thy friend}
verses.nlt_text: follow my advice and save yourself, for you have placed yourself at your friend's mercy. Now swallow your pride; go and beg to have your name erased.

verses.kjv_text: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.nlt_text: Don't put it off; do it now! Don't rest until you do.

verses.kjv_text: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand {of the hunter}, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.nlt_text: Save yourself like a gazelle escaping from a hunter, like a bird fleeing from a net.

verses.kjv_text: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.nlt_text: Take a lesson from the ants, you lazybones. Learn from their ways and become wise!

verses.kjv_text: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.nlt_text: Though they have no prince or governor or ruler to make them work,

verses.kjv_text: Provideth her meat in the summer, {and} gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.nlt_text: they labor hard all summer, gathering food for the winter.

verses.kjv_text: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.nlt_text: But you, lazybones, how long will you sleep? When will you wake up?

verses.kjv_text: {Yet} a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.nlt_text: A little extra sleep, a little more slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest--

verses.kjv_text: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.nlt_text: then poverty will pounce on you like a bandit; scarcity will attack you like an armed robber.

verses.kjv_text: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.nlt_text: What are worthless and wicked people like? They are constant liars,

verses.kjv_text: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.nlt_text: signaling their deceit with a wink of the eye, a nudge of the foot, or the wiggle of fingers.

verses.kjv_text: Frowardness {is} in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord. {soweth: Heb. casteth forth}
verses.nlt_text: Their perverted hearts plot evil, and they constantly stir up trouble.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.nlt_text: But they will be destroyed suddenly, broken in an instant beyond all hope of healing.

verses.kjv_text: These six {things} doth the LORD hate: yea, seven {are} an abomination unto him: {unto...: Heb. of his soul}
verses.nlt_text: There are six things the LORD hates-- no, seven things he detests:

verses.kjv_text: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood, {A proud...: Heb. Haughty eyes}
verses.nlt_text: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that kill the innocent,

verses.kjv_text: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.nlt_text: a heart that plots evil, feet that race to do wrong,

verses.kjv_text: A false witness {that} speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.nlt_text: a false witness who pours out lies, a person who sows discord in a family.

verses.kjv_text: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.nlt_text: My son, obey your father's commands, and don't neglect your mother's instruction.

verses.kjv_text: Bind them continually upon thine heart, {and} tie them about thy neck.
verses.nlt_text: Keep their words always in your heart. Tie them around your neck.

verses.kjv_text: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and {when} thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.nlt_text: When you walk, their counsel will lead you. When you sleep, they will protect you. When you wake up, they will advise you.

verses.kjv_text: For the commandment {is} a lamp; and the law {is} light; and reproofs of instruction {are} the way of life: {lamp: or, candle}
verses.nlt_text: For their command is a lamp and their instruction a light; their corrective discipline is the way to life.

verses.kjv_text: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman. {of the...: or, of the strange tongue}
verses.nlt_text: It will keep you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of a promiscuous woman.

verses.kjv_text: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.nlt_text: Don't lust for her beauty. Don't let her coy glances seduce you.

verses.kjv_text: For by means of a whorish woman {a man is brought} to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life. {the adulteress: Heb. the woman of a man, or, a man's wife}
verses.nlt_text: For a prostitute will bring you to poverty, but sleeping with another man's wife will cost you your life.

verses.kjv_text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.nlt_text: Can a man scoop a flame into his lap and not have his clothes catch on fire?

verses.kjv_text: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.nlt_text: Can he walk on hot coals and not blister his feet?

verses.kjv_text: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.nlt_text: So it is with the man who sleeps with another man's wife. He who embraces her will not go unpunished.

verses.kjv_text: {Men} do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.nlt_text: Excuses might be found for a thief who steals because he is starving.

verses.kjv_text: But {if} he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.nlt_text: But if he is caught, he must pay back seven times what he stole, even if he has to sell everything in his house.

verses.kjv_text: {But} whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he {that} doeth it destroyeth his own soul. {understanding: Heb. heart}
verses.nlt_text: But the man who commits adultery is an utter fool, for he destroys himself.

verses.kjv_text: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.nlt_text: He will be wounded and disgraced. His shame will never be erased.

verses.kjv_text: For jealousy {is} the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.nlt_text: For the woman's jealous husband will be furious, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

verses.kjv_text: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts. {He will...: Heb. He will not accept the face of any ransom}
verses.nlt_text: He will accept no compensation, nor be satisfied with a payoff of any size.

verses.kjv_text: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Follow my advice, my son; always treasure my commands.

verses.kjv_text: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.nlt_text: Obey my commands and live! Guard my instructions as you guard your own eyes.

verses.kjv_text: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.nlt_text: Tie them on your fingers as a reminder. Write them deep within your heart.

verses.kjv_text: Say unto wisdom, Thou {art} my sister; and call understanding {thy} kinswoman:
verses.nlt_text: Love wisdom like a sister; make insight a beloved member of your family.

verses.kjv_text: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger {which} flattereth with her words.
verses.nlt_text: Let them protect you from an affair with an immoral woman, from listening to the flattery of a promiscuous woman.

verses.kjv_text: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.nlt_text: While I was at the window of my house, looking through the curtain,

verses.kjv_text: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding, {the youths: Heb. the sons}
verses.nlt_text: I saw some naive young men, and one in particular who lacked common sense.

verses.kjv_text: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.nlt_text: He was crossing the street near the house of an immoral woman, strolling down the path by her house.

verses.kjv_text: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night: {in the evening: Heb. in the evening of days}
verses.nlt_text: It was at twilight, in the evening, as deep darkness fell.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there met him a woman {with} the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.nlt_text: The woman approached him, seductively dressed and sly of heart.

verses.kjv_text: (She {is} loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.nlt_text: She was the brash, rebellious type, never content to stay at home.

verses.kjv_text: Now {is she} without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.nlt_text: She is often in the streets and markets, soliciting at every corner.

verses.kjv_text: So she caught him, and kissed him, {and} with an impudent face said unto him, {with...: Heb. she strengthened her face and said}
verses.nlt_text: She threw her arms around him and kissed him, and with a brazen look she said,

verses.kjv_text: {I have} peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows. {I have...: Heb. Peace offerings are upon me}
verses.nlt_text: "I've just made my peace offerings and fulfilled my vows.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.nlt_text: You're the one I was looking for! I came out to find you, and here you are!

verses.kjv_text: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved {works}, with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: My bed is spread with beautiful blankets, with colored sheets of Egyptian linen.

verses.kjv_text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.nlt_text: I've perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.kjv_text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.nlt_text: Come, let's drink our fill of love until morning. Let's enjoy each other's caresses,

verses.kjv_text: For the goodman {is} not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.nlt_text: for my husband is not home. He's away on a long trip.

verses.kjv_text: He hath taken a bag of money with him, {and} will come home at the day appointed. {with...: Heb. in his hand} {the day...: or, the new moon}
verses.nlt_text: He has taken a wallet full of money with him and won't return until later this month. "

verses.kjv_text: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.nlt_text: So she seduced him with her pretty speech and enticed him with her flattery.

verses.kjv_text: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks; {straightway: Heb. suddenly}
verses.nlt_text: He followed her at once, like an ox going to the slaughter. He was like a stag caught in a trap,

verses.kjv_text: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it {is} for his life.
verses.nlt_text: awaiting the arrow that would pierce its heart. He was like a bird flying into a snare, little knowing it would cost him his life.

verses.kjv_text: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: So listen to me, my sons, and pay attention to my words.

verses.kjv_text: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let your hearts stray away toward her. Don't wander down her wayward path.

verses.kjv_text: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong {men} have been slain by her.
verses.nlt_text: For she has been the ruin of many; many men have been her victims.

verses.kjv_text: Her house {is} the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.nlt_text: Her house is the road to the grave. Her bedroom is the den of death.

verses.kjv_text: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.nlt_text: Listen as Wisdom calls out! Hear as understanding raises her voice!

verses.kjv_text: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.nlt_text: On the hilltop along the road, she takes her stand at the crossroads.

verses.kjv_text: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.nlt_text: By the gates at the entrance to the town, on the road leading in, she cries aloud,

verses.kjv_text: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice {is} to the sons of man.
verses.nlt_text: "I call to you, to all of you! I raise my voice to all people.

verses.kjv_text: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.nlt_text: You simple people, use good judgment. You foolish people, show some understanding.

verses.kjv_text: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips {shall be} right things.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to me! For I have important things to tell you. Everything I say is right,

verses.kjv_text: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness {is} an abomination to my lips. {an...: Heb. the abomination of my lips}
verses.nlt_text: for I speak the truth and detest every kind of deception.

verses.kjv_text: All the words of my mouth {are} in righteousness; {there is} nothing froward or perverse in them. {froward: Heb. wreathed}
verses.nlt_text: My advice is wholesome. There is nothing devious or crooked in it.

verses.kjv_text: They {are} all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: My words are plain to anyone with understanding, clear to those with knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.nlt_text: Choose my instruction rather than silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.

verses.kjv_text: For wisdom {is} better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.nlt_text: For wisdom is far more valuable than rubies. Nothing you desire can compare with it.

verses.kjv_text: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions. {prudence: or, subtilty}
verses.nlt_text: "I, Wisdom, live together with good judgment. I know where to discover knowledge and discernment.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD {is} to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.nlt_text: All who fear the LORD will hate evil. Therefore, I hate pride and arrogance, corruption and perverse speech.

verses.kjv_text: Counsel {is} mine, and sound wisdom: I {am} understanding; I have strength.
verses.nlt_text: Common sense and success belong to me. Insight and strength are mine.

verses.kjv_text: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.nlt_text: Because of me, kings reign, and rulers make just decrees.

verses.kjv_text: By me princes rule, and nobles, {even} all the judges of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Rulers lead with my help, and nobles make righteous judgments.

verses.kjv_text: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.nlt_text: "I love all who love me. Those who search will surely find me.

verses.kjv_text: Riches and honour {are} with me; {yea}, durable riches and righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: I have riches and honor, as well as enduring wealth and justice.

verses.kjv_text: My fruit {is} better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.nlt_text: My gifts are better than gold, even the purest gold, my wages better than sterling silver!

verses.kjv_text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment: {lead: or, walk}
verses.nlt_text: I walk in righteousness, in paths of justice.

verses.kjv_text: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.nlt_text: Those who love me inherit wealth. I will fill their treasuries.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.nlt_text: "The LORD formed me from the beginning, before he created anything else.

verses.kjv_text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.nlt_text: I was appointed in ages past, at the very first, before the earth began.

verses.kjv_text: When {there were} no depths, I was brought forth; when {there were} no fountains abounding with water.
verses.nlt_text: I was born before the oceans were created, before the springs bubbled forth their waters.

verses.kjv_text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.nlt_text: Before the mountains were formed, before the hills, I was born--

verses.kjv_text: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world. {fields: or, open places} {the highest...: or, the chief part}
verses.nlt_text: before he had made the earth and fields and the first handfuls of soil.

verses.kjv_text: When he prepared the heavens, I {was} there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth: {a compass: or, a circle}
verses.nlt_text: I was there when he established the heavens, when he drew the horizon on the oceans.

verses.kjv_text: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.nlt_text: I was there when he set the clouds above, when he established springs deep in the earth.

verses.kjv_text: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.nlt_text: I was there when he set the limits of the seas, so they would not spread beyond their boundaries. And when he marked off the earth's foundations,

verses.kjv_text: Then I was by him, {as} one brought up {with him}: and I was daily {his} delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.nlt_text: I was the architect at his side. I was his constant delight, rejoicing always in his presence.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights {were} with the sons of men.
verses.nlt_text: And how happy I was with the world he created; how I rejoiced with the human family!

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed {are they that} keep my ways.
verses.nlt_text: "And so, my children, listen to me, for all who follow my ways are joyful.

verses.kjv_text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to my instruction and be wise. Don't ignore it.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {is} the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.nlt_text: Joyful are those who listen to me, watching for me daily at my gates, waiting for me outside my home!

verses.kjv_text: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD. {obtain: Heb. bring forth}
verses.nlt_text: For whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.nlt_text: But those who miss me injure themselves. All who hate me love death."

verses.kjv_text: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved its seven columns.

verses.kjv_text: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table. {her beasts: Heb. her killing}
verses.nlt_text: She has prepared a great banquet, mixed the wines, and set the table.

verses.kjv_text: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.nlt_text: She has sent her servants to invite everyone to come. She calls out from the heights overlooking the city.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso {is} simple, let him turn in hither: {as for} him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.nlt_text: "Come in with me," she urges the simple. To those who lack good judgment, she says,

verses.kjv_text: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine {which} I have mingled.
verses.nlt_text: "Come, eat my food, and drink the wine I have mixed.

verses.kjv_text: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.nlt_text: Leave your simple ways behind, and begin to live; learn to use good judgment."

verses.kjv_text: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked {man getteth} himself a blot.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who rebukes a mocker will get an insult in return. Anyone who corrects the wicked will get hurt.

verses.kjv_text: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.nlt_text: So don't bother correcting mockers; they will only hate you. But correct the wise, and they will love you.

verses.kjv_text: Give {instruction} to a wise {man}, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just {man}, and he will increase in learning.
verses.nlt_text: Instruct the wise, and they will be even wiser. Teach the righteous, and they will learn even more.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD {is} the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy {is} understanding.
verses.nlt_text: Fear of the LORD is the foundation of wisdom. Knowledge of the Holy One results in good judgment.

verses.kjv_text: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom will multiply your days and add years to your life.

verses.kjv_text: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but {if} thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear {it}.
verses.nlt_text: If you become wise, you will be the one to benefit. If you scorn wisdom, you will be the one to suffer.

verses.kjv_text: A foolish woman {is} clamorous: {she is} simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.nlt_text: The woman named Folly is brash. She is ignorant and doesn't know it.

verses.kjv_text: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.nlt_text: She sits in her doorway on the heights overlooking the city.

verses.kjv_text: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.nlt_text: She calls out to men going by who are minding their own business.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso {is} simple, let him turn in hither: and {as for} him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.nlt_text: "Come in with me," she urges the simple. To those who lack good judgment, she says,

verses.kjv_text: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread {eaten} in secret is pleasant. {eaten...: Heb. of secrecies}
verses.nlt_text: "Stolen water is refreshing; food eaten in secret tastes the best!"

verses.kjv_text: But he knoweth not that the dead {are} there; {and that} her guests {are} in the depths of hell.
verses.nlt_text: But little do they know that the dead are there. Her guests are in the depths of the grave.

verses.kjv_text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son {is} the heaviness of his mother.
verses.nlt_text: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise child brings joy to a father; a foolish child brings grief to a mother.

verses.kjv_text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.nlt_text: Tainted wealth has no lasting value, but right living can save your life.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked. {the substance...: or, the wicked for their wickedness}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will not let the godly go hungry, but he refuses to satisfy the craving of the wicked.

verses.kjv_text: He becometh poor that dealeth {with} a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.nlt_text: Lazy people are soon poor; hard workers get rich.

verses.kjv_text: He that gathereth in summer {is} a wise son: {but} he that sleepeth in harvest {is} a son that causeth shame.
verses.nlt_text: A wise youth harvests in the summer, but one who sleeps during harvest is a disgrace.

verses.kjv_text: Blessings {are} upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.nlt_text: The godly are showered with blessings; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions.

verses.kjv_text: The memory of the just {is} blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.nlt_text: We have happy memories of the godly, but the name of a wicked person rots away.

verses.kjv_text: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall. {a prating...: Heb. a fool of lips} {fall: Heb. be beaten}
verses.nlt_text: The wise are glad to be instructed, but babbling fools fall flat on their faces.

verses.kjv_text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.nlt_text: People with integrity walk safely, but those who follow crooked paths will slip and fall.

verses.kjv_text: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall. {fall: Heb. be beaten}
verses.nlt_text: People who wink at wrong cause trouble, but a bold reproof promotes peace.

verses.kjv_text: The mouth of a righteous {man is} a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.nlt_text: The words of the godly are a life-giving fountain; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions.

verses.kjv_text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.nlt_text: Hatred stirs up quarrels, but love makes up for all offenses.

verses.kjv_text: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod {is} for the back of him that is void of understanding. {of understanding: Heb. of heart}
verses.nlt_text: Wise words come from the lips of people with understanding, but those lacking sense will be beaten with a rod.

verses.kjv_text: Wise {men} lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish {is} near destruction.
verses.nlt_text: Wise people treasure knowledge, but the babbling of a fool invites disaster.

verses.kjv_text: The rich man's wealth {is} his strong city: the destruction of the poor {is} their poverty.
verses.nlt_text: The wealth of the rich is their fortress; the poverty of the poor is their destruction.

verses.kjv_text: The labour of the righteous {tendeth} to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.nlt_text: The earnings of the godly enhance their lives, but evil people squander their money on sin.

verses.kjv_text: He {is in} the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth. {erreth: or, causeth to err}
verses.nlt_text: People who accept discipline are on the pathway to life, but those who ignore correction will go astray.

verses.kjv_text: He that hideth hatred {with} lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, {is} a fool.
verses.nlt_text: Hiding hatred makes you a liar; slandering others makes you a fool.

verses.kjv_text: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips {is} wise.
verses.nlt_text: Too much talk leads to sin. Be sensible and keep your mouth shut.

verses.kjv_text: The tongue of the just {is as} choice silver: the heart of the wicked {is} little worth.
verses.nlt_text: The words of the godly are like sterling silver; the heart of a fool is worthless.

verses.kjv_text: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom. {of wisdom: Heb. of heart}
verses.nlt_text: The words of the godly encourage many, but fools are destroyed by their lack of common sense.

verses.kjv_text: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.nlt_text: The blessing of the LORD makes a person rich, and he adds no sorrow with it.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: Doing wrong is fun for a fool, but living wisely brings pleasure to the sensible.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.nlt_text: The fears of the wicked will be fulfilled; the hopes of the godly will be granted.

verses.kjv_text: As the whirlwind passeth, so {is} the wicked no {more}: but the righteous {is} an everlasting foundation.
verses.nlt_text: When the storms of life come, the wicked are whirled away, but the godly have a lasting foundation.

verses.kjv_text: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so {is} the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.nlt_text: Lazy people irritate their employers, like vinegar to the teeth or smoke in the eyes.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened. {prolongeth: Heb. addeth}
verses.nlt_text: Fear of the LORD lengthens one's life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

verses.kjv_text: The hope of the righteous {shall be} gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.nlt_text: The hopes of the godly result in happiness, but the expectations of the wicked come to nothing.

verses.kjv_text: The way of the LORD {is} strength to the upright: but destruction {shall be} to the workers of iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to those with integrity, but it destroys the wicked.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.nlt_text: The godly will never be disturbed, but the wicked will be removed from the land.

verses.kjv_text: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.nlt_text: The mouth of the godly person gives wise advice, but the tongue that deceives will be cut off.

verses.kjv_text: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked {speaketh} frowardness. {frowardness: Heb. frowardnesses}
verses.nlt_text: The lips of the godly speak helpful words, but the mouth of the wicked speaks perverse words.

verses.kjv_text: A false balance {is} abomination to the LORD: but a just weight {is} his delight. {A false...: Heb. Balances of deceit} {just...: Heb. perfect stone}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests the use of dishonest scales, but he delights in accurate weights.

verses.kjv_text: {When} pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly {is} wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: Pride leads to disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.

verses.kjv_text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.nlt_text: Honesty guides good people; dishonesty destroys treacherous people.

verses.kjv_text: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.nlt_text: Riches won't help on the day of judgment, but right living can save you from death.

verses.kjv_text: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness. {direct: Heb. rectify}
verses.nlt_text: The godly are directed by honesty; the wicked fall beneath their load of sin.

verses.kjv_text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in {their own} naughtiness.
verses.nlt_text: The godliness of good people rescues them; the ambition of treacherous people traps them.

verses.kjv_text: When a wicked man dieth, {his} expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust {men} perisheth.
verses.nlt_text: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them, for they rely on their own feeble strength.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.nlt_text: The godly are rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.

verses.kjv_text: An hypocrite with {his} mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.nlt_text: With their words, the godless destroy their friends, but knowledge will rescue the righteous.

verses.kjv_text: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, {there is} shouting.
