verses.nlt_text: The whole city celebrates when the godly succeed; they shout for joy when the wicked die.

verses.kjv_text: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.nlt_text: Upright citizens are good for a city and make it prosper, but the talk of the wicked tears it apart.

verses.kjv_text: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace. {void...: Heb. destitute of heart}
verses.nlt_text: It is foolish to belittle one's neighbor; a sensible person keeps quiet.

verses.kjv_text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter. {A talebearer: Heb. He that walketh, being a talebearer}
verses.nlt_text: A gossip goes around telling secrets, but those who are trustworthy can keep a confidence.

verses.kjv_text: Where no counsel {is}, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors {there is} safety.
verses.nlt_text: Without wise leadership, a nation falls; there is safety in having many advisers.

verses.kjv_text: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart {for it}: and he that hateth suretiship is sure. {smart: Heb. be sore broken} {suretiship: Heb. those that strike hands}
verses.nlt_text: There's danger in putting up security for a stranger's debt; it's safer not to guarantee another person's debt.

verses.kjv_text: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong {men} retain riches.
verses.nlt_text: A gracious woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.

verses.kjv_text: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but {he that is} cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.nlt_text: Your kindness will reward you, but your cruelty will destroy you.

verses.kjv_text: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness {shall be} a sure reward.
verses.nlt_text: Evil people get rich for the moment, but the reward of the godly will last.

verses.kjv_text: As righteousness {tendeth} to life: so he that pursueth evil {pursueth it} to his own death.
verses.nlt_text: Godly people find life; evil people find death.

verses.kjv_text: They that are of a froward heart {are} abomination to the LORD: but {such as are} upright in {their} way {are} his delight.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests people with crooked hearts, but he delights in those with integrity.

verses.kjv_text: {Though} hand {join} in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.nlt_text: Evil people will surely be punished, but the children of the godly will go free.

verses.kjv_text: {As} a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, {so is} a fair woman which is without discretion. {is without: Heb. departeth from}
verses.nlt_text: A beautiful woman who lacks discretion is like a gold ring in a pig's snout.

verses.kjv_text: The desire of the righteous {is} only good: {but} the expectation of the wicked {is} wrath.
verses.nlt_text: The godly can look forward to a reward, while the wicked can expect only judgment.

verses.kjv_text: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and {there is} that withholdeth more than is meet, but {it tendeth} to poverty.
verses.nlt_text: Give freely and become more wealthy; be stingy and lose everything.

verses.kjv_text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself. {liberal...: Heb. soul of blessing}
verses.nlt_text: The generous will prosper; those who refresh others will themselves be refreshed.

verses.kjv_text: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing {shall be} upon the head of him that selleth {it}.
verses.nlt_text: People curse those who hoard their grain, but they bless the one who sells in time of need.

verses.kjv_text: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.nlt_text: If you search for good, you will find favor; but if you search for evil, it will find you!

verses.kjv_text: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.nlt_text: Trust in your money and down you go! But the godly flourish like leaves in spring.

verses.kjv_text: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool {shall be} servant to the wise of heart.
verses.nlt_text: Those who bring trouble on their families inherit the wind. The fool will be a servant to the wise.

verses.kjv_text: The fruit of the righteous {is} a tree of life; and he that winneth souls {is} wise. {winneth: Heb. taketh}
verses.nlt_text: The seeds of good deeds become a tree of life; a wise person wins friends.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.nlt_text: If the righteous are rewarded here on earth, what will happen to wicked sinners?

verses.kjv_text: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof {is} brutish.
verses.nlt_text: To learn, you must love discipline; it is stupid to hate correction.

verses.kjv_text: A good {man} obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD approves of those who are good, but he condemns those who plan wickedness.

verses.kjv_text: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.nlt_text: Wickedness never brings stability, but the godly have deep roots.

verses.kjv_text: A virtuous woman {is} a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed {is} as rottenness in his bones.
verses.nlt_text: A worthy wife is a crown for her husband, but a disgraceful woman is like cancer in his bones.

verses.kjv_text: The thoughts of the righteous {are} right: {but} the counsels of the wicked {are} deceit.
verses.nlt_text: The plans of the godly are just; the advice of the wicked is treacherous.

verses.kjv_text: The words of the wicked {are} to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.nlt_text: The words of the wicked are like a murderous ambush, but the words of the godly save lives.

verses.kjv_text: The wicked are overthrown, and {are} not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked die and disappear, but the family of the godly stands firm.

verses.kjv_text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised. {of a...: Heb. perverse of heart}
verses.nlt_text: A sensible person wins admiration, but a warped mind is despised.

verses.kjv_text: {He that is} despised, and hath a servant, {is} better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.nlt_text: Better to be an ordinary person with a servant than to be self-important but have no food.

verses.kjv_text: A righteous {man} regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked {are} cruel. {tender...: or, bowels}
verses.nlt_text: The godly care for their animals, but the wicked are always cruel.

verses.kjv_text: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain {persons is} void of understanding.
verses.nlt_text: A hard worker has plenty of food, but a person who chases fantasies has no sense.

verses.kjv_text: The wicked desireth the net of evil {men}: but the root of the righteous yieldeth {fruit}. {the net: or, the fortress}
verses.nlt_text: Thieves are jealous of each other's loot, but the godly are well rooted and bear their own fruit.

verses.kjv_text: The wicked is snared by the transgression of {his} lips: but the just shall come out of trouble. {The wicked...: Heb. The snare of the wicked is in the transgression of lips}
verses.nlt_text: The wicked are trapped by their own words, but the godly escape such trouble.

verses.kjv_text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of {his} mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Wise words bring many benefits, and hard work brings rewards.

verses.kjv_text: The way of a fool {is} right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel {is} wise.
verses.nlt_text: Fools think their own way is right, but the wise listen to others.

verses.kjv_text: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent {man} covereth shame. {presently: Heb. in that day}
verses.nlt_text: A fool is quick-tempered, but a wise person stays calm when insulted.

verses.kjv_text: {He that} speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.nlt_text: An honest witness tells the truth; a false witness tells lies.

verses.kjv_text: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise {is} health.
verses.nlt_text: Some people make cutting remarks, but the words of the wise bring healing.

verses.kjv_text: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue {is} but for a moment.
verses.nlt_text: Truthful words stand the test of time, but lies are soon exposed.

verses.kjv_text: Deceit {is} in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace {is} joy.
verses.nlt_text: Deceit fills hearts that are plotting evil; joy fills hearts that are planning peace!

verses.kjv_text: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.nlt_text: No harm comes to the godly, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.

verses.kjv_text: Lying lips {are} abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly {are} his delight.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests lying lips, but he delights in those who tell the truth.

verses.kjv_text: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.nlt_text: The wise don't make a show of their knowledge, but fools broadcast their foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute. {slothful: or, deceitful}
verses.nlt_text: Work hard and become a leader; be lazy and become a slave.

verses.kjv_text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.nlt_text: Worry weighs a person down; an encouraging word cheers a person up.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous {is} more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them. {excellent: or, abundant}
verses.nlt_text: The godly give good advice to their friends; the wicked lead them astray.

verses.kjv_text: The slothful {man} roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man {is} precious.
verses.nlt_text: Lazy people don't even cook the game they catch, but the diligent make use of everything they find.

verses.kjv_text: In the way of righteousness {is} life; and {in} the pathway {thereof there is} no death.
verses.nlt_text: The way of the godly leads to life; that path does not lead to death.

verses.kjv_text: A wise son {heareth} his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.nlt_text: A wise child accepts a parent's discipline; a mocker refuses to listen to correction.

verses.kjv_text: A man shall eat good by the fruit of {his} mouth: but the soul of the transgressors {shall eat} violence.
verses.nlt_text: Wise words will win you a good meal, but treacherous people have an appetite for violence.

verses.kjv_text: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: {but} he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.nlt_text: Those who control their tongue will have a long life; opening your mouth can ruin everything.

verses.kjv_text: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and {hath} nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.nlt_text: Lazy people want much but get little, but those who work hard will prosper.

verses.kjv_text: A righteous {man} hateth lying: but a wicked {man} is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.nlt_text: The godly hate lies; the wicked cause shame and disgrace.

verses.kjv_text: Righteousness keepeth {him that is} upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner. {the sinner: Heb. sin}
verses.nlt_text: Godliness guards the path of the blameless, but the evil are misled by sin.

verses.kjv_text: There is that maketh himself rich, yet {hath} nothing: {there is} that maketh himself poor, yet {hath} great riches.
verses.nlt_text: Some who are poor pretend to be rich; others who are rich pretend to be poor.

verses.kjv_text: The ransom of a man's life {are} his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.nlt_text: The rich can pay a ransom for their lives, but the poor won't even get threatened.

verses.kjv_text: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out. {lamp: or, candle}
verses.nlt_text: The life of the godly is full of light and joy, but the light of the wicked will be snuffed out.

verses.kjv_text: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised {is} wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: Pride leads to conflict; those who take advice are wise.

verses.kjv_text: Wealth {gotten} by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase. {by labour: Heb. with the hand}
verses.nlt_text: Wealth from get-rich-quick schemes quickly disappears; wealth from hard work grows over time.

verses.kjv_text: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but {when} the desire cometh, {it is} a tree of life.
verses.nlt_text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a dream fulfilled is a tree of life.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded. {shall be rewarded: or, shall be in peace}
verses.nlt_text: People who despise advice are asking for trouble; those who respect a command will succeed.

verses.kjv_text: The law of the wise {is} a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.nlt_text: The instruction of the wise is like a life-giving fountain; those who accept it avoid the snares of death.

verses.kjv_text: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors {is} hard.
verses.nlt_text: A person with good sense is respected; a treacherous person is headed for destruction.

verses.kjv_text: Every prudent {man} dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open {his} folly. {layeth...: Heb. spreadeth}
verses.nlt_text: Wise people think before they act; fools don't-- and even brag about their foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador {is} health. {a faithful...: Heb. an ambassador of faithfulness}
verses.nlt_text: An unreliable messenger stumbles into trouble, but a reliable messenger brings healing.

verses.kjv_text: Poverty and shame {shall be to} him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.nlt_text: If you ignore criticism, you will end in poverty and disgrace; if you accept correction, you will be honored.

verses.kjv_text: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but {it is} abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.nlt_text: It is pleasant to see dreams come true, but fools refuse to turn from evil to attain them.

verses.kjv_text: He that walketh with wise {men} shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed. {destroyed: Heb. broken}
verses.nlt_text: Walk with the wise and become wise; associate with fools and get in trouble.

verses.kjv_text: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.nlt_text: Trouble chases sinners, while blessings reward the righteous.

verses.kjv_text: A good {man} leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner {is} laid up for the just.
verses.nlt_text: Good people leave an inheritance to their grandchildren, but the sinner's wealth passes to the godly.

verses.kjv_text: Much food {is in} the tillage of the poor: but there is {that is} destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.nlt_text: A poor person's farm may produce much food, but injustice sweeps it all away.

verses.kjv_text: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.nlt_text: Those who spare the rod of discipline hate their children. Those who love their children care enough to discipline them.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.nlt_text: The godly eat to their hearts' content, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

verses.kjv_text: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.nlt_text: A wise woman builds her home, but a foolish woman tears it down with her own hands.

verses.kjv_text: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but {he that is} perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.nlt_text: Those who follow the right path fear the LORD; those who take the wrong path despise him.

verses.kjv_text: In the mouth of the foolish {is} a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.nlt_text: A fool's proud talk becomes a rod that beats him, but the words of the wise keep them safe.

verses.kjv_text: Where no oxen {are}, the crib {is} clean: but much increase {is} by the strength of the ox.
verses.nlt_text: Without oxen a stable stays clean, but you need a strong ox for a large harvest.

verses.kjv_text: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.nlt_text: An honest witness does not lie; a false witness breathes lies.

verses.kjv_text: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and {findeth it} not: but knowledge {is} easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.nlt_text: A mocker seeks wisdom and never finds it, but knowledge comes easily to those with understanding.

verses.kjv_text: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not {in him} the lips of knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: Stay away from fools, for you won't find knowledge on their lips.

verses.kjv_text: The wisdom of the prudent {is} to understand his way: but the folly of fools {is} deceit.
verses.nlt_text: The prudent understand where they are going, but fools deceive themselves.

verses.kjv_text: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous {there is} favour.
verses.nlt_text: Fools make fun of guilt, but the godly acknowledge it and seek reconciliation.

verses.kjv_text: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy. {his own...: Heb. the bitterness of his soul}
verses.nlt_text: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can fully share its joy.

verses.kjv_text: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.nlt_text: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the godly will flourish.

verses.kjv_text: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof {are} the ways of death.
verses.nlt_text: There is a path before each person that seems right, but it ends in death.

verses.kjv_text: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth {is} heaviness.
verses.nlt_text: Laughter can conceal a heavy heart, but when the laughter ends, the grief remains.

verses.kjv_text: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man {shall be satisfied} from himself.
verses.nlt_text: Backsliders get what they deserve; good people receive their reward.

verses.kjv_text: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent {man} looketh well to his going.
verses.nlt_text: Only simpletons believe everything they're told! The prudent carefully consider their steps.

verses.kjv_text: A wise {man} feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.nlt_text: The wise are cautious and avoid danger; fools plunge ahead with reckless confidence.

verses.kjv_text: {He that is} soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.nlt_text: Short-tempered people do foolish things, and schemers are hated.

verses.kjv_text: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: Simpletons are clothed with foolishness, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.nlt_text: Evil people will bow before good people; the wicked will bow at the gates of the godly.

verses.kjv_text: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich {hath} many friends. {the rich...: Heb. many are the lovers of the rich}
verses.nlt_text: The poor are despised even by their neighbors, while the rich have many "friends."

verses.kjv_text: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy {is} he.
verses.nlt_text: It is a sin to belittle one's neighbor; blessed are those who help the poor.

verses.kjv_text: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth {shall be} to them that devise good.
verses.nlt_text: If you plan to do evil, you will be lost; if you plan to do good, you will receive unfailing love and faithfulness.

verses.kjv_text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips {tendeth} only to penury.
verses.nlt_text: Work brings profit, but mere talk leads to poverty!

verses.kjv_text: The crown of the wise {is} their riches: {but} the foolishness of fools {is} folly.
verses.nlt_text: Wealth is a crown for the wise; the effort of fools yields only foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful {witness} speaketh lies.
verses.nlt_text: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is a traitor.

verses.kjv_text: In the fear of the LORD {is} strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.nlt_text: Those who fear the LORD are secure; he will be a refuge for their children.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD {is} a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.nlt_text: Fear of the LORD is a life-giving fountain; it offers escape from the snares of death.

verses.kjv_text: In the multitude of people {is} the king's honour: but in the want of people {is} the destruction of the prince.
verses.nlt_text: A growing population is a king's glory; a prince without subjects has nothing.

verses.kjv_text: {He that is} slow to wrath {is} of great understanding: but {he that is} hasty of spirit exalteth folly. {hasty...: Heb. short of spirit}
verses.nlt_text: People with understanding control their anger; a hot temper shows great foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: A sound heart {is} the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.nlt_text: A peaceful heart leads to a healthy body; jealousy is like cancer in the bones.

verses.kjv_text: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.nlt_text: Those who oppress the poor insult their Maker, but helping the poor honors him.

verses.kjv_text: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked are crushed by disaster, but the godly have a refuge when they die.

verses.kjv_text: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but {that which is} in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.nlt_text: Wisdom is enshrined in an understanding heart; wisdom is not found among fools.

verses.kjv_text: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin {is} a reproach to any people. {to any...: Heb. to nations}
verses.nlt_text: Godliness makes a nation great, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

verses.kjv_text: The king's favour {is} toward a wise servant: but his wrath is {against} him that causeth shame.
verses.nlt_text: A king rejoices in wise servants but is angry with those who disgrace him.

verses.kjv_text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.nlt_text: A gentle answer deflects anger, but harsh words make tempers flare.

verses.kjv_text: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness. {poureth: Heb. belcheth, or, bubbleth}
verses.nlt_text: The tongue of the wise makes knowledge appealing, but the mouth of a fool belches out foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: The eyes of the LORD {are} in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD is watching everywhere, keeping his eye on both the evil and the good.

verses.kjv_text: A wholesome tongue {is} a tree of life: but perverseness therein {is} a breach in the spirit. {A wholesome...: Heb. The healing of the tongue}
verses.nlt_text: Gentle words are a tree of life; a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.

verses.kjv_text: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.nlt_text: Only a fool despises a parent's discipline; whoever learns from correction is wise.

verses.kjv_text: In the house of the righteous {is} much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.nlt_text: There is treasure in the house of the godly, but the earnings of the wicked bring trouble.

verses.kjv_text: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish {doeth} not so.
verses.nlt_text: The lips of the wise give good advice; the heart of a fool has none to give.

verses.kjv_text: The sacrifice of the wicked {is} an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright {is} his delight.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but he delights in the prayers of the upright.

verses.kjv_text: The way of the wicked {is} an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but he loves those who pursue godliness.

verses.kjv_text: Correction {is} grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: {and} he that hateth reproof shall die. {Correction: or, Instruction}
verses.nlt_text: Whoever abandons the right path will be severely disciplined; whoever hates correction will die.

verses.kjv_text: Hell and destruction {are} before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.nlt_text: Even Death and Destruction hold no secrets from the LORD. How much more does he know the human heart!

verses.kjv_text: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.nlt_text: Mockers hate to be corrected, so they stay away from the wise.

verses.kjv_text: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.nlt_text: A glad heart makes a happy face; a broken heart crushes the spirit.

verses.kjv_text: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.nlt_text: A wise person is hungry for knowledge, while the fool feeds on trash.

verses.kjv_text: All the days of the afflicted {are} evil: but he that is of a merry heart {hath} a continual feast.
verses.nlt_text: For the despondent, every day brings trouble; for the happy heart, life is a continual feast.

verses.kjv_text: Better {is} little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.nlt_text: Better to have little, with fear for the LORD, than to have great treasure and inner turmoil.

verses.kjv_text: Better {is} a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.nlt_text: A bowl of vegetables with someone you love is better than steak with someone you hate.

verses.kjv_text: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but {he that is} slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.nlt_text: A hot-tempered person starts fights; a cool-tempered person stops them.

verses.kjv_text: The way of the slothful {man is} as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous {is} made plain. {is made...: Heb. is raised up as a causey}
verses.nlt_text: A lazy person's way is blocked with briers, but the path of the upright is an open highway.

verses.kjv_text: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.nlt_text: Sensible children bring joy to their father; foolish children despise their mother.

verses.kjv_text: Folly {is} joy to {him that is} destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly. {destitute...: Heb. void of heart}
verses.nlt_text: Foolishness brings joy to those with no sense; a sensible person stays on the right path.

verses.kjv_text: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.nlt_text: Plans go wrong for lack of advice; many advisers bring success.

verses.kjv_text: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word {spoken} in due season, how good {is it}! {due...: Heb. his season}
verses.nlt_text: Everyone enjoys a fitting reply; it is wonderful to say the right thing at the right time!

verses.kjv_text: The way of life {is} above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.nlt_text: The path of life leads upward for the wise; they leave the grave behind.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but he protects the property of widows.

verses.kjv_text: The thoughts of the wicked {are} an abomination to the LORD: but {the words} of the pure {are} pleasant words. {pleasant...: Heb. words of pleasantness}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests evil plans, but he delights in pure words.

verses.kjv_text: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.nlt_text: Greed brings grief to the whole family, but those who hate bribes will live.

verses.kjv_text: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.nlt_text: The heart of the godly thinks carefully before speaking; the mouth of the wicked overflows with evil words.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD {is} far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayers of the righteous.

verses.kjv_text: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: {and} a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.nlt_text: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart; good news makes for good health.

verses.kjv_text: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.nlt_text: If you listen to constructive criticism, you will be at home among the wise.

verses.kjv_text: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding. {instruction: or, correction} {heareth: or, obeyeth} {getteth...: Heb. possesseth an heart}
verses.nlt_text: If you reject discipline, you only harm yourself; but if you listen to correction, you grow in understanding.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD {is} the instruction of wisdom; and before honour {is} humility.
verses.nlt_text: Fear of the LORD teaches wisdom; humility precedes honor.

verses.kjv_text: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, {is} from the LORD. {preparations: or, disposings}
verses.nlt_text: We can make our own plans, but the LORD gives the right answer.

verses.kjv_text: All the ways of a man {are} clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.nlt_text: People may be pure in their own eyes, but the LORD examines their motives.

verses.kjv_text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established. {Commit: Heb. Roll}
verses.nlt_text: Commit your actions to the LORD, and your plans will succeed.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD hath made all {things} for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has made everything for his own purposes, even the wicked for a day of disaster.

verses.kjv_text: Every one {that is} proud in heart {is} an abomination to the LORD: {though} hand {join} in hand, he shall not be unpunished. {unpunished: Heb. held innocent}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests the proud; they will surely be punished.

verses.kjv_text: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD {men} depart from evil.
verses.nlt_text: Unfailing love and faithfulness make atonement for sin. By fearing the LORD, people avoid evil.

verses.kjv_text: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.nlt_text: When people's lives please the LORD, even their enemies are at peace with them.

verses.kjv_text: Better {is} a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.nlt_text: Better to have little, with godliness, than to be rich and dishonest.

verses.kjv_text: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.nlt_text: We can make our plans, but the LORD determines our steps.

verses.kjv_text: A divine sentence {is} in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment. {A divine...: Heb. Divination}
verses.nlt_text: The king speaks with divine wisdom; he must never judge unfairly.

verses.kjv_text: A just weight and balance {are} the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag {are} his work. {the weights: Heb. the stones}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD demands accurate scales and balances; he sets the standards for fairness.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: A king detests wrongdoing, for his rule is built on justice.

verses.kjv_text: Righteous lips {are} the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.nlt_text: The king is pleased with words from righteous lips; he loves those who speak honestly.

verses.kjv_text: The wrath of a king {is as} messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.nlt_text: The anger of the king is a deadly threat; the wise will try to appease it.

verses.kjv_text: In the light of the king's countenance {is} life; and his favour {is} as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.nlt_text: When the king smiles, there is life; his favor refreshes like a spring rain.

verses.kjv_text: How much better {is it} to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.nlt_text: How much better to get wisdom than gold, and good judgment than silver!

verses.kjv_text: The highway of the upright {is} to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.nlt_text: The path of the virtuous leads away from evil; whoever follows that path is safe.

verses.kjv_text: Pride {goeth} before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.nlt_text: Pride goes before destruction, and haughtiness before a fall.

verses.kjv_text: Better {it is to be} of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.nlt_text: Better to live humbly with the poor than to share plunder with the proud.

verses.kjv_text: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy {is} he. {handleth...: or, understandeth a matter}
verses.nlt_text: Those who listen to instruction will prosper; those who trust the LORD will be joyful.

verses.kjv_text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.nlt_text: The wise are known for their understanding, and pleasant words are persuasive.

verses.kjv_text: Understanding {is} a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools {is} folly.
verses.nlt_text: Discretion is a life-giving fountain to those who possess it, but discipline is wasted on fools.

verses.kjv_text: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips. {teacheth: Heb. maketh wise}
verses.nlt_text: From a wise mind comes wise speech; the words of the wise are persuasive.

verses.kjv_text: Pleasant words {are as} an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.nlt_text: Kind words are like honey-- sweet to the soul and healthy for the body.

verses.kjv_text: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof {are} the ways of death.
verses.nlt_text: There is a path before each person that seems right, but it ends in death.

verses.kjv_text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him. {He...: Heb. The soul of him that} {craveth...: Heb. boweth unto him}
verses.nlt_text: It is good for workers to have an appetite; an empty stomach drives them on.

verses.kjv_text: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips {there is} as a burning fire. {An...: Heb. A man of Belial}
verses.nlt_text: Scoundrels create trouble; their words are a destructive blaze.

verses.kjv_text: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends. {soweth: Heb. sendeth forth}
verses.nlt_text: A troublemaker plants seeds of strife; gossip separates the best of friends.

verses.kjv_text: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way {that is} not good.
verses.nlt_text: Violent people mislead their companions, leading them down a harmful path.

verses.kjv_text: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.nlt_text: With narrowed eyes, people plot evil; with a smirk, they plan their mischief.

verses.kjv_text: The hoary head {is} a crown of glory, {if} it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is gained by living a godly life.

verses.kjv_text: {He that is} slow to anger {is} better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.nlt_text: Better to be patient than powerful; better to have self-control than to conquer a city.

verses.kjv_text: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof {is} of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: We may throw the dice, but the LORD determines how they fall.

verses.kjv_text: Better {is} a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices {with} strife. {sacrifices: or, good cheer}
verses.nlt_text: Better a dry crust eaten in peace than a house filled with feasting-- and conflict.

verses.kjv_text: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.nlt_text: A wise servant will rule over the master's disgraceful son and will share the inheritance of the master's children.

verses.kjv_text: The fining pot {is} for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.nlt_text: Fire tests the purity of silver and gold, but the LORD tests the heart.

verses.kjv_text: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; {and} a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.nlt_text: Wrongdoers eagerly listen to gossip; liars pay close attention to slander.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: {and} he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished. {unpunished: Heb. held innocent}
verses.nlt_text: Those who mock the poor insult their Maker; those who rejoice at the misfortune of others will be punished.

verses.kjv_text: Children's children {are} the crown of old men; and the glory of children {are} their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Grandchildren are the crowning glory of the aged; parents are the pride of their children.

verses.kjv_text: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince. {Excellent...: Heb. A lip of excellency} {lying...: Heb. a lip of lying}
verses.nlt_text: Eloquent words are not fitting for a fool; even less are lies fitting for a ruler.

verses.kjv_text: A gift {is as} a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth. {a precious...: Heb. a stone of grace}
verses.nlt_text: A bribe is like a lucky charm; whoever gives one will prosper!

verses.kjv_text: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth {very} friends. {seeketh: or, procureth}
verses.nlt_text: Love prospers when a fault is forgiven, but dwelling on it separates close friends.

verses.kjv_text: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool. {entereth...: or, aweth more a wise man, than to strike a fool an hundred times}
verses.nlt_text: A single rebuke does more for a person of understanding than a hundred lashes on the back of a fool.

verses.kjv_text: An evil {man} seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.nlt_text: Evil people are eager for rebellion, but they will be severely punished.

verses.kjv_text: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.nlt_text: It is safer to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than to confront a fool caught in foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.nlt_text: If you repay good with evil, evil will never leave your house.

verses.kjv_text: The beginning of strife {is as} when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.nlt_text: Starting a quarrel is like opening a floodgate, so stop before a dispute breaks out.

verses.kjv_text: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both {are} abomination to the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent-- both are detestable to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore {is there} a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing {he hath} no heart {to it}?
verses.nlt_text: It is senseless to pay tuition to educate a fool, since he has no heart for learning.

verses.kjv_text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.nlt_text: A friend is always loyal, and a brother is born to help in time of need.

verses.kjv_text: A man void of understanding striketh hands, {and} becometh surety in the presence of his friend. {understanding: Heb. heart}
verses.nlt_text: It's poor judgment to guarantee another person's debt or put up security for a friend.

verses.kjv_text: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: {and} he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who loves to quarrel loves sin; anyone who trusts in high walls invites disaster.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief. {He that hath a froward...: Heb. The froward of heart}
verses.nlt_text: The crooked heart will not prosper; the lying tongue tumbles into trouble.

verses.kjv_text: He that begetteth a fool {doeth it} to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.nlt_text: It is painful to be the parent of a fool; there is no joy for the father of a rebel.

verses.kjv_text: A merry heart doeth good {like} a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones. {like: or, to}
verses.nlt_text: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit saps a person's strength.

verses.kjv_text: A wicked {man} taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked take secret bribes to pervert the course of justice.

verses.kjv_text: Wisdom {is} before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool {are} in the ends of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Sensible people keep their eyes glued on wisdom, but a fool's eyes wander to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv_text: A foolish son {is} a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.nlt_text: Foolish children bring grief to their father and bitterness to the one who gave them birth.

verses.kjv_text: Also to punish the just {is} not good, {nor} to strike princes for equity.
verses.nlt_text: It is wrong to punish the godly for being good or to flog leaders for being honest.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: {and} a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit. {an...: or, a cool}
verses.nlt_text: A truly wise person uses few words; a person with understanding is even-tempered.

verses.kjv_text: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: {and} he that shutteth his lips {is esteemed} a man of understanding.
verses.nlt_text: Even fools are thought wise when they keep silent; with their mouths shut, they seem intelligent.

verses.kjv_text: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh {and} intermeddleth with all wisdom. {Through...: or, He that separateth himself seeketh according to his desire, and intermeddleth in every business}
verses.nlt_text: Unfriendly people care only about themselves; they lash out at common sense.

verses.kjv_text: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.nlt_text: Fools have no interest in understanding; they only want to air their own opinions.

verses.kjv_text: When the wicked cometh, {then} cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.nlt_text: Doing wrong leads to disgrace, and scandalous behavior brings contempt.

verses.kjv_text: The words of a man's mouth {are as} deep waters, {and} the wellspring of wisdom {as} a flowing brook.
verses.nlt_text: Wise words are like deep waters; wisdom flows from the wise like a bubbling brook.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.nlt_text: It is not right to acquit the guilty or deny justice to the innocent.

verses.kjv_text: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.nlt_text: Fools' words get them into constant quarrels; they are asking for a beating.

verses.kjv_text: A fool's mouth {is} his destruction, and his lips {are} the snare of his soul.
verses.nlt_text: The mouths of fools are their ruin; they trap themselves with their lips.

verses.kjv_text: The words of a talebearer {are} as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly. {talebearer: or, whisperer} {as wounds: or, like as when men are wounded} {most...: Heb. chambers}
verses.nlt_text: Rumors are dainty morsels that sink deep into one's heart.

verses.kjv_text: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.nlt_text: A lazy person is as bad as someone who destroys things.

verses.kjv_text: The name of the LORD {is} a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe. {safe: Heb. set aloft}
verses.nlt_text: The name of the LORD is a strong fortress; the godly run to him and are safe.

verses.kjv_text: The rich man's wealth {is} his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.nlt_text: The rich think of their wealth as a strong defense; they imagine it to be a high wall of safety.

verses.kjv_text: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour {is} humility.
verses.nlt_text: Haughtiness goes before destruction; humility precedes honor.

verses.kjv_text: He that answereth a matter before he heareth {it}, it {is} folly and shame unto him. {answereth...: Heb. returneth a word}
verses.nlt_text: Spouting off before listening to the facts is both shameful and foolish.

verses.kjv_text: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.nlt_text: The human spirit can endure a sick body, but who can bear a crushed spirit?

verses.kjv_text: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: Intelligent people are always ready to learn. Their ears are open for knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.nlt_text: Giving a gift can open doors; it gives access to important people!

verses.kjv_text: {He that is} first in his own cause {seemeth} just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.nlt_text: The first to speak in court sounds right-- until the cross-examination begins.

verses.kjv_text: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.nlt_text: Casting lots can end arguments; it settles disputes between powerful opponents.

verses.kjv_text: A brother offended {is harder to be won} than a strong city: and {their} contentions {are} like the bars of a castle.
verses.nlt_text: An offended friend is harder to win back than a fortified city. Arguments separate friends like a gate locked with bars.

verses.kjv_text: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; {and} with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.nlt_text: Wise words satisfy like a good meal; the right words bring satisfaction.

verses.kjv_text: Death and life {are} in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.nlt_text: The tongue can bring death or life; those who love to talk will reap the consequences.

verses.kjv_text: {Whoso} findeth a wife findeth a good {thing}, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The man who finds a wife finds a treasure, and he receives favor from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.nlt_text: The poor plead for mercy; the rich answer with insults.

verses.kjv_text: A man {that hath} friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend {that} sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.nlt_text: There are "friends" who destroy each other, but a real friend sticks closer than a brother.

verses.kjv_text: Better {is} the poor that walketh in his integrity, than {he that is} perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.nlt_text: Better to be poor and honest than to be dishonest and a fool.

verses.kjv_text: Also, {that} the soul {be} without knowledge, {it is} not good; and he that hasteth with {his} feet sinneth.
verses.nlt_text: Enthusiasm without knowledge is no good; haste makes mistakes.

verses.kjv_text: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: People ruin their lives by their own foolishness and then are angry at the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.nlt_text: Wealth makes many "friends"; poverty drives them all away.

verses.kjv_text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and {he that} speaketh lies shall not escape. {unpunished: Heb. held innocent}
verses.nlt_text: A false witness will not go unpunished, nor will a liar escape.

verses.kjv_text: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man {is} a friend to him that giveth gifts. {him...: Heb. a man of gifts}
verses.nlt_text: Many seek favors from a ruler; everyone is the friend of a person who gives gifts!

verses.kjv_text: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth {them with} words, {yet} they {are} wanting {to him}.
verses.nlt_text: The relatives of the poor despise them; how much more will their friends avoid them! Though the poor plead with them, their friends are gone.

verses.kjv_text: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good. {wisdom: Heb. an heart}
verses.nlt_text: To acquire wisdom is to love oneself; people who cherish understanding will prosper.

verses.kjv_text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and {he that} speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.nlt_text: A false witness will not go unpunished, and a liar will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.nlt_text: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule over princes!

verses.kjv_text: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and {it is} his glory to pass over a transgression. {discretion: or, prudence}
verses.nlt_text: Sensible people control their temper; they earn respect by overlooking wrongs.

verses.kjv_text: The king's wrath {is} as the roaring of a lion; but his favour {is} as dew upon the grass.
verses.nlt_text: The king's anger is like a lion's roar, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

verses.kjv_text: A foolish son {is} the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife {are} a continual dropping.
verses.nlt_text: A foolish child is a calamity to a father; a quarrelsome wife is as annoying as constant dripping.

verses.kjv_text: House and riches {are} the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife {is} from the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Fathers can give their sons an inheritance of houses and wealth, but only the LORD can give an understanding wife.

verses.kjv_text: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.nlt_text: Lazy people sleep soundly, but idleness leaves them hungry.

verses.kjv_text: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; {but} he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.nlt_text: Keep the commandments and keep your life; despising them leads to death.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again. {that which...: or, his deed}
verses.nlt_text: If you help the poor, you are lending to the LORD-- and he will repay you!

verses.kjv_text: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying. {for...: or, to his destruction: or, to cause him to die}
verses.nlt_text: Discipline your children while there is hope. Otherwise you will ruin their lives.

verses.kjv_text: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver {him}, yet thou must do it again. {do: Heb. add}
verses.nlt_text: Hot-tempered people must pay the penalty. If you rescue them once, you will have to do it again.

verses.kjv_text: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.nlt_text: Get all the advice and instruction you can, so you will be wise the rest of your life.

verses.kjv_text: {There are} many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.nlt_text: You can make many plans, but the LORD's purpose will prevail.

verses.kjv_text: The desire of a man {is} his kindness: and a poor man {is} better than a liar.
verses.nlt_text: Loyalty makes a person attractive. It is better to be poor than dishonest.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of the LORD {tendeth} to life: and {he that hath it} shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.nlt_text: Fear of the LORD leads to life, bringing security and protection from harm.

verses.kjv_text: A slothful {man} hideth his hand in {his} bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.nlt_text: Lazy people take food in their hand but don't even lift it to their mouth.

verses.kjv_text: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, {and} he will understand knowledge. {will beware: Heb. will be cunning}
verses.nlt_text: If you punish a mocker, the simpleminded will learn a lesson; if you correct the wise, they will be all the wiser.

verses.kjv_text: He that wasteth {his} father, {and} chaseth away {his} mother, {is} a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.nlt_text: Children who mistreat their father or chase away their mother are an embarrassment and a public disgrace.

verses.kjv_text: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction {that causeth} to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: If you stop listening to instruction, my child, you will turn your back on knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity. {An...: Heb. A witness of Belial}
verses.nlt_text: A corrupt witness makes a mockery of justice; the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.

verses.kjv_text: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.nlt_text: Punishment is made for mockers, and the backs of fools are made to be beaten.

verses.kjv_text: Wine {is} a mocker, strong drink {is} raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.nlt_text: Wine produces mockers; alcohol leads to brawls. Those led astray by drink cannot be wise.

verses.kjv_text: The fear of a king {is} as the roaring of a lion: {whoso} provoketh him to anger sinneth {against} his own soul.
verses.nlt_text: The king's fury is like a lion's roar; to rouse his anger is to risk your life.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.nlt_text: Avoiding a fight is a mark of honor; only fools insist on quarreling.

verses.kjv_text: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; {therefore} shall he beg in harvest, and {have} nothing. {cold: or, winter}
verses.nlt_text: Those too lazy to plow in the right season will have no food at the harvest.

verses.kjv_text: Counsel in the heart of man {is like} deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.nlt_text: Though good advice lies deep within the heart, a person with understanding will draw it out.

verses.kjv_text: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find? {goodness: or, bounty}
verses.nlt_text: Many will say they are loyal friends, but who can find one who is truly reliable?

verses.kjv_text: The just {man} walketh in his integrity: his children {are} blessed after him.
verses.nlt_text: The godly walk with integrity; blessed are their children who follow them.

verses.kjv_text: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.nlt_text: When a king sits in judgment, he weighs all the evidence, distinguishing the bad from the good.

verses.kjv_text: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.nlt_text: Who can say, "I have cleansed my heart; I am pure and free from sin"?

verses.kjv_text: Divers weights, {and} divers measures, both of them {are} alike abomination to the LORD. {Divers weights: Heb. A stone and a stone} {divers measures: Heb. an ephah and an ephah}
verses.nlt_text: False weights and unequal measures-- the LORD detests double standards of every kind.

verses.kjv_text: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work {be} pure, and whether {it be} right.
verses.nlt_text: Even children are known by the way they act, whether their conduct is pure, and whether it is right.

verses.kjv_text: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.nlt_text: Ears to hear and eyes to see-- both are gifts from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, {and} thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.nlt_text: If you love sleep, you will end in poverty. Keep your eyes open, and there will be plenty to eat!

verses.kjv_text: {It is} naught, {it is} naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.nlt_text: The buyer haggles over the price, saying, "It's worthless," then brags about getting a bargain!

verses.kjv_text: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge {are} a precious jewel.
verses.nlt_text: Wise words are more valuable than much gold and many rubies.

verses.kjv_text: Take his garment that is surety {for} a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.nlt_text: Get security from someone who guarantees a stranger's debt. Get a deposit if he does it for foreigners.

verses.kjv_text: Bread of deceit {is} sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel. {deceit: Heb. lying, or, falsehood}
verses.nlt_text: Stolen bread tastes sweet, but it turns to gravel in the mouth.

verses.kjv_text: {Every} purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.nlt_text: Plans succeed through good counsel; don't go to war without wise advice.

verses.kjv_text: He that goeth about {as} a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips. {flattereth: or, enticeth}
verses.nlt_text: A gossip goes around telling secrets, so don't hang around with chatterers.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness. {lamp: or, candle}
verses.nlt_text: If you insult your father or mother, your light will be snuffed out in total darkness.

verses.kjv_text: An inheritance {may be} gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.nlt_text: An inheritance obtained too early in life is not a blessing in the end.

verses.kjv_text: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; {but} wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
verses.nlt_text: Don't say, "I will get even for this wrong." Wait for the LORD to handle the matter.

verses.kjv_text: Divers weights {are} an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance {is} not good. {a false...: Heb. balance of deceit}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD detests double standards; he is not pleased by dishonest scales.

verses.kjv_text: Man's goings {are} of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.nlt_text: The LORD directs our steps, so why try to understand everything along the way?

verses.kjv_text: {It is} a snare to the man {who} devoureth {that which is} holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.nlt_text: Don't trap yourself by making a rash promise to God and only later counting the cost.

verses.kjv_text: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.nlt_text: A wise king scatters the wicked like wheat, then runs his threshing wheel over them.

verses.kjv_text: The spirit of man {is} the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly. {candle: or, lamp}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD's light penetrates the human spirit, exposing every hidden motive.

verses.kjv_text: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.nlt_text: Unfailing love and faithfulness protect the king; his throne is made secure through love.

verses.kjv_text: The glory of young men {is} their strength: and the beauty of old men {is} the gray head.
verses.nlt_text: The glory of the young is their strength; the gray hair of experience is the splendor of the old.

verses.kjv_text: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so {do} stripes the inward parts of the belly. {cleanseth...: Heb. is a purging medicine against}
verses.nlt_text: Physical punishment cleanses away evil; such discipline purifies the heart.

verses.kjv_text: The king's heart {is} in the hand of the LORD, {as} the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.nlt_text: The king's heart is like a stream of water directed by the LORD; he guides it wherever he pleases.

verses.kjv_text: Every way of a man {is} right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
verses.nlt_text: People may be right in their own eyes, but the LORD examines their heart.

verses.kjv_text: To do justice and judgment {is} more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD is more pleased when we do what is right and just than when we offer him sacrifices.

verses.kjv_text: An high look, and a proud heart, {and} the plowing of the wicked, {is} sin. {An...: Heb. Haughtiness of eyes} {the plowing: or, the light}
verses.nlt_text: Haughty eyes, a proud heart, and evil actions are all sin.

verses.kjv_text: The thoughts of the diligent {tend} only to plenteousness; but of every one {that is} hasty only to want.
verses.nlt_text: Good planning and hard work lead to prosperity, but hasty shortcuts lead to poverty.

verses.kjv_text: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue {is} a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.nlt_text: Wealth created by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist and a deadly trap.

verses.kjv_text: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment. {destroy...: Heb. saw them, or, dwell with them}
verses.nlt_text: The violence of the wicked sweeps them away, because they refuse to do what is just.

verses.kjv_text: The way of man {is} froward and strange: but {as for} the pure, his work {is} right.
verses.nlt_text: The guilty walk a crooked path; the innocent travel a straight road.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house. {a brawling...: Heb. a woman of contentions} {a wide...: Heb. an house of society}
verses.nlt_text: It's better to live alone in the corner of an attic than with a quarrelsome wife in a lovely home.

verses.kjv_text: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes. {findeth...: Heb. is not favoured}
verses.nlt_text: Evil people desire evil; their neighbors get no mercy from them.

verses.kjv_text: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: If you punish a mocker, the simpleminded become wise; if you instruct the wise, they will be all the wiser.

verses.kjv_text: The righteous {man} wisely considereth the house of the wicked: {but God} overthroweth the wicked for {their} wickedness.
verses.nlt_text: The Righteous One knows what is going on in the homes of the wicked; he will bring disaster on them.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.nlt_text: Those who shut their ears to the cries of the poor will be ignored in their own time of need.

verses.kjv_text: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.nlt_text: A secret gift calms anger; a bribe under the table pacifies fury.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction {shall be} to the workers of iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: Justice is a joy to the godly, but it terrifies evildoers.

verses.kjv_text: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.nlt_text: The person who strays from common sense will end up in the company of the dead.

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth pleasure {shall be} a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich. {pleasure: or, sport}
verses.nlt_text: Those who love pleasure become poor; those who love wine and luxury will never be rich.

verses.kjv_text: The wicked {shall be} a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.nlt_text: The wicked are punished in place of the godly, and traitors in place of the honest.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman. {in...: Heb. in the land of the desert}
verses.nlt_text: It's better to live alone in the desert than with a quarrelsome, complaining wife.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.nlt_text: The wise have wealth and luxury, but fools spend whatever they get.

verses.kjv_text: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.nlt_text: Whoever pursues righteousness and unfailing love will find life, righteousness, and honor.

verses.kjv_text: A wise {man} scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.nlt_text: The wise conquer the city of the strong and level the fortress in which they trust.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.nlt_text: Watch your tongue and keep your mouth shut, and you will stay out of trouble.

verses.kjv_text: Proud {and} haughty scorner {is} his name, who dealeth in proud wrath. {in proud...: Heb. in the wrath of pride}
verses.nlt_text: Mockers are proud and haughty; they act with boundless arrogance.

verses.kjv_text: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.nlt_text: Despite their desires, the lazy will come to ruin, for their hands refuse to work.

verses.kjv_text: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.nlt_text: Some people are always greedy for more, but the godly love to give!

verses.kjv_text: The sacrifice of the wicked {is} abomination: how much more, {when} he bringeth it with a wicked mind? {with...: Heb. in wickedness?}
verses.nlt_text: The sacrifice of an evil person is detestable, especially when it is offered with wrong motives.

verses.kjv_text: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly. {A...: Heb. A witness of lies}
verses.nlt_text: A false witness will be cut off, but a credible witness will be allowed to speak.

verses.kjv_text: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but {as for} the upright, he directeth his way. {directeth: or, considereth}
verses.nlt_text: The wicked bluff their way through, but the virtuous think before they act.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: No human wisdom or understanding or plan can stand against the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: The horse {is} prepared against the day of battle: but safety {is} of the LORD. {safety: or, victory}
verses.nlt_text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, but the victory belongs to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: A {good} name {is} rather to be chosen than great riches, {and} loving favour rather than silver and gold. {loving...: or, favour is better than, etc}
verses.nlt_text: Choose a good reputation over great riches; being held in high esteem is better than silver or gold.

verses.kjv_text: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD {is} the maker of them all.
verses.nlt_text: The rich and poor have this in common: The LORD made them both.

verses.kjv_text: A prudent {man} foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.nlt_text: A prudent person foresees danger and takes precautions. The simpleton goes blindly on and suffers the consequences.

verses.kjv_text: By humility {and} the fear of the LORD {are} riches, and honour, and life. {By...: or, The reward of humility, etc}
verses.nlt_text: True humility and fear of the LORD lead to riches, honor, and long life.

verses.kjv_text: Thorns {and} snares {are} in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.nlt_text: Corrupt people walk a thorny, treacherous road; whoever values life will avoid it.

verses.kjv_text: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it. {Train...: or, Catechise} {in...: Heb. in his way}
verses.nlt_text: Direct your children onto the right path, and when they are older, they will not leave it.

verses.kjv_text: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower {is} servant to the lender. {the lender: Heb. the man that lendeth}
verses.nlt_text: Just as the rich rule the poor, so the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.kjv_text: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail. {the rod...: or, with the rod of his anger he shall be consumed}
verses.nlt_text: Those who plant injustice will harvest disaster, and their reign of terror will come to an end.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor. {He that...: Heb. Good of eye}
verses.nlt_text: Blessed are those who are generous, because they feed the poor.

verses.kjv_text: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.nlt_text: Throw out the mocker, and fighting goes, too. Quarrels and insults will disappear.

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth pureness of heart, {for} the grace of his lips the king {shall be} his friend. {for...: or, and hath grace in his lips}
verses.nlt_text: Whoever loves a pure heart and gracious speech will have the king as a friend.

verses.kjv_text: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor. {the words: or, the matters}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD preserves those with knowledge, but he ruins the plans of the treacherous.

verses.kjv_text: The slothful {man} saith, {There is} a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.nlt_text: The lazy person claims, "There's a lion out there! If I go outside, I might be killed!"

verses.kjv_text: The mouth of strange women {is} a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.nlt_text: The mouth of an immoral woman is a dangerous trap; those who make the LORD angry will fall into it.

verses.kjv_text: Foolishness {is} bound in the heart of a child; {but} the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.nlt_text: A youngster's heart is filled with foolishness, but physical discipline will drive it far away.

verses.kjv_text: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his {riches, and} he that giveth to the rich, {shall} surely {come} to want.
verses.nlt_text: A person who gets ahead by oppressing the poor or by showering gifts on the rich will end in poverty.

verses.kjv_text: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to the words of the wise; apply your heart to my instruction.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips. {within...: Heb. in thy belly}
verses.nlt_text: For it is good to keep these sayings in your heart and always ready on your lips.

verses.kjv_text: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee. {even...: or, trust thou also}
verses.nlt_text: I am teaching you today-- yes, you-- so you will trust in the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.nlt_text: I have written thirty sayings for you, filled with advice and knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee? {to them...: or, to those that send thee?}
verses.nlt_text: In this way, you may know the truth and take an accurate report to those who sent you.

verses.kjv_text: Rob not the poor, because he {is} poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.nlt_text: Don't rob the poor just because you can, or exploit the needy in court.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD is their defender. He will ruin anyone who ruins them.

verses.kjv_text: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.nlt_text: Don't befriend angry people or associate with hot-tempered people,

verses.kjv_text: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.nlt_text: or you will learn to be like them and endanger your soul.

verses.kjv_text: Be not thou {one} of them that strike hands, {or} of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.nlt_text: Don't agree to guarantee another person's debt or put up security for someone else.

verses.kjv_text: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.nlt_text: If you can't pay it, even your bed will be snatched from under you.

verses.kjv_text: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set. {landmark: or, bound}
verses.nlt_text: Don't cheat your neighbor by moving the ancient boundary markers set up by previous generations.

verses.kjv_text: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean {men}. {mean...: Heb. obscure men}
verses.nlt_text: Do you see any truly competent workers? They will serve kings rather than working for ordinary people.

verses.kjv_text: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what {is} before thee:
verses.nlt_text: While dining with a ruler, pay attention to what is put before you.

verses.kjv_text: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou {be} a man given to appetite.
verses.nlt_text: If you are a big eater, put a knife to your throat;

verses.kjv_text: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they {are} deceitful meat.
verses.nlt_text: don't desire all the delicacies, for he might be trying to trick you.

verses.kjv_text: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: Don't wear yourself out trying to get rich. Be wise enough to know when to quit.

verses.kjv_text: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for {riches} certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven. {set...: Heb. cause thine eyes to fly upon}
verses.nlt_text: In the blink of an eye wealth disappears, for it will sprout wings and fly away like an eagle.

verses.kjv_text: Eat thou not the bread of {him that hath} an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.nlt_text: Don't eat with people who are stingy; don't desire their delicacies.

verses.kjv_text: For as he thinketh in his heart, so {is} he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart {is} not with thee.
verses.nlt_text: They are always thinking about how much it costs. "Eat and drink," they say, but they don't mean it.

verses.kjv_text: The morsel {which} thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.nlt_text: You will throw up what little you've eaten, and your compliments will be wasted.

verses.kjv_text: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.nlt_text: Don't waste your breath on fools, for they will despise the wisest advice.

verses.kjv_text: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless: {landmark: or, bound}
verses.nlt_text: Don't cheat your neighbor by moving the ancient boundary markers; don't take the land of defenseless orphans.

verses.kjv_text: For their redeemer {is} mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.nlt_text: For their Redeemer is strong; he himself will bring their charges against you.

verses.kjv_text: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: Commit yourself to instruction; listen carefully to words of knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: Withhold not correction from the child: for {if} thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.nlt_text: Don't fail to discipline your children. They won't die if you spank them.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.nlt_text: Physical discipline may well save them from death.

verses.kjv_text: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine. {even...: or, even I will rejoice}
verses.nlt_text: My child, if your heart is wise, my own heart will rejoice!

verses.kjv_text: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.nlt_text: Everything in me will celebrate when you speak what is right.

verses.kjv_text: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but {be thou} in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.nlt_text: Don't envy sinners, but always continue to fear the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off. {end: or, reward}
verses.nlt_text: You will be rewarded for this; your hope will not be disappointed.

verses.kjv_text: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.nlt_text: My child, listen and be wise: Keep your heart on the right course.

verses.kjv_text: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: {of flesh: Heb. of their flesh}
verses.nlt_text: Do not carouse with drunkards or feast with gluttons,

verses.kjv_text: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe {a man} with rags.
verses.nlt_text: for they are on their way to poverty, and too much sleep clothes them in rags.

verses.kjv_text: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and don't despise your mother when she is old.

verses.kjv_text: Buy the truth, and sell {it} not; {also} wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
