verses.nlt_text: "Raise a signal flag on a bare hilltop. Call up an army against Babylon. Wave your hand to encourage them as they march into the palaces of the high and mighty.

verses.kjv_text: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, {even} them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.nlt_text: I, the LORD, have dedicated these soldiers for this task. Yes, I have called mighty warriors to express my anger, and they will rejoice when I am exalted."

verses.kjv_text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle. {like...: Heb. the likeness of}
verses.nlt_text: Hear the noise on the mountains! Listen, as the vast armies march! It is the noise and shouting of many nations. The LORD of Heaven's Armies has called this army together.

verses.kjv_text: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, {even} the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.nlt_text: They come from distant countries, from beyond the farthest horizons. They are the LORD's weapons to carry out his anger. With them he will destroy the whole land.

verses.kjv_text: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD {is} at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.nlt_text: Scream in terror, for the day of the LORD has arrived-- the time for the Almighty to destroy.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt: {be faint: or, fall down}
verses.nlt_text: Every arm is paralyzed with fear. Every heart melts,

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces {shall be as} flames. {be amazed: Heb. wonder} {one...: Heb. every man at his neighbour} {flames: Heb. faces of the flames}
verses.nlt_text: and people are terrified. Pangs of anguish grip them, like those of a woman in labor. They look helplessly at one another, their faces aflame with fear.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.nlt_text: For see, the day of the LORD is coming-- the terrible day of his fury and fierce anger. The land will be made desolate, and all the sinners destroyed with it.

verses.kjv_text: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.nlt_text: The heavens will be black above them; the stars will give no light. The sun will be dark when it rises, and the moon will provide no light.

verses.kjv_text: And I will punish the world for {their} evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.nlt_text: "I, the LORD, will punish the world for its evil and the wicked for their sin. I will crush the arrogance of the proud and humble the pride of the mighty.

verses.kjv_text: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.nlt_text: I will make people scarcer than gold-- more rare than the fine gold of Ophir.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.nlt_text: For I will shake the heavens. The earth will move from its place when the LORD of Heaven's Armies displays his wrath in the day of his fierce anger."

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone in Babylon will run about like a hunted gazelle, like sheep without a shepherd. They will try to find their own people and flee to their own land.

verses.kjv_text: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined {unto them} shall fall by the sword.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who is captured will be cut down-- run through with a sword.

verses.kjv_text: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.nlt_text: Their little children will be dashed to death before their eyes. Their homes will be sacked, and their wives will be raped.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and {as for} gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.nlt_text: "Look, I will stir up the Medes against Babylon. They cannot be tempted by silver or bribed with gold.

verses.kjv_text: {Their} bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.nlt_text: The attacking armies will shoot down the young men with arrows. They will have no mercy on helpless babies and will show no compassion for children."

verses.kjv_text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. {as...: Heb. as the overthrowing}
verses.nlt_text: Babylon, the most glorious of kingdoms, the flower of Chaldean pride, will be devastated like Sodom and Gomorrah when God destroyed them.

verses.kjv_text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.nlt_text: Babylon will never be inhabited again. It will remain empty for generation after generation. Nomads will refuse to camp there, and shepherds will not bed down their sheep.

verses.kjv_text: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there. {wild...: Heb. Ziim} {doleful...: Heb. Ochim} {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}
verses.nlt_text: Desert animals will move into the ruined city, and the houses will be haunted by howling creatures. Owls will live among the ruins, and wild goats will go there to dance.

verses.kjv_text: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in {their} pleasant palaces: and her time {is} near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged. {the wild...: Heb. Iim} {desolate...: or, palaces}
verses.nlt_text: Hyenas will howl in its fortresses, and jackals will make dens in its luxurious palaces. Babylon's days are numbered; its time of destruction will soon arrive.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD will have mercy on the descendants of Jacob. He will choose Israel as his special people once again. He will bring them back to settle once again in their own land. And people from many different nations will come and join them there and unite with the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors. {whose...: Heb. that had taken them captives}
verses.nlt_text: The nations of the world will help the LORD's people to return, and those who come to live in their land will serve them. Those who captured Israel will themselves be captured, and Israel will rule over its enemies.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.nlt_text: In that wonderful day when the LORD gives his people rest from sorrow and fear, from slavery and chains,

verses.kjv_text: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! {proverb: or, taunting speech} {golden...: or, exactress of gold}
verses.nlt_text: you will taunt the king of Babylon. You will say, "The mighty man has been destroyed. Yes, your insolence is ended.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, {and} the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD has crushed your wicked power and broken your evil rule.

verses.kjv_text: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, {and} none hindereth. {a continual...: Heb. a stroke without removing}
verses.nlt_text: You struck the people with endless blows of rage and held the nations in your angry grip with unrelenting tyranny.

verses.kjv_text: The whole earth is at rest, {and} is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.nlt_text: But finally the earth is at rest and quiet. Now it can sing again!

verses.kjv_text: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, {and} the cedars of Lebanon, {saying}, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.nlt_text: Even the trees of the forest-- the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon-- sing out this joyous song: 'Since you have been cut down, no one will come now to cut us down!'

verses.kjv_text: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet {thee} at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, {even} all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations. {Hell: or, The grave} {chief...: Heb. leaders, or, great goats}
verses.nlt_text: "In the place of the dead there is excitement over your arrival. The spirits of world leaders and mighty kings long dead stand up to see you.

verses.kjv_text: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.nlt_text: With one voice they all cry out, 'Now you are as weak as we are!

verses.kjv_text: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, {and} the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.nlt_text: Your might and power were buried with you. The sound of the harp in your palace has ceased. Now maggots are your sheet, and worms your blanket.'

verses.kjv_text: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! {how} art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations! {O Lucifer: or, O day star}
verses.nlt_text: "How you are fallen from heaven, O shining star, son of the morning! You have been thrown down to the earth, you who destroyed the nations of the world.

verses.kjv_text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.nlt_text: For you said to yourself, 'I will ascend to heaven and set my throne above God's stars. I will preside on the mountain of the gods far away in the north.

verses.kjv_text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.nlt_text: I will climb to the highest heavens and be like the Most High.'

verses.kjv_text: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, you will be brought down to the place of the dead, down to its lowest depths.

verses.kjv_text: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, {and} consider thee, {saying, Is} this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.nlt_text: Everyone there will stare at you and ask, 'Can this be the one who shook the earth and made the kingdoms of the world tremble?

verses.kjv_text: {That} made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; {that} opened not the house of his prisoners? {opened...: or, did not let his prisoners loose homeward?}
verses.nlt_text: Is this the one who destroyed the world and made it into a wasteland? Is this the king who demolished the world's greatest cities and had no mercy on his prisoners?'

verses.kjv_text: All the kings of the nations, {even} all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.nlt_text: "The kings of the nations lie in stately glory, each in his own tomb,

verses.kjv_text: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, {and as} the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.nlt_text: but you will be thrown out of your grave like a worthless branch. Like a corpse trampled underfoot, you will be dumped into a mass grave with those killed in battle. You will descend to the pit.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, {and} slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.nlt_text: You will not be given a proper burial, for you have destroyed your nation and slaughtered your people. The descendants of such an evil person will never again receive honor.

verses.kjv_text: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.nlt_text: Kill this man's children! Let them die because of their father's sins! They must not rise and conquer the earth, filling the world with their cities."

verses.kjv_text: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies says: "I, myself, have risen against Babylon! I will destroy its children and its children's children," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.nlt_text: "I will make Babylon a desolate place of owls, filled with swamps and marshes. I will sweep the land with the broom of destruction. I, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, {so} shall it stand:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD of Heaven's Armies has sworn this oath: "It will all happen as I have planned. It will be as I have decided.

verses.kjv_text: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.nlt_text: I will break the Assyrians when they are in Israel; I will trample them on my mountains. My people will no longer be their slaves nor bow down under their heavy loads.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this {is} the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.nlt_text: I have a plan for the whole earth, a hand of judgment upon all the nations.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul {it}? and his hand {is} stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.nlt_text: The LORD of Heaven's Armies has spoken-- who can change his plans? When his hand is raised, who can stop him?"

verses.kjv_text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me the year King Ahaz died:

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit {shall be} a fiery flying serpent. {cockatrice: or, adder}
verses.nlt_text: Do not rejoice, you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken-- that the king who attacked you is dead. For from that snake a more poisonous snake will be born, a fiery serpent to destroy you!

verses.kjv_text: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.nlt_text: I will feed the poor in my pasture; the needy will lie down in peace. But as for you, I will wipe you out with famine and destroy the few who remain.

verses.kjv_text: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, {art} dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none {shall be} alone in his appointed times. {none...: or, he shall not be alone} {appointed...: or, assemblies}
verses.nlt_text: Wail at the gates! Weep in the cities! Melt with fear, you Philistines! A powerful army comes like smoke from the north. Each soldier rushes forward eager to fight.

verses.kjv_text: What shall {one} then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it. {trust...: or, betake themselves unto it}
verses.nlt_text: What should we tell the Philistine messengers? Tell them, "The LORD has built Jerusalem; its walls will give refuge to his oppressed people."

verses.kjv_text: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, {and} brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, {and} brought to silence; {brought...: or, cut off}
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Moab: In one night the town of Ar will be leveled, and the city of Kir will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads {shall be} baldness, {and} every beard cut off.
verses.nlt_text: Your people will go to their temple in Dibon to mourn. They will go to their sacred shrines to weep. They will wail for the fate of Nebo and Medeba, shaving their heads in sorrow and cutting off their beards.

verses.kjv_text: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly. {weeping...: Heb. descending into weeping, or, coming down with weeping}
verses.nlt_text: They will wear burlap as they wander the streets. From every home and public square will come the sound of wailing.

verses.kjv_text: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard {even} unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Heshbon and Elealeh will cry out; their voices will be heard as far away as Jahaz! The bravest warriors of Moab will cry out in utter terror. They will be helpless with fear.

verses.kjv_text: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives {shall flee} unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction. {his...: or, to the borders thereof, even to Zoar, as an heifer} {destruction: Heb. breaking}
verses.nlt_text: My heart weeps for Moab. Its people flee to Zoar and Eglath-shelishiyah. Weeping, they climb the road to Luhith. Their cries of distress can be heard all along the road to Horonaim.

verses.kjv_text: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing. {desolate: Heb. desolations}
verses.nlt_text: Even the waters of Nimrim are dried up! The grassy banks are scorched. The tender plants are gone; nothing green remains.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows. {brook...: or, valley of the Arabians}
verses.nlt_text: The people grab their possessions and carry them across the Ravine of Willows.

verses.kjv_text: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
verses.nlt_text: A cry of distress echoes through the land of Moab from one end to the other-- from Eglaim to Beer-elim.

verses.kjv_text: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land. {more: Heb. additions}
verses.nlt_text: The stream near Dibon runs red with blood, but I am still not finished with Dibon! Lions will hunt down the survivors-- both those who try to escape and those who remain behind.

verses.kjv_text: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion. {Sela: or, Petra: Heb. A rock}
verses.nlt_text: Send lambs from Sela as tribute to the ruler of the land. Send them through the desert to the mountain of beautiful Zion.

verses.kjv_text: For it shall be, {that}, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, {so} the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon. {cast...: or, a nest forsaken}
verses.nlt_text: The women of Moab are left like homeless birds at the shallow crossings of the Arnon River.

verses.kjv_text: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth. {Take: Heb. Bring}
verses.nlt_text: "Help us," they cry. "Defend us against our enemies. Protect us from their relentless attack. Do not betray us now that we have escaped.

verses.kjv_text: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land. {extortioner: Heb. wringer} {the oppressors: Heb. the treaders down}
verses.nlt_text: Let our refugees stay among you. Hide them from our enemies until the terror is past." When oppression and destruction have ended and enemy raiders have disappeared,

verses.kjv_text: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness. {established: or, prepared}
verses.nlt_text: then God will establish one of David's descendants as king. He will rule with mercy and truth. He will always do what is just and be eager to do what is right.

verses.kjv_text: We have heard of the pride of Moab; {he is} very proud: {even} of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: {but} his lies {shall} not {be} so.
verses.nlt_text: We have heard about proud Moab-- about its pride and arrogance and rage. But all that boasting has disappeared.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely {they are} stricken. {mourn: or, mutter}
verses.nlt_text: The entire land of Moab weeps. Yes, everyone in Moab mourns for the cakes of raisins from Kir-hareseth. They are all gone now.

verses.kjv_text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, {and} the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come {even} unto Jazer, they wandered {through} the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea. {stretched...: or, plucked up}
verses.nlt_text: The farms of Heshbon are abandoned; the vineyards at Sibmah are deserted. The rulers of the nations have broken down Moab-- that beautiful grapevine. Its tendrils spread north as far as the town of Jazer and trailed eastward into the wilderness. Its shoots reached so far west that they crossed over the Dead Sea.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen. {the shouting...: or, the alarm is fallen upon, etc}
verses.nlt_text: So now I weep for Jazer and the vineyards of Sibmah; my tears will flow for Heshbon and Elealeh. There are no more shouts of joy over your summer fruits and harvest.

verses.kjv_text: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in {their} presses; I have made {their vintage} shouting to cease.
verses.nlt_text: Gone now is the gladness, gone the joy of harvest. There will be no singing in the vineyards, no more happy shouts, no treading of grapes in the winepresses. I have ended all their harvest joys.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
verses.nlt_text: My heart's cry for Moab is like a lament on a harp. I am filled with anguish for Kir-hareseth.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Moab will worship at their pagan shrines, but it will do them no good. They will cry to the gods in their temples, but no one will be able to save them.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has already said these things about Moab in the past.

verses.kjv_text: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant {shall be} very small {and} feeble. {feeble: or, not many}
verses.nlt_text: But now the LORD says, "Within three years, counting each day, the glory of Moab will be ended. From its great population, only a few of its people will be left alive."

verses.kjv_text: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from {being} a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Damascus: "Look, the city of Damascus will disappear! It will become a heap of ruins.

verses.kjv_text: The cities of Aroer {are} forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make {them} afraid.
verses.nlt_text: The towns of Aroer will be deserted. Flocks will graze in the streets and lie down undisturbed, with no one to chase them away.

verses.kjv_text: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.nlt_text: The fortified towns of Israel will also be destroyed, and the royal power of Damascus will end. All that remains of Syria will share the fate of Israel's departed glory," declares the LORD of Heaven's Armies.

verses.kjv_text: And in that day it shall come to pass, {that} the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.nlt_text: "In that day Israel's glory will grow dim; its robust body will waste away.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.nlt_text: The whole land will look like a grainfield after the harvesters have gathered the grain. It will be desolate, like the fields in the valley of Rephaim after the harvest.

verses.kjv_text: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two {or} three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four {or} five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Only a few of its people will be left, like stray olives left on a tree after the harvest. Only two or three remain in the highest branches, four or five scattered here and there on the limbs," declares the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then at last the people will look to their Creator and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect {that} which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images. {images: or, sun images}
verses.nlt_text: They will no longer look to their idols for help or worship what their own hands have made. They will never again bow down to their Asherah poles or worship at the pagan shrines they have built.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
verses.nlt_text: Their largest cities will be like a deserted forest, like the land the Hivites and Amorites abandoned when the Israelites came here so long ago. It will be utterly desolate.

verses.kjv_text: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
verses.nlt_text: Why? Because you have turned from the God who can save you. You have forgotten the Rock who can hide you. So you may plant the finest grapevines and import the most expensive seedlings.

verses.kjv_text: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: {but} the harvest {shall be} a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow. {a heap...: or, removed in the day of inheritance, and there shall be deadly sorrow}
verses.nlt_text: They may sprout on the day you set them out; yes, they may blossom on the very morning you plant them, but you will never pick any grapes from them. Your only harvest will be a load of grief and unrelieved pain.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to the multitude of many people, {which} make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, {that} make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters! {multitude: or, noise} {mighty: or, many}
verses.nlt_text: Listen! The armies of many nations roar like the roaring of the sea. Hear the thunder of the mighty forces as they rush forward like thundering waves.

verses.kjv_text: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but {God} shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind. {a rolling...: or, thistledown}
verses.nlt_text: But though they thunder like breakers on a beach, God will silence them, and they will run away. They will flee like chaff scattered by the wind, like a tumbleweed whirling before a storm.

verses.kjv_text: And behold at eveningtide trouble; {and} before the morning he {is} not. This {is} the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.nlt_text: In the evening Israel waits in terror, but by dawn its enemies are dead. This is the just reward of those who plunder us, a fitting end for those who destroy us.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which {is} beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.nlt_text: Listen, Ethiopia-- land of fluttering sails that lies at the headwaters of the Nile,

verses.kjv_text: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, {saying}, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled! {scattered...: or, outspread and polished} {meted...: or, that meteth out and treadeth down: Heb. of line, line, and treading under foot} {have...: or, despise}
verses.nlt_text: that sends ambassadors in swift boats down the river. Go, swift messengers! Take a message to a tall, smooth-skinned people, who are feared far and wide for their conquests and destruction, and whose land is divided by rivers.

verses.kjv_text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
verses.nlt_text: All you people of the world, everyone who lives on the earth-- when I raise my battle flag on the mountain, look! When I blow the ram's horn, listen!

verses.kjv_text: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, {and} like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest. {consider...: or, regard my set dwelling} {upon...: or, after rain}
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD has told me this: "I will watch quietly from my dwelling place-- as quietly as the heat rises on a summer day, or as the morning dew forms during the harvest."

verses.kjv_text: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away {and} cut down the branches.
verses.nlt_text: Even before you begin your attack, while your plans are ripening like grapes, the LORD will cut off your new growth with pruning shears. He will snip off and discard your spreading branches.

verses.kjv_text: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.nlt_text: Your mighty army will be left dead in the fields for the mountain vultures and wild animals. The vultures will tear at the corpses all summer. The wild animals will gnaw at the bones all winter.

verses.kjv_text: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion. {scattered...: or, outspread and polished}
verses.nlt_text: At that time the LORD of Heaven's Armies will receive gifts from this land divided by rivers, from this tall, smooth-skinned people, who are feared far and wide for their conquests and destruction. They will bring the gifts to Jerusalem, where the LORD of Heaven's Armies dwells.

verses.kjv_text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Egypt: Look! The LORD is advancing against Egypt, riding on a swift cloud. The idols of Egypt tremble. The hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.

verses.kjv_text: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, {and} kingdom against kingdom. {set: Heb. mingle}
verses.nlt_text: "I will make Egyptian fight against Egyptian-- brother against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, province against province.

verses.kjv_text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards. {fail: Heb. be emptied} {destroy: Heb. swallow up}
verses.nlt_text: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will confuse their plans. They will plead with their idols for wisdom and call on spirits, mediums, and those who consult the spirits of the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts. {give...: or, shut up}
verses.nlt_text: I will hand Egypt over to a hard, cruel master. A fierce king will rule them," says the Lord, the LORD of Heaven's Armies.

verses.kjv_text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.nlt_text: The waters of the Nile will fail to rise and flood the fields. The riverbed will be parched and dry.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall turn the rivers far away; {and} the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.nlt_text: The canals of the Nile will dry up, and the streams of Egypt will stink with rotting reeds and rushes.

verses.kjv_text: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no {more}. {and be...: Heb. and shall not be}
verses.nlt_text: All the greenery along the riverbank and all the crops along the river will dry up and blow away.

verses.kjv_text: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.nlt_text: The fishermen will lament for lack of work. Those who cast hooks into the Nile will groan, and those who use nets will lose heart.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded. {networks: or, white works}
verses.nlt_text: There will be no flax for the harvesters, no thread for the weavers.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices {and} ponds for fish. {purposes: Heb. foundations} {for fish: Heb. of living things}
verses.nlt_text: They will be in despair, and all the workers will be sick at heart.

verses.kjv_text: Surely the princes of Zoan {are} fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I {am} the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.nlt_text: What fools are the officials of Zoan! Their best counsel to the king of Egypt is stupid and wrong. Will they still boast to Pharaoh of their wisdom? Will they dare brag about all their wise ancestors?

verses.kjv_text: Where {are} they? where {are} thy wise {men}? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: Where are your wise counselors, Pharaoh? Let them tell you what God plans, what the LORD of Heaven's Armies is going to do to Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, {even they that are} the stay of the tribes thereof. {they that...: or, governors: Heb. corners}
verses.nlt_text: The officials of Zoan are fools, and the officials of Memphis are deluded. The leaders of the people have led Egypt astray.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken {man} staggereth in his vomit. {a perverse...: Heb. a spirit of perversities}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD has sent a spirit of foolishness on them, so all their suggestions are wrong. They cause Egypt to stagger like a drunk in his vomit.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall there be {any} work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.nlt_text: There is nothing Egypt can do. All are helpless-- the head and the tail, the noble palm branch and the lowly reed.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.nlt_text: In that day the Egyptians will be as weak as women. They will cower in fear beneath the upraised fist of the LORD of Heaven's Armies.

verses.kjv_text: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.nlt_text: Just to speak the name of Israel will terrorize them, for the LORD of Heaven's Armies has laid out his plans against them.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction. {the language: Heb. the lip} {of destruction: or, of Heres, or, of the sun}
verses.nlt_text: In that day five of Egypt's cities will follow the LORD of Heaven's Armies. They will even begin to speak Hebrew, the language of Canaan. One of these cities will be Heliopolis, the City of the Sun.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the heart of Egypt, and there will be a monument to the LORD at its border.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.nlt_text: It will be a sign and a witness that the LORD of Heaven's Armies is worshiped in the land of Egypt. When the people cry to the LORD for help against those who oppress them, he will send them a savior who will rescue them.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform {it}.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will make himself known to the Egyptians. Yes, they will know the LORD and will give their sacrifices and offerings to him. They will make a vow to the LORD and will keep it.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal {it}: and they shall return {even} to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will strike Egypt, and then he will bring healing. For the Egyptians will turn to the LORD, and he will listen to their pleas and heal them.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.nlt_text: In that day Egypt and Assyria will be connected by a highway. The Egyptians and Assyrians will move freely between their lands, and they will both worship God.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, {even} a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.nlt_text: And Israel will be their ally. The three will be together, and Israel will be a blessing to them.

verses.kjv_text: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed {be} Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD of Heaven's Armies will say, "Blessed be Egypt, my people. Blessed be Assyria, the land I have made. Blessed be Israel, my special possession!"

verses.kjv_text: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.nlt_text: In the year when King Sargon of Assyria sent his commander in chief to capture the Philistine city of Ashdod,

verses.kjv_text: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot. {by: Heb. by the hand of}
verses.nlt_text: the LORD told Isaiah son of Amoz, "Take off the burlap you have been wearing, and remove your sandals." Isaiah did as he was told and walked around naked and barefoot.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years {for} a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said, "My servant Isaiah has been walking around naked and barefoot for the last three years. This is a sign-- a symbol of the terrible troubles I will bring upon Egypt and Ethiopia.

verses.kjv_text: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with {their} buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt. {the Egyptians...: Heb. the captivity of Egypt} {shame: Heb. nakedness}
verses.nlt_text: For the king of Assyria will take away the Egyptians and Ethiopians as prisoners. He will make them walk naked and barefoot, both young and old, their buttocks bared, to the shame of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Philistines will be thrown into panic, for they counted on the power of Ethiopia and boasted of their allies in Egypt!

verses.kjv_text: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such {is} our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape? {isle: or, country}
verses.nlt_text: They will say, 'If this can happen to Egypt, what chance do we have? We were counting on Egypt to protect us from the king of Assyria.'"

verses.kjv_text: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; {so} it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Babylon-- the desert by the sea: Disaster is roaring down on you from the desert, like a whirlwind sweeping in from the Negev.

verses.kjv_text: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease. {grievous: Heb. hard}
verses.nlt_text: I see a terrifying vision: I see the betrayer betraying, the destroyer destroying. Go ahead, you Elamites and Medes, attack and lay siege. I will make an end to all the groaning Babylon caused.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing {of it}; I was dismayed at the seeing {of it}.
verses.nlt_text: My stomach aches and burns with pain. Sharp pangs of anguish are upon me, like those of a woman in labor. I grow faint when I hear what God is planning; I am too afraid to look.

verses.kjv_text: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me. {heart...: or, mind wandered} {turned: Heb. put}
verses.nlt_text: My mind reels and my heart races. I longed for evening to come, but now I am terrified of the dark.

verses.kjv_text: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, {and} anoint the shield.
verses.nlt_text: Look! They are preparing a great feast. They are spreading rugs for people to sit on. Everyone is eating and drinking. But quick! Grab your shields and prepare for battle. You are being attacked!

verses.kjv_text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the Lord said to me, "Put a watchman on the city wall. Let him shout out what he sees.

verses.kjv_text: And he saw a chariot {with} a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, {and} a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.nlt_text: He should look for chariots drawn by pairs of horses, and for riders on donkeys and camels. Let the watchman be fully alert."

verses.kjv_text: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights: {he...: or, cried as a lion} {whole...: or, every night}
verses.nlt_text: Then the watchman called out, "Day after day I have stood on the watchtower, my lord. Night after night I have remained at my post.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, {with} a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.nlt_text: Now at last-- look! Here comes a man in a chariot with a pair of horses!" Then the watchman said, "Babylon is fallen, fallen! All the idols of Babylon lie broken on the ground!"

verses.kjv_text: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you. {corn: Heb. son}
verses.nlt_text: O my people, threshed and winnowed, I have told you everything the LORD of Heaven's Armies has said, everything the God of Israel has told me.

verses.kjv_text: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Edom: Someone from Edom keeps calling to me, "Watchman, how much longer until morning? When will the night be over?"

verses.kjv_text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
verses.nlt_text: The watchman replies, "Morning is coming, but night will soon return. If you wish to ask again, then come back and ask."

verses.kjv_text: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Arabia: O caravans from Dedan, hide in the deserts of Arabia.

verses.kjv_text: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled. {brought: or, bring ye}
verses.nlt_text: O people of Tema, bring water to these thirsty people, food to these weary refugees.

verses.kjv_text: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war. {from the swords: or, for fear, etc: Heb. from the face, etc}
verses.nlt_text: They have fled from the sword, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and the terrors of battle.

verses.kjv_text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.nlt_text: The Lord said to me, "Within a year, counting each day, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end.

verses.kjv_text: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken {it}. {archers: Heb. bows}
verses.nlt_text: Only a few of its courageous archers will survive. I, the LORD, the God of Israel, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Jerusalem-- the Valley of Vision: What is happening? Why is everyone running to the rooftops?

verses.kjv_text: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain {men are} not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.nlt_text: The whole city is in a terrible uproar. What do I see in this reveling city? Bodies are lying everywhere, killed not in battle but by famine and disease.

verses.kjv_text: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, {which} have fled from far. {by...: Heb. of the bow}
verses.nlt_text: All your leaders have fled. They surrendered without resistance. The people tried to slip away, but they were captured, too.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people. {weep...: Heb. be bitter in weeping}
verses.nlt_text: That's why I said, "Leave me alone to weep; do not try to comfort me. Let me cry for my people as I watch them being destroyed."

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.nlt_text: Oh, what a day of crushing defeat! What a day of confusion and terror brought by the Lord, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, upon the Valley of Vision! The walls of Jerusalem have been broken, and cries of death echo from the mountainsides.

verses.kjv_text: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men {and} horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield. {uncovered: Heb. made naked}
verses.nlt_text: Elamites are the archers, with their chariots and charioteers. The men of Kir hold up the shields.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate. {thy...: Heb. the choice of thy valleys} {at: or, toward}
verses.nlt_text: Chariots fill your beautiful valleys, and charioteers storm your gates.

verses.kjv_text: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.nlt_text: Judah's defenses have been stripped away. You run to the armory for your weapons.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.nlt_text: You inspect the breaks in the walls of Jerusalem. You store up water in the lower pool.

verses.kjv_text: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.nlt_text: You survey the houses and tear some down for stone to strengthen the walls.

verses.kjv_text: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.nlt_text: Between the city walls, you build a reservoir for water from the old pool. But you never ask for help from the One who did all this. You never considered the One who planned this long ago.

verses.kjv_text: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.nlt_text: At that time the Lord, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, called you to weep and mourn. He told you to shave your heads in sorrow for your sins and to wear clothes of burlap to show your remorse.

verses.kjv_text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.nlt_text: But instead, you dance and play; you slaughter cattle and kill sheep. You feast on meat and drink wine. You say, "Let's feast and drink, for tomorrow we die!"

verses.kjv_text: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD of Heaven's Armies has revealed this to me: "Till the day you die, you will never be forgiven for this sin." That is the judgment of the Lord, the LORD of Heaven's Armies.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, {even} unto Shebna, which {is} over the house, {and say},
verses.nlt_text: This is what the Lord, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, said to me: "Confront Shebna, the palace administrator, and give him this message:

verses.kjv_text: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, {as} he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, {and} that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock? {as...: or, O he}
verses.nlt_text: "Who do you think you are, and what are you doing here, building a beautiful tomb for yourself-- a monument high up in the rock?

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee. {will carry...: or, who covered thee with an excellent covering, and clothed thee gorgeously, (next verse) shall surely, etc} {a mighty...: Heb. the captivity of a man}
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD is about to hurl you away, mighty man. He is going to grab you,

verses.kjv_text: He will surely violently turn and toss thee {like} a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory {shall be} the shame of thy lord's house. {large: Heb. large of spaces}
verses.nlt_text: crumple you into a ball, and toss you away into a distant, barren land. There you will die, and your glorious chariots will be broken and useless. You are a disgrace to your master!

verses.kjv_text: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, I will drive you out of office," says the LORD. "I will pull you down from your high position.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.nlt_text: And then I will call my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah to replace you.

verses.kjv_text: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.nlt_text: I will dress him in your royal robes and will give him your title and your authority. And he will be a father to the people of Jerusalem and Judah.

verses.kjv_text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.nlt_text: I will give him the key to the house of David-- the highest position in the royal court. When he opens doors, no one will be able to close them; when he closes doors, no one will be able to open them.

verses.kjv_text: And I will fasten him {as} a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
verses.nlt_text: He will bring honor to his family name, for I will drive him firmly in place like a nail in the wall.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons. {vessels of flagons: or, instruments of viols}
verses.nlt_text: They will give him great responsibility, and he will bring honor to even the lowliest members of his family. "

verses.kjv_text: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that {was} upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken {it}.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD of Heaven's Armies also says: "The time will come when I will pull out the nail that seemed so firm. It will come out and fall to the ground. Everything it supports will fall with it. I, the LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning Tyre: Weep, O ships of Tarshish, for the harbor and houses of Tyre are gone! The rumors you heard in Cyprus are all true.

verses.kjv_text: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished. {still: Heb. silent}
verses.nlt_text: Mourn in silence, you people of the coast and you merchants of Sidon. Your traders crossed the sea,

verses.kjv_text: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, {is} her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.nlt_text: sailing over deep waters. They brought you grain from Egypt and harvests from along the Nile. You were the marketplace of the world.

verses.kjv_text: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, {even} the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, {nor} bring up virgins.
verses.nlt_text: But now you are put to shame, city of Sidon, for Tyre, the fortress of the sea, says, "Now I am childless; I have no sons or daughters."

verses.kjv_text: As at the report concerning Egypt, {so} shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.nlt_text: When Egypt hears the news about Tyre, there will be great sorrow.

verses.kjv_text: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.nlt_text: Send word now to Tarshish! Wail, you people who live in distant lands!

verses.kjv_text: {Is} this your joyous {city}, whose antiquity {is} of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn. {afar...: Heb. from afar off}
verses.nlt_text: Is this silent ruin all that is left of your once joyous city? What a long history was yours! Think of all the colonists you sent to distant places.

verses.kjv_text: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning {city}, whose merchants {are} princes, whose traffickers {are} the honourable of the earth?
verses.nlt_text: Who has brought this disaster on Tyre, that great creator of kingdoms? Her traders were all princes, her merchants were nobles.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, {and} to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth. {to stain: Heb. to pollute}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD of Heaven's Armies has done it to destroy your pride and bring low all earth's nobility.

verses.kjv_text: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: {there is} no more strength. {strength: Heb. girdle}
verses.nlt_text: Come, people of Tarshish, sweep over the land like the flooding Nile, for Tyre is defenseless.

verses.kjv_text: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant {city}, to destroy the strong holds thereof. {against...: or, concerning a merchantman} {the merchant city: Heb. Canaan} {strong...: or, strengths}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD held out his hand over the sea and shook the kingdoms of the earth. He has spoken out against Phoenicia, ordering that her fortresses be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.nlt_text: He says, "Never again will you rejoice, O daughter of Sidon, for you have been crushed. Even if you flee to Cyprus, you will find no rest."

verses.kjv_text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, {till} the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; {and} he brought it to ruin.
verses.nlt_text: Look at the land of Babylonia-- the people of that land are gone! The Assyrians have handed Babylon over to the wild animals of the desert. They have built siege ramps against its walls, torn down its palaces, and turned it to a heap of rubble.

verses.kjv_text: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.nlt_text: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor is destroyed!

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot. {shall Tyre...: Heb. it shall be unto Tyre as the song of an harlot}
verses.nlt_text: For seventy years, the length of a king's life, Tyre will be forgotten. But then the city will come back to life as in the song about the prostitute:

verses.kjv_text: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.nlt_text: Take a harp and walk the streets, you forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody and sing your songs so you will be remembered again.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, after seventy years the LORD will revive Tyre. But she will be no different than she was before. She will again be a prostitute to all kingdoms around the world.

verses.kjv_text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing. {durable: Heb. old}
verses.nlt_text: But in the end her profits will be given to the LORD. Her wealth will not be hoarded but will provide good food and fine clothing for the LORD's priests.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof. {turneth...: Heb. perverteth the face thereof}
verses.nlt_text: Look! The LORD is about to destroy the earth and make it a vast wasteland. He devastates the surface of the earth and scatters the people.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him. {priest: or, prince}
verses.nlt_text: Priests and laypeople, servants and masters, maids and mistresses, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, bankers and debtors-- none will be spared.

verses.kjv_text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
verses.nlt_text: The earth will be completely emptied and looted. The LORD has spoken!

verses.kjv_text: The earth mourneth {and} fadeth away, the world languisheth {and} fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish. {the haughty...: Heb. the height of the people}
verses.nlt_text: The earth mourns and dries up, and the crops waste away and wither. Even the greatest people on earth waste away.

verses.kjv_text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.nlt_text: The earth suffers for the sins of its people, for they have twisted God's instructions, violated his laws, and broken his everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, a curse consumes the earth. Its people must pay the price for their sin. They are destroyed by fire, and only a few are left alive.

verses.kjv_text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.nlt_text: The grapevines waste away, and there is no new wine. All the merrymakers sigh and mourn.

verses.kjv_text: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.nlt_text: The cheerful sound of tambourines is stilled; the happy cries of celebration are heard no more. The melodious chords of the harp are silent.

verses.kjv_text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.nlt_text: Gone are the joys of wine and song; alcoholic drink turns bitter in the mouth.

verses.kjv_text: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.nlt_text: The city writhes in chaos; every home is locked to keep out intruders.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.nlt_text: Mobs gather in the streets, crying out for wine. Joy has turned to gloom. Gladness has been banished from the land.

verses.kjv_text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.nlt_text: The city is left in ruins, its gates battered down.

verses.kjv_text: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, {there shall be} as the shaking of an olive tree, {and} as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.nlt_text: Throughout the earth the story is the same-- only a remnant is left, like the stray olives left on the tree or the few grapes left on the vine after harvest.

verses.kjv_text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.nlt_text: But all who are left shout and sing for joy. Those in the west praise the LORD's majesty.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, {even} the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea. {fires: or, valleys}
verses.nlt_text: In eastern lands, give glory to the LORD. In the lands beyond the sea, praise the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, {even} glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously. {uttermost...: Heb. wing} {My leanness: Heb. Leanness to me, or, My secret to me}
verses.nlt_text: We hear songs of praise from the ends of the earth, songs that give glory to the Righteous One! But my heart is heavy with grief. Weep for me, for I wither away. Deceit still prevails, and treachery is everywhere.

verses.kjv_text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, {are} upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Terror and traps and snares will be your lot, you people of the earth.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.nlt_text: Those who flee in terror will fall into a trap, and those who escape the trap will be caught in a snare. Destruction falls like rain from the heavens; the foundations of the earth shake.

verses.kjv_text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.nlt_text: The earth has broken up. It has utterly collapsed; it is violently shaken.

verses.kjv_text: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.nlt_text: The earth staggers like a drunk. It trembles like a tent in a storm. It falls and will not rise again, for the guilt of its rebellion is very heavy.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones {that are} on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. {punish: Heb. visit upon}
verses.nlt_text: In that day the LORD will punish the gods in the heavens and the proud rulers of the nations on earth.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall be gathered together, {as} prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited. {as prisoners...: Heb. with the gathering of prisoners} {pit: or, dungeon} {visited: or, found wanting}
verses.nlt_text: They will be rounded up and put in prison. They will be shut up in prison and will finally be punished.

verses.kjv_text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously. {before...: or, there shall be glory before his ancients}
verses.nlt_text: Then the glory of the moon will wane, and the brightness of the sun will fade, for the LORD of Heaven's Armies will rule on Mount Zion. He will rule in great glory in Jerusalem, in the sight of all the leaders of his people.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, thou {art} my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful {things; thy} counsels of old {are} faithfulness {and} truth.
verses.nlt_text: O LORD, I will honor and praise your name, for you are my God. You do such wonderful things! You planned them long ago, and now you have accomplished them.

verses.kjv_text: For thou hast made of a city an heap; {of} a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.nlt_text: You turn mighty cities into heaps of ruins. Cities with strong walls are turned to rubble. Beautiful palaces in distant lands disappear and will never be rebuilt.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, strong nations will declare your glory; ruthless nations will fear you.

verses.kjv_text: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones {is} as a storm {against} the wall.
verses.nlt_text: But you are a tower of refuge to the poor, O LORD, a tower of refuge to the needy in distress. You are a refuge from the storm and a shelter from the heat. For the oppressive acts of ruthless people are like a storm beating against a wall,

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; {even} the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.nlt_text: or like the relentless heat of the desert. But you silence the roar of foreign nations. As the shade of a cloud cools relentless heat, so the boastful songs of ruthless people are stilled.

verses.kjv_text: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.nlt_text: In Jerusalem, the LORD of Heaven's Armies will spread a wonderful feast for all the people of the world. It will be a delicious banquet with clear, well-aged wine and choice meat.

verses.kjv_text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations. {destroy: Heb. swallow up} {cast: Heb. covered}
verses.nlt_text: There he will remove the cloud of gloom, the shadow of death that hangs over the earth.

verses.kjv_text: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken {it}.
verses.nlt_text: He will swallow up death forever! The Sovereign LORD will wipe away all tears. He will remove forever all insults and mockery against his land and people. The LORD has spoken!

verses.kjv_text: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this {is} our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this {is} the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.nlt_text: In that day the people will proclaim, "This is our God! We trusted in him, and he saved us! This is the LORD, in whom we trusted. Let us rejoice in the salvation he brings!"

verses.kjv_text: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill. {trodden down under: or, threshed, etc} {trodden down for...: or, threshed in Madmenah}
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD's hand of blessing will rest on Jerusalem. But Moab will be crushed. It will be like straw trampled down and left to rot.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth {his hands} to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.nlt_text: God will push down Moab's people as a swimmer pushes down water with his hands. He will end their pride and all their evil works.

verses.kjv_text: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, {and} bring to the ground, {even} to the dust.
verses.nlt_text: The high walls of Moab will be demolished. They will be brought down to the ground, down into the dust.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will {God} appoint {for} walls and bulwarks.
verses.nlt_text: In that day, everyone in the land of Judah will sing this song: Our city is strong! We are surrounded by the walls of God's salvation.

verses.kjv_text: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in. {truth: Heb. truths}
verses.nlt_text: Open the gates to all who are righteous; allow the faithful to enter.

verses.kjv_text: Thou wilt keep {him} in perfect peace, {whose} mind {is} stayed {on thee}: because he trusteth in thee. {perfect...: Heb. peace, peace} {mind: or, thought, or, imagination}
verses.nlt_text: You will keep in perfect peace all who trust in you, all whose thoughts are fixed on you!

verses.kjv_text: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH {is} everlasting strength: {everlasting...: Heb. the rock of ages}
verses.nlt_text: Trust in the LORD always, for the LORD GOD is the eternal Rock.

verses.kjv_text: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, {even} to the ground; he bringeth it {even} to the dust.
verses.nlt_text: He humbles the proud and brings down the arrogant city. He brings it down to the dust.

verses.kjv_text: The foot shall tread it down, {even} the feet of the poor, {and} the steps of the needy.
verses.nlt_text: The poor and oppressed trample it underfoot, and the needy walk all over it.

verses.kjv_text: The way of the just {is} uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.nlt_text: But for those who are righteous, the way is not steep and rough. You are a God who does what is right, and you smooth out the path ahead of them.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of {our} soul {is} to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.nlt_text: LORD, we show our trust in you by obeying your laws; our heart's desire is to glorify your name.

verses.kjv_text: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments {are} in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: All night long I search for you; in the morning I earnestly seek for God. For only when you come to judge the earth will people learn what is right.

verses.kjv_text: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, {yet} will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Your kindness to the wicked does not make them do good. Although others do right, the wicked keep doing wrong and take no notice of the LORD's majesty.

verses.kjv_text: LORD, {when} thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: {but} they shall see, and be ashamed for {their} envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them. {at...: or, toward thy people}
verses.nlt_text: O LORD, they pay no attention to your upraised fist. Show them your eagerness to defend your people. Then they will be ashamed. Let your fire consume your enemies.

verses.kjv_text: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us. {in us: or, for us}
verses.nlt_text: LORD, you will grant us peace; all we have accomplished is really from you.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD our God, {other} lords beside thee have had dominion over us: {but} by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.nlt_text: O LORD our God, others have ruled us, but you alone are the one we worship.

verses.kjv_text: {They are} dead, they shall not live; {they are} deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.nlt_text: Those we served before are dead and gone. Their departed spirits will never return! You attacked them and destroyed them, and they are long forgotten.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed {it} far {unto} all the ends of the earth.
