verses.nlt_text: O LORD, you have made our nation great; yes, you have made us great. You have extended our borders, and we give you the glory!

verses.kjv_text: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer {when} thy chastening {was} upon them. {prayer: Heb. secret speech}
verses.nlt_text: LORD, in distress we searched for you. We prayed beneath the burden of your discipline.

verses.kjv_text: Like as a woman with child, {that} draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, {and} crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Just as a pregnant woman writhes and cries out in pain as she gives birth, so were we in your presence, LORD.

verses.kjv_text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.nlt_text: We, too, writhe in agony, but nothing comes of our suffering. We have not given salvation to the earth, nor brought life into the world.

verses.kjv_text: Thy dead {men} shall live, {together with} my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew {is as} the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.nlt_text: But those who die in the LORD will live; their bodies will rise again! Those who sleep in the earth will rise up and sing for joy! For your life-giving light will fall like dew on your people in the place of the dead!

verses.kjv_text: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.nlt_text: Go home, my people, and lock your doors! Hide yourselves for a little while until the LORD's anger has passed.

verses.kjv_text: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain. {blood: Heb. bloods}
verses.nlt_text: Look! The LORD is coming from heaven to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will no longer hide those who have been killed. They will be brought out for all to see.

verses.kjv_text: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that {is} in the sea. {piercing: or, crossing like a bar}
verses.nlt_text: In that day the LORD will take his terrible, swift sword and punish Leviathan, the swiftly moving serpent, the coiling, writhing serpent. He will kill the dragon of the sea.

verses.kjv_text: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.nlt_text: "In that day, sing about the fruitful vineyard.

verses.kjv_text: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest {any} hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.nlt_text: I, the LORD, will watch over it, watering it carefully. Day and night I will watch so no one can harm it.

verses.kjv_text: Fury {is} not in me: who would set the briers {and} thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together. {go...: or, march against}
verses.nlt_text: My anger will be gone. If I find briers and thorns growing, I will attack them; I will burn them up--

verses.kjv_text: Or let him take hold of my strength, {that} he may make peace with me; {and} he shall make peace with me.
verses.nlt_text: unless they turn to me for help. Let them make peace with me; yes, let them make peace with me."

verses.kjv_text: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.nlt_text: The time is coming when Jacob's descendants will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole earth with fruit!

verses.kjv_text: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? {or} is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him? {as...: Heb. according to the stroke of}
verses.nlt_text: Has the LORD struck Israel as he struck her enemies? Has he punished her as he punished them?

verses.kjv_text: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind. {it shooteth...: or, thou sendest it forth} {he...: or, when he removeth it with}
verses.nlt_text: No, but he exiled Israel to call her to account. She was exiled from her land as though blown away in a storm from the east.

verses.kjv_text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this {is} all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up. {images: or, sun images}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD did this to purge Israel's wickedness, to take away all her sin. As a result, all the pagan altars will be crushed to dust. No Asherah pole or pagan shrine will be left standing.

verses.kjv_text: Yet the defenced city {shall be} desolate, {and} the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.nlt_text: The fortified towns will be silent and empty, the houses abandoned, the streets overgrown with weeds. Calves will graze there, chewing on twigs and branches.

verses.kjv_text: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, {and} set them on fire: for it {is} a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.nlt_text: The people are like the dead branches of a tree, broken off and used for kindling beneath the cooking pots. Israel is a foolish and stupid nation, for its people have turned away from God. Therefore, the one who made them will show them no pity or mercy.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Yet the time will come when the LORD will gather them together like handpicked grain. One by one he will gather them-- from the Euphrates River in the east to the Brook of Egypt in the west.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: In that day the great trumpet will sound. Many who were dying in exile in Assyria and Egypt will return to Jerusalem to worship the LORD on his holy mountain.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty {is} a fading flower, which {are} on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine! {overcome: Heb. broken}
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits the proud city of Samaria-- the glorious crown of the drunks of Israel. It sits at the head of a fertile valley, but its glorious beauty will fade like a flower. It is the pride of a people brought down by wine.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, {which} as a tempest of hail {and} a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.nlt_text: For the Lord will send a mighty army against it. Like a mighty hailstorm and a torrential rain, they will burst upon it like a surging flood and smash it to the ground.

verses.kjv_text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet: {under...: Heb. with feet}
verses.nlt_text: The proud city of Samaria-- the glorious crown of the drunks of Israel-- will be trampled beneath its enemies' feet.

verses.kjv_text: And the glorious beauty, which {is} on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, {and} as the hasty fruit before the summer; which {when} he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up. {eateth: Heb. swalloweth}
verses.nlt_text: It sits at the head of a fertile valley, but its glorious beauty will fade like a flower. Whoever sees it will snatch it up, as an early fig is quickly picked and eaten.

verses.kjv_text: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
verses.nlt_text: Then at last the LORD of Heaven's Armies will himself be Israel's glorious crown. He will be the pride and joy of the remnant of his people.

verses.kjv_text: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
verses.nlt_text: He will give a longing for justice to their judges. He will give great courage to their warriors who stand at the gates.

verses.kjv_text: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble {in} judgment.
verses.nlt_text: Now, however, Israel is led by drunks who reel with wine and stagger with alcohol. The priests and prophets stagger with alcohol and lose themselves in wine. They reel when they see visions and stagger as they render decisions.

verses.kjv_text: For all tables are full of vomit {and} filthiness, {so that there is} no place {clean}.
verses.nlt_text: Their tables are covered with vomit; filth is everywhere.

verses.kjv_text: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? {them that are} weaned from the milk, {and} drawn from the breasts. {doctrine: Heb. the hearing?}
verses.nlt_text: "Who does the LORD think we are?" they ask. "Why does he speak to us like this? Are we little children, just recently weaned?

verses.kjv_text: For precept {must be} upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, {and} there a little: {must be: or, hath been}
verses.nlt_text: He tells us everything over and over-- one line at a time, one line at a time, a little here, and a little there!"

verses.kjv_text: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people. {stammering...: Heb. stammerings of lip} {will...: or, he hath spoken}
verses.nlt_text: So now God will have to speak to his people through foreign oppressors who speak a strange language!

verses.kjv_text: To whom he said, This {is} the rest {wherewith} ye may cause the weary to rest; and this {is} the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
verses.nlt_text: God has told his people, "Here is a place of rest; let the weary rest here. This is a place of quiet rest." But they would not listen.

verses.kjv_text: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, {and} there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD will spell out his message for them again, one line at a time, one line at a time, a little here, and a little there, so that they will stumble and fall. They will be injured, trapped, and captured.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which {is} in Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, listen to this message from the LORD, you scoffing rulers in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
verses.nlt_text: You boast, "We have struck a bargain to cheat death and have made a deal to dodge the grave. The coming destruction can never touch us, for we have built a strong refuge made of lies and deception."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner {stone}, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "Look! I am placing a foundation stone in Jerusalem, a firm and tested stone. It is a precious cornerstone that is safe to build on. Whoever believes need never be shaken.

verses.kjv_text: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
verses.nlt_text: I will test you with the measuring line of justice and the plumb line of righteousness. Since your refuge is made of lies, a hailstorm will knock it down. Since it is made of deception, a flood will sweep it away.

verses.kjv_text: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it. {trodden...: Heb. a treading down to it}
verses.nlt_text: I will cancel the bargain you made to cheat death, and I will overturn your deal to dodge the grave. When the terrible enemy sweeps through, you will be trampled into the ground.

verses.kjv_text: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only {to} understand the report. {to...: or, when he shall make you to understand doctrine}
verses.nlt_text: Again and again that flood will come, morning after morning, day and night, until you are carried away." This message will bring terror to your people.

verses.kjv_text: For the bed is shorter than that {a man} can stretch himself {on it}: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself {in it}.
verses.nlt_text: The bed you have made is too short to lie on. The blankets are too narrow to cover you.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD shall rise up as {in} mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as {in} the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will come as he did against the Philistines at Mount Perazim and against the Amorites at Gibeon. He will come to do a strange thing; he will come to do an unusual deed:

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
verses.nlt_text: For the Lord, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, has plainly said that he is determined to crush the whole land. So scoff no more, or your punishment will be even greater.

verses.kjv_text: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to me; listen, and pay close attention.

verses.kjv_text: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
verses.nlt_text: Does a farmer always plow and never sow? Is he forever cultivating the soil and never planting?

verses.kjv_text: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place? {the principal...: or, the wheat in the principal place, and barley in the appointed place} {rie: or, spelt} {place: Heb. border?}
verses.nlt_text: Does he not finally plant his seeds-- black cumin, cumin, wheat, barley, and emmer wheat-- each in its proper way, and each in its proper place?

verses.kjv_text: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, {and} doth teach him. {For...: or, And he bindeth it in such sort as his God doth teach him}
verses.nlt_text: The farmer knows just what to do, for God has given him understanding.

verses.kjv_text: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
verses.nlt_text: A heavy sledge is never used to thresh black cumin; rather, it is beaten with a light stick. A threshing wheel is never rolled on cumin; instead, it is beaten lightly with a flail.

verses.kjv_text: Bread {corn} is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break {it with} the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it {with} his horsemen.
verses.nlt_text: Grain for bread is easily crushed, so he doesn't keep on pounding it. He threshes it under the wheels of a cart, but he doesn't pulverize it.

verses.kjv_text: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, {which} is wonderful in counsel, {and} excellent in working.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD of Heaven's Armies is a wonderful teacher, and he gives the farmer great wisdom.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city {where} David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices. {Woe...: or, O Ariel, that is, the lion of God} {the city: or, of the city} {kill: Heb. cut off the heads of}
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits Ariel, the City of David. Year after year you celebrate your feasts.

verses.kjv_text: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
verses.nlt_text: Yet I will bring disaster upon you, and there will be much weeping and sorrow. For Jerusalem will become what her name Ariel means-- an altar covered with blood.

verses.kjv_text: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
verses.nlt_text: I will be your enemy, surrounding Jerusalem and attacking its walls. I will build siege towers and destroy it.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt be brought down, {and} shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust. {whisper: Heb. peep, or, chirp}
verses.nlt_text: Then deep from the earth you will speak; from low in the dust your words will come. Your voice will whisper from the ground like a ghost conjured up from the grave.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones {shall be} as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
verses.nlt_text: "But suddenly, your ruthless enemies will be crushed like the finest of dust. Your many attackers will be driven away like chaff before the wind. Suddenly, in an instant,

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
verses.nlt_text: I, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, will act for you with thunder and earthquake and great noise, with whirlwind and storm and consuming fire.

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.nlt_text: All the nations fighting against Jerusalem will vanish like a dream! Those who are attacking her walls will vanish like a vision in the night.

verses.kjv_text: It shall even be as when an hungry {man} dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, {he is} faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.nlt_text: A hungry person dreams of eating but wakes up still hungry. A thirsty person dreams of drinking but is still faint from thirst when morning comes. So it will be with your enemies, with those who attack Mount Zion."

verses.kjv_text: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink. {cry ye...: or, take your pleasure, and riot}
verses.nlt_text: Are you amazed and incredulous? Don't you believe it? Then go ahead and be blind. You are stupid, but not from wine! You stagger, but not from liquor!

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered. {rulers: Heb. heads}
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has closed the eyes of your prophets and visionaries.

verses.kjv_text: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which {men} deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it {is} sealed: {book: or, letter}
verses.nlt_text: All the future events in this vision are like a sealed book to them. When you give it to those who can read, they will say, "We can't read it because it is sealed."

verses.kjv_text: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
verses.nlt_text: When you give it to those who cannot read, they will say, "We don't know how to read."

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near {me} with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
verses.nlt_text: And so the Lord says, "These people say they are mine. They honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. And their worship of me is nothing but man-made rules learned by rote.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, {even} a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise {men} shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent {men} shall be hid. {proceed: Heb. add}
verses.nlt_text: Because of this, I will once again astound these hypocrites with amazing wonders. The wisdom of the wise will pass away, and the intelligence of the intelligent will disappear."

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits those who try to hide their plans from the LORD, who do their evil deeds in the dark! "The LORD can't see us," they say. "He doesn't know what's going on!"

verses.kjv_text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
verses.nlt_text: How foolish can you be? He is the Potter, and he is certainly greater than you, the clay! Should the created thing say of the one who made it, "He didn't make me"? Does a jar ever say, "The potter who made me is stupid"?

verses.kjv_text: {Is} it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.nlt_text: Soon-- and it will not be very long-- the forests of Lebanon will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will yield bountiful crops.

verses.kjv_text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
verses.nlt_text: In that day the deaf will hear words read from a book, and the blind will see through the gloom and darkness.

verses.kjv_text: The meek also shall increase {their} joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel. {increase: Heb. add}
verses.nlt_text: The humble will be filled with fresh joy from the LORD. The poor will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
verses.nlt_text: The scoffer will be gone, the arrogant will disappear, and those who plot evil will be killed.

verses.kjv_text: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
verses.nlt_text: Those who convict the innocent by their false testimony will disappear. A similar fate awaits those who use trickery to pervert justice and who tell lies to destroy the innocent.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
verses.nlt_text: That is why the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says to the people of Israel, "My people will no longer be ashamed or turn pale with fear.

verses.kjv_text: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: For when they see their many children and all the blessings I have given them, they will recognize the holiness of the Holy One of Israel. They will stand in awe of the God of Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine. {come...: Heb. know understanding}
verses.nlt_text: Then the wayward will gain understanding, and complainers will accept instruction.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits my rebellious children," says the LORD. "You make plans that are contrary to mine. You make alliances not directed by my Spirit, thus piling up your sins.

verses.kjv_text: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.nlt_text: For without consulting me, you have gone down to Egypt for help. You have put your trust in Pharaoh's protection. You have tried to hide in his shade.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt {your} confusion.
verses.nlt_text: But by trusting Pharaoh, you will be humiliated, and by depending on him, you will be disgraced.

verses.kjv_text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.nlt_text: For though his power extends to Zoan and his officials have arrived in Hanes,

verses.kjv_text: They were all ashamed of a people {that} could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.nlt_text: all who trust in him will be ashamed. He will not help you. Instead, he will disgrace you."

verses.kjv_text: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence {come} the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people {that} shall not profit {them}.
verses.nlt_text: This message came to me concerning the animals in the Negev: The caravan moves slowly across the terrible desert to Egypt-- donkeys weighed down with riches and camels loaded with treasure-- all to pay for Egypt's protection. They travel through the wilderness, a place of lionesses and lions, a place where vipers and poisonous snakes live. All this, and Egypt will give you nothing in return.

verses.kjv_text: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength {is} to sit still. {concerning...: or, to her}
verses.nlt_text: Egypt's promises are worthless! Therefore, I call her Rahab-- the Harmless Dragon.

verses.kjv_text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever: {the...: Heb. the latter day}
verses.nlt_text: Now go and write down these words. Write them in a book. They will stand until the end of time as a witness

verses.kjv_text: That this {is} a rebellious people, lying children, children {that} will not hear the law of the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: that these people are stubborn rebels who refuse to pay attention to the LORD's instructions.

verses.kjv_text: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
verses.nlt_text: They tell the seers, "Stop seeing visions!" They tell the prophets, "Don't tell us what is right. Tell us nice things. Tell us lies.

verses.kjv_text: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
verses.nlt_text: Forget all this gloom. Get off your narrow path. Stop telling us about your 'Holy One of Israel.'"

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon: {oppression: or, fraud}
verses.nlt_text: This is the reply of the Holy One of Israel: "Because you despise what I tell you and trust instead in oppression and lies,

verses.kjv_text: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
verses.nlt_text: calamity will come upon you suddenly-- like a bulging wall that bursts and falls. In an instant it will collapse and come crashing down.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water {withal} out of the pit. {the potters'...: Heb. the bottle of potters}
verses.nlt_text: You will be smashed like a piece of pottery-- shattered so completely that there won't be a piece big enough to carry coals from a fireplace or a little water from the well."

verses.kjv_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the Sovereign LORD, the Holy One of Israel, says: "Only in returning to me and resting in me will you be saved. In quietness and confidence is your strength. But you would have none of it.

verses.kjv_text: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.nlt_text: You said, 'No, we will get our help from Egypt. They will give us swift horses for riding into battle.' But the only swiftness you are going to see is the swiftness of your enemies chasing you!

verses.kjv_text: One thousand {shall flee} at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill. {a beacon: or, a tree bereft of branches, or, boughs: or, a mast}
verses.nlt_text: One of them will chase a thousand of you. Five of them will make all of you flee. You will be left like a lonely flagpole on a hill or a tattered banner on a distant mountaintop."

verses.kjv_text: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD {is} a God of judgment: blessed {are} all they that wait for him.
verses.nlt_text: So the LORD must wait for you to come to him so he can show you his love and compassion. For the LORD is a faithful God. Blessed are those who wait for his help.

verses.kjv_text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
verses.nlt_text: O people of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will be gracious if you ask for help. He will surely respond to the sound of your cries.

verses.kjv_text: And {though} the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers: {affliction: or, oppression}
verses.nlt_text: Though the Lord gave you adversity for food and suffering for drink, he will still be with you to teach you. You will see your teacher with your own eyes.

verses.kjv_text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This {is} the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verses.nlt_text: Your own ears will hear him. Right behind you a voice will say, "This is the way you should go," whether to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence. {thy graven...: Heb. the graven images of thy silver} {cast: Heb. scatter}
verses.nlt_text: Then you will destroy all your silver idols and your precious gold images. You will throw them out like filthy rags, saying to them, "Good riddance!"

verses.kjv_text: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD will bless you with rain at planting time. There will be wonderful harvests and plenty of pastureland for your livestock.

verses.kjv_text: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan. {clean: or, savoury: Heb. leavened}
verses.nlt_text: The oxen and donkeys that till the ground will eat good grain, its chaff blown away by the wind.

verses.kjv_text: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers {and} streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall. {high hill: Heb. lifted up, etc}
verses.nlt_text: In that day, when your enemies are slaughtered and the towers fall, there will be streams of water flowing down every mountain and hill.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.nlt_text: The moon will be as bright as the sun, and the sun will be seven times brighter-- like the light of seven days in one! So it will be when the LORD begins to heal his people and cure the wounds he gave them.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning {with} his anger, and the burden {thereof is} heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire: {burden...: or, grievousness of flame} {heavy: Heb. heaviness}
verses.nlt_text: Look! The LORD is coming from far away, burning with anger, surrounded by thick, rising smoke. His lips are filled with fury; his words consume like fire.

verses.kjv_text: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and {there shall be} a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing {them} to err.
verses.nlt_text: His hot breath pours out like a flood up to the neck of his enemies. He will sift out the proud nations for destruction. He will bridle them and lead them away to ruin.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall have a song, as in the night {when} a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel. {mighty...: Heb. Rock}
verses.nlt_text: But the people of God will sing a song of joy, like the songs at the holy festivals. You will be filled with joy, as when a flutist leads a group of pilgrims to Jerusalem, the mountain of the LORD-- to the Rock of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of {his} anger, and {with} the flame of a devouring fire, {with} scattering, and tempest, and hailstones. {his glorious...: Heb. the glory of his voice}
verses.nlt_text: And the LORD will make his majestic voice heard. He will display the strength of his mighty arm. It will descend with devouring flames, with cloudbursts, thunderstorms, and huge hailstones.

verses.kjv_text: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, {which} smote with a rod.
verses.nlt_text: At the LORD's command, the Assyrians will be shattered. He will strike them down with his royal scepter.

verses.kjv_text: And {in} every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, {it} shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it. {in every...: Heb. every passing of the rod founded} {lay...: Heb. cause to rest upon} {with it: or, against them}
verses.nlt_text: And as the LORD strikes them with his rod of punishment, his people will celebrate with tambourines and harps. Lifting his mighty arm, he will fight the Assyrians.

verses.kjv_text: For Tophet {is} ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made {it} deep {and} large: the pile thereof {is} fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it. {of old: Heb. from yesterday}
verses.nlt_text: Topheth-- the place of burning-- has long been ready for the Assyrian king; the pyre is piled high with wood. The breath of the LORD, like fire from a volcano, will set it ablaze.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because {they are} many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits those who look to Egypt for help, trusting their horses, chariots, and charioteers and depending on the strength of human armies instead of looking to the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Yet he also {is} wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity. {call...: Heb. remove}
verses.nlt_text: In his wisdom, the LORD will send great disaster; he will not change his mind. He will rise against the wicked and against their helpers.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Egyptians {are} men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
verses.nlt_text: For these Egyptians are mere humans, not God! Their horses are puny flesh, not mighty spirits! When the LORD raises his fist against them, those who help will stumble, and those being helped will fall. They will all fall down and die together.

verses.kjv_text: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, {he} will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof. {noise: or, multitude}
verses.nlt_text: But this is what the LORD has told me: "When a strong young lion stands growling over a sheep it has killed, it is not frightened by the shouts and noise of a whole crowd of shepherds. In the same way, the LORD of Heaven's Armies will come down and fight on Mount Zion.

verses.kjv_text: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver {it; and} passing over he will preserve it.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD of Heaven's Armies will hover over Jerusalem and protect it like a bird protecting its nest. He will defend and save the city; he will pass over it and rescue it."

verses.kjv_text: Turn ye unto {him from} whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.nlt_text: Though you are such wicked rebels, my people, come and return to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you {for} a sin. {his idols of gold: Heb. the idols of his gold}
verses.nlt_text: I know the glorious day will come when each of you will throw away the gold idols and silver images your sinful hands have made.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited. {from: or, for fear of} {discomfited: or, tributary: Heb. for melting, or, tribute}
verses.nlt_text: "The Assyrians will be destroyed, but not by the swords of men. The sword of God will strike them, and they will panic and flee. The strong young Assyrians will be taken away as captives.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire {is} in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem. {he...: Heb. his rock shall pass away for fear} {his strong hold: or, his strength}
verses.nlt_text: Even the strongest will quake with terror, and princes will flee when they see your battle flags," says the LORD, whose fire burns in Zion, whose flame blazes from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.nlt_text: Look, a righteous king is coming! And honest princes will rule under him.

verses.kjv_text: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land. {great: Heb. heavy}
verses.nlt_text: Each one will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a parched land.

verses.kjv_text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.nlt_text: Then everyone who has eyes will be able to see the truth, and everyone who has ears will be able to hear it.

verses.kjv_text: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly. {rash: Heb. hasty} {plainly: or, elegantly}
verses.nlt_text: Even the hotheads will be full of sense and understanding. Those who stammer will speak out plainly.

verses.kjv_text: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said {to be} bountiful.
verses.nlt_text: In that day ungodly fools will not be heroes. Scoundrels will not be respected.

verses.kjv_text: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.nlt_text: For fools speak foolishness and make evil plans. They practice ungodliness and spread false teachings about the LORD. They deprive the hungry of food and give no water to the thirsty.

verses.kjv_text: The instruments also of the churl {are} evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right. {the needy...: or, he speaketh against the poor in judgment}
verses.nlt_text: The smooth tricks of scoundrels are evil. They plot crooked schemes. They lie to convict the poor, even when the cause of the poor is just.

verses.kjv_text: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand. {stand: or, be established}
verses.nlt_text: But generous people plan to do what is generous, and they stand firm in their generosity.

verses.kjv_text: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.nlt_text: Listen, you women who lie around in ease. Listen to me, you who are so smug.

verses.kjv_text: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come. {Many...: Heb. Days above a year}
verses.nlt_text: In a short time-- just a little more than a year-- you careless ones will suddenly begin to care. For your fruit crops will fail, and the harvest will never take place.

verses.kjv_text: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird {sackcloth} upon {your} loins.
verses.nlt_text: Tremble, you women of ease; throw off your complacency. Strip off your pretty clothes, and put on burlap to show your grief.

verses.kjv_text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine. {pleasant...: Heb. fields of desire}
verses.nlt_text: Beat your breasts in sorrow for your bountiful farms and your fruitful grapevines.

verses.kjv_text: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns {and} briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy {in} the joyous city: {yea...: or, burning upon}
verses.nlt_text: For your land will be overgrown with thorns and briers. Your joyful homes and happy towns will be gone.

verses.kjv_text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks; {forts...: or, clifts and watchtowers}
verses.nlt_text: The palace and the city will be deserted, and busy towns will be empty. Wild donkeys will frolic and flocks will graze in the empty forts and watchtowers

verses.kjv_text: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.nlt_text: until at last the Spirit is poured out on us from heaven. Then the wilderness will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will yield bountiful crops.

verses.kjv_text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.nlt_text: Justice will rule in the wilderness and righteousness in the fertile field.

verses.kjv_text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.nlt_text: And this righteousness will bring peace. Yes, it will bring quietness and confidence forever.

verses.kjv_text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.nlt_text: My people will live in safety, quietly at home. They will be at rest.

verses.kjv_text: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place. {low in...: or, utterly abased}
verses.nlt_text: Even if the forest should be destroyed and the city torn down,

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {are} ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth {thither} the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.nlt_text: the LORD will greatly bless his people. Wherever they plant seed, bountiful crops will spring up. Their cattle and donkeys will graze freely.

verses.kjv_text: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou {wast} not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; {and} when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits you Assyrians, who have destroyed others but have never been destroyed yourselves. You betray others, but you have never been betrayed. When you are done destroying, you will be destroyed. When you are done betraying, you will be betrayed.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.nlt_text: But LORD, be merciful to us, for we have waited for you. Be our strong arm each day and our salvation in times of trouble.

verses.kjv_text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.nlt_text: The enemy runs at the sound of your voice. When you stand up, the nations flee!

verses.kjv_text: And your spoil shall be gathered {like} the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.nlt_text: Just as caterpillars and locusts strip the fields and vines, so the fallen army of Assyria will be stripped!

verses.kjv_text: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: Though the LORD is very great and lives in heaven, he will make Jerusalem his home of justice and righteousness.

verses.kjv_text: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, {and} strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD {is} his treasure. {salvation: Heb. salvations}
verses.nlt_text: In that day he will be your sure foundation, providing a rich store of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD will be your treasure.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly. {valiant...: or, messengers}
verses.nlt_text: But now your brave warriors weep in public. Your ambassadors of peace cry in bitter disappointment.

verses.kjv_text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.nlt_text: Your roads are deserted; no one travels them anymore. The Assyrians have broken their peace treaty and care nothing for the promises they made before witnesses. They have no respect for anyone.

verses.kjv_text: The earth mourneth {and} languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed {and} hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off {their fruits}. {hewn...: or, withered away}
verses.nlt_text: The land of Israel wilts in mourning. Lebanon withers with shame. The plain of Sharon is now a wilderness. Bashan and Carmel have been plundered.

verses.kjv_text: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD says: "I will stand up and show my power and might.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, {as} fire, shall devour you.
verses.nlt_text: You Assyrians produce nothing but dry grass and stubble. Your own breath will turn to fire and consume you.

verses.kjv_text: And the people shall be {as} the burnings of lime: {as} thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.nlt_text: Your people will be burned up completely, like thornbushes cut down and tossed in a fire.

verses.kjv_text: Hear, ye {that are} far off, what I have done; and, ye {that are} near, acknowledge my might.
verses.nlt_text: Listen to what I have done, you nations far away! And you that are near, acknowledge my might!"

verses.kjv_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.nlt_text: The sinners in Jerusalem shake with fear. Terror seizes the godless. "Who can live with this devouring fire?" they cry. "Who can survive this all-consuming fire?"

verses.kjv_text: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil; {righteously: Heb. in righteousnesses} {uprightly: Heb. uprightnesses} {oppressions: or, deceits} {blood: Heb. bloods}
verses.nlt_text: Those who are honest and fair, who refuse to profit by fraud, who stay far away from bribes, who refuse to listen to those who plot murder, who shut their eyes to all enticement to do wrong--

verses.kjv_text: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence {shall be} the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters {shall be} sure. {high: Heb. heights, or, high places}
verses.nlt_text: these are the ones who will dwell on high. The rocks of the mountains will be their fortress. Food will be supplied to them, and they will have water in abundance.

verses.kjv_text: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off. {that...: Heb. of far distances}
verses.nlt_text: Your eyes will see the king in all his splendor, and you will see a land that stretches into the distance.

verses.kjv_text: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where {is} the scribe? where {is} the receiver? where {is} he that counted the towers? {receiver: Heb. weigher?}
verses.nlt_text: You will think back to this time of terror, asking, "Where are the Assyrian officers who counted our towers? Where are the bookkeepers who recorded the plunder taken from our fallen city?"

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, {that thou canst} not understand. {stammering: or, ridiculous}
verses.nlt_text: You will no longer see these fierce, violent people with their strange, unknown language.

verses.kjv_text: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle {that} shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, you will see Zion as a place of holy festivals. You will see Jerusalem, a city quiet and secure. It will be like a tent whose ropes are taut and whose stakes are firmly fixed.

verses.kjv_text: But there the glorious LORD {will be} unto us a place of broad rivers {and} streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby. {of...: Heb. broad of spaces, or, hands}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will be our Mighty One. He will be like a wide river of protection that no enemy can cross, that no enemy ship can sail upon.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD {is} our judge, the LORD {is} our lawgiver, the LORD {is} our king; he will save us. {lawgiver: Heb. statutemaker}
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD is our judge, our lawgiver, and our king. He will care for us and save us.

verses.kjv_text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey. {Thy...: or, They have forsaken thy tacklings}
verses.nlt_text: The enemies' sails hang loose on broken masts with useless tackle. Their treasure will be divided by the people of God. Even the lame will take their share!

verses.kjv_text: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein {shall be} forgiven {their} iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel will no longer say, "We are sick and helpless," for the LORD will forgive their sins.

verses.kjv_text: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it. {all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof}
verses.nlt_text: Come here and listen, O nations of the earth. Let the world and everything in it hear my words.

verses.kjv_text: For the indignation of the LORD {is} upon all nations, and {his} fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD is enraged against the nations. His fury is against all their armies. He will completely destroy them, dooming them to slaughter.

verses.kjv_text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.nlt_text: Their dead will be left unburied, and the stench of rotting bodies will fill the land. The mountains will flow with their blood.

verses.kjv_text: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling {fig} from the fig tree.
verses.nlt_text: The heavens above will melt away and disappear like a rolled-up scroll. The stars will fall from the sky like withered leaves from a grapevine, or shriveled figs from a fig tree.

verses.kjv_text: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.nlt_text: And when my sword has finished its work in the heavens, it will fall upon Edom, the nation I have marked for destruction.

verses.kjv_text: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, {and} with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.nlt_text: The sword of the LORD is drenched with blood and covered with fat-- with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of rams prepared for sacrifice. Yes, the LORD will offer a sacrifice in the city of Bozrah. He will make a mighty slaughter in Edom.

verses.kjv_text: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness. {unicorns: or, rhinocerots} {soaked: or, drunken}
verses.nlt_text: Even men as strong as wild oxen will die-- the young men alongside the veterans. The land will be soaked with blood and the soil enriched with fat.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} the day of the LORD'S vengeance, {and} the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.nlt_text: For it is the day of the LORD's revenge, the year when Edom will be paid back for all it did to Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.nlt_text: The streams of Edom will be filled with burning pitch, and the ground will be covered with fire.

verses.kjv_text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.nlt_text: This judgment on Edom will never end; the smoke of its burning will rise forever. The land will lie deserted from generation to generation. No one will live there anymore.

verses.kjv_text: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness. {cormorant: or, pelican}
verses.nlt_text: It will be haunted by the desert owl and the screech owl, the great owl and the raven. For God will measure that land carefully; he will measure it for chaos and destruction.

verses.kjv_text: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none {shall be} there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.nlt_text: It will be called the Land of Nothing, and all its nobles will soon be gone.

verses.kjv_text: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, {and} a court for owls. {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}
verses.nlt_text: Thorns will overrun its palaces; nettles and thistles will grow in its forts. The ruins will become a haunt for jackals and a home for owls.

verses.kjv_text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest. {The wild...desert: Heb. Ziim} {the wild...island: Heb. Ijim} {screech...: or, night monster}
verses.nlt_text: Desert animals will mingle there with hyenas, their howls filling the night. Wild goats will bleat at one another among the ruins, and night creatures will come there to rest.

verses.kjv_text: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.nlt_text: There the owl will make her nest and lay her eggs. She will hatch her young and cover them with her wings. And the buzzards will come, each one with its mate.

verses.kjv_text: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.nlt_text: Search the book of the LORD, and see what he will do. Not one of these birds and animals will be missing, and none will lack a mate, for the LORD has promised this. His Spirit will make it all come true.

verses.kjv_text: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.nlt_text: He has surveyed and divided the land and deeded it over to those creatures. They will possess it forever, from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.nlt_text: Even the wilderness and desert will be glad in those days. The wasteland will rejoice and blossom with spring crocuses.

verses.kjv_text: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, {and} the excellency of our God.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, there will be an abundance of flowers and singing and joy! The deserts will become as green as the mountains of Lebanon, as lovely as Mount Carmel or the plain of Sharon. There the LORD will display his glory, the splendor of our God.

verses.kjv_text: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.nlt_text: With this news, strengthen those who have tired hands, and encourage those who have weak knees.

verses.kjv_text: Say to them {that are} of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come {with} vengeance, {even} God {with} a recompence; he will come and save you. {fearful: Heb. hasty}
verses.nlt_text: Say to those with fearful hearts, "Be strong, and do not fear, for your God is coming to destroy your enemies. He is coming to save you."

verses.kjv_text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.nlt_text: And when he comes, he will open the eyes of the blind and unplug the ears of the deaf.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the lame {man} leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.nlt_text: The lame will leap like a deer, and those who cannot speak will sing for joy! Springs will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams will water the wasteland.

verses.kjv_text: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, {shall be} grass with reeds and rushes. {grass...: or, a court for reeds, etc}
verses.nlt_text: The parched ground will become a pool, and springs of water will satisfy the thirsty land. Marsh grass and reeds and rushes will flourish where desert jackals once lived.

verses.kjv_text: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it {shall be} for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err {therein}. {but...: or, for he shall be with them}
verses.nlt_text: And a great road will go through that once deserted land. It will be named the Highway of Holiness. Evil-minded people will never travel on it. It will be only for those who walk in God's ways; fools will never walk there.

verses.kjv_text: No lion shall be there, nor {any} ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk {there}:
verses.nlt_text: Lions will not lurk along its course, nor any other ferocious beasts. There will be no other dangers. Only the redeemed will walk on it.

verses.kjv_text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.nlt_text: Those who have been ransomed by the LORD will return. They will enter Jerusalem singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Sorrow and mourning will disappear, and they will be filled with joy and gladness.

verses.kjv_text: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, {that} Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.nlt_text: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah's reign, King Sennacherib of Assyria came to attack the fortified towns of Judah and conquered them.

verses.kjv_text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king of Assyria sent his chief of staff from Lachish with a huge army to confront King Hezekiah in Jerusalem. The Assyrians took up a position beside the aqueduct that feeds water into the upper pool, near the road leading to the field where cloth is washed.

verses.kjv_text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder. {scribe: or, secretary}
verses.nlt_text: These are the officials who went out to meet with them: Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator; Shebna the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the royal historian.

verses.kjv_text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence {is} this wherein thou trustest?
verses.nlt_text: Then the Assyrian king's chief of staff told them to give this message to Hezekiah: "This is what the great king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in that makes you so confident?

verses.kjv_text: I say, {sayest thou}, (but {they are but} vain words) {I have} counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me? {vain...: Heb. a word of lips} {I have...: or, but counsel and strength are for the war}
verses.nlt_text: Do you think that mere words can substitute for military skill and strength? Who are you counting on, that you have rebelled against me?

verses.kjv_text: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so {is} Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.nlt_text: On Egypt? If you lean on Egypt, it will be like a reed that splinters beneath your weight and pierces your hand. Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, is completely unreliable!

verses.kjv_text: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: {is it} not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.nlt_text: "But perhaps you will say to me, 'We are trusting in the LORD our God!' But isn't he the one who was insulted by Hezekiah? Didn't Hezekiah tear down his shrines and altars and make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem worship only at the altar here in Jerusalem?

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them. {pledges: or, hostages}
verses.nlt_text: "I'll tell you what! Strike a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you 2,000 horses if you can find that many men to ride on them!

verses.kjv_text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.nlt_text: With your tiny army, how can you think of challenging even the weakest contingent of my master's troops, even with the help of Egypt's chariots and charioteers?

verses.kjv_text: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.nlt_text: What's more, do you think we have invaded your land without the LORD's direction? The LORD himself told us, 'Attack this land and destroy it!'"

verses.kjv_text: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand {it}: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that {are} on the wall.
verses.nlt_text: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Assyrian chief of staff, "Please speak to us in Aramaic, for we understand it well. Don't speak in Hebrew, for the people on the wall will hear."

verses.kjv_text: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? {hath he} not {sent me} to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.nlt_text: But Sennacherib's chief of staff replied, "Do you think my master sent this message only to you and your master? He wants all the people to hear it, for when we put this city under siege, they will suffer along with you. They will be so hungry and thirsty that they will eat their own dung and drink their own urine."

verses.kjv_text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.nlt_text: Then the chief of staff stood and shouted in Hebrew to the people on the wall, "Listen to this message from the great king of Assyria!

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the king says: Don't let Hezekiah deceive you. He will never be able to rescue you.

verses.kjv_text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let him fool you into trusting in the LORD by saying, 'The LORD will surely rescue us. This city will never fall into the hands of the Assyrian king!'

verses.kjv_text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make {an agreement} with me {by} a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern; {Make...: or, Seek my favour by a present: Heb. Make with me a blessing}
verses.nlt_text: "Don't listen to Hezekiah! These are the terms the king of Assyria is offering: Make peace with me-- open the gates and come out. Then each of you can continue eating from your own grapevine and fig tree and drinking from your own well.

verses.kjv_text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.nlt_text: Then I will arrange to take you to another land like this one-- a land of grain and new wine, bread and vineyards.

verses.kjv_text: {Beware} lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.nlt_text: "Don't let Hezekiah mislead you by saying, 'The LORD will rescue us!' Have the gods of any other nations ever saved their people from the king of Assyria?

verses.kjv_text: Where {are} the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where {are} the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.nlt_text: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? And what about the gods of Sepharvaim? Did any god rescue Samaria from my power?

verses.kjv_text: Who {are they} among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.nlt_text: What god of any nation has ever been able to save its people from my power? So what makes you think that the LORD can rescue Jerusalem from me?"

verses.kjv_text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.nlt_text: But the people were silent and did not utter a word because Hezekiah had commanded them, "Do not answer him."

verses.kjv_text: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with {their} clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.nlt_text: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator; Shebna the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the royal historian, went back to Hezekiah. They tore their clothes in despair, and they went in to see the king and told him what the Assyrian chief of staff had said.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard {it}, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: When King Hezekiah heard their report, he tore his clothes and put on burlap and went into the Temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent Eliakim, who {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.nlt_text: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the court secretary, and the leading priests, all dressed in burlap, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day {is} a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and {there is} not strength to bring forth. {blasphemy: or, provocation}
verses.nlt_text: They told him, "This is what King Hezekiah says: Today is a day of trouble, insults, and disgrace. It is like when a child is ready to be born, but the mother has no strength to deliver the baby.

verses.kjv_text: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up {thy} prayer for the remnant that is left. {left: Heb. found}
verses.nlt_text: But perhaps the LORD your God has heard the Assyrian chief of staff, sent by the king to defy the living God, and will punish him for his words. Oh, pray for those of us who are left!"

verses.kjv_text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.nlt_text: After King Hezekiah's officials delivered the king's message to Isaiah,

verses.kjv_text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.nlt_text: the prophet replied, "Say to your master, 'This is what the LORD says: Do not be disturbed by this blasphemous speech against me from the Assyrian king's messengers.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land. {send...: or, put a spirit into him}
verses.nlt_text: Listen! I myself will move against him, and the king will receive a message that he is needed at home. So he will return to his land, where I will have him killed with a sword.' "

verses.kjv_text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the Assyrian chief of staff left Jerusalem and went to consult the king of Assyria, who had left Lachish and was attacking Libnah.

verses.kjv_text: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard {it}, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Soon afterward King Sennacherib received word that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was leading an army to fight against him. Before leaving to meet the attack, he sent messengers back to Hezekiah in Jerusalem with this message:

verses.kjv_text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.nlt_text: "This message is for King Hezekiah of Judah. Don't let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you with promises that Jerusalem will not be captured by the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.nlt_text: You know perfectly well what the kings of Assyria have done wherever they have gone. They have completely destroyed everyone who stood in their way! Why should you be any different?

verses.kjv_text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, {as} Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which {were} in Telassar?
verses.nlt_text: Have the gods of other nations rescued them-- such nations as Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Tel-assar? My predecessors destroyed them all!

verses.kjv_text: Where {is} the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.nlt_text: What happened to the king of Hamath and the king of Arpad? What happened to the kings of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?"

verses.kjv_text: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: After Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it, he went up to the LORD's Temple and spread it out before the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.nlt_text: And Hezekiah prayed this prayer before the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest {between} the cherubims, thou {art} the God, {even} thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.nlt_text: "O LORD of Heaven's Armies, God of Israel, you are enthroned between the mighty cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the earth. You alone created the heavens and the earth.

verses.kjv_text: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
verses.nlt_text: Bend down, O LORD, and listen! Open your eyes, O LORD, and see! Listen to Sennacherib's words of defiance against the living God.

verses.kjv_text: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries, {nations: Heb. lands}
verses.nlt_text: "It is true, LORD, that the kings of Assyria have destroyed all these nations.

verses.kjv_text: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they {were} no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them. {cast: Heb. given}
verses.nlt_text: And they have thrown the gods of these nations into the fire and burned them. But of course the Assyrians could destroy them! They were not gods at all-- only idols of wood and stone shaped by human hands.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou {art} the LORD, {even} thou only.
verses.nlt_text: Now, O LORD our God, rescue us from his power; then all the kingdoms of the earth will know that you alone, O LORD, are God. "
