verses.nlt_text: How long must I see the battle flags and hear the trumpets of war?

verses.kjv_text: For my people {is} foolish, they have not known me; they {are} sottish children, and they have none understanding: they {are} wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: "My people are foolish and do not know me," says the LORD. "They are stupid children who have no understanding. They are clever enough at doing wrong, but they have no idea how to do right!"

verses.kjv_text: I beheld the earth, and, lo, {it was} without form, and void; and the heavens, and they {had} no light.
verses.nlt_text: I looked at the earth, and it was empty and formless. I looked at the heavens, and there was no light.

verses.kjv_text: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.nlt_text: I looked at the mountains and hills, and they trembled and shook.

verses.kjv_text: I beheld, and, lo, {there was} no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.nlt_text: I looked, and all the people were gone. All the birds of the sky had flown away.

verses.kjv_text: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place {was} a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, {and} by his fierce anger.
verses.nlt_text: I looked, and the fertile fields had become a wilderness. The towns lay in ruins, crushed by the LORD's fierce anger.

verses.kjv_text: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The whole land will be ruined, but I will not destroy it completely.

verses.kjv_text: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken {it}, I have purposed {it}, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.nlt_text: The earth will mourn and the heavens will be draped in black because of my decree against my people. I have made up my mind and will not change it."

verses.kjv_text: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city {shall be} forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.nlt_text: At the noise of charioteers and archers, the people flee in terror. They hide in the bushes and run for the mountains. All the towns have been abandoned-- not a person remains!

verses.kjv_text: And {when} thou {art} spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; {thy} lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life. {face: Heb. eyes}
verses.nlt_text: What are you doing, you who have been plundered? Why do you dress up in beautiful clothing and put on gold jewelry? Why do you brighten your eyes with mascara? Your primping will do you no good! The allies who were your lovers despise you and seek to kill you.

verses.kjv_text: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, {and} the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, {that} bewaileth herself, {that} spreadeth her hands, {saying}, Woe {is} me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.nlt_text: I hear a cry, like that of a woman in labor, the groans of a woman giving birth to her first child. It is beautiful Jerusalem gasping for breath and crying out, "Help! I'm being murdered!"

verses.kjv_text: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be {any} that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.nlt_text: "Run up and down every street in Jerusalem," says the LORD. "Look high and low; search throughout the city! If you can find even one just and honest person, I will not destroy the city.

verses.kjv_text: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.nlt_text: But even when they are under oath, saying, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' they are still telling lies!"

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, {are} not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, {but} they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.nlt_text: LORD, you are searching for honesty. You struck your people, but they paid no attention. You crushed them, but they refused to be corrected. They are determined, with faces set like stone; they have refused to repent.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I said, Surely these {are} poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, {nor} the judgment of their God.
verses.nlt_text: Then I said, "But what can we expect from the poor? They are ignorant. They don't know the ways of the LORD. They don't understand God's laws.

verses.kjv_text: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, {and} the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, {and} burst the bonds.
verses.nlt_text: So I will go and speak to their leaders. Surely they know the ways of the LORD and understand God's laws." But the leaders, too, as one man, had thrown off God's yoke and broken his chains.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, {and} a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, {and} their backslidings are increased. {evenings: or, deserts} {are increased: Heb. are strong}
verses.nlt_text: So now a lion from the forest will attack them; a wolf from the desert will pounce on them. A leopard will lurk near their towns, tearing apart any who dare to venture out. For their rebellion is great, and their sins are many.

verses.kjv_text: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by {them that are} no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
verses.nlt_text: "How can I pardon you? For even your children have turned from me. They have sworn by gods that are not gods at all! I fed my people until they were full. But they thanked me by committing adultery and lining up at the brothels.

verses.kjv_text: They were {as} fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
verses.nlt_text: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for his neighbor's wife.

verses.kjv_text: Shall I not visit for these {things}? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.nlt_text: Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?

verses.kjv_text: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they {are} not the LORD'S.
verses.nlt_text: "Go down the rows of the vineyards and destroy the grapevines, leaving a scattered few alive. Strip the branches from the vines, for these people do not belong to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel and Judah are full of treachery against me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: They have belied the LORD, and said, {It is} not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.nlt_text: "They have lied about the LORD and said, 'He won't bother us! No disasters will come upon us. There will be no war or famine.

verses.kjv_text: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word {is} not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.nlt_text: God's prophets are all windbags who don't really speak for him. Let their predictions of disaster fall on themselves!'"

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, this is what the LORD God of Heaven's Armies says: "Because the people are talking like this, my messages will flame out of your mouth and burn the people like kindling wood.

verses.kjv_text: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it {is} a mighty nation, it {is} an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.nlt_text: O Israel, I will bring a distant nation against you," says the LORD. "It is a mighty nation, an ancient nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you cannot understand.

verses.kjv_text: Their quiver {is} as an open sepulchre, they {are} all mighty men.
verses.nlt_text: Their weapons are deadly; their warriors are mighty.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, {which} thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.nlt_text: They will devour the food of your harvest; they will devour your sons and daughters. They will devour your flocks and herds; they will devour your grapes and figs. And they will destroy your fortified towns, which you think are so safe.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.nlt_text: "Yet even in those days I will not blot you out completely," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these {things} unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land {that is} not yours.
verses.nlt_text: "And when your people ask, 'Why did the LORD our God do all this to us?' you must reply, 'You rejected him and gave yourselves to foreign gods in your own land. Now you will serve foreigners in a land that is not your own.'

verses.kjv_text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.nlt_text: "Make this announcement to Israel, and say this to Judah:

verses.kjv_text: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not: {understanding: Heb. heart}
verses.nlt_text: Listen, you foolish and senseless people, with eyes that do not see and ears that do not hear.

verses.kjv_text: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand {for} the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.nlt_text: Have you no respect for me? Why don't you tremble in my presence? I, the LORD, define the ocean's sandy shoreline as an everlasting boundary that the waters cannot cross. The waves may toss and roar, but they can never pass the boundaries I set.

verses.kjv_text: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.nlt_text: But my people have stubborn and rebellious hearts. They have turned away and abandoned me.

verses.kjv_text: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.nlt_text: They do not say from the heart, 'Let us live in awe of the LORD our God, for he gives us rain each spring and fall, assuring us of a harvest when the time is right.'

verses.kjv_text: Your iniquities have turned away these {things}, and your sins have withholden good {things} from you.
verses.nlt_text: Your wickedness has deprived you of these wonderful blessings. Your sin has robbed you of all these good things.

verses.kjv_text: For among my people are found wicked {men}: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men. {they lay...: or, they pry as fowlers lie in wait}
verses.nlt_text: "Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait for victims like a hunter hiding in a blind. They continually set traps to catch people.

verses.kjv_text: As a cage is full of birds, so {are} their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich. {cage: or, coop}
verses.nlt_text: Like a cage filled with birds, their homes are filled with evil plots. And now they are great and rich.

verses.kjv_text: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.nlt_text: They are fat and sleek, and there is no limit to their wicked deeds. They refuse to provide justice to orphans and deny the rights of the poor.

verses.kjv_text: Shall I not visit for these {things}? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.nlt_text: Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?

verses.kjv_text: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land; {A wonderful...: or, Astonishment and filthiness}
verses.nlt_text: A horrible and shocking thing has happened in this land--

verses.kjv_text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love {to have it} so: and what will ye do in the end thereof? {bear...: or, take into their hands}
verses.nlt_text: the prophets give false prophecies, and the priests rule with an iron hand. Worse yet, my people like it that way! But what will you do when the end comes?

verses.kjv_text: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.nlt_text: "Run for your lives, you people of Benjamin! Get out of Jerusalem! Sound the alarm in Tekoa! Send up a signal at Beth-hakkerem! A powerful army is coming from the north, coming with disaster and destruction.

verses.kjv_text: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate {woman}. {comely: or, dwelling at home}
verses.nlt_text: O Jerusalem, you are my beautiful and delicate daughter-- but I will destroy you!

verses.kjv_text: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch {their} tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.nlt_text: Enemies will surround you, like shepherds camped around the city. Each chooses a place for his troops to devour.

verses.kjv_text: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.nlt_text: They shout, 'Prepare for battle! Attack at noon!' 'No, it's too late; the day is fading, and the evening shadows are falling.'

verses.kjv_text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.nlt_text: 'Well then, let's attack at night and destroy her palaces!'"

verses.kjv_text: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this {is} the city to be visited; she {is} wholly oppression in the midst of her. {cast...: or, pour out the engine of shot}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies says: "Cut down the trees for battering rams. Build siege ramps against the walls of Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished, for she is wicked through and through.

verses.kjv_text: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually {is} grief and wounds.
verses.nlt_text: She spouts evil like a fountain. Her streets echo with the sounds of violence and destruction. I always see her sickness and sores.

verses.kjv_text: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited. {depart: Heb. be loosed, or, disjointed}
verses.nlt_text: Listen to this warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn from you in disgust. Listen, or I will turn you into a heap of ruins, a land where no one lives."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies says: "Even the few who remain in Israel will be picked over again, as when a harvester checks each vine a second time to pick the grapes that were missed."

verses.kjv_text: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear {is} uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.nlt_text: To whom can I give warning? Who will listen when I speak? Their ears are closed, and they cannot hear. They scorn the word of the LORD. They don't want to listen at all.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with {him that is} full of days.
verses.nlt_text: So now I am filled with the LORD's fury. Yes, I am tired of holding it in! "I will pour out my fury on children playing in the streets and on gatherings of young men, on husbands and wives and on those who are old and gray.

verses.kjv_text: And their houses shall be turned unto others, {with their} fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Their homes will be turned over to their enemies, as will their fields and their wives. For I will raise my powerful fist against the people of this land," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one {is} given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.nlt_text: "From the least to the greatest, their lives are ruled by greed. From prophets to priests, they are all frauds.

verses.kjv_text: They have healed also the hurt {of the daughter} of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when {there is} no peace. {hurt: Heb. bruise, or, breach}
verses.nlt_text: They offer superficial treatments for my people's mortal wound. They give assurances of peace when there is no peace.

verses.kjv_text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time {that} I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Are they ashamed of their disgusting actions? Not at all-- they don't even know how to blush! Therefore, they will lie among the slaughtered. They will be brought down when I punish them," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where {is} the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk {therein}.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "Stop at the crossroads and look around. Ask for the old, godly way, and walk in it. Travel its path, and you will find rest for your souls. But you reply, 'No, that's not the road we want!'

verses.kjv_text: Also I set watchmen over you, {saying}, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.nlt_text: I posted watchmen over you who said, 'Listen for the sound of the alarm.' But you replied, 'No! We won't pay attention!'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what {is} among them.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, listen to this, all you nations. Take note of my people's situation.

verses.kjv_text: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, {even} the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.nlt_text: Listen, all the earth! I will bring disaster on my people. It is the fruit of their own schemes, because they refuse to listen to me. They have rejected my word.

verses.kjv_text: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings {are} not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.nlt_text: There's no use offering me sweet frankincense from Sheba. Keep your fragrant calamus imported from distant lands! I will not accept your burnt offerings. Your sacrifices have no pleasing aroma for me."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: "I will put obstacles in my people's path. Fathers and sons will both fall over them. Neighbors and friends will die together."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "Look! A great army coming from the north! A great nation is rising against you from far-off lands.

verses.kjv_text: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they {are} cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.nlt_text: They are armed with bows and spears. They are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like a roaring sea as they ride forward on horses. They are coming in battle formation, planning to destroy you, beautiful Jerusalem. "

verses.kjv_text: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, {and} pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.nlt_text: We have heard reports about the enemy, and we wring our hands in fright. Pangs of anguish have gripped us, like those of a woman in labor.

verses.kjv_text: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy {and} fear {is} on every side.
verses.nlt_text: Don't go out to the fields! Don't travel on the roads! The enemy's sword is everywhere and terrorizes us at every turn!

verses.kjv_text: O daughter of my people, gird {thee} with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, {as for} an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.nlt_text: Oh, my people, dress yourselves in burlap and sit among the ashes. Mourn and weep bitterly, as for the loss of an only son. For suddenly the destroying armies will be upon you!

verses.kjv_text: I have set thee {for} a tower {and} a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.nlt_text: "Jeremiah, I have made you a tester of metals, that you may determine the quality of my people.

verses.kjv_text: They {are} all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: {they are} brass and iron; they {are} all corrupters.
verses.nlt_text: They are the worst kind of rebel, full of slander. They are as hard as bronze and iron, and they lead others into corruption.

verses.kjv_text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.nlt_text: The bellows fiercely fan the flames to burn out the corruption. But it does not purify them, for the wickedness remains.

verses.kjv_text: Reprobate silver shall {men} call them, because the LORD hath rejected them. {Reprobate...: or, Refuse silver}
verses.nlt_text: I will label them 'Rejected Silver,' for I, the LORD, am discarding them."

verses.kjv_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,

verses.kjv_text: Stand in the gate of the LORD'S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all {ye of} Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "Go to the entrance of the LORD's Temple, and give this message to the people: 'O Judah, listen to this message from the LORD! Listen to it, all of you who worship here!

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, says:" 'Even now, if you quit your evil ways, I will let you stay in your own land.

verses.kjv_text: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, {are} these.
verses.nlt_text: But don't be fooled by those who promise you safety simply because the LORD's Temple is here. They chant, "The LORD's Temple is here! The LORD's Temple is here!"

verses.kjv_text: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.nlt_text: But I will be merciful only if you stop your evil thoughts and deeds and start treating each other with justice;

verses.kjv_text: {If} ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.nlt_text: only if you stop exploiting foreigners, orphans, and widows; only if you stop your murdering; and only if you stop harming yourselves by worshiping idols.

verses.kjv_text: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.nlt_text: Then I will let you stay in this land that I gave to your ancestors to keep forever.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.nlt_text: " 'Don't be fooled into thinking that you will never suffer because the Temple is here. It's a lie!

verses.kjv_text: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
verses.nlt_text: Do you really think you can steal, murder, commit adultery, lie, and burn incense to Baal and all those other new gods of yours,

verses.kjv_text: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations? {which...: Heb. whereupon my name is called}
verses.nlt_text: and then come here and stand before me in my Temple and chant, "We are safe!"-- only to go right back to all those evils again?

verses.kjv_text: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen {it}, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Don't you yourselves admit that this Temple, which bears my name, has become a den of thieves? Surely I see all the evil going on there. I, the LORD, have spoken!

verses.kjv_text: But go ye now unto my place which {was} in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.nlt_text: " 'Go now to the place at Shiloh where I once put the Tabernacle that bore my name. See what I did there because of all the wickedness of my people, the Israelites.

verses.kjv_text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.nlt_text: While you were doing these wicked things, says the LORD, I spoke to you about it repeatedly, but you would not listen. I called out to you, but you refused to answer.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore will I do unto {this} house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.nlt_text: So just as I destroyed Shiloh, I will now destroy this Temple that bears my name, this Temple that you trust in for help, this place that I gave to you and your ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, {even} the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.nlt_text: And I will send you out of my sight into exile, just as I did your relatives, the people of Israel. '

verses.kjv_text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Pray no more for these people, Jeremiah. Do not weep or pray for them, and don't beg me to help them, for I will not listen to you.

verses.kjv_text: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.nlt_text: Don't you see what they are doing throughout the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.kjv_text: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead {their} dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger. {queen...: or, frame, or, workmanship of heaven}
verses.nlt_text: No wonder I am so angry! Watch how the children gather wood and the fathers build sacrificial fires. See how the women knead dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. And they pour out liquid offerings to their other idol gods!

verses.kjv_text: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: {do they} not {provoke} themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.nlt_text: Am I the one they are hurting?" asks the LORD. "Most of all, they hurt themselves, to their own shame."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.nlt_text: So this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "I will pour out my terrible fury on this place. Its people, animals, trees, and crops will be consumed by the unquenchable fire of my anger."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Take your burnt offerings and your other sacrifices and eat them yourselves!

verses.kjv_text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices: {concerning: Heb. concerning the matter of}
verses.nlt_text: When I led your ancestors out of Egypt, it was not burnt offerings and sacrifices I wanted from them.

verses.kjv_text: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.nlt_text: This is what I told them: 'Obey me, and I will be your God, and you will be my people. Do everything as I say, and all will be well!'

verses.kjv_text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels {and} in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward. {imagination: or, stubbornness} {went: Heb. were}
verses.nlt_text: "But my people would not listen to me. They kept doing whatever they wanted, following the stubborn desires of their evil hearts. They went backward instead of forward.

verses.kjv_text: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending {them}:
verses.nlt_text: From the day your ancestors left Egypt until now, I have continued to send my servants, the prophets-- day in and day out.

verses.kjv_text: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: But my people have not listened to me or even tried to hear. They have been stubborn and sinful-- even worse than their ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Tell them all this, but do not expect them to listen. Shout out your warnings, but do not expect them to respond.

verses.kjv_text: But thou shalt say unto them, This {is} a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth. {correction: or, instruction}
verses.nlt_text: Say to them, 'This is the nation whose people will not obey the LORD their God and who refuse to be taught. Truth has vanished from among them; it is no longer heard on their lips.

verses.kjv_text: Cut off thine hair, {O Jerusalem}, and cast {it} away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.nlt_text: Shave your head in mourning, and weep alone on the mountains. For the LORD has rejected and forsaken this generation that has provoked his fury.'

verses.kjv_text: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.nlt_text: "The people of Judah have sinned before my very eyes," says the LORD. "They have set up their abominable idols right in the Temple that bears my name, defiling it.

verses.kjv_text: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which {is} in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded {them} not, neither came it into my heart. {came...: Heb. came it upon my heart}
verses.nlt_text: They have built pagan shrines at Topheth, the garbage dump in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, and there they burn their sons and daughters in the fire. I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.nlt_text: So beware, for the time is coming," says the LORD, "when that garbage dump will no longer be called Topheth or the valley of Ben-Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the bodies in Topheth until there is no more room for them.

verses.kjv_text: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray {them} away.
verses.nlt_text: The bodies of my people will be food for the vultures and wild animals, and no one will be left to scare them away.

verses.kjv_text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.nlt_text: I will put an end to the happy singing and laughter in the streets of Jerusalem. The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard in the towns of Judah. The land will lie in complete desolation.

verses.kjv_text: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.nlt_text: "In that day," says the LORD, "the enemy will break open the graves of the kings and officials of Judah, and the graves of the priests, prophets, and common people of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: They will spread out their bones on the ground before the sun, moon, and stars-- the gods my people have loved, served, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up again or buried but will be scattered on the ground like manure.

verses.kjv_text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.nlt_text: And the people of this evil nation who survive will wish to die rather than live where I will send them. I, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, have spoken!

verses.kjv_text: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.nlt_text: "Jeremiah, say to the people, 'This is what the LORD says: " 'When people fall down, don't they get up again? When they discover they're on the wrong road, don't they turn back?

verses.kjv_text: Why {then} is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.nlt_text: Then why do these people stay on their self-destructive path? Why do the people of Jerusalem refuse to turn back? They cling tightly to their lies and will not turn around.

verses.kjv_text: I hearkened and heard, {but} they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.nlt_text: I listen to their conversations and don't hear a word of truth. Is anyone sorry for doing wrong? Does anyone say, "What a terrible thing I have done"? No! All are running down the path of sin as swiftly as a horse galloping into battle!

verses.kjv_text: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Even the stork that flies across the sky knows the time of her migration, as do the turtledove, the swallow, and the crane. They all return at the proper time each year. But not my people! They do not know the LORD's laws.

verses.kjv_text: How do ye say, We {are} wise, and the law of the LORD {is} with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he {it}; the pen of the scribes {is} in vain. {in vain made...: or, the false pen of the scribes worketh for falsehood}
verses.nlt_text: " 'How can you say, "We are wise because we have the word of the LORD," when your teachers have twisted it by writing lies?

verses.kjv_text: The wise {men} are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom {is} in them? {The wise...: or, Have they been ashamed, etc} {what...: Heb. the wisdom of what thing}
verses.nlt_text: These wise teachers will fall into the trap of their own foolishness, for they have rejected the word of the LORD. Are they so wise after all?

verses.kjv_text: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, {and} their fields to them that shall inherit {them}: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.nlt_text: I will give their wives to others and their farms to strangers. From the least to the greatest, their lives are ruled by greed. Yes, even my prophets and priests are like that. They are all frauds.

verses.kjv_text: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when {there is} no peace.
verses.nlt_text: They offer superficial treatments for my people's mortal wound. They give assurances of peace when there is no peace.

verses.kjv_text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD. {I will...: or, In gathering I will consume}
verses.nlt_text: Are they ashamed of these disgusting actions? Not at all-- they don't even know how to blush! Therefore, they will lie among the slaughtered. They will be brought down when I punish them, says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: {there shall be} no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and {the things that} I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.nlt_text: I will surely consume them. There will be no more harvests of figs and grapes. Their fruit trees will all die. Whatever I gave them will soon be gone. I, the LORD, have spoken!'

verses.kjv_text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD. {gall: or, poison}
verses.nlt_text: "Then the people will say, 'Why should we wait here to die? Come, let's go to the fortified towns and die there. For the LORD our God has decreed our destruction and has given us a cup of poison to drink because we sinned against the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: We looked for peace, but no good {came; and} for a time of health, and behold trouble!
verses.nlt_text: We hoped for peace, but no peace came. We hoped for a time of healing, but found only terror.'

verses.kjv_text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein. {all...: Heb. the fulness thereof}
verses.nlt_text: "The snorting of the enemies' warhorses can be heard all the way from the land of Dan in the north! The neighing of their stallions makes the whole land tremble. They are coming to devour the land and everything in it-- cities and people alike.

verses.kjv_text: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which {will} not {be} charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I will send these enemy troops among you like poisonous snakes you cannot charm. They will bite you, and you will die. I, the Lord, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: {When} I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart {is} faint in me. {in: Heb. upon}
verses.nlt_text: My grief is beyond healing; my heart is broken.

verses.kjv_text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: {Is} not the LORD in Zion? {is} not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, {and} with strange vanities? {them...: Heb. the country of them that are far off}
verses.nlt_text: Listen to the weeping of my people; it can be heard all across the land. "Has the LORD abandoned Jerusalem? " the people ask. "Is her King no longer there?" "Oh, why have they provoked my anger with their carved idols and their worthless foreign gods?" says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.nlt_text: "The harvest is finished, and the summer is gone," the people cry, "yet we are not saved!"

verses.kjv_text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
verses.nlt_text: I hurt with the hurt of my people. I mourn and am overcome with grief.

verses.kjv_text: {Is there} no balm in Gilead; {is there} no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered? {recovered: Heb. gone up?}
verses.nlt_text: Is there no medicine in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why is there no healing for the wounds of my people?

verses.kjv_text: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people! {Oh...: Heb. Who will give my head, etc}
verses.nlt_text: If only my head were a pool of water and my eyes a fountain of tears, I would weep day and night for all my people who have been slaughtered.

verses.kjv_text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they {be} all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.nlt_text: Oh, that I could go away and forget my people and live in a travelers' shack in the desert. For they are all adulterers-- a pack of treacherous liars.

verses.kjv_text: And they bend their tongues {like} their bow {for} lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: "My people bend their tongues like bows to shoot out lies. They refuse to stand up for the truth. They only go from bad to worse. They do not know me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders. {neighbour: or, friend}
verses.nlt_text: "Beware of your neighbor! Don't even trust your brother! For brother takes advantage of brother, and friend slanders friend.

verses.kjv_text: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, {and} weary themselves to commit iniquity. {deceive: or, mock}
verses.nlt_text: They all fool and defraud each other; no one tells the truth. With practiced tongues they tell lies; they wear themselves out with all their sinning.

verses.kjv_text: Thine habitation {is} in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: They pile lie upon lie and utterly refuse to acknowledge me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, this is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies says: "See, I will melt them down in a crucible and test them like metal. What else can I do with my people?

verses.kjv_text: Their tongue {is as} an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: {one} speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait. {in heart: Heb. in the midst of him} {his wait: or, wait for him}
verses.nlt_text: For their tongues shoot lies like poisoned arrows. They speak friendly words to their neighbors while scheming in their heart to kill them.

verses.kjv_text: Shall I not visit them for these {things}? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.nlt_text: Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?"

verses.kjv_text: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through {them}; neither can {men} hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone. {habitations: or, pastures} {burned up: or, desolate} {both...: Heb. from the fowl even to, etc}
verses.nlt_text: I will weep for the mountains and wail for the wilderness pastures. For they are desolate and empty of life; the lowing of cattle is heard no more; the birds and wild animals have all fled.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, {and} a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant. {desolate: Heb. desolation}
verses.nlt_text: "I will make Jerusalem into a heap of ruins," says the LORD. "It will be a place haunted by jackals. The towns of Judah will be ghost towns, with no one living in them."

verses.kjv_text: Who {is} the wise man, that may understand this? and {who is he} to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth {and} is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
verses.nlt_text: Who is wise enough to understand all this? Who has been instructed by the LORD and can explain it to others? Why has the land been so ruined that no one dares to travel through it?

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
verses.nlt_text: The LORD replies, "This has happened because my people have abandoned my instructions; they have refused to obey what I said.

verses.kjv_text: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them: {imagination: or, stubbornness}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, they have stubbornly followed their own desires and worshiped the images of Baal, as their ancestors taught them.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, {even} this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.nlt_text: So now, this is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, says: Look! I will feed them with bitterness and give them poison to drink.

verses.kjv_text: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.nlt_text: I will scatter them around the world, in places they and their ancestors never heard of, and even there I will chase them with the sword until I have destroyed them completely."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning {women}, that they may come:
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies says: "Consider all this, and call for the mourners. Send for the women who mourn at funerals.

verses.kjv_text: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.nlt_text: Quick! Begin your weeping! Let the tears flow from your eyes.

verses.kjv_text: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast {us} out.
verses.nlt_text: Hear the people of Jerusalem crying in despair, 'We are ruined! We are completely humiliated! We must leave our land, because our homes have been torn down.' "

verses.kjv_text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.nlt_text: Listen, you women, to the words of the LORD; open your ears to what he has to say. Teach your daughters to wail; teach one another how to lament.

verses.kjv_text: For death is come up into our windows, {and} is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, {and} the young men from the streets.
verses.nlt_text: For death has crept in through our windows and has entered our mansions. It has killed off the flower of our youth: Children no longer play in the streets, and young men no longer gather in the squares.

verses.kjv_text: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather {them}.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "Bodies will be scattered across the fields like clumps of manure, like bundles of grain after the harvest. No one will be left to bury them."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise {man} glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty {man} glory in his might, let not the rich {man} glory in his riches:
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "Don't let the wise boast in their wisdom, or the powerful boast in their power, or the rich boast in their riches.

verses.kjv_text: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I {am} the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these {things} I delight, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But those who wish to boast should boast in this alone: that they truly know me and understand that I am the LORD who demonstrates unfailing love and who brings justice and righteousness to the earth, and that I delight in these things. I, the LORD, have spoken!

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all {them which are} circumcised with the uncircumcised; {punish: Heb. visit upon}
verses.nlt_text: "A time is coming," says the LORD, "when I will punish all those who are circumcised in body but not in spirit--

verses.kjv_text: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all {that are} in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all {these} nations {are} uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel {are} uncircumcised in the heart. {in the utmost...: Heb. cut off into corners, or, having the corners of their hair polled}
verses.nlt_text: the Egyptians, Edomites, Ammonites, Moabites, the people who live in the desert in remote places, and yes, even the people of Judah. And like all these pagan nations, the people of Israel also have uncircumcised hearts."

verses.kjv_text: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you, O Israel!

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "Do not act like the other nations, who try to read their future in the stars. Do not be afraid of their predictions, even though other nations are terrified by them.

verses.kjv_text: For the customs of the people {are} vain: for {one} cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe. {customs...: Heb. statutes, or, ordinances are vanity}
verses.nlt_text: Their ways are futile and foolish. They cut down a tree, and a craftsman carves an idol.

verses.kjv_text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.nlt_text: They decorate it with gold and silver and then fasten it securely with hammer and nails so it won't fall over.

verses.kjv_text: They {are} upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also {is it} in them to do good.
verses.nlt_text: Their gods are like helpless scarecrows in a cucumber field! They cannot speak, and they need to be carried because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of such gods, for they can neither harm you nor do you any good."

verses.kjv_text: Forasmuch as {there is} none like unto thee, O LORD; thou {art} great, and thy name {is} great in might.
verses.nlt_text: LORD, there is no one like you! For you are great, and your name is full of power.

verses.kjv_text: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise {men} of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, {there is} none like unto thee. {to...: or, it liketh thee}
verses.nlt_text: Who would not fear you, O King of nations? That title belongs to you alone! Among all the wise people of the earth and in all the kingdoms of the world, there is no one like you.

verses.kjv_text: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock {is} a doctrine of vanities. {altogether: Heb. in one, or, at once}
verses.nlt_text: People who worship idols are stupid and foolish. The things they worship are made of wood!

verses.kjv_text: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple {is} their clothing: they {are} all the work of cunning {men}.
verses.nlt_text: They bring beaten sheets of silver from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz, and they give these materials to skillful craftsmen who make their idols. Then they dress these gods in royal blue and purple robes made by expert tailors.

verses.kjv_text: But the LORD {is} the true God, he {is} the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation. {true...: Heb. God of truth} {living God: Heb. living Gods} {everlasting...: Heb. king of eternity}
verses.nlt_text: But the LORD is the only true God. He is the living God and the everlasting King! The whole earth trembles at his anger. The nations cannot stand up to his wrath.

verses.kjv_text: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, {even} they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.nlt_text: Say this to those who worship other gods: "Your so-called gods, who did not make the heavens and earth, will vanish from the earth and from under the heavens."

verses.kjv_text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.nlt_text: But God made the earth by his power, and he preserves it by his wisdom. With his own understanding he stretched out the heavens.

verses.kjv_text: When he uttereth his voice, {there is} a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures. {multitude: or, noise} {with: or, for}
verses.nlt_text: When he speaks in the thunder, the heavens roar with rain. He causes the clouds to rise over the earth. He sends the lightning with the rain and releases the wind from his storehouses.

verses.kjv_text: Every man is brutish in {his} knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image {is} falsehood, and {there is} no breath in them. {brutish in his knowledge: or, more brutish than to know}
verses.nlt_text: The whole human race is foolish and has no knowledge! The craftsmen are disgraced by the idols they make, for their carefully shaped works are a fraud. These idols have no breath or power.

verses.kjv_text: They {are} vanity, {and} the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.nlt_text: Idols are worthless; they are ridiculous lies! On the day of reckoning they will all be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: The portion of Jacob {is} not like them: for he {is} the former of all {things}; and Israel {is} the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts {is} his name.
verses.nlt_text: But the God of Israel is no idol! He is the Creator of everything that exists, including Israel, his own special possession. The LORD of Heaven's Armies is his name!

verses.kjv_text: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress. {inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress}
verses.nlt_text: Pack your bags and prepare to leave; the siege is about to begin.

verses.kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find {it so}.
verses.nlt_text: For this is what the LORD says: "Suddenly, I will fling out all you who live in this land. I will pour great troubles upon you, and at last you will feel my anger."

verses.kjv_text: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this {is} a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.nlt_text: My wound is severe, and my grief is great. My sickness is incurable, but I must bear it.

verses.kjv_text: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they {are} not: {there is} none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.nlt_text: My home is gone, and no one is left to help me rebuild it. My children have been taken away, and I will never see them again.

verses.kjv_text: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.nlt_text: The shepherds of my people have lost their senses. They no longer seek wisdom from the LORD. Therefore, they fail completely, and their flocks are scattered.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, {and} a den of dragons.
verses.nlt_text: Listen! Hear the terrifying roar of great armies as they roll down from the north. The towns of Judah will be destroyed and become a haunt for jackals.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, I know that the way of man {is} not in himself: {it is} not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.nlt_text: I know, LORD, that our lives are not our own. We are not able to plan our own course.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing. {bring...: Heb. diminish me}
verses.nlt_text: So correct me, LORD, but please be gentle. Do not correct me in anger, for I would die.

verses.kjv_text: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.nlt_text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that refuse to acknowledge you-- on the peoples that do not call upon your name. For they have devoured your people Israel; they have devoured and consumed them, making the land a desolate wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The LORD gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,

verses.kjv_text: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.nlt_text: "Remind the people of Judah and Jerusalem about the terms of my covenant with them.

verses.kjv_text: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed {be} the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
verses.nlt_text: Say to them, 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is anyone who does not obey the terms of my covenant!

verses.kjv_text: Which I commanded your fathers in the day {that} I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
verses.nlt_text: For I said to your ancestors when I brought them out of the iron-smelting furnace of Egypt, "If you obey me and do whatever I command you, then you will be my people, and I will be your God."

verses.kjv_text: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as {it is} this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD. {So...: Heb. Amen}
verses.nlt_text: I said this so I could keep my promise to your ancestors to give you a land flowing with milk and honey-- the land you live in today.' " Then I replied, "Amen, LORD! May it be so."

verses.kjv_text: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said, "Broadcast this message in the streets of Jerusalem. Go from town to town throughout the land and say, 'Remember the ancient covenant, and do everything it requires.

verses.kjv_text: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day {that} I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, {even} unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.nlt_text: For I solemnly warned your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, "Obey me!" I have repeated this warning over and over to this day,

verses.kjv_text: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded {them} to do; but they did {them} not. {imagination: or, stubbornness}
verses.nlt_text: but your ancestors did not listen or even pay attention. Instead, they stubbornly followed their own evil desires. And because they refused to obey, I brought upon them all the curses described in this covenant.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Again the LORD spoke to me and said, "I have discovered a conspiracy against me among the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.nlt_text: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers. They have refused to listen to me and are worshiping other gods. Israel and Judah have both broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them. {to escape: Heb. to go forth of}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: I am going to bring calamity upon them, and they will not escape. Though they beg for mercy, I will not listen to their cries.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble. {trouble: Heb. evil}
verses.nlt_text: Then the people of Judah and Jerusalem will pray to their idols and burn incense before them. But the idols will not save them when disaster strikes!

verses.kjv_text: For {according to} the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and {according to} the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to {that} shameful thing, {even} altars to burn incense unto Baal. {shameful...: Heb. shame}
verses.nlt_text: Look now, people of Judah; you have as many gods as you have towns. You have as many altars of shame-- altars for burning incense to your god Baal-- as there are streets in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear {them} in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble. {trouble: Heb. evil}
verses.nlt_text: "Pray no more for these people, Jeremiah. Do not weep or pray for them, for I will not listen to them when they cry out to me in distress.

verses.kjv_text: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, {seeing} she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest. {What...: Heb. What is to my beloved in my house} {when...: or, when thy evil is}
verses.nlt_text: "What right do my beloved people have to come to my Temple, when they have done so many immoral things? Can their vows and sacrifices prevent their destruction? They actually rejoice in doing evil!

verses.kjv_text: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, {and} of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.nlt_text: I, the LORD, once called them a thriving olive tree, beautiful to see and full of good fruit. But now I have sent the fury of their enemies to burn them with fire, leaving them charred and broken.

verses.kjv_text: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.nlt_text: "I, the LORD of Heaven's Armies, who planted this olive tree, have ordered it destroyed. For the people of Israel and Judah have done evil, arousing my anger by burning incense to Baal."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD hath given me knowledge {of it}, and I know {it}: then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD told me about the plots my enemies were making against me.

verses.kjv_text: But I {was} like a lamb {or} an ox {that} is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, {saying}, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered. {the tree...: Heb. the stalk with his bread}
verses.nlt_text: I was like a lamb being led to the slaughter. I had no idea that they were planning to kill me! "Let's destroy this man and all his words," they said. "Let's cut him down, so his name will be forgotten forever."

verses.kjv_text: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.nlt_text: O LORD of Heaven's Armies, you make righteous judgments, and you examine the deepest thoughts and secrets. Let me see your vengeance against them, for I have committed my cause to you.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says about the men of Anathoth who wanted me dead. They had said, "We will kill you if you do not stop prophesying in the LORD's name."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine: {punish: Heb. visit upon}
verses.nlt_text: So this is what the LORD of Heaven's Armies says about them: "I will punish them! Their young men will die in battle, and their boys and girls will starve to death.

verses.kjv_text: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, {even} the year of their visitation.
verses.nlt_text: Not one of these plotters from Anathoth will survive, for I will bring disaster upon them when their time of punishment comes."

verses.kjv_text: Righteous {art} thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of {thy} judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? {wherefore} are all they happy that deal very treacherously? {talk...: or, reason the case with thee}
verses.nlt_text: LORD, you always give me justice when I bring a case before you. So let me bring you this complaint: Why are the wicked so prosperous? Why are evil people so happy?

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou {art} near in their mouth, and far from their reins. {they grow: Heb. they go on}
verses.nlt_text: You have planted them, and they have taken root and prospered. Your name is on their lips, but you are far from their hearts.

verses.kjv_text: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter. {toward...: Heb. with thee}
verses.nlt_text: But as for me, LORD, you know my heart. You see me and test my thoughts. Drag these people away like sheep to be butchered! Set them aside to be slaughtered!

verses.kjv_text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.nlt_text: How long must this land mourn? Even the grass in the fields has withered. The wild animals and birds have disappeared because of the evil in the land. For the people have said, "The LORD doesn't see what's ahead for us!"

verses.kjv_text: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and {if} in the land of peace, {wherein} thou trustedst, {they wearied thee}, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.nlt_text: "If racing against mere men makes you tired, how will you race against horses? If you stumble and fall on open ground, what will you do in the thickets near the Jordan?

verses.kjv_text: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee. {they have called...: or, they cried after thee fully} {fair...: Heb. good things}
verses.nlt_text: Even your brothers, members of your own family, have turned against you. They plot and raise complaints against you. Do not trust them, no matter how pleasantly they speak.

verses.kjv_text: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies. {the dearly...: Heb. the love}
verses.nlt_text: "I have abandoned my people, my special possession. I have surrendered my dearest ones to their enemies.

verses.kjv_text: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it. {crieth...: or, yelleth: Heb. giveth out his voice}
verses.nlt_text: My chosen people have roared at me like a lion of the forest, so I have treated them with contempt.

verses.kjv_text: Mine heritage {is} unto me {as} a speckled bird, the birds round about {are} against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour. {speckled: or, taloned} {come to: or, cause them to come to}
verses.nlt_text: My chosen people act like speckled vultures, but they themselves are surrounded by vultures. Bring on the wild animals to pick their corpses clean!

verses.kjv_text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness. {pleasant...: Heb. portion of desire}
verses.nlt_text: "Many rulers have ravaged my vineyard, trampling down the vines and turning all its beauty into a barren wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: They have made it desolate, {and being} desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth {it} to heart.
verses.nlt_text: They have made it an empty wasteland; I hear its mournful cry. The whole land is desolate, and no one even cares.

verses.kjv_text: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the {one} end of the land even to the {other} end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
verses.nlt_text: On all the bare hilltops, destroying armies can be seen. The sword of the LORD devours people from one end of the nation to the other. No one will escape!

verses.kjv_text: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, {but} shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD. {they shall: or, ye shall}
verses.nlt_text: My people have planted wheat but are harvesting thorns. They have worn themselves out, but it has done them no good. They will harvest a crop of shame because of the fierce anger of the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
verses.nlt_text: Now this is what the LORD says: "I will uproot from their land all the evil nations reaching out for the possession I gave my people Israel. And I will uproot Judah from among them.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
verses.nlt_text: But afterward I will return and have compassion on all of them. I will bring them home to their own lands again, each nation to its own possession.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
verses.nlt_text: And if these nations truly learn the ways of my people, and if they learn to swear by my name, saying, 'As surely as the LORD lives' (just as they taught my people to swear by the name of Baal), then they will be given a place among my people.

verses.kjv_text: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: But any nation who refuses to obey me will be uprooted and destroyed. I, the LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and buy a linen loincloth and put it on, but do not wash it."

verses.kjv_text: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put {it} on my loins.
verses.nlt_text: So I bought the loincloth as the LORD directed me, and I put it on.

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD gave me another message:

verses.kjv_text: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which {is} upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.nlt_text: "Take the linen loincloth you are wearing, and go to the Euphrates River. Hide it there in a hole in the rocks."

verses.kjv_text: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.nlt_text: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates as the LORD had instructed me.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
verses.nlt_text: A long time afterward the LORD said to me, "Go back to the Euphrates and get the loincloth I told you to hide there."

verses.kjv_text: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.nlt_text: So I went to the Euphrates and dug it out of the hole where I had hidden it. But now it was rotting and falling apart. The loincloth was good for nothing.

verses.kjv_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then I received this message from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the LORD says: This shows how I will rot away the pride of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing. {imagination: or, stubbornness}
verses.nlt_text: These wicked people refuse to listen to me. They stubbornly follow their own desires and worship other gods. Therefore, they will become like this loincloth-- good for nothing!

verses.kjv_text: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
