verses.nlt_text: He has dragged me off the path and torn me in pieces, leaving me helpless and devastated.

verses.kjv_text: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.nlt_text: He has drawn his bow and made me the target for his arrows.

verses.kjv_text: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins. {arrows: Heb. sons}
verses.nlt_text: He shot his arrows deep into my heart.

verses.kjv_text: I was a derision to all my people; {and} their song all the day.
verses.nlt_text: My own people laugh at me. All day long they sing their mocking songs.

verses.kjv_text: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood. {bitterness: Heb. bitternesses}
verses.nlt_text: He has filled me with bitterness and given me a bitter cup of sorrow to drink.

verses.kjv_text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes. {covered...: or, rolled me in the ashes}
verses.nlt_text: He has made me chew on gravel. He has rolled me in the dust.

verses.kjv_text: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity. {prosperity: Heb. good}
verses.nlt_text: Peace has been stripped away, and I have forgotten what prosperity is.

verses.kjv_text: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: I cry out, "My splendor is gone! Everything I had hoped for from the LORD is lost!"

verses.kjv_text: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall. {Remembering: or, Remember}
verses.nlt_text: The thought of my suffering and homelessness is bitter beyond words.

verses.kjv_text: My soul hath {them} still in remembrance, and is humbled in me. {humbled: Heb. bowed}
verses.nlt_text: I will never forget this awful time, as I grieve over my loss.

verses.kjv_text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope. {recall...: Heb. make to return to my heart}
verses.nlt_text: Yet I still dare to hope when I remember this:

verses.kjv_text: {It is of} the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.nlt_text: The faithful love of the LORD never ends! His mercies never cease.

verses.kjv_text: {They are} new every morning: great {is} thy faithfulness.
verses.nlt_text: Great is his faithfulness; his mercies begin afresh each morning.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD {is} my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.nlt_text: I say to myself, "The LORD is my inheritance; therefore, I will hope in him!"

verses.kjv_text: The LORD {is} good unto them that wait for him, to the soul {that} seeketh him.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD is good to those who depend on him, to those who search for him.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} good that {a man} should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: So it is good to wait quietly for salvation from the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.nlt_text: And it is good for people to submit at an early age to the yoke of his discipline:

verses.kjv_text: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne {it} upon him.
verses.nlt_text: Let them sit alone in silence beneath the LORD's demands.

verses.kjv_text: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.nlt_text: Let them lie face down in the dust, for there may be hope at last.

verses.kjv_text: He giveth {his} cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.nlt_text: Let them turn the other cheek to those who strike them and accept the insults of their enemies.

verses.kjv_text: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.nlt_text: For no one is abandoned by the Lord forever.

verses.kjv_text: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.nlt_text: Though he brings grief, he also shows compassion because of the greatness of his unfailing love.

verses.kjv_text: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men. {willingly: Heb. from his heart}
verses.nlt_text: For he does not enjoy hurting people or causing them sorrow.

verses.kjv_text: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.nlt_text: If people crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,

verses.kjv_text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High, {the most High: or, a superior}
verses.nlt_text: if they deprive others of their rights in defiance of the Most High,

verses.kjv_text: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not. {approveth not: or, seeth not}
verses.nlt_text: if they twist justice in the courts-- doesn't the Lord see all these things?

verses.kjv_text: Who {is} he {that} saith, and it cometh to pass, {when} the Lord commandeth {it} not?
verses.nlt_text: Who can command things to happen without the Lord's permission?

verses.kjv_text: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.nlt_text: Does not the Most High send both calamity and good?

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins? {complain: or, murmur}
verses.nlt_text: Then why should we, mere humans, complain when we are punished for our sins?

verses.kjv_text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, let us test and examine our ways. Let us turn back to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Let us lift up our heart with {our} hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.nlt_text: Let us lift our hearts and hands to God in heaven and say,

verses.kjv_text: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.nlt_text: "We have sinned and rebelled, and you have not forgiven us.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.nlt_text: "You have engulfed us with your anger, chased us down, and slaughtered us without mercy.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that {our} prayer should not pass through.
verses.nlt_text: You have hidden yourself in a cloud so our prayers cannot reach you.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast made us {as} the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.nlt_text: You have discarded us as refuse and garbage among the nations.

verses.kjv_text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.nlt_text: "All our enemies have spoken out against us.

verses.kjv_text: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.nlt_text: We are filled with fear, for we are trapped, devastated, and ruined."

verses.kjv_text: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.nlt_text: Tears stream from my eyes because of the destruction of my people!

verses.kjv_text: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.nlt_text: My tears flow endlessly; they will not stop

verses.kjv_text: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.

verses.kjv_text: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city. {mine heart: Heb. my soul} {because...: or, more than all}
verses.nlt_text: My heart is breaking over the fate of all the women of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.nlt_text: My enemies, whom I have never harmed, hunted me down like a bird.

verses.kjv_text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.nlt_text: They threw me into a pit and dropped stones on me.

verses.kjv_text: Waters flowed over mine head; {then} I said, I am cut off.
verses.nlt_text: The water rose over my head, and I cried out, "This is the end!"

verses.kjv_text: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.nlt_text: But I called on your name, LORD, from deep within the pit.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.nlt_text: You heard me when I cried, "Listen to my pleading! Hear my cry for help!"

verses.kjv_text: Thou drewest near in the day {that} I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, you came when I called; you told me, "Do not fear."

verses.kjv_text: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.nlt_text: Lord, you are my lawyer! Plead my case! For you have redeemed my life.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.nlt_text: You have seen the wrong they have done to me, LORD. Be my judge, and prove me right.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast seen all their vengeance {and} all their imaginations against me.
verses.nlt_text: You have seen the vengeful plots my enemies have laid against me.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, {and} all their imaginations against me;
verses.nlt_text: LORD, you have heard the vile names they call me. You know all about the plans they have made.

verses.kjv_text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.nlt_text: My enemies whisper and mutter as they plot against me all day long.

verses.kjv_text: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I {am} their musick.
verses.nlt_text: Look at them! Whether they sit or stand, I am the object of their mocking songs.

verses.kjv_text: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.nlt_text: Pay them back, LORD, for all the evil they have done.

verses.kjv_text: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them. {sorrow...: or, obstinacy of heart}
verses.nlt_text: Give them hard and stubborn hearts, and then let your curse fall on them!

verses.kjv_text: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Chase them down in your anger, destroying them beneath the LORD's heavens.

verses.kjv_text: How is the gold become dim! {how} is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
verses.nlt_text: How the gold has lost its luster! Even the finest gold has become dull. The sacred gemstones lie scattered in the streets!

verses.kjv_text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.nlt_text: See how the precious children of Jerusalem, worth their weight in fine gold, are now treated like pots of clay made by a common potter.

verses.kjv_text: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people {is become} cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness. {sea...: or, sea calves}
verses.nlt_text: Even the jackals feed their young, but not my people Israel. They ignore their children's cries, like ostriches in the desert.

verses.kjv_text: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, {and} no man breaketh {it} unto them.
verses.nlt_text: The parched tongues of their little ones stick to the roofs of their mouths in thirst. The children cry for bread, but no one has any to give them.

verses.kjv_text: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.nlt_text: The people who once ate the richest foods now beg in the streets for anything they can get. Those who once wore the finest clothes now search the garbage dumps for food.

verses.kjv_text: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her. {punishment of the iniquity: or, iniquity}
verses.nlt_text: The guilt of my people is greater than that of Sodom, where utter disaster struck in a moment and no hand offered help.

verses.kjv_text: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing {was} of sapphire:
verses.nlt_text: Our princes once glowed with health-- brighter than snow, whiter than milk. Their faces were as ruddy as rubies, their appearance like fine jewels.

verses.kjv_text: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick. {blacker...: Heb. darker than blackness}
verses.nlt_text: But now their faces are blacker than soot. No one recognizes them in the streets. Their skin sticks to their bones; it is as dry and hard as wood.

verses.kjv_text: {They that be} slain with the sword are better than {they that be} slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for {want of} the fruits of the field. {pine...: Heb. flow out}
verses.nlt_text: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger. Starving, they waste away for lack of food from the fields.

verses.kjv_text: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.nlt_text: Tenderhearted women have cooked their own children. They have eaten them to survive the siege.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.nlt_text: But now the anger of the LORD is satisfied. His fierce anger has been poured out. He started a fire in Jerusalem that burned the city to its foundations.

verses.kjv_text: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Not a king in all the earth-- no one in all the world-- would have believed that an enemy could march through the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: For the sins of her prophets, {and} the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
verses.nlt_text: Yet it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the sins of her priests, who defiled the city by shedding innocent blood.

verses.kjv_text: They have wandered {as} blind {men} in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments. {so...: or, in that they could not but touch}
verses.nlt_text: They wandered blindly through the streets, so defiled by blood that no one dared touch them.

verses.kjv_text: They cried unto them, Depart ye; {it is} unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn {there}. {it...: or, ye polluted}
verses.nlt_text: "Get away!" the people shouted at them. "You're defiled! Don't touch us!" So they fled to distant lands and wandered among foreign nations, but none would let them stay.

verses.kjv_text: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders. {anger: or, face}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD himself has scattered them, and he no longer helps them. People show no respect for the priests and no longer honor the leaders.

verses.kjv_text: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation {that} could not save {us}.
verses.nlt_text: We looked in vain for our allies to come and save us, but we were looking to nations that could not help us.

verses.kjv_text: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.nlt_text: We couldn't go into the streets without danger to our lives. Our end was near; our days were numbered. We were doomed!

verses.kjv_text: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: Our enemies were swifter than eagles in flight. If we fled to the mountains, they found us. If we hid in the wilderness, they were waiting for us there.

verses.kjv_text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
verses.nlt_text: Our king-- the LORD's anointed, the very life of our nation-- was caught in their snares. We had thought that his shadow would protect us against any nation on earth!

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.nlt_text: Are you rejoicing in the land of Uz, O people of Edom? But you, too, must drink from the cup of the LORD's anger. You, too, will be stripped naked in your drunkenness.

verses.kjv_text: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins. {The...: or, Thine iniquity} {discover...: or, carry thee captive for thy sins}
verses.nlt_text: O beautiful Jerusalem, your punishment will end; you will soon return from exile. But Edom, your punishment is just beginning; soon your many sins will be exposed.

verses.kjv_text: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.nlt_text: LORD, remember what has happened to us. See how we have been disgraced!

verses.kjv_text: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.nlt_text: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.

verses.kjv_text: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers {are} as widows.
verses.nlt_text: We are orphaned and fatherless. Our mothers are widowed.

verses.kjv_text: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us. {is...: Heb. cometh for price}
verses.nlt_text: We have to pay for water to drink, and even firewood is expensive.

verses.kjv_text: Our necks {are} under persecution: we labour, {and} have no rest. {Our...: Heb. On our necks are we persecuted}
verses.nlt_text: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are exhausted but are given no rest.

verses.kjv_text: We have given the hand {to} the Egyptians, {and to} the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.nlt_text: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough food to survive.

verses.kjv_text: Our fathers have sinned, {and are} not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.nlt_text: Our ancestors sinned, but they have died-- and we are suffering the punishment they deserved!

verses.kjv_text: Servants have ruled over us: {there is} none that doth deliver {us} out of their hand.
verses.nlt_text: Slaves have now become our masters; there is no one left to rescue us.

verses.kjv_text: We gat our bread with {the peril of} our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: We hunt for food at the risk of our lives, for violence rules the countryside.

verses.kjv_text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine. {terrible: or, terrors, or, storms}
verses.nlt_text: The famine has blackened our skin as though baked in an oven.

verses.kjv_text: They ravished the women in Zion, {and} the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.nlt_text: Our enemies rape the women in Jerusalem and the young girls in all the towns of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.nlt_text: Our princes are being hanged by their thumbs, and our elders are treated with contempt.

verses.kjv_text: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.nlt_text: Young men are led away to work at millstones, and boys stagger under heavy loads of wood.

verses.kjv_text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.nlt_text: The elders no longer sit in the city gates; the young men no longer dance and sing.

verses.kjv_text: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.nlt_text: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.

verses.kjv_text: The crown is fallen {from} our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned! {The...: Heb. The crown of our head is fallen}
verses.nlt_text: The garlands have fallen from our heads. Weep for us because we have sinned.

verses.kjv_text: For this our heart is faint; for these {things} our eyes are dim.
verses.nlt_text: Our hearts are sick and weary, and our eyes grow dim with tears.

verses.kjv_text: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.nlt_text: For Jerusalem is empty and desolate, a place haunted by jackals.

verses.kjv_text: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.nlt_text: But LORD, you remain the same forever! Your throne continues from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, {and} forsake us so long time? {so...: Heb. for length of days?}
verses.nlt_text: Why do you continue to forget us? Why have you abandoned us for so long?

verses.kjv_text: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.nlt_text: Restore us, O LORD, and bring us back to you again! Give us back the joys we once had!

verses.kjv_text: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us. {But...: or, For wilt thou utterly reject us?}
verses.nlt_text: Or have you utterly rejected us? Are you angry with us still?

verses.kjv_text: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth {month}, in the fifth {day} of the month, as I {was} among the captives by the river of Chebar, {that} the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God. {captives: Heb. captivity}
verses.nlt_text: On July 31 of my thirtieth year, while I was with the Judean exiles beside the Kebar River in Babylon, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.

verses.kjv_text: In the fifth {day} of the month, which {was} the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
verses.nlt_text: This happened during the fifth year of King Jehoiachin's captivity.

verses.kjv_text: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him. {Ezekiel: Heb. Jehezkel}
verses.nlt_text: (The LORD gave this message to Ezekiel son of Buzi, a priest, beside the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians, and he felt the hand of the LORD take hold of him.)

verses.kjv_text: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness {was} about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire. {infolding...: Heb. catching itself}
verses.nlt_text: As I looked, I saw a great storm coming from the north, driving before it a huge cloud that flashed with lightning and shone with brilliant light. There was fire inside the cloud, and in the middle of the fire glowed something like gleaming amber.

verses.kjv_text: Also out of the midst thereof {came} the likeness of four living creatures. And this {was} their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
verses.nlt_text: From the center of the cloud came four living beings that looked human,

verses.kjv_text: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
verses.nlt_text: except that each had four faces and four wings.

verses.kjv_text: And their feet {were} straight feet; and the sole of their feet {was} like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass. {straight...: Heb. a straight foot}
verses.nlt_text: Their legs were straight, and their feet had hooves like those of a calf and shone like burnished bronze.

verses.kjv_text: And {they had} the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
verses.nlt_text: Under each of their four wings I could see human hands. So each of the four beings had four faces and four wings.

verses.kjv_text: Their wings {were} joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.nlt_text: The wings of each living being touched the wings of the beings beside it. Each one moved straight forward in any direction without turning around.

verses.kjv_text: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
verses.nlt_text: Each had a human face in the front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and the face of an eagle at the back.

verses.kjv_text: Thus {were} their faces: and their wings {were} stretched upward; two {wings} of every one {were} joined one to another, and two covered their bodies. {stretched...: or, divided above}
verses.nlt_text: Each had two pairs of outstretched wings-- one pair stretched out to touch the wings of the living beings on either side of it, and the other pair covered its body.

verses.kjv_text: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; {and} they turned not when they went.
verses.nlt_text: They went in whatever direction the spirit chose, and they moved straight forward in any direction without turning around.

verses.kjv_text: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance {was} like burning coals of fire, {and} like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.nlt_text: The living beings looked like bright coals of fire or brilliant torches, and lightning seemed to flash back and forth among them.

verses.kjv_text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.nlt_text: And the living beings darted to and fro like flashes of lightning.

verses.kjv_text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
verses.nlt_text: As I looked at these beings, I saw four wheels touching the ground beside them, one wheel belonging to each.

verses.kjv_text: The appearance of the wheels and their work {was} like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work {was} as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.nlt_text: The wheels sparkled as if made of beryl. All four wheels looked alike and were made the same; each wheel had a second wheel turning crosswise within it.

verses.kjv_text: When they went, they went upon their four sides: {and} they turned not when they went.
verses.nlt_text: The beings could move in any of the four directions they faced, without turning as they moved.

verses.kjv_text: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings {were} full of eyes round about them four. {and their rings: or, and their strakes}
verses.nlt_text: The rims of the four wheels were tall and frightening, and they were covered with eyes all around.

verses.kjv_text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.nlt_text: When the living beings moved, the wheels moved with them. When they flew upward, the wheels went up, too.

verses.kjv_text: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither {was their} spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature {was} in the wheels. {of...: or, of life}
verses.nlt_text: The spirit of the living beings was in the wheels. So wherever the spirit went, the wheels and the living beings also went.

verses.kjv_text: When those went, {these} went; and when those stood, {these} stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature {was} in the wheels. {of...: or, of life}
verses.nlt_text: When the beings moved, the wheels moved. When the beings stopped, the wheels stopped. When the beings flew upward, the wheels rose up, for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.

verses.kjv_text: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature {was} as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.nlt_text: Spread out above them was a surface like the sky, glittering like crystal.

verses.kjv_text: And under the firmament {were} their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.nlt_text: Beneath this surface the wings of each living being stretched out to touch the others' wings, and each had two wings covering its body.

verses.kjv_text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.nlt_text: As they flew, their wings sounded to me like waves crashing against the shore or like the voice of the Almighty or like the shouting of a mighty army. When they stopped, they let down their wings.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a voice from the firmament that {was} over their heads, when they stood, {and} had let down their wings.
verses.nlt_text: As they stood with wings lowered, a voice spoke from beyond the crystal surface above them.

verses.kjv_text: And above the firmament that {was} over their heads {was} the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne {was} the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
verses.nlt_text: Above this surface was something that looked like a throne made of blue lapis lazuli. And on this throne high above was a figure whose appearance resembled a man.

verses.kjv_text: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
verses.nlt_text: From what appeared to be his waist up, he looked like gleaming amber, flickering like a fire. And from his waist down, he looked like a burning flame, shining with splendor.

verses.kjv_text: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so {was} the appearance of the brightness round about. This {was} the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw {it}, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.nlt_text: All around him was a glowing halo, like a rainbow shining in the clouds on a rainy day. This is what the glory of the LORD looked like to me. When I saw it, I fell face down on the ground, and I heard someone's voice speaking to me.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Stand up, son of man," said the voice. "I want to speak with you."

verses.kjv_text: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit came into me as he spoke, and he set me on my feet. I listened carefully to his words.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, {even} unto this very day. {nation: Heb. nations}
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man," he said, "I am sending you to the nation of Israel, a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me. They and their ancestors have been rebelling against me to this very day.

verses.kjv_text: For {they are} impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD. {impudent: Heb. hard of face}
verses.nlt_text: They are a stubborn and hard-hearted people. But I am sending you to say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says!'

verses.kjv_text: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they {are} a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
verses.nlt_text: And whether they listen or refuse to listen-- for remember, they are rebels-- at least they will know they have had a prophet among them.

verses.kjv_text: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns {be} with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they {be} a rebellious house. {briers...: or, rebels}
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, do not fear them or their words. Don't be afraid even though their threats surround you like nettles and briers and stinging scorpions. Do not be dismayed by their dark scowls, even though they are rebels.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they {are} most rebellious. {most...: Heb. rebellion}
verses.nlt_text: You must give them my messages whether they listen or not. But they won't listen, for they are completely rebellious!

verses.kjv_text: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
verses.nlt_text: Son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not join them in their rebellion. Open your mouth, and eat what I give you."

verses.kjv_text: And when I looked, behold, an hand {was} sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book {was} therein;
verses.nlt_text: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me. It held a scroll,

verses.kjv_text: And he spread it before me; and it {was} written within and without: and {there was} written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
verses.nlt_text: which he unrolled. And I saw that both sides were covered with funeral songs, words of sorrow, and pronouncements of doom.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: The voice said to me, "Son of man, eat what I am giving you-- eat this scroll! Then go and give its message to the people of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
verses.nlt_text: So I opened my mouth, and he fed me the scroll.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat {it}; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.nlt_text: "Fill your stomach with this," he said. And when I ate it, it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Son of man, go to the people of Israel and give them my messages.

verses.kjv_text: For thou {art} not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, {but} to the house of Israel; {of a...: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of tongue}
verses.nlt_text: I am not sending you to a foreign people whose language you cannot understand.

verses.kjv_text: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee. {of a...: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of language} {Surely...: or, If I had sent thee, etc. would they not have hearkened unto thee?}
verses.nlt_text: No, I am not sending you to people with strange and difficult speech. If I did, they would listen!

verses.kjv_text: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel {are} impudent and hardhearted. {impudent...: Heb. stiff of forehead, and hard of heart}
verses.nlt_text: But the people of Israel won't listen to you any more than they listen to me! For the whole lot of them are hard-hearted and stubborn.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.nlt_text: But look, I have made you as obstinate and hard-hearted as they are.

verses.kjv_text: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they {be} a rebellious house.
verses.nlt_text: I have made your forehead as hard as the hardest rock! So don't be afraid of them or fear their angry looks, even though they are rebels."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
verses.nlt_text: Then he added, "Son of man, let all my words sink deep into your own heart first. Listen to them carefully for yourself.

verses.kjv_text: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
verses.nlt_text: Then go to your people in exile and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says!' Do this whether they listen to you or not."

verses.kjv_text: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, {saying}, Blessed {be} the glory of the LORD from his place.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a loud rumbling sound behind me. (May the glory of the LORD be praised in his place!)

verses.kjv_text: {I heard} also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing. {touched: Heb. kissed}
verses.nlt_text: It was the sound of the wings of the living beings as they brushed against each other and the rumbling of their wheels beneath them.

verses.kjv_text: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me. {in bitterness: Heb. bitter} {heat: Heb. hot anger}
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit lifted me up and took me away. I went in bitterness and turmoil, but the LORD's hold on me was strong.

verses.kjv_text: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.nlt_text: Then I came to the colony of Judean exiles in Tel-abib, beside the Kebar River. I was overwhelmed and sat among them for seven days.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: After seven days the LORD gave me a message. He said,

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for Israel. Whenever you receive a message from me, warn people immediately.

verses.kjv_text: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked {man} shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.nlt_text: If I warn the wicked, saying, 'You are under the penalty of death,' but you fail to deliver the warning, they will die in their sins. And I will hold you responsible for their deaths.

verses.kjv_text: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.nlt_text: If you warn them and they refuse to repent and keep on sinning, they will die in their sins. But you will have saved yourself because you obeyed me.

verses.kjv_text: Again, When a righteous {man} doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand. {righteousness which: Heb. righteousnesses}
verses.nlt_text: "If righteous people turn away from their righteous behavior and ignore the obstacles I put in their way, they will die. And if you do not warn them, they will die in their sins. None of their righteous acts will be remembered, and I will hold you responsible for their deaths.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous {man}, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.nlt_text: But if you warn righteous people not to sin and they listen to you and do not sin, they will live, and you will have saved yourself, too."

verses.kjv_text: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD took hold of me and said, "Get up and go out into the valley, and I will speak to you there."

verses.kjv_text: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
verses.nlt_text: So I got up and went, and there I saw the glory of the LORD, just as I had seen in my first vision by the Kebar River. And I fell face down on the ground.

verses.kjv_text: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Spirit came into me and set me on my feet. He spoke to me and said, "Go to your house and shut yourself in.

verses.kjv_text: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
verses.nlt_text: There, son of man, you will be tied with ropes so you cannot go out among the people.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they {are} a rebellious house. {a reprover: Heb. a man reproving}
verses.nlt_text: And I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be speechless and unable to rebuke them, for they are rebels.

verses.kjv_text: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they {are} a rebellious house.
verses.nlt_text: But when I give you a message, I will loosen your tongue and let you speak. Then you will say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says!' Those who choose to listen will listen, but those who refuse will refuse, for they are rebels.

verses.kjv_text: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, {even} Jerusalem:
verses.nlt_text: "And now, son of man, take a large clay brick and set it down in front of you. Then draw a map of the city of Jerusalem on it.

verses.kjv_text: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set {battering} rams against it round about. {battering...: chief leaders}
verses.nlt_text: Show the city under siege. Build a wall around it so no one can escape. Set up the enemy camp, and surround the city with siege ramps and battering rams.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it {for} a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This {shall be} a sign to the house of Israel. {an...: or, a flat plate, or, slice}
verses.nlt_text: Then take an iron griddle and place it between you and the city. Turn toward the city and demonstrate how harsh the siege will be against Jerusalem. This will be a warning to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: {according} to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: "Now lie on your left side and place the sins of Israel on yourself. You are to bear their sins for the number of days you lie there on your side.

verses.kjv_text: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: I am requiring you to bear Israel's sins for 390 days-- one day for each year of their sin.

verses.kjv_text: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year. {each...: Heb. a day for a year, a day for a year}
verses.nlt_text: After that, turn over and lie on your right side for 40 days-- one day for each year of Judah's sin.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm {shall be} uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
verses.nlt_text: "Meanwhile, keep staring at the siege of Jerusalem. Lie there with your arm bared and prophesy her destruction.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege. {from one...: Heb. from thy side to thy side}
verses.nlt_text: I will tie you up with ropes so you won't be able to turn from side to side until the days of your siege have been completed.

verses.kjv_text: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, {according} to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof. {fitches: or, spelt}
verses.nlt_text: "Now go and get some wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and emmer wheat, and mix them together in a storage jar. Use them to make bread for yourself during the 390 days you will be lying on your side.

verses.kjv_text: And thy meat which thou shalt eat {shall be} by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
verses.nlt_text: Ration this out to yourself, eight ounces of food for each day, and eat it at set times.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
verses.nlt_text: Then measure out a jar of water for each day, and drink it at set times.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt eat it {as} barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
verses.nlt_text: Prepare and eat this food as you would barley cakes. While all the people are watching, bake it over a fire using dried human dung as fuel and then eat the bread."

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said, "This is how Israel will eat defiled bread in the Gentile lands to which I will banish them!"

verses.kjv_text: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: Then I said, "O Sovereign LORD, must I be defiled by using human dung? For I have never been defiled before. From the time I was a child until now I have never eaten any animal that died of sickness or was killed by other animals. I have never eaten any meat forbidden by the law."

verses.kjv_text: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
verses.nlt_text: "All right," the LORD said. "You may bake your bread with cow dung instead of human dung."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
verses.nlt_text: Then he told me, "Son of man, I will make food very scarce in Jerusalem. It will be weighed out with great care and eaten fearfully. The water will be rationed out drop by drop, and the people will drink it with dismay.

verses.kjv_text: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: Lacking food and water, people will look at one another in terror, and they will waste away under their punishment.

verses.kjv_text: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause {it} to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the {hair}.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a razor to shave your head and beard. Use a scale to weigh the hair into three equal parts.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, {and} smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.nlt_text: Place a third of it at the center of your map of Jerusalem. After acting out the siege, burn it there. Scatter another third across your map and chop it with a sword. Scatter the last third to the wind, for I will scatter my people with the sword.

verses.kjv_text: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts. {skirts: Heb. wings}
verses.nlt_text: Keep just a bit of the hair and tie it up in your robe.

verses.kjv_text: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; {for} thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then take some of these hairs out and throw them into the fire, burning them up. A fire will then spread from this remnant and destroy all of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This {is} Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries {that are} round about her.
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This is an illustration of what will happen to Jerusalem. I placed her at the center of the nations,

verses.kjv_text: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that {are} round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
verses.nlt_text: but she has rebelled against my regulations and decrees and has been even more wicked than the surrounding nations. She has refused to obey the regulations and decrees I gave her to follow.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that {are} round about you, {and} have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that {are} round about you;
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: You people have behaved worse than your neighbors and have refused to obey my decrees and regulations. You have not even lived up to the standards of the nations around you.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, {am} against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, I myself, the Sovereign LORD, am now your enemy. I will punish you publicly while all the nations watch.

verses.kjv_text: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
verses.nlt_text: Because of your detestable idols, I will punish you like I have never punished anyone before or ever will again.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
verses.nlt_text: Parents will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. I will punish you and scatter to the winds the few who survive.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish {thee}; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
verses.nlt_text: "As surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, I will cut you off completely. I will show you no pity at all because you have defiled my Temple with your vile images and detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.nlt_text: A third of your people will die in the city from disease and famine. A third of them will be slaughtered by the enemy outside the city walls. And I will scatter a third to the winds, chasing them with my sword.

verses.kjv_text: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken {it} in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
verses.nlt_text: Then at last my anger will be spent, and I will be satisfied. And when my fury against them has subsided, all Israel will know that I, the LORD, have spoken to them in my jealous anger.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that {are} round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
verses.nlt_text: "So I will turn you into a ruin, a mockery in the eyes of the surrounding nations and to all who pass by.

verses.kjv_text: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that {are} round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken {it}.
verses.nlt_text: You will become an object of mockery and taunting and horror. You will be a warning to all the nations around you. They will see what happens when the LORD punishes a nation in anger and rebukes it, says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for {their} destruction, {and} which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
verses.nlt_text: "I will shower you with the deadly arrows of famine to destroy you. The famine will become more and more severe until every crumb of food is gone.

verses.kjv_text: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken {it}.
verses.nlt_text: And along with the famine, wild animals will attack you and rob you of your children. Disease and war will stalk your land, and I will bring the sword of the enemy against you. I, the LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Again a message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, turn and face the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

verses.kjv_text: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, {even} I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.nlt_text: Proclaim this message from the Sovereign LORD against the mountains of Israel. This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills and to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring war upon you, and I will smash your pagan shrines.

verses.kjv_text: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain {men} before your idols. {images: or, sun images}
verses.nlt_text: All your altars will be demolished, and your places of worship will be destroyed. I will kill your people in front of your idols.

verses.kjv_text: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars. {lay: Heb. give}
verses.nlt_text: I will lay your corpses in front of your idols and scatter your bones around your altars.

verses.kjv_text: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished. {images: or, sun images}
verses.nlt_text: Wherever you live there will be desolation, and I will destroy your pagan shrines. Your altars will be demolished, your idols will be smashed, your places of worship will be torn down, and all the religious objects you have made will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The place will be littered with corpses, and you will know that I alone am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have {some} that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
verses.nlt_text: "But I will let a few of my people escape destruction, and they will be scattered among the nations of the world.

verses.kjv_text: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
verses.nlt_text: Then when they are exiled among the nations, they will remember me. They will recognize how hurt I am by their unfaithful hearts and lustful eyes that long for their idols. Then at last they will hate themselves for all their detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD, {and that} I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
verses.nlt_text: They will know that I alone am the LORD and that I was serious when I said I would bring this calamity on them.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Clap your hands in horror, and stamp your feet. Cry out because of all the detestable sins the people of Israel have committed. Now they are going to die from war and famine and disease.

verses.kjv_text: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
verses.nlt_text: Disease will strike down those who are far away in exile. War will destroy those who are nearby. And anyone who survives will be killed by famine. So at last I will spend my fury on them.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall ye know that I {am} the LORD, when their slain {men} shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
verses.nlt_text: They will know that I am the LORD when their dead lie scattered among their idols and altars on every hill and mountain and under every green tree and every great shade tree-- the places where they offered sacrifices to their idols.

verses.kjv_text: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD. {more...: or, desolate from the wilderness}
verses.nlt_text: I will crush them and make their cities desolate from the wilderness in the south to Riblah in the north. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says to Israel: "The end is here! Wherever you look-- east, west, north, or south-- your land is finished.

verses.kjv_text: Now {is} the end {come} upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations. {recompense: Heb. give}
verses.nlt_text: No hope remains, for I will unleash my anger against you. I will call you to account for all your detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I will turn my eyes away and show no pity. I will repay you for all your detestable sins. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Disaster after disaster is coming your way!

verses.kjv_text: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come. {watcheth for: Heb. awaketh against}
verses.nlt_text: The end has come. It has finally arrived. Your final doom is waiting!

verses.kjv_text: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble {is} near, and not the sounding again of the mountains. {sounding...: or, echo}
verses.nlt_text: O people of Israel, the day of your destruction is dawning. The time has come; the day of trouble is near. Shouts of anguish will be heard on the mountains, not shouts of joy.

verses.kjv_text: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
verses.nlt_text: Soon I will pour out my fury on you and unleash my anger against you. I will call you to account for all your detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations {that} are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD that smiteth. {thee according: Heb. upon thee, etc}
verses.nlt_text: I will turn my eyes away and show no pity. I will repay you for all your detestable sins. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who is striking the blow.

verses.kjv_text: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
verses.nlt_text: "The day of judgment is here; your destruction awaits! The people's wickedness and pride have blossomed to full flower.

verses.kjv_text: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them {shall remain}, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither {shall there be} wailing for them. {theirs: or, their tumultuous persons: Heb. tumult}
verses.nlt_text: Their violence has grown into a rod that will beat them for their wickedness. None of these proud and wicked people will survive. All their wealth and prestige will be swept away.

verses.kjv_text: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath {is} upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, the time has come; the day is here! Buyers should not rejoice over bargains, nor sellers grieve over losses, for all of them will fall under my terrible anger.

verses.kjv_text: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision {is} touching the whole multitude thereof, {which} shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life. {although they...: Heb. though their life were yet among the living} {in the...: or, whose life is in his iniquity} {the iniquity: Heb. his iniquity}
verses.nlt_text: Even if the merchants survive, they will never return to their business. For what God has said applies to everyone-- it will not be changed! Not one person whose life is twisted by sin will ever recover.

verses.kjv_text: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath {is} upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "The trumpet calls Israel's army to mobilize, but no one listens, for my fury is against them all.

verses.kjv_text: The sword {is} without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that {is} in the field shall die with the sword; and he that {is} in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.nlt_text: There is war outside the city and disease and famine within. Those outside the city walls will be killed by enemy swords. Those inside the city will die of famine and disease.

verses.kjv_text: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: The survivors who escape to the mountains will moan like doves, weeping for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak {as} water. {be weak...: Heb. go into water}
verses.nlt_text: Their hands will hang limp, their knees will be weak as water.

verses.kjv_text: They shall also gird {themselves} with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame {shall be} upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.nlt_text: They will dress themselves in burlap; horror and shame will cover them. They will shave their heads in sorrow and remorse.

verses.kjv_text: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity. {removed: Heb. for a separation, or, uncleanness} {it is...: or, their iniquity is their stumblingblock}
verses.nlt_text: "They will throw their money in the streets, tossing it out like worthless trash. Their silver and gold won't save them on that day of the LORD's anger. It will neither satisfy nor feed them, for their greed can only trip them up.

verses.kjv_text: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations {and} of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them. {set it far...: or, made it unto them an unclean thing}
verses.nlt_text: They were proud of their beautiful jewelry and used it to make detestable idols and vile images. Therefore, I will make all their wealth disgusting to them.

verses.kjv_text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
verses.nlt_text: I will give it as plunder to foreigners, to the most wicked of nations, and they will defile it.

verses.kjv_text: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret {place}: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it. {robbers: or, burglers}
verses.nlt_text: I will turn my eyes from them as these robbers invade and defile my treasured land.

verses.kjv_text: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.nlt_text: "Prepare chains for my people, for the land is bloodied by terrible crimes. Jerusalem is filled with violence.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled. {their holy...: or, they shall inherit their holy places}
verses.nlt_text: I will bring the most ruthless of nations to occupy their homes. I will break down their proud fortresses and defile their sanctuaries.

verses.kjv_text: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and {there shall be} none. {Destruction: Heb. Cutting off}
verses.nlt_text: Terror and trembling will overcome my people. They will look for peace but not find it.

verses.kjv_text: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
verses.nlt_text: Calamity will follow calamity; rumor will follow rumor. They will look in vain for a vision from the prophets. They will receive no teaching from the priests and no counsel from the leaders.

verses.kjv_text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD. {according...: Heb. with their judgments}
verses.nlt_text: The king and the prince will stand helpless, weeping in despair, and the people's hands will tremble with fear. I will bring on them the evil they have done to others, and they will receive the punishment they so richly deserve. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth {month}, in the fifth {day} of the month, {as} I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
verses.nlt_text: Then on September 17, during the sixth year of King Jehoiachin's captivity, while the leaders of Judah were in my home, the Sovereign LORD took hold of me.

verses.kjv_text: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
verses.nlt_text: I saw a figure that appeared to be a man. From what appeared to be his waist down, he looked like a burning flame. From the waist up he looked like gleaming amber.

verses.kjv_text: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where {was} the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
verses.nlt_text: He reached out what seemed to be a hand and took me by the hair. Then the Spirit lifted me up into the sky and transported me to Jerusalem in a vision from God. I was taken to the north gate of the inner courtyard of the Temple, where there is a large idol that has made the LORD very jealous.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel {was} there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, the glory of the God of Israel was there, just as I had seen it before in the valley.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked, and there to the north, beside the entrance to the gate near the altar, stood the idol that had made the LORD so jealous.

verses.kjv_text: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? {even} the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, {and} thou shalt see greater abominations.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man," he said, "do you see what they are doing? Do you see the detestable sins the people of Israel are committing to drive me from my Temple? But come, and you will see even more detestable sins than these!"

verses.kjv_text: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
verses.nlt_text: Then he brought me to the door of the Temple courtyard, where I could see a hole in the wall.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
verses.nlt_text: He said to me, "Now, son of man, dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and found a hidden doorway.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
verses.nlt_text: "Go in," he said, "and see the wicked and detestable sins they are committing in there!"

verses.kjv_text: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
verses.nlt_text: So I went in and saw the walls engraved with all kinds of crawling animals and detestable creatures. I also saw the various idols worshiped by the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
verses.nlt_text: Seventy leaders of Israel were standing there with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan in the center. Each of them held an incense burner, from which a cloud of incense rose above their heads.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the leaders of Israel are doing with their idols in dark rooms? They are saying, 'The LORD doesn't see us; he has deserted our land!'"

verses.kjv_text: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, {and} thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD added, "Come, and I will show you even more detestable sins than these!"

verses.kjv_text: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD'S house which {was} toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
verses.nlt_text: He brought me to the north gate of the LORD's Temple, and some women were sitting there, weeping for the god Tammuz.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen {this}, O son of man? turn thee yet again, {and} thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
verses.nlt_text: "Have you seen this?" he asked. "But I will show you even more detestable sins than these!"

verses.kjv_text: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD'S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, {were} about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
verses.nlt_text: Then he brought me into the inner courtyard of the LORD's Temple. At the entrance to the sanctuary, between the entry room and the bronze altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs to the sanctuary of the LORD. They were facing east, bowing low to the ground, worshiping the sun!

verses.kjv_text: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen {this}, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose. {Is it...: or, Is there any thing lighter than to commit}
verses.nlt_text: "Have you seen this, son of man?" he asked. "Is it nothing to the people of Judah that they commit these detestable sins, leading the whole nation into violence, thumbing their noses at me, and provoking my anger?

verses.kjv_text: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, {yet} will I not hear them.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, I will respond in fury. I will neither pity nor spare them. And though they cry for mercy, I will not listen."

verses.kjv_text: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man {with} his destroying weapon in his hand.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD thundered, "Bring on the men appointed to punish the city! Tell them to bring their weapons with them!"

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them {was} clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar. {which lieth: Heb. which is turned} {a slaughter...: Heb. a weapon of his breaking in pieces} {by his...: Heb. upon his loins}
verses.nlt_text: Six men soon appeared from the upper gate that faces north, each carrying a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man dressed in linen, who carried a writer's case at his side. They all went into the Temple courtyard and stood beside the bronze altar.

verses.kjv_text: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which {had} the writer's inkhorn by his side;
verses.nlt_text: Then the glory of the God of Israel rose up from between the cherubim, where it had rested, and moved to the entrance of the Temple. And the LORD called to the man dressed in linen who was carrying the writer's case.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof. {set a mark: Heb. mark a mark}
verses.nlt_text: He said to him, "Walk through the streets of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of all who weep and sigh because of the detestable sins being committed in their city."

verses.kjv_text: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity: {mine hearing: Heb. mine ears}
verses.nlt_text: Then I heard the LORD say to the other men, "Follow him through the city and kill everyone whose forehead is not marked. Show no mercy; have no pity!

verses.kjv_text: Slay utterly old {and} young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom {is} the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which {were} before the house. {utterly: Heb. to destruction}
