verses.nlt_text: Kill them all-- old and young, girls and women and little children. But do not touch anyone with the mark. Begin right here at the Temple." So they began by killing the seventy leaders.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
verses.nlt_text: "Defile the Temple!" the LORD commanded. "Fill its courtyards with corpses. Go!" So they went and began killing throughout the city.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
verses.nlt_text: While they were out killing, I was all alone. I fell face down on the ground and cried out, "O Sovereign LORD! Will your fury against Jerusalem wipe out everyone left in Israel?"

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah {is} exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not. {full of blood: Heb. filled with, etc} {perverseness: or, wresting of judgment}
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to me, "The sins of the people of Israel and Judah are very, very great. The entire land is full of murder; the city is filled with injustice. They are saying, 'The LORD doesn't see it! The LORD has abandoned the land!'

verses.kjv_text: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, {but} I will recompense their way upon their head.
verses.nlt_text: So I will not spare them or have any pity on them. I will fully repay them for all they have done."

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which {had} the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me. {reported...: Heb. returned the word}
verses.nlt_text: Then the man in linen clothing, who carried the writer's case, reported back and said, "I have done as you commanded."

verses.kjv_text: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.nlt_text: In my vision I saw what appeared to be a throne of blue lapis lazuli above the crystal surface over the heads of the cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, {even} under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter {them} over the city. And he went in in my sight. {thine hand: Heb. the hollow of thine hand}
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD spoke to the man in linen clothing and said, "Go between the whirling wheels beneath the cherubim, and take a handful of burning coals and scatter them over the city." He did this as I watched.

verses.kjv_text: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.nlt_text: The cherubim were standing at the south end of the Temple when the man went in, and the cloud of glory filled the inner courtyard.

verses.kjv_text: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, {and stood} over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD'S glory. {went up: Heb. was lifted up}
verses.nlt_text: Then the glory of the LORD rose up from above the cherubim and went over to the door of the Temple. The Temple was filled with this cloud of glory, and the courtyard glowed brightly with the glory of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard {even} to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
verses.nlt_text: The moving wings of the cherubim sounded like the voice of God Almighty and could be heard even in the outer courtyard.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, {that} when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD said to the man in linen clothing, "Go between the cherubim and take some burning coals from between the wheels." So the man went in and stood beside one of the wheels.

verses.kjv_text: And {one} cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that {was} between the cherubims, and took {thereof}, and put {it} into the hands of {him that was} clothed with linen: who took {it}, and went out. {stretched forth: Heb. sent forth}
verses.nlt_text: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand and took some live coals from the fire burning among them. He put the coals into the hands of the man in linen clothing, and the man took them and went out.

verses.kjv_text: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.
verses.nlt_text: (All the cherubim had what looked like human hands under their wings.)

verses.kjv_text: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels {was} as the colour of a beryl stone.
verses.nlt_text: I looked, and each of the four cherubim had a wheel beside him, and the wheels sparkled like beryl.

verses.kjv_text: And {as for} their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
verses.nlt_text: All four wheels looked alike and were made the same; each wheel had a second wheel turning crosswise within it.

verses.kjv_text: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
verses.nlt_text: The cherubim could move in any of the four directions they faced, without turning as they moved. They went straight in the direction they faced, never turning aside.

verses.kjv_text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, {were} full of eyes round about, {even} the wheels that they four had. {body: Heb. flesh}
verses.nlt_text: Both the cherubim and the wheels were covered with eyes. The cherubim had eyes all over their bodies, including their hands, their backs, and their wings.

verses.kjv_text: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel. {it was...: or, they were called in my hearing, wheel, or, galgal}
verses.nlt_text: I heard someone refer to the wheels as "the whirling wheels."

verses.kjv_text: And every one had four faces: the first face {was} the face of a cherub, and the second face {was} the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.nlt_text: Each of the four cherubim had four faces: the first was the face of an ox, the second was a human face, the third was the face of a lion, and the fourth was the face of an eagle.

verses.kjv_text: And the cherubims were lifted up. This {is} the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
verses.nlt_text: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the same living beings I had seen beside the Kebar River.

verses.kjv_text: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.nlt_text: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved with them. When they lifted their wings to fly, the wheels stayed beside them.

verses.kjv_text: When they stood, {these} stood; and when they were lifted up, {these} lifted up themselves {also}: for the spirit of the living creature {was} in them. {of...: or, of life}
verses.nlt_text: When the cherubim stopped, the wheels stopped. When they flew upward, the wheels rose up, for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.

verses.kjv_text: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
verses.nlt_text: Then the glory of the LORD moved out from the door of the Temple and hovered above the cherubim.

verses.kjv_text: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also {were} beside them, and {every one} stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD'S house; and the glory of the God of Israel {was} over them above.
verses.nlt_text: And as I watched, the cherubim flew with their wheels to the east gate of the LORD's Temple. And the glory of the God of Israel hovered above them.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they {were} the cherubims.
verses.nlt_text: These were the same living beings I had seen beneath the God of Israel when I was by the Kebar River. I knew they were cherubim,

verses.kjv_text: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man {was} under their wings.
verses.nlt_text: for each had four faces and four wings and what looked like human hands under their wings.

verses.kjv_text: And the likeness of their faces {was} the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
verses.nlt_text: And their faces were just like the faces of the beings I had seen at the Kebar, and they traveled straight ahead, just as the others had.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD'S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Spirit lifted me and brought me to the east gateway of the LORD's Temple, where I saw twenty-five prominent men of the city. Among them were Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, who were leaders among the people.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these {are} the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are planning evil and giving wicked counsel in this city.

verses.kjv_text: Which say, {It is} not near; let us build houses: this {city is} the caldron, and we {be} the flesh. {It is...: or, It is not for us to build houses near}
verses.nlt_text: They say to the people, 'Is it not a good time to build houses? This city is like an iron pot. We are safe inside it like meat in a pot. '

verses.kjv_text: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, son of man, prophesy against them loudly and clearly."

verses.kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, {every one of} them.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon me, and he told me to say, "This is what the LORD says to the people of Israel: I know what you are saying, for I know every thought that comes into your minds.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
verses.nlt_text: You have murdered many in this city and filled its streets with the dead.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they {are} the flesh, and this {city is} the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: This city is an iron pot all right, but the pieces of meat are the victims of your injustice. As for you, I will soon drag you from this pot.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: I will bring on you the sword of war you so greatly fear, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
verses.nlt_text: I will drive you out of Jerusalem and hand you over to foreigners, who will carry out my judgments against you.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: You will be slaughtered all the way to the borders of Israel. I will execute judgment on you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: This {city} shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; {but} I will judge you in the border of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: No, this city will not be an iron pot for you, and you will not be like meat safe inside it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel,

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall know that I {am} the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that {are} round about you. {for ye...: or, which have not walked}
verses.nlt_text: and you will know that I am the LORD. For you have refused to obey my decrees and regulations; instead, you have copied the standards of the nations around you."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
verses.nlt_text: While I was still prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah suddenly died. Then I fell face down on the ground and cried out, "O Sovereign LORD, are you going to kill everyone in Israel?"

verses.kjv_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, thy brethren, {even} thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, {are} they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, the people still left in Jerusalem are talking about you and your relatives and all the people of Israel who are in exile. They are saying, 'Those people are far away from the LORD, so now he has given their land to us!'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, tell the exiles, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Although I have scattered you in the countries of the world, I will be a sanctuary to you during your time in exile.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: I, the Sovereign LORD, will gather you back from the nations where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel once again.'

verses.kjv_text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
verses.nlt_text: "When the people return to their homeland, they will remove every trace of their vile images and detestable idols.

verses.kjv_text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
verses.nlt_text: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them. I will take away their stony, stubborn heart and give them a tender, responsive heart,

verses.kjv_text: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.nlt_text: so they will obey my decrees and regulations. Then they will truly be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.kjv_text: But {as for them} whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: But as for those who long for vile images and detestable idols, I will repay them fully for their sins. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel {was} over them above.
verses.nlt_text: Then the cherubim lifted their wings and rose into the air with their wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered above them.

verses.kjv_text: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which {is} on the east side of the city.
verses.nlt_text: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the city and stopped above the mountain to the east.

verses.kjv_text: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward the Spirit of God carried me back again to Babylonia, to the people in exile there. And so ended the vision of my visit to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
verses.nlt_text: And I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.

verses.kjv_text: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Again a message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they {are} a rebellious house.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, you live among rebels who have eyes but refuse to see. They have ears but refuse to hear. For they are a rebellious people.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they {be} a rebellious house. {stuff: or, instruments}
verses.nlt_text: "So now, son of man, pretend you are being sent into exile. Pack the few items an exile could carry, and leave your home to go somewhere else. Do this right in front of the people so they can see you. For perhaps they will pay attention to this, even though they are such rebels.

verses.kjv_text: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity. {as they...: Heb. as the goings forth of captivity}
verses.nlt_text: Bring your baggage outside during the day so they can watch you. Then in the evening, as they are watching, leave your house as captives do when they begin a long march to distant lands.

verses.kjv_text: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby. {Dig...: Heb. Dig for thee}
verses.nlt_text: Dig a hole through the wall while they are watching and go out through it.

verses.kjv_text: In their sight shalt thou bear {it} upon {thy} shoulders, {and} carry {it} forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee {for} a sign unto the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: As they watch, lift your pack to your shoulders and walk away into the night. Cover your face so you cannot see the land you are leaving. For I have made you a sign for the people of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought {it} forth in the twilight, {and} I bare {it} upon {my} shoulder in their sight. {digged: Heb. digged for me}
verses.nlt_text: So I did as I was told. In broad daylight I brought my pack outside, filled with the things I might carry into exile. Then in the evening while the people looked on, I dug through the wall with my hands and went out into the night with my pack on my shoulder.

verses.kjv_text: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The next morning this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, these rebels, the people of Israel, have asked you what all this means.

verses.kjv_text: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden {concerneth} the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that {are} among them.
verses.nlt_text: Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: These actions contain a message for King Zedekiah in Jerusalem and for all the people of Israel.'

verses.kjv_text: Say, I {am} your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove {and} go into captivity. {they...: Heb. by removing go into captivity}
verses.nlt_text: Explain that your actions are a sign to show what will soon happen to them, for they will be driven into exile as captives.

verses.kjv_text: And the prince that {is} among them shall bear upon {his} shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with {his} eyes.
verses.nlt_text: "Even Zedekiah will leave Jerusalem at night through a hole in the wall, taking only what he can carry with him. He will cover his face, and his eyes will not see the land he is leaving.

verses.kjv_text: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon {to} the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.nlt_text: Then I will throw my net over him and capture him in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Babylonians, though he will never see it, and he will die there.

verses.kjv_text: And I will scatter toward every wind all that {are} about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.nlt_text: I will scatter his servants and warriors to the four winds and send the sword after them.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.nlt_text: And when I scatter them among the nations, they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD. {a few...: Heb. men of number}
verses.nlt_text: But I will spare a few of them from death by war, famine, or disease, so they can confess all their detestable sins to their captors. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, tremble as you eat your food. Shake with fear as you drink your water.

verses.kjv_text: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, {and} of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein. {all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof}
verses.nlt_text: Tell the people, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says concerning those living in Israel and Jerusalem: They will eat their food with trembling and sip their water in despair, for their land will be stripped bare because of their violence.

verses.kjv_text: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: The cities will be destroyed and the farmland made desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Again a message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, what {is} that proverb {that} ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, you've heard that proverb they quote in Israel: 'Time passes, and prophecies come to nothing.'

verses.kjv_text: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
verses.nlt_text: Tell the people, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will put an end to this proverb, and you will soon stop quoting it.' Now give them this new proverb to replace the old one: 'The time has come for every prophecy to be fulfilled!'

verses.kjv_text: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "There will be no more false visions and flattering predictions in Israel.

verses.kjv_text: For I {am} the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: For I am the LORD! If I say it, it will happen. There will be no more delays, you rebels of Israel. I will fulfill my threat of destruction in your own lifetime. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, behold, {they of} the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth {is} for many days {to come}, and he prophesieth of the times {that are} far off.
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, the people of Israel are saying, 'He's talking about the distant future. His visions won't come true for a long, long time.'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, tell them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: No more delay! I will now do everything I have threatened. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!'"

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD; {that prophesy out...: Heb. that are prophets out of their own hearts}
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, prophesy against the false prophets of Israel who are inventing their own prophecies. Say to them, 'Listen to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing! {follow: Heb. walk after} {and...: or, and things which they have not seen}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: What sorrow awaits the false prophets who are following their own imaginations and have seen nothing at all!'

verses.kjv_text: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
verses.nlt_text: "O people of Israel, these prophets of yours are like jackals digging in the ruins.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD. {gaps: or, breaches} {made...: Heb. hedged the hedge}
verses.nlt_text: They have done nothing to repair the breaks in the walls around the nation. They have not helped it to stand firm in battle on the day of the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made {others} to hope that they would confirm the word.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, they have told lies and made false predictions. They say, 'This message is from the LORD,' even though the LORD never sent them. And yet they expect him to fulfill their prophecies!

verses.kjv_text: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith {it}; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.nlt_text: Can your visions be anything but false if you claim, 'This message is from the LORD,' when I have not even spoken to you?

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I {am} against you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because what you say is false and your visions are a lie, I will stand against you, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I {am} the Lord GOD. {assembly: or, secret, or, counsel}
verses.nlt_text: I will raise my fist against all the prophets who see false visions and make lying predictions, and they will be banished from the community of Israel. I will blot their names from Israel's record books, and they will never again set foot in their own land. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and {there was} no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered {morter}: {a wall: or, a slight wall}
verses.nlt_text: "This will happen because these evil prophets deceive my people by saying, 'All is peaceful' when there is no peace at all! It's as if the people have built a flimsy wall, and these prophets are trying to reinforce it by covering it with whitewash!

verses.kjv_text: Say unto them which daub {it} with untempered {morter}, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Tell these whitewashers that their wall will soon fall down. A heavy rainstorm will undermine it; great hailstones and mighty winds will knock it down.

verses.kjv_text: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where {is} the daubing wherewith ye have daubed {it}?
verses.nlt_text: And when the wall falls, the people will cry out, 'What happened to your whitewash?'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend {it} with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in {my} fury to consume {it}.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will sweep away your whitewashed wall with a storm of indignation, with a great flood of anger, and with hailstones of fury.

verses.kjv_text: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered {morter}, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I will break down your wall right to its foundation, and when it falls, it will crush you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered {morter}, and will say unto you, The wall {is} no {more}, neither they that daubed it;
verses.nlt_text: At last my anger against the wall and those who covered it with whitewash will be satisfied. Then I will say to you: 'The wall and those who whitewashed it are both gone.

verses.kjv_text: {To wit}, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and {there is} no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: They were lying prophets who claimed peace would come to Jerusalem when there was no peace. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!'

verses.kjv_text: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.nlt_text: "Now, son of man, speak out against the women who prophesy from their own imaginations.

verses.kjv_text: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the {women} that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive {that come} unto you? {armholes: or, elbows}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: What sorrow awaits you women who are ensnaring the souls of my people, young and old alike. You tie magic charms on their wrists and furnish them with magic veils. Do you think you can trap others without bringing destruction on yourselves?

verses.kjv_text: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear {your} lies?
verses.nlt_text: You bring shame on me among my people for a few handfuls of barley or a piece of bread. By lying to my people who love to listen to lies, you kill those who should not die, and you promise life to those who should not live.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make {them} fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, {even} the souls that ye hunt to make {them} fly. {to make...: or, into gardens}
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against all your magic charms, which you use to ensnare my people like birds. I will tear them from your arms, setting my people free like birds set free from a cage.

verses.kjv_text: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I will tear off the magic veils and save my people from your grasp. They will no longer be your victims. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life: {by...: or, that I should save his life: Heb. by quickening him}
verses.nlt_text: You have discouraged the righteous with your lies, but I didn't want them to be sad. And you have encouraged the wicked by promising them life, even though they continue in their sins.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Because of all this, you will no longer talk of seeing visions that you never saw, nor will you make predictions. For I will rescue my people from your grasp. Then you will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.nlt_text: Then some of the leaders of Israel visited me, and while they were sitting with me,

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, these leaders have set up idols in their hearts. They have embraced things that will make them fall into sin. Why should I listen to their requests?

verses.kjv_text: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.nlt_text: Tell them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The people of Israel have set up idols in their hearts and fallen into sin, and then they go to a prophet asking for a message. So I, the LORD, will give them the kind of answer their great idolatry deserves.

verses.kjv_text: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.nlt_text: I will do this to capture the minds and hearts of all my people who have turned from me to worship their detestable idols.'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn {yourselves} from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations. {yourselves: or, others}
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, tell the people of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Repent and turn away from your idols, and stop all your detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:
verses.nlt_text: I, the LORD, will answer all those, both Israelites and foreigners, who reject me and set up idols in their hearts and so fall into sin, and who then come to a prophet asking for my advice.

verses.kjv_text: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I will turn against such people and make a terrible example of them, eliminating them from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.nlt_text: " 'And if a prophet is deceived into giving a message, it is because I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet. I will lift my fist against such prophets and cut them off from the community of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh {unto him};
verses.nlt_text: False prophets and those who seek their guidance will all be punished for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: In this way, the people of Israel will learn not to stray from me, polluting themselves with sin. They will be my people, and I will be their God. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!'"

verses.kjv_text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, suppose the people of a country were to sin against me, and I lifted my fist to crush them, cutting off their food supply and sending a famine to destroy both people and animals.

verses.kjv_text: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver {but} their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were there, their righteousness would save no one but themselves, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts: {spoil: or, bereave}
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose I were to send wild animals to invade the country, kill the people, and make the land too desolate and dangerous to pass through.

verses.kjv_text: {Though} these three men {were} in it, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate. {in it: Heb. in the midst of it}
verses.nlt_text: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, even if those three men were there, they wouldn't be able to save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be made desolate.

verses.kjv_text: Or {if} I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose I were to bring war against the land, and I sent enemy armies to destroy both people and animals.

verses.kjv_text: Though these three men {were} in it, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.nlt_text: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, even if those three men were there, they wouldn't be able to save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.

verses.kjv_text: Or {if} I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose I were to pour out my fury by sending an epidemic into the land, and the disease killed people and animals alike.

verses.kjv_text: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, {were} in it, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall {but} deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were there, they wouldn't be able to save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved by their righteousness.

verses.kjv_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast? {How...: or, Also when}
verses.nlt_text: "Now this is what the Sovereign LORD says: How terrible it will be when all four of these dreadful punishments fall upon Jerusalem-- war, famine, wild animals, and disease-- destroying all her people and animals.

verses.kjv_text: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, {both} sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, {even} concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.nlt_text: Yet there will be survivors, and they will come here to join you as exiles in Babylon. You will see with your own eyes how wicked they are, and then you will feel better about what I have done to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: When you meet them and see their behavior, you will understand that these things are not being done to Israel without cause. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, {or than} a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, how does a grapevine compare to a tree? Is a vine's wood as useful as the wood of a tree?

verses.kjv_text: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will {men} take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.nlt_text: Can its wood be used for making things, like pegs to hang up pots and pans?

verses.kjv_text: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for {any} work? {Is it...: Heb. Will it prosper?}
verses.nlt_text: No, it can only be used for fuel, and even as fuel, it burns too quickly.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for {any} work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned? {meet: Heb. made fit}
verses.nlt_text: Vines are useless both before and after being put into the fire!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: "And this is what the Sovereign LORD says: The people of Jerusalem are like grapevines growing among the trees of the forest. Since they are useless, I have thrown them on the fire to be burned.

verses.kjv_text: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from {one} fire, and {another} fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I set my face against them.
verses.nlt_text: And I will see to it that if they escape from one fire, they will fall into another. When I turn against them, you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD. {committed...: Heb. trespassed a trespass}
verses.nlt_text: And I will make the land desolate because my people have been unfaithful to me. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then another message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity {is} of the land of Canaan; thy father {was} an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite. {birth: Heb. cutting out, or, habitation}
verses.nlt_text: Give her this message from the Sovereign LORD: You are nothing but a Canaanite! Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

verses.kjv_text: And {as for} thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple {thee}; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all. {to supple...: or, when I looked upon thee}
verses.nlt_text: On the day you were born, no one cared about you. Your umbilical cord was not cut, and you were never washed, rubbed with salt, and wrapped in cloth.

verses.kjv_text: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.nlt_text: No one had the slightest interest in you; no one pitied you or cared for you. On the day you were born, you were unwanted, dumped in a field and left to die.

verses.kjv_text: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee {when thou wast} in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee {when thou wast} in thy blood, Live. {polluted: or, trodden under foot}
verses.nlt_text: "But I came by and saw you there, helplessly kicking about in your own blood. As you lay there, I said, 'Live!'

verses.kjv_text: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: {thy} breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou {wast} naked and bare. {caused...: Heb. made thee a million} {excellent...: Heb. ornament of ornaments}
verses.nlt_text: And I helped you to thrive like a plant in the field. You grew up and became a beautiful jewel. Your breasts became full, and your body hair grew, but you were still naked.

verses.kjv_text: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time {was} the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
verses.nlt_text: And when I passed by again, I saw that you were old enough for love. So I wrapped my cloak around you to cover your nakedness and declared my marriage vows. I made a covenant with you, says the Sovereign LORD, and you became mine.

verses.kjv_text: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil. {blood: Heb. bloods}
verses.nlt_text: "Then I bathed you and washed off your blood, and I rubbed fragrant oils into your skin.

verses.kjv_text: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.nlt_text: I gave you expensive clothing of fine linen and silk, beautifully embroidered, and sandals made of fine goatskin leather.

verses.kjv_text: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.nlt_text: I gave you lovely jewelry, bracelets, beautiful necklaces,

verses.kjv_text: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head. {forehead: Heb. nose}
verses.nlt_text: a ring for your nose, earrings for your ears, and a lovely crown for your head.

verses.kjv_text: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment {was of} fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: And so you were adorned with gold and silver. Your clothes were made of fine linen and were beautifully embroidered. You ate the finest foods-- choice flour, honey, and olive oil-- and became more beautiful than ever. You looked like a queen, and so you were!

verses.kjv_text: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it {was} perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: Your fame soon spread throughout the world because of your beauty. I dressed you in my splendor and perfected your beauty, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.nlt_text: "But you thought your fame and beauty were your own. So you gave yourself as a prostitute to every man who came along. Your beauty was theirs for the asking.

verses.kjv_text: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: {the like things} shall not come, neither shall it be {so}.
verses.nlt_text: You used the lovely things I gave you to make shrines for idols, where you played the prostitute. Unbelievable! How could such a thing ever happen?

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them, {of men: Heb. of a male}
verses.nlt_text: You took the very jewels and gold and silver ornaments I had given you and made statues of men and worshiped them. This is adultery against me!

verses.kjv_text: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.nlt_text: You used the beautifully embroidered clothes I gave you to dress your idols. Then you used my special oil and my incense to worship them.

verses.kjv_text: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, {wherewith} I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and {thus} it was, saith the Lord GOD. {a sweet...: Heb. a savour of rest}
verses.nlt_text: Imagine it! You set before them as a sacrifice the choice flour, olive oil, and honey I had given you, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. {Is this} of thy whoredoms a small matter, {to be...: Heb. to devour}
verses.nlt_text: "Then you took your sons and daughters-- the children you had borne to me-- and sacrificed them to your gods. Was your prostitution not enough?

verses.kjv_text: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through {the fire} for them?
verses.nlt_text: Must you also slaughter my children by sacrificing them to idols?

verses.kjv_text: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, {and} wast polluted in thy blood.
verses.nlt_text: In all your years of adultery and detestable sin, you have not once remembered the days long ago when you lay naked in a field, kicking about in your own blood.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you, says the Sovereign LORD. In addition to all your other wickedness,

verses.kjv_text: {That} thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street. {eminent...: or, brothel house}
verses.nlt_text: you built a pagan shrine and put altars to idols in every town square.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.nlt_text: On every street corner you defiled your beauty, offering your body to every passerby in an endless stream of prostitution.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.nlt_text: Then you added lustful Egypt to your lovers, provoking my anger with your increasing promiscuity.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary {food}, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way. {daughters: or, cities}
verses.nlt_text: That is why I struck you with my fist and reduced your boundaries. I handed you over to your enemies, the Philistines, and even they were shocked by your lewd conduct.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.nlt_text: You have prostituted yourself with the Assyrians, too. It seems you can never find enough new lovers! And after your prostitution there, you still were not satisfied.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
verses.nlt_text: You added to your lovers by embracing Babylonia, the land of merchants, but you still weren't satisfied.

verses.kjv_text: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these {things}, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.nlt_text: "What a sick heart you have, says the Sovereign LORD, to do such things as these, acting like a shameless prostitute.

verses.kjv_text: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire; {In that thou buildest...: or, In thy daughters is thine, etc}
verses.nlt_text: You build your pagan shrines on every street corner and your altars to idols in every square. In fact, you have been worse than a prostitute, so eager for sin that you have not even demanded payment.

verses.kjv_text: {But as} a wife that committeth adultery, {which} taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.nlt_text: Yes, you are an adulterous wife who takes in strangers instead of her own husband.

verses.kjv_text: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom. {hirest: Heb. bribest}
verses.nlt_text: Prostitutes charge for their services-- but not you! You give gifts to your lovers, bribing them to come and have sex with you.

verses.kjv_text: And the contrary is in thee from {other} women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.nlt_text: So you are the opposite of other prostitutes. You pay your lovers instead of their paying you!

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, you prostitute, listen to this message from the LORD!

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.nlt_text: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have poured out your lust and exposed yourself in prostitution to all your lovers, and because you have worshiped detestable idols, and because you have slaughtered your children as sacrifices to your gods,

verses.kjv_text: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all {them} that thou hast loved, with all {them} that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: this is what I am going to do. I will gather together all your allies-- the lovers with whom you have sinned, both those you loved and those you hated-- and I will strip you naked in front of them so they can stare at you.

verses.kjv_text: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy. {as: Heb. with judgments of}
verses.nlt_text: I will punish you for your murder and adultery. I will cover you with blood in my jealous fury.

verses.kjv_text: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare. {thy fair...: Heb. instruments of thine ornament}
verses.nlt_text: Then I will give you to these many nations who are your lovers, and they will destroy you. They will knock down your pagan shrines and the altars to your idols. They will strip you and take your beautiful jewels, leaving you stark naked.

verses.kjv_text: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.nlt_text: They will band together in a mob to stone you and cut you up with swords.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.nlt_text: They will burn your homes and punish you in front of many women. I will stop your prostitution and end your payments to your many lovers.

verses.kjv_text: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.nlt_text: "Then at last my fury against you will be spent, and my jealous anger will subside. I will be calm and will not be angry with you anymore.

verses.kjv_text: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these {things}; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon {thine} head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.nlt_text: But first, because you have not remembered your youth but have angered me by doing all these evil things, I will fully repay you for all of your sins, says the Sovereign LORD. For you have added lewd acts to all your detestable sins.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use {this} proverb against thee, saying, As {is} the mother, {so is} her daughter.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who makes up proverbs will say of you, 'Like mother, like daughter.'

verses.kjv_text: Thou {art} thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou {art} the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother {was} an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.nlt_text: For your mother loathed her husband and her children, and so do you. And you are exactly like your sisters, for they despised their husbands and their children. Truly your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

verses.kjv_text: And thine elder sister {is} Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, {is} Sodom and her daughters. {thy younger: Heb. lesser than thou}
verses.nlt_text: "Your older sister was Samaria, who lived with her daughters in the north. Your younger sister was Sodom, who lived with her daughters in the south.

verses.kjv_text: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as {if that were} a very little {thing}, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways. {as if...: or, that was lothed as a small thing}
verses.nlt_text: But you have not merely sinned as they did. You quickly surpassed them in corruption.

verses.kjv_text: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.nlt_text: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, Sodom and her daughters were never as wicked as you and your daughters.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.nlt_text: Sodom's sins were pride, gluttony, and laziness, while the poor and needy suffered outside her door.

verses.kjv_text: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw {good}.
verses.nlt_text: She was proud and committed detestable sins, so I wiped her out, as you have seen.

verses.kjv_text: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.nlt_text: "Even Samaria did not commit half your sins. You have done far more detestable things than your sisters ever did. They seem righteous compared to you.

verses.kjv_text: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.nlt_text: Shame on you! Your sins are so terrible that you make your sisters seem righteous, even virtuous.

verses.kjv_text: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then {will I bring again} the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.nlt_text: "But someday I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and Samaria, and I will restore you, too.

verses.kjv_text: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will be truly ashamed of everything you have done, for your sins make them feel good in comparison.

verses.kjv_text: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, your sisters, Sodom and Samaria, and all their people will be restored, and at that time you also will be restored.

verses.kjv_text: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride, {mentioned: Heb. for a report, or, hearing} {pride: Heb. prides, or, excellencies}
verses.nlt_text: In your proud days you held Sodom in contempt.

verses.kjv_text: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of {thy} reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all {that are} round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about. {Syria: Heb. Aram} {despise: or, spoil}
verses.nlt_text: But now your greater wickedness has been exposed to all the world, and you are the one who is scorned-- by Edom and all her neighbors and by Philistia.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD. {borne: Heb. borne them}
verses.nlt_text: This is your punishment for all your lewdness and detestable sins, says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.nlt_text: "Now this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will give you what you deserve, for you have taken your solemn vows lightly by breaking your covenant.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.nlt_text: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you when you were young, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

verses.kjv_text: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will remember with shame all the evil you have done. I will make your sisters, Samaria and Sodom, to be your daughters, even though they are not part of our covenant.

verses.kjv_text: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD:
verses.nlt_text: And I will reaffirm my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: You will remember your sins and cover your mouth in silent shame when I forgive you of all that you have done. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
verses.nlt_text: "Son of man, give this riddle, and tell this story to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar: {divers...: Heb. embroidering}
verses.nlt_text: Give them this message from the Sovereign LORD: "A great eagle with broad wings and long feathers, covered with many-colored plumage, came to Lebanon. He seized the top of a cedar tree

verses.kjv_text: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.nlt_text: and plucked off its highest branch. He carried it away to a city filled with merchants. He planted it in a city of traders.

verses.kjv_text: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed {it} by great waters, {and} set it {as} a willow tree. {planted...: Heb. put it in a field of seed}
verses.nlt_text: He also took a seedling from the land and planted it in fertile soil. He placed it beside a broad river, where it could grow like a willow tree.

verses.kjv_text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.nlt_text: It took root there and grew into a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned up toward the eagle, and its roots grew down into the ground. It produced strong branches and put out shoots.

verses.kjv_text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
verses.nlt_text: But then another great eagle came with broad wings and full plumage. So the vine now sent its roots and branches toward him for water,

verses.kjv_text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine. {soil: Heb. field}
verses.nlt_text: even though it was already planted in good soil and had plenty of water so it could grow into a splendid vine and produce rich leaves and luscious fruit.

verses.kjv_text: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
verses.nlt_text: "So now the Sovereign LORD asks: Will this vine grow and prosper? No! I will pull it up, roots and all! I will cut off its fruit and let its leaves wither and die. I will pull it up easily without a strong arm or a large army.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, behold, {being} planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
verses.nlt_text: But when the vine is transplanted, will it thrive? No, it will wither away when the east wind blows against it. It will die in the same good soil where it had grown so well."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then this message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these {things mean}? tell {them}, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
verses.nlt_text: "Say to these rebels of Israel: Don't you understand the meaning of this riddle of the eagles? The king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, took away her king and princes, and brought them to Babylon.

verses.kjv_text: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land: {taken an...: Heb. brought him to an oath}
verses.nlt_text: He made a treaty with a member of the royal family and forced him to take an oath of loyalty. He also exiled Israel's most influential leaders,

verses.kjv_text: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, {but} that by keeping of his covenant it might stand. {but...: Heb. to keep his covenant, to stand to it}
verses.nlt_text: so Israel would not become strong again and revolt. Only by keeping her treaty with Babylon could Israel survive.

verses.kjv_text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such {things}? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
verses.nlt_text: "Nevertheless, this man of Israel's royal family rebelled against Babylon, sending ambassadors to Egypt to request a great army and many horses. Can Israel break her sworn treaties like that and get away with it?

verses.kjv_text: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place {where} the king {dwelleth} that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, {even} with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.nlt_text: No! For as surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, the king of Israel will die in Babylon, the land of the king who put him in power and whose treaty he disregarded and broke.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall Pharaoh with {his} mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
verses.nlt_text: Pharaoh and all his mighty army will fail to help Israel when the king of Babylon lays siege to Jerusalem again and destroys many lives.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these {things}, he shall not escape.
verses.nlt_text: For the king of Israel disregarded his treaty and broke it after swearing to obey; therefore, he will not escape.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; {As} I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
verses.nlt_text: "So this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, I will punish him for breaking my covenant and disregarding the solemn oath he made in my name.

verses.kjv_text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
verses.nlt_text: I will throw my net over him and capture him in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and put him on trial for this treason against me.

verses.kjv_text: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken {it}.
verses.nlt_text: And all his best warriors will be killed in battle, and those who survive will be scattered to the four winds. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set {it}; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant {it} upon an high mountain and eminent:
verses.nlt_text: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will take a branch from the top of a tall cedar, and I will plant it on the top of Israel's highest mountain.

verses.kjv_text: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.nlt_text: It will become a majestic cedar, sending forth its branches and producing seed. Birds of every sort will nest in it, finding shelter in the shade of its branches.

verses.kjv_text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done {it}.
verses.nlt_text: And all the trees will know that it is I, the LORD, who cuts the tall tree down and makes the short tree grow tall. It is I who makes the green tree wither and gives the dead tree new life. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do what I said!"

verses.kjv_text: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then another message came to me from the LORD:

verses.kjv_text: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
verses.nlt_text: "Why do you quote this proverb concerning the land of Israel: 'The parents have eaten sour grapes, but their children's mouths pucker at the taste'?

verses.kjv_text: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have {occasion} any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign LORD, you will not quote this proverb anymore in Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.nlt_text: For all people are mine to judge-- both parents and children alike. And this is my rule: The person who sins is the one who will die.

verses.kjv_text: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right, {that...: Heb. judgment and justice}
verses.nlt_text: "Suppose a certain man is righteous and does what is just and right.

verses.kjv_text: {And} hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
verses.nlt_text: He does not feast in the mountains before Israel's idols or worship them. He does not commit adultery or have intercourse with a woman during her menstrual period.

verses.kjv_text: And hath not oppressed any, {but} hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.nlt_text: He is a merciful creditor, not keeping the items given as security by poor debtors. He does not rob the poor but instead gives food to the hungry and provides clothes for the needy.

verses.kjv_text: He {that} hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, {that} hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
verses.nlt_text: He grants loans without interest, stays away from injustice, is honest and fair when judging others,

verses.kjv_text: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he {is} just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: and faithfully obeys my decrees and regulations. Anyone who does these things is just and will surely live, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: If he beget a son {that is} a robber, a shedder of blood, and {that} doeth the like to {any} one of these {things}, {robber: or, breaker up of an house} {that doeth...: or, that doeth to his brother besides any of these}
verses.nlt_text: "But suppose that man has a son who grows up to be a robber or murderer and refuses to do what is right.

verses.kjv_text: And that doeth not any of those {duties}, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.nlt_text: And that son does all the evil things his father would never do-- he worships idols on the mountains, commits adultery,

verses.kjv_text: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.nlt_text: oppresses the poor and helpless, steals from debtors by refusing to let them redeem their security, worships idols, commits detestable sins,

verses.kjv_text: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him. {blood: Heb. bloods}
verses.nlt_text: and lends money at excessive interest. Should such a sinful person live? No! He must die and must take full blame.
