verses.kjv_text: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.nlt_text: In just a short time he will restore us, so that we may live in his presence.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall we know, {if} we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter {and} former rain unto the earth.
verses.nlt_text: Oh, that we might know the LORD! Let us press on to know him. He will respond to us as surely as the arrival of dawn or the coming of rains in early spring."

verses.kjv_text: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness {is} as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away. {goodness: or, mercy, or, kindness}
verses.nlt_text: "O Israel and Judah, what should I do with you?" asks the LORD. "For your love vanishes like the morning mist and disappears like dew in the sunlight.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore have I hewed {them} by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments {are as} the light {that} goeth forth. {and...: or, that thy judgments might be, etc}
verses.nlt_text: I sent my prophets to cut you to pieces-- to slaughter you with my words, with judgments as inescapable as light.

verses.kjv_text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.nlt_text: I want you to show love, not offer sacrifices. I want you to know me more than I want burnt offerings.

verses.kjv_text: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me. {men: or, Adam}
verses.nlt_text: But like Adam, you broke my covenant and betrayed my trust.

verses.kjv_text: Gilead {is} a city of them that work iniquity, {and is} polluted with blood. {polluted: or, cunning for}
verses.nlt_text: "Gilead is a city of sinners, tracked with footprints of blood.

verses.kjv_text: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, {so} the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness. {by...: Heb. with one shoulder, or, to Shechem} {lewdness: or, enormity}
verses.nlt_text: Priests form bands of robbers, waiting in ambush for their victims. They murder travelers along the road to Shechem and practice every kind of sin.

verses.kjv_text: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there {is} the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I have seen something horrible in Ephraim and Israel: My people are defiled by prostituting themselves with other gods!

verses.kjv_text: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.nlt_text: "O Judah, a harvest of punishment is also waiting for you, though I wanted to restore the fortunes of my people.

verses.kjv_text: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, {and} the troop of robbers spoileth without. {wickedness: Heb. evils} {spoileth: Heb. strippeth}
verses.nlt_text: "I want to heal Israel, but its sins are too great. Samaria is filled with liars. Thieves are on the inside and bandits on the outside!

verses.kjv_text: And they consider not in their hearts {that} I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face. {consider...: Heb. say not to}
verses.nlt_text: Its people don't realize that I am watching them. Their sinful deeds are all around them, and I see them all.

verses.kjv_text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.nlt_text: "The people entertain the king with their wickedness, and the princes laugh at their lies.

verses.kjv_text: They {are} all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, {who} ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened. {who...: or, the raiser will cease} {raising: or, waking}
verses.nlt_text: They are all adulterers, always aflame with lust. They are like an oven that is kept hot while the baker is kneading the dough.

verses.kjv_text: In the day of our king the princes have made {him} sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners. {bottles...: or, heat through wine}
verses.nlt_text: On royal holidays, the princes get drunk with wine, carousing with those who mock them.

verses.kjv_text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire. {made...: or, applied}
verses.nlt_text: Their hearts are like an oven blazing with intrigue. Their plot smolders through the night, and in the morning it breaks out like a raging fire.

verses.kjv_text: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: {there is} none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.nlt_text: Burning like an oven, they consume their leaders. They kill their kings one after another, and no one cries to me for help.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.nlt_text: "The people of Israel mingle with godless foreigners, making themselves as worthless as a half-baked cake!

verses.kjv_text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth {it} not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not. {here...: Heb. sprinkled}
verses.nlt_text: Worshiping foreign gods has sapped their strength, but they don't even know it. Their hair is gray, but they don't realize they're old and weak.

verses.kjv_text: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.nlt_text: Their arrogance testifies against them, yet they don't return to the LORD their God or even try to find him.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.nlt_text: "The people of Israel have become like silly, witless doves, first calling to Egypt, then flying to Assyria for help.

verses.kjv_text: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.nlt_text: But as they fly about, I will throw my net over them and bring them down like a bird from the sky. I will punish them for all the evil they do.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me. {destruction: Heb. spoil}
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits those who have deserted me! Let them die, for they have rebelled against me. I wanted to redeem them, but they have told lies about me.

verses.kjv_text: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, {and} they rebel against me.
verses.nlt_text: They do not cry out to me with sincere hearts. Instead, they sit on their couches and wail. They cut themselves, begging foreign gods for grain and new wine, and they turn away from me.

verses.kjv_text: Though I have bound {and} strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me. {have...: or, chastened}
verses.nlt_text: I trained them and made them strong, yet now they plot evil against me.

verses.kjv_text: They return, {but} not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this {shall be} their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: They look everywhere except to the Most High. They are as useless as a crooked bow. Their leaders will be killed by their enemies because of their insolence toward me. Then the people of Egypt will laugh at them.

verses.kjv_text: {Set} the trumpet to thy mouth. {He shall come} as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law. {thy: Heb. the roof of thy}
verses.nlt_text: "Sound the alarm! The enemy descends like an eagle on the people of the LORD, for they have broken my covenant and revolted against my law.

verses.kjv_text: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
verses.nlt_text: Now Israel pleads with me, 'Help us, for you are our God!'

verses.kjv_text: Israel hath cast off {the thing that is} good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.nlt_text: But it is too late. The people of Israel have rejected what is good, and now their enemies will chase after them.

verses.kjv_text: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew {it} not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.nlt_text: The people have appointed kings without my consent, and princes without my knowledge. By making idols for themselves from their silver and gold, they have brought about their own destruction.

verses.kjv_text: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast {thee} off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long {will it be} ere they attain to innocency?
verses.nlt_text: "O Samaria, I reject this calf-- this idol you have made. My fury burns against you. How long will you be incapable of innocence?

verses.kjv_text: For from Israel {was} it also: the workman made it; therefore it {is} not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.nlt_text: This calf you worship, O Israel, was crafted by your own hands! It is not God! Therefore, it must be smashed to bits.

verses.kjv_text: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up. {stalk: or, standing corn}
verses.nlt_text: "They have planted the wind and will harvest the whirlwind. The stalks of grain wither and produce nothing to eat. And even if there is any grain, foreigners will eat it.

verses.kjv_text: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein {is} no pleasure.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel have been swallowed up; they lie among the nations like an old discarded pot.

verses.kjv_text: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers. {lovers: Heb. loves}
verses.nlt_text: Like a wild donkey looking for a mate, they have gone up to Assyria. The people of Israel have sold themselves-- sold themselves to many lovers.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes. {sorrow: or, begin} {a...: or, in a little while}
verses.nlt_text: But though they have sold themselves to many allies, I will now gather them together for judgment. Then they will writhe under the burden of the great king.

verses.kjv_text: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.nlt_text: "Israel has built many altars to take away sin, but these very altars became places for sinning!

verses.kjv_text: I have written to him the great things of my law, {but} they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.nlt_text: Even though I gave them all my laws, they act as if those laws don't apply to them.

verses.kjv_text: They sacrifice flesh {for} the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat {it; but} the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt. {They sacrifice...: or, In the sacrifices of mine offerings they, etc}
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel love their rituals of sacrifice, but to me their sacrifices are all meaningless. I will hold my people accountable for their sins, and I will punish them. They will return to Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Israel has forgotten its Maker and built great palaces, and Judah has fortified its cities. Therefore, I will send down fire on their cities and will burn up their fortresses."

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as {other} people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor. {upon: or, in, etc}
verses.nlt_text: O people of Israel, do not rejoice as other nations do. For you have been unfaithful to your God, hiring yourselves out like prostitutes, worshiping other gods on every threshing floor.

verses.kjv_text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her. {winepress: or, winefat}
verses.nlt_text: So now your harvests will be too small to feed you. There will be no grapes for making new wine.

verses.kjv_text: They shall not dwell in the LORD'S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean {things} in Assyria.
verses.nlt_text: You may no longer stay here in the LORD's land. Instead, you will return to Egypt, and in Assyria you will eat food that is ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv_text: They shall not offer wine {offerings} to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices {shall be} unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: There you will make no offerings of wine to the LORD. None of your sacrifices there will please him. They will be unclean, like food touched by a person in mourning. All who present such sacrifices will be defiled. They may eat this food themselves, but they may not offer it to the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.nlt_text: What then will you do on festival days? How will you observe the LORD's festivals?

verses.kjv_text: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant {places} for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns {shall be} in their tabernacles. {destruction: Heb. spoil} {the...: or, their silver shall be desired, the nettle, etc.: Heb. the desire}
verses.nlt_text: Even if you escape destruction from Assyria, Egypt will conquer you, and Memphis will bury you. Nettles will take over your treasures of silver; thistles will invade your ruined homes.

verses.kjv_text: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know {it}: the prophet {is} a fool, the spiritual man {is} mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred. {spiritual...: Heb. man of the spirit}
verses.nlt_text: The time of Israel's punishment has come; the day of payment is here. Soon Israel will know this all too well. Because of your great sin and hostility, you say, "The prophets are crazy and the inspired men are fools!"

verses.kjv_text: The watchman of Ephraim {was} with my God: {but} the prophet {is} a snare of a fowler in all his ways, {and} hatred in the house of his God. {in the: or, against the}
verses.nlt_text: The prophet is a watchman over Israel for my God, yet traps are laid for him wherever he goes. He faces hostility even in the house of God.

verses.kjv_text: They have deeply corrupted {themselves}, as in the days of Gibeah: {therefore} he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.nlt_text: The things my people do are as depraved as what they did in Gibeah long ago. God will not forget. He will surely punish them for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: {but} they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto {that} shame; and {their} abominations were according as they loved.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD says, "O Israel, when I first found you, it was like finding fresh grapes in the desert. When I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the first ripe figs of the season. But then they deserted me for Baal-peor, giving themselves to that shameful idol. Soon they became vile, as vile as the god they worshiped.

verses.kjv_text: {As for} Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.nlt_text: The glory of Israel will fly away like a bird, for your children will not be born or grow in the womb or even be conceived.

verses.kjv_text: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, {that there shall} not {be} a man {left}: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.nlt_text: Even if you do have children who grow up, I will take them from you. It will be a terrible day when I turn away and leave you alone.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, {is} planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.nlt_text: I have watched Israel become as beautiful as Tyre. But now Israel will bring out her children for slaughter."

verses.kjv_text: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts. {miscarrying: Heb. that casteth the fruit}
verses.nlt_text: O LORD, what should I request for your people? I will ask for wombs that don't give birth and breasts that give no milk.

verses.kjv_text: All their wickedness {is} in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes {are} revolters.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD says, "All their wickedness began at Gilgal; there I began to hate them. I will drive them from my land because of their evil actions. I will love them no more because all their leaders are rebels.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay {even} the beloved {fruit} of their womb. {the...: Heb. the desires}
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel are struck down. Their roots are dried up, and they will bear no more fruit. And if they give birth, I will slaughter their beloved children."

verses.kjv_text: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.nlt_text: My God will reject the people of Israel because they will not listen or obey. They will be wanderers, homeless among the nations.

verses.kjv_text: Israel {is} an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images. {an...: or, a vine emptying the fruit which it giveth} {images: Heb. statues, or, standing images}
verses.nlt_text: How prosperous Israel is-- a luxuriant vine loaded with fruit. But the richer the people get, the more pagan altars they build. The more bountiful their harvests, the more beautiful their sacred pillars.

verses.kjv_text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images. {Their heart...: or, He hath divided their heart} {break...: Heb. behead} {images: Heb. statues, or, standing images}
verses.nlt_text: The hearts of the people are fickle; they are guilty and must be punished. The LORD will break down their altars and smash their sacred pillars.

verses.kjv_text: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
verses.nlt_text: Then they will say, "We have no king because we didn't fear the LORD. But even if we had a king, what could he do for us anyway?"

verses.kjv_text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.nlt_text: They spout empty words and make covenants they don't intend to keep. So injustice springs up among them like poisonous weeds in a farmer's field.

verses.kjv_text: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof {that} rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it. {the priests...: or, Chemarim}
verses.nlt_text: The people of Samaria tremble in fear for what might happen to their calf idol at Beth-aven. The people mourn and the priests wail, because its glory will be stripped away.

verses.kjv_text: It shall be also carried unto Assyria {for} a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.nlt_text: This idol will be carted away to Assyria, a gift to the great king there. Ephraim will be ridiculed and Israel will be shamed, because its people have trusted in this idol.

verses.kjv_text: {As for} Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water. {the water: Heb. the face of the water}
verses.nlt_text: Samaria and its king will be cut off; they will float away like driftwood on an ocean wave.

verses.kjv_text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.nlt_text: And the pagan shrines of Aven, the place of Israel's sin, will crumble. Thorns and thistles will grow up around their altars. They will beg the mountains, "Bury us!" and plead with the hills, "Fall on us!"

verses.kjv_text: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD says, "O Israel, ever since Gibeah, there has been only sin and more sin! You have made no progress whatsoever. Was it not right that the wicked men of Gibeah were attacked?

verses.kjv_text: {It is} in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows. {when...: or, when I shall bind them for their two transgressions, or, in their two habitations}
verses.nlt_text: Now whenever it fits my plan, I will attack you, too. I will call out the armies of the nations to punish you for your multiplied sins.

verses.kjv_text: And Ephraim {is as} an heifer {that is} taught, {and} loveth to tread out {the corn}; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, {and} Jacob shall break his clods. {her...: Heb. the beauty of her neck}
verses.nlt_text: "Israel is like a trained heifer treading out the grain-- an easy job she loves. But I will put a heavy yoke on her tender neck. I will force Judah to pull the plow and Israel to break up the hard ground.

verses.kjv_text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for {it is} time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.nlt_text: I said, 'Plant the good seeds of righteousness, and you will harvest a crop of love. Plow up the hard ground of your hearts, for now is the time to seek the LORD, that he may come and shower righteousness upon you.'

verses.kjv_text: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.nlt_text: "But you have cultivated wickedness and harvested a thriving crop of sins. You have eaten the fruit of lies-- trusting in your military might, believing that great armies could make your nation safe.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon {her} children.
verses.nlt_text: Now the terrors of war will rise among your people. All your fortifications will fall, just as when Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel. Even mothers and children were dashed to death there.

verses.kjv_text: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off. {your...: Heb. the evil of your evil}
verses.nlt_text: You will share that fate, Bethel, because of your great wickedness. When the day of judgment dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: When Israel {was} a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: {As} they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.nlt_text: But the more I called to him, the farther he moved from me, offering sacrifices to the images of Baal and burning incense to idols.

verses.kjv_text: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.nlt_text: I myself taught Israel how to walk, leading him along by the hand. But he doesn't know or even care that it was I who took care of him.

verses.kjv_text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them. {take off: Heb. lift up}
verses.nlt_text: I led Israel along with my ropes of kindness and love. I lifted the yoke from his neck, and I myself stooped to feed him.

verses.kjv_text: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.nlt_text: "But since my people refuse to return to me, they will return to Egypt and will be forced to serve Assyria.

verses.kjv_text: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour {them}, because of their own counsels.
verses.nlt_text: War will swirl through their cities; their enemies will crash through their gates. They will destroy them, trapping them in their own evil plans.

verses.kjv_text: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt {him}. {none...: Heb. together they exalted not}
verses.nlt_text: For my people are determined to desert me. They call me the Most High, but they don't truly honor me.

verses.kjv_text: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? {how} shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? {how} shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.nlt_text: "Oh, how can I give you up, Israel? How can I let you go? How can I destroy you like Admah or demolish you like Zeboiim? My heart is torn within me, and my compassion overflows.

verses.kjv_text: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I {am} God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.nlt_text: No, I will not unleash my fierce anger. I will not completely destroy Israel, for I am God and not a mere mortal. I am the Holy One living among you, and I will not come to destroy.

verses.kjv_text: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.nlt_text: For someday the people will follow me. I, the LORD, will roar like a lion. And when I roar, my people will return trembling from the west.

verses.kjv_text: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: Like a flock of birds, they will come from Egypt. Trembling like doves, they will return from Assyria. And I will bring them home again," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints. {saints: or, most holy}
verses.nlt_text: Israel surrounds me with lies and deceit, but Judah still obeys God and is faithful to the Holy One.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Israel feed on the wind; they chase after the east wind all day long. They pile up lies and violence; they are making an alliance with Assyria while sending olive oil to buy support from Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him. {punish: Heb. visit upon}
verses.nlt_text: Now the LORD is bringing charges against Judah. He is about to punish Jacob for all his deceitful ways, and pay him back for all he has done.

verses.kjv_text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God: {had...: Heb. was a prince, or, behaved himself princely}
verses.nlt_text: Even in the womb, Jacob struggled with his brother; when he became a man, he even fought with God.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him {in} Bethel, and there he spake with us;
verses.nlt_text: Yes, he wrestled with the angel and won. He wept and pleaded for a blessing from him. There at Bethel he met God face to face, and God spoke to him--

verses.kjv_text: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD {is} his memorial.
verses.nlt_text: the LORD God of Heaven's Armies, the LORD is his name!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
verses.nlt_text: So now, come back to your God. Act with love and justice, and always depend on him.

verses.kjv_text: {He is} a merchant, the balances of deceit {are} in his hand: he loveth to oppress. {a merchant: or, Canaan} {oppress: or, deceive}
verses.nlt_text: But no, the people are like crafty merchants selling from dishonest scales-- they love to cheat.

verses.kjv_text: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: {in} all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that {were} sin. {in all...: or, all my labours suffice me not: he shall have punishment of iniquity in whom is sin} {that: Heb. which}
verses.nlt_text: Israel boasts, "I am rich! I've made a fortune all by myself! No one has caught me cheating! My record is spotless!"

verses.kjv_text: And I {that am} the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.nlt_text: "But I am the LORD your God, who rescued you from slavery in Egypt. And I will make you live in tents again, as you do each year at the Festival of Shelters.

verses.kjv_text: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets. {ministry: Heb. hand}
verses.nlt_text: I sent my prophets to warn you with many visions and parables."

verses.kjv_text: {Is there} iniquity {in} Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars {are} as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.nlt_text: But the people of Gilead are worthless because of their idol worship. And in Gilgal, too, they sacrifice bulls; their altars are lined up like the heaps of stone along the edges of a plowed field.

verses.kjv_text: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept {sheep}.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob fled to the land of Aram, and there he earned a wife by tending sheep.

verses.kjv_text: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.nlt_text: Then by a prophet the LORD brought Jacob's descendants out of Egypt; and by that prophet they were protected.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim provoked {him} to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him. {most...: Heb. with bitternesses} {blood: Heb. bloods}
verses.nlt_text: But the people of Israel have bitterly provoked the LORD, so their Lord will now sentence them to death in payment for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.nlt_text: When the tribe of Ephraim spoke, the people shook with fear, for that tribe was important in Israel. But the people of Ephraim sinned by worshiping Baal and thus sealed their destruction.

verses.kjv_text: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, {and} idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves. {they sin...: Heb. they add to sin} {the men...: or, the sacrificers of men}
verses.nlt_text: Now they continue to sin by making silver idols, images shaped skillfully with human hands. "Sacrifice to these," they cry, "and kiss the calf idols!"

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff {that} is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, they will disappear like the morning mist, like dew in the morning sun, like chaff blown by the wind, like smoke from a chimney.

verses.kjv_text: Yet I {am} the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for {there is} no saviour beside me.
verses.nlt_text: "I have been the LORD your God ever since I brought you out of Egypt. You must acknowledge no God but me, for there is no other savior.

verses.kjv_text: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought. {great...: Heb. droughts}
verses.nlt_text: I took care of you in the wilderness, in that dry and thirsty land.

verses.kjv_text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.nlt_text: But when you had eaten and were satisfied, you became proud and forgot me.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe {them}:
verses.nlt_text: So now I will attack you like a lion, like a leopard that lurks along the road.

verses.kjv_text: I will meet them as a bear {that is} bereaved {of her whelps}, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them. {wild...: Heb. beast of the field}
verses.nlt_text: Like a bear whose cubs have been taken away, I will tear out your heart. I will devour you like a hungry lioness and mangle you like a wild animal.

verses.kjv_text: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me {is} thine help. {is...: Heb. in thy help}
verses.nlt_text: "You are about to be destroyed, O Israel-- yes, by me, your only helper.

verses.kjv_text: I will be thy king: where {is any other} that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes? {I will...: rather, Where is thy king?}
verses.nlt_text: Now where is your king? Let him save you! Where are all the leaders of the land, the king and the officials you demanded of me?

verses.kjv_text: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took {him} away in my wrath.
verses.nlt_text: In my anger I gave you kings, and in my fury I took them away.

verses.kjv_text: The iniquity of Ephraim {is} bound up; his sin {is} hid.
verses.nlt_text: "Ephraim's guilt has been collected, and his sin has been stored up for punishment.

verses.kjv_text: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he {is} an unwise son; for he should not stay long in {the place of} the breaking forth of children. {long: Heb. a time}
verses.nlt_text: Pain has come to the people like the pain of childbirth, but they are like a child who resists being born. The moment of birth has arrived, but they stay in the womb!

verses.kjv_text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes. {power: Heb. hand}
verses.nlt_text: "Should I ransom them from the grave? Should I redeem them from death? O death, bring on your terrors! O grave, bring on your plagues! For I will not take pity on them.

verses.kjv_text: Though he be fruitful among {his} brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels. {pleasant...: Heb. vessels of desire}
verses.nlt_text: Ephraim was the most fruitful of all his brothers, but the east wind-- a blast from the LORD-- will arise in the desert. All their flowing springs will run dry, and all their wells will disappear. Every precious thing they own will be plundered and carried away.

verses.kjv_text: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Samaria must bear the consequences of their guilt because they rebelled against their God. They will be killed by an invading army, their little ones dashed to death against the ground, their pregnant women ripped open by swords."

verses.kjv_text: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for your sins have brought you down.

verses.kjv_text: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive {us} graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips. {receive...: or, give good}
verses.nlt_text: Bring your confessions, and return to the LORD. Say to him, "Forgive all our sins and graciously receive us, so that we may offer you our praises.

verses.kjv_text: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, {Ye are} our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.nlt_text: Assyria cannot save us, nor can our war-horses. Never again will we say to the idols we have made, 'You are our gods.' No, in you alone do the orphans find mercy."

verses.kjv_text: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD says, "Then I will heal you of your faithlessness; my love will know no bounds, for my anger will be gone forever.

verses.kjv_text: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon. {grow: or, blossom} {cast...: Heb. strike}
verses.nlt_text: I will be to Israel like a refreshing dew from heaven. Israel will blossom like the lily; it will send roots deep into the soil like the cedars in Lebanon.

verses.kjv_text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon. {spread: Heb. go}
verses.nlt_text: Its branches will spread out like beautiful olive trees, as fragrant as the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.kjv_text: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive {as} the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof {shall be} as the wine of Lebanon. {grow: or, blossom} {scent: or, memorial}
verses.nlt_text: My people will again live under my shade. They will flourish like grain and blossom like grapevines. They will be as fragrant as the wines of Lebanon.

verses.kjv_text: Ephraim {shall say}, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard {him}, and observed him: I {am} like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.nlt_text: "O Israel, stay away from idols! I am the one who answers your prayers and cares for you. I am like a tree that is always green; all your fruit comes from me."

verses.kjv_text: Who {is} wise, and he shall understand these {things}? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD {are} right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.nlt_text: Let those who are wise understand these things. Let those with discernment listen carefully. The paths of the LORD are true and right, and righteous people live by walking in them. But in those paths sinners stumble and fall.

verses.kjv_text: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD gave this message to Joel son of Pethuel.

verses.kjv_text: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.nlt_text: Hear this, you leaders of the people. Listen, all who live in the land. In all your history, has anything like this happened before?

verses.kjv_text: Tell ye your children of it, and {let} your children {tell} their children, and their children another generation.
verses.nlt_text: Tell your children about it in the years to come, and let your children tell their children. Pass the story down from generation to generation.

verses.kjv_text: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten. {That which the palmerworm...: Heb. The residue of the palmerworm}
verses.nlt_text: After the cutting locusts finished eating the crops, the swarming locusts took what was left! After them came the hopping locusts, and then the stripping locusts, too!

verses.kjv_text: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.nlt_text: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you wine-drinkers! All the grapes are ruined, and all your sweet wine is gone.

verses.kjv_text: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth {are} the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
verses.nlt_text: A vast army of locusts has invaded my land, a terrible army too numerous to count. Its teeth are like lions' teeth, its fangs like those of a lioness.

verses.kjv_text: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast {it} away; the branches thereof are made white. {barked...: Heb. laid my fig tree for a barking}
verses.nlt_text: It has destroyed my grapevines and ruined my fig trees, stripping their bark and destroying it, leaving the branches white and bare.

verses.kjv_text: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.nlt_text: Weep like a bride dressed in black, mourning the death of her husband.

verses.kjv_text: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD'S ministers, mourn.
verses.nlt_text: For there is no grain or wine to offer at the Temple of the LORD. So the priests are in mourning. The ministers of the LORD are weeping.

verses.kjv_text: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.nlt_text: The fields are ruined, the land is stripped bare. The grain is destroyed, the grapes have shriveled, and the olive oil is gone.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.nlt_text: Despair, all you farmers! Wail, all you vine growers! Weep, because the wheat and barley-- all the crops of the field-- are ruined.

verses.kjv_text: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, {even} all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.nlt_text: The grapevines have dried up, and the fig trees have withered. The pomegranate trees, palm trees, and apple trees-- all the fruit trees-- have dried up. And the people's joy has dried up with them.

verses.kjv_text: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
verses.nlt_text: Dress yourselves in burlap and weep, you priests! Wail, you who serve before the altar! Come, spend the night in burlap, you ministers of my God. For there is no grain or wine to offer at the Temple of your God.

verses.kjv_text: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders {and} all the inhabitants of the land {into} the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD, {solemn...: or, day of restraint}
verses.nlt_text: Announce a time of fasting; call the people together for a solemn meeting. Bring the leaders and all the people of the land into the Temple of the LORD your God, and cry out to him there.

verses.kjv_text: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD {is} at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.nlt_text: The day of the LORD is near, the day when destruction comes from the Almighty. How terrible that day will be!

verses.kjv_text: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, {yea}, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.nlt_text: Our food disappears before our very eyes. No joyful celebrations are held in the house of our God.

verses.kjv_text: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered. {seed: Heb. grains}
verses.nlt_text: The seeds die in the parched ground, and the grain crops fail. The barns stand empty, and granaries are abandoned.

verses.kjv_text: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.nlt_text: How the animals moan with hunger! The herds of cattle wander about confused, because they have no pasture. The flocks of sheep and goats bleat in misery.

verses.kjv_text: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field. {pastures: or, habitations}
verses.nlt_text: LORD, help us! The fire has consumed the wilderness pastures, and flames have burned up all the trees.

verses.kjv_text: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: Even the wild animals cry out to you because the streams have dried up, and fire has consumed the wilderness pastures.

verses.kjv_text: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for {it is} nigh at hand; {trumpet: or, cornet}
verses.nlt_text: Sound the alarm in Jerusalem! Raise the battle cry on my holy mountain! Let everyone tremble in fear because the day of the LORD is upon us.

verses.kjv_text: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, {even} to the years of many generations. {of many...: Heb. of generation and generation}
verses.nlt_text: It is a day of darkness and gloom, a day of thick clouds and deep blackness. Suddenly, like dawn spreading across the mountains, a great and mighty army appears. Nothing like it has been seen before or will ever be seen again.

verses.kjv_text: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land {is} as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.nlt_text: Fire burns in front of them, and flames follow after them. Ahead of them the land lies as beautiful as the Garden of Eden. Behind them is nothing but desolation; not one thing escapes.

verses.kjv_text: The appearance of them {is} as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.nlt_text: They look like horses; they charge forward like war horses.

verses.kjv_text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.nlt_text: Look at them as they leap along the mountaintops. Listen to the noise they make-- like the rumbling of chariots, like the roar of fire sweeping across a field of stubble, or like a mighty army moving into battle.

verses.kjv_text: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness. {blackness: Heb. pot}
verses.nlt_text: Fear grips all the people; every face grows pale with terror.

verses.kjv_text: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.nlt_text: The attackers march like warriors and scale city walls like soldiers. Straight forward they march, never breaking rank.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and {when} they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded. {sword: or, dart}
verses.nlt_text: They never jostle each other; each moves in exactly the right position. They break through defenses without missing a step.

verses.kjv_text: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.nlt_text: They swarm over the city and run along its walls. They enter all the houses, climbing like thieves through the windows.

verses.kjv_text: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.nlt_text: The earth quakes as they advance, and the heavens tremble. The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars no longer shine.

verses.kjv_text: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp {is} very great: for {he is} strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD {is} great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.nlt_text: The LORD is at the head of the column. He leads them with a shout. This is his mighty army, and they follow his orders. The day of the LORD is an awesome, terrible thing. Who can possibly survive?

verses.kjv_text: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye {even} to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.nlt_text: That is why the LORD says, "Turn to me now, while there is time. Give me your hearts. Come with fasting, weeping, and mourning.

verses.kjv_text: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he {is} gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.nlt_text: Don't tear your clothing in your grief, but tear your hearts instead." Return to the LORD your God, for he is merciful and compassionate, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love. He is eager to relent and not punish.

verses.kjv_text: Who knoweth {if} he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; {even} a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
verses.nlt_text: Who knows? Perhaps he will give you a reprieve, sending you a blessing instead of this curse. Perhaps you will be able to offer grain and wine to the LORD your God as before.

verses.kjv_text: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.nlt_text: Blow the ram's horn in Jerusalem! Announce a time of fasting; call the people together for a solemn meeting.

verses.kjv_text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.nlt_text: Gather all the people-- the elders, the children, and even the babies. Call the bridegroom from his quarters and the bride from her private room.

verses.kjv_text: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where {is} their God? {rule over: or, use a byword against}
verses.nlt_text: Let the priests, who minister in the LORD's presence, stand and weep between the entry room to the Temple and the altar. Let them pray, "Spare your people, LORD! Don't let your special possession become an object of mockery. Don't let them become a joke for unbelieving foreigners who say, 'Has the God of Israel left them?'"

verses.kjv_text: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
verses.nlt_text: Then the LORD will pity his people and jealously guard the honor of his land.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
verses.nlt_text: The LORD will reply, "Look! I am sending you grain and new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy your needs. You will no longer be an object of mockery among the surrounding nations.

verses.kjv_text: But I will remove far off from you the northern {army}, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things. {hath...: Heb. hath magnified to do}
verses.nlt_text: I will drive away these armies from the north. I will send them into the parched wastelands. Those in the front will be driven into the Dead Sea, and those at the rear into the Mediterranean. The stench of their rotting bodies will rise over the land." Surely the LORD has done great things!

verses.kjv_text: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things. {will...: Heb. hath magnified to do}
verses.nlt_text: Don't be afraid, my people. Be glad now and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things.

verses.kjv_text: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be afraid, you animals of the field, for the wilderness pastures will soon be green. The trees will again be filled with fruit; fig trees and grapevines will be loaded down once more.

verses.kjv_text: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first {month}. {the former rain moderately: or, a teacher of righteousness} {moderately: Heb. according to righteousness}
verses.nlt_text: Rejoice, you people of Jerusalem! Rejoice in the LORD your God! For the rain he sends demonstrates his faithfulness. Once more the autumn rains will come, as well as the rains of spring.

verses.kjv_text: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.nlt_text: The threshing floors will again be piled high with grain, and the presses will overflow with new wine and olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.nlt_text: The LORD says, "I will give you back what you lost to the swarming locusts, the hopping locusts, the stripping locusts, and the cutting locusts. It was I who sent this great destroying army against you.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.nlt_text: Once again you will have all the food you want, and you will praise the LORD your God, who does these miracles for you. Never again will my people be disgraced.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall know that I {am} in the midst of Israel, and {that} I {am} the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will know that I am among my people Israel, that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. Never again will my people be disgraced.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass afterward, {that} I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.nlt_text: "Then, after doing all those things, I will pour out my Spirit upon all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams, and your young men will see visions.

verses.kjv_text: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.nlt_text: In those days I will pour out my Spirit even on servants-- men and women alike.

verses.kjv_text: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.nlt_text: And I will cause wonders in the heavens and on the earth-- blood and fire and columns of smoke.

verses.kjv_text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
verses.nlt_text: The sun will become dark, and the moon will turn blood red before that great and terrible day of the LORD arrives.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
verses.nlt_text: But everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved, for some on Mount Zion in Jerusalem will escape, just as the LORD has said. These will be among the survivors whom the LORD has called.

verses.kjv_text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.nlt_text: "At the time of those events," says the LORD, "when I restore the prosperity of Judah and Jerusalem,

verses.kjv_text: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and {for} my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.nlt_text: I will gather the armies of the world into the valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will judge them for harming my people, my special possession, for scattering my people among the nations, and for dividing up my land.

verses.kjv_text: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.nlt_text: They cast lots to decide which of my people would be their slaves. They traded boys to obtain prostitutes and sold girls for enough wine to get drunk.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly {and} speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.nlt_text: "What do you have against me, Tyre and Sidon and you cities of Philistia? Are you trying to take revenge on me? If you are, then watch out! I will strike swiftly and pay you back for everything you have done.

verses.kjv_text: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things: {pleasant: Heb. desirable}
verses.nlt_text: You have taken my silver and gold and all my precious treasures, and have carried them off to your pagan temples.

verses.kjv_text: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border. {the Grecians: Heb. the sons of the Grecians}
verses.nlt_text: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, so they could take them far from their homeland.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.nlt_text: "But I will bring them back from all the places to which you sold them, and I will pay you back for everything you have done.

verses.kjv_text: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken {it}.
verses.nlt_text: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the people of Arabia, a nation far away. I, the LORD, have spoken!"

verses.kjv_text: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up: {Prepare: Heb. Sanctify}
verses.nlt_text: Say to the nations far and wide: "Get ready for war! Call out your best warriors. Let all your fighting men advance for the attack.

verses.kjv_text: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I {am} strong. {pruninghooks: or, scythes}
verses.nlt_text: Hammer your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Train even your weaklings to be warriors.

verses.kjv_text: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD. {cause...: or, the LORD shall bring down}
verses.nlt_text: Come quickly, all you nations everywhere. Gather together in the valley." And now, O LORD, call out your warriors!

verses.kjv_text: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.nlt_text: "Let the nations be called to arms. Let them march to the valley of Jehoshaphat. There I, the LORD, will sit to pronounce judgment on them all.

verses.kjv_text: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness {is} great.
verses.nlt_text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread the grapes, for the winepress is full. The storage vats are overflowing with the wickedness of these people."

verses.kjv_text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD {is} near in the valley of decision. {decision: or, concision, or, threshing}
verses.nlt_text: Thousands upon thousands are waiting in the valley of decision. There the day of the LORD will soon arrive.

verses.kjv_text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.nlt_text: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.

verses.kjv_text: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD {will be} the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel. {hope: Heb. place of repair, or, harbour}
verses.nlt_text: The LORD's voice will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth will shake. But the LORD will be a refuge for his people, a strong fortress for the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: So shall ye know that I {am} the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more. {holy: Heb. holiness}
verses.nlt_text: "Then you will know that I, the LORD your God, live in Zion, my holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy forever, and foreign armies will never conquer her again.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim. {flow: Heb. go}
verses.nlt_text: In that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. Water will fill the streambeds of Judah, and a fountain will burst forth from the LORD's Temple, watering the arid valley of acacias.

verses.kjv_text: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence {against} the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.nlt_text: But Egypt will become a wasteland and Edom will become a wilderness, because they attacked the people of Judah and killed innocent people in their land.

verses.kjv_text: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation. {dwell: or, abide}
verses.nlt_text: "But Judah will be filled with people forever, and Jerusalem will endure through all generations.

verses.kjv_text: For I will cleanse their blood {that} I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion. {for the...: or, even I the LORD that}
verses.nlt_text: I will pardon my people's crimes, which I have not yet pardoned; and I, the LORD, will make my home in Jerusalem with my people."

verses.kjv_text: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.nlt_text: This message was given to Amos, a shepherd from the town of Tekoa in Judah. He received this message in visions two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam II, the son of Jehoash, was king of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.nlt_text: This is what he saw and heard: "The LORD roars from his Temple on Mount Zion; his voice thunders from Jerusalem! Suddenly, the lush pastures of the shepherds dry up. All the grass on Mount Carmel withers and dies."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron: {and...: or, yea, for four} {turn...: or, convert it, or, let it be quiet}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Damascus have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They beat down my people in Gilead as grain is threshed with iron sledges.

verses.kjv_text: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on King Hazael's palace, and the fortresses of King Ben-hadad will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD. {the plain...: or, Bikathaven} {the house...: or, Betheden}
verses.nlt_text: I will break down the gates of Damascus and slaughter the people in the valley of Aven. I will destroy the ruler in Beth-eden, and the people of Aram will go as captives to Kir," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver {them} up to Edom: {away captive...: or, them away with an entire}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Gaza have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They sent whole villages into exile, selling them as slaves to Edom.

verses.kjv_text: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on the walls of Gaza, and all its fortresses will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.nlt_text: I will slaughter the people of Ashdod and destroy the king of Ashkelon. Then I will turn to attack Ekron, and the few Philistines still left will be killed," says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant: {the brotherly...: Heb. the covenant of brethren}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Tyre have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They broke their treaty of brotherhood with Israel, selling whole villages as slaves to Edom.

verses.kjv_text: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on the walls of Tyre, and all its fortresses will be destroyed."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever: {did cast...: Heb. corrupted his compassions}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Edom have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They chased down their relatives, the Israelites, with swords, showing them no mercy. In their rage, they slashed them continually and were unrelenting in their anger.

verses.kjv_text: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on Teman, and the fortresses of Bozrah will be destroyed."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border: {ripped...: or, divided the mountains}
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Ammon have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! When they attacked Gilead to extend their borders, they ripped open pregnant women with their swords.

verses.kjv_text: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on the walls of Rabbah, and all its fortresses will be destroyed. The battle will come upon them with shouts, like a whirlwind in a mighty storm.

verses.kjv_text: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: And their king and his princes will go into exile together," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Moab have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They desecrated the bones of Edom's king, burning them to ashes.

verses.kjv_text: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, {and} with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on the land of Moab, and all the fortresses in Kerioth will be destroyed. The people will fall in the noise of battle, as the warriors shout and the ram's horn sounds.

verses.kjv_text: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: And I will destroy their king and slaughter all their princes," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Judah have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They have rejected the instruction of the LORD, refusing to obey his decrees. They have been led astray by the same lies that deceived their ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: So I will send down fire on Judah, and all the fortresses of Jerusalem will be destroyed."

verses.kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away {the punishment} thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.nlt_text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Israel have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They sell honorable people for silver and poor people for a pair of sandals.

verses.kjv_text: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the {same} maid, to profane my holy name: {maid: or, young woman}
verses.nlt_text: They trample helpless people in the dust and shove the oppressed out of the way. Both father and son sleep with the same woman, corrupting my holy name.

verses.kjv_text: And they lay {themselves} down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned {in} the house of their god. {the condemned: or, such as have fined, or, mulcted}
verses.nlt_text: At their religious festivals, they lounge in clothing their debtors put up as security. In the house of their god, they drink wine bought with unjust fines.

verses.kjv_text: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height {was} like the height of the cedars, and he {was} strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.nlt_text: "But as my people watched, I destroyed the Amorites, though they were as tall as cedars and as strong as oaks. I destroyed the fruit on their branches and dug out their roots.

verses.kjv_text: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.nlt_text: It was I who rescued you from Egypt and led you through the desert for forty years, so you could possess the land of the Amorites.

verses.kjv_text: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. {Is it} not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
verses.nlt_text: I chose some of your sons to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. Can you deny this, my people of Israel?" asks the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.nlt_text: "But you caused the Nazirites to sin by making them drink wine, and you commanded the prophets, 'Shut up!'

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed {that is} full of sheaves. {I am...: or, I will press your place, as a cart full of sheaves presseth}
verses.nlt_text: "So I will make you groan like a wagon loaded down with sheaves of grain.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself: {himself: Heb. his soul, or, life}
verses.nlt_text: Your fastest runners will not get away. The strongest among you will become weak. Even mighty warriors will be unable to save themselves.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and {he that is} swift of foot shall not deliver {himself}: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
verses.nlt_text: The archers will not stand their ground. The swiftest runners won't be fast enough to escape. Even those riding horses won't be able to save themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And {he that is} courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD. {courageous: Heb. strong of his heart}
verses.nlt_text: On that day the most courageous of your fighting men will drop their weapons and run for their lives," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Listen to this message that the LORD has spoken against you, O people of Israel and Judah-- against the entire family I rescued from Egypt:

verses.kjv_text: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities. {punish: Heb. visit upon}
verses.nlt_text: "From among all the families on the earth, I have been intimate with you alone. That is why I must punish you for all your sins."

verses.kjv_text: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
verses.nlt_text: Can two people walk together without agreeing on the direction?

verses.kjv_text: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing? {cry: Heb. give forth his voice}
verses.nlt_text: Does a lion ever roar in a thicket without first finding a victim? Does a young lion growl in its den without first catching its prey?

verses.kjv_text: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin {is} for him? shall {one} take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.nlt_text: Does a bird ever get caught in a trap that has no bait? Does a trap spring shut when there's nothing to catch?

verses.kjv_text: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done {it}? {be afraid: or, run together?} {the LORD...: or, shall not the LORD do somewhat?}
verses.nlt_text: When the ram's horn blows a warning, shouldn't the people be alarmed? Does disaster come to a city unless the LORD has planned it?

verses.kjv_text: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: Indeed, the Sovereign LORD never does anything until he reveals his plans to his servants the prophets.

verses.kjv_text: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
verses.nlt_text: The lion has roared-- so who isn't frightened? The Sovereign LORD has spoken-- so who can refuse to proclaim his message?

verses.kjv_text: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof. {oppressed: or, oppressions}
verses.nlt_text: Announce this to the leaders of Philistia and to the great ones of Egypt: "Take your seats now on the hills around Samaria, and witness the chaos and oppression in Israel."

verses.kjv_text: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces. {robbery: or, spoil}
verses.nlt_text: "My people have forgotten how to do right," says the LORD. "Their fortresses are filled with wealth taken by theft and violence.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary {there shall be} even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
