verses.nlt_text: "Not everyone who calls out to me, 'Lord! Lord!' will enter the Kingdom of Heaven. Only those who actually do the will of my Father in heaven will enter.

verses.kjv_text: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.nlt_text: On judgment day many will say to me, 'Lord! Lord! We prophesied in your name and cast out demons in your name and performed many miracles in your name.'

verses.kjv_text: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: But I will reply, 'I never knew you. Get away from me, you who break God's laws.'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who listens to my teaching and follows it is wise, like a person who builds a house on solid rock.

verses.kjv_text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.nlt_text: Though the rain comes in torrents and the floodwaters rise and the winds beat against that house, it won't collapse because it is built on bedrock.

verses.kjv_text: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.nlt_text: But anyone who hears my teaching and ignores it is foolish, like a person who builds a house on sand.

verses.kjv_text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.nlt_text: When the rains and floods come and the winds beat against that house, it will collapse with a mighty crash."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,

verses.kjv_text: For he taught them as {one} having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.nlt_text: for he taught with real authority-- quite unlike their teachers of religious law.

verses.kjv_text: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.nlt_text: Large crowds followed Jesus as he came down the mountainside.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, a man with leprosy approached him and knelt before him. "Lord," the man said, "if you are willing, you can heal me and make me clean."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus put forth {his} hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus reached out and touched him. "I am willing," he said. "Be healed!" And instantly the leprosy disappeared.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to him, "Don't tell anyone about this. Instead, go to the priest and let him examine you. Take along the offering required in the law of Moses for those who have been healed of leprosy. This will be a public testimony that you have been cleansed."

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus returned to Capernaum, a Roman officer came and pleaded with him,

verses.kjv_text: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.nlt_text: "Lord, my young servant lies in bed, paralyzed and in terrible pain."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "I will come and heal him."

verses.kjv_text: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.nlt_text: But the officer said, "Lord, I am not worthy to have you come into my home. Just say the word from where you are, and my servant will be healed.

verses.kjv_text: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this {man}, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth {it}.
verses.nlt_text: I know this because I am under the authority of my superior officers, and I have authority over my soldiers. I only need to say, 'Go,' and they go, or 'Come,' and they come. And if I say to my slaves, 'Do this,' they do it."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus heard {it}, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. Turning to those who were following him, he said, "I tell you the truth, I haven't seen faith like this in all Israel!

verses.kjv_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: And I tell you this, that many Gentiles will come from all over the world-- from east and west-- and sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob at the feast in the Kingdom of Heaven.

verses.kjv_text: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.nlt_text: But many Israelites-- those for whom the Kingdom was prepared-- will be thrown into outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, {so} be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the Roman officer, "Go back home. Because you believed, it has happened." And the young servant was healed that same hour.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus arrived at Peter's house, Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with a high fever.

verses.kjv_text: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.nlt_text: But when Jesus touched her hand, the fever left her. Then she got up and prepared a meal for him.

verses.kjv_text: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with {his} word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.nlt_text: That evening many demon-possessed people were brought to Jesus. He cast out the evil spirits with a simple command, and he healed all the sick.

verses.kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare {our} sicknesses.
verses.nlt_text: This fulfilled the word of the Lord through the prophet Isaiah, who said, "He took our sicknesses and removed our diseases."

verses.kjv_text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he instructed his disciples to cross to the other side of the lake.

verses.kjv_text: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.nlt_text: Then one of the teachers of religious law said to him, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air {have} nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay {his} head.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "Foxes have dens to live in, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place even to lay his head."

verses.kjv_text: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.nlt_text: Another of his disciples said, "Lord, first let me return home and bury my father."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus told him, "Follow me now. Let the spiritually dead bury their own dead. "

verses.kjv_text: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus got into the boat and started across the lake with his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, a fierce storm struck the lake, with waves breaking into the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples came to {him}, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples went and woke him up, shouting, "Lord, save us! We're going to drown!"

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "Why are you afraid? You have so little faith!" Then he got up and rebuked the wind and waves, and suddenly all was calm.

verses.kjv_text: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.nlt_text: The disciples were amazed. "Who is this man?" they asked. "Even the winds and waves obey him!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus arrived on the other side of the lake, in the region of the Gadarenes, two men who were possessed by demons met him. They lived in a cemetery and were so violent that no one could go through that area.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.nlt_text: They began screaming at him, "Why are you interfering with us, Son of God? Have you come here to torture us before God's appointed time?"

verses.kjv_text: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.nlt_text: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding in the distance.

verses.kjv_text: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.nlt_text: So the demons begged, "If you cast us out, send us into that herd of pigs."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.nlt_text: "All right, go!" Jesus commanded them. So the demons came out of the men and entered the pigs, and the whole herd plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned in the water.

verses.kjv_text: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.nlt_text: The herdsmen fled to the nearby town, telling everyone what happened to the demon-possessed men.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought {him} that he would depart out of their coasts.
verses.nlt_text: Then the entire town came out to meet Jesus, but they begged him to go away and leave them alone.

verses.kjv_text: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus climbed into a boat and went back across the lake to his own town.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.nlt_text: Some people brought to him a paralyzed man on a mat. Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, "Be encouraged, my child! Your sins are forgiven."

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This {man} blasphemeth.
verses.nlt_text: But some of the teachers of religious law said to themselves, "That's blasphemy! Does he think he's God?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he asked them, "Why do you have such evil thoughts in your hearts?

verses.kjv_text: For whether is easier, to say, {Thy} sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.nlt_text: Is it easier to say 'Your sins are forgiven,' or 'Stand up and walk'?

verses.kjv_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.nlt_text: So I will prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins." Then Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said, "Stand up, pick up your mat, and go home!"

verses.kjv_text: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.nlt_text: And the man jumped up and went home!

verses.kjv_text: But when the multitudes saw {it}, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.nlt_text: Fear swept through the crowd as they saw this happen. And they praised God for sending a man with such great authority.

verses.kjv_text: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was walking along, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at his tax collector's booth. "Follow me and be my disciple," Jesus said to him. So Matthew got up and followed him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: Later, Matthew invited Jesus and his disciples to his home as dinner guests, along with many tax collectors and other disreputable sinners.

verses.kjv_text: And when the Pharisees saw {it}, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.nlt_text: But when the Pharisees saw this, they asked his disciples, "Why does your teacher eat with such scum? "

verses.kjv_text: But when Jesus heard {that}, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard this, he said, "Healthy people don't need a doctor-- sick people do."

verses.kjv_text: But go ye and learn what {that} meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.nlt_text: Then he added, "Now go and learn the meaning of this Scripture: 'I want you to show mercy, not offer sacrifices.' For I have come to call not those who think they are righteous, but those who know they are sinners."

verses.kjv_text: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.nlt_text: One day the disciples of John the Baptist came to Jesus and asked him, "Why don't your disciples fast like we do and the Pharisees do?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Do wedding guests mourn while celebrating with the groom? Of course not. But someday the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

verses.kjv_text: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse. {new: or, raw, or, unwrought}
verses.nlt_text: "Besides, who would patch old clothing with new cloth? For the new patch would shrink and rip away from the old cloth, leaving an even bigger tear than before.

verses.kjv_text: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved. {bottles: or, sacks of skin, or, leather}
verses.nlt_text: "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. For the old skins would burst from the pressure, spilling the wine and ruining the skins. New wine is stored in new wineskins so that both are preserved."

verses.kjv_text: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was saying this, the leader of a synagogue came and knelt before him. "My daughter has just died," he said, "but you can bring her back to life again if you just come and lay your hand on her."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and {so did} his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus and his disciples got up and went with him.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind {him}, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.nlt_text: Just then a woman who had suffered for twelve years with constant bleeding came up behind him. She touched the fringe of his robe,

verses.kjv_text: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.nlt_text: for she thought, "If I can just touch his robe, I will be healed."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus turned around, and when he saw her he said, "Daughter, be encouraged! Your faith has made you well." And the woman was healed at that moment.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus arrived at the official's home, he saw the noisy crowd and heard the funeral music.

verses.kjv_text: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.nlt_text: "Get out!" he told them. "The girl isn't dead; she's only asleep." But the crowd laughed at him.

verses.kjv_text: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.nlt_text: After the crowd was put outside, however, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she stood up!

verses.kjv_text: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land. {the fame...: or, this fame}
verses.nlt_text: The report of this miracle swept through the entire countryside.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, {Thou} Son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.nlt_text: After Jesus left the girl's home, two blind men followed along behind him, shouting, "Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.nlt_text: They went right into the house where he was staying, and Jesus asked them, "Do you believe I can make you see?" "Yes, Lord," they told him, "we do."

verses.kjv_text: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Then he touched their eyes and said, "Because of your faith, it will happen."

verses.kjv_text: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See {that} no man know {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Then their eyes were opened, and they could see! Jesus sternly warned them, "Don't tell anyone about this."

verses.kjv_text: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.nlt_text: But instead, they went out and spread his fame all over the region.

verses.kjv_text: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.nlt_text: When they left, a demon-possessed man who couldn't speak was brought to Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus cast out the demon, and then the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed. "Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!" they exclaimed.

verses.kjv_text: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.nlt_text: But the Pharisees said, "He can cast out demons because he is empowered by the prince of demons."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus traveled through all the towns and villages of that area, teaching in the synagogues and announcing the Good News about the Kingdom. And he healed every kind of disease and illness.

verses.kjv_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd. {fainted...: or, were tired and lay down}
verses.nlt_text: When he saw the crowds, he had compassion on them because they were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly {is} plenteous, but the labourers {are} few;
verses.nlt_text: He said to his disciples, "The harvest is great, but the workers are few.

verses.kjv_text: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.nlt_text: So pray to the Lord who is in charge of the harvest; ask him to send more workers into his fields."

verses.kjv_text: And when he had called unto {him} his twelve disciples, he gave them power {against} unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease. {against: or, over}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus called his twelve disciples together and gave them authority to cast out evil spirits and to heal every kind of disease and illness.

verses.kjv_text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James {the son} of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.nlt_text: Here are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon (also called Peter), then Andrew (Peter's brother), James (son of Zebedee), John (James's brother),

verses.kjv_text: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James {the son} of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.nlt_text: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew (the tax collector), James (son of Alphaeus), Thaddaeus,

verses.kjv_text: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.nlt_text: Simon (the zealot), Judas Iscariot (who later betrayed him).

verses.kjv_text: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into {any} city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: "Don't go to the Gentiles or the Samaritans,

verses.kjv_text: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: but only to the people of Israel-- God's lost sheep.

verses.kjv_text: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.nlt_text: Go and announce to them that the Kingdom of Heaven is near.

verses.kjv_text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.nlt_text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cure those with leprosy, and cast out demons. Give as freely as you have received!

verses.kjv_text: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses, {Provide: or, Get}
verses.nlt_text: "Don't take any money in your money belts-- no gold, silver, or even copper coins.

verses.kjv_text: Nor scrip for {your} journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat. {staves: Gr. a staff}
verses.nlt_text: Don't carry a traveler's bag with a change of clothes and sandals or even a walking stick. Don't hesitate to accept hospitality, because those who work deserve to be fed.

verses.kjv_text: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.nlt_text: "Whenever you enter a city or village, search for a worthy person and stay in his home until you leave town.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.nlt_text: When you enter the home, give it your blessing.

verses.kjv_text: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.nlt_text: If it turns out to be a worthy home, let your blessing stand; if it is not, take back the blessing.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.nlt_text: If any household or town refuses to welcome you or listen to your message, shake its dust from your feet as you leave.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, the wicked cities of Sodom and Gomorrah will be better off than such a town on the judgment day.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves. {harmless: or, simple}
verses.nlt_text: "Look, I am sending you out as sheep among wolves. So be as shrewd as snakes and harmless as doves.

verses.kjv_text: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.nlt_text: But beware! For you will be handed over to the courts and will be flogged with whips in the synagogues.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.nlt_text: You will stand trial before governors and kings because you are my followers. But this will be your opportunity to tell the rulers and other unbelievers about me.

verses.kjv_text: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.nlt_text: When you are arrested, don't worry about how to respond or what to say. God will give you the right words at the right time.

verses.kjv_text: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.nlt_text: For it is not you who will be speaking-- it will be the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

verses.kjv_text: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against {their} parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "A brother will betray his brother to death, a father will betray his own child, and children will rebel against their parents and cause them to be killed.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be hated of all {men} for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.nlt_text: And all nations will hate you because you are my followers. But everyone who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.kjv_text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come. {have...: or, end, or, finish}
verses.nlt_text: When you are persecuted in one town, flee to the next. I tell you the truth, the Son of Man will return before you have reached all the towns of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: The disciple is not above {his} master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.nlt_text: "Students are not greater than their teacher, and slaves are not greater than their master.

verses.kjv_text: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more {shall they call} them of his household? {Beelzebub: Gr. Beelzebul}
verses.nlt_text: Students are to be like their teacher, and slaves are to be like their master. And since I, the master of the household, have been called the prince of demons, the members of my household will be called by even worse names!

verses.kjv_text: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.nlt_text: "But don't be afraid of those who threaten you. For the time is coming when everything that is covered will be revealed, and all that is secret will be made known to all.

verses.kjv_text: What I tell you in darkness, {that} speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, {that} preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.nlt_text: What I tell you now in the darkness, shout abroad when daybreak comes. What I whisper in your ear, shout from the housetops for all to hear!

verses.kjv_text: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't be afraid of those who want to kill your body; they cannot touch your soul. Fear only God, who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

verses.kjv_text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father. {farthing: it is in value halfpenny farthing in the original, as being the tenth part of the Roman penny}
verses.nlt_text: What is the price of two sparrows-- one copper coin? But not a single sparrow can fall to the ground without your Father knowing it.

verses.kjv_text: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.nlt_text: And the very hairs on your head are all numbered.

verses.kjv_text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.nlt_text: So don't be afraid; you are more valuable to God than a whole flock of sparrows.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: "Everyone who acknowledges me publicly here on earth, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: But everyone who denies me here on earth, I will also deny before my Father in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't imagine that I came to bring peace to the earth! I came not to bring peace, but a sword.

verses.kjv_text: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.nlt_text: 'I have come to set a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

verses.kjv_text: And a man's foes {shall be} they of his own household.
verses.nlt_text: Your enemies will be right in your own household!'

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.nlt_text: "If you love your father or mother more than you love me, you are not worthy of being mine; or if you love your son or daughter more than me, you are not worthy of being mine.

verses.kjv_text: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.nlt_text: If you refuse to take up your cross and follow me, you are not worthy of being mine.

verses.kjv_text: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.nlt_text: If you cling to your life, you will lose it; but if you give up your life for me, you will find it.

verses.kjv_text: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who receives you receives me, and anyone who receives me receives the Father who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
verses.nlt_text: If you receive a prophet as one who speaks for God, you will be given the same reward as a prophet. And if you receive righteous people because of their righteousness, you will be given a reward like theirs.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold {water} only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.nlt_text: And if you give even a cup of cold water to one of the least of my followers, you will surely be rewarded."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had finished giving these instructions to his twelve disciples, he went out to teach and preach in towns throughout the region.

verses.kjv_text: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: John the Baptist, who was in prison, heard about all the things the Messiah was doing. So he sent his disciples to ask Jesus,

verses.kjv_text: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.nlt_text: "Are you the Messiah we've been expecting, or should we keep looking for someone else?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "Go back to John and tell him what you have heard and seen--

verses.kjv_text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.nlt_text: the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised to life, and the Good News is being preached to the poor.

verses.kjv_text: And blessed is {he}, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.nlt_text: And tell him, 'God blesses those who do not turn away because of me. ' "

verses.kjv_text: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.nlt_text: As John's disciples were leaving, Jesus began talking about him to the crowds. "What kind of man did you go into the wilderness to see? Was he a weak reed, swayed by every breath of wind?

verses.kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft {clothing} are in kings' houses.
verses.nlt_text: Or were you expecting to see a man dressed in expensive clothes? No, people with expensive clothes live in palaces.

verses.kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: Were you looking for a prophet? Yes, and he is more than a prophet.

verses.kjv_text: For this is {he}, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.nlt_text: John is the man to whom the Scriptures refer when they say, 'Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, and he will prepare your way before you.'

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, of all who have ever lived, none is greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least person in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he is!

verses.kjv_text: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force. {suffereth...: or, is gotten by force, and they that thrust men}
verses.nlt_text: And from the time John the Baptist began preaching until now, the Kingdom of Heaven has been forcefully advancing, and violent people are attacking it.

verses.kjv_text: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.nlt_text: For before John came, all the prophets and the law of Moses looked forward to this present time.

verses.kjv_text: And if ye will receive {it}, this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.nlt_text: And if you are willing to accept what I say, he is Elijah, the one the prophets said would come.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand!

verses.kjv_text: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.nlt_text: "To what can I compare this generation? It is like children playing a game in the public square. They complain to their friends,

verses.kjv_text: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
verses.nlt_text: 'We played wedding songs, and you didn't dance, so we played funeral songs, and you didn't mourn.'

verses.kjv_text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
verses.nlt_text: For John didn't spend his time eating and drinking, and you say, 'He's possessed by a demon.'

verses.kjv_text: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.nlt_text: The Son of Man, on the other hand, feasts and drinks, and you say, 'He's a glutton and a drunkard, and a friend of tax collectors and other sinners!' But wisdom is shown to be right by its results."

verses.kjv_text: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus began to denounce the towns where he had done so many of his miracles, because they hadn't repented of their sins and turned to God.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you, Korazin and Bethsaida! For if the miracles I did in you had been done in wicked Tyre and Sidon, their people would have repented of their sins long ago, clothing themselves in burlap and throwing ashes on their heads to show their remorse.

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, Tyre and Sidon will be better off on judgment day than you.

verses.kjv_text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.nlt_text: "And you people of Capernaum, will you be honored in heaven? No, you will go down to the place of the dead. For if the miracles I did for you had been done in wicked Sodom, it would still be here today.

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, even Sodom will be better off on judgment day than you."

verses.kjv_text: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
verses.nlt_text: At that time Jesus prayed this prayer: "O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, thank you for hiding these things from those who think themselves wise and clever, and for revealing them to the childlike.

verses.kjv_text: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, Father, it pleased you to do it this way!

verses.kjv_text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and {he} to whomsoever the Son will reveal {him}.
verses.nlt_text: "My Father has entrusted everything to me. No one truly knows the Son except the Father, and no one truly knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."

verses.kjv_text: Come unto me, all {ye} that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said, "Come to me, all of you who are weary and carry heavy burdens, and I will give you rest.

verses.kjv_text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.nlt_text: Take my yoke upon you. Let me teach you, because I am humble and gentle at heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

verses.kjv_text: For my yoke {is} easy, and my burden is light.
verses.nlt_text: For my yoke is easy to bear, and the burden I give you is light."

verses.kjv_text: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
verses.nlt_text: At about that time Jesus was walking through some grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, so they began breaking off some heads of grain and eating them.

verses.kjv_text: But when the Pharisees saw {it}, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.nlt_text: But some Pharisees saw them do it and protested, "Look, your disciples are breaking the law by harvesting grain on the Sabbath."

verses.kjv_text: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said to them, "Haven't you read in the Scriptures what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

verses.kjv_text: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.nlt_text: He went into the house of God, and they broke the law by eating the sacred loaves of bread that only the priests are allowed to eat.

verses.kjv_text: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.nlt_text: And haven't you read in the law of Moses that the priests on duty in the Temple may work on the Sabbath?

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, That in this place is {one} greater than the temple.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, there is one here who is even greater than the Temple!

verses.kjv_text: But if ye had known what {this} meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.nlt_text: But you would not have condemned my innocent disciples if you knew the meaning of this Scripture: 'I want you to show mercy, not offer sacrifices.'

verses.kjv_text: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.nlt_text: For the Son of Man is Lord, even over the Sabbath!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus went over to their synagogue,

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there was a man which had {his} hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.nlt_text: where he noticed a man with a deformed hand. The Pharisees asked Jesus, "Does the law permit a person to work by healing on the Sabbath?" (They were hoping he would say yes, so they could bring charges against him.)

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift {it} out?
verses.nlt_text: And he answered, "If you had a sheep that fell into a well on the Sabbath, wouldn't you work to pull it out? Of course you would.

verses.kjv_text: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.nlt_text: And how much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Yes, the law permits a person to do good on the Sabbath."

verses.kjv_text: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched {it} forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to the man, "Hold out your hand." So the man held out his hand, and it was restored, just like the other one!

verses.kjv_text: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him. {held...: or, took counsel}
verses.nlt_text: Then the Pharisees called a meeting to plot how to kill Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But when Jesus knew {it}, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus knew what they were planning. So he left that area, and many people followed him. He healed all the sick among them,

verses.kjv_text: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.nlt_text: but he warned them not to reveal who he was.

verses.kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.nlt_text: This fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah concerning him:

verses.kjv_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.nlt_text: "Look at my Servant, whom I have chosen. He is my Beloved, who pleases me. I will put my Spirit upon him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.

verses.kjv_text: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.nlt_text: He will not fight or shout or raise his voice in public.

verses.kjv_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.nlt_text: He will not crush the weakest reed or put out a flickering candle. Finally he will cause justice to be victorious.

verses.kjv_text: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.nlt_text: And his name will be the hope of all the world."

verses.kjv_text: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.nlt_text: Then a demon-possessed man, who was blind and couldn't speak, was brought to Jesus. He healed the man so that he could both speak and see.

verses.kjv_text: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.nlt_text: The crowd was amazed and asked, "Could it be that Jesus is the Son of David, the Messiah?"

verses.kjv_text: But when the Pharisees heard {it}, they said, This {fellow} doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils. {Beelzebub: Gr. Beelzebul}
verses.nlt_text: But when the Pharisees heard about the miracle, they said, "No wonder he can cast out demons. He gets his power from Satan, the prince of demons."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew their thoughts and replied, "Any kingdom divided by civil war is doomed. A town or family splintered by feuding will fall apart.

verses.kjv_text: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.nlt_text: And if Satan is casting out Satan, he is divided and fighting against himself. His own kingdom will not survive.

verses.kjv_text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast {them} out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.nlt_text: And if I am empowered by Satan, what about your own exorcists? They cast out demons, too, so they will condemn you for what you have said.

verses.kjv_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
verses.nlt_text: But if I am casting out demons by the Spirit of God, then the Kingdom of God has arrived among you.

verses.kjv_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.nlt_text: For who is powerful enough to enter the house of a strong man like Satan and plunder his goods? Only someone even stronger-- someone who could tie him up and then plunder his house.

verses.kjv_text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who isn't with me opposes me, and anyone who isn't working with me is actually working against me.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy {against} the {Holy} Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.nlt_text: "Every sin and blasphemy can be forgiven-- except blasphemy against the Holy Spirit, which will never be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the {world} to come.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man can be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven, either in this world or in the world to come.

verses.kjv_text: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by {his} fruit.
verses.nlt_text: "A tree is identified by its fruit. If a tree is good, its fruit will be good. If a tree is bad, its fruit will be bad.

verses.kjv_text: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.nlt_text: You brood of snakes! How could evil men like you speak what is good and right? For whatever is in your heart determines what you say.

verses.kjv_text: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.nlt_text: A good person produces good things from the treasury of a good heart, and an evil person produces evil things from the treasury of an evil heart.

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.nlt_text: And I tell you this, you must give an account on judgment day for every idle word you speak.

verses.kjv_text: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.nlt_text: The words you say will either acquit you or condemn you."

verses.kjv_text: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.nlt_text: One day some teachers of religious law and Pharisees came to Jesus and said, "Teacher, we want you to show us a miraculous sign to prove your authority."

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "Only an evil, adulterous generation would demand a miraculous sign; but the only sign I will give them is the sign of the prophet Jonah.

verses.kjv_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: For as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish for three days and three nights, so will the Son of Man be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.

verses.kjv_text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas {is} here.
verses.nlt_text: "The people of Nineveh will stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for they repented of their sins at the preaching of Jonah. Now someone greater than Jonah is here-- but you refuse to repent.

verses.kjv_text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon {is} here.
verses.nlt_text: The queen of Sheba will also stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for she came from a distant land to hear the wisdom of Solomon. Now someone greater than Solomon is here-- but you refuse to listen.

verses.kjv_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.nlt_text: "When an evil spirit leaves a person, it goes into the desert, seeking rest but finding none.

verses.kjv_text: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth {it} empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.nlt_text: Then it says, 'I will return to the person I came from.' So it returns and finds its former home empty, swept, and in order.

verses.kjv_text: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last {state} of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.nlt_text: Then the spirit finds seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they all enter the person and live there. And so that person is worse off than before. That will be the experience of this evil generation."

verses.kjv_text: While he yet talked to the people, behold, {his} mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was speaking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, asking to speak to him.

verses.kjv_text: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.nlt_text: Someone told Jesus, "Your mother and your brothers are outside, and they want to speak to you."

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"

verses.kjv_text: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.nlt_text: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, "Look, these are my mother and brothers.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother!"

verses.kjv_text: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.nlt_text: Later that same day Jesus left the house and sat beside the lake.

verses.kjv_text: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.nlt_text: A large crowd soon gathered around him, so he got into a boat. Then he sat there and taught as the people stood on the shore.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.nlt_text: He told many stories in the form of parables, such as this one:"Listen! A farmer went out to plant some seeds.

verses.kjv_text: And when he sowed, some {seeds} fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.nlt_text: As he scattered them across his field, some seeds fell on a footpath, and the birds came and ate them.

verses.kjv_text: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.nlt_text: Other seeds fell on shallow soil with underlying rock. The seeds sprouted quickly because the soil was shallow.

verses.kjv_text: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.nlt_text: But the plants soon wilted under the hot sun, and since they didn't have deep roots, they died.

verses.kjv_text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.nlt_text: Other seeds fell among thorns that grew up and choked out the tender plants.

verses.kjv_text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.nlt_text: Still other seeds fell on fertile soil, and they produced a crop that was thirty, sixty, and even a hundred times as much as had been planted!

verses.kjv_text: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.nlt_text: His disciples came and asked him, "Why do you use parables when you talk to the people?"

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "You are permitted to understand the secrets of the Kingdom of Heaven, but others are not.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.nlt_text: To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given, and they will have an abundance of knowledge. But for those who are not listening, even what little understanding they have will be taken away from them.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.nlt_text: That is why I use these parables, For they look, but they don't really see. They hear, but they don't really listen or understand.

verses.kjv_text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.nlt_text: This fulfills the prophecy of Isaiah that says, 'When you hear what I say, you will not understand. When you see what I do, you will not comprehend.

verses.kjv_text: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and {their} ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with {their} eyes, and hear with {their} ears, and should understand with {their} heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.nlt_text: For the hearts of these people are hardened, and their ears cannot hear, and they have closed their eyes-- so their eyes cannot see, and their ears cannot hear, and their hearts cannot understand, and they cannot turn to me and let me heal them.'

verses.kjv_text: But blessed {are} your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.nlt_text: "But blessed are your eyes, because they see; and your ears, because they hear.

verses.kjv_text: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous {men} have desired to see {those things} which ye see, and have not seen {them}; and to hear {those things} which ye hear, and have not heard {them}.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, but they didn't see it. And they longed to hear what you hear, but they didn't hear it.

verses.kjv_text: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.nlt_text: "Now listen to the explanation of the parable about the farmer planting seeds:

verses.kjv_text: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth {it} not, then cometh the wicked {one}, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.nlt_text: The seed that fell on the footpath represents those who hear the message about the Kingdom and don't understand it. Then the evil one comes and snatches away the seed that was planted in their hearts.

verses.kjv_text: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.nlt_text: The seed on the rocky soil represents those who hear the message and immediately receive it with joy.

verses.kjv_text: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended. {offended: he relapseth, or, falleth into sin}
verses.nlt_text: But since they don't have deep roots, they don't last long. They fall away as soon as they have problems or are persecuted for believing God's word.

verses.kjv_text: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.nlt_text: The seed that fell among the thorns represents those who hear God's word, but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the worries of this life and the lure of wealth, so no fruit is produced.

verses.kjv_text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth {it}; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.nlt_text: The seed that fell on good soil represents those who truly hear and understand God's word and produce a harvest of thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as had been planted!"

verses.kjv_text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.nlt_text: Here is another story Jesus told: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a farmer who planted good seed in his field.

verses.kjv_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.nlt_text: But that night as the workers slept, his enemy came and planted weeds among the wheat, then slipped away.

verses.kjv_text: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.nlt_text: When the crop began to grow and produce grain, the weeds also grew.

verses.kjv_text: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.nlt_text: "The farmer's workers went to him and said, 'Sir, the field where you planted that good seed is full of weeds! Where did they come from?'

verses.kjv_text: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.nlt_text: " 'An enemy has done this!' the farmer exclaimed." 'Should we pull out the weeds?' they asked.

verses.kjv_text: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.nlt_text: " 'No,' he replied, 'you'll uproot the wheat if you do.

verses.kjv_text: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.nlt_text: Let both grow together until the harvest. Then I will tell the harvesters to sort out the weeds, tie them into bundles, and burn them, and to put the wheat in the barn.'"

verses.kjv_text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.nlt_text: Here is another illustration Jesus used: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a mustard seed planted in a field.

verses.kjv_text: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.nlt_text: It is the smallest of all seeds, but it becomes the largest of garden plants; it grows into a tree, and birds come and make nests in its branches."

verses.kjv_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened. {measures: the word in the Greek is a measure containing about a peck and a half, wanting a little more than a pint}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus also used this illustration: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like the yeast a woman used in making bread. Even though she put only a little yeast in three measures of flour, it permeated every part of the dough."

verses.kjv_text: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus always used stories and illustrations like these when speaking to the crowds. In fact, he never spoke to them without using such parables.

verses.kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.nlt_text: This fulfilled what God had spoken through the prophet: "I will speak to you in parables. I will explain things hidden since the creation of the world. "

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.nlt_text: Then, leaving the crowds outside, Jesus went into the house. His disciples said, "Please explain to us the story of the weeds in the field."

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "The Son of Man is the farmer who plants the good seed.

verses.kjv_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked {one};
verses.nlt_text: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the people of the Kingdom. The weeds are the people who belong to the evil one.

verses.kjv_text: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.nlt_text: The enemy who planted the weeds among the wheat is the devil. The harvest is the end of the world, and the harvesters are the angels.

verses.kjv_text: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.nlt_text: "Just as the weeds are sorted out and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the world.

verses.kjv_text: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity; {things...: or, scandals}
verses.nlt_text: The Son of Man will send his angels, and they will remove from his Kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.

verses.kjv_text: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.nlt_text: And the angels will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in their Father's Kingdom. Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand!

verses.kjv_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.nlt_text: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure that a man discovered hidden in a field. In his excitement, he hid it again and sold everything he owned to get enough money to buy the field.

verses.kjv_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.nlt_text: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a merchant on the lookout for choice pearls.

verses.kjv_text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.nlt_text: When he discovered a pearl of great value, he sold everything he owned and bought it!

verses.kjv_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.nlt_text: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a fishing net that was thrown into the water and caught fish of every kind.

verses.kjv_text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.nlt_text: When the net was full, they dragged it up onto the shore, sat down, and sorted the good fish into crates, but threw the bad ones away.

verses.kjv_text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.nlt_text: That is the way it will be at the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked people from the righteous,

verses.kjv_text: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.nlt_text: throwing the wicked into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Do you understand all these things?" "Yes," they said, "we do."

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe {which is} instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man {that is} an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure {things} new and old.
verses.nlt_text: Then he added, "Every teacher of religious law who becomes a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a homeowner who brings from his storeroom new gems of truth as well as old."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, {that} when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had finished telling these stories and illustrations, he left that part of the country.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this {man} this wisdom, and {these} mighty works?
verses.nlt_text: He returned to Nazareth, his hometown. When he taught there in the synagogue, everyone was amazed and said, "Where does he get this wisdom and the power to do miracles?"

verses.kjv_text: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.nlt_text: Then they scoffed, "He's just the carpenter's son, and we know Mary, his mother, and his brothers-- James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas.

verses.kjv_text: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this {man} all these things?
verses.nlt_text: All his sisters live right here among us. Where did he learn all these things?"

verses.kjv_text: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.nlt_text: And they were deeply offended and refused to believe in him.Then Jesus told them, "A prophet is honored everywhere except in his own hometown and among his own family."

verses.kjv_text: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.nlt_text: And so he did only a few miracles there because of their unbelief.

verses.kjv_text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus, {tetrarch: or, governor over four provinces}
verses.nlt_text: When Herod Antipas, the ruler of Galilee, heard about Jesus,

verses.kjv_text: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him. {do...: or, are wrought by him}
verses.nlt_text: he said to his advisers, "This must be John the Baptist raised from the dead! That is why he can do such miracles."

verses.kjv_text: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put {him} in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
verses.nlt_text: For Herod had arrested and imprisoned John as a favor to his wife Herodias (the former wife of Herod's brother Philip).

verses.kjv_text: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.nlt_text: John had been telling Herod, "It is against God's law for you to marry her."

verses.kjv_text: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of a riot, because all the people believed John was a prophet.

verses.kjv_text: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod. {before...: Gr. in the midst}
verses.nlt_text: But at a birthday party for Herod, Herodias's daughter performed a dance that greatly pleased him,

verses.kjv_text: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.nlt_text: so he promised with a vow to give her anything she wanted.

verses.kjv_text: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
verses.nlt_text: At her mother's urging, the girl said, "I want the head of John the Baptist on a tray!"

verses.kjv_text: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded {it} to be given {her}.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king regretted what he had said; but because of the vow he had made in front of his guests, he issued the necessary orders.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.nlt_text: So John was beheaded in the prison,

verses.kjv_text: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought {it} to her mother.
verses.nlt_text: and his head was brought on a tray and given to the girl, who took it to her mother.

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Later, John's disciples came for his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus heard {of it}, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard {thereof}, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.nlt_text: As soon as Jesus heard the news, he left in a boat to a remote area to be alone. But the crowds heard where he was headed and followed on foot from many towns.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus saw the huge crowd as he stepped from the boat, and he had compassion on them and healed their sick.

verses.kjv_text: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.nlt_text: That evening the disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it's already getting late. Send the crowds away so they can go to the villages and buy food for themselves."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "That isn't necessary-- you feed them."

verses.kjv_text: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.nlt_text: "But we have only five loaves of bread and two fish!" they answered.

verses.kjv_text: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.nlt_text: "Bring them here," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to {his} disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.nlt_text: Then he told the people to sit down on the grass. Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up toward heaven, and blessed them. Then, breaking the loaves into pieces, he gave the bread to the disciples, who distributed it to the people.

verses.kjv_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.nlt_text: They all ate as much as they wanted, and afterward, the disciples picked up twelve baskets of leftovers.

verses.kjv_text: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.nlt_text: About 5,000 men were fed that day, in addition to all the women and children!

verses.kjv_text: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.nlt_text: Immediately after this, Jesus insisted that his disciples get back into the boat and cross to the other side of the lake, while he sent the people home.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
verses.nlt_text: After sending them home, he went up into the hills by himself to pray. Night fell while he was there alone.

verses.kjv_text: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the disciples were in trouble far away from land, for a strong wind had risen, and they were fighting heavy waves.

verses.kjv_text: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.nlt_text: About three o'clock in the morning Jesus came toward them, walking on the water.

verses.kjv_text: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.nlt_text: When the disciples saw him walking on the water, they were terrified. In their fear, they cried out, "It's a ghost!"

verses.kjv_text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus spoke to them at once. "Don't be afraid," he said. "Take courage. I am here! "

verses.kjv_text: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter called to him, "Lord, if it's really you, tell me to come to you, walking on the water."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, come," Jesus said.So Peter went over the side of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me. {boisterous: or, strong}
verses.nlt_text: But when he saw the strong wind and the waves, he was terrified and began to sink. "Save me, Lord!" he shouted.
