verses.kjv_text: And immediately Jesus stretched forth {his} hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus immediately reached out and grabbed him. "You have so little faith," Jesus said. "Why did you doubt me?"

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.nlt_text: When they climbed back into the boat, the wind stopped.

verses.kjv_text: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then the disciples worshiped him. "You really are the Son of God!" they exclaimed.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.nlt_text: After they had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret.

verses.kjv_text: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.nlt_text: When the people recognized Jesus, the news of his arrival spread quickly throughout the whole area, and soon people were bringing all their sick to be healed.

verses.kjv_text: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.nlt_text: They begged him to let the sick touch at least the fringe of his robe, and all who touched him were healed.

verses.kjv_text: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Some Pharisees and teachers of religious law now arrived from Jerusalem to see Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.nlt_text: "Why do your disciples disobey our age-old tradition?" they demanded. "They ignore our tradition of ceremonial hand washing before they eat."

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "And why do you, by your traditions, violate the direct commandments of God?

verses.kjv_text: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.nlt_text: For instance, God says, 'Honor your father and mother,' and 'Anyone who speaks disrespectfully of father or mother must be put to death.'

verses.kjv_text: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to {his} father or {his} mother, {It is} a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
verses.nlt_text: But you say it is all right for people to say to their parents, 'Sorry, I can't help you. For I have vowed to give to God what I would have given to you.'

verses.kjv_text: And honour not his father or his mother, {he shall be free}. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
verses.nlt_text: In this way, you say they don't need to honor their parents. And so you cancel the word of God for the sake of your own tradition.

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
verses.nlt_text: You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you, for he wrote,

verses.kjv_text: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with {their} lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.nlt_text: 'These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

verses.kjv_text: But in vain they do worship me, teaching {for} doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.nlt_text: Their worship is a farce, for they teach man-made ideas as commands from God.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus called to the crowd to come and hear. "Listen," he said, "and try to understand.

verses.kjv_text: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
verses.nlt_text: It's not what goes into your mouth that defiles you; you are defiled by the words that come out of your mouth."

verses.kjv_text: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
verses.nlt_text: Then the disciples came to him and asked, "Do you realize you offended the Pharisees by what you just said?"

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Every plant not planted by my heavenly Father will be uprooted,

verses.kjv_text: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
verses.nlt_text: so ignore them. They are blind guides leading the blind, and if one blind person guides another, they will both fall into a ditch."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter said to Jesus, "Explain to us the parable that says people aren't defiled by what they eat."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
verses.nlt_text: "Don't you understand yet?" Jesus asked.

verses.kjv_text: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.nlt_text: "Anything you eat passes through the stomach and then goes into the sewer.

verses.kjv_text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.nlt_text: But the words you speak come from the heart-- that's what defiles you.

verses.kjv_text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
verses.nlt_text: For from the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, all sexual immorality, theft, lying, and slander.

verses.kjv_text: These are {the things} which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
verses.nlt_text: These are what defile you. Eating with unwashed hands will never defile you."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus left Galilee and went north to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, {thou} Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
verses.nlt_text: A Gentile woman who lived there came to him, pleading, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David! For my daughter is possessed by a demon that torments her severely."

verses.kjv_text: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus gave her no reply, not even a word. Then his disciples urged him to send her away. "Tell her to go away," they said. "She is bothering us with all her begging."

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the woman, "I was sent only to help God's lost sheep-- the people of Israel."

verses.kjv_text: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.nlt_text: But she came and worshiped him, pleading again, "Lord, help me!"

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast {it} to dogs.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "It isn't right to take food from the children and throw it to the dogs."

verses.kjv_text: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
verses.nlt_text: She replied, "That's true, Lord, but even dogs are allowed to eat the scraps that fall beneath their master's table."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great {is} thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
verses.nlt_text: "Dear woman," Jesus said to her, "your faith is great. Your request is granted." And her daughter was instantly healed.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus returned to the Sea of Galilee and climbed a hill and sat down.

verses.kjv_text: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them {those that were} lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
verses.nlt_text: A vast crowd brought to him people who were lame, blind, crippled, those who couldn't speak, and many others. They laid them before Jesus, and he healed them all.

verses.kjv_text: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: The crowd was amazed! Those who hadn't been able to speak were talking, the crippled were made well, the lame were walking, and the blind could see again! And they praised the God of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus called his disciples {unto him}, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus called his disciples and told them, "I feel sorry for these people. They have been here with me for three days, and they have nothing left to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry, or they will faint along the way."

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.nlt_text: The disciples replied, "Where would we get enough food here in the wilderness for such a huge crowd?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked, "How much bread do you have?" They replied, "Seven loaves, and a few small fish."

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus told all the people to sit down on the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake {them}, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.nlt_text: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, thanked God for them, and broke them into pieces. He gave them to the disciples, who distributed the food to the crowd.

verses.kjv_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken {meat} that was left seven baskets full.
verses.nlt_text: They all ate as much as they wanted. Afterward, the disciples picked up seven large baskets of leftover food.

verses.kjv_text: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.nlt_text: There were 4,000 men who were fed that day, in addition to all the women and children.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus sent the people home, and he got into a boat and crossed over to the region of Magadan.

verses.kjv_text: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: One day the Pharisees and Sadducees came to test Jesus, demanding that he show them a miraculous sign from heaven to prove his authority.

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, {It will be} fair weather: for the sky is red.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "You know the saying, 'Red sky at night means fair weather tomorrow;

verses.kjv_text: And in the morning, {It will be} foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O {ye} hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not {discern} the signs of the times?
verses.nlt_text: red sky in the morning means foul weather all day.' You know how to interpret the weather signs in the sky, but you don't know how to interpret the signs of the times!

verses.kjv_text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
verses.nlt_text: Only an evil, adulterous generation would demand a miraculous sign, but the only sign I will give them is the sign of the prophet Jonah. " Then Jesus left them and went away.

verses.kjv_text: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.nlt_text: Later, after they crossed to the other side of the lake, the disciples discovered they had forgotten to bring any bread.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.nlt_text: "Watch out!" Jesus warned them. "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

verses.kjv_text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, {It is} because we have taken no bread.
verses.nlt_text: At this they began to argue with each other because they hadn't brought any bread.

verses.kjv_text: {Which} when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said, "You have so little faith! Why are you arguing with each other about having no bread?

verses.kjv_text: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.nlt_text: Don't you understand even yet? Don't you remember the 5,000 I fed with five loaves, and the baskets of leftovers you picked up?

verses.kjv_text: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.nlt_text: Or the 4,000 I fed with seven loaves, and the large baskets of leftovers you picked up?

verses.kjv_text: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake {it} not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
verses.nlt_text: Why can't you understand that I'm not talking about bread? So again I say, 'Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.'"

verses.kjv_text: Then understood they how that he bade {them} not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.nlt_text: Then at last they understood that he wasn't speaking about the yeast in bread, but about the deceptive teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Some {say that thou art} John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: "Well," they replied, "some say John the Baptist, some say Elijah, and others say Jeremiah or one of the other prophets."

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
verses.nlt_text: Then he asked them, "But who do you say I am?"

verses.kjv_text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed {it} unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "You are blessed, Simon son of John, because my Father in heaven has revealed this to you. You did not learn this from any human being.

verses.kjv_text: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. {Peter: this name signifies a rock}
verses.nlt_text: Now I say to you that you are Peter (which means 'rock'), and upon this rock I will build my church, and all the powers of hell will not conquer it.

verses.kjv_text: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: And I will give you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven. Whatever you forbid on earth will be forbidden in heaven, and whatever you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven."

verses.kjv_text: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Then he sternly warned the disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
verses.nlt_text: From then on Jesus began to tell his disciples plainly that it was necessary for him to go to Jerusalem, and that he would suffer many terrible things at the hands of the elders, the leading priests, and the teachers of religious law. He would be killed, but on the third day he would be raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee. {Be...: Gr. Pity thyself}
verses.nlt_text: But Peter took him aside and began to reprimand him for saying such things. "Heaven forbid, Lord," he said. "This will never happen to you!"

verses.kjv_text: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus turned to Peter and said, "Get away from me, Satan! You are a dangerous trap to me. You are seeing things merely from a human point of view, not from God's."

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any {man} will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If any of you wants to be my follower, you must turn from your selfish ways, take up your cross, and follow me.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.nlt_text: If you try to hang on to your life, you will lose it. But if you give up your life for my sake, you will save it.

verses.kjv_text: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.nlt_text: And what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but lose your own soul? Is anything worth more than your soul?

verses.kjv_text: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
verses.nlt_text: For the Son of Man will come with his angels in the glory of his Father and will judge all people according to their deeds.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: And I tell you the truth, some standing here right now will not die before they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom."

verses.kjv_text: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.nlt_text: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the two brothers, James and John, and led them up a high mountain to be alone.

verses.kjv_text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.nlt_text: As the men watched, Jesus' appearance was transformed so that his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as light.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, Moses and Elijah appeared and began talking with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.nlt_text: Peter blurted out, "Lord, it's wonderful for us to be here! If you want, I'll make three shelters as memorials-- one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

verses.kjv_text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.nlt_text: But even as he spoke, a bright cloud came over them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy. Listen to him."

verses.kjv_text: And when the disciples heard {it}, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples were terrified and fell face down on the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus came over and touched them. "Get up," he said. "Don't be afraid."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
verses.nlt_text: And when they looked, they saw only Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: As they went back down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, "Don't tell anyone what you have seen until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.nlt_text: Then his disciples asked him, "Why do the teachers of religious law insist that Elijah must return before the Messiah comes? "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Elijah is indeed coming first to get everything ready for the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
verses.nlt_text: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, but he wasn't recognized, and they chose to abuse him. And in the same way they will also make the Son of Man suffer."

verses.kjv_text: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.nlt_text: Then the disciples realized he was talking about John the Baptist.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a {certain} man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.nlt_text: At the foot of the mountain, a large crowd was waiting for them. A man came and knelt before Jesus and said,

verses.kjv_text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.nlt_text: "Lord, have mercy on my son. He has seizures and suffers terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

verses.kjv_text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.nlt_text: So I brought him to your disciples, but they couldn't heal him."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "You faithless and corrupt people! How long must I be with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to me."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus rebuked the demon in the boy, and it left him. From that moment the boy was well.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.nlt_text: Afterward the disciples asked Jesus privately, "Why couldn't we cast out that demon?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verses.nlt_text: "You don't have enough faith," Jesus told them. "I tell you the truth, if you had faith even as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it would move. Nothing would be impossible. "

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
verses.nlt_text: After they gathered again in Galilee, Jesus told them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of his enemies.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
verses.nlt_text: He will be killed, but on the third day he will be raised from the dead." And the disciples were filled with grief.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute {money} came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute? {tribute: called in the original, didrachma, being in value fifteen pence sterling; about thirty seven cents}
verses.nlt_text: On their arrival in Capernaum, the collectors of the Temple tax came to Peter and asked him, "Doesn't your teacher pay the Temple tax?"

verses.kjv_text: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, he does," Peter replied. Then he went into the house.But before he had a chance to speak, Jesus asked him, "What do you think, Peter? Do kings tax their own people or the people they have conquered? "

verses.kjv_text: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
verses.nlt_text: "They tax the people they have conquered," Peter replied."Well, then," Jesus said, "the citizens are free!

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee. {a piece...: or, a stater: it is half an ounce of silver, in value two shillings and six pence, sterling; about fifty five cents}
verses.nlt_text: However, we don't want to offend them, so go down to the lake and throw in a line. Open the mouth of the first fish you catch, and you will find a large silver coin. Take it and pay the tax for both of us."

verses.kjv_text: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
verses.nlt_text: About that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus called a little child to him and put the child among them.

verses.kjv_text: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "I tell you the truth, unless you turn from your sins and become like little children, you will never get into the Kingdom of Heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: So anyone who becomes as humble as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
verses.nlt_text: "And anyone who welcomes a little child like this on my behalf is welcoming me.

verses.kjv_text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and {that} he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
verses.nlt_text: But if you cause one of these little ones who trusts in me to fall into sin, it would be better for you to have a large millstone tied around your neck and be drowned in the depths of the sea.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits the world, because it tempts people to sin. Temptations are inevitable, but what sorrow awaits the person who does the tempting.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast {them} from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
verses.nlt_text: So if your hand or foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It's better to enter eternal life with only one hand or one foot than to be thrown into eternal fire with both of your hands and feet.

verses.kjv_text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast {it} from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
verses.nlt_text: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It's better to enter eternal life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

verses.kjv_text: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: "Beware that you don't look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that in heaven their angels are always in the presence of my heavenly Father.

verses.kjv_text: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
verses.nlt_text: "If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them wanders away, what will he do? Won't he leave the ninety-nine others on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?

verses.kjv_text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that {sheep}, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
verses.nlt_text: And if he finds it, I tell you the truth, he will rejoice over it more than over the ninety-nine that didn't wander away!

verses.kjv_text: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, it is not my heavenly Father's will that even one of these little ones should perish.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
verses.nlt_text: "If another believer sins against you, go privately and point out the offense. If the other person listens and confesses it, you have won that person back.

verses.kjv_text: But if he will not hear {thee, then} take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
verses.nlt_text: But if you are unsuccessful, take one or two others with you and go back again, so that everything you say may be confirmed by two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv_text: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell {it} unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
verses.nlt_text: If the person still refuses to listen, take your case to the church. Then if he or she won't accept the church's decision, treat that person as a pagan or a corrupt tax collector.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, whatever you forbid on earth will be forbidden in heaven, and whatever you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: "I also tell you this: If two of you agree here on earth concerning anything you ask, my Father in heaven will do it for you.

verses.kjv_text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.nlt_text: For where two or three gather together as my followers, I am there among them."

verses.kjv_text: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter came to him and asked, "Lord, how often should I forgive someone who sins against me? Seven times?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
verses.nlt_text: "No, not seven times," Jesus replied, "but seventy times seven!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, the Kingdom of Heaven can be compared to a king who decided to bring his accounts up to date with servants who had borrowed money from him.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents. {talents: a talent is seven hundred and fifty ounces of silver, which after five shillings the ounce is pounds shillings}
verses.nlt_text: In the process, one of his debtors was brought in who owed him millions of dollars.

verses.kjv_text: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
verses.nlt_text: He couldn't pay, so his master ordered that he be sold-- along with his wife, his children, and everything he owned-- to pay the debt.

verses.kjv_text: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all. {worshipped him: or, besought him}
verses.nlt_text: "But the man fell down before his master and begged him, 'Please, be patient with me, and I will pay it all.'

verses.kjv_text: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
verses.nlt_text: Then his master was filled with pity for him, and he released him and forgave his debt.

verses.kjv_text: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took {him} by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest. {pence: the Roman penny is the eighth part of an ounce, which after five shillings the ounce is seven pence halfpenny; about fourteen cents}
verses.nlt_text: "But when the man left the king, he went to a fellow servant who owed him a few thousand dollars. He grabbed him by the throat and demanded instant payment.

verses.kjv_text: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.nlt_text: "His fellow servant fell down before him and begged for a little more time. 'Be patient with me, and I will pay it,' he pleaded.

verses.kjv_text: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
verses.nlt_text: But his creditor wouldn't wait. He had the man arrested and put in prison until the debt could be paid in full.

verses.kjv_text: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.nlt_text: "When some of the other servants saw this, they were very upset. They went to the king and told him everything that had happened.

verses.kjv_text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
verses.nlt_text: Then the king called in the man he had forgiven and said, 'You evil servant! I forgave you that tremendous debt because you pleaded with me.

verses.kjv_text: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
verses.nlt_text: Shouldn't you have mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?'

verses.kjv_text: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angry king sent the man to prison to be tortured until he had paid his entire debt.

verses.kjv_text: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
verses.nlt_text: "That's what my heavenly Father will do to you if you refuse to forgive your brothers and sisters from your heart."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, {that} when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went down to the region of Judea east of the Jordan River.

verses.kjv_text: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.nlt_text: Large crowds followed him there, and he healed their sick.

verses.kjv_text: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.nlt_text: Some Pharisees came and tried to trap him with this question: "Should a man be allowed to divorce his wife for just any reason?"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made {them} at the beginning made them male and female,
verses.nlt_text: "Haven't you read the Scriptures?" Jesus replied. "They record that from the beginning 'God made them male and female.'

verses.kjv_text: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
verses.nlt_text: And he said, 'This explains why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife, and the two are united into one.'

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.nlt_text: Since they are no longer two but one, let no one split apart what God has joined together."

verses.kjv_text: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.nlt_text: "Then why did Moses say in the law that a man could give his wife a written notice of divorce and send her away?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Moses permitted divorce only as a concession to your hard hearts, but it was not what God had originally intended.

verses.kjv_text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except {it be} for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
verses.nlt_text: And I tell you this, whoever divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery-- unless his wife has been unfaithful. "

verses.kjv_text: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with {his} wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus' disciples then said to him, "If this is the case, it is better not to marry!"

verses.kjv_text: But he said unto them, All {men} cannot receive this saying, save {they} to whom it is given.
verses.nlt_text: "Not everyone can accept this statement," Jesus said. "Only those whom God helps.

verses.kjv_text: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from {their} mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive {it}, let him receive {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Some are born as eunuchs, some have been made eunuchs by others, and some choose not to marry for the sake of the Kingdom of Heaven. Let anyone accept this who can."

verses.kjv_text: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put {his} hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.nlt_text: One day some parents brought their children to Jesus so he could lay his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples scolded the parents for bothering him.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "Let the children come to me. Don't stop them! For the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to those who are like these children."

verses.kjv_text: And he laid {his} hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.nlt_text: And he placed his hands on their heads and blessed them before he left.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.nlt_text: Someone came to Jesus with this question: "Teacher, what good deed must I do to have eternal life?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? {there is} none good but one, {that is}, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.nlt_text: "Why ask me about what is good?" Jesus replied. "There is only One who is good. But to answer your question-- if you want to receive eternal life, keep the commandments."

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.nlt_text: "Which ones?" the man asked.And Jesus replied: " 'You must not murder. You must not commit adultery. You must not steal. You must not testify falsely.

verses.kjv_text: Honour thy father and {thy} mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.nlt_text: Honor your father and mother. Love your neighbor as yourself.' "

verses.kjv_text: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.nlt_text: "I've obeyed all these commandments," the young man replied. "What else must I do?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go {and} sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come {and} follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told him, "If you want to be perfect, go and sell all your possessions and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

verses.kjv_text: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.nlt_text: But when the young man heard this, he went away very sad, for he had many possessions.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "I tell you the truth, it is very hard for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of Heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: I'll say it again-- it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv_text: When his disciples heard {it}, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.nlt_text: The disciples were astounded. "Then who in the world can be saved?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus beheld {them}, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus looked at them intently and said, "Humanly speaking, it is impossible. But with God everything is possible."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter said to him, "We've given up everything to follow you. What will we get?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," Jesus replied, "and I assure you that when the world is made new and the Son of Man sits upon his glorious throne, you who have been my followers will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.nlt_text: And everyone who has given up houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or property, for my sake, will receive a hundred times as much in return and will inherit eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: But many {that are} first shall be last; and the last {shall be} first.
verses.nlt_text: But many who are the greatest now will be least important then, and those who seem least important now will be the greatest then.

verses.kjv_text: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man {that is} an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.nlt_text: "For the Kingdom of Heaven is like the landowner who went out early one morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard. {penny: the Roman penny is the eighth part of an ounce, which after five shillings the ounce is seven pence halfpenny; about fourteen cents}
verses.nlt_text: He agreed to pay the normal daily wage and sent them out to work.

verses.kjv_text: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.nlt_text: "At nine o'clock in the morning he was passing through the marketplace and saw some people standing around doing nothing.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.nlt_text: So he hired them, telling them he would pay them whatever was right at the end of the day.

verses.kjv_text: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.nlt_text: So they went to work in the vineyard. At noon and again at three o'clock he did the same thing.

verses.kjv_text: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.nlt_text: "At five o'clock that afternoon he was in town again and saw some more people standing around. He asked them, 'Why haven't you been working today?'

verses.kjv_text: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, {that} shall ye receive.
verses.nlt_text: "They replied, 'Because no one hired us.'"The landowner told them, 'Then go out and join the others in my vineyard.'

verses.kjv_text: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them {their} hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.nlt_text: "That evening he told the foreman to call the workers in and pay them, beginning with the last workers first.

verses.kjv_text: And when they came that {were hired} about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.nlt_text: When those hired at five o'clock were paid, each received a full day's wage.

verses.kjv_text: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.nlt_text: When those hired first came to get their pay, they assumed they would receive more. But they, too, were paid a day's wage.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had received {it}, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
verses.nlt_text: When they received their pay, they protested to the owner,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, These last have wrought {but} one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day. {have wrought...: or, have continued one hour only}
verses.nlt_text: 'Those people worked only one hour, and yet you've paid them just as much as you paid us who worked all day in the scorching heat.'

verses.kjv_text: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.nlt_text: "He answered one of them, 'Friend, I haven't been unfair! Didn't you agree to work all day for the usual wage?

verses.kjv_text: Take {that} thine {is}, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: Take your money and go. I wanted to pay this last worker the same as you.

verses.kjv_text: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.nlt_text: Is it against the law for me to do what I want with my money? Should you be jealous because I am kind to others?'

verses.kjv_text: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.nlt_text: "So those who are last now will be first then, and those who are first will be last."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside privately and told them what was going to happen to him.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.nlt_text: "Listen," he said, "we're going up to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be betrayed to the leading priests and the teachers of religious law. They will sentence him to die.

verses.kjv_text: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify {him}: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.nlt_text: Then they will hand him over to the Romans to be mocked, flogged with a whip, and crucified. But on the third day he will be raised from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping {him}, and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.nlt_text: Then the mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus with her sons. She knelt respectfully to ask a favor.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: "What is your request?" he asked.She replied, "In your Kingdom, please let my two sons sit in places of honor next to you, one on your right and the other on your left."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus answered by saying to them, "You don't know what you are asking! Are you able to drink from the bitter cup of suffering I am about to drink?" "Oh yes," they replied, "we are able!"

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but {it shall be given to them} for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "You will indeed drink from my bitter cup. But I have no right to say who will sit on my right or my left. My Father has prepared those places for the ones he has chosen."

verses.kjv_text: And when the ten heard {it}, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.nlt_text: When the ten other disciples heard what James and John had asked, they were indignant.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus called them {unto him}, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers in this world lord it over their people, and officials flaunt their authority over those under them.

verses.kjv_text: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.nlt_text: But among you it will be different. Whoever wants to be a leader among you must be your servant,

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.nlt_text: and whoever wants to be first among you must become your slave.

verses.kjv_text: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.nlt_text: For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve others and to give his life as a ransom for many."

verses.kjv_text: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus and the disciples left the town of Jericho, a large crowd followed behind.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, {thou} Son of David.
verses.nlt_text: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was coming that way, they began shouting, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, {thou} Son of David.
verses.nlt_text: "Be quiet!" the crowd yelled at them.But they only shouted louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and called, "What do you want me to do for you?"

verses.kjv_text: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.nlt_text: "Lord," they said, "we want to see!"

verses.kjv_text: So Jesus had compassion {on them}, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. Instantly they could see! Then they followed him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus and the disciples approached Jerusalem, they came to the town of Bethphage on the Mount of Olives. Jesus sent two of them on ahead.

verses.kjv_text: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose {them}, and bring {them} unto me.
verses.nlt_text: "Go into the village over there," he said. "As soon as you enter it, you will see a donkey tied there, with its colt beside it. Untie them and bring them to me.

verses.kjv_text: And if any {man} say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone asks what you are doing, just say, 'The Lord needs them,' and he will immediately let you take them."

verses.kjv_text: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.nlt_text: This took place to fulfill the prophecy that said,

verses.kjv_text: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.nlt_text: "Tell the people of Israel, 'Look, your King is coming to you. He is humble, riding on a donkey-- riding on a donkey's colt.' "

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.nlt_text: The two disciples did as Jesus commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set {him} thereon.
verses.nlt_text: They brought the donkey and the colt to him and threw their garments over the colt, and he sat on it.

verses.kjv_text: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed {them} in the way.
verses.nlt_text: Most of the crowd spread their garments on the road ahead of him, and others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

verses.kjv_text: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus was in the center of the procession, and the people all around him were shouting, "Praise God for the Son of David! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the LORD! Praise God in highest heaven!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.nlt_text: The entire city of Jerusalem was in an uproar as he entered. "Who is this?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: And the crowds replied, "It's Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus entered the Temple and began to drive out all the people buying and selling animals for sacrifice. He knocked over the tables of the money changers and the chairs of those selling doves.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.nlt_text: He said to them, "The Scriptures declare, 'My Temple will be called a house of prayer,' but you have turned it into a den of thieves!"

verses.kjv_text: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.nlt_text: The blind and the lame came to him in the Temple, and he healed them.

verses.kjv_text: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.nlt_text: The leading priests and the teachers of religious law saw these wonderful miracles and heard even the children in the Temple shouting, "Praise God for the Son of David." But the leaders were indignant.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.nlt_text: They asked Jesus, "Do you hear what these children are saying?" "Yes," Jesus replied. "Haven't you ever read the Scriptures? For they say, 'You have taught children and infants to give you praise.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.nlt_text: Then he returned to Bethany, where he stayed overnight.

verses.kjv_text: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.nlt_text: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to Jerusalem, he was hungry,

verses.kjv_text: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away. {a fig tree: Gr. one fig tree}
verses.nlt_text: and he noticed a fig tree beside the road. He went over to see if there were any figs, but there were only leaves. Then he said to it, "May you never bear fruit again!" And immediately the fig tree withered up.

verses.kjv_text: And when the disciples saw {it}, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.nlt_text: The disciples were amazed when they saw this and asked, "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this {which is done} to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told them, "I tell you the truth, if you have faith and don't doubt, you can do things like this and much more. You can even say to this mountain, 'May you be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' and it will happen.

verses.kjv_text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.nlt_text: You can pray for anything, and if you have faith, you will receive it."

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus returned to the Temple and began teaching, the leading priests and elders came up to him. They demanded, "By what authority are you doing all these things? Who gave you the right?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.nlt_text: "I'll tell you by what authority I do these things if you answer one question," Jesus replied.

verses.kjv_text: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.nlt_text: "Did John's authority to baptize come from heaven, or was it merely human?" They talked it over among themselves. "If we say it was from heaven, he will ask us why we didn't believe John.

verses.kjv_text: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: But if we say it was merely human, we'll be mobbed because the people believe John was a prophet."

verses.kjv_text: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.nlt_text: So they finally replied, "We don't know." And Jesus responded, "Then I won't tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.kjv_text: But what think ye? A {certain} man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.nlt_text: "But what do you think about this? A man with two sons told the older boy, 'Son, go out and work in the vineyard today.'

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.nlt_text: The son answered, 'No, I won't go,' but later he changed his mind and went anyway.

verses.kjv_text: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I {go}, sir: and went not.
verses.nlt_text: Then the father told the other son, 'You go,' and he said, 'Yes, sir, I will.' But he didn't go.

verses.kjv_text: Whether of them twain did the will of {his} father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.nlt_text: "Which of the two obeyed his father?" They replied, "The first." Then Jesus explained his meaning: "I tell you the truth, corrupt tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the Kingdom of God before you do.

verses.kjv_text: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen {it}, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.nlt_text: For John the Baptist came and showed you the right way to live, but you didn't believe him, while tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even when you saw this happening, you refused to believe him and repent of your sins.

verses.kjv_text: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.nlt_text: "Now listen to another story. A certain landowner planted a vineyard, built a wall around it, dug a pit for pressing out the grape juice, and built a lookout tower. Then he leased the vineyard to tenant farmers and moved to another country.

verses.kjv_text: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.nlt_text: At the time of the grape harvest, he sent his servants to collect his share of the crop.

verses.kjv_text: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.nlt_text: But the farmers grabbed his servants, beat one, killed one, and stoned another.

verses.kjv_text: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.nlt_text: So the landowner sent a larger group of his servants to collect for him, but the results were the same.

verses.kjv_text: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.nlt_text: "Finally, the owner sent his son, thinking, 'Surely they will respect my son.'

verses.kjv_text: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: "But when the tenant farmers saw his son coming, they said to one another, 'Here comes the heir to this estate. Come on, let's kill him and get the estate for ourselves!'

verses.kjv_text: And they caught him, and cast {him} out of the vineyard, and slew {him}.
verses.nlt_text: So they grabbed him, dragged him out of the vineyard, and murdered him.

verses.kjv_text: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.nlt_text: "When the owner of the vineyard returns," Jesus asked, "what do you think he will do to those farmers?"

verses.kjv_text: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out {his} vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.nlt_text: The religious leaders replied, "He will put the wicked men to a horrible death and lease the vineyard to others who will give him his share of the crop after each harvest."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus asked them, "Didn't you ever read this in the Scriptures? 'The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone. This is the Lord's doing, and it is wonderful to see.'

verses.kjv_text: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a nation that will produce the proper fruit.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who stumbles over that stone will be broken to pieces, and it will crush anyone it falls on. "

verses.kjv_text: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.nlt_text: When the leading priests and Pharisees heard this parable, they realized he was telling the story against them-- they were the wicked farmers.

verses.kjv_text: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: They wanted to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowds, who considered Jesus to be a prophet.

verses.kjv_text: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus also told them other parables. He said,

verses.kjv_text: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.nlt_text: "The Kingdom of Heaven can be illustrated by the story of a king who prepared a great wedding feast for his son.

verses.kjv_text: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and {my} fatlings {are} killed, and all things {are} ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.nlt_text: When the banquet was ready, he sent his servants to notify those who were invited. But they all refused to come!

verses.kjv_text: But they made light of {it}, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.nlt_text: "So he sent other servants to tell them, 'The feast has been prepared. The bulls and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the banquet!'

verses.kjv_text: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated {them} spitefully, and slew {them}.
verses.nlt_text: But the guests he had invited ignored them and went their own way, one to his farm, another to his business.

verses.kjv_text: But when the king heard {thereof}, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.nlt_text: Others seized his messengers and insulted them and killed them.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.nlt_text: "The king was furious, and he sent out his army to destroy the murderers and burn their town.

verses.kjv_text: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.nlt_text: And he said to his servants, 'The wedding feast is ready, and the guests I invited aren't worthy of the honor.

verses.kjv_text: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.nlt_text: Now go out to the street corners and invite everyone you see.'

verses.kjv_text: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.nlt_text: So the servants brought in everyone they could find, good and bad alike, and the banquet hall was filled with guests.

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.nlt_text: "But when the king came in to meet the guests, he noticed a man who wasn't wearing the proper clothes for a wedding.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast {him} into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.nlt_text: 'Friend,' he asked, 'how is it that you are here without wedding clothes?' But the man had no reply.

verses.kjv_text: For many are called, but few {are} chosen.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king said to his aides, 'Bind his hands and feet and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

verses.kjv_text: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in {his} talk.
verses.nlt_text: "For many are called, but few are chosen."

verses.kjv_text: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any {man}: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Pharisees met together to plot how to trap Jesus into saying something for which he could be arrested.

verses.kjv_text: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.nlt_text: They sent some of their disciples, along with the supporters of Herod, to meet with him. "Teacher," they said, "we know how honest you are. You teach the way of God truthfully. You are impartial and don't play favorites.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, {ye} hypocrites?
verses.nlt_text: Now tell us what you think about this: Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

verses.kjv_text: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny. {penny: in value seven pence halfpenny}
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus knew their evil motives. "You hypocrites!" he said. "Why are you trying to trap me?

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Whose {is} this image and superscription? {superscription: or, inscription}
verses.nlt_text: Here, show me the coin used for the tax." When they handed him a Roman coin,

verses.kjv_text: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
verses.nlt_text: he asked, "Whose picture and title are stamped on it?"

verses.kjv_text: When they had heard {these words}, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.nlt_text: "Caesar's," they replied."Well, then," he said, "give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God."

verses.kjv_text: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.nlt_text: His reply amazed them, and they went away.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.nlt_text: That same day Jesus was approached by some Sadducees-- religious leaders who say there is no resurrection from the dead. They posed this question:

verses.kjv_text: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher, Moses said, 'If a man dies without children, his brother should marry the widow and have a child who will carry on the brother's name.'

verses.kjv_text: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh. {seventh: Gr. seven}
verses.nlt_text: Well, suppose there were seven brothers. The oldest one married and then died without children, so his brother married the widow.

verses.kjv_text: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.nlt_text: But the second brother also died, and the third brother married her. This continued with all seven of them.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.nlt_text: Last of all, the woman also died.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.nlt_text: So tell us, whose wife will she be in the resurrection? For all seven were married to her."

verses.kjv_text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Your mistake is that you don't know the Scriptures, and you don't know the power of God.

verses.kjv_text: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.nlt_text: For when the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. In this respect they will be like the angels in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
verses.nlt_text: "But now, as to whether there will be a resurrection of the dead-- haven't you ever read about this in the Scriptures? Long after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, God said,

verses.kjv_text: And when the multitude heard {this}, they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.nlt_text: 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.' So he is the God of the living, not the dead."

verses.kjv_text: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.nlt_text: When the crowds heard him, they were astounded at his teaching.

verses.kjv_text: Then one of them, {which was} a lawyer, asked {him a question}, tempting him, and saying,
verses.nlt_text: But when the Pharisees heard that he had silenced the Sadducees with his reply, they met together to question him again.

verses.kjv_text: Master, which {is} the great commandment in the law?
verses.nlt_text: One of them, an expert in religious law, tried to trap him with this question:

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher, which is the most important commandment in the law of Moses?"

verses.kjv_text: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, " 'You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.'

verses.kjv_text: And the second {is} like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.nlt_text: This is the first and greatest commandment.

verses.kjv_text: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: A second is equally important: 'Love your neighbor as yourself.'

verses.kjv_text: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
verses.nlt_text: The entire law and all the demands of the prophets are based on these two commandments."

verses.kjv_text: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, {The Son} of David.
verses.nlt_text: Then, surrounded by the Pharisees, Jesus asked them a question:

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.nlt_text: "What do you think about the Messiah? Whose son is he?" They replied, "He is the son of David."

verses.kjv_text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "Then why does David, speaking under the inspiration of the Spirit, call the Messiah 'my Lord'? For David said,

verses.kjv_text: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
verses.nlt_text: 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies beneath your feet.'

verses.kjv_text: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any {man} from that day forth ask him any more {questions}.
verses.nlt_text: Since David called the Messiah 'my Lord,' how can the Messiah be his son?"

verses.kjv_text: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
verses.nlt_text: "The teachers of religious law and the Pharisees are the official interpreters of the law of Moses.

verses.kjv_text: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, {that} observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.nlt_text: So practice and obey whatever they tell you, but don't follow their example. For they don't practice what they teach.
