verses.kjv_text: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay {them} on men's shoulders; but they {themselves} will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.nlt_text: They crush people with impossible religious demands and never lift a finger to ease the burden.

verses.kjv_text: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments, {phylacteries: pieces of parchment containing sentences of the law}
verses.nlt_text: "Everything they do is for show. On their arms they wear extra wide prayer boxes with Scripture verses inside, and they wear robes with extra long tassels.

verses.kjv_text: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.nlt_text: And they love to sit at the head table at banquets and in the seats of honor in the synagogues.

verses.kjv_text: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.nlt_text: They love to receive respectful greetings as they walk in the marketplaces, and to be called 'Rabbi.'

verses.kjv_text: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, {even} Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't let anyone call you 'Rabbi,' for you have only one teacher, and all of you are equal as brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: And call no {man} your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: And don't address anyone here on earth as 'Father,' for only God in heaven is your spiritual Father.

verses.kjv_text: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, {even} Christ.
verses.nlt_text: And don't let anyone call you 'Teacher,' for you have only one teacher, the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.nlt_text: The greatest among you must be a servant.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.nlt_text: But those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.

verses.kjv_text: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in {yourselves}, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you shut the door of the Kingdom of Heaven in people's faces. You won't go in yourselves, and you don't let others enter either.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you cross land and sea to make one convert, and then you turn that person into twice the child of hell you yourselves are!

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, {ye} blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.nlt_text: "Blind guides! What sorrow awaits you! For you say that it means nothing to swear 'by God's Temple,' but that it is binding to swear 'by the gold in the Temple.'

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.nlt_text: Blind fools! Which is more important-- the gold or the Temple that makes the gold sacred?

verses.kjv_text: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty. {guilty: or, debtor, or, bound}
verses.nlt_text: And you say that to swear 'by the altar' is not binding, but to swear 'by the gifts on the altar' is binding.

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} fools and blind: for whether {is} greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.nlt_text: How blind! For which is more important-- the gift on the altar or the altar that makes the gift sacred?

verses.kjv_text: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.nlt_text: When you swear 'by the altar,' you are swearing by it and by everything on it.

verses.kjv_text: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.nlt_text: And when you swear 'by the Temple,' you are swearing by it and by God, who lives in it.

verses.kjv_text: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.nlt_text: And when you swear 'by heaven,' you are swearing by the throne of God and by God, who sits on the throne.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier {matters} of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone. {anise: Gr. dill}
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you are careful to tithe even the tiniest income from your herb gardens, but you ignore the more important aspects of the law-- justice, mercy, and faith. You should tithe, yes, but do not neglect the more important things.

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.nlt_text: Blind guides! You strain your water so you won't accidentally swallow a gnat, but you swallow a camel!

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you are so careful to clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside you are filthy-- full of greed and self-indulgence!

verses.kjv_text: {Thou} blind Pharisee, cleanse first that {which is} within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.nlt_text: You blind Pharisee! First wash the inside of the cup and the dish, and then the outside will become clean, too.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead {men's} bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs-- beautiful on the outside but filled on the inside with dead people's bones and all sorts of impurity.

verses.kjv_text: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: Outwardly you look like righteous people, but inwardly your hearts are filled with hypocrisy and lawlessness.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you build tombs for the prophets your ancestors killed, and you decorate the monuments of the godly people your ancestors destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: Then you say, 'If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would never have joined them in killing the prophets.'

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: "But in saying that, you testify against yourselves that you are indeed the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

verses.kjv_text: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.nlt_text: Go ahead and finish what your ancestors started.

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} serpents, {ye} generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.nlt_text: Snakes! Sons of vipers! How will you escape the judgment of hell?

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and {some} of them ye shall kill and crucify; and {some} of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute {them} from city to city:
verses.nlt_text: "Therefore, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers of religious law. But you will kill some by crucifixion, and you will flog others with whips in your synagogues, chasing them from city to city.

verses.kjv_text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, you will be held responsible for the murder of all godly people of all time-- from the murder of righteous Abel to the murder of Zechariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed in the Temple between the sanctuary and the altar.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, this judgment will fall on this very generation.

verses.kjv_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, {thou} that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under {her} wings, and ye would not!
verses.nlt_text: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones God's messengers! How often I have wanted to gather your children together as a hen protects her chicks beneath her wings, but you wouldn't let me.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.nlt_text: And now, look, your house is abandoned and desolate.

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: For I tell you this, you will never see me again until you say, 'Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord!' "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to {him} for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was leaving the Temple grounds, his disciples pointed out to him the various Temple buildings.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.nlt_text: But he responded, "Do you see all these buildings? I tell you the truth, they will be completely demolished. Not one stone will be left on top of another!"

verses.kjv_text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what {shall be} the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.nlt_text: Later, Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives. His disciples came to him privately and said, "Tell us, when will all this happen? What sign will signal your return and the end of the world? "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "Don't let anyone mislead you,

verses.kjv_text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.nlt_text: for many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am the Messiah.' They will deceive many.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all {these things} must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.nlt_text: And you will hear of wars and threats of wars, but don't panic. Yes, these things must take place, but the end won't follow immediately.

verses.kjv_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.nlt_text: Nation will go to war against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in many parts of the world.

verses.kjv_text: All these {are} the beginning of sorrows.
verses.nlt_text: But all this is only the first of the birth pains, with more to come.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
verses.nlt_text: "Then you will be arrested, persecuted, and killed. You will be hated all over the world because you are my followers.

verses.kjv_text: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.nlt_text: And many will turn away from me and betray and hate each other.

verses.kjv_text: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.nlt_text: And many false prophets will appear and will deceive many people.

verses.kjv_text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.nlt_text: Sin will be rampant everywhere, and the love of many will grow cold.

verses.kjv_text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.nlt_text: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.kjv_text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.nlt_text: And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.

verses.kjv_text: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.nlt_text: "The day is coming when you will see what Daniel the prophet spoke about-- the sacrilegious object that causes desecration standing in the Holy Place." (Reader, pay attention!)

verses.kjv_text: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.nlt_text: "Then those in Judea must flee to the hills.

verses.kjv_text: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.nlt_text: A person out on the deck of a roof must not go down into the house to pack.

verses.kjv_text: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.nlt_text: A person out in the field must not return even to get a coat.

verses.kjv_text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.nlt_text: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and for nursing mothers in those days.

verses.kjv_text: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.nlt_text: And pray that your flight will not be in winter or on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv_text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.nlt_text: For there will be greater anguish than at any time since the world began. And it will never be so great again.

verses.kjv_text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, unless that time of calamity is shortened, not a single person will survive. But it will be shortened for the sake of God's chosen ones.

verses.kjv_text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here {is} Christ, or there; believe {it} not.
verses.nlt_text: "Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Messiah,' or 'There he is,' don't believe it.

verses.kjv_text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if {it were} possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.nlt_text: For false messiahs and false prophets will rise up and perform great signs and wonders so as to deceive, if possible, even God's chosen ones.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.nlt_text: See, I have warned you about this ahead of time.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, {he is} in the secret chambers; believe {it} not.
verses.nlt_text: "So if someone tells you, 'Look, the Messiah is out in the desert,' don't bother to go and look. Or, 'Look, he is hiding here,' don't believe it!

verses.kjv_text: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.nlt_text: For as the lightning flashes in the east and shines to the west, so it will be when the Son of Man comes.

verses.kjv_text: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.nlt_text: Just as the gathering of vultures shows there is a carcass nearby, so these signs indicate that the end is near.

verses.kjv_text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.nlt_text: "Immediately after the anguish of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will give no light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.

verses.kjv_text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.nlt_text: And then at last, the sign that the Son of Man is coming will appear in the heavens, and there will be deep mourning among all the peoples of the earth. And they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other. {with...: or, with a trumpet, and a great voice}
verses.nlt_text: And he will send out his angels with the mighty blast of a trumpet, and they will gather his chosen ones from all over the world-- from the farthest ends of the earth and heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer {is} nigh:
verses.nlt_text: "Now learn a lesson from the fig tree. When its branches bud and its leaves begin to sprout, you know that summer is near.

verses.kjv_text: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, {even} at the doors. {it: or, he}
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, when you see all these things, you can know his return is very near, right at the door.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass from the scene until all these things take place.

verses.kjv_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.nlt_text: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

verses.kjv_text: But of that day and hour knoweth no {man}, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.nlt_text: "However, no one knows the day or hour when these things will happen, not even the angels in heaven or the Son himself. Only the Father knows.

verses.kjv_text: But as the days of Noe {were}, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.nlt_text: "When the Son of Man returns, it will be like it was in Noah's day.

verses.kjv_text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.nlt_text: In those days before the flood, the people were enjoying banquets and parties and weddings right up to the time Noah entered his boat.

verses.kjv_text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.nlt_text: People didn't realize what was going to happen until the flood came and swept them all away. That is the way it will be when the Son of Man comes.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.nlt_text: "Two men will be working together in the field; one will be taken, the other left.

verses.kjv_text: Two {women shall be} grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.nlt_text: Two women will be grinding flour at the mill; one will be taken, the other left.

verses.kjv_text: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.nlt_text: "So you, too, must keep watch! For you don't know what day your Lord is coming.

verses.kjv_text: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.nlt_text: Understand this: If a homeowner knew exactly when a burglar was coming, he would keep watch and not permit his house to be broken into.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.nlt_text: You also must be ready all the time, for the Son of Man will come when least expected.

verses.kjv_text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.nlt_text: "A faithful, sensible servant is one to whom the master can give the responsibility of managing his other household servants and feeding them.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {is} that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.nlt_text: If the master returns and finds that the servant has done a good job, there will be a reward.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, the master will put that servant in charge of all he owns.

verses.kjv_text: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.nlt_text: But what if the servant is evil and thinks, 'My master won't be back for a while,'

verses.kjv_text: And shall begin to smite {his} fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.nlt_text: and he begins beating the other servants, partying, and getting drunk?

verses.kjv_text: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for {him}, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.nlt_text: The master will return unannounced and unexpected,

verses.kjv_text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint {him} his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth. {cut...: or, cut him off}
verses.nlt_text: and he will cut the servant to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.nlt_text: "The Kingdom of Heaven can be illustrated by the story of ten bridesmaids who took their lamps and went to meet the bridegroom.

verses.kjv_text: And five of them were wise, and five {were} foolish.
verses.nlt_text: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

verses.kjv_text: They that {were} foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.nlt_text: The five who were foolish didn't take enough olive oil for their lamps,

verses.kjv_text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.nlt_text: but the other five were wise enough to take along extra oil.

verses.kjv_text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.nlt_text: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

verses.kjv_text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.nlt_text: "At midnight they were roused by the shout, 'Look, the bridegroom is coming! Come out and meet him!'

verses.kjv_text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.nlt_text: "All the bridesmaids got up and prepared their lamps.

verses.kjv_text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out. {gone out: or, going out}
verses.nlt_text: Then the five foolish ones asked the others, 'Please give us some of your oil because our lamps are going out.'

verses.kjv_text: But the wise answered, saying, {Not so}; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.nlt_text: "But the others replied, 'We don't have enough for all of us. Go to a shop and buy some for yourselves.'

verses.kjv_text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.nlt_text: "But while they were gone to buy oil, the bridegroom came. Then those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was locked.

verses.kjv_text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.nlt_text: Later, when the other five bridesmaids returned, they stood outside, calling, 'Lord! Lord! Open the door for us!'

verses.kjv_text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.nlt_text: "But he called back, 'Believe me, I don't know you!'

verses.kjv_text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.nlt_text: "So you, too, must keep watch! For you do not know the day or hour of my return.

verses.kjv_text: For {the kingdom of heaven is} as a man travelling into a far country, {who} called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.nlt_text: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven can be illustrated by the story of a man going on a long trip. He called together his servants and entrusted his money to them while he was gone.

verses.kjv_text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey. {talents: a talent is one hundred and eighty seven pounds ten shillings}
verses.nlt_text: He gave five bags of silver to one, two bags of silver to another, and one bag of silver to the last-- dividing it in proportion to their abilities. He then left on his trip.

verses.kjv_text: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made {them} other five talents.
verses.nlt_text: "The servant who received the five bags of silver began to invest the money and earned five more.

verses.kjv_text: And likewise he that {had received} two, he also gained other two.
verses.nlt_text: The servant with two bags of silver also went to work and earned two more.

verses.kjv_text: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
verses.nlt_text: But the servant who received the one bag of silver dug a hole in the ground and hid the master's money.

verses.kjv_text: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.nlt_text: "After a long time their master returned from his trip and called them to give an account of how they had used his money.

verses.kjv_text: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.nlt_text: The servant to whom he had entrusted the five bags of silver came forward with five more and said, 'Master, you gave me five bags of silver to invest, and I have earned five more.'

verses.kjv_text: His lord said unto him, Well done, {thou} good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.nlt_text: "The master was full of praise. 'Well done, my good and faithful servant. You have been faithful in handling this small amount, so now I will give you many more responsibilities. Let's celebrate together! '

verses.kjv_text: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.nlt_text: "The servant who had received the two bags of silver came forward and said, 'Master, you gave me two bags of silver to invest, and I have earned two more.'

verses.kjv_text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.nlt_text: "The master said, 'Well done, my good and faithful servant. You have been faithful in handling this small amount, so now I will give you many more responsibilities. Let's celebrate together!'

verses.kjv_text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.nlt_text: "Then the servant with the one bag of silver came and said, 'Master, I knew you were a harsh man, harvesting crops you didn't plant and gathering crops you didn't cultivate.

verses.kjv_text: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, {there} thou hast {that is} thine.
verses.nlt_text: I was afraid I would lose your money, so I hid it in the earth. Look, here is your money back.'

verses.kjv_text: His lord answered and said unto him, {Thou} wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.nlt_text: "But the master replied, 'You wicked and lazy servant! If you knew I harvested crops I didn't plant and gathered crops I didn't cultivate,

verses.kjv_text: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and {then} at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.nlt_text: why didn't you deposit my money in the bank? At least I could have gotten some interest on it.'

verses.kjv_text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give {it} unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.nlt_text: "Then he ordered, 'Take the money from this servant, and give it to the one with the ten bags of silver.

verses.kjv_text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.nlt_text: To those who use well what they are given, even more will be given, and they will have an abundance. But from those who do nothing, even what little they have will be taken away.

verses.kjv_text: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.nlt_text: Now throw this useless servant into outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

verses.kjv_text: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.nlt_text: "But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then he will sit upon his glorious throne.

verses.kjv_text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth {his} sheep from the goats:
verses.nlt_text: All the nations will be gathered in his presence, and he will separate the people as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.nlt_text: He will place the sheep at his right hand and the goats at his left.

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.nlt_text: "Then the King will say to those on his right, 'Come, you who are blessed by my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the creation of the world.

verses.kjv_text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.nlt_text: For I was hungry, and you fed me. I was thirsty, and you gave me a drink. I was a stranger, and you invited me into your home.

verses.kjv_text: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.nlt_text: I was naked, and you gave me clothing. I was sick, and you cared for me. I was in prison, and you visited me.'

verses.kjv_text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed {thee}? or thirsty, and gave {thee} drink?
verses.nlt_text: "Then these righteous ones will reply, 'Lord, when did we ever see you hungry and feed you? Or thirsty and give you something to drink?

verses.kjv_text: When saw we thee a stranger, and took {thee} in? or naked, and clothed {thee}?
verses.nlt_text: Or a stranger and show you hospitality? Or naked and give you clothing?

verses.kjv_text: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.nlt_text: When did we ever see you sick or in prison and visit you?'

verses.kjv_text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done {it} unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done {it} unto me.
verses.nlt_text: "And the King will say, 'I tell you the truth, when you did it to one of the least of these my brothers and sisters, you were doing it to me!'

verses.kjv_text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.nlt_text: "Then the King will turn to those on the left and say, 'Away with you, you cursed ones, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his demons.

verses.kjv_text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.nlt_text: For I was hungry, and you didn't feed me. I was thirsty, and you didn't give me a drink.

verses.kjv_text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
verses.nlt_text: I was a stranger, and you didn't invite me into your home. I was naked, and you didn't give me clothing. I was sick and in prison, and you didn't visit me.'

verses.kjv_text: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
verses.nlt_text: "Then they will reply, 'Lord, when did we ever see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and not help you?'

verses.kjv_text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did {it} not to one of the least of these, ye did {it} not to me.
verses.nlt_text: "And he will answer, 'I tell you the truth, when you refused to help the least of these my brothers and sisters, you were refusing to help me.'

verses.kjv_text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.nlt_text: "And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous will go into eternal life."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,

verses.kjv_text: Ye know that after two days is {the feast of} the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.nlt_text: "As you know, Passover begins in two days, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified."

verses.kjv_text: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.nlt_text: At that same time the leading priests and elders were meeting at the residence of Caiaphas, the high priest,

verses.kjv_text: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill {him}.
verses.nlt_text: plotting how to capture Jesus secretly and kill him.

verses.kjv_text: But they said, Not on the feast {day}, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.nlt_text: "But not during the Passover celebration," they agreed, "or the people may riot."

verses.kjv_text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Jesus was in Bethany at the home of Simon, a man who had previously had leprosy.

verses.kjv_text: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat {at meat}.
verses.nlt_text: While he was eating, a woman came in with a beautiful alabaster jar of expensive perfume and poured it over his head.

verses.kjv_text: But when his disciples saw {it}, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose {is} this waste?
verses.nlt_text: The disciples were indignant when they saw this. "What a waste of money," they said.

verses.kjv_text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.nlt_text: "It could have been sold for a high price and the money given to the poor."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus understood {it}, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus, aware of this, replied, "Why criticize this woman for doing such a good thing to me?

verses.kjv_text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.nlt_text: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me.

verses.kjv_text: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did {it} for my burial.
verses.nlt_text: She has poured this perfume on me to prepare my body for burial.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, {there} shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, wherever the Good News is preached throughout the world, this woman's deed will be remembered and discussed."

verses.kjv_text: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.nlt_text: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve disciples, went to the leading priests

verses.kjv_text: And said {unto them}, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.nlt_text: and asked, "How much will you pay me to betray Jesus to you?" And they gave him thirty pieces of silver.

verses.kjv_text: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.nlt_text: From that time on, Judas began looking for an opportunity to betray Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Now the first {day} of the {feast of} unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.nlt_text: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal for you?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.nlt_text: "As you go into the city," he told them, "you will see a certain man. Tell him, 'The Teacher says: My time has come, and I will eat the Passover meal with my disciples at your house.'"

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.nlt_text: So the disciples did as Jesus told them and prepared the Passover meal there.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.nlt_text: When it was evening, Jesus sat down at the table with the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.nlt_text: While they were eating, he said, "I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me."

verses.kjv_text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.nlt_text: Greatly distressed, each one asked in turn, "Am I the one, Lord?"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said, He that dippeth {his} hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "One of you who has just eaten from this bowl with me will betray me.

verses.kjv_text: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.nlt_text: For the Son of Man must die, as the Scriptures declared long ago. But how terrible it will be for the one who betrays him. It would be far better for that man if he had never been born!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.nlt_text: Judas, the one who would betray him, also asked, "Rabbi, am I the one?" And Jesus told him, "You have said it."

verses.kjv_text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed {it}, and brake {it}, and gave {it} to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body. {blessed it: many Greek copies have gave thanks}
verses.nlt_text: As they were eating, Jesus took some bread and blessed it. Then he broke it in pieces and gave it to the disciples, saying, "Take this and eat it, for this is my body."

verses.kjv_text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave {it} to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.nlt_text: And he took a cup of wine and gave thanks to God for it. He gave it to them and said, "Each of you drink from it,

verses.kjv_text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.nlt_text: for this is my blood, which confirms the covenant between God and his people. It is poured out as a sacrifice to forgive the sins of many.

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: Mark my words-- I will not drink wine again until the day I drink it new with you in my Father's Kingdom."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives. {hymn: or, psalm}
verses.nlt_text: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.nlt_text: On the way, Jesus told them, "Tonight all of you will desert me. For the Scriptures say, 'God will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

verses.kjv_text: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: But after I have been raised from the dead, I will go ahead of you to Galilee and meet you there."

verses.kjv_text: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all {men} shall be offended because of thee, {yet} will I never be offended. {offended: or, though the faith of other men should be shaken and fail, yet mine will be firm and constant}
verses.nlt_text: Peter declared, "Even if everyone else deserts you, I will never desert you."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, Peter-- this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny three times that you even know me."

verses.kjv_text: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.nlt_text: "No!" Peter insisted. "Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny you!" And all the other disciples vowed the same.

verses.kjv_text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus went with them to the olive grove called Gethsemane, and he said, "Sit here while I go over there to pray."

verses.kjv_text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.nlt_text: He took Peter and Zebedee's two sons, James and John, and he became anguished and distressed.

verses.kjv_text: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou {wilt}.
verses.nlt_text: He told them, "My soul is crushed with grief to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me."

verses.kjv_text: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.nlt_text: He went on a little farther and bowed with his face to the ground, praying, "My Father! If it is possible, let this cup of suffering be taken away from me. Yet I want your will to be done, not mine."

verses.kjv_text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed {is} willing, but the flesh {is} weak.
verses.nlt_text: Then he returned to the disciples and found them asleep. He said to Peter, "Couldn't you watch with me even one hour?

verses.kjv_text: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.nlt_text: Keep watch and pray, so that you will not give in to temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak!"

verses.kjv_text: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus left them a second time and prayed, "My Father! If this cup cannot be taken away unless I drink it, your will be done."

verses.kjv_text: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.nlt_text: When he returned to them again, he found them sleeping, for they couldn't keep their eyes open.

verses.kjv_text: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take {your} rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.nlt_text: So he went to pray a third time, saying the same things again.

verses.kjv_text: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.nlt_text: Then he came to the disciples and said, "Go ahead and sleep. Have your rest. But look-- the time has come. The Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.kjv_text: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.nlt_text: Up, let's be going. Look, my betrayer is here!"

verses.kjv_text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.nlt_text: And even as Jesus said this, Judas, one of the twelve disciples, arrived with a crowd of men armed with swords and clubs. They had been sent by the leading priests and elders of the people.

verses.kjv_text: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.nlt_text: The traitor, Judas, had given them a prearranged signal: "You will know which one to arrest when I greet him with a kiss."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.nlt_text: So Judas came straight to Jesus. "Greetings, Rabbi!" he exclaimed and gave him the kiss.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out {his} hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "My friend, go ahead and do what you have come for." Then the others grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.nlt_text: But one of the men with Jesus pulled out his sword and struck the high priest's slave, slashing off his ear.

verses.kjv_text: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.nlt_text: "Put away your sword," Jesus told him. "Those who use the sword will die by the sword.

verses.kjv_text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.nlt_text: Don't you realize that I could ask my Father for thousands of angels to protect us, and he would send them instantly?

verses.kjv_text: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.nlt_text: But if I did, how would the Scriptures be fulfilled that describe what must happen now?"

verses.kjv_text: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the crowd, "Am I some dangerous revolutionary, that you come with swords and clubs to arrest me? Why didn't you arrest me in the Temple? I was there teaching every day.

verses.kjv_text: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led {him} away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.nlt_text: But this is all happening to fulfill the words of the prophets as recorded in the Scriptures." At that point, all the disciples deserted him and fled.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.nlt_text: Then the people who had arrested Jesus led him to the home of Caiaphas, the high priest, where the teachers of religious law and the elders had gathered.

verses.kjv_text: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Peter followed him at a distance and came to the high priest's courtyard. He went in and sat with the guards and waited to see how it would all end.

verses.kjv_text: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, {yet} found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.nlt_text: Inside, the leading priests and the entire high council were trying to find witnesses who would lie about Jesus, so they could put him to death.

verses.kjv_text: And said, This {fellow} said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.nlt_text: But even though they found many who agreed to give false witness, they could not use anyone's testimony. Finally, two men came forward

verses.kjv_text: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what {is it which} these witness against thee?
verses.nlt_text: who declared, "This man said, 'I am able to destroy the Temple of God and rebuild it in three days.'"

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, "Well, aren't you going to answer these charges? What do you have to say for yourself?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to him, "I demand in the name of the living God-- tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God."

verses.kjv_text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "You have said it. And in the future you will see the Son of Man seated in the place of power at God's right hand and coming on the clouds of heaven."

verses.kjv_text: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.nlt_text: Then the high priest tore his clothing to show his horror and said, "Blasphemy! Why do we need other witnesses? You have all heard his blasphemy.

verses.kjv_text: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote {him} with the palms of their hands, {the palms...: or, rods}
verses.nlt_text: What is your verdict?" "Guilty!" they shouted. "He deserves to die!"

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.nlt_text: Then they began to spit in Jesus' face and beat him with their fists. And some slapped him,

verses.kjv_text: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: jeering, "Prophesy to us, you Messiah! Who hit you that time?"

verses.kjv_text: But he denied before {them} all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant girl came over and said to him, "You were one of those with Jesus the Galilean."

verses.kjv_text: And when he was gone out into the porch, another {maid} saw him, and said unto them that were there, This {fellow} was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter denied it in front of everyone. "I don't know what you're talking about," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.nlt_text: Later, out by the gate, another servant girl noticed him and said to those standing around, "This man was with Jesus of Nazareth. "

verses.kjv_text: And after a while came unto {him} they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art {one} of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.nlt_text: Again Peter denied it, this time with an oath. "I don't even know the man," he said.

verses.kjv_text: Then began he to curse and to swear, {saying}, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.nlt_text: A little later some of the other bystanders came over to Peter and said, "You must be one of them; we can tell by your Galilean accent."

verses.kjv_text: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.nlt_text: Peter swore, "A curse on me if I'm lying-- I don't know the man!" And immediately the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv_text: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.nlt_text: Very early in the morning the leading priests and the elders met again to lay plans for putting Jesus to death.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had bound him, they led {him} away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.nlt_text: Then they bound him, led him away, and took him to Pilate, the Roman governor.

verses.kjv_text: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.nlt_text: When Judas, who had betrayed him, realized that Jesus had been condemned to die, he was filled with remorse. So he took the thirty pieces of silver back to the leading priests and the elders.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What {is that} to us? see thou {to that}.
verses.nlt_text: "I have sinned," he declared, "for I have betrayed an innocent man." "What do we care?" they retorted. "That's your problem."

verses.kjv_text: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.nlt_text: Then Judas threw the silver coins down in the Temple and went out and hanged himself.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.nlt_text: The leading priests picked up the coins. "It wouldn't be right to put this money in the Temple treasury," they said, "since it was payment for murder."

verses.kjv_text: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
verses.nlt_text: After some discussion they finally decided to buy the potter's field, and they made it into a cemetery for foreigners.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.nlt_text: That is why the field is still called the Field of Blood.

verses.kjv_text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value; {whom...: or, whom they bought of the children of Israel}
verses.nlt_text: This fulfilled the prophecy of Jeremiah that says, "They took the thirty pieces of silver-- the price at which he was valued by the people of Israel,

verses.kjv_text: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.nlt_text: and purchased the potter's field, as the LORD directed. "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.nlt_text: Now Jesus was standing before Pilate, the Roman governor. "Are you the king of the Jews?" the governor asked him.Jesus replied, "You have said it."

verses.kjv_text: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.nlt_text: But when the leading priests and the elders made their accusations against him, Jesus remained silent.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.nlt_text: "Don't you hear all these charges they are bringing against you?" Pilate demanded.

verses.kjv_text: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus made no response to any of the charges, much to the governor's surprise.

verses.kjv_text: Now at {that} feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.nlt_text: Now it was the governor's custom each year during the Passover celebration to release one prisoner to the crowd-- anyone they wanted.

verses.kjv_text: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.nlt_text: This year there was a notorious prisoner, a man named Barabbas.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.nlt_text: As the crowds gathered before Pilate's house that morning, he asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you-- Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?"

verses.kjv_text: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.nlt_text: (He knew very well that the religious leaders had arrested Jesus out of envy.)

verses.kjv_text: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.nlt_text: Just then, as Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him this message: "Leave that innocent man alone. I suffered through a terrible nightmare about him last night."

verses.kjv_text: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the leading priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas to be released and for Jesus to be put to death.

verses.kjv_text: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.nlt_text: So the governor asked again, "Which of these two do you want me to release to you?" The crowd shouted back, "Barabbas!"

verses.kjv_text: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? {They} all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate responded, "Then what should I do with Jesus who is called the Messiah?" They shouted back, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv_text: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.nlt_text: "Why?" Pilate demanded. "What crime has he committed?" But the mob roared even louder, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv_text: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but {that} rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed {his} hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye {to it}.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate saw that he wasn't getting anywhere and that a riot was developing. So he sent for a bowl of water and washed his hands before the crowd, saying, "I am innocent of this man's blood. The responsibility is yours!"

verses.kjv_text: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood {be} on us, and on our children.
verses.nlt_text: And all the people yelled back, "We will take responsibility for his death-- we and our children!"

verses.kjv_text: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered {him} to be crucified.
verses.nlt_text: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. He ordered Jesus flogged with a lead-tipped whip, then turned him over to the Roman soldiers to be crucified.

verses.kjv_text: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band {of soldiers}. {common hall: or, governor's house}
verses.nlt_text: Some of the governor's soldiers took Jesus into their headquarters and called out the entire regiment.

verses.kjv_text: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.nlt_text: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put {it} upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.nlt_text: They wove thorn branches into a crown and put it on his head, and they placed a reed stick in his right hand as a scepter. Then they knelt before him in mockery and taunted, "Hail! King of the Jews!"

verses.kjv_text: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.nlt_text: And they spit on him and grabbed the stick and struck him on the head with it.

verses.kjv_text: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify {him}.
verses.nlt_text: When they were finally tired of mocking him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him again. Then they led him away to be crucified.

verses.kjv_text: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.nlt_text: Along the way, they came across a man named Simon, who was from Cyrene, and the soldiers forced him to carry Jesus' cross.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.nlt_text: And they went out to a place called Golgotha (which means "Place of the Skull").

verses.kjv_text: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted {thereof}, he would not drink.
verses.nlt_text: The soldiers gave him wine mixed with bitter gall, but when he had tasted it, he refused to drink it.

verses.kjv_text: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.nlt_text: After they had nailed him to the cross, the soldiers gambled for his clothes by throwing dice.

verses.kjv_text: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.nlt_text: Then they sat around and kept guard as he hung there.

verses.kjv_text: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.nlt_text: A sign was fastened to the cross above Jesus' head, announcing the charge against him. It read: "This is Jesus, the King of the Jews."

verses.kjv_text: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.nlt_text: Two revolutionaries were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

verses.kjv_text: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.nlt_text: The people passing by shouted abuse, shaking their heads in mockery.

verses.kjv_text: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest {it} in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.nlt_text: "Look at you now!" they yelled at him. "You said you were going to destroy the Temple and rebuild it in three days. Well then, if you are the Son of God, save yourself and come down from the cross!"

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking {him}, with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.nlt_text: The leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders also mocked Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.nlt_text: "He saved others," they scoffed, "but he can't save himself! So he is the King of Israel, is he? Let him come down from the cross right now, and we will believe in him!

verses.kjv_text: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: He trusted God, so let God rescue him now if he wants him! For he said, 'I am the Son of God.'"

verses.kjv_text: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.nlt_text: Even the revolutionaries who were crucified with him ridiculed him in the same way.

verses.kjv_text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.nlt_text: At noon, darkness fell across the whole land until three o'clock.

verses.kjv_text: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.nlt_text: At about three o'clock, Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?" which means "My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?"

verses.kjv_text: Some of them that stood there, when they heard {that}, said, This {man} calleth for Elias.
verses.nlt_text: Some of the bystanders misunderstood and thought he was calling for the prophet Elijah.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled {it} with vinegar, and put {it} on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.nlt_text: One of them ran and filled a sponge with sour wine, holding it up to him on a reed stick so he could drink.

verses.kjv_text: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.nlt_text: But the rest said, "Wait! Let's see whether Elijah comes to save him."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus shouted out again, and he released his spirit.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.nlt_text: At that moment the curtain in the sanctuary of the Temple was torn in two, from top to bottom. The earth shook, rocks split apart,

verses.kjv_text: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.nlt_text: and tombs opened. The bodies of many godly men and women who had died were raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.nlt_text: They left the cemetery after Jesus' resurrection, went into the holy city of Jerusalem, and appeared to many people.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: The Roman officer and the other soldiers at the crucifixion were terrified by the earthquake and all that had happened. They said, "This man truly was the Son of God!"

verses.kjv_text: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.nlt_text: And many women who had come from Galilee with Jesus to care for him were watching from a distance.

verses.kjv_text: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
verses.nlt_text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary (the mother of James and Joseph), and the mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee.

verses.kjv_text: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
verses.nlt_text: As evening approached, Joseph, a rich man from Arimathea who had become a follower of Jesus,

verses.kjv_text: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.nlt_text: went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body. And Pilate issued an order to release it to him.

verses.kjv_text: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.nlt_text: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a long sheet of clean linen cloth.

verses.kjv_text: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.nlt_text: He placed it in his own new tomb, which had been carved out of the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance and left.

verses.kjv_text: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: Both Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting across from the tomb and watching.

verses.kjv_text: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.nlt_text: The next day, on the Sabbath, the leading priests and Pharisees went to see Pilate.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.nlt_text: They told him, "Sir, we remember what that deceiver once said while he was still alive: 'After three days I will rise from the dead.'

verses.kjv_text: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.nlt_text: So we request that you seal the tomb until the third day. This will prevent his disciples from coming and stealing his body and then telling everyone he was raised from the dead! If that happens, we'll be worse off than we were at first."

verses.kjv_text: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make {it} as sure as ye can.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate replied, "Take guards and secure it the best you can."

verses.kjv_text: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.nlt_text: So they sealed the tomb and posted guards to protect it.

verses.kjv_text: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first {day} of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: Early on Sunday morning, as the new day was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went out to visit the tomb.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it. {was: or, had been}
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly there was a great earthquake! For an angel of the Lord came down from heaven, rolled aside the stone, and sat on it.

verses.kjv_text: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.nlt_text: His face shone like lightning, and his clothing was as white as snow.

verses.kjv_text: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead {men}.
verses.nlt_text: The guards shook with fear when they saw him, and they fell into a dead faint.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angel spoke to the women. "Don't be afraid!" he said. "I know you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

verses.kjv_text: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.nlt_text: He isn't here! He is risen from the dead, just as he said would happen. Come, see where his body was lying.

verses.kjv_text: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.nlt_text: And now, go quickly and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead, and he is going ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there. Remember what I have told you."

verses.kjv_text: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.nlt_text: The women ran quickly from the tomb. They were very frightened but also filled with great joy, and they rushed to give the disciples the angel's message.

verses.kjv_text: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.nlt_text: And as they went, Jesus met them and greeted them. And they ran to him, grasped his feet, and worshiped him.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to them, "Don't be afraid! Go tell my brothers to leave for Galilee, and they will see me there."

verses.kjv_text: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
verses.nlt_text: As the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and told the leading priests what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.nlt_text: A meeting with the elders was called, and they decided to give the soldiers a large bribe.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him {away} while we slept.
verses.nlt_text: They told the soldiers, "You must say, 'Jesus' disciples came during the night while we were sleeping, and they stole his body.'

verses.kjv_text: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.nlt_text: If the governor hears about it, we'll stand up for you so you won't get in trouble."

verses.kjv_text: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.nlt_text: So the guards accepted the bribe and said what they were told to say. Their story spread widely among the Jews, and they still tell it today.

verses.kjv_text: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.nlt_text: Then the eleven disciples left for Galilee, going to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

verses.kjv_text: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
verses.nlt_text: When they saw him, they worshiped him-- but some of them doubted!

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus came and told his disciples, "I have been given all authority in heaven and on earth.

verses.kjv_text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: {teach...: or, make disciples, or, Christians of all nations}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, {even} unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Teach these new disciples to obey all the commands I have given you. And be sure of this: I am with you always, even to the end of the age."

verses.kjv_text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
verses.nlt_text: This is the Good News about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God. It began

verses.kjv_text: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.nlt_text: just as the prophet Isaiah had written: "Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, and he will prepare your way.

verses.kjv_text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.nlt_text: He is a voice shouting in the wilderness, 'Prepare the way for the LORD's coming! Clear the road for him!' "

verses.kjv_text: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins. {for: or, unto}
verses.nlt_text: This messenger was John the Baptist. He was in the wilderness and preached that people should be baptized to show that they had turned to God to receive forgiveness for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.nlt_text: All of Judea, including all the people of Jerusalem, went out to see and hear John. And when they confessed their sins, he baptized them in the Jordan River.

verses.kjv_text: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
verses.nlt_text: His clothes were woven from coarse camel hair, and he wore a leather belt around his waist. For food he ate locusts and wild honey.

verses.kjv_text: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
verses.nlt_text: John announced: "Someone is coming soon who is greater than I am-- so much greater that I'm not even worthy to stoop down like a slave and untie the straps of his sandals.

verses.kjv_text: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit!"

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him: {opened: or, cloven, or, rent}
