verses.nlt_text: As Jesus came up out of the water, he saw the heavens splitting apart and the Holy Spirit descending on him like a dove.

verses.kjv_text: And there came a voice from heaven, {saying}, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.nlt_text: And a voice from heaven said, "You are my dearly loved Son, and you bring me great joy."

verses.kjv_text: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit then compelled Jesus to go into the wilderness,

verses.kjv_text: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
verses.nlt_text: where he was tempted by Satan for forty days. He was out among the wild animals, and angels took care of him.

verses.kjv_text: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
verses.nlt_text: Later on, after John was arrested, Jesus went into Galilee, where he preached God's Good News.

verses.kjv_text: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
verses.nlt_text: "The time promised by God has come at last!" he announced. "The Kingdom of God is near! Repent of your sins and believe the Good News!"

verses.kjv_text: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.nlt_text: One day as Jesus was walking along the shore of the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew throwing a net into the water, for they fished for a living.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus called out to them, "Come, follow me, and I will show you how to fish for people!"

verses.kjv_text: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
verses.nlt_text: And they left their nets at once and followed him.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the {son} of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
verses.nlt_text: A little farther up the shore Jesus saw Zebedee's sons, James and John, in a boat repairing their nets.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.nlt_text: He called them at once, and they also followed him, leaving their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired men.

verses.kjv_text: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus and his companions went to the town of Capernaum. When the Sabbath day came, he went into the synagogue and began to teach.

verses.kjv_text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.nlt_text: The people were amazed at his teaching, for he taught with real authority-- quite unlike the teachers of religious law.

verses.kjv_text: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, a man in the synagogue who was possessed by an evil spirit began shouting,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Let {us} alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.nlt_text: "Why are you interfering with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are-- the Holy One sent from God!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus cut him short. "Be quiet! Come out of the man," he ordered.

verses.kjv_text: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
verses.nlt_text: At that, the evil spirit screamed, threw the man into a convulsion, and then came out of him.

verses.kjv_text: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine {is} this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
verses.nlt_text: Amazement gripped the audience, and they began to discuss what had happened. "What sort of new teaching is this?" they asked excitedly. "It has such authority! Even evil spirits obey his orders!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: The news about Jesus spread quickly throughout the entire region of Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.nlt_text: After Jesus left the synagogue with James and John, they went to Simon and Andrew's home.

verses.kjv_text: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
verses.nlt_text: Now Simon's mother-in-law was sick in bed with a high fever. They told Jesus about her right away.

verses.kjv_text: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
verses.nlt_text: So he went to her bedside, took her by the hand, and helped her sit up. Then the fever left her, and she prepared a meal for them.

verses.kjv_text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
verses.nlt_text: That evening after sunset, many sick and demon-possessed people were brought to Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.nlt_text: The whole town gathered at the door to watch.

verses.kjv_text: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him. {to speak...: or, to say that they knew him}
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus healed many people who were sick with various diseases, and he cast out many demons. But because the demons knew who he was, he did not allow them to speak.

verses.kjv_text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
verses.nlt_text: Before daybreak the next morning, Jesus got up and went out to an isolated place to pray.

verses.kjv_text: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
verses.nlt_text: Later Simon and the others went out to find him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All {men} seek for thee.
verses.nlt_text: When they found him, they said, "Everyone is looking for you."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "We must go on to other towns as well, and I will preach to them, too. That is why I came."

verses.kjv_text: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
verses.nlt_text: So he traveled throughout the region of Galilee, preaching in the synagogues and casting out demons.

verses.kjv_text: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.nlt_text: A man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus, begging to be healed. "If you are willing, you can heal me and make me clean," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth {his} hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verses.nlt_text: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out and touched him. "I am willing," he said. "Be healed!"

verses.kjv_text: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly the leprosy disappeared, and the man was healed.

verses.kjv_text: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus sent him on his way with a stern warning:

verses.kjv_text: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't tell anyone about this. Instead, go to the priest and let him examine you. Take along the offering required in the law of Moses for those who have been healed of leprosy. This will be a public testimony that you have been cleansed."

verses.kjv_text: But he went out, and began to publish {it} much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
verses.nlt_text: But the man went and spread the word, proclaiming to everyone what had happened. As a result, large crowds soon surrounded Jesus, and he couldn't publicly enter a town anywhere. He had to stay out in the secluded places, but people from everywhere kept coming to him.

verses.kjv_text: And again he entered into Capernaum after {some} days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus returned to Capernaum several days later, the news spread quickly that he was back home.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive {them}, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Soon the house where he was staying was so packed with visitors that there was no more room, even outside the door. While he was preaching God's word to them,

verses.kjv_text: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
verses.nlt_text: four men arrived carrying a paralyzed man on a mat.

verses.kjv_text: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken {it} up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
verses.nlt_text: They couldn't bring him to Jesus because of the crowd, so they dug a hole through the roof above his head. Then they lowered the man on his mat, right down in front of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.nlt_text: Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, "My child, your sins are forgiven."

verses.kjv_text: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.nlt_text: But some of the teachers of religious law who were sitting there thought to themselves,

verses.kjv_text: Why doth this {man} thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
verses.nlt_text: "What is he saying? This is blasphemy! Only God can forgive sins!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew immediately what they were thinking, so he asked them, "Why do you question this in your hearts?

verses.kjv_text: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, {Thy} sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.nlt_text: Is it easier to say to the paralyzed man 'Your sins are forgiven,' or 'Stand up, pick up your mat, and walk'?

verses.kjv_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
verses.nlt_text: So I will prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins." Then Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said,

verses.kjv_text: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
verses.nlt_text: "Stand up, pick up your mat, and go home!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
verses.nlt_text: And the man jumped up, grabbed his mat, and walked out through the stunned onlookers.They were all amazed and praised God, exclaiming, "We've never seen anything like this before!"

verses.kjv_text: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus went out to the lakeshore again and taught the crowds that were coming to him.

verses.kjv_text: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the {son} of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him. {at the...: or, at the place where the custom was received}
verses.nlt_text: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at his tax collector's booth. "Follow me and be my disciple," Jesus said to him. So Levi got up and followed him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
verses.nlt_text: Later, Levi invited Jesus and his disciples to his home as dinner guests, along with many tax collectors and other disreputable sinners. (There were many people of this kind among Jesus' followers.)

verses.kjv_text: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
verses.nlt_text: But when the teachers of religious law who were Pharisees saw him eating with tax collectors and other sinners, they asked his disciples, "Why does he eat with such scum? "

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus heard {it}, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard this, he told them, "Healthy people don't need a doctor-- sick people do. I have come to call not those who think they are righteous, but those who know they are sinners."

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.nlt_text: Once when John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, some people came to Jesus and asked, "Why don't your disciples fast like John's disciples and the Pharisees do?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Do wedding guests fast while celebrating with the groom? Of course not. They can't fast while the groom is with them.

verses.kjv_text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.nlt_text: But someday the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

verses.kjv_text: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse. {new cloth: or, raw, or, unwrought cloth}
verses.nlt_text: "Besides, who would patch old clothing with new cloth? For the new patch would shrink and rip away from the old cloth, leaving an even bigger tear than before.

verses.kjv_text: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles. {bottles: or, sacks of skin}
verses.nlt_text: "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. For the wine would burst the wineskins, and the wine and the skins would both be lost. New wine calls for new wineskins."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
verses.nlt_text: One Sabbath day as Jesus was walking through some grainfields, his disciples began breaking off heads of grain to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
verses.nlt_text: But the Pharisees said to Jesus, "Look, why are they breaking the law by harvesting grain on the Sabbath?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said to them, "Haven't you ever read in the Scriptures what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

verses.kjv_text: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
verses.nlt_text: He went into the house of God (during the days when Abiathar was high priest) and broke the law by eating the sacred loaves of bread that only the priests are allowed to eat. He also gave some to his companions."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to them, "The Sabbath was made to meet the needs of people, and not people to meet the requirements of the Sabbath.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.nlt_text: So the Son of Man is Lord, even over the Sabbath!"

verses.kjv_text: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus went into the synagogue again and noticed a man with a deformed hand.

verses.kjv_text: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
verses.nlt_text: Since it was the Sabbath, Jesus' enemies watched him closely. If he healed the man's hand, they planned to accuse him of working on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth. {Stand forth: Gr. Arise, stand forth in the midst}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said to the man, "Come and stand in front of everyone."

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
verses.nlt_text: Then he turned to his critics and asked, "Does the law permit good deeds on the Sabbath, or is it a day for doing evil? Is this a day to save life or to destroy it?" But they wouldn't answer him.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched {it} out: and his hand was restored whole as the other. {hardness: or, blindness}
verses.nlt_text: He looked around at them angrily and was deeply saddened by their hard hearts. Then he said to the man, "Hold out your hand." So the man held out his hand, and it was restored!

verses.kjv_text: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.nlt_text: At once the Pharisees went away and met with the supporters of Herod to plot how to kill Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus went out to the lake with his disciples, and a large crowd followed him. They came from all over Galilee, Judea,

verses.kjv_text: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and {from} beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Jerusalem, Idumea, from east of the Jordan River, and even from as far north as Tyre and Sidon. The news about his miracles had spread far and wide, and vast numbers of people came to see him.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus instructed his disciples to have a boat ready so the crowd would not crush him.

verses.kjv_text: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues. {pressed: or, rushed}
verses.nlt_text: He had healed many people that day, so all the sick people eagerly pushed forward to touch him.

verses.kjv_text: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: And whenever those possessed by evil spirits caught sight of him, the spirits would throw them to the ground in front of him shrieking, "You are the Son of God!"

verses.kjv_text: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus sternly commanded the spirits not to reveal who he was.

verses.kjv_text: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth {unto him} whom he would: and they came unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward Jesus went up on a mountain and called out the ones he wanted to go with him. And they came to him.

verses.kjv_text: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
verses.nlt_text: Then he appointed twelve of them and called them his apostles. They were to accompany him, and he would send them out to preach,

verses.kjv_text: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
verses.nlt_text: giving them authority to cast out demons.

verses.kjv_text: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
verses.nlt_text: Here are their names: Simon (whom he named Peter),

verses.kjv_text: And James the {son} of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
verses.nlt_text: James and John (the sons of Zebedee, but Jesus nicknamed them "Sons of Thunder"),

verses.kjv_text: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the {son} of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
verses.nlt_text: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Thaddaeus, Simon (the zealot),

verses.kjv_text: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house. {into...: or, home}
verses.nlt_text: Judas Iscariot (who later betrayed him).

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.nlt_text: One time Jesus entered a house, and the crowds began to gather again. Soon he and his disciples couldn't even find time to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And when his friends heard {of it}, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself. {friends: or, kinsmen}
verses.nlt_text: When his family heard what was happening, they tried to take him away. "He's out of his mind," they said.

verses.kjv_text: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
verses.nlt_text: But the teachers of religious law who had arrived from Jerusalem said, "He's possessed by Satan, the prince of demons. That's where he gets the power to cast out demons."

verses.kjv_text: And he called them {unto him}, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus called them over and responded with an illustration. "How can Satan cast out Satan?" he asked.

verses.kjv_text: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.nlt_text: "A kingdom divided by civil war will collapse.

verses.kjv_text: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.nlt_text: Similarly, a family splintered by feuding will fall apart.

verses.kjv_text: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
verses.nlt_text: And if Satan is divided and fights against himself, how can he stand? He would never survive.

verses.kjv_text: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
verses.nlt_text: Let me illustrate this further. Who is powerful enough to enter the house of a strong man like Satan and plunder his goods? Only someone even stronger-- someone who could tie him up and then plunder his house.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, all sin and blasphemy can be forgiven,

verses.kjv_text: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
verses.nlt_text: but anyone who blasphemes the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven. This is a sin with eternal consequences."

verses.kjv_text: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
verses.nlt_text: He told them this because they were saying, "He's possessed by an evil spirit."

verses.kjv_text: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus' mother and brothers came to see him. They stood outside and sent word for him to come out and talk with them.

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
verses.nlt_text: There was a crowd sitting around Jesus, and someone said, "Your mother and your brothers are outside asking for you."

verses.kjv_text: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"

verses.kjv_text: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.nlt_text: Then he looked at those around him and said, "Look, these are my mother and brothers.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who does God's will is my brother and sister and mother."

verses.kjv_text: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
verses.nlt_text: Once again Jesus began teaching by the lakeshore. A very large crowd soon gathered around him, so he got into a boat. Then he sat in the boat while all the people remained on the shore.

verses.kjv_text: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
verses.nlt_text: He taught them by telling many stories in the form of parables, such as this one:

verses.kjv_text: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
verses.nlt_text: "Listen! A farmer went out to plant some seed.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
verses.nlt_text: As he scattered it across his field, some of the seed fell on a footpath, and the birds came and ate it.

verses.kjv_text: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
verses.nlt_text: Other seed fell on shallow soil with underlying rock. The seed sprouted quickly because the soil was shallow.

verses.kjv_text: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.nlt_text: But the plant soon wilted under the hot sun, and since it didn't have deep roots, it died.

verses.kjv_text: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.nlt_text: Other seed fell among thorns that grew up and choked out the tender plants so they produced no grain.

verses.kjv_text: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.nlt_text: Still other seeds fell on fertile soil, and they sprouted, grew, and produced a crop that was thirty, sixty, and even a hundred times as much as had been planted!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."

verses.kjv_text: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
verses.nlt_text: Later, when Jesus was alone with the twelve disciples and with the others who were gathered around, they asked him what the parables meant.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all {these} things are done in parables:
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "You are permitted to understand the secret of the Kingdom of God. But I use parables for everything I say to outsiders,

verses.kjv_text: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and {their} sins should be forgiven them.
verses.nlt_text: so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled: 'When they see what I do, they will learn nothing. When they hear what I say, they will not understand. Otherwise, they will turn to me and be forgiven.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to them, "If you can't understand the meaning of this parable, how will you understand all the other parables?

verses.kjv_text: The sower soweth the word.
verses.nlt_text: The farmer plants seed by taking God's word to others.

verses.kjv_text: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
verses.nlt_text: The seed that fell on the footpath represents those who hear the message, only to have Satan come at once and take it away.

verses.kjv_text: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
verses.nlt_text: The seed on the rocky soil represents those who hear the message and immediately receive it with joy.

verses.kjv_text: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended. {offended: or, stumbled, or, caused to fall into sin}
verses.nlt_text: But since they don't have deep roots, they don't last long. They fall away as soon as they have problems or are persecuted for believing God's word.

verses.kjv_text: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
verses.nlt_text: The seed that fell among the thorns represents others who hear God's word,

verses.kjv_text: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful. {lusts: or, inordinate desires}
verses.nlt_text: but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the worries of this life, the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things, so no fruit is produced.

verses.kjv_text: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive {it}, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.nlt_text: And the seed that fell on good soil represents those who hear and accept God's word and produce a harvest of thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as had been planted!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick? {bushel: the word in the original signifieth a less measure}
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus asked them, "Would anyone light a lamp and then put it under a basket or under a bed? Of course not! A lamp is placed on a stand, where its light will shine.

verses.kjv_text: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
verses.nlt_text: For everything that is hidden will eventually be brought into the open, and every secret will be brought to light.

verses.kjv_text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
verses.nlt_text: Then he added, "Pay close attention to what you hear. The closer you listen, the more understanding you will be given-- and you will receive even more.

verses.kjv_text: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
verses.nlt_text: To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given. But for those who are not listening, even what little understanding they have will be taken away from them."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus also said, "The Kingdom of God is like a farmer who scatters seed on the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
verses.nlt_text: Night and day, while he's asleep or awake, the seed sprouts and grows, but he does not understand how it happens.

verses.kjv_text: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
verses.nlt_text: The earth produces the crops on its own. First a leaf blade pushes through, then the heads of wheat are formed, and finally the grain ripens.

verses.kjv_text: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come. {brought...: or, ripe}
verses.nlt_text: And as soon as the grain is ready, the farmer comes and harvests it with a sickle, for the harvest time has come."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "How can I describe the Kingdom of God? What story should I use to illustrate it?

verses.kjv_text: {It is} like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
verses.nlt_text: It is like a mustard seed planted in the ground. It is the smallest of all seeds,

verses.kjv_text: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
verses.nlt_text: but it becomes the largest of all garden plants; it grows long branches, and birds can make nests in its shade."

verses.kjv_text: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus used many similar stories and illustrations to teach the people as much as they could understand.

verses.kjv_text: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, in his public ministry he never taught without using parables; but afterward, when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them.

verses.kjv_text: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
verses.nlt_text: As evening came, Jesus said to his disciples, "Let's cross to the other side of the lake."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
verses.nlt_text: So they took Jesus in the boat and started out, leaving the crowds behind (although other boats followed).

verses.kjv_text: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
verses.nlt_text: But soon a fierce storm came up. High waves were breaking into the boat, and it began to fill with water.

verses.kjv_text: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus was sleeping at the back of the boat with his head on a cushion. The disciples woke him up, shouting, "Teacher, don't you care that we're going to drown?"

verses.kjv_text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus woke up, he rebuked the wind and said to the water, "Silence! Be still!" Suddenly the wind stopped, and there was a great calm.

verses.kjv_text: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
verses.nlt_text: Then he asked them, "Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith?"

verses.kjv_text: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
verses.nlt_text: So they arrived at the other side of the lake, in the region of the Gerasenes.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus climbed out of the boat, a man possessed by an evil spirit came out from a cemetery to meet him.

verses.kjv_text: Who had {his} dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
verses.nlt_text: This man lived among the burial caves and could no longer be restrained, even with a chain.

verses.kjv_text: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any {man} tame him.
verses.nlt_text: Whenever he was put into chains and shackles-- as he often was-- he snapped the chains from his wrists and smashed the shackles. No one was strong enough to subdue him.

verses.kjv_text: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.nlt_text: Day and night he wandered among the burial caves and in the hills, howling and cutting himself with sharp stones.

verses.kjv_text: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus was still some distance away, the man saw him, ran to meet him, and bowed low before him.

verses.kjv_text: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, {thou} Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
verses.nlt_text: With a shriek, he screamed, "Why are you interfering with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In the name of God, I beg you, don't torture me!"

verses.kjv_text: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, {thou} unclean spirit.
verses.nlt_text: For Jesus had already said to the spirit, "Come out of the man, you evil spirit."

verses.kjv_text: And he asked him, What {is} thy name? And he answered, saying, My name {is} Legion: for we are many.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus demanded, "What is your name?" And he replied, "My name is Legion, because there are many of us inside this man."

verses.kjv_text: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.nlt_text: Then the evil spirits begged him again and again not to send them to some distant place.

verses.kjv_text: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
verses.nlt_text: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding on the hillside nearby.

verses.kjv_text: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
verses.nlt_text: "Send us into those pigs," the spirits begged. "Let us enter them."

verses.kjv_text: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus gave them permission. The evil spirits came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the entire herd of 2,000 pigs plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned in the water.

verses.kjv_text: And they that fed the swine fled, and told {it} in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
verses.nlt_text: The herdsmen fled to the nearby town and the surrounding countryside, spreading the news as they ran. People rushed out to see what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.nlt_text: A crowd soon gathered around Jesus, and they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons. He was sitting there fully clothed and perfectly sane, and they were all afraid.

verses.kjv_text: And they that saw {it} told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and {also} concerning the swine.
verses.nlt_text: Then those who had seen what happened told the others about the demon-possessed man and the pigs.

verses.kjv_text: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
verses.nlt_text: And the crowd began pleading with Jesus to go away and leave them alone.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon possessed begged to go with him.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "No, go home to your family, and tell them everything the Lord has done for you and how merciful he has been."

verses.kjv_text: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all {men} did marvel.
verses.nlt_text: So the man started off to visit the Ten Towns of that region and began to proclaim the great things Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed at what he told them.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus got into the boat again and went back to the other side of the lake, where a large crowd gathered around him on the shore.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
verses.nlt_text: Then a leader of the local synagogue, whose name was Jairus, arrived. When he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet,

verses.kjv_text: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: {I pray thee}, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
verses.nlt_text: pleading fervently with him. "My little daughter is dying," he said. "Please come and lay your hands on her; heal her so she can live."

verses.kjv_text: And {Jesus} went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus went with him, and all the people followed, crowding around him.

verses.kjv_text: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
verses.nlt_text: A woman in the crowd had suffered for twelve years with constant bleeding.

verses.kjv_text: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
verses.nlt_text: She had suffered a great deal from many doctors, and over the years she had spent everything she had to pay them, but she had gotten no better. In fact, she had gotten worse.

verses.kjv_text: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
verses.nlt_text: She had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him through the crowd and touched his robe.

verses.kjv_text: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
verses.nlt_text: For she thought to herself, "If I can just touch his robe, I will be healed."

verses.kjv_text: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in {her} body that she was healed of that plague.
verses.nlt_text: Immediately the bleeding stopped, and she could feel in her body that she had been healed of her terrible condition.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus realized at once that healing power had gone out from him, so he turned around in the crowd and asked, "Who touched my robe?"

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.nlt_text: His disciples said to him, "Look at this crowd pressing around you. How can you ask, 'Who touched me?'"

verses.kjv_text: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
verses.nlt_text: But he kept on looking around to see who had done it.

verses.kjv_text: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.nlt_text: Then the frightened woman, trembling at the realization of what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and told him what she had done.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verses.nlt_text: And he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace. Your suffering is over."

verses.kjv_text: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's {house certain} which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
verses.nlt_text: While he was still speaking to her, messengers arrived from the home of Jairus, the leader of the synagogue. They told him, "Your daughter is dead. There's no use troubling the Teacher now."

verses.kjv_text: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus overheard them and said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid. Just have faith."

verses.kjv_text: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus stopped the crowd and wouldn't let anyone go with him except Peter, James, and John (the brother of James).

verses.kjv_text: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
verses.nlt_text: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw much commotion and weeping and wailing.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.nlt_text: He went inside and asked, "Why all this commotion and weeping? The child isn't dead; she's only asleep."

verses.kjv_text: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
verses.nlt_text: The crowd laughed at him. But he made them all leave, and he took the girl's father and mother and his three disciples into the room where the girl was lying.

verses.kjv_text: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
verses.nlt_text: Holding her hand, he said to her, "Talitha koum," which means "Little girl, get up!"

verses.kjv_text: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was {of the age} of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
verses.nlt_text: And the girl, who was twelve years old, immediately stood up and walked around! They were overwhelmed and totally amazed.

verses.kjv_text: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell anyone what had happened, and then he told them to give her something to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus left that part of the country and returned with his disciples to Nazareth, his hometown.

verses.kjv_text: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing {him} were astonished, saying, From whence hath this {man} these things? and what wisdom {is} this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.nlt_text: The next Sabbath he began teaching in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. They asked, "Where did he get all this wisdom and the power to perform such miracles?"

verses.kjv_text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him. {offended: scandalized in, or, by him}
verses.nlt_text: Then they scoffed, "He's just a carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon. And his sisters live right here among us." They were deeply offended and refused to believe in him.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told them, "A prophet is honored everywhere except in his own hometown and among his relatives and his own family."

verses.kjv_text: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed {them}.
verses.nlt_text: And because of their unbelief, he couldn't do any mighty miracles among them except to place his hands on a few sick people and heal them.

verses.kjv_text: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
verses.nlt_text: And he was amazed at their unbelief. Then Jesus went from village to village, teaching the people.

verses.kjv_text: And he called {unto him} the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
verses.nlt_text: And he called his twelve disciples together and began sending them out two by two, giving them authority to cast out evil spirits.

verses.kjv_text: And commanded them that they should take nothing for {their} journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in {their} purse: {money: the word signifieth a piece of brass money, in value somewhat less than a farthing, but here it is taken in general for money}
verses.nlt_text: He told them to take nothing for their journey except a walking stick-- no food, no traveler's bag, no money.

verses.kjv_text: But {be} shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
verses.nlt_text: He allowed them to wear sandals but not to take a change of clothes.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
verses.nlt_text: "Wherever you go," he said, "stay in the same house until you leave town.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city. {and: Gr. or}
verses.nlt_text: But if any place refuses to welcome you or listen to you, shake its dust from your feet as you leave to show that you have abandoned those people to their fate."

verses.kjv_text: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.nlt_text: So the disciples went out, telling everyone they met to repent of their sins and turn to God.

verses.kjv_text: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed {them}.
verses.nlt_text: And they cast out many demons and healed many sick people, anointing them with olive oil.

verses.kjv_text: And king Herod heard {of him}; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.nlt_text: Herod Antipas, the king, soon heard about Jesus, because everyone was talking about him. Some were saying, "This must be John the Baptist raised from the dead. That is why he can do such miracles."

verses.kjv_text: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: Others said, "He's the prophet Elijah." Still others said, "He's a prophet like the other great prophets of the past."

verses.kjv_text: But when Herod heard {thereof}, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: When Herod heard about Jesus, he said, "John, the man I beheaded, has come back from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
verses.nlt_text: For Herod had sent soldiers to arrest and imprison John as a favor to Herodias. She had been his brother Philip's wife, but Herod had married her.

verses.kjv_text: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
verses.nlt_text: John had been telling Herod, "It is against God's law for you to marry your brother's wife."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not: {a quarrel: or, an inward grudge}
verses.nlt_text: So Herodias bore a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But without Herod's approval she was powerless,

verses.kjv_text: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly. {observed him: or, kept him, or, saved him}
verses.nlt_text: for Herod respected John; and knowing that he was a good and holy man, he protected him. Herod was greatly disturbed whenever he talked with John, but even so, he liked to listen to him.

verses.kjv_text: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief {estates} of Galilee;
verses.nlt_text: Herodias's chance finally came on Herod's birthday. He gave a party for his high government officials, army officers, and the leading citizens of Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give {it} thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then his daughter, also named Herodias, came in and performed a dance that greatly pleased Herod and his guests. "Ask me for anything you like," the king said to the girl, "and I will give it to you."

verses.kjv_text: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give {it} thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: He even vowed, "I will give you whatever you ask, up to half my kingdom!"

verses.kjv_text: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
verses.nlt_text: She went out and asked her mother, "What should I ask for?" Her mother told her, "Ask for the head of John the Baptist!"

verses.kjv_text: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
verses.nlt_text: So the girl hurried back to the king and told him, "I want the head of John the Baptist, right now, on a tray!"

verses.kjv_text: And the king was exceeding sorry; {yet} for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
verses.nlt_text: Then the king deeply regretted what he had said; but because of the vows he had made in front of his guests, he couldn't refuse her.

verses.kjv_text: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison, {an...: or, one of his guard}
verses.nlt_text: So he immediately sent an executioner to the prison to cut off John's head and bring it to him. The soldier beheaded John in the prison,

verses.kjv_text: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.nlt_text: brought his head on a tray, and gave it to the girl, who took it to her mother.

verses.kjv_text: And when his disciples heard {of it}, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.nlt_text: When John's disciples heard what had happened, they came to get his body and buried it in a tomb.

verses.kjv_text: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
verses.nlt_text: The apostles returned to Jesus from their ministry tour and told him all they had done and taught.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said, "Let's go off by ourselves to a quiet place and rest awhile." He said this because there were so many people coming and going that Jesus and his apostles didn't even have time to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
verses.nlt_text: So they left by boat for a quiet place, where they could be alone.

verses.kjv_text: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
verses.nlt_text: But many people recognized them and saw them leaving, and people from many towns ran ahead along the shore and got there ahead of them.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus saw the huge crowd as he stepped from the boat, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.

verses.kjv_text: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time {is} far passed:
verses.nlt_text: Late in the afternoon his disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it's already getting late.

verses.kjv_text: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
verses.nlt_text: Send the crowds away so they can go to the nearby farms and villages and buy something to eat."

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat? {pennyworth: the Roman penny is sevenpence halfpenny}
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "You feed them." "With what?" they asked. "We'd have to work for months to earn enough money to buy food for all these people!"

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.nlt_text: "How much bread do you have?" he asked. "Go and find out." They came back and reported, "We have five loaves of bread and two fish."

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told the disciples to have the people sit down in groups on the green grass.

verses.kjv_text: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.nlt_text: So they sat down in groups of fifty or a hundred.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave {them} to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up toward heaven, and blessed them. Then, breaking the loaves into pieces, he kept giving the bread to the disciples so they could distribute it to the people. He also divided the fish for everyone to share.

verses.kjv_text: And they did all eat, and were filled.
verses.nlt_text: They all ate as much as they wanted,

verses.kjv_text: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
verses.nlt_text: and afterward, the disciples picked up twelve baskets of leftover bread and fish.

verses.kjv_text: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.nlt_text: A total of 5,000 men and their families were fed from those loaves!

verses.kjv_text: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people. {unto...: or, over against Bethsaida}
verses.nlt_text: Immediately after this, Jesus insisted that his disciples get back into the boat and head across the lake to Bethsaida, while he sent the people home.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
verses.nlt_text: After telling everyone good-bye, he went up into the hills by himself to pray.

verses.kjv_text: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.nlt_text: Late that night, the disciples were in their boat in the middle of the lake, and Jesus was alone on land.

verses.kjv_text: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verses.nlt_text: He saw that they were in serious trouble, rowing hard and struggling against the wind and waves. About three o'clock in the morning Jesus came toward them, walking on the water. He intended to go past them,

verses.kjv_text: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
verses.nlt_text: but when they saw him walking on the water, they cried out in terror, thinking he was a ghost.

verses.kjv_text: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.nlt_text: They were all terrified when they saw him.But Jesus spoke to them at once. "Don't be afraid," he said. "Take courage! I am here! "

verses.kjv_text: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
verses.nlt_text: Then he climbed into the boat, and the wind stopped. They were totally amazed,

verses.kjv_text: For they considered not {the miracle} of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
verses.nlt_text: for they still didn't understand the significance of the miracle of the loaves. Their hearts were too hard to take it in.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
verses.nlt_text: After they had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret. They brought the boat to shore

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
verses.nlt_text: and climbed out. The people recognized Jesus at once,

verses.kjv_text: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.nlt_text: and they ran throughout the whole area, carrying sick people on mats to wherever they heard he was.

verses.kjv_text: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole. {touched him: or, touched it}
verses.nlt_text: Wherever he went-- in villages, cities, or the countryside-- they brought the sick out to the marketplaces. They begged him to let the sick touch at least the fringe of his robe, and all who touched him were healed.

verses.kjv_text: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: One day some Pharisees and teachers of religious law arrived from Jerusalem to see Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault. {defiled: or, common}
verses.nlt_text: They noticed that some of his disciples failed to follow the Jewish ritual of hand washing before eating.

verses.kjv_text: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash {their} hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders. {oft: or, diligently: in the original, with the fist: Theophylact, up to the elbow}
verses.nlt_text: (The Jews, especially the Pharisees, do not eat until they have poured water over their cupped hands, as required by their ancient traditions.

verses.kjv_text: And {when they come} from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, {as} the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables. {pots: sextarius is about a pint and an half} {tables: or, beds}
verses.nlt_text: Similarly, they don't eat anything from the market until they immerse their hands in water. This is but one of many traditions they have clung to-- such as their ceremonial washing of cups, pitchers, and kettles.)

verses.kjv_text: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
verses.nlt_text: So the Pharisees and teachers of religious law asked him, "Why don't your disciples follow our age-old tradition? They eat without first performing the hand-washing ceremony."

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with {their} lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you, for he wrote,

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching {for} doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.nlt_text: 'These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. Their worship is a farce, for they teach man-made ideas as commands from God.'

verses.kjv_text: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, {as} the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
verses.nlt_text: For you ignore God's law and substitute your own tradition."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition. {reject: or, frustrate}
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "You skillfully sidestep God's law in order to hold on to your own tradition.

verses.kjv_text: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
verses.nlt_text: For instance, Moses gave you this law from God: 'Honor your father and mother,' and 'Anyone who speaks disrespectfully of father or mother must be put to death.'

verses.kjv_text: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
verses.nlt_text: But you say it is all right for people to say to their parents, 'Sorry, I can't help you. For I have vowed to give to God what I would have given to you.'

verses.kjv_text: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
verses.nlt_text: In this way, you let them disregard their needy parents.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had called all the people {unto him}, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one {of you}, and understand:
verses.nlt_text: And so you cancel the word of God in order to hand down your own tradition. And this is only one example among many others."

verses.kjv_text: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus called to the crowd to come and hear. "All of you listen," he said, "and try to understand.

verses.kjv_text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: It's not what goes into your body that defiles you; you are defiled by what comes from your heart. "

verses.kjv_text: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, {it} cannot defile him;
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus went into a house to get away from the crowd, and his disciples asked him what he meant by the parable he had just used.

verses.kjv_text: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
verses.nlt_text: "Don't you understand either?" he asked. "Can't you see that the food you put into your body cannot defile you?

verses.kjv_text: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
verses.nlt_text: Food doesn't go into your heart, but only passes through the stomach and then goes into the sewer." (By saying this, he declared that every kind of food is acceptable in God's eyes.)

verses.kjv_text: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
verses.nlt_text: And then he added, "It is what comes from inside that defiles you.

verses.kjv_text: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: {covetousness...: Gr. covetousnesses, wickednesses}
verses.nlt_text: For from within, out of a person's heart, come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder,

verses.kjv_text: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
verses.nlt_text: adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, envy, slander, pride, and foolishness.

verses.kjv_text: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know {it}: but he could not be hid.
verses.nlt_text: All these vile things come from within; they are what defile you."

verses.kjv_text: For a {certain} woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus left Galilee and went north to the region of Tyre. He didn't want anyone to know which house he was staying in, but he couldn't keep it a secret.

verses.kjv_text: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter. {Greek: or, Gentile}
verses.nlt_text: Right away a woman who had heard about him came and fell at his feet. Her little girl was possessed by an evil spirit,

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast {it} unto the dogs.
verses.nlt_text: and she begged him to cast out the demon from her daughter.Since she was a Gentile, born in Syrian Phoenicia,

verses.kjv_text: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told her, "First I should feed the children-- my own family, the Jews. It isn't right to take food from the children and throw it to the dogs."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
verses.nlt_text: She replied, "That's true, Lord, but even the dogs under the table are allowed to eat the scraps from the children's plates."

verses.kjv_text: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
verses.nlt_text: "Good answer!" he said. "Now go home, for the demon has left your daughter."

verses.kjv_text: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
verses.nlt_text: And when she arrived home, she found her little girl lying quietly in bed, and the demon was gone.

verses.kjv_text: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus left Tyre and went up to Sidon before going back to the Sea of Galilee and the region of the Ten Towns.

verses.kjv_text: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
verses.nlt_text: A deaf man with a speech impediment was brought to him, and the people begged Jesus to lay his hands on the man to heal him.

verses.kjv_text: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus led him away from the crowd so they could be alone. He put his fingers into the man's ears. Then, spitting on his own fingers, he touched the man's tongue.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
verses.nlt_text: Looking up to heaven, he sighed and said, "Ephphatha," which means, "Be opened!"

verses.kjv_text: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published {it};
verses.nlt_text: Instantly the man could hear perfectly, and his tongue was freed so he could speak plainly!

verses.kjv_text: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told the crowd not to tell anyone, but the more he told them not to, the more they spread the news.

verses.kjv_text: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples {unto him}, and saith unto them,
verses.nlt_text: About this time another large crowd had gathered, and the people ran out of food again. Jesus called his disciples and told them,

verses.kjv_text: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
verses.nlt_text: "I feel sorry for these people. They have been here with me for three days, and they have nothing left to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
verses.nlt_text: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a long distance."

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these {men} with bread here in the wilderness?
verses.nlt_text: His disciples replied, "How are we supposed to find enough food to feed them out here in the wilderness?"

verses.kjv_text: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked, "How much bread do you have?" "Seven loaves," they replied.

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before {them}; and they did set {them} before the people.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus told all the people to sit down on the ground. Then he took the seven loaves, thanked God for them, and broke them into pieces. He gave them to his disciples, who distributed the bread to the crowd.

verses.kjv_text: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before {them}.
verses.nlt_text: A few small fish were found, too, so Jesus also blessed these and told the disciples to distribute them.

verses.kjv_text: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.nlt_text: They ate as much as they wanted. Afterward, the disciples picked up seven large baskets of leftover food.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.nlt_text: There were about 4,000 people in the crowd that day, and Jesus sent them home after they had eaten.

verses.kjv_text: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
verses.nlt_text: Immediately after this, he got into a boat with his disciples and crossed over to the region of Dalmanutha.

verses.kjv_text: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
verses.nlt_text: When the Pharisees heard that Jesus had arrived, they came and started to argue with him. Testing him, they demanded that he show them a miraculous sign from heaven to prove his authority.

verses.kjv_text: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
verses.nlt_text: When he heard this, he sighed deeply in his spirit and said, "Why do these people keep demanding a miraculous sign? I tell you the truth, I will not give this generation any such sign."

verses.kjv_text: Now {the disciples} had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
verses.nlt_text: So he got back into the boat and left them, and he crossed to the other side of the lake.

verses.kjv_text: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and {of} the leaven of Herod.
verses.nlt_text: But the disciples had forgotten to bring any food. They had only one loaf of bread with them in the boat.

verses.kjv_text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, {It is} because we have no bread.
verses.nlt_text: As they were crossing the lake, Jesus warned them, "Watch out! Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod."

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus knew {it}, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
verses.nlt_text: At this they began to argue with each other because they hadn't brought any bread.

verses.kjv_text: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said, "Why are you arguing about having no bread? Don't you know or understand even yet? Are your hearts too hard to take it in?

verses.kjv_text: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
verses.nlt_text: 'You have eyes-- can't you see? You have ears-- can't you hear?' Don't you remember anything at all?

verses.kjv_text: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
verses.nlt_text: When I fed the 5,000 with five loaves of bread, how many baskets of leftovers did you pick up afterward?" "Twelve," they said.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
verses.nlt_text: "And when I fed the 4,000 with seven loaves, how many large baskets of leftovers did you pick up?" "Seven," they said.

verses.kjv_text: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't you understand yet?" he asked them.

verses.kjv_text: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
