verses.nlt_text: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man to Jesus, and they begged him to touch the man and heal him.

verses.kjv_text: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then, spitting on the man's eyes, he laid his hands on him and asked, "Can you see anything now?"

verses.kjv_text: After that he put {his} hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
verses.nlt_text: The man looked around. "Yes," he said, "I see people, but I can't see them very clearly. They look like trees walking around."

verses.kjv_text: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell {it} to any in the town.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus placed his hands on the man's eyes again, and his eyes were opened. His sight was completely restored, and he could see everything clearly.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus sent him away, saying, "Don't go back into the village on your way home."

verses.kjv_text: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some {say}, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus and his disciples left Galilee and went up to the villages near Caesarea Philippi. As they were walking along, he asked them, "Who do people say I am?"

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
verses.nlt_text: "Well," they replied, "some say John the Baptist, some say Elijah, and others say you are one of the other prophets."

verses.kjv_text: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he asked them, "But who do you say I am?" Peter replied, "You are the Messiah. "

verses.kjv_text: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and {of} the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus began to tell them that the Son of Man must suffer many terrible things and be rejected by the elders, the leading priests, and the teachers of religious law. He would be killed, but three days later he would rise from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
verses.nlt_text: As he talked about this openly with his disciples, Peter took him aside and began to reprimand him for saying such things.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had called the people {unto him} with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus turned around and looked at his disciples, then reprimanded Peter. "Get away from me, Satan!" he said. "You are seeing things merely from a human point of view, not from God's."

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
verses.nlt_text: Then, calling the crowd to join his disciples, he said, "If any of you wants to be my follower, you must turn from your selfish ways, take up your cross, and follow me.

verses.kjv_text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verses.nlt_text: If you try to hang on to your life, you will lose it. But if you give up your life for my sake and for the sake of the Good News, you will save it.

verses.kjv_text: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.nlt_text: And what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but lose your own soul?

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.nlt_text: Is anything worth more than your soul?

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus went on to say, "I tell you the truth, some standing here right now will not die before they see the Kingdom of God arrive in great power!"

verses.kjv_text: And after six days Jesus taketh {with him} Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
verses.nlt_text: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain to be alone. As the men watched, Jesus' appearance was transformed,

verses.kjv_text: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
verses.nlt_text: and his clothes became dazzling white, far whiter than any earthly bleach could ever make them.

verses.kjv_text: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and began talking with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.nlt_text: Peter exclaimed, "Rabbi, it's wonderful for us to be here! Let's make three shelters as memorials-- one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

verses.kjv_text: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.nlt_text: He said this because he didn't really know what else to say, for they were all terrified.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.nlt_text: Then a cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my dearly loved Son. Listen to him."

verses.kjv_text: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, when they looked around, Moses and Elijah were gone, and only Jesus was with them.

verses.kjv_text: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: As they went back down the mountain, he told them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.nlt_text: So they kept it to themselves, but they often asked each other what he meant by "rising from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.nlt_text: Then they asked him, "Why do the teachers of religious law insist that Elijah must return before the Messiah comes? "

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "Elijah is indeed coming first to get everything ready for the Messiah. Yet why do the Scriptures say that the Son of Man must suffer greatly and be treated with utter contempt?

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.nlt_text: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they chose to abuse him, just as the Scriptures predicted."

verses.kjv_text: And when he came to {his} disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.nlt_text: When they returned to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd surrounding them, and some teachers of religious law were arguing with them.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to {him} saluted him.
verses.nlt_text: When the crowd saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with awe, and they ran to greet him.

verses.kjv_text: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them? {with them: or, among yourselves}
verses.nlt_text: "What is all this arguing about?" Jesus asked.

verses.kjv_text: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.nlt_text: One of the men in the crowd spoke up and said, "Teacher, I brought my son so you could heal him. He is possessed by an evil spirit that won't let him talk.

verses.kjv_text: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not. {teareth...: or, dasheth him}
verses.nlt_text: And whenever this spirit seizes him, it throws him violently to the ground. Then he foams at the mouth and grinds his teeth and becomes rigid. So I asked your disciples to cast out the evil spirit, but they couldn't do it."

verses.kjv_text: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said to them, "You faithless people! How long must I be with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to me."

verses.kjv_text: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.nlt_text: So they brought the boy. But when the evil spirit saw Jesus, it threw the child into a violent convulsion, and he fell to the ground, writhing and foaming at the mouth.

verses.kjv_text: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.nlt_text: "How long has this been happening?" Jesus asked the boy's father.He replied, "Since he was a little boy.

verses.kjv_text: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.nlt_text: The spirit often throws him into the fire or into water, trying to kill him. Have mercy on us and help us, if you can."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things {are} possible to him that believeth.
verses.nlt_text: "What do you mean, 'If I can'?" Jesus asked. "Anything is possible if a person believes."

verses.kjv_text: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.nlt_text: The father instantly cried out, "I do believe, but help me overcome my unbelief!"

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, {Thou} dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw that the crowd of onlookers was growing, he rebuked the evil spirit. "Listen, you spirit that makes this boy unable to hear and speak," he said. "I command you to come out of this child and never enter him again!"

verses.kjv_text: And {the spirit} cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.nlt_text: Then the spirit screamed and threw the boy into another violent convulsion and left him. The boy appeared to be dead. A murmur ran through the crowd as people said, "He's dead."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.nlt_text: Afterward, when Jesus was alone in the house with his disciples, they asked him, "Why couldn't we cast out that evil spirit?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "This kind can be cast out only by prayer. "

verses.kjv_text: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Leaving that region, they traveled through Galilee. Jesus didn't want anyone to know he was there,

verses.kjv_text: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.nlt_text: for he wanted to spend more time with his disciples and teach them. He said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of his enemies. He will be killed, but three days later he will rise from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.nlt_text: They didn't understand what he was saying, however, and they were afraid to ask him what he meant.

verses.kjv_text: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.nlt_text: After they arrived at Capernaum and settled in a house, Jesus asked his disciples, "What were you discussing out on the road?"

verses.kjv_text: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who {should be} the greatest.
verses.nlt_text: But they didn't answer, because they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.

verses.kjv_text: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, {the same} shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.nlt_text: He sat down, called the twelve disciples over to him, and said, "Whoever wants to be first must take last place and be the servant of everyone else."

verses.kjv_text: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.nlt_text: Then he put a little child among them. Taking the child in his arms, he said to them,

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who welcomes a little child like this on my behalf welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me welcomes not only me but also my Father who sent me."

verses.kjv_text: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.nlt_text: John said to Jesus, "Teacher, we saw someone using your name to cast out demons, but we told him to stop because he wasn't in our group."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't stop him!" Jesus said. "No one who performs a miracle in my name will soon be able to speak evil of me.

verses.kjv_text: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who is not against us is for us.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone gives you even a cup of water because you belong to the Messiah, I tell you the truth, that person will surely be rewarded.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall offend one of {these} little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.nlt_text: "But if you cause one of these little ones who trusts in me to fall into sin, it would be better for you to be thrown into the sea with a large millstone hung around your neck.

verses.kjv_text: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched: {offend...: or, cause thee to offend}
verses.nlt_text: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It's better to enter eternal life with only one hand than to go into the unquenchable fires of hell with two hands.

verses.kjv_text: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched: {offend...: or, cause thee to offend}
verses.nlt_text: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It's better to enter eternal life with only one foot than to be thrown into hell with two feet.

verses.kjv_text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire: {offend...: or, cause thee to offend}
verses.nlt_text: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out. It's better to enter the Kingdom of God with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,

verses.kjv_text: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
verses.nlt_text: "For everyone will be tested with fire.

verses.kjv_text: Salt {is} good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
verses.nlt_text: Salt is good for seasoning. But if it loses its flavor, how do you make it salty again? You must have the qualities of salt among yourselves and live in peace with each other."

verses.kjv_text: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus left Capernaum and went down to the region of Judea and into the area east of the Jordan River. Once again crowds gathered around him, and as usual he was teaching them.

verses.kjv_text: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away {his} wife? tempting him.
verses.nlt_text: Some Pharisees came and tried to trap him with this question: "Should a man be allowed to divorce his wife?"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus answered them with a question: "What did Moses say in the law about divorce?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put {her} away.
verses.nlt_text: "Well, he permitted it," they replied. "He said a man can give his wife a written notice of divorce and send her away."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus responded, "He wrote this commandment only as a concession to your hard hearts.

verses.kjv_text: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.nlt_text: But 'God made them male and female' from the beginning of creation.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.nlt_text: 'This explains why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife,

verses.kjv_text: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.nlt_text: and the two are united into one.' Since they are no longer two but one,

verses.kjv_text: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.nlt_text: let no one split apart what God has joined together."

verses.kjv_text: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same {matter}.
verses.nlt_text: Later, when he was alone with his disciples in the house, they brought up the subject again.

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.nlt_text: He told them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery against her.

verses.kjv_text: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.nlt_text: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries someone else, she commits adultery."

verses.kjv_text: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and {his} disciples rebuked those that brought {them}.
verses.nlt_text: One day some parents brought their children to Jesus so he could touch and bless them. But the disciples scolded the parents for bothering him.

verses.kjv_text: But when Jesus saw {it}, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw what was happening, he was angry with his disciples. He said to them, "Let the children come to me. Don't stop them! For the Kingdom of God belongs to those who are like these children.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, anyone who doesn't receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it."

verses.kjv_text: And he took them up in his arms, put {his} hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.nlt_text: Then he took the children in his arms and placed his hands on their heads and blessed them.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was starting out on his way to Jerusalem, a man came running up to him, knelt down, and asked, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? {there is} none good but one, {that is}, God.
verses.nlt_text: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus asked. "Only God is truly good.

verses.kjv_text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.nlt_text: But to answer your question, you know the commandments: 'You must not murder. You must not commit adultery. You must not steal. You must not testify falsely. You must not cheat anyone. Honor your father and mother.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher," the man replied, "I've obeyed all these commandments since I was young."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Looking at the man, Jesus felt genuine love for him. "There is still one thing you haven't done," he told him. "Go and sell all your possessions and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

verses.kjv_text: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
verses.nlt_text: At this the man's face fell, and he went away very sad, for he had many possessions.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.nlt_text: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the Kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.nlt_text: This amazed them. But Jesus said again, "Dear children, it is very hard to enter the Kingdom of God.

verses.kjv_text: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv_text: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
verses.nlt_text: The disciples were astounded. "Then who in the world can be saved?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men {it is} impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus looked at them intently and said, "Humanly speaking, it is impossible. But not with God. Everything is possible with God."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter began to speak up. "We've given up everything to follow you," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," Jesus replied, "and I assure you that everyone who has given up house or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or property, for my sake and for the Good News,

verses.kjv_text: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: will receive now in return a hundred times as many houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and property-- along with persecution. And in the world to come that person will have eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: But many {that are} first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.nlt_text: But many who are the greatest now will be least important then, and those who seem least important now will be the greatest then. "

verses.kjv_text: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
verses.nlt_text: They were now on the way up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were filled with awe, and the people following behind were overwhelmed with fear. Taking the twelve disciples aside, Jesus once more began to describe everything that was about to happen to him.

verses.kjv_text: {Saying}, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
verses.nlt_text: "Listen," he said, "we're going up to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be betrayed to the leading priests and the teachers of religious law. They will sentence him to die and hand him over to the Romans.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.nlt_text: They will mock him, spit on him, flog him with a whip, and kill him, but after three days he will rise again."

verses.kjv_text: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
verses.nlt_text: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came over and spoke to him. "Teacher," they said, "we want you to do us a favor."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
verses.nlt_text: "What is your request?" he asked.

verses.kjv_text: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
verses.nlt_text: They replied, "When you sit on your glorious throne, we want to sit in places of honor next to you, one on your right and the other on your left."

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said to them, "You don't know what you are asking! Are you able to drink from the bitter cup of suffering I am about to drink? Are you able to be baptized with the baptism of suffering I must be baptized with?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
verses.nlt_text: "Oh yes," they replied, "we are able!" Then Jesus told them, "You will indeed drink from my bitter cup and be baptized with my baptism of suffering.

verses.kjv_text: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but {it shall be given to them} for whom it is prepared.
verses.nlt_text: But I have no right to say who will sit on my right or my left. God has prepared those places for the ones he has chosen."

verses.kjv_text: And when the ten heard {it}, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
verses.nlt_text: When the ten other disciples heard what James and John had asked, they were indignant.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus called them {to him}, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them. {are...: or, think good}
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers in this world lord it over their people, and officials flaunt their authority over those under them.

verses.kjv_text: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
verses.nlt_text: But among you it will be different. Whoever wants to be a leader among you must be your servant,

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
verses.nlt_text: and whoever wants to be first among you must be the slave of everyone else.

verses.kjv_text: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.nlt_text: For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve others and to give his life as a ransom for many."

verses.kjv_text: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.nlt_text: Then they reached Jericho, and as Jesus and his disciples left town, a large crowd followed him. A blind beggar named Bartimaeus (son of Timaeus) was sitting beside the road.

verses.kjv_text: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, {thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.nlt_text: When Bartimaeus heard that Jesus of Nazareth was nearby, he began to shout, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.kjv_text: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, {Thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.nlt_text: "Be quiet!" many of the people yelled at him.But he only shouted louder, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard him, he stopped and said, "Tell him to come here." So they called the blind man. "Cheer up," they said. "Come on, he's calling you!"

verses.kjv_text: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Bartimaeus threw aside his coat, jumped up, and came to Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.nlt_text: "What do you want me to do for you?" Jesus asked."My rabbi, " the blind man said, "I want to see!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way. {made...: or, saved thee}
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus said to him, "Go, for your faith has healed you." Instantly the man could see, and he followed Jesus down the road.

verses.kjv_text: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem, they came to the towns of Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives. Jesus sent two of them on ahead.

verses.kjv_text: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring {him}.
verses.nlt_text: "Go into that village over there," he told them. "As soon as you enter it, you will see a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone asks, 'What are you doing?' just say, 'The Lord needs it and will return it soon.'"

verses.kjv_text: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
verses.nlt_text: The two disciples left and found the colt standing in the street, tied outside the front door.

verses.kjv_text: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.nlt_text: As they were untying it, some bystanders demanded, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
verses.nlt_text: They said what Jesus had told them to say, and they were permitted to take it.

verses.kjv_text: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verses.nlt_text: Then they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it, and he sat on it.

verses.kjv_text: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed {them} in the way.
verses.nlt_text: Many in the crowd spread their garments on the road ahead of him, and others spread leafy branches they had cut in the fields.

verses.kjv_text: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus was in the center of the procession, and the people all around him were shouting, "Praise God! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the LORD!

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.nlt_text: Blessings on the coming Kingdom of our ancestor David! Praise God in highest heaven!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus came to Jerusalem and went into the Temple. After looking around carefully at everything, he left because it was late in the afternoon. Then he returned to Bethany with the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
verses.nlt_text: The next morning as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

verses.kjv_text: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not {yet}.
verses.nlt_text: He noticed a fig tree in full leaf a little way off, so he went over to see if he could find any figs. But there were only leaves because it was too early in the season for fruit.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the tree, "May no one ever eat your fruit again!" And the disciples heard him say it.

verses.kjv_text: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
verses.nlt_text: When they arrived back in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the Temple and began to drive out the people buying and selling animals for sacrifices. He knocked over the tables of the money changers and the chairs of those selling doves,

verses.kjv_text: And would not suffer that any man should carry {any} vessel through the temple.
verses.nlt_text: and he stopped everyone from using the Temple as a marketplace.

verses.kjv_text: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves. {of all...: or, an house of prayer for all nations}
verses.nlt_text: He said to them, "The Scriptures declare, 'My Temple will be called a house of prayer for all nations,' but you have turned it into a den of thieves."

verses.kjv_text: And the scribes and chief priests heard {it}, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
verses.nlt_text: When the leading priests and teachers of religious law heard what Jesus had done, they began planning how to kill him. But they were afraid of him because the people were so amazed at his teaching.

verses.kjv_text: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
verses.nlt_text: That evening Jesus and the disciples left the city.

verses.kjv_text: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.nlt_text: The next morning as they passed by the fig tree he had cursed, the disciples noticed it had withered from the roots up.

verses.kjv_text: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.nlt_text: Peter remembered what Jesus had said to the tree on the previous day and exclaimed, "Look, Rabbi! The fig tree you cursed has withered and died!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God. {Have...: or, Have the faith of God}
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the disciples, "Have faith in God.

verses.kjv_text: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, you can say to this mountain, 'May you be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' and it will happen. But you must really believe it will happen and have no doubt in your heart.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive {them}, and ye shall have {them}.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, you can pray for anything, and if you believe that you've received it, it will be yours.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.nlt_text: But when you are praying, first forgive anyone you are holding a grudge against, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your sins, too. "

verses.kjv_text: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
verses.nlt_text: Again they entered Jerusalem. As Jesus was walking through the Temple area, the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders came up to him.

verses.kjv_text: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.nlt_text: They demanded, "By what authority are you doing all these things? Who gave you the right to do them?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things. {question: or, thing}
verses.nlt_text: "I'll tell you by what authority I do these things if you answer one question," Jesus replied.

verses.kjv_text: The baptism of John, was {it} from heaven, or of men? answer me.
verses.nlt_text: "Did John's authority to baptize come from heaven, or was it merely human? Answer me!"

verses.kjv_text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.nlt_text: They talked it over among themselves. "If we say it was from heaven, he will ask why we didn't believe John.

verses.kjv_text: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all {men} counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
verses.nlt_text: But do we dare say it was merely human?" For they were afraid of what the people would do, because everyone believed that John was a prophet.

verses.kjv_text: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.nlt_text: So they finally replied, "We don't know." And Jesus responded, "Then I won't tell you by what authority I do these things."

verses.kjv_text: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A {certain} man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about {it}, and digged {a place for} the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus began teaching them with stories: "A man planted a vineyard. He built a wall around it, dug a pit for pressing out the grape juice, and built a lookout tower. Then he leased the vineyard to tenant farmers and moved to another country.

verses.kjv_text: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.nlt_text: At the time of the grape harvest, he sent one of his servants to collect his share of the crop.

verses.kjv_text: And they caught {him}, and beat him, and sent {him} away empty.
verses.nlt_text: But the farmers grabbed the servant, beat him up, and sent him back empty-handed.

verses.kjv_text: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded {him} in the head, and sent {him} away shamefully handled.
verses.nlt_text: The owner then sent another servant, but they insulted him and beat him over the head.

verses.kjv_text: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.nlt_text: The next servant he sent was killed. Others he sent were either beaten or killed,

verses.kjv_text: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.nlt_text: until there was only one left-- his son whom he loved dearly. The owner finally sent him, thinking, 'Surely they will respect my son.'

verses.kjv_text: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
verses.nlt_text: "But the tenant farmers said to one another, 'Here comes the heir to this estate. Let's kill him and get the estate for ourselves!'

verses.kjv_text: And they took him, and killed {him}, and cast {him} out of the vineyard.
verses.nlt_text: So they grabbed him and murdered him and threw his body out of the vineyard.

verses.kjv_text: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.nlt_text: "What do you suppose the owner of the vineyard will do?" Jesus asked. "I'll tell you-- he will come and kill those farmers and lease the vineyard to others.

verses.kjv_text: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.nlt_text: Didn't you ever read this in the Scriptures? 'The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone.

verses.kjv_text: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.nlt_text: This is the Lord's doing, and it is wonderful to see.' "

verses.kjv_text: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.nlt_text: The religious leaders wanted to arrest Jesus because they realized he was telling the story against them-- they were the wicked farmers. But they were afraid of the crowd, so they left him and went away.

verses.kjv_text: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in {his} words.
verses.nlt_text: Later the leaders sent some Pharisees and supporters of Herod to trap Jesus into saying something for which he could be arrested.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher," they said, "we know how honest you are. You are impartial and don't play favorites. You teach the way of God truthfully. Now tell us-- is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?

verses.kjv_text: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see {it}. {penny: valuing of our money seven pence halfpenny}
verses.nlt_text: Should we pay them, or shouldn't we?" Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, "Why are you trying to trap me? Show me a Roman coin, and I'll tell you."

verses.kjv_text: And they brought {it}. And he saith unto them, Whose {is} this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.nlt_text: When they handed it to him, he asked, "Whose picture and title are stamped on it?" "Caesar's," they replied.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.nlt_text: "Well, then," Jesus said, "give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God." His reply completely amazed them.

verses.kjv_text: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus was approached by some Sadducees-- religious leaders who say there is no resurrection from the dead. They posed this question:

verses.kjv_text: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave {his} wife {behind him}, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher, Moses gave us a law that if a man dies, leaving a wife without children, his brother should marry the widow and have a child who will carry on the brother's name.

verses.kjv_text: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.nlt_text: Well, suppose there were seven brothers. The oldest one married and then died without children.

verses.kjv_text: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.nlt_text: So the second brother married the widow, but he also died without children. Then the third brother married her.

verses.kjv_text: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.nlt_text: This continued with all seven of them, and still there were no children. Last of all, the woman also died.

verses.kjv_text: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.nlt_text: So tell us, whose wife will she be in the resurrection? For all seven were married to her."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Your mistake is that you don't know the Scriptures, and you don't know the power of God.

verses.kjv_text: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: For when the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. In this respect they will be like the angels in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I {am} the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.nlt_text: "But now, as to whether the dead will be raised-- haven't you ever read about this in the writings of Moses, in the story of the burning bush? Long after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, God said to Moses, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

verses.kjv_text: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.nlt_text: So he is the God of the living, not the dead. You have made a serious error."

verses.kjv_text: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.nlt_text: One of the teachers of religious law was standing there listening to the debate. He realized that Jesus had answered well, so he asked, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments {is}, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "The most important commandment is this: 'Listen, O Israel! The Lord our God is the one and only Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this {is} the first commandment.
verses.nlt_text: And you must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind, and all your strength.'

verses.kjv_text: And the second {is} like, {namely} this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.nlt_text: The second is equally important: 'Love your neighbor as yourself.' No other commandment is greater than these."

verses.kjv_text: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.nlt_text: The teacher of religious law replied, "Well said, Teacher. You have spoken the truth by saying that there is only one God and no other.

verses.kjv_text: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love {his} neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.nlt_text: And I know it is important to love him with all my heart and all my understanding and all my strength, and to love my neighbor as myself. This is more important than to offer all of the burnt offerings and sacrifices required in the law."

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him {any question}.
verses.nlt_text: Realizing how much the man understood, Jesus said to him, "You are not far from the Kingdom of God." And after that, no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
verses.nlt_text: Later, as Jesus was teaching the people in the Temple, he asked, "Why do the teachers of religious law claim that the Messiah is the son of David?

verses.kjv_text: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.nlt_text: For David himself, speaking under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit, said, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies beneath your feet.'

verses.kjv_text: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he {then} his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.nlt_text: Since David himself called the Messiah 'my Lord,' how can the Messiah be his son?" The large crowd listened to him with great delight.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and {love} salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus also taught: "Beware of these teachers of religious law! For they like to parade around in flowing robes and receive respectful greetings as they walk in the marketplaces.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.nlt_text: And how they love the seats of honor in the synagogues and the head table at banquets.

verses.kjv_text: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.nlt_text: Yet they shamelessly cheat widows out of their property and then pretend to be pious by making long prayers in public. Because of this, they will be more severely punished."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much. {money: a piece of brass money}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus sat down near the collection box in the Temple and watched as the crowds dropped in their money. Many rich people put in large amounts.

verses.kjv_text: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing. {mites: it is the seventh part of one piece of that brass money}
verses.nlt_text: Then a poor widow came and dropped in two small coins.

verses.kjv_text: And he called {unto him} his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, "I tell you the truth, this poor widow has given more than all the others who are making contributions.

verses.kjv_text: For all {they} did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, {even} all her living.
verses.nlt_text: For they gave a tiny part of their surplus, but she, poor as she is, has given everything she had to live on."

verses.kjv_text: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings {are here}!
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was leaving the Temple that day, one of his disciples said, "Teacher, look at these magnificent buildings! Look at the impressive stones in the walls."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Yes, look at these great buildings. But they will be completely demolished. Not one stone will be left on top of another!"

verses.kjv_text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.nlt_text: Later, Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives across the valley from the Temple. Peter, James, John, and Andrew came to him privately and asked him,

verses.kjv_text: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what {shall be} the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.nlt_text: "Tell us, when will all this happen? What sign will show us that these things are about to be fulfilled?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any {man} deceive you:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Don't let anyone mislead you,

verses.kjv_text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am {Christ}; and shall deceive many.
verses.nlt_text: for many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am the Messiah.' They will deceive many.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for {such things} must needs be; but the end {shall} not {be} yet.
verses.nlt_text: And you will hear of wars and threats of wars, but don't panic. Yes, these things must take place, but the end won't follow immediately.

verses.kjv_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these {are} the beginnings of sorrows. {sorrows: the word in the original importeth "the pains of a woman in travail"}
verses.nlt_text: Nation will go to war against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in many parts of the world, as well as famines. But this is only the first of the birth pains, with more to come.

verses.kjv_text: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.nlt_text: "When these things begin to happen, watch out! You will be handed over to the local councils and beaten in the synagogues. You will stand trial before governors and kings because you are my followers. But this will be your opportunity to tell them about me.

verses.kjv_text: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.nlt_text: For the Good News must first be preached to all nations.

verses.kjv_text: But when they shall lead {you}, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: But when you are arrested and stand trial, don't worry in advance about what to say. Just say what God tells you at that time, for it is not you who will be speaking, but the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against {their} parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: "A brother will betray his brother to death, a father will betray his own child, and children will rebel against their parents and cause them to be killed.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be hated of all {men} for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.nlt_text: And everyone will hate you because you are my followers. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.kjv_text: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.nlt_text: "The day is coming when you will see the sacrilegious object that causes desecration standing where he should not be." (Reader, pay attention!) "Then those in Judea must flee to the hills.

verses.kjv_text: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter {therein}, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.nlt_text: A person out on the deck of a roof must not go down into the house to pack.

verses.kjv_text: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.nlt_text: A person out in the field must not return even to get a coat.

verses.kjv_text: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.nlt_text: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and for nursing mothers in those days.

verses.kjv_text: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.nlt_text: And pray that your flight will not be in winter.

verses.kjv_text: For {in} those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.nlt_text: For there will be greater anguish in those days than at any time since God created the world. And it will never be so great again.

verses.kjv_text: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, unless the Lord shortens that time of calamity, not a single person will survive. But for the sake of his chosen ones he has shortened those days.

verses.kjv_text: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here {is} Christ; or, lo, {he is} there; believe {him} not:
verses.nlt_text: "Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Messiah,' or 'There he is,' don't believe it.

verses.kjv_text: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if {it were} possible, even the elect.
verses.nlt_text: For false messiahs and false prophets will rise up and perform signs and wonders so as to deceive, if possible, even God's chosen ones.

verses.kjv_text: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.nlt_text: Watch out! I have warned you about this ahead of time!

verses.kjv_text: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.nlt_text: "At that time, after the anguish of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will give no light,

verses.kjv_text: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.nlt_text: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.

verses.kjv_text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.nlt_text: Then everyone will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.kjv_text: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: And he will send out his angels to gather his chosen ones from all over the world-- from the farthest ends of the earth and heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.nlt_text: "Now learn a lesson from the fig tree. When its branches bud and its leaves begin to sprout, you know that summer is near.

verses.kjv_text: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, {even} at the doors.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, when you see all these things taking place, you can know that his return is very near, right at the door.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass from the scene before all these things take place.

verses.kjv_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.nlt_text: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

verses.kjv_text: But of that day and {that} hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.nlt_text: "However, no one knows the day or hour when these things will happen, not even the angels in heaven or the Son himself. Only the Father knows.

verses.kjv_text: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.nlt_text: And since you don't know when that time will come, be on guard! Stay alert!

verses.kjv_text: {For the Son of man is} as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.nlt_text: "The coming of the Son of Man can be illustrated by the story of a man going on a long trip. When he left home, he gave each of his slaves instructions about the work they were to do, and he told the gatekeeper to watch for his return.

verses.kjv_text: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.nlt_text: You, too, must keep watch! For you don't know when the master of the household will return-- in the evening, at midnight, before dawn, or at daybreak.

verses.kjv_text: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let him find you sleeping when he arrives without warning.

verses.kjv_text: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.nlt_text: I say to you what I say to everyone: Watch for him!"

verses.kjv_text: After two days was {the feast of} the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put {him} to death.
verses.nlt_text: It was now two days before Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread. The leading priests and the teachers of religious law were still looking for an opportunity to capture Jesus secretly and kill him.

verses.kjv_text: But they said, Not on the feast {day}, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.nlt_text: "But not during the Passover celebration," they agreed, "or the people may riot."

verses.kjv_text: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured {it} on his head. {spikenard: or, pure nard, or, liquid nard}
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Jesus was in Bethany at the home of Simon, a man who had previously had leprosy. While he was eating, a woman came in with a beautiful alabaster jar of expensive perfume made from essence of nard. She broke open the jar and poured the perfume over his head.

verses.kjv_text: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.nlt_text: Some of those at the table were indignant. "Why waste such expensive perfume?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.nlt_text: "It could have been sold for a year's wages and the money given to the poor!" So they scolded her harshly.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "Leave her alone. Why criticize her for doing such a good thing to me?

verses.kjv_text: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.nlt_text: You will always have the poor among you, and you can help them whenever you want to. But you will not always have me.

verses.kjv_text: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.nlt_text: She has done what she could and has anointed my body for burial ahead of time.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, {this} also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, wherever the Good News is preached throughout the world, this woman's deed will be remembered and discussed."

verses.kjv_text: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve disciples, went to the leading priests to arrange to betray Jesus to them.

verses.kjv_text: And when they heard {it}, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.nlt_text: They were delighted when they heard why he had come, and they promised to give him money. So he began looking for an opportunity to betray Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover? {killed: or, sacrificed}
verses.nlt_text: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb is sacrificed, Jesus' disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go to prepare the Passover meal for you?"

verses.kjv_text: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus sent two of them into Jerusalem with these instructions: "As you go into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him.

verses.kjv_text: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.nlt_text: At the house he enters, say to the owner, 'The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples?'

verses.kjv_text: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished {and} prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.nlt_text: He will take you upstairs to a large room that is already set up. That is where you should prepare our meal."

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.nlt_text: So the two disciples went into the city and found everything just as Jesus had said, and they prepared the Passover meal there.

verses.kjv_text: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.nlt_text: In the evening Jesus arrived with the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.nlt_text: As they were at the table eating, Jesus said, "I tell you the truth, one of you eating with me here will betray me."

verses.kjv_text: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, {Is} it I? and another {said, Is} it I?
verses.nlt_text: Greatly distressed, each one asked in turn, "Am I the one?"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, {It is} one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "It is one of you twelve who is eating from this bowl with me.

verses.kjv_text: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.nlt_text: For the Son of Man must die, as the Scriptures declared long ago. But how terrible it will be for the one who betrays him. It would be far better for that man if he had never been born!"

verses.kjv_text: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake {it}, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.nlt_text: As they were eating, Jesus took some bread and blessed it. Then he broke it in pieces and gave it to the disciples, saying, "Take it, for this is my body."

verses.kjv_text: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave {it} to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.nlt_text: And he took a cup of wine and gave thanks to God for it. He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.nlt_text: And he said to them, "This is my blood, which confirms the covenant between God and his people. It is poured out as a sacrifice for many.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, I will not drink wine again until the day I drink it new in the Kingdom of God."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives. {hymn: or, psalm}
verses.nlt_text: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered. {offended: or, scandalized, or, shall stumble}
verses.nlt_text: On the way, Jesus told them, "All of you will desert me. For the Scriptures say, 'God will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

verses.kjv_text: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: But after I am raised from the dead, I will go ahead of you to Galilee and meet you there."

verses.kjv_text: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet {will} not I.
verses.nlt_text: Peter said to him, "Even if everyone else deserts you, I never will."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, {even} in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, Peter-- this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny three times that you even know me."

verses.kjv_text: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.nlt_text: "No!" Peter declared emphatically. "Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny you!" And all the others vowed the same.

verses.kjv_text: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.nlt_text: They went to the olive grove called Gethsemane, and Jesus said, "Sit here while I go and pray."

verses.kjv_text: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.nlt_text: He took Peter, James, and John with him, and he became deeply troubled and distressed.

verses.kjv_text: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.nlt_text: He told them, "My soul is crushed with grief to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me."

verses.kjv_text: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.nlt_text: He went on a little farther and fell to the ground. He prayed that, if it were possible, the awful hour awaiting him might pass him by.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Abba, Father, all things {are} possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.nlt_text: "Abba, Father," he cried out, "everything is possible for you. Please take this cup of suffering away from me. Yet I want your will to be done, not mine."

verses.kjv_text: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.nlt_text: Then he returned and found the disciples asleep. He said to Peter, "Simon, are you asleep? Couldn't you watch with me even one hour?

verses.kjv_text: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly {is} ready, but the flesh {is} weak.
verses.nlt_text: Keep watch and pray, so that you will not give in to temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak."

verses.kjv_text: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus left them again and prayed the same prayer as before.

verses.kjv_text: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.nlt_text: When he returned to them again, he found them sleeping, for they couldn't keep their eyes open. And they didn't know what to say.

verses.kjv_text: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take {your} rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.nlt_text: When he returned to them the third time, he said, "Go ahead and sleep. Have your rest. But no-- the time has come. The Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.kjv_text: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.nlt_text: Up, let's be going. Look, my betrayer is here!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.nlt_text: And immediately, even as Jesus said this, Judas, one of the twelve disciples, arrived with a crowd of men armed with swords and clubs. They had been sent by the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders.

verses.kjv_text: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead {him} away safely.
verses.nlt_text: The traitor, Judas, had given them a prearranged signal: "You will know which one to arrest when I greet him with a kiss. Then you can take him away under guard."

verses.kjv_text: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.nlt_text: As soon as they arrived, Judas walked up to Jesus. "Rabbi!" he exclaimed, and gave him the kiss.

verses.kjv_text: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.nlt_text: Then the others grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

verses.kjv_text: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.nlt_text: But one of the men with Jesus pulled out his sword and struck the high priest's slave, slashing off his ear.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and {with} staves to take me?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked them, "Am I some dangerous revolutionary, that you come with swords and clubs to arrest me?

verses.kjv_text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: Why didn't you arrest me in the Temple? I was there among you teaching every day. But these things are happening to fulfill what the Scriptures say about me."

verses.kjv_text: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.nlt_text: Then all his disciples deserted him and ran away.

verses.kjv_text: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about {his} naked {body}; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.nlt_text: One young man following behind was clothed only in a long linen shirt. When the mob tried to grab him,

verses.kjv_text: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.nlt_text: he slipped out of his shirt and ran away naked.

verses.kjv_text: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.nlt_text: They took Jesus to the high priest's home where the leading priests, the elders, and the teachers of religious law had gathered.

verses.kjv_text: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Peter followed him at a distance and went right into the high priest's courtyard. There he sat with the guards, warming himself by the fire.
