verses.kjv_text: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.nlt_text: Inside, the leading priests and the entire high council were trying to find evidence against Jesus, so they could put him to death. But they couldn't find any.

verses.kjv_text: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.nlt_text: Many false witnesses spoke against him, but they contradicted each other.

verses.kjv_text: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Finally, some men stood up and gave this false testimony:

verses.kjv_text: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.nlt_text: "We heard him say, 'I will destroy this Temple made with human hands, and in three days I will build another, made without human hands.'"

verses.kjv_text: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.nlt_text: But even then they didn't get their stories straight!

verses.kjv_text: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what {is it which} these witness against thee?
verses.nlt_text: Then the high priest stood up before the others and asked Jesus, "Well, aren't you going to answer these charges? What do you have to say for yourself?"

verses.kjv_text: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus was silent and made no reply. Then the high priest asked him, "Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "I Am. And you will see the Son of Man seated in the place of power at God's right hand and coming on the clouds of heaven. "

verses.kjv_text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.nlt_text: Then the high priest tore his clothing to show his horror and said, "Why do we need other witnesses?

verses.kjv_text: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.nlt_text: You have all heard his blasphemy. What is your verdict?" "Guilty!" they all cried. "He deserves to die!"

verses.kjv_text: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.nlt_text: Then some of them began to spit at him, and they blindfolded him and beat him with their fists. "Prophesy to us," they jeered. And the guards slapped him as they took him away.

verses.kjv_text: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Peter was in the courtyard below. One of the servant girls who worked for the high priest came by

verses.kjv_text: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.nlt_text: and noticed Peter warming himself at the fire. She looked at him closely and said, "You were one of those with Jesus of Nazareth. "

verses.kjv_text: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter denied it. "I don't know what you're talking about," he said, and he went out into the entryway. Just then, a rooster crowed.

verses.kjv_text: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is {one} of them.
verses.nlt_text: When the servant girl saw him standing there, she began telling the others, "This man is definitely one of them!"

verses.kjv_text: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art {one} of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth {thereto}.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter denied it again.A little later some of the other bystanders confronted Peter and said, "You must be one of them, because you are a Galilean."

verses.kjv_text: But he began to curse and to swear, {saying}, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.nlt_text: Peter swore, "A curse on me if I'm lying-- I don't know this man you're talking about!"

verses.kjv_text: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept. {when...: or, he wept abundantly, or, he began to weep}
verses.nlt_text: And immediately the rooster crowed the second time.Suddenly, Jesus' words flashed through Peter's mind: "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny three times that you even know me." And he broke down and wept.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried {him} away, and delivered {him} to Pilate.
verses.nlt_text: Very early in the morning the leading priests, the elders, and the teachers of religious law-- the entire high council-- met to discuss their next step. They bound Jesus, led him away, and took him to Pilate, the Roman governor.

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the king of the Jews?" Jesus replied, "You have said it."

verses.kjv_text: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.nlt_text: Then the leading priests kept accusing him of many crimes,

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.nlt_text: and Pilate asked him, "Aren't you going to answer them? What about all these charges they are bringing against you?"

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said nothing, much to Pilate's surprise.

verses.kjv_text: Now at {that} feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.nlt_text: Now it was the governor's custom each year during the Passover celebration to release one prisoner-- anyone the people requested.

verses.kjv_text: And there was {one} named Barabbas, {which lay} bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
verses.nlt_text: One of the prisoners at that time was Barabbas, a revolutionary who had committed murder in an uprising.

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire {him to do} as he had ever done unto them.
verses.nlt_text: The crowd went to Pilate and asked him to release a prisoner as usual.

verses.kjv_text: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.nlt_text: "Would you like me to release this 'King of the Jews'?" Pilate asked.

verses.kjv_text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.nlt_text: (For he realized by now that the leading priests had arrested Jesus out of envy.)

verses.kjv_text: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.nlt_text: But at this point the leading priests stirred up the crowd to demand the release of Barabbas instead of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do {unto him} whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.nlt_text: Pilate asked them, "Then what should I do with this man you call the king of the Jews?"

verses.kjv_text: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.nlt_text: They shouted back, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.nlt_text: "Why?" Pilate demanded. "What crime has he committed?" But the mob roared even louder, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv_text: And {so} Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged {him}, to be crucified.
verses.nlt_text: So to pacify the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He ordered Jesus flogged with a lead-tipped whip, then turned him over to the Roman soldiers to be crucified.

verses.kjv_text: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band. {Praetorium: or, the palace, or, hall of audience}
verses.nlt_text: The soldiers took Jesus into the courtyard of the governor's headquarters (called the Praetorium) and called out the entire regiment.

verses.kjv_text: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his {head},
verses.nlt_text: They dressed him in a purple robe, and they wove thorn branches into a crown and put it on his head.

verses.kjv_text: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.nlt_text: Then they saluted him and taunted, "Hail! King of the Jews!"

verses.kjv_text: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing {their} knees worshipped him.
verses.nlt_text: And they struck him on the head with a reed stick, spit on him, and dropped to their knees in mock worship.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.nlt_text: When they were finally tired of mocking him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him again. Then they led him away to be crucified.

verses.kjv_text: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
verses.nlt_text: A passerby named Simon, who was from Cyrene, was coming in from the countryside just then, and the soldiers forced him to carry Jesus' cross. (Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus.)

verses.kjv_text: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
verses.nlt_text: And they brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha (which means "Place of the Skull").

verses.kjv_text: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received {it} not.
verses.nlt_text: They offered him wine drugged with myrrh, but he refused it.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
verses.nlt_text: Then the soldiers nailed him to the cross. They divided his clothes and threw dice to decide who would get each piece.

verses.kjv_text: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.nlt_text: It was nine o'clock in the morning when they crucified him.

verses.kjv_text: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.nlt_text: A sign was fastened to the cross, announcing the charge against him. It read, "The King of the Jews."

verses.kjv_text: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.nlt_text: Two revolutionaries were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

verses.kjv_text: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest {it} in three days,
verses.nlt_text: The people passing by shouted abuse, shaking their heads in mockery. "Ha! Look at you now!" they yelled at him. "You said you were going to destroy the Temple and rebuild it in three days.

verses.kjv_text: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
verses.nlt_text: Well then, save yourself and come down from the cross!"

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.nlt_text: The leading priests and teachers of religious law also mocked Jesus. "He saved others," they scoffed, "but he can't save himself!

verses.kjv_text: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
verses.nlt_text: Let this Messiah, this King of Israel, come down from the cross so we can see it and believe him!" Even the men who were crucified with Jesus ridiculed him.

verses.kjv_text: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.nlt_text: At noon, darkness fell across the whole land until three o'clock.

verses.kjv_text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.nlt_text: Then at three o'clock Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" which means "My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?"

verses.kjv_text: And some of them that stood by, when they heard {it}, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.nlt_text: Some of the bystanders misunderstood and thought he was calling for the prophet Elijah.

verses.kjv_text: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put {it} on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.nlt_text: One of them ran and filled a sponge with sour wine, holding it up to him on a reed stick so he could drink. "Wait!" he said. "Let's see whether Elijah comes to take him down!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus uttered another loud cry and breathed his last.

verses.kjv_text: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.nlt_text: And the curtain in the sanctuary of the Temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.

verses.kjv_text: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: When the Roman officer who stood facing him saw how he had died, he exclaimed, "This man truly was the Son of God!"

verses.kjv_text: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
verses.nlt_text: Some women were there, watching from a distance, including Mary Magdalene, Mary (the mother of James the younger and of Joseph), and Salome.

verses.kjv_text: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: They had been followers of Jesus and had cared for him while he was in Galilee. Many other women who had come with him to Jerusalem were also there.

verses.kjv_text: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.nlt_text: This all happened on Friday, the day of preparation, the day before the Sabbath. As evening approached,

verses.kjv_text: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph of Arimathea took a risk and went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body. (Joseph was an honored member of the high council, and he was waiting for the Kingdom of God to come.)

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling {unto him} the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate couldn't believe that Jesus was already dead, so he called for the Roman officer and asked if he had died yet.

verses.kjv_text: And when he knew {it} of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
verses.nlt_text: The officer confirmed that Jesus was dead, so Pilate told Joseph he could have the body.

verses.kjv_text: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: Joseph bought a long sheet of linen cloth. Then he took Jesus' body down from the cross, wrapped it in the cloth, and laid it in a tomb that had been carved out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone in front of the entrance.

verses.kjv_text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary {the mother} of Joses beheld where he was laid.
verses.nlt_text: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where Jesus' body was laid.

verses.kjv_text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the {mother} of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.nlt_text: Saturday evening, when the Sabbath ended, Mary Magdalene and Salome and Mary the mother of James went out and purchased burial spices so they could anoint Jesus' body.

verses.kjv_text: And very early in the morning the first {day} of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.nlt_text: Very early on Sunday morning, just at sunrise, they went to the tomb.

verses.kjv_text: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.nlt_text: On the way they were asking each other, "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance to the tomb?"

verses.kjv_text: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.nlt_text: But as they arrived, they looked up and saw that the stone, which was very large, had already been rolled aside.

verses.kjv_text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.nlt_text: When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man clothed in a white robe sitting on the right side. The women were shocked,

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verses.nlt_text: but the angel said, "Don't be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He isn't here! He is risen from the dead! Look, this is where they laid his body.

verses.kjv_text: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Now go and tell his disciples, including Peter, that Jesus is going ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you before he died."

verses.kjv_text: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any {man}; for they were afraid.
verses.nlt_text: The women fled from the tomb, trembling and bewildered, and they said nothing to anyone because they were too frightened. Then they briefly reported all this to Peter and his companions. Afterward Jesus himself sent them out from east to west with the sacred and unfailing message of salvation that gives eternal life. Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Now when {Jesus} was risen early the first {day} of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
verses.nlt_text: After Jesus rose from the dead early on Sunday morning, the first person who saw him was Mary Magdalene, the woman from whom he had cast out seven demons.

verses.kjv_text: {And} she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.nlt_text: She went to the disciples, who were grieving and weeping, and told them what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.nlt_text: But when she told them that Jesus was alive and she had seen him, they didn't believe her.

verses.kjv_text: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward he appeared in a different form to two of his followers who were walking from Jerusalem into the country.

verses.kjv_text: And they went and told {it} unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.nlt_text: They rushed back to tell the others, but no one believed them.

verses.kjv_text: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen. {at meat: or, together}
verses.nlt_text: Still later he appeared to the eleven disciples as they were eating together. He rebuked them for their stubborn unbelief because they refused to believe those who had seen him after he had been raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.nlt_text: And then he told them, "Go into all the world and preach the Good News to everyone.

verses.kjv_text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who believes and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe will be condemned.

verses.kjv_text: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.nlt_text: These miraculous signs will accompany those who believe: They will cast out demons in my name, and they will speak in new languages.

verses.kjv_text: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.nlt_text: They will be able to handle snakes with safety, and if they drink anything poisonous, it won't hurt them. They will be able to place their hands on the sick, and they will be healed."

verses.kjv_text: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.nlt_text: When the Lord Jesus had finished talking with them, he was taken up into heaven and sat down in the place of honor at God's right hand.

verses.kjv_text: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with {them}, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: And the disciples went everywhere and preached, and the Lord worked through them, confirming what they said by many miraculous signs.

verses.kjv_text: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.nlt_text: Many people have set out to write accounts about the events that have been fulfilled among us.

verses.kjv_text: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
verses.nlt_text: They used the eyewitness reports circulating among us from the early disciples.

verses.kjv_text: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.nlt_text: Having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I also have decided to write a careful account for you, most honorable Theophilus,

verses.kjv_text: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
verses.nlt_text: so you can be certain of the truth of everything you were taught.

verses.kjv_text: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife {was} of the daughters of Aaron, and her name {was} Elisabeth.
verses.nlt_text: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a Jewish priest named Zechariah. He was a member of the priestly order of Abijah, and his wife, Elizabeth, was also from the priestly line of Aaron.

verses.kjv_text: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.nlt_text: Zechariah and Elizabeth were righteous in God's eyes, careful to obey all of the Lord's commandments and regulations.

verses.kjv_text: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were {now} well stricken in years.
verses.nlt_text: They had no children because Elizabeth was unable to conceive, and they were both very old.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
verses.nlt_text: One day Zechariah was serving God in the Temple, for his order was on duty that week.

verses.kjv_text: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: As was the custom of the priests, he was chosen by lot to enter the sanctuary of the Lord and burn incense.

verses.kjv_text: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.nlt_text: While the incense was being burned, a great crowd stood outside, praying.

verses.kjv_text: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.nlt_text: While Zechariah was in the sanctuary, an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the incense altar.

verses.kjv_text: And when Zacharias saw {him}, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.nlt_text: Zechariah was shaken and overwhelmed with fear when he saw him.

verses.kjv_text: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
verses.nlt_text: But the angel said, "Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayer. Your wife, Elizabeth, will give you a son, and you are to name him John.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.nlt_text: You will have great joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth,

verses.kjv_text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
verses.nlt_text: for he will be great in the eyes of the Lord. He must never touch wine or other alcoholic drinks. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even before his birth.

verses.kjv_text: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
verses.nlt_text: And he will turn many Israelites to the Lord their God.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord. {to the wisdom: or, by the wisdom}
verses.nlt_text: He will be a man with the spirit and power of Elijah. He will prepare the people for the coming of the Lord. He will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and he will cause those who are rebellious to accept the wisdom of the godly."

verses.kjv_text: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.nlt_text: Zechariah said to the angel, "How can I be sure this will happen? I'm an old man now, and my wife is also well along in years."

verses.kjv_text: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angel said, "I am Gabriel! I stand in the very presence of God. It was he who sent me to bring you this good news!

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.nlt_text: But now, since you didn't believe what I said, you will be silent and unable to speak until the child is born. For my words will certainly be fulfilled at the proper time."

verses.kjv_text: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah to come out of the sanctuary, wondering why he was taking so long.

verses.kjv_text: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.nlt_text: When he finally did come out, he couldn't speak to them. Then they realized from his gestures and his silence that he must have seen a vision in the sanctuary.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.nlt_text: When Zechariah's week of service in the Temple was over, he returned home.

verses.kjv_text: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Soon afterward his wife, Elizabeth, became pregnant and went into seclusion for five months.

verses.kjv_text: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on {me}, to take away my reproach among men.
verses.nlt_text: "How kind the Lord is!" she exclaimed. "He has taken away my disgrace of having no children."

verses.kjv_text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.nlt_text: In the sixth month of Elizabeth's pregnancy, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a village in Galilee,

verses.kjv_text: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name {was} Mary.
verses.nlt_text: to a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of King David.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, {thou that art} highly favoured, the Lord {is} with thee: blessed {art} thou among women. {highly...: or, graciously accepted, or, of much grace}
verses.nlt_text: Gabriel appeared to her and said, "Greetings, favored woman! The Lord is with you! "

verses.kjv_text: And when she saw {him}, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.nlt_text: Confused and disturbed, Mary tried to think what the angel could mean.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't be afraid, Mary," the angel told her, "for you have found favor with God!

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
verses.nlt_text: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
verses.nlt_text: He will be very great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his ancestor David.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.nlt_text: And he will reign over Israel forever; his Kingdom will never end!"

verses.kjv_text: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.nlt_text: Mary asked the angel, "But how can this happen? I am a virgin."

verses.kjv_text: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: The angel replied, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the baby to be born will be holy, and he will be called the Son of God.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.nlt_text: What's more, your relative Elizabeth has become pregnant in her old age! People used to say she was barren, but she's now in her sixth month.

verses.kjv_text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.nlt_text: For nothing is impossible with God. "

verses.kjv_text: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.nlt_text: Mary responded, "I am the Lord's servant. May everything you have said about me come true." And then the angel left her.

verses.kjv_text: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.nlt_text: A few days later Mary hurried to the hill country of Judea, to the town

verses.kjv_text: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.nlt_text: where Zechariah lived. She entered the house and greeted Elizabeth.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
verses.nlt_text: At the sound of Mary's greeting, Elizabeth's child leaped within her, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed {art} thou among women, and blessed {is} the fruit of thy womb.
verses.nlt_text: Elizabeth gave a glad cry and exclaimed to Mary, "God has blessed you above all women, and your child is blessed.

verses.kjv_text: And whence {is} this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.nlt_text: Why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should visit me?

verses.kjv_text: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.nlt_text: When I heard your greeting, the baby in my womb jumped for joy.

verses.kjv_text: And blessed {is} she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord. {that...: or, which believed that there}
verses.nlt_text: You are blessed because you believed that the Lord would do what he said."

verses.kjv_text: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
verses.nlt_text: Mary responded, "Oh, how my soul praises the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
verses.nlt_text: How my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!

verses.kjv_text: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.nlt_text: For he took notice of his lowly servant girl, and from now on all generations will call me blessed.

verses.kjv_text: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy {is} his name.
verses.nlt_text: For the Mighty One is holy, and he has done great things for me.

verses.kjv_text: And his mercy {is} on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.nlt_text: He shows mercy from generation to generation to all who fear him.

verses.kjv_text: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.nlt_text: His mighty arm has done tremendous things! He has scattered the proud and haughty ones.

verses.kjv_text: He hath put down the mighty from {their} seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.nlt_text: He has brought down princes from their thrones and exalted the humble.

verses.kjv_text: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
verses.nlt_text: He has filled the hungry with good things and sent the rich away with empty hands.

verses.kjv_text: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of {his} mercy;
verses.nlt_text: He has helped his servant Israel and remembered to be merciful.

verses.kjv_text: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.nlt_text: For he made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his children forever."

verses.kjv_text: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.nlt_text: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months and then went back to her own home.

verses.kjv_text: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.nlt_text: When it was time for Elizabeth's baby to be born, she gave birth to a son.

verses.kjv_text: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.nlt_text: And when her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had been very merciful to her, everyone rejoiced with her.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.nlt_text: When the baby was eight days old, they all came for the circumcision ceremony. They wanted to name him Zechariah, after his father.

verses.kjv_text: And his mother answered and said, Not {so}; but he shall be called John.
verses.nlt_text: But Elizabeth said, "No! His name is John!"

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.nlt_text: "What?" they exclaimed. "There is no one in all your family by that name."

verses.kjv_text: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.nlt_text: So they used gestures to ask the baby's father what he wanted to name him.

verses.kjv_text: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verses.nlt_text: He motioned for a writing tablet, and to everyone's surprise he wrote, "His name is John."

verses.kjv_text: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue {loosed}, and he spake, and praised God.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly Zechariah could speak again, and he began praising God.

verses.kjv_text: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea. {sayings: or, things}
verses.nlt_text: Awe fell upon the whole neighborhood, and the news of what had happened spread throughout the Judean hills.

verses.kjv_text: And all they that heard {them} laid {them} up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who heard about it reflected on these events and asked, "What will this child turn out to be?" For the hand of the Lord was surely upon him in a special way.

verses.kjv_text: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then his father, Zechariah, was filled with the Holy Spirit and gave this prophecy:

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.nlt_text: "Praise the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has visited and redeemed his people.

verses.kjv_text: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
verses.nlt_text: He has sent us a mighty Savior from the royal line of his servant David,

verses.kjv_text: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
verses.nlt_text: just as he promised through his holy prophets long ago.

verses.kjv_text: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.nlt_text: Now we will be saved from our enemies and from all who hate us.

verses.kjv_text: To perform the mercy {promised} to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.nlt_text: He has been merciful to our ancestors by remembering his sacred covenant--

verses.kjv_text: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.nlt_text: the covenant he swore with an oath to our ancestor Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.nlt_text: We have been rescued from our enemies so we can serve God without fear,

verses.kjv_text: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.nlt_text: in holiness and righteousness for as long as we live.

verses.kjv_text: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
verses.nlt_text: "And you, my little son, will be called the prophet of the Most High, because you will prepare the way for the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins, {by: or, for}
verses.nlt_text: You will tell his people how to find salvation through forgiveness of their sins.

verses.kjv_text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us, {tender...: or, bowels of the mercy} {dayspring: or, sunrising, or, branch}
verses.nlt_text: Because of God's tender mercy, the morning light from heaven is about to break upon us,

verses.kjv_text: To give light to them that sit in darkness and {in} the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
verses.nlt_text: to give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, and to guide us to the path of peace."

verses.kjv_text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
verses.nlt_text: John grew up and became strong in spirit. And he lived in the wilderness until he began his public ministry to Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed. {taxed: or, enrolled}
verses.nlt_text: At that time the Roman emperor, Augustus, decreed that a census should be taken throughout the Roman Empire.

verses.kjv_text: ({And} this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.nlt_text: (This was the first census taken when Quirinius was governor of Syria.)

verses.kjv_text: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city. {taxed: or, enrolled}
verses.nlt_text: All returned to their own ancestral towns to register for this census.

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
verses.nlt_text: And because Joseph was a descendant of King David, he had to go to Bethlehem in Judea, David's ancient home. He traveled there from the village of Nazareth in Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child. {taxed: or, enrolled}
verses.nlt_text: He took with him Mary, his fianc�e, who was now obviously pregnant.

verses.kjv_text: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.nlt_text: And while they were there, the time came for her baby to be born.

verses.kjv_text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.nlt_text: She gave birth to her first child, a son. She wrapped him snugly in strips of cloth and laid him in a manger, because there was no lodging available for them.

verses.kjv_text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. {watch: or, the night watches}
verses.nlt_text: That night there were shepherds staying in the fields nearby, guarding their flocks of sheep.

verses.kjv_text: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, an angel of the Lord appeared among them, and the radiance of the Lord's glory surrounded them. They were terrified,

verses.kjv_text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.nlt_text: but the angel reassured them. "Don't be afraid!" he said. "I bring you good news that will bring great joy to all people.

verses.kjv_text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: The Savior-- yes, the Messiah, the Lord-- has been born today in Bethlehem, the city of David!

verses.kjv_text: And this {shall be} a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.nlt_text: And you will recognize him by this sign: You will find a baby wrapped snugly in strips of cloth, lying in a manger."

verses.kjv_text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, the angel was joined by a vast host of others-- the armies of heaven-- praising God and saying,

verses.kjv_text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.nlt_text: "Glory to God in highest heaven, and peace on earth to those with whom God is pleased."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us. {the shepherds: Gr. the men the shepherds}
verses.nlt_text: When the angels had returned to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, "Let's go to Bethlehem! Let's see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about."

verses.kjv_text: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.nlt_text: They hurried to the village and found Mary and Joseph. And there was the baby, lying in the manger.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had seen {it}, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.nlt_text: After seeing him, the shepherds told everyone what had happened and what the angel had said to them about this child.

verses.kjv_text: And all they that heard {it} wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.nlt_text: All who heard the shepherds' story were astonished,

verses.kjv_text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered {them} in her heart.
verses.nlt_text: but Mary kept all these things in her heart and thought about them often.

verses.kjv_text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.nlt_text: The shepherds went back to their flocks, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen. It was just as the angel had told them.

verses.kjv_text: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.nlt_text: Eight days later, when the baby was circumcised, he was named Jesus, the name given him by the angel even before he was conceived.

verses.kjv_text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present {him} to the Lord;
verses.nlt_text: Then it was time for their purification offering, as required by the law of Moses after the birth of a child; so his parents took him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
verses.nlt_text: The law of the Lord says, "If a woman's first child is a boy, he must be dedicated to the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.nlt_text: So they offered the sacrifice required in the law of the Lord-- "either a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons."

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name {was} Simeon; and the same man {was} just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.nlt_text: At that time there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon. He was righteous and devout and was eagerly waiting for the Messiah to come and rescue Israel. The Holy Spirit was upon him

verses.kjv_text: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.nlt_text: and had revealed to him that he would not die until he had seen the Lord's Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.nlt_text: That day the Spirit led him to the Temple. So when Mary and Joseph came to present the baby Jesus to the Lord as the law required,

verses.kjv_text: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.nlt_text: Simeon was there. He took the child in his arms and praised God, saying,

verses.kjv_text: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.nlt_text: "Sovereign Lord, now let your servant die in peace, as you have promised.

verses.kjv_text: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.nlt_text: I have seen your salvation,

verses.kjv_text: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.nlt_text: which you have prepared for all people.

verses.kjv_text: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.nlt_text: He is a light to reveal God to the nations, and he is the glory of your people Israel!"

verses.kjv_text: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus' parents were amazed at what was being said about him.

verses.kjv_text: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this {child} is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.nlt_text: Then Simeon blessed them, and he said to Mary, the baby's mother, "This child is destined to cause many in Israel to fall, but he will be a joy to many others. He has been sent as a sign from God, but many will oppose him.

verses.kjv_text: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, the deepest thoughts of many hearts will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your very soul."

verses.kjv_text: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.nlt_text: Anna, a prophet, was also there in the Temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. Her husband died when they had been married only seven years.

verses.kjv_text: And she {was} a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served {God} with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.nlt_text: Then she lived as a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the Temple but stayed there day and night, worshiping God with fasting and prayer.

verses.kjv_text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem. {Jerusalem: or, Israel}
verses.nlt_text: She came along just as Simeon was talking with Mary and Joseph, and she began praising God. She talked about the child to everyone who had been waiting expectantly for God to rescue Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus' parents had fulfilled all the requirements of the law of the Lord, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.nlt_text: There the child grew up healthy and strong. He was filled with wisdom, and God's favor was on him.

verses.kjv_text: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.nlt_text: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover festival.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus was twelve years old, they attended the festival as usual.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not {of it}.
verses.nlt_text: After the celebration was over, they started home to Nazareth, but Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. His parents didn't miss him at first,

verses.kjv_text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among {their} kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.nlt_text: because they assumed he was among the other travelers. But when he didn't show up that evening, they started looking for him among their relatives and friends.

verses.kjv_text: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.nlt_text: When they couldn't find him, they went back to Jerusalem to search for him there.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.nlt_text: Three days later they finally discovered him in the Temple, sitting among the religious teachers, listening to them and asking questions.

verses.kjv_text: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.nlt_text: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

verses.kjv_text: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.nlt_text: His parents didn't know what to think. "Son," his mother said to him, "why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been frantic, searching for you everywhere."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.nlt_text: "But why did you need to search?" he asked. "Didn't you know that I must be in my Father's house?"

verses.kjv_text: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.nlt_text: But they didn't understand what he meant.

verses.kjv_text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.nlt_text: Then he returned to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. And his mother stored all these things in her heart.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man. {stature: or, age}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus grew in wisdom and in stature and in favor with God and all the people.

verses.kjv_text: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene, {tetrarch: or, governor of four provinces}
verses.nlt_text: It was now the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius, the Roman emperor. Pontius Pilate was governor over Judea; Herod Antipas was ruler over Galilee; his brother Philip was ruler over Iturea and Traconitis; Lysanias was ruler over Abilene.

verses.kjv_text: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: Annas and Caiaphas were the high priests. At this time a message from God came to John son of Zechariah, who was living in the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
verses.nlt_text: Then John went from place to place on both sides of the Jordan River, preaching that people should be baptized to show that they had turned to God to receive forgiveness for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.nlt_text: Isaiah had spoken of John when he said, "He is a voice shouting in the wilderness, 'Prepare the way for the LORD's coming! Clear the road for him!

verses.kjv_text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways {shall be} made smooth;
verses.nlt_text: The valleys will be filled, and the mountains and hills made level. The curves will be straightened, and the rough places made smooth.

verses.kjv_text: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.nlt_text: And then all people will see the salvation sent from God.' "

verses.kjv_text: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.nlt_text: When the crowds came to John for baptism, he said, "You brood of snakes! Who warned you to flee God's coming wrath?

verses.kjv_text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to {our} father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham. {worthy of: or, meet for}
verses.nlt_text: Prove by the way you live that you have repented of your sins and turned to God. Don't just say to each other, 'We're safe, for we are descendants of Abraham.' That means nothing, for I tell you, God can create children of Abraham from these very stones.

verses.kjv_text: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.nlt_text: Even now the ax of God's judgment is poised, ready to sever the roots of the trees. Yes, every tree that does not produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into the fire."

verses.kjv_text: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.nlt_text: The crowds asked, "What should we do?"

verses.kjv_text: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.nlt_text: John replied, "If you have two shirts, give one to the poor. If you have food, share it with those who are hungry."

verses.kjv_text: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.nlt_text: Even corrupt tax collectors came to be baptized and asked, "Teacher, what should we do?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "Collect no more taxes than the government requires."

verses.kjv_text: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse {any} falsely; and be content with your wages. {Do violence...: or, Put no man in fear} {wages: or, allowance}
verses.nlt_text: "What should we do?" asked some soldiers.John replied, "Don't extort money or make false accusations. And be content with your pay."

verses.kjv_text: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not; {in expectation: or, in suspense} {mused: or, reasoned, or, debated}
verses.nlt_text: Everyone was expecting the Messiah to come soon, and they were eager to know whether John might be the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: John answered, saying unto {them} all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.nlt_text: John answered their questions by saying, "I baptize you with water; but someone is coming soon who is greater than I am-- so much greater that I'm not even worthy to be his slave and untie the straps of his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

verses.kjv_text: Whose fan {is} in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.nlt_text: He is ready to separate the chaff from the wheat with his winnowing fork. Then he will clean up the threshing area, gathering the wheat into his barn but burning the chaff with never-ending fire."

verses.kjv_text: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.nlt_text: John used many such warnings as he announced the Good News to the people.

verses.kjv_text: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.nlt_text: John also publicly criticized Herod Antipas, the ruler of Galilee, for marrying Herodias, his brother's wife, and for many other wrongs he had done.

verses.kjv_text: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.nlt_text: So Herod put John in prison, adding this sin to his many others.

verses.kjv_text: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.nlt_text: One day when the crowds were being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. As he was praying, the heavens opened,

verses.kjv_text: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.nlt_text: and the Holy Spirit, in bodily form, descended on him like a dove. And a voice from heaven said, "You are my dearly loved Son, and you bring me great joy. "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was {the son} of Heli,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus was about thirty years old when he began his public ministry. Jesus was known as the son of Joseph. Joseph was the son of Heli.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Matthat, which was {the son} of Levi, which was {the son} of Melchi, which was {the son} of Janna, which was {the son} of Joseph,
verses.nlt_text: Heli was the son of Matthat. Matthat was the son of Levi. Levi was the son of Melki. Melki was the son of Jannai. Jannai was the son of Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Mattathias, which was {the son} of Amos, which was {the son} of Naum, which was {the son} of Esli, which was {the son} of Nagge,
verses.nlt_text: Joseph was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Amos. Amos was the son of Nahum. Nahum was the son of Esli. Esli was the son of Naggai.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Maath, which was {the son} of Mattathias, which was {the son} of Semei, which was {the son} of Joseph, which was {the son} of Juda,
verses.nlt_text: Naggai was the son of Maath. Maath was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Semein. Semein was the son of Josech. Josech was the son of Joda.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Joanna, which was {the son} of Rhesa, which was {the son} of Zorobabel, which was {the son} of Salathiel, which was {the son} of Neri,
verses.nlt_text: Joda was the son of Joanan. Joanan was the son of Rhesa. Rhesa was the son of Zerubbabel. Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the son of Neri.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Melchi, which was {the son} of Addi, which was {the son} of Cosam, which was {the son} of Elmodam, which was {the son} of Er,
verses.nlt_text: Neri was the son of Melki. Melki was the son of Addi. Addi was the son of Cosam. Cosam was the son of Elmadam. Elmadam was the son of Er.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Jose, which was {the son} of Eliezer, which was {the son} of Jorim, which was {the son} of Matthat, which was {the son} of Levi,
verses.nlt_text: Er was the son of Joshua. Joshua was the son of Eliezer. Eliezer was the son of Jorim. Jorim was the son of Matthat. Matthat was the son of Levi.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Simeon, which was {the son} of Juda, which was {the son} of Joseph, which was {the son} of Jonan, which was {the son} of Eliakim,
verses.nlt_text: Levi was the son of Simeon. Simeon was the son of Judah. Judah was the son of Joseph. Joseph was the son of Jonam. Jonam was the son of Eliakim.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Melea, which was {the son} of Menan, which was {the son} of Mattatha, which was {the son} of Nathan, which was {the son} of David,
verses.nlt_text: Eliakim was the son of Melea. Melea was the son of Menna. Menna was the son of Mattatha. Mattatha was the son of Nathan. Nathan was the son of David.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Jesse, which was {the son} of Obed, which was {the son} of Booz, which was {the son} of Salmon, which was {the son} of Naasson,
verses.nlt_text: David was the son of Jesse. Jesse was the son of Obed. Obed was the son of Boaz. Boaz was the son of Salmon. Salmon was the son of Nahshon.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Aminadab, which was {the son} of Aram, which was {the son} of Esrom, which was {the son} of Phares, which was {the son} of Juda,
verses.nlt_text: Nahshon was the son of Amminadab. Amminadab was the son of Admin. Admin was the son of Arni. Arni was the son of Hezron. Hezron was the son of Perez. Perez was the son of Judah.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Jacob, which was {the son} of Isaac, which was {the son} of Abraham, which was {the son} of Thara, which was {the son} of Nachor,
verses.nlt_text: Judah was the son of Jacob. Jacob was the son of Isaac. Isaac was the son of Abraham. Abraham was the son of Terah. Terah was the son of Nahor.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Saruch, which was {the son} of Ragau, which was {the son} of Phalec, which was {the son} of Heber, which was {the son} of Sala,
verses.nlt_text: Nahor was the son of Serug. Serug was the son of Reu. Reu was the son of Peleg. Peleg was the son of Eber. Eber was the son of Shelah.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Cainan, which was {the son} of Arphaxad, which was {the son} of Sem, which was {the son} of Noe, which was {the son} of Lamech,
verses.nlt_text: Shelah was the son of Cainan. Cainan was the son of Arphaxad. Arphaxad was the son of Shem. Shem was the son of Noah. Noah was the son of Lamech.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Mathusala, which was {the son} of Enoch, which was {the son} of Jared, which was {the son} of Maleleel, which was {the son} of Cainan,
verses.nlt_text: Lamech was the son of Methuselah. Methuselah was the son of Enoch. Enoch was the son of Jared. Jared was the son of Mahalalel. Mahalalel was the son of Kenan.

verses.kjv_text: Which was {the son} of Enos, which was {the son} of Seth, which was {the son} of Adam, which was {the son} of God.
verses.nlt_text: Kenan was the son of Enosh. Enosh was the son of Seth. Seth was the son of Adam. Adam was the son of God.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan River. He was led by the Spirit in the wilderness,

verses.kjv_text: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.nlt_text: where he was tempted by the devil for forty days. Jesus ate nothing all that time and became very hungry.

verses.kjv_text: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.nlt_text: Then the devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, change this stone into a loaf of bread."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus told him, "No! The Scriptures say, 'People do not live by bread alone.' "

verses.kjv_text: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.nlt_text: Then the devil took him up and revealed to him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

verses.kjv_text: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.nlt_text: "I will give you the glory of these kingdoms and authority over them," the devil said, "because they are mine to give to anyone I please.

verses.kjv_text: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine. {worship me: or, fall down before me}
verses.nlt_text: I will give it all to you if you will worship me."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "The Scriptures say, 'You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
verses.nlt_text: Then the devil took him to Jerusalem, to the highest point of the Temple, and said, "If you are the Son of God, jump off!

verses.kjv_text: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures say, 'He will order his angels to protect and guard you.

verses.kjv_text: And in {their} hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.nlt_text: And they will hold you up with their hands so you won't even hurt your foot on a stone.' "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "The Scriptures also say, 'You must not test the Lord your God.' "

verses.kjv_text: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.nlt_text: When the devil had finished tempting Jesus, he left him until the next opportunity came.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus returned to Galilee, filled with the Holy Spirit's power. Reports about him spread quickly through the whole region.

verses.kjv_text: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.nlt_text: He taught regularly in their synagogues and was praised by everyone.

verses.kjv_text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.nlt_text: When he came to the village of Nazareth, his boyhood home, he went as usual to the synagogue on the Sabbath and stood up to read the Scriptures.

verses.kjv_text: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
verses.nlt_text: The scroll of Isaiah the prophet was handed to him. He unrolled the scroll and found the place where this was written:

verses.kjv_text: The Spirit of the Lord {is} upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.nlt_text: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, for he has anointed me to bring Good News to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim that captives will be released, that the blind will see, that the oppressed will be set free,

verses.kjv_text: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: and that the time of the Lord's favor has come. "

verses.kjv_text: And he closed the book, and he gave {it} again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.nlt_text: He rolled up the scroll, handed it back to the attendant, and sat down. All eyes in the synagogue looked at him intently.

verses.kjv_text: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.nlt_text: Then he began to speak to them. "The Scripture you've just heard has been fulfilled this very day!"

verses.kjv_text: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
verses.nlt_text: Everyone spoke well of him and was amazed by the gracious words that came from his lips. "How can this be?" they asked. "Isn't this Joseph's son?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "You will undoubtedly quote me this proverb: 'Physician, heal yourself'-- meaning, 'Do miracles here in your hometown like those you did in Capernaum.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.nlt_text: But I tell you the truth, no prophet is accepted in his own hometown.

verses.kjv_text: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.nlt_text: "Certainly there were many needy widows in Israel in Elijah's time, when the heavens were closed for three and a half years, and a severe famine devastated the land.

verses.kjv_text: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, {a city} of Sidon, unto a woman {that was} a widow.
verses.nlt_text: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them. He was sent instead to a foreigner-- a widow of Zarephath in the land of Sidon.

verses.kjv_text: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.nlt_text: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of the prophet Elisha, but the only one healed was Naaman, a Syrian."

verses.kjv_text: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.nlt_text: When they heard this, the people in the synagogue were furious.

verses.kjv_text: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong. {brow: or, edge}
verses.nlt_text: Jumping up, they mobbed him and forced him to the edge of the hill on which the town was built. They intended to push him over the cliff,

verses.kjv_text: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
verses.nlt_text: but he passed right through the crowd and went on his way.

verses.kjv_text: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus went to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and taught there in the synagogue every Sabbath day.

verses.kjv_text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.nlt_text: There, too, the people were amazed at his teaching, for he spoke with authority.

verses.kjv_text: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.nlt_text: Once when he was in the synagogue, a man possessed by a demon-- an evil spirit-- began shouting at Jesus,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Let {us} alone; what have we to do with thee, {thou} Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God. {Let...: or, Away}
verses.nlt_text: "Go away! Why are you interfering with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are-- the Holy One sent from God!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus cut him short. "Be quiet! Come out of the man," he ordered. At that, the demon threw the man to the floor as the crowd watched; then it came out of him without hurting him further.

verses.kjv_text: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word {is} this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.nlt_text: Amazed, the people exclaimed, "What authority and power this man's words possess! Even evil spirits obey him, and they flee at his command!"

verses.kjv_text: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.nlt_text: The news about Jesus spread through every village in the entire region.

verses.kjv_text: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.nlt_text: After leaving the synagogue that day, Jesus went to Simon's home, where he found Simon's mother-in-law very sick with a high fever. "Please heal her," everyone begged.

verses.kjv_text: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Standing at her bedside, he rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and prepared a meal for them.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.nlt_text: As the sun went down that evening, people throughout the village brought sick family members to Jesus. No matter what their diseases were, the touch of his hand healed every one.

verses.kjv_text: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking {them} suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ. {to speak...: or, to say that they knew him to be Christ}
verses.nlt_text: Many were possessed by demons; and the demons came out at his command, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But because they knew he was the Messiah, he rebuked them and refused to let them speak.

verses.kjv_text: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.nlt_text: Early the next morning Jesus went out to an isolated place. The crowds searched everywhere for him, and when they finally found him, they begged him not to leave them.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.nlt_text: But he replied, "I must preach the Good News of the Kingdom of God in other towns, too, because that is why I was sent."

verses.kjv_text: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: So he continued to travel around, preaching in synagogues throughout Judea.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.nlt_text: One day as Jesus was preaching on the shore of the Sea of Galilee, great crowds pressed in on him to listen to the word of God.

verses.kjv_text: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing {their} nets.
verses.nlt_text: He noticed two empty boats at the water's edge, for the fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
