verses.kjv_text: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.nlt_text: Stepping into one of the boats, Jesus asked Simon, its owner, to push it out into the water. So he sat in the boat and taught the crowds from there.

verses.kjv_text: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.nlt_text: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Now go out where it is deeper, and let down your nets to catch some fish."

verses.kjv_text: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.nlt_text: "Master," Simon replied, "we worked hard all last night and didn't catch a thing. But if you say so, I'll let the nets down again."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.nlt_text: And this time their nets were so full of fish they began to tear!

verses.kjv_text: And they beckoned unto {their} partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.nlt_text: A shout for help brought their partners in the other boat, and soon both boats were filled with fish and on the verge of sinking.

verses.kjv_text: When Simon Peter saw {it}, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.nlt_text: When Simon Peter realized what had happened, he fell to his knees before Jesus and said, "Oh, Lord, please leave me-- I'm too much of a sinner to be around you."

verses.kjv_text: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.nlt_text: For he was awestruck by the number of fish they had caught, as were the others with him.

verses.kjv_text: And so {was} also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.nlt_text: His partners, James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were also amazed.Jesus replied to Simon, "Don't be afraid! From now on you'll be fishing for people!"

verses.kjv_text: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.nlt_text: And as soon as they landed, they left everything and followed Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on {his} face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.nlt_text: In one of the villages, Jesus met a man with an advanced case of leprosy. When the man saw Jesus, he bowed with his face to the ground, begging to be healed. "Lord," he said, "if you are willing, you can heal me and make me clean."

verses.kjv_text: And he put forth {his} hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus reached out and touched him. "I am willing," he said. "Be healed!" And instantly the leprosy disappeared.

verses.kjv_text: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus instructed him not to tell anyone what had happened. He said, "Go to the priest and let him examine you. Take along the offering required in the law of Moses for those who have been healed of leprosy. This will be a public testimony that you have been cleansed."

verses.kjv_text: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.nlt_text: But despite Jesus' instructions, the report of his power spread even faster, and vast crowds came to hear him preach and to be healed of their diseases.

verses.kjv_text: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus often withdrew to the wilderness for prayer.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was {present} to heal them.
verses.nlt_text: One day while Jesus was teaching, some Pharisees and teachers of religious law were sitting nearby. (It seemed that these men showed up from every village in all Galilee and Judea, as well as from Jerusalem.) And the Lord's healing power was strongly with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought {means} to bring him in, and to lay {him} before him.
verses.nlt_text: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a sleeping mat. They tried to take him inside to Jesus,

verses.kjv_text: And when they could not find by what {way} they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with {his} couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: but they couldn't reach him because of the crowd. So they went up to the roof and took off some tiles. Then they lowered the sick man on his mat down into the crowd, right in front of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.nlt_text: Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the man, "Young man, your sins are forgiven."

verses.kjv_text: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.nlt_text: But the Pharisees and teachers of religious law said to themselves, "Who does he think he is? That's blasphemy! Only God can forgive sins!"

verses.kjv_text: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he asked them, "Why do you question this in your hearts?

verses.kjv_text: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.nlt_text: Is it easier to say 'Your sins are forgiven,' or 'Stand up and walk'?

verses.kjv_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.nlt_text: So I will prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins." Then Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said, "Stand up, pick up your mat, and go home!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.nlt_text: And immediately, as everyone watched, the man jumped up, picked up his mat, and went home praising God.

verses.kjv_text: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone was gripped with great wonder and awe, and they praised God, exclaiming, "We have seen amazing things today!"

verses.kjv_text: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Later, as Jesus left the town, he saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at his tax collector's booth. "Follow me and be my disciple," Jesus said to him.

verses.kjv_text: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.nlt_text: So Levi got up, left everything, and followed him.

verses.kjv_text: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.nlt_text: Later, Levi held a banquet in his home with Jesus as the guest of honor. Many of Levi's fellow tax collectors and other guests also ate with them.

verses.kjv_text: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.nlt_text: But the Pharisees and their teachers of religious law complained bitterly to Jesus' disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with such scum? "

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus answered them, "Healthy people don't need a doctor-- sick people do.

verses.kjv_text: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.nlt_text: I have come to call not those who think they are righteous, but those who know they are sinners and need to repent."

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise {the disciples} of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.nlt_text: One day some people said to Jesus, "John the Baptist's disciples fast and pray regularly, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees. Why are your disciples always eating and drinking?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "Do wedding guests fast while celebrating with the groom? Of course not.

verses.kjv_text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.nlt_text: But someday the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast."

verses.kjv_text: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was {taken} out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus gave them this illustration: "No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and uses it to patch an old garment. For then the new garment would be ruined, and the new patch wouldn't even match the old garment.

verses.kjv_text: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.nlt_text: "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. For the new wine would burst the wineskins, spilling the wine and ruining the skins.

verses.kjv_text: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.nlt_text: New wine must be stored in new wineskins.

verses.kjv_text: No man also having drunk old {wine} straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.nlt_text: But no one who drinks the old wine seems to want the new wine. 'The old is just fine,' they say."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing {them} in {their} hands.
verses.nlt_text: One Sabbath day as Jesus was walking through some grainfields, his disciples broke off heads of grain, rubbed off the husks in their hands, and ate the grain.

verses.kjv_text: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.nlt_text: But some Pharisees said, "Why are you breaking the law by harvesting grain on the Sabbath?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Haven't you read in the Scriptures what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

verses.kjv_text: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.nlt_text: He went into the house of God and broke the law by eating the sacred loaves of bread that only the priests can eat. He also gave some to his companions."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus added, "The Son of Man is Lord, even over the Sabbath."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.nlt_text: On another Sabbath day, a man with a deformed right hand was in the synagogue while Jesus was teaching.

verses.kjv_text: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.nlt_text: The teachers of religious law and the Pharisees watched Jesus closely. If he healed the man's hand, they planned to accuse him of working on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv_text: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus knew their thoughts. He said to the man with the deformed hand, "Come and stand in front of everyone." So the man came forward.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy {it}?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to his critics, "I have a question for you. Does the law permit good deeds on the Sabbath, or is it a day for doing evil? Is this a day to save life or to destroy it?"

verses.kjv_text: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.nlt_text: He looked around at them one by one and then said to the man, "Hold out your hand." So the man held out his hand, and it was restored!

verses.kjv_text: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: At this, the enemies of Jesus were wild with rage and began to discuss what to do with him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.nlt_text: One day soon afterward Jesus went up on a mountain to pray, and he prayed to God all night.

verses.kjv_text: And when it was day, he called {unto him} his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.nlt_text: At daybreak he called together all of his disciples and chose twelve of them to be apostles. Here are their names:

verses.kjv_text: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.nlt_text: Simon (whom he named Peter), Andrew (Peter's brother), James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,

verses.kjv_text: Matthew and Thomas, James the {son} of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.nlt_text: Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon (who was called the zealot),

verses.kjv_text: And Judas {the brother} of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.nlt_text: Judas (son of James), Judas Iscariot (who later betrayed him).

verses.kjv_text: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.nlt_text: When they came down from the mountain, the disciples stood with Jesus on a large, level area, surrounded by many of his followers and by the crowds. There were people from all over Judea and from Jerusalem and from as far north as the seacoasts of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.kjv_text: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.nlt_text: They had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases; and Jesus also cast out many evil spirits.

verses.kjv_text: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed {them} all.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone tried to touch him, because healing power went out from him, and he healed everyone.

verses.kjv_text: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed {be ye} poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus turned to his disciples and said, "God blesses you who are poor, for the Kingdom of God is yours.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {are ye} that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed {are ye} that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.nlt_text: God blesses you who are hungry now, for you will be satisfied. God blesses you who weep now, for in due time you will laugh.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you {from their company}, and shall reproach {you}, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.nlt_text: What blessings await you when people hate you and exclude you and mock you and curse you as evil because you follow the Son of Man.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward {is} great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: When that happens, be happy! Yes, leap for joy! For a great reward awaits you in heaven. And remember, their ancestors treated the ancient prophets that same way.

verses.kjv_text: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you who are rich, for you have your only happiness now.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits you who are fat and prosperous now, for a time of awful hunger awaits you. What sorrow awaits you who laugh now, for your laughing will turn to mourning and sorrow.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits you who are praised by the crowds, for their ancestors also praised false prophets.

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.nlt_text: "But to you who are willing to listen, I say, love your enemies! Do good to those who hate you.

verses.kjv_text: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.nlt_text: Bless those who curse you. Pray for those who hurt you.

verses.kjv_text: And unto him that smiteth thee on the {one} cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not {to take thy} coat also.
verses.nlt_text: If someone slaps you on one cheek, offer the other cheek also. If someone demands your coat, offer your shirt also.

verses.kjv_text: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask {them} not again.
verses.nlt_text: Give to anyone who asks; and when things are taken away from you, don't try to get them back.

verses.kjv_text: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.nlt_text: Do to others as you would like them to do to you.

verses.kjv_text: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.nlt_text: "If you love only those who love you, why should you get credit for that? Even sinners love those who love them!

verses.kjv_text: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.nlt_text: And if you do good only to those who do good to you, why should you get credit? Even sinners do that much!

verses.kjv_text: And if ye lend {to them} of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.nlt_text: And if you lend money only to those who can repay you, why should you get credit? Even sinners will lend to other sinners for a full return.

verses.kjv_text: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and {to} the evil.
verses.nlt_text: "Love your enemies! Do good to them. Lend to them without expecting to be repaid. Then your reward from heaven will be very great, and you will truly be acting as children of the Most High, for he is kind to those who are unthankful and wicked.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.nlt_text: You must be compassionate, just as your Father is compassionate.

verses.kjv_text: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.nlt_text: "Do not judge others, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn others, or it will all come back against you. Forgive others, and you will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.nlt_text: Give, and you will receive. Your gift will return to you in full-- pressed down, shaken together to make room for more, running over, and poured into your lap. The amount you give will determine the amount you get back. "

verses.kjv_text: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus gave the following illustration: "Can one blind person lead another? Won't they both fall into a ditch?

verses.kjv_text: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master. {that...: or, shall be perfected as his master}
verses.nlt_text: Students are not greater than their teacher. But the student who is fully trained will become like the teacher.

verses.kjv_text: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.nlt_text: "And why worry about a speck in your friend's eye when you have a log in your own?

verses.kjv_text: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.nlt_text: How can you think of saying, 'Friend, let me help you get rid of that speck in your eye,' when you can't see past the log in your own eye? Hypocrite! First get rid of the log in your own eye; then you will see well enough to deal with the speck in your friend's eye.

verses.kjv_text: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.nlt_text: "A good tree can't produce bad fruit, and a bad tree can't produce good fruit.

verses.kjv_text: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes. {grapes: Gr. a grape}
verses.nlt_text: A tree is identified by its fruit. Figs never grow on thornbushes, nor grapes on bramble bushes.

verses.kjv_text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.nlt_text: A good person produces good things from the treasury of a good heart, and an evil person produces evil things from the treasury of an evil heart. What you say flows from what is in your heart.

verses.kjv_text: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.nlt_text: "So why do you keep calling me 'Lord, Lord!' when you don't do what I say?

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.nlt_text: I will show you what it's like when someone comes to me, listens to my teaching, and then follows it.

verses.kjv_text: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.nlt_text: It is like a person building a house who digs deep and lays the foundation on solid rock. When the floodwaters rise and break against the house, it stands firm because it is well built.

verses.kjv_text: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.nlt_text: But anyone who hears and doesn't obey is like a person who builds a house without a foundation. When the floods sweep down against that house, it will collapse into a heap of ruins."

verses.kjv_text: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people, he returned to Capernaum.

verses.kjv_text: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.nlt_text: At that time the highly valued slave of a Roman officer was sick and near death.

verses.kjv_text: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.nlt_text: When the officer heard about Jesus, he sent some respected Jewish elders to ask him to come and heal his slave.

verses.kjv_text: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.nlt_text: So they earnestly begged Jesus to help the man. "If anyone deserves your help, he does," they said,

verses.kjv_text: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.nlt_text: "for he loves the Jewish people and even built a synagogue for us."

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus went with them. But just before they arrived at the house, the officer sent some friends to say, "Lord, don't trouble yourself by coming to my home, for I am not worthy of such an honor.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.nlt_text: I am not even worthy to come and meet you. Just say the word from where you are, and my servant will be healed.

verses.kjv_text: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth {it}. {one: Gr. this man}
verses.nlt_text: I know this because I am under the authority of my superior officers, and I have authority over my soldiers. I only need to say, 'Go,' and they go, or 'Come,' and they come. And if I say to my slaves, 'Do this,' they do it."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. Turning to the crowd that was following him, he said, "I tell you, I haven't seen faith like this in all Israel!"

verses.kjv_text: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.nlt_text: And when the officer's friends returned to his house, they found the slave completely healed.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.nlt_text: Soon afterward Jesus went with his disciples to the village of Nain, and a large crowd followed him.

verses.kjv_text: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.nlt_text: A funeral procession was coming out as he approached the village gate. The young man who had died was a widow's only son, and a large crowd from the village was with her.

verses.kjv_text: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.nlt_text: When the Lord saw her, his heart overflowed with compassion. "Don't cry!" he said.

verses.kjv_text: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare {him} stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise. {bier: or, coffin}
verses.nlt_text: Then he walked over to the coffin and touched it, and the bearers stopped. "Young man," he said, "I tell you, get up."

verses.kjv_text: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.nlt_text: Then the dead boy sat up and began to talk! And Jesus gave him back to his mother.

verses.kjv_text: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.nlt_text: Great fear swept the crowd, and they praised God, saying, "A mighty prophet has risen among us," and "God has visited his people today."

verses.kjv_text: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.nlt_text: And the news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding countryside.

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples of John the Baptist told John about everything Jesus was doing. So John called for two of his disciples,

verses.kjv_text: And John calling {unto him} two of his disciples sent {them} to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.nlt_text: and he sent them to the Lord to ask him, "Are you the Messiah we've been expecting, or should we keep looking for someone else?"

verses.kjv_text: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.nlt_text: John's two disciples found Jesus and said to him, "John the Baptist sent us to ask, 'Are you the Messiah we've been expecting, or should we keep looking for someone else?'"

verses.kjv_text: And in that same hour he cured many of {their} infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many {that were} blind he gave sight.
verses.nlt_text: At that very time, Jesus cured many people of their diseases and illnesses, and he cast out evil spirits and restored sight to many who were blind.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.nlt_text: Then he told John's disciples, "Go back to John and tell him what you have seen and heard-- the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised to life, and the Good News is being preached to the poor.

verses.kjv_text: And blessed is {he}, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.nlt_text: And tell him, 'God blesses those who do not turn away because of me. ' "

verses.kjv_text: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.nlt_text: After John's disciples left, Jesus began talking about him to the crowds. "What kind of man did you go into the wilderness to see? Was he a weak reed, swayed by every breath of wind?

verses.kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.nlt_text: Or were you expecting to see a man dressed in expensive clothes? No, people who wear beautiful clothes and live in luxury are found in palaces.

verses.kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: Were you looking for a prophet? Yes, and he is more than a prophet.

verses.kjv_text: This is {he}, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.nlt_text: John is the man to whom the Scriptures refer when they say, 'Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, and he will prepare your way before you.'

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, of all who have ever lived, none is greater than John. Yet even the least person in the Kingdom of God is greater than he is!"

verses.kjv_text: And all the people that heard {him}, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.nlt_text: When they heard this, all the people-- even the tax collectors-- agreed that God's way was right, for they had been baptized by John.

verses.kjv_text: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him. {rejected: or, frustrated} {against...: or, within themselves}
verses.nlt_text: But the Pharisees and experts in religious law rejected God's plan for them, for they had refused John's baptism.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.nlt_text: "To what can I compare the people of this generation?" Jesus asked. "How can I describe them?

verses.kjv_text: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.nlt_text: They are like children playing a game in the public square. They complain to their friends, 'We played wedding songs, and you didn't dance, so we played funeral songs, and you didn't weep.'

verses.kjv_text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.nlt_text: For John the Baptist didn't spend his time eating bread or drinking wine, and you say, 'He's possessed by a demon.'

verses.kjv_text: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.nlt_text: The Son of Man, on the other hand, feasts and drinks, and you say, 'He's a glutton and a drunkard, and a friend of tax collectors and other sinners!'

verses.kjv_text: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.nlt_text: But wisdom is shown to be right by the lives of those who follow it. "

verses.kjv_text: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.nlt_text: One of the Pharisees asked Jesus to have dinner with him, so Jesus went to his home and sat down to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that {Jesus} sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.nlt_text: When a certain immoral woman from that city heard he was eating there, she brought a beautiful alabaster jar filled with expensive perfume.

verses.kjv_text: And stood at his feet behind {him} weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe {them} with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed {them} with the ointment.
verses.nlt_text: Then she knelt behind him at his feet, weeping. Her tears fell on his feet, and she wiped them off with her hair. Then she kept kissing his feet and putting perfume on them.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw {it}, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman {this is} that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.nlt_text: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him. She's a sinner!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus answered his thoughts. "Simon," he said to the Pharisee, "I have something to say to you." "Go ahead, Teacher," Simon replied.

verses.kjv_text: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told him this story: "A man loaned money to two people-- 500 pieces of silver to one and 50 pieces to the other.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.nlt_text: But neither of them could repay him, so he kindly forgave them both, canceling their debts. Who do you suppose loved him more after that?"

verses.kjv_text: Simon answered and said, I suppose that {he}, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.nlt_text: Simon answered, "I suppose the one for whom he canceled the larger debt." "That's right," Jesus said.

verses.kjv_text: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped {them} with the hairs of her head.
verses.nlt_text: Then he turned to the woman and said to Simon, "Look at this woman kneeling here. When I entered your home, you didn't offer me water to wash the dust from my feet, but she has washed them with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

verses.kjv_text: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.nlt_text: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I first came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.

verses.kjv_text: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.nlt_text: You neglected the courtesy of olive oil to anoint my head, but she has anointed my feet with rare perfume.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, {the same} loveth little.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you, her sins-- and they are many-- have been forgiven, so she has shown me much love. But a person who is forgiven little shows only little love."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to the woman, "Your sins are forgiven."

verses.kjv_text: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.nlt_text: The men at the table said among themselves, "Who is this man, that he goes around forgiving sins?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve {were} with him,
verses.nlt_text: Soon afterward Jesus began a tour of the nearby towns and villages, preaching and announcing the Good News about the Kingdom of God. He took his twelve disciples with him,

verses.kjv_text: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.nlt_text: along with some women he had healed and from whom he had cast out evil spirits. Among them were Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons;

verses.kjv_text: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.nlt_text: Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's business manager; Susanna; and many others who were contributing their own resources to support Jesus and his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus told a story to a large crowd that had gathered from many towns to hear him:

verses.kjv_text: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.nlt_text: "A farmer went out to plant his seed. As he scattered it across his field, some seed fell on a footpath, where it was stepped on, and the birds ate it.

verses.kjv_text: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.nlt_text: Other seed fell among rocks. It began to grow, but the plant soon wilted and died for lack of moisture.

verses.kjv_text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.nlt_text: Other seed fell among thorns that grew up with it and choked out the tender plants.

verses.kjv_text: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Still other seed fell on fertile soil. This seed grew and produced a crop that was a hundred times as much as had been planted!" When he had said this, he called out, "Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.nlt_text: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "You are permitted to understand the secrets of the Kingdom of God. But I use parables to teach the others so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled: 'When they look, they won't really see. When they hear, they won't understand.'

verses.kjv_text: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.nlt_text: "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is God's word.

verses.kjv_text: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.nlt_text: The seeds that fell on the footpath represent those who hear the message, only to have the devil come and take it away from their hearts and prevent them from believing and being saved.

verses.kjv_text: They on the rock {are they}, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.nlt_text: The seeds on the rocky soil represent those who hear the message and receive it with joy. But since they don't have deep roots, they believe for a while, then they fall away when they face temptation.

verses.kjv_text: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of {this} life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.nlt_text: The seeds that fell among the thorns represent those who hear the message, but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the cares and riches and pleasures of this life. And so they never grow into maturity.

verses.kjv_text: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep {it}, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.nlt_text: And the seeds that fell on the good soil represent honest, good-hearted people who hear God's word, cling to it, and patiently produce a huge harvest.

verses.kjv_text: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth {it} under a bed; but setteth {it} on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.nlt_text: "No one lights a lamp and then covers it with a bowl or hides it under a bed. A lamp is placed on a stand, where its light can be seen by all who enter the house.

verses.kjv_text: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither {any thing} hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.nlt_text: For all that is secret will eventually be brought into the open, and everything that is concealed will be brought to light and made known to all.

verses.kjv_text: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have. {seemeth...: or, thinketh that he hath}
verses.nlt_text: "So pay attention to how you hear. To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given. But for those who are not listening, even what they think they understand will be taken away from them."

verses.kjv_text: Then came to him {his} mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus' mother and brothers came to see him, but they couldn't get to him because of the crowd.

verses.kjv_text: And it was told him {by certain} which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.nlt_text: Someone told Jesus, "Your mother and your brothers are outside, and they want to see you."

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "My mother and my brothers are all those who hear God's word and obey it."

verses.kjv_text: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "Let's cross to the other side of the lake." So they got into a boat and started out.

verses.kjv_text: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled {with water}, and were in jeopardy.
verses.nlt_text: As they sailed across, Jesus settled down for a nap. But soon a fierce storm came down on the lake. The boat was filling with water, and they were in real danger.

verses.kjv_text: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples went and woke him up, shouting, "Master, Master, we're going to drown!" When Jesus woke up, he rebuked the wind and the raging waves. The storm stopped and all was calm!

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.nlt_text: Then he asked them, "Where is your faith?" The disciples were terrified and amazed. "Who is this man?" they asked each other. "When he gives a command, even the wind and waves obey him!"

verses.kjv_text: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: So they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in {any} house, but in the tombs.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was climbing out of the boat, a man who was possessed by demons came out to meet him. For a long time he had been homeless and naked, living in a cemetery outside the town.

verses.kjv_text: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, {thou} Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.nlt_text: As soon as he saw Jesus, he shrieked and fell down in front of him. Then he screamed, "Why are you interfering with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Please, I beg you, don't torture me!"

verses.kjv_text: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.nlt_text: For Jesus had already commanded the evil spirit to come out of him. This spirit had often taken control of the man. Even when he was placed under guard and put in chains and shackles, he simply broke them and rushed out into the wilderness, completely under the demon's power.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus demanded, "What is your name?" "Legion," he replied, for he was filled with many demons.

verses.kjv_text: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.nlt_text: The demons kept begging Jesus not to send them into the bottomless pit.

verses.kjv_text: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.nlt_text: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding on the hillside nearby, and the demons begged him to let them enter into the pigs.So Jesus gave them permission.

verses.kjv_text: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.nlt_text: Then the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the entire herd plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned.

verses.kjv_text: When they that fed {them} saw what was done, they fled, and went and told {it} in the city and in the country.
verses.nlt_text: When the herdsmen saw it, they fled to the nearby town and the surrounding countryside, spreading the news as they ran.

verses.kjv_text: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.nlt_text: People rushed out to see what had happened. A crowd soon gathered around Jesus, and they saw the man who had been freed from the demons. He was sitting at Jesus' feet, fully clothed and perfectly sane, and they were all afraid.

verses.kjv_text: They also which saw {it} told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.nlt_text: Then those who had seen what happened told the others how the demon-possessed man had been healed.

verses.kjv_text: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
verses.nlt_text: And all the people in the region of the Gerasenes begged Jesus to go away and leave them alone, for a great wave of fear swept over them.So Jesus returned to the boat and left, crossing back to the other side of the lake.

verses.kjv_text: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.nlt_text: The man who had been freed from the demons begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him home, saying,

verses.kjv_text: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
verses.nlt_text: "No, go back to your family, and tell them everything God has done for you." So he went all through the town proclaiming the great things Jesus had done for him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people {gladly} received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.nlt_text: On the other side of the lake the crowds welcomed Jesus, because they had been waiting for him.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
verses.nlt_text: Then a man named Jairus, a leader of the local synagogue, came and fell at Jesus' feet, pleading with him to come home with him.

verses.kjv_text: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.nlt_text: His only daughter, who was twelve years old, was dying.As Jesus went with him, he was surrounded by the crowds.

verses.kjv_text: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.nlt_text: A woman in the crowd had suffered for twelve years with constant bleeding, and she could find no cure.

verses.kjv_text: Came behind {him}, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verses.nlt_text: Coming up behind Jesus, she touched the fringe of his robe. Immediately, the bleeding stopped.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press {thee}, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.nlt_text: "Who touched me?" Jesus asked.Everyone denied it, and Peter said, "Master, this whole crowd is pressing up against you."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "Someone deliberately touched me, for I felt healing power go out from me."

verses.kjv_text: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.nlt_text: When the woman realized that she could not stay hidden, she began to tremble and fell to her knees before him. The whole crowd heard her explain why she had touched him and that she had been immediately healed.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.nlt_text: "Daughter," he said to her, "your faith has made you well. Go in peace."

verses.kjv_text: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's {house}, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.nlt_text: While he was still speaking to her, a messenger arrived from the home of Jairus, the leader of the synagogue. He told him, "Your daughter is dead. There's no use troubling the Teacher now."

verses.kjv_text: But when Jesus heard {it}, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.nlt_text: But when Jesus heard what had happened, he said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid. Just have faith, and she will be healed."

verses.kjv_text: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.nlt_text: When they arrived at the house, Jesus wouldn't let anyone go in with him except Peter, John, James, and the little girl's father and mother.

verses.kjv_text: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.nlt_text: The house was filled with people weeping and wailing, but he said, "Stop the weeping! She isn't dead; she's only asleep."

verses.kjv_text: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.nlt_text: But the crowd laughed at him because they all knew she had died.

verses.kjv_text: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus took her by the hand and said in a loud voice, "My child, get up!"

verses.kjv_text: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.nlt_text: And at that moment her life returned, and she immediately stood up! Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

verses.kjv_text: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.nlt_text: Her parents were overwhelmed, but Jesus insisted that they not tell anyone what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus called together his twelve disciples and gave them power and authority to cast out demons and to heal all diseases.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.nlt_text: Then he sent them out to tell everyone about the Kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Take nothing for {your} journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.nlt_text: "Take nothing for your journey," he instructed them. "Don't take a walking stick, a traveler's bag, food, money, or even a change of clothes.

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.nlt_text: Wherever you go, stay in the same house until you leave town.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.nlt_text: And if a town refuses to welcome you, shake its dust from your feet as you leave to show that you have abandoned those people to their fate."

verses.kjv_text: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.nlt_text: So they began their circuit of the villages, preaching the Good News and healing the sick.

verses.kjv_text: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.nlt_text: When Herod Antipas, the ruler of Galilee, heard about everything Jesus was doing, he was puzzled. Some were saying that John the Baptist had been raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.nlt_text: Others thought Jesus was Elijah or one of the other prophets risen from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.nlt_text: "I beheaded John," Herod said, "so who is this man about whom I hear such stories?" And he kept trying to see him.

verses.kjv_text: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.nlt_text: When the apostles returned, they told Jesus everything they had done. Then he slipped quietly away with them toward the town of Bethsaida.

verses.kjv_text: And the people, when they knew {it}, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.nlt_text: But the crowds found out where he was going, and they followed him. He welcomed them and taught them about the Kingdom of God, and he healed those who were sick.

verses.kjv_text: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.nlt_text: Late in the afternoon the twelve disciples came to him and said, "Send the crowds away to the nearby villages and farms, so they can find food and lodging for the night. There is nothing to eat here in this remote place."

verses.kjv_text: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "You feed them." "But we have only five loaves of bread and two fish," they answered. "Or are you expecting us to go and buy enough food for this whole crowd?"

verses.kjv_text: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.nlt_text: For there were about 5,000 men there.Jesus replied, "Tell them to sit down in groups of about fifty each."

verses.kjv_text: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.nlt_text: So the people all sat down.

verses.kjv_text: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up toward heaven, and blessed them. Then, breaking the loaves into pieces, he kept giving the bread and fish to the disciples so they could distribute it to the people.

verses.kjv_text: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.nlt_text: They all ate as much as they wanted, and afterward, the disciples picked up twelve baskets of leftovers!

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus left the crowds to pray alone. Only his disciples were with him, and he asked them, "Who do people say I am?"

verses.kjv_text: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some {say}, Elias; and others {say}, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.nlt_text: "Well," they replied, "some say John the Baptist, some say Elijah, and others say you are one of the other ancient prophets risen from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then he asked them, "But who do you say I am?" Peter replied, "You are the Messiah sent from God!"

verses.kjv_text: And he straitly charged them, and commanded {them} to tell no man that thing;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus warned his disciples not to tell anyone who he was.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.nlt_text: "The Son of Man must suffer many terrible things," he said. "He will be rejected by the elders, the leading priests, and the teachers of religious law. He will be killed, but on the third day he will be raised from the dead."

verses.kjv_text: And he said to {them} all, If any {man} will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to the crowd, "If any of you wants to be my follower, you must turn from your selfish ways, take up your cross daily, and follow me.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.nlt_text: If you try to hang on to your life, you will lose it. But if you give up your life for my sake, you will save it.

verses.kjv_text: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.nlt_text: And what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but are yourself lost or destroyed?

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and {in his} Father's, and of the holy angels.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone is ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of that person when he returns in his glory and in the glory of the Father and the holy angels.

verses.kjv_text: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, some standing here right now will not die before they see the Kingdom of God."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray. {sayings: or, things}
verses.nlt_text: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John up on a mountain to pray.

verses.kjv_text: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment {was} white {and} glistering.
verses.nlt_text: And as he was praying, the appearance of his face was transformed, and his clothes became dazzling white.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
verses.nlt_text: Then two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared and began talking with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: They were glorious to see. And they were speaking about his exodus from this world, which was about to be fulfilled in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.nlt_text: Peter and the others had fallen asleep. When they woke up, they saw Jesus' glory and the two men standing with him.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
verses.nlt_text: As Moses and Elijah were starting to leave, Peter, not even knowing what he was saying, blurted out, "Master, it's wonderful for us to be here! Let's make three shelters as memorials-- one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

verses.kjv_text: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.nlt_text: But even as he was saying this, a cloud came over them, and terror gripped them as the cloud covered them.

verses.kjv_text: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.nlt_text: Then a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, my Chosen One. Listen to him."

verses.kjv_text: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept {it} close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
verses.nlt_text: When the voice finished, Jesus was there alone. They didn't tell anyone at that time what they had seen.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
verses.nlt_text: The next day, after they had come down the mountain, a large crowd met Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
verses.nlt_text: A man in the crowd called out to him, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, my only child.

verses.kjv_text: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
verses.nlt_text: An evil spirit keeps seizing him, making him scream. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It batters him and hardly ever leaves him alone.

verses.kjv_text: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
verses.nlt_text: I begged your disciples to cast out the spirit, but they couldn't do it."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
verses.nlt_text: "You faithless and corrupt people," Jesus said, "how long must I be with you and put up with you?" Then he said to the man, "Bring your son here."

verses.kjv_text: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare {him}. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
verses.nlt_text: As the boy came forward, the demon knocked him to the ground and threw him into a violent convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the evil spirit and healed the boy. Then he gave him back to his father.

verses.kjv_text: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: Awe gripped the people as they saw this majestic display of God's power. While everyone was marveling at everything he was doing, Jesus said to his disciples,

verses.kjv_text: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
verses.nlt_text: "Listen to me and remember what I say. The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of his enemies."

verses.kjv_text: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
verses.nlt_text: But they didn't know what he meant. Its significance was hidden from them, so they couldn't understand it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.

verses.kjv_text: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
verses.nlt_text: Then his disciples began arguing about which of them was the greatest.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus knew their thoughts, so he brought a little child to his side.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to them, "Anyone who welcomes a little child like this on my behalf welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me also welcomes my Father who sent me. Whoever is the least among you is the greatest."

verses.kjv_text: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.nlt_text: John said to Jesus, "Master, we saw someone using your name to cast out demons, but we told him to stop because he isn't in our group."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid {him} not: for he that is not against us is for us.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "Don't stop him! Anyone who is not against you is for you."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.nlt_text: As the time drew near for him to ascend to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.nlt_text: He sent messengers ahead to a Samaritan village to prepare for his arrival.

verses.kjv_text: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: But the people of the village did not welcome Jesus because he was on his way to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And when his disciples James and John saw {this}, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
verses.nlt_text: When James and John saw this, they said to Jesus, "Lord, should we call down fire from heaven to burn them up?"

verses.kjv_text: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.

verses.kjv_text: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save {them}. And they went to another village.
verses.nlt_text: So they went on to another village.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain {man} said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.nlt_text: As they were walking along, someone said to Jesus, "I will follow you wherever you go."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air {have} nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay {his} head.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "Foxes have dens to live in, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place even to lay his head."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.nlt_text: He said to another person, "Come, follow me." The man agreed, but he said, "Lord, first let me return home and bury my father."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus told him, "Let the spiritually dead bury their own dead! Your duty is to go and preach about the Kingdom of God."

verses.kjv_text: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
verses.nlt_text: Another said, "Yes, Lord, I will follow you, but first let me say good-bye to my family."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus told him, "Anyone who puts a hand to the plow and then looks back is not fit for the Kingdom of God."

verses.kjv_text: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
verses.nlt_text: The Lord now chose seventy-two other disciples and sent them ahead in pairs to all the towns and places he planned to visit.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly {is} great, but the labourers {are} few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.nlt_text: These were his instructions to them: "The harvest is great, but the workers are few. So pray to the Lord who is in charge of the harvest; ask him to send more workers into his fields.

verses.kjv_text: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
verses.nlt_text: Now go, and remember that I am sending you out as lambs among wolves.

verses.kjv_text: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
verses.nlt_text: Don't take any money with you, nor a traveler's bag, nor an extra pair of sandals. And don't stop to greet anyone on the road.

verses.kjv_text: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace {be} to this house.
verses.nlt_text: "Whenever you enter someone's home, first say, 'May God's peace be on this house.'

verses.kjv_text: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.nlt_text: If those who live there are peaceful, the blessing will stand; if they are not, the blessing will return to you.

verses.kjv_text: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.nlt_text: Don't move around from home to home. Stay in one place, eating and drinking what they provide. Don't hesitate to accept hospitality, because those who work deserve their pay.

verses.kjv_text: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.nlt_text: "If you enter a town and it welcomes you, eat whatever is set before you.

verses.kjv_text: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Heal the sick, and tell them, 'The Kingdom of God is near you now.'

verses.kjv_text: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
verses.nlt_text: But if a town refuses to welcome you, go out into its streets and say,

verses.kjv_text: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.nlt_text: 'We wipe even the dust of your town from our feet to show that we have abandoned you to your fate. And know this-- the Kingdom of God is near!'

verses.kjv_text: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.nlt_text: I assure you, even wicked Sodom will be better off than such a town on judgment day.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you, Korazin and Bethsaida! For if the miracles I did in you had been done in wicked Tyre and Sidon, their people would have repented of their sins long ago, clothing themselves in burlap and throwing ashes on their heads to show their remorse.

verses.kjv_text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, Tyre and Sidon will be better off on judgment day than you.

verses.kjv_text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
verses.nlt_text: And you people of Capernaum, will you be honored in heaven? No, you will go down to the place of the dead. "

verses.kjv_text: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to the disciples, "Anyone who accepts your message is also accepting me. And anyone who rejects you is rejecting me. And anyone who rejects me is rejecting God, who sent me."

verses.kjv_text: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
verses.nlt_text: When the seventy-two disciples returned, they joyfully reported to him, "Lord, even the demons obey us when we use your name!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," he told them, "I saw Satan fall from heaven like lightning!

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.nlt_text: Look, I have given you authority over all the power of the enemy, and you can walk among snakes and scorpions and crush them. Nothing will injure you.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: But don't rejoice because evil spirits obey you; rejoice because your names are registered in heaven."

verses.kjv_text: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.nlt_text: At that same time Jesus was filled with the joy of the Holy Spirit, and he said, "O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, thank you for hiding these things from those who think themselves wise and clever, and for revealing them to the childlike. Yes, Father, it pleased you to do it this way.
