verses.kjv_text: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and {he} to whom the Son will reveal {him}. {many ancient copies add these words at the beginning of verse, and turning to his disciples, he said}
verses.nlt_text: "My Father has entrusted everything to me. No one truly knows the Son except the Father, and no one truly knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."

verses.kjv_text: And he turned him unto {his} disciples, and said privately, Blessed {are} the eyes which see the things that ye see:
verses.nlt_text: Then when they were alone, he turned to the disciples and said, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you have seen.

verses.kjv_text: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen {them}; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard {them}.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, many prophets and kings longed to see what you see, but they didn't see it. And they longed to hear what you hear, but they didn't hear it."

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.nlt_text: One day an expert in religious law stood up to test Jesus by asking him this question: "Teacher, what should I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.kjv_text: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "What does the law of Moses say? How do you read it?"

verses.kjv_text: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.nlt_text: The man answered, " 'You must love the LORD your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength, and all your mind.' And, 'Love your neighbor as yourself.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.nlt_text: "Right!" Jesus told him. "Do this and you will live!"

verses.kjv_text: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
verses.nlt_text: The man wanted to justify his actions, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said, A certain {man} went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded {him}, and departed, leaving {him} half dead.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied with a story: "A Jewish man was traveling on a trip from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he was attacked by bandits. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him up, and left him half dead beside the road.

verses.kjv_text: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.nlt_text: "By chance a priest came along. But when he saw the man lying there, he crossed to the other side of the road and passed him by.

verses.kjv_text: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked {on him}, and passed by on the other side.
verses.nlt_text: A Temple assistant walked over and looked at him lying there, but he also passed by on the other side.

verses.kjv_text: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion {on him},
verses.nlt_text: "Then a despised Samaritan came along, and when he saw the man, he felt compassion for him.

verses.kjv_text: And went to {him}, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.nlt_text: Going over to him, the Samaritan soothed his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put the man on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.

verses.kjv_text: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave {them} to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verses.nlt_text: The next day he handed the innkeeper two silver coins, telling him, 'Take care of this man. If his bill runs higher than this, I'll pay you the next time I'm here.'

verses.kjv_text: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.nlt_text: "Now which of these three would you say was a neighbor to the man who was attacked by bandits?" Jesus asked.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.nlt_text: The man replied, "The one who showed him mercy." Then Jesus said, "Yes, now go and do the same."

verses.kjv_text: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus and the disciples continued on their way to Jerusalem, they came to a certain village where a woman named Martha welcomed them into her home.

verses.kjv_text: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
verses.nlt_text: Her sister, Mary, sat at the Lord's feet, listening to what he taught.

verses.kjv_text: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.nlt_text: But Martha was distracted by the big dinner she was preparing. She came to Jesus and said, "Lord, doesn't it seem unfair to you that my sister just sits here while I do all the work? Tell her to come and help me."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
verses.nlt_text: But the Lord said to her, "My dear Martha, you are worried and upset over all these details!

verses.kjv_text: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.nlt_text: There is only one thing worth being concerned about. Mary has discovered it, and it will not be taken away from her."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: Once Jesus was in a certain place praying. As he finished, one of his disciples came to him and said, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "This is how you should pray: "Father, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come soon.

verses.kjv_text: Give us day by day our daily bread. {day by day: or, for the day}
verses.nlt_text: Give us each day the food we need,

verses.kjv_text: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
verses.nlt_text: and forgive us our sins, as we forgive those who sin against us. And don't let us yield to temptation. "

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.nlt_text: Then, teaching them more about prayer, he used this story: "Suppose you went to a friend's house at midnight, wanting to borrow three loaves of bread. You say to him,

verses.kjv_text: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him? {in...: or, out of his way}
verses.nlt_text: 'A friend of mine has just arrived for a visit, and I have nothing for him to eat.'

verses.kjv_text: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
verses.nlt_text: And suppose he calls out from his bedroom, 'Don't bother me. The door is locked for the night, and my family and I are all in bed. I can't help you.'

verses.kjv_text: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.nlt_text: But I tell you this-- though he won't do it for friendship's sake, if you keep knocking long enough, he will get up and give you whatever you need because of your shameless persistence.

verses.kjv_text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.nlt_text: "And so I tell you, keep on asking, and you will receive what you ask for. Keep on seeking, and you will find. Keep on knocking, and the door will be opened to you.

verses.kjv_text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.nlt_text: For everyone who asks, receives. Everyone who seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door will be opened.

verses.kjv_text: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if {he ask} a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.nlt_text: "You fathers-- if your children ask for a fish, do you give them a snake instead?

verses.kjv_text: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion? {offer: Gr. give}
verses.nlt_text: Or if they ask for an egg, do you give them a scorpion? Of course not!

verses.kjv_text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall {your} heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
verses.nlt_text: So if you sinful people know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him."

verses.kjv_text: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus cast out a demon from a man who couldn't speak, and when the demon was gone, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed,

verses.kjv_text: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils. {Beelzebub: Gr. Beelzebul}
verses.nlt_text: but some of them said, "No wonder he can cast out demons. He gets his power from Satan, the prince of demons."

verses.kjv_text: And others, tempting {him}, sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Others, trying to test Jesus, demanded that he show them a miraculous sign from heaven to prove his authority.

verses.kjv_text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house {divided} against a house falleth.
verses.nlt_text: He knew their thoughts, so he said, "Any kingdom divided by civil war is doomed. A family splintered by feuding will fall apart.

verses.kjv_text: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
verses.nlt_text: You say I am empowered by Satan. But if Satan is divided and fighting against himself, how can his kingdom survive?

verses.kjv_text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast {them} out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.nlt_text: And if I am empowered by Satan, what about your own exorcists? They cast out demons, too, so they will condemn you for what you have said.

verses.kjv_text: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
verses.nlt_text: But if I am casting out demons by the power of God, then the Kingdom of God has arrived among you.

verses.kjv_text: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
verses.nlt_text: For when a strong man like Satan is fully armed and guards his palace, his possessions are safe--

verses.kjv_text: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
verses.nlt_text: until someone even stronger attacks and overpowers him, strips him of his weapons, and carries off his belongings.

verses.kjv_text: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone who isn't with me opposes me, and anyone who isn't working with me is actually working against me.

verses.kjv_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
verses.nlt_text: "When an evil spirit leaves a person, it goes into the desert, searching for rest. But when it finds none, it says, 'I will return to the person I came from.'

verses.kjv_text: And when he cometh, he findeth {it} swept and garnished.
verses.nlt_text: So it returns and finds that its former home is all swept and in order.

verses.kjv_text: Then goeth he, and taketh {to him} seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last {state} of that man is worse than the first.
verses.nlt_text: Then the spirit finds seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they all enter the person and live there. And so that person is worse off than before."

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed {is} the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
verses.nlt_text: As he was speaking, a woman in the crowd called out, "God bless your mother-- the womb from which you came, and the breasts that nursed you!"

verses.kjv_text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed {are} they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "But even more blessed are all who hear the word of God and put it into practice."

verses.kjv_text: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verses.nlt_text: As the crowd pressed in on Jesus, he said, "This evil generation keeps asking me to show them a miraculous sign. But the only sign I will give them is the sign of Jonah.

verses.kjv_text: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
verses.nlt_text: What happened to him was a sign to the people of Nineveh that God had sent him. What happens to the Son of Man will be a sign to these people that he was sent by God.

verses.kjv_text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon {is} here.
verses.nlt_text: "The queen of Sheba will stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for she came from a distant land to hear the wisdom of Solomon. Now someone greater than Solomon is here-- but you refuse to listen.

verses.kjv_text: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas {is} here.
verses.nlt_text: The people of Nineveh will also stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for they repented of their sins at the preaching of Jonah. Now someone greater than Jonah is here-- but you refuse to repent.

verses.kjv_text: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth {it} in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
verses.nlt_text: "No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a basket. Instead, a lamp is placed on a stand, where its light can be seen by all who enter the house.

verses.kjv_text: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when {thine eye} is evil, thy body also {is} full of darkness.
verses.nlt_text: "Your eye is a lamp that provides light for your body. When your eye is good, your whole body is filled with light. But when it is bad, your body is filled with darkness.

verses.kjv_text: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
verses.nlt_text: Make sure that the light you think you have is not actually darkness.

verses.kjv_text: If thy whole body therefore {be} full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light. {the bright...: Gr. a candle by its bright shining}
verses.nlt_text: If you are filled with light, with no dark corners, then your whole life will be radiant, as though a floodlight were filling you with light."

verses.kjv_text: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was speaking, one of the Pharisees invited him home for a meal. So he went in and took his place at the table.

verses.kjv_text: And when the Pharisee saw {it}, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
verses.nlt_text: His host was amazed to see that he sat down to eat without first performing the hand-washing ceremony required by Jewish custom.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Lord said to him, "You Pharisees are so careful to clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside you are filthy-- full of greed and wickedness!

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
verses.nlt_text: Fools! Didn't God make the inside as well as the outside?

verses.kjv_text: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you. {of...: or, as you are able}
verses.nlt_text: So clean the inside by giving gifts to the poor, and you will be clean all over.

verses.kjv_text: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you Pharisees! For you are careful to tithe even the tiniest income from your herb gardens, but you ignore justice and the love of God. You should tithe, yes, but do not neglect the more important things.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you Pharisees! For you love to sit in the seats of honor in the synagogues and receive respectful greetings as you walk in the marketplaces.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over {them} are not aware {of them}.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, what sorrow awaits you! For you are like hidden graves in a field. People walk over them without knowing the corruption they are stepping on."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher," said an expert in religious law, "you have insulted us, too, in what you just said."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Woe unto you also, {ye} lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," said Jesus, "what sorrow also awaits you experts in religious law! For you crush people with impossible religious demands, and you never lift a finger to ease the burden.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits you! For you build monuments for the prophets your own ancestors killed long ago.

verses.kjv_text: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
verses.nlt_text: But in fact, you stand as witnesses who agree with what your ancestors did. They killed the prophets, and you join in their crime by building the monuments!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and {some} of them they shall slay and persecute:
verses.nlt_text: This is what God in his wisdom said about you: 'I will send prophets and apostles to them, but they will kill some and persecute the others.'

verses.kjv_text: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.nlt_text: "As a result, this generation will be held responsible for the murder of all God's prophets from the creation of the world--

verses.kjv_text: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
verses.nlt_text: from the murder of Abel to the murder of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, it will certainly be charged against this generation.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered. {hindered: or, forbad}
verses.nlt_text: "What sorrow awaits you experts in religious law! For you remove the key to knowledge from the people. You don't enter the Kingdom yourselves, and you prevent others from entering."

verses.kjv_text: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge {him} vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was leaving, the teachers of religious law and the Pharisees became hostile and tried to provoke him with many questions.

verses.kjv_text: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
verses.nlt_text: They wanted to trap him into saying something they could use against him.

verses.kjv_text: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the crowds grew until thousands were milling about and stepping on each other. Jesus turned first to his disciples and warned them, "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees-- their hypocrisy.

verses.kjv_text: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
verses.nlt_text: The time is coming when everything that is covered up will be revealed, and all that is secret will be made known to all.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.nlt_text: Whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have whispered behind closed doors will be shouted from the housetops for all to hear!

verses.kjv_text: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.nlt_text: "Dear friends, don't be afraid of those who want to kill your body; they cannot do any more to you after that.

verses.kjv_text: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.nlt_text: But I'll tell you whom to fear. Fear God, who has the power to kill you and then throw you into hell. Yes, he's the one to fear.

verses.kjv_text: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
verses.nlt_text: "What is the price of five sparrows-- two copper coins? Yet God does not forget a single one of them.

verses.kjv_text: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.nlt_text: And the very hairs on your head are all numbered. So don't be afraid; you are more valuable to God than a whole flock of sparrows.

verses.kjv_text: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, everyone who acknowledges me publicly here on earth, the Son of Man will also acknowledge in the presence of God's angels.

verses.kjv_text: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
verses.nlt_text: But anyone who denies me here on earth will be denied before God's angels.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man can be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and {unto} magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
verses.nlt_text: "And when you are brought to trial in the synagogues and before rulers and authorities, don't worry about how to defend yourself or what to say,

verses.kjv_text: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
verses.nlt_text: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what needs to be said."

verses.kjv_text: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
verses.nlt_text: Then someone called from the crowd, "Teacher, please tell my brother to divide our father's estate with me."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Friend, who made me a judge over you to decide such things as that?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Beware! Guard against every kind of greed. Life is not measured by how much you own."

verses.kjv_text: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.nlt_text: Then he told them a story: "A rich man had a fertile farm that produced fine crops.

verses.kjv_text: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
verses.nlt_text: He said to himself, 'What should I do? I don't have room for all my crops.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, 'I know! I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones. Then I'll have room enough to store all my wheat and other goods.

verses.kjv_text: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, {and} be merry.
verses.nlt_text: And I'll sit back and say to myself, "My friend, you have enough stored away for years to come. Now take it easy! Eat, drink, and be merry!"'

verses.kjv_text: But God said unto him, {Thou} fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided? {thy...: Gr. do they require thy soul}
verses.nlt_text: "But God said to him, 'You fool! You will die this very night. Then who will get everything you worked for?'

verses.kjv_text: So {is} he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, a person is a fool to store up earthly wealth but not have a rich relationship with God."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
verses.nlt_text: Then, turning to his disciples, Jesus said, "That is why I tell you not to worry about everyday life-- whether you have enough food to eat or enough clothes to wear.

verses.kjv_text: The life is more than meat, and the body {is more} than raiment.
verses.nlt_text: For life is more than food, and your body more than clothing.

verses.kjv_text: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verses.nlt_text: Look at the ravens. They don't plant or harvest or store food in barns, for God feeds them. And you are far more valuable to him than any birds!

verses.kjv_text: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
verses.nlt_text: Can all your worries add a single moment to your life?

verses.kjv_text: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
verses.nlt_text: And if worry can't accomplish a little thing like that, what's the use of worrying over bigger things?

verses.kjv_text: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.nlt_text: "Look at the lilies and how they grow. They don't work or make their clothing, yet Solomon in all his glory was not dressed as beautifully as they are.

verses.kjv_text: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more {will he clothe} you, O ye of little faith?
verses.nlt_text: And if God cares so wonderfully for flowers that are here today and thrown into the fire tomorrow, he will certainly care for you. Why do you have so little faith?

verses.kjv_text: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind. {neither...: or, live not in careful suspense}
verses.nlt_text: "And don't be concerned about what to eat and what to drink. Don't worry about such things.

verses.kjv_text: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
verses.nlt_text: These things dominate the thoughts of unbelievers all over the world, but your Father already knows your needs.

verses.kjv_text: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Seek the Kingdom of God above all else, and he will give you everything you need.

verses.kjv_text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: "So don't be afraid, little flock. For it gives your Father great happiness to give you the Kingdom.

verses.kjv_text: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
verses.nlt_text: "Sell your possessions and give to those in need. This will store up treasure for you in heaven! And the purses of heaven never get old or develop holes. Your treasure will be safe; no thief can steal it and no moth can destroy it.

verses.kjv_text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.nlt_text: Wherever your treasure is, there the desires of your heart will also be.

verses.kjv_text: Let your loins be girded about, and {your} lights burning;
verses.nlt_text: "Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning,

verses.kjv_text: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
verses.nlt_text: as though you were waiting for your master to return from the wedding feast. Then you will be ready to open the door and let him in the moment he arrives and knocks.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {are} those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
verses.nlt_text: The servants who are ready and waiting for his return will be rewarded. I tell you the truth, he himself will seat them, put on an apron, and serve them as they sit and eat!

verses.kjv_text: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find {them} so, blessed are those servants.
verses.nlt_text: He may come in the middle of the night or just before dawn. But whenever he comes, he will reward the servants who are ready.

verses.kjv_text: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.nlt_text: "Understand this: If a homeowner knew exactly when a burglar was coming, he would not permit his house to be broken into.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
verses.nlt_text: You also must be ready all the time, for the Son of Man will come when least expected."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.nlt_text: Peter asked, "Lord, is that illustration just for us or for everyone?"

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom {his} lord shall make ruler over his household, to give {them their} portion of meat in due season?
verses.nlt_text: And the Lord replied, "A faithful, sensible servant is one to whom the master can give the responsibility of managing his other household servants and feeding them.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {is} that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.nlt_text: If the master returns and finds that the servant has done a good job, there will be a reward.

verses.kjv_text: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, the master will put that servant in charge of all he owns.

verses.kjv_text: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.nlt_text: But what if the servant thinks, 'My master won't be back for a while,' and he begins beating the other servants, partying, and getting drunk?

verses.kjv_text: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for {him}, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers. {cut...: or, cut him off}
verses.nlt_text: The master will return unannounced and unexpected, and he will cut the servant in pieces and banish him with the unfaithful.

verses.kjv_text: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not {himself}, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many {stripes}.
verses.nlt_text: "And a servant who knows what the master wants, but isn't prepared and doesn't carry out those instructions, will be severely punished.

verses.kjv_text: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few {stripes}. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verses.nlt_text: But someone who does not know, and then does something wrong, will be punished only lightly. When someone has been given much, much will be required in return; and when someone has been entrusted with much, even more will be required.

verses.kjv_text: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
verses.nlt_text: "I have come to set the world on fire, and I wish it were already burning!

verses.kjv_text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished! {straitened: or, pained}
verses.nlt_text: I have a terrible baptism of suffering ahead of me, and I am under a heavy burden until it is accomplished.

verses.kjv_text: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.nlt_text: Do you think I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I have come to divide people against each other!

verses.kjv_text: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.nlt_text: From now on families will be split apart, three in favor of me, and two against-- or two in favor and three against.

verses.kjv_text: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.nlt_text: 'Father will be divided against son and son against father; mother against daughter and daughter against mother; and mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus turned to the crowd and said, "When you see clouds beginning to form in the west, you say, 'Here comes a shower.' And you are right.

verses.kjv_text: And when {ye see} the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
verses.nlt_text: When the south wind blows, you say, 'Today will be a scorcher.' And it is.

verses.kjv_text: {Ye} hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
verses.nlt_text: You fools! You know how to interpret the weather signs of the earth and sky, but you don't know how to interpret the present times.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.nlt_text: "Why can't you decide for yourselves what is right?

verses.kjv_text: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, {as thou art} in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
verses.nlt_text: When you are on the way to court with your accuser, try to settle the matter before you get there. Otherwise, your accuser may drag you before the judge, who will hand you over to an officer, who will throw you into prison.

verses.kjv_text: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
verses.nlt_text: And if that happens, you won't be free again until you have paid the very last penny. "

verses.kjv_text: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.nlt_text: About this time Jesus was informed that Pilate had murdered some people from Galilee as they were offering sacrifices at the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
verses.nlt_text: "Do you think those Galileans were worse sinners than all the other people from Galilee?" Jesus asked. "Is that why they suffered?

verses.kjv_text: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.nlt_text: Not at all! And you will perish, too, unless you repent of your sins and turn to God.

verses.kjv_text: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem? {sinners: or, debtors}
verses.nlt_text: And what about the eighteen people who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them? Were they the worst sinners in Jerusalem?

verses.kjv_text: He spake also this parable; A certain {man} had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told this story: "A man planted a fig tree in his garden and came again and again to see if there was any fruit on it, but he was always disappointed.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
verses.nlt_text: Finally, he said to his gardener, 'I've waited three years, and there hasn't been a single fig! Cut it down. It's just taking up space in the garden.'

verses.kjv_text: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung {it}:
verses.nlt_text: "The gardener answered, 'Sir, give it one more chance. Leave it another year, and I'll give it special attention and plenty of fertilizer.

verses.kjv_text: And if it bear fruit, {well}: and if not, {then} after that thou shalt cut it down.
verses.nlt_text: If we get figs next year, fine. If not, then you can cut it down.'"

verses.kjv_text: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
verses.nlt_text: One Sabbath day as Jesus was teaching in a synagogue,

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up {herself}.
verses.nlt_text: he saw a woman who had been crippled by an evil spirit. She had been bent double for eighteen years and was unable to stand up straight.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus saw her, he called {her to him}, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said, "Dear woman, you are healed of your sickness!"

verses.kjv_text: And he laid {his} hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.nlt_text: Then he touched her, and instantly she could stand straight. How she praised God!

verses.kjv_text: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
verses.nlt_text: But the leader in charge of the synagogue was indignant that Jesus had healed her on the Sabbath day. "There are six days of the week for working," he said to the crowd. "Come on those days to be healed, not on the Sabbath."

verses.kjv_text: The Lord then answered him, and said, {Thou} hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or {his} ass from the stall, and lead {him} away to watering?
verses.nlt_text: But the Lord replied, "You hypocrites! Each of you works on the Sabbath day! Don't you untie your ox or your donkey from its stall on the Sabbath and lead it out for water?

verses.kjv_text: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
verses.nlt_text: This dear woman, a daughter of Abraham, has been held in bondage by Satan for eighteen years. Isn't it right that she be released, even on the Sabbath?"

verses.kjv_text: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.nlt_text: This shamed his enemies, but all the people rejoiced at the wonderful things he did.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said, "What is the Kingdom of God like? How can I illustrate it?

verses.kjv_text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
verses.nlt_text: It is like a tiny mustard seed that a man planted in a garden; it grows and becomes a tree, and the birds make nests in its branches."

verses.kjv_text: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.nlt_text: He also asked, "What else is the Kingdom of God like?

verses.kjv_text: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.nlt_text: It is like the yeast a woman used in making bread. Even though she put only a little yeast in three measures of flour, it permeated every part of the dough."

verses.kjv_text: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he went, always pressing on toward Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
verses.nlt_text: Someone asked him, "Lord, will only a few be saved?" He replied,

verses.kjv_text: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.nlt_text: "Work hard to enter the narrow door to God's Kingdom, for many will try to enter but will fail.

verses.kjv_text: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
verses.nlt_text: When the master of the house has locked the door, it will be too late. You will stand outside knocking and pleading, 'Lord, open the door for us!' But he will reply, 'I don't know you or where you come from.'

verses.kjv_text: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will say, 'But we ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.'

verses.kjv_text: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all {ye} workers of iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: And he will reply, 'I tell you, I don't know you or where you come from. Get away from me, all you who do evil.'

verses.kjv_text: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you {yourselves} thrust out.
verses.nlt_text: "There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, for you will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the Kingdom of God, but you will be thrown out.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall come from the east, and {from} the west, and from the north, and {from} the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: And people will come from all over the world-- from east and west, north and south-- to take their places in the Kingdom of God.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
verses.nlt_text: And note this: Some who seem least important now will be the greatest then, and some who are the greatest now will be least important then. "

verses.kjv_text: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
verses.nlt_text: At that time some Pharisees said to him, "Get away from here if you want to live! Herod Antipas wants to kill you!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third {day} I shall be perfected.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Go tell that fox that I will keep on casting out demons and healing people today and tomorrow; and the third day I will accomplish my purpose.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the {day} following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, today, tomorrow, and the next day I must proceed on my way. For it wouldn't do for a prophet of God to be killed except in Jerusalem!

verses.kjv_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen {doth gather} her brood under {her} wings, and ye would not!
verses.nlt_text: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones God's messengers! How often I have wanted to gather your children together as a hen protects her chicks beneath her wings, but you wouldn't let me.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until {the time} come when ye shall say, Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: And now, look, your house is abandoned. And you will never see me again until you say, 'Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord!' "

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
verses.nlt_text: One Sabbath day Jesus went to eat dinner in the home of a leader of the Pharisees, and the people were watching him closely.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
verses.nlt_text: There was a man there whose arms and legs were swollen.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in religious law, "Is it permitted in the law to heal people on the Sabbath day, or not?"

verses.kjv_text: And they held their peace. And he took {him}, and healed him, and let him go;
verses.nlt_text: When they refused to answer, Jesus touched the sick man and healed him and sent him away.

verses.kjv_text: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
verses.nlt_text: Then he turned to them and said, "Which of you doesn't work on the Sabbath? If your son or your cow falls into a pit, don't you rush to get him out?"

verses.kjv_text: And they could not answer him again to these things.
verses.nlt_text: Again they could not answer.

verses.kjv_text: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus noticed that all who had come to the dinner were trying to sit in the seats of honor near the head of the table, he gave them this advice:

verses.kjv_text: When thou art bidden of any {man} to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
verses.nlt_text: "When you are invited to a wedding feast, don't sit in the seat of honor. What if someone who is more distinguished than you has also been invited?

verses.kjv_text: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
verses.nlt_text: The host will come and say, 'Give this person your seat.' Then you will be embarrassed, and you will have to take whatever seat is left at the foot of the table!

verses.kjv_text: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
verses.nlt_text: "Instead, take the lowest place at the foot of the table. Then when your host sees you, he will come and say, 'Friend, we have a better place for you!' Then you will be honored in front of all the other guests.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.nlt_text: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."

verses.kjv_text: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor {thy} rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then he turned to his host. "When you put on a luncheon or a banquet," he said, "don't invite your friends, brothers, relatives, and rich neighbors. For they will invite you back, and that will be your only reward.

verses.kjv_text: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.nlt_text: Instead, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind.

verses.kjv_text: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
verses.nlt_text: Then at the resurrection of the righteous, God will reward you for inviting those who could not repay you."

verses.kjv_text: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed {is} he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: Hearing this, a man sitting at the table with Jesus exclaimed, "What a blessing it will be to attend a banquet in the Kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied with this story: "A man prepared a great feast and sent out many invitations.

verses.kjv_text: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
verses.nlt_text: When the banquet was ready, he sent his servant to tell the guests, 'Come, the banquet is ready.'

verses.kjv_text: And they all with one {consent} began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.nlt_text: But they all began making excuses. One said, 'I have just bought a field and must inspect it. Please excuse me.'

verses.kjv_text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.nlt_text: Another said, 'I have just bought five pairs of oxen, and I want to try them out. Please excuse me.'

verses.kjv_text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.nlt_text: Another said, 'I now have a wife, so I can't come.'

verses.kjv_text: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
verses.nlt_text: "The servant returned and told his master what they had said. His master was furious and said, 'Go quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and invite the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.'

verses.kjv_text: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
verses.nlt_text: After the servant had done this, he reported, 'There is still room for more.'

verses.kjv_text: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel {them} to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.nlt_text: So his master said, 'Go out into the country lanes and behind the hedges and urge anyone you find to come, so that the house will be full.

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
verses.nlt_text: For none of those I first invited will get even the smallest taste of my banquet.'"

verses.kjv_text: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
verses.nlt_text: A large crowd was following Jesus. He turned around and said to them,

verses.kjv_text: If any {man} come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.nlt_text: "If you want to be my disciple, you must hate everyone else by comparison-- your father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters-- yes, even your own life. Otherwise, you cannot be my disciple.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
verses.nlt_text: And if you do not carry your own cross and follow me, you cannot be my disciple.

verses.kjv_text: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have {sufficient} to finish {it}?
verses.nlt_text: "But don't begin until you count the cost. For who would begin construction of a building without first calculating the cost to see if there is enough money to finish it?

verses.kjv_text: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish {it}, all that behold {it} begin to mock him,
verses.nlt_text: Otherwise, you might complete only the foundation before running out of money, and then everyone would laugh at you.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
verses.nlt_text: They would say, 'There's the person who started that building and couldn't afford to finish it!'

verses.kjv_text: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
verses.nlt_text: "Or what king would go to war against another king without first sitting down with his counselors to discuss whether his army of 10,000 could defeat the 20,000 soldiers marching against him?

verses.kjv_text: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
verses.nlt_text: And if he can't, he will send a delegation to discuss terms of peace while the enemy is still far away.

verses.kjv_text: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.nlt_text: So you cannot become my disciple without giving up everything you own.

verses.kjv_text: Salt {is} good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
verses.nlt_text: "Salt is good for seasoning. But if it loses its flavor, how do you make it salty again?

verses.kjv_text: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; {but} men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.nlt_text: Flavorless salt is good neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown away. Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand!"

verses.kjv_text: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
verses.nlt_text: Tax collectors and other notorious sinners often came to listen to Jesus teach.

verses.kjv_text: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
verses.nlt_text: This made the Pharisees and teachers of religious law complain that he was associating with such sinful people-- even eating with them!

verses.kjv_text: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus told them this story:

verses.kjv_text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verses.nlt_text: "If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them gets lost, what will he do? Won't he leave the ninety-nine others in the wilderness and go to search for the one that is lost until he finds it?

verses.kjv_text: And when he hath found {it}, he layeth {it} on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.nlt_text: And when he has found it, he will joyfully carry it home on his shoulders.

verses.kjv_text: And when he cometh home, he calleth together {his} friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.nlt_text: When he arrives, he will call together his friends and neighbors, saying, 'Rejoice with me because I have found my lost sheep.'

verses.kjv_text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, there is more joy in heaven over one lost sinner who repents and returns to God than over ninety-nine others who are righteous and haven't strayed away!

verses.kjv_text: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find {it}? {pieces...: drachma, here translated a piece of silver, is the eighth part of an ounce, which cometh to seven pence halfpenny, and is equal to the Roman penny}
verses.nlt_text: "Or suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Won't she light a lamp and sweep the entire house and search carefully until she finds it?

verses.kjv_text: And when she hath found {it}, she calleth {her} friends and {her} neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.nlt_text: And when she finds it, she will call in her friends and neighbors and say, 'Rejoice with me because I have found my lost coin.'

verses.kjv_text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, there is joy in the presence of God's angels when even one sinner repents."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
verses.nlt_text: To illustrate the point further, Jesus told them this story: "A man had two sons.

verses.kjv_text: And the younger of them said to {his} father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth {to me}. And he divided unto them {his} living.
verses.nlt_text: The younger son told his father, 'I want my share of your estate now before you die.' So his father agreed to divide his wealth between his sons.

verses.kjv_text: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.nlt_text: "A few days later this younger son packed all his belongings and moved to a distant land, and there he wasted all his money in wild living.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.nlt_text: About the time his money ran out, a great famine swept over the land, and he began to starve.

verses.kjv_text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.nlt_text: He persuaded a local farmer to hire him, and the man sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.

verses.kjv_text: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.nlt_text: The young man became so hungry that even the pods he was feeding the pigs looked good to him. But no one gave him anything.

verses.kjv_text: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.nlt_text: "When he finally came to his senses, he said to himself, 'At home even the hired servants have food enough to spare, and here I am dying of hunger!

verses.kjv_text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.nlt_text: I will go home to my father and say, "Father, I have sinned against both heaven and you,

verses.kjv_text: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
verses.nlt_text: and I am no longer worthy of being called your son. Please take me on as a hired servant."'

verses.kjv_text: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.nlt_text: "So he returned home to his father. And while he was still a long way off, his father saw him coming. Filled with love and compassion, he ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.

verses.kjv_text: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
verses.nlt_text: His son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against both heaven and you, and I am no longer worthy of being called your son. '

verses.kjv_text: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put {it} on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on {his} feet:
verses.nlt_text: "But his father said to the servants, 'Quick! Bring the finest robe in the house and put it on him. Get a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet.

verses.kjv_text: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill {it}; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.nlt_text: And kill the calf we have been fattening. We must celebrate with a feast,

verses.kjv_text: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
verses.nlt_text: for this son of mine was dead and has now returned to life. He was lost, but now he is found.' So the party began.

verses.kjv_text: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
verses.nlt_text: "Meanwhile, the older son was in the fields working. When he returned home, he heard music and dancing in the house,

verses.kjv_text: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
verses.nlt_text: and he asked one of the servants what was going on.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
verses.nlt_text: 'Your brother is back,' he was told, 'and your father has killed the fattened calf. We are celebrating because of his safe return.'

verses.kjv_text: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
verses.nlt_text: "The older brother was angry and wouldn't go in. His father came out and begged him,

verses.kjv_text: And he answering said to {his} father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
verses.nlt_text: but he replied, 'All these years I've slaved for you and never once refused to do a single thing you told me to. And in all that time you never gave me even one young goat for a feast with my friends.

verses.kjv_text: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
verses.nlt_text: Yet when this son of yours comes back after squandering your money on prostitutes, you celebrate by killing the fattened calf!'

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
verses.nlt_text: "His father said to him, 'Look, dear son, you have always stayed by me, and everything I have is yours.

verses.kjv_text: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verses.nlt_text: We had to celebrate this happy day. For your brother was dead and has come back to life! He was lost, but now he is found!'"

verses.kjv_text: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told this story to his disciples: "There was a certain rich man who had a manager handling his affairs. One day a report came that the manager was wasting his employer's money.

verses.kjv_text: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
verses.nlt_text: So the employer called him in and said, 'What's this I hear about you? Get your report in order, because you are going to be fired.'

verses.kjv_text: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
verses.nlt_text: "The manager thought to himself, 'Now what? My boss has fired me. I don't have the strength to dig ditches, and I'm too proud to beg.

verses.kjv_text: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
verses.nlt_text: Ah, I know how to ensure that I'll have plenty of friends who will give me a home when I am fired.'

verses.kjv_text: So he called every one of his lord's debtors {unto him}, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
verses.nlt_text: "So he invited each person who owed money to his employer to come and discuss the situation. He asked the first one, 'How much do you owe him?'

verses.kjv_text: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty. {measures: the word Batus in the original containeth nine gallons three quarts}
verses.nlt_text: The man replied, 'I owe him 800 gallons of olive oil.' So the manager told him, 'Take the bill and quickly change it to 400 gallons. '

verses.kjv_text: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore. {measures: the word here interpreted a measure in the original containeth about fourteen bushels and two quarts}
verses.nlt_text: " 'And how much do you owe my employer?' he asked the next man. 'I owe him 1,000 bushels of wheat,' was the reply. 'Here,' the manager said, 'take the bill and change it to 800 bushels. '

verses.kjv_text: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
verses.nlt_text: "The rich man had to admire the dishonest rascal for being so shrewd. And it is true that the children of this world are more shrewd in dealing with the world around them than are the children of the light.

verses.kjv_text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations. {mammon: or, riches}
verses.nlt_text: Here's the lesson: Use your worldly resources to benefit others and make friends. Then, when your earthly possessions are gone, they will welcome you to an eternal home.

verses.kjv_text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
verses.nlt_text: "If you are faithful in little things, you will be faithful in large ones. But if you are dishonest in little things, you won't be honest with greater responsibilities.

verses.kjv_text: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true {riches}? {mammon: or, riches}
verses.nlt_text: And if you are untrustworthy about worldly wealth, who will trust you with the true riches of heaven?

verses.kjv_text: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
verses.nlt_text: And if you are not faithful with other people's things, why should you be trusted with things of your own?

verses.kjv_text: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.nlt_text: "No one can serve two masters. For you will hate one and love the other; you will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money."

verses.kjv_text: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
verses.nlt_text: The Pharisees, who dearly loved their money, heard all this and scoffed at him.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to them, "You like to appear righteous in public, but God knows your hearts. What this world honors is detestable in the sight of God.

verses.kjv_text: The law and the prophets {were} until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
verses.nlt_text: "Until John the Baptist, the law of Moses and the messages of the prophets were your guides. But now the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is eager to get in.

verses.kjv_text: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
verses.nlt_text: But that doesn't mean that the law has lost its force. It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the smallest point of God's law to be overturned.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from {her} husband committeth adultery.
verses.nlt_text: "For example, a man who divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery. And anyone who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery."

verses.kjv_text: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "There was a certain rich man who was splendidly clothed in purple and fine linen and who lived each day in luxury.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.nlt_text: At his gate lay a poor man named Lazarus who was covered with sores.

verses.kjv_text: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.nlt_text: As Lazarus lay there longing for scraps from the rich man's table, the dogs would come and lick his open sores.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
verses.nlt_text: "Finally, the poor man died and was carried by the angels to be with Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried,

verses.kjv_text: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.nlt_text: and his soul went to the place of the dead. There, in torment, he saw Abraham in the far distance with Lazarus at his side.

verses.kjv_text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
verses.nlt_text: "The rich man shouted, 'Father Abraham, have some pity! Send Lazarus over here to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. I am in anguish in these flames.'

verses.kjv_text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
verses.nlt_text: "But Abraham said to him, 'Son, remember that during your lifetime you had everything you wanted, and Lazarus had nothing. So now he is here being comforted, and you are in anguish.

verses.kjv_text: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that {would come} from thence.
verses.nlt_text: And besides, there is a great chasm separating us. No one can cross over to you from here, and no one can cross over to us from there.'

verses.kjv_text: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
verses.nlt_text: "Then the rich man said, 'Please, Father Abraham, at least send him to my father's home.

verses.kjv_text: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
verses.nlt_text: For I have five brothers, and I want him to warn them so they don't end up in this place of torment.'

verses.kjv_text: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
verses.nlt_text: "But Abraham said, 'Moses and the prophets have warned them. Your brothers can read what they wrote.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
verses.nlt_text: "The rich man replied, 'No, Father Abraham! But if someone is sent to them from the dead, then they will repent of their sins and turn to God.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: "But Abraham said, 'If they won't listen to Moses and the prophets, they won't listen even if someone rises from the dead.'"

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe {unto him}, through whom they come!
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "There will always be temptations to sin, but what sorrow awaits the person who does the tempting!

verses.kjv_text: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.nlt_text: It would be better to be thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around your neck than to cause one of these little ones to fall into sin.

verses.kjv_text: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.nlt_text: So watch yourselves!"If another believer sins, rebuke that person; then if there is repentance, forgive.

verses.kjv_text: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.nlt_text: Even if that person wrongs you seven times a day and each time turns again and asks forgiveness, you must forgive."

verses.kjv_text: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.nlt_text: The apostles said to the Lord, "Show us how to increase our faith."

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.nlt_text: The Lord answered, "If you had faith even as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, 'May you be uprooted and thrown into the sea,' and it would obey you!

verses.kjv_text: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.nlt_text: "When a servant comes in from plowing or taking care of sheep, does his master say, 'Come in and eat with me'?

verses.kjv_text: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.nlt_text: No, he says, 'Prepare my meal, put on your apron, and serve me while I eat. Then you can eat later.'

verses.kjv_text: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.nlt_text: And does the master thank the servant for doing what he was told to do? Of course not.

verses.kjv_text: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, when you obey me you should say, 'We are unworthy servants who have simply done our duty.'"

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus continued on toward Jerusalem, he reached the border between Galilee and Samaria.
