verses.kjv_text: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
verses.nlt_text: As he entered a village there, ten lepers stood at a distance,

verses.kjv_text: And they lifted up {their} voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
verses.nlt_text: crying out, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he saw {them}, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.nlt_text: He looked at them and said, "Go show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed of their leprosy.

verses.kjv_text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
verses.nlt_text: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, came back to Jesus, shouting, "Praise God!"

verses.kjv_text: And fell down on {his} face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
verses.nlt_text: He fell to the ground at Jesus' feet, thanking him for what he had done. This man was a Samaritan.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where {are} the nine?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked, "Didn't I heal ten men? Where are the other nine?

verses.kjv_text: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
verses.nlt_text: Has no one returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus said to the man, "Stand up and go. Your faith has healed you. "

verses.kjv_text: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation: {with...: or, with outward shew}
verses.nlt_text: One day the Pharisees asked Jesus, "When will the Kingdom of God come?" Jesus replied, "The Kingdom of God can't be detected by visible signs.

verses.kjv_text: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you. {within you: or, among you}
verses.nlt_text: You won't be able to say, 'Here it is!' or 'It's over there!' For the Kingdom of God is already among you. "

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see the day when the Son of Man returns, but you won't see it.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after {them}, nor follow {them}.
verses.nlt_text: People will tell you, 'Look, there is the Son of Man,' or 'Here he is,' but don't go out and follow them.

verses.kjv_text: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one {part} under heaven, shineth unto the other {part} under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.nlt_text: For as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so it will be on the day when the Son of Man comes.

verses.kjv_text: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.nlt_text: But first the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected by this generation.

verses.kjv_text: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.nlt_text: "When the Son of Man returns, it will be like it was in Noah's day.

verses.kjv_text: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.nlt_text: In those days, the people enjoyed banquets and parties and weddings right up to the time Noah entered his boat and the flood came and destroyed them all.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.nlt_text: "And the world will be as it was in the days of Lot. People went about their daily business-- eating and drinking, buying and selling, farming and building--

verses.kjv_text: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed {them} all.
verses.nlt_text: until the morning Lot left Sodom. Then fire and burning sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

verses.kjv_text: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, it will be 'business as usual' right up to the day when the Son of Man is revealed.

verses.kjv_text: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.nlt_text: On that day a person out on the deck of a roof must not go down into the house to pack. A person out in the field must not return home.

verses.kjv_text: Remember Lot's wife.
verses.nlt_text: Remember what happened to Lot's wife!

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
verses.nlt_text: If you cling to your life, you will lose it, and if you let your life go, you will save it.

verses.kjv_text: I tell you, in that night there shall be two {men} in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.nlt_text: That night two people will be asleep in one bed; one will be taken, the other left.

verses.kjv_text: Two {women} shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.nlt_text: Two women will be grinding flour together at the mill; one will be taken, the other left. "

verses.kjv_text: Two {men} shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left. {this verse is not found in most of the Greek copies}
And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body {is}, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.nlt_text: "Where will this happen, Lord?" the disciples asked.Jesus replied, "Just as the gathering of vultures shows there is a carcass nearby, so these signs indicate that the end is near."

verses.kjv_text: And he spake a parable unto them {to this end}, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
verses.nlt_text: One day Jesus told his disciples a story to show that they should always pray and never give up.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man: {in a city: Gr. in a certain city}
verses.nlt_text: "There was a judge in a certain city," he said, "who neither feared God nor cared about people.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.nlt_text: A widow of that city came to him repeatedly, saying, 'Give me justice in this dispute with my enemy.'

verses.kjv_text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.nlt_text: The judge ignored her for a while, but finally he said to himself, 'I don't fear God or care about people,

verses.kjv_text: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.nlt_text: but this woman is driving me crazy. I'm going to see that she gets justice, because she is wearing me out with her constant requests!'"

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Lord said, "Learn a lesson from this unjust judge.

verses.kjv_text: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.nlt_text: Even he rendered a just decision in the end. So don't you think God will surely give justice to his chosen people who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?

verses.kjv_text: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, he will grant justice to them quickly! But when the Son of Man returns, how many will he find on the earth who have faith?"

verses.kjv_text: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others: {that...: or, as being righteous}
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told this story to some who had great confidence in their own righteousness and scorned everyone else:

verses.kjv_text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.nlt_text: "Two men went to the Temple to pray. One was a Pharisee, and the other was a despised tax collector.

verses.kjv_text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men {are}, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.nlt_text: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed this prayer: 'I thank you, God, that I am not a sinner like everyone else. For I don't cheat, I don't sin, and I don't commit adultery. I'm certainly not like that tax collector!

verses.kjv_text: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.nlt_text: I fast twice a week, and I give you a tenth of my income.'

verses.kjv_text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as {his} eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.nlt_text: "But the tax collector stood at a distance and dared not even lift his eyes to heaven as he prayed. Instead, he beat his chest in sorrow, saying, 'O God, be merciful to me, for I am a sinner.'

verses.kjv_text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified {rather} than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you, this sinner, not the Pharisee, returned home justified before God. For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."

verses.kjv_text: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when {his} disciples saw {it}, they rebuked them.
verses.nlt_text: One day some parents brought their little children to Jesus so he could touch and bless them. But when the disciples saw this, they scolded the parents for bothering him.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus called them {unto him}, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus called for the children and said to the disciples, "Let the children come to me. Don't stop them! For the Kingdom of God belongs to those who are like these children.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, anyone who doesn't receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it."

verses.kjv_text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.nlt_text: Once a religious leader asked Jesus this question: "Good Teacher, what should I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none {is} good, save one, {that is}, God.
verses.nlt_text: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus asked him. "Only God is truly good.

verses.kjv_text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.nlt_text: But to answer your question, you know the commandments: 'You must not commit adultery. You must not murder. You must not steal. You must not testify falsely. Honor your father and mother.' "

verses.kjv_text: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.nlt_text: The man replied, "I've carefully obeyed all these commandments since I was young."

verses.kjv_text: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard his answer, he said, "There is still one thing you haven't done. Sell all your possessions and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

verses.kjv_text: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.nlt_text: But when the man heard this he became sad, for he was very rich.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw this, he said, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the Kingdom of God!

verses.kjv_text: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv_text: And they that heard {it} said, Who then can be saved?
verses.nlt_text: Those who heard this said, "Then who in the world can be saved?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "What is impossible for people is possible with God."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.nlt_text: Peter said, "We've left our homes to follow you."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," Jesus replied, "and I assure you that everyone who has given up house or wife or brothers or parents or children, for the sake of the Kingdom of God,

verses.kjv_text: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.nlt_text: will be repaid many times over in this life, and will have eternal life in the world to come."

verses.kjv_text: Then he took {unto him} the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
verses.nlt_text: Taking the twelve disciples aside, Jesus said, "Listen, we're going up to Jerusalem, where all the predictions of the prophets concerning the Son of Man will come true.

verses.kjv_text: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.nlt_text: He will be handed over to the Romans, and he will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit upon.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall scourge {him}, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.nlt_text: They will flog him with a whip and kill him, but on the third day he will rise again."

verses.kjv_text: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.nlt_text: But they didn't understand any of this. The significance of his words was hidden from them, and they failed to grasp what he was talking about.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind beggar was sitting beside the road.

verses.kjv_text: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.nlt_text: When he heard the noise of a crowd going past, he asked what was happening.

verses.kjv_text: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.nlt_text: They told him that Jesus the Nazarene was going by.

verses.kjv_text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, {thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.nlt_text: So he began shouting, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.kjv_text: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, {Thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.nlt_text: "Be quiet!" the people in front yelled at him.But he only shouted louder, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard him, he stopped and ordered that the man be brought to him. As the man came near, Jesus asked him,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.nlt_text: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord," he said, "I want to see!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus said, "All right, receive your sight! Your faith has healed you."

verses.kjv_text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw {it}, gave praise unto God.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly the man could see, and he followed Jesus, praising God. And all who saw it praised God, too.

verses.kjv_text: And {Jesus} entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus entered Jericho and made his way through the town.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, {there was} a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.nlt_text: There was a man there named Zacchaeus. He was the chief tax collector in the region, and he had become very rich.

verses.kjv_text: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.nlt_text: He tried to get a look at Jesus, but he was too short to see over the crowd.

verses.kjv_text: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that {way}.
verses.nlt_text: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree beside the road, for Jesus was going to pass that way.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus came by, he looked up at Zacchaeus and called him by name. "Zacchaeus!" he said. "Quick, come down! I must be a guest in your home today."

verses.kjv_text: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.nlt_text: Zacchaeus quickly climbed down and took Jesus to his house in great excitement and joy.

verses.kjv_text: And when they saw {it}, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.nlt_text: But the people were displeased. "He has gone to be the guest of a notorious sinner," they grumbled.

verses.kjv_text: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore {him} fourfold.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Zacchaeus stood before the Lord and said, "I will give half my wealth to the poor, Lord, and if I have cheated people on their taxes, I will give them back four times as much!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "Salvation has come to this home today, for this man has shown himself to be a true son of Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.nlt_text: For the Son of Man came to seek and save those who are lost."

verses.kjv_text: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
verses.nlt_text: The crowd was listening to everything Jesus said. And because he was nearing Jerusalem, he told them a story to correct the impression that the Kingdom of God would begin right away.

verses.kjv_text: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.nlt_text: He said, "A nobleman was called away to a distant empire to be crowned king and then return.

verses.kjv_text: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come. {pounds: mina, here translated a pound, is twelve ounces and an half: which according to five shillings the ounce is three pounds two shillings and sixpence}
verses.nlt_text: Before he left, he called together ten of his servants and divided among them ten pounds of silver, saying, 'Invest this for me while I am gone.'

verses.kjv_text: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this {man} to reign over us.
verses.nlt_text: But his people hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, 'We do not want him to be our king.'

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading. {money: Gr. silver}
verses.nlt_text: "After he was crowned king, he returned and called in the servants to whom he had given the money. He wanted to find out what their profits were.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.nlt_text: The first servant reported, 'Master, I invested your money and made ten times the original amount!'

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.nlt_text: " 'Well done!' the king exclaimed. 'You are a good servant. You have been faithful with the little I entrusted to you, so you will be governor of ten cities as your reward.'

verses.kjv_text: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.nlt_text: "The next servant reported, 'Master, I invested your money and made five times the original amount.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.nlt_text: " 'Well done!' the king said. 'You will be governor over five cities.'

verses.kjv_text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, {here is} thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.nlt_text: "But the third servant brought back only the original amount of money and said, 'Master, I hid your money and kept it safe.

verses.kjv_text: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.nlt_text: I was afraid because you are a hard man to deal with, taking what isn't yours and harvesting crops you didn't plant.'

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, {thou} wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.nlt_text: " 'You wicked servant!' the king roared. 'Your own words condemn you. If you knew that I'm a hard man who takes what isn't mine and harvests crops I didn't plant,

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury? {money: Gr. silver}
verses.nlt_text: why didn't you deposit my money in the bank? At least I could have gotten some interest on it.'

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give {it} to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.nlt_text: "Then, turning to the others standing nearby, the king ordered, 'Take the money from this servant, and give it to the one who has ten pounds.'

verses.kjv_text: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.nlt_text: " 'But, master,' they said, 'he already has ten pounds!'

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.nlt_text: " 'Yes,' the king replied, 'and to those who use well what they are given, even more will be given. But from those who do nothing, even what little they have will be taken away.

verses.kjv_text: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay {them} before me.
verses.nlt_text: And as for these enemies of mine who didn't want me to be their king-- bring them in and execute them right here in front of me.'"

verses.kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: After telling this story, Jesus went on toward Jerusalem, walking ahead of his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called {the mount} of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: As they came to the towns of Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two disciples ahead.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Go ye into the village over against {you}; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring {him hither}.
verses.nlt_text: "Go into that village over there," he told them. "As you enter it, you will see a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose {him}? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone asks, 'Why are you untying that colt?' just say, 'The Lord needs it.'"

verses.kjv_text: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.nlt_text: So they went and found the colt, just as Jesus had said.

verses.kjv_text: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.nlt_text: And sure enough, as they were untying it, the owners asked them, "Why are you untying that colt?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.nlt_text: And the disciples simply replied, "The Lord needs it."

verses.kjv_text: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
verses.nlt_text: So they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it for him to ride on.

verses.kjv_text: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.nlt_text: As he rode along, the crowds spread out their garments on the road ahead of him.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.nlt_text: When they reached the place where the road started down the Mount of Olives, all of his followers began to shout and sing as they walked along, praising God for all the wonderful miracles they had seen.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Blessed {be} the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.nlt_text: "Blessings on the King who comes in the name of the LORD! Peace in heaven, and glory in highest heaven!"

verses.kjv_text: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.nlt_text: But some of the Pharisees among the crowd said, "Teacher, rebuke your followers for saying things like that!"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "If they kept quiet, the stones along the road would burst into cheers!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.nlt_text: But as they came closer to Jerusalem and Jesus saw the city ahead, he began to weep.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things {which belong} unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.nlt_text: "How I wish today that you of all people would understand the way to peace. But now it is too late, and peace is hidden from your eyes.

verses.kjv_text: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.nlt_text: Before long your enemies will build ramparts against your walls and encircle you and close in on you from every side.

verses.kjv_text: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.nlt_text: They will crush you into the ground, and your children with you. Your enemies will not leave a single stone in place, because you did not accept your opportunity for salvation."

verses.kjv_text: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus entered the Temple and began to drive out the people selling animals for sacrifices.

verses.kjv_text: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.nlt_text: He said to them, "The Scriptures declare, 'My Temple will be a house of prayer,' but you have turned it into a den of thieves."

verses.kjv_text: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.nlt_text: After that, he taught daily in the Temple, but the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the other leaders of the people began planning how to kill him.

verses.kjv_text: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him. {were...: or, hanged on him}
verses.nlt_text: But they could think of nothing, because all the people hung on every word he said.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, {that} on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon {him} with the elders,
verses.nlt_text: One day as Jesus was teaching the people and preaching the Good News in the Temple, the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders came up to him.

verses.kjv_text: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.nlt_text: They demanded, "By what authority are you doing all these things? Who gave you the right?"

verses.kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
verses.nlt_text: "Let me ask you a question first," he replied.

verses.kjv_text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
verses.nlt_text: "Did John's authority to baptize come from heaven, or was it merely human?"

verses.kjv_text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
verses.nlt_text: They talked it over among themselves. "If we say it was from heaven, he will ask why we didn't believe John.

verses.kjv_text: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: But if we say it was merely human, the people will stone us because they are convinced John was a prophet."

verses.kjv_text: And they answered, that they could not tell whence {it was}.
verses.nlt_text: So they finally replied that they didn't know.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus responded, "Then I won't tell you by what authority I do these things."

verses.kjv_text: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.nlt_text: Now Jesus turned to the people again and told them this story: "A man planted a vineyard, leased it to tenant farmers, and moved to another country to live for several years.

verses.kjv_text: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent {him} away empty.
verses.nlt_text: At the time of the grape harvest, he sent one of his servants to collect his share of the crop. But the farmers attacked the servant, beat him up, and sent him back empty-handed.

verses.kjv_text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated {him} shamefully, and sent {him} away empty.
verses.nlt_text: So the owner sent another servant, but they also insulted him, beat him up, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.kjv_text: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast {him} out.
verses.nlt_text: A third man was sent, and they wounded him and chased him away.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence {him} when they see him.
verses.nlt_text: " 'What will I do?' the owner asked himself. 'I know! I'll send my cherished son. Surely they will respect him.'

verses.kjv_text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
verses.nlt_text: "But when the tenant farmers saw his son, they said to each other, 'Here comes the heir to this estate. Let's kill him and get the estate for ourselves!'

verses.kjv_text: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed {him}. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.nlt_text: So they dragged him out of the vineyard and murdered him."What do you suppose the owner of the vineyard will do to them?" Jesus asked.

verses.kjv_text: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard {it}, they said, God forbid.
verses.nlt_text: "I'll tell you-- he will come and kill those farmers and lease the vineyard to others." "How terrible that such a thing should ever happen," his listeners protested.

verses.kjv_text: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus looked at them and said, "Then what does this Scripture mean? 'The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone.'

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who stumbles over that stone will be broken to pieces, and it will crush anyone it falls on."

verses.kjv_text: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.nlt_text: The teachers of religious law and the leading priests wanted to arrest Jesus immediately because they realized he was telling the story against them-- they were the wicked farmers. But they were afraid of the people's reaction.

verses.kjv_text: And they watched {him}, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
verses.nlt_text: Watching for their opportunity, the leaders sent spies pretending to be honest men. They tried to get Jesus to say something that could be reported to the Roman governor so he would arrest Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person {of any}, but teachest the way of God truly: {truly: or, of a truth}
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher," they said, "we know that you speak and teach what is right and are not influenced by what others think. You teach the way of God truthfully.

verses.kjv_text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
verses.nlt_text: Now tell us-- is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

verses.kjv_text: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
verses.nlt_text: He saw through their trickery and said,

verses.kjv_text: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
verses.nlt_text: "Show me a Roman coin. Whose picture and title are stamped on it?" "Caesar's," they replied.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
verses.nlt_text: "Well then," he said, "give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God."

verses.kjv_text: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.nlt_text: So they failed to trap him by what he said in front of the people. Instead, they were amazed by his answer, and they became silent.

verses.kjv_text: Then came to {him} certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus was approached by some Sadducees-- religious leaders who say there is no resurrection from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.nlt_text: They posed this question: "Teacher, Moses gave us a law that if a man dies, leaving a wife but no children, his brother should marry the widow and have a child who will carry on the brother's name.

verses.kjv_text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.nlt_text: Well, suppose there were seven brothers. The oldest one married and then died without children.

verses.kjv_text: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
verses.nlt_text: So the second brother married the widow, but he also died.

verses.kjv_text: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
verses.nlt_text: Then the third brother married her. This continued with all seven of them, who died without children.

verses.kjv_text: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, the woman also died.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
verses.nlt_text: So tell us, whose wife will she be in the resurrection? For all seven were married to her!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Marriage is for people here on earth.

verses.kjv_text: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.nlt_text: But in the age to come, those worthy of being raised from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.

verses.kjv_text: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
verses.nlt_text: And they will never die again. In this respect they will be like angels. They are children of God and children of the resurrection.

verses.kjv_text: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: "But now, as to whether the dead will be raised-- even Moses proved this when he wrote about the burning bush. Long after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, he referred to the Lord as 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

verses.kjv_text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.nlt_text: So he is the God of the living, not the dead, for they are all alive to him."

verses.kjv_text: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
verses.nlt_text: "Well said, Teacher!" remarked some of the teachers of religious law who were standing there.

verses.kjv_text: And after that they durst not ask him any {question at all}.
verses.nlt_text: And then no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus presented them with a question. "Why is it," he asked, "that the Messiah is said to be the son of David?

verses.kjv_text: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.nlt_text: For David himself wrote in the book of Psalms: 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit in the place of honor at my right hand

verses.kjv_text: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.nlt_text: until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet.'

verses.kjv_text: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
verses.nlt_text: Since David called the Messiah 'Lord,' how can the Messiah be his son?"

verses.kjv_text: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.nlt_text: Then, with the crowds listening, he turned to his disciples and said,

verses.kjv_text: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
verses.nlt_text: "Beware of these teachers of religious law! For they like to parade around in flowing robes and love to receive respectful greetings as they walk in the marketplaces. And how they love the seats of honor in the synagogues and the head table at banquets.

verses.kjv_text: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
verses.nlt_text: Yet they shamelessly cheat widows out of their property and then pretend to be pious by making long prayers in public. Because of this, they will be severely punished."

verses.kjv_text: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.nlt_text: While Jesus was in the Temple, he watched the rich people dropping their gifts in the collection box.

verses.kjv_text: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.nlt_text: Then a poor widow came by and dropped in two small coins.

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth," Jesus said, "this poor widow has given more than all the rest of them.

verses.kjv_text: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.nlt_text: For they have given a tiny part of their surplus, but she, poor as she is, has given everything she has."

verses.kjv_text: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.nlt_text: Some of his disciples began talking about the majestic stonework of the Temple and the memorial decorations on the walls. But Jesus said,

verses.kjv_text: {As for} these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.nlt_text: "The time is coming when all these things will be completely demolished. Not one stone will be left on top of another!"

verses.kjv_text: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign {will there be} when these things shall come to pass?
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher," they asked, "when will all this happen? What sign will show us that these things are about to take place?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am {Christ}; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them. {and the time: or, and, The time}
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "Don't let anyone mislead you, for many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am the Messiah,' and saying, 'The time has come!' But don't believe them.

verses.kjv_text: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end {is} not by and by.
verses.nlt_text: And when you hear of wars and insurrections, don't panic. Yes, these things must take place first, but the end won't follow immediately."

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.nlt_text: Then he added, "Nation will go to war against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

verses.kjv_text: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: There will be great earthquakes, and there will be famines and plagues in many lands, and there will be terrifying things and great miraculous signs from heaven.

verses.kjv_text: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute {you}, delivering {you} up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.nlt_text: "But before all this occurs, there will be a time of great persecution. You will be dragged into synagogues and prisons, and you will stand trial before kings and governors because you are my followers.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.nlt_text: But this will be your opportunity to tell them about me.

verses.kjv_text: Settle {it} therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.nlt_text: So don't worry in advance about how to answer the charges against you,

verses.kjv_text: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.nlt_text: for I will give you the right words and such wisdom that none of your opponents will be able to reply or refute you!

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and {some} of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: Even those closest to you-- your parents, brothers, relatives, and friends-- will betray you. They will even kill some of you.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall be hated of all {men} for my name's sake.
verses.nlt_text: And everyone will hate you because you are my followers.

verses.kjv_text: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.nlt_text: But not a hair of your head will perish!

verses.kjv_text: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.nlt_text: By standing firm, you will win your souls.

verses.kjv_text: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.nlt_text: "And when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then you will know that the time of its destruction has arrived.

verses.kjv_text: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.nlt_text: Then those in Judea must flee to the hills. Those in Jerusalem must get out, and those out in the country should not return to the city.

verses.kjv_text: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: For those will be days of God's vengeance, and the prophetic words of the Scriptures will be fulfilled.

verses.kjv_text: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.nlt_text: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and for nursing mothers in those days. For there will be disaster in the land and great anger against this people.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: They will be killed by the sword or sent away as captives to all the nations of the world. And Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the period of the Gentiles comes to an end.

verses.kjv_text: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.nlt_text: "And there will be strange signs in the sun, moon, and stars. And here on earth the nations will be in turmoil, perplexed by the roaring seas and strange tides.

verses.kjv_text: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.nlt_text: People will be terrified at what they see coming upon the earth, for the powers in the heavens will be shaken.

verses.kjv_text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.nlt_text: Then everyone will see the Son of Man coming on a cloud with power and great glory.

verses.kjv_text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.nlt_text: So when all these things begin to happen, stand and look up, for your salvation is near!"

verses.kjv_text: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.nlt_text: Then he gave them this illustration: "Notice the fig tree, or any other tree.

verses.kjv_text: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.nlt_text: When the leaves come out, you know without being told that summer is near.

verses.kjv_text: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, when you see all these things taking place, you can know that the Kingdom of God is near.

verses.kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass from the scene until all these things have taken place.

verses.kjv_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.nlt_text: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

verses.kjv_text: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and {so} that day come upon you unawares.
verses.nlt_text: "Watch out! Don't let your hearts be dulled by carousing and drunkenness, and by the worries of this life. Don't let that day catch you unaware,

verses.kjv_text: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.nlt_text: like a trap. For that day will come upon everyone living on the earth.

verses.kjv_text: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.nlt_text: Keep alert at all times. And pray that you might be strong enough to escape these coming horrors and stand before the Son of Man."

verses.kjv_text: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called {the mount} of Olives.
verses.nlt_text: Every day Jesus went to the Temple to teach, and each evening he returned to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv_text: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.nlt_text: The crowds gathered at the Temple early each morning to hear him.

verses.kjv_text: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.nlt_text: The Festival of Unleavened Bread, which is also called Passover, was approaching.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.nlt_text: The leading priests and teachers of religious law were plotting how to kill Jesus, but they were afraid of the people's reaction.

verses.kjv_text: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.nlt_text: Then Satan entered into Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve disciples,

verses.kjv_text: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.nlt_text: and he went to the leading priests and captains of the Temple guard to discuss the best way to betray Jesus to them.

verses.kjv_text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.nlt_text: They were delighted, and they promised to give him money.

verses.kjv_text: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude. {in the...: or, without tumult}
verses.nlt_text: So he agreed and began looking for an opportunity to betray Jesus so they could arrest him when the crowds weren't around.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.nlt_text: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread arrived, when the Passover lamb is sacrificed.

verses.kjv_text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus sent Peter and John ahead and said, "Go and prepare the Passover meal, so we can eat it together."

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.nlt_text: "Where do you want us to prepare it?" they asked him.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "As soon as you enter Jerusalem, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him. At the house he enters,

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.nlt_text: say to the owner, 'The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples?'

verses.kjv_text: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.nlt_text: He will take you upstairs to a large room that is already set up. That is where you should prepare our meal."

verses.kjv_text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.nlt_text: They went off to the city and found everything just as Jesus had said, and they prepared the Passover meal there.

verses.kjv_text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.nlt_text: When the time came, Jesus and the apostles sat down together at the table.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer: {With desire...: or, I have heartily desired}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "I have been very eager to eat this Passover meal with you before my suffering begins.

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: For I tell you now that I won't eat this meal again until its meaning is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God."

verses.kjv_text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide {it} among yourselves:
verses.nlt_text: Then he took a cup of wine and gave thanks to God for it. Then he said, "Take this and share it among yourselves.

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
verses.nlt_text: For I will not drink wine again until the Kingdom of God has come."

verses.kjv_text: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake {it}, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.nlt_text: He took some bread and gave thanks to God for it. Then he broke it in pieces and gave it to the disciples, saying, "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this to remember me."

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup {is} the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.nlt_text: After supper he took another cup of wine and said, "This cup is the new covenant between God and his people-- an agreement confirmed with my blood, which is poured out as a sacrifice for you.

verses.kjv_text: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me {is} with me on the table.
verses.nlt_text: "But here at this table, sitting among us as a friend, is the man who will betray me.

verses.kjv_text: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.nlt_text: For it has been determined that the Son of Man must die. But what sorrow awaits the one who betrays him."

verses.kjv_text: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples began to ask each other which of them would ever do such a thing.

verses.kjv_text: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.nlt_text: Then they began to argue among themselves about who would be the greatest among them.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "In this world the kings and great men lord it over their people, yet they are called 'friends of the people.'

verses.kjv_text: But ye {shall} not {be} so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.nlt_text: But among you it will be different. Those who are the greatest among you should take the lowest rank, and the leader should be like a servant.

verses.kjv_text: For whether {is} greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? {is} not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.nlt_text: Who is more important, the one who sits at the table or the one who serves? The one who sits at the table, of course. But not here! For I am among you as one who serves.

verses.kjv_text: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.nlt_text: "You have stayed with me in my time of trial.

verses.kjv_text: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
verses.nlt_text: And just as my Father has granted me a Kingdom, I now grant you the right

verses.kjv_text: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: to eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. And you will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired {to have} you, that he may sift {you} as wheat:
verses.nlt_text: "Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.

verses.kjv_text: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.nlt_text: But I have pleaded in prayer for you, Simon, that your faith should not fail. So when you have repented and turned to me again, strengthen your brothers."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.nlt_text: Peter said, "Lord, I am ready to go to prison with you, and even to die with you."

verses.kjv_text: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "Peter, let me tell you something. Before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny three times that you even know me."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus asked them, "When I sent you out to preach the Good News and you did not have money, a traveler's bag, or extra clothing, did you need anything?" "No," they replied.

verses.kjv_text: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take {it}, and likewise {his} scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.nlt_text: "But now," he said, "take your money and a traveler's bag. And if you don't have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one!

verses.kjv_text: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.nlt_text: For the time has come for this prophecy about me to be fulfilled: 'He was counted among the rebels.' Yes, everything written about me by the prophets will come true."

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Lord, behold, here {are} two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.nlt_text: "Look, Lord," they replied, "we have two swords among us." "That's enough," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.nlt_text: Then, accompanied by the disciples, Jesus left the upstairs room and went as usual to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.nlt_text: There he told them, "Pray that you will not give in to temptation."

verses.kjv_text: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.nlt_text: He walked away, about a stone's throw, and knelt down and prayed,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done. {willing, remove: Gr. willing to remove}
verses.nlt_text: "Father, if you are willing, please take this cup of suffering away from me. Yet I want your will to be done, not mine."

verses.kjv_text: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.nlt_text: Then an angel from heaven appeared and strengthened him.

verses.kjv_text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.nlt_text: He prayed more fervently, and he was in such agony of spirit that his sweat fell to the ground like great drops of blood.

verses.kjv_text: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.nlt_text: At last he stood up again and returned to the disciples, only to find them asleep, exhausted from grief.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.nlt_text: "Why are you sleeping?" he asked them. "Get up and pray, so that you will not give in to temptation."

verses.kjv_text: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
verses.nlt_text: But even as Jesus said this, a crowd approached, led by Judas, one of his twelve disciples. Judas walked over to Jesus to greet him with a kiss.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "Judas, would you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?"

verses.kjv_text: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.nlt_text: When the other disciples saw what was about to happen, they exclaimed, "Lord, should we fight? We brought the swords!"

verses.kjv_text: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.nlt_text: And one of them struck at the high priest's slave, slashing off his right ear.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said, "No more of this." And he touched the man's ear and healed him.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus spoke to the leading priests, the captains of the Temple guard, and the elders who had come for him. "Am I some dangerous revolutionary," he asked, "that you come with swords and clubs to arrest me?

verses.kjv_text: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.nlt_text: Why didn't you arrest me in the Temple? I was there every day. But this is your moment, the time when the power of darkness reigns."

verses.kjv_text: Then took they him, and led {him}, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
verses.nlt_text: So they arrested him and led him to the high priest's home. And Peter followed at a distance.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.nlt_text: The guards lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat around it, and Peter joined them there.

verses.kjv_text: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.nlt_text: A servant girl noticed him in the firelight and began staring at him. Finally she said, "This man was one of Jesus' followers!"

verses.kjv_text: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter denied it. "Woman," he said, "I don't even know him!"

verses.kjv_text: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
verses.nlt_text: After a while someone else looked at him and said, "You must be one of them!" "No, man, I'm not!" Peter retorted.

verses.kjv_text: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this {fellow} also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.nlt_text: About an hour later someone else insisted, "This must be one of them, because he is a Galilean, too."

verses.kjv_text: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter said, "Man, I don't know what you are talking about." And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.nlt_text: At that moment the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered that the Lord had said, "Before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny three times that you even know me."

verses.kjv_text: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.nlt_text: And Peter left the courtyard, weeping bitterly.

verses.kjv_text: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote {him}.
verses.nlt_text: The guards in charge of Jesus began mocking and beating him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.nlt_text: They blindfolded him and said, "Prophesy to us! Who hit you that time?"

verses.kjv_text: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.nlt_text: And they hurled all sorts of terrible insults at him.

verses.kjv_text: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.nlt_text: At daybreak all the elders of the people assembled, including the leading priests and the teachers of religious law. Jesus was led before this high council,

verses.kjv_text: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.nlt_text: and they said, "Tell us, are you the Messiah?" But he replied, "If I tell you, you won't believe me.

verses.kjv_text: And if I also ask {you}, ye will not answer me, nor let {me} go.
verses.nlt_text: And if I ask you a question, you won't answer.

verses.kjv_text: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
verses.nlt_text: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated in the place of power at God's right hand. "

verses.kjv_text: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.nlt_text: They all shouted, "So, are you claiming to be the Son of God?" And he replied, "You say that I am."

verses.kjv_text: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
verses.nlt_text: "Why do we need other witnesses?" they said. "We ourselves heard him say it."

verses.kjv_text: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.nlt_text: Then the entire council took Jesus to Pilate, the Roman governor.

verses.kjv_text: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this {fellow} perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.nlt_text: They began to state their case: "This man has been leading our people astray by telling them not to pay their taxes to the Roman government and by claiming he is the Messiah, a king."

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest {it}.
verses.nlt_text: So Pilate asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?" Jesus replied, "You have said it."

verses.kjv_text: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and {to} the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate turned to the leading priests and to the crowd and said, "I find nothing wrong with this man!"

verses.kjv_text: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.nlt_text: Then they became insistent. "But he is causing riots by his teaching wherever he goes-- all over Judea, from Galilee to Jerusalem!"

verses.kjv_text: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.nlt_text: "Oh, is he a Galilean?" Pilate asked.

verses.kjv_text: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.nlt_text: When they said that he was, Pilate sent him to Herod Antipas, because Galilee was under Herod's jurisdiction, and Herod happened to be in Jerusalem at the time.

verses.kjv_text: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long {season}, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.nlt_text: Herod was delighted at the opportunity to see Jesus, because he had heard about him and had been hoping for a long time to see him perform a miracle.

verses.kjv_text: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.nlt_text: He asked Jesus question after question, but Jesus refused to answer.

verses.kjv_text: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the leading priests and the teachers of religious law stood there shouting their accusations.

verses.kjv_text: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked {him}, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.nlt_text: Then Herod and his soldiers began mocking and ridiculing Jesus. Finally, they put a royal robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.

verses.kjv_text: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.nlt_text: (Herod and Pilate, who had been enemies before, became friends that day.)

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.nlt_text: Then Pilate called together the leading priests and other religious leaders, along with the people,

verses.kjv_text: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined {him} before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.nlt_text: and he announced his verdict. "You brought this man to me, accusing him of leading a revolt. I have examined him thoroughly on this point in your presence and find him innocent.

verses.kjv_text: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Herod came to the same conclusion and sent him back to us. Nothing this man has done calls for the death penalty.

verses.kjv_text: I will therefore chastise him, and release {him}.
verses.nlt_text: So I will have him flogged, and then I will release him."

verses.kjv_text: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this {man}, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.nlt_text: Then a mighty roar rose from the crowd, and with one voice they shouted, "Kill him, and release Barabbas to us!"

verses.kjv_text: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.nlt_text: (Barabbas was in prison for taking part in an insurrection in Jerusalem against the government, and for murder.)

verses.kjv_text: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate argued with them, because he wanted to release Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But they cried, saying, Crucify {him}, crucify him.
verses.nlt_text: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let {him} go.
verses.nlt_text: For the third time he demanded, "Why? What crime has he committed? I have found no reason to sentence him to death. So I will have him flogged, and then I will release him."

verses.kjv_text: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.nlt_text: But the mob shouted louder and louder, demanding that Jesus be crucified, and their voices prevailed.

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required. {gave...: or, assented}
verses.nlt_text: So Pilate sentenced Jesus to die as they demanded.

verses.kjv_text: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.nlt_text: As they had requested, he released Barabbas, the man in prison for insurrection and murder. But he turned Jesus over to them to do as they wished.

verses.kjv_text: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear {it} after Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: As they led Jesus away, a man named Simon, who was from Cyrene, happened to be coming in from the countryside. The soldiers seized him and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.nlt_text: A large crowd trailed behind, including many grief-stricken women.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, don't weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

verses.kjv_text: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed {are} the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.nlt_text: For the days are coming when they will say, 'Fortunate indeed are the women who are childless, the wombs that have not borne a child and the breasts that have never nursed.'

verses.kjv_text: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.nlt_text: People will beg the mountains, 'Fall on us,' and plead with the hills, 'Bury us.'

verses.kjv_text: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.nlt_text: For if these things are done when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry? "

verses.kjv_text: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.nlt_text: Two others, both criminals, were led out to be executed with him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left. {Calvary: or, The place of a skull}
verses.nlt_text: When they came to a place called The Skull, they nailed him to the cross. And the criminals were also crucified-- one on his right and one on his left.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing." And the soldiers gambled for his clothes by throwing dice.

verses.kjv_text: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided {him}, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.nlt_text: The crowd watched and the leaders scoffed. "He saved others," they said, "let him save himself if he is really God's Messiah, the Chosen One."

verses.kjv_text: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.nlt_text: The soldiers mocked him, too, by offering him a drink of sour wine.

verses.kjv_text: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.nlt_text: They called out to him, "If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!"

verses.kjv_text: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.nlt_text: A sign was fastened to the cross above him with these words: "This is the King of the Jews."

verses.kjv_text: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.nlt_text: One of the criminals hanging beside him scoffed, "So you're the Messiah, are you? Prove it by saving yourself-- and us, too, while you're at it!"

verses.kjv_text: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.nlt_text: But the other criminal protested, "Don't you fear God even when you have been sentenced to die?

verses.kjv_text: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.nlt_text: We deserve to die for our crimes, but this man hasn't done anything wrong."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your Kingdom."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus replied, "I assure you, today you will be with me in paradise."
