verses.kjv_text: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour. {earth: or, land}
verses.nlt_text: By this time it was noon, and darkness fell across the whole land until three o'clock.

verses.kjv_text: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.nlt_text: The light from the sun was gone. And suddenly, the curtain in the sanctuary of the Temple was torn down the middle.

verses.kjv_text: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus shouted, "Father, I entrust my spirit into your hands!" And with those words he breathed his last.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.nlt_text: When the Roman officer overseeing the execution saw what had happened, he worshiped God and said, "Surely this man was innocent. "

verses.kjv_text: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.nlt_text: And when all the crowd that came to see the crucifixion saw what had happened, they went home in deep sorrow.

verses.kjv_text: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus' friends, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, {there was} a man named Joseph, a counsellor; {and he was} a good man, and a just:
verses.nlt_text: Now there was a good and righteous man named Joseph. He was a member of the Jewish high council,

verses.kjv_text: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) {he was} of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: but he had not agreed with the decision and actions of the other religious leaders. He was from the town of Arimathea in Judea, and he was waiting for the Kingdom of God to come.

verses.kjv_text: This {man} went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.

verses.kjv_text: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.nlt_text: Then he took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in a long sheet of linen cloth and laid it in a new tomb that had been carved out of rock.

verses.kjv_text: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.nlt_text: This was done late on Friday afternoon, the day of preparation, as the Sabbath was about to begin.

verses.kjv_text: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
verses.nlt_text: As his body was taken away, the women from Galilee followed and saw the tomb where his body was placed.

verses.kjv_text: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
verses.nlt_text: Then they went home and prepared spices and ointments to anoint his body. But by the time they were finished the Sabbath had begun, so they rested as required by the law.

verses.kjv_text: Now upon the first {day} of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain {others} with them.
verses.nlt_text: But very early on Sunday morning the women went to the tomb, taking the spices they had prepared.

verses.kjv_text: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: They found that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.

verses.kjv_text: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: So they went in, but they didn't find the body of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
verses.nlt_text: As they stood there puzzled, two men suddenly appeared to them, clothed in dazzling robes.

verses.kjv_text: And as they were afraid, and bowed down {their} faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead? {the living: or, him that liveth}
verses.nlt_text: The women were terrified and bowed with their faces to the ground. Then the men asked, "Why are you looking among the dead for someone who is alive?

verses.kjv_text: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
verses.nlt_text: He isn't here! He is risen from the dead! Remember what he told you back in Galilee,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
verses.nlt_text: that the Son of Man must be betrayed into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and that he would rise again on the third day."

verses.kjv_text: And they remembered his words,
verses.nlt_text: Then they remembered that he had said this.

verses.kjv_text: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.nlt_text: So they rushed back from the tomb to tell his eleven disciples-- and everyone else-- what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary {the mother} of James, and other {women that were} with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
verses.nlt_text: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and several other women who told the apostles what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
verses.nlt_text: But the story sounded like nonsense to the men, so they didn't believe it.

verses.kjv_text: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
verses.nlt_text: However, Peter jumped up and ran to the tomb to look. Stooping, he peered in and saw the empty linen wrappings; then he went home again, wondering what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem {about} threescore furlongs.
verses.nlt_text: That same day two of Jesus' followers were walking to the village of Emmaus, seven miles from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
verses.nlt_text: As they walked along they were talking about everything that had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, while they communed {together} and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
verses.nlt_text: As they talked and discussed these things, Jesus himself suddenly came and began walking with them.

verses.kjv_text: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.nlt_text: But God kept them from recognizing him.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, What manner of communications {are} these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.nlt_text: He asked them, "What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?" They stopped short, sadness written across their faces.

verses.kjv_text: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.nlt_text: Then one of them, Cleopas, replied, "You must be the only person in Jerusalem who hasn't heard about all the things that have happened there the last few days."

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.nlt_text: "What things?" Jesus asked."The things that happened to Jesus, the man from Nazareth," they said. "He was a prophet who did powerful miracles, and he was a mighty teacher in the eyes of God and all the people.

verses.kjv_text: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.nlt_text: But our leading priests and other religious leaders handed him over to be condemned to death, and they crucified him.

verses.kjv_text: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.nlt_text: We had hoped he was the Messiah who had come to rescue Israel. This all happened three days ago.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.nlt_text: "Then some women from our group of his followers were at his tomb early this morning, and they came back with an amazing report.

verses.kjv_text: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.nlt_text: They said his body was missing, and they had seen angels who told them Jesus is alive!

verses.kjv_text: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found {it} even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.nlt_text: Some of our men ran out to see, and sure enough, his body was gone, just as the women had said."

verses.kjv_text: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said to them, "You foolish people! You find it so hard to believe all that the prophets wrote in the Scriptures.

verses.kjv_text: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.nlt_text: Wasn't it clearly predicted that the Messiah would have to suffer all these things before entering his glory?"

verses.kjv_text: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus took them through the writings of Moses and all the prophets, explaining from all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

verses.kjv_text: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.nlt_text: By this time they were nearing Emmaus and the end of their journey. Jesus acted as if he were going on,

verses.kjv_text: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.nlt_text: but they begged him, "Stay the night with us, since it is getting late." So he went home with them.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed {it}, and brake, and gave to them.
verses.nlt_text: As they sat down to eat, he took the bread and blessed it. Then he broke it and gave it to them.

verses.kjv_text: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight. {vanished...: or, ceased to be seen of them}
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, their eyes were opened, and they recognized him. And at that moment he disappeared!

verses.kjv_text: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.nlt_text: They said to each other, "Didn't our hearts burn within us as he talked with us on the road and explained the Scriptures to us?"

verses.kjv_text: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.nlt_text: And within the hour they were on their way back to Jerusalem. There they found the eleven disciples and the others who had gathered with them,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.nlt_text: who said, "The Lord has really risen! He appeared to Peter. "

verses.kjv_text: And they told what things {were done} in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.nlt_text: Then the two from Emmaus told their story of how Jesus had appeared to them as they were walking along the road, and how they had recognized him as he was breaking the bread.

verses.kjv_text: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace {be} unto you.
verses.nlt_text: And just as they were telling about it, Jesus himself was suddenly standing there among them. "Peace be with you," he said.

verses.kjv_text: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.nlt_text: But the whole group was startled and frightened, thinking they were seeing a ghost!

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.nlt_text: "Why are you frightened?" he asked. "Why are your hearts filled with doubt?

verses.kjv_text: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.nlt_text: Look at my hands. Look at my feet. You can see that it's really me. Touch me and make sure that I am not a ghost, because ghosts don't have bodies, as you see that I do."

verses.kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them {his} hands and {his} feet.
verses.nlt_text: As he spoke, he showed them his hands and his feet.

verses.kjv_text: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.nlt_text: Still they stood there in disbelief, filled with joy and wonder. Then he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"

verses.kjv_text: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.nlt_text: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,

verses.kjv_text: And he took {it}, and did eat before them.
verses.nlt_text: and he ate it as they watched.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, These {are} the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and {in} the prophets, and {in} the psalms, concerning me.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "When I was with you before, I told you that everything written about me in the law of Moses and the prophets and in the Psalms must be fulfilled."

verses.kjv_text: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
verses.nlt_text: Then he opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.nlt_text: And he said, "Yes, it was written long ago that the Messiah would suffer and die and rise from the dead on the third day.

verses.kjv_text: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: It was also written that this message would be proclaimed in the authority of his name to all the nations, beginning in Jerusalem: 'There is forgiveness of sins for all who repent.'

verses.kjv_text: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.nlt_text: You are witnesses of all these things.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.nlt_text: "And now I will send the Holy Spirit, just as my Father promised. But stay here in the city until the Holy Spirit comes and fills you with power from heaven."

verses.kjv_text: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus led them to Bethany, and lifting his hands to heaven, he blessed them.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.nlt_text: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up to heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.nlt_text: So they worshiped him and then returned to Jerusalem filled with great joy.

verses.kjv_text: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: And they spent all of their time in the Temple, praising God.

verses.kjv_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.nlt_text: In the beginning the Word already existed. The Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.kjv_text: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.nlt_text: He existed in the beginning with God.

verses.kjv_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.nlt_text: God created everything through him, and nothing was created except through him.

verses.kjv_text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.nlt_text: The Word gave life to everything that was created, and his life brought light to everyone.

verses.kjv_text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not. {comprehended: or, did not admit, or, receive}
verses.nlt_text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness can never extinguish it.

verses.kjv_text: There was a man sent from God, whose name {was} John.
verses.nlt_text: God sent a man, John the Baptist,

verses.kjv_text: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all {men} through him might believe.
verses.nlt_text: to tell about the light so that everyone might believe because of his testimony.

verses.kjv_text: He was not that Light, but {was sent} to bear witness of that Light.
verses.nlt_text: John himself was not the light; he was simply a witness to tell about the light.

verses.kjv_text: {That} was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.nlt_text: The one who is the true light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.

verses.kjv_text: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.nlt_text: He came into the very world he created, but the world didn't recognize him.

verses.kjv_text: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.nlt_text: He came to his own people, and even they rejected him.

verses.kjv_text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, {even} to them that believe on his name: {power: or, the right, or, privilege}
verses.nlt_text: But to all who believed him and accepted him, he gave the right to become children of God.

verses.kjv_text: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.nlt_text: They are reborn-- not with a physical birth resulting from human passion or plan, but a birth that comes from God.

verses.kjv_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.nlt_text: So the Word became human and made his home among us. He was full of unfailing love and faithfulness. And we have seen his glory, the glory of the Father's one and only Son.

verses.kjv_text: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.nlt_text: John testified about him when he shouted to the crowds, "This is the one I was talking about when I said, 'Someone is coming after me who is far greater than I am, for he existed long before me.'"

verses.kjv_text: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.nlt_text: From his abundance we have all received one gracious blessing after another.

verses.kjv_text: For the law was given by Moses, {but} grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: For the law was given through Moses, but God's unfailing love and faithfulness came through Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared {him}.
verses.nlt_text: No one has ever seen God. But the one and only Son is himself God and is near to the Father's heart. He has revealed God to us.

verses.kjv_text: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.nlt_text: This was John's testimony when the Jewish leaders sent priests and Temple assistants from Jerusalem to ask John, "Who are you?"

verses.kjv_text: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.nlt_text: He came right out and said, "I am not the Messiah."

verses.kjv_text: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No. {that prophet: or, a prophet?}
verses.nlt_text: "Well then, who are you?" they asked. "Are you Elijah?" "No," he replied."Are you the Prophet we are expecting?" "No."

verses.kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.nlt_text: "Then who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you have to say about yourself?"

verses.kjv_text: He said, I {am} the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.nlt_text: John replied in the words of the prophet Isaiah: "I am a voice shouting in the wilderness, 'Clear the way for the LORD's coming!' "

verses.kjv_text: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Pharisees who had been sent

verses.kjv_text: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.nlt_text: asked him, "If you aren't the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet, what right do you have to baptize?"

verses.kjv_text: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.nlt_text: John told them, "I baptize with water, but right here in the crowd is someone you do not recognize.

verses.kjv_text: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.nlt_text: Though his ministry follows mine, I'm not even worthy to be his slave and untie the straps of his sandal."

verses.kjv_text: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.nlt_text: This encounter took place in Bethany, an area east of the Jordan River, where John was baptizing.

verses.kjv_text: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world. {taketh away: or, beareth}
verses.nlt_text: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.kjv_text: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.nlt_text: He is the one I was talking about when I said, 'A man is coming after me who is far greater than I am, for he existed long before me.'

verses.kjv_text: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.nlt_text: I did not recognize him as the Messiah, but I have been baptizing with water so that he might be revealed to Israel."

verses.kjv_text: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.nlt_text: Then John testified, "I saw the Holy Spirit descending like a dove from heaven and resting upon him.

verses.kjv_text: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: I didn't know he was the one, but when God sent me to baptize with water, he told me, 'The one on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv_text: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: I saw this happen to Jesus, so I testify that he is the Chosen One of God. "

verses.kjv_text: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.nlt_text: The following day John was again standing with two of his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus walked by, John looked at him and declared, "Look! There is the Lamb of God!"

verses.kjv_text: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: When John's two disciples heard this, they followed Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou? {dwellest: or, abidest}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus looked around and saw them following. "What do you want?" he asked them.They replied, "Rabbi" (which means "Teacher"), "where are you staying?"

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour. {about...: that was two hours before night}
verses.nlt_text: "Come and see," he said. It was about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him to the place where he was staying, and they remained with him the rest of the day.

verses.kjv_text: One of the two which heard John {speak}, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
verses.nlt_text: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of these men who heard what John said and then followed Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ. {the Christ: or, the Anointed}
verses.nlt_text: Andrew went to find his brother, Simon, and told him, "We have found the Messiah" (which means "Christ").

verses.kjv_text: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.nlt_text: Then Andrew brought Simon to meet Jesus. Looking intently at Simon, Jesus said, "Your name is Simon, son of John-- but you will be called Cephas" (which means "Peter").

verses.kjv_text: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.nlt_text: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said to him, "Come, follow me."

verses.kjv_text: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.nlt_text: Philip was from Bethsaida, Andrew and Peter's hometown.

verses.kjv_text: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.nlt_text: Philip went to look for Nathanael and told him, "We have found the very person Moses and the prophets wrote about! His name is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth."

verses.kjv_text: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.nlt_text: "Nazareth!" exclaimed Nathanael. "Can anything good come from Nazareth?" "Come and see for yourself," Philip replied.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.nlt_text: As they approached, Jesus said, "Now here is a genuine son of Israel-- a man of complete integrity."

verses.kjv_text: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.nlt_text: "How do you know about me?" Nathanael asked.Jesus replied, "I could see you under the fig tree before Philip found you."

verses.kjv_text: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Then Nathanael exclaimed, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God-- the King of Israel!"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked him, "Do you believe this just because I told you I had seen you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than this."

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "I tell you the truth, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God going up and down on the Son of Man, the one who is the stairway between heaven and earth. "

verses.kjv_text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.nlt_text: The next day there was a wedding celebration in the village of Cana in Galilee. Jesus' mother was there,

verses.kjv_text: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.nlt_text: and Jesus and his disciples were also invited to the celebration.

verses.kjv_text: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.nlt_text: The wine supply ran out during the festivities, so Jesus' mother told him, "They have no more wine."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.nlt_text: "Dear woman, that's not our problem," Jesus replied. "My time has not yet come."

verses.kjv_text: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do {it}.
verses.nlt_text: But his mother told the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."

verses.kjv_text: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.nlt_text: Standing nearby were six stone water jars, used for Jewish ceremonial washing. Each could hold twenty to thirty gallons.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told the servants, "Fill the jars with water." When the jars had been filled,

verses.kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare {it}.
verses.nlt_text: he said, "Now dip some out, and take it to the master of ceremonies." So the servants followed his instructions.

verses.kjv_text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.nlt_text: When the master of ceremonies tasted the water that was now wine, not knowing where it had come from (though, of course, the servants knew), he called the bridegroom over.

verses.kjv_text: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: {but} thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.nlt_text: "A host always serves the best wine first," he said. "Then, when everyone has had a lot to drink, he brings out the less expensive wine. But you have kept the best until now!"

verses.kjv_text: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.nlt_text: This miraculous sign at Cana in Galilee was the first time Jesus revealed his glory. And his disciples believed in him.

verses.kjv_text: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.nlt_text: After the wedding he went to Capernaum for a few days with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
verses.nlt_text: It was nearly time for the Jewish Passover celebration, so Jesus went to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.nlt_text: In the Temple area he saw merchants selling cattle, sheep, and doves for sacrifices; he also saw dealers at tables exchanging foreign money.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus made a whip from some ropes and chased them all out of the Temple. He drove out the sheep and cattle, scattered the money changers' coins over the floor, and turned over their tables.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.nlt_text: Then, going over to the people who sold doves, he told them, "Get these things out of here. Stop turning my Father's house into a marketplace!"

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.nlt_text: Then his disciples remembered this prophecy from the Scriptures: "Passion for God's house will consume me."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.nlt_text: But the Jewish leaders demanded, "What are you doing? If God gave you authority to do this, show us a miraculous sign to prove it."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.nlt_text: "All right," Jesus replied. "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.nlt_text: "What!" they exclaimed. "It has taken forty-six years to build this Temple, and you can rebuild it in three days?"

verses.kjv_text: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.nlt_text: But when Jesus said "this temple," he meant his own body.

verses.kjv_text: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.nlt_text: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered he had said this, and they believed both the Scriptures and what Jesus had said.

verses.kjv_text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast {day}, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.nlt_text: Because of the miraculous signs Jesus did in Jerusalem at the Passover celebration, many began to trust in him.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all {men},
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus didn't trust them, because he knew human nature.

verses.kjv_text: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
verses.nlt_text: No one needed to tell him what mankind is really like.

verses.kjv_text: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.nlt_text: There was a man named Nicodemus, a Jewish religious leader who was a Pharisee.

verses.kjv_text: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.nlt_text: After dark one evening, he came to speak with Jesus. "Rabbi," he said, "we all know that God has sent you to teach us. Your miraculous signs are evidence that God is with you."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. {again: or, from above}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, unless you are born again, you cannot see the Kingdom of God."

verses.kjv_text: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.nlt_text: "What do you mean?" exclaimed Nicodemus. "How can an old man go back into his mother's womb and be born again?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and {of} the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I assure you, no one can enter the Kingdom of God without being born of water and the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.nlt_text: Humans can reproduce only human life, but the Holy Spirit gives birth to spiritual life.

verses.kjv_text: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again. {again: or, from above}
verses.nlt_text: So don't be surprised when I say, 'You must be born again.'

verses.kjv_text: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: The wind blows wherever it wants. Just as you can hear the wind but can't tell where it comes from or where it is going, so you can't explain how people are born of the Spirit."

verses.kjv_text: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.nlt_text: "How are these things possible?" Nicodemus asked.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "You are a respected Jewish teacher, and yet you don't understand these things?

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.nlt_text: I assure you, we tell you what we know and have seen, and yet you won't believe our testimony.

verses.kjv_text: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you {of} heavenly things?
verses.nlt_text: But if you don't believe me when I tell you about earthly things, how can you possibly believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

verses.kjv_text: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, {even} the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: No one has ever gone to heaven and returned. But the Son of Man has come down from heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.nlt_text: And as Moses lifted up the bronze snake on a pole in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

verses.kjv_text: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: so that everyone who believes in him will have eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.nlt_text: "For God loved the world so much that he gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.nlt_text: God sent his Son into the world not to judge the world, but to save the world through him.

verses.kjv_text: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: "There is no judgment against anyone who believes in him. But anyone who does not believe in him has already been judged for not believing in God's one and only Son.

verses.kjv_text: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.nlt_text: And the judgment is based on this fact: God's light came into the world, but people loved the darkness more than the light, for their actions were evil.

verses.kjv_text: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved. {reproved: or, discovered}
verses.nlt_text: All who do evil hate the light and refuse to go near it for fear their sins will be exposed.

verses.kjv_text: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.nlt_text: But those who do what is right come to the light so others can see that they are doing what God wants. "

verses.kjv_text: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus and his disciples left Jerusalem and went into the Judean countryside. Jesus spent some time with them there, baptizing people.

verses.kjv_text: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.nlt_text: At this time John the Baptist was baptizing at Aenon, near Salim, because there was plenty of water there; and people kept coming to him for baptism.

verses.kjv_text: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.nlt_text: (This was before John was thrown into prison.)

verses.kjv_text: Then there arose a question between {some} of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.nlt_text: A debate broke out between John's disciples and a certain Jew over ceremonial cleansing.

verses.kjv_text: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all {men} come to him.
verses.nlt_text: So John's disciples came to him and said, "Rabbi, the man you met on the other side of the Jordan River, the one you identified as the Messiah, is also baptizing people. And everybody is going to him instead of coming to us."

verses.kjv_text: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven. {receive: or, take unto himself}
verses.nlt_text: John replied, "No one can receive anything unless God gives it from heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.nlt_text: You yourselves know how plainly I told you, 'I am not the Messiah. I am only here to prepare the way for him.'

verses.kjv_text: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: It is the bridegroom who marries the bride, and the best man is simply glad to stand with him and hear his vows. Therefore, I am filled with joy at his success.

verses.kjv_text: He must increase, but I {must} decrease.
verses.nlt_text: He must become greater and greater, and I must become less and less.

verses.kjv_text: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.nlt_text: "He has come from above and is greater than anyone else. We are of the earth, and we speak of earthly things, but he has come from heaven and is greater than anyone else.

verses.kjv_text: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.nlt_text: He testifies about what he has seen and heard, but how few believe what he tells them!

verses.kjv_text: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who accepts his testimony can affirm that God is true.

verses.kjv_text: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure {unto him}.
verses.nlt_text: For he is sent by God. He speaks God's words, for God gives him the Spirit without limit.

verses.kjv_text: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.nlt_text: The Father loves his Son and has put everything into his hands.

verses.kjv_text: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.nlt_text: And anyone who believes in God's Son has eternal life. Anyone who doesn't obey the Son will never experience eternal life but remains under God's angry judgment."

verses.kjv_text: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew the Pharisees had heard that he was baptizing and making more disciples than John

verses.kjv_text: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.nlt_text: (though Jesus himself didn't baptize them-- his disciples did).

verses.kjv_text: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: So he left Judea and returned to Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.nlt_text: He had to go through Samaria on the way.

verses.kjv_text: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.nlt_text: Eventually he came to the Samaritan village of Sychar, near the field that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with {his} journey, sat thus on the well: {and} it was about the sixth hour.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob's well was there; and Jesus, tired from the long walk, sat wearily beside the well about noontime.

verses.kjv_text: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.nlt_text: Soon a Samaritan woman came to draw water, and Jesus said to her, "Please give me a drink."

verses.kjv_text: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.nlt_text: He was alone at the time because his disciples had gone into the village to buy some food.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.nlt_text: The woman was surprised, for Jews refuse to have anything to do with Samaritans. She said to Jesus, "You are a Jew, and I am a Samaritan woman. Why are you asking me for a drink?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "If you only knew the gift God has for you and who you are speaking to, you would ask me, and I would give you living water."

verses.kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.nlt_text: "But sir, you don't have a rope or a bucket," she said, "and this well is very deep. Where would you get this living water?

verses.kjv_text: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.nlt_text: And besides, do you think you're greater than our ancestor Jacob, who gave us this well? How can you offer better water than he and his sons and his animals enjoyed?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Anyone who drinks this water will soon become thirsty again.

verses.kjv_text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.nlt_text: But those who drink the water I give will never be thirsty again. It becomes a fresh, bubbling spring within them, giving them eternal life."

verses.kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.nlt_text: "Please, sir," the woman said, "give me this water! Then I'll never be thirsty again, and I won't have to come here to get water."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.nlt_text: "Go and get your husband," Jesus told her.

verses.kjv_text: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.nlt_text: "I don't have a husband," the woman replied.Jesus said, "You're right! You don't have a husband--

verses.kjv_text: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.nlt_text: for you have had five husbands, and you aren't even married to the man you're living with now. You certainly spoke the truth!"

verses.kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: "Sir," the woman said, "you must be a prophet.

verses.kjv_text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.nlt_text: So tell me, why is it that you Jews insist that Jerusalem is the only place of worship, while we Samaritans claim it is here at Mount Gerizim, where our ancestors worshiped?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Believe me, dear woman, the time is coming when it will no longer matter whether you worship the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.nlt_text: You Samaritans know very little about the one you worship, while we Jews know all about him, for salvation comes through the Jews.

verses.kjv_text: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.nlt_text: But the time is coming-- indeed it's here now-- when true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth. The Father is looking for those who will worship him that way.

verses.kjv_text: God {is} a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship {him} in spirit and in truth.
verses.nlt_text: For God is Spirit, so those who worship him must worship in spirit and in truth."

verses.kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.nlt_text: The woman said, "I know the Messiah is coming-- the one who is called Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am {he}.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told her, "I Am the Messiah!"

verses.kjv_text: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.nlt_text: Just then his disciples came back. They were shocked to find him talking to a woman, but none of them had the nerve to ask, "What do you want with her?" or "Why are you talking to her?"

verses.kjv_text: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.nlt_text: The woman left her water jar beside the well and ran back to the village, telling everyone,

verses.kjv_text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.nlt_text: "Come and see a man who told me everything I ever did! Could he possibly be the Messiah?"

verses.kjv_text: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.nlt_text: So the people came streaming from the village to see him.

verses.kjv_text: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the disciples were urging Jesus, "Rabbi, eat something."

verses.kjv_text: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "I have a kind of food you know nothing about."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him {ought} to eat?
verses.nlt_text: "Did someone bring him food while we were gone?" the disciples asked each other.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus explained: "My nourishment comes from doing the will of God, who sent me, and from finishing his work.

verses.kjv_text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and {then} cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.nlt_text: You know the saying, 'Four months between planting and harvest.' But I say, wake up and look around. The fields are already ripe for harvest.

verses.kjv_text: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.nlt_text: The harvesters are paid good wages, and the fruit they harvest is people brought to eternal life. What joy awaits both the planter and the harvester alike!

verses.kjv_text: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.nlt_text: You know the saying, 'One plants and another harvests.' And it's true.

verses.kjv_text: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.nlt_text: I sent you to harvest where you didn't plant; others had already done the work, and now you will get to gather the harvest."

verses.kjv_text: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.nlt_text: Many Samaritans from the village believed in Jesus because the woman had said, "He told me everything I ever did!"

verses.kjv_text: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.nlt_text: When they came out to see him, they begged him to stay in their village. So he stayed for two days,

verses.kjv_text: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.nlt_text: long enough for many more to hear his message and believe.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard {him} ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.nlt_text: Then they said to the woman, "Now we believe, not just because of what you told us, but because we have heard him ourselves. Now we know that he is indeed the Savior of the world."

verses.kjv_text: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: At the end of the two days, Jesus went on to Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.nlt_text: He himself had said that a prophet is not honored in his own hometown.

verses.kjv_text: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.nlt_text: Yet the Galileans welcomed him, for they had been in Jerusalem at the Passover celebration and had seen everything he did there.

verses.kjv_text: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum. {nobleman: or, courtier, or, ruler}
verses.nlt_text: As he traveled through Galilee, he came to Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was a government official in nearby Capernaum whose son was very sick.

verses.kjv_text: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.nlt_text: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Jesus to come to Capernaum to heal his son, who was about to die.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked, "Will you never believe in me unless you see miraculous signs and wonders?"

verses.kjv_text: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.nlt_text: The official pleaded, "Lord, please come now before my little boy dies."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told him, "Go back home. Your son will live!" And the man believed what Jesus said and started home.

verses.kjv_text: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told {him}, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.nlt_text: While the man was on his way, some of his servants met him with the news that his son was alive and well.

verses.kjv_text: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.nlt_text: He asked them when the boy had begun to get better, and they replied, "Yesterday afternoon at one o'clock his fever suddenly disappeared!"

verses.kjv_text: So the father knew that {it was} at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.nlt_text: Then the father realized that that was the very time Jesus had told him, "Your son will live." And he and his entire household believed in Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} again the second miracle {that} Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: This was the second miraculous sign Jesus did in Galilee after coming from Judea.

verses.kjv_text: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward Jesus returned to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish holy days.

verses.kjv_text: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep {market} a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches. {market: or, gate}
verses.nlt_text: Inside the city, near the Sheep Gate, was the pool of Bethesda, with five covered porches.

verses.kjv_text: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.nlt_text: Crowds of sick people-- blind, lame, or paralyzed-- lay on the porches.

verses.kjv_text: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.nlt_text: One of the men lying there had been sick for thirty-eight years.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time {in that case}, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw him and knew he had been ill for a long time, he asked him, "Would you like to get well?"

verses.kjv_text: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.nlt_text: "I can't, sir," the sick man said, "for I have no one to put me into the pool when the water bubbles up. Someone else always gets there ahead of me."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told him, "Stand up, pick up your mat, and walk!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly, the man was healed! He rolled up his sleeping mat and began walking! But this miracle happened on the Sabbath,

verses.kjv_text: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry {thy} bed.
verses.nlt_text: so the Jewish leaders objected. They said to the man who was cured, "You can't work on the Sabbath! The law doesn't allow you to carry that sleeping mat!"

verses.kjv_text: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.nlt_text: But he replied, "The man who healed me told me, 'Pick up your mat and walk.'"

verses.kjv_text: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.nlt_text: "Who said such a thing as that?" they demanded.

verses.kjv_text: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in {that} place. {a multitude...: or, from the multitude that was}
verses.nlt_text: The man didn't know, for Jesus had disappeared into the crowd.

verses.kjv_text: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: But afterward Jesus found him in the Temple and told him, "Now you are well; so stop sinning, or something even worse may happen to you."

verses.kjv_text: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.nlt_text: Then the man went and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had healed him.

verses.kjv_text: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.nlt_text: So the Jewish leaders began harassing Jesus for breaking the Sabbath rules.

verses.kjv_text: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "My Father is always working, and so am I."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.nlt_text: So the Jewish leaders tried all the harder to find a way to kill him. For he not only broke the Sabbath, he called God his Father, thereby making himself equal with God.

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus explained, "I tell you the truth, the Son can do nothing by himself. He does only what he sees the Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son also does.

verses.kjv_text: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.nlt_text: For the Father loves the Son and shows him everything he is doing. In fact, the Father will show him how to do even greater works than healing this man. Then you will truly be astonished.

verses.kjv_text: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth {them}; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.nlt_text: For just as the Father gives life to those he raises from the dead, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants.

verses.kjv_text: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.nlt_text: In addition, the Father judges no one. Instead, he has given the Son absolute authority to judge,

verses.kjv_text: That all {men} should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.nlt_text: so that everyone will honor the Son, just as they honor the Father. Anyone who does not honor the Son is certainly not honoring the Father who sent him.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, those who listen to my message and believe in God who sent me have eternal life. They will never be condemned for their sins, but they have already passed from death into life.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.nlt_text: "And I assure you that the time is coming, indeed it's here now, when the dead will hear my voice-- the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen will live.

verses.kjv_text: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.nlt_text: The Father has life in himself, and he has granted that same life-giving power to his Son.

verses.kjv_text: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.nlt_text: And he has given him authority to judge everyone because he is the Son of Man.

verses.kjv_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.nlt_text: Don't be so surprised! Indeed, the time is coming when all the dead in their graves will hear the voice of God's Son,

verses.kjv_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.nlt_text: and they will rise again. Those who have done good will rise to experience eternal life, and those who have continued in evil will rise to experience judgment.

verses.kjv_text: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.nlt_text: I can do nothing on my own. I judge as God tells me. Therefore, my judgment is just, because I carry out the will of the one who sent me, not my own will.

verses.kjv_text: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.nlt_text: "If I were to testify on my own behalf, my testimony would not be valid.

verses.kjv_text: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.nlt_text: But someone else is also testifying about me, and I assure you that everything he says about me is true.

verses.kjv_text: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, you sent investigators to listen to John the Baptist, and his testimony about me was true.

verses.kjv_text: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.nlt_text: Of course, I have no need of human witnesses, but I say these things so you might be saved.

verses.kjv_text: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.nlt_text: John was like a burning and shining lamp, and you were excited for a while about his message.

verses.kjv_text: But I have greater witness than {that} of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.nlt_text: But I have a greater witness than John-- my teachings and my miracles. The Father gave me these works to accomplish, and they prove that he sent me.

verses.kjv_text: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.nlt_text: And the Father who sent me has testified about me himself. You have never heard his voice or seen him face to face,

verses.kjv_text: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.nlt_text: and you do not have his message in your hearts, because you do not believe me-- the one he sent to you.

verses.kjv_text: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.nlt_text: "You search the Scriptures because you think they give you eternal life. But the Scriptures point to me!

verses.kjv_text: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.nlt_text: Yet you refuse to come to me to receive this life.

verses.kjv_text: I receive not honour from men.
verses.nlt_text: "Your approval means nothing to me,

verses.kjv_text: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.nlt_text: because I know you don't have God's love within you.

verses.kjv_text: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.nlt_text: For I have come to you in my Father's name, and you have rejected me. Yet if others come in their own name, you gladly welcome them.

verses.kjv_text: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that {cometh} from God only?
verses.nlt_text: No wonder you can't believe! For you gladly honor each other, but you don't care about the honor that comes from the one who alone is God.

verses.kjv_text: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is {one} that accuseth you, {even} Moses, in whom ye trust.
verses.nlt_text: "Yet it isn't I who will accuse you before the Father. Moses will accuse you! Yes, Moses, in whom you put your hopes.

verses.kjv_text: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
verses.nlt_text: If you really believed Moses, you would believe me, because he wrote about me.

verses.kjv_text: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.nlt_text: But since you don't believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?"

verses.kjv_text: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is {the sea} of Tiberias.
verses.nlt_text: After this, Jesus crossed over to the far side of the Sea of Galilee, also known as the Sea of Tiberias.

verses.kjv_text: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.nlt_text: A huge crowd kept following him wherever he went, because they saw his miraculous signs as he healed the sick.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus climbed a hill and sat down with his disciples around him.

verses.kjv_text: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.nlt_text: (It was nearly time for the Jewish Passover celebration.)

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus then lifted up {his} eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus soon saw a huge crowd of people coming to look for him. Turning to Philip, he asked, "Where can we buy bread to feed all these people?"

verses.kjv_text: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.nlt_text: He was testing Philip, for he already knew what he was going to do.

verses.kjv_text: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.nlt_text: Philip replied, "Even if we worked for months, we wouldn't have enough money to feed them!"

verses.kjv_text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.nlt_text: Then Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, spoke up.

verses.kjv_text: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.nlt_text: "There's a young boy here with five barley loaves and two fish. But what good is that with this huge crowd?"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.nlt_text: "Tell everyone to sit down," Jesus said. So they all sat down on the grassy slopes. (The men alone numbered 5,000.)

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus took the loaves, gave thanks to God, and distributed them to the people. Afterward he did the same with the fish. And they all ate as much as they wanted.

verses.kjv_text: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.nlt_text: After everyone was full, Jesus told his disciples, "Now gather the leftovers, so that nothing is wasted."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they gathered {them} together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.nlt_text: So they picked up the pieces and filled twelve baskets with scraps left by the people who had eaten from the five barley loaves.

verses.kjv_text: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.nlt_text: When the people saw him do this miraculous sign, they exclaimed, "Surely, he is the Prophet we have been expecting!"

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw that they were ready to force him to be their king, he slipped away into the hills by himself.

verses.kjv_text: And when even was {now} come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.nlt_text: That evening Jesus' disciples went down to the shore to wait for him.

verses.kjv_text: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.nlt_text: But as darkness fell and Jesus still hadn't come back, they got into the boat and headed across the lake toward Capernaum.

verses.kjv_text: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.nlt_text: Soon a gale swept down upon them, and the sea grew very rough.

verses.kjv_text: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.nlt_text: They had rowed three or four miles when suddenly they saw Jesus walking on the water toward the boat. They were terrified,

verses.kjv_text: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.nlt_text: but he called out to them, "Don't be afraid. I am here! "

verses.kjv_text: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.nlt_text: Then they were eager to let him in the boat, and immediately they arrived at their destination!

verses.kjv_text: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but {that} his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.nlt_text: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the far shore saw that the disciples had taken the only boat, and they realized Jesus had not gone with them.

verses.kjv_text: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.nlt_text: Several boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the Lord had blessed the bread and the people had eaten.

verses.kjv_text: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went across to Capernaum to look for him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.nlt_text: They found him on the other side of the lake and asked, "Rabbi, when did you get here?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, you want to be with me because I fed you, not because you understood the miraculous signs.

verses.kjv_text: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed. {Labour not: or, Work not}
verses.nlt_text: But don't be so concerned about perishable things like food. Spend your energy seeking the eternal life that the Son of Man can give you. For God the Father has given me the seal of his approval."

verses.kjv_text: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.nlt_text: They replied, "We want to perform God's works, too. What should we do?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "This is the only work God wants from you: Believe in the one he has sent."

verses.kjv_text: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.nlt_text: They answered, "Show us a miraculous sign if you want us to believe in you. What can you do?

verses.kjv_text: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.nlt_text: After all, our ancestors ate manna while they journeyed through the wilderness! The Scriptures say, 'Moses gave them bread from heaven to eat.' "

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "I tell you the truth, Moses didn't give you bread from heaven. My Father did. And now he offers you the true bread from heaven.

verses.kjv_text: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.nlt_text: The true bread of God is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."

verses.kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.nlt_text: "Sir," they said, "give us that bread every day."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry again. Whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

verses.kjv_text: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.nlt_text: But you haven't believed in me even though you have seen me.

verses.kjv_text: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.nlt_text: However, those the Father has given me will come to me, and I will never reject them.

verses.kjv_text: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: For I have come down from heaven to do the will of God who sent me, not to do my own will.

verses.kjv_text: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.nlt_text: And this is the will of God, that I should not lose even one of all those he has given me, but that I should raise them up at the last day.
