verses.kjv_text: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.nlt_text: For it is my Father's will that all who see his Son and believe in him should have eternal life. I will raise them up at the last day."

verses.kjv_text: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Then the people began to murmur in disagreement because he had said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.nlt_text: They said, "Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph? We know his father and mother. How can he say, 'I came down from heaven'?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus replied, "Stop complaining about what I said.

verses.kjv_text: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.nlt_text: For no one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them to me, and at the last day I will raise them up.

verses.kjv_text: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.nlt_text: As it is written in the Scriptures, 'They will all be taught by God.' Everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him comes to me.

verses.kjv_text: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.nlt_text: (Not that anyone has ever seen the Father; only I, who was sent from God, have seen him.)

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, anyone who believes has eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: I am that bread of life.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I am the bread of life!

verses.kjv_text: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.nlt_text: Your ancestors ate manna in the wilderness, but they all died.

verses.kjv_text: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who eats the bread from heaven, however, will never die.

verses.kjv_text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.nlt_text: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Anyone who eats this bread will live forever; and this bread, which I will offer so the world may live, is my flesh."

verses.kjv_text: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us {his} flesh to eat?
verses.nlt_text: Then the people began arguing with each other about what he meant. "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus said again, "I tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you cannot have eternal life within you.

verses.kjv_text: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.nlt_text: But anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise that person at the last day.

verses.kjv_text: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.nlt_text: For my flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.

verses.kjv_text: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in him.

verses.kjv_text: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.nlt_text: I live because of the living Father who sent me; in the same way, anyone who feeds on me will live because of me.

verses.kjv_text: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.nlt_text: I am the true bread that came down from heaven. Anyone who eats this bread will not die as your ancestors did (even though they ate the manna) but will live forever."

verses.kjv_text: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.nlt_text: He said these things while he was teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

verses.kjv_text: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard {this}, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.nlt_text: Many of his disciples said, "This is very hard to understand. How can anyone accept it?"

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you? {offend: or, scandalize, or, cause you to stumble}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus was aware that his disciples were complaining, so he said to them, "Does this offend you?

verses.kjv_text: {What} and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.nlt_text: Then what will you think if you see the Son of Man ascend to heaven again?

verses.kjv_text: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, {they} are spirit, and {they} are life.
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit alone gives eternal life. Human effort accomplishes nothing. And the very words I have spoken to you are spirit and life.

verses.kjv_text: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.nlt_text: But some of you do not believe me." (For Jesus knew from the beginning which ones didn't believe, and he knew who would betray him.)

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "That is why I said that people can't come to me unless the Father gives them to me."

verses.kjv_text: From that {time} many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.nlt_text: At this point many of his disciples turned away and deserted him.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus turned to the Twelve and asked, "Are you also going to leave?"

verses.kjv_text: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter replied, "Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words that give eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.nlt_text: We believe, and we know you are the Holy One of God. "

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said, "I chose the twelve of you, but one is a devil."

verses.kjv_text: He spake of Judas Iscariot {the son} of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.nlt_text: He was speaking of Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, one of the Twelve, who would later betray him.

verses.kjv_text: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.nlt_text: After this, Jesus traveled around Galilee. He wanted to stay out of Judea, where the Jewish leaders were plotting his death.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.nlt_text: But soon it was time for the Jewish Festival of Shelters,

verses.kjv_text: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.nlt_text: and Jesus' brothers said to him, "Leave here and go to Judea, where your followers can see your miracles!

verses.kjv_text: For {there is} no man {that} doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.nlt_text: You can't become famous if you hide like this! If you can do such wonderful things, show yourself to the world!"

verses.kjv_text: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.nlt_text: For even his brothers didn't believe in him.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Now is not the right time for me to go, but you can go anytime.

verses.kjv_text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.nlt_text: The world can't hate you, but it does hate me because I accuse it of doing evil.

verses.kjv_text: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
verses.nlt_text: You go on. I'm not going to this festival, because my time has not yet come."

verses.kjv_text: When he had said these words unto them, he abode {still} in Galilee.
verses.nlt_text: After saying these things, Jesus remained in Galilee.

verses.kjv_text: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.nlt_text: But after his brothers left for the festival, Jesus also went, though secretly, staying out of public view.

verses.kjv_text: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.nlt_text: The Jewish leaders tried to find him at the festival and kept asking if anyone had seen him.

verses.kjv_text: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.nlt_text: There was a lot of grumbling about him among the crowds. Some argued, "He's a good man," but others said, "He's nothing but a fraud who deceives the people."

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.nlt_text: But no one had the courage to speak favorably about him in public, for they were afraid of getting in trouble with the Jewish leaders.

verses.kjv_text: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.nlt_text: Then, midway through the festival, Jesus went up to the Temple and began to teach.

verses.kjv_text: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned? {letters: or, learning}
verses.nlt_text: The people were surprised when they heard him. "How does he know so much when he hasn't been trained?" they asked.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus told them, "My message is not my own; it comes from God who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or {whether} I speak of myself.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who wants to do the will of God will know whether my teaching is from God or is merely my own.

verses.kjv_text: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.nlt_text: Those who speak for themselves want glory only for themselves, but a person who seeks to honor the one who sent him speaks truth, not lies.

verses.kjv_text: Did not Moses give you the law, and {yet} none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.nlt_text: Moses gave you the law, but none of you obeys it! In fact, you are trying to kill me."

verses.kjv_text: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.nlt_text: The crowd replied, "You're demon possessed! Who's trying to kill you?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I did one miracle on the Sabbath, and you were amazed.

verses.kjv_text: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.nlt_text: But you work on the Sabbath, too, when you obey Moses' law of circumcision. (Actually, this tradition of circumcision began with the patriarchs, long before the law of Moses.)

verses.kjv_text: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day? {that...: or, without breaking the law of Moses}
verses.nlt_text: For if the correct time for circumcising your son falls on the Sabbath, you go ahead and do it so as not to break the law of Moses. So why should you be angry with me for healing a man on the Sabbath?

verses.kjv_text: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.nlt_text: Look beneath the surface so you can judge correctly."

verses.kjv_text: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.nlt_text: Some of the people who lived in Jerusalem started to ask each other, "Isn't this the man they are trying to kill?

verses.kjv_text: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
verses.nlt_text: But here he is, speaking in public, and they say nothing to him. Could our leaders possibly believe that he is the Messiah?

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.nlt_text: But how could he be? For we know where this man comes from. When the Messiah comes, he will simply appear; no one will know where he comes from."

verses.kjv_text: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.nlt_text: While Jesus was teaching in the Temple, he called out, "Yes, you know me, and you know where I come from. But I'm not here on my own. The one who sent me is true, and you don't know him.

verses.kjv_text: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.nlt_text: But I know him because I come from him, and he sent me to you."

verses.kjv_text: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.nlt_text: Then the leaders tried to arrest him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.

verses.kjv_text: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this {man} hath done?
verses.nlt_text: Many among the crowds at the Temple believed in him. "After all," they said, "would you expect the Messiah to do more miraculous signs than this man has done?"

verses.kjv_text: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.nlt_text: When the Pharisees heard that the crowds were whispering such things, they and the leading priests sent Temple guards to arrest Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and {then} I go unto him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus told them, "I will be with you only a little longer. Then I will return to the one who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find {me}: and where I am, {thither} ye cannot come.
verses.nlt_text: You will search for me but not find me. And you cannot go where I am going."

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles? {Gentiles: or, Greeks}
verses.nlt_text: The Jewish leaders were puzzled by this statement. "Where is he planning to go?" they asked. "Is he thinking of leaving the country and going to the Jews in other lands? Maybe he will even teach the Greeks!

verses.kjv_text: What {manner of} saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find {me}: and where I am, {thither} ye cannot come?
verses.nlt_text: What does he mean when he says, 'You will search for me but not find me,' and 'You cannot go where I am going'?"

verses.kjv_text: In the last day, that great {day} of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.nlt_text: On the last day, the climax of the festival, Jesus stood and shouted to the crowds, "Anyone who is thirsty may come to me!

verses.kjv_text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who believes in me may come and drink! For the Scriptures declare, 'Rivers of living water will flow from his heart.' "

verses.kjv_text: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet {given}; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
verses.nlt_text: (When he said "living water," he was speaking of the Spirit, who would be given to everyone believing in him. But the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet entered into his glory.)

verses.kjv_text: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.nlt_text: When the crowds heard him say this, some of them declared, "Surely this man is the Prophet we've been expecting."

verses.kjv_text: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.nlt_text: Others said, "He is the Messiah." Still others said, "But he can't be! Will the Messiah come from Galilee?

verses.kjv_text: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures clearly state that the Messiah will be born of the royal line of David, in Bethlehem, the village where King David was born."

verses.kjv_text: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.nlt_text: So the crowd was divided about him.

verses.kjv_text: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.nlt_text: Some even wanted him arrested, but no one laid a hand on him.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.nlt_text: When the Temple guards returned without having arrested Jesus, the leading priests and Pharisees demanded, "Why didn't you bring him in?"

verses.kjv_text: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.nlt_text: "We have never heard anyone speak like this!" the guards responded.

verses.kjv_text: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.nlt_text: "Have you been led astray, too?" the Pharisees mocked.

verses.kjv_text: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.nlt_text: "Is there a single one of us rulers or Pharisees who believes in him?

verses.kjv_text: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.nlt_text: This foolish crowd follows him, but they are ignorant of the law. God's curse is on them!"

verses.kjv_text: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,) {to Jesus: Gr. to him}
verses.nlt_text: Then Nicodemus, the leader who had met with Jesus earlier, spoke up.

verses.kjv_text: Doth our law judge {any} man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.nlt_text: "Is it legal to convict a man before he is given a hearing?" he asked.

verses.kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.nlt_text: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Search the Scriptures and see for yourself-- no prophet ever comes from Galilee!"

verses.kjv_text: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.nlt_text: Then the meeting broke up, and everybody went home.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus returned to the Mount of Olives,

verses.kjv_text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.nlt_text: but early the next morning he was back again at the Temple. A crowd soon gathered, and he sat down and taught them.

verses.kjv_text: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.nlt_text: As he was speaking, the teachers of religious law and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in the act of adultery. They put her in front of the crowd.

verses.kjv_text: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.nlt_text: "Teacher," they said to Jesus, "this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

verses.kjv_text: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.nlt_text: The law of Moses says to stone her. What do you say?"

verses.kjv_text: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with {his} finger wrote on the ground, {as though he heard them not}.
verses.nlt_text: They were trying to trap him into saying something they could use against him, but Jesus stooped down and wrote in the dust with his finger.

verses.kjv_text: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.nlt_text: They kept demanding an answer, so he stood up again and said, "All right, but let the one who has never sinned throw the first stone!"

verses.kjv_text: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.nlt_text: Then he stooped down again and wrote in the dust.

verses.kjv_text: And they which heard {it}, being convicted by {their own} conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, {even} unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.nlt_text: When the accusers heard this, they slipped away one by one, beginning with the oldest, until only Jesus was left in the middle of the crowd with the woman.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus stood up again and said to the woman, "Where are your accusers? Didn't even one of them condemn you?"

verses.kjv_text: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.nlt_text: "No, Lord," she said.And Jesus said, "Neither do I. Go and sin no more."

verses.kjv_text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus spoke to the people once more and said, "I am the light of the world. If you follow me, you won't have to walk in darkness, because you will have the light that leads to life."

verses.kjv_text: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.nlt_text: The Pharisees replied, "You are making those claims about yourself! Such testimony is not valid."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, {yet} my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "These claims are valid even though I make them about myself. For I know where I came from and where I am going, but you don't know this about me.

verses.kjv_text: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.nlt_text: You judge me by human standards, but I do not judge anyone.

verses.kjv_text: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: And if I did, my judgment would be correct in every respect because I am not alone. The Father who sent me is with me.

verses.kjv_text: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.nlt_text: Your own law says that if two people agree about something, their witness is accepted as fact.

verses.kjv_text: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.nlt_text: I am one witness, and my Father who sent me is the other."

verses.kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.nlt_text: "Where is your father?" they asked.Jesus answered, "Since you don't know who I am, you don't know who my Father is. If you knew me, you would also know my Father."

verses.kjv_text: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus made these statements while he was teaching in the section of the Temple known as the Treasury. But he was not arrested, because his time had not yet come.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.nlt_text: Later Jesus said to them again, "I am going away. You will search for me but will die in your sin. You cannot come where I am going."

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.nlt_text: The people asked, "Is he planning to commit suicide? What does he mean, 'You cannot come where I am going'?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus continued, "You are from below; I am from above. You belong to this world; I do not.

verses.kjv_text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am {he}, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.nlt_text: That is why I said that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I Am who I claim to be, you will die in your sins."

verses.kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even {the same} that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.nlt_text: Who are you?" they demanded.Jesus replied, "The one I have always claimed to be.

verses.kjv_text: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.nlt_text: I have much to say about you and much to condemn, but I won't. For I say only what I have heard from the one who sent me, and he is completely truthful."

verses.kjv_text: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.nlt_text: But they still didn't understand that he was talking about his Father.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am {he}, and {that} I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.nlt_text: So Jesus said, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man on the cross, then you will understand that I Am he. I do nothing on my own but say only what the Father taught me.

verses.kjv_text: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.nlt_text: And the one who sent me is with me-- he has not deserted me. For I always do what pleases him."

verses.kjv_text: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.nlt_text: Then many who heard him say these things believed in him.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, {then} are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said to the people who believed in him, "You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teachings.

verses.kjv_text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.nlt_text: And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

verses.kjv_text: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.nlt_text: "But we are descendants of Abraham," they said. "We have never been slaves to anyone. What do you mean, 'You will be set free'?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, everyone who sins is a slave of sin.

verses.kjv_text: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: {but} the Son abideth ever.
verses.nlt_text: A slave is not a permanent member of the family, but a son is part of the family forever.

verses.kjv_text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.nlt_text: So if the Son sets you free, you are truly free.

verses.kjv_text: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I realize that you are descendants of Abraham. And yet some of you are trying to kill me because there's no room in your hearts for my message.

verses.kjv_text: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.nlt_text: I am telling you what I saw when I was with my Father. But you are following the advice of your father."

verses.kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: "Our father is Abraham!" they declared."No," Jesus replied, "for if you were really the children of Abraham, you would follow his example.

verses.kjv_text: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, you are trying to kill me because I told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.

verses.kjv_text: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, {even} God.
verses.nlt_text: No, you are imitating your real father." They replied, "We aren't illegitimate children! God himself is our true Father."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, because I have come to you from God. I am not here on my own, but he sent me.

verses.kjv_text: Why do ye not understand my speech? {even} because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.nlt_text: Why can't you understand what I am saying? It's because you can't even hear me!

verses.kjv_text: Ye are of {your} father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it. {of his own: or, from his own will or disposition}
verses.nlt_text: For you are the children of your father the devil, and you love to do the evil things he does. He was a murderer from the beginning. He has always hated the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, it is consistent with his character; for he is a liar and the father of lies.

verses.kjv_text: And because I tell {you} the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.nlt_text: So when I tell the truth, you just naturally don't believe me!

verses.kjv_text: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.nlt_text: Which of you can truthfully accuse me of sin? And since I am telling you the truth, why don't you believe me?

verses.kjv_text: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear {them} not, because ye are not of God.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who belongs to God listens gladly to the words of God. But you don't listen because you don't belong to God."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.nlt_text: The people retorted, "You Samaritan devil! Didn't we say all along that you were possessed by a demon?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.nlt_text: "No," Jesus said, "I have no demon in me. For I honor my Father-- and you dishonor me.

verses.kjv_text: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.nlt_text: And though I have no wish to glorify myself, God is going to glorify me. He is the true judge.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, anyone who obeys my teaching will never die!"

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.nlt_text: The people said, "Now we know you are possessed by a demon. Even Abraham and the prophets died, but you say, 'Anyone who obeys my teaching will never die!'

verses.kjv_text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.nlt_text: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus answered, "If I want glory for myself, it doesn't count. But it is my Father who will glorify me. You say, 'He is our God,'

verses.kjv_text: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.nlt_text: but you don't even know him. I know him. If I said otherwise, I would be as great a liar as you! But I do know him and obey him.

verses.kjv_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw {it}, and was glad.
verses.nlt_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced as he looked forward to my coming. He saw it and was glad."

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.nlt_text: The people said, "You aren't even fifty years old. How can you say you have seen Abraham? "

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, before Abraham was even born, I Am! "

verses.kjv_text: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.nlt_text: At that point they picked up stones to throw at him. But Jesus was hidden from them and left the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: And as {Jesus} passed by, he saw a man which was blind from {his} birth.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus was walking along, he saw a man who had been blind from birth.

verses.kjv_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.nlt_text: "Rabbi," his disciples asked him, "why was this man born blind? Was it because of his own sins or his parents' sins?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.nlt_text: "It was not because of his sins or his parents' sins," Jesus answered. "This happened so the power of God could be seen in him.

verses.kjv_text: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.nlt_text: We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work.

verses.kjv_text: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.nlt_text: But while I am here in the world, I am the light of the world."

verses.kjv_text: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay, {anointed...: or, spread the clay upon the eyes of the blind man}
verses.nlt_text: Then he spit on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and spread the mud over the blind man's eyes.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.nlt_text: He told him, "Go wash yourself in the pool of Siloam" (Siloam means "sent"). So the man went and washed and came back seeing!

verses.kjv_text: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.nlt_text: His neighbors and others who knew him as a blind beggar asked each other, "Isn't this the man who used to sit and beg?"

verses.kjv_text: Some said, This is he: others {said}, He is like him: {but} he said, I am {he}.
verses.nlt_text: Some said he was, and others said, "No, he just looks like him!" But the beggar kept saying, "Yes, I am the same one!"

verses.kjv_text: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.nlt_text: They asked, "Who healed you? What happened?"

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.nlt_text: He told them, "The man they call Jesus made mud and spread it over my eyes and told me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam and wash yourself.' So I went and washed, and now I can see!"

verses.kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.nlt_text: "Where is he now?" they asked."I don't know," he replied.

verses.kjv_text: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.nlt_text: Then they took the man who had been blind to the Pharisees,

verses.kjv_text: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.nlt_text: because it was on the Sabbath that Jesus had made the mud and healed him.

verses.kjv_text: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.nlt_text: The Pharisees asked the man all about it. So he told them, "He put the mud over my eyes, and when I washed it away, I could see!"

verses.kjv_text: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.nlt_text: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man Jesus is not from God, for he is working on the Sabbath." Others said, "But how could an ordinary sinner do such miraculous signs?" So there was a deep division of opinion among them.

verses.kjv_text: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Pharisees again questioned the man who had been blind and demanded, "What's your opinion about this man who healed you?" The man replied, "I think he must be a prophet."

verses.kjv_text: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.nlt_text: The Jewish leaders still refused to believe the man had been blind and could now see, so they called in his parents.

verses.kjv_text: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.nlt_text: They asked them, "Is this your son? Was he born blind? If so, how can he now see?"

verses.kjv_text: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.nlt_text: His parents replied, "We know this is our son and that he was born blind,

verses.kjv_text: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.nlt_text: but we don't know how he can see or who healed him. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself."

verses.kjv_text: These {words} spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.nlt_text: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who had announced that anyone saying Jesus was the Messiah would be expelled from the synagogue.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.nlt_text: That's why they said, "He is old enough. Ask him."

verses.kjv_text: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.nlt_text: So for the second time they called in the man who had been blind and told him, "God should get the glory for this, because we know this man Jesus is a sinner."

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner {or no}, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.nlt_text: "I don't know whether he is a sinner," the man replied. "But I know this: I was blind, and now I can see!"

verses.kjv_text: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.nlt_text: "But what did he do?" they asked. "How did he heal you?"

verses.kjv_text: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear {it} again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.nlt_text: "Look!" the man exclaimed. "I told you once. Didn't you listen? Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples, too?"

verses.kjv_text: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.nlt_text: Then they cursed him and said, "You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses!

verses.kjv_text: We know that God spake unto Moses: {as for} this {fellow}, we know not from whence he is.
verses.nlt_text: We know God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where this man comes from."

verses.kjv_text: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and {yet} he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.nlt_text: "Why, that's very strange!" the man replied. "He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from?

verses.kjv_text: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.nlt_text: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but he is ready to hear those who worship him and do his will.

verses.kjv_text: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.nlt_text: Ever since the world began, no one has been able to open the eyes of someone born blind.

verses.kjv_text: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.nlt_text: If this man were not from God, he couldn't have done it."

verses.kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out. {cast...: or, excommunicated him}
verses.nlt_text: "You were born a total sinner!" they answered. "Are you trying to teach us?" And they threw him out of the synagogue.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus heard what had happened, he found the man and asked, "Do you believe in the Son of Man? "

verses.kjv_text: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.nlt_text: The man answered, "Who is he, sir? I want to believe in him."

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.nlt_text: "You have seen him," Jesus said, "and he is speaking to you!"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, Lord, I believe!" the man said. And he worshiped Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told him, "I entered this world to render judgment-- to give sight to the blind and to show those who think they see that they are blind."

verses.kjv_text: And {some} of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.nlt_text: Some Pharisees who were standing nearby heard him and asked, "Are you saying we're blind?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.nlt_text: "If you were blind, you wouldn't be guilty," Jesus replied. "But you remain guilty because you claim you can see.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, anyone who sneaks over the wall of a sheepfold, rather than going through the gate, must surely be a thief and a robber!

verses.kjv_text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.nlt_text: But the one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.kjv_text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.nlt_text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep recognize his voice and come to him. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

verses.kjv_text: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.nlt_text: After he has gathered his own flock, he walks ahead of them, and they follow him because they know his voice.

verses.kjv_text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.nlt_text: They won't follow a stranger; they will run from him because they don't know his voice."

verses.kjv_text: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Those who heard Jesus use this illustration didn't understand what he meant,

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.nlt_text: so he explained it to them: "I tell you the truth, I am the gate for the sheep.

verses.kjv_text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.nlt_text: All who came before me were thieves and robbers. But the true sheep did not listen to them.

verses.kjv_text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I am the gate. Those who come in through me will be saved. They will come and go freely and will find good pastures.

verses.kjv_text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have {it} more abundantly.
verses.nlt_text: The thief's purpose is to steal and kill and destroy. My purpose is to give them a rich and satisfying life.

verses.kjv_text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.nlt_text: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd sacrifices his life for the sheep.

verses.kjv_text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.nlt_text: A hired hand will run when he sees a wolf coming. He will abandon the sheep because they don't belong to him and he isn't their shepherd. And so the wolf attacks them and scatters the flock.

verses.kjv_text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.nlt_text: The hired hand runs away because he's working only for the money and doesn't really care about the sheep.

verses.kjv_text: I am the good shepherd, and know my {sheep}, and am known of mine.
verses.nlt_text: "I am the good shepherd; I know my own sheep, and they know me,

verses.kjv_text: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.nlt_text: just as my Father knows me and I know the Father. So I sacrifice my life for the sheep.

verses.kjv_text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, {and} one shepherd.
verses.nlt_text: I have other sheep, too, that are not in this sheepfold. I must bring them also. They will listen to my voice, and there will be one flock with one shepherd.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.nlt_text: "The Father loves me because I sacrifice my life so I may take it back again.

verses.kjv_text: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.nlt_text: No one can take my life from me. I sacrifice it voluntarily. For I have the authority to lay it down when I want to and also to take it up again. For this is what my Father has commanded."

verses.kjv_text: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.nlt_text: When he said these things, the people were again divided in their opinions about him.

verses.kjv_text: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.nlt_text: Some said, "He's demon possessed and out of his mind. Why listen to a man like that?"

verses.kjv_text: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.nlt_text: Others said, "This doesn't sound like a man possessed by a demon! Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"

verses.kjv_text: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.nlt_text: It was now winter, and Jesus was in Jerusalem at the time of Hanukkah, the Festival of Dedication.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
verses.nlt_text: He was in the Temple, walking through the section known as Solomon's Colonnade.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly. {make...: or, hold us in suspense}
verses.nlt_text: The people surrounded him and asked, "How long are you going to keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "I have already told you, and you don't believe me. The proof is the work I do in my Father's name.

verses.kjv_text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.nlt_text: But you don't believe me because you are not my sheep.

verses.kjv_text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.nlt_text: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

verses.kjv_text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any {man} pluck them out of my hand.
verses.nlt_text: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them away from me,

verses.kjv_text: My Father, which gave {them} me, is greater than all; and no {man} is able to pluck {them} out of my Father's hand.
verses.nlt_text: for my Father has given them to me, and he is more powerful than anyone else. No one can snatch them from the Father's hand.

verses.kjv_text: I and {my} Father are one.
verses.nlt_text: The Father and I are one."

verses.kjv_text: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.nlt_text: Once again the people picked up stones to kill him.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said, "At my Father's direction I have done many good works. For which one are you going to stone me?"

verses.kjv_text: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.nlt_text: They replied, "We're stoning you not for any good work, but for blasphemy! You, a mere man, claim to be God."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "It is written in your own Scriptures that God said to certain leaders of the people, 'I say, you are gods!'

verses.kjv_text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.nlt_text: And you know that the Scriptures cannot be altered. So if those people who received God's message were called 'gods,'

verses.kjv_text: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.nlt_text: why do you call it blasphemy when I say, 'I am the Son of God'? After all, the Father set me apart and sent me into the world.

verses.kjv_text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.nlt_text: Don't believe me unless I carry out my Father's work.

verses.kjv_text: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father {is} in me, and I in him.
verses.nlt_text: But if I do his work, believe in the evidence of the miraculous works I have done, even if you don't believe me. Then you will know and understand that the Father is in me, and I am in the Father."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.nlt_text: Once again they tried to arrest him, but he got away and left them.

verses.kjv_text: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.nlt_text: He went beyond the Jordan River near the place where John was first baptizing and stayed there awhile.

verses.kjv_text: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.nlt_text: And many followed him. "John didn't perform miraculous signs," they remarked to one another, "but everything he said about this man has come true."

verses.kjv_text: And many believed on him there.
verses.nlt_text: And many who were there believed in Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Now a certain {man} was sick, {named} Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.nlt_text: A man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany with his sisters, Mary and Martha.

verses.kjv_text: (It was {that} Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.nlt_text: This is the Mary who later poured the expensive perfume on the Lord's feet and wiped them with her hair. Her brother, Lazarus, was sick.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.nlt_text: So the two sisters sent a message to Jesus telling him, "Lord, your dear friend is very sick."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus heard {that}, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.nlt_text: But when Jesus heard about it he said, "Lazarus's sickness will not end in death. No, it happened for the glory of God so that the Son of God will receive glory from this."

verses.kjv_text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.nlt_text: So although Jesus loved Martha, Mary, and Lazarus,

verses.kjv_text: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.nlt_text: he stayed where he was for the next two days.

verses.kjv_text: Then after that saith he to {his} disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, he said to his disciples, "Let's go back to Judea."

verses.kjv_text: {His} disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.nlt_text: But his disciples objected. "Rabbi," they said, "only a few days ago the people in Judea were trying to stone you. Are you going there again?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "There are twelve hours of daylight every day. During the day people can walk safely. They can see because they have the light of this world.

verses.kjv_text: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.nlt_text: But at night there is danger of stumbling because they have no light."

verses.kjv_text: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but now I will go and wake him up."

verses.kjv_text: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples said, "Lord, if he is sleeping, he will soon get better!"

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.nlt_text: They thought Jesus meant Lazarus was simply sleeping, but Jesus meant Lazarus had died.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.nlt_text: So he told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead.

verses.kjv_text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.nlt_text: And for your sakes, I'm glad I wasn't there, for now you will really believe. Come, let's go see him."

verses.kjv_text: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.nlt_text: Thomas, nicknamed the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, "Let's go, too-- and die with Jesus."

verses.kjv_text: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had {lain} in the grave four days already.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus arrived at Bethany, he was told that Lazarus had already been in his grave for four days.

verses.kjv_text: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off: {about...: that is, about two miles}
verses.nlt_text: Bethany was only a few miles down the road from Jerusalem,

verses.kjv_text: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.nlt_text: and many of the people had come to console Martha and Mary in their loss.

verses.kjv_text: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat {still} in the house.
verses.nlt_text: When Martha got word that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him. But Mary stayed in the house.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.nlt_text: Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if only you had been here, my brother would not have died.

verses.kjv_text: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give {it} thee.
verses.nlt_text: But even now I know that God will give you whatever you ask."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told her, "Your brother will rise again."

verses.kjv_text: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes," Martha said, "he will rise when everyone else rises, at the last day."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told her, "I am the resurrection and the life. Anyone who believes in me will live, even after dying.

verses.kjv_text: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who lives in me and believes in me will never ever die. Do you believe this, Martha?"

verses.kjv_text: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, Lord," she told him. "I have always believed you are the Messiah, the Son of God, the one who has come into the world from God."

verses.kjv_text: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.nlt_text: Then she returned to Mary. She called Mary aside from the mourners and told her, "The Teacher is here and wants to see you."

verses.kjv_text: As soon as she heard {that}, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.nlt_text: So Mary immediately went to him.

verses.kjv_text: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus had stayed outside the village, at the place where Martha met him.

verses.kjv_text: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.nlt_text: When the people who were at the house consoling Mary saw her leave so hastily, they assumed she was going to Lazarus's grave to weep. So they followed her there.

verses.kjv_text: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.nlt_text: When Mary arrived and saw Jesus, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if only you had been here, my brother would not have died."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled, {was troubled: Gr. he troubled himself}
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw her weeping and saw the other people wailing with her, a deep anger welled up within him, and he was deeply troubled.

verses.kjv_text: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.nlt_text: "Where have you put him?" he asked them.They told him, "Lord, come and see."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus wept.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus wept.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.nlt_text: The people who were standing nearby said, "See how much he loved him!"

verses.kjv_text: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.nlt_text: But some said, "This man healed a blind man. Couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus was still angry as he arrived at the tomb, a cave with a stone rolled across its entrance.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been {dead} four days.
verses.nlt_text: "Roll the stone aside," Jesus told them.But Martha, the dead man's sister, protested, "Lord, he has been dead for four days. The smell will be terrible."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "Didn't I tell you that you would see God's glory if you believe?"

verses.kjv_text: Then they took away the stone {from the place} where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up {his} eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.nlt_text: So they rolled the stone aside. Then Jesus looked up to heaven and said, "Father, thank you for hearing me.

verses.kjv_text: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said {it}, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.nlt_text: You always hear me, but I said it out loud for the sake of all these people standing here, so that they will believe you sent me."

verses.kjv_text: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus shouted, "Lazarus, come out!"

verses.kjv_text: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.nlt_text: And the dead man came out, his hands and feet bound in graveclothes, his face wrapped in a headcloth. Jesus told them, "Unwrap him and let him go!"

verses.kjv_text: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.nlt_text: Many of the people who were with Mary believed in Jesus when they saw this happen.

verses.kjv_text: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.nlt_text: But some went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

verses.kjv_text: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.nlt_text: Then the leading priests and Pharisees called the high council together. "What are we going to do?" they asked each other. "This man certainly performs many miraculous signs.

verses.kjv_text: If we let him thus alone, all {men} will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.nlt_text: If we allow him to go on like this, soon everyone will believe in him. Then the Roman army will come and destroy both our Temple and our nation."

verses.kjv_text: And one of them, {named} Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.nlt_text: Caiaphas, who was high priest at that time, said, "You don't know what you're talking about!

verses.kjv_text: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.nlt_text: You don't realize that it's better for you that one man should die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed."

verses.kjv_text: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.nlt_text: He did not say this on his own; as high priest at that time he was led to prophesy that Jesus would die for the entire nation.

verses.kjv_text: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.nlt_text: And not only for that nation, but to bring together and unite all the children of God scattered around the world.

verses.kjv_text: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.nlt_text: So from that time on, the Jewish leaders began to plot Jesus' death.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, Jesus stopped his public ministry among the people and left Jerusalem. He went to a place near the wilderness, to the village of Ephraim, and stayed there with his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.nlt_text: It was now almost time for the Jewish Passover celebration, and many people from all over the country arrived in Jerusalem several days early so they could go through the purification ceremony before Passover began.

verses.kjv_text: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.nlt_text: They kept looking for Jesus, but as they stood around in the Temple, they said to each other, "What do you think? He won't come for Passover, will he?"

verses.kjv_text: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew {it}, that they might take him.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the leading priests and Pharisees had publicly ordered that anyone seeing Jesus must report it immediately so they could arrest him.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: Six days before the Passover celebration began, Jesus arrived in Bethany, the home of Lazarus-- the man he had raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.nlt_text: A dinner was prepared in Jesus' honor. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those who ate with him.

verses.kjv_text: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.nlt_text: Then Mary took a twelve-ounce jar of expensive perfume made from essence of nard, and she anointed Jesus' feet with it, wiping his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's {son}, which should betray him,
verses.nlt_text: But Judas Iscariot, the disciple who would soon betray him, said,

verses.kjv_text: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.nlt_text: "That perfume was worth a year's wages. It should have been sold and the money given to the poor."

verses.kjv_text: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.nlt_text: Not that he cared for the poor-- he was a thief, and since he was in charge of the disciples' money, he often stole some for himself.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Leave her alone. She did this in preparation for my burial.

verses.kjv_text: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.nlt_text: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me."

verses.kjv_text: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: When all the people heard of Jesus' arrival, they flocked to see him and also to see Lazarus, the man Jesus had raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.nlt_text: Then the leading priests decided to kill Lazarus, too,

verses.kjv_text: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: for it was because of him that many of the people had deserted them and believed in Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.nlt_text: The next day, the news that Jesus was on the way to Jerusalem swept through the city. A large crowd of Passover visitors

verses.kjv_text: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed {is} the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: took palm branches and went down the road to meet him. They shouted, "Praise God! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the LORD! Hail to the King of Israel!"

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.nlt_text: Jesus found a young donkey and rode on it, fulfilling the prophecy that said:

verses.kjv_text: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't be afraid, people of Jerusalem. Look, your King is coming, riding on a donkey's colt."

verses.kjv_text: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and {that} they had done these things unto him.
verses.nlt_text: His disciples didn't understand at the time that this was a fulfillment of prophecy. But after Jesus entered into his glory, they remembered what had happened and realized that these things had been written about him.

verses.kjv_text: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.nlt_text: Many in the crowd had seen Jesus call Lazarus from the tomb, raising him from the dead, and they were telling others about it.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.nlt_text: That was the reason so many went out to meet him-- because they had heard about this miraculous sign.

verses.kjv_text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Pharisees said to each other, "There's nothing we can do. Look, everyone has gone after him!"

verses.kjv_text: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.nlt_text: Some Greeks who had come to Jerusalem for the Passover celebration

verses.kjv_text: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: paid a visit to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee. They said, "Sir, we want to meet Jesus."

verses.kjv_text: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Philip told Andrew about it, and they went together to ask Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Now the time has come for the Son of Man to enter into his glory.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, unless a kernel of wheat is planted in the soil and dies, it remains alone. But its death will produce many new kernels-- a plentiful harvest of new lives.

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.nlt_text: Those who love their life in this world will lose it. Those who care nothing for their life in this world will keep it for eternity.

verses.kjv_text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will {my} Father honour.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who wants to be my disciple must follow me, because my servants must be where I am. And the Father will honor anyone who serves me.

verses.kjv_text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.nlt_text: "Now my soul is deeply troubled. Should I pray, 'Father, save me from this hour'? But this is the very reason I came!

verses.kjv_text: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, {saying}, I have both glorified {it}, and will glorify {it} again.
verses.nlt_text: Father, bring glory to your name." Then a voice spoke from heaven, saying, "I have already brought glory to my name, and I will do so again."

verses.kjv_text: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard {it}, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.nlt_text: When the crowd heard the voice, some thought it was thunder, while others declared an angel had spoken to him.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told them, "The voice was for your benefit, not mine.

verses.kjv_text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.nlt_text: The time for judging this world has come, when Satan, the ruler of this world, will be cast out.

verses.kjv_text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all {men} unto me.
verses.nlt_text: And when I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw everyone to myself."

verses.kjv_text: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.nlt_text: He said this to indicate how he was going to die.

verses.kjv_text: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.nlt_text: The crowd responded, "We understood from Scripture that the Messiah would live forever. How can you say the Son of Man will die? Just who is this Son of Man, anyway?"

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "My light will shine for you just a little longer. Walk in the light while you can, so the darkness will not overtake you. Those who walk in the darkness cannot see where they are going.

verses.kjv_text: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.nlt_text: Put your trust in the light while there is still time; then you will become children of the light." After saying these things, Jesus went away and was hidden from them.

verses.kjv_text: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.nlt_text: But despite all the miraculous signs Jesus had done, most of the people still did not believe in him.

verses.kjv_text: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.nlt_text: This is exactly what Isaiah the prophet had predicted: "LORD, who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD revealed his powerful arm?"

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.nlt_text: But the people couldn't believe, for as Isaiah also said,

verses.kjv_text: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with {their} eyes, nor understand with {their} heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
