verses.nlt_text: "The Lord has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts-- so that their eyes cannot see, and their hearts cannot understand, and they cannot turn to me and have me heal them."

verses.kjv_text: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.nlt_text: Isaiah was referring to Jesus when he said this, because he saw the future and spoke of the Messiah's glory.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess {him}, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.nlt_text: Many people did believe in him, however, including some of the Jewish leaders. But they wouldn't admit it for fear that the Pharisees would expel them from the synagogue.

verses.kjv_text: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.nlt_text: For they loved human praise more than the praise of God.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus shouted to the crowds, "If you trust me, you are trusting not only me, but also God who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: For when you see me, you are seeing the one who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.nlt_text: I have come as a light to shine in this dark world, so that all who put their trust in me will no longer remain in the dark.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.nlt_text: I will not judge those who hear me but don't obey me, for I have come to save the world and not to judge it.

verses.kjv_text: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.nlt_text: But all who reject me and my message will be judged on the day of judgment by the truth I have spoken.

verses.kjv_text: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.nlt_text: I don't speak on my own authority. The Father who sent me has commanded me what to say and how to say it.

verses.kjv_text: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.nlt_text: And I know his commands lead to eternal life; so I say whatever the Father tells me to say."

verses.kjv_text: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.nlt_text: Before the Passover celebration, Jesus knew that his hour had come to leave this world and return to his Father. He had loved his disciples during his ministry on earth, and now he loved them to the very end.

verses.kjv_text: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's {son}, to betray him;
verses.nlt_text: It was time for supper, and the devil had already prompted Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew that the Father had given him authority over everything and that he had come from God and would return to God.

verses.kjv_text: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.nlt_text: So he got up from the table, took off his robe, wrapped a towel around his waist,

verses.kjv_text: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe {them} with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.nlt_text: and poured water into a basin. Then he began to wash the disciples' feet, drying them with the towel he had around him.

verses.kjv_text: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet? {Peter saith: Gr. he saith}
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus came to Simon Peter, Peter said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "You don't understand now what I am doing, but someday you will."

verses.kjv_text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.nlt_text: "No," Peter protested, "you will never ever wash my feet!" Jesus replied, "Unless I wash you, you won't belong to me."

verses.kjv_text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also {my} hands and {my} head.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter exclaimed, "Then wash my hands and head as well, Lord, not just my feet!"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash {his} feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "A person who has bathed all over does not need to wash, except for the feet, to be entirely clean. And you disciples are clean, but not all of you."

verses.kjv_text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.nlt_text: For Jesus knew who would betray him. That is what he meant when he said, "Not all of you are clean."

verses.kjv_text: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.nlt_text: After washing their feet, he put on his robe again and sat down and asked, "Do you understand what I was doing?

verses.kjv_text: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for {so} I am.
verses.nlt_text: You call me 'Teacher' and 'Lord,' and you are right, because that's what I am.

verses.kjv_text: If I then, {your} Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
verses.nlt_text: And since I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you ought to wash each other's feet.

verses.kjv_text: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.nlt_text: I have given you an example to follow. Do as I have done to you.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, slaves are not greater than their master. Nor is the messenger more important than the one who sends the message.

verses.kjv_text: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.nlt_text: Now that you know these things, God will bless you for doing them.

verses.kjv_text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.nlt_text: "I am not saying these things to all of you; I know the ones I have chosen. But this fulfills the Scripture that says, 'The one who eats my food has turned against me.'

verses.kjv_text: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am {he}. {Now: or, From henceforth}
verses.nlt_text: I tell you this beforehand, so that when it happens you will believe that I Am the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, anyone who welcomes my messenger is welcoming me, and anyone who welcomes me is welcoming the Father who sent me."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.nlt_text: Now Jesus was deeply troubled, and he exclaimed, "I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me!"

verses.kjv_text: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.nlt_text: The disciples looked at each other, wondering whom he could mean.

verses.kjv_text: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.nlt_text: The disciple Jesus loved was sitting next to Jesus at the table.

verses.kjv_text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter motioned to him to ask, "Who's he talking about?"

verses.kjv_text: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.nlt_text: So that disciple leaned over to Jesus and asked, "Lord, who is it?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped {it}. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave {it} to Judas Iscariot, {the son} of Simon. {sop: or, morsel}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus responded, "It is the one to whom I give the bread I dip in the bowl." And when he had dipped it, he gave it to Judas, son of Simon Iscariot.

verses.kjv_text: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.nlt_text: When Judas had eaten the bread, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus told him, "Hurry and do what you're going to do."

verses.kjv_text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.nlt_text: None of the others at the table knew what Jesus meant.

verses.kjv_text: For some {of them} thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy {those things} that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.nlt_text: Since Judas was their treasurer, some thought Jesus was telling him to go and pay for the food or to give some money to the poor.

verses.kjv_text: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.nlt_text: So Judas left at once, going out into the night.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.nlt_text: As soon as Judas left the room, Jesus said, "The time has come for the Son of Man to enter into his glory, and God will be glorified because of him.

verses.kjv_text: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.nlt_text: And since God receives glory because of the Son, he will soon give glory to the Son.

verses.kjv_text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.nlt_text: Dear children, I will be with you only a little longer. And as I told the Jewish leaders, you will search for me, but you can't come where I am going.

verses.kjv_text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.nlt_text: So now I am giving you a new commandment: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, you should love each other.

verses.kjv_text: By this shall all {men} know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.nlt_text: Your love for one another will prove to the world that you are my disciples."

verses.kjv_text: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter asked, "Lord, where are you going?" And Jesus replied, "You can't go with me now, but you will follow me later."

verses.kjv_text: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.nlt_text: "But why can't I come now, Lord?" he asked. "I'm ready to die for you."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus answered, "Die for me? I tell you the truth, Peter-- before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny three times that you even know me.

verses.kjv_text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't let your hearts be troubled. Trust in God, and trust also in me.

verses.kjv_text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if {it were} not {so}, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.nlt_text: There is more than enough room in my Father's home. If this were not so, would I have told you that I am going to prepare a place for you?

verses.kjv_text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, {there} ye may be also.
verses.nlt_text: When everything is ready, I will come and get you, so that you will always be with me where I am.

verses.kjv_text: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.nlt_text: And you know the way to where I am going."

verses.kjv_text: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.nlt_text: "No, we don't know, Lord," Thomas said. "We have no idea where you are going, so how can we know the way?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus told him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one can come to the Father except through me.

verses.kjv_text: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.nlt_text: If you had really known me, you would know who my Father is. From now on, you do know him and have seen him!"

verses.kjv_text: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.nlt_text: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father, and we will be satisfied."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou {then}, Shew us the Father?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and yet you still don't know who I am? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father! So why are you asking me to show him to you?

verses.kjv_text: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.nlt_text: Don't you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I speak are not my own, but my Father who lives in me does his work through me.

verses.kjv_text: Believe me that I {am} in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
verses.nlt_text: Just believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me. Or at least believe because of the work you have seen me do.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater {works} than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, anyone who believes in me will do the same works I have done, and even greater works, because I am going to be with the Father.

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.nlt_text: You can ask for anything in my name, and I will do it, so that the Son can bring glory to the Father.

verses.kjv_text: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do {it}.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it!

verses.kjv_text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.nlt_text: "If you love me, obey my commandments.

verses.kjv_text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.nlt_text: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Advocate, who will never leave you.

verses.kjv_text: {Even} the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.nlt_text: He is the Holy Spirit, who leads into all truth. The world cannot receive him, because it isn't looking for him and doesn't recognize him. But you know him, because he lives with you now and later will be in you.

verses.kjv_text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you. {comfortless: or, orphans}
verses.nlt_text: No, I will not abandon you as orphans-- I will come to you.

verses.kjv_text: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.nlt_text: Soon the world will no longer see me, but you will see me. Since I live, you also will live.

verses.kjv_text: At that day ye shall know that I {am} in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.nlt_text: When I am raised to life again, you will know that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.nlt_text: Those who accept my commandments and obey them are the ones who love me. And because they love me, my Father will love them. And I will love them and reveal myself to each of them."

verses.kjv_text: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.nlt_text: Judas (not Judas Iscariot, but the other disciple with that name) said to him, "Lord, why are you going to reveal yourself only to us and not to the world at large?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "All who love me will do what I say. My Father will love them, and we will come and make our home with each of them.

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who doesn't love me will not obey me. And remember, my words are not my own. What I am telling you is from the Father who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you, being {yet} present with you.
verses.nlt_text: I am telling you these things now while I am still with you.

verses.kjv_text: But the Comforter, {which is} the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.nlt_text: But when the Father sends the Advocate as my representative-- that is, the Holy Spirit-- he will teach you everything and will remind you of everything I have told you.

verses.kjv_text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.nlt_text: "I am leaving you with a gift-- peace of mind and heart. And the peace I give is a gift the world cannot give. So don't be troubled or afraid.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come {again} unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.nlt_text: Remember what I told you: I am going away, but I will come back to you again. If you really loved me, you would be happy that I am going to the Father, who is greater than I am.

verses.kjv_text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.nlt_text: I have told you these things before they happen so that when they do happen, you will believe.

verses.kjv_text: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.nlt_text: "I don't have much more time to talk to you, because the ruler of this world approaches. He has no power over me,

verses.kjv_text: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.nlt_text: but I will do what the Father requires of me, so that the world will know that I love the Father. Come, let's be going.

verses.kjv_text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.nlt_text: "I am the true grapevine, and my Father is the gardener.

verses.kjv_text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every {branch} that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.nlt_text: He cuts off every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit, and he prunes the branches that do bear fruit so they will produce even more.

verses.kjv_text: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.nlt_text: You have already been pruned and purified by the message I have given you.

verses.kjv_text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.nlt_text: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. For a branch cannot produce fruit if it is severed from the vine, and you cannot be fruitful unless you remain in me.

verses.kjv_text: I am the vine, ye {are} the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing. {without me: or, severed from me}
verses.nlt_text: "Yes, I am the vine; you are the branches. Those who remain in me, and I in them, will produce much fruit. For apart from me you can do nothing.

verses.kjv_text: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast {them} into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who does not remain in me is thrown away like a useless branch and withers. Such branches are gathered into a pile to be burned.

verses.kjv_text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.nlt_text: But if you remain in me and my words remain in you, you may ask for anything you want, and it will be granted!

verses.kjv_text: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.nlt_text: When you produce much fruit, you are my true disciples. This brings great glory to my Father.

verses.kjv_text: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.nlt_text: "I have loved you even as the Father has loved me. Remain in my love.

verses.kjv_text: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.nlt_text: When you obey my commandments, you remain in my love, just as I obey my Father's commandments and remain in his love.

verses.kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and {that} your joy might be full.
verses.nlt_text: I have told you these things so that you will be filled with my joy. Yes, your joy will overflow!

verses.kjv_text: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.nlt_text: This is my commandment: Love each other in the same way I have loved you.

verses.kjv_text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.nlt_text: There is no greater love than to lay down one's life for one's friends.

verses.kjv_text: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.nlt_text: You are my friends if you do what I command.

verses.kjv_text: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.nlt_text: I no longer call you slaves, because a master doesn't confide in his slaves. Now you are my friends, since I have told you everything the Father told me.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and {that} your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.nlt_text: You didn't choose me. I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit, so that the Father will give you whatever you ask for, using my name.

verses.kjv_text: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.nlt_text: This is my command: Love each other.

verses.kjv_text: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before {it hated} you.
verses.nlt_text: "If the world hates you, remember that it hated me first.

verses.kjv_text: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.nlt_text: The world would love you as one of its own if you belonged to it, but you are no longer part of the world. I chose you to come out of the world, so it hates you.

verses.kjv_text: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.nlt_text: Do you remember what I told you? 'A slave is not greater than the master.' Since they persecuted me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to me, they would listen to you.

verses.kjv_text: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.nlt_text: They will do all this to you because of me, for they have rejected the One who sent me.

verses.kjv_text: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin. {cloke: or, excuse}
verses.nlt_text: They would not be guilty if I had not come and spoken to them. But now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.kjv_text: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who hates me also hates my Father.

verses.kjv_text: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.nlt_text: If I hadn't done such miraculous signs among them that no one else could do, they would not be guilty. But as it is, they have seen everything I did, yet they still hate me and my Father.

verses.kjv_text: But {this cometh to pass}, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.nlt_text: This fulfills what is written in their Scriptures: 'They hated me without cause.'

verses.kjv_text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, {even} the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.nlt_text: "But I will send you the Advocate-- the Spirit of truth. He will come to you from the Father and will testify all about me.

verses.kjv_text: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.nlt_text: And you must also testify about me because you have been with me from the beginning of my ministry.

verses.kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended. {offended: scandalized or, made to stumble}
verses.nlt_text: "I have told you these things so that you won't abandon your faith.

verses.kjv_text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.nlt_text: For you will be expelled from the synagogues, and the time is coming when those who kill you will think they are doing a holy service for God.

verses.kjv_text: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.nlt_text: This is because they have never known the Father or me.

verses.kjv_text: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I'm telling you these things now, so that when they happen, you will remember my warning. I didn't tell you earlier because I was going to be with you for a while longer.

verses.kjv_text: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.nlt_text: "But now I am going away to the One who sent me, and not one of you is asking where I am going.

verses.kjv_text: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, you grieve because of what I've told you.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.nlt_text: But in fact, it is best for you that I go away, because if I don't, the Advocate won't come. If I do go away, then I will send him to you.

verses.kjv_text: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment: {reprove: or, convince}
verses.nlt_text: And when he comes, he will convict the world of its sin, and of God's righteousness, and of the coming judgment.

verses.kjv_text: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.nlt_text: The world's sin is that it refuses to believe in me.

verses.kjv_text: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.nlt_text: Righteousness is available because I go to the Father, and you will see me no more.

verses.kjv_text: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.nlt_text: Judgment will come because the ruler of this world has already been judged.

verses.kjv_text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.nlt_text: "There is so much more I want to tell you, but you can't bear it now.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, {that} shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.nlt_text: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak on his own but will tell you what he has heard. He will tell you about the future.

verses.kjv_text: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew {it} unto you.
verses.nlt_text: He will bring me glory by telling you whatever he receives from me.

verses.kjv_text: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew {it} unto you.
verses.nlt_text: All that belongs to the Father is mine; this is why I said, 'The Spirit will tell you whatever he receives from me.'

verses.kjv_text: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.nlt_text: "In a little while you won't see me anymore. But a little while after that, you will see me again."

verses.kjv_text: Then said {some} of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.nlt_text: Some of the disciples asked each other, "What does he mean when he says, 'In a little while you won't see me, but then you will see me,' and 'I am going to the Father'?

verses.kjv_text: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.nlt_text: And what does he mean by 'a little while'? We don't understand."

verses.kjv_text: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus realized they wanted to ask him about it, so he said, "Are you asking yourselves what I meant? I said in a little while you won't see me, but a little while after that you will see me again.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.nlt_text: I tell you the truth, you will weep and mourn over what is going to happen to me, but the world will rejoice. You will grieve, but your grief will suddenly turn to wonderful joy.

verses.kjv_text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.nlt_text: It will be like a woman suffering the pains of labor. When her child is born, her anguish gives way to joy because she has brought a new baby into the world.

verses.kjv_text: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.nlt_text: So you have sorrow now, but I will see you again; then you will rejoice, and no one can rob you of that joy.

verses.kjv_text: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give {it} you.
verses.nlt_text: At that time you won't need to ask me for anything. I tell you the truth, you will ask the Father directly, and he will grant your request because you use my name.

verses.kjv_text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.nlt_text: You haven't done this before. Ask, using my name, and you will receive, and you will have abundant joy.

verses.kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father. {proverbs: or, parables}
verses.nlt_text: "I have spoken of these matters in figures of speech, but soon I will stop speaking figuratively and will tell you plainly all about the Father.

verses.kjv_text: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.nlt_text: Then you will ask in my name. I'm not saying I will ask the Father on your behalf,

verses.kjv_text: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.nlt_text: for the Father himself loves you dearly because you love me and believe that I came from God.

verses.kjv_text: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I came from the Father into the world, and now I will leave the world and return to the Father."

verses.kjv_text: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb. {proverb: or, parable}
verses.nlt_text: Then his disciples said, "At last you are speaking plainly and not figuratively.

verses.kjv_text: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.nlt_text: Now we understand that you know everything, and there's no need to question you. From this we believe that you came from God."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus asked, "Do you finally believe?

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me. {his own: or, his own home}
verses.nlt_text: But the time is coming-- indeed it's here now-- when you will be scattered, each one going his own way, leaving me alone. Yet I am not alone because the Father is with me.

verses.kjv_text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.nlt_text: I have told you all this so that you may have peace in me. Here on earth you will have many trials and sorrows. But take heart, because I have overcome the world."

verses.kjv_text: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
verses.nlt_text: After saying all these things, Jesus looked up to heaven and said, "Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son so he can give glory back to you.

verses.kjv_text: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
verses.nlt_text: For you have given him authority over everyone. He gives eternal life to each one you have given him.

verses.kjv_text: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.nlt_text: And this is the way to have eternal life-- to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, the one you sent to earth.

verses.kjv_text: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
verses.nlt_text: I brought glory to you here on earth by completing the work you gave me to do.

verses.kjv_text: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.nlt_text: Now, Father, bring me into the glory we shared before the world began.

verses.kjv_text: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.nlt_text: "I have revealed you to the ones you gave me from this world. They were always yours. You gave them to me, and they have kept your word.

verses.kjv_text: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
verses.nlt_text: Now they know that everything I have is a gift from you,

verses.kjv_text: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received {them}, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
verses.nlt_text: for I have passed on to them the message you gave me. They accepted it and know that I came from you, and they believe you sent me.

verses.kjv_text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
verses.nlt_text: "My prayer is not for the world, but for those you have given me, because they belong to you.

verses.kjv_text: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.nlt_text: All who are mine belong to you, and you have given them to me, so they bring me glory.

verses.kjv_text: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we {are}.
verses.nlt_text: Now I am departing from the world; they are staying in this world, but I am coming to you. Holy Father, you have given me your name; now protect them by the power of your name so that they will be united just as we are.

verses.kjv_text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: During my time here, I protected them by the power of the name you gave me. I guarded them so that not one was lost, except the one headed for destruction, as the Scriptures foretold.

verses.kjv_text: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.nlt_text: "Now I am coming to you. I told them many things while I was with them in this world so they would be filled with my joy.

verses.kjv_text: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.nlt_text: I have given them your word. And the world hates them because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.

verses.kjv_text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
verses.nlt_text: I'm not asking you to take them out of the world, but to keep them safe from the evil one.

verses.kjv_text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.nlt_text: They do not belong to this world any more than I do.

verses.kjv_text: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
verses.nlt_text: Make them holy by your truth; teach them your word, which is truth.

verses.kjv_text: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.nlt_text: Just as you sent me into the world, I am sending them into the world.

verses.kjv_text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth. {sanctified...: or, truly sanctified}
verses.nlt_text: And I give myself as a holy sacrifice for them so they can be made holy by your truth.

verses.kjv_text: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
verses.nlt_text: "I am praying not only for these disciples but also for all who will ever believe in me through their message.

verses.kjv_text: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, {art} in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.nlt_text: I pray that they will all be one, just as you and I are one-- as you are in me, Father, and I am in you. And may they be in us so that the world will believe you sent me.

verses.kjv_text: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.nlt_text: "I have given them the glory you gave me, so they may be one as we are one.

verses.kjv_text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
verses.nlt_text: I am in them and you are in me. May they experience such perfect unity that the world will know that you sent me and that you love them as much as you love me.

verses.kjv_text: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.nlt_text: Father, I want these whom you have given me to be with me where I am. Then they can see all the glory you gave me because you loved me even before the world began!

verses.kjv_text: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
verses.nlt_text: "O righteous Father, the world doesn't know you, but I do; and these disciples know you sent me.

verses.kjv_text: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare {it}: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.nlt_text: I have revealed you to them, and I will continue to do so. Then your love for me will be in them, and I will be in them."

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: After saying these things, Jesus crossed the Kidron Valley with his disciples and entered a grove of olive trees.

verses.kjv_text: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: Judas, the betrayer, knew this place, because Jesus had often gone there with his disciples.

verses.kjv_text: Judas then, having received a band {of men} and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.nlt_text: The leading priests and Pharisees had given Judas a contingent of Roman soldiers and Temple guards to accompany him. Now with blazing torches, lanterns, and weapons, they arrived at the olive grove.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus fully realized all that was going to happen to him, so he stepped forward to meet them. "Who are you looking for?" he asked.

verses.kjv_text: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am {he}. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.nlt_text: "Jesus the Nazarene," they replied."I Am he," Jesus said. (Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.)

verses.kjv_text: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am {he}, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.nlt_text: As Jesus said "I Am he," they all drew back and fell to the ground!

verses.kjv_text: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.nlt_text: Once more he asked them, "Who are you looking for?" And again they replied, "Jesus the Nazarene."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am {he}: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.nlt_text: "I told you that I Am he," Jesus said. "And since I am the one you want, let these others go."

verses.kjv_text: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.nlt_text: He did this to fulfill his own statement: "I did not lose a single one of those you have given me."

verses.kjv_text: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
verses.nlt_text: Then Simon Peter drew a sword and slashed off the right ear of Malchus, the high priest's slave.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus said to Peter, "Put your sword back into its sheath. Shall I not drink from the cup of suffering the Father has given me?"

verses.kjv_text: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.nlt_text: So the soldiers, their commanding officer, and the Temple guards arrested Jesus and tied him up.

verses.kjv_text: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year. {year: year. And Annas sent Christ bound unto Caiaphas the high priest}
verses.nlt_text: First they took him to Annas, the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest at that time.

verses.kjv_text: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.nlt_text: Caiaphas was the one who had told the other Jewish leaders, "It's better that one man should die for the people."

verses.kjv_text: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and {so did} another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another of the disciples. That other disciple was acquainted with the high priest, so he was allowed to enter the high priest's courtyard with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.nlt_text: Peter had to stay outside the gate. Then the disciple who knew the high priest spoke to the woman watching at the gate, and she let Peter in.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also {one} of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.nlt_text: The woman asked Peter, "You're not one of that man's disciples, are you?" "No," he said, "I am not."

verses.kjv_text: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.nlt_text: Because it was cold, the household servants and the guards had made a charcoal fire. They stood around it, warming themselves, and Peter stood with them, warming himself.

verses.kjv_text: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.nlt_text: Inside, the high priest began asking Jesus about his followers and what he had been teaching them.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Everyone knows what I teach. I have preached regularly in the synagogues and the Temple, where the people gather. I have not spoken in secret.

verses.kjv_text: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.nlt_text: Why are you asking me this question? Ask those who heard me. They know what I said."

verses.kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so? {with...: or, with a rod}
verses.nlt_text: Then one of the Temple guards standing nearby slapped Jesus across the face. "Is that the way to answer the high priest?" he demanded.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "If I said anything wrong, you must prove it. But if I'm speaking the truth, why are you beating me?"

verses.kjv_text: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.nlt_text: Then Annas bound Jesus and sent him to Caiaphas, the high priest.

verses.kjv_text: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also {one} of his disciples? He denied {it}, and said, I am not.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, as Simon Peter was standing by the fire, they asked him again, "You're not one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, saying, "No, I am not."

verses.kjv_text: One of the servants of the high priest, being {his} kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.nlt_text: But one of the household slaves of the high priest, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, "Didn't I see you out there in the olive grove with Jesus?"

verses.kjv_text: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.nlt_text: Again Peter denied it. And immediately a rooster crowed.

verses.kjv_text: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover. {the hall...: or, Pilate's house}
verses.nlt_text: Jesus' trial before Caiaphas ended in the early hours of the morning. Then he was taken to the headquarters of the Roman governor. His accusers didn't go inside because it would defile them, and they wouldn't be allowed to celebrate the Passover.

verses.kjv_text: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.nlt_text: So Pilate, the governor, went out to them and asked, "What is your charge against this man?"

verses.kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: "We wouldn't have handed him over to you if he weren't a criminal!" they retorted.

verses.kjv_text: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.nlt_text: "Then take him away and judge him by your own law," Pilate told them."Only the Romans are permitted to execute someone," the Jewish leaders replied.

verses.kjv_text: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.nlt_text: (This fulfilled Jesus' prediction about the way he would die.)

verses.kjv_text: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.nlt_text: Then Pilate went back into his headquarters and called for Jesus to be brought to him. "Are you the king of the Jews?" he asked him.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "Is this your own question, or did others tell you about me?"

verses.kjv_text: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.nlt_text: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate retorted. "Your own people and their leading priests brought you to me for trial. Why? What have you done?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus answered, "My Kingdom is not an earthly kingdom. If it were, my followers would fight to keep me from being handed over to the Jewish leaders. But my Kingdom is not of this world."

verses.kjv_text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate said, "So you are a king?" Jesus responded, "You say I am a king. Actually, I was born and came into the world to testify to the truth. All who love the truth recognize that what I say is true."

verses.kjv_text: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault {at all}.
verses.nlt_text: "What is truth?" Pilate asked. Then he went out again to the people and told them, "He is not guilty of any crime.

verses.kjv_text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.nlt_text: But you have a custom of asking me to release one prisoner each year at Passover. Would you like me to release this 'King of the Jews'?"

verses.kjv_text: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.nlt_text: But they shouted back, "No! Not this man. We want Barabbas!" (Barabbas was a revolutionary.)

verses.kjv_text: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged {him}.
verses.nlt_text: Then Pilate had Jesus flogged with a lead-tipped whip.

verses.kjv_text: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put {it} on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.nlt_text: The soldiers wove a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they put a purple robe on him.

verses.kjv_text: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.nlt_text: "Hail! King of the Jews!" they mocked, as they slapped him across the face.

verses.kjv_text: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate went outside again and said to the people, "I am going to bring him out to you now, but understand clearly that I find him not guilty."

verses.kjv_text: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And {Pilate} saith unto them, Behold the man!
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said, "Look, here is the man!"

verses.kjv_text: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify {him}, crucify {him}. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify {him}: for I find no fault in him.
verses.nlt_text: When they saw him, the leading priests and Temple guards began shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!" "Take him yourselves and crucify him," Pilate said. "I find him not guilty."

verses.kjv_text: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: The Jewish leaders replied, "By our law he ought to die because he called himself the Son of God."

verses.kjv_text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.nlt_text: When Pilate heard this, he was more frightened than ever.

verses.kjv_text: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.nlt_text: He took Jesus back into the headquarters again and asked him, "Where are you from?" But Jesus gave no answer.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
verses.nlt_text: "Why don't you talk to me?" Pilate demanded. "Don't you realize that I have the power to release you or crucify you?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power {at all} against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus said, "You would have no power over me at all unless it were given to you from above. So the one who handed me over to you has the greater sin."

verses.kjv_text: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
verses.nlt_text: Then Pilate tried to release him, but the Jewish leaders shouted, "If you release this man, you are no 'friend of Caesar.' Anyone who declares himself a king is a rebel against Caesar."

verses.kjv_text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.nlt_text: When they said this, Pilate brought Jesus out to them again. Then Pilate sat down on the judgment seat on the platform that is called the Stone Pavement (in Hebrew, [Gabbatha]).

verses.kjv_text: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
verses.nlt_text: It was now about noon on the day of preparation for the Passover. And Pilate said to the people, "Look, here is your king!"

verses.kjv_text: But they cried out, Away with {him}, away with {him}, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
verses.nlt_text: "Away with him," they yelled. "Away with him! Crucify him!" "What? Crucify your king?" Pilate asked."We have no king but Caesar," the leading priests shouted back.

verses.kjv_text: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led {him} away.
verses.nlt_text: Then Pilate turned Jesus over to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus away.

verses.kjv_text: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called {the place} of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.nlt_text: Carrying the cross by himself, he went to the place called Place of the Skull (in Hebrew, [Golgotha]).

verses.kjv_text: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.nlt_text: There they nailed him to the cross. Two others were crucified with him, one on either side, with Jesus between them.

verses.kjv_text: And Pilate wrote a title, and put {it} on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.nlt_text: And Pilate posted a sign over him that read, "Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews."

verses.kjv_text: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, {and} Greek, {and} Latin.
verses.nlt_text: The place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek, so that many people could read it.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.nlt_text: Then the leading priests objected and said to Pilate, "Change it from 'The King of the Jews' to 'He said, I am King of the Jews.'"

verses.kjv_text: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.nlt_text: Pilate replied, "No, what I have written, I have written."

verses.kjv_text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also {his} coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout. {woven: or, wrought}
verses.nlt_text: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided his clothes among the four of them. They also took his robe, but it was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

verses.kjv_text: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.nlt_text: So they said, "Rather than tearing it apart, let's throw dice for it. This fulfilled the Scripture that says, "They divided my garments among themselves and threw dice for my clothing." So that is what they did.

verses.kjv_text: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the {wife} of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene. {Cleophas: or, Clopas}
verses.nlt_text: Standing near the cross were Jesus' mother, and his mother's sister, Mary (the wife of Clopas), and Mary Magdalene.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus saw his mother standing there beside the disciple he loved, he said to her, "Dear woman, here is your son."

verses.kjv_text: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own {home}.
verses.nlt_text: And he said to this disciple, "Here is your mother." And from then on this disciple took her into his home.

verses.kjv_text: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus knew that his mission was now finished, and to fulfill Scripture he said, "I am thirsty."

verses.kjv_text: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put {it} upon hyssop, and put {it} to his mouth.
verses.nlt_text: A jar of sour wine was sitting there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put it on a hyssop branch, and held it up to his lips.

verses.kjv_text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.nlt_text: When Jesus had tasted it, he said, "It is finished!" Then he bowed his head and released his spirit.

verses.kjv_text: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and {that} they might be taken away.
verses.nlt_text: It was the day of preparation, and the Jewish leaders didn't want the bodies hanging there the next day, which was the Sabbath (and a very special Sabbath, because it was the Passover). So they asked Pilate to hasten their deaths by ordering that their legs be broken. Then their bodies could be taken down.

verses.kjv_text: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.nlt_text: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men crucified with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.nlt_text: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead, so they didn't break his legs.

verses.kjv_text: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.nlt_text: One of the soldiers, however, pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.

verses.kjv_text: And he that saw {it} bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
verses.nlt_text: (This report is from an eyewitness giving an accurate account. He speaks the truth so that you also can believe.)

verses.kjv_text: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.nlt_text: These things happened in fulfillment of the Scriptures that say, "Not one of his bones will be broken,"

verses.kjv_text: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.nlt_text: and "They will look on the one they pierced."

verses.kjv_text: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave {him} leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward Joseph of Arimathea, who had been a secret disciple of Jesus (because he feared the Jewish leaders), asked Pilate for permission to take down Jesus' body. When Pilate gave permission, Joseph came and took the body away.

verses.kjv_text: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound {weight}.
verses.nlt_text: With him came Nicodemus, the man who had come to Jesus at night. He brought seventy-five pounds of perfumed ointment made from myrrh and aloes.

verses.kjv_text: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
verses.nlt_text: Following Jewish burial custom, they wrapped Jesus' body with the spices in long sheets of linen cloth.

verses.kjv_text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.nlt_text: The place of crucifixion was near a garden, where there was a new tomb, never used before.

verses.kjv_text: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation {day}; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.nlt_text: And so, because it was the day of preparation for the Jewish Passover and since the tomb was close at hand, they laid Jesus there.

verses.kjv_text: The first {day} of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: Early on Sunday morning, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and found that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.

verses.kjv_text: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.nlt_text: She ran and found Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. She said, "They have taken the Lord's body out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have put him!"

verses.kjv_text: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: Peter and the other disciple started out for the tomb.

verses.kjv_text: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: They were both running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

verses.kjv_text: And he stooping down, {and looking in}, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.nlt_text: He stooped and looked in and saw the linen wrappings lying there, but he didn't go in.

verses.kjv_text: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.nlt_text: Then Simon Peter arrived and went inside. He also noticed the linen wrappings lying there,

verses.kjv_text: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.nlt_text: while the cloth that had covered Jesus' head was folded up and lying apart from the other wrappings.

verses.kjv_text: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.nlt_text: Then the disciple who had reached the tomb first also went in, and he saw and believed--

verses.kjv_text: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: for until then they still hadn't understood the Scriptures that said Jesus must rise from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.nlt_text: Then they went home.

verses.kjv_text: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, {and looked} into the sepulchre,
verses.nlt_text: Mary was standing outside the tomb crying, and as she wept, she stooped and looked in.

verses.kjv_text: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.nlt_text: She saw two white-robed angels, one sitting at the head and the other at the foot of the place where the body of Jesus had been lying.

verses.kjv_text: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.nlt_text: "Dear woman, why are you crying?" the angels asked her."Because they have taken away my Lord," she replied, "and I don't know where they have put him."

verses.kjv_text: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: She turned to leave and saw someone standing there. It was Jesus, but she didn't recognize him.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.nlt_text: "Dear woman, why are you crying?" Jesus asked her. "Who are you looking for?" She thought he was the gardener. "Sir," she said, "if you have taken him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will go and get him."

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.nlt_text: "Mary!" Jesus said.She turned to him and cried out, "Rabboni!" (which is Hebrew for "Teacher").

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and {to} my God, and your God.
verses.nlt_text: "Don't cling to me," Jesus said, "for I haven't yet ascended to the Father. But go find my brothers and tell them that I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God."

verses.kjv_text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and {that} he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.nlt_text: Mary Magdalene found the disciples and told them, "I have seen the Lord!" Then she gave them his message.

verses.kjv_text: Then the same day at evening, being the first {day} of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace {be} unto you.
verses.nlt_text: That Sunday evening the disciples were meeting behind locked doors because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders. Suddenly, Jesus was standing there among them! "Peace be with you," he said.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them {his} hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: As he spoke, he showed them the wounds in his hands and his side. They were filled with joy when they saw the Lord!

verses.kjv_text: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace {be} unto you: as {my} Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.nlt_text: Again he said, "Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, so I am sending you."

verses.kjv_text: And when he had said this, he breathed on {them}, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.nlt_text: Then he breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; {and} whose soever {sins} ye retain, they are retained.
verses.nlt_text: If you forgive anyone's sins, they are forgiven. If you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven."

verses.kjv_text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.nlt_text: One of the disciples, Thomas (nicknamed the Twin), was not with the others when Jesus came.

verses.kjv_text: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.nlt_text: They told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he replied, "I won't believe it unless I see the nail wounds in his hands, put my fingers into them, and place my hand into the wound in his side."

verses.kjv_text: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: {then} came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace {be} unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Eight days later the disciples were together again, and this time Thomas was with them. The doors were locked; but suddenly, as before, Jesus was standing among them. "Peace be with you," he said.

verses.kjv_text: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust {it} into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here, and look at my hands. Put your hand into the wound in my side. Don't be faithless any longer. Believe!"

verses.kjv_text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.nlt_text: "My Lord and my God!" Thomas exclaimed.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed {are} they that have not seen, and {yet} have believed.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus told him, "You believe because you have seen me. Blessed are those who believe without seeing me."

verses.kjv_text: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.nlt_text: The disciples saw Jesus do many other miraculous signs in addition to the ones recorded in this book.

verses.kjv_text: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.nlt_text: But these are written so that you may continue to believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing in him you will have life by the power of his name.

verses.kjv_text: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he {himself}.
verses.nlt_text: Later, Jesus appeared again to the disciples beside the Sea of Galilee. This is how it happened.

verses.kjv_text: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the {sons} of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.nlt_text: Several of the disciples were there-- Simon Peter, Thomas (nicknamed the Twin), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples.

verses.kjv_text: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.nlt_text: Simon Peter said, "I'm going fishing." "We'll come, too," they all said. So they went out in the boat, but they caught nothing all night.

verses.kjv_text: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: At dawn Jesus was standing on the beach, but the disciples couldn't see who he was.

verses.kjv_text: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No. {Children: or, Sirs}
verses.nlt_text: He called out, "Fellows, have you caught any fish?" "No," they replied.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Throw out your net on the right-hand side of the boat, and you'll get some!" So they did, and they couldn't haul in the net because there were so many fish in it.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt {his} fisher's coat {unto him}, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.nlt_text: Then the disciple Jesus loved said to Peter, "It's the Lord!" When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his tunic (for he had stripped for work), jumped into the water, and headed to shore.

verses.kjv_text: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.nlt_text: The others stayed with the boat and pulled the loaded net to the shore, for they were only about a hundred yards from shore.

verses.kjv_text: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.nlt_text: When they got there, they found breakfast waiting for them-- fish cooking over a charcoal fire, and some bread.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.nlt_text: "Bring some of the fish you've just caught," Jesus said.

verses.kjv_text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.nlt_text: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net to the shore. There were 153 large fish, and yet the net hadn't torn.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Come {and} dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: "Now come and have some breakfast!" Jesus said. None of the disciples dared to ask him, "Who are you?" They knew it was the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.nlt_text: Then Jesus served them the bread and the fish.

verses.kjv_text: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: This was the third time Jesus had appeared to his disciples since he had been raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, {son} of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
