verses.nlt_text: After breakfast Jesus asked Simon Peter, "Simon son of John, do you love me more than these? " "Yes, Lord," Peter replied, "you know I love you." "Then feed my lambs," Jesus told him.

verses.kjv_text: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, {son} of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus repeated the question: "Simon son of John, do you love me?" "Yes, Lord," Peter said, "you know I love you." "Then take care of my sheep," Jesus said.

verses.kjv_text: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, {son} of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.nlt_text: A third time he asked him, "Simon son of John, do you love me?" Peter was hurt that Jesus asked the question a third time. He said, "Lord, you know everything. You know that I love you." Jesus said, "Then feed my sheep.

verses.kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry {thee} whither thou wouldest not.
verses.nlt_text: "I tell you the truth, when you were young, you were able to do as you liked; you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and others will dress you and take you where you don't want to go."

verses.kjv_text: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus said this to let him know by what kind of death he would glorify God. Then Jesus told him, "Follow me."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.nlt_text: Peter turned around and saw behind them the disciple Jesus loved-- the one who had leaned over to Jesus during supper and asked, "Lord, who will betray you?"

verses.kjv_text: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what {shall} this man {do}?
verses.nlt_text: Peter asked Jesus, "What about him, Lord?"

verses.kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what {is that} to thee? follow thou me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus replied, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? As for you, follow me."

verses.kjv_text: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what {is that} to thee?
verses.nlt_text: So the rumor spread among the community of believers that this disciple wouldn't die. But that isn't what Jesus said at all. He only said, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?"

verses.kjv_text: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.nlt_text: This disciple is the one who testifies to these events and has recorded them here. And we know that his account of these things is accurate.

verses.kjv_text: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus also did many other things. If they were all written down, I suppose the whole world could not contain the books that would be written.

verses.kjv_text: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.nlt_text: In my first book I told you, Theophilus, about everything Jesus began to do and teach

verses.kjv_text: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.nlt_text: until the day he was taken up to heaven after giving his chosen apostles further instructions through the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verses.nlt_text: During the forty days after his crucifixion, he appeared to the apostles from time to time, and he proved to them in many ways that he was actually alive. And he talked to them about the Kingdom of God.

verses.kjv_text: And, being assembled together with {them}, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, {saith he}, ye have heard of me. {being...: or, eating together}
verses.nlt_text: Once when he was eating with them, he commanded them, "Do not leave Jerusalem until the Father sends you the gift he promised, as I told you before.

verses.kjv_text: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
verses.nlt_text: John baptized with water, but in just a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit."

verses.kjv_text: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
verses.nlt_text: So when the apostles were with Jesus, they kept asking him, "Lord, has the time come for you to free Israel and restore our kingdom?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
verses.nlt_text: He replied, "The Father alone has the authority to set those dates and times, and they are not for you to know.

verses.kjv_text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. {power...: or, the power of the Holy Ghost coming upon you}
verses.nlt_text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you. And you will be my witnesses, telling people about me everywhere-- in Jerusalem, throughout Judea, in Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.nlt_text: After saying this, he was taken up into a cloud while they were watching, and they could no longer see him.

verses.kjv_text: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.nlt_text: As they strained to see him rising into heaven, two white-robed men suddenly stood among them.

verses.kjv_text: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.nlt_text: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why are you standing here staring into heaven? Jesus has been taken from you into heaven, but someday he will return from heaven in the same way you saw him go!"

verses.kjv_text: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
verses.nlt_text: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, a distance of half a mile.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James {the son} of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas {the brother} of James.
verses.nlt_text: When they arrived, they went to the upstairs room of the house where they were staying.Here are the names of those who were present: Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon (the Zealot), and Judas (son of James).

verses.kjv_text: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.nlt_text: They all met together and were constantly united in prayer, along with Mary the mother of Jesus, several other women, and the brothers of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.nlt_text: During this time, when about 120 believers were together in one place, Peter stood up and addressed them.

verses.kjv_text: Men {and} brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: "Brothers," he said, "the Scriptures had to be fulfilled concerning Judas, who guided those who arrested Jesus. This was predicted long ago by the Holy Spirit, speaking through King David.

verses.kjv_text: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.nlt_text: Judas was one of us and shared in the ministry with us."

verses.kjv_text: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.nlt_text: (Judas had bought a field with the money he received for his treachery. Falling headfirst there, his body split open, spilling out all his intestines.

verses.kjv_text: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.nlt_text: The news of his death spread to all the people of Jerusalem, and they gave the place the Aramaic name [Akeldama,] which means "Field of Blood.")

verses.kjv_text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take. {bishoprick: or, office, or, charge}
verses.nlt_text: Peter continued, "This was written in the book of Psalms, where it says, 'Let his home become desolate, with no one living in it.' It also says, 'Let someone else take his position.'

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.nlt_text: "So now we must choose a replacement for Judas from among the men who were with us the entire time we were traveling with the Lord Jesus--

verses.kjv_text: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.nlt_text: from the time he was baptized by John until the day he was taken from us. Whoever is chosen will join us as a witness of Jesus' resurrection."

verses.kjv_text: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.nlt_text: So they nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

verses.kjv_text: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all {men}, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
verses.nlt_text: Then they all prayed, "O Lord, you know every heart. Show us which of these men you have chosen

verses.kjv_text: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
verses.nlt_text: as an apostle to replace Judas in this ministry, for he has deserted us and gone where he belongs."

verses.kjv_text: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
verses.nlt_text: Then they cast lots, and Matthias was selected to become an apostle with the other eleven.

verses.kjv_text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.nlt_text: On the day of Pentecost all the believers were meeting together in one place.

verses.kjv_text: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, there was a sound from heaven like the roaring of a mighty windstorm, and it filled the house where they were sitting.

verses.kjv_text: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verses.nlt_text: Then, what looked like flames or tongues of fire appeared and settled on each of them.

verses.kjv_text: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.nlt_text: And everyone present was filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking in other languages, as the Holy Spirit gave them this ability.

verses.kjv_text: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
verses.nlt_text: At that time there were devout Jews from every nation living in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language. {was...: Gr. voice was made confounded: or, troubled in mind}
verses.nlt_text: When they heard the loud noise, everyone came running, and they were bewildered to hear their own languages being spoken by the believers.

verses.kjv_text: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
verses.nlt_text: They were completely amazed. "How can this be?" they exclaimed. "These people are all from Galilee,

verses.kjv_text: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
verses.nlt_text: and yet we hear them speaking in our own native languages!

verses.kjv_text: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
verses.nlt_text: Here we are-- Parthians, Medes, Elamites, people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, the province of Asia,

verses.kjv_text: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
verses.nlt_text: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, and the areas of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome (both Jews and converts to Judaism),

verses.kjv_text: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
verses.nlt_text: Cretans, and Arabs. And we all hear these people speaking in our own languages about the wonderful things God has done!"

verses.kjv_text: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.nlt_text: They stood there amazed and perplexed. "What can this mean?" they asked each other.

verses.kjv_text: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
verses.nlt_text: But others in the crowd ridiculed them, saying, "They're just drunk, that's all!"

verses.kjv_text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all {ye} that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter stepped forward with the eleven other apostles and shouted to the crowd, "Listen carefully, all of you, fellow Jews and residents of Jerusalem! Make no mistake about this.

verses.kjv_text: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is {but} the third hour of the day.
verses.nlt_text: These people are not drunk, as some of you are assuming. Nine o'clock in the morning is much too early for that.

verses.kjv_text: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
verses.nlt_text: No, what you see was predicted long ago by the prophet Joel:

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.nlt_text: 'In the last days,' God says, 'I will pour out my Spirit upon all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams.

verses.kjv_text: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
verses.nlt_text: In those days I will pour out my Spirit even on my servants-- men and women alike-- and they will prophesy.

verses.kjv_text: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
verses.nlt_text: And I will cause wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below-- blood and fire and clouds of smoke.

verses.kjv_text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
verses.nlt_text: The sun will become dark, and the moon will turn blood red before that great and glorious day of the LORD arrives.

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.nlt_text: But everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved.'

verses.kjv_text: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.nlt_text: "People of Israel, listen! God publicly endorsed Jesus the Nazarene by doing powerful miracles, wonders, and signs through him, as you well know.

verses.kjv_text: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.nlt_text: But God knew what would happen, and his prearranged plan was carried out when Jesus was betrayed. With the help of lawless Gentiles, you nailed him to a cross and killed him.

verses.kjv_text: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.nlt_text: But God released him from the horrors of death and raised him back to life, for death could not keep him in its grip.

verses.kjv_text: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.nlt_text: King David said this about him: 'I see that the LORD is always with me. I will not be shaken, for he is right beside me.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
verses.nlt_text: No wonder my heart is glad, and my tongue shouts his praises! My body rests in hope.

verses.kjv_text: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.nlt_text: For you will not leave my soul among the dead or allow your Holy One to rot in the grave.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verses.nlt_text: You have shown me the way of life, and you will fill me with the joy of your presence.'

verses.kjv_text: Men {and} brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day. {let me: or, I may}
verses.nlt_text: "Dear brothers, think about this! You can be sure that the patriarch David wasn't referring to himself, for he died and was buried, and his tomb is still here among us.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
verses.nlt_text: But he was a prophet, and he knew God had promised with an oath that one of David's own descendants would sit on his throne.

verses.kjv_text: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
verses.nlt_text: David was looking into the future and speaking of the Messiah's resurrection. He was saying that God would not leave him among the dead or allow his body to rot in the grave.

verses.kjv_text: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.nlt_text: "God raised Jesus from the dead, and we are all witnesses of this.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
verses.nlt_text: Now he is exalted to the place of highest honor in heaven, at God's right hand. And the Father, as he had promised, gave him the Holy Spirit to pour out upon us, just as you see and hear today.

verses.kjv_text: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.nlt_text: For David himself never ascended into heaven, yet he said, 'The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit in the place of honor at my right hand

verses.kjv_text: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
verses.nlt_text: until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet." '

verses.kjv_text: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
verses.nlt_text: "So let everyone in Israel know for certain that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, to be both Lord and Messiah!"

verses.kjv_text: Now when they heard {this}, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men {and} brethren, what shall we do?
verses.nlt_text: Peter's words pierced their hearts, and they said to him and to the other apostles, "Brothers, what should we do?"

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Peter replied, "Each of you must repent of your sins, turn to God, and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ to show that you have received forgiveness for your sins. Then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, {even} as many as the Lord our God shall call.
verses.nlt_text: This promise is to you, and to your children, and even to the Gentiles-- all who have been called by the Lord our God."

verses.kjv_text: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter continued preaching for a long time, strongly urging all his listeners, "Save yourselves from this crooked generation!"

verses.kjv_text: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added {unto them} about three thousand souls.
verses.nlt_text: Those who believed what Peter said were baptized and added to the church that day-- about 3,000 in all.

verses.kjv_text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.nlt_text: All the believers devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching, and to fellowship, and to sharing in meals (including the Lord's Supper), and to prayer.

verses.kjv_text: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
verses.nlt_text: A deep sense of awe came over them all, and the apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders.

verses.kjv_text: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.nlt_text: And all the believers met together in one place and shared everything they had.

verses.kjv_text: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all {men}, as every man had need.
verses.nlt_text: They sold their property and possessions and shared the money with those in need.

verses.kjv_text: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart, {from...: or, at home}
verses.nlt_text: They worshiped together at the Temple each day, met in homes for the Lord's Supper, and shared their meals with great joy and generosity--

verses.kjv_text: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
verses.nlt_text: all the while praising God and enjoying the goodwill of all the people. And each day the Lord added to their fellowship those who were being saved.

verses.kjv_text: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, {being} the ninth {hour}.
verses.nlt_text: Peter and John went to the Temple one afternoon to take part in the three o'clock prayer service.

verses.kjv_text: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.nlt_text: As they approached the Temple, a man lame from birth was being carried in. Each day he was put beside the Temple gate, the one called the Beautiful Gate, so he could beg from the people going into the Temple.

verses.kjv_text: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
verses.nlt_text: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for some money.

verses.kjv_text: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
verses.nlt_text: Peter and John looked at him intently, and Peter said, "Look at us!"

verses.kjv_text: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.nlt_text: The lame man looked at them eagerly, expecting some money.

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter said, "I don't have any silver or gold for you. But I'll give you what I have. In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, get up and walk!"

verses.kjv_text: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted {him} up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter took the lame man by the right hand and helped him up. And as he did, the man's feet and ankles were instantly healed and strengthened.

verses.kjv_text: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.nlt_text: He jumped up, stood on his feet, and began to walk! Then, walking, leaping, and praising God, he went into the Temple with them.

verses.kjv_text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.nlt_text: All the people saw him walking and heard him praising God.

verses.kjv_text: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
verses.nlt_text: When they realized he was the lame beggar they had seen so often at the Beautiful Gate, they were absolutely astounded!

verses.kjv_text: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
verses.nlt_text: They all rushed out in amazement to Solomon's Colonnade, where the man was holding tightly to Peter and John.

verses.kjv_text: And when Peter saw {it}, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
verses.nlt_text: Peter saw his opportunity and addressed the crowd. "People of Israel," he said, "what is so surprising about this? And why stare at us as though we had made this man walk by our own power or godliness?

verses.kjv_text: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let {him} go.
verses.nlt_text: For it is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob-- the God of all our ancestors-- who has brought glory to his servant Jesus by doing this. This is the same Jesus whom you handed over and rejected before Pilate, despite Pilate's decision to release him.

verses.kjv_text: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
verses.nlt_text: You rejected this holy, righteous one and instead demanded the release of a murderer.

verses.kjv_text: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses. {Prince: or, Author}
verses.nlt_text: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. And we are witnesses of this fact!

verses.kjv_text: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.nlt_text: "Through faith in the name of Jesus, this man was healed-- and you know how crippled he was before. Faith in Jesus' name has healed him before your very eyes.

verses.kjv_text: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did {it}, as {did} also your rulers.
verses.nlt_text: "Friends, I realize that what you and your leaders did to Jesus was done in ignorance.

verses.kjv_text: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: But God was fulfilling what all the prophets had foretold about the Messiah-- that he must suffer these things.

verses.kjv_text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
verses.nlt_text: Now repent of your sins and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped away.

verses.kjv_text: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
verses.nlt_text: Then times of refreshment will come from the presence of the Lord, and he will again send you Jesus, your appointed Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
verses.nlt_text: For he must remain in heaven until the time for the final restoration of all things, as God promised long ago through his holy prophets.

verses.kjv_text: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Moses said, 'The LORD your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your own people. Listen carefully to everything he tells you.'

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
verses.nlt_text: Then Moses said, 'Anyone who will not listen to that Prophet will be completely cut off from God's people.'

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
verses.nlt_text: "Starting with Samuel, every prophet spoke about what is happening today.

verses.kjv_text: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
verses.nlt_text: You are the children of those prophets, and you are included in the covenant God promised to your ancestors. For God said to Abraham, 'Through your descendants all the families on earth will be blessed.'

verses.kjv_text: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
verses.nlt_text: When God raised up his servant, Jesus, he sent him first to you people of Israel, to bless you by turning each of you back from your sinful ways."

verses.kjv_text: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them, {captain: or, ruler}
verses.nlt_text: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, they were confronted by the priests, the captain of the Temple guard, and some of the Sadducees.

verses.kjv_text: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: These leaders were very disturbed that Peter and John were teaching the people that through Jesus there is a resurrection of the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And they laid hands on them, and put {them} in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
verses.nlt_text: They arrested them and, since it was already evening, put them in jail until morning.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
verses.nlt_text: But many of the people who heard their message believed it, so the number of believers now totaled about 5,000 men, not counting women and children.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
verses.nlt_text: The next day the council of all the rulers and elders and teachers of religious law met in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Annas the high priest was there, along with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other relatives of the high priest.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
verses.nlt_text: They brought in the two disciples and demanded, "By what power, or in whose name, have you done this?"

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, "Rulers and elders of our people,

verses.kjv_text: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
verses.nlt_text: are we being questioned today because we've done a good deed for a crippled man? Do you want to know how he was healed?

verses.kjv_text: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, {even} by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
verses.nlt_text: Let me clearly state to all of you and to all the people of Israel that he was healed by the powerful name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, the man you crucified but whom God raised from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
verses.nlt_text: For Jesus is the one referred to in the Scriptures, where it says, 'The stone that you builders rejected has now become the cornerstone.'

verses.kjv_text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.nlt_text: There is salvation in no one else! God has given no other name under heaven by which we must be saved."

verses.kjv_text: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: The members of the council were amazed when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, for they could see that they were ordinary men with no special training in the Scriptures. They also recognized them as men who had been with Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.nlt_text: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing right there among them, there was nothing the council could say.

verses.kjv_text: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.nlt_text: So they ordered Peter and John out of the council chamber and conferred among themselves.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them {is} manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny {it}.
verses.nlt_text: "What should we do with these men?" they asked each other. "We can't deny that they have performed a miraculous sign, and everybody in Jerusalem knows about it.

verses.kjv_text: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
verses.nlt_text: But to keep them from spreading their propaganda any further, we must warn them not to speak to anyone in Jesus' name again."

verses.kjv_text: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: So they called the apostles back in and commanded them never again to speak or teach in the name of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter and John replied, "Do you think God wants us to obey you rather than him?

verses.kjv_text: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
verses.nlt_text: We cannot stop telling about everything we have seen and heard."

verses.kjv_text: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all {men} glorified God for that which was done.
verses.nlt_text: The council then threatened them further, but they finally let them go because they didn't know how to punish them without starting a riot. For everyone was praising God

verses.kjv_text: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
verses.nlt_text: for this miraculous sign-- the healing of a man who had been lame for more than forty years.

verses.kjv_text: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
verses.nlt_text: As soon as they were freed, Peter and John returned to the other believers and told them what the leading priests and elders had said.

verses.kjv_text: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou {art} God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.nlt_text: When they heard the report, all the believers lifted their voices together in prayer to God: "O Sovereign Lord, Creator of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them--

verses.kjv_text: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
verses.nlt_text: you spoke long ago by the Holy Spirit through our ancestor David, your servant, saying, 'Why were the nations so angry? Why did they waste their time with futile plans?

verses.kjv_text: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
verses.nlt_text: The kings of the earth prepared for battle; the rulers gathered together against the LORD and against his Messiah.'

verses.kjv_text: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
verses.nlt_text: "In fact, this has happened here in this very city! For Herod Antipas, Pontius Pilate the governor, the Gentiles, and the people of Israel were all united against Jesus, your holy servant, whom you anointed.

verses.kjv_text: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
verses.nlt_text: But everything they did was determined beforehand according to your will.

verses.kjv_text: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
verses.nlt_text: And now, O Lord, hear their threats, and give us, your servants, great boldness in preaching your word.

verses.kjv_text: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Stretch out your hand with healing power; may miraculous signs and wonders be done through the name of your holy servant Jesus."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.nlt_text: After this prayer, the meeting place shook, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they preached the word of God with boldness.

verses.kjv_text: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any {of them} that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.nlt_text: All the believers were united in heart and mind. And they felt that what they owned was not their own, so they shared everything they had.

verses.kjv_text: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
verses.nlt_text: The apostles testified powerfully to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and God's great blessing was upon them all.

verses.kjv_text: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
verses.nlt_text: There were no needy people among them, because those who owned land or houses would sell them

verses.kjv_text: And laid {them} down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
verses.nlt_text: and bring the money to the apostles to give to those in need.

verses.kjv_text: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, {and} of the country of Cyprus,
verses.nlt_text: For instance, there was Joseph, the one the apostles nicknamed Barnabas (which means "Son of Encouragement"). He was from the tribe of Levi and came from the island of Cyprus.

verses.kjv_text: Having land, sold {it}, and brought the money, and laid {it} at the apostles' feet.
verses.nlt_text: He sold a field he owned and brought the money to the apostles.

verses.kjv_text: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.nlt_text: But there was a certain man named Ananias who, with his wife, Sapphira, sold some property.

verses.kjv_text: And kept back {part} of the price, his wife also being privy {to it}, and brought a certain part, and laid {it} at the apostles' feet.
verses.nlt_text: He brought part of the money to the apostles, claiming it was the full amount. With his wife's consent, he kept the rest.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back {part} of the price of the land? {to lie to: or, to deceive}
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter said, "Ananias, why have you let Satan fill your heart? You lied to the Holy Spirit, and you kept some of the money for yourself.

verses.kjv_text: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
verses.nlt_text: The property was yours to sell or not sell, as you wished. And after selling it, the money was also yours to give away. How could you do a thing like this? You weren't lying to us but to God!"

verses.kjv_text: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
verses.nlt_text: As soon as Ananias heard these words, he fell to the floor and died. Everyone who heard about it was terrified.

verses.kjv_text: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried {him} out, and buried {him}.
verses.nlt_text: Then some young men got up, wrapped him in a sheet, and took him out and buried him.

verses.kjv_text: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.nlt_text: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.nlt_text: Peter asked her, "Was this the price you and your husband received for your land?" "Yes," she replied, "that was the price."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband {are} at the door, and shall carry thee out.
verses.nlt_text: And Peter said, "How could the two of you even think of conspiring to test the Spirit of the Lord like this? The young men who buried your husband are just outside the door, and they will carry you out, too."

verses.kjv_text: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying {her} forth, buried {her} by her husband.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly, she fell to the floor and died. When the young men came in and saw that she was dead, they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

verses.kjv_text: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
verses.nlt_text: Great fear gripped the entire church and everyone else who heard what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
verses.nlt_text: The apostles were performing many miraculous signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers were meeting regularly at the Temple in the area known as Solomon's Colonnade.

verses.kjv_text: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
verses.nlt_text: But no one else dared to join them, even though all the people had high regard for them.

verses.kjv_text: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
verses.nlt_text: Yet more and more people believed and were brought to the Lord-- crowds of both men and women.

verses.kjv_text: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid {them} on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them. {into...: or, in every street}
verses.nlt_text: As a result of the apostles' work, sick people were brought out into the streets on beds and mats so that Peter's shadow might fall across some of them as he went by.

verses.kjv_text: There came also a multitude {out} of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
verses.nlt_text: Crowds came from the villages around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those possessed by evil spirits, and they were all healed.

verses.kjv_text: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation, {indignation: or, envy}
verses.nlt_text: The high priest and his officials, who were Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.

verses.kjv_text: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
verses.nlt_text: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

verses.kjv_text: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
verses.nlt_text: But an angel of the Lord came at night, opened the gates of the jail, and brought them out. Then he told them,

verses.kjv_text: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
verses.nlt_text: "Go to the Temple and give the people this message of life!"

verses.kjv_text: And when they heard {that}, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.nlt_text: So at daybreak the apostles entered the Temple, as they were told, and immediately began teaching.When the high priest and his officials arrived, they convened the high council-- the full assembly of the elders of Israel. Then they sent for the apostles to be brought from the jail for trial.

verses.kjv_text: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
verses.nlt_text: But when the Temple guards went to the jail, the men were gone. So they returned to the council and reported,

verses.kjv_text: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.nlt_text: "The jail was securely locked, with the guards standing outside, but when we opened the gates, no one was there!"

verses.kjv_text: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
verses.nlt_text: When the captain of the Temple guard and the leading priests heard this, they were perplexed, wondering where it would all end.

verses.kjv_text: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
verses.nlt_text: Then someone arrived with startling news: "The men you put in jail are standing in the Temple, teaching the people!"

verses.kjv_text: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
verses.nlt_text: The captain went with his Temple guards and arrested the apostles, but without violence, for they were afraid the people would stone them.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had brought them, they set {them} before the council: and the high priest asked them,
verses.nlt_text: Then they brought the apostles before the high council, where the high priest confronted them.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
verses.nlt_text: "Didn't we tell you never again to teach in this man's name?" he demanded. "Instead, you have filled all Jerusalem with your teaching about him, and you want to make us responsible for his death!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter and the {other} apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter and the apostles replied, "We must obey God rather than any human authority.

verses.kjv_text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
verses.nlt_text: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead after you killed him by hanging him on a cross.

verses.kjv_text: Him hath God exalted with his right hand {to be} a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
verses.nlt_text: Then God put him in the place of honor at his right hand as Prince and Savior. He did this so the people of Israel would repent of their sins and be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: And we are his witnesses of these things; and {so is} also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
verses.nlt_text: We are witnesses of these things and so is the Holy Spirit, who is given by God to those who obey him."

verses.kjv_text: When they heard {that}, they were cut {to the heart}, and took counsel to slay them.
verses.nlt_text: When they heard this, the high council was furious and decided to kill them.

verses.kjv_text: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
verses.nlt_text: But one member, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, who was an expert in religious law and respected by all the people, stood up and ordered that the men be sent outside the council chamber for a while.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said to his colleagues, "Men of Israel, take care what you are planning to do to these men!

verses.kjv_text: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought. {obeyed: or, believed}
verses.nlt_text: Some time ago there was that fellow Theudas, who pretended to be someone great. About 400 others joined him, but he was killed, and all his followers went their various ways. The whole movement came to nothing.

verses.kjv_text: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, {even} as many as obeyed him, were dispersed. {obeyed: or, believed}
verses.nlt_text: After him, at the time of the census, there was Judas of Galilee. He got people to follow him, but he was killed, too, and all his followers were scattered.

verses.kjv_text: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
verses.nlt_text: "So my advice is, leave these men alone. Let them go. If they are planning and doing these things merely on their own, it will soon be overthrown.

verses.kjv_text: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
verses.nlt_text: But if it is from God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God!"

verses.kjv_text: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten {them}, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.nlt_text: The others accepted his advice. They called in the apostles and had them flogged. Then they ordered them never again to speak in the name of Jesus, and they let them go.

verses.kjv_text: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.nlt_text: The apostles left the high council rejoicing that God had counted them worthy to suffer disgrace for the name of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: And every day, in the Temple and from house to house, they continued to teach and preach this message: "Jesus is the Messiah."

verses.kjv_text: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.nlt_text: But as the believers rapidly multiplied, there were rumblings of discontent. The Greek-speaking believers complained about the Hebrew-speaking believers, saying that their widows were being discriminated against in the daily distribution of food.

verses.kjv_text: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples {unto them}, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
verses.nlt_text: So the Twelve called a meeting of all the believers. They said, "We apostles should spend our time teaching the word of God, not running a food program.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.nlt_text: And so, brothers, select seven men who are well respected and are full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will give them this responsibility.

verses.kjv_text: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.nlt_text: Then we apostles can spend our time in prayer and teaching the word."

verses.kjv_text: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
verses.nlt_text: Everyone liked this idea, and they chose the following: Stephen (a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit), Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas of Antioch (an earlier convert to the Jewish faith).

verses.kjv_text: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid {their} hands on them.
verses.nlt_text: These seven were presented to the apostles, who prayed for them as they laid their hands on them.

verses.kjv_text: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.nlt_text: So God's message continued to spread. The number of believers greatly increased in Jerusalem, and many of the Jewish priests were converted, too.

verses.kjv_text: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.nlt_text: Stephen, a man full of God's grace and power, performed amazing miracles and signs among the people.

verses.kjv_text: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called {the synagogue} of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
verses.nlt_text: But one day some men from the Synagogue of Freed Slaves, as it was called, started to debate with him. They were Jews from Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, and the province of Asia.

verses.kjv_text: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
verses.nlt_text: None of them could stand against the wisdom and the Spirit with which Stephen spoke.

verses.kjv_text: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and {against} God.
verses.nlt_text: So they persuaded some men to lie about Stephen, saying, "We heard him blaspheme Moses, and even God."

verses.kjv_text: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon {him}, and caught him, and brought {him} to the council,
verses.nlt_text: This roused the people, the elders, and the teachers of religious law. So they arrested Stephen and brought him before the high council.

verses.kjv_text: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.nlt_text: The lying witnesses said, "This man is always speaking against the holy Temple and against the law of Moses.

verses.kjv_text: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us. {customs: or, rites}
verses.nlt_text: We have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy the Temple and change the customs Moses handed down to us."

verses.kjv_text: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.nlt_text: At this point everyone in the high council stared at Stephen, because his face became as bright as an angel's.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.nlt_text: Then the high priest asked Stephen, "Are these accusations true?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
verses.nlt_text: This was Stephen's reply: "Brothers and fathers, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham in Mesopotamia before he settled in Haran.

verses.kjv_text: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
verses.nlt_text: God told him, 'Leave your native land and your relatives, and come into the land that I will show you.'

verses.kjv_text: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
verses.nlt_text: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and lived in Haran until his father died. Then God brought him here to the land where you now live.

verses.kjv_text: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not {so much as} to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when {as yet} he had no child.
verses.nlt_text: "But God gave him no inheritance here, not even one square foot of land. God did promise, however, that eventually the whole land would belong to Abraham and his descendants-- even though he had no children yet.

verses.kjv_text: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat {them} evil four hundred years.
verses.nlt_text: God also told him that his descendants would live in a foreign land, where they would be oppressed as slaves for 400 years.

verses.kjv_text: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.nlt_text: 'But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,' God said, 'and in the end they will come out and worship me here in this place.'

verses.kjv_text: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so {Abraham} begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac {begat} Jacob; and Jacob {begat} the twelve patriarchs.
verses.nlt_text: "God also gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision at that time. So when Abraham became the father of Isaac, he circumcised him on the eighth day. And the practice was continued when Isaac became the father of Jacob, and when Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs of the Israelite nation.

verses.kjv_text: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
verses.nlt_text: "These patriarchs were jealous of their brother Joseph, and they sold him to be a slave in Egypt. But God was with him

verses.kjv_text: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.nlt_text: and rescued him from all his troubles. And God gave him favor before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. God also gave Joseph unusual wisdom, so that Pharaoh appointed him governor over all of Egypt and put him in charge of the palace.

verses.kjv_text: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.nlt_text: "But a famine came upon Egypt and Canaan. There was great misery, and our ancestors ran out of food.

verses.kjv_text: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.nlt_text: Jacob heard that there was still grain in Egypt, so he sent his sons-- our ancestors-- to buy some.

verses.kjv_text: And at the second {time} Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.nlt_text: The second time they went, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and they were introduced to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv_text: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to {him}, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.nlt_text: Then Joseph sent for his father, Jacob, and all his relatives to come to Egypt, seventy-five persons in all.

verses.kjv_text: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.nlt_text: So Jacob went to Egypt. He died there, as did our ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor {the father} of Sychem.
verses.nlt_text: Their bodies were taken to Shechem and buried in the tomb Abraham had bought for a certain price from Hamor's sons in Shechem.

verses.kjv_text: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.nlt_text: "As the time drew near when God would fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt greatly increased.

verses.kjv_text: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.nlt_text: But then a new king came to the throne of Egypt who knew nothing about Joseph.

verses.kjv_text: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
verses.nlt_text: This king exploited our people and oppressed them, forcing parents to abandon their newborn babies so they would die.

verses.kjv_text: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months: {exceeding fair: or, fair to God}
verses.nlt_text: "At that time Moses was born-- a beautiful child in God's eyes. His parents cared for him at home for three months.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.nlt_text: When they had to abandon him, Pharaoh's daughter adopted him and raised him as her own son.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
verses.nlt_text: Moses was taught all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was powerful in both speech and action.

verses.kjv_text: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: "One day when Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his relatives, the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And seeing one {of them} suffer wrong, he defended {him}, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
verses.nlt_text: He saw an Egyptian mistreating an Israelite. So Moses came to the man's defense and avenged him, killing the Egyptian.

verses.kjv_text: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not. {For: or, Now}
verses.nlt_text: Moses assumed his fellow Israelites would realize that God had sent him to rescue them, but they didn't.

verses.kjv_text: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.nlt_text: "The next day he visited them again and saw two men of Israel fighting. He tried to be a peacemaker. 'Men,' he said, 'you are brothers. Why are you fighting each other?'

verses.kjv_text: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.nlt_text: "But the man in the wrong pushed Moses aside. 'Who made you a ruler and judge over us?' he asked.

verses.kjv_text: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.nlt_text: 'Are you going to kill me as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?'

verses.kjv_text: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
verses.nlt_text: When Moses heard that, he fled the country and lived as a foreigner in the land of Midian. There his two sons were born.

verses.kjv_text: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.nlt_text: "Forty years later, in the desert near Mount Sinai, an angel appeared to Moses in the flame of a burning bush.

verses.kjv_text: When Moses saw {it}, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold {it}, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
verses.nlt_text: When Moses saw it, he was amazed at the sight. As he went to take a closer look, the voice of the LORD called out to him,

verses.kjv_text: {Saying}, I {am} the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.nlt_text: 'I am the God of your ancestors-- the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.' Moses shook with terror and did not dare to look.

verses.kjv_text: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
verses.nlt_text: "Then the LORD said to him, 'Take off your sandals, for you are standing on holy ground.

verses.kjv_text: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.nlt_text: I have certainly seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now go, for I am sending you back to Egypt.'

verses.kjv_text: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send {to be} a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.nlt_text: "So God sent back the same man his people had previously rejected when they demanded, 'Who made you a ruler and judge over us?' Through the angel who appeared to him in the burning bush, God sent Moses to be their ruler and savior.

verses.kjv_text: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.nlt_text: And by means of many wonders and miraculous signs, he led them out of Egypt, through the Red Sea, and through the wilderness for forty years.

verses.kjv_text: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear. {like...: or, as myself}
verses.nlt_text: "Moses himself told the people of Israel, 'God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your own people.'

verses.kjv_text: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and {with} our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
verses.nlt_text: Moses was with our ancestors, the assembly of God's people in the wilderness, when the angel spoke to him at Mount Sinai. And there Moses received life-giving words to pass on to us.

verses.kjv_text: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust {him} from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
verses.nlt_text: "But our ancestors refused to listen to Moses. They rejected him and wanted to return to Egypt.

verses.kjv_text: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for {as for} this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.nlt_text: They told Aaron, 'Make us some gods who can lead us, for we don't know what has become of this Moses, who brought us out of Egypt.'

verses.kjv_text: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.nlt_text: So they made an idol shaped like a calf, and they sacrificed to it and celebrated over this thing they had made.

verses.kjv_text: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices {by the space of} forty years in the wilderness?
verses.nlt_text: Then God turned away from them and abandoned them to serve the stars of heaven as their gods! In the book of the prophets it is written, 'Was it to me you were bringing sacrifices and offerings during those forty years in the wilderness, Israel?

verses.kjv_text: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.nlt_text: No, you carried your pagan gods-- the shrine of Molech, the star of your god Rephan, and the images you made to worship them. So I will send you into exile as far away as Babylon.'

verses.kjv_text: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen. {speaking: or, who spake}
verses.nlt_text: "Our ancestors carried the Tabernacle with them through the wilderness. It was constructed according to the plan God had shown to Moses.

verses.kjv_text: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David; {that...: or, having received}
verses.nlt_text: Years later, when Joshua led our ancestors in battle against the nations that God drove out of this land, the Tabernacle was taken with them into their new territory. And it stayed there until the time of King David.

verses.kjv_text: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.nlt_text: "David found favor with God and asked for the privilege of building a permanent Temple for the God of Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: But Solomon built him an house.
verses.nlt_text: But it was Solomon who actually built it.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.nlt_text: However, the Most High doesn't live in temples made by human hands. As the prophet says,

verses.kjv_text: Heaven {is} my throne, and earth {is} my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what {is} the place of my rest?
verses.nlt_text: 'Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Could you build me a temple as good as that?' asks the LORD. 'Could you build me such a resting place?

verses.kjv_text: Hath not my hand made all these things?
verses.nlt_text: Didn't my hands make both heaven and earth?'

verses.kjv_text: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers {did}, so {do} ye.
verses.nlt_text: "You stubborn people! You are heathen at heart and deaf to the truth. Must you forever resist the Holy Spirit? That's what your ancestors did, and so do you!

verses.kjv_text: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.nlt_text: Name one prophet your ancestors didn't persecute! They even killed the ones who predicted the coming of the Righteous One-- the Messiah whom you betrayed and murdered.

verses.kjv_text: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept {it}.
verses.nlt_text: You deliberately disobeyed God's law, even though you received it from the hands of angels."

verses.kjv_text: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with {their} teeth.
verses.nlt_text: The Jewish leaders were infuriated by Stephen's accusation, and they shook their fists at him in rage.

verses.kjv_text: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.nlt_text: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, gazed steadily into heaven and saw the glory of God, and he saw Jesus standing in the place of honor at God's right hand.

verses.kjv_text: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.nlt_text: And he told them, "Look, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing in the place of honor at God's right hand!"

verses.kjv_text: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
verses.nlt_text: Then they put their hands over their ears and began shouting. They rushed at him

verses.kjv_text: And cast {him} out of the city, and stoned {him}: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
verses.nlt_text: and dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. His accusers took off their coats and laid them at the feet of a young man named Saul.

verses.kjv_text: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon {God}, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.nlt_text: As they stoned him, Stephen prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."

verses.kjv_text: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.nlt_text: He fell to his knees, shouting, "Lord, don't charge them with this sin!" And with that, he died.

verses.kjv_text: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.nlt_text: Saul was one of the witnesses, and he agreed completely with the killing of Stephen. A great wave of persecution began that day, sweeping over the church in Jerusalem; and all the believers except the apostles were scattered through the regions of Judea and Samaria.

verses.kjv_text: And devout men carried Stephen {to his burial}, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.nlt_text: (Some devout men came and buried Stephen with great mourning.)

verses.kjv_text: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed {them} to prison.
verses.nlt_text: But Saul was going everywhere to destroy the church. He went from house to house, dragging out both men and women to throw them into prison.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
verses.nlt_text: But the believers who were scattered preached the Good News about Jesus wherever they went.

verses.kjv_text: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Philip, for example, went to the city of Samaria and told the people there about the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
verses.nlt_text: Crowds listened intently to Philip because they were eager to hear his message and see the miraculous signs he did.

verses.kjv_text: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed {with them}: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
verses.nlt_text: Many evil spirits were cast out, screaming as they left their victims. And many who had been paralyzed or lame were healed.

verses.kjv_text: And there was great joy in that city.
verses.nlt_text: So there was great joy in that city.

verses.kjv_text: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
verses.nlt_text: A man named Simon had been a sorcerer there for many years, amazing the people of Samaria and claiming to be someone great.

verses.kjv_text: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone, from the least to the greatest, often spoke of him as "the Great One-- the Power of God."

verses.kjv_text: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
