verses.nlt_text: They listened closely to him because for a long time he had astounded them with his magic.

verses.kjv_text: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.nlt_text: But now the people believed Philip's message of Good News concerning the Kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ. As a result, many men and women were baptized.

verses.kjv_text: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done. {miracles...: Gr. signs and great miracles}
verses.nlt_text: Then Simon himself believed and was baptized. He began following Philip wherever he went, and he was amazed by the signs and great miracles Philip performed.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
verses.nlt_text: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that the people of Samaria had accepted God's message, they sent Peter and John there.

verses.kjv_text: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
verses.nlt_text: As soon as they arrived, they prayed for these new believers to receive the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
verses.nlt_text: The Holy Spirit had not yet come upon any of them, for they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Then laid they {their} hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter and John laid their hands upon these believers, and they received the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
verses.nlt_text: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given when the apostles laid their hands on people, he offered them money to buy this power.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: "Let me have this power, too," he exclaimed, "so that when I lay my hands on people, they will receive the Holy Spirit!"

verses.kjv_text: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter replied, "May your money be destroyed with you for thinking God's gift can be bought!

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
verses.nlt_text: You can have no part in this, for your heart is not right with God.

verses.kjv_text: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
verses.nlt_text: Repent of your wickedness and pray to the Lord. Perhaps he will forgive your evil thoughts,

verses.kjv_text: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and {in} the bond of iniquity.
verses.nlt_text: for I can see that you are full of bitter jealousy and are held captive by sin."

verses.kjv_text: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
verses.nlt_text: "Pray to the Lord for me," Simon exclaimed, "that these terrible things you've said won't happen to me!"

verses.kjv_text: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.nlt_text: After testifying and preaching the word of the Lord in Samaria, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem. And they stopped in many Samaritan villages along the way to preach the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
verses.nlt_text: As for Philip, an angel of the Lord said to him, "Go south down the desert road that runs from Jerusalem to Gaza."

verses.kjv_text: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
verses.nlt_text: So he started out, and he met the treasurer of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under the Kandake, the queen of Ethiopia. The eunuch had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

verses.kjv_text: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
verses.nlt_text: and he was now returning. Seated in his carriage, he was reading aloud from the book of the prophet Isaiah.

verses.kjv_text: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
verses.nlt_text: The Holy Spirit said to Philip, "Go over and walk along beside the carriage."

verses.kjv_text: And Philip ran thither to {him}, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
verses.nlt_text: Philip ran over and heard the man reading from the prophet Isaiah. Philip asked, "Do you understand what you are reading?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
verses.nlt_text: The man replied, "How can I, unless someone instructs me?" And he urged Philip to come up into the carriage and sit with him.

verses.kjv_text: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
verses.nlt_text: The passage of Scripture he had been reading was this: "He was led like a sheep to the slaughter. And as a lamb is silent before the shearers, he did not open his mouth.

verses.kjv_text: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
verses.nlt_text: He was humiliated and received no justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
verses.nlt_text: The eunuch asked Philip, "Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or someone else?"

verses.kjv_text: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: So beginning with this same Scripture, Philip told him the Good News about Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And as they went on {their} way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, {here is} water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.nlt_text: As they rode along, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, "Look! There's some water! Why can't I be baptized?"

verses.kjv_text: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.nlt_text: He ordered the carriage to stop, and they went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.nlt_text: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away. The eunuch never saw him again but went on his way rejoicing.

verses.kjv_text: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Philip found himself farther north at the town of Azotus. He preached the Good News there and in every town along the way until he came to Caesarea.

verses.kjv_text: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Saul was uttering threats with every breath and was eager to kill the Lord's followers. So he went to the high priest.

verses.kjv_text: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem. {of this way: Gr. of the way}
verses.nlt_text: He requested letters addressed to the synagogues in Damascus, asking for their cooperation in the arrest of any followers of the Way he found there. He wanted to bring them-- both men and women-- back to Jerusalem in chains.

verses.kjv_text: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
verses.nlt_text: As he was approaching Damascus on this mission, a light from heaven suddenly shone down around him.

verses.kjv_text: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.nlt_text: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, "Saul! Saul! Why are you persecuting me?"

verses.kjv_text: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: {it is} hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.nlt_text: "Who are you, lord?" Saul asked.And the voice replied, "I am Jesus, the one you are persecuting!

verses.kjv_text: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord {said} unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.nlt_text: Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."

verses.kjv_text: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
verses.nlt_text: The men with Saul stood speechless, for they heard the sound of someone's voice but saw no one!

verses.kjv_text: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought {him} into Damascus.
verses.nlt_text: Saul picked himself up off the ground, but when he opened his eyes he was blind. So his companions led him by the hand to Damascus.

verses.kjv_text: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
verses.nlt_text: He remained there blind for three days and did not eat or drink.

verses.kjv_text: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I {am here}, Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Now there was a believer in Damascus named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, calling, "Ananias!" "Yes, Lord!" he replied.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord {said} unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for {one} called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verses.nlt_text: The Lord said, "Go over to Straight Street, to the house of Judas. When you get there, ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul. He is praying to me right now.

verses.kjv_text: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting {his} hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.nlt_text: I have shown him a vision of a man named Ananias coming in and laying hands on him so he can see again."

verses.kjv_text: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.nlt_text: "But Lord," exclaimed Ananias, "I've heard many people talk about the terrible things this man has done to the believers in Jerusalem!

verses.kjv_text: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
verses.nlt_text: And he is authorized by the leading priests to arrest everyone who calls upon your name."

verses.kjv_text: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: But the Lord said, "Go, for Saul is my chosen instrument to take my message to the Gentiles and to kings, as well as to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
verses.nlt_text: And I will show him how much he must suffer for my name's sake."

verses.kjv_text: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, {even} Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: So Ananias went and found Saul. He laid his hands on him and said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road, has sent me so that you might regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."

verses.kjv_text: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly something like scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he regained his sight. Then he got up and was baptized.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
verses.nlt_text: Afterward he ate some food and regained his strength. Saul stayed with the believers in Damascus for a few days.

verses.kjv_text: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: And immediately he began preaching about Jesus in the synagogues, saying, "He is indeed the Son of God!"

verses.kjv_text: But all that heard {him} were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
verses.nlt_text: All who heard him were amazed. "Isn't this the same man who caused such devastation among Jesus' followers in Jerusalem?" they asked. "And didn't he come here to arrest them and take them in chains to the leading priests?"

verses.kjv_text: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Saul's preaching became more and more powerful, and the Jews in Damascus couldn't refute his proofs that Jesus was indeed the Messiah.

verses.kjv_text: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
verses.nlt_text: After a while some of the Jews plotted together to kill him.

verses.kjv_text: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
verses.nlt_text: They were watching for him day and night at the city gate so they could murder him, but Saul was told about their plot.

verses.kjv_text: Then the disciples took him by night, and let {him} down by the wall in a basket.
verses.nlt_text: So during the night, some of the other believers lowered him in a large basket through an opening in the city wall.

verses.kjv_text: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
verses.nlt_text: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to meet with the believers, but they were all afraid of him. They did not believe he had truly become a believer!

verses.kjv_text: But Barnabas took him, and brought {him} to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and told them how Saul had seen the Lord on the way to Damascus and how the Lord had spoken to Saul. He also told them that Saul had preached boldly in the name of Jesus in Damascus.

verses.kjv_text: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: So Saul stayed with the apostles and went all around Jerusalem with them, preaching boldly in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
verses.nlt_text: He debated with some Greek-speaking Jews, but they tried to murder him.

verses.kjv_text: {Which} when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.nlt_text: When the believers heard about this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus, his hometown.

verses.kjv_text: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verses.nlt_text: The church then had peace throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria, and it became stronger as the believers lived in the fear of the Lord. And with the encouragement of the Holy Spirit, it also grew in numbers.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all {quarters}, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Peter traveled from place to place, and he came down to visit the believers in the town of Lydda.

verses.kjv_text: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
verses.nlt_text: There he met a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.

verses.kjv_text: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
verses.nlt_text: Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you! Get up, and roll up your sleeping mat!" And he was healed instantly.

verses.kjv_text: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Then the whole population of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas walking around, and they turned to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did. {Dorcas: or, Doe, or, Roe}
verses.nlt_text: There was a believer in Joppa named Tabitha (which in Greek is Dorcas). She was always doing kind things for others and helping the poor.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid {her} in an upper chamber.
verses.nlt_text: About this time she became ill and died. Her body was washed for burial and laid in an upstairs room.

verses.kjv_text: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring {him} that he would not delay to come to them. {delay: or, be grieved}
verses.nlt_text: But the believers had heard that Peter was nearby at Lydda, so they sent two men to beg him, "Please come as soon as possible!"

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.nlt_text: So Peter returned with them; and as soon as he arrived, they took him to the upstairs room. The room was filled with widows who were weeping and showing him the coats and other clothes Dorcas had made for them.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning {him} to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter asked them all to leave the room; then he knelt and prayed. Turning to the body he said, "Get up, Tabitha." And she opened her eyes! When she saw Peter, she sat up!

verses.kjv_text: And he gave her {his} hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
verses.nlt_text: He gave her his hand and helped her up. Then he called in the widows and all the believers, and he presented her to them alive.

verses.kjv_text: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: The news spread through the whole town, and many believed in the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.nlt_text: And Peter stayed a long time in Joppa, living with Simon, a tanner of hides.

verses.kjv_text: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian {band},
verses.nlt_text: In Caesarea there lived a Roman army officer named Cornelius, who was a captain of the Italian Regiment.

verses.kjv_text: {A} devout {man}, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
verses.nlt_text: He was a devout, God-fearing man, as was everyone in his household. He gave generously to the poor and prayed regularly to God.

verses.kjv_text: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
verses.nlt_text: One afternoon about three o'clock, he had a vision in which he saw an angel of God coming toward him. "Cornelius!" the angel said.

verses.kjv_text: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
verses.nlt_text: Cornelius stared at him in terror. "What is it, sir?" he asked the angel.And the angel replied, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have been received by God as an offering!

verses.kjv_text: And now send men to Joppa, and call for {one} Simon, whose surname is Peter:
verses.nlt_text: Now send some men to Joppa, and summon a man named Simon Peter.

verses.kjv_text: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
verses.nlt_text: He is staying with Simon, a tanner who lives near the seashore."

verses.kjv_text: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.nlt_text: As soon as the angel was gone, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier, one of his personal attendants.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had declared all {these} things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.nlt_text: He told them what had happened and sent them off to Joppa.

verses.kjv_text: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.nlt_text: The next day as Cornelius's messengers were nearing the town, Peter went up on the flat roof to pray. It was about noon,

verses.kjv_text: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.nlt_text: and he was hungry. But while a meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

verses.kjv_text: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.nlt_text: He saw the sky open, and something like a large sheet was let down by its four corners.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.nlt_text: In the sheet were all sorts of animals, reptiles, and birds.

verses.kjv_text: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.nlt_text: Then a voice said to him, "Get up, Peter; kill and eat them."

verses.kjv_text: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.nlt_text: "No, Lord," Peter declared. "I have never eaten anything that our Jewish laws have declared impure and unclean. "

verses.kjv_text: And the voice {spake} unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, {that} call not thou common.
verses.nlt_text: But the voice spoke again: "Do not call something unclean if God has made it clean."

verses.kjv_text: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.nlt_text: The same vision was repeated three times. Then the sheet was suddenly pulled up to heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
verses.nlt_text: Peter was very perplexed. What could the vision mean? Just then the men sent by Cornelius found Simon's house. Standing outside the gate,

verses.kjv_text: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.nlt_text: they asked if a man named Simon Peter was staying there.

verses.kjv_text: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, as Peter was puzzling over the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, "Three men have come looking for you.

verses.kjv_text: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.nlt_text: Get up, go downstairs, and go with them without hesitation. Don't worry, for I have sent them."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what {is} the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.nlt_text: So Peter went down and said, "I'm the man you are looking for. Why have you come?"

verses.kjv_text: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
verses.nlt_text: They said, "We were sent by Cornelius, a Roman officer. He is a devout and God-fearing man, well respected by all the Jews. A holy angel instructed him to summon you to his house so that he can hear your message."

verses.kjv_text: Then called he them in, and lodged {them}. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.nlt_text: So Peter invited the men to stay for the night. The next day he went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa.

verses.kjv_text: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.nlt_text: They arrived in Caesarea the following day. Cornelius was waiting for them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

verses.kjv_text: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped {him}.
verses.nlt_text: As Peter entered his home, Cornelius fell at his feet and worshiped him.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.nlt_text: But Peter pulled him up and said, "Stand up! I'm a human being just like you!"

verses.kjv_text: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.nlt_text: So they talked together and went inside, where many others were assembled.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.nlt_text: Peter told them, "You know it is against our laws for a Jewish man to enter a Gentile home like this or to associate with you. But God has shown me that I should no longer think of anyone as impure or unclean.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore came I {unto you} without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
verses.nlt_text: So I came without objection as soon as I was sent for. Now tell me why you sent for me."

verses.kjv_text: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.nlt_text: Cornelius replied, "Four days ago I was praying in my house about this same time, three o'clock in the afternoon. Suddenly, a man in dazzling clothes was standing in front of me.

verses.kjv_text: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.nlt_text: He told me, 'Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been noticed by God!

verses.kjv_text: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of {one} Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: Now send messengers to Joppa, and summon a man named Simon Peter. He is staying in the home of Simon, a tanner who lives near the seashore.'

verses.kjv_text: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
verses.nlt_text: So I sent for you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here, waiting before God to hear the message the Lord has given you."

verses.kjv_text: Then Peter opened {his} mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter replied, "I see very clearly that God shows no favoritism.

verses.kjv_text: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.nlt_text: In every nation he accepts those who fear him and do what is right.

verses.kjv_text: The word which {God} sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
verses.nlt_text: This is the message of Good News for the people of Israel-- that there is peace with God through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

verses.kjv_text: That word, {I say}, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.nlt_text: You know what happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee, after John began preaching his message of baptism.

verses.kjv_text: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.nlt_text: And you know that God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. Then Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

verses.kjv_text: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.nlt_text: "And we apostles are witnesses of all he did throughout Judea and in Jerusalem. They put him to death by hanging him on a cross,

verses.kjv_text: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.nlt_text: but God raised him to life on the third day. Then God allowed him to appear,

verses.kjv_text: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, {even} to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: not to the general public, but to us whom God had chosen in advance to be his witnesses. We were those who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God {to be} the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.nlt_text: And he ordered us to preach everywhere and to testify that Jesus is the one appointed by God to be the judge of all-- the living and the dead.

verses.kjv_text: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.nlt_text: He is the one all the prophets testified about, saying that everyone who believes in him will have their sins forgiven through his name."

verses.kjv_text: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.nlt_text: Even as Peter was saying these things, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who were listening to the message.

verses.kjv_text: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: The Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out on the Gentiles, too.

verses.kjv_text: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.nlt_text: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God.Then Peter asked,

verses.kjv_text: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
verses.nlt_text: "Can anyone object to their being baptized, now that they have received the Holy Spirit just as we did?"

verses.kjv_text: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.nlt_text: So he gave orders for them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Afterward Cornelius asked him to stay with them for several days.

verses.kjv_text: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.nlt_text: Soon the news reached the apostles and other believers in Judea that the Gentiles had received the word of God.

verses.kjv_text: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.nlt_text: But when Peter arrived back in Jerusalem, the Jewish believers criticized him.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.nlt_text: "You entered the home of Gentiles and even ate with them!" they said.

verses.kjv_text: But Peter rehearsed {the matter} from the beginning, and expounded {it} by order unto them, saying,
verses.nlt_text: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened.

verses.kjv_text: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.nlt_text: "I was in the town of Joppa," he said, "and while I was praying, I went into a trance and saw a vision. Something like a large sheet was let down by its four corners from the sky. And it came right down to me.

verses.kjv_text: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.nlt_text: When I looked inside the sheet, I saw all sorts of small animals, wild animals, reptiles, and birds.

verses.kjv_text: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.nlt_text: And I heard a voice say, 'Get up, Peter; kill and eat them.'

verses.kjv_text: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: " 'No, Lord,' I replied. 'I have never eaten anything that our Jewish laws have declared impure or unclean. '

verses.kjv_text: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, {that} call not thou common.
verses.nlt_text: "But the voice from heaven spoke again: 'Do not call something unclean if God has made it clean.'

verses.kjv_text: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.nlt_text: This happened three times before the sheet and all it contained was pulled back up to heaven.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.nlt_text: "Just then three men who had been sent from Caesarea arrived at the house where we were staying.

verses.kjv_text: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
verses.nlt_text: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry that they were Gentiles. These six brothers here accompanied me, and we soon entered the home of the man who had sent for us.

verses.kjv_text: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.nlt_text: He told us how an angel had appeared to him in his home and had told him, 'Send messengers to Joppa, and summon a man named Simon Peter.

verses.kjv_text: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.nlt_text: He will tell you how you and everyone in your household can be saved!'

verses.kjv_text: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.nlt_text: "As I began to speak," Peter continued, "the Holy Spirit fell on them, just as he fell on us at the beginning.

verses.kjv_text: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Then I thought of the Lord's words when he said, 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv_text: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as {he did} unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.nlt_text: And since God gave these Gentiles the same gift he gave us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to stand in God's way?"

verses.kjv_text: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.nlt_text: When the others heard this, they stopped objecting and began praising God. They said, "We can see that God has also given the Gentiles the privilege of repenting of their sins and receiving eternal life."

verses.kjv_text: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the believers who had been scattered during the persecution after Stephen's death traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch of Syria. They preached the word of God, but only to Jews.

verses.kjv_text: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: However, some of the believers who went to Antioch from Cyprus and Cyrene began preaching to the Gentiles about the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: The power of the Lord was with them, and a large number of these Gentiles believed and turned to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.nlt_text: When the church at Jerusalem heard what had happened, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

verses.kjv_text: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: When he arrived and saw this evidence of God's blessing, he was filled with joy, and he encouraged the believers to stay true to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and strong in faith. And many people were brought to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.nlt_text: Then Barnabas went on to Tarsus to look for Saul.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch. {with...: or, in the church}
verses.nlt_text: When he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. Both of them stayed there with the church for a full year, teaching large crowds of people. (It was at Antioch that the believers were first called Christians.)

verses.kjv_text: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.nlt_text: During this time some prophets traveled from Jerusalem to Antioch.

verses.kjv_text: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.nlt_text: One of them named Agabus stood up in one of the meetings and predicted by the Spirit that a great famine was coming upon the entire Roman world. (This was fulfilled during the reign of Claudius.)

verses.kjv_text: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.nlt_text: So the believers in Antioch decided to send relief to the brothers and sisters in Judea, everyone giving as much as they could.

verses.kjv_text: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.nlt_text: This they did, entrusting their gifts to Barnabas and Saul to take to the elders of the church in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth {his} hands to vex certain of the church. {stretched...: or, began}
verses.nlt_text: About that time King Herod Agrippa began to persecute some believers in the church.

verses.kjv_text: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.nlt_text: He had the apostle James (John's brother) killed with a sword.

verses.kjv_text: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
verses.nlt_text: When Herod saw how much this pleased the Jewish people, he also arrested Peter. (This took place during the Passover celebration.)

verses.kjv_text: And when he had apprehended him, he put {him} in prison, and delivered {him} to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people. {Easter: Gr. Passover} {quaternions: a file of four soldiers}
verses.nlt_text: Then he imprisoned him, placing him under the guard of four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring Peter out for public trial after the Passover.

verses.kjv_text: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him. {prayer...: or, instant and earnest prayer was made}
verses.nlt_text: But while Peter was in prison, the church prayed very earnestly for him.

verses.kjv_text: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
verses.nlt_text: The night before Peter was to be placed on trial, he was asleep, fastened with two chains between two soldiers. Others stood guard at the prison gate.

verses.kjv_text: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon {him}, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from {his} hands.
verses.nlt_text: Suddenly, there was a bright light in the cell, and an angel of the Lord stood before Peter. The angel struck him on the side to awaken him and said, "Quick! Get up!" And the chains fell off his wrists.

verses.kjv_text: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
verses.nlt_text: Then the angel told him, "Get dressed and put on your sandals." And he did. "Now put on your coat and follow me," the angel ordered.

verses.kjv_text: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
verses.nlt_text: So Peter left the cell, following the angel. But all the time he thought it was a vision. He didn't realize it was actually happening.

verses.kjv_text: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
verses.nlt_text: They passed the first and second guard posts and came to the iron gate leading to the city, and this opened for them all by itself. So they passed through and started walking down the street, and then the angel suddenly left him.

verses.kjv_text: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and {from} all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.nlt_text: Peter finally came to his senses. "It's really true!" he said. "The Lord has sent his angel and saved me from Herod and from what the Jewish leaders had planned to do to me!"

verses.kjv_text: And when he had considered {the thing}, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
verses.nlt_text: When he realized this, he went to the home of Mary, the mother of John Mark, where many were gathered for prayer.

verses.kjv_text: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda. {to hearken: or, to ask who was there}
verses.nlt_text: He knocked at the door in the gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to open it.

verses.kjv_text: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
verses.nlt_text: When she recognized Peter's voice, she was so overjoyed that, instead of opening the door, she ran back inside and told everyone, "Peter is standing at the door!"

verses.kjv_text: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
verses.nlt_text: "You're out of your mind!" they said. When she insisted, they decided, "It must be his angel."

verses.kjv_text: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened {the door}, and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, Peter continued knocking. When they finally opened the door and saw him, they were amazed.

verses.kjv_text: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
verses.nlt_text: He motioned for them to quiet down and told them how the Lord had led him out of prison. "Tell James and the other brothers what happened," he said. And then he went to another place.

verses.kjv_text: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
verses.nlt_text: At dawn there was a great commotion among the soldiers about what had happened to Peter.

verses.kjv_text: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that {they} should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and {there} abode.
verses.nlt_text: Herod Agrippa ordered a thorough search for him. When he couldn't be found, Herod interrogated the guards and sentenced them to death. Afterward Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while.

verses.kjv_text: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's {country}. {was highly...: or, bare an hostile mind, intending war} {the king's chamberlain: Gr. that was over the king's bedchamber}
verses.nlt_text: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. So they sent a delegation to make peace with him because their cities were dependent upon Herod's country for food. The delegates won the support of Blastus, Herod's personal assistant,

verses.kjv_text: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.nlt_text: and an appointment with Herod was granted. When the day arrived, Herod put on his royal robes, sat on his throne, and made a speech to them.

verses.kjv_text: And the people gave a shout, {saying, It is} the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.nlt_text: The people gave him a great ovation, shouting, "It's the voice of a god, not of a man!"

verses.kjv_text: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.nlt_text: Instantly, an angel of the Lord struck Herod with a sickness, because he accepted the people's worship instead of giving the glory to God. So he was consumed with worms and died.

verses.kjv_text: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, the word of God continued to spread, and there were many new believers.

verses.kjv_text: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled {their} ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark. {ministry: or, charge}
verses.nlt_text: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission to Jerusalem, they returned, taking John Mark with them.

verses.kjv_text: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul. {which...: or, Herod's foster brother}
verses.nlt_text: Among the prophets and teachers of the church at Antioch of Syria were Barnabas, Simeon (called "the black man"), Lucius (from Cyrene), Manaen (the childhood companion of King Herod Antipas), and Saul.

verses.kjv_text: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.nlt_text: One day as these men were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Dedicate Barnabas and Saul for the special work to which I have called them."

verses.kjv_text: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid {their} hands on them, they sent {them} away.
verses.nlt_text: So after more fasting and prayer, the men laid their hands on them and sent them on their way.

verses.kjv_text: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.nlt_text: So Barnabas and Saul were sent out by the Holy Spirit. They went down to the seaport of Seleucia and then sailed for the island of Cyprus.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to {their} minister.
verses.nlt_text: There, in the town of Salamis, they went to the Jewish synagogues and preached the word of God. John Mark went with them as their assistant.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name {was} Barjesus:
verses.nlt_text: Afterward they traveled from town to town across the entire island until finally they reached Paphos, where they met a Jewish sorcerer, a false prophet named Bar-Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.nlt_text: He had attached himself to the governor, Sergius Paulus, who was an intelligent man. The governor invited Barnabas and Saul to visit him, for he wanted to hear the word of God.

verses.kjv_text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.nlt_text: But Elymas, the sorcerer (as his name means in Greek), interfered and urged the governor to pay no attention to what Barnabas and Saul said. He was trying to keep the governor from believing.

verses.kjv_text: Then Saul, (who also {is called} Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
verses.nlt_text: Saul, also known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and he looked the sorcerer in the eye.

verses.kjv_text: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, {thou} child of the devil, {thou} enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "You son of the devil, full of every sort of deceit and fraud, and enemy of all that is good! Will you never stop perverting the true ways of the Lord?

verses.kjv_text: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord {is} upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.nlt_text: Watch now, for the Lord has laid his hand of punishment upon you, and you will be struck blind. You will not see the sunlight for some time." Instantly mist and darkness came over the man's eyes, and he began groping around begging for someone to take his hand and lead him.

verses.kjv_text: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: When the governor saw what had happened, he became a believer, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.nlt_text: Paul and his companions then left Paphos by ship for Pamphylia, landing at the port town of Perga. There John Mark left them and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.nlt_text: But Paul and Barnabas traveled inland to Antioch of Pisidia. On the Sabbath they went to the synagogue for the services.

verses.kjv_text: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, {Ye} men {and} brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.nlt_text: After the usual readings from the books of Moses and the prophets, those in charge of the service sent them this message: "Brothers, if you have any word of encouragement for the people, come and give it."

verses.kjv_text: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with {his} hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.nlt_text: So Paul stood, lifted his hand to quiet them, and started speaking. "Men of Israel," he said, "and you God-fearing Gentiles, listen to me.

verses.kjv_text: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.nlt_text: "The God of this nation of Israel chose our ancestors and made them multiply and grow strong during their stay in Egypt. Then with a powerful arm he led them out of their slavery.

verses.kjv_text: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness. {suffered...: or bore, or fed them as a nurse beareth, or feedeth, her child}
verses.nlt_text: He put up with them through forty years of wandering in the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.nlt_text: Then he destroyed seven nations in Canaan and gave their land to Israel as an inheritance.

verses.kjv_text: And after that he gave {unto them} judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.nlt_text: All this took about 450 years."After that, God gave them judges to rule until the time of Samuel the prophet.

verses.kjv_text: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.nlt_text: Then the people begged for a king, and God gave them Saul son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, who reigned for forty years.

verses.kjv_text: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the {son} of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.nlt_text: But God removed Saul and replaced him with David, a man about whom God said, 'I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart. He will do everything I want him to do.'

verses.kjv_text: Of this man's seed hath God according to {his} promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: "And it is one of King David's descendants, Jesus, who is God's promised Savior of Israel!

verses.kjv_text: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.nlt_text: Before he came, John the Baptist preached that all the people of Israel needed to repent of their sins and turn to God and be baptized.

verses.kjv_text: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not {he}. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of {his} feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.nlt_text: As John was finishing his ministry he asked, 'Do you think I am the Messiah? No, I am not! But he is coming soon-- and I'm not even worthy to be his slave and untie the sandals on his feet.'

verses.kjv_text: Men {and} brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.nlt_text: "Brothers-- you sons of Abraham, and also you God-fearing Gentiles-- this message of salvation has been sent to us!

verses.kjv_text: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled {them} in condemning {him}.
verses.nlt_text: The people in Jerusalem and their leaders did not recognize Jesus as the one the prophets had spoken about. Instead, they condemned him, and in doing this they fulfilled the prophets' words that are read every Sabbath.

verses.kjv_text: And though they found no cause of death {in him}, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.nlt_text: They found no legal reason to execute him, but they asked Pilate to have him killed anyway.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took {him} down from the tree, and laid {him} in a sepulchre.
verses.nlt_text: "When they had done all that the prophecies said about him, they took him down from the cross and placed him in a tomb.

verses.kjv_text: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.nlt_text: But God raised him from the dead!

verses.kjv_text: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.nlt_text: And over a period of many days he appeared to those who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv_text: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.nlt_text: "And now we are here to bring you this Good News. The promise was made to our ancestors,

verses.kjv_text: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.nlt_text: and God has now fulfilled it for us, their descendants, by raising Jesus. This is what the second psalm says about Jesus: 'You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. '

verses.kjv_text: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, {now} no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David. {mercies: Gr. holy, or just things: which word the Septuagint in many places, uses for that which is in the Hebrew, mercies}
verses.nlt_text: For God had promised to raise him from the dead, not leaving him to rot in the grave. He said, 'I will give you the sacred blessings I promised to David.'

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore he saith also in another {psalm}, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.nlt_text: Another psalm explains it more fully: 'You will not allow your Holy One to rot in the grave.'

verses.kjv_text: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption: {after...: or, after he had in his own age served the will of God}
verses.nlt_text: This is not a reference to David, for after David had done the will of God in his own generation, he died and was buried with his ancestors, and his body decayed.

verses.kjv_text: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.nlt_text: No, it was a reference to someone else-- someone whom God raised and whose body did not decay.

verses.kjv_text: Be it known unto you therefore, men {and} brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.nlt_text: "Brothers, listen! We are here to proclaim that through this man Jesus there is forgiveness for your sins.

verses.kjv_text: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who believes in him is declared right with God-- something the law of Moses could never do.

verses.kjv_text: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.nlt_text: Be careful! Don't let the prophets' words apply to you. For they said,

verses.kjv_text: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.nlt_text: 'Look, you mockers, be amazed and die! For I am doing something in your own day, something you wouldn't believe even if someone told you about it.' "

verses.kjv_text: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath. {the next...: Gr. in the week between, or, in the sabbath between}
verses.nlt_text: As Paul and Barnabas left the synagogue that day, the people begged them to speak about these things again the next week.

verses.kjv_text: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.nlt_text: Many Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, and the two men urged them to continue to rely on the grace of God.

verses.kjv_text: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.nlt_text: The following week almost the entire city turned out to hear them preach the word of the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.nlt_text: But when some of the Jews saw the crowds, they were jealous; so they slandered Paul and argued against whatever he said.

verses.kjv_text: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.nlt_text: Then Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly and declared, "It was necessary that we first preach the word of God to you Jews. But since you have rejected it and judged yourselves unworthy of eternal life, we will offer it to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: For so hath the Lord commanded us, {saying}, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: For the Lord gave us this command when he said, 'I have made you a light to the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the farthest corners of the earth.' "

verses.kjv_text: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.nlt_text: When the Gentiles heard this, they were very glad and thanked the Lord for his message; and all who were chosen for eternal life became believers.

verses.kjv_text: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.nlt_text: So the Lord's message spread throughout that region.

verses.kjv_text: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.nlt_text: Then the Jews stirred up the influential religious women and the leaders of the city, and they incited a mob against Paul and Barnabas and ran them out of town.

verses.kjv_text: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.nlt_text: So they shook the dust from their feet as a sign of rejection and went to the town of Iconium.

verses.kjv_text: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.nlt_text: And the believers were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.nlt_text: The same thing happened in Iconium. Paul and Barnabas went to the Jewish synagogue and preached with such power that a great number of both Jews and Greeks became believers.

verses.kjv_text: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Some of the Jews, however, spurned God's message and poisoned the minds of the Gentiles against Paul and Barnabas.

verses.kjv_text: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.nlt_text: But the apostles stayed there a long time, preaching boldly about the grace of the Lord. And the Lord proved their message was true by giving them power to do miraculous signs and wonders.

verses.kjv_text: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.nlt_text: But the people of the town were divided in their opinion about them. Some sided with the Jews, and some with the apostles.

verses.kjv_text: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use {them} despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.nlt_text: Then a mob of Gentiles and Jews, along with their leaders, decided to attack and stone them.

verses.kjv_text: They were ware of {it}, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.nlt_text: When the apostles learned of it, they fled to the region of Lycaonia-- to the towns of Lystra and Derbe and the surrounding area.

verses.kjv_text: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.nlt_text: And there they preached the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
verses.nlt_text: While they were at Lystra, Paul and Barnabas came upon a man with crippled feet. He had been that way from birth, so he had never walked. He was sitting

verses.kjv_text: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.nlt_text: and listening as Paul preached. Looking straight at him, Paul realized he had faith to be healed.

verses.kjv_text: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.nlt_text: So Paul called to him in a loud voice, "Stand up!" And the man jumped to his feet and started walking.

verses.kjv_text: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.nlt_text: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in their local dialect, "These men are gods in human form!"

verses.kjv_text: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.nlt_text: They decided that Barnabas was the Greek god Zeus and that Paul was Hermes, since he was the chief speaker.

verses.kjv_text: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.nlt_text: Now the temple of Zeus was located just outside the town. So the priest of the temple and the crowd brought bulls and wreaths of flowers to the town gates, and they prepared to offer sacrifices to the apostles.

verses.kjv_text: {Which} when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard {of}, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.nlt_text: But when Barnabas and Paul heard what was happening, they tore their clothing in dismay and ran out among the people, shouting,

verses.kjv_text: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.nlt_text: "Friends, why are you doing this? We are merely human beings-- just like you! We have come to bring you the Good News that you should turn from these worthless things and turn to the living God, who made heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.

verses.kjv_text: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.nlt_text: In the past he permitted all the nations to go their own ways,

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.nlt_text: but he never left them without evidence of himself and his goodness. For instance, he sends you rain and good crops and gives you food and joyful hearts."

verses.kjv_text: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.nlt_text: But even with these words, Paul and Barnabas could scarcely restrain the people from sacrificing to them.

verses.kjv_text: And there came thither {certain} Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew {him} out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.nlt_text: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowds to their side. They stoned Paul and dragged him out of town, thinking he was dead.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.nlt_text: But as the believers gathered around him, he got up and went back into the town. The next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and {to} Iconium, and Antioch, {had taught many: Gr. had made many disciples}
verses.nlt_text: After preaching the Good News in Derbe and making many disciples, Paul and Barnabas returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch of Pisidia,

verses.kjv_text: Confirming the souls of the disciples, {and} exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: where they strengthened the believers. They encouraged them to continue in the faith, reminding them that we must suffer many hardships to enter the Kingdom of God.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.nlt_text: Paul and Barnabas also appointed elders in every church. With prayer and fasting, they turned the elders over to the care of the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

verses.kjv_text: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.nlt_text: Then they traveled back through Pisidia to Pamphylia.

verses.kjv_text: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.nlt_text: They preached the word in Perga, then went down to Attalia.

verses.kjv_text: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: Finally, they returned by ship to Antioch of Syria, where their journey had begun. The believers there had entrusted them to the grace of God to do the work they had now completed.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.nlt_text: Upon arriving in Antioch, they called the church together and reported everything God had done through them and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles, too.

verses.kjv_text: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.nlt_text: And they stayed there with the believers for a long time.

verses.kjv_text: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, {and said}, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.nlt_text: While Paul and Barnabas were at Antioch of Syria, some men from Judea arrived and began to teach the believers: "Unless you are circumcised as required by the law of Moses, you cannot be saved."

verses.kjv_text: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.nlt_text: Paul and Barnabas disagreed with them, arguing vehemently. Finally, the church decided to send Paul and Barnabas to Jerusalem, accompanied by some local believers, to talk to the apostles and elders about this question.

verses.kjv_text: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.nlt_text: The church sent the delegates to Jerusalem, and they stopped along the way in Phoenicia and Samaria to visit the believers. They told them-- much to everyone's joy-- that the Gentiles, too, were being converted.

verses.kjv_text: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and {of} the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.nlt_text: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Barnabas and Paul were welcomed by the whole church, including the apostles and elders. They reported everything God had done through them.

verses.kjv_text: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command {them} to keep the law of Moses. {rose...: or, rose up, said they, certain}
verses.nlt_text: But then some of the believers who belonged to the sect of the Pharisees stood up and insisted, "The Gentile converts must be circumcised and required to follow the law of Moses."

verses.kjv_text: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.nlt_text: So the apostles and elders met together to resolve this issue.

verses.kjv_text: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men {and} brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.nlt_text: At the meeting, after a long discussion, Peter stood and addressed them as follows: "Brothers, you all know that God chose me from among you some time ago to preach to the Gentiles so that they could hear the Good News and believe.

verses.kjv_text: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as {he did} unto us;
verses.nlt_text: God knows people's hearts, and he confirmed that he accepts Gentiles by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to us.

verses.kjv_text: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.nlt_text: He made no distinction between us and them, for he cleansed their hearts through faith.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.nlt_text: So why are you now challenging God by burdening the Gentile believers with a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors were able to bear?

verses.kjv_text: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.nlt_text: We believe that we are all saved the same way, by the undeserved grace of the Lord Jesus."

verses.kjv_text: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone listened quietly as Barnabas and Paul told about the miraculous signs and wonders God had done through them among the Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men {and} brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.nlt_text: When they had finished, James stood and said, "Brothers, listen to me.

verses.kjv_text: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.nlt_text: Peter has told you about the time God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people for himself.

verses.kjv_text: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.nlt_text: And this conversion of Gentiles is exactly what the prophets predicted. As it is written:

verses.kjv_text: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.nlt_text: 'Afterward I will return and restore the fallen house of David. I will rebuild its ruins and restore it,

verses.kjv_text: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.nlt_text: so that the rest of humanity might seek the LORD, including the Gentiles-- all those I have called to be mine. The LORD has spoken--

verses.kjv_text: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.nlt_text: he who made these things known so long ago.'

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.nlt_text: "And so my judgment is that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.

verses.kjv_text: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and {from} fornication, and {from} things strangled, and {from} blood.
