verses.nlt_text: Of course not! Even if everyone else is a liar, God is true. As the Scriptures say about him, "You will be proved right in what you say, and you will win your case in court."

verses.kjv_text: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? {Is} God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.nlt_text: "But," some might say, "our sinfulness serves a good purpose, for it helps people see how righteous God is. Isn't it unfair, then, for him to punish us?" (This is merely a human point of view.)

verses.kjv_text: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.nlt_text: Of course not! If God were not entirely fair, how would he be qualified to judge the world?

verses.kjv_text: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.nlt_text: "But," someone might still argue, "how can God condemn me as a sinner if my dishonesty highlights his truthfulness and brings him more glory?"

verses.kjv_text: And not {rather}, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.nlt_text: And some people even slander us by claiming that we say, "The more we sin, the better it is!" Those who say such things deserve to be condemned.

verses.kjv_text: What then? are we better {than they}? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin; {proved: Gr. charged}
verses.nlt_text: Well then, should we conclude that we Jews are better than others? No, not at all, for we have already shown that all people, whether Jews or Gentiles, are under the power of sin.

verses.kjv_text: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "No one is righteous-- not even one.

verses.kjv_text: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.nlt_text: No one is truly wise; no one is seeking God.

verses.kjv_text: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.nlt_text: All have turned away; all have become useless. No one does good, not a single one."

verses.kjv_text: Their throat {is} an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps {is} under their lips:
verses.nlt_text: "Their talk is foul, like the stench from an open grave. Their tongues are filled with lies." "Snake venom drips from their lips."

verses.kjv_text: Whose mouth {is} full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.nlt_text: "Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness."

verses.kjv_text: Their feet {are} swift to shed blood:
verses.nlt_text: "They rush to commit murder.

verses.kjv_text: Destruction and misery {are} in their ways:
verses.nlt_text: Destruction and misery always follow them.

verses.kjv_text: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.nlt_text: They don't know where to find peace."

verses.kjv_text: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.nlt_text: "They have no fear of God at all."

verses.kjv_text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God. {guilty...: or, subject to the judgment of God}
verses.nlt_text: Obviously, the law applies to those to whom it was given, for its purpose is to keep people from having excuses, and to show that the entire world is guilty before God.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law {is} the knowledge of sin.
verses.nlt_text: For no one can ever be made right with God by doing what the law commands. The law simply shows us how sinful we are.

verses.kjv_text: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.nlt_text: But now God has shown us a way to be made right with him without keeping the requirements of the law, as was promised in the writings of Moses and the prophets long ago.

verses.kjv_text: Even the righteousness of God {which is} by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.nlt_text: We are made right with God by placing our faith in Jesus Christ. And this is true for everyone who believes, no matter who we are.

verses.kjv_text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.nlt_text: For everyone has sinned; we all fall short of God's glorious standard.

verses.kjv_text: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: Yet God, with undeserved kindness, declares that we are righteous. He did this through Christ Jesus when he freed us from the penalty for our sins.

verses.kjv_text: Whom God hath set forth {to be} a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God; {set forth: or, foreordained} {remission: or, passing over}
verses.nlt_text: For God presented Jesus as the sacrifice for sin. People are made right with God when they believe that Jesus sacrificed his life, shedding his blood. This sacrifice shows that God was being fair when he held back and did not punish those who sinned in times past,

verses.kjv_text: To declare, {I say}, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: for he was looking ahead and including them in what he would do in this present time. God did this to demonstrate his righteousness, for he himself is fair and just, and he declares sinners to be right in his sight when they believe in Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Where {is} boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.nlt_text: Can we boast, then, that we have done anything to be accepted by God? No, because our acquittal is not based on obeying the law. It is based on faith.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.nlt_text: So we are made right with God through faith and not by obeying the law.

verses.kjv_text: {Is he} the God of the Jews only? {is he} not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.nlt_text: After all, is God the God of the Jews only? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Of course he is.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing {it is} one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.nlt_text: There is only one God, and he makes people right with himself only by faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.nlt_text: Well then, if we emphasize faith, does this mean that we can forget about the law? Of course not! In fact, only when we have faith do we truly fulfill the law.

verses.kjv_text: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.nlt_text: Abraham was, humanly speaking, the founder of our Jewish nation. What did he discover about being made right with God?

verses.kjv_text: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath {whereof} to glory; but not before God.
verses.nlt_text: If his good deeds had made him acceptable to God, he would have had something to boast about. But that was not God's way.

verses.kjv_text: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures tell us, "Abraham believed God, and God counted him as righteous because of his faith."

verses.kjv_text: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.nlt_text: When people work, their wages are not a gift, but something they have earned.

verses.kjv_text: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: But people are counted as righteous, not because of their work, but because of their faith in God who forgives sinners.

verses.kjv_text: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.nlt_text: David also spoke of this when he described the happiness of those who are declared righteous without working for it:

verses.kjv_text: {Saying}, Blessed {are} they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.nlt_text: "Oh, what joy for those whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sins are put out of sight.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {is} the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, what joy for those whose record the LORD has cleared of sin."

verses.kjv_text: {Cometh} this blessedness then upon the circumcision {only}, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: Now, is this blessing only for the Jews, or is it also for uncircumcised Gentiles? Well, we have been saying that Abraham was counted as righteous by God because of his faith.

verses.kjv_text: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.nlt_text: But how did this happen? Was he counted as righteous only after he was circumcised, or was it before he was circumcised? Clearly, God accepted Abraham before he was circumcised!

verses.kjv_text: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which {he had yet} being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.nlt_text: Circumcision was a sign that Abraham already had faith and that God had already accepted him and declared him to be righteous-- even before he was circumcised. So Abraham is the spiritual father of those who have faith but have not been circumcised. They are counted as righteous because of their faith.

verses.kjv_text: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which {he had} being {yet} uncircumcised.
verses.nlt_text: And Abraham is also the spiritual father of those who have been circumcised, but only if they have the same kind of faith Abraham had before he was circumcised.

verses.kjv_text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, {was} not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.nlt_text: Clearly, God's promise to give the whole earth to Abraham and his descendants was based not on his obedience to God's law, but on a right relationship with God that comes by faith.

verses.kjv_text: For if they which are of the law {be} heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.nlt_text: If God's promise is only for those who obey the law, then faith is not necessary and the promise is pointless.

verses.kjv_text: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, {there is} no transgression.
verses.nlt_text: For the law always brings punishment on those who try to obey it. (The only way to avoid breaking the law is to have no law to break!)

verses.kjv_text: Therefore {it is} of faith, that {it might be} by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.nlt_text: So the promise is received by faith. It is given as a free gift. And we are all certain to receive it, whether or not we live according to the law of Moses, if we have faith like Abraham's. For Abraham is the father of all who believe.

verses.kjv_text: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, {even} God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were. {before him: or, like unto him}
verses.nlt_text: That is what the Scriptures mean when God told him, "I have made you the father of many nations." This happened because Abraham believed in the God who brings the dead back to life and who creates new things out of nothing.

verses.kjv_text: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.nlt_text: Even when there was no reason for hope, Abraham kept hoping-- believing that he would become the father of many nations. For God had said to him, "That's how many descendants you will have!"

verses.kjv_text: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
verses.nlt_text: And Abraham's faith did not weaken, even though, at about 100 years of age, he figured his body was as good as dead-- and so was Sarah's womb.

verses.kjv_text: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.nlt_text: Abraham never wavered in believing God's promise. In fact, his faith grew stronger, and in this he brought glory to God.

verses.kjv_text: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.nlt_text: He was fully convinced that God is able to do whatever he promises.

verses.kjv_text: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: And because of Abraham's faith, God counted him as righteous.

verses.kjv_text: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.nlt_text: And when God counted him as righteous, it wasn't just for Abraham's benefit. It was recorded

verses.kjv_text: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.nlt_text: for our benefit, too, assuring us that God will also count us as righteous if we believe in him, the one who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.nlt_text: He was handed over to die because of our sins, and he was raised to life to make us right with God.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, since we have been made right in God's sight by faith, we have peace with God because of what Jesus Christ our Lord has done for us.

verses.kjv_text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.nlt_text: Because of our faith, Christ has brought us into this place of undeserved privilege where we now stand, and we confidently and joyfully look forward to sharing God's glory.

verses.kjv_text: And not only {so}, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.nlt_text: We can rejoice, too, when we run into problems and trials, for we know that they help us develop endurance.

verses.kjv_text: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.nlt_text: And endurance develops strength of character, and character strengthens our confident hope of salvation.

verses.kjv_text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.nlt_text: And this hope will not lead to disappointment. For we know how dearly God loves us, because he has given us the Holy Spirit to fill our hearts with his love.

verses.kjv_text: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly. {in due time: or, according to the time}
verses.nlt_text: When we were utterly helpless, Christ came at just the right time and died for us sinners.

verses.kjv_text: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.nlt_text: Now, most people would not be willing to die for an upright person, though someone might perhaps be willing to die for a person who is especially good.

verses.kjv_text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.nlt_text: But God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners.

verses.kjv_text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.nlt_text: And since we have been made right in God's sight by the blood of Christ, he will certainly save us from God's condemnation.

verses.kjv_text: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.nlt_text: For since our friendship with God was restored by the death of his Son while we were still his enemies, we will certainly be saved through the life of his Son.

verses.kjv_text: And not only {so}, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement. {atonement: or, reconciliation}
verses.nlt_text: So now we can rejoice in our wonderful new relationship with God because our Lord Jesus Christ has made us friends of God.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned: {for that: or, in whom}
verses.nlt_text: When Adam sinned, sin entered the world. Adam's sin brought death, so death spread to everyone, for everyone sinned.

verses.kjv_text: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, people sinned even before the law was given. But it was not counted as sin because there was not yet any law to break.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.nlt_text: Still, everyone died-- from the time of Adam to the time of Moses-- even those who did not disobey an explicit commandment of God, as Adam did. Now Adam is a symbol, a representation of Christ, who was yet to come.

verses.kjv_text: But not as the offence, so also {is} the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, {which is} by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.nlt_text: But there is a great difference between Adam's sin and God's gracious gift. For the sin of this one man, Adam, brought death to many. But even greater is God's wonderful grace and his gift of forgiveness to many through this other man, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And not as {it was} by one that sinned, {so is} the gift: for the judgment {was} by one to condemnation, but the free gift {is} of many offences unto justification.
verses.nlt_text: And the result of God's gracious gift is very different from the result of that one man's sin. For Adam's sin led to condemnation, but God's free gift leads to our being made right with God, even though we are guilty of many sins.

verses.kjv_text: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.) {by one man's...: or, by one offence}
verses.nlt_text: For the sin of this one man, Adam, caused death to rule over many. But even greater is God's wonderful grace and his gift of righteousness, for all who receive it will live in triumph over sin and death through this one man, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore as by the offence of one {judgment came} upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one {the free gift came} upon all men unto justification of life. {by the offence...: or, by one offence} {by the righteousness...: or, by one righteousness}
verses.nlt_text: Yes, Adam's one sin brings condemnation for everyone, but Christ's one act of righteousness brings a right relationship with God and new life for everyone.

verses.kjv_text: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.nlt_text: Because one person disobeyed God, many became sinners. But because one other person obeyed God, many will be made righteous.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.nlt_text: God's law was given so that all people could see how sinful they were. But as people sinned more and more, God's wonderful grace became more abundant.

verses.kjv_text: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.nlt_text: So just as sin ruled over all people and brought them to death, now God's wonderful grace rules instead, giving us right standing with God and resulting in eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.kjv_text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.nlt_text: Well then, should we keep on sinning so that God can show us more and more of his wonderful grace?

verses.kjv_text: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.nlt_text: Of course not! Since we have died to sin, how can we continue to live in it?

verses.kjv_text: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death? {were: or, are}
verses.nlt_text: Or have you forgotten that when we were joined with Christ Jesus in baptism, we joined him in his death?

verses.kjv_text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.nlt_text: For we died and were buried with Christ by baptism. And just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glorious power of the Father, now we also may live new lives.

verses.kjv_text: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also {in the likeness} of {his} resurrection:
verses.nlt_text: Since we have been united with him in his death, we will also be raised to life as he was.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with {him}, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.nlt_text: We know that our old sinful selves were crucified with Christ so that sin might lose its power in our lives. We are no longer slaves to sin.

verses.kjv_text: For he that is dead is freed from sin. {freed: Gr. justified}
verses.nlt_text: For when we died with Christ we were set free from the power of sin.

verses.kjv_text: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.nlt_text: And since we died with Christ, we know we will also live with him.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.nlt_text: We are sure of this because Christ was raised from the dead, and he will never die again. Death no longer has any power over him.

verses.kjv_text: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.nlt_text: When he died, he died once to break the power of sin. But now that he lives, he lives for the glory of God.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.nlt_text: So you also should consider yourselves to be dead to the power of sin and alive to God through Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Do not let sin control the way you live; do not give in to sinful desires.

verses.kjv_text: Neither yield ye your members {as} instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members {as} instruments of righteousness unto God. {instruments: Gr. arms, or, weapons}
verses.nlt_text: Do not let any part of your body become an instrument of evil to serve sin. Instead, give yourselves completely to God, for you were dead, but now you have new life. So use your whole body as an instrument to do what is right for the glory of God.

verses.kjv_text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.nlt_text: Sin is no longer your master, for you no longer live under the requirements of the law. Instead, you live under the freedom of God's grace.

verses.kjv_text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.nlt_text: Well then, since God's grace has set us free from the law, does that mean we can go on sinning? Of course not!

verses.kjv_text: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.nlt_text: Don't you realize that you become the slave of whatever you choose to obey? You can be a slave to sin, which leads to death, or you can choose to obey God, which leads to righteous living.

verses.kjv_text: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you. {which...: Gr. whereto ye were delivered}
verses.nlt_text: Thank God! Once you were slaves of sin, but now you wholeheartedly obey this teaching we have given you.

verses.kjv_text: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: Now you are free from your slavery to sin, and you have become slaves to righteous living.

verses.kjv_text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.nlt_text: Because of the weakness of your human nature, I am using the illustration of slavery to help you understand all this. Previously, you let yourselves be slaves to impurity and lawlessness, which led ever deeper into sin. Now you must give yourselves to be slaves to righteous living so that you will become holy.

verses.kjv_text: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness. {from...: Gr. to righteousness}
verses.nlt_text: When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the obligation to do right.

verses.kjv_text: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things {is} death.
verses.nlt_text: And what was the result? You are now ashamed of the things you used to do, things that end in eternal doom.

verses.kjv_text: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.nlt_text: But now you are free from the power of sin and have become slaves of God. Now you do those things that lead to holiness and result in eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: For the wages of sin {is} death; but the gift of God {is} eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.nlt_text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life through Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.nlt_text: Now, dear brothers and sisters-- you who are familiar with the law-- don't you know that the law applies only while a person is living?

verses.kjv_text: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to {her} husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of {her} husband.
verses.nlt_text: For example, when a woman marries, the law binds her to her husband as long as he is alive. But if he dies, the laws of marriage no longer apply to her.

verses.kjv_text: So then if, while {her} husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.nlt_text: So while her husband is alive, she would be committing adultery if she married another man. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law and does not commit adultery when she remarries.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, {even} to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.nlt_text: So, my dear brothers and sisters, this is the point: You died to the power of the law when you died with Christ. And now you are united with the one who was raised from the dead. As a result, we can produce a harvest of good deeds for God.

verses.kjv_text: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death. {motions: Gr. passions}
verses.nlt_text: When we were controlled by our old nature, sinful desires were at work within us, and the law aroused these evil desires that produced a harvest of sinful deeds, resulting in death.

verses.kjv_text: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not {in} the oldness of the letter. {that being...: or, being dead to that}
verses.nlt_text: But now we have been released from the law, for we died to it and are no longer captive to its power. Now we can serve God, not in the old way of obeying the letter of the law, but in the new way of living in the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: What shall we say then? {Is} the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet. {lust: or, concupiscence}
verses.nlt_text: Well then, am I suggesting that the law of God is sinful? Of course not! In fact, it was the law that showed me my sin. I would never have known that coveting is wrong if the law had not said, "You must not covet."

verses.kjv_text: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin {was} dead.
verses.nlt_text: But sin used this command to arouse all kinds of covetous desires within me! If there were no law, sin would not have that power.

verses.kjv_text: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.nlt_text: At one time I lived without understanding the law. But when I learned the command not to covet, for instance, the power of sin came to life,

verses.kjv_text: And the commandment, which {was ordained} to life, I found {to be} unto death.
verses.nlt_text: and I died. So I discovered that the law's commands, which were supposed to bring life, brought spiritual death instead.

verses.kjv_text: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew {me}.
verses.nlt_text: Sin took advantage of those commands and deceived me; it used the commands to kill me.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the law {is} holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.nlt_text: But still, the law itself is holy, and its commands are holy and right and good.

verses.kjv_text: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.nlt_text: But how can that be? Did the law, which is good, cause my death? Of course not! Sin used what was good to bring about my condemnation to death. So we can see how terrible sin really is. It uses God's good commands for its own evil purposes.

verses.kjv_text: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.nlt_text: So the trouble is not with the law, for it is spiritual and good. The trouble is with me, for I am all too human, a slave to sin.

verses.kjv_text: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I. {allow: Gr. know}
verses.nlt_text: I don't really understand myself, for I want to do what is right, but I don't do it. Instead, I do what I hate.

verses.kjv_text: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that {it is} good.
verses.nlt_text: But if I know that what I am doing is wrong, this shows that I agree that the law is good.

verses.kjv_text: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.nlt_text: So I am not the one doing wrong; it is sin living in me that does it.

verses.kjv_text: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but {how} to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.nlt_text: And I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my sinful nature. I want to do what is right, but I can't.

verses.kjv_text: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.nlt_text: I want to do what is good, but I don't. I don't want to do what is wrong, but I do it anyway.

verses.kjv_text: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.nlt_text: But if I do what I don't want to do, I am not really the one doing wrong; it is sin living in me that does it.

verses.kjv_text: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.nlt_text: I have discovered this principle of life-- that when I want to do what is right, I inevitably do what is wrong.

verses.kjv_text: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.nlt_text: I love God's law with all my heart.

verses.kjv_text: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.nlt_text: But there is another power within me that is at war with my mind. This power makes me a slave to the sin that is still within me.

verses.kjv_text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? {the body...: or, this body of death}
verses.nlt_text: Oh, what a miserable person I am! Who will free me from this life that is dominated by sin and death?

verses.kjv_text: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.nlt_text: Thank God! The answer is in Jesus Christ our Lord. So you see how it is: In my mind I really want to obey God's law, but because of my sinful nature I am a slave to sin.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: So now there is no condemnation for those who belong to Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.nlt_text: And because you belong to him, the power of the life-giving Spirit has freed you from the power of sin that leads to death.

verses.kjv_text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh: {for sin: or, by a sacrifice for sin}
verses.nlt_text: The law of Moses was unable to save us because of the weakness of our sinful nature. So God did what the law could not do. He sent his own Son in a body like the bodies we sinners have. And in that body God declared an end to sin's control over us by giving his Son as a sacrifice for our sins.

verses.kjv_text: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: He did this so that the just requirement of the law would be fully satisfied for us, who no longer follow our sinful nature but instead follow the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: Those who are dominated by the sinful nature think about sinful things, but those who are controlled by the Holy Spirit think about things that please the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: For to be carnally minded {is} death; but to be spiritually minded {is} life and peace. {to be carnally...: Gr. the minding of the flesh} {to be spiritually...: Gr. the minding of the Spirit}
verses.nlt_text: So letting your sinful nature control your mind leads to death. But letting the Spirit control your mind leads to life and peace.

verses.kjv_text: Because the carnal mind {is} enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be. {the carnal...: Gr. the minding of the flesh}
verses.nlt_text: For the sinful nature is always hostile to God. It never did obey God's laws, and it never will.

verses.kjv_text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.nlt_text: That's why those who are still under the control of their sinful nature can never please God.

verses.kjv_text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.nlt_text: But you are not controlled by your sinful nature. You are controlled by the Spirit if you have the Spirit of God living in you. (And remember that those who do not have the Spirit of Christ living in them do not belong to him at all.)

verses.kjv_text: And if Christ {be} in you, the body {is} dead because of sin; but the Spirit {is} life because of righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: And Christ lives within you, so even though your body will die because of sin, the Spirit gives you life because you have been made right with God.

verses.kjv_text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you. {by: or, because of}
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from the dead, lives in you. And just as God raised Christ Jesus from the dead, he will give life to your mortal bodies by this same Spirit living within you.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, dear brothers and sisters, you have no obligation to do what your sinful nature urges you to do.

verses.kjv_text: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.nlt_text: For if you live by its dictates, you will die. But if through the power of the Spirit you put to death the deeds of your sinful nature, you will live.

verses.kjv_text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.nlt_text: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are children of God.

verses.kjv_text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.nlt_text: So you have not received a spirit that makes you fearful slaves. Instead, you received God's Spirit when he adopted you as his own children. Now we call him, "Abba, Father."

verses.kjv_text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.nlt_text: For his Spirit joins with our spirit to affirm that we are God's children.

verses.kjv_text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with {him}, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.nlt_text: And since we are his children, we are his heirs. In fact, together with Christ we are heirs of God's glory. But if we are to share his glory, we must also share his suffering.

verses.kjv_text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time {are} not worthy {to be compared} with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.nlt_text: Yet what we suffer now is nothing compared to the glory he will reveal to us later.

verses.kjv_text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.nlt_text: For all creation is waiting eagerly for that future day when God will reveal who his children really are.

verses.kjv_text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected {the same} in hope,
verses.nlt_text: Against its will, all creation was subjected to God's curse. But with eager hope,

verses.kjv_text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.nlt_text: the creation looks forward to the day when it will join God's children in glorious freedom from death and decay.

verses.kjv_text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now. {the...: or, every creature}
verses.nlt_text: For we know that all creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

verses.kjv_text: And not only {they}, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, {to wit}, the redemption of our body.
verses.nlt_text: And we believers also groan, even though we have the Holy Spirit within us as a foretaste of future glory, for we long for our bodies to be released from sin and suffering. We, too, wait with eager hope for the day when God will give us our full rights as his adopted children, including the new bodies he has promised us.

verses.kjv_text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.nlt_text: We were given this hope when we were saved. (If we already have something, we don't need to hope for it.

verses.kjv_text: But if we hope for that we see not, {then} do we with patience wait for {it}.
verses.nlt_text: But if we look forward to something we don't yet have, we must wait patiently and confidently.)

verses.kjv_text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.nlt_text: And the Holy Spirit helps us in our weakness. For example, we don't know what God wants us to pray for. But the Holy Spirit prays for us with groanings that cannot be expressed in words.

verses.kjv_text: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what {is} the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to {the will of} God. {because: or, that}
verses.nlt_text: And the Father who knows all hearts knows what the Spirit is saying, for the Spirit pleads for us believers in harmony with God's own will.

verses.kjv_text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to {his} purpose.
verses.nlt_text: And we know that God causes everything to work together for the good of those who love God and are called according to his purpose for them.

verses.kjv_text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate {to be} conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.nlt_text: For God knew his people in advance, and he chose them to become like his Son, so that his Son would be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.nlt_text: And having chosen them, he called them to come to him. And having called them, he gave them right standing with himself. And having given them right standing, he gave them his glory.

verses.kjv_text: What shall we then say to these things? If God {be} for us, who {can be} against us?
verses.nlt_text: What shall we say about such wonderful things as these? If God is for us, who can ever be against us?

verses.kjv_text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.nlt_text: Since he did not spare even his own Son but gave him up for us all, won't he also give us everything else?

verses.kjv_text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? {It is} God that justifieth.
verses.nlt_text: Who dares accuse us whom God has chosen for his own? No one-- for God himself has given us right standing with himself.

verses.kjv_text: Who {is} he that condemneth? {It is} Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.nlt_text: Who then will condemn us? No one-- for Christ Jesus died for us and was raised to life for us, and he is sitting in the place of honor at God's right hand, pleading for us.

verses.kjv_text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? {shall} tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.nlt_text: Can anything ever separate us from Christ's love? Does it mean he no longer loves us if we have trouble or calamity, or are persecuted, or hungry, or destitute, or in danger, or threatened with death?

verses.kjv_text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.nlt_text: (As the Scriptures say, "For your sake we are killed every day; we are being slaughtered like sheep.")

verses.kjv_text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.nlt_text: No, despite all these things, overwhelming victory is ours through Christ, who loved us.

verses.kjv_text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.nlt_text: And I am convinced that nothing can ever separate us from God's love. Neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither our fears for today nor our worries about tomorrow-- not even the powers of hell can separate us from God's love.

verses.kjv_text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.nlt_text: No power in the sky above or in the earth below-- indeed, nothing in all creation will ever be able to separate us from the love of God that is revealed in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv_text: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
verses.nlt_text: With Christ as my witness, I speak with utter truthfulness. My conscience and the Holy Spirit confirm it.

verses.kjv_text: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.nlt_text: My heart is filled with bitter sorrow and unending grief

verses.kjv_text: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh: {accursed: or, separated}
verses.nlt_text: for my people, my Jewish brothers and sisters. I would be willing to be forever cursed-- cut off from Christ!-- if that would save them.

verses.kjv_text: Who are Israelites; to whom {pertaineth} the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service {of God}, and the promises; {covenants: or, testaments}
verses.nlt_text: They are the people of Israel, chosen to be God's adopted children. God revealed his glory to them. He made covenants with them and gave them his law. He gave them the privilege of worshiping him and receiving his wonderful promises.

verses.kjv_text: Whose {are} the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ {came}, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob are their ancestors, and Christ himself was an Israelite as far as his human nature is concerned. And he is God, the one who rules over everything and is worthy of eternal praise! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they {are} not all Israel, which are of Israel:
verses.nlt_text: Well then, has God failed to fulfill his promise to Israel? No, for not all who are born into the nation of Israel are truly members of God's people!

verses.kjv_text: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, {are they} all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.nlt_text: Being descendants of Abraham doesn't make them truly Abraham's children. For the Scriptures say, "Isaac is the son through whom your descendants will be counted," though Abraham had other children, too.

verses.kjv_text: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these {are} not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.nlt_text: This means that Abraham's physical descendants are not necessarily children of God. Only the children of the promise are considered to be Abraham's children.

verses.kjv_text: For this {is} the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
verses.nlt_text: For God had promised, "I will return about this time next year, and Sarah will have a son."

verses.kjv_text: And not only {this}; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, {even} by our father Isaac;
verses.nlt_text: This son was our ancestor Isaac. When he married Rebekah, she gave birth to twins.

verses.kjv_text: (For {the children} being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
verses.nlt_text: But before they were born, before they had done anything good or bad, she received a message from God. (This message shows that God chooses people according to his own purposes;

verses.kjv_text: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger. {elder: or, greater} {younger: or, lesser}
verses.nlt_text: he calls people, but not according to their good or bad works.) She was told, "Your older son will serve your younger son."

verses.kjv_text: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.nlt_text: In the words of the Scriptures, "I loved Jacob, but I rejected Esau."

verses.kjv_text: What shall we say then? {Is there} unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.nlt_text: Are we saying, then, that God was unfair? Of course not!

verses.kjv_text: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.nlt_text: For God said to Moses, "I will show mercy to anyone I choose, and I will show compassion to anyone I choose."

verses.kjv_text: So then {it is} not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.nlt_text: So it is God who decides to show mercy. We can neither choose it nor work for it.

verses.kjv_text: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures say that God told Pharaoh, "I have appointed you for the very purpose of displaying my power in you and to spread my fame throughout the earth."

verses.kjv_text: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will {have mercy}, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.nlt_text: So you see, God chooses to show mercy to some, and he chooses to harden the hearts of others so they refuse to listen.

verses.kjv_text: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
verses.nlt_text: Well then, you might say, "Why does God blame people for not responding? Haven't they simply done what he makes them do?"

verses.kjv_text: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed {it}, Why hast thou made me thus? {repliest...: or, answerest again, or, disputest with God?}
verses.nlt_text: No, don't say that. Who are you, a mere human being, to argue with God? Should the thing that was created say to the one who created it, "Why have you made me like this?"

verses.kjv_text: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.nlt_text: When a potter makes jars out of clay, doesn't he have a right to use the same lump of clay to make one jar for decoration and another to throw garbage into?

verses.kjv_text: {What} if God, willing to shew {his} wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction: {fitted: or, made up}
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, even though God has the right to show his anger and his power, he is very patient with those on whom his anger falls, who were made for destruction.

verses.kjv_text: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.nlt_text: He does this to make the riches of his glory shine even brighter on those to whom he shows mercy, who were prepared in advance for glory.

verses.kjv_text: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.nlt_text: And we are among those whom he selected, both from the Jews and from the Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.nlt_text: Concerning the Gentiles, God says in the prophecy of Hosea, "Those who were not my people, I will now call my people. And I will love those whom I did not love before."

verses.kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, {that} in the place where it was said unto them, Ye {are} not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
verses.nlt_text: And, "Then, at the place where they were told, 'You are not my people,' there they will be called 'children of the living God.' "

verses.kjv_text: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.nlt_text: And concerning Israel, Isaiah the prophet cried out, "Though the people of Israel are as numerous as the sand of the seashore, only a remnant will be saved.

verses.kjv_text: For he will finish the work, and cut {it} short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth. {the work: or, the account}
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD will carry out his sentence upon the earth quickly and with finality."

verses.kjv_text: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha. {Sabaoth: Heb. hosts}
verses.nlt_text: And Isaiah said the same thing in another place: "If the LORD of Heaven's Armies had not spared a few of our children, we would have been wiped out like Sodom, destroyed like Gomorrah."

verses.kjv_text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.nlt_text: What does all this mean? Even though the Gentiles were not trying to follow God's standards, they were made right with God. And it was by faith that this took place.

verses.kjv_text: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: But the people of Israel, who tried so hard to get right with God by keeping the law, never succeeded.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore? Because {they sought it} not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.nlt_text: Why not? Because they were trying to get right with God by keeping the law instead of by trusting in him. They stumbled over the great rock in their path.

verses.kjv_text: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed. {ashamed: or confounded}
verses.nlt_text: God warned them of this in the Scriptures when he said, "I am placing a stone in Jerusalem that makes people stumble, a rock that makes them fall. But anyone who trusts in him will never be disgraced."

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, the longing of my heart and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.

verses.kjv_text: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.nlt_text: I know what enthusiasm they have for God, but it is misdirected zeal.

verses.kjv_text: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
verses.nlt_text: For they don't understand God's way of making people right with himself. Refusing to accept God's way, they cling to their own way of getting right with God by trying to keep the law.

verses.kjv_text: For Christ {is} the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.nlt_text: For Christ has already accomplished the purpose for which the law was given. As a result, all who believe in him are made right with God.

verses.kjv_text: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
verses.nlt_text: For Moses writes that the law's way of making a person right with God requires obedience to all of its commands.

verses.kjv_text: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down {from above}:)
verses.nlt_text: But faith's way of getting right with God says, "Don't say in your heart, 'Who will go up to heaven' (to bring Christ down to earth).

verses.kjv_text: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
verses.nlt_text: And don't say, 'Who will go down to the place of the dead' (to bring Christ back to life again)."

verses.kjv_text: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, {even} in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.nlt_text: In fact, it says, "The message is very close at hand; it is on your lips and in your heart." And that message is the very message about faith that we preach:

verses.kjv_text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.nlt_text: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

verses.kjv_text: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.nlt_text: For it is by believing in your heart that you are made right with God, and it is by confessing with your mouth that you are saved.

verses.kjv_text: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures tell us, "Anyone who trusts in him will never be disgraced. "

verses.kjv_text: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.nlt_text: Jew and Gentile are the same in this respect. They have the same Lord, who gives generously to all who call on him.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.nlt_text: For "Everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved."

verses.kjv_text: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.nlt_text: But how can they call on him to save them unless they believe in him? And how can they believe in him if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear about him unless someone tells them?

verses.kjv_text: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.nlt_text: And how will anyone go and tell them without being sent? That is why the Scriptures say, "How beautiful are the feet of messengers who bring good news!"

verses.kjv_text: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report? {our report: Gr. the hearing of us?} {report: or, preaching?}
verses.nlt_text: But not everyone welcomes the Good News, for Isaiah the prophet said, "LORD, who has believed our message?"

verses.kjv_text: So then faith {cometh} by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.nlt_text: So faith comes from hearing, that is, hearing the Good News about Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.nlt_text: But I ask, have the people of Israel actually heard the message? Yes, they have: "The message has gone throughout the earth, and the words to all the world."

verses.kjv_text: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by {them that are} no people, {and} by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.nlt_text: But I ask, did the people of Israel really understand? Yes, they did, for even in the time of Moses, God said, "I will rouse your jealousy through people who are not even a nation. I will provoke your anger through the foolish Gentiles."

verses.kjv_text: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.nlt_text: And later Isaiah spoke boldly for God, saying, "I was found by people who were not looking for me. I showed myself to those who were not asking for me."

verses.kjv_text: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.nlt_text: But regarding Israel, God said, "All day long I opened my arms to them, but they were disobedient and rebellious."

verses.kjv_text: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, {of} the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.nlt_text: I ask, then, has God rejected his own people, the nation of Israel? Of course not! I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv_text: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying, {of Elias: Gr. in Elias?}
verses.nlt_text: No, God has not rejected his own people, whom he chose from the very beginning. Do you realize what the Scriptures say about this? Elijah the prophet complained to God about the people of Israel and said,

verses.kjv_text: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.nlt_text: "LORD, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me, too."

verses.kjv_text: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to {the image of} Baal.
verses.nlt_text: And do you remember God's reply? He said, "No, I have 7,000 others who have never bowed down to Baal!"

verses.kjv_text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.nlt_text: It is the same today, for a few of the people of Israel have remained faithful because of God's grace-- his undeserved kindness in choosing them.

verses.kjv_text: And if by grace, then {is it} no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if {it be} of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.nlt_text: And since it is through God's kindness, then it is not by their good works. For in that case, God's grace would not be what it really is-- free and undeserved.

verses.kjv_text: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded {blinded: or, hardened}
verses.nlt_text: So this is the situation: Most of the people of Israel have not found the favor of God they are looking for so earnestly. A few have-- the ones God has chosen-- but the hearts of the rest were hardened.

verses.kjv_text: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day. {slumber: or, remorse}
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "God has put them into a deep sleep. To this day he has shut their eyes so they do not see, and closed their ears so they do not hear."

verses.kjv_text: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.nlt_text: Likewise, David said, "Let their bountiful table become a snare, a trap that makes them think all is well. Let their blessings cause them to stumble, and let them get what they deserve.

verses.kjv_text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.nlt_text: Let their eyes go blind so they cannot see, and let their backs be bent forever."

verses.kjv_text: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but {rather} through their fall salvation {is come} unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.nlt_text: Did God's people stumble and fall beyond recovery? Of course not! They were disobedient, so God made salvation available to the Gentiles. But he wanted his own people to become jealous and claim it for themselves.

verses.kjv_text: Now if the fall of them {be} the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness? {diminishing: or, decay, or, loss}
verses.nlt_text: Now if the Gentiles were enriched because the people of Israel turned down God's offer of salvation, think how much greater a blessing the world will share when they finally accept it.

verses.kjv_text: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.nlt_text: I am saying all this especially for you Gentiles. God has appointed me as the apostle to the Gentiles. I stress this,

verses.kjv_text: If by any means I may provoke to emulation {them which are} my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.nlt_text: for I want somehow to make the people of Israel jealous of what you Gentiles have, so I might save some of them.

verses.kjv_text: For if the casting away of them {be} the reconciling of the world, what {shall} the receiving {of them be}, but life from the dead?
verses.nlt_text: For since their rejection meant that God offered salvation to the rest of the world, their acceptance will be even more wonderful. It will be life for those who were dead!

verses.kjv_text: For if the firstfruit {be} holy, the lump {is} also {holy}: and if the root {be} holy, so {are} the branches.
verses.nlt_text: And since Abraham and the other patriarchs were holy, their descendants will also be holy-- just as the entire batch of dough is holy because the portion given as an offering is holy. For if the roots of the tree are holy, the branches will be, too.

verses.kjv_text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree; {among them: or, for them}
verses.nlt_text: But some of these branches from Abraham's tree-- some of the people of Israel-- have been broken off. And you Gentiles, who were branches from a wild olive tree, have been grafted in. So now you also receive the blessing God has promised Abraham and his children, sharing in the rich nourishment from the root of God's special olive tree.

verses.kjv_text: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.nlt_text: But you must not brag about being grafted in to replace the branches that were broken off. You are just a branch, not the root.

verses.kjv_text: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
verses.nlt_text: "Well," you may say, "those branches were broken off to make room for me."

verses.kjv_text: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.nlt_text: Yes, but remember-- those branches were broken off because they didn't believe in Christ, and you are there because you do believe. So don't think highly of yourself, but fear what could happen.

verses.kjv_text: For if God spared not the natural branches, {take heed} lest he also spare not thee.
verses.nlt_text: For if God did not spare the original branches, he won't spare you either.

verses.kjv_text: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in {his} goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.nlt_text: Notice how God is both kind and severe. He is severe toward those who disobeyed, but kind to you if you continue to trust in his kindness. But if you stop trusting, you also will be cut off.

verses.kjv_text: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
verses.nlt_text: And if the people of Israel turn from their unbelief, they will be grafted in again, for God has the power to graft them back into the tree.

verses.kjv_text: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural {branches}, be graffed into their own olive tree?
verses.nlt_text: You, by nature, were a branch cut from a wild olive tree. So if God was willing to do something contrary to nature by grafting you into his cultivated tree, he will be far more eager to graft the original branches back into the tree where they belong.

verses.kjv_text: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in. {blindness: or, hardness}
verses.nlt_text: I want you to understand this mystery, dear brothers and sisters, so that you will not feel proud about yourselves. Some of the people of Israel have hard hearts, but this will last only until the full number of Gentiles comes to Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.nlt_text: And so all Israel will be saved. As the Scriptures say, "The one who rescues will come from Jerusalem, and he will turn Israel away from ungodliness.

verses.kjv_text: For this {is} my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.nlt_text: And this is my covenant with them, that I will take away their sins."

verses.kjv_text: As concerning the gospel, {they are} enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, {they are} beloved for the fathers' sakes.
verses.nlt_text: Many of the people of Israel are now enemies of the Good News, and this benefits you Gentiles. Yet they are still the people he loves because he chose their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.kjv_text: For the gifts and calling of God {are} without repentance.
verses.nlt_text: For God's gifts and his call can never be withdrawn.

verses.kjv_text: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief: {believed: or, obeyed}
verses.nlt_text: Once, you Gentiles were rebels against God, but when the people of Israel rebelled against him, God was merciful to you instead.

verses.kjv_text: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy. {believed: or, obeyed}
verses.nlt_text: Now they are the rebels, and God's mercy has come to you so that they, too, will share in God's mercy.

verses.kjv_text: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all. {concluded...: or, shut them all up together}
verses.nlt_text: For God has imprisoned everyone in disobedience so he could have mercy on everyone.

verses.kjv_text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable {are} his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.nlt_text: Oh, how great are God's riches and wisdom and knowledge! How impossible it is for us to understand his decisions and his ways!

verses.kjv_text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.nlt_text: For who can know the LORD's thoughts? Who knows enough to give him advice?

verses.kjv_text: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.nlt_text: And who has given him so much that he needs to pay it back?

verses.kjv_text: For of him, and through him, and to him, {are} all things: to whom {be} glory for ever. Amen. {whom: Gr. him}
verses.nlt_text: For everything comes from him and exists by his power and is intended for his glory. All glory to him forever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, {which is} your reasonable service.
verses.nlt_text: And so, dear brothers and sisters, I plead with you to give your bodies to God because of all he has done for you. Let them be a living and holy sacrifice-- the kind he will find acceptable. This is truly the way to worship him.

verses.kjv_text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what {is} that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.nlt_text: Don't copy the behavior and customs of this world, but let God transform you into a new person by changing the way you think. Then you will learn to know God's will for you, which is good and pleasing and perfect.

verses.kjv_text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think {of himself} more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith. {soberly: Gr. to sobriety}
verses.nlt_text: Because of the privilege and authority God has given me, I give each of you this warning: Don't think you are better than you really are. Be honest in your evaluation of yourselves, measuring yourselves by the faith God has given us.

verses.kjv_text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.nlt_text: Just as our bodies have many parts and each part has a special function,

verses.kjv_text: So we, {being} many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.nlt_text: so it is with Christ's body. We are many parts of one body, and we all belong to each other.

verses.kjv_text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, {let us prophesy} according to the proportion of faith;
verses.nlt_text: In his grace, God has given us different gifts for doing certain things well. So if God has given you the ability to prophesy, speak out with as much faith as God has given you.

verses.kjv_text: Or ministry, {let us wait} on {our} ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.nlt_text: If your gift is serving others, serve them well. If you are a teacher, teach well.

verses.kjv_text: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, {let him do it} with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness. {giveth: or, imparteth} {with simplicity: or, liberally}
verses.nlt_text: If your gift is to encourage others, be encouraging. If it is giving, give generously. If God has given you leadership ability, take the responsibility seriously. And if you have a gift for showing kindness to others, do it gladly.

verses.kjv_text: {Let} love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.nlt_text: Don't just pretend to love others. Really love them. Hate what is wrong. Hold tightly to what is good.

verses.kjv_text: {Be} kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another; {with...: or, in the love of the brethren}
verses.nlt_text: Love each other with genuine affection, and take delight in honoring each other.

verses.kjv_text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.nlt_text: Never be lazy, but work hard and serve the Lord enthusiastically.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.nlt_text: Rejoice in our confident hope. Be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.

verses.kjv_text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.nlt_text: When God's people are in need, be ready to help them. Always be eager to practice hospitality.

verses.kjv_text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.nlt_text: Bless those who persecute you. Don't curse them; pray that God will bless them.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.nlt_text: Be happy with those who are happy, and weep with those who weep.

verses.kjv_text: {Be} of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits. {condescend...: or, be contented with mean things}
verses.nlt_text: Live in harmony with each other. Don't be too proud to enjoy the company of ordinary people. And don't think you know it all!

verses.kjv_text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.nlt_text: Never pay back evil with more evil. Do things in such a way that everyone can see you are honorable.

verses.kjv_text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.nlt_text: Do all that you can to live in peace with everyone.

verses.kjv_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but {rather} give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance {is} mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, never take revenge. Leave that to the righteous anger of God. For the Scriptures say, "I will take revenge; I will pay them back," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, "If your enemies are hungry, feed them. If they are thirsty, give them something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals of shame on their heads."

verses.kjv_text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let evil conquer you, but conquer evil by doing good.

verses.kjv_text: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God. {ordained: or, ordered}
