verses.nlt_text: So because of your superior knowledge, a weak believer for whom Christ died will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
verses.nlt_text: And when you sin against other believers by encouraging them to do something they believe is wrong, you are sinning against Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
verses.nlt_text: So if what I eat causes another believer to sin, I will never eat meat again as long as I live-- for I don't want to cause another believer to stumble.

verses.kjv_text: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
verses.nlt_text: Am I not as free as anyone else? Am I not an apostle? Haven't I seen Jesus our Lord with my own eyes? Isn't it because of my work that you belong to the Lord?

verses.kjv_text: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Even if others think I am not an apostle, I certainly am to you. You yourselves are proof that I am the Lord's apostle.

verses.kjv_text: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,
verses.nlt_text: This is my answer to those who question my authority.

verses.kjv_text: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
verses.nlt_text: Don't we have the right to live in your homes and share your meals?

verses.kjv_text: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and {as} the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas? {wife: or, woman}
verses.nlt_text: Don't we have the right to bring a Christian wife with us as the other disciples and the Lord's brothers do, and as Peter does?

verses.kjv_text: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
verses.nlt_text: Or is it only Barnabas and I who have to work to support ourselves?

verses.kjv_text: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
verses.nlt_text: What soldier has to pay his own expenses? What farmer plants a vineyard and doesn't have the right to eat some of its fruit? What shepherd cares for a flock of sheep and isn't allowed to drink some of the milk?

verses.kjv_text: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
verses.nlt_text: Am I expressing merely a human opinion, or does the law say the same thing?

verses.kjv_text: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?
verses.nlt_text: For the law of Moses says, "You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain." Was God thinking only about oxen when he said this?

verses.kjv_text: Or saith he {it} altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, {this} is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
verses.nlt_text: Wasn't he actually speaking to us? Yes, it was written for us, so that the one who plows and the one who threshes the grain might both expect a share of the harvest.

verses.kjv_text: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, {is it} a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
verses.nlt_text: Since we have planted spiritual seed among you, aren't we entitled to a harvest of physical food and drink?

verses.kjv_text: If others be partakers of {this} power over you, {are} not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: If you support others who preach to you, shouldn't we have an even greater right to be supported? But we have never used this right. We would rather put up with anything than be an obstacle to the Good News about Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live {of the things} of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar? {live: or, feed}
verses.nlt_text: Don't you realize that those who work in the temple get their meals from the offerings brought to the temple? And those who serve at the altar get a share of the sacrificial offerings.

verses.kjv_text: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, the Lord ordered that those who preach the Good News should be supported by those who benefit from it.

verses.kjv_text: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for {it were} better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
verses.nlt_text: Yet I have never used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that I want to start now. In fact, I would rather die than lose my right to boast about preaching without charge.

verses.kjv_text: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
verses.nlt_text: Yet preaching the Good News is not something I can boast about. I am compelled by God to do it. How terrible for me if I didn't preach the Good News!

verses.kjv_text: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation {of the gospel} is committed unto me.
verses.nlt_text: If I were doing this on my own initiative, I would deserve payment. But I have no choice, for God has given me this sacred trust.

verses.kjv_text: What is my reward then? {Verily} that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
verses.nlt_text: What then is my pay? It is the opportunity to preach the Good News without charging anyone. That's why I never demand my rights when I preach the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: For though I be free from all {men}, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
verses.nlt_text: Even though I am a free man with no master, I have become a slave to all people to bring many to Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
verses.nlt_text: When I was with the Jews, I lived like a Jew to bring the Jews to Christ. When I was with those who follow the Jewish law, I too lived under that law. Even though I am not subject to the law, I did this so I could bring to Christ those who are under the law.

verses.kjv_text: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
verses.nlt_text: When I am with the Gentiles who do not follow the Jewish law, I too live apart from that law so I can bring them to Christ. But I do not ignore the law of God; I obey the law of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all {men}, that I might by all means save some.
verses.nlt_text: When I am with those who are weak, I share their weakness, for I want to bring the weak to Christ. Yes, I try to find common ground with everyone, doing everything I can to save some.

verses.kjv_text: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with {you}.
verses.nlt_text: I do everything to spread the Good News and share in its blessings.

verses.kjv_text: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
verses.nlt_text: Don't you realize that in a race everyone runs, but only one person gets the prize? So run to win!

verses.kjv_text: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they {do it} to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
verses.nlt_text: All athletes are disciplined in their training. They do it to win a prize that will fade away, but we do it for an eternal prize.

verses.kjv_text: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
verses.nlt_text: So I run with purpose in every step. I am not just shadowboxing.

verses.kjv_text: But I keep under my body, and bring {it} into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
verses.nlt_text: I discipline my body like an athlete, training it to do what it should. Otherwise, I fear that after preaching to others I myself might be disqualified.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
verses.nlt_text: I don't want you to forget, dear brothers and sisters, about our ancestors in the wilderness long ago. All of them were guided by a cloud that moved ahead of them, and all of them walked through the sea on dry ground.

verses.kjv_text: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.nlt_text: In the cloud and in the sea, all of them were baptized as followers of Moses.

verses.kjv_text: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
verses.nlt_text: All of them ate the same spiritual food,

verses.kjv_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ. {followed...: or, went with them}
verses.nlt_text: and all of them drank the same spiritual water. For they drank from the spiritual rock that traveled with them, and that rock was Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.nlt_text: Yet God was not pleased with most of them, and their bodies were scattered in the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted. {our...: Gr. our figures}
verses.nlt_text: These things happened as a warning to us, so that we would not crave evil things as they did,

verses.kjv_text: Neither be ye idolaters, as {were} some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
verses.nlt_text: or worship idols as some of them did. As the Scriptures say, "The people celebrated with feasting and drinking, and they indulged in pagan revelry."

verses.kjv_text: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
verses.nlt_text: And we must not engage in sexual immorality as some of them did, causing 23,000 of them to die in one day.

verses.kjv_text: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
verses.nlt_text: Nor should we put Christ to the test, as some of them did and then died from snakebites.

verses.kjv_text: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
verses.nlt_text: And don't grumble as some of them did, and then were destroyed by the angel of death.

verses.kjv_text: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come. {ensamples: or, types}
verses.nlt_text: These things happened to them as examples for us. They were written down to warn us who live at the end of the age.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
verses.nlt_text: If you think you are standing strong, be careful not to fall.

verses.kjv_text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God {is} faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear {it}. {common...: or, moderate}
verses.nlt_text: The temptations in your life are no different from what others experience. And God is faithful. He will not allow the temptation to be more than you can stand. When you are tempted, he will show you a way out so that you can endure.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.nlt_text: So, my dear friends, flee from the worship of idols.

verses.kjv_text: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
verses.nlt_text: You are reasonable people. Decide for yourselves if what I am saying is true.

verses.kjv_text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
verses.nlt_text: When we bless the cup at the Lord's Table, aren't we sharing in the blood of Christ? And when we break the bread, aren't we sharing in the body of Christ?

verses.kjv_text: For we {being} many are one bread, {and} one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
verses.nlt_text: And though we are many, we all eat from one loaf of bread, showing that we are one body.

verses.kjv_text: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
verses.nlt_text: Think about the people of Israel. Weren't they united by eating the sacrifices at the altar?

verses.kjv_text: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
verses.nlt_text: What am I trying to say? Am I saying that food offered to idols has some significance, or that idols are real gods?

verses.kjv_text: But I {say}, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
verses.nlt_text: No, not at all. I am saying that these sacrifices are offered to demons, not to God. And I don't want you to participate with demons.

verses.kjv_text: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
verses.nlt_text: You cannot drink from the cup of the Lord and from the cup of demons, too. You cannot eat at the Lord's Table and at the table of demons, too.

verses.kjv_text: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
verses.nlt_text: What? Do we dare to rouse the Lord's jealousy? Do you think we are stronger than he is?

verses.kjv_text: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not. {expedient: or, profitable}
verses.nlt_text: You say, "I am allowed to do anything"-- but not everything is good for you. You say, "I am allowed to do anything"-- but not everything is beneficial.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's {wealth}.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be concerned for your own good but for the good of others.

verses.kjv_text: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, {that} eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
verses.nlt_text: So you may eat any meat that is sold in the marketplace without raising questions of conscience.

verses.kjv_text: For the earth {is} the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
verses.nlt_text: For "the earth is the LORD's, and everything in it."

verses.kjv_text: If any of them that believe not bid you {to a feast}, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
verses.nlt_text: If someone who isn't a believer asks you home for dinner, accept the invitation if you want to. Eat whatever is offered to you without raising questions of conscience.

verses.kjv_text: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth {is} the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:
verses.nlt_text: (But suppose someone tells you, "This meat was offered to an idol." Don't eat it, out of consideration for the conscience of the one who told you.

verses.kjv_text: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another {man's} conscience?
verses.nlt_text: It might not be a matter of conscience for you, but it is for the other person.) For why should my freedom be limited by what someone else thinks?

verses.kjv_text: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks? {grace: or, thanksgiving}
verses.nlt_text: If I can thank God for the food and enjoy it, why should I be condemned for eating it?

verses.kjv_text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.nlt_text: So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

verses.kjv_text: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God: {Gentiles: Gr. Greeks}
verses.nlt_text: Don't give offense to Jews or Gentiles or the church of God.

verses.kjv_text: Even as I please all {men} in all {things}, not seeking mine own profit, but the {profit} of many, that they may be saved.
verses.nlt_text: I, too, try to please everyone in everything I do. I don't just do what is best for me; I do what is best for others so that many may be saved.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye followers of me, even as I also {am} of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: And you should imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered {them} to you. {ordinances: or, traditions}
verses.nlt_text: I am so glad that you always keep me in your thoughts, and that you are following the teachings I passed on to you.

verses.kjv_text: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman {is} the man; and the head of Christ {is} God.
verses.nlt_text: But there is one thing I want you to know: The head of every man is Christ, the head of woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

verses.kjv_text: Every man praying or prophesying, having {his} head covered, dishonoureth his head.
verses.nlt_text: A man dishonors his head if he covers his head while praying or prophesying.

verses.kjv_text: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with {her} head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
verses.nlt_text: But a woman dishonors her head if she prays or prophesies without a covering on her head, for this is the same as shaving her head.

verses.kjv_text: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, if she refuses to wear a head covering, she should cut off all her hair! But since it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or her head shaved, she should wear a covering.

verses.kjv_text: For a man indeed ought not to cover {his} head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.nlt_text: A man should not wear anything on his head when worshiping, for man is made in God's image and reflects God's glory. And woman reflects man's glory.

verses.kjv_text: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
verses.nlt_text: For the first man didn't come from woman, but the first woman came from man.

verses.kjv_text: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
verses.nlt_text: And man was not made for woman, but woman was made for man.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause ought the woman to have power on {her} head because of the angels. {power: that is a covering in sign that she is under the power of her husband}
verses.nlt_text: For this reason, and because the angels are watching, a woman should wear a covering on her head to show she is under authority.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: But among the Lord's people, women are not independent of men, and men are not independent of women.

verses.kjv_text: For as the woman {is} of the man, even so {is} the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
verses.nlt_text: For although the first woman came from man, every other man was born from a woman, and everything comes from God.

verses.kjv_text: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
verses.nlt_text: Judge for yourselves. Is it right for a woman to pray to God in public without covering her head?

verses.kjv_text: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
verses.nlt_text: Isn't it obvious that it's disgraceful for a man to have long hair?

verses.kjv_text: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for {her} hair is given her for a covering. {covering: or, veil}
verses.nlt_text: And isn't long hair a woman's pride and joy? For it has been given to her as a covering.

verses.kjv_text: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
verses.nlt_text: But if anyone wants to argue about this, I simply say that we have no other custom than this, and neither do God's other churches.

verses.kjv_text: Now in this that I declare {unto you} I praise {you} not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
verses.nlt_text: But in the following instructions, I cannot praise you. For it sounds as if more harm than good is done when you meet together.

verses.kjv_text: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it. {divisions: or, schisms}
verses.nlt_text: First, I hear that there are divisions among you when you meet as a church, and to some extent I believe it.

verses.kjv_text: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you. {heresies: or, sects}
verses.nlt_text: But, of course, there must be divisions among you so that you who have God's approval will be recognized!

verses.kjv_text: When ye come together therefore into one place, {this} is not to eat the Lord's supper. {this...: or, ye cannot eat}
verses.nlt_text: When you meet together, you are not really interested in the Lord's Supper.

verses.kjv_text: For in eating every one taketh before {other} his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.nlt_text: For some of you hurry to eat your own meal without sharing with others. As a result, some go hungry while others get drunk.

verses.kjv_text: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise {you} not. {have not: or, are poor?}
verses.nlt_text: What? Don't you have your own homes for eating and drinking? Or do you really want to disgrace God's church and shame the poor? What am I supposed to say? Do you want me to praise you? Well, I certainly will not praise you for this!

verses.kjv_text: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the {same} night in which he was betrayed took bread:
verses.nlt_text: For I pass on to you what I received from the Lord himself. On the night when he was betrayed, the Lord Jesus took some bread

verses.kjv_text: And when he had given thanks, he brake {it}, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me. {in...: or, for a remembrance}
verses.nlt_text: and gave thanks to God for it. Then he broke it in pieces and said, "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this to remember me."

verses.kjv_text: After the same manner also {he took} the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink {it}, in remembrance of me.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, he took the cup of wine after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant between God and his people-- an agreement confirmed with my blood. Do this to remember me as often as you drink it."

verses.kjv_text: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come. {ye do...: or, shew ye}
verses.nlt_text: For every time you eat this bread and drink this cup, you are announcing the Lord's death until he comes again.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink {this} cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: So anyone who eats this bread or drinks this cup of the Lord unworthily is guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of {that} bread, and drink of {that} cup.
verses.nlt_text: That is why you should examine yourself before eating the bread and drinking the cup.

verses.kjv_text: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body. {damnation: or, judgment}
verses.nlt_text: For if you eat the bread or drink the cup without honoring the body of Christ, you are eating and drinking God's judgment upon yourself.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause many {are} weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
verses.nlt_text: That is why many of you are weak and sick and some have even died.

verses.kjv_text: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
verses.nlt_text: But if we would examine ourselves, we would not be judged by God in this way.

verses.kjv_text: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
verses.nlt_text: Yet when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned along with the world.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
verses.nlt_text: So, my dear brothers and sisters, when you gather for the Lord's Supper, wait for each other.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come. {condemnation: or, judgment}
verses.nlt_text: If you are really hungry, eat at home so you won't bring judgment upon yourselves when you meet together. I'll give you instructions about the other matters after I arrive.

verses.kjv_text: Now concerning spiritual {gifts}, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
verses.nlt_text: Now, dear brothers and sisters, regarding your question about the special abilities the Spirit gives us. I don't want you to misunderstand this.

verses.kjv_text: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
verses.nlt_text: You know that when you were still pagans, you were led astray and swept along in worshiping speechless idols.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and {that} no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost. {accursed: or, anathema}
verses.nlt_text: So I want you to know that no one speaking by the Spirit of God will curse Jesus, and no one can say Jesus is Lord, except by the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but the same Spirit is the source of them all.

verses.kjv_text: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord. {administrations: or, ministries}
verses.nlt_text: There are different kinds of service, but we serve the same Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
verses.nlt_text: God works in different ways, but it is the same God who does the work in all of us.

verses.kjv_text: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
verses.nlt_text: A spiritual gift is given to each of us so we can help each other.

verses.kjv_text: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
verses.nlt_text: To one person the Spirit gives the ability to give wise advice; to another the same Spirit gives a message of special knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
verses.nlt_text: The same Spirit gives great faith to another, and to someone else the one Spirit gives the gift of healing.

verses.kjv_text: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another {divers} kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
verses.nlt_text: He gives one person the power to perform miracles, and another the ability to prophesy. He gives someone else the ability to discern whether a message is from the Spirit of God or from another spirit. Still another person is given the ability to speak in unknown languages, while another is given the ability to interpret what is being said.

verses.kjv_text: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
verses.nlt_text: It is the one and only Spirit who distributes all these gifts. He alone decides which gift each person should have.

verses.kjv_text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also {is} Christ.
verses.nlt_text: The human body has many parts, but the many parts make up one whole body. So it is with the body of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether {we be} Jews or Gentiles, whether {we be} bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit. {Gentiles: Gr. Greeks}
verses.nlt_text: Some of us are Jews, some are Gentiles, some are slaves, and some are free. But we have all been baptized into one body by one Spirit, and we all share the same Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, the body has many different parts, not just one part.

verses.kjv_text: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.nlt_text: If the foot says, "I am not a part of the body because I am not a hand," that does not make it any less a part of the body.

verses.kjv_text: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.nlt_text: And if the ear says, "I am not part of the body because I am not an eye," would that make it any less a part of the body?

verses.kjv_text: If the whole body {were} an eye, where {were} the hearing? If the whole {were} hearing, where {were} the smelling?
verses.nlt_text: If the whole body were an eye, how would you hear? Or if your whole body were an ear, how would you smell anything?

verses.kjv_text: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
verses.nlt_text: But our bodies have many parts, and God has put each part just where he wants it.

verses.kjv_text: And if they were all one member, where {were} the body?
verses.nlt_text: How strange a body would be if it had only one part!

verses.kjv_text: But now {are they} many members, yet but one body.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, there are many parts, but only one body.

verses.kjv_text: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
verses.nlt_text: The eye can never say to the hand, "I don't need you." The head can't say to the feet, "I don't need you."

verses.kjv_text: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
verses.nlt_text: In fact, some parts of the body that seem weakest and least important are actually the most necessary.

verses.kjv_text: And those {members} of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely {parts} have more abundant comeliness. {bestow: or, put on}
verses.nlt_text: And the parts we regard as less honorable are those we clothe with the greatest care. So we carefully protect those parts that should not be seen,

verses.kjv_text: For our comely {parts} have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that {part} which lacked:
verses.nlt_text: while the more honorable parts do not require this special care. So God has put the body together such that extra honor and care are given to those parts that have less dignity.

verses.kjv_text: That there should be no schism in the body; but {that} the members should have the same care one for another. {schism: or, division}
verses.nlt_text: This makes for harmony among the members, so that all the members care for each other.

verses.kjv_text: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.nlt_text: If one part suffers, all the parts suffer with it, and if one part is honored, all the parts are glad.

verses.kjv_text: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
verses.nlt_text: All of you together are Christ's body, and each of you is a part of it.

verses.kjv_text: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues. {diversities: or, kinds}
verses.nlt_text: Here are some of the parts God has appointed for the church: first are apostles, second are prophets, third are teachers, then those who do miracles, those who have the gift of healing, those who can help others, those who have the gift of leadership, those who speak in unknown languages.

verses.kjv_text: {Are} all apostles? {are} all prophets? {are} all teachers? {are} all workers of miracles? {workers...: or, powers?}
verses.nlt_text: Are we all apostles? Are we all prophets? Are we all teachers? Do we all have the power to do miracles?

verses.kjv_text: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.nlt_text: Do we all have the gift of healing? Do we all have the ability to speak in unknown languages? Do we all have the ability to interpret unknown languages? Of course not!

verses.kjv_text: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
verses.nlt_text: So you should earnestly desire the most helpful gifts.But now let me show you a way of life that is best of all.

verses.kjv_text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become {as} sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.nlt_text: If I could speak all the languages of earth and of angels, but didn't love others, I would only be a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.

verses.kjv_text: And though I have {the gift of} prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.nlt_text: If I had the gift of prophecy, and if I understood all of God's secret plans and possessed all knowledge, and if I had such faith that I could move mountains, but didn't love others, I would be nothing.

verses.kjv_text: And though I bestow all my goods to feed {the poor}, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.nlt_text: If I gave everything I have to the poor and even sacrificed my body, I could boast about it; but if I didn't love others, I would have gained nothing.

verses.kjv_text: Charity suffereth long, {and} is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, {vaunteth...: or, is not rash}
verses.nlt_text: Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous or boastful or proud

verses.kjv_text: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.nlt_text: or rude. It does not demand its own way. It is not irritable, and it keeps no record of being wronged.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth; {in the truth: or, with the truth}
verses.nlt_text: It does not rejoice about injustice but rejoices whenever the truth wins out.

verses.kjv_text: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.nlt_text: Love never gives up, never loses faith, is always hopeful, and endures through every circumstance.

verses.kjv_text: Charity never faileth: but whether {there be} prophecies, they shall fail; whether {there be} tongues, they shall cease; whether {there be} knowledge, it shall vanish away. {fail: Gr. vanish away}
verses.nlt_text: Prophecy and speaking in unknown languages and special knowledge will become useless. But love will last forever!

verses.kjv_text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.nlt_text: Now our knowledge is partial and incomplete, and even the gift of prophecy reveals only part of the whole picture!

verses.kjv_text: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away. {done away: Gr. vanish away}
verses.nlt_text: But when full understanding comes, these partial things will become useless.

verses.kjv_text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things. {thought: or, reasoned} {put away: Gr. vanish away}
verses.nlt_text: When I was a child, I spoke and thought and reasoned as a child. But when I grew up, I put away childish things.

verses.kjv_text: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known. {darkly: Gr. in a riddle}
verses.nlt_text: Now we see things imperfectly as in a cloudy mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.

verses.kjv_text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these {is} charity.
verses.nlt_text: Three things will last forever-- faith, hope, and love-- and the greatest of these is love.

verses.kjv_text: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual {gifts}, but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.nlt_text: Let love be your highest goal! But you should also desire the special abilities the Spirit gives-- especially the ability to prophesy.

verses.kjv_text: For he that speaketh in an {unknown} tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth {him}; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries. {understandeth: Gr. heareth}
verses.nlt_text: For if you have the ability to speak in tongues, you will be talking only to God, since people won't be able to understand you. You will be speaking by the power of the Spirit, but it will all be mysterious.

verses.kjv_text: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men {to} edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.nlt_text: But one who prophesies strengthens others, encourages them, and comforts them.

verses.kjv_text: He that speaketh in an {unknown} tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.nlt_text: A person who speaks in tongues is strengthened personally, but one who speaks a word of prophecy strengthens the entire church.

verses.kjv_text: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater {is} he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.nlt_text: I wish you could all speak in tongues, but even more I wish you could all prophesy. For prophecy is greater than speaking in tongues, unless someone interprets what you are saying so that the whole church will be strengthened.

verses.kjv_text: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, if I should come to you speaking in an unknown language, how would that help you? But if I bring you a revelation or some special knowledge or prophecy or teaching, that will be helpful.

verses.kjv_text: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped? {sounds: or, tunes}
verses.nlt_text: Even lifeless instruments like the flute or the harp must play the notes clearly, or no one will recognize the melody.

verses.kjv_text: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.nlt_text: And if the bugler doesn't sound a clear call, how will the soldiers know they are being called to battle?

verses.kjv_text: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air. {easy...: Gr. significant}
verses.nlt_text: It's the same for you. If you speak to people in words they don't understand, how will they know what you are saying? You might as well be talking into empty space.

verses.kjv_text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them {is} without signification.
verses.nlt_text: There are many different languages in the world, and every language has meaning.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh {shall be} a barbarian unto me.
verses.nlt_text: But if I don't understand a language, I will be a foreigner to someone who speaks it, and the one who speaks it will be a foreigner to me.

verses.kjv_text: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual {gifts}, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church. {of spiritual gifts: Gr. of spirits}
verses.nlt_text: And the same is true for you. Since you are so eager to have the special abilities the Spirit gives, seek those that will strengthen the whole church.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an {unknown} tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.nlt_text: So anyone who speaks in tongues should pray also for the ability to interpret what has been said.

verses.kjv_text: For if I pray in an {unknown} tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.nlt_text: For if I pray in tongues, my spirit is praying, but I don't understand what I am saying.

verses.kjv_text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.nlt_text: Well then, what shall I do? I will pray in the spirit, and I will also pray in words I understand. I will sing in the spirit, and I will also sing in words I understand.

verses.kjv_text: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
verses.nlt_text: For if you praise God only in the spirit, how can those who don't understand you praise God along with you? How can they join you in giving thanks when they don't understand what you are saying?

verses.kjv_text: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.nlt_text: You will be giving thanks very well, but it won't strengthen the people who hear you.

verses.kjv_text: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
verses.nlt_text: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than any of you.

verses.kjv_text: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that {by my voice} I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an {unknown} tongue.
verses.nlt_text: But in a church meeting I would rather speak five understandable words to help others than ten thousand words in an unknown language.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men. {men: Gr. perfect, or, of a ripe age}
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, don't be childish in your understanding of these things. Be innocent as babies when it comes to evil, but be mature in understanding matters of this kind.

verses.kjv_text: In the law it is written, With {men of} other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: It is written in the Scriptures: "I will speak to my own people through strange languages and through the lips of foreigners. But even then, they will not listen to me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying {serveth} not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.nlt_text: So you see that speaking in tongues is a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for the benefit of believers, not unbelievers.

verses.kjv_text: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in {those that are} unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.nlt_text: Even so, if unbelievers or people who don't understand these things come into your church meeting and hear everyone speaking in an unknown language, they will think you are crazy.

verses.kjv_text: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or {one} unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.nlt_text: But if all of you are prophesying, and unbelievers or people who don't understand these things come into your meeting, they will be convicted of sin and judged by what you say.

verses.kjv_text: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on {his} face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
verses.nlt_text: As they listen, their secret thoughts will be exposed, and they will fall to their knees and worship God, declaring, "God is truly here among you."

verses.kjv_text: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.nlt_text: Well, my brothers and sisters, let's summarize. When you meet together, one will sing, another will teach, another will tell some special revelation God has given, one will speak in tongues, and another will interpret what is said. But everything that is done must strengthen all of you.

verses.kjv_text: If any man speak in an {unknown} tongue, {let it be} by two, or at the most {by} three, and {that} by course; and let one interpret. {two...: by two or three sentences separately}
verses.nlt_text: No more than two or three should speak in tongues. They must speak one at a time, and someone must interpret what they say.

verses.kjv_text: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.nlt_text: But if no one is present who can interpret, they must be silent in your church meeting and speak in tongues to God privately.

verses.kjv_text: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.nlt_text: Let two or three people prophesy, and let the others evaluate what is said.

verses.kjv_text: If {any thing} be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.nlt_text: But if someone is prophesying and another person receives a revelation from the Lord, the one who is speaking must stop.

verses.kjv_text: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.nlt_text: In this way, all who prophesy will have a turn to speak, one after the other, so that everyone will learn and be encouraged.

verses.kjv_text: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.nlt_text: Remember that people who prophesy are in control of their spirit and can take turns.

verses.kjv_text: For God is not {the author} of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints. {confusion: Gr. tumult, or, unquietness}
verses.nlt_text: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the meetings of God's holy people.

verses.kjv_text: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but {they are commanded} to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
verses.nlt_text: Women should be silent during the church meetings. It is not proper for them to speak. They should be submissive, just as the law says.

verses.kjv_text: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.nlt_text: If they have any questions, they should ask their husbands at home, for it is improper for women to speak in church meetings.

verses.kjv_text: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.nlt_text: Or do you think God's word originated with you Corinthians? Are you the only ones to whom it was given?

verses.kjv_text: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: If you claim to be a prophet or think you are spiritual, you should recognize that what I am saying is a command from the Lord himself.

verses.kjv_text: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.nlt_text: But if you do not recognize this, you yourself will not be recognized.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.nlt_text: So, my dear brothers and sisters, be eager to prophesy, and don't forbid speaking in tongues.

verses.kjv_text: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.nlt_text: But be sure that everything is done properly and in order.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
verses.nlt_text: Let me now remind you, dear brothers and sisters, of the Good News I preached to you before. You welcomed it then, and you still stand firm in it.

verses.kjv_text: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain. {keep...: or, hold fast} {what: Gr. by what speech}
verses.nlt_text: It is this Good News that saves you if you continue to believe the message I told you-- unless, of course, you believed something that was never true in the first place.

verses.kjv_text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.nlt_text: I passed on to you what was most important and what had also been passed on to me. Christ died for our sins, just as the Scriptures said.

verses.kjv_text: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.nlt_text: He was buried, and he was raised from the dead on the third day, just as the Scriptures said.

verses.kjv_text: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.nlt_text: He was seen by Peter and then by the Twelve.

verses.kjv_text: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.nlt_text: After that, he was seen by more than 500 of his followers at one time, most of whom are still alive, though some have died.

verses.kjv_text: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.nlt_text: Then he was seen by James and later by all the apostles.

verses.kjv_text: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time. {one...: or, an abortive}
verses.nlt_text: Last of all, as though I had been born at the wrong time, I also saw him.

verses.kjv_text: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.nlt_text: For I am the least of all the apostles. In fact, I'm not even worthy to be called an apostle after the way I persecuted God's church.

verses.kjv_text: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which {was bestowed} upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.nlt_text: But whatever I am now, it is all because God poured out his special favor on me-- and not without results. For I have worked harder than any of the other apostles; yet it was not I but God who was working through me by his grace.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore whether {it were} I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.nlt_text: So it makes no difference whether I preach or they preach, for we all preach the same message you have already believed.

verses.kjv_text: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.nlt_text: But tell me this-- since we preach that Christ rose from the dead, why are some of you saying there will be no resurrection of the dead?

verses.kjv_text: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
verses.nlt_text: For if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ has not been raised either.

verses.kjv_text: And if Christ be not risen, then {is} our preaching vain, and your faith {is} also vain.
verses.nlt_text: And if Christ has not been raised, then all our preaching is useless, and your faith is useless.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.nlt_text: And we apostles would all be lying about God-- for we have said that God raised Christ from the grave. But that can't be true if there is no resurrection of the dead.

verses.kjv_text: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
verses.nlt_text: And if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ has not been raised.

verses.kjv_text: And if Christ be not raised, your faith {is} vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.nlt_text: And if Christ has not been raised, then your faith is useless and you are still guilty of your sins.

verses.kjv_text: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
verses.nlt_text: In that case, all who have died believing in Christ are lost!

verses.kjv_text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
verses.nlt_text: And if our hope in Christ is only for this life, we are more to be pitied than anyone in the world.

verses.kjv_text: But now is Christ risen from the dead, {and} become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.nlt_text: But in fact, Christ has been raised from the dead. He is the first of a great harvest of all who have died.

verses.kjv_text: For since by man {came} death, by man {came} also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.nlt_text: So you see, just as death came into the world through a man, now the resurrection from the dead has begun through another man.

verses.kjv_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.nlt_text: Just as everyone dies because we all belong to Adam, everyone who belongs to Christ will be given new life.

verses.kjv_text: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
verses.nlt_text: But there is an order to this resurrection: Christ was raised as the first of the harvest; then all who belong to Christ will be raised when he comes back.

verses.kjv_text: Then {cometh} the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.nlt_text: After that the end will come, when he will turn the Kingdom over to God the Father, having destroyed every ruler and authority and power.

verses.kjv_text: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.nlt_text: For Christ must reign until he humbles all his enemies beneath his feet.

verses.kjv_text: The last enemy {that} shall be destroyed {is} death.
verses.nlt_text: And the last enemy to be destroyed is death.

verses.kjv_text: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under {him, it is} manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures say, "God has put all things under his authority." (Of course, when it says "all things are under his authority," that does not include God himself, who gave Christ his authority.)

verses.kjv_text: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.nlt_text: Then, when all things are under his authority, the Son will put himself under God's authority, so that God, who gave his Son authority over all things, will be utterly supreme over everything everywhere.

verses.kjv_text: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.nlt_text: If the dead will not be raised, what point is there in people being baptized for those who are dead? Why do it unless the dead will someday rise again?

verses.kjv_text: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.nlt_text: And why should we ourselves risk our lives hour by hour?

verses.kjv_text: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily. {your: some read, our}
verses.nlt_text: For I swear, dear brothers and sisters, that I face death daily. This is as certain as my pride in what Christ Jesus our Lord has done in you.

verses.kjv_text: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die. {after...: or, to speak after the manner of men}
verses.nlt_text: And what value was there in fighting wild beasts-- those people of Ephesus-- if there will be no resurrection from the dead? And if there is no resurrection, "Let's feast and drink, for tomorrow we die!"

verses.kjv_text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be fooled by those who say such things, for "bad company corrupts good character."

verses.kjv_text: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak {this} to your shame.
verses.nlt_text: Think carefully about what is right, and stop sinning. For to your shame I say that some of you don't know God at all.

verses.kjv_text: But some {man} will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.nlt_text: But someone may ask, "How will the dead be raised? What kind of bodies will they have?"

verses.kjv_text: {Thou} fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.nlt_text: What a foolish question! When you put a seed into the ground, it doesn't grow into a plant unless it dies first.

verses.kjv_text: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other {grain}:
verses.nlt_text: And what you put in the ground is not the plant that will grow, but only a bare seed of wheat or whatever you are planting.

verses.kjv_text: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.nlt_text: Then God gives it the new body he wants it to have. A different plant grows from each kind of seed.

verses.kjv_text: All flesh {is} not the same flesh: but {there is} one {kind of} flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, {and} another of birds.
verses.nlt_text: Similarly there are different kinds of flesh-- one kind for humans, another for animals, another for birds, and another for fish.

verses.kjv_text: {There are} also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial {is} one, and the {glory} of the terrestrial {is} another.
verses.nlt_text: There are also bodies in the heavens and bodies on the earth. The glory of the heavenly bodies is different from the glory of the earthly bodies.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for {one} star differeth from {another} star in glory.
verses.nlt_text: The sun has one kind of glory, while the moon and stars each have another kind. And even the stars differ from each other in their glory.

verses.kjv_text: So also {is} the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.nlt_text: It is the same way with the resurrection of the dead. Our earthly bodies are planted in the ground when we die, but they will be raised to live forever.

verses.kjv_text: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.nlt_text: Our bodies are buried in brokenness, but they will be raised in glory. They are buried in weakness, but they will be raised in strength.

verses.kjv_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.nlt_text: They are buried as natural human bodies, but they will be raised as spiritual bodies. For just as there are natural bodies, there are also spiritual bodies.

verses.kjv_text: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam {was made} a quickening spirit.
verses.nlt_text: The Scriptures tell us, "The first man, Adam, became a living person." But the last Adam-- that is, Christ-- is a life-giving Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit that {was} not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.nlt_text: What comes first is the natural body, then the spiritual body comes later.

verses.kjv_text: The first man {is} of the earth, earthy: the second man {is} the Lord from heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Adam, the first man, was made from the dust of the earth, while Christ, the second man, came from heaven.

verses.kjv_text: As {is} the earthy, such {are} they also that are earthy: and as {is} the heavenly, such {are} they also that are heavenly.
verses.nlt_text: Earthly people are like the earthly man, and heavenly people are like the heavenly man.

verses.kjv_text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.nlt_text: Just as we are now like the earthly man, we will someday be like the heavenly man.

verses.kjv_text: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.nlt_text: What I am saying, dear brothers and sisters, is that our physical bodies cannot inherit the Kingdom of God. These dying bodies cannot inherit what will last forever.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.nlt_text: But let me reveal to you a wonderful secret. We will not all die, but we will all be transformed!

verses.kjv_text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.nlt_text: It will happen in a moment, in the blink of an eye, when the last trumpet is blown. For when the trumpet sounds, those who have died will be raised to live forever. And we who are living will also be transformed.

verses.kjv_text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal {must} put on immortality.
verses.nlt_text: For our dying bodies must be transformed into bodies that will never die; our mortal bodies must be transformed into immortal bodies.

verses.kjv_text: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.nlt_text: Then, when our dying bodies have been transformed into bodies that will never die, this Scripture will be fulfilled: "Death is swallowed up in victory.

verses.kjv_text: O death, where {is} thy sting? O grave, where {is} thy victory? {grave: or, hell}
verses.nlt_text: O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting? "

verses.kjv_text: The sting of death {is} sin; and the strength of sin {is} the law.
verses.nlt_text: For sin is the sting that results in death, and the law gives sin its power.

verses.kjv_text: But thanks {be} to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: But thank God! He gives us victory over sin and death through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless.

verses.kjv_text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
verses.nlt_text: Now regarding your question about the money being collected for God's people in Jerusalem. You should follow the same procedure I gave to the churches in Galatia.

verses.kjv_text: Upon the first {day} of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as {God} hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.nlt_text: On the first day of each week, you should each put aside a portion of the money you have earned. Don't wait until I get there and then try to collect it all at once.

verses.kjv_text: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by {your} letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem. {liberality: Gr. gift}
verses.nlt_text: When I come, I will write letters of recommendation for the messengers you choose to deliver your gift to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.nlt_text: And if it seems appropriate for me to go along, they can travel with me.

verses.kjv_text: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.nlt_text: I am coming to visit you after I have been to Macedonia, for I am planning to travel through Macedonia.

verses.kjv_text: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.nlt_text: Perhaps I will stay awhile with you, possibly all winter, and then you can send me on my way to my next destination.

verses.kjv_text: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.nlt_text: This time I don't want to make just a short visit and then go right on. I want to come and stay awhile, if the Lord will let me.

verses.kjv_text: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.nlt_text: In the meantime, I will be staying here at Ephesus until the Festival of Pentecost.

verses.kjv_text: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and {there are} many adversaries.
verses.nlt_text: There is a wide-open door for a great work here, although many oppose me.

verses.kjv_text: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also {do}.
verses.nlt_text: When Timothy comes, don't intimidate him. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let anyone treat him with contempt. Send him on his way with your blessing when he returns to me. I expect him to come with the other believers.

verses.kjv_text: As touching {our} brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.nlt_text: Now about our brother Apollos-- I urged him to visit you with the other believers, but he was not willing to go right now. He will see you later when he has the opportunity.

verses.kjv_text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.nlt_text: Be on guard. Stand firm in the faith. Be courageous. Be strong.

verses.kjv_text: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.nlt_text: And do everything with love.

verses.kjv_text: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and {that} they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.nlt_text: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first of the harvest of believers in Greece, and they are spending their lives in service to God's people. I urge you, dear brothers and sisters,

verses.kjv_text: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with {us}, and laboureth.
verses.nlt_text: to submit to them and others like them who serve with such devotion.

verses.kjv_text: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.nlt_text: I am very glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come here. They have been providing the help you weren't here to give me.

verses.kjv_text: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
verses.nlt_text: They have been a wonderful encouragement to me, as they have been to you. You must show your appreciation to all who serve so well.

verses.kjv_text: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.nlt_text: The churches here in the province of Asia send greetings in the Lord, as do Aquila and Priscilla and all the others who gather in their home for church meetings.

verses.kjv_text: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
verses.nlt_text: All the brothers and sisters here send greetings to you. Greet each other with Christian love.

verses.kjv_text: The salutation of {me} Paul with mine own hand.
verses.nlt_text: HERE IS MY GREETING IN MY OWN HANDWRITING-- PAUL.

verses.kjv_text: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone does not love the Lord, that person is cursed. Our Lord, come!

verses.kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you.
verses.nlt_text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

verses.kjv_text: My love {be} with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. «{The first epistle} to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus and Timotheus.}»
verses.nlt_text: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy {our} brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy.I am writing to God's church in Corinth and to all of his holy people throughout Greece.

verses.kjv_text: Grace {be} to you and peace from God our Father, and {from} the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
verses.nlt_text: All praise to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is our merciful Father and the source of all comfort.

verses.kjv_text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.nlt_text: He comforts us in all our troubles so that we can comfort others. When they are troubled, we will be able to give them the same comfort God has given us.

verses.kjv_text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
verses.nlt_text: For the more we suffer for Christ, the more God will shower us with his comfort through Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And whether we be afflicted, {it is} for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, {it is} for your consolation and salvation. {is effectual: or, is wrought}
verses.nlt_text: Even when we are weighed down with troubles, it is for your comfort and salvation! For when we ourselves are comforted, we will certainly comfort you. Then you can patiently endure the same things we suffer.

verses.kjv_text: And our hope of you {is} stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so {shall ye be} also of the consolation.
verses.nlt_text: We are confident that as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in the comfort God gives us.

verses.kjv_text: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.nlt_text: We think you ought to know, dear brothers and sisters, about the trouble we went through in the province of Asia. We were crushed and overwhelmed beyond our ability to endure, and we thought we would never live through it.

verses.kjv_text: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead: {sentence: or, answer}
verses.nlt_text: In fact, we expected to die. But as a result, we stopped relying on ourselves and learned to rely only on God, who raises the dead.

verses.kjv_text: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver {us};
verses.nlt_text: And he did rescue us from mortal danger, and he will rescue us again. We have placed our confidence in him, and he will continue to rescue us.

verses.kjv_text: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift {bestowed} upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
verses.nlt_text: And you are helping us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks because God has graciously answered so many prayers for our safety.

verses.kjv_text: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.nlt_text: We can say with confidence and a clear conscience that we have lived with a God-given holiness and sincerity in all our dealings. We have depended on God's grace, not on our own human wisdom. That is how we have conducted ourselves before the world, and especially toward you.

verses.kjv_text: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
verses.nlt_text: Our letters have been straightforward, and there is nothing written between the lines and nothing you can't understand. I hope someday you will fully understand us,

verses.kjv_text: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also {are} ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: even if you don't understand us now. Then on the day when the Lord Jesus returns, you will be proud of us in the same way we are proud of you.

verses.kjv_text: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit; {benefit: or, grace}
verses.nlt_text: Since I was so sure of your understanding and trust, I wanted to give you a double blessing by visiting you twice--

verses.kjv_text: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
verses.nlt_text: first on my way to Macedonia and again when I returned from Macedonia. Then you could send me on my way to Judea.

verses.kjv_text: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
verses.nlt_text: You may be asking why I changed my plan. Do you think I make my plans carelessly? Do you think I am like people of the world who say "Yes" when they really mean "No"?

verses.kjv_text: But {as} God {is} true, our word toward you was not yea and nay. {word: or, preaching}
verses.nlt_text: As surely as God is faithful, my word to you does not waver between "Yes" and "No."

verses.kjv_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, {even} by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
verses.nlt_text: For Jesus Christ, the Son of God, does not waver between "Yes" and "No." He is the one whom Silas, Timothy, and I preached to you, and as God's ultimate "Yes," he always does what he says.

verses.kjv_text: For all the promises of God in him {are} yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
verses.nlt_text: For all of God's promises have been fulfilled in Christ with a resounding "Yes!" And through Christ, our "Amen" (which means "Yes") ascends to God for his glory.

verses.kjv_text: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, {is} God;
verses.nlt_text: It is God who enables us, along with you, to stand firm for Christ. He has commissioned us,

verses.kjv_text: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.nlt_text: and he has identified us as his own by placing the Holy Spirit in our hearts as the first installment that guarantees everything he has promised us.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
verses.nlt_text: Now I call upon God as my witness that I am telling the truth. The reason I didn't return to Corinth was to spare you from a severe rebuke.

verses.kjv_text: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
verses.nlt_text: But that does not mean we want to dominate you by telling you how to put your faith into practice. We want to work together with you so you will be full of joy, for it is by your own faith that you stand firm.

verses.kjv_text: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
verses.nlt_text: So I decided that I would not bring you grief with another painful visit.

verses.kjv_text: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
verses.nlt_text: For if I cause you grief, who will make me glad? Certainly not someone I have grieved.

verses.kjv_text: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is {the joy} of you all.
verses.nlt_text: That is why I wrote to you as I did, so that when I do come, I won't be grieved by the very ones who ought to give me the greatest joy. Surely you all know that my joy comes from your being joyful.

verses.kjv_text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.nlt_text: I wrote that letter in great anguish, with a troubled heart and many tears. I didn't want to grieve you, but I wanted to let you know how much love I have for you.
