verses.kjv_text: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
verses.nlt_text: I am not overstating it when I say that the man who caused all the trouble hurt all of you more than he hurt me.

verses.kjv_text: Sufficient to such a man {is} this punishment, which {was inflicted} of many. {punishment: or, censure}
verses.nlt_text: Most of you opposed him, and that was punishment enough.

verses.kjv_text: So that contrariwise ye {ought} rather to forgive {him}, and comfort {him}, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
verses.nlt_text: Now, however, it is time to forgive and comfort him. Otherwise he may be overcome by discouragement.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm {your} love toward him.
verses.nlt_text: So I urge you now to reaffirm your love for him.

verses.kjv_text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
verses.nlt_text: I wrote to you as I did to test you and see if you would fully comply with my instructions.

verses.kjv_text: To whom ye forgive any thing, I {forgive} also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave {it}, for your sakes {forgave I it} in the person of Christ; {person: or, sight}
verses.nlt_text: When you forgive this man, I forgive him, too. And when I forgive whatever needs to be forgiven, I do so with Christ's authority for your benefit,

verses.kjv_text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.nlt_text: so that Satan will not outsmart us. For we are familiar with his evil schemes.

verses.kjv_text: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to {preach} Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
verses.nlt_text: When I came to the city of Troas to preach the Good News of Christ, the Lord opened a door of opportunity for me.

verses.kjv_text: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
verses.nlt_text: But I had no peace of mind because my dear brother Titus hadn't yet arrived with a report from you. So I said good-bye and went on to Macedonia to find him.

verses.kjv_text: Now thanks {be} unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.nlt_text: But thank God! He has made us his captives and continues to lead us along in Christ's triumphal procession. Now he uses us to spread the knowledge of Christ everywhere, like a sweet perfume.

verses.kjv_text: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verses.nlt_text: Our lives are a Christ-like fragrance rising up to God. But this fragrance is perceived differently by those who are being saved and by those who are perishing.

verses.kjv_text: To the one {we are} the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who {is} sufficient for these things?
verses.nlt_text: To those who are perishing, we are a dreadful smell of death and doom. But to those who are being saved, we are a life-giving perfume. And who is adequate for such a task as this?

verses.kjv_text: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ. {corrupt: or, deal deceitfully with} {in Christ: or, of Christ}
verses.nlt_text: You see, we are not like the many hucksters who preach for personal profit. We preach the word of God with sincerity and with Christ's authority, knowing that God is watching us.

verses.kjv_text: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some {others}, epistles of commendation to you, or {letters} of commendation from you?
verses.nlt_text: Are we beginning to praise ourselves again? Are we like others, who need to bring you letters of recommendation, or who ask you to write such letters on their behalf? Surely not!

verses.kjv_text: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verses.nlt_text: The only letter of recommendation we need is you yourselves. Your lives are a letter written in our hearts; everyone can read it and recognize our good work among you.

verses.kjv_text: {Forasmuch as ye are} manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
verses.nlt_text: Clearly, you are a letter from Christ showing the result of our ministry among you. This "letter" is written not with pen and ink, but with the Spirit of the living God. It is carved not on tablets of stone, but on human hearts.

verses.kjv_text: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
verses.nlt_text: We are confident of all this because of our great trust in God through Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency {is} of God;
verses.nlt_text: It is not that we think we are qualified to do anything on our own. Our qualification comes from God.

verses.kjv_text: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life. {giveth life: or, quickeneth}
verses.nlt_text: He has enabled us to be ministers of his new covenant. This is a covenant not of written laws, but of the Spirit. The old written covenant ends in death; but under the new covenant, the Spirit gives life.

verses.kjv_text: But if the ministration of death, written {and} engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which {glory} was to be done away:
verses.nlt_text: The old way, with laws etched in stone, led to death, though it began with such glory that the people of Israel could not bear to look at Moses' face. For his face shone with the glory of God, even though the brightness was already fading away.

verses.kjv_text: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
verses.nlt_text: Shouldn't we expect far greater glory under the new way, now that the Holy Spirit is giving life?

verses.kjv_text: For if the ministration of condemnation {be} glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
verses.nlt_text: If the old way, which brings condemnation, was glorious, how much more glorious is the new way, which makes us right with God!

verses.kjv_text: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, that first glory was not glorious at all compared with the overwhelming glory of the new way.

verses.kjv_text: For if that which is done away {was} glorious, much more that which remaineth {is} glorious.
verses.nlt_text: So if the old way, which has been replaced, was glorious, how much more glorious is the new, which remains forever!

verses.kjv_text: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech: {plainness: or, boldness}
verses.nlt_text: Since this new way gives us such confidence, we can be very bold.

verses.kjv_text: And not as Moses, {which} put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
verses.nlt_text: We are not like Moses, who put a veil over his face so the people of Israel would not see the glory, even though it was destined to fade away.

verses.kjv_text: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which {vail} is done away in Christ.
verses.nlt_text: But the people's minds were hardened, and to this day whenever the old covenant is being read, the same veil covers their minds so they cannot understand the truth. And this veil can be removed only by believing in Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, even today when they read Moses' writings, their hearts are covered with that veil, and they do not understand.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
verses.nlt_text: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord {is}, there {is} liberty.
verses.nlt_text: For the Lord is the Spirit, and wherever the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

verses.kjv_text: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, {even} as by the Spirit of the Lord. {by the...: or, of the Lord the Spirit}
verses.nlt_text: So all of us who have had that veil removed can see and reflect the glory of the Lord. And the Lord-- who is the Spirit-- makes us more and more like him as we are changed into his glorious image.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, since God in his mercy has given us this new way, we never give up.

verses.kjv_text: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God. {dishonesty: Gr. shame}
verses.nlt_text: We reject all shameful deeds and underhanded methods. We don't try to trick anyone or distort the word of God. We tell the truth before God, and all who are honest know this.

verses.kjv_text: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
verses.nlt_text: If the Good News we preach is hidden behind a veil, it is hidden only from people who are perishing.

verses.kjv_text: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Satan, who is the god of this world, has blinded the minds of those who don't believe. They are unable to see the glorious light of the Good News. They don't understand this message about the glory of Christ, who is the exact likeness of God.

verses.kjv_text: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
verses.nlt_text: You see, we don't go around preaching about ourselves. We preach that Jesus Christ is Lord, and we ourselves are your servants for Jesus' sake.

verses.kjv_text: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to {give} the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ. {hath: Gr. is he who hath}
verses.nlt_text: For God, who said, "Let there be light in the darkness," has made this light shine in our hearts so we could know the glory of God that is seen in the face of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verses.nlt_text: We now have this light shining in our hearts, but we ourselves are like fragile clay jars containing this great treasure. This makes it clear that our great power is from God, not from ourselves.

verses.kjv_text: {We are} troubled on every side, yet not distressed; {we are} perplexed, but not in despair; {in despair: or, altogether without help, or, means}
verses.nlt_text: We are pressed on every side by troubles, but we are not crushed. We are perplexed, but not driven to despair.

verses.kjv_text: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
verses.nlt_text: We are hunted down, but never abandoned by God. We get knocked down, but we are not destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
verses.nlt_text: Through suffering, our bodies continue to share in the death of Jesus so that the life of Jesus may also be seen in our bodies.

verses.kjv_text: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, we live under constant danger of death because we serve Jesus, so that the life of Jesus will be evident in our dying bodies.

verses.kjv_text: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
verses.nlt_text: So we live in the face of death, but this has resulted in eternal life for you.

verses.kjv_text: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
verses.nlt_text: But we continue to preach because we have the same kind of faith the psalmist had when he said, "I believed in God, so I spoke."

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present {us} with you.
verses.nlt_text: We know that God, who raised the Lord Jesus, will also raise us with Jesus and present us to himself together with you.

verses.kjv_text: For all things {are} for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
verses.nlt_text: All of this is for your benefit. And as God's grace reaches more and more people, there will be great thanksgiving, and God will receive more and more glory.

verses.kjv_text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward {man} is renewed day by day.
verses.nlt_text: That is why we never give up. Though our bodies are dying, our spirits are being renewed every day.

verses.kjv_text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding {and} eternal weight of glory;
verses.nlt_text: For our present troubles are small and won't last very long. Yet they produce for us a glory that vastly outweighs them and will last forever!

verses.kjv_text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen {are} temporal; but the things which are not seen {are} eternal.
verses.nlt_text: So we don't look at the troubles we can see now; rather, we fix our gaze on things that cannot be seen. For the things we see now will soon be gone, but the things we cannot see will last forever.

verses.kjv_text: For we know that if our earthly house of {this} tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.nlt_text: For we know that when this earthly tent we live in is taken down (that is, when we die and leave this earthly body), we will have a house in heaven, an eternal body made for us by God himself and not by human hands.

verses.kjv_text: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
verses.nlt_text: We grow weary in our present bodies, and we long to put on our heavenly bodies like new clothing.

verses.kjv_text: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.nlt_text: For we will put on heavenly bodies; we will not be spirits without bodies.

verses.kjv_text: For we that are in {this} tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
verses.nlt_text: While we live in these earthly bodies, we groan and sigh, but it's not that we want to die and get rid of these bodies that clothe us. Rather, we want to put on our new bodies so that these dying bodies will be swallowed up by life.

verses.kjv_text: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing {is} God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: God himself has prepared us for this, and as a guarantee he has given us his Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore {we are} always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
verses.nlt_text: So we are always confident, even though we know that as long as we live in these bodies we are not at home with the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
verses.nlt_text: For we live by believing and not by seeing.

verses.kjv_text: We are confident, {I say}, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, we are fully confident, and we would rather be away from these earthly bodies, for then we will be at home with the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him. {labour: or, endeavour}
verses.nlt_text: So whether we are here in this body or away from this body, our goal is to please him.

verses.kjv_text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things {done} in {his} body, according to that he hath done, whether {it be} good or bad.
verses.nlt_text: For we must all stand before Christ to be judged. We will each receive whatever we deserve for the good or evil we have done in this earthly body.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
verses.nlt_text: Because we understand our fearful responsibility to the Lord, we work hard to persuade others. God knows we are sincere, and I hope you know this, too.

verses.kjv_text: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to {answer} them which glory in appearance, and not in heart. {in appearance: Gr. in the face}
verses.nlt_text: Are we commending ourselves to you again? No, we are giving you a reason to be proud of us, so you can answer those who brag about having a spectacular ministry rather than having a sincere heart.

verses.kjv_text: For whether we be beside ourselves, {it is} to God: or whether we be sober, {it is} for your cause.
verses.nlt_text: If it seems we are crazy, it is to bring glory to God. And if we are in our right minds, it is for your benefit.

verses.kjv_text: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verses.nlt_text: Either way, Christ's love controls us. Since we believe that Christ died for all, we also believe that we have all died to our old life.

verses.kjv_text: And {that} he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
verses.nlt_text: He died for everyone so that those who receive his new life will no longer live for themselves. Instead, they will live for Christ, who died and was raised for them.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we {him} no more.
verses.nlt_text: So we have stopped evaluating others from a human point of view. At one time we thought of Christ merely from a human point of view. How differently we know him now!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore if any man {be} in Christ, {he is} a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new. {he is: or, let him be}
verses.nlt_text: This means that anyone who belongs to Christ has become a new person. The old life is gone; a new life has begun!

verses.kjv_text: And all things {are} of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.nlt_text: And all of this is a gift from God, who brought us back to himself through Christ. And God has given us this task of reconciling people to him.

verses.kjv_text: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation. {committed...: Gr. put in us}
verses.nlt_text: For God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, no longer counting people's sins against them. And he gave us this wonderful message of reconciliation.

verses.kjv_text: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech {you} by us: we pray {you} in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
verses.nlt_text: So we are Christ's ambassadors; God is making his appeal through us. We speak for Christ when we plead, "Come back to God!"

verses.kjv_text: For he hath made him {to be} sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.nlt_text: For God made Christ, who never sinned, to be the offering for our sin, so that we could be made right with God through Christ.

verses.kjv_text: We then, {as} workers together {with him}, beseech {you} also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
verses.nlt_text: As God's partners, we beg you not to accept this marvelous gift of God's kindness and then ignore it.

verses.kjv_text: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now {is} the accepted time; behold, now {is} the day of salvation.)
verses.nlt_text: For God says, "At just the right time, I heard you. On the day of salvation, I helped you." Indeed, the "right time" is now. Today is the day of salvation.

verses.kjv_text: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
verses.nlt_text: We live in such a way that no one will stumble because of us, and no one will find fault with our ministry.

verses.kjv_text: But in all {things} approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses, {approving: Gr. commending}
verses.nlt_text: In everything we do, we show that we are true ministers of God. We patiently endure troubles and hardships and calamities of every kind.

verses.kjv_text: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings; {in tumults: or, in tossings to and fro}
verses.nlt_text: We have been beaten, been put in prison, faced angry mobs, worked to exhaustion, endured sleepless nights, and gone without food.

verses.kjv_text: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
verses.nlt_text: We prove ourselves by our purity, our understanding, our patience, our kindness, by the Holy Spirit within us, and by our sincere love.

verses.kjv_text: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.nlt_text: We faithfully preach the truth. God's power is working in us. We use the weapons of righteousness in the right hand for attack and the left hand for defense.

verses.kjv_text: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and {yet} true;
verses.nlt_text: We serve God whether people honor us or despise us, whether they slander us or praise us. We are honest, but they call us impostors.

verses.kjv_text: As unknown, and {yet} well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.nlt_text: We are ignored, even though we are well known. We live close to death, but we are still alive. We have been beaten, but we have not been killed.

verses.kjv_text: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and {yet} possessing all things.
verses.nlt_text: Our hearts ache, but we always have joy. We are poor, but we give spiritual riches to others. We own nothing, and yet we have everything.

verses.kjv_text: O {ye} Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
verses.nlt_text: Oh, dear Corinthian friends! We have spoken honestly with you, and our hearts are open to you.

verses.kjv_text: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
verses.nlt_text: There is no lack of love on our part, but you have withheld your love from us.

verses.kjv_text: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto {my} children,) be ye also enlarged.
verses.nlt_text: I am asking you to respond as if you were my own children. Open your hearts to us!

verses.kjv_text: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
verses.nlt_text: Don't team up with those who are unbelievers. How can righteousness be a partner with wickedness? How can light live with darkness?

verses.kjv_text: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
verses.nlt_text: What harmony can there be between Christ and the devil? How can a believer be a partner with an unbeliever?

verses.kjv_text: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in {them}; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.nlt_text: And what union can there be between God's temple and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God said: "I will live in them and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean {thing}; and I will receive you,
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, come out from among unbelievers, and separate yourselves from them, says the LORD. Don't touch their filthy things, and I will welcome you.

verses.kjv_text: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.nlt_text: And I will be your Father, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the LORD Almighty. "

verses.kjv_text: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.nlt_text: Because we have these promises, dear friends, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that can defile our body or spirit. And let us work toward complete holiness because we fear God.

verses.kjv_text: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
verses.nlt_text: Please open your hearts to us. We have not done wrong to anyone, nor led anyone astray, nor taken advantage of anyone.

verses.kjv_text: I speak not {this} to condemn {you}: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with {you}.
verses.nlt_text: I'm not saying this to condemn you. I said before that you are in our hearts, and we live or die together with you.

verses.kjv_text: Great {is} my boldness of speech toward you, great {is} my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
verses.nlt_text: I have the highest confidence in you, and I take great pride in you. You have greatly encouraged me and made me happy despite all our troubles.

verses.kjv_text: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without {were} fightings, within {were} fears.
verses.nlt_text: When we arrived in Macedonia, there was no rest for us. We faced conflict from every direction, with battles on the outside and fear on the inside.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
verses.nlt_text: But God, who encourages those who are discouraged, encouraged us by the arrival of Titus.

verses.kjv_text: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
verses.nlt_text: His presence was a joy, but so was the news he brought of the encouragement he received from you. When he told us how much you long to see me, and how sorry you are for what happened, and how loyal you are to me, I was filled with joy!

verses.kjv_text: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though {it were} but for a season.
verses.nlt_text: I am not sorry that I sent that severe letter to you, though I was sorry at first, for I know it was painful to you for a little while.

verses.kjv_text: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing. {after...: or, according to God}
verses.nlt_text: Now I am glad I sent it, not because it hurt you, but because the pain caused you to repent and change your ways. It was the kind of sorrow God wants his people to have, so you were not harmed by us in any way.

verses.kjv_text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verses.nlt_text: For the kind of sorrow God wants us to experience leads us away from sin and results in salvation. There's no regret for that kind of sorrow. But worldly sorrow, which lacks repentance, results in spiritual death.

verses.kjv_text: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, {what} clearing of yourselves, yea, {what} indignation, yea, {what} fear, yea, {what} vehement desire, yea, {what} zeal, yea, {what} revenge! In all {things} ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
verses.nlt_text: Just see what this godly sorrow produced in you! Such earnestness, such concern to clear yourselves, such indignation, such alarm, such longing to see me, such zeal, and such a readiness to punish wrong. You showed that you have done everything necessary to make things right.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, {I did it} not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
verses.nlt_text: My purpose, then, was not to write about who did the wrong or who was wronged. I wrote to you so that in the sight of God you could see for yourselves how loyal you are to us.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
verses.nlt_text: We have been greatly encouraged by this.In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was about the way all of you welcomed him and set his mind at ease.

verses.kjv_text: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which {I made} before Titus, is found a truth.
verses.nlt_text: I had told him how proud I was of you-- and you didn't disappoint me. I have always told you the truth, and now my boasting to Titus has also proved true!

verses.kjv_text: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him. {inward...: Gr. bowels}
verses.nlt_text: Now he cares for you more than ever when he remembers the way all of you obeyed him and welcomed him with such fear and deep respect.

verses.kjv_text: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all {things}.
verses.nlt_text: I am very happy now because I have complete confidence in you.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
verses.nlt_text: Now I want you to know, dear brothers and sisters, what God in his kindness has done through the churches in Macedonia.

verses.kjv_text: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality. {liberality: Gr. simplicity}
verses.nlt_text: They are being tested by many troubles, and they are very poor. But they are also filled with abundant joy, which has overflowed in rich generosity.

verses.kjv_text: For to {their} power, I bear record, yea, and beyond {their} power {they were} willing of themselves;
verses.nlt_text: For I can testify that they gave not only what they could afford, but far more. And they did it of their own free will.

verses.kjv_text: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and {take upon us} the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.nlt_text: They begged us again and again for the privilege of sharing in the gift for the believers in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: And {this they did}, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
verses.nlt_text: They even did more than we had hoped, for their first action was to give themselves to the Lord and to us, just as God wanted them to do.

verses.kjv_text: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also. {grace: or, gift}
verses.nlt_text: So we have urged Titus, who encouraged your giving in the first place, to return to you and encourage you to finish this ministry of giving.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, as ye abound in every {thing, in} faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and {in} all diligence, and {in} your love to us, {see} that ye abound in this grace also.
verses.nlt_text: Since you excel in so many ways-- in your faith, your gifted speakers, your knowledge, your enthusiasm, and your love from us-- I want you to excel also in this gracious act of giving.

verses.kjv_text: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
verses.nlt_text: I am not commanding you to do this. But I am testing how genuine your love is by comparing it with the eagerness of the other churches.

verses.kjv_text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
verses.nlt_text: You know the generous grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. Though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, so that by his poverty he could make you rich.

verses.kjv_text: And herein I give {my} advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago. {forward: Gr. willing}
verses.nlt_text: Here is my advice: It would be good for you to finish what you started a year ago. Last year you were the first who wanted to give, and you were the first to begin doing it.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore perform the doing {of it}; that as {there was} a readiness to will, so {there may be} a performance also out of that which ye have.
verses.nlt_text: Now you should finish what you started. Let the eagerness you showed in the beginning be matched now by your giving. Give in proportion to what you have.

verses.kjv_text: For if there be first a willing mind, {it is} accepted according to that a man hath, {and} not according to that he hath not.
verses.nlt_text: Whatever you give is acceptable if you give it eagerly. And give according to what you have, not what you don't have.

verses.kjv_text: For {I mean} not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
verses.nlt_text: Of course, I don't mean your giving should make life easy for others and hard for yourselves. I only mean that there should be some equality.

verses.kjv_text: But by an equality, {that} now at this time your abundance {may be a supply} for their want, that their abundance also may be {a supply} for your want: that there may be equality:
verses.nlt_text: Right now you have plenty and can help those who are in need. Later, they will have plenty and can share with you when you need it. In this way, things will be equal.

verses.kjv_text: As it is written, He that {had gathered} much had nothing over; and he that {had gathered} little had no lack.
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "Those who gathered a lot had nothing left over, and those who gathered only a little had enough."

verses.kjv_text: But thanks {be} to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
verses.nlt_text: But thank God! He has given Titus the same enthusiasm for you that I have.

verses.kjv_text: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Titus welcomed our request that he visit you again. In fact, he himself was very eager to go and see you.

verses.kjv_text: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise {is} in the gospel throughout all the churches;
verses.nlt_text: We are also sending another brother with Titus. All the churches praise him as a preacher of the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: And not {that} only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and {declaration of} your ready mind: {grace: or, gift}
verses.nlt_text: He was appointed by the churches to accompany us as we take the offering to Jerusalem-- a service that glorifies the Lord and shows our eagerness to help.

verses.kjv_text: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
verses.nlt_text: We are traveling together to guard against any criticism for the way we are handling this generous gift.

verses.kjv_text: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.nlt_text: We are careful to be honorable before the Lord, but we also want everyone else to see that we are honorable.

verses.kjv_text: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which {I have} in you. {I have: or, he hath}
verses.nlt_text: We are also sending with them another of our brothers who has proven himself many times and has shown on many occasions how eager he is. He is now even more enthusiastic because of his great confidence in you.

verses.kjv_text: Whether {any do enquire} of Titus, {he is} my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren {be enquired of, they are} the messengers of the churches, {and} the glory of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone asks about Titus, say that he is my partner who works with me to help you. And the brothers with him have been sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.nlt_text: So show them your love, and prove to all the churches that our boasting about you is justified.

verses.kjv_text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
verses.nlt_text: I really don't need to write to you about this ministry of giving for the believers in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv_text: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
verses.nlt_text: For I know how eager you are to help, and I have been boasting to the churches in Macedonia that you in Greece were ready to send an offering a year ago. In fact, it was your enthusiasm that stirred up many of the Macedonian believers to begin giving.

verses.kjv_text: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
verses.nlt_text: But I am sending these brothers to be sure you really are ready, as I have been telling them, and that your money is all collected. I don't want to be wrong in my boasting about you.

verses.kjv_text: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
verses.nlt_text: We would be embarrassed-- not to mention your own embarrassment-- if some Macedonian believers came with me and found that you weren't ready after all I had told them!

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as {a matter of} bounty, and not as {of} covetousness. {bounty: Gr. blessing} {whereof...: or, which hath been so much spoken of before}
verses.nlt_text: So I thought I should send these brothers ahead of me to make sure the gift you promised is ready. But I want it to be a willing gift, not one given grudgingly.

verses.kjv_text: But this {I say}, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
verses.nlt_text: Remember this-- a farmer who plants only a few seeds will get a small crop. But the one who plants generously will get a generous crop.

verses.kjv_text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, {so let him give}; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.nlt_text: You must each decide in your heart how much to give. And don't give reluctantly or in response to pressure. "For God loves a person who gives cheerfully."

verses.kjv_text: And God {is} able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all {things}, may abound to every good work:
verses.nlt_text: And God will generously provide all you need. Then you will always have everything you need and plenty left over to share with others.

verses.kjv_text: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "They share freely and give generously to the poor. Their good deeds will be remembered forever."

verses.kjv_text: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for {your} food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
verses.nlt_text: For God is the one who provides seed for the farmer and then bread to eat. In the same way, he will provide and increase your resources and then produce a great harvest of generosity in you.

verses.kjv_text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God. {bountifulness: or, liberality: Gr. simplicity}
verses.nlt_text: Yes, you will be enriched in every way so that you can always be generous. And when we take your gifts to those who need them, they will thank God.

verses.kjv_text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
verses.nlt_text: So two good things will result from this ministry of giving-- the needs of the believers in Jerusalem will be met, and they will joyfully express their thanks to God.

verses.kjv_text: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for {your} liberal distribution unto them, and unto all {men};
verses.nlt_text: As a result of your ministry, they will give glory to God. For your generosity to them and to all believers will prove that you are obedient to the Good News of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.nlt_text: And they will pray for you with deep affection because of the overflowing grace God has given to you.

verses.kjv_text: Thanks {be} unto God for his unspeakable gift.
verses.nlt_text: Thank God for this gift too wonderful for words!

verses.kjv_text: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence {am} base among you, but being absent am bold toward you: {in presence: or, in outward appearance}
verses.nlt_text: Now I, Paul, appeal to you with the gentleness and kindness of Christ-- though I realize you think I am timid in person and bold only when I write from far away.

verses.kjv_text: But I beseech {you}, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh. {think: or, reckon}
verses.nlt_text: Well, I am begging you now so that when I come I won't have to be bold with those who think we act from human motives.

verses.kjv_text: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
verses.nlt_text: We are human, but we don't wage war as humans do.

verses.kjv_text: (For the weapons of our warfare {are} not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;) {through God: or, to God}
verses.nlt_text: We use God's mighty weapons, not worldly weapons, to knock down the strongholds of human reasoning and to destroy false arguments.

verses.kjv_text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ; {imaginations: or, reasonings}
verses.nlt_text: We destroy every proud obstacle that keeps people from knowing God. We capture their rebellious thoughts and teach them to obey Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.nlt_text: And after you have become fully obedient, we will punish everyone who remains disobedient.

verses.kjv_text: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he {is} Christ's, even so {are} we Christ's.
verses.nlt_text: Look at the obvious facts. Those who say they belong to Christ must recognize that we belong to Christ as much as they do.

verses.kjv_text: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
verses.nlt_text: I may seem to be boasting too much about the authority given to us by the Lord. But our authority builds you up; it doesn't tear you down. So I will not be ashamed of using my authority.

verses.kjv_text: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
verses.nlt_text: I'm not trying to frighten you by my letters.

verses.kjv_text: For {his} letters, say they, {are} weighty and powerful; but {his} bodily presence {is} weak, and {his} speech contemptible. {say they: Gr. saith he}
verses.nlt_text: For some say, " Paul's letters are demanding and forceful, but in person he is weak, and his speeches are worthless!"

verses.kjv_text: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such {will we be} also in deed when we are present.
verses.nlt_text: Those people should realize that our actions when we arrive in person will be as forceful as what we say in our letters from far away.

verses.kjv_text: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise. {are...: or, understand it not}
verses.nlt_text: Oh, don't worry; we wouldn't dare say that we are as wonderful as these other men who tell you how important they are! But they are only comparing themselves with each other, using themselves as the standard of measurement. How ignorant!

verses.kjv_text: But we will not boast of things without {our} measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you. {rule: or, line}
verses.nlt_text: We will not boast about things done outside our area of authority. We will boast only about what has happened within the boundaries of the work God has given us, which includes our working with you.

verses.kjv_text: For we stretch not ourselves beyond {our measure}, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in {preaching} the gospel of Christ:
verses.nlt_text: We are not reaching beyond these boundaries when we claim authority over you, as if we had never visited you. For we were the first to travel all the way to Corinth with the Good News of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Not boasting of things without {our} measure, {that is}, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly, {enlarged...: or, magnified in you}
verses.nlt_text: Nor do we boast and claim credit for the work someone else has done. Instead, we hope that your faith will grow so that the boundaries of our work among you will be extended.

verses.kjv_text: To preach the gospel in the {regions} beyond you, {and} not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand. {line: or, rule}
verses.nlt_text: Then we will be able to go and preach the Good News in other places far beyond you, where no one else is working. Then there will be no question of our boasting about work done in someone else's territory.

verses.kjv_text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "If you want to boast, boast only about the LORD."

verses.kjv_text: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.nlt_text: When people commend themselves, it doesn't count for much. The important thing is for the Lord to commend them.

verses.kjv_text: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in {my} folly: and indeed bear with me. {indeed bear...: or, indeed ye do bear with me}
verses.nlt_text: I hope you will put up with a little more of my foolishness. Please bear with me.

verses.kjv_text: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present {you as} a chaste virgin to Christ.
verses.nlt_text: For I am jealous for you with the jealousy of God himself. I promised you as a pure bride to one husband-- Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.nlt_text: But I fear that somehow your pure and undivided devotion to Christ will be corrupted, just as Eve was deceived by the cunning ways of the serpent.

verses.kjv_text: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or {if} ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with {him}. {with him: or, with me}
verses.nlt_text: You happily put up with whatever anyone tells you, even if they preach a different Jesus than the one we preach, or a different kind of Spirit than the one you received, or a different kind of gospel than the one you believed.

verses.kjv_text: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.nlt_text: But I don't consider myself inferior in any way to these "super apostles" who teach such things.

verses.kjv_text: But though {I be} rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
verses.nlt_text: I may be unskilled as a speaker, but I'm not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every possible way.

verses.kjv_text: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
verses.nlt_text: Was I wrong when I humbled myself and honored you by preaching God's Good News to you without expecting anything in return?

verses.kjv_text: I robbed other churches, taking wages {of them}, to do you service.
verses.nlt_text: I "robbed" other churches by accepting their contributions so I could serve you at no cost.

verses.kjv_text: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all {things} I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and {so} will I keep {myself}.
verses.nlt_text: And when I was with you and didn't have enough to live on, I did not become a financial burden to anyone. For the brothers who came from Macedonia brought me all that I needed. I have never been a burden to you, and I never will be.

verses.kjv_text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia. {no man...: Gr. this boasting shall not be stopped in me}
verses.nlt_text: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, no one in all of Greece will ever stop me from boasting about this.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
verses.nlt_text: Why? Because I don't love you? God knows that I do.

verses.kjv_text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.nlt_text: But I will continue doing what I have always done. This will undercut those who are looking for an opportunity to boast that their work is just like ours.

verses.kjv_text: For such {are} false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: These people are false apostles. They are deceitful workers who disguise themselves as apostles of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.nlt_text: But I am not surprised! Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore {it is} no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.nlt_text: So it is no wonder that his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. In the end they will get the punishment their wicked deeds deserve.

verses.kjv_text: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little. {receive: or, suffer}
verses.nlt_text: Again I say, don't think that I am a fool to talk like this. But even if you do, listen to me, as you would to a foolish person, while I also boast a little.

verses.kjv_text: That which I speak, I speak {it} not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.nlt_text: Such boasting is not from the Lord, but I am acting like a fool.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.nlt_text: And since others boast about their human achievements, I will, too.

verses.kjv_text: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye {yourselves} are wise.
verses.nlt_text: After all, you think you are so wise, but you enjoy putting up with fools!

verses.kjv_text: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour {you}, if a man take {of you}, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
verses.nlt_text: You put up with it when someone enslaves you, takes everything you have, takes advantage of you, takes control of everything, and slaps you in the face.

verses.kjv_text: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
verses.nlt_text: I'm ashamed to say that we've been too "weak" to do that!But whatever they dare to boast about-- I'm talking like a fool again-- I dare to boast about it, too.

verses.kjv_text: Are they Hebrews? so {am} I. Are they Israelites? so {am} I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so {am} I.
verses.nlt_text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

verses.kjv_text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I {am} more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
verses.nlt_text: Are they servants of Christ? I know I sound like a madman, but I have served him far more! I have worked harder, been put in prison more often, been whipped times without number, and faced death again and again.

verses.kjv_text: Of the Jews five times received I forty {stripes} save one.
verses.nlt_text: Five different times the Jewish leaders gave me thirty-nine lashes.

verses.kjv_text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.nlt_text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked. Once I spent a whole night and a day adrift at sea.

verses.kjv_text: {In} journeyings often, {in} perils of waters, {in} perils of robbers, {in} perils by {mine own} countrymen, {in} perils by the heathen, {in} perils in the city, {in} perils in the wilderness, {in} perils in the sea, {in} perils among false brethren;
verses.nlt_text: I have traveled on many long journeys. I have faced danger from rivers and from robbers. I have faced danger from my own people, the Jews, as well as from the Gentiles. I have faced danger in the cities, in the deserts, and on the seas. And I have faced danger from men who claim to be believers but are not.

verses.kjv_text: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.nlt_text: I have worked hard and long, enduring many sleepless nights. I have been hungry and thirsty and have often gone without food. I have shivered in the cold, without enough clothing to keep me warm.

verses.kjv_text: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
verses.nlt_text: Then, besides all this, I have the daily burden of my concern for all the churches.

verses.kjv_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
verses.nlt_text: Who is weak without my feeling that weakness? Who is led astray, and I do not burn with anger?

verses.kjv_text: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
verses.nlt_text: If I must boast, I would rather boast about the things that show how weak I am.

verses.kjv_text: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
verses.nlt_text: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, who is worthy of eternal praise, knows I am not lying.

verses.kjv_text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
verses.nlt_text: When I was in Damascus, the governor under King Aretas kept guards at the city gates to catch me.

verses.kjv_text: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.nlt_text: I had to be lowered in a basket through a window in the city wall to escape from him.

verses.kjv_text: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord. {I will come: Gr. For I will come}
verses.nlt_text: This boasting will do no good, but I must go on. I will reluctantly tell about visions and revelations from the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
verses.nlt_text: I was caught up to the third heaven fourteen years ago. Whether I was in my body or out of my body, I don't know-- only God knows.

verses.kjv_text: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
verses.nlt_text: Yes, only God knows whether I was in my body or outside my body. But I do know

verses.kjv_text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter. {lawful: or, possible}
verses.nlt_text: that I was caught up to paradise and heard things so astounding that they cannot be expressed in words, things no human is allowed to tell.

verses.kjv_text: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
verses.nlt_text: That experience is worth boasting about, but I'm not going to do it. I will boast only about my weaknesses.

verses.kjv_text: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but {now} I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me {to be}, or {that} he heareth of me.
verses.nlt_text: If I wanted to boast, I would be no fool in doing so, because I would be telling the truth. But I won't do it, because I don't want anyone to give me credit beyond what they can see in my life or hear in my message,

verses.kjv_text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verses.nlt_text: even though I have received such wonderful revelations from God. So to keep me from becoming proud, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger from Satan to torment me and keep me from becoming proud.

verses.kjv_text: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
verses.nlt_text: Three different times I begged the Lord to take it away.

verses.kjv_text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.nlt_text: Each time he said, "My grace is all you need. My power works best in weakness." So now I am glad to boast about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ can work through me.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.nlt_text: That's why I take pleasure in my weaknesses, and in the insults, hardships, persecutions, and troubles that I suffer for Christ. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

verses.kjv_text: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
verses.nlt_text: You have made me act like a fool-- boasting like this. You ought to be writing commendations for me, for I am not at all inferior to these "super apostles," even though I am nothing at all.

verses.kjv_text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
verses.nlt_text: When I was with you, I certainly gave you proof that I am an apostle. For I patiently did many signs and wonders and miracles among you.

verses.kjv_text: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except {it be} that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
verses.nlt_text: The only thing I failed to do, which I do in the other churches, was to become a financial burden to you. Please forgive me for this wrong!

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.nlt_text: Now I am coming to you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you. I don't want what you have-- I want you. After all, children don't provide for their parents. Rather, parents provide for their children.

verses.kjv_text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved. {for you: Gr. for your souls}
verses.nlt_text: I will gladly spend myself and all I have for you, even though it seems that the more I love you, the less you love me.

verses.kjv_text: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
verses.nlt_text: Some of you admit I was not a burden to you. But others still think I was sneaky and took advantage of you by trickery.

verses.kjv_text: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
verses.nlt_text: But how? Did any of the men I sent to you take advantage of you?

verses.kjv_text: I desired Titus, and with {him} I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? {walked we} not in the same steps?
verses.nlt_text: When I urged Titus to visit you and sent our other brother with him, did Titus take advantage of you? No! For we have the same spirit and walk in each other's steps, doing things the same way.

verses.kjv_text: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but {we do} all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
verses.nlt_text: Perhaps you think we're saying these things just to defend ourselves. No, we tell you this as Christ's servants, and with God as our witness. Everything we do, dear friends, is to strengthen you.

verses.kjv_text: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and {that} I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest {there be} debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
verses.nlt_text: For I am afraid that when I come I won't like what I find, and you won't like my response. I am afraid that I will find quarreling, jealousy, anger, selfishness, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorderly behavior.

verses.kjv_text: {And} lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and {that} I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, I am afraid that when I come again, God will humble me in your presence. And I will be grieved because many of you have not given up your old sins. You have not repented of your impurity, sexual immorality, and eagerness for lustful pleasure.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the third {time} I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
verses.nlt_text: This is the third time I am coming to visit you (and as the Scriptures say, "The facts of every case must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses").

verses.kjv_text: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
verses.nlt_text: I have already warned those who had been sinning when I was there on my second visit. Now I again warn them and all others, just as I did before, that next time I will not spare them.

verses.kjv_text: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
verses.nlt_text: I will give you all the proof you want that Christ speaks through me. Christ is not weak when he deals with you; he is powerful among you.

verses.kjv_text: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you. {in him: or, with him}
verses.nlt_text: Although he was crucified in weakness, he now lives by the power of God. We, too, are weak, just as Christ was, but when we deal with you we will be alive with him and will have God's power.

verses.kjv_text: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
verses.nlt_text: Examine yourselves to see if your faith is genuine. Test yourselves. Surely you know that Jesus Christ is among you; if not, you have failed the test of genuine faith.

verses.kjv_text: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
verses.nlt_text: As you test yourselves, I hope you will recognize that we have not failed the test of apostolic authority.

verses.kjv_text: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
verses.nlt_text: We pray to God that you will not do what is wrong by refusing our correction. I hope we won't need to demonstrate our authority when we arrive. Do the right thing before we come-- even if that makes it look like we have failed to demonstrate our authority.

verses.kjv_text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.nlt_text: For we cannot oppose the truth, but must always stand for the truth.

verses.kjv_text: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, {even} your perfection. {perfection: or, reformation, or, restoration}
verses.nlt_text: We are glad to seem weak if it helps show that you are actually strong. We pray that you will become mature.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing this to you before I come, hoping that I won't need to deal severely with you when I do come. For I want to use the authority the Lord has given me to strengthen you, not to tear you down.

verses.kjv_text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, I close my letter with these last words: Be joyful. Grow to maturity. Encourage each other. Live in harmony and peace. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.kjv_text: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
verses.nlt_text: Greet each other with Christian love.

verses.kjv_text: All the saints salute you.
verses.nlt_text: All of God's people here send you their greetings.

verses.kjv_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, {be} with you all. Amen. «{The second epistle} to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, {a city} of Macedonia, by Titus and Lucas.»
verses.nlt_text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, an apostle. I was not appointed by any group of people or any human authority, but by Jesus Christ himself and by God the Father, who raised Jesus from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.nlt_text: All the brothers and sisters here join me in sending this letter to the churches of Galatia.

verses.kjv_text: Grace {be} to you and peace from God the Father, and {from} our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
verses.nlt_text: Jesus gave his life for our sins, just as God our Father planned, in order to rescue us from this evil world in which we live.

verses.kjv_text: To whom {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: All glory to God forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
verses.nlt_text: I am shocked that you are turning away so soon from God, who called you to himself through the loving mercy of Christ. You are following a different way that pretends to be the Good News

verses.kjv_text: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: but is not the Good News at all. You are being fooled by those who deliberately twist the truth concerning Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.nlt_text: Let God's curse fall on anyone, including us or even an angel from heaven, who preaches a different kind of Good News than the one we preached to you.

verses.kjv_text: As we said before, so say I now again, If any {man} preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
verses.nlt_text: I say again what we have said before: If anyone preaches any other Good News than the one you welcomed, let that person be cursed.

verses.kjv_text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Obviously, I'm not trying to win the approval of people, but of God. If pleasing people were my goal, I would not be Christ's servant.

verses.kjv_text: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, I want you to understand that the gospel message I preach is not based on mere human reasoning.

verses.kjv_text: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught {it}, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: I received my message from no human source, and no one taught me. Instead, I received it by direct revelation from Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
verses.nlt_text: You know what I was like when I followed the Jewish religion-- how I violently persecuted God's church. I did my best to destroy it.

verses.kjv_text: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers. {equals: Gr. equals in years}
verses.nlt_text: I was far ahead of my fellow Jews in my zeal for the traditions of my ancestors.

verses.kjv_text: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called {me} by his grace,
verses.nlt_text: But even before I was born, God chose me and called me by his marvelous grace. Then it pleased him

verses.kjv_text: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.nlt_text: to reveal his Son to me so that I would proclaim the Good News about Jesus to the Gentiles.When this happened, I did not rush out to consult with any human being.

verses.kjv_text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.nlt_text: Nor did I go up to Jerusalem to consult with those who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went away into Arabia, and later I returned to the city of Damascus.

verses.kjv_text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days. {went up: or, returned}
verses.nlt_text: Then three years later I went to Jerusalem to get to know Peter, and I stayed with him for fifteen days.

verses.kjv_text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
verses.nlt_text: The only other apostle I met at that time was James, the Lord's brother.

verses.kjv_text: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.nlt_text: I declare before God that what I am writing to you is not a lie.

verses.kjv_text: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.nlt_text: After that visit I went north into the provinces of Syria and Cilicia.

verses.kjv_text: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
verses.nlt_text: And still the Christians in the churches in Judea didn't know me personally.

verses.kjv_text: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.nlt_text: All they knew was that people were saying, "The one who used to persecute us is now preaching the very faith he tried to destroy!"

verses.kjv_text: And they glorified God in me.
verses.nlt_text: And they praised God because of me.

verses.kjv_text: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with {me} also.
verses.nlt_text: Then fourteen years later I went back to Jerusalem again, this time with Barnabas; and Titus came along, too.

verses.kjv_text: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain. {privately: or, severally}
verses.nlt_text: I went there because God revealed to me that I should go. While I was there I met privately with those considered to be leaders of the church and shared with them the message I had been preaching to the Gentiles. I wanted to make sure that we were in agreement, for fear that all my efforts had been wasted and I was running the race for nothing.

verses.kjv_text: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.nlt_text: And they supported me and did not even demand that my companion Titus be circumcised, though he was a Gentile.

verses.kjv_text: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.nlt_text: Even that question came up only because of some so-called Christians there-- false ones, really-- who were secretly brought in. They sneaked in to spy on us and take away the freedom we have in Christ Jesus. They wanted to enslave us and force us to follow their Jewish regulations.

verses.kjv_text: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.nlt_text: But we refused to give in to them for a single moment. We wanted to preserve the truth of the gospel message for you.

verses.kjv_text: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed {to be somewhat} in conference added nothing to me:
verses.nlt_text: And the leaders of the church had nothing to add to what I was preaching. (By the way, their reputation as great leaders made no difference to me, for God has no favorites.)

verses.kjv_text: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as {the gospel} of the circumcision {was} unto Peter;
verses.nlt_text: Instead, they saw that God had given me the responsibility of preaching the gospel to the Gentiles, just as he had given Peter the responsibility of preaching to the Jews.

verses.kjv_text: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
verses.nlt_text: For the same God who worked through Peter as the apostle to the Jews also worked through me as the apostle to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we {should go} unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, James, Peter, and John, who were known as pillars of the church, recognized the gift God had given me, and they accepted Barnabas and me as their co-workers. They encouraged us to keep preaching to the Gentiles, while they continued their work with the Jews.

verses.kjv_text: Only {they would} that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
verses.nlt_text: Their only suggestion was that we keep on helping the poor, which I have always been eager to do.

verses.kjv_text: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
verses.nlt_text: But when Peter came to Antioch, I had to oppose him to his face, for what he did was very wrong.
