verses.kjv_text: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
verses.nlt_text: When he first arrived, he ate with the Gentile Christians, who were not circumcised. But afterward, when some friends of James came, Peter wouldn't eat with the Gentiles anymore. He was afraid of criticism from these people who insisted on the necessity of circumcision.

verses.kjv_text: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, other Jewish Christians followed Peter's hypocrisy, and even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.

verses.kjv_text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before {them} all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
verses.nlt_text: When I saw that they were not following the truth of the gospel message, I said to Peter in front of all the others, "Since you, a Jew by birth, have discarded the Jewish laws and are living like a Gentile, why are you now trying to make these Gentiles follow the Jewish traditions?

verses.kjv_text: We {who are} Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.nlt_text: "You and I are Jews by birth, not 'sinners' like the Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.nlt_text: Yet we know that a person is made right with God by faith in Jesus Christ, not by obeying the law. And we have believed in Christ Jesus, so that we might be made right with God because of our faith in Christ, not because we have obeyed the law. For no one will ever be made right with God by obeying the law."

verses.kjv_text: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, {is} therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
verses.nlt_text: But suppose we seek to be made right with God through faith in Christ and then we are found guilty because we have abandoned the law. Would that mean Christ has led us into sin? Absolutely not!

verses.kjv_text: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
verses.nlt_text: Rather, I am a sinner if I rebuild the old system of law I already tore down.

verses.kjv_text: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
verses.nlt_text: For when I tried to keep the law, it condemned me. So I died to the law-- I stopped trying to meet all its requirements-- so that I might live for God.

verses.kjv_text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.nlt_text: My old self has been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. So I live in this earthly body by trusting in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

verses.kjv_text: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness {come} by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verses.nlt_text: I do not treat the grace of God as meaningless. For if keeping the law could make us right with God, then there was no need for Christ to die.

verses.kjv_text: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.nlt_text: Oh, foolish Galatians! Who has cast an evil spell on you? For the meaning of Jesus Christ's death was made as clear to you as if you had seen a picture of his death on the cross.

verses.kjv_text: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.nlt_text: Let me ask you this one question: Did you receive the Holy Spirit by obeying the law of Moses? Of course not! You received the Spirit because you believed the message you heard about Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.nlt_text: How foolish can you be? After starting your Christian lives in the Spirit, why are you now trying to become perfect by your own human effort?

verses.kjv_text: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if {it be} yet in vain. {so many: or, so great}
verses.nlt_text: Have you experienced so much for nothing? Surely it was not in vain, was it?

verses.kjv_text: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, {doeth he it} by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.nlt_text: I ask you again, does God give you the Holy Spirit and work miracles among you because you obey the law? Of course not! It is because you believe the message you heard about Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness. {accounted: or, imputed}
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, "Abraham believed God, and God counted him as righteous because of his faith."

verses.kjv_text: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: The real children of Abraham, then, are those who put their faith in God.

verses.kjv_text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, {saying}, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.nlt_text: What's more, the Scriptures looked forward to this time when God would declare the Gentiles to be righteous because of their faith. God proclaimed this good news to Abraham long ago when he said, "All nations will be blessed through you."

verses.kjv_text: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: So all who put their faith in Christ share the same blessing Abraham received because of his faith.

verses.kjv_text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed {is} every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.nlt_text: But those who depend on the law to make them right with God are under his curse, for the Scriptures say, "Cursed is everyone who does not observe and obey all the commands that are written in God's Book of the Law."

verses.kjv_text: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, {it is} evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.nlt_text: So it is clear that no one can be made right with God by trying to keep the law. For the Scriptures say, "It is through faith that a righteous person has life."

verses.kjv_text: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.nlt_text: This way of faith is very different from the way of law, which says, "It is through obeying the law that a person has life."

verses.kjv_text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed {is} every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.nlt_text: But Christ has rescued us from the curse pronounced by the law. When he was hung on the cross, he took upon himself the curse for our wrongdoing. For it is written in the Scriptures, "Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree."

verses.kjv_text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.nlt_text: Through Christ Jesus, God has blessed the Gentiles with the same blessing he promised to Abraham, so that we who are believers might receive the promised Holy Spirit through faith.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though {it be} but a man's covenant, yet {if it be} confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto. {covenant: or, testament}
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, here's an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or amend an irrevocable agreement, so it is in this case.

verses.kjv_text: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.nlt_text: God gave the promises to Abraham and his child. And notice that the Scripture doesn't say "to his children, " as if it meant many descendants. Rather, it says "to his child"-- and that, of course, means Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And this I say, {that} the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.nlt_text: This is what I am trying to say: The agreement God made with Abraham could not be canceled 430 years later when God gave the law to Moses. God would be breaking his promise.

verses.kjv_text: For if the inheritance {be} of the law, {it is} no more of promise: but God gave {it} to Abraham by promise.
verses.nlt_text: For if the inheritance could be received by keeping the law, then it would not be the result of accepting God's promise. But God graciously gave it to Abraham as a promise.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore then {serveth} the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; {and it was} ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.nlt_text: Why, then, was the law given? It was given alongside the promise to show people their sins. But the law was designed to last only until the coming of the child who was promised. God gave his law through angels to Moses, who was the mediator between God and the people.

verses.kjv_text: Now a mediator is not {a mediator} of one, but God is one.
verses.nlt_text: Now a mediator is helpful if more than one party must reach an agreement. But God, who is one, did not use a mediator when he gave his promise to Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: {Is} the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.nlt_text: Is there a conflict, then, between God's law and God's promises? Absolutely not! If the law could give us new life, we could be made right with God by obeying it.

verses.kjv_text: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.nlt_text: But the Scriptures declare that we are all prisoners of sin, so we receive God's promise of freedom only by believing in Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.nlt_text: Before the way of faith in Christ was available to us, we were placed under guard by the law. We were kept in protective custody, so to speak, until the way of faith was revealed.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster {to bring us} unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.nlt_text: Let me put it another way. The law was our guardian until Christ came; it protected us until we could be made right with God through faith.

verses.kjv_text: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.nlt_text: And now that the way of faith has come, we no longer need the law as our guardian.

verses.kjv_text: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: For you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.nlt_text: And all who have been united with Christ in baptism have put on the character of Christ, like putting on new clothes.

verses.kjv_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: There is no longer Jew or Gentile, slave or free, male and female. For you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And if ye {be} Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.nlt_text: And now that you belong to Christ, you are the true children of Abraham. You are his heirs, and God's promise to Abraham belongs to you.

verses.kjv_text: Now I say, {That} the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.nlt_text: Think of it this way. If a father dies and leaves an inheritance for his young children, those children are not much better off than slaves until they grow up, even though they actually own everything their father had.

verses.kjv_text: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.nlt_text: They have to obey their guardians until they reach whatever age their father set.

verses.kjv_text: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world: {elements: or, rudiments}
verses.nlt_text: And that's the way it was with us before Christ came. We were like children; we were slaves to the basic spiritual principles of this world.

verses.kjv_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.nlt_text: But when the right time came, God sent his Son, born of a woman, subject to the law.

verses.kjv_text: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.nlt_text: God sent him to buy freedom for us who were slaves to the law, so that he could adopt us as his very own children.

verses.kjv_text: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.nlt_text: And because we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, prompting us to call out, "Abba, Father."

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Now you are no longer a slave but God's own child. And since you are his child, God has made you his heir.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.nlt_text: Before you Gentiles knew God, you were slaves to so-called gods that do not even exist.

verses.kjv_text: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage? {turn ye again: or, turn ye back} {elements: or, rudiments}
verses.nlt_text: So now that you know God (or should I say, now that God knows you), why do you want to go back again and become slaves once more to the weak and useless spiritual principles of this world?

verses.kjv_text: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.nlt_text: You are trying to earn favor with God by observing certain days or months or seasons or years.

verses.kjv_text: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.nlt_text: I fear for you. Perhaps all my hard work with you was for nothing.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I {am}; for I {am} as ye {are}: ye have not injured me at all.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, I plead with you to live as I do in freedom from these things, for I have become like you Gentiles-- free from those laws.You did not mistreat me when I first preached to you.

verses.kjv_text: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.nlt_text: Surely you remember that I was sick when I first brought you the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, {even} as Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: But even though my condition tempted you to reject me, you did not despise me or turn me away. No, you took me in and cared for me as though I were an angel from God or even Christ Jesus himself.

verses.kjv_text: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if {it had been} possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me. {Where...: or, What was then}
verses.nlt_text: Where is that joyful and grateful spirit you felt then? I am sure you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me if it had been possible.

verses.kjv_text: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.nlt_text: Have I now become your enemy because I am telling you the truth?

verses.kjv_text: They zealously affect you, {but} not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them. {exclude you: or, exclude us}
verses.nlt_text: Those false teachers are so eager to win your favor, but their intentions are not good. They are trying to shut you off from me so that you will pay attention only to them.

verses.kjv_text: But {it is} good to be zealously affected always in {a} good {thing}, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.nlt_text: If someone is eager to do good things for you, that's all right; but let them do it all the time, not just when I'm with you.

verses.kjv_text: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
verses.nlt_text: Oh, my dear children! I feel as if I'm going through labor pains for you again, and they will continue until Christ is fully developed in your lives.

verses.kjv_text: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you. {I stand...: or, I am perplexed for you}
verses.nlt_text: I wish I were with you right now so I could change my tone. But at this distance I don't know how else to help you.

verses.kjv_text: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.nlt_text: Tell me, you who want to live under the law, do you know what the law actually says?

verses.kjv_text: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.nlt_text: The Scriptures say that Abraham had two sons, one from his slave-wife and one from his freeborn wife.

verses.kjv_text: But he {who was} of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman {was} by promise.
verses.nlt_text: The son of the slave-wife was born in a human attempt to bring about the fulfillment of God's promise. But the son of the freeborn wife was born as God's own fulfillment of his promise.

verses.kjv_text: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar. {covenants: or, testaments} {Sinai: Gr. Sina}
verses.nlt_text: These two women serve as an illustration of God's two covenants. The first woman, Hagar, represents Mount Sinai where people received the law that enslaved them.

verses.kjv_text: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children. {answereth to: or, is in the same rank with}
verses.nlt_text: And now Jerusalem is just like Mount Sinai in Arabia, because she and her children live in slavery to the law.

verses.kjv_text: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.nlt_text: But the other woman, Sarah, represents the heavenly Jerusalem. She is the free woman, and she is our mother.

verses.kjv_text: For it is written, Rejoice, {thou} barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
verses.nlt_text: As Isaiah said, "Rejoice, O childless woman, you who have never given birth! Break into a joyful shout, you who have never been in labor! For the desolate woman now has more children than the woman who lives with her husband!"

verses.kjv_text: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.nlt_text: And you, dear brothers and sisters, are children of the promise, just like Isaac.

verses.kjv_text: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him {that was born} after the Spirit, even so {it is} now.
verses.nlt_text: But you are now being persecuted by those who want you to keep the law, just as Ishmael, the child born by human effort, persecuted Isaac, the child born by the power of the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
verses.nlt_text: But what do the Scriptures say about that? "Get rid of the slave and her son, for the son of the slave woman will not share the inheritance with the free woman's son."

verses.kjv_text: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.nlt_text: So, dear brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman; we are children of the free woman.

verses.kjv_text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.nlt_text: So Christ has truly set us free. Now make sure that you stay free, and don't get tied up again in slavery to the law.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.nlt_text: Listen! I, Paul, tell you this: If you are counting on circumcision to make you right with God, then Christ will be of no benefit to you.

verses.kjv_text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.nlt_text: I'll say it again. If you are trying to find favor with God by being circumcised, you must obey every regulation in the whole law of Moses.

verses.kjv_text: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.nlt_text: For if you are trying to make yourselves right with God by keeping the law, you have been cut off from Christ! You have fallen away from God's grace.

verses.kjv_text: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.nlt_text: But we who live by the Spirit eagerly wait to receive by faith the righteousness God has promised to us.

verses.kjv_text: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.nlt_text: For when we place our faith in Christ Jesus, there is no benefit in being circumcised or being uncircumcised. What is important is faith expressing itself in love.

verses.kjv_text: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth? {hinder you: or, drive you back}
verses.nlt_text: You were running the race so well. Who has held you back from following the truth?

verses.kjv_text: This persuasion {cometh} not of him that calleth you.
verses.nlt_text: It certainly isn't God, for he is the one who called you to freedom.

verses.kjv_text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.nlt_text: This false teaching is like a little yeast that spreads through the whole batch of dough!

verses.kjv_text: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.nlt_text: I am trusting the Lord to keep you from believing false teachings. God will judge that person, whoever he is, who has been confusing you.

verses.kjv_text: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, if I were still preaching that you must be circumcised-- as some say I do-- why am I still being persecuted? If I were no longer preaching salvation through the cross of Christ, no one would be offended.

verses.kjv_text: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.nlt_text: I just wish that those troublemakers who want to mutilate you by circumcision would mutilate themselves.

verses.kjv_text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only {use} not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.nlt_text: For you have been called to live in freedom, my brothers and sisters. But don't use your freedom to satisfy your sinful nature. Instead, use your freedom to serve one another in love.

verses.kjv_text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, {even} in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.nlt_text: For the whole law can be summed up in this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.kjv_text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.nlt_text: But if you are always biting and devouring one another, watch out! Beware of destroying one another.

verses.kjv_text: {This} I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh. {ye...: or, fulfil not}
verses.nlt_text: So I say, let the Holy Spirit guide your lives. Then you won't be doing what your sinful nature craves.

verses.kjv_text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.nlt_text: The sinful nature wants to do evil, which is just the opposite of what the Spirit wants. And the Spirit gives us desires that are the opposite of what the sinful nature desires. These two forces are constantly fighting each other, so you are not free to carry out your good intentions.

verses.kjv_text: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.nlt_text: But when you are directed by the Spirit, you are not under obligation to the law of Moses.

verses.kjv_text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are {these}; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.nlt_text: When you follow the desires of your sinful nature, the results are very clear: sexual immorality, impurity, lustful pleasures,

verses.kjv_text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.nlt_text: idolatry, sorcery, hostility, quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, dissension, division,

verses.kjv_text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told {you} in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.nlt_text: envy, drunkenness, wild parties, and other sins like these. Let me tell you again, as I have before, that anyone living that sort of life will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

verses.kjv_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.nlt_text: But the Holy Spirit produces this kind of fruit in our lives: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

verses.kjv_text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.nlt_text: gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against these things!

verses.kjv_text: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts. {affections: or, passions}
verses.nlt_text: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have nailed the passions and desires of their sinful nature to his cross and crucified them there.

verses.kjv_text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: Since we are living by the Spirit, let us follow the Spirit's leading in every part of our lives.

verses.kjv_text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.nlt_text: Let us not become conceited, or provoke one another, or be jealous of one another.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted. {if: or, although}
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, if another believer is overcome by some sin, you who are godly should gently and humbly help that person back onto the right path. And be careful not to fall into the same temptation yourself.

verses.kjv_text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Share each other's burdens, and in this way obey the law of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.nlt_text: If you think you are too important to help someone, you are only fooling yourself. You are not that important.

verses.kjv_text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.nlt_text: Pay careful attention to your own work, for then you will get the satisfaction of a job well done, and you won't need to compare yourself to anyone else.

verses.kjv_text: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.nlt_text: For we are each responsible for our own conduct.

verses.kjv_text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.nlt_text: Those who are taught the word of God should provide for their teachers, sharing all good things with them.

verses.kjv_text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be misled-- you cannot mock the justice of God. You will always harvest what you plant.

verses.kjv_text: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.nlt_text: Those who live only to satisfy their own sinful nature will harvest decay and death from that sinful nature. But those who live to please the Spirit will harvest everlasting life from the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.nlt_text: So let's not get tired of doing what is good. At just the right time we will reap a harvest of blessing if we don't give up.

verses.kjv_text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all {men}, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, whenever we have the opportunity, we should do good to everyone-- especially to those in the family of faith.

verses.kjv_text: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.nlt_text: NOTICE WHAT LARGE LETTERS I USE AS I WRITE THESE CLOSING WORDS IN MY OWN HANDWRITING.

verses.kjv_text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Those who are trying to force you to be circumcised want to look good to others. They don't want to be persecuted for teaching that the cross of Christ alone can save.

verses.kjv_text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.nlt_text: And even those who advocate circumcision don't keep the whole law themselves. They only want you to be circumcised so they can boast about it and claim you as their disciples.

verses.kjv_text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world. {by whom: or, whereby}
verses.nlt_text: As for me, may I never boast about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of that cross, my interest in this world has been crucified, and the world's interest in me has also died.

verses.kjv_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.nlt_text: It doesn't matter whether we have been circumcised or not. What counts is whether we have been transformed into a new creation.

verses.kjv_text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace {be} on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.nlt_text: May God's peace and mercy be upon all who live by this principle; they are the new people of God.

verses.kjv_text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: From now on, don't let anyone trouble me with these things. For I bear on my body the scars that show I belong to Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with your spirit. Amen. «{To the} Galatians written from Rome.»
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus.I am writing to God's holy people in Ephesus, who are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Grace {be} to you, and peace, from God our Father, and {from} the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly {places} in Christ: {places: or, things}
verses.nlt_text: All praise to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms because we are united with Christ.

verses.kjv_text: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.nlt_text: Even before he made the world, God loved us and chose us in Christ to be holy and without fault in his eyes.

verses.kjv_text: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.nlt_text: God decided in advance to adopt us into his own family by bringing us to himself through Jesus Christ. This is what he wanted to do, and it gave him great pleasure.

verses.kjv_text: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.nlt_text: So we praise God for the glorious grace he has poured out on us who belong to his dear Son.

verses.kjv_text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.nlt_text: He is so rich in kindness and grace that he purchased our freedom with the blood of his Son and forgave our sins.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.nlt_text: He has showered his kindness on us, along with all wisdom and understanding.

verses.kjv_text: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
verses.nlt_text: God has now revealed to us his mysterious plan regarding Christ, a plan to fulfill his own good pleasure.

verses.kjv_text: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; {even} in him: {heaven: Gr. the heavens}
verses.nlt_text: And this is the plan: At the right time he will bring everything together under the authority of Christ-- everything in heaven and on earth.

verses.kjv_text: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.nlt_text: Furthermore, because we are united with Christ, we have received an inheritance from God, for he chose us in advance, and he makes everything work out according to his plan.

verses.kjv_text: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ. {trusted: or, hoped}
verses.nlt_text: God's purpose was that we Jews who were the first to trust in Christ would bring praise and glory to God.

verses.kjv_text: In whom ye also {trusted}, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.nlt_text: And now you Gentiles have also heard the truth, the Good News that God saves you. And when you believed in Christ, he identified you as his own by giving you the Holy Spirit, whom he promised long ago.

verses.kjv_text: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.nlt_text: The Spirit is God's guarantee that he will give us the inheritance he promised and that he has purchased us to be his own people. He did this so we would praise and glorify him.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
verses.nlt_text: Ever since I first heard of your strong faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for God's people everywhere,

verses.kjv_text: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.nlt_text: I have not stopped thanking God for you. I pray for you constantly,

verses.kjv_text: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him: {in...: or, for the acknowledgement}
verses.nlt_text: asking God, the glorious Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, to give you spiritual wisdom and insight so that you might grow in your knowledge of God.

verses.kjv_text: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.nlt_text: I pray that your hearts will be flooded with light so that you can understand the confident hope he has given to those he called-- his holy people who are his rich and glorious inheritance.

verses.kjv_text: And what {is} the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power, {his mighty power: Gr. the might of his power}
verses.nlt_text: I also pray that you will understand the incredible greatness of God's power for us who believe him. This is the same mighty power

verses.kjv_text: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set {him} at his own right hand in the heavenly {places},
verses.nlt_text: that raised Christ from the dead and seated him in the place of honor at God's right hand in the heavenly realms.

verses.kjv_text: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.nlt_text: Now he is far above any ruler or authority or power or leader or anything else-- not only in this world but also in the world to come.

verses.kjv_text: And hath put all {things} under his feet, and gave him {to be} the head over all {things} to the church,
verses.nlt_text: God has put all things under the authority of Christ and has made him head over all things for the benefit of the church.

verses.kjv_text: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.nlt_text: And the church is his body; it is made full and complete by Christ, who fills all things everywhere with himself.

verses.kjv_text: And you {hath he quickened}, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.nlt_text: Once you were dead because of your disobedience and your many sins.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
verses.nlt_text: You used to live in sin, just like the rest of the world, obeying the devil-- the commander of the powers in the unseen world. He is the spirit at work in the hearts of those who refuse to obey God.

verses.kjv_text: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others. {desires: Gr. wills}
verses.nlt_text: All of us used to live that way, following the passionate desires and inclinations of our sinful nature. By our very nature we were subject to God's anger, just like everyone else.

verses.kjv_text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.nlt_text: But God is so rich in mercy, and he loved us so much,

verses.kjv_text: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;) {by...: or, by whose grace}
verses.nlt_text: that even though we were dead because of our sins, he gave us life when he raised Christ from the dead. (It is only by God's grace that you have been saved!)

verses.kjv_text: And hath raised {us} up together, and made {us} sit together in heavenly {places} in Christ Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: For he raised us from the dead along with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms because we are united with Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in {his} kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: So God can point to us in all future ages as examples of the incredible wealth of his grace and kindness toward us, as shown in all he has done for us who are united with Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: {it is} the gift of God:
verses.nlt_text: God saved you by his grace when you believed. And you can't take credit for this; it is a gift from God.

verses.kjv_text: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.nlt_text: Salvation is not a reward for the good things we have done, so none of us can boast about it.

verses.kjv_text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them. {ordained: or, prepared}
verses.nlt_text: For we are God's masterpiece. He has created us anew in Christ Jesus, so we can do the good things he planned for us long ago.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore remember, that ye {being} in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.nlt_text: Don't forget that you Gentiles used to be outsiders. You were called "uncircumcised heathens" by the Jews, who were proud of their circumcision, even though it affected only their bodies and not their hearts.

verses.kjv_text: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verses.nlt_text: In those days you were living apart from Christ. You were excluded from citizenship among the people of Israel, and you did not know the covenant promises God had made to them. You lived in this world without God and without hope.

verses.kjv_text: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: But now you have been united with Christ Jesus. Once you were far away from God, but now you have been brought near to him through the blood of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition {between us};
verses.nlt_text: For Christ himself has brought peace to us. He united Jews and Gentiles into one people when, in his own body on the cross, he broke down the wall of hostility that separated us.

verses.kjv_text: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, {even} the law of commandments {contained} in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, {so} making peace;
verses.nlt_text: He did this by ending the system of law with its commandments and regulations. He made peace between Jews and Gentiles by creating in himself one new people from the two groups.

verses.kjv_text: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby: {thereby: or, in himself}
verses.nlt_text: Together as one body, Christ reconciled both groups to God by means of his death on the cross, and our hostility toward each other was put to death.

verses.kjv_text: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.nlt_text: He brought this Good News of peace to you Gentiles who were far away from him, and peace to the Jews who were near.

verses.kjv_text: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.nlt_text: Now all of us can come to the Father through the same Holy Spirit because of what Christ has done for us.

verses.kjv_text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.nlt_text: So now you Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens along with all of God's holy people. You are members of God's family.

verses.kjv_text: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner {stone};
verses.nlt_text: Together, we are his house, built on the foundation of the apostles and the prophets. And the cornerstone is Christ Jesus himself.

verses.kjv_text: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.nlt_text: We are carefully joined together in him, becoming a holy temple for the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: Through him you Gentiles are also being made part of this dwelling where God lives by his Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
verses.nlt_text: When I think of all this, I, Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus for the benefit of you Gentiles...

verses.kjv_text: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
verses.nlt_text: assuming, by the way, that you know God gave me the special responsibility of extending his grace to you Gentiles.

verses.kjv_text: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words, {afore...: or, a little before}
verses.nlt_text: As I briefly wrote earlier, God himself revealed his mysterious plan to me.

verses.kjv_text: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.nlt_text: As you read what I have written, you will understand my insight into this plan regarding Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.nlt_text: God did not reveal it to previous generations, but now by his Spirit he has revealed it to his holy apostles and prophets.

verses.kjv_text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
verses.nlt_text: And this is God's plan: Both Gentiles and Jews who believe the Good News share equally in the riches inherited by God's children. Both are part of the same body, and both enjoy the promise of blessings because they belong to Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.nlt_text: By God's grace and mighty power, I have been given the privilege of serving him by spreading this Good News.

verses.kjv_text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
verses.nlt_text: Though I am the least deserving of all God's people, he graciously gave me the privilege of telling the Gentiles about the endless treasures available to them in Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And to make all {men} see what {is} the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
verses.nlt_text: I was chosen to explain to everyone this mysterious plan that God, the Creator of all things, had kept secret from the beginning.

verses.kjv_text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly {places} might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.nlt_text: God's purpose in all this was to use the church to display his wisdom in its rich variety to all the unseen rulers and authorities in the heavenly places.

verses.kjv_text: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.nlt_text: This was his eternal plan, which he carried out through Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv_text: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.nlt_text: Because of Christ and our faith in him, we can now come boldly and confidently into God's presence.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.nlt_text: So please don't lose heart because of my trials here. I am suffering for you, so you should feel honored.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.nlt_text: When I think of all this, I fall to my knees and pray to the Father,

verses.kjv_text: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
verses.nlt_text: the Creator of everything in heaven and on earth.

verses.kjv_text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
verses.nlt_text: I pray that from his glorious, unlimited resources he will empower you with inner strength through his Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.nlt_text: Then Christ will make his home in your hearts as you trust in him. Your roots will grow down into God's love and keep you strong.

verses.kjv_text: May be able to comprehend with all saints what {is} the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.nlt_text: And may you have the power to understand, as all God's people should, how wide, how long, how high, and how deep his love is.

verses.kjv_text: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verses.nlt_text: May you experience the love of Christ, though it is too great to understand fully. Then you will be made complete with all the fullness of life and power that comes from God.

verses.kjv_text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.nlt_text: Now all glory to God, who is able, through his mighty power at work within us, to accomplish infinitely more than we might ask or think.

verses.kjv_text: Unto him {be} glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Glory to him in the church and in Christ Jesus through all generations forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called, {of the Lord: or, in the Lord}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore I, a prisoner for serving the Lord, beg you to lead a life worthy of your calling, for you have been called by God.

verses.kjv_text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.nlt_text: Always be humble and gentle. Be patient with each other, making allowance for each other's faults because of your love.

verses.kjv_text: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.nlt_text: Make every effort to keep yourselves united in the Spirit, binding yourselves together with peace.

verses.kjv_text: {There is} one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.nlt_text: For there is one body and one Spirit, just as you have been called to one glorious hope for the future.

verses.kjv_text: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.nlt_text: There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.kjv_text: One God and Father of all, who {is} above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.nlt_text: and one God and Father, who is over all and in all and living through all.

verses.kjv_text: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: However, he has given each one of us a special gift through the generosity of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men. {captivity...: or, a multitude of captives}
verses.nlt_text: That is why the Scriptures say, "When he ascended to the heights, he led a crowd of captives and gave gifts to his people."

verses.kjv_text: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.nlt_text: Notice that it says "he ascended." This clearly means that Christ also descended to our lowly world.

verses.kjv_text: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.) {fill: or, fulfil}
verses.nlt_text: And the same one who descended is the one who ascended higher than all the heavens, so that he might fill the entire universe with himself.

verses.kjv_text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.nlt_text: Now these are the gifts Christ gave to the church: the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, and the pastors and teachers.

verses.kjv_text: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
verses.nlt_text: Their responsibility is to equip God's people to do his work and build up the church, the body of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ: {in: or, into} {stature: or, age}
verses.nlt_text: This will continue until we all come to such unity in our faith and knowledge of God's Son that we will be mature in the Lord, measuring up to the full and complete standard of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: That we {henceforth} be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, {and} cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.nlt_text: Then we will no longer be immature like children. We won't be tossed and blown about by every wind of new teaching. We will not be influenced when people try to trick us with lies so clever they sound like the truth.

verses.kjv_text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, {even} Christ: {speaking...: or, being sincere}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, we will speak the truth in love, growing in every way more and more like Christ, who is the head of his body, the church.

verses.kjv_text: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.nlt_text: He makes the whole body fit together perfectly. As each part does its own special work, it helps the other parts grow, so that the whole body is healthy and growing and full of love.

verses.kjv_text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.nlt_text: With the Lord's authority I say this: Live no longer as the Gentiles do, for they are hopelessly confused.

verses.kjv_text: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart: {blindness: or, hardness}
verses.nlt_text: Their minds are full of darkness; they wander far from the life God gives because they have closed their minds and hardened their hearts against him.

verses.kjv_text: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.nlt_text: They have no sense of shame. They live for lustful pleasure and eagerly practice every kind of impurity.

verses.kjv_text: But ye have not so learned Christ;
verses.nlt_text: But that isn't what you learned about Christ.

verses.kjv_text: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: Since you have heard about Jesus and have learned the truth that comes from him,

verses.kjv_text: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.nlt_text: throw off your old sinful nature and your former way of life, which is corrupted by lust and deception.

verses.kjv_text: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.nlt_text: Instead, let the Spirit renew your thoughts and attitudes.

verses.kjv_text: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness. {true...: or, holiness of truth}
verses.nlt_text: Put on your new nature, created to be like God-- truly righteous and holy.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.nlt_text: So stop telling lies. Let us tell our neighbors the truth, for we are all parts of the same body.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.nlt_text: And "don't sin by letting anger control you." Don't let the sun go down while you are still angry,

verses.kjv_text: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.nlt_text: for anger gives a foothold to the devil.

verses.kjv_text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with {his} hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth. {to give: or, to distribute}
verses.nlt_text: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Instead, use your hands for good hard work, and then give generously to others in need.

verses.kjv_text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers. {to...: or, to edify profitably}
verses.nlt_text: Don't use foul or abusive language. Let everything you say be good and helpful, so that your words will be an encouragement to those who hear them.

verses.kjv_text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.nlt_text: And do not bring sorrow to God's Holy Spirit by the way you live. Remember, he has identified you as his own, guaranteeing that you will be saved on the day of redemption.

verses.kjv_text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.nlt_text: Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, harsh words, and slander, as well as all types of evil behavior.

verses.kjv_text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, be kind to each other, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as God through Christ has forgiven you.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
verses.nlt_text: Imitate God, therefore, in everything you do, because you are his dear children.

verses.kjv_text: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.nlt_text: Live a life filled with love, following the example of Christ. He loved us and offered himself as a sacrifice for us, a pleasing aroma to God.

verses.kjv_text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.nlt_text: Let there be no sexual immorality, impurity, or greed among you. Such sins have no place among God's people.

verses.kjv_text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.nlt_text: Obscene stories, foolish talk, and coarse jokes-- these are not for you. Instead, let there be thankfulness to God.

verses.kjv_text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.nlt_text: You can be sure that no immoral, impure, or greedy person will inherit the Kingdom of Christ and of God. For a greedy person is an idolater, worshiping the things of this world.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience. {disobedience: or, unbelief}
verses.nlt_text: Don't be fooled by those who try to excuse these sins, for the anger of God will fall on all who disobey him.

verses.kjv_text: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
verses.nlt_text: Don't participate in the things these people do.

verses.kjv_text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now {are ye} light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.nlt_text: For once you were full of darkness, but now you have light from the Lord. So live as people of light!

verses.kjv_text: (For the fruit of the Spirit {is} in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
verses.nlt_text: For this light within you produces only what is good and right and true.

verses.kjv_text: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Carefully determine what pleases the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove {them}.
verses.nlt_text: Take no part in the worthless deeds of evil and darkness; instead, expose them.

verses.kjv_text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.nlt_text: It is shameful even to talk about the things that ungodly people do in secret.

verses.kjv_text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light. {reproved: or, discovered}
verses.nlt_text: But their evil intentions will be exposed when the light shines on them,

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light. {he: or, it}
verses.nlt_text: for the light makes everything visible. This is why it is said, "Awake, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will give you light."

verses.kjv_text: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.nlt_text: So be careful how you live. Don't live like fools, but like those who are wise.

verses.kjv_text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.nlt_text: Make the most of every opportunity in these evil days.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord {is}.
verses.nlt_text: Don't act thoughtlessly, but understand what the Lord wants you to do.

verses.kjv_text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.nlt_text: Don't be drunk with wine, because that will ruin your life. Instead, be filled with the Holy Spirit,

verses.kjv_text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.nlt_text: singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs among yourselves, and making music to the Lord in your hearts.

verses.kjv_text: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.nlt_text: And give thanks for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
verses.nlt_text: And further, submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: For wives, this means submit to your husbands as to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.nlt_text: For a husband is the head of his wife as Christ is the head of the church. He is the Savior of his body, the church.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so {let} the wives {be} to their own husbands in every thing.
verses.nlt_text: As the church submits to Christ, so you wives should submit to your husbands in everything.

verses.kjv_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.nlt_text: For husbands, this means love your wives, just as Christ loved the church. He gave up his life for her

verses.kjv_text: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.nlt_text: to make her holy and clean, washed by the cleansing of God's word.

verses.kjv_text: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.nlt_text: He did this to present her to himself as a glorious church without a spot or wrinkle or any other blemish. Instead, she will be holy and without fault.

verses.kjv_text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as they love their own bodies. For a man who loves his wife actually shows love for himself.

verses.kjv_text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.nlt_text: No one hates his own body but feeds and cares for it, just as Christ cares for the church.

verses.kjv_text: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.nlt_text: And we are members of his body.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "A man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife, and the two are united into one."

verses.kjv_text: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
verses.nlt_text: This is a great mystery, but it is an illustration of the way Christ and the church are one.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife {see} that she reverence {her} husband.
verses.nlt_text: So again I say, each man must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

verses.kjv_text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.nlt_text: Children, obey your parents because you belong to the Lord, for this is the right thing to do.

verses.kjv_text: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
verses.nlt_text: "Honor your father and mother." This is the first commandment with a promise:

verses.kjv_text: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.nlt_text: If you honor your father and mother, "things will go well for you, and you will have a long life on the earth."

verses.kjv_text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger by the way you treat them. Rather, bring them up with the discipline and instruction that comes from the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Servants, be obedient to them that are {your} masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.nlt_text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with deep respect and fear. Serve them sincerely as you would serve Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.nlt_text: Try to please them all the time, not just when they are watching you. As slaves of Christ, do the will of God with all your heart.

verses.kjv_text: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.nlt_text: Work with enthusiasm, as though you were working for the Lord rather than for people.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether {he be} bond or free.
verses.nlt_text: Remember that the Lord will reward each one of us for the good we do, whether we are slaves or free.

verses.kjv_text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him. {forbearing: or, moderating} {your...: some read, both your and their Master}
verses.nlt_text: Masters, treat your slaves in the same way. Don't threaten them; remember, you both have the same Master in heaven, and he has no favorites.

verses.kjv_text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.nlt_text: A final word: Be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

verses.kjv_text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.nlt_text: Put on all of God's armor so that you will be able to stand firm against all strategies of the devil.

verses.kjv_text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high {places}. {flesh...: Gr. blood and flesh} {spiritual...: or, wicked spirits} {high: or, heavenly}
verses.nlt_text: For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. {having...: or, having overcome all}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, put on every piece of God's armor so you will be able to resist the enemy in the time of evil. Then after the battle you will still be standing firm.

verses.kjv_text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
verses.nlt_text: Stand your ground, putting on the belt of truth and the body armor of God's righteousness.

verses.kjv_text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.nlt_text: For shoes, put on the peace that comes from the Good News so that you will be fully prepared.

verses.kjv_text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.nlt_text: In addition to all of these, hold up the shield of faith to stop the fiery arrows of the devil.

verses.kjv_text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.nlt_text: Put on salvation as your helmet, and take the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

verses.kjv_text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.nlt_text: Pray in the Spirit at all times and on every occasion. Stay alert and be persistent in your prayers for all believers everywhere.

verses.kjv_text: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.nlt_text: And pray for me, too. Ask God to give me the right words so I can boldly explain God's mysterious plan that the Good News is for Jews and Gentiles alike.

verses.kjv_text: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak. {in bonds: or, in a chain} {therein: or, thereof}
verses.nlt_text: I am in chains now, still preaching this message as God's ambassador. So pray that I will keep on speaking boldly for him, as I should.

verses.kjv_text: But that ye also may know my affairs, {and} how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.nlt_text: To bring you up to date, Tychicus will give you a full report about what I am doing and how I am getting along. He is a beloved brother and faithful helper in the Lord's work.

verses.kjv_text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and {that} he might comfort your hearts.
verses.nlt_text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose-- to let you know how we are doing and to encourage you.

verses.kjv_text: Peace {be} to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Peace be with you, dear brothers and sisters, and may God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you love with faithfulness.

verses.kjv_text: Grace {be} with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. «{To the} Ephesians written from Rome, by Tychicus.» {in sincerity: or, with incorruption}
verses.nlt_text: May God's grace be eternally upon all who love our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus.I am writing to all of God's holy people in Philippi who belong to Christ Jesus, including the elders and deacons.

verses.kjv_text: Grace {be} unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and {from} the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you, {remembrance: or, mention}
verses.nlt_text: Every time I think of you, I give thanks to my God.

verses.kjv_text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
verses.nlt_text: Whenever I pray, I make my requests for all of you with joy,

verses.kjv_text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.nlt_text: for you have been my partners in spreading the Good News about Christ from the time you first heard it until now.

verses.kjv_text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform {it} until the day of Jesus Christ: {perform: or, finish}
verses.nlt_text: And I am certain that God, who began the good work within you, will continue his work until it is finally finished on the day when Christ Jesus returns.

verses.kjv_text: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace. {I have...: or, ye have me in your heart} {of my...: or, with me of grace}
verses.nlt_text: So it is right that I should feel as I do about all of you, for you have a special place in my heart. You share with me the special favor of God, both in my imprisonment and in defending and confirming the truth of the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: God knows how much I love you and long for you with the tender compassion of Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and {in} all judgment; {judgment: or, sense}
verses.nlt_text: I pray that your love will overflow more and more, and that you will keep on growing in knowledge and understanding.

verses.kjv_text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ; {approve: or, try} {are...: or, differ}
verses.nlt_text: For I want you to understand what really matters, so that you may live pure and blameless lives until the day of Christ's return.

verses.kjv_text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.nlt_text: May you always be filled with the fruit of your salvation-- the righteous character produced in your life by Jesus Christ-- for this will bring much glory and praise to God.

verses.kjv_text: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things {which happened} unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.nlt_text: And I want you to know, my dear brothers and sisters, that everything that has happened to me here has helped to spread the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other {places}; {in Christ: or, for Christ} {the palace: or, Caesar's court} {in all other...: or, to all others}
verses.nlt_text: For everyone here, including the whole palace guard, knows that I am in chains because of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.nlt_text: And because of my imprisonment, most of the believers here have gained confidence and boldly speak God's message without fear.

verses.kjv_text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.nlt_text: It's true that some are preaching out of jealousy and rivalry. But others preach about Christ with pure motives.

verses.kjv_text: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.nlt_text: They preach because they love me, for they know I have been appointed to defend the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.nlt_text: Those others do not have pure motives as they preach about Christ. They preach with selfish ambition, not sincerely, intending to make my chains more painful to me.

verses.kjv_text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.nlt_text: But that doesn't matter. Whether their motives are false or genuine, the message about Christ is being preached either way, so I rejoice. And I will continue to rejoice.

verses.kjv_text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.nlt_text: For I know that as you pray for me and the Spirit of Jesus Christ helps me, this will lead to my deliverance.

verses.kjv_text: According to my earnest expectation and {my} hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but {that} with all boldness, as always, {so} now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether {it be} by life, or by death.
verses.nlt_text: For I fully expect and hope that I will never be ashamed, but that I will continue to be bold for Christ, as I have been in the past. And I trust that my life will bring honor to Christ, whether I live or die.

verses.kjv_text: For to me to live {is} Christ, and to die {is} gain.
verses.nlt_text: For to me, living means living for Christ, and dying is even better.

verses.kjv_text: But if I live in the flesh, this {is} the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.nlt_text: But if I live, I can do more fruitful work for Christ. So I really don't know which is better.
