verses.kjv_text: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
verses.nlt_text: I'm torn between two desires: I long to go and be with Christ, which would be far better for me.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh {is} more needful for you.
verses.nlt_text: But for your sakes, it is better that I continue to live.

verses.kjv_text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
verses.nlt_text: Knowing this, I am convinced that I will remain alive so I can continue to help all of you grow and experience the joy of your faith.

verses.kjv_text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
verses.nlt_text: And when I come to you again, you will have even more reason to take pride in Christ Jesus because of what he is doing through me.

verses.kjv_text: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.nlt_text: Above all, you must live as citizens of heaven, conducting yourselves in a manner worthy of the Good News about Christ. Then, whether I come and see you again or only hear about you, I will know that you are standing side by side, fighting together for the faith, which is the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be intimidated in any way by your enemies. This will be a sign to them that they are going to be destroyed, but that you are going to be saved, even by God himself.

verses.kjv_text: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.nlt_text: For you have been given not only the privilege of trusting in Christ but also the privilege of suffering for him.

verses.kjv_text: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear {to be} in me.
verses.nlt_text: We are in this struggle together. You have seen my struggle in the past, and you know that I am still in the midst of it.

verses.kjv_text: If {there be} therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.nlt_text: Is there any encouragement from belonging to Christ? Any comfort from his love? Any fellowship together in the Spirit? Are your hearts tender and compassionate?

verses.kjv_text: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, {being} of one accord, of one mind.
verses.nlt_text: Then make me truly happy by agreeing wholeheartedly with each other, loving one another, and working together with one mind and purpose.

verses.kjv_text: {Let} nothing {be done} through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be selfish; don't try to impress others. Be humble, thinking of others as better than yourselves.

verses.kjv_text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.nlt_text: Don't look out only for your own interests, but take an interest in others, too.

verses.kjv_text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: You must have the same attitude that Christ Jesus had.

verses.kjv_text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
verses.nlt_text: Though he was God, he did not think of equality with God as something to cling to.

verses.kjv_text: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.nlt_text: Instead, he gave up his divine privileges; he took the humble position of a slave and was born as a human being. When he appeared in human form,

verses.kjv_text: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross. {fashion: or habit}
verses.nlt_text: he humbled himself in obedience to God and died a criminal's death on a cross.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, God elevated him to the place of highest honor and gave him the name above all other names,

verses.kjv_text: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of {things} in heaven, and {things} in earth, and {things} under the earth;
verses.nlt_text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

verses.kjv_text: And {that} every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ {is} Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.nlt_text: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, you always followed my instructions when I was with you. And now that I am away, it is even more important. Work hard to show the results of your salvation, obeying God with deep reverence and fear.

verses.kjv_text: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of {his} good pleasure.
verses.nlt_text: For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases him.

verses.kjv_text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
verses.nlt_text: Do everything without complaining and arguing,

verses.kjv_text: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world; {harmless: or, sincere} {ye shine: or, shine ye}
verses.nlt_text: so that no one can criticize you. Live clean, innocent lives as children of God, shining like bright lights in a world full of crooked and perverse people.

verses.kjv_text: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.nlt_text: Hold firmly to the word of life; then, on the day of Christ's return, I will be proud that I did not run the race in vain and that my work was not useless.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all. {offered: Gr. poured forth}
verses.nlt_text: But I will rejoice even if I lose my life, pouring it out like a liquid offering to God, just like your faithful service is an offering to God. And I want all of you to share that joy.

verses.kjv_text: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, you should rejoice, and I will share your joy.

verses.kjv_text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state. {But: or, Moreover}
verses.nlt_text: If the Lord Jesus is willing, I hope to send Timothy to you soon for a visit. Then he can cheer me up by telling me how you are getting along.

verses.kjv_text: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state. {likeminded: or, so dear unto me}
verses.nlt_text: I have no one else like Timothy, who genuinely cares about your welfare.

verses.kjv_text: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
verses.nlt_text: All the others care only for themselves and not for what matters to Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
verses.nlt_text: But you know how Timothy has proved himself. Like a son with his father, he has served with me in preaching the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.nlt_text: I hope to send him to you just as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me here.

verses.kjv_text: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.nlt_text: And I have confidence from the Lord that I myself will come to see you soon.

verses.kjv_text: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.nlt_text: Meanwhile, I thought I should send Epaphroditus back to you. He is a true brother, co-worker, and fellow soldier. And he was your messenger to help me in my need.

verses.kjv_text: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
verses.nlt_text: I am sending him because he has been longing to see you, and he was very distressed that you heard he was ill.

verses.kjv_text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.nlt_text: And he certainly was ill; in fact, he almost died. But God had mercy on him-- and also on me, so that I would not have one sorrow after another.

verses.kjv_text: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful. {carefully: or, with more anxious care}
verses.nlt_text: So I am all the more anxious to send him back to you, for I know you will be glad to see him, and then I will not be so worried about you.

verses.kjv_text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation: {hold...: or, honour such}
verses.nlt_text: Welcome him with Christian love and with great joy, and give him the honor that people like him deserve.

verses.kjv_text: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
verses.nlt_text: For he risked his life for the work of Christ, and he was at the point of death while doing for me what you couldn't do from far away.

verses.kjv_text: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed {is} not grievous, but for you {it is} safe.
verses.nlt_text: Whatever happens, my dear brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord. I never get tired of telling you these things, and I do it to safeguard your faith.

verses.kjv_text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.nlt_text: Watch out for those dogs, those people who do evil, those mutilators who say you must be circumcised to be saved.

verses.kjv_text: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.nlt_text: For we who worship by the Spirit of God are the ones who are truly circumcised. We rely on what Christ Jesus has done for us. We put no confidence in human effort,

verses.kjv_text: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.nlt_text: though I could have confidence in my own effort if anyone could. Indeed, if others have reason for confidence in their own efforts, I have even more!

verses.kjv_text: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, {of} the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.nlt_text: I was circumcised when I was eight days old. I am a pure-blooded citizen of Israel and a member of the tribe of Benjamin-- a real Hebrew if there ever was one! I was a member of the Pharisees, who demand the strictest obedience to the Jewish law.

verses.kjv_text: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.nlt_text: I was so zealous that I harshly persecuted the church. And as for righteousness, I obeyed the law without fault.

verses.kjv_text: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
verses.nlt_text: I once thought these things were valuable, but now I consider them worthless because of what Christ has done.

verses.kjv_text: Yea doubtless, and I count all things {but} loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them {but} dung, that I may win Christ,
verses.nlt_text: Yes, everything else is worthless when compared with the infinite value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have discarded everything else, counting it all as garbage, so that I could gain Christ

verses.kjv_text: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
verses.nlt_text: and become one with him. I no longer count on my own righteousness through obeying the law; rather, I become righteous through faith in Christ. For God's way of making us right with himself depends on faith.

verses.kjv_text: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
verses.nlt_text: I want to know Christ and experience the mighty power that raised him from the dead. I want to suffer with him, sharing in his death,

verses.kjv_text: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.nlt_text: so that one way or another I will experience the resurrection from the dead!

verses.kjv_text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: I don't mean to say that I have already achieved these things or that I have already reached perfection. But I press on to possess that perfection for which Christ Jesus first possessed me.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but {this} one thing {I do}, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.nlt_text: No, dear brothers and sisters, I have not achieved it, but I focus on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead,

verses.kjv_text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: I press on to reach the end of the race and receive the heavenly prize for which God, through Christ Jesus, is calling us.

verses.kjv_text: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Let all who are spiritually mature agree on these things. If you disagree on some point, I believe God will make it plain to you.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.nlt_text: But we must hold on to the progress we have already made.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, pattern your lives after mine, and learn from those who follow our example.

verses.kjv_text: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, {that they are} the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.nlt_text: For I have told you often before, and I say it again with tears in my eyes, that there are many whose conduct shows they are really enemies of the cross of Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Whose end {is} destruction, whose God {is their} belly, and {whose} glory {is} in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.nlt_text: They are headed for destruction. Their god is their appetite, they brag about shameful things, and they think only about this life here on earth.

verses.kjv_text: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ: {conversation...: or, we live or conduct ourselves as citizens of heaven, or, for obtaining heaven}
verses.nlt_text: But we are citizens of heaven, where the Lord Jesus Christ lives. And we are eagerly waiting for him to return as our Savior.

verses.kjv_text: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
verses.nlt_text: He will take our weak mortal bodies and change them into glorious bodies like his own, using the same power with which he will bring everything under his control.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, {my} dearly beloved.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stay true to the Lord. I love you and long to see you, dear friends, for you are my joy and the crown I receive for my work.

verses.kjv_text: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Now I appeal to Euodia and Syntyche. Please, because you belong to the Lord, settle your disagreement.

verses.kjv_text: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and {with} other my fellowlabourers, whose names {are} in the book of life.
verses.nlt_text: And I ask you, my true partner, to help these two women, for they worked hard with me in telling others the Good News. They worked along with Clement and the rest of my co-workers, whose names are written in the Book of Life.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: {and} again I say, Rejoice.
verses.nlt_text: Always be full of joy in the Lord. I say it again-- rejoice!

verses.kjv_text: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord {is} at hand.
verses.nlt_text: Let everyone see that you are considerate in all you do. Remember, the Lord is coming soon.

verses.kjv_text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.nlt_text: Don't worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell God what you need, and thank him for all he has done.

verses.kjv_text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will experience God's peace, which exceeds anything we can understand. His peace will guard your hearts and minds as you live in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things {are} honest, whatsoever things {are} just, whatsoever things {are} pure, whatsoever things {are} lovely, whatsoever things {are} of good report; if {there be} any virtue, and if {there be} any praise, think on these things. {honest: or, venerable}
verses.nlt_text: And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise.

verses.kjv_text: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.nlt_text: Keep putting into practice all you learned and received from me-- everything you heard from me and saw me doing. Then the God of peace will be with you.

verses.kjv_text: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity. {hath...: or, is revived}
verses.nlt_text: How I praise the Lord that you are concerned about me again. I know you have always been concerned for me, but you didn't have the chance to help me.

verses.kjv_text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, {therewith} to be content.
verses.nlt_text: Not that I was ever in need, for I have learned how to be content with whatever I have.

verses.kjv_text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.nlt_text: I know how to live on almost nothing or with everything. I have learned the secret of living in every situation, whether it is with a full stomach or empty, with plenty or little.

verses.kjv_text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.nlt_text: For I can do everything through Christ, who gives me strength.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
verses.nlt_text: Even so, you have done well to share with me in my present difficulty.

verses.kjv_text: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
verses.nlt_text: As you know, you Philippians were the only ones who gave me financial help when I first brought you the Good News and then traveled on from Macedonia. No other church did this.

verses.kjv_text: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.nlt_text: Even when I was in Thessalonica you sent help more than once.

verses.kjv_text: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.nlt_text: I don't say this because I want a gift from you. Rather, I want you to receive a reward for your kindness.

verses.kjv_text: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things {which were sent} from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God. {I have all: or, I have received all}
verses.nlt_text: At the moment I have all I need-- and more! I am generously supplied with the gifts you sent me with Epaphroditus. They are a sweet-smelling sacrifice that is acceptable and pleasing to God.

verses.kjv_text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: And this same God who takes care of me will supply all your needs from his glorious riches, which have been given to us in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Now unto God and our Father {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Now all glory to God our Father forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.nlt_text: Give my greetings to each of God's holy people-- all who belong to Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you their greetings.

verses.kjv_text: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
verses.nlt_text: And all the rest of God's people send you greetings, too, especially those in Caesar's household.

verses.kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you all. Amen. «{To the} Philippians written from Rome, by Epaphroditus.»
verses.nlt_text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus {our} brother,
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy.

verses.kjv_text: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace {be} unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: We are writing to God's holy people in the city of Colosse, who are faithful brothers and sisters in Christ.May God our Father give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.nlt_text: We always pray for you, and we give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love {which ye have} to all the saints,
verses.nlt_text: For we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all of God's people,

verses.kjv_text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.nlt_text: which come from your confident hope of what God has reserved for you in heaven. You have had this expectation ever since you first heard the truth of the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: Which is come unto you, as {it is} in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as {it doth} also in you, since the day ye heard {of it}, and knew the grace of God in truth:
verses.nlt_text: This same Good News that came to you is going out all over the world. It is bearing fruit everywhere by changing lives, just as it changed your lives from the day you first heard and understood the truth about God's wonderful grace.

verses.kjv_text: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
verses.nlt_text: You learned about the Good News from Epaphras, our beloved co-worker. He is Christ's faithful servant, and he is helping us on your behalf.

verses.kjv_text: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: He has told us about the love for others that the Holy Spirit has given you.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard {it}, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.nlt_text: So we have not stopped praying for you since we first heard about you. We ask God to give you complete knowledge of his will and to give you spiritual wisdom and understanding.

verses.kjv_text: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.nlt_text: Then the way you live will always honor and please the Lord, and your lives will produce every kind of good fruit. All the while, you will grow as you learn to know God better and better.

verses.kjv_text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.nlt_text: We also pray that you will be strengthened with all his glorious power so you will have all the endurance and patience you need. May you be filled with joy,

verses.kjv_text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
verses.nlt_text: always thanking the Father. He has enabled you to share in the inheritance that belongs to his people, who live in the light.

verses.kjv_text: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated {us} into the kingdom of his dear Son: {his...: Gr. the Son of his love}
verses.nlt_text: For he has rescued us from the kingdom of darkness and transferred us into the Kingdom of his dear Son,

verses.kjv_text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, {even} the forgiveness of sins:
verses.nlt_text: who purchased our freedom and forgave our sins.

verses.kjv_text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
verses.nlt_text: Christ is the visible image of the invisible God. He existed before anything was created and is supreme over all creation,

verses.kjv_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether {they be} thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.nlt_text: for through him God created everything in the heavenly realms and on earth. He made the things we can see and the things we can't see-- such as thrones, kingdoms, rulers, and authorities in the unseen world. Everything was created through him and for him.

verses.kjv_text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.nlt_text: He existed before anything else, and he holds all creation together.

verses.kjv_text: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all {things} he might have the preeminence. {in...: or, among all}
verses.nlt_text: Christ is also the head of the church, which is his body. He is the beginning, supreme over all who rise from the dead. So he is first in everything.

verses.kjv_text: For it pleased {the Father} that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.nlt_text: For God in all his fullness was pleased to live in Christ,

verses.kjv_text: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, {I say}, whether {they be} things in earth, or things in heaven. {having...: or, making}
verses.nlt_text: and through him God reconciled everything to himself. He made peace with everything in heaven and on earth by means of Christ's blood on the cross.

verses.kjv_text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in {your} mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled {in...: or, by your mind in}
verses.nlt_text: This includes you who were once far away from God. You were his enemies, separated from him by your evil thoughts and actions.

verses.kjv_text: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.nlt_text: Yet now he has reconciled you to himself through the death of Christ in his physical body. As a result, he has brought you into his own presence, and you are holy and blameless as you stand before him without a single fault.

verses.kjv_text: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and {be} not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, {and} which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.nlt_text: But you must continue to believe this truth and stand firmly in it. Don't drift away from the assurance you received when you heard the Good News. The Good News has been preached all over the world, and I, Paul, have been appointed as God's servant to proclaim it.

verses.kjv_text: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
verses.nlt_text: I am glad when I suffer for you in my body, for I am participating in the sufferings of Christ that continue for his body, the church.

verses.kjv_text: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God; {to fulfil...: or, fully to preach the word}
verses.nlt_text: God has given me the responsibility of serving his church by proclaiming his entire message to you.

verses.kjv_text: {Even} the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
verses.nlt_text: This message was kept secret for centuries and generations past, but now it has been revealed to God's people.

verses.kjv_text: To whom God would make known what {is} the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory: {in: or, among}
verses.nlt_text: For God wanted them to know that the riches and glory of Christ are for you Gentiles, too. And this is the secret: Christ lives in you. This gives you assurance of sharing his glory.

verses.kjv_text: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
verses.nlt_text: So we tell others about Christ, warning everyone and teaching everyone with all the wisdom God has given us. We want to present them to God, perfect in their relationship to Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
verses.nlt_text: That's why I work and struggle so hard, depending on Christ's mighty power that works within me.

verses.kjv_text: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and {for} them at Laodicea, and {for} as many as have not seen my face in the flesh; {conflict: or, fear, or, care}
verses.nlt_text: I want you to know how much I have agonized for you and for the church at Laodicea, and for many other believers who have never met me personally.

verses.kjv_text: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
verses.nlt_text: I want them to be encouraged and knit together by strong ties of love. I want them to have complete confidence that they understand God's mysterious plan, which is Christ himself.

verses.kjv_text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge. {In whom: or, Wherein}
verses.nlt_text: In him lie hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.nlt_text: I am telling you this so no one will deceive you with well-crafted arguments.

verses.kjv_text: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.nlt_text: For though I am far away from you, my heart is with you. And I rejoice that you are living as you should and that your faith in Christ is strong.

verses.kjv_text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, {so} walk ye in him:
verses.nlt_text: And now, just as you accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord, you must continue to follow him.

verses.kjv_text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.nlt_text: Let your roots grow down into him, and let your lives be built on him. Then your faith will grow strong in the truth you were taught, and you will overflow with thankfulness.

verses.kjv_text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ. {rudiments: or, elements} {make a prey: or, seduce you, or, lead you astray}
verses.nlt_text: Don't let anyone capture you with empty philosophies and high-sounding nonsense that come from human thinking and from the spiritual powers of this world, rather than from Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.nlt_text: For in Christ lives all the fullness of God in a human body.

verses.kjv_text: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.nlt_text: So you also are complete through your union with Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.

verses.kjv_text: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
verses.nlt_text: When you came to Christ, you were "circumcised," but not by a physical procedure. Christ performed a spiritual circumcision-- the cutting away of your sinful nature.

verses.kjv_text: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with {him} through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
verses.nlt_text: For you were buried with Christ when you were baptized. And with him you were raised to new life because you trusted the mighty power of God, who raised Christ from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.nlt_text: You were dead because of your sins and because your sinful nature was not yet cut away. Then God made you alive with Christ, for he forgave all our sins.

verses.kjv_text: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.nlt_text: He canceled the record of the charges against us and took it away by nailing it to the cross.

verses.kjv_text: {And} having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it. {in it: or, in himself}
verses.nlt_text: In this way, he disarmed the spiritual rulers and authorities. He shamed them publicly by his victory over them on the cross.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath {days}: {in meat...: or, for eating and drinking} {respect: or, part}
verses.nlt_text: So don't let anyone condemn you for what you eat or drink, or for not celebrating certain holy days or new moon ceremonies or Sabbaths.

verses.kjv_text: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body {is} of Christ.
verses.nlt_text: For these rules are only shadows of the reality yet to come. And Christ himself is that reality.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind, {beguile...: or, judge against you} {in a...: Gr. being a voluntary in humility}
verses.nlt_text: Don't let anyone condemn you by insisting on pious self-denial or the worship of angels, saying they have had visions about these things. Their sinful minds have made them proud,

verses.kjv_text: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.nlt_text: and they are not connected to Christ, the head of the body. For he holds the whole body together with its joints and ligaments, and it grows as God nourishes it.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances, {rudiments: or, elements}
verses.nlt_text: You have died with Christ, and he has set you free from the spiritual powers of this world. So why do you keep on following the rules of the world, such as,

verses.kjv_text: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.nlt_text: "Don't handle! Don't taste! Don't touch!"?

verses.kjv_text: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.nlt_text: Such rules are mere human teachings about things that deteriorate as we use them.

verses.kjv_text: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh. {neglecting: or, punishing, or, not sparing}
verses.nlt_text: These rules may seem wise because they require strong devotion, pious self-denial, and severe bodily discipline. But they provide no help in conquering a person's evil desires.

verses.kjv_text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verses.nlt_text: Since you have been raised to new life with Christ, set your sights on the realities of heaven, where Christ sits in the place of honor at God's right hand.

verses.kjv_text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth. {affection: or, mind}
verses.nlt_text: Think about the things of heaven, not the things of earth.

verses.kjv_text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.nlt_text: For you died to this life, and your real life is hidden with Christ in God.

verses.kjv_text: When Christ, {who is} our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
verses.nlt_text: And when Christ, who is your life, is revealed to the whole world, you will share in all his glory.

verses.kjv_text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.nlt_text: So put to death the sinful, earthly things lurking within you. Have nothing to do with sexual immorality, impurity, lust, and evil desires. Don't be greedy, for a greedy person is an idolater, worshiping the things of this world.

verses.kjv_text: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
verses.nlt_text: Because of these sins, the anger of God is coming.

verses.kjv_text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
verses.nlt_text: You used to do these things when your life was still part of this world.

verses.kjv_text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.nlt_text: But now is the time to get rid of anger, rage, malicious behavior, slander, and dirty language.

verses.kjv_text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.nlt_text: Don't lie to each other, for you have stripped off your old sinful nature and all its wicked deeds.

verses.kjv_text: And have put on the new {man}, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.nlt_text: Put on your new nature, and be renewed as you learn to know your Creator and become like him.

verses.kjv_text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond {nor} free: but Christ {is} all, and in all.
verses.nlt_text: In this new life, it doesn't matter if you are a Jew or a Gentile, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbaric, uncivilized, slave, or free. Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.

verses.kjv_text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.nlt_text: Since God chose you to be the holy people he loves, you must clothe yourselves with tenderhearted mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

verses.kjv_text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also {do} ye. {quarrel: or, complaint}
verses.nlt_text: Make allowance for each other's faults, and forgive anyone who offends you. Remember, the Lord forgave you, so you must forgive others.

verses.kjv_text: And above all these things {put on} charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.nlt_text: Above all, clothe yourselves with love, which binds us all together in perfect harmony.

verses.kjv_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.nlt_text: And let the peace that comes from Christ rule in your hearts. For as members of one body you are called to live in peace. And always be thankful.

verses.kjv_text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Let the message about Christ, in all its richness, fill your lives. Teach and counsel each other with all the wisdom he gives. Sing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs to God with thankful hearts.

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, {do} all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.nlt_text: And whatever you do or say, do it as a representative of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks through him to God the Father.

verses.kjv_text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting for those who belong to the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Husbands, love {your} wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.nlt_text: Husbands, love your wives and never treat them harshly.

verses.kjv_text: Children, obey {your} parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Children, always obey your parents, for this pleases the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Fathers, provoke not your children {to anger}, lest they be discouraged.
verses.nlt_text: Fathers, do not aggravate your children, or they will become discouraged.

verses.kjv_text: Servants, obey in all things {your} masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
verses.nlt_text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything you do. Try to please them all the time, not just when they are watching you. Serve them sincerely because of your reverent fear of the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever ye do, do {it} heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.nlt_text: Work willingly at whatever you do, as though you were working for the Lord rather than for people.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Remember that the Lord will give you an inheritance as your reward, and that the Master you are serving is Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.nlt_text: But if you do what is wrong, you will be paid back for the wrong you have done. For God has no favorites.

verses.kjv_text: Masters, give unto {your} servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.nlt_text: Masters, be just and fair to your slaves. Remember that you also have a Master-- in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.nlt_text: Devote yourselves to prayer with an alert mind and a thankful heart.

verses.kjv_text: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
verses.nlt_text: Pray for us, too, that God will give us many opportunities to speak about his mysterious plan concerning Christ. That is why I am here in chains.

verses.kjv_text: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.nlt_text: Pray that I will proclaim this message as clearly as I should.

verses.kjv_text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.nlt_text: Live wisely among those who are not believers, and make the most of every opportunity.

verses.kjv_text: Let your speech {be} alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.nlt_text: Let your conversation be gracious and attractive so that you will have the right response for everyone.

verses.kjv_text: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, {who is} a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.nlt_text: Tychicus will give you a full report about how I am getting along. He is a beloved brother and faithful helper who serves with me in the Lord's work.

verses.kjv_text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
verses.nlt_text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose-- to let you know how we are doing and to encourage you.

verses.kjv_text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is {one} of you. They shall make known unto you all things which {are done} here.
verses.nlt_text: I am also sending Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, one of your own people. He and Tychicus will tell you everything that's happening here.

verses.kjv_text: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
verses.nlt_text: Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, sends you his greetings, and so does Mark, Barnabas's cousin. As you were instructed before, make Mark welcome if he comes your way.

verses.kjv_text: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only {are my} fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus (the one we call Justus) also sends his greetings. These are the only Jewish believers among my co-workers; they are working with me here for the Kingdom of God. And what a comfort they have been!

verses.kjv_text: Epaphras, who is {one} of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God. {labouring...: or, striving} {complete: or, filled}
verses.nlt_text: Epaphras, a member of your own fellowship and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings. He always prays earnestly for you, asking God to make you strong and perfect, fully confident that you are following the whole will of God.

verses.kjv_text: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them {that are} in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.nlt_text: I can assure you that he prays hard for you and also for the believers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.

verses.kjv_text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.nlt_text: Luke, the beloved doctor, sends his greetings, and so does Demas.

verses.kjv_text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.nlt_text: Please give my greetings to our brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church that meets in her house.

verses.kjv_text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the {epistle} from Laodicea.
verses.nlt_text: After you have read this letter, pass it on to the church at Laodicea so they can read it, too. And you should read the letter I wrote to them.

verses.kjv_text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.nlt_text: And say to Archippus, "Be sure to carry out the ministry the Lord gave you."

verses.kjv_text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace {be} with you. Amen. «{Written from Rome to Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.}»
verses.nlt_text: HERE IS MY GREETING IN MY OWN HANDWRITING-- PAUL.Remember my chains.May God's grace be with you.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians {which is} in God the Father and {in} the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace {be} unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, Silas, and Timothy.We are writing to the church in Thessalonica, to you who belong to God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.May God give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.nlt_text: We always thank God for all of you and pray for you constantly.

verses.kjv_text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
verses.nlt_text: As we pray to our God and Father about you, we think of your faithful work, your loving deeds, and the enduring hope you have because of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God. {beloved...: or, beloved of God, your election}
verses.nlt_text: We know, dear brothers and sisters, that God loves you and has chosen you to be his own people.

verses.kjv_text: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.nlt_text: For when we brought you the Good News, it was not only with words but also with power, for the Holy Spirit gave you full assurance that what we said was true. And you know of our concern for you from the way we lived when we were with you.

verses.kjv_text: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
verses.nlt_text: So you received the message with joy from the Holy Spirit in spite of the severe suffering it brought you. In this way, you imitated both us and the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.nlt_text: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Greece-- throughout both Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.kjv_text: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
verses.nlt_text: And now the word of the Lord is ringing out from you to people everywhere, even beyond Macedonia and Achaia, for wherever we go we find people telling us about your faith in God. We don't need to tell them about it,

verses.kjv_text: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
verses.nlt_text: for they keep talking about the wonderful welcome you gave us and how you turned away from idols to serve the living and true God.

verses.kjv_text: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, {even} Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
verses.nlt_text: And they speak of how you are looking forward to the coming of God's Son from heaven-- Jesus, whom God raised from the dead. He is the one who has rescued us from the terrors of the coming judgment.

verses.kjv_text: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
verses.nlt_text: You yourselves know, dear brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not a failure.

verses.kjv_text: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
verses.nlt_text: You know how badly we had been treated at Philippi just before we came to you and how much we suffered there. Yet our God gave us the courage to declare his Good News to you boldly, in spite of great opposition.

verses.kjv_text: For our exhortation {was} not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
verses.nlt_text: So you can see we were not preaching with any deceit or impure motives or trickery.

verses.kjv_text: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
verses.nlt_text: For we speak as messengers approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News. Our purpose is to please God, not people. He alone examines the motives of our hearts.

verses.kjv_text: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God {is} witness:
verses.nlt_text: Never once did we try to win you with flattery, as you well know. And God is our witness that we were not pretending to be your friends just to get your money!

verses.kjv_text: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor {yet} of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ. {been...: or, used authority}
verses.nlt_text: As for human praise, we have never sought it from you or anyone else.

verses.kjv_text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
verses.nlt_text: As apostles of Christ we certainly had a right to make some demands of you, but instead we were like children among you. Or we were like a mother feeding and caring for her own children.

verses.kjv_text: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
verses.nlt_text: We loved you so much that we shared with you not only God's Good News but our own lives, too.

verses.kjv_text: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
verses.nlt_text: Don't you remember, dear brothers and sisters, how hard we worked among you? Night and day we toiled to earn a living so that we would not be a burden to any of you as we preached God's Good News to you.

verses.kjv_text: Ye {are} witnesses, and God {also}, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
verses.nlt_text: You yourselves are our witnesses-- and so is God-- that we were devout and honest and faultless toward all of you believers.

verses.kjv_text: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father {doth} his children,
verses.nlt_text: And you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children.

verses.kjv_text: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
verses.nlt_text: We pleaded with you, encouraged you, and urged you to live your lives in a way that God would consider worthy. For he called you to share in his Kingdom and glory.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received {it} not {as} the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, we never stop thanking God that when you received his message from us, you didn't think of our words as mere human ideas. You accepted what we said as the very word of God-- which, of course, it is. And this word continues to work in you who believe.

verses.kjv_text: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they {have} of the Jews:
verses.nlt_text: And then, dear brothers and sisters, you suffered persecution from your own countrymen. In this way, you imitated the believers in God's churches in Judea who, because of their belief in Christ Jesus, suffered from their own people, the Jews.

verses.kjv_text: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men: {persecuted us: or, chased us out}
verses.nlt_text: For some of the Jews killed the prophets, and some even killed the Lord Jesus. Now they have persecuted us, too. They fail to please God and work against all humanity

verses.kjv_text: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.nlt_text: as they try to keep us from preaching the Good News of salvation to the Gentiles. By doing this, they continue to pile up their sins. But the anger of God has caught up with them at last.

verses.kjv_text: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, after we were separated from you for a little while (though our hearts never left you), we tried very hard to come back because of our intense longing to see you again.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
verses.nlt_text: We wanted very much to come to you, and I, Paul, tried again and again, but Satan prevented us.

verses.kjv_text: For what {is} our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? {Are} not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming? {rejoicing: or, glorying?}
verses.nlt_text: After all, what gives us hope and joy, and what will be our proud reward and crown as we stand before our Lord Jesus when he returns? It is you!

verses.kjv_text: For ye are our glory and joy.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, you are our pride and joy.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
verses.nlt_text: Finally, when we could stand it no longer, we decided to stay alone in Athens,

verses.kjv_text: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
verses.nlt_text: and we sent Timothy to visit you. He is our brother and God's co-worker in proclaiming the Good News of Christ. We sent him to strengthen you, to encourage you in your faith,

verses.kjv_text: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto. {there unto: or, to sufferings, or, to persecution}
verses.nlt_text: and to keep you from being shaken by the troubles you were going through. But you know that we are destined for such troubles.

verses.kjv_text: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
verses.nlt_text: Even while we were with you, we warned you that troubles would soon come-- and they did, as you well know.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
verses.nlt_text: That is why, when I could bear it no longer, I sent Timothy to find out whether your faith was still strong. I was afraid that the tempter had gotten the best of you and that our work had been useless.

verses.kjv_text: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also {to see} you:
verses.nlt_text: But now Timothy has just returned, bringing us good news about your faith and love. He reports that you always remember our visit with joy and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
verses.nlt_text: So we have been greatly encouraged in the midst of our troubles and suffering, dear brothers and sisters, because you have remained strong in your faith.

verses.kjv_text: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: It gives us new life to know that you are standing firm in the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
verses.nlt_text: How we thank God for you! Because of you we have great joy as we enter God's presence.

verses.kjv_text: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.nlt_text: Night and day we pray earnestly for you, asking God to let us see you again to fill the gaps in your faith.

verses.kjv_text: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you. {direct: or, guide}
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and our Lord Jesus bring us to you very soon.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all {men}, even as we {do} toward you:
verses.nlt_text: And may the Lord make your love for one another and for all people grow and overflow, just as our love for you overflows.

verses.kjv_text: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints. {saints: or, holy ones, or, angels}
verses.nlt_text: May he, as a result, make your hearts strong, blameless, and holy as you stand before God our Father when our Lord Jesus comes again with all his holy people. Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort {you} by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, {so} ye would abound more and more. {beseech: or, request} {exhort: or, beseech}
verses.nlt_text: Finally, dear brothers and sisters, we urge you in the name of the Lord Jesus to live in a way that pleases God, as we have taught you. You live this way already, and we encourage you to do so even more.

verses.kjv_text: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: For you remember what we taught you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: For this is the will of God, {even} your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
verses.nlt_text: God's will is for you to be holy, so stay away from all sexual sin.

verses.kjv_text: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
verses.nlt_text: Then each of you will control his own body and live in holiness and honor--

verses.kjv_text: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
verses.nlt_text: not in lustful passion like the pagans who do not know God and his ways.

verses.kjv_text: That no {man} go beyond and defraud his brother in {any} matter: because that the Lord {is} the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified. {defraud: or, oppress, or, overreach} {in...: or, in the matter}
verses.nlt_text: Never harm or cheat a Christian brother in this matter by violating his wife, for the Lord avenges all such sins, as we have solemnly warned you before.

verses.kjv_text: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
verses.nlt_text: God has called us to live holy lives, not impure lives.

verses.kjv_text: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit. {despiseth: or, rejecteth}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, anyone who refuses to live by these rules is not disobeying human teaching but is rejecting God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.

verses.kjv_text: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
verses.nlt_text: But we don't need to write to you about the importance of loving each other, for God himself has taught you to love one another.

verses.kjv_text: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
verses.nlt_text: Indeed, you already show your love for all the believers throughout Macedonia. Even so, dear brothers and sisters, we urge you to love them even more.

verses.kjv_text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
verses.nlt_text: Make it your goal to live a quiet life, minding your own business and working with your hands, just as we instructed you before.

verses.kjv_text: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and {that} ye may have lack of nothing. {of...: or, of no man}
verses.nlt_text: Then people who are not Christians will respect the way you live, and you will not need to depend on others.

verses.kjv_text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
verses.nlt_text: And now, dear brothers and sisters, we want you to know what will happen to the believers who have died so you will not grieve like people who have no hope.

verses.kjv_text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
verses.nlt_text: For since we believe that Jesus died and was raised to life again, we also believe that when Jesus returns, God will bring back with him the believers who have died.

verses.kjv_text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive {and} remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep. {prevent: or, come before, or, anticipate, or, precede}
verses.nlt_text: We tell you this directly from the Lord: We who are still living when the Lord returns will not meet him ahead of those who have died.

verses.kjv_text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
verses.nlt_text: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven with a commanding shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet call of God. First, the Christians who have died will rise from their graves.

verses.kjv_text: Then we which are alive {and} remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Then, together with them, we who are still alive and remain on the earth will be caught up in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. Then we will be with the Lord forever.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words. {comfort: or, exhort}
verses.nlt_text: So encourage each other with these words.

verses.kjv_text: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Now concerning how and when all this will happen, dear brothers and sisters, we don't really need to write you.

verses.kjv_text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
verses.nlt_text: For you know quite well that the day of the Lord's return will come unexpectedly, like a thief in the night.

verses.kjv_text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
verses.nlt_text: When people are saying, "Everything is peaceful and secure," then disaster will fall on them as suddenly as a pregnant woman's labor pains begin. And there will be no escape.

verses.kjv_text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.nlt_text: But you aren't in the dark about these things, dear brothers and sisters, and you won't be surprised when the day of the Lord comes like a thief.

verses.kjv_text: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
verses.nlt_text: For you are all children of the light and of the day; we don't belong to darkness and night.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore let us not sleep, as {do} others; but let us watch and be sober.
verses.nlt_text: So be on your guard, not asleep like the others. Stay alert and be clearheaded.

verses.kjv_text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.nlt_text: Night is the time when people sleep and drinkers get drunk.

verses.kjv_text: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.nlt_text: But let us who live in the light be clearheaded, protected by the armor of faith and love, and wearing as our helmet the confidence of our salvation.

verses.kjv_text: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.nlt_text: For God chose to save us through our Lord Jesus Christ, not to pour out his anger on us.

verses.kjv_text: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.nlt_text: Christ died for us so that, whether we are dead or alive when he returns, we can live with him forever.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do. {comfort: or, exhort}
verses.nlt_text: So encourage each other and build each other up, just as you are already doing.

verses.kjv_text: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, honor those who are your leaders in the Lord's work. They work hard among you and give you spiritual guidance.

verses.kjv_text: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. {And} be at peace among yourselves.
verses.nlt_text: Show them great respect and wholehearted love because of their work. And live peacefully with each other.

verses.kjv_text: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all {men}. {exhort: or, beseech} {unruly: or, disorderly}
verses.nlt_text: Brothers and sisters, we urge you to warn those who are lazy. Encourage those who are timid. Take tender care of those who are weak. Be patient with everyone.

verses.kjv_text: See that none render evil for evil unto any {man}; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all {men}.
verses.nlt_text: See that no one pays back evil for evil, but always try to do good to each other and to all people.

verses.kjv_text: Rejoice evermore.
verses.nlt_text: Always be joyful.

verses.kjv_text: Pray without ceasing.
verses.nlt_text: Never stop praying.

verses.kjv_text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.nlt_text: Be thankful in all circumstances, for this is God's will for you who belong to Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Quench not the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: Do not stifle the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Despise not prophesyings.
verses.nlt_text: Do not scoff at prophecies,

verses.kjv_text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.nlt_text: but test everything that is said. Hold on to what is good.

verses.kjv_text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
verses.nlt_text: Stay away from every kind of evil.

verses.kjv_text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and {I pray God} your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Now may the God of peace make you holy in every way, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless until our Lord Jesus Christ comes again.

verses.kjv_text: Faithful {is} he that calleth you, who also will do {it}.
verses.nlt_text: God will make this happen, for he who calls you is faithful.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, pray for us.

verses.kjv_text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
verses.nlt_text: Greet all the brothers and sisters with Christian love.

verses.kjv_text: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren. {charge: or, adjure}
verses.nlt_text: I command you in the name of the Lord to read this letter to all the brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you. Amen. «{The first epistle} to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.»
verses.nlt_text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, Silas, and Timothy.We are writing to the church in Thessalonica, to you who belong to God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, we can't help but thank God for you, because your faith is flourishing and your love for one another is growing.

verses.kjv_text: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
verses.nlt_text: We proudly tell God's other churches about your endurance and faithfulness in all the persecutions and hardships you are suffering.

verses.kjv_text: {Which is} a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
verses.nlt_text: And God will use this persecution to show his justice and to make you worthy of his Kingdom, for which you are suffering.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing {it is} a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
verses.nlt_text: In his justice he will pay back those who persecute you.

verses.kjv_text: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, {his...: Gr. the angels of his power}
verses.nlt_text: And God will provide rest for you who are being persecuted and also for us when the Lord Jesus appears from heaven. He will come with his mighty angels,

verses.kjv_text: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ: {taking: or, yielding}
verses.nlt_text: in flaming fire, bringing judgment on those who don't know God and on those who refuse to obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
verses.nlt_text: They will be punished with eternal destruction, forever separated from the Lord and from his glorious power.

verses.kjv_text: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
verses.nlt_text: When he comes on that day, he will receive glory from his holy people-- praise from all who believe. And this includes you, for you believed what we told you about him.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of {this} calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of {his} goodness, and the work of faith with power: {count: or, vouchsafe}
verses.nlt_text: So we keep on praying for you, asking our God to enable you to live a life worthy of his call. May he give you the power to accomplish all the good things your faith prompts you to do.

verses.kjv_text: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Then the name of our Lord Jesus will be honored because of the way you live, and you will be honored along with him. This is all made possible because of the grace of our God and our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and {by} our gathering together unto him, {unto him: or, around him}
verses.nlt_text: Now, dear brothers and sisters, let us clarify some things about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and how we will be gathered to meet him.

verses.kjv_text: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be so easily shaken or alarmed by those who say that the day of the Lord has already begun. Don't believe them, even if they claim to have had a spiritual vision, a revelation, or a letter supposedly from us.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man deceive you by any means: for {that day shall not come}, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.nlt_text: Don't be fooled by what they say. For that day will not come until there is a great rebellion against God and the man of lawlessness is revealed-- the one who brings destruction.

verses.kjv_text: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
verses.nlt_text: He will exalt himself and defy everything that people call god and every object of worship. He will even sit in the temple of God, claiming that he himself is God.

verses.kjv_text: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.nlt_text: Don't you remember that I told you about all this when I was with you?

verses.kjv_text: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time. {withholdeth: or, holdeth}
verses.nlt_text: And you know what is holding him back, for he can be revealed only when his time comes.
