verses.kjv_text: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth {will let}, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.nlt_text: For this lawlessness is already at work secretly, and it will remain secret until the one who is holding it back steps out of the way.

verses.kjv_text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.nlt_text: Then the man of lawlessness will be revealed, but the Lord Jesus will kill him with the breath of his mouth and destroy him by the splendor of his coming.

verses.kjv_text: {Even him}, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.nlt_text: This man will come to do the work of Satan with counterfeit power and signs and miracles.

verses.kjv_text: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.nlt_text: He will use every kind of evil deception to fool those on their way to destruction, because they refuse to love and accept the truth that would save them.

verses.kjv_text: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.nlt_text: So God will cause them to be greatly deceived, and they will believe these lies.

verses.kjv_text: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.nlt_text: Then they will be condemned for enjoying evil rather than believing the truth.

verses.kjv_text: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.nlt_text: As for us, we can't help but thank God for you, dear brothers and sisters loved by the Lord. We are always thankful that God chose you to be among the first to experience salvation-- a salvation that came through the Spirit who makes you holy and through your belief in the truth.

verses.kjv_text: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: He called you to salvation when we told you the Good News; now you can share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
verses.nlt_text: With all these things in mind, dear brothers and sisters, stand firm and keep a strong grip on the teaching we passed on to you both in person and by letter.

verses.kjv_text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given {us} everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
verses.nlt_text: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope,

verses.kjv_text: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verses.nlt_text: comfort you and strengthen you in every good thing you do and say.

verses.kjv_text: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have {free} course, and be glorified, even as {it is} with you: {have...: Gr. run}
verses.nlt_text: Finally, dear brothers and sisters, we ask you to pray for us. Pray that the Lord's message will spread rapidly and be honored wherever it goes, just as when it came to you.

verses.kjv_text: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all {men} have not faith. {unreasonable: Gr. absurd}
verses.nlt_text: Pray, too, that we will be rescued from wicked and evil people, for not everyone is a believer.

verses.kjv_text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep {you} from evil.
verses.nlt_text: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

verses.kjv_text: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.nlt_text: And we are confident in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we commanded you.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ. {patient...: or, patience of Christ}
verses.nlt_text: May the Lord lead your hearts into a full understanding and expression of the love of God and the patient endurance that comes from Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.nlt_text: And now, dear brothers and sisters, we give you this command in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ: Stay away from all believers who live idle lives and don't follow the tradition they received from us.

verses.kjv_text: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.nlt_text: For you know that you ought to imitate us. We were not idle when we were with you.

verses.kjv_text: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.nlt_text: We never accepted food from anyone without paying for it. We worked hard day and night so we would not be a burden to any of you.

verses.kjv_text: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.nlt_text: We certainly had the right to ask you to feed us, but we wanted to give you an example to follow.

verses.kjv_text: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.nlt_text: Even while we were with you, we gave you this command: "Those unwilling to work will not get to eat."

verses.kjv_text: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.nlt_text: Yet we hear that some of you are living idle lives, refusing to work and meddling in other people's business.

verses.kjv_text: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.nlt_text: We command such people and urge them in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and work to earn their own living.

verses.kjv_text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing. {be...: or, faint not}
verses.nlt_text: As for the rest of you, dear brothers and sisters, never get tired of doing good.

verses.kjv_text: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed. {by...: or, signify that man by an epistle}
verses.nlt_text: Take note of those who refuse to obey what we say in this letter. Stay away from them so they will be ashamed.

verses.kjv_text: Yet count {him} not as an enemy, but admonish {him} as a brother.
verses.nlt_text: Don't think of them as enemies, but warn them as you would a brother or sister.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord {be} with you all.
verses.nlt_text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you his peace at all times and in every situation. The Lord be with you all.

verses.kjv_text: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.nlt_text: HERE IS MY GREETING IN MY OWN HANDWRITING-- PAUL. I DO THIS IN ALL MY LETTERS TO PROVE THEY ARE FROM ME.

verses.kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you all. Amen. «{The second epistle} to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.»
verses.nlt_text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, {which is} our hope;
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, appointed by the command of God our Savior and Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.

verses.kjv_text: Unto Timothy, {my} own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing to Timothy, my true son in the faith.May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

verses.kjv_text: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.nlt_text: When I left for Macedonia, I urged you to stay there in Ephesus and stop those whose teaching is contrary to the truth.

verses.kjv_text: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: {so do}.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let them waste their time in endless discussion of myths and spiritual pedigrees. These things only lead to meaningless speculations, which don't help people live a life of faith in God.

verses.kjv_text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and {of} a good conscience, and {of} faith unfeigned:
verses.nlt_text: The purpose of my instruction is that all believers would be filled with love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and genuine faith.

verses.kjv_text: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling; {having...: or, not aiming at}
verses.nlt_text: But some people have missed this whole point. They have turned away from these things and spend their time in meaningless discussions.

verses.kjv_text: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.nlt_text: They want to be known as teachers of the law of Moses, but they don't know what they are talking about, even though they speak so confidently.

verses.kjv_text: But we know that the law {is} good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.nlt_text: We know that the law is good when used correctly.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.nlt_text: For the law was not intended for people who do what is right. It is for people who are lawless and rebellious, who are ungodly and sinful, who consider nothing sacred and defile what is holy, who kill their father or mother or commit other murders.

verses.kjv_text: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.nlt_text: The law is for people who are sexually immoral, or who practice homosexuality, or are slave traders, liars, promise breakers, or who do anything else that contradicts the wholesome teaching

verses.kjv_text: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.nlt_text: that comes from the glorious Good News entrusted to me by our blessed God.

verses.kjv_text: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.nlt_text: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength to do his work. He considered me trustworthy and appointed me to serve him,

verses.kjv_text: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did {it} ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.nlt_text: even though I used to blaspheme the name of Christ. In my insolence, I persecuted his people. But God had mercy on me because I did it in ignorance and unbelief.

verses.kjv_text: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Oh, how generous and gracious our Lord was! He filled me with the faith and love that come from Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.nlt_text: This is a trustworthy saying, and everyone should accept it: "Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners"-- and I am the worst of them all.

verses.kjv_text: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.nlt_text: But God had mercy on me so that Christ Jesus could use me as a prime example of his great patience with even the worst sinners. Then others will realize that they, too, can believe in him and receive eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, {be} honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: All honor and glory to God forever and ever! He is the eternal King, the unseen one who never dies; he alone is God. Amen.

verses.kjv_text: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.nlt_text: Timothy, my son, here are my instructions for you, based on the prophetic words spoken about you earlier. May they help you fight well in the Lord's battles.

verses.kjv_text: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.nlt_text: Cling to your faith in Christ, and keep your conscience clear. For some people have deliberately violated their consciences; as a result, their faith has been shipwrecked.

verses.kjv_text: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.nlt_text: Hymenaeus and Alexander are two examples. I threw them out and handed them over to Satan so they might learn not to blaspheme God.

verses.kjv_text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, {and} giving of thanks, be made for all men; {exhort: or, desire}
verses.nlt_text: I urge you, first of all, to pray for all people. Ask God to help them; intercede on their behalf, and give thanks for them.

verses.kjv_text: For kings, and {for} all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty. {authority: or, eminent place}
verses.nlt_text: Pray this way for kings and all who are in authority so that we can live peaceful and quiet lives marked by godliness and dignity.

verses.kjv_text: For this {is} good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.nlt_text: This is good and pleases God our Savior,

verses.kjv_text: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.nlt_text: who wants everyone to be saved and to understand the truth.

verses.kjv_text: For {there is} one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.nlt_text: For there is only one God and one Mediator who can reconcile God and humanity-- the man Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time. {to...: or, a testimony}
verses.nlt_text: He gave his life to purchase freedom for everyone. This is the message God gave to the world at just the right time.

verses.kjv_text: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, {and} lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.nlt_text: And I have been chosen as a preacher and apostle to teach the Gentiles this message about faith and truth. I'm not exaggerating-- just telling the truth.

verses.kjv_text: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.nlt_text: In every place of worship, I want men to pray with holy hands lifted up to God, free from anger and controversy.

verses.kjv_text: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array; {broided: or, plaited}
verses.nlt_text: And I want women to be modest in their appearance. They should wear decent and appropriate clothing and not draw attention to themselves by the way they fix their hair or by wearing gold or pearls or expensive clothes.

verses.kjv_text: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.nlt_text: For women who claim to be devoted to God should make themselves attractive by the good things they do.

verses.kjv_text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.nlt_text: Women should learn quietly and submissively.

verses.kjv_text: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.nlt_text: I do not let women teach men or have authority over them. Let them listen quietly.

verses.kjv_text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.nlt_text: For God made Adam first, and afterward he made Eve.

verses.kjv_text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.nlt_text: And it was not Adam who was deceived by Satan. The woman was deceived, and sin was the result.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.nlt_text: But women will be saved through childbearing, assuming they continue to live in faith, love, holiness, and modesty.

verses.kjv_text: This {is} a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.nlt_text: This is a trustworthy saying: "If someone aspires to be an elder, he desires an honorable position."

verses.kjv_text: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach; {of good...: or, modest}
verses.nlt_text: So an elder must be a man whose life is above reproach. He must be faithful to his wife. He must exercise self-control, live wisely, and have a good reputation. He must enjoy having guests in his home, and he must be able to teach.

verses.kjv_text: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous; {given...: or, ready to quarrel, and offer wrong, as one in wine}
verses.nlt_text: He must not be a heavy drinker or be violent. He must be gentle, not quarrelsome, and not love money.

verses.kjv_text: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.nlt_text: He must manage his own family well, having children who respect and obey him.

verses.kjv_text: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.nlt_text: For if a man cannot manage his own household, how can he take care of God's church?

verses.kjv_text: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil. {a novice: or, one newly come to the faith}
verses.nlt_text: An elder must not be a new believer, because he might become proud, and the devil would cause him to fall.

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.nlt_text: Also, people outside the church must speak well of him so that he will not be disgraced and fall into the devil's trap.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise {must} the deacons {be} grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, deacons must be well respected and have integrity. They must not be heavy drinkers or dishonest with money.

verses.kjv_text: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.nlt_text: They must be committed to the mystery of the faith now revealed and must live with a clear conscience.

verses.kjv_text: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being {found} blameless.
verses.nlt_text: Before they are appointed as deacons, let them be closely examined. If they pass the test, then let them serve as deacons.

verses.kjv_text: Even so {must their} wives {be} grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, their wives must be respected and must not slander others. They must exercise self-control and be faithful in everything they do.

verses.kjv_text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.nlt_text: A deacon must be faithful to his wife, and he must manage his children and household well.

verses.kjv_text: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus. {used...: or, ministered}
verses.nlt_text: Those who do well as deacons will be rewarded with respect from others and will have increased confidence in their faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.nlt_text: I am writing these things to you now, even though I hope to be with you soon,

verses.kjv_text: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth. {ground: or, stay}
verses.nlt_text: so that if I am delayed, you will know how people must conduct themselves in the household of God. This is the church of the living God, which is the pillar and foundation of the truth.

verses.kjv_text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.nlt_text: Without question, this is the great mystery of our faith: Christ was revealed in a human body and vindicated by the Spirit. He was seen by angels and announced to the nations. He was believed in throughout the world and taken to heaven in glory.

verses.kjv_text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.nlt_text: Now the Holy Spirit tells us clearly that in the last times some will turn away from the true faith; they will follow deceptive spirits and teachings that come from demons.

verses.kjv_text: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.nlt_text: These people are hypocrites and liars, and their consciences are dead.

verses.kjv_text: Forbidding to marry, {and commanding} to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.nlt_text: They will say it is wrong to be married and wrong to eat certain foods. But God created those foods to be eaten with thanks by faithful people who know the truth.

verses.kjv_text: For every creature of God {is} good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.nlt_text: Since everything God created is good, we should not reject any of it but receive it with thanks.

verses.kjv_text: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.nlt_text: For we know it is made acceptable by the word of God and prayer.

verses.kjv_text: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.nlt_text: If you explain these things to the brothers and sisters, Timothy, you will be a worthy servant of Christ Jesus, one who is nourished by the message of faith and the good teaching you have followed.

verses.kjv_text: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself {rather} unto godliness.
verses.nlt_text: Do not waste time arguing over godless ideas and old wives' tales. Instead, train yourself to be godly.

verses.kjv_text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come. {little: or, for a little time}
verses.nlt_text: "Physical training is good, but training for godliness is much better, promising benefits in this life and in the life to come."

verses.kjv_text: This {is} a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.nlt_text: This is a trustworthy saying, and everyone should accept it.

verses.kjv_text: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.nlt_text: This is why we work hard and continue to struggle, for our hope is in the living God, who is the Savior of all people and particularly of all believers.

verses.kjv_text: These things command and teach.
verses.nlt_text: Teach these things and insist that everyone learn them.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.nlt_text: Don't let anyone think less of you because you are young. Be an example to all believers in what you say, in the way you live, in your love, your faith, and your purity.

verses.kjv_text: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.nlt_text: Until I get there, focus on reading the Scriptures to the church, encouraging the believers, and teaching them.

verses.kjv_text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.nlt_text: Do not neglect the spiritual gift you received through the prophecy spoken over you when the elders of the church laid their hands on you.

verses.kjv_text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all. {to all: or, in all things}
verses.nlt_text: Give your complete attention to these matters. Throw yourself into your tasks so that everyone will see your progress.

verses.kjv_text: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.nlt_text: Keep a close watch on how you live and on your teaching. Stay true to what is right for the sake of your own salvation and the salvation of those who hear you.

verses.kjv_text: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat {him} as a father; {and} the younger men as brethren;
verses.nlt_text: Never speak harshly to an older man, but appeal to him respectfully as you would to your own father. Talk to younger men as you would to your own brothers.

verses.kjv_text: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.nlt_text: Treat older women as you would your mother, and treat younger women with all purity as you would your own sisters.

verses.kjv_text: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.nlt_text: Take care of any widow who has no one else to care for her.

verses.kjv_text: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God. {piety: or, kindness}
verses.nlt_text: But if she has children or grandchildren, their first responsibility is to show godliness at home and repay their parents by taking care of them. This is something that pleases God.

verses.kjv_text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.nlt_text: Now a true widow, a woman who is truly alone in this world, has placed her hope in God. She prays night and day, asking God for his help.

verses.kjv_text: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth. {in...: or, delicately}
verses.nlt_text: But the widow who lives only for pleasure is spiritually dead even while she lives.

verses.kjv_text: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.nlt_text: Give these instructions to the church so that no one will be open to criticism.

verses.kjv_text: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel. {house: or, kindred}
verses.nlt_text: But those who won't care for their relatives, especially those in their own household, have denied the true faith. Such people are worse than unbelievers.

verses.kjv_text: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man, {taken...: or, chosen}
verses.nlt_text: A widow who is put on the list for support must be a woman who is at least sixty years old and was faithful to her husband.

verses.kjv_text: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.nlt_text: She must be well respected by everyone because of the good she has done. Has she brought up her children well? Has she been kind to strangers and served other believers humbly? Has she helped those who are in trouble? Has she always been ready to do good?

verses.kjv_text: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.nlt_text: The younger widows should not be on the list, because their physical desires will overpower their devotion to Christ and they will want to remarry.

verses.kjv_text: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.nlt_text: Then they would be guilty of breaking their previous pledge.

verses.kjv_text: And withal they learn {to be} idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.nlt_text: And if they are on the list, they will learn to be lazy and will spend their time gossiping from house to house, meddling in other people's business and talking about things they shouldn't.

verses.kjv_text: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully. {to speak...: Gr. for their railing}
verses.nlt_text: So I advise these younger widows to marry again, have children, and take care of their own homes. Then the enemy will not be able to say anything against them.

verses.kjv_text: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.nlt_text: For I am afraid that some of them have already gone astray and now follow Satan.

verses.kjv_text: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.nlt_text: If a woman who is a believer has relatives who are widows, she must take care of them and not put the responsibility on the church. Then the church can care for the widows who are truly alone.

verses.kjv_text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.nlt_text: Elders who do their work well should be respected and paid well, especially those who work hard at both preaching and teaching.

verses.kjv_text: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer {is} worthy of his reward.
verses.nlt_text: For the Scripture says, "You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain." And in another place, "Those who work deserve their pay!"

verses.kjv_text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses. {before: or, under}
verses.nlt_text: Do not listen to an accusation against an elder unless it is confirmed by two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv_text: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.nlt_text: Those who sin should be reprimanded in front of the whole church; this will serve as a strong warning to others.

verses.kjv_text: I charge {thee} before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality. {preferring...: or, prejudice}
verses.nlt_text: I solemnly command you in the presence of God and Christ Jesus and the holy angels to obey these instructions without taking sides or showing favoritism to anyone.

verses.kjv_text: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.nlt_text: Never be in a hurry about appointing a church leader. Do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

verses.kjv_text: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.nlt_text: Don't drink only water. You ought to drink a little wine for the sake of your stomach because you are sick so often.

verses.kjv_text: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some {men} they follow after.
verses.nlt_text: Remember, the sins of some people are obvious, leading them to certain judgment. But there are others whose sins will not be revealed until later.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also the good works {of some} are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, the good deeds of some people are obvious. And the good deeds done in secret will someday come to light.

verses.kjv_text: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and {his} doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.nlt_text: All slaves should show full respect for their masters so they will not bring shame on the name of God and his teaching.

verses.kjv_text: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise {them}, because they are brethren; but rather do {them} service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort. {faithful: or, believing}
verses.nlt_text: If the masters are believers, that is no excuse for being disrespectful. Those slaves should work all the harder because their efforts are helping other believers who are well loved. Teach these things, Timothy, and encourage everyone to obey them.

verses.kjv_text: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, {even} the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.nlt_text: Some people may contradict our teaching, but these are the wholesome teachings of the Lord Jesus Christ. These teachings promote a godly life.

verses.kjv_text: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings, {proud: or, a fool} {doting: or, sick}
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who teaches something different is arrogant and lacks understanding. Such a person has an unhealthy desire to quibble over the meaning of words. This stirs up arguments ending in jealousy, division, slander, and evil suspicions.

verses.kjv_text: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself. {Perverse...: or, Gallings one of another}
verses.nlt_text: These people always cause trouble. Their minds are corrupt, and they have turned their backs on the truth. To them, a show of godliness is just a way to become wealthy.

verses.kjv_text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.nlt_text: Yet true godliness with contentment is itself great wealth.

verses.kjv_text: For we brought nothing into {this} world, {and it is} certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.nlt_text: After all, we brought nothing with us when we came into the world, and we can't take anything with us when we leave it.

verses.kjv_text: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.nlt_text: So if we have enough food and clothing, let us be content.

verses.kjv_text: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and {into} many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.nlt_text: But people who long to be rich fall into temptation and are trapped by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.

verses.kjv_text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows. {erred: or, been seduced}
verses.nlt_text: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. And some people, craving money, have wandered from the true faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.

verses.kjv_text: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.nlt_text: But you, Timothy, are a man of God; so run from all these evil things. Pursue righteousness and a godly life, along with faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

verses.kjv_text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.nlt_text: Fight the good fight for the true faith. Hold tightly to the eternal life to which God has called you, which you have confessed so well before many witnesses.

verses.kjv_text: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and {before} Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession; {confession: or, profession}
verses.nlt_text: And I charge you before God, who gives life to all, and before Christ Jesus, who gave a good testimony before Pontius Pilate,

verses.kjv_text: That thou keep {this} commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.nlt_text: that you obey this command without wavering. Then no one can find fault with you from now until our Lord Jesus Christ comes again.

verses.kjv_text: Which in his times he shall shew, {who is} the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.nlt_text: For at just the right time Christ will be revealed from heaven by the blessed and only almighty God, the King of all kings and Lord of all lords.

verses.kjv_text: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom {be} honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: He alone can never die, and he lives in light so brilliant that no human can approach him. No human eye has ever seen him, nor ever will. All honor and power to him forever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy; {uncertain...: Gr. uncertainty of riches}
verses.nlt_text: Teach those who are rich in this world not to be proud and not to trust in their money, which is so unreliable. Their trust should be in God, who richly gives us all we need for our enjoyment.

verses.kjv_text: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate; {willing...: or, sociable}
verses.nlt_text: Tell them to use their money to do good. They should be rich in good works and generous to those in need, always being ready to share with others.

verses.kjv_text: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: By doing this they will be storing up their treasure as a good foundation for the future so that they may experience true life.

verses.kjv_text: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane {and} vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called: {science: Gr. knowledge}
verses.nlt_text: Timothy, guard what God has entrusted to you. Avoid godless, foolish discussions with those who oppose you with their so-called knowledge.

verses.kjv_text: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace {be} with thee. Amen. «{The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.}»
verses.nlt_text: Some people have wandered from the faith by following such foolishness.May God's grace be with you all.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. I have been sent out to tell others about the life he has promised through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: To Timothy, {my} dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing to Timothy, my dear son.May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

verses.kjv_text: I thank God, whom I serve from {my} forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.nlt_text: Timothy, I thank God for you-- the God I serve with a clear conscience, just as my ancestors did. Night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

verses.kjv_text: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy; {Greatly...: or, remembering thy tears, I greatly desire to see thee that}
verses.nlt_text: I long to see you again, for I remember your tears as we parted. And I will be filled with joy when we are together again.

verses.kjv_text: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.nlt_text: I remember your genuine faith, for you share the faith that first filled your grandmother Lois and your mother, Eunice. And I know that same faith continues strong in you.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.nlt_text: This is why I remind you to fan into flames the spiritual gift God gave you when I laid my hands on you.

verses.kjv_text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.nlt_text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear and timidity, but of power, love, and self-discipline.

verses.kjv_text: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.nlt_text: So never be ashamed to tell others about our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, either, even though I'm in prison for him. With the strength God gives you, be ready to suffer with me for the sake of the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: Who hath saved us, and called {us} with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.nlt_text: For God saved us and called us to live a holy life. He did this, not because we deserved it, but because that was his plan from before the beginning of time-- to show us his grace through Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.nlt_text: And now he has made all of this plain to us by the appearing of Christ Jesus, our Savior. He broke the power of death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the Good News.

verses.kjv_text: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.nlt_text: And God chose me to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of this Good News.

verses.kjv_text: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day. {believed: or, trusted}
verses.nlt_text: That is why I am suffering here in prison. But I am not ashamed of it, for I know the one in whom I trust, and I am sure that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until the day of his return.

verses.kjv_text: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Hold on to the pattern of wholesome teaching you learned from me-- a pattern shaped by the faith and love that you have in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.nlt_text: Through the power of the Holy Spirit who lives within us, carefully guard the precious truth that has been entrusted to you.

verses.kjv_text: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.nlt_text: As you know, everyone from the province of Asia has deserted me-- even Phygelus and Hermogenes.

verses.kjv_text: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.nlt_text: May the Lord show special kindness to Onesiphorus and all his family because he often visited and encouraged me. He was never ashamed of me because I was in chains.

verses.kjv_text: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found {me}.
verses.nlt_text: When he came to Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.

verses.kjv_text: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.nlt_text: May the Lord show him special kindness on the day of Christ's return. And you know very well how helpful he was in Ephesus.

verses.kjv_text: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: Timothy, my dear son, be strong through the grace that God gives you in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also. {among: or, by}
verses.nlt_text: You have heard me teach things that have been confirmed by many reliable witnesses. Now teach these truths to other trustworthy people who will be able to pass them on to others.

verses.kjv_text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Endure suffering along with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of {this} life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.nlt_text: Soldiers don't get tied up in the affairs of civilian life, for then they cannot please the officer who enlisted them.

verses.kjv_text: And if a man also strive for masteries, {yet} is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.nlt_text: And athletes cannot win the prize unless they follow the rules.

verses.kjv_text: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits. {that...: or, labouring first, must be partaker of the fruits}
verses.nlt_text: And hardworking farmers should be the first to enjoy the fruit of their labor.

verses.kjv_text: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.nlt_text: Think about what I am saying. The Lord will help you understand all these things.

verses.kjv_text: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.nlt_text: Always remember that Jesus Christ, a descendant of King David, was raised from the dead. This is the Good News I preach.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, {even} unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.nlt_text: And because I preach this Good News, I am suffering and have been chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.nlt_text: So I am willing to endure anything if it will bring salvation and eternal glory in Christ Jesus to those God has chosen.

verses.kjv_text: {It is} a faithful saying: For if we be dead with {him}, we shall also live with {him}:
verses.nlt_text: This is a trustworthy saying: If we die with him, we will also live with him.

verses.kjv_text: If we suffer, we shall also reign with {him}: if we deny {him}, he also will deny us:
verses.nlt_text: If we endure hardship, we will reign with him. If we deny him, he will deny us.

verses.kjv_text: If we believe not, {yet} he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.nlt_text: If we are unfaithful, he remains faithful, for he cannot deny who he is.

verses.kjv_text: Of these things put {them} in remembrance, charging {them} before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, {but} to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.nlt_text: Remind everyone about these things, and command them in God's presence to stop fighting over words. Such arguments are useless, and they can ruin those who hear them.

verses.kjv_text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.nlt_text: Work hard so you can present yourself to God and receive his approval. Be a good worker, one who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly explains the word of truth.

verses.kjv_text: But shun profane {and} vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.nlt_text: Avoid worthless, foolish talk that only leads to more godless behavior.

verses.kjv_text: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus; {canker: or, gangrene}
verses.nlt_text: This kind of talk spreads like cancer, as in the case of Hymenaeus and Philetus.

verses.kjv_text: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.nlt_text: They have left the path of truth, claiming that the resurrection of the dead has already occurred; in this way, they have turned some people away from the faith.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity. {sure: or, steady}
verses.nlt_text: But God's truth stands firm like a foundation stone with this inscription: "The LORD knows those who are his," and "All who belong to the LORD must turn away from evil."

verses.kjv_text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.nlt_text: In a wealthy home some utensils are made of gold and silver, and some are made of wood and clay. The expensive utensils are used for special occasions, and the cheap ones are for everyday use.

verses.kjv_text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, {and} prepared unto every good work.
verses.nlt_text: If you keep yourself pure, you will be a special utensil for honorable use. Your life will be clean, and you will be ready for the Master to use you for every good work.

verses.kjv_text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.nlt_text: Run from anything that stimulates youthful lusts. Instead, pursue righteous living, faithfulness, love, and peace. Enjoy the companionship of those who call on the Lord with pure hearts.

verses.kjv_text: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.nlt_text: Again I say, don't get involved in foolish, ignorant arguments that only start fights.

verses.kjv_text: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all {men}, apt to teach, patient, {patient: or, forbearing}
verses.nlt_text: A servant of the Lord must not quarrel but must be kind to everyone, be able to teach, and be patient with difficult people.

verses.kjv_text: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.nlt_text: Gently instruct those who oppose the truth. Perhaps God will change those people's hearts, and they will learn the truth.

verses.kjv_text: And {that} they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will. {recover...: Gr. awake} {taken...: Gr. taken alive}
verses.nlt_text: Then they will come to their senses and escape from the devil's trap. For they have been held captive by him to do whatever he wants.

verses.kjv_text: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.nlt_text: You should know this, Timothy, that in the last days there will be very difficult times.

verses.kjv_text: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.nlt_text: For people will love only themselves and their money. They will be boastful and proud, scoffing at God, disobedient to their parents, and ungrateful. They will consider nothing sacred.

verses.kjv_text: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good, {false...: or, one who foments strife}
verses.nlt_text: They will be unloving and unforgiving; they will slander others and have no self-control. They will be cruel and hate what is good.

verses.kjv_text: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.nlt_text: They will betray their friends, be reckless, be puffed up with pride, and love pleasure rather than God.

verses.kjv_text: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.nlt_text: They will act religious, but they will reject the power that could make them godly. Stay away from people like that!

verses.kjv_text: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.nlt_text: They are the kind who work their way into people's homes and win the confidence of vulnerable women who are burdened with the guilt of sin and controlled by various desires.

verses.kjv_text: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.nlt_text: (Such women are forever following new teachings, but they are never able to understand the truth.)

verses.kjv_text: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith. {reprobate: or, of no judgment}
verses.nlt_text: These teachers oppose the truth just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses. They have depraved minds and a counterfeit faith.

verses.kjv_text: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all {men}, as theirs also was.
verses.nlt_text: But they won't get away with this for long. Someday everyone will recognize what fools they are, just as with Jannes and Jambres.

verses.kjv_text: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience, {fully...: or, been a diligent follower of}
verses.nlt_text: But you, Timothy, certainly know what I teach, and how I live, and what my purpose in life is. You know my faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.

verses.kjv_text: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of {them} all the Lord delivered me.
verses.nlt_text: You know how much persecution and suffering I have endured. You know all about how I was persecuted in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra-- but the Lord rescued me from all of it.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, and everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

verses.kjv_text: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.nlt_text: But evil people and impostors will flourish. They will deceive others and will themselves be deceived.

verses.kjv_text: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned {them};
verses.nlt_text: But you must remain faithful to the things you have been taught. You know they are true, for you know you can trust those who taught you.

verses.kjv_text: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: You have been taught the holy Scriptures from childhood, and they have given you the wisdom to receive the salvation that comes by trusting in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: All scripture {is} given by inspiration of God, and {is} profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.nlt_text: All Scripture is inspired by God and is useful to teach us what is true and to make us realize what is wrong in our lives. It corrects us when we are wrong and teaches us to do what is right.

verses.kjv_text: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works. {throughly...: or, perfected}
verses.nlt_text: God uses it to prepare and equip his people to do every good work.

verses.kjv_text: I charge {thee} therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.nlt_text: I solemnly urge you in the presence of God and Christ Jesus, who will someday judge the living and the dead when he appears to set up his Kingdom:

verses.kjv_text: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.nlt_text: Preach the word of God. Be prepared, whether the time is favorable or not. Patiently correct, rebuke, and encourage your people with good teaching.

verses.kjv_text: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.nlt_text: For a time is coming when people will no longer listen to sound and wholesome teaching. They will follow their own desires and will look for teachers who will tell them whatever their itching ears want to hear.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall turn away {their} ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.nlt_text: They will reject the truth and chase after myths.

verses.kjv_text: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry. {make...; or, fulfil}
verses.nlt_text: But you should keep a clear mind in every situation. Don't be afraid of suffering for the Lord. Work at telling others the Good News, and fully carry out the ministry God has given you.

verses.kjv_text: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.nlt_text: As for me, my life has already been poured out as an offering to God. The time of my death is near.

verses.kjv_text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished {my} course, I have kept the faith:
verses.nlt_text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, and I have remained faithful.

verses.kjv_text: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.nlt_text: And now the prize awaits me-- the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give me on the day of his return. And the prize is not just for me but for all who eagerly look forward to his appearing.

verses.kjv_text: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.nlt_text: Timothy, please come as soon as you can.

verses.kjv_text: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.nlt_text: Demas has deserted me because he loves the things of this life and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.

verses.kjv_text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.nlt_text: Only Luke is with me. Bring Mark with you when you come, for he will be helpful to me in my ministry.

verses.kjv_text: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.nlt_text: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

verses.kjv_text: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring {with thee}, and the books, {but} especially the parchments.
verses.nlt_text: When you come, be sure to bring the coat I left with Carpus at Troas. Also bring my books, and especially my papers.

verses.kjv_text: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.nlt_text: Alexander the coppersmith did me much harm, but the Lord will judge him for what he has done.

verses.kjv_text: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words. {our words: or, our preachings}
verses.nlt_text: Be careful of him, for he fought against everything we said.

verses.kjv_text: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all {men} forsook me: {I pray God} that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.nlt_text: The first time I was brought before the judge, no one came with me. Everyone abandoned me. May it not be counted against them.

verses.kjv_text: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and {that} all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.nlt_text: But the Lord stood with me and gave me strength so that I might preach the Good News in its entirety for all the Gentiles to hear. And he rescued me from certain death.

verses.kjv_text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve {me} unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, and the Lord will deliver me from every evil attack and will bring me safely into his heavenly Kingdom. All glory to God forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.nlt_text: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and those living in the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.kjv_text: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.nlt_text: Erastus stayed at Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick at Miletus.

verses.kjv_text: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.nlt_text: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: The Lord Jesus Christ {be} with thy spirit. Grace {be} with you. Amen. «{The second epistle} unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.»
verses.nlt_text: May the Lord be with your spirit. And may his grace be with all of you.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, a slave of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I have been sent to proclaim faith to those God has chosen and to teach them to know the truth that shows them how to live godly lives.

verses.kjv_text: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began; {In: or, For}
verses.nlt_text: This truth gives them confidence that they have eternal life, which God-- who does not lie-- promised them before the world began.

verses.kjv_text: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.nlt_text: And now at just the right time he has revealed this message, which we announce to everyone. It is by the command of God our Savior that I have been entrusted with this work for him.

verses.kjv_text: To Titus, {mine} own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing to Titus, my true son in the faith that we share.May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee: {wanting: or, left undone}
verses.nlt_text: I left you on the island of Crete so you could complete our work there and appoint elders in each town as I instructed you.

verses.kjv_text: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.nlt_text: An elder must live a blameless life. He must be faithful to his wife, and his children must be believers who don't have a reputation for being wild or rebellious.

verses.kjv_text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.nlt_text: For an elder must live a blameless life. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered; he must not be a heavy drinker, violent, or dishonest with money.

verses.kjv_text: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate; {men: or, things}
verses.nlt_text: Rather, he must enjoy having guests in his home, and he must love what is good. He must live wisely and be just. He must live a devout and disciplined life.

verses.kjv_text: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers. {as...: or, in teaching}
verses.nlt_text: He must have a strong belief in the trustworthy message he was taught; then he will be able to encourage others with wholesome teaching and show those who oppose it where they are wrong.

verses.kjv_text: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.nlt_text: For there are many rebellious people who engage in useless talk and deceive others. This is especially true of those who insist on circumcision for salvation.

verses.kjv_text: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.nlt_text: They must be silenced, because they are turning whole families away from the truth by their false teaching. And they do it only for money.

verses.kjv_text: One of themselves, {even} a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians {are} alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.nlt_text: Even one of their own men, a prophet from Crete, has said about them, "The people of Crete are all liars, cruel animals, and lazy gluttons."

verses.kjv_text: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.nlt_text: This is true. So reprimand them sternly to make them strong in the faith.

verses.kjv_text: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.nlt_text: They must stop listening to Jewish myths and the commands of people who have turned away from the truth.

verses.kjv_text: Unto the pure all things {are} pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving {is} nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.nlt_text: Everything is pure to those whose hearts are pure. But nothing is pure to those who are corrupt and unbelieving, because their minds and consciences are corrupted.

verses.kjv_text: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny {him}, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate. {reprobate: or, void of judgment}
verses.nlt_text: Such people claim they know God, but they deny him by the way they live. They are detestable and disobedient, worthless for doing anything good.

verses.kjv_text: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.nlt_text: As for you, Titus, promote the kind of living that reflects wholesome teaching.

verses.kjv_text: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience. {sober: or, vigilant}
verses.nlt_text: Teach the older men to exercise self-control, to be worthy of respect, and to live wisely. They must have sound faith and be filled with love and patience.

verses.kjv_text: The aged women likewise, that {they be} in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things; {holiness: or, holy women} {false...: or, one who foments strife}
verses.nlt_text: Similarly, teach the older women to live in a way that honors God. They must not slander others or be heavy drinkers. Instead, they should teach others what is good.

verses.kjv_text: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children, {sober: or, wise}
verses.nlt_text: These older women must train the younger women to love their husbands and their children,

verses.kjv_text: {To be} discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.nlt_text: to live wisely and be pure, to work in their homes, to do good, and to be submissive to their husbands. Then they will not bring shame on the word of God.

verses.kjv_text: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded. {sober...: or, discreet}
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, encourage the young men to live wisely.

verses.kjv_text: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine {shewing} uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.nlt_text: And you yourself must be an example to them by doing good works of every kind. Let everything you do reflect the integrity and seriousness of your teaching.

verses.kjv_text: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.nlt_text: Teach the truth so that your teaching can't be criticized. Then those who oppose us will be ashamed and have nothing bad to say about us.

verses.kjv_text: {Exhort} servants to be obedient unto their own masters, {and} to please {them} well in all {things}; not answering again; {answering...: or, gainsaying}
verses.nlt_text: Slaves must always obey their masters and do their best to please them. They must not talk back

verses.kjv_text: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.nlt_text: or steal, but must show themselves to be entirely trustworthy and good. Then they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive in every way.

verses.kjv_text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, {hath...: or, to all men, hath appeared}
verses.nlt_text: For the grace of God has been revealed, bringing salvation to all people.

verses.kjv_text: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.nlt_text: And we are instructed to turn from godless living and sinful pleasures. We should live in this evil world with wisdom, righteousness, and devotion to God,

verses.kjv_text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; {glorious...: Gr. the appearance of the glory of the great God, and of our Saviour Jesus Christ}
verses.nlt_text: while we look forward with hope to that wonderful day when the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, will be revealed.

verses.kjv_text: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.nlt_text: He gave his life to free us from every kind of sin, to cleanse us, and to make us his very own people, totally committed to doing good deeds.

verses.kjv_text: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.nlt_text: You must teach these things and encourage the believers to do them. You have the authority to correct them when necessary, so don't let anyone disregard what you say.

verses.kjv_text: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.nlt_text: Remind the believers to submit to the government and its officers. They should be obedient, always ready to do what is good.

verses.kjv_text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, {but} gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.nlt_text: They must not slander anyone and must avoid quarreling. Instead, they should be gentle and show true humility to everyone.

verses.kjv_text: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, {and} hating one another.
verses.nlt_text: Once we, too, were foolish and disobedient. We were misled and became slaves to many lusts and pleasures. Our lives were full of evil and envy, and we hated each other.

verses.kjv_text: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared, {love: or, pity}
verses.nlt_text: But-- "When God our Savior revealed his kindness and love,

verses.kjv_text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.nlt_text: he saved us, not because of the righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He washed away our sins, giving us a new birth and new life through the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour; {abundantly: Gr. richly}
verses.nlt_text: He generously poured out the Spirit upon us through Jesus Christ our Savior.

verses.kjv_text: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: Because of his grace he declared us righteous and gave us confidence that we will inherit eternal life."

verses.kjv_text: {This is} a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.nlt_text: This is a trustworthy saying, and I want you to insist on these teachings so that all who trust in God will devote themselves to doing good. These teachings are good and beneficial for everyone.

verses.kjv_text: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.nlt_text: Do not get involved in foolish discussions about spiritual pedigrees or in quarrels and fights about obedience to Jewish laws. These things are useless and a waste of time.

verses.kjv_text: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.nlt_text: If people are causing divisions among you, give a first and second warning. After that, have nothing more to do with them.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.nlt_text: For people like that have turned away from the truth, and their own sins condemn them.

verses.kjv_text: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.nlt_text: I am planning to send either Artemas or Tychicus to you. As soon as one of them arrives, do your best to meet me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to stay there for the winter.

verses.kjv_text: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.nlt_text: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos with their trip. See that they are given everything they need.

verses.kjv_text: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful. {maintain...: or, profess honest trades}
verses.nlt_text: Our people must learn to do good by meeting the urgent needs of others; then they will not be unproductive.

verses.kjv_text: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace {be} with you all. Amen. «{It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.}»
verses.nlt_text: Everybody here sends greetings. Please give my greetings to the believers-- all who love us.May God's grace be with you all.

verses.kjv_text: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy {our} brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Paul, a prisoner for preaching the Good News about Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy.I am writing to Philemon, our beloved co-worker,

verses.kjv_text: And to {our} beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
verses.nlt_text: and to our sister Apphia, and to our fellow soldier Archippus, and to the church that meets in your house.

verses.kjv_text: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
verses.nlt_text: I always thank my God when I pray for you, Philemon,

verses.kjv_text: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
verses.nlt_text: because I keep hearing about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of God's people.

verses.kjv_text: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
verses.nlt_text: And I am praying that you will put into action the generosity that comes from your faith as you understand and experience all the good things we have in Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
verses.nlt_text: Your love has given me much joy and comfort, my brother, for your kindness has often refreshed the hearts of God's people.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
verses.nlt_text: That is why I am boldly asking a favor of you. I could demand it in the name of Christ because it is the right thing for you to do.

verses.kjv_text: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech {thee}, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: But because of our love, I prefer simply to ask you. Consider this as a request from me-- Paul, an old man and now also a prisoner for the sake of Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
verses.nlt_text: I appeal to you to show kindness to my child, Onesimus. I became his father in the faith while here in prison.

verses.kjv_text: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
