verses.nlt_text: Onesimus hasn't been of much use to you in the past, but now he is very useful to both of us.

verses.kjv_text: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
verses.nlt_text: I am sending him back to you, and with him comes my own heart.

verses.kjv_text: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
verses.nlt_text: I wanted to keep him here with me while I am in these chains for preaching the Good News, and he would have helped me on your behalf.

verses.kjv_text: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
verses.nlt_text: But I didn't want to do anything without your consent. I wanted you to help because you were willing, not because you were forced.

verses.kjv_text: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
verses.nlt_text: It seems Onesimus ran away for a little while so that you could have him back forever.

verses.kjv_text: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
verses.nlt_text: He is no longer like a slave to you. He is more than a slave, for he is a beloved brother, especially to me. Now he will mean much more to you, both as a man and as a brother in the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
verses.nlt_text: So if you consider me your partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.

verses.kjv_text: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth {thee} ought, put that on mine account;
verses.nlt_text: If he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to me.

verses.kjv_text: I Paul have written {it} with mine own hand, I will repay {it}: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
verses.nlt_text: I, PAUL, WRITE THIS WITH MY OWN HAND: I WILL REPAY IT. AND I WON't mention that you owe me your very soul!

verses.kjv_text: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, my brother, please do me this favor for the Lord's sake. Give me this encouragement in Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
verses.nlt_text: I am confident as I write this letter that you will do what I ask and even more!

verses.kjv_text: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verses.nlt_text: One more thing-- please prepare a guest room for me, for I am hoping that God will answer your prayers and let me return to you soon.

verses.kjv_text: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
verses.nlt_text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings.

verses.kjv_text: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
verses.nlt_text: So do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my co-workers.

verses.kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with your spirit. Amen. «{Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.}»
verses.nlt_text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

verses.kjv_text: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.nlt_text: Long ago God spoke many times and in many ways to our ancestors through the prophets.

verses.kjv_text: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by {his} Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.nlt_text: And now in these final days, he has spoken to us through his Son. God promised everything to the Son as an inheritance, and through the Son he created the universe.

verses.kjv_text: Who being the brightness of {his} glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.nlt_text: The Son radiates God's own glory and expresses the very character of God, and he sustains everything by the mighty power of his command. When he had cleansed us from our sins, he sat down in the place of honor at the right hand of the majestic God in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.nlt_text: This shows that the Son is far greater than the angels, just as the name God gave him is greater than their names.

verses.kjv_text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.nlt_text: For God never said to any angel what he said to Jesus: "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. " God also said, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son."

verses.kjv_text: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him. {again...: or, when he bringeth again}
verses.nlt_text: And when he brought his firstborn Son into the world, God said, "Let all of God's angels worship him."

verses.kjv_text: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire. {And of: Gr. And unto}
verses.nlt_text: Regarding the angels, he says, "He sends his angels like the winds, his servants like flames of fire."

verses.kjv_text: But unto the Son {he saith}, Thy throne, O God, {is} for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness {is} the sceptre of thy kingdom. {righteousness: Gr. rightness, or, straightness}
verses.nlt_text: But to the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever. You rule with a scepter of justice.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, {even} thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.nlt_text: You love justice and hate evil. Therefore, O God, your God has anointed you, pouring out the oil of joy on you more than on anyone else."

verses.kjv_text: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.nlt_text: He also says to the Son, "In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundation of the earth and made the heavens with your hands.

verses.kjv_text: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.nlt_text: They will perish, but you remain forever. They will wear out like old clothing.

verses.kjv_text: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.nlt_text: You will fold them up like a cloak and discard them like old clothing. But you are always the same; you will live forever."

verses.kjv_text: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.nlt_text: And God never said to any of the angels, "Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet."

verses.kjv_text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, angels are only servants-- spirits sent to care for people who will inherit salvation.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let {them} slip. {let...: Gr. run out as leaking vessels}
verses.nlt_text: So we must listen very carefully to the truth we have heard, or we may drift away from it.

verses.kjv_text: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.nlt_text: For the message God delivered through angels has always stood firm, and every violation of the law and every act of disobedience was punished.

verses.kjv_text: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard {him};
verses.nlt_text: So what makes us think we can escape if we ignore this great salvation that was first announced by the Lord Jesus himself and then delivered to us by those who heard him speak?

verses.kjv_text: God also bearing {them} witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will? {gifts: or, distributions}
verses.nlt_text: And God confirmed the message by giving signs and wonders and various miracles and gifts of the Holy Spirit whenever he chose.

verses.kjv_text: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.nlt_text: And furthermore, it is not angels who will control the future world we are talking about.

verses.kjv_text: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.nlt_text: For in one place the Scriptures say, "What are people that you should think of them, or a son of man that you should care for him?

verses.kjv_text: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands: {lower...: or, while inferior to}
verses.nlt_text: Yet you made them only a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.

verses.kjv_text: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing {that is} not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.nlt_text: You gave them authority over all things." Now when it says "all things," it means nothing is left out. But we have not yet seen all things put under their authority.

verses.kjv_text: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man. {for the: or, by the}
verses.nlt_text: What we do see is Jesus, who was given a position "a little lower than the angels"; and because he suffered death for us, he is now "crowned with glory and honor." Yes, by God's grace, Jesus tasted death for everyone.

verses.kjv_text: For it became him, for whom {are} all things, and by whom {are} all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.nlt_text: God, for whom and through whom everything was made, chose to bring many children into glory. And it was only right that he should make Jesus, through his suffering, a perfect leader, fit to bring them into their salvation.

verses.kjv_text: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified {are} all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.nlt_text: So now Jesus and the ones he makes holy have the same Father. That is why Jesus is not ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.nlt_text: For he said to God, "I will proclaim your name to my brothers and sisters. I will praise you among your assembled people."

verses.kjv_text: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.nlt_text: He also said, "I will put my trust in him," that is, "I and the children God has given me."

verses.kjv_text: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.nlt_text: Because God's children are human beings-- made of flesh and blood-- the Son also became flesh and blood. For only as a human being could he die, and only by dying could he break the power of the devil, who had the power of death.

verses.kjv_text: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.nlt_text: Only in this way could he set free all who have lived their lives as slaves to the fear of dying.

verses.kjv_text: For verily he took not on {him the nature of} angels; but he took on {him} the seed of Abraham. {took not...: Gr. taketh not hold of angels, but of the seed of Abraham he taketh hold}
verses.nlt_text: We also know that the Son did not come to help angels; he came to help the descendants of Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto {his} brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things {pertaining} to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, it was necessary for him to be made in every respect like us, his brothers and sisters, so that he could be our merciful and faithful High Priest before God. Then he could offer a sacrifice that would take away the sins of the people.

verses.kjv_text: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.nlt_text: Since he himself has gone through suffering and testing, he is able to help us when we are being tested.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.nlt_text: And so, dear brothers and sisters who belong to God and are partners with those called to heaven, think carefully about this Jesus whom we declare to be God's messenger and High Priest.

verses.kjv_text: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses {was faithful} in all his house. {appointed: Gr. made}
verses.nlt_text: For he was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses served faithfully when he was entrusted with God's entire house.

verses.kjv_text: For this {man} was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.nlt_text: But Jesus deserves far more glory than Moses, just as a person who builds a house deserves more praise than the house itself.

verses.kjv_text: For every house is builded by some {man}; but he that built all things {is} God.
verses.nlt_text: For every house has a builder, but the one who built everything is God.

verses.kjv_text: And Moses verily {was} faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.nlt_text: Moses was certainly faithful in God's house as a servant. His work was an illustration of the truths God would reveal later.

verses.kjv_text: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.nlt_text: But Christ, as the Son, is in charge of God's entire house. And we are God's house, if we keep our courage and remain confident in our hope in Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.nlt_text: That is why the Holy Spirit says, "Today when you hear his voice,

verses.kjv_text: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.nlt_text: don't harden your hearts as Israel did when they rebelled, when they tested me in the wilderness.

verses.kjv_text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.nlt_text: There your ancestors tested and tried my patience, even though they saw my miracles for forty years.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in {their} heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.nlt_text: So I was angry with them, and I said, 'Their hearts always turn away from me. They refuse to do what I tell them.'

verses.kjv_text: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.) {They...: Gr. If they shall enter}
verses.nlt_text: So in my anger I took an oath: 'They will never enter my place of rest.' "

verses.kjv_text: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.nlt_text: Be careful then, dear brothers and sisters. Make sure that your own hearts are not evil and unbelieving, turning you away from the living God.

verses.kjv_text: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.nlt_text: You must warn each other every day, while it is still "today," so that none of you will be deceived by sin and hardened against God.

verses.kjv_text: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.nlt_text: For if we are faithful to the end, trusting God just as firmly as when we first believed, we will share in all that belongs to Christ.

verses.kjv_text: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.nlt_text: Remember what it says: "Today when you hear his voice, don't harden your hearts as Israel did when they rebelled."

verses.kjv_text: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.nlt_text: And who was it who rebelled against God, even though they heard his voice? Wasn't it the people Moses led out of Egypt?

verses.kjv_text: But with whom was he grieved forty years? {was it} not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.nlt_text: And who made God angry for forty years? Wasn't it the people who sinned, whose corpses lay in the wilderness?

verses.kjv_text: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.nlt_text: And to whom was God speaking when he took an oath that they would never enter his rest? Wasn't it the people who disobeyed him?

verses.kjv_text: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.nlt_text: So we see that because of their unbelief they were not able to enter his rest.

verses.kjv_text: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left {us} of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.nlt_text: God's promise of entering his rest still stands, so we ought to tremble with fear that some of you might fail to experience it.

verses.kjv_text: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard {it}. {the word...: Gr. the word of hearing} {not being...: or, because they were not united by faith to}
verses.nlt_text: For this good news-- that God has prepared this rest-- has been announced to us just as it was to them. But it did them no good because they didn't share the faith of those who listened to God.

verses.kjv_text: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.nlt_text: For only we who believe can enter his rest. As for the others, God said, "In my anger I took an oath: 'They will never enter my place of rest,' " even though this rest has been ready since he made the world.

verses.kjv_text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh {day} on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.nlt_text: We know it is ready because of the place in the Scriptures where it mentions the seventh day: "On the seventh day God rested from all his work."

verses.kjv_text: And in this {place} again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.nlt_text: But in the other passage God said, "They will never enter my place of rest."

verses.kjv_text: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief: {it was: or, the gospel was}
verses.nlt_text: So God's rest is there for people to enter, but those who first heard this good news failed to enter because they disobeyed God.

verses.kjv_text: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.nlt_text: So God set another time for entering his rest, and that time is today. God announced this through David much later in the words already quoted: "Today when you hear his voice, don't harden your hearts."

verses.kjv_text: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day. {Jesus: that is, Joshua}
verses.nlt_text: Now if Joshua had succeeded in giving them this rest, God would not have spoken about another day of rest still to come.

verses.kjv_text: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God. {rest: or, keeping of a sabbath}
verses.nlt_text: So there is a special rest still waiting for the people of God.

verses.kjv_text: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God {did} from his.
verses.nlt_text: For all who have entered into God's rest have rested from their labors, just as God did after creating the world.

verses.kjv_text: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief. {unbelief: or, disobedience}
verses.nlt_text: So let us do our best to enter that rest. But if we disobey God, as the people of Israel did, we will fall.

verses.kjv_text: For the word of God {is} quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and {is} a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.nlt_text: For the word of God is alive and powerful. It is sharper than the sharpest two-edged sword, cutting between soul and spirit, between joint and marrow. It exposes our innermost thoughts and desires.

verses.kjv_text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things {are} naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.nlt_text: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God. Everything is naked and exposed before his eyes, and he is the one to whom we are accountable.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast {our} profession.
verses.nlt_text: So then, since we have a great High Priest who has entered heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we believe.

verses.kjv_text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as {we are, yet} without sin.
verses.nlt_text: This High Priest of ours understands our weaknesses, for he faced all of the same testings we do, yet he did not sin.

verses.kjv_text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.nlt_text: So let us come boldly to the throne of our gracious God. There we will receive his mercy, and we will find grace to help us when we need it most.

verses.kjv_text: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things {pertaining} to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.nlt_text: Every high priest is a man chosen to represent other people in their dealings with God. He presents their gifts to God and offers sacrifices for their sins.

verses.kjv_text: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity. {can...: or, can reasonably bear with}
verses.nlt_text: And he is able to deal gently with ignorant and wayward people because he himself is subject to the same weaknesses.

verses.kjv_text: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.nlt_text: That is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins as well as theirs.

verses.kjv_text: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as {was} Aaron.
verses.nlt_text: And no one can become a high priest simply because he wants such an honor. He must be called by God for this work, just as Aaron was.

verses.kjv_text: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.nlt_text: That is why Christ did not honor himself by assuming he could become High Priest. No, he was chosen by God, who said to him, "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. "

verses.kjv_text: As he saith also in another {place}, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.nlt_text: And in another passage God said to him, "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.kjv_text: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared; {in that...: or, for his piety}
verses.nlt_text: While Jesus was here on earth, he offered prayers and pleadings, with a loud cry and tears, to the one who could rescue him from death. And God heard his prayers because of his deep reverence for God.

verses.kjv_text: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.nlt_text: Even though Jesus was God's Son, he learned obedience from the things he suffered.

verses.kjv_text: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.nlt_text: In this way, God qualified him as a perfect High Priest, and he became the source of eternal salvation for all those who obey him.

verses.kjv_text: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.nlt_text: And God designated him to be a High Priest in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.kjv_text: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.nlt_text: There is much more we would like to say about this, but it is difficult to explain, especially since you are spiritually dull and don't seem to listen.

verses.kjv_text: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which {be} the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.nlt_text: You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again the basic things about God's word. You are like babies who need milk and cannot eat solid food.

verses.kjv_text: For every one that useth milk {is} unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe. {is unskillful: Gr. hath no experience}
verses.nlt_text: For someone who lives on milk is still an infant and doesn't know how to do what is right.

verses.kjv_text: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, {even} those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil. {of full age: or, perfect} {use: or, an habit, or, perfection}
verses.nlt_text: Solid food is for those who are mature, who through training have the skill to recognize the difference between right and wrong.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God, {principles...: or, word of the beginning of}
verses.nlt_text: So let us stop going over the basic teachings about Christ again and again. Let us go on instead and become mature in our understanding. Surely we don't need to start again with the fundamental importance of repenting from evil deeds and placing our faith in God.

verses.kjv_text: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.nlt_text: You don't need further instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

verses.kjv_text: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.nlt_text: And so, God willing, we will move forward to further understanding.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
verses.nlt_text: For it is impossible to bring back to repentance those who were once enlightened-- those who have experienced the good things of heaven and shared in the Holy Spirit,

verses.kjv_text: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.nlt_text: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the power of the age to come--

verses.kjv_text: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put {him} to an open shame.
verses.nlt_text: and who then turn away from God. It is impossible to bring such people back to repentance; by rejecting the Son of God, they themselves are nailing him to the cross once again and holding him up to public shame.

verses.kjv_text: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God: {by: or, for}
verses.nlt_text: When the ground soaks up the falling rain and bears a good crop for the farmer, it has God's blessing.

verses.kjv_text: But that which beareth thorns and briers {is} rejected, and {is} nigh unto cursing; whose end {is} to be burned.
verses.nlt_text: But if a field bears thorns and thistles, it is useless. The farmer will soon condemn that field and burn it.

verses.kjv_text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, even though we are talking this way, we really don't believe it applies to you. We are confident that you are meant for better things, things that come with salvation.

verses.kjv_text: For God {is} not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.nlt_text: For God is not unjust. He will not forget how hard you have worked for him and how you have shown your love to him by caring for other believers, as you still do.

verses.kjv_text: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.nlt_text: Our great desire is that you will keep on loving others as long as life lasts, in order to make certain that what you hope for will come true.

verses.kjv_text: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.nlt_text: Then you will not become spiritually dull and indifferent. Instead, you will follow the example of those who are going to inherit God's promises because of their faith and endurance.

verses.kjv_text: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.nlt_text: For example, there was God's promise to Abraham. Since there was no one greater to swear by, God took an oath in his own name, saying:

verses.kjv_text: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.nlt_text: "I will certainly bless you, and I will multiply your descendants beyond number."

verses.kjv_text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham waited patiently, and he received what God had promised.

verses.kjv_text: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation {is} to them an end of all strife.
verses.nlt_text: Now when people take an oath, they call on someone greater than themselves to hold them to it. And without any question that oath is binding.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed {it} by an oath: {confirmed...: Gr. interposed himself by}
verses.nlt_text: God also bound himself with an oath, so that those who received the promise could be perfectly sure that he would never change his mind.

verses.kjv_text: That by two immutable things, in which {it was} impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verses.nlt_text: So God has given both his promise and his oath. These two things are unchangeable because it is impossible for God to lie. Therefore, we who have fled to him for refuge can have great confidence as we hold to the hope that lies before us.

verses.kjv_text: Which {hope} we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verses.nlt_text: This hope is a strong and trustworthy anchor for our souls. It leads us through the curtain into God's inner sanctuary.

verses.kjv_text: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, {even} Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus has already gone in there for us. He has become our eternal High Priest in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.kjv_text: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.nlt_text: This Melchizedek was king of the city of Salem and also a priest of God Most High. When Abraham was returning home after winning a great battle against the kings, Melchizedek met him and blessed him.

verses.kjv_text: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.nlt_text: Then Abraham took a tenth of all he had captured in battle and gave it to Melchizedek. The name Melchizedek means "king of justice," and king of Salem means "king of peace."

verses.kjv_text: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually. {without descent: Gr. without pedigree}
verses.nlt_text: There is no record of his father or mother or any of his ancestors-- no beginning or end to his life. He remains a priest forever, resembling the Son of God.

verses.kjv_text: Now consider how great this man {was}, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.nlt_text: Consider then how great this Melchizedek was. Even Abraham, the great patriarch of Israel, recognized this by giving him a tenth of what he had taken in battle.

verses.kjv_text: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.nlt_text: Now the law of Moses required that the priests, who are descendants of Levi, must collect a tithe from the rest of the people of Israel, who are also descendants of Abraham.

verses.kjv_text: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises. {descent: or, pedigree}
verses.nlt_text: But Melchizedek, who was not a descendant of Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham. And Melchizedek placed a blessing upon Abraham, the one who had already received the promises of God.

verses.kjv_text: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.nlt_text: And without question, the person who has the power to give a blessing is greater than the one who is blessed.

verses.kjv_text: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he {receiveth them}, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.nlt_text: The priests who collect tithes are men who die, so Melchizedek is greater than they are, because we are told that he lives on.

verses.kjv_text: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.nlt_text: In addition, we might even say that these Levites-- the ones who collect the tithe-- paid a tithe to Melchizedek when their ancestor Abraham paid a tithe to him.

verses.kjv_text: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.nlt_text: For although Levi wasn't born yet, the seed from which he came was in Abraham's body when Melchizedek collected the tithe from him.

verses.kjv_text: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need {was there} that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.nlt_text: So if the priesthood of Levi, on which the law was based, could have achieved the perfection God intended, why did God need to establish a different priesthood, with a priest in the order of Melchizedek instead of the order of Levi and Aaron?

verses.kjv_text: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.nlt_text: And if the priesthood is changed, the law must also be changed to permit it.

verses.kjv_text: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.nlt_text: For the priest we are talking about belongs to a different tribe, whose members have never served at the altar as priests.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.nlt_text: What I mean is, our Lord came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never mentioned priests coming from that tribe.

verses.kjv_text: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.nlt_text: This change has been made very clear since a different priest, who is like Melchizedek, has appeared.

verses.kjv_text: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus became a priest, not by meeting the physical requirement of belonging to the tribe of Levi, but by the power of a life that cannot be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: For he testifieth, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.nlt_text: And the psalmist pointed this out when he prophesied, "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.kjv_text: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.nlt_text: Yes, the old requirement about the priesthood was set aside because it was weak and useless.

verses.kjv_text: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope {did}; by the which we draw nigh unto God. {the bringing...: or, it was the bringing in}
verses.nlt_text: For the law never made anything perfect. But now we have confidence in a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

verses.kjv_text: And inasmuch as not without an oath {he was made priest}:
verses.nlt_text: This new system was established with a solemn oath. Aaron's descendants became priests without such an oath,

verses.kjv_text: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:) {without...: or, without swearing of an oath}
verses.nlt_text: but there was an oath regarding Jesus. For God said to him, "The LORD has taken an oath and will not break his vow: 'You are a priest forever.' "

verses.kjv_text: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.nlt_text: Because of this oath, Jesus is the one who guarantees this better covenant with God.

verses.kjv_text: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.nlt_text: There were many priests under the old system, for death prevented them from remaining in office.

verses.kjv_text: But this {man}, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood. {an...: or, which passeth not from one to another}
verses.nlt_text: But because Jesus lives forever, his priesthood lasts forever.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them. {to the...: or, evermore}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore he is able, once and forever, to save those who come to God through him. He lives forever to intercede with God on their behalf.

verses.kjv_text: For such an high priest became us, {who is} holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.nlt_text: He is the kind of high priest we need because he is holy and blameless, unstained by sin. He has been set apart from sinners and has been given the highest place of honor in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.nlt_text: Unlike those other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices every day. They did this for their own sins first and then for the sins of the people. But Jesus did this once for all when he offered himself as the sacrifice for the people's sins.

verses.kjv_text: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, {maketh} the Son, who is consecrated for evermore. {consecrated: Gr. perfected}
verses.nlt_text: The law appointed high priests who were limited by human weakness. But after the law was given, God appointed his Son with an oath, and his Son has been made the perfect High Priest forever.

verses.kjv_text: Now of the things which we have spoken {this is} the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.nlt_text: Here is the main point: We have a High Priest who sat down in the place of honor beside the throne of the majestic God in heaven.

verses.kjv_text: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man. {of the sanctuary: or, of holy things}
verses.nlt_text: There he ministers in the heavenly Tabernacle, the true place of worship that was built by the Lord and not by human hands.

verses.kjv_text: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore {it is} of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.nlt_text: And since every high priest is required to offer gifts and sacrifices, our High Priest must make an offering, too.

verses.kjv_text: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law: {there...: or, they are priests}
verses.nlt_text: If he were here on earth, he would not even be a priest, since there already are priests who offer the gifts required by the law.

verses.kjv_text: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, {that} thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
verses.nlt_text: They serve in a system of worship that is only a copy, a shadow of the real one in heaven. For when Moses was getting ready to build the Tabernacle, God gave him this warning: "Be sure that you make everything according to the pattern I have shown you here on the mountain."

verses.kjv_text: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises. {covenant: or, testament}
verses.nlt_text: But now Jesus, our High Priest, has been given a ministry that is far superior to the old priesthood, for he is the one who mediates for us a far better covenant with God, based on better promises.

verses.kjv_text: For if that first {covenant} had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.nlt_text: If the first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no need for a second covenant to replace it.

verses.kjv_text: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
verses.nlt_text: But when God found fault with the people, he said: "The day is coming, says the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv_text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and led them out of the land of Egypt. They did not remain faithful to my covenant, so I turned my back on them, says the LORD.

verses.kjv_text: For this {is} the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people: {put: Gr. give} {in: or, upon}
verses.nlt_text: But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel on that day, says the LORD: I will put my laws in their minds, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.kjv_text: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.nlt_text: And they will not need to teach their neighbors, nor will they need to teach their relatives, saying, 'You should know the LORD.' For everyone, from the least to the greatest, will know me already.

verses.kjv_text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.nlt_text: And I will forgive their wickedness, and I will never again remember their sins."

verses.kjv_text: In that he saith, A new {covenant}, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old {is} ready to vanish away.
verses.nlt_text: When God speaks of a "new" covenant, it means he has made the first one obsolete. It is now out of date and will soon disappear.

verses.kjv_text: Then verily the first {covenant} had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary. {ordinances: or, ceremonies}
verses.nlt_text: That first covenant between God and Israel had regulations for worship and a place of worship here on earth.

verses.kjv_text: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein {was} the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary. {the sanctuary: or, holy}
verses.nlt_text: There were two rooms in that Tabernacle. In the first room were a lampstand, a table, and sacred loaves of bread on the table. This room was called the Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.nlt_text: Then there was a curtain, and behind the curtain was the second room called the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein {was} the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.nlt_text: In that room were a gold incense altar and a wooden chest called the Ark of the Covenant, which was covered with gold on all sides. Inside the Ark were a gold jar containing manna, Aaron's staff that sprouted leaves, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

verses.kjv_text: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.nlt_text: Above the Ark were the cherubim of divine glory, whose wings stretched out over the Ark's cover, the place of atonement. But we cannot explain these things in detail now.

verses.kjv_text: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service {of God}.
verses.nlt_text: When these things were all in place, the priests regularly entered the first room as they performed their religious duties.

verses.kjv_text: But into the second {went} the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and {for} the errors of the people:
verses.nlt_text: But only the high priest ever entered the Most Holy Place, and only once a year. And he always offered blood for his own sins and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.

verses.kjv_text: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.nlt_text: By these regulations the Holy Spirit revealed that the entrance to the Most Holy Place was not freely open as long as the Tabernacle and the system it represented were still in use.

verses.kjv_text: Which {was} a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.nlt_text: This is an illustration pointing to the present time. For the gifts and sacrifices that the priests offer are not able to cleanse the consciences of the people who bring them.

verses.kjv_text: {Which stood} only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed {on them} until the time of reformation. {ordinances: or, rites, or, ceremonies}
verses.nlt_text: For that old system deals only with food and drink and various cleansing ceremonies-- physical regulations that were in effect only until a better system could be established.

verses.kjv_text: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.nlt_text: So Christ has now become the High Priest over all the good things that have come. He has entered that greater, more perfect Tabernacle in heaven, which was not made by human hands and is not part of this created world.

verses.kjv_text: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption {for us}.
verses.nlt_text: With his own blood-- not the blood of goats and calves-- he entered the Most Holy Place once for all time and secured our redemption forever.

verses.kjv_text: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.nlt_text: Under the old system, the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a young cow could cleanse people's bodies from ceremonial impurity.

verses.kjv_text: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God? {spot: or, fault}
verses.nlt_text: Just think how much more the blood of Christ will purify our consciences from sinful deeds so that we can worship the living God. For by the power of the eternal Spirit, Christ offered himself to God as a perfect sacrifice for our sins.

verses.kjv_text: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions {that were} under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.nlt_text: That is why he is the one who mediates a new covenant between God and people, so that all who are called can receive the eternal inheritance God has promised them. For Christ died to set them free from the penalty of the sins they had committed under that first covenant.

verses.kjv_text: For where a testament {is}, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator. {be: or, be brought in}
verses.nlt_text: Now when someone leaves a will, it is necessary to prove that the person who made it is dead.

verses.kjv_text: For a testament {is} of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.nlt_text: The will goes into effect only after the person's death. While the person who made it is still alive, the will cannot be put into effect.

verses.kjv_text: Whereupon neither the first {testament} was dedicated without blood. {dedicated: or, purified}
verses.nlt_text: That is why even the first covenant was put into effect with the blood of an animal.

verses.kjv_text: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people, {scarlet: or, purple}
verses.nlt_text: For after Moses had read each of God's commandments to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, and sprinkled both the book of God's law and all the people, using hyssop branches and scarlet wool.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, This {is} the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "This blood confirms the covenant God has made with you."

verses.kjv_text: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.nlt_text: And in the same way, he sprinkled blood on the Tabernacle and on everything used for worship.

verses.kjv_text: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.nlt_text: In fact, according to the law of Moses, nearly everything was purified with blood. For without the shedding of blood, there is no forgiveness.

verses.kjv_text: {It was} therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.nlt_text: That is why the Tabernacle and everything in it, which were copies of things in heaven, had to be purified by the blood of animals. But the real things in heaven had to be purified with far better sacrifices than the blood of animals.

verses.kjv_text: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, {which are} the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
verses.nlt_text: For Christ did not enter into a holy place made with human hands, which was only a copy of the true one in heaven. He entered into heaven itself to appear now before God on our behalf.

verses.kjv_text: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.nlt_text: And he did not enter heaven to offer himself again and again, like the high priest here on earth who enters the Most Holy Place year after year with the blood of an animal.

verses.kjv_text: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.nlt_text: If that had been necessary, Christ would have had to die again and again, ever since the world began. But now, once for all time, he has appeared at the end of the age to remove sin by his own death as a sacrifice.

verses.kjv_text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.nlt_text: And just as each person is destined to die once and after that comes judgment,

verses.kjv_text: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.nlt_text: so also Christ died once for all time as a sacrifice to take away the sins of many people. He will come again, not to deal with our sins, but to bring salvation to all who are eagerly waiting for him.

verses.kjv_text: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, {and} not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.nlt_text: The old system under the law of Moses was only a shadow, a dim preview of the good things to come, not the good things themselves. The sacrifices under that system were repeated again and again, year after year, but they were never able to provide perfect cleansing for those who came to worship.

verses.kjv_text: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins. {would...: or, they would have ceased to be offered, because, etc.}
verses.nlt_text: If they could have provided perfect cleansing, the sacrifices would have stopped, for the worshipers would have been purified once for all time, and their feelings of guilt would have disappeared.

verses.kjv_text: But in those {sacrifices there is} a remembrance again {made} of sins every year.
verses.nlt_text: But instead, those sacrifices actually reminded them of their sins year after year.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.nlt_text: For it is not possible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me: {hast...: or, thou hast fitted me}
verses.nlt_text: That is why, when Christ came into the world, he said to God, "You did not want animal sacrifices or sin offerings. But you have given me a body to offer.

verses.kjv_text: In burnt offerings and {sacrifices} for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.nlt_text: You were not pleased with burnt offerings or other offerings for sin.

verses.kjv_text: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.nlt_text: Then I said, 'Look, I have come to do your will, O God-- as is written about me in the Scriptures.' "

verses.kjv_text: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and {offering} for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure {therein}; which are offered by the law;
verses.nlt_text: First, Christ said, "You did not want animal sacrifices or sin offerings or burnt offerings or other offerings for sin, nor were you pleased with them" (though they are required by the law of Moses).

verses.kjv_text: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.nlt_text: Then he said, "Look, I have come to do your will." He cancels the first covenant in order to put the second into effect.

verses.kjv_text: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once {for all}.
verses.nlt_text: For God's will was for us to be made holy by the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ, once for all time.

verses.kjv_text: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.nlt_text: Under the old covenant, the priest stands and ministers before the altar day after day, offering the same sacrifices again and again, which can never take away sins.

verses.kjv_text: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.nlt_text: But our High Priest offered himself to God as a single sacrifice for sins, good for all time. Then he sat down in the place of honor at God's right hand.

verses.kjv_text: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.nlt_text: There he waits until his enemies are humbled and made a footstool under his feet.

verses.kjv_text: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.nlt_text: For by that one offering he forever made perfect those who are being made holy.

verses.kjv_text: {Whereof} the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.nlt_text: And the Holy Spirit also testifies that this is so. For he says,

verses.kjv_text: This {is} the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.nlt_text: "This is the new covenant I will make with my people on that day, says the LORD: I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."

verses.kjv_text: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more. {And their: some copies have, Then he said, And their}
verses.nlt_text: Then he says, "I will never again remember their sins and lawless deeds."

verses.kjv_text: Now where remission of these {is, there is} no more offering for sin.
verses.nlt_text: And when sins have been forgiven, there is no need to offer any more sacrifices.

verses.kjv_text: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus, {boldness: or, liberty}
verses.nlt_text: And so, dear brothers and sisters, we can boldly enter heaven's Most Holy Place because of the blood of Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh; {consecrated: or, new made}
verses.nlt_text: By his death, Jesus opened a new and life-giving way through the curtain into the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv_text: And {having} an high priest over the house of God;
verses.nlt_text: And since we have a great High Priest who rules over God's house,

verses.kjv_text: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.nlt_text: let us go right into the presence of God with sincere hearts fully trusting him. For our guilty consciences have been sprinkled with Christ's blood to make us clean, and our bodies have been washed with pure water.

verses.kjv_text: Let us hold fast the profession of {our} faith without wavering; (for he {is} faithful that promised;)
verses.nlt_text: Let us hold tightly without wavering to the hope we affirm, for God can be trusted to keep his promise.

verses.kjv_text: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.nlt_text: Let us think of ways to motivate one another to acts of love and good works.

verses.kjv_text: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some {is}; but exhorting {one another}: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.nlt_text: And let us not neglect our meeting together, as some people do, but encourage one another, especially now that the day of his return is drawing near.

verses.kjv_text: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, if we deliberately continue sinning after we have received knowledge of the truth, there is no longer any sacrifice that will cover these sins.

verses.kjv_text: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.nlt_text: There is only the terrible expectation of God's judgment and the raging fire that will consume his enemies.

verses.kjv_text: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.nlt_text: For anyone who refused to obey the law of Moses was put to death without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv_text: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.nlt_text: Just think how much worse the punishment will be for those who have trampled on the Son of God, and have treated the blood of the covenant, which made us holy, as if it were common and unholy, and have insulted and disdained the Holy Spirit who brings God's mercy to us.

verses.kjv_text: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance {belongeth} unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.nlt_text: For we know the one who said, "I will take revenge. I will pay them back." He also said, "The LORD will judge his own people."

verses.kjv_text: {It is} a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.nlt_text: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

verses.kjv_text: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.nlt_text: Think back on those early days when you first learned about Christ. Remember how you remained faithful even though it meant terrible suffering.

verses.kjv_text: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.nlt_text: Sometimes you were exposed to public ridicule and were beaten, and sometimes you helped others who were suffering the same things.

verses.kjv_text: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance. {in yourselves...: or, that ye have in or, for} yourselves}
verses.nlt_text: You suffered along with those who were thrown into jail, and when all you owned was taken from you, you accepted it with joy. You knew there were better things waiting for you that will last forever.

verses.kjv_text: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.nlt_text: So do not throw away this confident trust in the Lord. Remember the great reward it brings you!

verses.kjv_text: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.nlt_text: Patient endurance is what you need now, so that you will continue to do God's will. Then you will receive all that he has promised.

verses.kjv_text: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.nlt_text: "For in just a little while, the Coming One will come and not delay.

verses.kjv_text: Now the just shall live by faith: but if {any man} draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.nlt_text: And my righteous ones will live by faith. But I will take no pleasure in anyone who turns away."

verses.kjv_text: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.nlt_text: But we are not like those who turn away from God to their own destruction. We are the faithful ones, whose souls will be saved.

verses.kjv_text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. {substance: or, ground, or, confidence}
verses.nlt_text: Faith is the confidence that what we hope for will actually happen; it gives us assurance about things we cannot see.

verses.kjv_text: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.nlt_text: Through their faith, the people in days of old earned a good reputation.

verses.kjv_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.nlt_text: By faith we understand that the entire universe was formed at God's command, that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh. {yet...: or, is yet spoken of}
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Abel brought a more acceptable offering to God than Cain did. Abel's offering gave evidence that he was a righteous man, and God showed his approval of his gifts. Although Abel is long dead, he still speaks to us by his example of faith.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Enoch was taken up to heaven without dying-- "he disappeared, because God took him." For before he was taken up, he was known as a person who pleased God.

verses.kjv_text: But without faith {it is} impossible to please {him}: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and {that} he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.nlt_text: And it is impossible to please God without faith. Anyone who wants to come to him must believe that God exists and that he rewards those who sincerely seek him.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith. {moved...: or, being wary}
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Noah built a large boat to save his family from the flood. He obeyed God, who warned him about things that had never happened before. By his faith Noah condemned the rest of the world, and he received the righteousness that comes by faith.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Abraham obeyed when God called him to leave home and go to another land that God would give him as his inheritance. He went without knowing where he was going.

verses.kjv_text: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as {in} a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.nlt_text: And even when he reached the land God promised him, he lived there by faith-- for he was like a foreigner, living in tents. And so did Isaac and Jacob, who inherited the same promise.

verses.kjv_text: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker {is} God.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham was confidently looking forward to a city with eternal foundations, a city designed and built by God.

verses.kjv_text: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that even Sarah was able to have a child, though she was barren and was too old. She believed that God would keep his promise.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, {so many} as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.nlt_text: And so a whole nation came from this one man who was as good as dead-- a nation with so many people that, like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore, there is no way to count them.

verses.kjv_text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of {them}, and embraced {them}, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth. {in faith: Gr. according to faith}
verses.nlt_text: All these people died still believing what God had promised them. They did not receive what was promised, but they saw it all from a distance and welcomed it. They agreed that they were foreigners and nomads here on earth.

verses.kjv_text: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.nlt_text: Obviously people who say such things are looking forward to a country they can call their own.

verses.kjv_text: And truly, if they had been mindful of that {country} from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.nlt_text: If they had longed for the country they came from, they could have gone back.

verses.kjv_text: But now they desire a better {country}, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.nlt_text: But they were looking for a better place, a heavenly homeland. That is why God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten {son},
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Abraham offered Isaac as a sacrifice when God was testing him. Abraham, who had received God's promises, was ready to sacrifice his only son, Isaac,

verses.kjv_text: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called: {of: or, to}
verses.nlt_text: even though God had told him, "Isaac is the son through whom your descendants will be counted."

verses.kjv_text: Accounting that God {was} able to raise {him} up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.nlt_text: Abraham reasoned that if Isaac died, God was able to bring him back to life again. And in a sense, Abraham did receive his son back from the dead.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Isaac promised blessings for the future to his sons, Jacob and Esau.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, {leaning} upon the top of his staff.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Jacob, when he was old and dying, blessed each of Joseph's sons and bowed in worship as he leaned on his staff.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones. {made...: or, remembered}
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Joseph, when he was about to die, said confidently that the people of Israel would leave Egypt. He even commanded them to take his bones with them when they left.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw {he was} a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Moses' parents hid him for three months when he was born. They saw that God had given them an unusual child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's command.

verses.kjv_text: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Moses, when he grew up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

verses.kjv_text: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.nlt_text: He chose to share the oppression of God's people instead of enjoying the fleeting pleasures of sin.

verses.kjv_text: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward. {of Christ: or, for Christ}
verses.nlt_text: He thought it was better to suffer for the sake of Christ than to own the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his great reward.

verses.kjv_text: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Moses left the land of Egypt, not fearing the king's anger. He kept right on going because he kept his eyes on the one who is invisible.

verses.kjv_text: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Moses commanded the people of Israel to keep the Passover and to sprinkle blood on the doorposts so that the angel of death would not kill their firstborn sons.

verses.kjv_text: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry {land}: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that the people of Israel went right through the Red Sea as though they were on dry ground. But when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were all drowned.

verses.kjv_text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that the people of Israel marched around Jericho for seven days, and the walls came crashing down.

verses.kjv_text: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace. {that...: or, that were disobedient}
verses.nlt_text: It was by faith that Rahab the prostitute was not destroyed with the people in her city who refused to obey God. For she had given a friendly welcome to the spies.

verses.kjv_text: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and {of} Barak, and {of} Samson, and {of} Jephthae; {of} David also, and Samuel, and {of} the prophets:
verses.nlt_text: How much more do I need to say? It would take too long to recount the stories of the faith of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and all the prophets.

verses.kjv_text: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.nlt_text: By faith these people overthrew kingdoms, ruled with justice, and received what God had promised them. They shut the mouths of lions,

verses.kjv_text: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.nlt_text: quenched the flames of fire, and escaped death by the edge of the sword. Their weakness was turned to strength. They became strong in battle and put whole armies to flight.

verses.kjv_text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.nlt_text: Women received their loved ones back again from death.But others were tortured, refusing to turn from God in order to be set free. They placed their hope in a better life after the resurrection.

verses.kjv_text: And others had trial of {cruel} mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.nlt_text: Some were jeered at, and their backs were cut open with whips. Others were chained in prisons.

verses.kjv_text: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
verses.nlt_text: Some died by stoning, some were sawed in half, and others were killed with the sword. Some went about wearing skins of sheep and goats, destitute and oppressed and mistreated.

verses.kjv_text: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and {in} mountains, and {in} dens and caves of the earth.
verses.nlt_text: They were too good for this world, wandering over deserts and mountains, hiding in caves and holes in the ground.

verses.kjv_text: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
verses.nlt_text: All these people earned a good reputation because of their faith, yet none of them received all that God had promised.

verses.kjv_text: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect. {provided: or, foreseen}
verses.nlt_text: For God had something better in mind for us, so that they would not reach perfection without us.
