verses.kjv_text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset {us}, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a huge crowd of witnesses to the life of faith, let us strip off every weight that slows us down, especially the sin that so easily trips us up. And let us run with endurance the race God has set before us.

verses.kjv_text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of {our} faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God. {author: or, beginner}
verses.nlt_text: We do this by keeping our eyes on Jesus, the champion who initiates and perfects our faith. Because of the joy awaiting him, he endured the cross, disregarding its shame. Now he is seated in the place of honor beside God's throne.

verses.kjv_text: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.nlt_text: Think of all the hostility he endured from sinful people; then you won't become weary and give up.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.nlt_text: After all, you have not yet given your lives in your struggle against sin.

verses.kjv_text: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
verses.nlt_text: And have you forgotten the encouraging words God spoke to you as his children? He said, "My child, don't make light of the LORD's discipline, and don't give up when he corrects you.

verses.kjv_text: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.nlt_text: For the LORD disciplines those he loves, and he punishes each one he accepts as his child."

verses.kjv_text: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.nlt_text: As you endure this divine discipline, remember that God is treating you as his own children. Who ever heard of a child who is never disciplined by its father?

verses.kjv_text: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.nlt_text: If God doesn't discipline you as he does all of his children, it means that you are illegitimate and are not really his children at all.

verses.kjv_text: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected {us}, and we gave {them} reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.nlt_text: Since we respected our earthly fathers who disciplined us, shouldn't we submit even more to the discipline of the Father of our spirits, and live forever?

verses.kjv_text: For they verily for a few days chastened {us} after their own pleasure; but he for {our} profit, that {we} might be partakers of his holiness. {after...: or, as seemed good, or, meet to them}
verses.nlt_text: For our earthly fathers disciplined us for a few years, doing the best they knew how. But God's discipline is always good for us, so that we might share in his holiness.

verses.kjv_text: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.nlt_text: No discipline is enjoyable while it is happening-- it's painful! But afterward there will be a peaceful harvest of right living for those who are trained in this way.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.nlt_text: So take a new grip with your tired hands and strengthen your weak knees.

verses.kjv_text: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed. {straight: or, even}
verses.nlt_text: Mark out a straight path for your feet so that those who are weak and lame will not fall but become strong.

verses.kjv_text: Follow peace with all {men}, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.nlt_text: Work at living in peace with everyone, and work at living a holy life, for those who are not holy will not see the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble {you}, and thereby many be defiled; {fail...; or, fall from}
verses.nlt_text: Look after each other so that none of you fails to receive the grace of God. Watch out that no poisonous root of bitterness grows up to trouble you, corrupting many.

verses.kjv_text: Lest there {be} any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.nlt_text: Make sure that no one is immoral or godless like Esau, who traded his birthright as the firstborn son for a single meal.

verses.kjv_text: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears. {place...: or, way to change his mind}
verses.nlt_text: You know that afterward, when he wanted his father's blessing, he was rejected. It was too late for repentance, even though he begged with bitter tears.

verses.kjv_text: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.nlt_text: You have not come to a physical mountain, to a place of flaming fire, darkness, gloom, and whirlwind, as the Israelites did at Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv_text: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which {voice} they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.nlt_text: For they heard an awesome trumpet blast and a voice so terrible that they begged God to stop speaking.

verses.kjv_text: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.nlt_text: They staggered back under God's command: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death."

verses.kjv_text: And so terrible was the sight, {that} Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.nlt_text: Moses himself was so frightened at the sight that he said, "I am terrified and trembling."

verses.kjv_text: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.nlt_text: No, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to countless thousands of angels in a joyful gathering.

verses.kjv_text: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect, {written: or, enrolled}
verses.nlt_text: You have come to the assembly of God's firstborn children, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God himself, who is the judge over all things. You have come to the spirits of the righteous ones in heaven who have now been made perfect.

verses.kjv_text: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than {that of} Abel. {covenant: or, testament}
verses.nlt_text: You have come to Jesus, the one who mediates the new covenant between God and people, and to the sprinkled blood, which speaks of forgiveness instead of crying out for vengeance like the blood of Abel.

verses.kjv_text: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more {shall not} we {escape}, if we turn away from him that {speaketh} from heaven:
verses.nlt_text: Be careful that you do not refuse to listen to the One who is speaking. For if the people of Israel did not escape when they refused to listen to Moses, the earthly messenger, we will certainly not escape if we reject the One who speaks to us from heaven!

verses.kjv_text: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.nlt_text: When God spoke from Mount Sinai his voice shook the earth, but now he makes another promise: "Once again I will shake not only the earth but the heavens also."

verses.kjv_text: And this {word}, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain. {are shaken: or, may be shaken}
verses.nlt_text: This means that all of creation will be shaken and removed, so that only unshakable things will remain.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear: {let...: or, let us hold fast}
verses.nlt_text: Since we are receiving a Kingdom that is unshakable, let us be thankful and please God by worshiping him with holy fear and awe.

verses.kjv_text: For our God {is} a consuming fire.
verses.nlt_text: For our God is a devouring fire.

verses.kjv_text: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.nlt_text: Keep on loving each other as brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.nlt_text: Don't forget to show hospitality to strangers, for some who have done this have entertained angels without realizing it!

verses.kjv_text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; {and} them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.nlt_text: Remember those in prison, as if you were there yourself. Remember also those being mistreated, as if you felt their pain in your own bodies.

verses.kjv_text: Marriage {is} honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
verses.nlt_text: Give honor to marriage, and remain faithful to one another in marriage. God will surely judge people who are immoral and those who commit adultery.

verses.kjv_text: {Let your} conversation {be} without covetousness; {and be} content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.nlt_text: Don't love money; be satisfied with what you have. For God has said, "I will never fail you. I will never abandon you."

verses.kjv_text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord {is} my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.nlt_text: So we can say with confidence, "The LORD is my helper, so I will have no fear. What can mere people do to me?"

verses.kjv_text: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of {their} conversation. {have the rule: or, are the guides}
verses.nlt_text: Remember your leaders who taught you the word of God. Think of all the good that has come from their lives, and follow the example of their faith.

verses.kjv_text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.nlt_text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

verses.kjv_text: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For {it is} a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.nlt_text: So do not be attracted by strange, new ideas. Your strength comes from God's grace, not from rules about food, which don't help those who follow them.

verses.kjv_text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.nlt_text: We have an altar from which the priests in the Tabernacle have no right to eat.

verses.kjv_text: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.nlt_text: Under the old system, the high priest brought the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, and the bodies of the animals were burned outside the camp.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.nlt_text: So also Jesus suffered and died outside the city gates to make his people holy by means of his own blood.

verses.kjv_text: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.nlt_text: So let us go out to him, outside the camp, and bear the disgrace he bore.

verses.kjv_text: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.nlt_text: For this world is not our permanent home; we are looking forward to a home yet to come.

verses.kjv_text: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of {our} lips giving thanks to his name. {giving...: Gr. confessing to}
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, let us offer through Jesus a continual sacrifice of praise to God, proclaiming our allegiance to his name.

verses.kjv_text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.nlt_text: And don't forget to do good and to share with those in need. These are the sacrifices that please God.

verses.kjv_text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that {is} unprofitable for you. {have...: or, guide}
verses.nlt_text: Obey your spiritual leaders, and do what they say. Their work is to watch over your souls, and they are accountable to God. Give them reason to do this with joy and not with sorrow. That would certainly not be for your benefit.

verses.kjv_text: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.nlt_text: Pray for us, for our conscience is clear and we want to live honorably in everything we do.

verses.kjv_text: But I beseech {you} the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.nlt_text: And especially pray that I will be able to come back to you soon.

verses.kjv_text: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant, {covenant: or, testament}
verses.nlt_text: Now may the God of peace-- who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great Shepherd of the sheep, and ratified an eternal covenant with his blood--

verses.kjv_text: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen. {working: or, doing}
verses.nlt_text: may he equip you with all you need for doing his will. May he produce in you, through the power of Jesus Christ, every good thing that is pleasing to him. All glory to him forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.nlt_text: I urge you, dear brothers and sisters, to pay attention to what I have written in this brief exhortation.

verses.kjv_text: Know ye that {our} brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.nlt_text: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released from jail. If he comes here soon, I will bring him with me to see you.

verses.kjv_text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.nlt_text: Greet all your leaders and all the believers there. The believers from Italy send you their greetings.

verses.kjv_text: Grace {be} with you all. Amen. «{Written to the Hebrews from Italy, by Timothy.}»
verses.nlt_text: May God's grace be with you all.

verses.kjv_text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from James, a slave of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.I am writing to the "twelve tribes"-- Jewish believers scattered abroad.Greetings!

verses.kjv_text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; {temptations: or, trials}
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, when troubles come your way, consider it an opportunity for great joy.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing {this}, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.nlt_text: For you know that when your faith is tested, your endurance has a chance to grow.

verses.kjv_text: But let patience have {her} perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.nlt_text: So let it grow, for when your endurance is fully developed, you will be perfect and complete, needing nothing.

verses.kjv_text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all {men} liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.nlt_text: If you need wisdom, ask our generous God, and he will give it to you. He will not rebuke you for asking.

verses.kjv_text: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.nlt_text: But when you ask him, be sure that your faith is in God alone. Do not waver, for a person with divided loyalty is as unsettled as a wave of the sea that is blown and tossed by the wind.

verses.kjv_text: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.nlt_text: Such people should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: A double minded man {is} unstable in all his ways.
verses.nlt_text: Their loyalty is divided between God and the world, and they are unstable in everything they do.

verses.kjv_text: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted: {rejoice: or, glory}
verses.nlt_text: Believers who are poor have something to boast about, for God has honored them.

verses.kjv_text: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.nlt_text: And those who are rich should boast that God has humbled them. They will fade away like a little flower in the field.

verses.kjv_text: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.nlt_text: The hot sun rises and the grass withers; the little flower droops and falls, and its beauty fades away. In the same way, the rich will fade away with all of their achievements.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {is} the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.nlt_text: God blesses those who patiently endure testing and temptation. Afterward they will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love him.

verses.kjv_text: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man: {evil: or, evils}
verses.nlt_text: And remember, when you are being tempted, do not say, "God is tempting me." God is never tempted to do wrong, and he never tempts anyone else.

verses.kjv_text: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.nlt_text: Temptation comes from our own desires, which entice us and drag us away.

verses.kjv_text: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.nlt_text: These desires give birth to sinful actions. And when sin is allowed to grow, it gives birth to death.

verses.kjv_text: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.nlt_text: So don't be misled, my dear brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.nlt_text: Whatever is good and perfect comes down to us from God our Father, who created all the lights in the heavens. He never changes or casts a shifting shadow.

verses.kjv_text: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.nlt_text: He chose to give birth to us by giving us his true word. And we, out of all creation, became his prized possession.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.nlt_text: Understand this, my dear brothers and sisters: You must all be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to get angry.

verses.kjv_text: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.nlt_text: Human anger does not produce the righteousness God desires.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.nlt_text: So get rid of all the filth and evil in your lives, and humbly accept the word God has planted in your hearts, for it has the power to save your souls.

verses.kjv_text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.nlt_text: But don't just listen to God's word. You must do what it says. Otherwise, you are only fooling yourselves.

verses.kjv_text: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.nlt_text: For if you listen to the word and don't obey, it is like glancing at your face in a mirror.

verses.kjv_text: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.nlt_text: You see yourself, walk away, and forget what you look like.

verses.kjv_text: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth {therein}, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed. {deed: or, doing}
verses.nlt_text: But if you look carefully into the perfect law that sets you free, and if you do what it says and don't forget what you heard, then God will bless you for doing it.

verses.kjv_text: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion {is} vain.
verses.nlt_text: If you claim to be religious but don't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is worthless.

verses.kjv_text: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, {and} to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.nlt_text: Pure and genuine religion in the sight of God the Father means caring for orphans and widows in their distress and refusing to let the world corrupt you.

verses.kjv_text: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, {the Lord} of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.nlt_text: My dear brothers and sisters, how can you claim to have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ if you favor some people over others?

verses.kjv_text: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment; {assembly: Gr. synagogue}
verses.nlt_text: For example, suppose someone comes into your meeting dressed in fancy clothes and expensive jewelry, and another comes in who is poor and dressed in dirty clothes.

verses.kjv_text: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool: {in...: or, well, or, seemly}
verses.nlt_text: If you give special attention and a good seat to the rich person, but you say to the poor one, "You can stand over there, or else sit on the floor"-- well,

verses.kjv_text: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.nlt_text: doesn't this discrimination show that your judgments are guided by evil motives?

verses.kjv_text: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him? {of the: or, of that}
verses.nlt_text: Listen to me, dear brothers and sisters. Hasn't God chosen the poor in this world to be rich in faith? Aren't they the ones who will inherit the Kingdom he promised to those who love him?

verses.kjv_text: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.nlt_text: But you dishonor the poor! Isn't it the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?

verses.kjv_text: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called? {blaspheme: or, revile, or, slander}
verses.nlt_text: Aren't they the ones who slander Jesus Christ, whose noble name you bear?

verses.kjv_text: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
verses.nlt_text: Yes indeed, it is good when you obey the royal law as found in the Scriptures: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.kjv_text: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.nlt_text: But if you favor some people over others, you are committing a sin. You are guilty of breaking the law.

verses.kjv_text: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one {point}, he is guilty of all.
verses.nlt_text: For the person who keeps all of the laws except one is as guilty as a person who has broken all of God's laws.

verses.kjv_text: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law. {he that: or, that law which}
verses.nlt_text: For the same God who said, "You must not commit adultery," also said, "You must not murder." So if you murder someone but do not commit adultery, you have still broken the law.

verses.kjv_text: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.nlt_text: So whatever you say or whatever you do, remember that you will be judged by the law that sets you free.

verses.kjv_text: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment. {rejoiceth: or, glorieth}
verses.nlt_text: There will be no mercy for those who have not shown mercy to others. But if you have been merciful, God will be merciful when he judges you.

verses.kjv_text: What {doth it} profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.nlt_text: What good is it, dear brothers and sisters, if you say you have faith but don't show it by your actions? Can that kind of faith save anyone?

verses.kjv_text: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.nlt_text: Suppose you see a brother or sister who has no food or clothing,

verses.kjv_text: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be {ye} warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what {doth it} profit?
verses.nlt_text: and you say, "Good-bye and have a good day; stay warm and eat well"-- but then you don't give that person any food or clothing. What good does that do?

verses.kjv_text: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone. {alone: Gr. by itself}
verses.nlt_text: So you see, faith by itself isn't enough. Unless it produces good deeds, it is dead and useless.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works. {without: some copies read, by}
verses.nlt_text: Now someone may argue, "Some people have faith; others have good deeds." But I say, "How can you show me your faith if you don't have good deeds? I will show you my faith by my good deeds."

verses.kjv_text: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.nlt_text: You say you have faith, for you believe that there is one God. Good for you! Even the demons believe this, and they tremble in terror.

verses.kjv_text: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.nlt_text: How foolish! Can't you see that faith without good deeds is useless?

verses.kjv_text: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.nlt_text: Don't you remember that our ancestor Abraham was shown to be right with God by his actions when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?

verses.kjv_text: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect? {Seest...: or, Thou seest}
verses.nlt_text: You see, his faith and his actions worked together. His actions made his faith complete.

verses.kjv_text: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
verses.nlt_text: And so it happened just as the Scriptures say: "Abraham believed God, and God counted him as righteous because of his faith." He was even called the friend of God.

verses.kjv_text: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.nlt_text: So you see, we are shown to be right with God by what we do, not by faith alone.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent {them} out another way?
verses.nlt_text: Rahab the prostitute is another example. She was shown to be right with God by her actions when she hid those messengers and sent them safely away by a different road.

verses.kjv_text: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also. {spirit: or, breath}
verses.nlt_text: Just as the body is dead without breath, so also faith is dead without good works.

verses.kjv_text: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation. {condemnation: or, judgment}
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, not many of you should become teachers in the church, for we who teach will be judged more strictly.

verses.kjv_text: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same {is} a perfect man, {and} able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.nlt_text: Indeed, we all make many mistakes. For if we could control our tongues, we would be perfect and could also control ourselves in every other way.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.nlt_text: We can make a large horse go wherever we want by means of a small bit in its mouth.

verses.kjv_text: Behold also the ships, which though {they be} so great, and {are} driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.nlt_text: And a small rudder makes a huge ship turn wherever the pilot chooses to go, even though the winds are strong.

verses.kjv_text: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth! {a matter: or, wood}
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, the tongue is a small thing that makes grand speeches.But a tiny spark can set a great forest on fire.

verses.kjv_text: And the tongue {is} a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell. {course: Gr. wheel}
verses.nlt_text: And the tongue is a flame of fire. It is a whole world of wickedness, corrupting your entire body. It can set your whole life on fire, for it is set on fire by hell itself.

verses.kjv_text: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind: {kind: Gr. nature} {mankind: Gr. nature of man}
verses.nlt_text: People can tame all kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and fish,

verses.kjv_text: But the tongue can no man tame; {it is} an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.nlt_text: but no one can tame the tongue. It is restless and evil, full of deadly poison.

verses.kjv_text: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
verses.nlt_text: Sometimes it praises our Lord and Father, and sometimes it curses those who have been made in the image of God.

verses.kjv_text: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.nlt_text: And so blessing and cursing come pouring out of the same mouth. Surely, my brothers and sisters, this is not right!

verses.kjv_text: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet {water} and bitter? {place: or, hole}
verses.nlt_text: Does a spring of water bubble out with both fresh water and bitter water?

verses.kjv_text: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so {can} no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.nlt_text: Does a fig tree produce olives, or a grapevine produce figs? No, and you can't draw fresh water from a salty spring.

verses.kjv_text: Who {is} a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.nlt_text: If you are wise and understand God's ways, prove it by living an honorable life, doing good works with the humility that comes from wisdom.

verses.kjv_text: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.nlt_text: But if you are bitterly jealous and there is selfish ambition in your heart, don't cover up the truth with boasting and lying.

verses.kjv_text: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but {is} earthly, sensual, devilish. {sensual: or, natural}
verses.nlt_text: For jealousy and selfishness are not God's kind of wisdom. Such things are earthly, unspiritual, and demonic.

verses.kjv_text: For where envying and strife {is}, there {is} confusion and every evil work. {confusion: Gr. tumult, or, unquietness}
verses.nlt_text: For wherever there is jealousy and selfish ambition, there you will find disorder and evil of every kind.

verses.kjv_text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, {and} easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. {partiality: or, wrangling}
verses.nlt_text: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure. It is also peace loving, gentle at all times, and willing to yield to others. It is full of mercy and good deeds. It shows no favoritism and is always sincere.

verses.kjv_text: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.nlt_text: And those who are peacemakers will plant seeds of peace and reap a harvest of righteousness.

verses.kjv_text: From whence {come} wars and fightings among you? {come they} not hence, {even} of your lusts that war in your members? {fightings: or, brawlings} {lusts: or, pleasures}
verses.nlt_text: What is causing the quarrels and fights among you? Don't they come from the evil desires at war within you?

verses.kjv_text: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.nlt_text: You want what you don't have, so you scheme and kill to get it. You are jealous of what others have, but you can't get it, so you fight and wage war to take it away from them. Yet you don't have what you want because you don't ask God for it.

verses.kjv_text: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume {it} upon your lusts. {lusts: or, pleasures}
verses.nlt_text: And even when you ask, you don't get it because your motives are all wrong-- you want only what will give you pleasure.

verses.kjv_text: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
verses.nlt_text: You adulterers! Don't you realize that friendship with the world makes you an enemy of God? I say it again: If you want to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.

verses.kjv_text: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy? {to envy: or, enviously?}
verses.nlt_text: What do you think the Scriptures mean when they say that the spirit God has placed within us is filled with envy?

verses.kjv_text: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
verses.nlt_text: But he gives us even more grace to stand against such evil desires. As the Scriptures say, "God opposes the proud but favors the humble."

verses.kjv_text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.nlt_text: So humble yourselves before God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.kjv_text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse {your} hands, {ye} sinners; and purify {your} hearts, {ye} double minded.
verses.nlt_text: Come close to God, and God will come close to you. Wash your hands, you sinners; purify your hearts, for your loyalty is divided between God and the world.

verses.kjv_text: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and {your} joy to heaviness.
verses.nlt_text: Let there be tears for what you have done. Let there be sorrow and deep grief. Let there be sadness instead of laughter, and gloom instead of joy.

verses.kjv_text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.nlt_text: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up in honor.

verses.kjv_text: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of {his} brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.nlt_text: Don't speak evil against each other, dear brothers and sisters. If you criticize and judge each other, then you are criticizing and judging God's law. But your job is to obey the law, not to judge whether it applies to you.

verses.kjv_text: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
verses.nlt_text: God alone, who gave the law, is the Judge. He alone has the power to save or to destroy. So what right do you have to judge your neighbor?

verses.kjv_text: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.nlt_text: Look here, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we are going to a certain town and will stay there a year. We will do business there and make a profit."

verses.kjv_text: Whereas ye know not what {shall be} on the morrow. For what {is} your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away. {It...: or, For it is}
verses.nlt_text: How do you know what your life will be like tomorrow? Your life is like the morning fog-- it's here a little while, then it's gone.

verses.kjv_text: For that ye {ought} to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.nlt_text: What you ought to say is, "If the Lord wants us to, we will live and do this or that."

verses.kjv_text: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.nlt_text: Otherwise you are boasting about your own plans, and all such boasting is evil.

verses.kjv_text: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth {it} not, to him it is sin.
verses.nlt_text: Remember, it is sin to know what you ought to do and then not do it.

verses.kjv_text: Go to now, {ye} rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon {you}.
verses.nlt_text: Look here, you rich people: Weep and groan with anguish because of all the terrible troubles ahead of you.

verses.kjv_text: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.nlt_text: Your wealth is rotting away, and your fine clothes are moth-eaten rags.

verses.kjv_text: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.nlt_text: Your gold and silver have become worthless. The very wealth you were counting on will eat away your flesh like fire. This treasure you have accumulated will stand as evidence against you on the day of judgment.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth. {sabaoth: Heb. hosts}
verses.nlt_text: For listen! Hear the cries of the field workers whom you have cheated of their pay. The wages you held back cry out against you. The cries of those who harvest your fields have reached the ears of the Lord of Heaven's Armies.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.nlt_text: You have spent your years on earth in luxury, satisfying your every desire. You have fattened yourselves for the day of slaughter.

verses.kjv_text: Ye have condemned {and} killed the just; {and} he doth not resist you.
verses.nlt_text: You have condemned and killed innocent people, who do not resist you.

verses.kjv_text: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain. {Be...: or, Be long patient, or, Suffer with long patience}
verses.nlt_text: Dear brothers and sisters, be patient as you wait for the Lord's return. Consider the farmers who patiently wait for the rains in the fall and in the spring. They eagerly look for the valuable harvest to ripen.

verses.kjv_text: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.nlt_text: You, too, must be patient. Take courage, for the coming of the Lord is near.

verses.kjv_text: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door. {Grudge not: or, Groan, or, Grieve not}
verses.nlt_text: Don't grumble about each other, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. For look-- the Judge is standing at the door!

verses.kjv_text: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.nlt_text: For examples of patience in suffering, dear brothers and sisters, look at the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.nlt_text: We give great honor to those who endure under suffering. For instance, you know about Job, a man of great endurance. You can see how the Lord was kind to him at the end, for the Lord is full of tenderness and mercy.

verses.kjv_text: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and {your} nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.nlt_text: But most of all, my brothers and sisters, never take an oath, by heaven or earth or anything else. Just say a simple yes or no, so that you will not sin and be condemned.

verses.kjv_text: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.nlt_text: Are any of you suffering hardships? You should pray. Are any of you happy? You should sing praises.

verses.kjv_text: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.nlt_text: Are any of you sick? You should call for the elders of the church to come and pray over you, anointing you with oil in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv_text: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.nlt_text: Such a prayer offered in faith will heal the sick, and the Lord will make you well. And if you have committed any sins, you will be forgiven.

verses.kjv_text: Confess {your} faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.nlt_text: Confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The earnest prayer of a righteous person has great power and produces wonderful results.

verses.kjv_text: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months. {subject...: of the same nature, that is, a fellow mortal} {earnestly: or, in his prayer}
verses.nlt_text: Elijah was as human as we are, and yet when he prayed earnestly that no rain would fall, none fell for three and a half years!

verses.kjv_text: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.nlt_text: Then, when he prayed again, the sky sent down rain and the earth began to yield its crops.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.nlt_text: My dear brothers and sisters, if someone among you wanders away from the truth and is brought back,

verses.kjv_text: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.nlt_text: you can be sure that whoever brings the sinner back will save that person from death and bring about the forgiveness of many sins.

verses.kjv_text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ.I am writing to God's chosen people who are living as foreigners in the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

verses.kjv_text: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
verses.nlt_text: God the Father knew you and chose you long ago, and his Spirit has made you holy. As a result, you have obeyed him and have been cleansed by the blood of Jesus Christ.May God give you more and more grace and peace.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {be} the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, {abundant: Gr. much}
verses.nlt_text: All praise to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. It is by his great mercy that we have been born again, because God raised Jesus Christ from the dead. Now we live with great expectation,

verses.kjv_text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you, {for you: or, for us}
verses.nlt_text: and we have a priceless inheritance-- an inheritance that is kept in heaven for you, pure and undefiled, beyond the reach of change and decay.

verses.kjv_text: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.nlt_text: And through your faith, God is protecting you by his power until you receive this salvation, which is ready to be revealed on the last day for all to see.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
verses.nlt_text: So be truly glad. There is wonderful joy ahead, even though you have to endure many trials for a little while.

verses.kjv_text: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verses.nlt_text: These trials will show that your faith is genuine. It is being tested as fire tests and purifies gold-- though your faith is far more precious than mere gold. So when your faith remains strong through many trials, it will bring you much praise and glory and honor on the day when Jesus Christ is revealed to the whole world.

verses.kjv_text: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see {him} not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.nlt_text: You love him even though you have never seen him. Though you do not see him now, you trust him; and you rejoice with a glorious, inexpressible joy.

verses.kjv_text: Receiving the end of your faith, {even} the salvation of {your} souls.
verses.nlt_text: The reward for trusting him will be the salvation of your souls.

verses.kjv_text: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace {that should come} unto you:
verses.nlt_text: This salvation was something even the prophets wanted to know more about when they prophesied about this gracious salvation prepared for you.

verses.kjv_text: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
verses.nlt_text: They wondered what time or situation the Spirit of Christ within them was talking about when he told them in advance about Christ's suffering and his great glory afterward.

verses.kjv_text: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
verses.nlt_text: They were told that their messages were not for themselves, but for you. And now this Good News has been announced to you by those who preached in the power of the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. It is all so wonderful that even the angels are eagerly watching these things happen.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ; {to the end: Gr. perfectly}
verses.nlt_text: So think clearly and exercise self-control. Look forward to the gracious salvation that will come to you when Jesus Christ is revealed to the world.

verses.kjv_text: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
verses.nlt_text: So you must live as God's obedient children. Don't slip back into your old ways of living to satisfy your own desires. You didn't know any better then.

verses.kjv_text: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
verses.nlt_text: But now you must be holy in everything you do, just as God who chose you is holy.

verses.kjv_text: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures say, "You must be holy because I am holy."

verses.kjv_text: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning {here} in fear:
verses.nlt_text: And remember that the heavenly Father to whom you pray has no favorites. He will judge or reward you according to what you do. So you must live in reverent fear of him during your time as "foreigners in the land."

verses.kjv_text: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, {as} silver and gold, from your vain conversation {received} by tradition from your fathers;
verses.nlt_text: For you know that God paid a ransom to save you from the empty life you inherited from your ancestors. And the ransom he paid was not mere gold or silver.

verses.kjv_text: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
verses.nlt_text: It was the precious blood of Christ, the sinless, spotless Lamb of God.

verses.kjv_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
verses.nlt_text: God chose him as your ransom long before the world began, but he has now revealed him to you in these last days.

verses.kjv_text: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.nlt_text: Through Christ you have come to trust in God. And you have placed your faith and hope in God because he raised Christ from the dead and gave him great glory.

verses.kjv_text: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, {see that ye} love one another with a pure heart fervently:
verses.nlt_text: You were cleansed from your sins when you obeyed the truth, so now you must show sincere love to each other as brothers and sisters. Love each other deeply with all your heart.

verses.kjv_text: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
verses.nlt_text: For you have been born again, but not to a life that will quickly end. Your new life will last forever because it comes from the eternal, living word of God.

verses.kjv_text: For all flesh {is} as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away: {For: or, For that}
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "People are like grass; their beauty is like a flower in the field. The grass withers and the flower fades.

verses.kjv_text: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
verses.nlt_text: But the word of the Lord remains forever." And that word is the Good News that was preached to you.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
verses.nlt_text: So get rid of all evil behavior. Be done with all deceit, hypocrisy, jealousy, and all unkind speech.

verses.kjv_text: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
verses.nlt_text: Like newborn babies, you must crave pure spiritual milk so that you will grow into a full experience of salvation. Cry out for this nourishment,

verses.kjv_text: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord {is} gracious.
verses.nlt_text: now that you have had a taste of the Lord's kindness.

verses.kjv_text: To whom coming, {as unto} a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, {and} precious,
verses.nlt_text: You are coming to Christ, who is the living cornerstone of God's temple. He was rejected by people, but he was chosen by God for great honor.

verses.kjv_text: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ. {are: or, be ye}
verses.nlt_text: And you are living stones that God is building into his spiritual temple. What's more, you are his holy priests. Through the mediation of Jesus Christ, you offer spiritual sacrifices that please God.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
verses.nlt_text: As the Scriptures say, "I am placing a cornerstone in Jerusalem, chosen for great honor, and anyone who trusts in him will never be disgraced."

verses.kjv_text: Unto you therefore which believe {he is} precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner, {precious: or, an honour}
verses.nlt_text: Yes, you who trust him recognize the honor God has given him. But for those who reject him, "The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone."

verses.kjv_text: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, {even to them} which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
verses.nlt_text: And, "He is the stone that makes people stumble, the rock that makes them fall." They stumble because they do not obey God's word, and so they meet the fate that was planned for them.

verses.kjv_text: But ye {are} a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light: {peculiar: or, purchased} {praises: or, virtues}
verses.nlt_text: But you are not like that, for you are a chosen people. You are royal priests, a holy nation, God's very own possession. As a result, you can show others the goodness of God, for he called you out of the darkness into his wonderful light.

verses.kjv_text: Which in time past {were} not a people, but {are} now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.nlt_text: "Once you had no identity as a people; now you are God's people. Once you received no mercy; now you have received God's mercy."

verses.kjv_text: Dearly beloved, I beseech {you} as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, I warn you as "temporary residents and foreigners" to keep away from worldly desires that wage war against your very souls.

verses.kjv_text: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by {your} good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation. {whereas: or, wherein}
verses.nlt_text: Be careful to live properly among your unbelieving neighbors. Then even if they accuse you of doing wrong, they will see your honorable behavior, and they will give honor to God when he judges the world.

verses.kjv_text: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
verses.nlt_text: For the Lord's sake, respect all human authority-- whether the king as head of state,

verses.kjv_text: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
verses.nlt_text: or the officials he has appointed. For the king has sent them to punish those who do wrong and to honor those who do right.

verses.kjv_text: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.nlt_text: It is God's will that your honorable lives should silence those ignorant people who make foolish accusations against you.

verses.kjv_text: As free, and not using {your} liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God. {using: Gr. having}
verses.nlt_text: For you are free, yet you are God's slaves, so don't use your freedom as an excuse to do evil.

verses.kjv_text: Honour all {men}. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king. {Honour all: or, Esteem all}
verses.nlt_text: Respect everyone, and love your Christian brothers and sisters. Fear God, and respect the king.

verses.kjv_text: Servants, {be} subject to {your} masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
verses.nlt_text: You who are slaves must accept the authority of your masters with all respect. Do what they tell you-- not only if they are kind and reasonable, but even if they are cruel.

verses.kjv_text: For this {is} thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully. {thankworthy: or, thank}
verses.nlt_text: For God is pleased with you when you do what you know is right and patiently endure unfair treatment.

verses.kjv_text: For what glory {is it}, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer {for it}, ye take it patiently, this {is} acceptable with God. {acceptable: or, thank}
verses.nlt_text: Of course, you get no credit for being patient if you are beaten for doing wrong. But if you suffer for doing good and endure it patiently, God is pleased with you.

verses.kjv_text: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: {for us: some read, for you}
verses.nlt_text: For God called you to do good, even if it means suffering, just as Christ suffered for you. He is your example, and you must follow in his steps.

verses.kjv_text: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
verses.nlt_text: He never sinned, nor ever deceived anyone.

verses.kjv_text: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed {himself} to him that judgeth righteously: {himself: or, his cause}
verses.nlt_text: He did not retaliate when he was insulted, nor threaten revenge when he suffered. He left his case in the hands of God, who always judges fairly.

verses.kjv_text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed. {on: or, to}
verses.nlt_text: He personally carried our sins in his body on the cross so that we can be dead to sin and live for what is right. By his wounds you are healed.

verses.kjv_text: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verses.nlt_text: Once you were like sheep who wandered away. But now you have turned to your Shepherd, the Guardian of your souls.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise, ye wives, {be} in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, you wives must accept the authority of your husbands. Then, even if some refuse to obey the Good News, your godly lives will speak to them without any words. They will be won over

verses.kjv_text: While they behold your chaste conversation {coupled} with fear.
verses.nlt_text: by observing your pure and reverent lives.

verses.kjv_text: Whose adorning let it not be that outward {adorning} of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
verses.nlt_text: Don't be concerned about the outward beauty of fancy hairstyles, expensive jewelry, or beautiful clothes.

verses.kjv_text: But {let it be} the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, {even the ornament} of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verses.nlt_text: You should clothe yourselves instead with the beauty that comes from within, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is so precious to God.

verses.kjv_text: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
verses.nlt_text: This is how the holy women of old made themselves beautiful. They trusted God and accepted the authority of their husbands.

verses.kjv_text: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement. {daughters: Gr. children}
verses.nlt_text: For instance, Sarah obeyed her husband, Abraham, and called him her master. You are her daughters when you do what is right without fear of what your husbands might do.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with {them} according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, you husbands must give honor to your wives. Treat your wife with understanding as you live together. She may be weaker than you are, but she is your equal partner in God's gift of new life. Treat her as you should so your prayers will not be hindered.

verses.kjv_text: Finally, {be ye} all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, {be} pitiful, {be} courteous: {love as: or, loving to the}
verses.nlt_text: Finally, all of you should be of one mind. Sympathize with each other. Love each other as brothers and sisters. Be tenderhearted, and keep a humble attitude.

verses.kjv_text: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
verses.nlt_text: Don't repay evil for evil. Don't retaliate with insults when people insult you. Instead, pay them back with a blessing. That is what God has called you to do, and he will bless you for it.

verses.kjv_text: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.nlt_text: For the Scriptures say, "If you want to enjoy life and see many happy days, keep your tongue from speaking evil and your lips from telling lies.

verses.kjv_text: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
verses.nlt_text: Turn away from evil and do good. Search for peace, and work to maintain it.

verses.kjv_text: For the eyes of the Lord {are} over the righteous, and his ears {are open} unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord {is} against them that do evil. {against: Gr. upon}
verses.nlt_text: The eyes of the Lord watch over those who do right, and his ears are open to their prayers. But the Lord turns his face against those who do evil."

verses.kjv_text: And who {is} he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
verses.nlt_text: Now, who will want to harm you if you are eager to do good?

verses.kjv_text: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy {are ye}: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
verses.nlt_text: But even if you suffer for doing what is right, God will reward you for it. So don't worry or be afraid of their threats.

verses.kjv_text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and {be} ready always to {give} an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear: {fear: or, reverence}
verses.nlt_text: Instead, you must worship Christ as Lord of your life. And if someone asks about your Christian hope, always be ready to explain it.

verses.kjv_text: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
verses.nlt_text: But do this in a gentle and respectful way. Keep your conscience clear. Then if people speak against you, they will be ashamed when they see what a good life you live because you belong to Christ.

verses.kjv_text: For {it is} better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
verses.nlt_text: Remember, it is better to suffer for doing good, if that is what God wants, than to suffer for doing wrong!

verses.kjv_text: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.nlt_text: Christ suffered for our sins once for all time. He never sinned, but he died for sinners to bring you safely home to God. He suffered physical death, but he was raised to life in the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
verses.nlt_text: So he went and preached to the spirits in prison--

verses.kjv_text: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
verses.nlt_text: those who disobeyed God long ago when God waited patiently while Noah was building his boat. Only eight people were saved from drowning in that terrible flood.

verses.kjv_text: The like figure whereunto {even} baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
verses.nlt_text: And that water is a picture of baptism, which now saves you, not by removing dirt from your body, but as a response to God from a clean conscience. It is effective because of the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.nlt_text: Now Christ has gone to heaven. He is seated in the place of honor next to God, and all the angels and authorities and powers accept his authority.

verses.kjv_text: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
verses.nlt_text: So then, since Christ suffered physical pain, you must arm yourselves with the same attitude he had, and be ready to suffer, too. For if you have suffered physically for Christ, you have finished with sin.

verses.kjv_text: That he no longer should live the rest of {his} time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
verses.nlt_text: You won't spend the rest of your lives chasing your own desires, but you will be anxious to do the will of God.

verses.kjv_text: For the time past of {our} life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
verses.nlt_text: You have had enough in the past of the evil things that godless people enjoy-- their immorality and lust, their feasting and drunkenness and wild parties, and their terrible worship of idols.

verses.kjv_text: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with {them} to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of {you}:
verses.nlt_text: Of course, your former friends are surprised when you no longer plunge into the flood of wild and destructive things they do. So they slander you.

verses.kjv_text: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
verses.nlt_text: But remember that they will have to face God, who will judge everyone, both the living and the dead.

verses.kjv_text: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
verses.nlt_text: That is why the Good News was preached to those who are now dead-- so although they were destined to die like all people, they now live forever with God in the Spirit.

verses.kjv_text: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
verses.nlt_text: The end of the world is coming soon. Therefore, be earnest and disciplined in your prayers.

verses.kjv_text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins. {shall: or, will}
verses.nlt_text: Most important of all, continue to show deep love for each other, for love covers a multitude of sins.

verses.kjv_text: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
verses.nlt_text: Cheerfully share your home with those who need a meal or a place to stay.

verses.kjv_text: As every man hath received the gift, {even so} minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
verses.nlt_text: God has given each of you a gift from his great variety of spiritual gifts. Use them well to serve one another.

verses.kjv_text: If any man speak, {let him speak} as the oracles of God; if any man minister, {let him do it} as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Do you have the gift of speaking? Then speak as though God himself were speaking through you. Do you have the gift of helping others? Do it with all the strength and energy that God supplies. Then everything you do will bring glory to God through Jesus Christ. All glory and power to him forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, don't be surprised at the fiery trials you are going through, as if something strange were happening to you.

verses.kjv_text: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
verses.nlt_text: Instead, be very glad-- for these trials make you partners with Christ in his suffering, so that you will have the wonderful joy of seeing his glory when it is revealed to all the world.

verses.kjv_text: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy {are ye}; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
verses.nlt_text: So be happy when you are insulted for being a Christian, for then the glorious Spirit of God rests upon you.

verses.kjv_text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or {as} a thief, or {as} an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
verses.nlt_text: If you suffer, however, it must not be for murder, stealing, making trouble, or prying into other people's affairs.

verses.kjv_text: Yet if {any man suffer} as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
verses.nlt_text: But it is no shame to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God for the privilege of being called by his name!

verses.kjv_text: For the time {is come} that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if {it} first {begin} at us, what shall the end {be} of them that obey not the gospel of God?
verses.nlt_text: For the time has come for judgment, and it must begin with God's household. And if judgment begins with us, what terrible fate awaits those who have never obeyed God's Good News?

verses.kjv_text: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
verses.nlt_text: And also, "If the righteous are barely saved, what will happen to godless sinners?"

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls {to him} in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
verses.nlt_text: So if you are suffering in a manner that pleases God, keep on doing what is right, and trust your lives to the God who created you, for he will never fail you.

verses.kjv_text: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
verses.nlt_text: And now, a word to you who are elders in the churches. I, too, am an elder and a witness to the sufferings of Christ. And I, too, will share in his glory when he is revealed to the whole world. As a fellow elder, I appeal to you:

verses.kjv_text: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight {thereof}, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind; {which...: or, as much as in you is}
verses.nlt_text: Care for the flock that God has entrusted to you. Watch over it willingly, not grudgingly-- not for what you will get out of it, but because you are eager to serve God.

verses.kjv_text: Neither as being lords over {God's} heritage, but being ensamples to the flock. {being lords over: or, overruling}
verses.nlt_text: Don't lord it over the people assigned to your care, but lead them by your own good example.

verses.kjv_text: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verses.nlt_text: And when the Great Shepherd appears, you will receive a crown of never-ending glory and honor.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all {of you} be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, you younger men must accept the authority of the elders. And all of you, serve each other in humility, for "God opposes the proud but favors the humble."

verses.kjv_text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
verses.nlt_text: So humble yourselves under the mighty power of God, and at the right time he will lift you up in honor.

verses.kjv_text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.nlt_text: Give all your worries and cares to God, for he cares about you.

verses.kjv_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.nlt_text: Stay alert! Watch out for your great enemy, the devil. He prowls around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.

verses.kjv_text: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
verses.nlt_text: Stand firm against him, and be strong in your faith. Remember that your Christian brothers and sisters all over the world are going through the same kind of suffering you are.

verses.kjv_text: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle {you}.
verses.nlt_text: In his kindness God called you to share in his eternal glory by means of Christ Jesus. So after you have suffered a little while, he will restore, support, and strengthen you, and he will place you on a firm foundation.

verses.kjv_text: To him {be} glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: All power to him forever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
verses.nlt_text: I have written and sent this short letter to you with the help of Silas, whom I commend to you as a faithful brother. My purpose in writing is to encourage you and assure you that what you are experiencing is truly part of God's grace for you. Stand firm in this grace.

verses.kjv_text: The {church that is} at Babylon, elected together with {you}, saluteth you; and {so doth} Marcus my son.
verses.nlt_text: Your sister church here in Babylon sends you greetings, and so does my son Mark.

verses.kjv_text: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace {be} with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Greet each other with Christian love. Peace be with all of you who are in Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ: {Simon: or, Symeon} {God...: Gr. of our God and Saviour}
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Simon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ.I am writing to you who share the same precious faith we have. This faith was given to you because of the justice and fairness of Jesus Christ, our God and Savior.

verses.kjv_text: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.nlt_text: May God give you more and more grace and peace as you grow in your knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord.
