verses.kjv_text: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that {pertain} unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue: {to: or, by}
verses.nlt_text: By his divine power, God has given us everything we need for living a godly life. We have received all of this by coming to know him, the one who called us to himself by means of his marvelous glory and excellence.

verses.kjv_text: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verses.nlt_text: And because of his glory and excellence, he has given us great and precious promises. These are the promises that enable you to share his divine nature and escape the world's corruption caused by human desires.

verses.kjv_text: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
verses.nlt_text: In view of all this, make every effort to respond to God's promises. Supplement your faith with a generous provision of moral excellence, and moral excellence with knowledge,

verses.kjv_text: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
verses.nlt_text: and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with patient endurance, and patient endurance with godliness,

verses.kjv_text: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
verses.nlt_text: and godliness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with love for everyone.

verses.kjv_text: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make {you that ye shall} neither {be} barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. {barren: Gr. idle}
verses.nlt_text: The more you grow like this, the more productive and useful you will be in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
verses.nlt_text: But those who fail to develop in this way are shortsighted or blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their old sins.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
verses.nlt_text: So, dear brothers and sisters, work hard to prove that you really are among those God has called and chosen. Do these things, and you will never fall away.

verses.kjv_text: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: Then God will give you a grand entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know {them}, and be established in the present truth.
verses.nlt_text: Therefore, I will always remind you about these things-- even though you already know them and are standing firm in the truth you have been taught.

verses.kjv_text: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting {you} in remembrance;
verses.nlt_text: And it is only right that I should keep on reminding you as long as I live.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing that shortly I must put off {this} my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
verses.nlt_text: For our Lord Jesus Christ has shown me that I must soon leave this earthly life,

verses.kjv_text: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
verses.nlt_text: so I will work hard to make sure you always remember these things after I am gone.

verses.kjv_text: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.nlt_text: For we were not making up clever stories when we told you about the powerful coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. We saw his majestic splendor with our own eyes

verses.kjv_text: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.nlt_text: when he received honor and glory from God the Father. The voice from the majestic glory of God said to him, "This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy."

verses.kjv_text: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.nlt_text: We ourselves heard that voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

verses.kjv_text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verses.nlt_text: Because of that experience, we have even greater confidence in the message proclaimed by the prophets. You must pay close attention to what they wrote, for their words are like a lamp shining in a dark place-- until the Day dawns, and Christ the Morning Star shines in your hearts.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
verses.nlt_text: Above all, you must realize that no prophecy in Scripture ever came from the prophet's own understanding,

verses.kjv_text: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake {as they were} moved by the Holy Ghost. {in old time: or, at any time}
verses.nlt_text: or from human initiative. No, those prophets were moved by the Holy Spirit, and they spoke from God.

verses.kjv_text: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.nlt_text: But there were also false prophets in Israel, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will cleverly teach destructive heresies and even deny the Master who bought them. In this way, they will bring sudden destruction on themselves.

verses.kjv_text: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of. {pernicious ways: or, lascivious ways, as some copies read}
verses.nlt_text: Many will follow their evil teaching and shameful immorality. And because of these teachers, the way of truth will be slandered.

verses.kjv_text: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
verses.nlt_text: In their greed they will make up clever lies to get hold of your money. But God condemned them long ago, and their destruction will not be delayed.

verses.kjv_text: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast {them} down to hell, and delivered {them} into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.nlt_text: For God did not spare even the angels who sinned. He threw them into hell, in gloomy pits of darkness, where they are being held until the day of judgment.

verses.kjv_text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth {person}, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.nlt_text: And God did not spare the ancient world-- except for Noah and the seven others in his family. Noah warned the world of God's righteous judgment. So God protected Noah when he destroyed the world of ungodly people with a vast flood.

verses.kjv_text: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned {them} with an overthrow, making {them} an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.nlt_text: Later, God condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and turned them into heaps of ashes. He made them an example of what will happen to ungodly people.

verses.kjv_text: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.nlt_text: But God also rescued Lot out of Sodom because he was a righteous man who was sick of the shameful immorality of the wicked people around him.

verses.kjv_text: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed {his} righteous soul from day to day with {their} unlawful deeds;)
verses.nlt_text: Yes, Lot was a righteous man who was tormented in his soul by the wickedness he saw and heard day after day.

verses.kjv_text: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.nlt_text: So you see, the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their trials, even while keeping the wicked under punishment until the day of final judgment.

verses.kjv_text: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous {are they}, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities. {government: or, dominion}
verses.nlt_text: He is especially hard on those who follow their own twisted sexual desire, and who despise authority.These people are proud and arrogant, daring even to scoff at supernatural beings without so much as trembling.

verses.kjv_text: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord. {them: some read, themselves}
verses.nlt_text: But the angels, who are far greater in power and strength, do not dare to bring from the Lord a charge of blasphemy against those supernatural beings.

verses.kjv_text: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
verses.nlt_text: These false teachers are like unthinking animals, creatures of instinct, born to be caught and destroyed. They scoff at things they do not understand, and like animals, they will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, {as} they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots {they are} and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.nlt_text: Their destruction is their reward for the harm they have done. They love to indulge in evil pleasures in broad daylight. They are a disgrace and a stain among you. They delight in deception even as they eat with you in your fellowship meals.

verses.kjv_text: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children: {adultery: Gr. an adulteress}
verses.nlt_text: They commit adultery with their eyes, and their desire for sin is never satisfied. They lure unstable people into sin, and they are well trained in greed. They live under God's curse.

verses.kjv_text: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam {the son} of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.nlt_text: They have wandered off the right road and followed the footsteps of Balaam son of Beor, who loved to earn money by doing wrong.

verses.kjv_text: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
verses.nlt_text: But Balaam was stopped from his mad course when his donkey rebuked him with a human voice.

verses.kjv_text: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
verses.nlt_text: These people are as useless as dried-up springs or as mist blown away by the wind. They are doomed to blackest darkness.

verses.kjv_text: For when they speak great swelling {words} of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, {through much} wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error. {clean: or, for a little, or, a while, as some read}
verses.nlt_text: They brag about themselves with empty, foolish boasting. With an appeal to twisted sexual desires, they lure back into sin those who have barely escaped from a lifestyle of deception.

verses.kjv_text: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
verses.nlt_text: They promise freedom, but they themselves are slaves of sin and corruption. For you are a slave to whatever controls you.

verses.kjv_text: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
verses.nlt_text: And when people escape from the wickedness of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and then get tangled up and enslaved by sin again, they are worse off than before.

verses.kjv_text: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known {it}, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.nlt_text: It would be better if they had never known the way to righteousness than to know it and then reject the command they were given to live a holy life.

verses.kjv_text: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog {is} turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
verses.nlt_text: They prove the truth of this proverb: "A dog returns to its vomit." And another says, "A washed pig returns to the mud."

verses.kjv_text: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in {both} which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
verses.nlt_text: This is my second letter to you, dear friends, and in both of them I have tried to stimulate your wholesome thinking and refresh your memory.

verses.kjv_text: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
verses.nlt_text: I want you to remember what the holy prophets said long ago and what our Lord and Savior commanded through your apostles.

verses.kjv_text: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
verses.nlt_text: Most importantly, I want to remind you that in the last days scoffers will come, mocking the truth and following their own desires.

verses.kjv_text: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as {they were} from the beginning of the creation.
verses.nlt_text: They will say, "What happened to the promise that Jesus is coming again? From before the times of our ancestors, everything has remained the same since the world was first created."

verses.kjv_text: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water: {standing: Gr. consisting}
verses.nlt_text: They deliberately forget that God made the heavens by the word of his command, and he brought the earth out from the water and surrounded it with water.

verses.kjv_text: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.nlt_text: Then he used the water to destroy the ancient world with a mighty flood.

verses.kjv_text: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.nlt_text: And by the same word, the present heavens and earth have been stored up for fire. They are being kept for the day of judgment, when ungodly people will be destroyed.

verses.kjv_text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day {is} with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.nlt_text: But you must not forget this one thing, dear friends: A day is like a thousand years to the Lord, and a thousand years is like a day.

verses.kjv_text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.nlt_text: The Lord isn't really being slow about his promise, as some people think. No, he is being patient for your sake. He does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants everyone to repent.

verses.kjv_text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.nlt_text: But the day of the Lord will come as unexpectedly as a thief. Then the heavens will pass away with a terrible noise, and the very elements themselves will disappear in fire, and the earth and everything on it will be found to deserve judgment.

verses.kjv_text: {Seeing} then {that} all these things shall be dissolved, what manner {of persons} ought ye to be in {all} holy conversation and godliness,
verses.nlt_text: Since everything around us is going to be destroyed like this, what holy and godly lives you should live,

verses.kjv_text: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat? {hasting...: or, hasting the coming}
verses.nlt_text: looking forward to the day of God and hurrying it along. On that day, he will set the heavens on fire, and the elements will melt away in the flames.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.nlt_text: But we are looking forward to the new heavens and new earth he has promised, a world filled with God's righteousness.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
verses.nlt_text: And so, dear friends, while you are waiting for these things to happen, make every effort to be found living peaceful lives that are pure and blameless in his sight.

verses.kjv_text: And account {that} the longsuffering of our Lord {is} salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
verses.nlt_text: And remember, the Lord's patience gives people time to be saved. This is what our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you with the wisdom God gave him--

verses.kjv_text: As also in all {his} epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as {they do} also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.nlt_text: speaking of these things in all of his letters. Some of his comments are hard to understand, and those who are ignorant and unstable have twisted his letters to mean something quite different, just as they do with other parts of Scripture. And this will result in their destruction.

verses.kjv_text: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know {these things} before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.nlt_text: I am warning you ahead of time, dear friends. Be on guard so that you will not be carried away by the errors of these wicked people and lose your own secure footing.

verses.kjv_text: But grow in grace, and {in} the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him {be} glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Rather, you must grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.All glory to him, both now and forever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.nlt_text: We proclaim to you the one who existed from the beginning, whom we have heard and seen. We saw him with our own eyes and touched him with our own hands. He is the Word of life.

verses.kjv_text: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen {it}, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.nlt_text: This one who is life itself was revealed to us, and we have seen him. And now we testify and proclaim to you that he is the one who is eternal life. He was with the Father, and then he was revealed to us.

verses.kjv_text: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship {is} with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: We proclaim to you what we ourselves have actually seen and heard so that you may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.nlt_text: We are writing these things so that you may fully share our joy.

verses.kjv_text: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.nlt_text: This is the message we heard from Jesus and now declare to you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.

verses.kjv_text: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.nlt_text: So we are lying if we say we have fellowship with God but go on living in spiritual darkness; we are not practicing the truth.

verses.kjv_text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.nlt_text: But if we are living in the light, as God is in the light, then we have fellowship with each other, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

verses.kjv_text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.nlt_text: If we claim we have no sin, we are only fooling ourselves and not living in the truth.

verses.kjv_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us {our} sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.nlt_text: But if we confess our sins to him, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all wickedness.

verses.kjv_text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.nlt_text: If we claim we have not sinned, we are calling God a liar and showing that his word has no place in our hearts.

verses.kjv_text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.nlt_text: My dear children, I am writing this to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate who pleads our case before the Father. He is Jesus Christ, the one who is truly righteous.

verses.kjv_text: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for {the sins of} the whole world.
verses.nlt_text: He himself is the sacrifice that atones for our sins-- and not only our sins but the sins of all the world.

verses.kjv_text: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.nlt_text: And we can be sure that we know him if we obey his commandments.

verses.kjv_text: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.nlt_text: If someone claims, "I know God," but doesn't obey God's commandments, that person is a liar and is not living in the truth.

verses.kjv_text: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.nlt_text: But those who obey God's word truly show how completely they love him. That is how we know we are living in him.

verses.kjv_text: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.nlt_text: Those who say they live in God should live their lives as Jesus did.

verses.kjv_text: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, I am not writing a new commandment for you; rather it is an old one you have had from the very beginning. This old commandment-- to love one another-- is the same message you heard before.

verses.kjv_text: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.nlt_text: Yet it is also new. Jesus lived the truth of this commandment, and you also are living it. For the darkness is disappearing, and the true light is already shining.

verses.kjv_text: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.nlt_text: If anyone claims, "I am living in the light," but hates a Christian brother or sister, that person is still living in darkness.

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him. {occasion...: Gr. scandal}
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who loves another brother or sister is living in the light and does not cause others to stumble.

verses.kjv_text: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.nlt_text: But anyone who hates another brother or sister is still living and walking in darkness. Such a person does not know the way to go, having been blinded by the darkness.

verses.kjv_text: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing to you who are God's children because your sins have been forgiven through Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him {that is} from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing to you who are mature in the faith because you know Christ, who existed from the beginning. I am writing to you who are young in the faith because you have won your battle with the evil one.

verses.kjv_text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him {that is} from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
verses.nlt_text: I have written to you who are God's children because you know the Father. I have written to you who are mature in the faith because you know Christ, who existed from the beginning. I have written to you who are young in the faith because you are strong. God's word lives in your hearts, and you have won your battle with the evil one.

verses.kjv_text: Love not the world, neither the things {that are} in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.nlt_text: Do not love this world nor the things it offers you, for when you love the world, you do not have the love of the Father in you.

verses.kjv_text: For all that {is} in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.nlt_text: For the world offers only a craving for physical pleasure, a craving for everything we see, and pride in our achievements and possessions. These are not from the Father, but are from this world.

verses.kjv_text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.nlt_text: And this world is fading away, along with everything that people crave. But anyone who does what pleases God will live forever.

verses.kjv_text: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.nlt_text: Dear children, the last hour is here. You have heard that the Antichrist is coming, and already many such antichrists have appeared. From this we know that the last hour has come.

verses.kjv_text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would {no doubt} have continued with us: but {they went out}, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.nlt_text: These people left our churches, but they never really belonged with us; otherwise they would have stayed with us. When they left, it proved that they did not belong with us.

verses.kjv_text: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.nlt_text: But you are not like that, for the Holy One has given you his Spirit, and all of you know the truth.

verses.kjv_text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.nlt_text: So I am writing to you not because you don't know the truth but because you know the difference between truth and lies.

verses.kjv_text: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.nlt_text: And who is a liar? Anyone who says that Jesus is not the Christ. Anyone who denies the Father and the Son is an antichrist.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: {but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also}.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who denies the Son doesn't have the Father, either. But anyone who acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

verses.kjv_text: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.nlt_text: So you must remain faithful to what you have been taught from the beginning. If you do, you will remain in fellowship with the Son and with the Father.

verses.kjv_text: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, {even} eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: And in this fellowship we enjoy the eternal life he promised us.

verses.kjv_text: These {things} have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing these things to warn you about those who want to lead you astray.

verses.kjv_text: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him. {in him: or, in it}
verses.nlt_text: But you have received the Holy Spirit, and he lives within you, so you don't need anyone to teach you what is true. For the Spirit teaches you everything you need to know, and what he teaches is true-- it is not a lie. So just as he has taught you, remain in fellowship with Christ.

verses.kjv_text: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.nlt_text: And now, dear children, remain in fellowship with Christ so that when he returns, you will be full of courage and not shrink back from him in shame.

verses.kjv_text: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him. {ye know that every: or, know ye etc.} {is born: Gr. has been born}
verses.nlt_text: Since we know that Christ is righteous, we also know that all who do what is right are God's children.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.nlt_text: See how very much our Father loves us, for he calls us his children, and that is what we are! But the people who belong to this world don't recognize that we are God's children because they don't know him.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, we are already God's children, but he has not yet shown us what we will be like when Christ appears. But we do know that we will be like him, for we will see him as he really is.

verses.kjv_text: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.nlt_text: And all who have this eager expectation will keep themselves pure, just as he is pure.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who sins is breaking God's law, for all sin is contrary to the law of God.

verses.kjv_text: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.nlt_text: And you know that Jesus came to take away our sins, and there is no sin in him.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who continues to live in him will not sin. But anyone who keeps on sinning does not know him or understand who he is.

verses.kjv_text: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.nlt_text: Dear children, don't let anyone deceive you about this: When people do what is right, it shows that they are righteous, even as Christ is righteous.

verses.kjv_text: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.nlt_text: But when people keep on sinning, it shows that they belong to the devil, who has been sinning since the beginning. But the Son of God came to destroy the works of the devil.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God. {is born: or, has been born}
verses.nlt_text: Those who have been born into God's family do not make a practice of sinning, because God's life is in them. So they can't keep on sinning, because they are children of God.

verses.kjv_text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.nlt_text: So now we can tell who are children of God and who are children of the devil. Anyone who does not live righteously and does not love other believers does not belong to God.

verses.kjv_text: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another. {message: or, commandment}
verses.nlt_text: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

verses.kjv_text: Not as Cain, {who} was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
verses.nlt_text: We must not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? Because Cain had been doing what was evil, and his brother had been doing what was righteous.

verses.kjv_text: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.nlt_text: So don't be surprised, dear brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

verses.kjv_text: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not {his} brother abideth in death.
verses.nlt_text: If we love our Christian brothers and sisters, it proves that we have passed from death to life. But a person who has no love is still dead.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who hates another brother or sister is really a murderer at heart. And you know that murderers don't have eternal life within them.

verses.kjv_text: Hereby perceive we the love {of God}, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down {our} lives for the brethren.
verses.nlt_text: We know what real love is because Jesus gave up his life for us. So we also ought to give up our lives for our brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels {of compassion} from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
verses.nlt_text: If someone has enough money to live well and sees a brother or sister in need but shows no compassion-- how can God's love be in that person?

verses.kjv_text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.nlt_text: Dear children, let's not merely say that we love each other; let us show the truth by our actions.

verses.kjv_text: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him. {assure: Gr. persuade}
verses.nlt_text: Our actions will show that we belong to the truth, so we will be confident when we stand before God.

verses.kjv_text: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.nlt_text: Even if we feel guilty, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, {then} have we confidence toward God.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, if we don't feel guilty, we can come to God with bold confidence.

verses.kjv_text: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.nlt_text: And we will receive from him whatever we ask because we obey him and do the things that please him.

verses.kjv_text: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.nlt_text: And this is his commandment: We must believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.

verses.kjv_text: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
verses.nlt_text: Those who obey God's commandments remain in fellowship with him, and he with them. And we know he lives in us because the Spirit he gave us lives in us.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, do not believe everyone who claims to speak by the Spirit. You must test them to see if the spirit they have comes from God. For there are many false prophets in the world.

verses.kjv_text: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.nlt_text: This is how we know if they have the Spirit of God: If a person claiming to be a prophet acknowledges that Jesus Christ came in a real body, that person has the Spirit of God.

verses.kjv_text: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that {spirit} of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
verses.nlt_text: But if someone claims to be a prophet and does not acknowledge the truth about Jesus, that person is not from God. Such a person has the spirit of the Antichrist, which you heard is coming into the world and indeed is already here.

verses.kjv_text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.nlt_text: But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world.

verses.kjv_text: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.nlt_text: Those people belong to this world, so they speak from the world's viewpoint, and the world listens to them.

verses.kjv_text: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.nlt_text: But we belong to God, and those who know God listen to us. If they do not belong to God, they do not listen to us. That is how we know if someone has the Spirit of truth or the spirit of deception.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. {is born: Gr. has been born}
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, let us continue to love one another, for love comes from God. Anyone who loves is a child of God and knows God.

verses.kjv_text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.nlt_text: But anyone who does not love does not know God, for God is love.

verses.kjv_text: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
verses.nlt_text: God showed how much he loved us by sending his one and only Son into the world so that we might have eternal life through him.

verses.kjv_text: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son {to be} the propitiation for our sins.
verses.nlt_text: This is real love-- not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as a sacrifice to take away our sins.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, since God loved us that much, we surely ought to love each other.

verses.kjv_text: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
verses.nlt_text: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is brought to full expression in us.

verses.kjv_text: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: And God has given us his Spirit as proof that we live in him and he in us.

verses.kjv_text: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son {to be} the Saviour of the world.
verses.nlt_text: Furthermore, we have seen with our own eyes and now testify that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
verses.nlt_text: All who confess that Jesus is the Son of God have God living in them, and they live in God.

verses.kjv_text: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
verses.nlt_text: We know how much God loves us, and we have put our trust in his love.God is love, and all who live in love live in God, and God lives in them.

verses.kjv_text: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world. {our love: Gr. love with us}
verses.nlt_text: And as we live in God, our love grows more perfect. So we will not be afraid on the day of judgment, but we can face him with confidence because we live like Jesus here in this world.

verses.kjv_text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.nlt_text: Such love has no fear, because perfect love expels all fear. If we are afraid, it is for fear of punishment, and this shows that we have not fully experienced his perfect love.

verses.kjv_text: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.nlt_text: We love each other because he loved us first.

verses.kjv_text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verses.nlt_text: If someone says, "I love God," but hates a Christian brother or sister, that person is a liar; for if we don't love people we can see, how can we love God, whom we cannot see?

verses.kjv_text: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.nlt_text: And he has given us this command: Those who love God must also love their Christian brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him. {is born: Gr. has been born}
verses.nlt_text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has become a child of God. And everyone who loves the Father loves his children, too.

verses.kjv_text: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
verses.nlt_text: We know we love God's children if we love God and obey his commandments.

verses.kjv_text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.nlt_text: Loving God means keeping his commandments, and his commandments are not burdensome.

verses.kjv_text: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, {even} our faith. {is born: Gr. has been born}
verses.nlt_text: For every child of God defeats this evil world, and we achieve this victory through our faith.

verses.kjv_text: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.nlt_text: And who can win this battle against the world? Only those who believe that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.kjv_text: This is he that came by water and blood, {even} Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.nlt_text: And Jesus Christ was revealed as God's Son by his baptism in water and by shedding his blood on the cross-- not by water only, but by water and blood. And the Spirit, who is truth, confirms it with his testimony.

verses.kjv_text: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
verses.nlt_text: So we have these three witnesses--

verses.kjv_text: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
verses.nlt_text: the Spirit, the water, and the blood-- and all three agree.

verses.kjv_text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
verses.nlt_text: Since we believe human testimony, surely we can believe the greater testimony that comes from God. And God has testified about his Son.

verses.kjv_text: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
verses.nlt_text: All who believe in the Son of God know in their hearts that this testimony is true. Those who don't believe this are actually calling God a liar because they don't believe what God has testified about his Son.

verses.kjv_text: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.nlt_text: And this is what God has testified: He has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath the Son hath life; {and} he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
verses.nlt_text: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have God's Son does not have life.

verses.kjv_text: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.nlt_text: I have written this to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know you have eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us: {in: or, concerning}
verses.nlt_text: And we are confident that he hears us whenever we ask for anything that pleases him.

verses.kjv_text: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
verses.nlt_text: And since we know he hears us when we make our requests, we also know that he will give us what we ask for.

verses.kjv_text: If any man see his brother sin a sin {which is} not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
verses.nlt_text: If you see a Christian brother or sister sinning in a way that does not lead to death, you should pray, and God will give that person life. But there is a sin that leads to death, and I am not saying you should pray for those who commit it.

verses.kjv_text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.nlt_text: All wicked actions are sin, but not every sin leads to death.

verses.kjv_text: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not. {is born: Gr. has been born}
verses.nlt_text: We know that God's children do not make a practice of sinning, for God's Son holds them securely, and the evil one cannot touch them.

verses.kjv_text: {And} we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
verses.nlt_text: We know that we are children of God and that the world around us is under the control of the evil one.

verses.kjv_text: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, {even} in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: And we know that the Son of God has come, and he has given us understanding so that we can know the true God. And now we live in fellowship with the true God because we live in fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the only true God, and he is eternal life.

verses.kjv_text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Dear children, keep away from anything that might take God's place in your hearts.

verses.kjv_text: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from John, the elder. I am writing to the chosen lady and to her children, whom I love in the truth-- as does everyone else who knows the truth--

verses.kjv_text: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.nlt_text: because the truth lives in us and will be with us forever.

verses.kjv_text: Grace be with you, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love. {be: Gr. shall be}
verses.nlt_text: Grace, mercy, and peace, which come from God the Father and from Jesus Christ-- the Son of the Father-- will continue to be with us who live in truth and love.

verses.kjv_text: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.nlt_text: How happy I was to meet some of your children and find them living according to the truth, just as the Father commanded.

verses.kjv_text: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.nlt_text: I am writing to remind you, dear friends, that we should love one another. This is not a new commandment, but one we have had from the beginning.

verses.kjv_text: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
verses.nlt_text: Love means doing what God has commanded us, and he has commanded us to love one another, just as you heard from the beginning.

verses.kjv_text: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.nlt_text: I say this because many deceivers have gone out into the world. They deny that Jesus Christ came in a real body. Such a person is a deceiver and an antichrist.

verses.kjv_text: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward. {wrought: or, gained, some copies read, ye have gained, but that ye, etc.}
verses.nlt_text: Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked so hard to achieve. Be diligent so that you receive your full reward.

verses.kjv_text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who wanders away from this teaching has no relationship with God. But anyone who remains in the teaching of Christ has a relationship with both the Father and the Son.

verses.kjv_text: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into {your} house, neither bid him God speed:
verses.nlt_text: If anyone comes to your meeting and does not teach the truth about Christ, don't invite that person into your home or give any kind of encouragement.

verses.kjv_text: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.nlt_text: Anyone who encourages such people becomes a partner in their evil work.

verses.kjv_text: Having many things to write unto you, I would not {write} with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full. {face to...: Gr. mouth to mouth} {our: or, your}
verses.nlt_text: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to do it with paper and ink. For I hope to visit you soon and talk with you face to face. Then our joy will be complete.

verses.kjv_text: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Greetings from the children of your sister, chosen by God.

verses.kjv_text: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth. {in...: or, truly}
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from John, the elder. I am writing to Gaius, my dear friend, whom I love in the truth.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth. {wish: or, pray}
verses.nlt_text: Dear friend, I hope all is well with you and that you are as healthy in body as you are strong in spirit.

verses.kjv_text: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
verses.nlt_text: Some of the traveling teachers recently returned and made me very happy by telling me about your faithfulness and that you are living according to the truth.

verses.kjv_text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.nlt_text: I could have no greater joy than to hear that my children are following the truth.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
verses.nlt_text: Dear friend, you are being faithful to God when you care for the traveling teachers who pass through, even though they are strangers to you.

verses.kjv_text: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well: {after...: Gr. worthy of God}
verses.nlt_text: They have told the church here of your loving friendship. Please continue providing for such teachers in a manner that pleases God.

verses.kjv_text: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.nlt_text: For they are traveling for the Lord, and they accept nothing from people who are not believers.

verses.kjv_text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth. {fellowhelpers: or, joint-labourers}
verses.nlt_text: So we ourselves should support them so that we can be their partners as they teach the truth.

verses.kjv_text: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.nlt_text: I wrote to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be the leader, refuses to have anything to do with us.

verses.kjv_text: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth {them} out of the church.
verses.nlt_text: When I come, I will report some of the things he is doing and the evil accusations he is making against us. Not only does he refuse to welcome the traveling teachers, he also tells others not to help them. And when they do help, he puts them out of the church.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friend, don't let this bad example influence you. Follow only what is good. Remember that those who do good prove that they are God's children, and those who do evil prove that they do not know God.

verses.kjv_text: Demetrius hath good report of all {men}, and of the truth itself: yea, and we {also} bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
verses.nlt_text: Everyone speaks highly of Demetrius, as does the truth itself. We ourselves can say the same for him, and you know we speak the truth.

verses.kjv_text: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
verses.nlt_text: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.

verses.kjv_text: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face.
verses.nlt_text: For I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk face to face.

verses.kjv_text: Peace {be} to thee. {Our} friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name. {face to...: Gr. mouth to mouth}
verses.nlt_text: Peace be with you.Your friends here send you their greetings. Please give my personal greetings to each of our friends there.

verses.kjv_text: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, {and} called:
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from Jude, a slave of Jesus Christ and a brother of James.I am writing to all who have been called by God the Father, who loves you and keeps you safe in the care of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
verses.nlt_text: May God give you more and more mercy, peace, and love.

verses.kjv_text: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort {you} that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
verses.nlt_text: Dear friends, I had been eagerly planning to write to you about the salvation we all share. But now I find that I must write about something else, urging you to defend the faith that God has entrusted once for all time to his holy people.

verses.kjv_text: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: I say this because some ungodly people have wormed their way into your churches, saying that God's marvelous grace allows us to live immoral lives. The condemnation of such people was recorded long ago, for they have denied our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.nlt_text: So I want to remind you, though you already know these things, that Jesus first rescued the nation of Israel from Egypt, but later he destroyed those who did not remain faithful.

verses.kjv_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day. {first estate: or, principality}
verses.nlt_text: And I remind you of the angels who did not stay within the limits of authority God gave them but left the place where they belonged. God has kept them securely chained in prisons of darkness, waiting for the great day of judgment.

verses.kjv_text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire. {strange: Gr. other}
verses.nlt_text: And don't forget Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring towns, which were filled with immorality and every kind of sexual perversion. Those cities were destroyed by fire and serve as a warning of the eternal fire of God's judgment.

verses.kjv_text: Likewise also these {filthy} dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
verses.nlt_text: In the same way, these people-- who claim authority from their dreams-- live immoral lives, defy authority, and scoff at supernatural beings.

verses.kjv_text: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verses.nlt_text: But even Michael, one of the mightiest of the angels, did not dare accuse the devil of blasphemy, but simply said, "The Lord rebuke you!" (This took place when Michael was arguing with the devil about Moses' body.)

verses.kjv_text: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
verses.nlt_text: But these people scoff at things they do not understand. Like unthinking animals, they do whatever their instincts tell them, and so they bring about their own destruction.

verses.kjv_text: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
verses.nlt_text: What sorrow awaits them! For they follow in the footsteps of Cain, who killed his brother. Like Balaam, they deceive people for money. And like Korah, they perish in their rebellion.

verses.kjv_text: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds {they are} without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.nlt_text: When these people eat with you in your fellowship meals commemorating the Lord's love, they are like dangerous reefs that can shipwreck you. They are like shameless shepherds who care only for themselves. They are like clouds blowing over the land without giving any rain. They are like trees in autumn that are doubly dead, for they bear no fruit and have been pulled up by the roots.

verses.kjv_text: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verses.nlt_text: They are like wild waves of the sea, churning up the foam of their shameful deeds. They are like wandering stars, doomed forever to blackest darkness.

verses.kjv_text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
verses.nlt_text: Enoch, who lived in the seventh generation after Adam, prophesied about these people. He said, "Listen! The Lord is coming with countless thousands of his holy ones

verses.kjv_text: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard {speeches} which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.nlt_text: to execute judgment on the people of the world. He will convict every person of all the ungodly things they have done and for all the insults that ungodly sinners have spoken against him."

verses.kjv_text: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling {words}, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
verses.nlt_text: These people are grumblers and complainers, living only to satisfy their desires. They brag loudly about themselves, and they flatter others to get what they want.

verses.kjv_text: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.nlt_text: But you, my dear friends, must remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said.

verses.kjv_text: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.nlt_text: They told you that in the last times there would be scoffers whose purpose in life is to satisfy their ungodly desires.

verses.kjv_text: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.nlt_text: These people are the ones who are creating divisions among you. They follow their natural instincts because they do not have God's Spirit in them.

verses.kjv_text: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
verses.nlt_text: But you, dear friends, must build each other up in your most holy faith, pray in the power of the Holy Spirit,

verses.kjv_text: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.nlt_text: and await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, who will bring you eternal life. In this way, you will keep yourselves safe in God's love.

verses.kjv_text: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
verses.nlt_text: And you must show mercy to those whose faith is wavering.

verses.kjv_text: And others save with fear, pulling {them} out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.nlt_text: Rescue others by snatching them from the flames of judgment. Show mercy to still others, but do so with great caution, hating the sins that contaminate their lives.

verses.kjv_text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present {you} faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.nlt_text: Now all glory to God, who is able to keep you from falling away and will bring you with great joy into his glorious presence without a single fault.

verses.kjv_text: To the only wise God, our Saviour, {be} glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: All glory to him who alone is God, our Savior through Jesus Christ our Lord. All glory, majesty, power, and authority are his before all time, and in the present, and beyond all time! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified {it} by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.nlt_text: This is a revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants the events that must soon take place. He sent an angel to present this revelation to his servant John,

verses.kjv_text: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
verses.nlt_text: who faithfully reported everything he saw. This is his report of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv_text: Blessed {is} he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time {is} at hand.
verses.nlt_text: God blesses the one who reads the words of this prophecy to the church, and he blesses all who listen to its message and obey what it says, for the time is near.

verses.kjv_text: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace {be} unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.nlt_text: This letter is from John to the seven churches in the province of Asia. Grace and peace to you from the one who is, who always was, and who is still to come; from the sevenfold Spirit before his throne;

verses.kjv_text: And from Jesus Christ, {who is} the faithful witness, {and} the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.nlt_text: and from Jesus Christ. He is the faithful witness to these things, the first to rise from the dead, and the ruler of all the kings of the world.All glory to him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by shedding his blood for us.

verses.kjv_text: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him {be} glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.nlt_text: He has made us a Kingdom of priests for God his Father. All glory and power to him forever and ever! Amen.

verses.kjv_text: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they {also} which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.nlt_text: Look! He comes with the clouds of heaven. And everyone will see him-- even those who pierced him. And all the nations of the world will mourn for him. Yes! Amen!

verses.kjv_text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.nlt_text: "I am the Alpha and the Omega-- the beginning and the end," says the Lord God. "I am the one who is, who always was, and who is still to come-- the Almighty One."

verses.kjv_text: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.nlt_text: I, John, am your brother and your partner in suffering and in God's Kingdom and in the patient endurance to which Jesus calls us. I was exiled to the island of Patmos for preaching the word of God and for my testimony about Jesus.

verses.kjv_text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.nlt_text: It was the Lord's Day, and I was worshiping in the Spirit. Suddenly, I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet blast.

verses.kjv_text: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send {it} unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.nlt_text: It said, "Write in a book everything you see, and send it to the seven churches in the cities of Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."

verses.kjv_text: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.nlt_text: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.

verses.kjv_text: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks {one} like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.nlt_text: And standing in the middle of the lampstands was someone like the Son of Man. He was wearing a long robe with a gold sash across his chest.

verses.kjv_text: His head and {his} hairs {were} white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes {were} as a flame of fire;
verses.nlt_text: His head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow. And his eyes were like flames of fire.

verses.kjv_text: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.nlt_text: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and his voice thundered like mighty ocean waves.

verses.kjv_text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance {was} as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.nlt_text: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came from his mouth. And his face was like the sun in all its brilliance.

verses.kjv_text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.nlt_text: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as if I were dead. But he laid his right hand on me and said, "Don't be afraid! I am the First and the Last.

verses.kjv_text: I {am} he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.nlt_text: I am the living one. I died, but look-- I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and the grave.

verses.kjv_text: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.nlt_text: "Write down what you have seen-- both the things that are now happening and the things that will happen.

verses.kjv_text: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
verses.nlt_text: This is the meaning of the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

verses.kjv_text: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
verses.nlt_text: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Ephesus. This is the message from the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand, the one who walks among the seven gold lampstands:

verses.kjv_text: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
verses.nlt_text: "I know all the things you do. I have seen your hard work and your patient endurance. I know you don't tolerate evil people. You have examined the claims of those who say they are apostles but are not. You have discovered they are liars.

verses.kjv_text: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
verses.nlt_text: You have patiently suffered for me without quitting.

verses.kjv_text: Nevertheless I have {somewhat} against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
verses.nlt_text: "But I have this complaint against you. You don't love me or each other as you did at first!

verses.kjv_text: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
verses.nlt_text: Look how far you have fallen! Turn back to me and do the works you did at first. If you don't repent, I will come and remove your lampstand from its place among the churches.

verses.kjv_text: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.nlt_text: But this is in your favor: You hate the evil deeds of the Nicolaitans, just as I do.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches. To everyone who is victorious I will give fruit from the tree of life in the paradise of God.

verses.kjv_text: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
verses.nlt_text: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Smyrna. This is the message from the one who is the First and the Last, who was dead but is now alive:

verses.kjv_text: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and {I know} the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but {are} the synagogue of Satan.
verses.nlt_text: "I know about your suffering and your poverty-- but you are rich! I know the blasphemy of those opposing you. They say they are Jews, but they are not, because their synagogue belongs to Satan.

verses.kjv_text: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast {some} of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
verses.nlt_text: Don't be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will throw some of you into prison to test you. You will suffer for ten days. But if you remain faithful even when facing death, I will give you the crown of life.

verses.kjv_text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.nlt_text: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches. Whoever is victorious will not be harmed by the second death.

verses.kjv_text: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
verses.nlt_text: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Pergamum. This is the message from the one with the sharp two-edged sword:

verses.kjv_text: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, {even} where Satan's seat {is}: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas {was} my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.nlt_text: "I know that you live in the city where Satan has his throne, yet you have remained loyal to me. You refused to deny me even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was martyred among you there in Satan's city.

verses.kjv_text: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.nlt_text: "But I have a few complaints against you. You tolerate some among you whose teaching is like that of Balaam, who showed Balak how to trip up the people of Israel. He taught them to sin by eating food offered to idols and by committing sexual sin.

verses.kjv_text: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
verses.nlt_text: In a similar way, you have some Nicolaitans among you who follow the same teaching.

verses.kjv_text: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.nlt_text: Repent of your sin, or I will come to you suddenly and fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
